explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Writing): three advertisements
explanations.body: In groups of three, each student reads one of three advertisements to extract the EEIs (Elements of Essential Information). A. Write two questions about your ad and post them online. B. Read the other two groups’ questions and answer them from the ads. C. Return to your group and review each other’s answers. The three ads (red, blue and yellow):

rows: 换季大拍卖 · 秋装上市 · 夏装七折
Season-change sale · autumn clothes now in · summer clothes 30% off
全场 · 买一双 · 第二双半价 · 买一千送二百
Everything · buy one pair, the second pair half price · spend 1,000, get 200 back
大降价 · 一件九折 · 两件八点五折 · 三件八折 · 来就送小礼物
Big price cuts · one piece 10% off · two pieces 15% off · three pieces 20% off · a small gift just for coming
tables.title: Advertisements

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Reading and Speaking): shopping in Beijing
explanations.body: You have finally arrived at your Beijing hotel after a 12-hour flight; your luggage is on a different flight, so you must buy some clothes. A. In groups of three, each student chooses two categories and brainstorms questions or statements a clerk or customer might say. The book’s six categories, each with its example question:

rows: 这件衬衫你们有没有大号的？
我看起来怎么样？ (how do I look?)
价钱对不对？ (is it the right price?)
现金还是刷卡？ (cash or charge?)
tables.title: Six categories

explanations.title: Activity 2B and 2C: sizes and colors
explanations.body: B. Refer to the chart of clothing sizes (not included) and highlight the sizes you wear or intend to buy. C. Review some basic colors in Chinese; 浅 qiǎn (light) and 深 shēn (dark) go before a color, as in 浅蓝色 and 深蓝色.

tables.title: Basic colors

explanations.title: Activity 2D: role-play cards
explanations.body: You are at the local department store. Find a partner and act out the customer and the salesperson; switch roles and repeat. Customer: greet the clerk; tell the clerk what items you are looking for; ask about the available colors; ask about the available sizes; ask if you can try the items on; ask the clerk’s opinion on how the items suit or fit you; express some dissatisfaction and request adjustments; ask the prices and if you can get any discounts; decide on your purchases and ask about methods of payment. Salesperson: greet the customer and ask what they are looking for; ask what colors they prefer, tell them they are not available and offer alternatives; ask what sizes they wear, explain that Chinese sizes usually run smaller than Western ones and suggest other sizes; offer other styles that are more expensive but better quality; suggest items to try on; quote the prices and offer discounts, especially for multiple items; offer various payment options.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): Xiao Ming’s mother’s letter
explanations.body: Xiao Ming’s mom has sent him a letter along with a birthday gift. A. Read the letter and answer in Chinese: 1. What present did Xiao Ming get? 2. What is his mom’s concern? 3. What does his mom tell him he can do? B. Pair up: Xiao Ming discovers the present does not suit him; play Xiao Ming and exchange it for another style, color or size, while your partner is the sales associate. C. When you return, write an e-mail to your mom (妈妈：您好！… 祝好！ + your name) to thank her and update her on the gift. One sentence of the letter, which names a shopping center, reads in full: 蒙特雷的 Del Monte 购物中心有这家商店 (“This store is at the Del Monte shopping center in Monterey”).

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss. A. What are your favorite fruits and vegetables? Can you say them in Chinese? B. Have you been to any of the Monterey farmers’ markets? What fruits and vegetables have you bought?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 琳达 and 大卫 at a market stand
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters (for example 老闆，請問蘋果多少錢一斤？). Note from the book: colloquially, both 要 and 来 often substitute for the verb “to buy” when shopping, or “to order” in restaurants.

examples.translation: lín dá wǒ yào sān jīn zài mǎi yí chuàn xiāng jiāo liǎng jīn jú zi — I want three jin. And also a bunch of bananas and two jin of tangerines.

examples.text: 摊主：三斤苹果十五块，一串香蕉十块，两斤桔子八块。

examples.text: 大卫：天气这么热，老板，再给我们称个西瓜吧。
examples.translation: dà wèi tiān qì zhè me rè lǎo bǎn zài gěi wǒ men chēng gè xī guā ba — The weather is so hot, boss; please also weigh a watermelon for us.

examples.text: 摊主：西瓜十二斤半，五十块。
examples.translation: tān zhǔ xī guā shí èr jīn bàn wǔ shí kuài — The watermelon is twelve and a half jin, fifty yuan.

examples.text: 琳达：有点儿贵，能不能便宜点儿？

examples.text: 摊主：那就四十五块吧。我们的蔬菜很新鲜，你们买点儿吧。
examples.translation: tān zhǔ nà jiù sì shí wǔ kuài ba wǒ men de shū cài hěn xīn xiān nǐ men mǎi diǎnr ba — Then make it forty-five yuan. Our vegetables are very fresh; buy some.

examples.text: 大卫：好，给我们来两斤西红柿，一把菠菜，一斤青椒和四斤土豆。
examples.translation: dà wèi hǎo gěi wǒ men lái liǎng jīn xī hóng shì yì bǎ bō cài yì jīn qīng jiāo hé sì jīn tǔ dòu — Okay, give us two jin of tomatoes, a bunch of spinach, a jin of green peppers and four jin of potatoes.

examples.text: 琳达：一共多少钱？

examples.text: 摊主：水果七十八块，加上蔬菜，一共一百零二块。你就给我一百吧。
examples.translation: tān zhǔ shuǐ guǒ qī shí bā kuài jiā shàng shū cài yí gòng yì bǎi líng èr kuài nǐ jiù gěi wǒ yì bǎi ba — The fruit is seventy-eight yuan; with the vegetables, one hundred and two altogether. Just give me one hundred.

examples.text: 琳达：这是一百块。谢谢！
examples.translation: lín dá zhè shì yì bǎi kuài xiè xiè — Here is one hundred yuan. Thank you!

examples.text: 大卫：对了，琳达，我们再去买点海鲜和牛肉吧。

lessons.title: 237. Lesson 9 Presentation 2 grammar: weights and measure words for produce
lessons.subtitle: 钱 两 斤 · 一把菠菜 · 一串香蕉 · 一个西瓜 · 按斤称

explanations.title: Basic units of weight
explanations.body: The market system: 1 钱 = 5 g (0.176 oz); 1 两 = 10 钱 = 50 g (1.7637 oz); 1 斤 = 10 两 = 500 g (1.1023 lb). So 斤 in the market is half a kilogram.

tables.title: Units of weight

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the farmers’ market
explanations.body: A. Xiao Ming went to the farmers’ market for his grandmother. Since they don’t give receipts, he wrote down what he spent on each item (a table with vegetable or fruit, weight or amount, unit price, price). Read the shopping list, calculate the total he spent, and take turns playing him reporting back to his grandmother in Chinese. The book’s example (the numbers are spelled out here):

lessons.title: 238. Lesson 9 Presentation 2 grammar: 就 for “just” or “only”
lessons.subtitle: 我就一个哥哥 · 就给我一百吧 · 我早饭就喝了一杯咖啡

explanations.title: 就 for “just” or “only”
explanations.body: In Lesson 4 you used 就 to mean “indeed” or “exactly”. In this lesson 就 can also mean “only” or “just”. Type 1: Subject + 就 + Number + Measure Word + Noun. Type 2: Subject + 就 + Verb Phrase.

examples.text: 就四十块吧！
examples.translation: jiù sì shí kuài ba — Just forty yuan!

examples.text: 我就一个哥哥。
examples.translation: wǒ jiù yí gè gē gē — I have only one older brother.

examples.text: 他在美国就一个亲人。
examples.translation: tā zài měi guó jiù yí gè qīn rén — He has only one relative in America.

examples.text: 你们家就一个孩子吗？
examples.translation: nǐ men jiā jiù yí gè hái zi ma — Does your family have only one child?

examples.text: 就给我一百吧！
examples.translation: jiù gěi wǒ yì bǎi ba — Just give me one hundred!

examples.text: 你就点了两个菜吗？
examples.translation: nǐ jiù diǎn le liǎng gè cài ma — Did you order only two dishes?

examples.text: 我早饭就喝了一杯咖啡。
examples.translation: wǒ zǎo fàn jiù hē le yì bēi kā fēi — For breakfast I only drank a cup of coffee.

examples.text: 在这儿我就认识她。
examples.translation: zài zhèr wǒ jiù rèn shí tā — Here I only know her.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Work with a partner to translate into Chinese: 1. This stand only sells fruit. 2. We only have one homework assignment for tonight. 3. He only eats chicken. 4. I only have $20. 5. She only knows 100 Chinese characters. 6. Her daughter only works at one place. 7. Just give me $50. One possible translation of each (mine):

examples.translation: tā jiù chī jī ròu — He only eats chicken.

examples.text: 我就有二十块。
examples.translation: wǒ jiù yǒu èr shí kuài — I only have twenty dollars.

examples.translation: tā jiù rèn shí yì bǎi gè hàn zì — She only knows 100 Chinese characters.

examples.translation: tā nǚ ér jiù zài yí gè dì fāng gōng zuò — Her daughter only works at one place.

examples.text: 就给我五十块吧。
examples.translation: jiù gěi wǒ wǔ shí kuài ba — Just give me fifty.

explanations.title: Activity 3B and Activity 4
explanations.body: 3B. Use 就 to write two true and one false statement about yourself; 3C read them to your partner and have them guess the false one. Activity 4: divide into shopkeepers and shoppers. Shopkeepers decide which eight items to sell (shirts, suits, shoes, computers, cell phones, fruits and vegetables), draw each on a card and write the price underneath; each has ¥150 for change and may sell each item once. Shoppers make a shopping list of six items (color, size, style, type, quantity, amount to spend) and have ¥600 each. B. Begin shopping, and bargain! Keep each card you buy. C. When time is up, shopkeepers win by most items sold and most profit; shoppers by most items bought and least spent.

lessons.title: 239. Lesson 9 Presentation 2 skill integration: 找, 花, David’s diary and the market article
lessons.subtitle: 农贸市场 · 种类 价格 奶茶 摊主 · 菜市场 超市 上网买菜

explanations.title: Activity 1: new words, a dialog and a radio ad
explanations.body: New words: 找 (zhǎo) find; look for; give change. 花 (huā) flower. Activity 1: listen to a dialog and take notes, write three questions about it for a partner, then role-play the script (audio, not included). Activity 2: listen to a radio advertisement, extract the elements of essential information, write a summary and three specific details, report them to a partner in Chinese, write a script for a Chinese ad for the shop together and post it on Linoit, and vote for the best ad as a class (audio, not included).

tables.title: New words

explanations.title: Activity 3: David’s diary entry about the farmers’ market (农贸市场)
explanations.body: A. In pairs, take turns reading and translating each sentence. B. Together, write three significant facts about the farmers’ market, with details. C. Guess the meaning of 种类, 价格, 奶茶 and 摊主 from context and share your strategies. D. Listen to a monolog about two other students’ trip and number nine pictures in the order they visited the stands (audio and pictures, not included). E. Share the itinerary with your partner in Chinese.

examples.text: 今天一下课，我就和马林去逛农贸市场。农贸市场在蒙特雷山下，从国防语言学院到农贸市场走二十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: jīn tiān yí xià kè wǒ jiù hé mǎ lín qù guàng nóng mào shì chǎng nóng mào shì chǎng zài méng tè léi shān xià cóng guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn dào nóng mào shì chǎng zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — Right after class today I went with Ma Lin to browse the farmers’ market. The market is at the foot of Monterey’s hills, and from the Defense Language Institute it takes twenty minutes on foot.

examples.text: 农贸市场什么东西都有，不但有卖蔬菜、水果的，而且还有卖衣服、鲜花、小吃的。那儿的水果和蔬菜都很新鲜，种类又多，不过那儿的价格比别的地方贵一点。
examples.translation: nóng mào shì chǎng shén me dōng xī dōu yǒu bú dàn yǒu mài shū cài shuǐ guǒ de ér qiě hái yǒu mài yī fú xiān huā xiǎo chī de nàr de shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài dōu hěn xīn xiān zhǒng lèi yòu duō bú guò nàr de jià gé bǐ bié de dì fāng guì yì diǎn — The market has everything: not only vegetables and fruit but also clothes, flowers and snacks. The fruit and vegetables are fresh and there are many kinds, but the prices there are a bit higher than elsewhere.

examples.text: 那天我买了五个西红柿、一把菠菜、两斤苹果和一串香蕉。马林很喜欢中国小吃，他买了几个包子和一杯奶茶。摊主听说他是学生，还给他打了九折。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǒ mǎi le wǔ gè xī hóng shì yì bǎ bō cài liǎng jīn píng guǒ hé yí chuàn xiāng jiāo mǎ lín hěn xǐ huān zhōng guó xiǎo chī tā mǎi le jǐ gè bāo zi hé yì bēi nǎi chá tān zhǔ tīng shuō tā shì xué shēng huán gěi tā dǎ le jiǔ zhé — That day I bought five tomatoes, a bunch of spinach, two jin of apples and a bunch of bananas. Ma Lin likes Chinese snacks; he bought a few baozi and a cup of milk tea. The vendor heard he was a student and gave him ten percent off.

examples.text: 买完东西以后，我们就高高兴兴地回学校了。
examples.translation: mǎi wán dōng xī yǐ hòu wǒ men jiù gāo gāo xìng xìng dì huí xué xiào le — After we finished shopping, we happily went back to the school.

explanations.title: Activity 4: the newspaper article, paragraphs in the wrong order
explanations.body: The paragraphs of an online article have been posted in the wrong order. A. In groups of three, read one paragraph each and take notes. B. Report on your paragraph in Chinese, listen to the other two and fill in the table. C. Put the three paragraphs in the correct order. D. Guess what the underlined 超市 and 上网 mean from context. The correct order (mine, from the content): 3, then 1, then 2: traditional markets, then supermarkets, then buying online.

examples.text: 后来有了超市，人们开始去超市买生鲜蔬果。因为超市常常打折，有些蔬菜、水果的价格有时会比外面菜市场便宜。在超市买东西不但可以用现金，还可以刷卡，非常方便。
examples.translation: hòu lái yǒu le chāo shì rén men kāi shǐ qù chāo shì mǎi shēng xiān shū guǒ yīn wèi chāo shì cháng cháng dǎ zhé yǒu xiē shū cài shuǐ guǒ de jià gé yǒu shí huì bǐ wài miàn cài shì chǎng pián yi zài chāo shì mǎi dōng xī bú dàn kě yǐ yòng xiàn jīn hái kě yǐ shuā kǎ fēi cháng fāng biàn — Later there were supermarkets, and people began to buy fresh produce there. Supermarkets often have sales, so some vegetables and fruit are sometimes cheaper than at the outside markets. In a supermarket you can pay with cash or by card, which is very convenient.

examples.text: 最近几年，有越来越多的人喜欢上网买菜。他们可以在网上挑想买的蔬菜水果，用手机付费，然后东西就会送到家，不出门就可以吃到各种新鲜的水果、蔬菜，真是太方便了。
examples.translation: zuì jìn jǐ nián yǒu yuè lái yuè duō de rén xǐ huān shàng wǎng mǎi cài tā men kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng tiāo xiǎng mǎi de shū cài shuǐ guǒ yòng shǒu jī fù fèi rán hòu dōng xī jiù huì sòng dào jiā bù chū mén jiù kě yǐ chī dào gè zhǒng xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ shū cài zhēn shì tài fāng biàn le — In recent years more and more people like to buy groceries online. They can pick the vegetables and fruit they want online and pay by phone, and the things are delivered home; without going out you can eat all kinds of fresh fruit and vegetables, which is really convenient.

examples.text: 中国人以前都爱去菜市场买东西，因为菜市场的东西又新鲜又便宜。除了卖蔬菜、水果，他们也卖海鲜和肉类。有些菜市场还卖衣服和鞋子等。
examples.translation: zhōng guó rén yǐ qián dōu ài qù cài shì chǎng mǎi dōng xī yīn wèi cài shì chǎng de dōng xī yòu xīn xiān yòu pián yi chú le mài shū cài shuǐ guǒ tā men yě mài hǎi xiān hé ròu lèi yǒu xiē cài shì chǎng hái mài yī fú hé xié zi děng — Chinese people used to love going to the vegetable market, because the things there were fresh and cheap. Besides vegetables and fruit, they also sell seafood and meat. Some markets even sell clothes and shoes.

exercises.explanation: 农贸市场在蒙特雷山下。

Besides vegetables and fruit, what do they sell at the market?

exercises.prompt: What does David say about the prices there?
exercises.explanation: 那儿的价格比别的地方贵一点。

options: Five tomatoes, a bunch of spinach, two jin of apples and a bunch of bananas
exercises.explanation: 五个西红柿、一把菠菜、两斤苹果和一串香蕉。

What kind of services does it offer? How do you know? 4. What do you think 今日特价 means? 5. Based on the words you know, what do you think 首次购买生鲜免费送绿色土鸡蛋一盒 means? B. Share the strategies you used in Chinese. From the words: 今日特价 is today’s special price; the long line says that for a first purchase of fresh food you get a free box of green free-range eggs.

explanations.title: Activity 2: a farewell party in Taiwan
explanations.body: After immersion in Taiwan, you and your classmates decide to cook some Chinese dishes for a farewell party to thank your teachers. You have a budget of NT$5000 (= $150.00) for the ingredients. A. In groups of three, discuss in Chinese what dishes you want to make, write a shopping list for the local market in Chinese and post it on Linoit. B. One group plays the vendors (meat, vegetable and fruit stands) and the other the shoppers; then switch. Shoppers must: ask the unit price of each item; specify the quantity; ask the vendor to weigh some items; ask the vendor to select particular items; negotiate for the best prices; ask for payment options; buy everything on the list within the budget.

explanations.title: Activity 3: Passage 1 and Passage 2
explanations.body: A. Read Passage 1 while a partner reads Passage 2 and take notes. B. Report on your passage in Chinese while your partner fills in the key information. C. Discuss the questions: for each, what did you find out about her, and what shopping decisions does she make and why?

examples.text: 王美美在电脑公司工作，她平时工作很忙，没有时间去菜市场买菜，所以只能下班以后去附近的超市买，虽然超市的价钱比其他市场贵一点儿，可是东西很多，还能买到国外来的东西。超市也常会打折，所以有些蔬菜、水果的价格有时会比外面菜市场便宜。超市快关门以前，很多吃的东西都会有特价，非常便宜，所以不做饭也没问题。
examples.translation: wáng měi měi zài diàn nǎo gōng sī gōng zuò tā píng shí gōng zuò hěn máng méi yǒu shí jiān qù cài shì chǎng mǎi cài suǒ yǐ zhǐ néng xià bān yǐ hòu qù fù jìn de chāo shì mǎi suī rán chāo shì de jià qián bǐ qí tā shì chǎng guì yì diǎnr kě shì dōng xī hěn duō hái néng mǎi dào guó wài lái de dōng xī chāo shì yě cháng huì dǎ zhé suǒ yǐ yǒu xiē shū cài shuǐ guǒ de jià gé yǒu shí huì bǐ wài miàn cài shì chǎng pián yi chāo shì kuài guān mén yǐ qián hěn duō chī de dōng xī dū huì yǒu tè jià fēi cháng pián yi suǒ yǐ bú zuò fàn yě méi wèn tí — Wang Meimei works at a computer company. She is usually busy and has no time to go to the vegetable market, so she can only shop at the nearby supermarket after work. Although supermarket prices are a bit higher than other markets, there are lots of things and you can even buy things from abroad. Supermarkets often have sales, so some vegetables and fruit are sometimes cheaper than at the outside market. Shortly before the supermarket closes, lots of food has special prices and is very cheap, so not cooking is no problem.

examples.text: 李妈妈是个家庭妇女，她喜欢天天去菜市场买菜。每天一起床，她就会先想想那天要做的菜，然后去菜市场。她喜欢先逛逛不同的摊子，问一下价钱，然后在最便宜、最新鲜的摊子上买。有时她买了很多东西，也会请摊主给她打折。回家以前，她还会逛逛卖衣服和鞋子的摊子，再买一些小吃。她觉得去一个地方什么东西都能买到，真的太方便了！
examples.translation: lǐ mā mā shì gè jiā tíng fù nǚ tā xǐ huān tiān tiān qù cài shì chǎng mǎi cài měi tiān yì qǐ chuáng tā jiù huì xiān xiǎng xiǎng nà tiān yào zuò de cài rán hòu qù cài shì chǎng tā xǐ huān xiān guàng guàng bù tóng de tān zi wèn yí xià jià qián rán hòu zài zuì pián yi zuì xīn xiān de tān zi shàng mǎi yǒu shí tā mǎi le hěn duō dōng xī yě huì qǐng tān zhǔ gěi tā dǎ zhé huí jiā yǐ qián tā hái huì guàng guàng mài yī fú hé xié zi de tān zi zài mǎi yì xiē xiǎo chī tā jué de qù yí gè dì fāng shén me dōng xī dōu néng mǎi dào zhēn de tài fāng biàn le — Mrs. Li is a housewife and likes to go to the vegetable market every day. As soon as she gets up she thinks about the dishes to make that day, then goes to the market. She likes to browse different stands first, ask the price, and then buy at the cheapest, freshest stand. Sometimes when she buys a lot she asks the vendor for a discount. Before going home she also browses the stands selling clothes and shoes and buys some snacks. She feels that being able to buy everything in one place is really convenient!

explanations.title: Activity 4 and Activity 5
explanations.body: Activity 4. A. Listen to a dialog and answer in Chinese: 1. What is the first speaker’s assumption in the first sentence? 2. What does the second speaker say about the apple he bought? 3. What are three things he says about the farmers’ market? 4. What did the first speaker say he would do? (audio, not included). B. In groups of three, one group lists the advantages and disadvantages of shopping at a supermarket, the other those of a farmers’ market. C. Present your list and take notes on the other group’s; each group discusses the disadvantages of the other’s venue and presents a rebuttal in Chinese. D. Both groups write their lists in Chinese and post them on Linoit. Activity 5: during immersion you research traditional Chinese markets in Taipei. A. Browse two websites, 南門市場 (nanmenmarket.org) and 士東市場 (shi-dong.com), and discuss their key features in Chinese (the websites are not included). B. Discuss similarities and differences between traditional markets in Taipei and farmers’ markets in the U.S. C. Decide which market is better (location, prices, quality, variety) and research it. D. Create a PPT presentation on traditional markets in Taipei, with tips for shopping there, and present it to the class in Chinese.

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss. A. Do you prefer shopping at stores or online? What items do you usually buy online and why? B. List the things you bought in the last month, and their quantities; write as many items as you can in Chinese.

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 大卫 buys things online
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters (for example 快開學了，大衛正準備去商場買文具和衣服).

examples.text: 快开学了，大卫正准备去商场买文具和衣服，张文来了。
examples.translation: kuài kāi xué le dà wèi zhèng zhǔn bèi qù shāng chǎng mǎi wén jù hé yī fú zhāng wén lái le — School is about to start, and David was getting ready to go to the mall to buy stationery and clothes when Zhang Wen came.

examples.text: 他问大卫，为什么不上网买呢？
examples.translation: tā wèn dà wèi wèi shén me bú shàng wǎng mǎi ne — He asked David why he didn’t buy online.

examples.text: 大卫告诉张文，他还没有中国的信用卡，不能在网上买东西。
examples.translation: dà wèi gào sù zhāng wén tā hái méi yǒu zhōng guó de xìn yòng kǎ bù néng zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī — David told Zhang Wen that he did not have a Chinese credit card yet and could not buy things online.

examples.text: 张文马上说，“没问题，我可以先用信用卡帮你付账，然后，你给我现金就行了。”
examples.translation: zhāng wén mǎ shàng shuō méi wèn tí wǒ kě yǐ xiān yòng xìn yòng kǎ bāng nǐ fù zhàng rán hòu nǐ gěi wǒ xiàn jīn jiù xíng le — Zhang Wen immediately said, “No problem, I can first pay for you with my credit card, and then you just give me cash.”

examples.text: 网上的文具种类真多，大卫买了一个名牌书包，还买了一些笔记本和圆珠笔。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng de wén jù zhǒng lèi zhēn duō dà wèi mǎi le yí gè míng pái shū bāo hái mǎi le yì xiē bǐ jì běn hé yuán zhū bǐ — There are really many kinds of stationery online; David bought a name-brand school bag and also some notebooks and ballpoint pens.

examples.text: 买完文具以后，他又开始选购衣服，正好网上促销，很多东西都打折。
examples.translation: mǎi wán wén jù yǐ hòu tā yòu kāi shǐ xuǎn gòu yī fú zhèng hǎo wǎng shàng cù xiāo hěn duō dōng xī dōu dǎ zhé — After buying the stationery he started selecting clothes; by chance there was an online promotion and many things were discounted.

examples.text: 西装打九折，衬衫打八折，皮鞋和领带也都打折。
examples.translation: xī zhuāng dǎ jiǔ zhé chèn shān dǎ bā zhé pí xié hé lǐng dài yě dōu dǎ zhé — Suits were ten percent off, shirts twenty percent off, and leather shoes and ties were also discounted.

examples.text: 最后，大卫买了一套蓝色西装、两条领带、六双袜子和一双黑皮鞋，连牙刷、毛巾都在网上买了，一共花了两千多块。
examples.translation: zuì hòu dà wèi mǎi le yí tào lán sè xī zhuāng liǎng tiáo lǐng dài liù shuāng wà zi hé yì shuāng hēi pí xié lián yá shuā máo jīn dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yí gòng huā le liǎng qiān duō kuài — In the end David bought a blue suit, two ties, six pairs of socks and a pair of black leather shoes; he even bought a toothbrush and towels online, spending over two thousand yuan altogether.

examples.text: 他觉得在网上买东西真是又便宜，又方便。
examples.translation: tā jué de zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī zhēn shì yòu pián yi yòu fāng biàn — He felt that buying things online is really both cheap and convenient.

examples.text: 他对张文说，“谢谢你，今天晚上我请你吃大餐。”
examples.translation: tā duì zhāng wén shuō xiè xiè nǐ jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ qǐng nǐ chī dà cān — He said to Zhang Wen, “Thank you; tonight I’ll treat you to a big meal.”

lessons.title: 244. Lesson 9 Presentation 3 grammar: the 快…了 construction
lessons.subtitle: 快上课了 · 快下雨了 · 春节快到了 · 快要…了 · 就要…了 · 还没…(呢)

explanations.title: The 快…了 construction
explanations.body: The 快…了 construction indicates an action is about to take place or that it is almost a certain time. Its negative form is 还没…(呢), meaning an action has yet to take place. No specific time words or phrases may be used to modify the construction. Incorrect: 我弟弟四点钟快来了. Correct: 快四点钟了，我弟弟快来了. Patterns: 快 + Verb Phrase + 了; 快(到) Noun / Noun Phrase 了; Noun / Noun Phrase 快到了. There are a few other constructions similar to 快…了, such as 快要…了, 就要…了, 要…了 and 就…了.

examples.text: 快四点钟了，我弟弟快来了。
examples.translation: kuài sì diǎn zhōng le wǒ dì di kuài lái le — It’s almost four o’clock; my younger brother will be here soon.

examples.text: 快上课了！

examples.text: 快到下课的时间了。
examples.translation: kuài dào xià kè de shí jiān le — It’s almost time for class to end.

examples.text: 快到集合的时间了。
examples.translation: kuài dào jí hé de shí jiān le — It’s almost time to assemble.

examples.text: 父亲节快到了。
examples.translation: fù qīn jié kuài dào le — Father’s Day is almost here.

examples.text: 春节快到了。
examples.translation: chūn jié kuài dào le — The Spring Festival is almost here.

examples.text: 快开学了
examples.translation: kuài kāi xué le — School is about to start

examples.text: 快要开学了

lessons.title: 245. Lesson 9 Presentation 3 grammar: the 连…都/也… pattern
lessons.subtitle: 连我的老师都不认识 · 连一毛钱都没花 · 连三岁小孩都知道

explanations.title: The 连…都/也… pattern
explanations.body: Similar to the English “even”, 连…都/也… emphasizes surprise at something. “Even” in Chinese, however, necessitates both parts of the pattern, for example “I work out every day, even when it rains”: 我每天锻炼，连下雨天都/也去. In Chinese, 都 and 也 are interchangeable in this pattern, although 都 is more common. Patterns: Statement, 连 + Object + 都/也 + Verb; Statement, 连 + Object + 都/也 + 不/没 + Verb. The book’s fifth example is 她的英文很不好，连 hello 这个字都不会说 (Her English is very bad; she can’t even say the word “hello”).

examples.text: 这个汉字太难，连我的中文老师都不认识。
examples.translation: zhè ge hàn zì tài nán lián wǒ de zhōng wén lǎo shī dōu bú rèn shí — This character is so hard that even my Chinese teacher doesn’t know it.

examples.text: 我周末出去玩，连一毛钱都没花。
examples.translation: wǒ zhōu mò chū qù wán lián yì máo qián dōu méi huā — I went out to have fun at the weekend and didn’t even spend one mao.

examples.text: 这个问题太简单，连三岁小孩都知道。
examples.translation: zhè ge wèn tí tài jiǎn dān lián sān suì xiǎo hái dōu zhī dào — This question is so simple that even a three-year-old knows it.

examples.text: 这个问题太容易，连三岁小孩都知道。
examples.translation: zhè ge wèn tí tài róng yì lián sān suì xiǎo hái dōu zhī dào — This question is so easy that even a three-year-old knows it.

examples.text: 她喜欢吃辣，连她的汤都是辣的。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān chī là lián tā de tāng dōu shì là de — She likes spicy food; even her soup is spicy.

explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences below with 连…都/也…: 1. 她很有钱, 2. 大卫什么肉都吃, 3. 中国人常用手机扫码付费, 4. 他的中文很好, 5. 我女朋友很喜欢上网买东西, 6. 我的同学很能睡. One possible completion each (mine):

examples.translation: dà wèi shén me ròu dōu chī lián shé ròu dōu chī — David eats any kind of meat; he even eats snake.

examples.translation: zhōng guó rén cháng yòng shǒu jī sǎo mǎ fù fèi lián mǎi cài dōu yòng shǒu jī — Chinese people often pay by scanning a code on a phone; they even pay for vegetables with their phone.

examples.text: 他的中文很好，连中国人都听不出来他是美国人。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén hěn hǎo lián zhōng guó rén dōu tīng bù chū lái tā shì měi guó rén — His Chinese is very good; even Chinese people can’t tell he is American.

lessons.title: 246. Lesson 9 Presentation 3 grammar: the pivotal construction 请
lessons.subtitle: 我请你吃饭 · 请你帮他买一杯饮料 · 请你给我两条黄毛巾

explanations.title: The pivotal construction 请
explanations.body: There are two predicates (verbs) in a pivotal sentence. The object of the first predicate is also the subject of the second. There are a limited number of verbs in Chinese that appear in a pivotal construction. 请 is often used for invitations or polite requests, and in imperative sentences to express a request. For example, in 请您给我两条黄毛巾 there is no subject before the first verb, 请. Instead, 您 is both the object of 请 and the subject of the second verb, 给. Pattern: Subject + Verb 1 + {Subject/Object} + Verb 2 + Object.

examples.text: 我请你吃饭。
examples.translation: wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn — I invite you to a meal.

examples.text: 他请我去看电影。
examples.translation: tā qǐng wǒ qù kàn diàn yǐng — He invites me to see a movie.

examples.text: 他请我们去他家喝咖啡。
examples.translation: tā qǐng wǒ men qù tā jiā hē kā fēi — He invites us to his house for coffee.

examples.text: 请你帮他买一杯饮料。
examples.translation: qǐng nǐ bāng tā mǎi yì bēi yǐn liào — Please help him buy a drink.

examples.text: 请你给我他的手机号码。
examples.translation: qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ tā de shǒu jī hào mǎ — Please give me his cell phone number.

examples.text: 请您给我两条黄毛巾。
examples.translation: qǐng nín gěi wǒ liǎng tiáo huáng máo jīn — Please give me two yellow towels.

A summary (mine): it is Li Hua’s birthday tomorrow and she would like to invite friends for dinner at their home; she asks Wang Ying to tell 小力 and 大年; she will cook and asks them not to buy anything else; see you tomorrow afternoon.

I’d like to invite some friends to our home for dinner; please tell Xiao Li and Da Nian. I’ll make dinner, so please don’t buy anything else. Okay, see you tomorrow afternoon!

examples.text: 昨天是星期天，上午王小军和他的朋友先一起到中山公园去。那儿的风景很美，他们在那儿散了一会儿步，然后到书店去买了几本打折的书。买完书，他们又坐车到王府井百货大楼去买东西了。王小军的学校快开学了，所以他在文具部买了几枝红圆珠笔和一个绿色的笔记本。王小军还在鞋帽部买了一双黑色的皮鞋，又便宜又好看。王小军的朋友，有的买了夹克和领带，有的买了衬衫和裤子。王小军想买一套运动衣，可是没有合适的颜色。中午王小军和朋友们一起到王府井烤鸭店去吃北京烤鸭。下午他们在电影院看了一个电影就坐公共汽车回学校了。他们过了愉快的一天。
examples.translation: zuó tiān shì xīng qī tiān shàng wǔ wáng xiǎo jūn hé tā de péng yǒu xiān yì qǐ dào zhōng shān gōng yuán qù nàr de fēng jǐng hěn měi tā men zài nàr sàn le yí huìr bù rán hòu dào shū diàn qù mǎi le jǐ běn dǎ zhé de shū mǎi wán shū tā men yòu zuò chē dào wáng fǔ jǐng bǎi huò dà lóu qù mǎi dōng xī le wáng xiǎo jūn de xué xiào kuài kāi xué le suǒ yǐ tā zài wén jù bù mǎi le jǐ zhī hóng yuán zhū bǐ hé yí gè lǜ sè de bǐ jì běn wáng xiǎo jūn hái zài xié mào bù mǎi le yì shuāng hēi sè de pí xié yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn wáng xiǎo jūn de péng yǒu yǒu de mǎi le jiá kè hé lǐng dài yǒu de mǎi le chèn shān hé kù zi wáng xiǎo jūn xiǎng mǎi yí tào yùn dòng yī kě shì méi yǒu hé shì de yán sè zhōng wǔ wáng xiǎo jūn hé péng yǒu men yì qǐ dào wáng fǔ jǐng kǎo yā diàn qù chī běi jīng kǎo yā xià wǔ tā men zài diàn yǐng yuàn kàn le yí gè diàn yǐng jiù zuò gōng gòng qì chē huí xué xiào le tā men guò le yú kuài de yì tiān — Yesterday was Sunday. In the morning Wang Xiaojun and his friends first went to Zhongshan Park together. The scenery there is beautiful; they took a stroll for a while, then went to the bookstore and bought a few discounted books. After buying the books, they took a bus to the Wangfujing department store to shop. Wang Xiaojun’s school is about to start, so he bought a few red ballpoint pens and a green notebook in the stationery section. He also bought a pair of black leather shoes in the shoe and hat section, cheap and good-looking. Of his friends, some bought jackets and ties, some shirts and pants. Wang Xiaojun wanted a sports outfit but there was no suitable color. At noon he and his friends went to the Wangfujing roast duck restaurant for Beijing roast duck. lessons.title: 250. Lesson 9 Area Studies: China’s booming consumer economy

explanations.title: China’s booming consumer economy (1)
explanations.body: Since the late 1970s, China has transitioned from a closed, centrally planned economy to a market-based global giant. Reform began with the phaseout of collectivized agriculture and soon extended to price liberalization, fiscal decentralization, increased state-owned enterprise (SOE) autonomy, private sector growth, stock market development, modern banking practices, and opening up to foreign trade and investment. From 1978 to 2019, China has seen an average GDP growth rate of 9.3% annually. In 2019, its GDP was $27,307 trillion (as printed in the book), second only to the US; its per capita income was $19,504 in Purchasing Power Parity (PPP); and it became the world’s leading exporter, with exports valued at $2.5 billion (as printed in the book), the US coming in a distant second at only $1.6 billion. China’s robust economy and rising standard of living are promoting an ardent consumer lifestyle. According to the McKinsey China Report, the scale of China’s e-commerce ranks first in the world, reaching $1.5 trillion in 2019. (The book’s photographs, from People.com.cn, are not included.)

explanations.title: E-commerce and online payment
explanations.body: Today, the top five e-commerce retailers in China are Tmall Mall (天猫商城 tiānmāo shāngchéng), Taobao (淘宝 táobǎo), Jingdong Mall (京东商城 Jīngdōng shāngchéng), Pinduoduo (拼多多 pīn duōduō) and Suning Tesco (苏宁易购 Sūníng Yìgòu), which supply almost everything Chinese consumers need. Due to the prosperous e-commerce market, online payment and express delivery systems are also flourishing. The top three online pay apps are PayPal (贝宝 bèibǎo), Alipay (支付宝 zhīfùbǎo) and Tenpay (财付通 cáifùtōng). Almost everyone now pays for their purchases by phone; even in remote rural areas, cash is rarely used anymore.

tables.title: Top five e-commerce retailers
Top three online pay apps

explanations.title: Express delivery
explanations.body: Among the burgeoning express delivery services, the top three are SF Express (顺丰速运 shùnfēng sùyùn), Postal EMS (邮政 EMS yóuzhèng EMS) and YTO Express (圆通速递 yuántōng sùdì). SF Express has more than 15,000 vehicles and 13,000 service centers across the country. The company earned a revenue of $8.6 billion in 2016 and began trading publicly in January 2017. Wang Wei, Chairman of SF Express, has become one of the richest men in China, with a net worth of $21.4 billion. Nonetheless, it is not the entrepreneurs or CEOs that bring the nearly 100 million packages to Chinese doorsteps. Enabling these soaring revenues is the labor of over two million scooter couriers who make deliveries 24 hours a day; these workers delivered a total of 60 billion parcels in 2019, according to data from the State Post Bureau (SPB). China’s delivery services now boast 20,000 enterprises and over three million employees. SPB data shows that over 30,000 delivery outlets now cover 96% of townships in China. In short, China’s consumer market and service industries are surging in the wake of its ongoing economic expansion.

explanations.title: Lesson 10 objectives: 第十课 租房和住房 (Housing and Rentals)
explanations.body: By the end of the lesson you will be able to seek rental information, tour an apartment or house, and describe an apartment or house and its furnishings. To do that you must master the core vocabulary and grammar patterns: the modal verb 要; questions with the adverb 多 (有多大？); the (不但)…, 而且… construction; attributives; the 小是小了点, 可是… construction; existential sentences with 有; the question word 什么时候; the conditional construction 如果…, 就…; the position words 左边, 右边, 旁边, 中间, 前面, 对面, 里面; and the aspect marker 着. Area Studies: living environment and housing conditions in China.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening) and Activity 4
explanations.body: Activity 3. A. Pair up and write five sentences using the words from the picture of a house (套, 停车位, 公寓, 多大, 租, 租房, 房租, 押金, 而且, 包, 带, 看房, 付, 想, 要, 有, 水费, 网费, 电费, 每月, 客厅, 家具, 新的, 以前, 一室一厅). Use each word at least once and add any others you need, paying close attention to sentence structure and grammar. B. Take turns reading your sentences to the class. C. Your teacher and classmates point out errors and give feedback. Activity 4 (Speaking): pair up and call a rental agency to ask about housing in your area (rent, security deposit, utilities, facilities, furniture and so on); your partner plays the agent. Use the words and patterns of this lesson.

explanations.title: The modal verb 要 for desire or intention
explanations.body: The modal 要 + Verb expresses the desire or intention to do something. The negative form is 不想 + Verb, although some speakers in southern China use 不要 + Verb. The affirmative-negative question form is 要不要 + Verb. Patterns: 要 + Verb; 不想 (不要) + Verb; 要不要 + Verb?

examples.text: 我要租一套公寓。
examples.translation: wǒ yào zū yí tào gōng yù — I want to rent an apartment.

examples.text: 我现在有点儿累，不想写作业。
examples.translation: wǒ xiàn zài yǒu diǎnr lèi bù xiǎng xiě zuò yè — I’m a little tired now and don’t want to do homework.

examples.text: 我要去海边散步，你要不要和我一起去？
examples.translation: wǒ yào qù hǎi biān sàn bù nǐ yào bú yào hé wǒ yì qǐ qù — I want to go to the beach for a stroll. Do you want to go with me?

explanations.title: 要 and 想
explanations.body: Both 要 and 想 can express desire or intention, although 要 is stronger in tone. 想 is often used as a modal verb to mean “would like to” or “feel like doing”. Pattern: 要/想 + Verb.

examples.text: 我要买一条领带。
examples.translation: wǒ yào mǎi yì tiáo lǐng dài — I want to buy a tie.

examples.text: 我想买一条领带。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì tiáo lǐng dài — I would like to buy a tie.

examples.text: 我要去看电影。
examples.translation: wǒ yào qù kàn diàn yǐng — I want to go see a movie.

examples.text: 我想去看电影。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng qù kàn diàn yǐng — I’d like to go see a movie.

explanations.title: 要 for need, and 需要
explanations.body: 要 can also convey the need to do something. In that case the negation is 不用. Pattern: 要 + Verb; 不用 + Verb. When 要 expresses “need to”, 需要 can replace it without a significant change in meaning: 需要(要) + Verb; 不需要(不用) + Verb.

examples.text: 甲：租房以前，要付押金吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ zū fáng yǐ qián yào fù yā jīn ma — Before renting, do I need to pay a deposit?

examples.text: 乙：你不用付押金，只付一个月的房费就可以了。

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Activity 1. In pairs, take turns asking and answering. The example: A asks about the farmers’ market, B answers. Then ask and answer the six questions: 你要租房还是买房？ 你想租什么样的公寓？ 今天晚上，你要不要和我一起去看电影？ 你想在中国教英文吗？ 你知道，租房以前，需要付押金吗？ 我们每天要去图书馆做作业吗？ Activity 2 (Speaking): you and your partner will begin sharing an apartment next week; discuss what you need to buy for it, using 要, 想 and 需要.

lessons.title: 253. Lesson 10 Presentation 1 grammar: 有多大？ and (不但)…，而且…

explanations.title: The adverb 多
explanations.body: The adverb 多 is usually placed before monosyllabic (single-syllable) adjectives to inquire about degree or extent. 有 can precede 多 to indicate an estimation. Pattern: (有)多 + Adjective?

examples.text: 你公寓的客厅有多大？
examples.translation: nǐ gōng yù de kè tīng yǒu duō dà — How large is the living room in your apartment?

examples.text: 你公寓的客厅多大？
examples.translation: nǐ gōng yù de kè tīng duō dà — How large is the living room in your apartment?

examples.text: 你儿子现在有多高？
examples.translation: nǐ ér zi xiàn zài yǒu duō gāo — How tall is your son now?

examples.text: 你儿子现在多高？
examples.translation: nǐ ér zi xiàn zài duō gāo — How tall is your son now?

examples.text: 今天的天气有多热？
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì yǒu duō rè — How hot is the weather today?

examples.text: 今天的天气多热？
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì duō rè — How hot is the weather today?

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: Work in pairs. Using the (有)多 + Adjective pattern, write the questions you need to ask to get the measurements underlined in the following sentences. The book’s example: 珍妮的卧室有三十平米 → 珍妮的卧室有多大？ The sentences are 1. 马克有一米八二 2. 张老师的女儿今年三岁 3. 这种水果四十块一斤 4. 今天的气温是一百零三华氏度 5. 昨天晚上的气温有零下二十摄氏度 6. 琳达每天都是十二点才睡觉. The book gives no key; the questions below are mine:

rows: 珍妮的卧室有三十平米。
Jenny’s bedroom is 30 square meters: How big is Jenny’s bedroom? (the book’s example)
Mark is 1.82 m: How tall is Mark?
张老师的女儿今年三岁。
张老师的女儿今年多大？
Teacher Zhang’s daughter is three this year: How old is she?
This fruit is 40 yuan a jin: How much a jin?
今天的气温是一百零三华氏度。
Today it is 103 °F: How high is today’s temperature?
昨天晚上的气温有零下二十摄氏度。
昨天晚上的气温有多低？
Last night it was minus 20 °C: How low was last night’s temperature?
琳达每天都是十二点才睡觉。
琳达每天都是几点才睡觉？
Linda only goes to bed at twelve every day: What time does she go to bed?
tables.title: The sentences and their questions

explanations.title: The construction (不但)…，而且…
explanations.body: Similar to the English construction “not only…, but also…”, 不但…，而且… joins two phrases or clauses to emphasize their correlation. Used alone, 而且 can function as a conjunction to convey “moreover” or “furthermore”.

examples.text: 上海不但有很多好吃的饭馆，而且还有很多好玩的地方。
examples.translation: shàng hǎi bú dàn yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de fàn guǎn ér qiě hái yǒu hěn duō hǎo wán de dì fāng — Shanghai not only has many restaurants with good food, but also has many fun places.

examples.text: 这件衬衫不但颜色好，而且也很便宜。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn chèn shān bú dàn yán sè hǎo ér qiě yě hěn pián yi — This shirt not only has a nice color, it is also very cheap.

examples.text: 你租的公寓带家具，而且都是新的。
examples.translation: nǐ zū de gōng yù dài jiā jù ér qiě dōu shì xīn de — The apartment you have rented comes furnished, and (moreover) it’s all new.

examples.text: 这道菜很好吃，而且很好看。
examples.translation: zhè dào cài hěn hǎo chī ér qiě hěn hǎo kàn — This dish is really tasty; (furthermore) it looks very nice, as well.

explanations.title: Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening): listen to five statements and answer: 1. What is said about the apartment rent? 2. How is the clothing described? 3. How is the parents’ house described? 4. Describe the oranges sold in this store. 5. How is the weather described? (audio, not included). Activity 5 (Speaking and Writing): with a partner, use 不但…，而且… to describe pictures (the pictures are not included). Student A starts each sentence with 不但 and Student B finishes it with 而且. The book’s example for the apartment picture, and then one possible sentence each for 饺子, 图书馆, 西装, 西瓜, 客厅 and 海鲜 (mine):

examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge gōng yù bú dàn yán sè hǎo — This apartment not only has a nice color,

examples.text: 乙：而且样式很特别。
examples.translation: yǐ ér qiě yàng shì hěn tè bié — but also has a very special style.

examples.text: 这个饺子不但好吃，而且很便宜。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiǎo zi bú dàn hǎo chī ér qiě hěn pián yi — These dumplings are not only tasty, but also cheap.

examples.text: 这个图书馆不但很大，而且很安静。
examples.translation: zhè ge tú shū guǎn bú dàn hěn dà ér qiě hěn ān jìng — This library is not only big, but also quiet.

examples.text: 这套西装不但样式好，而且很便宜。
examples.translation: zhè tào xī zhuāng bú dàn yàng shì hǎo ér qiě hěn pián yi — This suit not only has a nice style, but is also cheap.

examples.text: 这个西瓜不但很大，而且很甜。
examples.translation: zhè ge xī guā bú dàn hěn dà ér qiě hěn tián — This watermelon is not only big, but also sweet.

examples.text: 这个客厅不但很大，而且很干净。
examples.translation: zhè ge kè tīng bú dàn hěn dà ér qiě hěn gān jìng — This living room is not only big, but also clean.

examples.text: 这些海鲜不但很新鲜，而且很便宜。
examples.translation: zhè xiē hǎi xiān bú dàn hěn xīn xiān ér qiě hěn pián yi — This seafood is not only fresh, but also cheap.

lessons.title: 254. Lesson 10 Presentation 1 skill integration: the Monterey apartment, ads and moving in
lessons.subtitle: 老同学帮我找公寓 · 钥匙 搬家 · 公寓出租 · 独立屋出租 · 拎包入住

explanations.title: Activity 1: a monolog and the passage
explanations.body: A. Listen to the monolog and summarize it, including at least three EEIs (essential elements of information) (audio, not included). B. Read the passage and answer: 1. Why is the speaker’s former classmate having a hard time finding an apartment? 2. According to the speaker, what advantages does the apartment have? 3. According to the manager, what advantages does the apartment have? 4. What does the speaker need to pay before renting? C. Compare answers with a partner. D. In Chinese, discuss where you would most like to live in Monterey, and report your choice and reasoning to the class. (The book prints the rent as 一千八.)

examples.text: 我刚来蒙特雷的第一个月是住在我的老同学家里。他比我早来蒙特雷两年，所以我请他帮我看看有没有合适的公寓出租。蒙特雷的房租很贵，他找了很长时间都没有找到合适的公寓。最后在网上看到了一个两室一厅的小公寓，每个月的房租只要一千八，包上网费，不包水电，而且交通很方便，开二十分钟的车就可以到学校了。他马上给出租公寓的王经理打电话问了一下。王经理说这个公寓是新公寓，去年建的，环境很美，客厅很大，还带一些家具，有一个停车位。租房以前，要付一个月的房租和一个月的押金。我觉得这个公寓很合适，明天要去看一下。
examples.translation: wǒ gāng lái méng tè léi de dì yī gè yuè shì zhù zài wǒ de lǎo tóng xué jiā lǐ tā bǐ wǒ zǎo lái méng tè léi liǎng nián suǒ yǐ wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ kàn kàn yǒu méi yǒu hé shì de gōng yù chū zū méng tè léi de fáng zū hěn guì tā zhǎo le hěn zhǎng shí jiān dōu méi yǒu zhǎo dào hé shì de gōng yù zuì hòu zài wǎng shàng kàn dào le yí gè liǎng shì yì tīng de xiǎo gōng yù měi gè yuè de fáng zū zhǐ yào yì qiān bā bāo shàng wǎng fèi bù bāo shuǐ diàn ér qiě jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn kāi èr shí fēn zhōng de chē jiù kě yǐ dào xué xiào le tā mǎ shàng gěi chū zū gōng yù de wáng jīng lǐ dǎ diàn huà wèn le yí xià wáng jīng lǐ shuō zhè ge gōng yù shì xīn gōng yù qù nián jiàn de huán jìng hěn měi kè tīng hěn dà hái dài yì xiē jiā jù yǒu yí gè tíng chē wèi zū fáng yǐ qián yào fù yí gè yuè de fáng zū hé yí gè yuè de yā jīn wǒ jué de zhè ge gōng yù hěn hé shì míng tiān yào qù kàn yí xià — I stayed at an old classmate’s home during my first month in Monterey. He came to Monterey two years before me, so I asked him to help me see if there was a suitable apartment for rent. Rents in Monterey are expensive, and he looked for a long time without finding a suitable apartment. Finally he saw a small two-bedroom, one-living-room apartment online; the monthly rent is only 1,800, including internet but not water and electricity, and the transportation is very convenient: it’s a twenty-minute drive to school. He immediately phoned Manager Wang, who rents out the apartment. Manager Wang said it is a new apartment, built last year, with a beautiful environment and a big living room, some furniture, and one parking space. Before renting, you must pay a month’s rent and a month’s deposit. I think this apartment is very suitable and plan to go and see it tomorrow.

explanations.title: Activity 2: a video clip
explanations.body: New words (生词): 钥匙 key; 搬家 move (residence); 赶鸭子上架 push someone beyond their ability (idiom). A. Watch a video clip and summarize it, taking notes on what you understand. B. Watch it again and answer: 1. Why does the speaker say “Today is a very important day”? 2. Does he need to buy any furniture? How do you know? 3. What else does he need to do after he moves in? C. Compare answers with a partner. D. In Chinese, pair up and share your experiences of finding or moving into an apartment or house, on campus or on post. (The video is not included.)

tables.title: 生词

explanations.title: Activity 3: two rental advertisements
explanations.body: A. Divide into two groups. Group A reads Advertisement 1 and Group B reads Advertisement 2. Guess the meaning of unknown words from the context, then translate the ads into English. The ads (as printed; the prices are in dollars): Advertisement 1, 公寓出租: 三藩市日落区有房出租，一室一浴一车库，月租 $2,300，包水费和垃圾，按金 $3,000，清洁金 $150，请电 415-233-6888. Advertisement 2, 独立屋出租: 日落区楼下两房出租，环境优美，交通便利，全新厨房，设备齐全，停车方便，$3,245/月，请电 415-845-2268. My translation of Ad 1: apartment for rent in San Francisco’s Sunset District, one bedroom, one bath, a garage; monthly rent $2,300, water and garbage included; deposit $3,000, cleaning fee $150. Ad 2: house for rent, two rooms downstairs in the Sunset District, beautiful environment, convenient transportation, brand-new kitchen, fully equipped, easy parking, $3,245 a month. B. Pair up with a student from the other group and paraphrase the information of your ad in standard conversational Chinese; the other student writes down the essential information, asking questions when necessary; then switch. Check your notes by reading each other’s ads.

explanations.title: Activity 4: an apartment ad
explanations.body: A. Read the ad and answer: 1. Where exactly is the apartment located? 2. What type of rooms does it have and how many? 3. What furniture, amenities or utilities are provided? 4. How does a prospective renter inquire about this apartment? B. Compare answers with a partner. C. Write at least three words you didn’t understand in the ad and see if your partner can figure out the meaning from context. D. You want to rent the apartment: call the contact person (your partner) to find out the monthly rent, security deposit, utilities, WiFi, parking facilities, etc.; switch roles and repeat. The ad (the book also prints the phone number 13519855673):

examples.text: 本套房位于中山大学旁，海鲜酒家后的阳光小区一楼。套房为三房两厅一厨两卫，房间配有全套家具：沙发，餐桌，大床；还提供：厨房用具，冰箱，热水器，洗衣机等生活必需品，套房还有电视，且每个房间都配有空调。您只需拎包即可入住。租金实惠，欢迎来电咨询。联系人：李先生
examples.translation: běn tào fáng wèi yú zhōng shān dà xué páng hǎi xiān jiǔ jiā hòu de yáng guāng xiǎo qū yì lóu tào fáng wèi sān fáng liǎng tīng yì chú liǎng wèi fáng jiān pèi yǒu quán tào jiā jù shā fā cān zhuō dà chuáng hái tí gōng chú fáng yòng jù bīng xiāng rè shuǐ qì xǐ yī jī děng shēng huó bì xū pǐn tào fáng hái yǒu diàn shì qiě měi gè fáng jiān dōu pèi yǒu kòng diào nín zhǐ xū līn bāo jí kě rù zhù zū jīn shí huì huān yíng lái diàn zī xún lián xì rén lǐ xiān shēng — This suite is next to Sun Yat-sen University, on the first floor of the Sunshine residential community behind the Seafood Restaurant. The suite has three bedrooms, two living rooms, one kitchen and two bathrooms, with a full set of furniture in the rooms: sofa, dining table, big bed. Also provided: kitchen utensils, refrigerator, water heater, washing machine and other daily necessities. The suite also has Wi-Fi and TV, and every room has air conditioning. You only need to bring your bags and move in. The rent is reasonable; calls for inquiries are welcome. Contact: Mr. Li (the phone number is in the book).

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): two ads
explanations.body: Form two groups of three. One student plays a prospective renter inquiring about two apartment ads, while the other two play the contact people, Mr. Zhang or Ms. Wang. A. The contact people first read their ads; the renter calls each one and writes down the essential details. B. lessons.title: 259. Lesson 10 Presentation 2 grammar: the attributive (定语) and 的
lessons.subtitle: 我租的公寓 · 穿红衣服的女孩 · 左边的房间 · 的 is not used / optional

explanations.title: The attributive
explanations.body: An attributive is a notional word or phrase that directly precedes the noun it modifies. It is often, but not always, linked to the noun by the structural particle 的. The book’s eight types, with two examples each:

examples.text: 这是我的书，不是图书馆的书。
examples.translation: zhè shì wǒ de shū bú shì tú shū guǎn de shū — This is my book, not the library’s book.

examples.text: 那是学校图书馆的书。
examples.translation: nà shì xué xiào tú shū guǎn de shū — That’s a school library book.

examples.text: 那间大房间是我父母的卧室。
examples.translation: nà jiān dà fáng jiān shì wǒ fù mǔ de wò shì — The big room is my parents’ bedroom.

examples.text: 这个又漂亮又舒服的沙发是朋友给的。
examples.translation: zhè ge yòu piào liàng yòu shū fú de shā fā shì péng yǒu gěi de — This beautiful and comfortable sofa was given to me by a friend.

examples.text: 说话的那个同学是我们的班长。
examples.translation: shuō huà de nà ge tóng xué shì wǒ men de bān zhǎng — The classmate speaking is our class leader.

examples.text: 那个坐着的女孩是我妹妹。
examples.translation: nà ge zuò zhe de nǚ hái shì wǒ mèi mèi — That girl sitting down is my little sister.

examples.text: 我们学校有一个医院。
examples.translation: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu yí gè yī yuàn — There’s a hospital in our school.

examples.text: 我们教室里有十多张书桌。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiào shì lǐ yǒu shí duō zhāng shū zhuō — There are over ten desks in our classroom.

examples.text: 你们住的房子有多大？
examples.translation: nǐ men zhù de fáng zi yǒu duō dà — How big is the house you live in?

examples.text: 这是学生们吃饭的食堂。
examples.translation: zhè shì xué shēng men chī fàn de shí táng — This is the cafeteria where students eat.

examples.text: 教中文的老师都是中国人。
examples.translation: jiāo zhōng wén de lǎo shī dōu shì zhōng guó rén — The teachers who teach Chinese are all Chinese.

examples.text: 穿红衣服的女孩是我姐姐。
examples.translation: chuān hóng yī fú de nǚ hái shì wǒ jiě jiě — The girl wearing red is my big sister.

examples.text: 在我家的客厅里有一个书架。
examples.translation: zài wǒ jiā de kè tīng lǐ yǒu yí gè shū jià — There’s a bookshelf in my living room.

examples.text: 在学校的后面有一个体育馆。
examples.translation: zài xué xiào de hòu miàn yǒu yí gè tǐ yù guǎn — There’s a gym behind the school.

examples.text: 山上的房子都很贵。
examples.translation: shān shàng de fáng zi dōu hěn guì — Houses on the mountain are all very expensive.

examples.text: 左边的房间是客人房。
examples.translation: zuǒ biān de fáng jiān shì kè rén fáng — The room on the left is a guest room.

explanations.title: The attributive always comes first
explanations.body: A Chinese attributive, whether a single word or a long phrase, must always precede the noun it modifies. Reversing the order will change both structure and meaning. In contrast, longer English attributives follow the modified part, often via a relative clause. As shown, the structural particle 的 is often used to link an attributive to the noun it modifies.

examples.text: 前边的教室
examples.translation: qián biān de jiào shì — the classroom at the front (前边 is the attributive)

examples.text: 教室的前边
examples.translation: jiào shì de qián biān — the front of the classroom (前边 is the modified noun)

examples.text: 穿红衣服的那个人是我姐姐。
examples.translation: chuān hóng yī fú de nà ge rén shì wǒ jiě jiě — The person (who is) wearing red is my big sister.

examples.text: 这就是你想租的公寓。
examples.translation: zhè jiù shì nǐ xiǎng zū de gōng yù — This is the apartment that you would like to rent.

explanations.title: When 的 is not used and when it is optional
explanations.body: 的 is not used with: nouns denoting the quality of a person or thing (车库, 皮鞋, 饭桌); pronouns indicating familial relationship (你妈妈, 我哥哥, 她妹妹); monosyllabic adjectives (白衬衫, 大楼, 快餐); numeral-measure word phrases (一件夹克, 两条领带, 三双筷子). 的 is optional with disyllabic pronouns modifying collective nouns (我们（的）学校, 他们（的）班) and with 很多, 不少 and the like (很多（的）人, 不少（的）问题).

tables.title: 的 is not used
的 is optional

options: A word that follows the noun
A word or phrase that directly precedes the noun it modifies

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the attributives
explanations.body: Pair up. Highlight the attributives in each sentence. Read the dialog aloud together, each reading one part, then translate it in the space provided. The five dialogs, with 甲 and 乙 for the book’s A and B. The attributives are 书架上的, 你在北京买的, 我在北京买的, 你做的, 我做的, 你在网上认识的, 我在网上认识的, 每天很忙的, 你上个星期穿的 and 一个学中文的美国朋友给我买的 (mine):

examples.text: 甲：书架上的那本书是你在北京买的那本吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ shū jià shàng de nà běn shū shì nǐ zài běi jīng mǎi de nà běn ma — Is the book on the shelf the one you bought in Beijing?

examples.text: 乙：不是。我在北京买的那本书在学校里。
examples.translation: yǐ bú shì wǒ zài běi jīng mǎi de nà běn shū zài xué xiào lǐ — No. The book I bought in Beijing is at school.

examples.text: 甲：你做的糖醋鱼比我做的好吃。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ zuò de táng cù yú bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo chī — The sweet and sour fish you made is tastier than the one I made.

examples.text: 乙：哪里。大家都喜欢吃你做的糖醋鱼。
examples.translation: yǐ nǎ lǐ dà jiā dōu xǐ huān chī nǐ zuò de táng cù yú — Not at all. Everyone likes to eat the sweet and sour fish you make.

examples.text: 甲：你在网上认识的女朋友是中国人吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ zài wǎng shàng rèn shí de nǚ péng yǒu shì zhōng guó rén ma — Is the girlfriend you met online Chinese?

examples.text: 乙：不是。我在网上认识的女朋友是韩国人。
examples.translation: yǐ bú shì wǒ zài wǎng shàng rèn shí de nǚ péng yǒu shì hán guó rén — No. The girlfriend I met online is Korean.

examples.text: 甲：你现在习惯在蒙特雷的学习和生活了吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ xiàn zài xí guàn zài méng tè léi de xué xí hé shēng huó le ma — Have you gotten used to studying and living in Monterey now?

examples.text: 乙：习惯了。我现在适应了每天很忙的生活。
examples.translation: yǐ xí guàn le wǒ xiàn zài shì yìng le měi tiān hěn máng de shēng huó — Yes. I’ve now adapted to a life that is busy every day.

examples.text: 甲：你上个星期穿的那件蓝衬衫很好看。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ shàng gè xīng qī chuān de nà jiàn lán chèn shān hěn hǎo kàn — The blue shirt you wore last week looked very nice.

examples.text: 乙：那是一个学中文的美国朋友给我买的。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì yí gè xué zhōng wén de měi guó péng yǒu gěi wǒ mǎi de — An American friend who studies Chinese bought it for me.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: Listen to a conversation and translate the five sentences with attributive constructions into English; then share your work with a partner (audio, not included).

explanations.title: The construction 小是小了点，可是…
explanations.body: The construction …是…，可是… occurs most often in conversation. The first part, …是…, agrees with what someone has given their opinion on, while the second part, 可是…, qualifies that opinion with an alternative view or perspective. Pattern: A 是 A，可是….

examples.text: 小是小了点，可是厨具很全，冰箱、洗碗机都有。
examples.translation: xiǎo shì xiǎo le diǎn kě shì chú jù hěn quán bīng xiāng xǐ wǎn jī dōu yǒu — It is a bit small, but it has a full array of kitchenware, a refrigerator and a dishwasher.

examples.text: 这道菜好吃是好吃，可是有点儿辣。
examples.translation: zhè dào cài hǎo chī shì hǎo chī kě shì yǒu diǎnr là — This dish is delicious alright, but it’s a bit spicy.

examples.text: 这件衣服好看是好看，可是有点儿贵。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn yī fú hǎo kàn shì hǎo kàn kě shì yǒu diǎnr guì — Sure, this item of clothing looks nice, but it’s a bit expensive.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: Pair up and make sentences with A 是 A，可是…. One student comments on each of twelve pictures with the first part (A 是 A), then the other student qualifies the comment with the second part (可是…). Write both parts of your completed sentences in the table. Take turns on each picture so that both of you create both parts, for a total of 12 sentences. (The pictures are not included.) The book’s example, and three more of my own:

examples.text: 甲：这件衣服真好看。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè jiàn yī fú zhēn hǎo kàn — This piece of clothing is really nice.

examples.text: 乙：这件衣服好看是好看，可是有点儿贵。
examples.translation: yǐ zhè jiàn yī fú hǎo kàn shì hǎo kàn kě shì yǒu diǎnr guì — It looks nice alright, but it’s a bit expensive.

examples.text: 这个房间大是大，可是有点儿旧。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng jiān dà shì dà kě shì yǒu diǎnr jiù — This room is big, but a bit old.

examples.text: 这个沙发漂亮是漂亮，可是不太舒服。
examples.translation: zhè ge shā fā piào liàng shì piào liàng kě shì bú tài shū fú — This sofa is pretty, but not very comfortable.

examples.text: 这个公寓便宜是便宜，可是离学校很远。
examples.translation: zhè ge gōng yù pián yi shì pián yi kě shì lí xué xiào hěn yuǎn — This apartment is cheap, but far from school.

Gives a cause and a result

exercises.prompt: What does 小是小了点，可是厨具很全 mean?

It is small because it is cheap

这件衣服好看，是可是有点儿贵。

lessons.title: 261. Lesson 10 Presentation 2 grammar: existential 有 and 什么时候
lessons.subtitle: 房间里有一个书桌 · 厨房里没有洗碗机 · 你什么时候起床？

explanations.title: The existential sentence with 有
explanations.body: The verb 有 is also used in existential sentences, i.e., sentences that express the existence (or absence) of someone or something. In this case, 有 is similar to the English “there is/are”. Pattern: Place + 有 + Object.

examples.text: 房间里有一个书桌和一个书架。
examples.translation: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yí gè shū zhuō hé yí gè shū jià — There is a desk and a bookshelf in the room.

examples.text: 我家的厨房里没有洗碗机。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā de chú fáng lǐ méi yǒu xǐ wǎn jī — There is no dishwasher in my kitchen.

examples.text: 你的老家有没有大学？
examples.translation: nǐ de lǎo jiā yǒu méi yǒu dà xué — Is there a college in your hometown?

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Take turns asking and answering the following questions. Then take turns asking and answering similar questions about your classroom and residence. The book’s example, then its five questions:

examples.text: 甲：这个房间里有什么？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge fáng jiān lǐ yǒu shén me — What is in this room?

examples.text: 乙：这个房间里有一个书桌和一个书架。
examples.translation: yǐ zhè ge fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yí gè shū zhuō hé yí gè shū jià — There is a desk and a bookshelf in this room.

examples.text: 甲：你家客厅里有什么？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ jiā kè tīng lǐ yǒu shén me — What is in your living room?

examples.text: 甲：冰箱里有没有水果？
examples.translation: jiǎ bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu méi yǒu shuǐ guǒ — Is there any fruit in the refrigerator?

examples.text: 甲：这个图书馆里有多少书？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge tú shū guǎn lǐ yǒu duō shǎo shū — How many books are in this library?

examples.text: 甲：这个饭馆有什么菜？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge fàn guǎn yǒu shén me cài — What dishes does this restaurant have?

examples.text: 甲：这个学校有多少老师和学生？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge xué xiào yǒu duō shǎo lǎo shī hé xué shēng — How many teachers and students does this school have?

explanations.title: The question word 什么时候
explanations.body: Similar to the English word “when”, 什么时候 is used to ask questions about time. Whereas English question words must come at the beginning of the sentence, Chinese question words simply take the syntactic place of the item being asked about; no sentence rearrangement is needed. Pattern: Subject + 什么时候 + Predicate?

examples.text: 我很喜欢这个公寓。咱们什么时候可以签合同？
examples.translation: wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè ge gōng yù zán men shén me shí hòu kě yǐ qiān hé tóng — I really like this apartment. When can we sign the contract?

examples.text: 你明天什么时候锻炼身体？
examples.translation: nǐ míng tiān shén me shí hòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ — When are you going to work out tomorrow?

examples.text: 琳达是什么时候开始学中文的？
examples.translation: lín dá shì shén me shí hòu kāi shǐ xué zhōng wén de — When did Linda start learning Chinese?

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: Interview two classmates about their daily life and studies. Write down their responses in a table (Interviewee 1 and Interviewee 2) and report your interview results to the class. The example questions:

examples.text: 你每天什么时候起床？
examples.translation: nǐ měi tiān shén me shí hòu qǐ chuáng — When do you get up every day?

examples.text: 你每天什么时候去学校上课？
examples.translation: nǐ měi tiān shén me shí hòu qù xué xiào shàng kè — When do you go to school for class every day?

examples.text: 你每天什么时候锻炼身体？
examples.translation: nǐ měi tiān shén me shí hòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ — When do you work out every day?

examples.text: 你什么时候开始学中文的？
examples.translation: nǐ shén me shí hòu kāi shǐ xué zhōng wén de — When did you start learning Chinese?

examples.text: 你什么时候完全适应这里的生活？
examples.translation: nǐ shén me shí hòu wán quán shì yìng zhè lǐ de shēng huó — When will you fully adapt to life here?

examples.text: 你什么时候有期末考试？
examples.translation: nǐ shén me shí hòu yǒu qī mò kǎo shì — When do you have your final exam?

exercises.prompt: What does the existential 有 express?
options: The existence or absence of someone or something

exercises.prompt: What is the pattern of the existential 有?
What does 房间里有一个书桌和一个书架 mean?
options: There is a desk and a bookshelf in the room
I have a desk and a bookshelf

exercises.prompt: What does 我家的厨房里没有洗碗机 mean?
options: My dishwasher is in the kitchen
There is no dishwasher in my kitchen

exercises.prompt: Which asks if there is a college in your hometown?
What does 什么时候 mean?
Where does 什么时候 go in Chinese?
options: In the place of the time being asked about

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks “When will you work out tomorrow?”
options: 你明天什么时候锻炼身体？
什么时候你明天锻炼身体？
你锻炼身体明天什么时候？

exercises.prompt: What does 琳达是什么时候开始学中文的？ ask?
options: When did Linda start learning Chinese?
exercises.explanation: 是…的 with 什么时候.

exercises.prompt: 房间里___一个书桌和一个书架。
我家的厨房里___有洗碗机。

lessons.title: 262. Lesson 10 Presentation 2 grammar: the conditional 如果…，就…
lessons.subtitle: 如果没什么问题，就… · 明天如果下雨 · 好吃你就多吃点儿

explanations.title: 如果…，就… (A and B)
explanations.body: A. The 如果…，就… construction indicates a conditional relationship between two clauses in a complex sentence. Like the English “if…then…”, 如果 indicates the supposed condition in the clause, while 就 indicates the result if that condition pertains. B. While a subject can come either before or after 如果, it can only come before 就: 如果 + Subject1…, Subject2 + 就…; Subject1 + 如果…, Subject2 + 就….

examples.text: 如果没什么问题，下周一我们就可以签合同。
examples.translation: rú guǒ méi shén me wèn tí xià zhōu yì wǒ men jiù kě yǐ qiān hé tóng — If there are no problems, we can sign the contract next Monday.

examples.text: 如果天气不好，我们就不去海边散步。
examples.translation: rú guǒ tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù bú qù hǎi biān sàn bù — If the weather is no good, we won’t go walking at the beach.

examples.text: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.translation: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bú qù pá shān le — If it rains tomorrow, we won’t go hiking.

examples.text: 明天如果下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.translation: míng tiān rú guǒ xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bú qù pá shān le — If it rains tomorrow, we won’t go hiking.

explanations.title: 如果 can be left out (C)
explanations.body: Colloquially, 如果 can be left out: …，就….

examples.text: 明天天气不好，我们就不去海边野餐。
examples.translation: míng tiān tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù bú qù hǎi biān yě cān — If the weather is bad tomorrow, we won’t go picnic at the beach.

examples.text: 好吃你就多吃点儿。
examples.translation: hǎo chī nǐ jiù duō chī diǎnr — If it tastes good, eat some more.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Take turns reading the clauses on the left aloud as you link them to the relevant clauses on the right with 如果…，就…, then write the complete sentences. Left: 你不喜欢去看电影, 你喜欢这件衣服的样式, 你晚上不想做饭, 你觉得带现金很麻烦, 这个公寓没有停车位. Right: 你去试衣间试试, 我们不租了, 你用微信扫码付钱, 我们不去了, 我们去一家中国饭馆吃饭. B. Read a sentence aloud while your partner translates it into English; take turns until you have done all five. A possible matching (the key is mine):

examples.text: 如果你不喜欢去看电影，我们就不去了。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ bù xǐ huān qù kàn diàn yǐng wǒ men jiù bú qù le — If you don’t like going to the movies, we won’t go.

examples.text: 如果你喜欢这件衣服的样式，你就去试衣间试试。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ xǐ huān zhè jiàn yī fú de yàng shì nǐ jiù qù shì yī jiān shì shì — If you like the style of this piece of clothing, go try it on in the fitting room.

examples.text: 如果你晚上不想做饭，我们就去一家中国饭馆吃饭。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ wǎn shàng bù xiǎng zuò fàn wǒ men jiù qù yì jiā zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī fàn — If you don’t feel like cooking in the evening, we’ll go to a Chinese restaurant to eat.

examples.text: 如果你觉得带现金很麻烦，你就用微信扫码付钱。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ jué de dài xiàn jīn hěn má fán nǐ jiù yòng wēi xìn sǎo mǎ fù qián — If you think carrying cash is troublesome, pay by scanning a code with WeChat.

examples.text: 如果这个公寓没有停车位，我们就不租了。
examples.translation: rú guǒ zhè ge gōng yù méi yǒu tíng chē wèi wǒ men jiù bù zū le — If this apartment has no parking space, we won’t rent it.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading): a cartoon, and Activity 8: a song
explanations.body: 开心一刻！ Read the cartoon’s captions aloud in pairs, then translate them (the cartoon is not included). Activity 8 (Reading and Speaking): the book has the children’s song “If You’re Happy Clap Your Hands” (如果开心你就跟我拍拍手) with the Chinese words, pinyin and English; you sing along while noting its use of 如果…，就…. It has four verses — clapping, stomping, shouting “Wonderful!”, and doing all three — and every verse is built on 如果(感到)开心你就跟我…. The song’s words are not copied here.

examples.text: 如果你考了一百分，爸爸就高兴死了。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ kǎo le yì bǎi fēn bà bà jiù gāo xìng sǐ le — If you get a hundred, Dad will be dead happy.

examples.text: 我还是想不及格吧，爸爸你可别死！
examples.translation: wǒ hái shì xiǎng bù jí gé ba bà bà nǐ kě bié sǐ — I’d better fail instead; Dad, don’t you die!

options: A cause and an effect that already happened

exercises.prompt: Which of the two words indicates the result?
exercises.explanation: 如果 gives the condition, 就 the result.

exercises.prompt: Where can the subject of the first clause go?
exercises.explanation: 如果明天下雨 / 明天如果下雨.

exercises.prompt: Where can the second subject go?
What does 如果天气不好，我们就不去海边散步 mean?
options: We walk at the beach because it’s bad
If the weather is bad, we won’t walk at the beach

exercises.prompt: What does 好吃你就多吃点儿 mean?
options: If it tastes good, eat some more
我们如果就明天下雨不去爬山了。
明天如果下雨，就我们不去爬山了。
明天如果下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
如果明天下雨，就我们不去爬山了。

exercises.prompt: Which is the best match for 你不喜欢去看电影，…?
Which is the best match for 这个公寓没有停车位，…?
options: 我们就去中国饭馆吃饭。

exercises.prompt: ___果没什么问题，下周一我们就可以签合同。
如果明天下雨，我们___不去爬山了。
明天___果下雨，我们就不去爬山了。

lessons.title: 263. Lesson 10 Presentation 2 skill integration: signing the contract, kitchen appliances
lessons.subtitle: 签了合同 · 钥匙 · 搬家 · 微波炉 烤箱 抽油烟机 · 在中国住过的地方

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: New words (生词): 微波炉 wēibōlú microwave; 钥匙 yàoshi key; 搬家 bānjiā move (residence). A. Listen to the monolog and write a summary (audio, not included). B. Read the passage and answer: 1. What are the advantages of this apartment? 2. What are the disadvantages? 3. What items is the speaker likely to buy this weekend? C. Compare your answers with a partner. D. In Chinese, tell your partner about your experiences looking for houses, apartments or dorms, including a description of those housing options. From the passage: advantages are the new look, the big living room, the safe environment and convenient transportation; disadvantages are the kitchenware that is not complete and no furniture in the dining room and the two bedrooms; this weekend he will probably buy furniture, bedding and kitchen things.

examples.text: 今天上午，我的老同学带我一起去看我想租的公寓。这是一个两室一厅的房子，看起来非常新。客厅挺大的，能有三十多平米，还带了一个双人沙发和一个新的地毯。厨房有一些厨具，不是很全，有一个冰箱，一个微波炉和一个洗碗机。饭厅不太大，也没有家具。不过这不是很大的问题，因为我就一个人住在这里。平时我也不太喜欢做饭，常常去饭馆吃。我看了一下卧室，觉得挺好的，主卧室很大，卫生间也很大。另一个卧室不太大，可以作客人房，也可以作书房。两个卧室都没有家具。公寓的环境很安全，而且交通也方便，我们都很喜欢，最后，我和王经理签了合同，也付了一个月的房租和押金。王经理给了我公寓的钥匙。这个周末，我得去商店买很多东西，然后准备搬家。
examples.translation: jīn tiān shàng wǔ wǒ de lǎo tóng xué dài wǒ yì qǐ qù kàn wǒ xiǎng zū de gōng yù zhè shì yí gè liǎng shì yì tīng de fáng zi kàn qǐ lái fēi cháng xīn kè tīng tǐng dà de néng yǒu sān shí duō píng mǐ hái dài le yí gè shuāng rén shā fā hé yí gè xīn de dì tǎn chú fáng yǒu yì xiē chú jù bú shì hěn quán yǒu yí gè bīng xiāng yí gè wēi bō lú hé yí gè xǐ wǎn jī fàn tīng bú tài dà yě méi yǒu jiā jù bú guò zhè bú shì hěn dà de wèn tí yīn wèi wǒ jiù yí gè rén zhù zài zhè lǐ píng shí wǒ yě bú tài xǐ huān zuò fàn cháng cháng qù fàn guǎn chī wǒ kàn le yí xià wò shì jué de tǐng hǎo de zhǔ wò shì hěn dà wèi shēng jiān yě hěn dà lìng yí gè wò shì bú tài dà kě yǐ zuò kè rén fáng yě kě yǐ zuò shū fáng liǎng gè wò shì dōu méi yǒu jiā jù gōng yù de huán jìng hěn ān quán ér qiě jiāo tōng yě fāng biàn wǒ men dōu hěn xǐ huān zuì hòu wǒ hé wáng jīng lǐ qiān le hé tóng yě fù le yí gè yuè de fáng zū hé yā jīn wáng jīng lǐ gěi le wǒ gōng yù de yào shi zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ děi qù shāng diàn mǎi hěn duō dōng xī rán hòu zhǔn bèi bān jiā — This morning my old classmate took me to see the apartment I want to rent. It is a two-bedroom, one-living-room place and looks very new. The living room is quite big, about thirty-odd square meters, and comes with a double sofa and a new carpet. The kitchen has some kitchenware, not complete, with a refrigerator, a microwave and a dishwasher. The dining room is not very big and has no furniture. But this is not a big problem, because I live here by myself. I don’t much like cooking anyway and often eat out. I had a look at the bedrooms and thought they were quite good: the master bedroom is big and the bathroom is big too. The other bedroom is not very big and can be a guest room or a study. Neither bedroom has furniture. The apartment’s environment is very safe and transportation is also convenient; we both like it. In the end, I signed the contract with Manager Wang and also paid a month’s rent and deposit. Manager Wang gave me the apartment key. This weekend I have to go to the stores to buy a lot of things, and then get ready to move.

lessons.title: 264. Lesson 10 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: a roommate, a news story, a house in Las Vegas
lessons.subtitle: …好像… · 小是小，可是… · 麻雀虽小，五脏俱全

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Imagine you are now studying at MIIS and want to find a Chinese roommate for the apartment you are renting. Draw a layout of the apartment in your notebook and label the rooms in Chinese. B. Pair up. Show the apartment to your prospective renter (your partner) and specify which areas will be shared. During the showing the renter comments on the apartment using …好像…, while you respond with the patterns …小是小，可是… and 如果…，就…. Conclude the conversation by scheduling a time to sign the contract. Switch roles and repeat.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Form two groups of three. You are studying Chinese at Taiwan Normal University in Taipei and your teacher assigns a group project on rental apartments in Taiwan. In your online research you find an interesting news story; watch the video and write a summary in English with these guides: 1. What exactly is this news item about? 2. What’s unique about the apartment featured in the story? 3. What are the advantages of this type of apartment? B. Discuss what the Chinese proverb 麻雀虽小，五脏俱全 (máquè suīxiǎo, wǔzàng jùquán: although a sparrow is tiny, it has all its vital organs) refers to in this news story. C. Prepare a presentation comparing standard apartments with this new kind of rental arrangement, listing their advantages and disadvantages in Chinese. D. Present your findings to the class in Chinese. (The video is not included.)

explanations.body: A. Your Chinese friend wants to buy a house in Las Vegas. They send you a Chinese real estate agent’s video tour of the house to get your opinion. Switch roles and repeat. (The video is not included.)

lessons.title: 266. Lesson 10 Presentation 3: my parents’ house (passage)
lessons.subtitle: 两层楼的房子 · 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发 · 后院种着很多果树

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss. A. Where do your parents live? How many floors does their house have? B. What do you like about their home? Is there anything special about it? C. Do you have memories of your childhood home?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 我父母的房子
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters (for example 我父母的房子在紐約州的一個小城市).

examples.text: 我父母的房子在纽约州的一个小城市，是一个两层楼的房子。大门在房子的中间，两边都有一个大窗户。
examples.translation: wǒ fù mǔ de fáng zi zài niǔ yuē zhōu de yí gè xiǎo chéng shì shì yí gè liǎng céng lóu de fáng zi dà mén zài fáng zi de zhōng jiān liǎng biān dōu yǒu yí gè dà chuāng hù — My parents’ house is in a small city in New York State; it is a two-story house. The front door is in the middle of the house, with a big window on each side.

examples.text: 进了大门，你会看见一个客厅。客厅里摆着一张三人沙发，沙发前面是一张咖啡桌。客厅右边是厨房，厨房旁边是饭厅。饭厅里有一张饭桌和六把椅子。书房在客厅后面，书房对面是卫生间。
examples.translation: jìn le dà mén nǐ huì kàn jiàn yí gè kè tīng kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng sān rén shā fā shā fā qián miàn shì yì zhāng kā fēi zhuō kè tīng yòu biān shì chú fáng chú fáng páng biān shì fàn tīng fàn tīng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng fàn zhuō hé liù bǎ yǐ zi shū fáng zài kè tīng hòu miàn shū fáng duì miàn shì wèi shēng jiān — Going in through the front door, you will see a living room. In the living room is a three-person sofa, and in front of the sofa is a coffee table. To the right of the living room is the kitchen, and next to the kitchen is the dining room. In the dining room are a dining table and six chairs. The study is behind the living room, and across from the study is the bathroom.

examples.text: 楼上有三个卧室。中间的主卧室是我父母的房间，里面放着一张双人床，两个床头柜，还有一个很大的衣橱。主卧室的左边是我妹妹的卧室，右边是我的卧室。我父母的房子还有一个地下室和一个车库。
examples.translation: lóu shàng yǒu sān gè wò shì zhōng jiān de zhǔ wò shì shì wǒ fù mǔ de fáng jiān lǐ miàn fàng zhe yì zhāng shuāng rén chuáng liǎng gè chuáng tóu guì hái yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yī chú zhǔ wò shì de zuǒ biān shì wǒ mèi mèi de wò shì yòu biān shì wǒ de wò shì wǒ fù mǔ de fáng zi hái yǒu yí gè dì xià shì hé yí gè chē kù — Upstairs are three bedrooms. The master bedroom in the middle is my parents’ room; in it are a double bed, two nightstands and a very big closet. To the left of the master bedroom is my younger sister’s bedroom, and to the right is mine. My parents’ house also has a basement and a garage.

examples.text: 房子的前院是个小花园。后院种着很多果树，还有一个菜园。
examples.translation: fáng zi de qián yuàn shì gè xiǎo huā yuán hòu yuàn zhòng zhe hěn duō guǒ shù hái yǒu yí gè cài yuán — The front yard of the house is a small garden. The backyard is planted with many fruit trees, and there is also a vegetable garden.

explanations.title: Activities 1 to 4
explanations.body: Activity 1. A. Listen to Presentation 3 and summarize it aloud (audio, not included). B. Listen again and write, in characters or pinyin, the names of the items pictured; fill in the house diagram with the room types and the furniture mentioned (pictures, not included). C. In Chinese, compare your work with a partner. Activity 2. A. Listen to a description of David’s house and label the rooms and the furniture on a layout of upstairs (楼上) and downstairs (楼下) (audio, not included). B. Describe the upstairs to a partner while they describe the downstairs. Activity 3. Pair up. On the map, write the name of each building or geographical feature in pinyin or characters (a hospital, a mountain, a furniture store, a restaurant, a cinema, a gym, a library; the map is not included), then write a description of the location of four places using 左边, 右边, 旁边, 对面, 前面, 后面 and 中间. The book’s example is 体育馆在图书馆的前面，饭馆的对面 (the gym is in front of the library and across from the restaurant). B. Share your work with the class. Activity 4. A. Pair up and tell your partner about where you live, using these questions as a guide. B. Write your partner’s description of their housing in pinyin or characters. C. Check your partner’s notes and correct any inaccuracies.

examples.text: 体育馆在图书馆的前面，饭馆的对面。
examples.translation: tǐ yù guǎn zài tú shū guǎn de qián miàn fàn guǎn de duì miàn — The gym is in front of the library and across from the restaurant.
