lessons.title: 267. Lesson 10 Presentation 3 grammar: the position words 左边 右边 旁边 中间 前面 后面 对面 里面
lessons.subtitle: 桌子上边 · 医院对面 · 厨房右边 · 房子的右边 / 右边的房子

explanations.title: The position words
explanations.body: Many position words are formed by attaching the suffix 边 or 面 to directional words like 左/右, 里/外, 上/下 or 前/后. You may also place a noun immediately before a position word to further specify its position, for example 厨房左边 or 学校前面. The book’s table: 左, 右, 里, 外, 上, 下, 前, 后 + 边 or 面, and 中间 and 对面 by themselves.

tables.title: Position words

explanations.title: Position words as subjects, objects and attributives
explanations.body: Position words can be subjects, objects or attributives. A position word specifies a location with a reference point. Chinese positional order is the reverse of English: Noun + Position in Chinese, Position + Noun in English.

examples.text: 我家房子的前边有一家商店。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā fáng zi de qián biān yǒu yì jiā shāng diàn — There is a store in front of my house. (subject)

examples.text: 日本饭馆在那个大楼的后面。
examples.translation: rì běn fàn guǎn zài nà ge dà lóu de hòu miàn — The Japanese restaurant is at the back of that building. (object)

examples.text: 左边的那张桌子是我的。
examples.translation: zuǒ biān de nà zhāng zhuō zi shì wǒ de — The desk on the left is mine. (attributive)

examples.text: 对面的那个大楼是中国银行。
examples.translation: duì miàn de nà ge dà lóu shì zhōng guó yín háng — The building opposite is the Bank of China. (attributive)

examples.text: 桌子上边
examples.translation: zhuō zi shàng biān — on top of the table

examples.text: 医院对面
examples.translation: yī yuàn duì miàn — opposite of the hospital

examples.text: 厨房右边
examples.translation: chú fáng yòu biān — to the right of the kitchen

examples.text: 书房和客厅中间
examples.translation: shū fáng hé kè tīng zhōng jiān — in the middle of the study and the living room

explanations.title: Modifier before the element it modifies
explanations.body: In Chinese a modifier always comes before the element it modifies. It is the same for position words when they modify a noun. In 房子的右边 (the right side of the house) 右边 is a noun, while in 右边的房子 (the house on the right) it is an adjective.

examples.text: 房子的右边
examples.translation: fáng zi de yòu biān — the right side of the house

examples.text: 右边的房子
examples.translation: yòu biān de fáng zi — the house on the right

explanations.title: Activities 1 to 3
explanations.body: Activity 1. A. Listen to the audio and draw in your notebook a layout of the university described (Xiamen University, 厦门大学; audio and picture not included). B. Compare layouts with a partner, then use position words to discuss the location of your class building and its surroundings. Activity 2 (Reading and Writing). Pair up and, from the images (not included), complete the sentences with position words: 这是我的老家 (图书馆, 学校, 医院, 电影院 …); the five presidents 老布什, 奥巴马, 小布什, 克林顿 and 卡特 (小布什, 老布什, 卡特 …); and 这是小明的卧室 (小明的床, 床头柜, 闹钟, 室内植物, 地毯 …). Activity 3. A. Complete the sentences from the seating picture of 大卫, 张文, 李红, 琳达, 林东, 王英, 夏冬 and 白雪; the book starts with 白雪坐在王英的左边, and then 林东, 王英, 大卫 and 张文 … B. Compare sentences with a partner. C. Take turns describing your classmates’ seating with 左边, 右边, 旁边, 中间, 前面, 后面 and/or 对面.

lessons.title: 268. Lesson 10 Presentation 3 grammar: the particle 着
lessons.subtitle: 摆着 放着 种着 · 开着 拿着 穿着 躺着 · 坐着讲课 站着看书

explanations.title: 着 for existence
explanations.body: When used to indicate that something exists in a certain location, 着 pairs with a stative verb to indicate stasis. Pattern: Place + Stative Verb + 着 + Object.

examples.text: 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发。
examples.translation: kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng sān rén shā fā — There is a three-person sofa in the living room.

examples.text: 主卧室里放着一张双人床。
examples.translation: zhǔ wò shì lǐ fàng zhe yì zhāng shuāng rén chuáng — There is a double bed in the master bedroom.

examples.text: 院子里种着很多花和果树。
examples.translation: yuàn zi lǐ zhòng zhe hěn duō huā hé guǒ shù — Many flowers and fruit trees are planted in the yard.

explanations.title: 着 as the continuous aspect marker
explanations.body: 着 is also the continuous aspect marker, most often used with ongoing or static action verbs like 开, 关, 穿, 戴 and 躺. Pattern: Verb + 着.

examples.text: 他的电脑在开着。
examples.translation: tā de diàn nǎo zài kāi zhe — His computer is on.

examples.text: 你手里拿着什么书？
examples.translation: nǐ shǒu lǐ ná zhe shén me shū — What book are you holding?

examples.text: 马克今天穿着一件蓝色衬衫。
examples.translation: mǎ kè jīn tiān chuān zhe yí jiàn lán sè chèn shān — Mark is wearing a blue shirt today.

examples.text: 琳达躺着在沙发上看电视。
examples.translation: lín dá tǎng zhe zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn shì — Linda is lying on the couch watching TV.

explanations.title: 着 for the manner of another action
explanations.body: Finally, 着 is used when one action describes the manner or state in which another action is performed. Pattern: Verb 1 + 着 + Verb 2.

examples.text: 王老师喜欢坐着讲课。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī xǐ huān zuò zhe jiǎng kè — Professor Wang likes to sit while teaching.

examples.text: 大卫喜欢站着看书。
examples.translation: dà wèi xǐ huān zhàn zhe kàn shū — David likes to stand while reading.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the conversation and complete the transcript in pinyin or characters (audio, not included). B. Pair up and determine whether each 着 in the dialog is an existential or a continuous aspect marker. C. With your partner, write two or more sentences with 着, one expressing existence and one a continuing action or state. D. Read your sentences to the class. The book prints the transcript with blanks; my completion (all the 着 here are existential):

examples.text: 甲：琳达，你这个公寓里住着几个人？
examples.translation: jiǎ lín dá nǐ zhè ge gōng yù lǐ zhù zhe jǐ gè rén — Linda, how many people live in this apartment of yours?

examples.text: 乙：一共三个人，我，珍妮和玛丽。
examples.translation: yǐ yí gòng sān gè rén wǒ zhēn nī hé mǎ lì — Three people altogether: me, Jenny and Mary.

examples.text: 甲：你们的客厅里都有什么家具？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ men de kè tīng lǐ dōu yǒu shén me jiā jù — What furniture do you have in your living room?

examples.text: 乙：客厅里放着一个沙发，两把椅子，和一张咖啡桌。
examples.translation: yǐ kè tīng lǐ fàng zhe yí gè shā fā liǎng bǎ yǐ zi hé yì zhāng kā fēi zhuō — In the living room are a sofa, two chairs and a coffee table.

examples.text: 甲：你们的厨房和饭厅大不大？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ men de chú fáng hé fàn tīng dà bú dà — Are your kitchen and dining room big?

examples.text: 乙：不太大。厨房旁边摆着一张饭桌和三把椅子，就是我们吃饭的地方。
examples.translation: yǐ bú tài dà chú fáng páng biān bǎi zhe yì zhāng fàn zhuō hé sān bǎ yǐ zi jiù shì wǒ men chī fàn de dì fāng — Not very. Beside the kitchen are a dining table and three chairs; that’s where we eat.

examples.text: 甲：这个公寓有车库吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge gōng yù yǒu chē kù ma — Does this apartment have a garage?

examples.text: 乙：有，可是只有一个停车位。现在车库停着珍妮的车。
examples.translation: yǐ yǒu kě shì zhǐ yǒu yí gè tíng chē wèi xiàn zài chē kù tíng zhe zhēn nī de chē — Yes, but there is only one parking space. Right now Jenny’s car is parked in the garage.

explanations.title: Activities 5, 6 and 7
explanations.body: Activity 5. Pair up. For each image (not included) use 着 and the words provided to ask and answer questions: 穿 with clothes, pants and shoes; 拿 with a book; 背 with a school bag; a coffee table with 摆 and flowers; the bedroom with 放, a bed, a nightstand and a carpet; the yard with 种, flowers and trees. Write your partner’s answers in the blanks, label each 着 as existential or continuous, and check each other’s work. The book’s example is 这个客厅里摆着什么？ (existential) with the answer 这个客厅里摆着一个沙发，地毯和电视, and 他手里拿着什么？ (continuous) with 他手里拿着咖啡. Activity 6. Take turns describing six pictures with “Verb 1 + 着 + Verb 2”, then write your partner’s descriptions; the example is 她在办公室坐着打电话 / 她在办公室坐着写字. Activity 7 (Speaking and Listening): Guess Who! 猜一猜是谁！ Using 着, describe a classmate’s dress, posture or behavior while the others guess who it is; the first to guess describes another student until everyone has been described.

examples.text: 他手里拿着咖啡。
examples.translation: tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe kā fēi — He is holding a coffee in his hand.

examples.text: 这个客厅里摆着一个沙发，地毯和电视。
examples.translation: zhè ge kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yí gè shā fā dì tǎn hé diàn shì — In this living room are a sofa, a carpet and a TV.

examples.text: 她在办公室坐着打电话。
examples.translation: tā zài bàn gōng shì zuò zhe dǎ diàn huà — She sits in the office making a phone call.

examples.text: 她在办公室坐着写字。
examples.translation: tā zài bàn gōng shì zuò zhe xiě zì — She sits in the office writing.

exercises.prompt: What does 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发 mean?

lessons.title: 272. Lesson 10 Area Studies: housing conditions and infrastructure in China
lessons.subtitle: 国家中心城市 · 人口密度 · 人均住房面积 · 高铁

explanations.title: Housing conditions and infrastructure in China (1)
explanations.body: Due to China’s large population and land mass, living conditions vary greatly. Currently the world’s most populous country at 1,394,015,977, China’s urban population represents 61.4% of the total (July 2020 est.). Compounding this challenge, China’s overall population density is 153 people per square kilometer, or 397 people per square mile. In comparison, US population density is only 92.9 people per square mile. Living conditions have improved dramatically since economic reforms began in 1978, especially in the large cities and coastal regions. Back then, the floor area per person for urban residents was only 6.7 square meters; it has now risen to 36.9 square meters. Most urban residents live in apartment buildings and some new wealthy residents live in mansions. (The book’s photographs are not included.)

explanations.title: Infrastructure and the nine national central cities
explanations.body: Economic reform has greatly improved China’s transportation system and overall infrastructure. By the end of 2019, 40 cities had opened 211 urban rail lines spanning 6,730 kilometers. As of December 2019, the total high-speed rail mileage exceeded 35,000 kilometers and the total mileage of routes operating over 300 kph exceeded 10,000 kilometers, accounting for more than two thirds of all global high speed rail. China now has more than 54,000 three-star or higher hotels, and the addition of many shopping centers, parks and recreational areas has further increased people’s quality of life. In the wake of rapid economic development, nine major “national central cities” (国家中心城市) have emerged in China: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chongqing, Tianjin, Wuhan, Chengdu, Zhengzhou and Xi’an. These metropolises not only play a central role in China’s economic development, they also compose a national grid to strategically drive regional development, compete internationally, and enhance China’s reputation and standing in the world.

tables.title: 国家中心城市

explanations.title: The countryside
explanations.body: While living conditions in the countryside still lag behind those in the cities, the floor area per person of rural residents reached 46.7 square meters in 2017, which is more spacious than that of their urban counterparts. Many rural residents still reside in homes built into caves or made from bamboo, or in yurts and other traditional dwellings. However, economic reforms have allowed some rural areas to prosper, resulting in construction booms with large, modern houses built in traditionally rural and undeveloped areas.

explanations.body: By the end of the lesson you will be able to open an account and deposit money at a Chinese bank, exchange currency, discuss online banking registration and services, and explain how to use Mobile Pay in China. explanations.title: The interrogative 怎么 (1)
explanations.body: 怎么 can be used to ask “how”, as in 我想开个账户，怎么办手续？ (I’d like to open an account. How do I apply?). When 怎么 is used as an interrogative adverb to ask how to carry out a specific action, it occurs between the subject and its predicate: Subject + 怎么 + Verb?

examples.text: 这个表怎么填？
examples.translation: zhè ge biǎo zěn me tián — How do I fill in this form?

examples.text: 我怎么兑换外币？
examples.translation: wǒ zěn me duì huàn wài bì — How do I exchange foreign currency?

examples.text: 你常常怎么锻炼身体？
examples.translation: nǐ cháng cháng zěn me duàn liàn shēn tǐ — How do you usually work out?

examples.text: 你怎么学中文？
examples.translation: nǐ zěn me xué zhōng wén — How do you study Chinese?

examples.text: 怎么写你的中文名字？
examples.translation: zěn me xiě nǐ de zhōng wén míng zì — How do you write your Chinese name?

examples.text: 在中国的银行，怎么开户？
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó de yín háng zěn me kāi hù — At a bank in China, how do you open an account?

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking). Complete the six sentences using 怎么, then pair up and read your partner’s questions aloud: 1. 请问去农贸市场___? 2. 营业员，请问定期存款___? 3. 王老师，中国的饺子很好吃，请问___? 4. 这个字我不认识，请问___? 5. 我还没有找到住的地方，请问___? 6. 这个苹果手机是新的，你知道___? The book gives no key; my completions:

examples.text: 请问去农贸市场怎么走？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn qù nóng mào shì chǎng zěn me zǒu — Excuse me, how do I get to the farmers’ market?

examples.text: 营业员，请问定期存款怎么存？
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán qǐng wèn dìng qī cún kuǎn zěn me cún — Clerk, how do I make a fixed-term deposit?

examples.text: 王老师，中国的饺子很好吃，请问怎么做？
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī zhōng guó de jiǎo zi hěn hǎo chī qǐng wèn zěn me zuò — Teacher Wang, Chinese dumplings are delicious; how are they made?

examples.text: 这个字我不认识，请问怎么读？
examples.translation: zhè ge zì wǒ bú rèn shí qǐng wèn zěn me dú — I don’t know this character; how is it read?

examples.text: 我还没有找到住的地方，请问怎么找房子？
examples.translation: wǒ hái méi yǒu zhǎo dào zhù de dì fāng qǐng wèn zěn me zhǎo fáng zi — I haven’t found a place to live yet; how do I look for a house?

examples.text: 这个苹果手机是新的，你知道怎么用吗？
examples.translation: zhè ge píng guǒ shǒu jī shì xīn de nǐ zhī dào zěn me yòng ma — This Apple phone is new; do you know how to use it?

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. You and a partner have just arrived at Qinghua University (清华大学) to begin advanced Chinese studies at the Inter-University Program (IUP, or “Stanford Center”). Write four “how to” questions using 怎么 to ask the University’s International Office. B. Read your list to the class; the class combines the ten best questions into a new list. C. Call the International Office and ask your questions in turn; your teacher plays the representative who answers the phone.

explanations.title: How to read decimals
explanations.body: Numbers before the decimal point are read the same as integers (whole numbers). Zeros before the decimal point are read 零. Decimal points are read as 点(儿), meaning “point” or “dot”. Numbers after the decimal point are read separately as digits. Patterns: 零 + 点 + Digits; Integer + 点 + Digits.

tables.title: Reading decimals

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Writing): exchange rates
explanations.body: A. Look up the exchange rates for the currencies in the table dated 2017年12月15日星期五 (人民币兑换率 for 100 units of each foreign currency), then complete the sentences by writing the rates in decimals; for example the rate for euros to renminbi is 1:7.78 (= 100:778.30). B. With your partner, use an online currency converter to write today’s exchange rates in Chinese for 英镑, 美元, 港币, 新台币, 日元, 加元 and 新西兰元 (1 unit each). C. Which is higher, the exchange rate for USD to renminbi in part A, or today’s? What might be the cause? The 2017 table and my readings of the five rates:

tables.title: The five rates, as decimals

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. You and two partners want to visit Hong Kong, Taiwan or Beijing. Look up the exchange rates in the three places and fill in a table (Destination, Exchange Rate, Estimated Cost of Trip). B. In Chinese, discuss which destination you want to go to and why. C. In Chinese, report to the class or teacher what you have decided, with the reasons, the exchange rate and the estimated cost of a trip.

exercises.prompt: Where does 怎么 go in a question about how to do something?
options: Between the subject and the predicate

exercises.prompt: What does 这个表怎么填？ ask?
options: How do I fill in this form?
exercises.explanation: 怎么填: how to fill in.

exercises.prompt: What does 我怎么兑换外币？ ask?
options: How do I exchange foreign currency?

exercises.prompt: What does 怎么写你的中文名字？ ask?
options: How do you write your Chinese name?

exercises.explanation: Digits after the point are read separately.

exercises.prompt: What does 点 mean in decimals?
exercises.explanation: Decimal points are read as 点(儿).
怎么填: how to fill in.
怎么走: how to get there.

lessons.title: 275. Lesson 11 Presentation 1 grammar: 这么 (so; in this way)
lessons.subtitle: 这么高？ · 这么写 · 这么冷 · 这么多 · 这么麻烦你

explanations.title: 这么
explanations.body: 这么 is placed before adjectives and verbs to convey the meaning “so…” or “in such a manner”. Patterns: 这么 + Adjective; 这么 + Verb.

examples.text: 这么高？那我换三百美元吧。
examples.translation: zhè me gāo nà wǒ huàn sān bǎi měi yuán ba — That high? Then I’ll exchange USD 300.

examples.text: 这个汉字应该这么写。
examples.translation: zhè ge hàn zì yīng gāi zhè me xiě — This Chinese character should be written like this.

examples.text: 今天的天气这么冷，我不想出去了。
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì zhè me lěng wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù le — The weather is so cold today that I don’t want to go out.

examples.text: “做饭日”做的饭这么多，我们都吃不完。
examples.translation: zuò fàn rì zuò de fàn zhè me duō wǒ men dōu chī bù wán — So much food was made on “cooking day” that we can’t finish it all.

examples.text: 这双皮鞋这么大，我穿不了。
examples.translation: zhè shuāng pí xié zhè me dà wǒ chuān bù liǎo — These shoes are so big that I can’t wear them.

examples.text: 这么走，什么时候才可以走到？
examples.translation: zhè me zǒu shén me shí hòu cái kě yǐ zǒu dào — Walking like this, when will we ever get there?

examples.text: 我这么麻烦你，真是非常不好意思。
examples.translation: wǒ zhè me má fán nǐ zhēn shì fēi cháng bù hǎo yì sī — I’m troubling you so much; I’m really very sorry.

lessons.title: 276. Lesson 11 Presentation 1 skill integration: current vs fixed accounts, and the exchange-rate joke
lessons.subtitle: 活期账户 定期账户 · 一卡通 · 网络笑话：该不该把钱换成美元

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a dialog and decide whether these statements are True or False (the dialog is audio, so no key is given here). B. Compare answers with a partner and explain your reasoning in Chinese. C. Read the script your teacher provides and perform the dialog with your partner. The statements (the book prints 5000 as digits; spelled out here):

examples.text: 在银行存美元，需要先填表，开个账户。
examples.translation: zài yín háng cún měi yuán xū yào xiān tián biǎo kāi gè zhàng hù — To deposit US dollars at a bank, you need to fill in a form first and open an account.

examples.text: 活期存款和定期存款没什么不同。
examples.translation: huó qī cún kuǎn hé dìng qī cún kuǎn méi shén me bù tóng — Current and fixed deposits are not different.

examples.text: 活期存款可以随时取钱，比较方便。
examples.translation: huó qī cún kuǎn kě yǐ suí shí qǔ qián bǐ jiào fāng biàn — With a current deposit you can withdraw money any time, which is more convenient.

examples.text: 小陈开了一个定期存款账户。
examples.translation: xiǎo chén kāi le yí gè dìng qī cún kuǎn zhàng hù — Xiao Chen opened a fixed-term deposit account.

examples.text: 营业员需要看小陈的学生证。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán xū yào kàn xiǎo chén de xué shēng zhèng — The clerk needs to see Xiao Chen’s student ID.

examples.text: 小陈第一次开账户就存了五千美元。
examples.translation: xiǎo chén dì yī cì kāi zhàng hù jiù cún le wǔ qiān měi yuán — Xiao Chen deposited 5,000 US dollars the first time he opened the account.

examples.text: 小陈只能提取人民币。
examples.translation: xiǎo chén zhǐ néng tí qǔ rén mín bì — Xiao Chen can only withdraw RMB.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Listen to Part 1 of a dialog and answer the questions while your partner listens to Part 2. Student A (Part 1): 1. What does the first speaker want to do? 2. What does the second speaker ask the first speaker for? 3. What does the first speaker decide to do? 4. What does the second speaker recommend? Student B (Part 2): 1. What can the customer expect in a week? 2. What can he do now? 3. How much cash can the customer withdraw today, and what bill denominations does he want? 4. What was yesterday’s exchange rate? B. Exchange the information about your dialog with your partner in Chinese. C. Check your answers against the script your teacher provides, then listen to the entire dialog again. D. In Chinese, summarize what Mark did for your partner. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking): a Chinese bank web page
explanations.body: A. You need to deposit some money at the bank. Read the web page from a Chinese bank, then fill in the table (type of account, time requirement, minimum deposit, rules for deposit and withdrawal, interest rates). B. Compare your table with your partner’s in Chinese. C. Tell each other in Chinese how you would like to deposit your money and why. The page, with the numbers spelled out, is titled 定期帐户和活期帐户:

examples.text: 在中国的银行开户，可以有两种选择：活期账户或定期账户。活期存款账户没有存期要求，可以用银行卡或存折在银行的营业厅或自动取款机上随时存款或提取现金。人民币活期存款一元起存，外币活期存款金额为不低于人民币二十元的外汇。定期存款一般来说是不能随时取的，存款时间可以是三个月，也可以是十年以上。定期存款的存款时间越长，利率就越高。定期开户五十元起存。你可以直接把现金存为定期存款，用卡就可以存钱，现在的存款卡叫做“一卡通”。定期存款提取方式有三种：第一种：到期的时候，取出全部的存款，银行给你所有的利息；第二种：到期以前取出全部的存款，银行按取钱那一天的活期存款利率计算利息；第三种：到期以前取一部分的存款，提出来的钱的利息按活期计算，别的还是按定期算。另外，你可以把定期换成活期，也可以把活期换成定期。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó de yín háng kāi hù kě yǐ yǒu liǎng zhǒng xuǎn zé huó qī zhàng hù huò dìng qī zhàng hù huó qī cún kuǎn zhàng hù méi yǒu cún qī yāo qiú kě yǐ yòng yín háng kǎ huò cún zhé zài yín háng de yíng yè tīng huò zì dòng qǔ kuǎn jī shàng suí shí cún kuǎn huò tí qǔ xiàn jīn rén mín bì huó qī cún kuǎn yì yuán qǐ cún wài bì huó qī cún kuǎn jīn é wèi bù dī yú rén mín bì èr shí yuán de wài huì dìng qī cún kuǎn yì bān lái shuō shì bù néng suí shí qǔ de cún kuǎn shí jiān kě yǐ shì sān gè yuè yě kě yǐ shì shí nián yǐ shàng dìng qī cún kuǎn de cún kuǎn shí jiān yuè zhǎng lì lǜ jiù yuè gāo dìng qī kāi hù wǔ shí yuán qǐ cún nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē bǎ xiàn jīn cún wèi dìng qī cún kuǎn yòng kǎ jiù kě yǐ cún qián xiàn zài de cún kuǎn kǎ jiào zuò yì kǎ tōng dìng qī cún kuǎn tí qǔ fāng shì yǒu sān zhǒng dì yī zhǒng dào qī de shí hòu qǔ chū quán bù de cún kuǎn yín háng gěi nǐ suǒ yǒu de lì xī dì èr zhǒng dào qī yǐ qián qǔ chū quán bù de cún kuǎn yín háng àn qǔ qián nà yì tiān de huó qī cún kuǎn lì lǜ jì suàn lì xī dì sān zhǒng dào qī yǐ qián qǔ yí bù fèn de cún kuǎn tí chū lái de qián de lì xī àn huó qī jì suàn bié de hái shì àn dìng qī suàn lìng wài nǐ kě yǐ bǎ dìng qī huàn chéng huó qī yě kě yǐ bǎ huó qī huàn chéng dìng qī — There are two options for opening an account at a bank in China: a current account or a fixed-term account. A current account has no deposit-period requirement; you can deposit or withdraw cash any time with a bank card or passbook at the bank’s hall or at an ATM. A current RMB deposit starts from 1 yuan, and a current foreign-currency deposit must be foreign exchange worth no less than 20 yuan. A fixed-term deposit generally cannot be withdrawn at any time; the term can be 3 months or more than 10 years, and the longer the term, the higher the interest rate. A fixed-term account starts from 50 yuan. You can deposit cash directly as a fixed deposit, and with a card you can deposit money; the current deposit card is called the “One Card”. There are three ways to withdraw a fixed deposit: first, at maturity you take out the whole deposit and the bank gives you all the interest; second, if you take out the whole deposit before maturity, the bank calculates the interest at the current-deposit rate of the day you withdraw; third, if you take out part of the deposit before maturity, the interest on the part withdrawn is calculated at the current rate and the rest still at the fixed rate. You can also change a fixed deposit into a current one, or a current one into a fixed one.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading): an internet joke
explanations.body: Read the article 网络笑话：该不该把钱换成美元 (Internet joke: should you change your money into US dollars?) and answer: 1. What happened to the American in the article? 2. What made him so happy? 3. What phenomenon allowed this to occur? (The book prints the amounts as digits.) The article (the answers are mine: he came with 100,000 dollars and left with 100,000 dollars while spending 180,000 yuan; he was happy because it was as if he had spent nothing; the RMB appreciated against the dollar):

examples.text: 有个美国人到中国旅游，用十万美元兑换到六十八万元人民币。他在中国吃喝玩乐了一年，花了十八万元人民币。一年后，他准备回国，于是到银行兑回美元，此时人民币升值，这位美国人用剩下的五十万元人民币换到了十万美元。来时十万美元，回去还是十万美元，等于没花钱，他高高兴兴地回家了。
examples.translation: yǒu gè měi guó rén dào zhōng guó lǚ yóu yòng shí wàn měi yuán duì huàn dào liù shí bā wàn yuán rén mín bì tā zài zhōng guó chī hē wán lè le yì nián huā le shí bā wàn yuán rén mín bì yì nián hòu tā zhǔn bèi huí guó yú shì dào yín háng duì huí měi yuán cǐ shí rén mín bì shēng zhí zhè wèi měi guó rén yòng shèng xià de wǔ shí wàn yuán rén mín bì huàn dào le shí wàn měi yuán lái shí shí wàn měi yuán huí qù hái shì shí wàn měi yuán děng yú méi huā qián tā gāo gāo xìng xìng dì huí jiā le — An American went to China to travel and exchanged 100,000 US dollars for 680,000 yuan. He spent a year eating, drinking and having fun in China, spending 180,000 yuan. A year later he got ready to go home, so he went to the bank to change back to dollars; at that time the RMB had appreciated, and with his remaining 500,000 yuan the American got 100,000 US dollars. He came with 100,000 dollars and went back with 100,000 dollars; it was as if he had spent no money, and he went home very happy.

exercises.prompt: How many kinds of account can you open at a Chinese bank?
Can you withdraw from a current account any time?
What is the minimum for a current RMB deposit?
exercises.explanation: 人民币活期存款一元起存。

exercises.prompt: What is the minimum for a fixed-term deposit?

exercises.prompt: What is the rule on interest and the term?

exercises.explanation: 存款时间越长，利率就越高。

exercises.prompt: If you withdraw the whole fixed deposit before maturity, what happens?

exercises.prompt: What is the deposit card called?
How much RMB did the American in the joke get for 100,000 dollars?

How much RMB did he have left?
exercises.explanation: 用剩下的五十万元人民币.

exercises.prompt: Why did he come out even?
options: The bank gave him a gift

exercises.explanation: 升值 (shēng zhí) means “to appreciate (in value)”.

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss. A. Do you bank online? What do you like most and least about it? B. What kind of online services do American banks provide? C. What services do you use regularly?

lessons.title: 280. Lesson 11 Presentation 2 grammar: 怎么 meaning “why”, and 怎么样 for “how about it?”
lessons.subtitle: 怎么没来？ · 怎么不…？ · 怎么今天… · 一起去吃饭，怎么样？ · 烤鸭怎么样？

explanations.title: The interrogative 怎么 (2): “why”, “how come”
explanations.body: 怎么 may be used to ask “why” or “how come”, as in 怎么不在网上交？ (Why don’t you pay online?). It can occur before or after the subject: Subject + 怎么 + Verb Phrase; 怎么 + Subject + Verb Phrase.

examples.text: 甲：陆老师今天怎么没来？
examples.translation: jiǎ lù lǎo shī jīn tiān zěn me méi lái — Why didn’t Teacher Lu come today?

examples.text: 乙：她去日本了。
examples.translation: yǐ tā qù rì běn le — She went to Japan.

examples.text: 我们去旧金山那天，你怎么不多买几本中文书？
examples.translation: wǒ men qù jiù jīn shān nà tiān nǐ zěn me bù duō mǎi jǐ běn zhōng wén shū — The day we went to San Francisco, why didn’t you buy a few more Chinese books?

examples.text: 明天要考试，你怎么还不看书？
examples.translation: míng tiān yào kǎo shì nǐ zěn me hái bú kàn shū — There is an exam tomorrow; why aren’t you studying yet?

examples.text: 怎么今天早上空军没集合？
examples.translation: zěn me jīn tiān zǎo shàng kōng jūn méi jí hé — Why didn’t the Air Force assemble this morning?

examples.text: 怎么你又回答错了？
examples.translation: zěn me nǐ yòu huí dá cuò le — How come you answered wrong again?

examples.text: 怎么你不给你的父母打电话？
examples.translation: zěn me nǐ bù gěi nǐ de fù mǔ dǎ diàn huà — Why don’t you call your parents?

explanations.title: Stress changes the meaning
explanations.body: The question 他怎么去中国？ can mean two different things, depending on where in the sentence the stress falls. When 怎么 is stressed, it means “how is he going to China?”, that is, by what means of transportation. When 去中国 is stressed, it means “why is he going to China?”, that is, why China specifically (and not someplace else), or what compels him to go there.

examples.text: 他怎么去中国？
examples.translation: tā zěn me qù zhōng guó — With 怎么 stressed: how is he going to China (by what means of transportation)?

examples.text: 他怎么去中国？
examples.translation: tā zěn me qù zhōng guó — With 去中国 stressed: why is he going to China (why China specifically, or what compels him to go)?

explanations.title: The interrogative 怎么样 (2)
explanations.body: 怎么样 can be used to ask for consent or an opinion in an open-ended way, similar to the English “How about it?” or “What do you think?” This use of 怎么样 most often appears after a noun or at the end of a sentence: Sentence + 怎么样？; Noun + 怎么样？

lessons.title: 281. Lesson 11 Presentation 2 grammar: 只要…就… (as long as)
lessons.subtitle: 只要注册一下就行了 · 你只要存美元，就可以取人民币 · 只要明天不下雨，我们就去冲浪

explanations.title: The construction 只要…就…
explanations.body: The conditional construction 只要…就… is similar to the English “as long as X, (then) Y”: as long as X occurs, Y will follow. 只要在银行的网站上注册一下就行了 (As long as you register on the bank’s website, that’ll do it). The conjunction 只要 in the first clause indicates the condition; the correlative adverb 就 in the second clause indicates the result. The subject of the first clause comes either before or after 只要, while the subject of the second clause always comes before 就. Patterns: 只要 + Condition, 就 + Result. Same subject: 只要 + Subject + VP, 就 + VP; 只要 + VP, Subject + 就 + VP; Subject + 只要 + VP, 就 + VP. Different subjects: 只要 + Subject 1 + VP, Subject 2 + 就 + VP; Subject 1 + 只要 + VP, Subject 2 + 就 + VP.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Use 只要…就… to connect the conditions on the left with their logical results on the right: 1. 有用户名和密码 2. 你中午有空 3. 你手机可以上网 4. 银行今天开门 5. 你有账号 6. 你给我打折; a. 去开账户 b. 可以直接存美元 c. 买这件夹克 d. 可以登录网上银行 e. 一起去吃午饭 f. 可以用苹果地图. You also need to add the subjects in the second clause. Check your completed sentences with a partner. B. With your partner, take turns reading three of your sentences to the class. My matching:

examples.text: 只要有用户名和密码，就可以登录网上银行。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào yǒu yòng hù míng hé mì mǎ jiù kě yǐ dēng lù wǎng shàng yín háng — As long as you have a username and password, you can log in to online banking.

examples.text: 只要你中午有空，我们就一起去吃午饭。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ zhōng wǔ yǒu kòng wǒ men jiù yì qǐ qù chī wǔ fàn — As long as you are free at noon, we’ll go to lunch together.

examples.text: 只要你手机可以上网，就可以用苹果地图。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ shǒu jī kě yǐ shàng wǎng jiù kě yǐ yòng píng guǒ dì tú — As long as your phone can go online, you can use Apple Maps.

examples.text: 只要银行今天开门，我们就去开账户。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào yín háng jīn tiān kāi mén wǒ men jiù qù kāi zhàng hù — As long as the bank is open today, we’ll go open an account.

examples.text: 只要你有账号，就可以直接存美元。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu zhàng hào jiù kě yǐ zhí jiē cún měi yuán — As long as you have an account number, you can deposit dollars directly.

examples.text: 只要你给我打折，我就买这件夹克。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ zhé wǒ jiù mǎi zhè jiàn jiá kè — As long as you give me a discount, I’ll buy this jacket.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Using 只要…就…, write five things you would do, given all the right conditions. B. In groups of three, read your ideas to your group. C. Vote for the three most interesting ideas and read them to the class.

options: Not only X, but also Y
If X, then Y was not possible
As long as X, then Y
exercises.explanation: 只要 gives the condition, 就 the result.

exercises.prompt: What does 就 indicate in this pattern?
Where can the subject of the first clause go?
Where must the subject of the second clause go?
What does 只要明天不下雨，我们就去冲浪 mean?
options: As long as it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we’ll go surfing
If it rains, we’ll go surfing
We’ll go surfing tomorrow no matter what

exercises.prompt: What does 你只要存美元，就可以取人民币 mean?
options: You need RMB to deposit dollars
As long as you deposit dollars, you can withdraw RMB

exercises.explanation: 就 follows the subject of the second clause.

exercises.prompt: Which is the best match for 只要银行今天开门，…?
Which is the best match for 只要你给我打折，…?
___要你好好学习，就一定能学好中文。
你只要存美元，就可以___人民币。

lessons.title: 282. Lesson 11 Presentation 2 skill integration: bank passages and the HSBC online-banking brochure
lessons.subtitle: 自动提款机 自助 一次性 · 中国建设银行 · 中国工商银行 · 如何注册使用个人网上银行

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. Where does this conversation take place (choose the correct picture)? 2. What does the first speaker want to tell the second? 3. What else does he want to do? 4. What exactly does the second speaker explain to the first? 5. What does the second speaker say about Chinese people compared to Americans? B. In groups of three compare answers. C. In Chinese, tell the others about an online banking service you used recently, and why and how you used it. (Audio, not included.) Activity 2 (Reading, Listening and Speaking). A. Pair up. Based on the characters you already know, fill in the pinyin and English meanings for each word in the supplementary vocabulary table (补充词汇). B. Listen to the passage and mark four statements true or false: 1. This passage is about online bank registration. 2. You must be at least 16 years old to register. 3. Having a username and password is the safest way to use the bank’s services. 4. Services include logging in, checking accounts, paying bills, transferring money and ordering food. C. Listen again and fill in a table with the different ways to register (means of registration and procedure). D. Check your work with a partner, then read the script your teacher provides. E. In Chinese, tell your partner how you prefer to register for an account online and how to do it. (Audio, not included.) The supplementary vocabulary (my readings):

tables.title: 补充词汇

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking): two banks
explanations.body: A. These two passages are about different Chinese banks. Read the first while your partner reads the second, then fill in your table (bank name, when established, size/scale, online services, other services); look up any words you don’t know. B. Exchange information with your partner in Chinese, then complete the second table with details from the other bank. C. Discuss in Chinese: 1. Which bank is older? 2. Which bank is larger? 3. What are the differences and similarities in their services? 4. Which one would you bank with and why? The book prints the figures as digits; they are spelled out here. Passage 1, 中国建设银行 (the book says 中国银行 once, where 中国建设银行 is meant):

examples.text: 中国建设银行成立于一九五四年十月一日，也叫做建行。它是中国五大国有商业银行之一。中国建设银行不仅在国内设有一万四千五百家分行，而且在美国、英国、法国、日本、韩国、香港、台湾等七十三个国家和地区设有分行。中国建设银行有多种服务，像存款取款、兑换外币、发行信用卡等。中国银行还设有网上银行。你可以在网上办理定期存款，注册电子钱包，也可以在网上付账单。网上银行可以为你提供一年三百六十五天，一天二十四小时的服务。中国建设银行除了有外币兑换、旅行支票等服务外，还有外语电话银行服务，为国外的客户提供英语、法语、德语、俄语、韩语等多语种服务。
examples.translation: zhōng guó jiàn shè yín háng chéng lì yú yī jiǔ wǔ sì nián shí yuè yí rì yě jiào zuò jiàn háng tā shì zhōng guó wǔ dà guó yǒu shāng yè yín háng zhī yì zhōng guó jiàn shè yín háng bù jǐn zài guó nèi shè yǒu yí wàn sì qiān wǔ bǎi jiā fēn háng ér qiě zài měi guó yīng guó fǎ guó rì běn hán guó xiāng gǎng tái wān děng qī shí sān gè guó jiā hé dì qū shè yǒu fēn háng zhōng guó jiàn shè yín háng yǒu duō zhǒng fú wù xiàng cún kuǎn qǔ kuǎn duì huàn wài bì fā xíng xìn yòng kǎ děng zhōng guó yín háng hái shè yǒu wǎng shàng yín háng nǐ kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng bàn lǐ dìng qī cún kuǎn zhù cè diàn zi qián bāo yě kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng fù zhàng dān wǎng shàng yín háng kě yǐ wèi nǐ tí gōng yì nián sān bǎi liù shí wǔ tiān yì tiān èr shí sì xiǎo shí de fú wù zhōng guó jiàn shè yín háng chú le yǒu wài bì duì huàn lǚ xíng zhī piào děng fú wù wài hái yǒu wài yǔ diàn huà yín háng fú wù wèi guó wài de kè hù tí gōng yīng yǔ fǎ yǔ dé yǔ é yǔ hán yǔ děng duō yǔ zhǒng fú wù — China Construction Bank was founded on 1 October 1954 and is also called 建行. It is one of China’s five big state-owned commercial banks. Besides its 14,500 domestic branches, it has branches in 73 countries and regions including the USA, Britain, France, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong and Taiwan. It has many services, such as deposits and withdrawals, foreign currency exchange and issuing credit cards. (The book says 中国银行 here.) It also has online banking, where you can handle fixed-term deposits, register an e-wallet and pay bills online, 365 days a year, 24 hours a day. Besides foreign currency exchange and traveler’s checks, it also has a foreign-language telephone banking service offering English, French, German, Russian, Korean and other languages to customers abroad.

explanations.title: Passage 2
explanations.body: 中国工商银行:

examples.text: 中国工商银行，也叫做工行，成立于一九八四年一月一日。中国工商银行在国内有三万多个分支，与国外五十多个国家和地区的四百一十家银行有业务往来。中国工商银行的服务非常多。它的电子银行业务包括：自助银行、电话银行、手机银行和网上银行。网上银行开通的城市有三百多个。客户不出家门就能够安全、方便地使用中国工商银行的网上银行服务。只要有用户名和密码，便能在世界各地进入网络银行。电子钱包和网上支付都很安全。除了开户、查询、转账等服务以外，客户也可以随时随地使用活期和定期存款、支票、信用卡、汇款和交费等网上银行服务。
examples.translation: zhōng guó gōng shāng yín háng yě jiào zuò gōng háng chéng lì yú yī jiǔ bā sì nián yī yuè yí rì zhōng guó gōng shāng yín háng zài guó nèi yǒu sān wàn duō gè fēn zhī yǔ guó wài wǔ shí duō gè guó jiā hé dì qū de sì bǎi yī shí jiā yín háng yǒu yè wù wǎng lái zhōng guó gōng shāng yín háng de fú wù fēi cháng duō tā de diàn zi yín háng yè wù bāo kuò zì zhù yín háng diàn huà yín háng shǒu jī yín háng hé wǎng shàng yín háng wǎng shàng yín háng kāi tōng de chéng shì yǒu sān bǎi duō gè kè hù bù chū jiā mén jiù néng gòu ān quán fāng biàn dì shǐ yòng zhōng guó gōng shāng yín háng de wǎng shàng yín háng fú wù zhǐ yào yǒu yòng hù míng hé mì mǎ biàn néng zài shì jiè gè dì jìn rù wǎng luò yín háng diàn zi qián bāo hé wǎng shàng zhī fù dōu hěn ān quán chú le kāi hù chá xún zhuǎn zhàng děng fú wù yǐ wài kè hù yě kě yǐ suí shí suí dì shǐ yòng huó qī hé dìng qī cún kuǎn zhī piào xìn yòng kǎ huì kuǎn hé jiāo fèi děng wǎng shàng yín háng fú wù — The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, also called 工行, was founded on 1 January 1984. It has more than 30,000 domestic branches and business ties with 410 banks in more than 50 countries and regions. Its services are very many. Its electronic banking includes self-service banking, telephone banking, mobile banking and online banking; online banking is available in more than 300 cities. Customers can use its online banking safely and conveniently without leaving home. As long as you have a username and password, you can get into online banking anywhere in the world. The e-wallet and online payment are both very safe. Besides opening accounts, inquiries and transfers, customers can also use current and fixed deposits, checks, credit cards, remittances and bill payment, any time and anywhere.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the HSBC brochure
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Translate the title of this HSBC (汇丰银行) brochure, 如何注册使用汇丰个人网上银行. B. Optional: translate the numbered headings, then read the entire brochure. C. Write a summary of the brochure in Chinese, then read it to the class. The brochure (the slogan is 环球金融 地方智慧, “global finance, local knowledge”; the numbered headings are written 一 to 四 here):

examples.text: 如何注册使用汇丰个人网上银行
examples.translation: rú hé zhù cè shǐ yòng huì fēng gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng — How to register and use HSBC personal online banking

examples.text: 客户朋友们：
examples.translation: kè hù péng yǒu men — Dear customers:

examples.text: 如何使用汇丰个人网银呢？这很简单。网银，就是我们常说的网上银行业务。您只要完成下面的几步，就可以马上开通和使用汇丰个人网上银行了。
examples.translation: rú hé shǐ yòng huì fēng gè rén wǎng yín ne zhè hěn jiǎn dān wǎng yín jiù shì wǒ men cháng shuō de wǎng shàng yín háng yè wù nín zhǐ yào wán chéng xià miàn de jǐ bù jiù kě yǐ mǎ shàng kāi tōng hé shǐ yòng huì fēng gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng le — How do you use HSBC personal online banking? It’s very simple. 网银 is what we often call online banking business. As soon as you complete the steps below, you can immediately activate and use HSBC personal online banking.

examples.text: 一、阅读并接受银行条款
examples.translation: yí yuè dú bìng jiē shòu yín háng tiáo kuǎn — 1. Read and accept the bank’s terms

examples.text: 请在个人网上银行注册页面阅读汇丰个人网上银行和电子账单及电子通知相关的条款，如果您接受这些条款，请点击注册页面上的「确认」。
examples.translation: qǐng zài gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng zhù cè yè miàn yuè dú huì fēng gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng hé diàn zi zhàng dān jí diàn zi tōng zhī xiāng guān de tiáo kuǎn rú guǒ nín jiē shòu zhè xiē tiáo kuǎn qǐng diǎn jī zhù cè yè miàn shàng de què rèn — On the personal online banking registration page, please read the terms for HSBC personal online banking and e-bills and e-notices; if you accept these terms, please click “Confirm” on the registration page.

examples.text: 二、确认您的身份
examples.translation: èr què rèn nín de shēn fèn — 2. Confirm your identity

examples.text: 只要您有汇丰中国个人银行账户，就可以用借记卡卡号或者您的个人电话号码开通个人网上银行。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nín yǒu huì fēng zhōng guó gè rén yín háng zhàng hù jiù kě yǐ yòng jiè jì kǎ kǎ hào huò zhě nín de gè rén diàn huà hào mǎ kāi tōng gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng — As long as you have an HSBC China personal bank account, you can activate personal online banking with your debit card number or your personal phone number.

examples.text: 三、设定网上银行账户
examples.translation: sān shè dìng wǎng shàng yín háng zhàng hù — 3. Set up your online banking account

examples.text: 您需要设定一个用户名和个人密码，我们将问您一些安全问题，以后在您需要重新设定登录信息时，可以用。
examples.translation: nín xū yào shè dìng yí gè yòng hù míng hé gè rén mì mǎ wǒ men jiāng wèn nín yì xiē ān quán wèn tí yǐ hòu zài nín xū yào chóng xīn shè dìng dēng lù xìn xī shí kě yǐ yòng — You need to set a username and a personal password, and we will ask you some security questions, which can be used later when you need to reset your login information.

examples.text: 四、完成网上银行注册后，怎么登录个人网上银行？
examples.translation: sì wán chéng wǎng shàng yín háng zhù cè hòu zěn me dēng lù gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng — 4. After completing online banking registration, how do you log in to personal online banking?

examples.text: 在您完成个人网上银行注册后，您可以用您的个人网上银行用户名及个人密码登录个人网上银行服务，使用网上银行的服务。为了您的服务安全，我们会在您登录的时候，发给您一个手机短信，告诉您一个安全密码，您需要输入这个安全密码，才能完成登录我们的网上银行。
examples.translation: zài nín wán chéng gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng zhù cè hòu nín kě yǐ yòng nín de gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng yòng hù míng jí gè rén mì mǎ dēng lù gè rén wǎng shàng yín háng fú wù shǐ yòng wǎng shàng yín háng de fú wù wèi le nín de fú wù ān quán wǒ men huì zài nín dēng lù de shí hòu fā gěi nín yí gè shǒu jī duǎn xìn gào sù nín yí gè ān quán mì mǎ nín xū yào shū rù zhè ge ān quán mì mǎ cái néng wán chéng dēng lù wǒ men de wǎng shàng yín háng — After you complete registration, you can log in to the personal online banking service with your username and personal password and use its services. For the safety of your service, when you log in we will send you a text message with a security code; you need to enter this security code to complete logging in to our online banking.

Study the flow chart from a Chinese bank to understand the various steps (the flow chart is not included). B. Go to the website of an American bank and look at its online registration instructions; use them as a guide to create a flow chart in Chinese, draw it on a flip chart and post it on the wall. C. lessons.title: 285. Lesson 11 Presentation 3: Mobile Pay (passage)
lessons.subtitle: 移动支付 · 微信 · 用手机扫一下码就行了 · 身上几乎不带现金了

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss. A. What methods of payment do Americans use? B. What are your preferred methods of payment? C. How do Chinese people make payments?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 移动支付 (Mobile Pay)
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters (for example 移動支付).

examples.text: 以前，中国人买东西通常用现金付款。今年我来中国留学，才发现大多数中国人都用移动支付，连小贩都用手机收费。所以，我马上请朋友小刚帮我注册一个电子钱包。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén mǎi dōng xī tōng cháng yòng xiàn jīn fù kuǎn jīn nián wǒ lái zhōng guó liú xué cái fā xiàn dà duō shù zhōng guó rén dōu yòng yí dòng zhī fù lián xiǎo fàn dōu yòng shǒu jī shōu fèi suǒ yǐ wǒ mǎ shàng qǐng péng yǒu xiǎo gāng bāng wǒ zhù cè yí gè diàn zi qián bāo — In the past, Chinese people usually paid cash when they bought things. This year I came to China to study abroad and only then discovered that most Chinese people use mobile payment; even vendors use their phones to collect fees. So I immediately asked my friend Xiaogang to help me register an e-wallet.

examples.text: 小刚先帮我下载了一个社交软件“微信”，然后，把我的银行账户和电子钱包连在一起。这样，我就可以用手机付款了。买什么东西，用手机扫一下码就行了。而且，除了买东西，还可以用移动支付交水电费，付房租，订机票什么的，真是太方便了。

This way I can pay with my phone. To buy anything, I just scan a code with my phone. Besides shopping, I can also use mobile payment to pay water and electricity bills, pay rent, book plane tickets and so on; it’s really too convenient.

This time I came to China to work and discovered that most Chinese people pay by phone; even vendors use their phones to collect fees. So yesterday I went to the bank and asked the clerk to help me register an e-wallet.

examples.translation: yíng yè yuán xiān bāng wǒ xià zài le shè jiāo ruǎn jiàn wēi xìn rán hòu bǎ wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù hé diàn zi qián bāo lián zài yì qǐ zhè yàng wǒ jiù kě yǐ yòng wēi xìn zhī fù fù kuǎn le mǎi shén me dōng xī yòng shǒu jī sǎo yí xià mǎ jiù xíng le ér qiě chú le mǎi dōng xī hái kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī zhī fù jiāo shuǐ diàn fèi fù fáng zū dìng jī piào shén me de zhēn shì tài fāng biàn le — The clerk first helped me download the social software “WeChat” and then linked my bank account and e-wallet. This way I can pay with WeChat Pay. To buy anything, I just scan a code with my phone. lessons.title: 286. Lesson 11 Presentation 3 grammar: the time word 以前
lessons.subtitle: 以前，中国人用现金 · 我以前不认识他 · 十点以前 · 睡觉以前

explanations.title: The time word 以前
explanations.body: The adverb 以前 can be used to mean “previously” or “in the past”. As in English, 以前 can begin a sentence when it is used as a general time reference. It can also be placed right after the subject. It may also follow a time word or an action to indicate “before” that particular reference point in time, as in 十点以前 or 睡觉以前. Patterns: General time reference: 以前 + Sentence; Subject + 以前 + Verb + Object. Specific time or action: Time + 以前, …; Verb Phrase + 以前, ….

examples.text: 以前，中国人买东西通常用现金付款。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén mǎi dōng xī tōng cháng yòng xiàn jīn fù kuǎn — In the past, Chinese people usually paid for things in cash.

examples.text: 以前，中国人没有移动支付，他们都用现金购物。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén méi yǒu yí dòng zhī fù tā men dōu yòng xiàn jīn gòu wù — In the past Chinese people had no mobile payment; they all shopped with cash.

examples.text: 以前她是服务员，现在她是老板。
examples.translation: yǐ qián tā shì fú wù yuán xiàn zài tā shì lǎo bǎn — She used to be a waitress; now she is the boss.

examples.text: 我以前不认识他。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ qián bú rèn shí tā — I didn’t know him before.

examples.text: 晚上十点以前要做完作业。
examples.translation: wǎn shàng shí diǎn yǐ qián yào zuò wán zuò yè — Homework has to be finished before ten at night.

examples.text: 上大学以前，你来过上海吗？
examples.translation: shàng dà xué yǐ qián nǐ lái guò shàng hǎi ma — Before you went to college, had you been to Shanghai?

examples.text: 用网上银行以前，我都得去银行交电话费。
examples.translation: yòng wǎng shàng yín háng yǐ qián wǒ dōu děi qù yín háng jiāo diàn huà fèi — Before using online banking, I always had to go to the bank to pay my phone bill.

explanations.title: Activities 1 to 3
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Speaking and Listening). Form groups of three. Using the two sentence patterns 以前… or 现在… and …以前，…, take turns describing six images (not included). Activity 2 (Listening). Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. What did the woman ask about Lao Chen’s wife? 2. How has the woman changed? 3. What does Lao Chen suggest she should do? 4. Was the woman happy in the end? Why didn’t she mention the problem sooner? (Audio, not included.) Activity 3 (Speaking and Listening). A. Using 以前, interview a classmate about their life before DLI and now, and take notes in a table (Name, Life Before DLI, Life Now). B. Based on your notes, report your interview results to the class in Chinese.

lessons.title: 287. Lesson 11 Presentation 3 grammar: the 把 construction
lessons.subtitle: 我把自行车修好了 · 请把那件衣服拿给我看看 · 我没把礼物给他

explanations.title: The 把 construction
explanations.body: The 把 construction is used to express how a direct object is disposed of, dealt with, manipulated or affected by the subject. For this reason, the verb is usually active and transitive. Compare: 王小英把那些书拿去了 tells what Wang Xiaoying did to those books (she took them, as opposed to loaning them to a friend); 王小英拿去了那些书 is simply a report of what happened (she took those books, as opposed to doing something else).

examples.text: 王小英把那些书拿去了。
examples.translation: wáng xiǎo yīng bǎ nà xiē shū ná qù le — Wang Xiaoying took those books (away). (what she did to them)

examples.text: 王小英拿去了那些书。
examples.translation: wáng xiǎo yīng ná qù le nà xiē shū — Wang Xiaoying took those books. (a plain report)

explanations.title: The verb needs an extra element
explanations.body: The verb in a 把 construction must be followed by an extra element to complete the “disposal”: a resultative complement, an indirect object, the perfective 了, or a reduplicated verb. The object in a 把 construction often refers to something or someone known to both speakers. This can be explicitly marked with pronouns like 这, 那, 你的, etc., or inferred from context. The 把 construction places the direct object before the verbal complex (verb + other elements) and after the subject. To negate it, place the negative marker 不 or 没 before 把. Affirmative: Subject + 把 + Direct Object + Verb + Other Elements (complements, particles, reduplicated verbs, etc.). Negative: Subject + 不/没 + 把 + Direct Object + Verb + Other Elements.

examples.text: 我把自行车修好了。
examples.translation: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē xiū hǎo le — I fixed the bike. (resultative complement)

examples.text: 他把你的字典给小陈了。
examples.translation: tā bǎ nǐ de zì diǎn gěi xiǎo chén le — He gave your dictionary to Xiao Chen. (indirect object)

examples.text: 老王把房子卖了。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng bǎ fáng zi mài le — Lao Wang sold the house. (perfective)

examples.text: 我得把这一课复习复习。
examples.translation: wǒ děi bǎ zhè yí kè fù xí fù xí — I have to review this lesson. (reduplicated verb)

examples.text: 王大年把我的书拿去了。
examples.translation: wáng dà nián bǎ wǒ de shū ná qù le — Wang Danian took my book.

examples.text: 我把那个书包送给我弟弟了。
examples.translation: wǒ bǎ nà ge shū bāo sòng gěi wǒ dì di le — I gave that school bag to my younger brother.

examples.text: 她把一本词典拿来了。
examples.translation: tā bǎ yì běn cí diǎn ná lái le — She brought a dictionary.

examples.text: 请把那件衣服拿给我看看。
examples.translation: qǐng bǎ nà jiàn yī fú ná gěi wǒ kàn kàn — Please bring that piece of clothing to me to take a look.

examples.text: 她把作业做完了。
examples.translation: tā bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le — She finished the homework.

examples.text: 小刚把我的银行账户和电子钱包连在一起。
examples.translation: xiǎo gāng bǎ wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù hé diàn zi qián bāo lián zài yì qǐ — Xiaogang linked my bank account and e-wallet together.

examples.text: 我没把礼物给他。
examples.translation: wǒ méi bǎ lǐ wù gěi tā — I didn’t give him the gift.

examples.text: 你不把饭吃了，不能走。
examples.translation: nǐ bù bǎ fàn chī le bù néng zǒu — If you don’t eat up your meal, you can’t leave.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Complete the following exchanges with 把, then perform them for the class: 1. A: 先生，请问您要买什么？ B: ___ (拿给我看看). 2. A: 小黄，我的笔记本还在你那儿吗？ B: ___ (给李红了). 3. A: 这是二百五十块。 B: 找您十四块 ___ (拿好). 4. A: 这是二百五十块。 B: 当然，你得 ___ (交给老师). (Exchange 4 repeats exchange 3’s first line in the book, so my fourth is a free one.) My completed exchanges:

examples.text: 甲：先生，请问您要买什么？

examples.text: 乙：请把那个书包拿给我看看。
examples.translation: yǐ qǐng bǎ nà ge shū bāo ná gěi wǒ kàn kàn — Please bring that school bag to me to take a look.

examples.text: 甲：小黄，我的笔记本还在你那儿吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo huáng wǒ de bǐ jì běn hái zài nǐ nàr ma — Xiao Huang, is my notebook still with you?

examples.text: 乙：我把你的笔记本给李红了。

examples.translation: yǐ dāng rán nǐ děi bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi lǎo shī — Of course, you have to hand in the homework to the teacher. (my line for exchange 4)

explanations.title: Activity 5: Game On! (SMART Board activity)
explanations.body: Divide into teams of three. Each team member rewrites two sentences using the 把 construction. The team that finishes first reads their sentences to the class first, followed by the slower team. The team with the most correct sentences wins; if the teams tie, the faster team wins. Team 1’s sentences were 我送给弟弟一个书包, 弟弟拿走了那本书, 老王卖了他的公寓, 大年做完了作业 (the book prints 做好完了), 他修好了自行车, 上课的时候不要打开手机. My rewrites of Team 1:

lessons.title: 288. Lesson 11 Presentation 3 grammar: 什么 (2) meaning “any”, and 什么的
lessons.subtitle: 什么东西都… · 什么服务都有 · 什么都没吃 · 订机票什么的

explanations.title: 什么 (2): “any”, “every”
explanations.body: 什么 usually means “what”, as in 这是什么? or 你喝什么? Coming before a noun, however, it can also mean “something”, “anything” or “everything”, and is often used together with 都 or 也. Affirmative: 什么 + Noun + 都 + Verb. Negative: 什么 + Noun + 都/也 + 不 + Verb; 什么 + Noun + 都/也 + 没(有) + Verb.

examples.text: 买什么东西，用手机扫一下码就行了。
examples.translation: mǎi shén me dōng xī yòng shǒu jī sǎo yí xià mǎ jiù xíng le — When you buy something, you can just use your cellphone to scan the code.

examples.text: 我们什么果汁都喝。
examples.translation: wǒ men shén me guǒ zhī dōu hē — We drink any kind of fruit juice.

examples.text: 妈妈做什么菜都好吃。
examples.translation: mā mā zuò shén me cài dōu hǎo chī — Whatever dish Mom makes is delicious.

examples.text: 网上银行什么服务都有。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng yín háng shén me fú wù dōu yǒu — Online banking has every kind of service.

examples.text: 她男朋友什么运动都喜欢。
examples.translation: tā nán péng yǒu shén me yùn dòng dōu xǐ huān — Her boyfriend likes every kind of sport.

examples.text: 在中国，你买什么东西都可以用移动支付。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó nǐ mǎi shén me dōng xī dōu kě yǐ yòng yí dòng zhī fù — In China, you can use mobile payment to buy anything.

examples.text: 今天我不舒服，什么东西都没吃。
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ bù shū fú shén me dōng xī dōu méi chī — I’m not feeling well today and haven’t eaten anything.

examples.text: 你在家里怎么什么事都不做？
examples.translation: nǐ zài jiā lǐ zěn me shén me shì dōu bú zuò — Why don’t you do anything at all at home?

explanations.title: 什么的: “and so on”
explanations.body: 什么 and 的 can be combined to form 什么的, meaning “and so on” or “etcetera”. As in English, it is used to end a list of similar items. Nouns, noun phrases and verb phrases can all be followed by 什么的. Patterns: Noun 1 + Noun 2 + (Noun 3…) + 什么的; Verb Phrase 1 + Verb Phrase 2 + (Verb Phrase 3…) + 什么的.

examples.text: 除了买东西，还可以用移动支付交水电费，付房租，订机票什么的。
examples.translation: chú le mǎi dōng xī hái kě yǐ yòng yí dòng zhī fù jiāo shuǐ diàn fèi fù fáng zū dìng jī piào shén me de — Besides shopping, you can also use mobile payment to pay water and electricity bills, pay the rent, book plane tickets, and so on.

examples.text: 我奶奶不吃肉，只吃蔬菜、豆腐、水果什么的。
examples.translation: wǒ nǎi nǎi bù chī ròu zhǐ chī shū cài dòu fǔ shuǐ guǒ shén me de — My grandmother doesn’t eat meat; she only eats vegetables, tofu, fruit and so on.

examples.text: 在中国银行换外汇很容易，你可以兑换美元、欧元、澳元、英镑什么的。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó yín háng huàn wài huì hěn róng yì nǐ kě yǐ duì huàn měi yuán ōu yuán ào yuán yīng bàng shén me de — It’s easy to change foreign currency at the Bank of China; you can exchange US dollars, euros, Australian dollars, pounds and so on.

examples.text: 网上银行又快又方便，你可以转账、汇款、付账单什么的。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng yín háng yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn nǐ kě yǐ zhuǎn zhàng huì kuǎn fù zhàng dān shén me de — Online banking is fast and convenient; you can transfer, remit, pay bills and so on.

examples.text: 跑步、游泳、爬山什么的，这些运动他都喜欢。
examples.translation: pǎo bù yóu yǒng pá shān shén me de zhè xiē yùn dòng tā dōu xǐ huān — Running, swimming, hiking and so on: he likes all these sports.

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8
explanations.body: Activity 7 (Listening and Speaking). A. Pair up. Each partner listens to two of four passages and fills in the information about the places or people mentioned. B. In Chinese, exchange information with your partner to complete the table. C. Report your information to the class in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 8 (Writing, Speaking, Listening and Reading). Form groups of three. You are tasked to write a DLI brochure for Chinese visitors. A. Each group member chooses two topics from the list (国防语言学院: 学生宿舍, 食堂, 体育馆, 图书馆, 老师, 学生) and, using 什么…都… and 什么的, writes a short paragraph of six to eight sentences about them, then reads it to the group. B. As a group, organize all the sentences and paragraphs on paper or in a PowerPoint document to make your brochure. C. Present your group brochure to the class.

lessons.title: 289. Lesson 11 Presentation 3 skill integration: WeChat Pay, two blogs and the payment “contempt chain”
lessons.subtitle: 绑定 · 红包 · 二维码 · 外国人在中国 · 支付鄙视链

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and mark the statements true or false (audio, so no key is given here). Check your answers with a partner and explain your reasoning in Chinese. B. Listen again and answer: 1. What does the first speaker want to know? 2. What conveniences does the second speaker mention? 3. What does the second speaker consider unusual? 4. What is the societal phenomenon mentioned at the end of the dialog? The statements:

examples.text: 杰克的新手机很便宜，而且很好看。
examples.translation: jié kè de xīn shǒu jī hěn pián yi ér qiě hěn hǎo kàn — Jack’s new phone is cheap and good-looking.

examples.text: 现在中国人最喜欢用的社交软件是脸书。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zhōng guó rén zuì xǐ huān yòng de shè jiāo ruǎn jiàn shì liǎn shū — The social software Chinese people like to use most now is Facebook.

examples.text: 杰克还不知道怎么用移动支付。
examples.translation: jié kè hái bù zhī dào zěn me yòng yí dòng zhī fù — Jack doesn’t yet know how to use mobile payment.

examples.text: 杰克觉得他有信用卡，所以不需要电子钱包。
examples.translation: jié kè jué de tā yǒu xìn yòng kǎ suǒ yǐ bù xū yào diàn zi qián bāo — Jack thinks that since he has a credit card he doesn’t need an e-wallet.

examples.text: 有电子钱包就可以用手机支付了。
examples.translation: yǒu diàn zi qián bāo jiù kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī zhī fù le — With an e-wallet you can pay by phone.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and select the correct images: 1. Where does this conversation take place (a farmers’ market, a bank or a restaurant)? 2. What options does the first speaker have (WeChat Pay, PayPal, Alipay, Apple Pay)? B. Listen again and complete the sentences with the information the second speaker relates, then translate: 1. 我先 ___ 帮你 ___，帮你 ___，然后你 ___。 2. 你今天回去以后，就 ___，然后 ___，将你的 ___。这样，你就可以 ___ 了。 C. Check your work with a partner. D. Read the script and perform the dialog. E. In Chinese, discuss what you might experience in China based on this conversation. The blanks cannot be recovered without the audio; my completion of both sentences:

examples.text: 我先帮你下载微信，帮你注册电子钱包，然后你把银行卡连在一起。
examples.translation: wǒ xiān bāng nǐ xià zài wēi xìn bāng nǐ zhù cè diàn zi qián bāo rán hòu nǐ bǎ yín háng kǎ lián zài yì qǐ — First I’ll help you download WeChat and register an e-wallet, then you link your bank card to it.

examples.text: 你今天回去以后，就打开微信，然后点击钱包，将你的银行卡绑定。这样，你就可以用微信支付了。
examples.translation: nǐ jīn tiān huí qù yǐ hòu jiù dǎ kāi wēi xìn rán hòu diǎn jī qián bāo jiāng nǐ de yín háng kǎ bǎng dìng zhè yàng nǐ jiù kě yǐ yòng wēi xìn zhī fù le — When you get back today, open WeChat, then tap Wallet and bind your bank card. This way you can use WeChat Pay.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): two blog posts
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read the first blog post while your partner reads the second. Write a summary of your post in Chinese, then read it to your partner. B. Compare the blog posts by filling in a table (Topic, Help Provided, Instructions, New Trends, Uses for New Tools). C. Report your findings to the class in Chinese, including what most surprised you about WeChat Pay. Blog 1 is by 董倩, 外国人在中国 (the first post is dated 20 January 2020); the book prints the figures as digits.

examples.text: 上次在北京吃早点，因为十块钱纸币难倒了老板，六块钱的早点只付了五块，有点儿《百万英镑》那种“有钱人”的感觉。这次再去，发现拿着手机等着付款的人很多。过去还有老年人拿现金支付。现在老年人都是手机支付了，连街头小商小贩都是手机收费。大多数外国朋友到中国以前都没有微信钱包。没有微信钱包在中国当然什么都干不了。那么怎么办呢？这非常简单。你先在手机上“下载”微信，然后请中国朋友给你发一个几块钱人民币的红包。你点开红包的时候，微信就会给你开通微信钱包。有了微信钱包，你还需要把微信钱包和你的银行卡连在一起，就是中国人说的“绑定”。如果你有中国的银行卡，可以先打开微信，然后点击钱包，选和银行卡绑定，输入银行卡号、姓名、身份证号码和手机号进行绑定，就这么简单。但是，你的手机号最好是中国国内的手机号。微信支付注册完成以后，你什么都可以扫码支付，吃早点、购物、打车、订餐什么的。
examples.translation: shàng cì zài běi jīng chī zǎo diǎn yīn wèi shí kuài qián zhǐ bì nán dǎo le lǎo bǎn liù kuài qián de zǎo diǎn zhǐ fù le wǔ kuài yǒu diǎnr bǎi wàn yīng bàng nà zhǒng yǒu qián rén de gǎn jué zhè cì zài qù fā xiàn ná zhuó shǒu jī děng zhe fù kuǎn de rén hěn duō guò qù hái yǒu lǎo nián rén ná xiàn jīn zhī fù xiàn zài lǎo nián rén dōu shì shǒu jī zhī fù le lián jiē tóu xiǎo shāng xiǎo fàn dōu shì shǒu jī shōu fèi dà duō shù wài guó péng yǒu dào zhōng guó yǐ qián dōu méi yǒu wēi xìn qián bāo méi yǒu wēi xìn qián bāo zài zhōng guó dāng rán shén me dōu gàn bù liǎo nà me zěn me bàn ne zhè fēi cháng jiǎn dān nǐ xiān zài shǒu jī shàng xià zài wēi xìn rán hòu qǐng zhōng guó péng yǒu gěi nǐ fā yí gè jǐ kuài qián rén mín bì de hóng bāo nǐ diǎn kāi hóng bāo de shí hòu wēi xìn jiù huì gěi nǐ kāi tōng wēi xìn qián bāo yǒu le wēi xìn qián bāo nǐ hái xū yào bǎ wēi xìn qián bāo hé nǐ de yín háng kǎ lián zài yì qǐ jiù shì zhōng guó rén shuō de bǎng dìng rú guǒ nǐ yǒu zhōng guó de yín háng kǎ kě yǐ xiān dǎ kāi wēi xìn rán hòu diǎn jī qián bāo xuǎn hé yín háng kǎ bǎng dìng shū rù yín háng kǎ hào xìng míng shēn fèn zhèng hào mǎ hé shǒu jī hào jìn xíng bǎng dìng jiù zhè me jiǎn dān dàn shì nǐ de shǒu jī hào zuì hǎo shì zhōng guó guó nèi de shǒu jī hào wēi xìn zhī fù zhù cè wán chéng yǐ hòu nǐ shén me dōu kě yǐ sǎo mǎ zhī fù chī zǎo diǎn gòu wù dǎ chē dìng cān shén me de — Last time I had breakfast in Beijing, a 10-yuan note stumped the owner and I paid only 5 yuan for a 6-yuan breakfast, which felt a bit like being the “rich man” in “The Million Pound Note”. This time I went again and found that many people were waiting with phones in hand to pay. In the past some elderly people still paid with cash; now the elderly all pay by phone, and even street vendors collect fees by phone. Most foreign friends have no WeChat wallet before they come to China, and without one you of course can’t do anything in China. So what to do? It’s very simple. First download WeChat on your phone, then ask a Chinese friend to send you a red packet of a few yuan. When you tap open the red packet, WeChat will activate a WeChat wallet for you. With the wallet, you also need to link it to your bank card, what Chinese people call “binding”. If you have a Chinese bank card, first open WeChat, tap Wallet, choose to bind a bank card, and enter the card number, name, ID number and phone number; it’s that simple. But your phone number had better be a Chinese domestic one. After registering WeChat Pay, you can scan to pay for everything: breakfast, shopping, taxis, ordering meals and so on.

explanations.title: Blog 2
explanations.body: Blog 2 is by 黄翔, 外国人在中国 (dated 18 February 2020):

examples.text: 听说现在微信支付可以绑定国外信用卡了，也就是说你可以把你的美国信用卡和微信钱包连在一起。操作非常简单。当然，你需要先用手机下载微信。在微信上，点击钱包，然后点击银行卡。国外手机直接输入信用卡卡号和个人信息就可以。电话号码就是你国外的手机号。然后设定微信支付密码就可以了。当收到红包，接受一下就把钱放入钱包了。支付的时候，在微信中扫描一下商家的二维码，支付就完成了！在微信中，还有一个“收钱”功能。选择“收钱”，就会看到一个二维码，付钱的人扫描一下钱就进来了。选择“支付”，同样出现二维码，对方扫描一下钱就走了。在中国要看清楚二维码，比如共享自行车，车上有二维码，一扫就打开了。但是，现在有人把自己的二维码放在自行车上，你一扫，钱就给他了！在中国你不仅可以用微信支付订机票，付手机费、水电费、付房租、订餐、订酒店，而且还可以用微信支付买房、卖房什么的。
examples.translation: tīng shuō xiàn zài wēi xìn zhī fù kě yǐ bǎng dìng guó wài xìn yòng kǎ le yě jiù shì shuō nǐ kě yǐ bǎ nǐ de měi guó xìn yòng kǎ hé wēi xìn qián bāo lián zài yì qǐ cāo zuò fēi cháng jiǎn dān dāng rán nǐ xū yào xiān yòng shǒu jī xià zài wēi xìn zài wēi xìn shàng diǎn jī qián bāo rán hòu diǎn jī yín háng kǎ guó wài shǒu jī zhí jiē shū rù xìn yòng kǎ kǎ hào hé gè rén xìn xī jiù kě yǐ diàn huà hào mǎ jiù shì nǐ guó wài de shǒu jī hào rán hòu shè dìng wēi xìn zhī fù mì mǎ jiù kě yǐ le dāng shōu dào hóng bāo jiē shòu yí xià jiù bǎ qián fàng rù qián bāo le zhī fù de shí hòu zài wēi xìn zhōng sǎo miáo yí xià shāng jiā de èr wéi mǎ zhī fù jiù wán chéng le zài wēi xìn zhōng hái yǒu yí gè shōu qián gōng néng xuǎn zé shōu qián jiù huì kàn dào yí gè èr wéi mǎ fù qián de rén sǎo miáo yí xià qián jiù jìn lái le xuǎn zé zhī fù tóng yàng chū xiàn èr wéi mǎ duì fāng sǎo miáo yí xià qián jiù zǒu le zài zhōng guó yào kàn qīng chǔ èr wéi mǎ bǐ rú gòng xiǎng zì xíng chē chē shàng yǒu èr wéi mǎ yì sǎo jiù dǎ kāi le dàn shì xiàn zài yǒu rén bǎ zì jǐ de èr wéi mǎ fàng zài zì xíng chē shàng nǐ yì sǎo qián jiù gěi tā le zài zhōng guó nǐ bù jǐn kě yǐ yòng wēi xìn zhī fù dìng jī piào fù shǒu jī fèi shuǐ diàn fèi fù fáng zū dìng cān dìng jiǔ diàn ér qiě hái kě yǐ yòng wēi xìn zhī fù mǎi fáng mài fáng shén me de — I hear that WeChat Pay can now bind foreign credit cards, which means you can link your American credit card to your WeChat wallet. The operation is very simple. Of course you first need to download WeChat on your phone. In WeChat tap Wallet, then tap Bank Cards. With a foreign phone, just enter the credit card number and personal information; the phone number is your foreign mobile number. Then set a WeChat Pay password. When you receive a red packet, accept it and the money goes into your wallet. To pay, scan the merchant’s QR code in WeChat and the payment is done! WeChat also has a “Collect money” function: choose it and you will see a QR code, and when the payer scans it the money comes in. Choose “Pay” and a QR code also appears; when the other side scans it, the money goes away. In China you must look carefully at QR codes: for example, shared bikes have a QR code on them that opens with one scan; but now some people stick their own QR code on bikes, and when you scan it, your money goes to them! In China you can use WeChat Pay not only to book plane tickets and pay phone bills, water and electricity bills, rent, order food and book hotels, but also to buy and sell houses and so on.

explanations.title: Optional Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and read the following WeChat message. In Chinese, discuss which payment method is likely to be used the most, and the least, by Chinese people in the future. B. Tell the class in Chinese where you are presently on that chain, based on the payment method you are currently most comfortable using. The “payment contempt chain” (支付鄙视链), from lowest to highest: 现金支付 < 银行卡支付 < 信用卡支付 < 手机微信支付/支付宝扫码支付 < 用除了支付宝以外的应用扫码支付 < 指纹支付 < 刷脸支付 (cash, bank card, credit card, WeChat Pay or Alipay scan, scanning with an app other than Alipay, fingerprint, face payment).

examples.text: 文文：见面啊？我也想啊，可是我现在还在德国留学呢。听说现在国内有一个关于支付的说法是不是真的啊？就是这个：支付鄙视链
examples.translation: wén wén jiàn miàn a wǒ yě xiǎng a kě shì wǒ xiàn zài hái zài dé guó liú xué ne tīng shuō xiàn zài guó nèi yǒu yí gè guān yú zhī fù de shuō fǎ shì bú shì zhēn de a jiù shì zhè ge zhī fù bǐ shì liàn — Wenwen: Meet up? I’d like to, but I’m still studying in Germany. I hear there is a saying about payment in China now; is it true? It’s this one: the payment “contempt chain”.

options: A friend sends a few yuan to activate your WeChat wallet
exercises.explanation: 请中国朋友给你发一个几块钱人民币的红包。

exercises.prompt: What does “绑定” mean in the blog?
options: To link a WeChat wallet to a bank card
exercises.explanation: 把微信钱包和银行卡连在一起，就是“绑定”。

exercises.prompt: What does Blog 1 say is best about the phone number?
options: It should be a foreign number
It should be a Chinese domestic number
exercises.explanation: 你的手机号最好是中国国内的手机号。

exercises.prompt: What can you pay with WeChat Pay after registering, per Blog 1?
exercises.explanation: 吃早点、购物、打车、订餐什么的.

exercises.prompt: What new feature does Blog 2 mention?
options: WeChat Pay needs a Chinese ID
WeChat Pay can bind foreign credit cards
exercises.explanation: 微信支付可以绑定国外信用卡了。

exercises.prompt: What does the “收钱” function show?
options: A QR code the payer scans
Some people stick their own QR codes on shared bikes
exercises.explanation: 有人把自己的二维码放在自行车上.

Which payment method is at the top of the “contempt chain”?
exercises.explanation: …＜ 指纹支付 ＜ 刷脸支付.

exercises.explanation: 红包 (hóng bāo) means “red packet (gift money)”.
二维码 (èr wéi mǎ) means “QR code”.

lessons.title: 290. Lesson 11 Presentation 3 using Chinese in context: the cashless life, WeChat Pay in the U.S.
lessons.subtitle: 体验中国无现金生活 · 在北京无现金生活的一天 · 在美国怎么用微信

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing, Reading, Listening and Speaking): 体验中国无现金生活
explanations.body: Experience the cashless life in China. Pair up. You and a classmate have been studying at Beijing Normal University for a semester; some American friends are coming to visit and you want to show them how to use WeChat Pay. A. Go online to find out how Americans use WeChat Pay on U.S. cellphones; before writing instructions for your friends, first write a Chinese version so your teacher can check the accuracy. B. You come across a video featuring an Australian expat and his American friend using WeChat Pay in Hangzhou, 两老外在杭州体验无现金生存 结果爽呆了! Watch the video and take notes in a table (在哪儿, 活动, 用微信支付做什么). C. Plan a WeChat Pay itinerary for your friends using the table 在北京无现金生活的一天 (时间: 上午, 中午, 下午, 晚上; 去哪儿; 活动; 用微信支付做什么). D. Read your instructions and itinerary to the class in Chinese. explanations.title: China’s banking system (1): the history
explanations.body: China has a long history of banking. As early as the Song Dynasty (960-1279), Chinese financial institutions conducted all major banking functions, including deposits, loans, issuance of notes, currency exchange, and long-distance remittance. In 1024, the first paper currency was issued by the state in Sichuan. The two major types of indigenous financial institutions, piàohào (票号) and qiánzhuāng (钱庄), cooperated more than competed in financial markets. In 1897, China’s first modern public bank, the Imperial Bank of China (中国通商银行), opened for business, while financier Sheng Xuanhuai (盛宣怀) founded the first private bank. In 1905, China’s first central bank was established as the Great Qing Bank of the Board of Revenue (大清户部银行); it was renamed the Great Qing Government Bank (大清银行) three years later. Following the Xinhai Revolution (辛亥革命) in 1911, the Daqing Bank was finally renamed the Bank of China (中国银行). Another government bank, the Bank of Communications (交通银行), was set up in 1908 by the Ministry of Posts and Communications to raise money to buy the Beijing-Hankou Railway (京汉铁路) from Belgian contractors.

tables.title: Names in the history

explanations.title: The People’s Republic and the big five
explanations.body: With the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, the People’s Bank of China (PBoC 中国人民银行) was established as the central bank. PBoC issues currency, monitors the money supply, regulates China’s financial institutions, and formulates monetary policy for the State Council. In the early 1980s, the government opened up the banking system and allowed five state-owned specialized banks to accept deposits and conduct business: 1) the Bank of China (BoC 中国银行); 2) the Industrial & Commercial Bank of China (ICBC 中国工商银行); 3) the China Construction Bank (CCB 中国建设银行); 4) the Bank of Communications (BoCom 交通银行); and 5) the Agricultural Bank of China (ABC 中国农业银行). (The book’s photographs are not included.)

explanations.title: Roles and today’s banking sector
explanations.body: The Bank of China manages foreign exchange transactions and reserves. The China Construction Bank lends state budget funds for capital construction projects. The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China raises both domestic and international funds to bolster the economy, manage credit, and promote industrial production and commercial circulation. And the Agricultural Bank of China lends to and invests deposits from the agricultural sector. Today, China’s banking sector is the largest in the world by assets, which totaled U.S. $40.1 trillion in the first quarter of 2019. As of April 2020, four Chinese banks topped the list of world banks ranked by total assets. According to Zhihu (知乎), there were 4,597 banks and financial institutions across the nation in 2020. Together, they play a vital role in the Chinese economy. China’s financial reform and development in the last 40 years has enabled both financial stability and tremendous economic growth. In recent years, however, the financial system has suffered declines in efficiency along with a rise in financial risk. Still dominated by state banks and pervasive government intervention, China increasingly needs to build a more open, market-oriented system to meet new economic needs and challenges at home and abroad.

examples.text: 上星期五我们全家给我母亲过生日。我们在一家有名的中餐馆订了一张桌子。那天我们一共点了五菜一汤，鸡鸭鱼肉都有，而且色味俱全。我们一边吃饭一边聊天，非常高兴！吃过饭以后，我们都把送给妈妈的生日礼物拿了出来。我妈妈常常喜欢走到海边散步，所以我送了她一双休闲运动鞋，是我到百货大楼挑的，不但价格、样式不错，而且也很舒服，走远路没问题。小弟送了她一套漂亮的餐具。除了杯子、盘子以外，还有好看的刀叉。大哥说我的父母什么都有，所以送了一个最小最方便的礼物。他帮妈妈在手机上下载了微信软件，然后从他的网上银行转了一千块钱的电子红包给妈妈。这样她想买什么只要用手机扫码就可以买到。他说连去市场买蔬菜、水果也可以用。妈妈说这些礼物她都很喜欢，谢谢我们给她过了一个愉快的生日。

We booked a table at a famous Chinese restaurant. That day we ordered five dishes and one soup altogether, with chicken, duck, fish and meat, and it all had color, aroma and taste. We chatted while we ate, and everyone was very happy! After the meal, we all took out the birthday presents we had for Mom. My mom often likes to walk to the seaside and stroll, so I gave her a pair of casual sports shoes that I picked at the department store; they are not only good in price and style but also comfortable, and she can walk long distances with no problem. My younger brother gave her a nice set of tableware. Besides cups and plates, there are also pretty knives and forks. My older brother said my parents have everything, so he gave the smallest and most convenient present. He helped Mom download the WeChat software on her phone and then transferred a 1,000-yuan electronic red packet from his online bank to Mom. This way, whatever she wants to buy, she only needs to scan a code with her phone. He said even buying vegetables and fruit at the market can be done this way. Mom said she liked all these presents and thanked us for giving her a happy birthday.

Three bedrooms, one living room, with furniture; big master bedroom, living room not small, small dining room and kitchen
Moved in last week; shopping this morning
Invite some friends over to get together
Two jin of tomatoes, two bunches of spinach, three jin of green peppers, seafood, beef, apples, tangerines, two bunches of bananas
tables.title: Passage B table

examples.text: 我们上个星期刚搬到新租的一套公寓。新公寓有三室一厅，带家具。主卧很大，客厅也不小，但饭厅和厨房都不大。每月房租两千五，贵是贵了点儿，可是包水费、电费和网费，还有一个不需要付钱的停车位，所以我们觉得还可以。这儿交通很方便，也很安全。搬进新家我们很开心，明天要请一些朋友来聚聚。今天上午我去超市买了一些东西，为聚会做准备。我买了两斤西红柿，两把菠菜，三斤青椒，还有海鲜和牛肉。除了蔬菜，我还买了一些苹果和橘子，还有两串香蕉。
examples.translation: wǒ men shàng gè xīng qī gāng bān dào xīn zū de yí tào gōng yù xīn gōng yù yǒu sān shì yì tīng dài jiā jù zhǔ wò hěn dà kè tīng yě bù xiǎo dàn fàn tīng hé chú fáng dōu bú dà měi yuè fáng zū liǎng qiān wǔ guì shì guì le diǎnr kě shì bāo shuǐ fèi diàn fèi hé wǎng fèi hái yǒu yí gè bù xū yào fù qián de tíng chē wèi suǒ yǐ wǒ men jué de hái kě yǐ zhèr jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn yě hěn ān quán bān jìn xīn jiā wǒ men hěn kāi xīn míng tiān yào qǐng yì xiē péng yǒu lái jù jù jīn tiān shàng wǔ wǒ qù chāo shì mǎi le yì xiē dōng xī wèi jù huì zuò zhǔn bèi wǒ mǎi le liǎng jīn xī hóng shì liǎng bǎ bō cài sān jīn qīng jiāo hái yǒu hǎi xiān hé niú ròu chú le shū cài wǒ hái mǎi le yì xiē píng guǒ hé jú zi hái yǒu liǎng chuàn xiāng jiāo — Last week we just moved into a newly rented apartment. The new apartment has three bedrooms and one living room and comes with furniture. The master bedroom is big and the living room is not small, but the dining room and kitchen are not big. The monthly rent is 2,500; it is expensive, to be sure, but it includes water, electricity and internet fees, and there is a parking space that you don’t have to pay for, so we think it’s all right. Transportation here is very convenient, and it’s very safe. We are very happy to have moved into our new home and tomorrow we will invite some friends to get together. This morning I went to the supermarket and bought some things to prepare for the party. I bought two jin of tomatoes, two bunches of spinach, three jin of green peppers, and also seafood and beef. Besides vegetables, I also bought some apples and tangerines, and two bunches of bananas.

explanations.title: Activity 3: the bank dialog
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and answer the questions: 1. Is the customer new or returning? How do you know? 2. What account(s) does the customer have with this bank? B. Listen again and fill in a table (Activity, Reason, How It Was Accomplished) in as much detail as possible. C. Ask a partner four questions in Chinese about the table, then read the script your teacher provides to check your answers. D. Orally translate David’s sentences into English; your partner translates them back into Chinese without looking at the script. Switch roles and translate the bank clerk’s sentences. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 1: measure words and shopping lists
explanations.body: A. What does a best man need to wear to a wedding? Make a shopping list with the appropriate measure words and compare with a partner. B. What do you need to furnish an apartment? Make a shopping list with your partner using measure words. C. Your class is planning a Chinese dinner party. Add the quantity and measure words for 啤酒, 奶茶, 白米饭, 橙汁, 饺子, 烤鸭, 麻婆豆腐 and 筷子. D. Choose more items from 苹果, 香蕉, 西瓜, 胡萝卜, 菠菜, 黄瓜, 草莓, 鸡, 牛肉, 包子, tell your partner your choices with quantities, and have them write them down. The book leaves the lists blank; these suggestions are mine:

rows: 一套西装、一件衬衫、一条领带、一双皮鞋、一双袜子
一张床、一张桌子、一把椅子、一个沙发、一台冰箱、一条地毯、一个书架、一个衣橱
四瓶啤酒、五杯奶茶、六碗白米饭、三瓶橙汁、两盘饺子、一只烤鸭、一盘麻婆豆腐、十双筷子
三斤苹果、两串香蕉、一个西瓜、两斤胡萝卜、一把菠菜、三根黄瓜、两斤草莓、一只鸡、两斤牛肉、六个包子
