lessons.title: 371. Lesson 15 Presentation 1 grammar: verb duplication
lessons.subtitle: 聚聚 · 热闹热闹 · 看看 · 聊聊天 · 恭喜恭喜

explanations.title: Verb Duplication
explanations.body: In this presentation verb duplication appears in several places: 我们请几个朋友来我家聚聚，热闹热闹。 刚才我已经把地址发给你了，你看看收到没有？ 大家聊聊天，然后在我家吃顿便饭。 Verb duplication indicates that an action lasts only a short time and is casual. It is often used to soften the tone and express one’s wishes tactfully. Notice the pronunciation: for monosyllabic verbs, the duplication is in neutral tone, e.g. 聚聚 jùju, 看看 kànkan; for two-syllable words, the second syllable is neutral, e.g. 热闹热闹 rènao rènao. Note: 恭喜恭喜 simply says congratulations twice, to show one’s heartfelt happiness for the new homeowner; it is not a case of verb duplication.

examples.text: 我们请几个朋友来我家聚聚，热闹热闹。
examples.translation: wǒ men qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu lái wǒ jiā jù jù rè nào rè nào — We’ll invite a few friends to my home to get together a bit and have some fun. (gather a bit, have some fun)

examples.text: 我们请几个朋友来我家聚，来我家热闹。
examples.translation: wǒ men qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu lái wǒ jiā jù lái wǒ jiā rè nào — We invite friends to gather in my home, bustling with noise. (no duplication)

examples.text: 你看看收到没有？
examples.translation: nǐ kàn kàn shōu dào méi yǒu — Could you check whether you received it?

examples.text: 你看收到没有？
examples.translation: nǐ kàn shōu dào méi yǒu — Please check whether you received it. (firmer)

examples.text: 大家聊聊天。
examples.translation: dà jiā liáo liáo tiān — Everybody chats (casually).

examples.text: 大家聊天。
examples.translation: dà jiā liáo tiān — Everybody converses.

examples.text: 你买新房子啦！恭喜恭喜！
examples.translation: nǐ mǎi xīn fáng zi la gōng xǐ gōng xǐ — You bought a new house! Congratulations, congratulations! (not verb duplication, just congratulating twice)

explanations.title: Activity 10 (Speaking and Writing): soften the tone for a stern teacher
explanations.body: A Chinese teacher asks you to pass his message to one of your classmates. He speaks sternly, but you want to pass his words to your classmate gently. A. Individually, soften the tone wherever you see fit. B. Work in pairs, compare your answers and discuss which paraphrases are more appropriate. The six originals and my softened versions (mine):

examples.text: 你告诉马文，他得每天早上起来锻炼。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén tā děi měi tiān zǎo shàng qǐ lái duàn liàn — Original: Tell Ma Wen he has to get up every morning and exercise.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，早上起来可以锻炼锻炼。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén zǎo shàng qǐ lái kě yǐ duàn liàn duàn liàn — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he could exercise a bit after getting up in the morning.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，他早上上课以前要复习生词。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén tā zǎo shàng shàng kè yǐ qián yào fù xí shēng cí — Original: Tell Ma Wen he must review vocabulary before class in the morning.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，早上上课以前可以复习复习生词。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén zǎo shàng shàng kè yǐ qián kě yǐ fù xí fù xí shēng cí — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he might review the new words a bit before class.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，有问题要问老师。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén yǒu wèn tí yào wèn lǎo shī — Original: Tell Ma Wen to ask the teacher when he has questions.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，有问题可以问问老师。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ wèn wèn lǎo shī — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he may ask the teacher when he has questions.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，下课以后要跑步。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén xià kè yǐ hòu yào pǎo bù — Original: Tell Ma Wen to run after class.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，下课以后可以跑跑步。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén xià kè yǐ hòu kě yǐ pǎo pǎo bù — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he can go for a run after class.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，有时间要和中国人聊天。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén yǒu shí jiān yào hé zhōng guó rén liáo tiān — Original: Tell Ma Wen to chat with Chinese people when he has time.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，有时间可以和中国人聊聊天。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén yǒu shí jiān kě yǐ hé zhōng guó rén liáo liáo tiān — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he can chat a bit with Chinese people when he has time.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，晚上睡觉以前听音乐。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén wǎn shàng shuì jiào yǐ qián tīng yīn yuè — Original: Tell Ma Wen to listen to music before bed.

examples.text: 你告诉马文，晚上睡觉以前可以听听音乐。
examples.translation: nǐ gào sù mǎ wén wǎn shàng shuì jiào yǐ qián kě yǐ tīng tīng yīn yuè — (mine, softened) Tell Ma Wen he can listen to a little music before bed.

explanations.title: Activity 11 (Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: The following paragraph describes a DLI soldier’s weekend. Complete the paragraph using single verbs or duplicated verbs where appropriate. My completed paragraph:

examples.text: 每个周六我都快到中午才起床。起床以后我就去食堂吃吃午饭。吃午饭的时候，常跟几个朋友坐在一起，一边吃，一边聊聊天，开开玩笑。下午，我有时和朋友一起去电影院看看电影，有时自己一个人去渔人码头走走。一个人走的时候，如果觉得没意思，我会听听音乐，或者给我家人打打电话。晚上回到学校，我会做做作业，复习复习，看看中国电视。有时候要去值值班。
examples.translation: měi gè zhōu liù wǒ dōu kuài dào zhōng wǔ cái qǐ chuáng qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu wǒ jiù qù shí táng chī chī wǔ fàn chī wǔ fàn de shí hòu cháng gēn jǐ gè péng yǒu zuò zài yì qǐ yì biān chī yì biān liáo liáo tiān kāi kāi wán xiào xià wǔ wǒ yǒu shí hé péng yǒu yì qǐ qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn kàn diàn yǐng yǒu shí zì jǐ yí gè rén qù yú rén mǎ tóu zǒu zǒu yí gè rén zǒu de shí hòu rú guǒ jué de méi yì si wǒ huì tīng tīng yīn yuè huò zhě gěi wǒ jiā rén dǎ dǎ diàn huà wǎn shàng huí dào xué xiào wǒ huì zuò zuò zuò yè fù xí fù xí kàn kàn zhōng guó diàn shì yǒu shí hòu yào qù zhí zhí bān — Every Saturday I don’t get up until almost noon. After getting up I go to the cafeteria to have lunch. While eating lunch I often sit with a few friends, chatting and joking as we eat. In the afternoon sometimes I go to the movie theater with friends to see a movie, sometimes I go alone to Fisherman’s Wharf for a walk. When I walk alone, if I feel bored, I listen to music or call my family. In the evening back at school I do my homework, review a bit and watch Chinese TV. Sometimes I have to go on duty. (my completion, mine; the book’s cues are 吃, 聊, 开, 看, 走, 听, 打, 做, 复习, 看, 值)

options: A short, casual action; it softens the tone

exercises.prompt: How is the second 看 in 看看 pronounced?
How is 热闹热闹 pronounced?
options: rènao rènao, with the second syllable neutral

exercises.prompt: Is 恭喜恭喜 verb duplication?
options: No, it is just congratulating twice

exercises.prompt: What does 你看看收到没有？ do?
options: Politely asks to check whether it arrived

options: The first is casual, “chat a bit”

大家聊___天，然后在我家吃顿便饭。

lessons.title: 372. Lesson 15 Presentation 1: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 孙丽请刘青来新家 · 妈妈的邮件 · 请朋友来聚会

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Each partner listens to one of two passages and fills in the table in pinyin: Passage 1: Time, Location and Participants; Event; About Liu Qing. Passage 2: Event; Situation; Solution. B. Sun Li calls Liu Qing to invite her to a gathering at her new home. Perform the dialog between Sun Li and Liu Qing with your partner. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, and Writing): the email
explanations.body: A. Read an email and answer the questions. New word: 短信 (duǎnxìn; text message). Questions: 1. What is the occasion for the proposed gathering? 2. What does the author want her daughter to do? 3. What is the daughter supposed to do if an invitee cannot attend this Saturday? 4. What concerns the author at the end of the message? What will she do to correct this? (Mine: 1. Showing the new home, getting old friends together, and the grandson’s first birthday. 2. Send text messages inviting the old friends, with the reason, time and address. 3. Ask them to come another day when they are free. 4. Two phone numbers in the earlier email were wrong; she will send a corrected email.) The email:

examples.text: 女儿：这个星期六下午四点左右，我和你爸爸想请一些老朋友们过来玩儿玩儿。请他们过来，第一是看看咱们的新房子，第二是大家好久不见，聚聚，热闹热闹。第三最重要，就是给我们的小外孙过一周岁生日。你是孩子的妈妈，所以我想让你给咱们家几位老朋友发个短信，请他们过来参加聚会。除了告诉他们聚会的原因和时间以外，也把地址发给他们。如果他们星期六都来得了，那最好。如果有人来不了，就请他们哪天有空儿再来。糟糕，十分钟以前我给你发了一个邮件，里面是他们的手机号码，可是有两个是错的！我马上再给你发了一个。过几分钟你看看收到没有，要是没收到就告诉我。妈妈
examples.translation: nǚ ér zhè ge xīng qī liù xià wǔ sì diǎn zuǒ yòu wǒ hé nǐ bà bà xiǎng qǐng yì xiē lǎo péng yǒu men guò lái wánr wánr qǐng tā men guò lái dì yī shì kàn kàn zán men de xīn fáng zi dì èr shì dà jiā hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn jù jù rè nào rè nào dì sān zuì zhòng yào jiù shì gěi wǒ men de xiǎo wài sūn guò yì zhōu suì shēng rì nǐ shì hái zi de mā mā suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng ràng nǐ gěi zán men jiā jǐ wèi lǎo péng yǒu fā gè duǎn xìn qǐng tā men guò lái cān jiā jù huì chú le gào sù tā men jù huì de yuán yīn hé shí jiān yǐ wài yě bǎ dì zhǐ fā gěi tā men rú guǒ tā men xīng qī liù dōu lái de liǎo nà zuì hǎo rú guǒ yǒu rén lái bù liǎo jiù qǐng tā men nǎ tiān yǒu kòngr zài lái zāo gāo shí fēn zhōng yǐ qián wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yí gè yóu jiàn lǐ miàn shì tā men de shǒu jī hào mǎ kě shì yǒu liǎng gè shì cuò de wǒ mǎ shàng zài gěi nǐ fā le yí gè guò jǐ fēn zhōng nǐ kàn kàn shōu dào méi yǒu yào shì méi shōu dào jiù gào sù wǒ mā mā — (Email, subject: 星期六下午) Daughter: This Saturday around four in the afternoon your father and I would like to invite some old friends over to have a good time. We invite them, first, to see our new home; second, because we haven’t seen each other for a long time, to get together and liven things up. Third and most important, to celebrate our little grandson’s first birthday. You are the child’s mother, so I’d like you to send a text message to a few of our old friends to invite them to the party. Besides telling them the reason and time of the party, also send them the address. If they can all come on Saturday, that’s best; if someone can’t come, ask them to come on another day when they are free. Oh no, ten minutes ago I sent you an email with their cell-phone numbers, but two are wrong! I’ll send you another one right away. In a few minutes see whether you received it, and if not tell me. Mom

explanations.title: Activity 2 B and Activity 3
explanations.body: B. In the space provided, compose a text message that invites friends to attend the event based on the mother’s instructions; in pairs check each other’s message. My message (mine):

examples.text: 各位叔叔阿姨，你们好！这个星期六下午四点左右，我爸爸妈妈想请大家来家里聚聚。第一，看看他们的新房子；第二，大家好久不见，热闹热闹；第三，给我儿子过一周岁生日。地址是……（见下条短信）。如果星期六来不了，请告诉我们哪天有空儿，欢迎再来。谢谢！
examples.translation: gè wèi shū shū ā yí nǐ men hǎo zhè ge xīng qī liù xià wǔ sì diǎn zuǒ yòu wǒ bà bà mā mā xiǎng qǐng dà jiā lái jiā lǐ jù jù dì yī kàn kàn tā men de xīn fáng zi dì èr dà jiā hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn rè nào rè nào dì sān gěi wǒ ér zi guò yì zhōu suì shēng rì dì zhǐ shì jiàn xià tiáo duǎn xìn rú guǒ xīng qī liù lái bù liǎo qǐng gào sù wǒ men nǎ tiān yǒu kòngr huān yíng zài lái xiè xiè — (mine) Dear uncles and aunts, hello! This Saturday around four in the afternoon my parents would like to invite everyone to their home. First, to see their new house; second, since we haven’t seen each other for a long time, to have a lively time; third, my son’s first birthday. The address is… (see the next message). If you can’t come on Saturday, tell us which day you’re free; you’re welcome to come then. Thank you!

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Work in groups of three. Interview your group members to learn what their plans would be if they held a gathering at home; fill in the table (Proposed Event; When & Where; Whom to Invite; Activities; rows A and B). B. Work between groups: one group gives a clue and asks the other group to figure out whose plan it is, including details. C. Within your group, convert one of the two plans into a phone conversation between the host (主人) and an invitee (朋友), five exchanges, and share it with the class.

exercises.prompt: How many reasons does the mother give for the gathering?
What is the most important reason?
exercises.explanation: 第三最重要，就是给我们的小外孙过一周岁生日。

exercises.prompt: What does the mother ask her daughter to do?
options: Text the old friends with the reason, time and address

exercises.prompt: What if someone can’t come on Saturday?
options: Ask them to come another day when they are free

exercises.prompt: What did the mother get wrong?
options: Two phone numbers in the email

exercises.prompt: 我想让你给咱们家几位老朋友发个短___。
给我们的小外孙过一周岁生___。

lessons.title: 373. Lesson 15 Presentation 1: using Chinese in context (invitations, picnic, New Year flyer)
lessons.subtitle: 两个留言 · 班级野餐 · 蒙特雷华人庆新春联欢会

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking, and Writing)
explanations.body: You are David and your partner is Linda, studying at Beijing University; the Chinese New Year is coming. Today you received two voice messages from Chinese friends inviting you to gatherings at their homes (photographs not included). A. Pair up. Listen to one message each; in English write the key information in the table (什么时间, 什么地点, 谁还参加, 做什么, 带什么礼物; 第一个留言, 第二个留言). New words: 地道 (dìdào; genuine), 表演 (biǎoyǎn; performance), 逛 (guàng; walk around), 大餐 (dà cān; feast), 书法 (shūfǎ; calligraphy). B. Share your information and take notes on your partner’s. C. Because of a time conflict you can attend only one gathering; discuss and decide which. D. Write a reply email to Wang Dong’s invitation (your partner replies to Xu Ying) and share it with the class. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking): the class picnic
explanations.body: You are the class leader and it is time for your class to have a picnic. A. Read the email from Zhang Laoshi, leader of the teaching team. The email:

examples.text: 马龙，你好！刚才李教官告诉我，学校已经同意我们班下星期三搞野餐活动了。我想请你来组织一下，好吗？时间和地点，准备什么样的食品、饮料以及怎么准备，你和同学们决定。下星期一以前，每位老师会交给你十二元钱。另外，上次我们班组织春节聚餐，还有很多纸盘、刀叉和餐巾纸没用完，就不需要再买了。我会带一些春卷过去，刘老师会带一些水果。我还有一个建议。以前教过你们的孙老师和高老师，虽然现在不教你们了，但她们都很关心你们的学习。特别是孙老师，每个星期都给我打电话，问你们的情况。我知道你们也很想念她们。你能不能写一封信，请她们参加我们的野餐呢？张老师
examples.translation: mǎ lóng nǐ hǎo gāng cái lǐ jiào guān gào sù wǒ xué xiào yǐ jīng tóng yì wǒ men bān xià xīng qī sān gǎo yě cān huó dòng le wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ lái zǔ zhī yí xià hǎo ma shí jiān hé dì diǎn zhǔn bèi shén me yàng de shí pǐn yǐn liào yǐ jí zěn me zhǔn bèi nǐ hé tóng xué men jué dìng xià xīng qī yī yǐ qián měi wèi lǎo shī huì jiāo gěi nǐ shí èr yuán qián lìng wài shàng cì wǒ men bān zǔ zhī chūn jié jù cān hái yǒu hěn duō zhǐ pán dāo chā hé cān jīn zhǐ méi yòng wán jiù bù xū yào zài mǎi le wǒ huì dài yì xiē chūn juǎn guò qù liú lǎo shī huì dài yì xiē shuǐ guǒ wǒ hái yǒu yí gè jiàn yì yǐ qián jiāo guò nǐ men de sūn lǎo shī hé gāo lǎo shī suī rán xiàn zài bù jiāo nǐ men le dàn tā men dōu hěn guān xīn nǐ men de xué xí tè bié shì sūn lǎo shī měi gè xīng qī dōu gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn nǐ men de qíng kuàng wǒ zhī dào nǐ men yě hěn xiǎng niàn tā men nǐ néng bù néng xiě yì fēng xìn qǐng tā men cān jiā wǒ men de yě cān ne zhāng lǎo shī — Ma Long, hello! Just now Instructor Li told me that the school has agreed to let our class hold a picnic next Wednesday. I’d like you to organize it, all right? You and the classmates decide the time and place, what kind of food and drinks to prepare and how. Before next Monday, each teacher will give you twelve yuan. In addition, last time our class organized the Spring Festival dinner there were still many paper plates, knives and forks and napkins unused, so there is no need to buy more. I’ll bring some spring rolls and Teacher Liu will bring some fruit. I have one more suggestion. Teachers Sun and Gao, who taught you before, although they no longer teach you now, both care a lot about your studies. Especially Teacher Sun, who calls me every week to ask about you. I know you also miss them very much. Could you write a letter inviting them to join our picnic? Teacher Zhang

explanations.title: Activity 2 B to D
explanations.body: B. Make a plan for the picnic and fill in the table in pinyin or characters: 地点; 开始时间和结束时间; 参加人员; 需要准备的东西. C. Write an email inviting Sun Laoshi and Gao Laoshi to the picnic, including the kind of event, the time, location, what food will be provided, who will attend and whether guests need to bring anything (subject: 邀请). D. Pair up, go over your email with your partner, refine it and share it with the class.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking): the New Year flyer
explanations.body: The Chinese New Year is coming and the local Chinese community is preparing a major celebration; one of your teachers is the organizer and needs your help. A. Below is an old flyer in English (Monterey Bay Chinese Community Chinese New Year Celebration; 蒙特雷华人庆新春联欢会; “2021 Year of Ox” beside “鼠年大庆” in the book; Chinese gourmet foods; Chinese traditional music, songs and dances; red envelopes of good fortune for children under 12; 12 PM to 3 PM, Saturday, Jan 18, 2021; Monterey Community Center). Design a new flyer in Chinese that is more specific to this year’s event, for example by listing the food and drinks provided. Write the Chinese version in the table (位置: 上边（红色部分）, 中间（蓝色部分）, 下边（黑色部分）; 中文). B. In pairs, share and refine your flyer. C. explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Photographs: a gathering and an elderly couple (not included). Pair up and discuss: A. What would you bring if you were invited to a housewarming party? B. What would guests be likely to talk about at a housewarming party?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 到老张家
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters. Notes: 1. 对了: in addition to “correct”, 对了 can also be used to indicate “by the way”. For example 对了，小王，今年你想在哪里过春节？ 2. 先 + verb + 着 is an idiomatic expression used to be excused from an ongoing action or state. For example 你们先吃着，我去打个电话；你先坐着，我马上就回来。 3. 早就 V = 很早以前就 V.

examples.text: 老张：王文来啦，快请进。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng wáng wén lái la kuài qǐng jìn — Wang Wen is here! Please come in.

examples.text: 王文：对不起，让你们久等了。老张，这是一点小礼物。
examples.translation: wáng wén duì bù qǐ ràng nǐ men jiǔ děng le lǎo zhāng zhè shì yì diǎn xiǎo lǐ wù — Sorry to have kept you waiting. Lao Zhang, here is a little gift.

examples.text: 老张：哎呀，人来就行了，什么都不用带。

examples.text: 王文：一点儿小意思。是我去景德镇出差时买的一套茶具。
examples.translation: wáng wén yì diǎnr xiǎo yì si shì wǒ qù jǐng dé zhèn chū chāi shí mǎi de yí tào chá jù — Just a small token. It’s a tea set I bought when I went to Jingdezhen on a business trip.

examples.text: 老张：那我就收下了，谢谢。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng nà wǒ jiù shōu xià le xiè xiè — Then I’ll accept it, thanks.

examples.text: 王文：你们的新房子真大，小区也很漂亮。
examples.translation: wáng wén nǐ men de xīn fáng zi zhēn dà xiǎo qū yě hěn piào liàng — Your new house is really big, and the neighborhood is lovely too.

examples.text: 老张：是呀，比以前住的公寓大多了，小区里很安静，学区也不错。离超市和社区医院都很近，生活非常方便。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng shì ya bǐ yǐ qián zhù de gōng yù dà duō le xiǎo qū lǐ hěn ān jìng xué qū yě bú cuò lí chāo shì hé shè qū yī yuàn dōu hěn jìn shēng huó fēi cháng fāng biàn — Yes, it’s much bigger than the apartment we lived in before; the neighborhood is quiet and the school district is good. It’s very close to the supermarket and the community clinic, so life is very convenient.

examples.text: 王文：太好了。真为你们高兴。
examples.translation: wáng wén tài hǎo le zhēn wèi nǐ men gāo xìng — Great. I’m really happy for you.

examples.text: 老张：来，这边坐。饮料、零食都在桌上，喜欢什么就吃什么。对了，你们几位都认识吧？

examples.text: 王文：认识认识，以前都见过面。
examples.translation: wáng wén rèn shí rèn shí yǐ qián dōu jiàn guò miàn — Yes, yes, we’ve all met before.

examples.text: 老张：太好了。那你们先聊着，我去厨房帮我太太准备晚饭。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng tài hǎo le nà nǐ men xiān liáo zhe wǒ qù chú fáng bāng wǒ tài tài zhǔn bèi wǎn fàn — Great. Then you chat first; I’ll go to the kitchen to help my wife prepare dinner.

examples.text: 王文：早就听说陈姐饭做得特别好，今天终于有机会尝尝了。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

lessons.title: 376. Lesson 15 Presentation 2 grammar: 想 + Verb + 什么 + 就 + Verb + 什么
lessons.subtitle: 喜欢什么就吃什么 · 你想买什么就买什么 · 想怎么做就怎么做

explanations.title: The 想 + Verb + 什么 + 就 + Verb + 什么 construction
explanations.body: This construction indicates that one can do as one likes. The question word 什么 serves as a reference to an open/unnamed object. Instead of 想 you can also use 要, 愿意, 喜欢, etc.; other question words such as 谁, 哪儿, 多少, 什么时候 and 怎么 can also be used this way. Affirmative: 想 + Verb + Question Word + 就 + Verb + Question Word. Negative: 不(是/能) 想 + Verb + Question Word + 就 + Verb + Question Word. Interrogative: 想 + Verb + Question Word + 就 + Verb + Question Word + 吗？ / 是不是想 + Verb + Question Word + 就 + Verb + Question Word？

examples.text: 我们是老朋友了，你想说什么就说什么。

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking, and Reading). A. Listen to six sentences and complete them with the construction: 1. 你愿意 ___。 2. 你想 ___。 3. 你要 ___。 4. 你愿意 ___。 5. 你想 ___。 6. 你喜欢 ___。 B. Take turns translating each sentence into English; your partner repeats it in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 2 (Speaking, Writing, and Reading). A. Pair up. Using the scenarios (在饭馆点菜, 去电影院看电影, 什么时候吃晚饭, 去哪儿买衣服) ask your partner a question; they answer with the construction or its variations; write the sentences in Chinese. B. Share two interactions with the class. My interactions (mine):

examples.text: 甲：你想吃什么就点什么。乙：好，我想吃什么就点什么，别客气。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ xiǎng chī shén me jiù diǎn shén me yǐ hǎo wǒ xiǎng chī shén me jiù diǎn shén me bié kè qì — A: Order whatever you want to eat. B: OK, I’ll order whatever I want; no need to be polite. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：我们看什么电影？乙：你想看什么就看什么。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ men kàn shén me diàn yǐng yǐ nǐ xiǎng kàn shén me jiù kàn shén me — A: What movie shall we watch? B: Watch whatever you want. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：我们什么时候吃晚饭？乙：你想什么时候吃就什么时候吃。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ men shén me shí hòu chī wǎn fàn yǐ nǐ xiǎng shén me shí hòu chī jiù shén me shí hòu chī — A: When shall we have dinner? B: Whenever you want. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：我们去哪儿买衣服？乙：你喜欢去哪儿就去哪儿。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ men qù nǎr mǎi yī fú yǐ nǐ xǐ huān qù nǎr jiù qù nǎr — A: Where shall we buy clothes? B: Wherever you like. (mine)

lessons.title: 377. Lesson 15 Presentation 2 grammar: the verb 让
lessons.subtitle: 让你们久等了 · 老师让我们读两遍课文 · 班长不让我们说英文

explanations.title: Verb 让
explanations.body: The verb 让 is often used to express: 1. To let or allow someone to do something. 2. To ask someone to do something. 3. To cause something to happen. 4. To cause someone to feel a certain way. 5. To yield. Affirmative: Subject + 让 + Object + Verb (+ Object). Negative: Subject + 不让 + Object + Verb (+ Object). Interrogative: Subject + 让 + Object + Verb (+ Object) + 吗？ Affirmative-negative: Subject + 让不让 + Object + Verb (+ Object)？

examples.text: 她让我看她的照片。
examples.translation: tā ràng wǒ kàn tā de zhào piān — She let me look at her photos. (to let/allow)

examples.text: 老师让我们读两遍课文。
examples.translation: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men dú liǎng biàn kè wén — The teacher asked us to read the text twice. (to ask)

examples.text: 这顿饭让你花了那么多钱，很不好意思。
examples.translation: zhè dùn fàn ràng nǐ huā le nà me duō qián hěn bù hǎo yì sī — This meal made you spend so much money; I feel bad. (to cause)

examples.text: 这里的天气让大家感觉很舒服。
examples.translation: zhè lǐ de tiān qì ràng dà jiā gǎn jué hěn shū fú — The weather here makes everyone feel comfortable. (to cause a feeling)

examples.text: 我们都给她让路。
examples.translation: wǒ men dōu gěi tā ràng lù — We all made way for her. (to yield)

explanations.title: Examples 1 to 8
explanations.body: The book’s examples:

examples.text: 他让我开他的车去银行。
examples.translation: tā ràng wǒ kāi tā de chē qù yín háng — He let me drive his car to the bank.

examples.text: 爸爸、妈妈让她坐飞机回家过春节。
examples.translation: bà bà mā mā ràng tā zuò fēi jī huí jiā guò chūn jié — Her father and mother had her fly home for Spring Festival.

examples.translation: tā de diàn zi yóu jiàn ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ hěn duō shì qíng — Her email reminded me of many things.

examples.text: 王老师的话让大家很高兴。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī de huà ràng dà jiā hěn gāo xìng — Teacher Wang’s words made everyone very happy.

examples.text: 班长不让我们在教室里说英文。

examples.translation: jūn duì ràng nǐ zài xiào wài zū fáng zhù ma — Does the military let you rent a place off campus?

examples.translation: xià gè zhōu mò xué xiào ràng bú ràng nǐ huí lǎo jiā — Does the school let you go back to your hometown next weekend?

explanations.title: Activities 3 and 4
explanations.body: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading). A. Listen to six sentences and write in English what you hear. B. Take turns translating each sentence into Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking). A. Write complete sentences using the scenarios given, using 让 in each: a teacher asks students to do something; parents let children do something; something makes you feel a certain way; you let someone go first. B. Pair up and share; take turns asking each other questions using the sentences you both wrote. My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 老师让我们每天复习生词。
examples.translation: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi tiān fù xí shēng cí — A teacher asks students to do something: The teacher asks us to review vocabulary every day. (mine)

examples.text: 爸爸妈妈让孩子在周末晚点儿睡觉。
examples.translation: bà bà mā mā ràng hái zi zài zhōu mò wǎn diǎnr shuì jiào — Parents let children do something: Parents let the kids go to bed later on weekends. (mine)

examples.text: 这个消息让我很高兴。
examples.translation: zhè ge xiāo xī ràng wǒ hěn gāo xìng — Something makes you feel a certain way: This news makes me very happy. (mine)

examples.text: 我让他先走。

lessons.title: 378. Lesson 15 Presentation 2 grammar: the complement of potentiality (2)
lessons.subtitle: 做得好 versus 做得很好 · 记得住 · 做不好饭 versus 做得不好

explanations.title: Distinctions between a complement of potentiality and a complement of degree
explanations.body: 1. A complement of potentiality never takes an adverbial modifier (such as 很, 非常, 特别), but a complement of degree generally appears with an adverbial modifier of degree. 2. A complement of potentiality can take an object directly after it; a complement of degree cannot and must repeat the verb. 3. A complement of potentiality is negated by placing 不 between the verb and the complement, but a complement of degree is negated by placing 不 after 得. 4. Some words can only be used as complements of potentiality, and some only as complements of degree.

examples.text: 陈姐饭做得好做不好？
examples.translation: chén jiě fàn zuò de hǎo zuò bù hǎo — Can Ms. Chen cook well? (potentiality)

examples.text: 陈姐饭做得好。
examples.translation: chén jiě fàn zuò de hǎo — Ms. Chen can cook well. (potentiality)

examples.text: 陈姐饭做得特别好。
examples.translation: chén jiě fàn zuò de tè bié hǎo — Ms. Chen cooks very well. (degree)

examples.text: 陈姐做得好饭吗？
examples.translation: chén jiě zuò de hǎo fàn ma — Can Ms. Chen cook well? (potentiality, object after)

examples.text: 陈姐做得好饭。
examples.translation: chén jiě zuò de hǎo fàn — Ms. Chen can cook well.

examples.text: 陈姐做饭做得很好。
examples.translation: chén jiě zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo — Ms. Chen cooks very well. (degree, verb repeated)

examples.text: 陈姐做不好饭。
examples.translation: chén jiě zuò bù hǎo fàn — Ms. Chen cannot cook well. (potentiality negative)

examples.text: 陈姐做饭做得不好。
examples.translation: chén jiě zuò fàn zuò de bù hǎo — Ms. Chen doesn’t cook well. (degree negative)

examples.text: 我记得住电话号码。
examples.translation: wǒ jì de zhù diàn huà hào mǎ — I am able to remember phone numbers. (only potentiality)

examples.text: 我记电话号码记得很好。
examples.translation: wǒ jì diàn huà hào mǎ jì de hěn hǎo — I remember phone numbers well. (only degree)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Create sentence pairs using the given cue: one sentence with a complement of potentiality and the other with a complement of degree. For example, cue: 做中国菜，好 → 小李做得好中国菜 / 小李做中国菜做得很好。 The cues: 写中文字，好; 说中文，清楚; 老师说的话，听懂; 收拾房间，干净; 写作业，好. B. Pair up, compare your work and ask your partner to translate your sentences into English. The book’s example and my pairs (mine; some cues, such as 听懂, naturally fit only one pattern):

examples.text: 小李做得好中国菜。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ zuò de hǎo zhōng guó cài — Cue: 做中国菜，好 (potentiality, the book’s example): Xiao Li can cook Chinese food well.

examples.text: 小李做中国菜做得很好。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ zuò zhōng guó cài zuò de hěn hǎo — (degree) Xiao Li cooks Chinese food very well.

examples.text: 他写得好中文字。
examples.translation: tā xiě de hǎo zhōng wén zì — (mine, 写中文字，好) He can write Chinese characters well.

examples.text: 他写中文字写得很好。
examples.translation: tā xiě zhōng wén zì xiě de hěn hǎo — He writes Chinese characters very well.

examples.text: 她说得清楚中文。
examples.translation: tā shuō de qīng chǔ zhōng wén — (mine, 说中文，清楚) She can speak Chinese clearly.

examples.text: 她说中文说得很清楚。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn qīng chǔ — She speaks Chinese very clearly.

examples.text: 我听得懂老师说的话。
examples.translation: wǒ tīng de dǒng lǎo shī shuō de huà — (mine, 老师说的话，听懂) I can understand what the teacher says.

examples.text: 我听老师说的话听得很懂。
examples.translation: wǒ tīng lǎo shī shuō de huà tīng de hěn dǒng — (mine) I understand what the teacher says very well. (this degree use is unusual)

examples.text: 他收拾得干净房间。
examples.translation: tā shōu shí de gān jìng fáng jiān — (mine, 收拾房间，干净) He can tidy the room clean.

examples.text: 他收拾房间收拾得很干净。
examples.translation: tā shōu shí fáng jiān shōu shí de hěn gān jìng — He tidies the room very clean.

examples.text: 我写得好作业。
examples.translation: wǒ xiě de hǎo zuò yè — (mine, 写作业，好) I can do the homework well.

examples.text: 我写作业写得很好。
examples.translation: wǒ xiě zuò yè xiě de hěn hǎo — I do homework very well.

What does 陈姐做饭做得特别好 mean?
What does 陈姐做不好饭 mean?
Which is only a potentiality complement?
Which sentence is a complement of degree?

lessons.title: 379. Lesson 15 Presentation 2: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 结婚三十周年 · 一点儿小意思 · 书法

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a WeChat message twice and write a summary in English. New words: 重要 (zhòngyào; important), 不好意思 (bù hǎoyìsi; feel sorry). B. Listen again and refine your summary. C. Read the statements and mark each True or False (the book gives no key and it depends on the audio, so none is given here). (Audio, not included.) The five statements:

examples.text: 马静和她先生刚刚参加了一个聚会。
examples.translation: mǎ jìng hé tā xiān shēng gāng gāng cān jiā le yí gè jù huì — 1. Ma Jing and her husband have just attended a party.

examples.text: 老张也是王真的朋友。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng yě shì wáng zhēn de péng yǒu — 2. Lao Zhang is also Wang Zhen’s friend.

examples.text: 马静的先生早就听说王真做鱼做得很好。
examples.translation: mǎ jìng de xiān shēng zǎo jiù tīng shuō wáng zhēn zuò yú zuò de hěn hǎo — 3. Ma Jing’s husband heard long ago that Wang Zhen cooks fish very well.

examples.text: 王真的新房子很漂亮，可是很贵。
examples.translation: wáng zhēn de xīn fáng zi hěn piào liàng kě shì hěn guì — 4. Wang Zhen’s new house is very beautiful but very expensive.

examples.text: 王真的孙子现在上小学，那个学校非常好。
examples.translation: wáng zhēn de sūn zi xiàn zài shàng xiǎo xué nà ge xué xiào fēi cháng hǎo — 5. Wang Zhen’s grandson is now in elementary school, and that school is very good.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage, consulting your dictionary as needed, then answer in English: What was the occasion? Did the guests listen to the host’s request? Why were the dishes served so special? How were the young children treated? (Mine: a thirtieth wedding anniversary; no, they still brought gifts; a friend from Guangdong cooked authentic Cantonese food in a northern city; they could eat and play whatever they liked.) B. Pair up and compare; take turns translating the underlined sentences into English and back into Chinese. C. Role play: you are the passage’s author and your partner is a guest. Welcome your guest; receive the present; discuss the food; include what kids can eat and do; thank your guest for attending.

examples.text: 今天我们家真是热闹。我儿子女儿请了很多朋友来我们家，庆祝我和我太太结婚三十周年。我儿子女儿早就告诉大家，什么东西都不要带，可是朋友们还是带来了各种各样的礼物，有鲜花，有水果，还有艺术品，说是他们的一点儿小意思。老万知道我太太喜欢打乒乓球，就送了她一套乒乓球拍。我喜欢喝茶，我女儿的男朋友就送了我一套日本茶具。大家都是好意，我们只好收下。今天的菜都是我的一位朋友准备的。他是广东人，广东菜做得特别好。有机会在北方的一个小城市尝到地道的广东菜，让大家非常高兴。今天也有很多孩子参加聚会。我女儿除了给他们准备了一些饮料和零食以外，还买了一些玩具。他们喜欢吃什么就吃什么，喜欢玩儿什么就玩儿什么。今天我和我太太过得十分开心，我们很感谢大家对我们的祝福。
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ men jiā zhēn shì rè nào wǒ ér zi nǚ ér qǐng le hěn duō péng yǒu lái wǒ men jiā qìng zhù wǒ hé wǒ tài tài jié hūn sān shí zhōu nián wǒ ér zi nǚ ér zǎo jiù gào sù dà jiā shén me dōng xī dōu bú yào dài kě shì péng yǒu men hái shì dài lái le gè zhǒng gè yàng de lǐ wù yǒu xiān huā yǒu shuǐ guǒ hái yǒu yì shù pǐn shuō shì tā men de yì diǎnr xiǎo yì si lǎo wàn zhī dào wǒ tài tài xǐ huān dǎ pīng pāng qiú jiù sòng le tā yí tào pīng pāng qiú pāi wǒ xǐ huān hē chá wǒ nǚ ér de nán péng yǒu jiù sòng le wǒ yí tào rì běn chá jù dà jiā dōu shì hǎo yì wǒ men zhǐ hǎo shōu xià jīn tiān de cài dōu shì wǒ de yí wèi péng yǒu zhǔn bèi de tā shì guǎng dōng rén guǎng dōng cài zuò de tè bié hǎo yǒu jī huì zài běi fāng de yí gè xiǎo chéng shì cháng dào dì dào de guǎng dōng cài ràng dà jiā fēi cháng gāo xìng jīn tiān yě yǒu hěn duō hái zi cān jiā jù huì wǒ nǚ ér chú le gěi tā men zhǔn bèi le yì xiē yǐn liào hé líng shí yǐ wài hái mǎi le yì xiē wán jù tā men xǐ huān chī shén me jiù chī shén me xǐ huān wánr shén me jiù wánr shén me jīn tiān wǒ hé wǒ tài tài guò de shí fēn kāi xīn wǒ men hěn gǎn xiè dà jiā duì wǒ men de zhù fú — Today our home was really lively. My son and daughter invited many friends to our home to celebrate the thirtieth anniversary of my wife’s and my marriage. My son and daughter had told everyone long ago not to bring anything, but friends still brought all kinds of gifts: flowers, fruit, and works of art, saying it was a small token. Lao Wan knew my wife likes table tennis and gave her a set of table tennis paddles. I like tea, so my daughter’s boyfriend gave me a Japanese tea set. They all meant well, so we had no choice but to accept. Today’s dishes were all prepared by a friend of mine. He is from Guangdong and cooks Cantonese food especially well. Having the chance to taste authentic Cantonese food in a small northern city made everyone very happy. Many children also came to the party. Besides preparing drinks and snacks for them, my daughter also bought some toys. They ate whatever they liked and played with whatever they liked. Today my wife and I were very happy, and we are very grateful for everyone’s blessings.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking, Writing, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and take turns writing the Chinese equivalents of the English sentences, using the expressions provided in parentheses. 1. Sorry to have kept you waiting. We left home very early, and went to look at a new apartment on our way here. We like it very much. (让, 早, 地) 2. We have brought you this tea set. I bought it when I was on a business trip in Shanghai. It is just a small token of appreciation and we hope you like it. (小意思) 3. The apartment we like is much larger than our current one. It is both pretty and quiet, and very close to the supermarket. (大多了, 又…又…) 4. The dishes you’ve made are so delicious! Yes, I’ll help myself with whatever dish I like. (真, 什么…什么…) 5. Did you write this? I heard a long time ago that you are very good at calligraphy (书法), and finally I have an opportunity to see your work (作品). (早, 有机会) 6. By the way, we will invite you to our new home as soon as we have moved into it. We will treat you to some simple homemade food. Please don’t bring anything, just yourselves. (对了, 什么都) B. Together, go over the Chinese sentences you have written. My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 对不起，让你们久等了。我们很早就出门了，在来的路上还看了一套新公寓，我们很喜欢。
examples.translation: duì bù qǐ ràng nǐ men jiǔ děng le wǒ men hěn zǎo jiù chū mén le zài lái de lù shàng hái kàn le yí tào xīn gōng yù wǒ men hěn xǐ huān — 1. (mine; 让, 早, 地) Sorry to have kept you waiting. We left home very early, and on the way here we looked at a new apartment; we like it very much.

examples.text: 这是我们带给你们的茶具，是我去上海出差时买的。一点小意思，希望你们喜欢。

explanations.body: You are a visiting professor at Guangzhou University and New Year’s Day is coming. A. It’s one week before; you are planning a celebration. In groups of three compare the two services below, decide which is best and fill in the table (上门家宴服务 versus 特色家宴: 好的地方, 不好的地方, 选哪个 & 为什么). The book prints phone numbers and times as digits; they are spelled out here.

examples.text: 上门家宴服务。朋友聚会，去饭店吗？最有名的饭店也不一定能做出您喜欢吃的菜。而且，饭店做菜往往放很多鸡精，对身体不好。另外，在饭店吃一顿大餐要花很多钱，不合算。怎么办？建议您跟我们联系，我们有最好的厨师，用最健康的食材，给您做一桌最好吃的大餐！我们去您家，您点什么菜我们就做什么菜，又快又好又便宜。此外，要是您想学，饭后我们还可以教您做一个名菜。请马上打美味热线：八零零，三三三，二一二一。

A friends’ gathering: go to a restaurant? Even the most famous restaurant may not be able to make the dishes you like. Moreover, restaurants often put in a lot of chicken essence, which is bad for health. Besides, a big meal at a restaurant costs a lot and isn’t worth it. What to do? We suggest you contact us: we have the best chefs, use the healthiest ingredients, and make you a table of the most delicious dishes! We come to your home and cook whatever dish you order; fast, good and cheap. In addition, if you want to learn, after the meal we can also teach you a famous dish. Call the delicious hot-line now: 800-333-2121 (read digit by digit).

explanations.title: Activity 2 B and C, and Activity 3
explanations.body: B. It is New Year’s Day and the guests have arrived. Each member of the group (the organizer, the cook and one of the guests) makes a speech in Chinese using the talking points. Organizer: welcome everybody to the event; what the event is about, who the attendants are; how the event will proceed (enjoy whatever drinks and food they like; exchange gifts after the meal, etc.); any questions? Cook: thank them for the opportunity to serve; describe the food, drinks and dessert; any questions? Guest: thank the organizer and the cook; comment on the environment, the food and the drinks; invite people to your new home to celebrate the Chinese New Year in a few weeks. C. It is now January 2. Write an email to a Chinese friend describing how the event went; include the EEIs in six to eight sentences. Activity 3 (Listening, Reading, Speaking, and Writing). You are training the managers of a Chinese company in Shanghai on American culture; one category is socializing. A. Today’s topic is house parties (开放式聚会) in America. Mr. Zhu, a guest speaker, first shares his experience while living in America. Listen to his description and write a summary. You organized a house party at your apartment the following day. Pictures taken during the party are shown (not included); tell your Chinese colleague (your partner) what happened; then switch. C. Write an email to a Chinese friend describing the party you held and share it with your partner. (Audio and pictures, not included.)

lessons.title: 382. Lesson 15 Presentation 3: the Independence Day picnic
lessons.subtitle: 七月四号是独立日 · 有的…有的… · 起来 · 一直玩到天黑才回家

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Photographs: a barbecue, kids and bikes (not included). Pair up and discuss: A. How do you usually celebrate Independence Day? B. What foods would you usually eat at a picnic on this holiday? C. What recreational activities do people enjoy, in addition to having a BBQ?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 公园烧烤
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters. Notes: 1. The 有的…有的… construction: 有的 can be used multiple times in a sentence to indicate different groups engaged in various actions or states. 2. The use of 起来: as a directional complement 起来 indicates upward movement, like the English adverb “up” as in 站起来. In addition, 起来 is often used to indicate the start of an action, such as 忙起来 and 吃起来 in the Presentation above. It can also indicate the start of a state such as 好起来 and 热起来. Idiomatic expressions are also used in the form of the verb + 起来: 看起来 (Lesson 10-2) means “it seems” or “it looks like,” and 想起来 (Lesson 15-1) means “just come to mind.”

examples.text: 七月四号是独立日，大卫约了几家朋友到公园烧烤。那天的天气特别好，没有风，不冷也不热。公园里人很多，有的躺在草地上晒太阳，有的沿着小路骑自行车，还有的坐在长椅上看风景。下午一点，大家都到了。大卫准备了汉堡和热狗，琳达带来了餐具和甜点，麦克买了饮料和水果。大家一放下东西就忙起来。爸爸们烤肉，妈妈们切水果，大家一边干活，一边聊天。聚会上玩得最开心的要数孩子们了，他们高兴地在草地上跑来跑去，又笑又叫。肉烤好了，孩子们也饿了，大家围坐一起吃起来。琳达烤的苹果派最受欢迎，大家都说没吃够。饭吃完了，爸爸们又带着孩子们踢球，而妈妈们忙着收拾垃圾。大家一直玩到天黑才回家。
examples.translation: qī yuè sì hào shì dú lì rì dà wèi yuē le jǐ jiā péng yǒu dào gōng yuán shāo kǎo nà tiān de tiān qì tè bié hǎo méi yǒu fēng bù lěng yě bú rè gōng yuán lǐ rén hěn duō yǒu de tǎng zài cǎo dì shàng shài tài yáng yǒu de yán zhe xiǎo lù qí zì xíng chē hái yǒu de zuò zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn fēng jǐng xià wǔ yì diǎn dà jiā dōu dào le dà wèi zhǔn bèi le hàn bǎo hé rè gǒu lín dá dài lái le cān jù hé tián diǎn mài kè mǎi le yǐn liào hé shuǐ guǒ dà jiā yí fàng xià dōng xī jiù máng qǐ lái bà bà men kǎo ròu mā mā men qiè shuǐ guǒ dà jiā yì biān gàn huó yì biān liáo tiān jù huì shàng wán de zuì kāi xīn de yào shǔ hái zi men le tā men gāo xìng de zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù yòu xiào yòu jiào ròu kǎo hǎo le hái zi men yě è le dà jiā wéi zuò yì qǐ chī qǐ lái lín dá kǎo de píng guǒ pài zuì shòu huān yíng dà jiā dōu shuō méi chī gòu fàn chī wán le bà bà men yòu dài zhe hái zi men tī qiú ér mā mā men máng zhe shōu shí lā jī dà jiā yì zhí wán dào tiān hēi cái huí jiā — July 4th is Independence Day, and David invited several families of friends to the park for a barbecue. The weather that day was especially good: no wind, neither cold nor hot. There were many people in the park; some lay on the grass sunbathing, some rode bicycles along the trail, and others sat on long benches looking at the scenery. At one in the afternoon everyone had arrived. David prepared hamburgers and hot dogs, Linda brought tableware and desserts, and Mike bought drinks and fruit. As soon as everyone put their things down they got busy. The dads grilled meat, the moms cut fruit, and everyone chatted while working. The happiest at the gathering were the children, who ran around on the lawn happily, laughing and shouting. When the meat was grilled and the children were hungry, everyone sat in a circle and began to eat. Linda’s apple pie was the most popular; everyone said they hadn’t had enough. When the meal was over, the dads took the kids to play soccer while the moms were busy tidying up the trash. Everyone played until dark before going home.

examples.text: 他们有的看书，有的做作业。
examples.translation: tā men yǒu de kàn shū yǒu de zuò zuò yè — They: some read, some do homework.

examples.text: 海滩上有很多人，有的站着，有的坐着，有的躺着。
examples.translation: hǎi tān shàng yǒu hěn duō rén yǒu de zhàn zhe yǒu de zuò zhe yǒu de tǎng zhe — There are many people on the beach; some stand, some sit, some lie down.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Global listening: 1. Why did David and his friends get together on that day? 2. Who worked hard for the gathering and who were the happiest? B. Detailed listening: 1. What was the weather like that day? 2. What were things like in the park? 3. What did David and Linda bring to the picnic? 4. What did the kids do? (Audio, not included. From the text, mine: Independence Day, to barbecue in the park; the dads grilled, the moms cut fruit, the children were the happiest; no wind, neither cold nor hot; many people lying on the grass, cycling on the trail, sitting on benches; David brought hamburgers and hot dogs, Linda tableware and dessert; they ran around on the lawn, laughing and shouting, then played soccer.) Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking). Pair up and fill in the table with the expressions you’ve just learned (rows: Weather; Activities in the park; BBQ; Doing something in a certain manner; Doing something back and forth; Those who were the busiest…; Some people doing A and some doing B; Something not happening until a certain time). The book leaves the cells empty; my answers (mine):

examples.text: 躺在草地上晒太阳，沿着小路骑自行车，坐在长椅上看风景
examples.translation: tǎng zài cǎo dì shàng shài tài yáng yán zhe xiǎo lù qí zì xíng chē zuò zài cháng yǐ shàng kàn fēng jǐng — Activities in the park

examples.text: 烤肉，烧烤，汉堡和热狗，苹果派

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Match the phrases in Column A with those in Column B by writing the letters in the leftmost column. B. Pair up, compare, and take turns asking each other questions about each of the sentences. The book leaves the key out; my matches (mine): 1-d, 2-e, 3-a, 4-f, 5-c, 6-b.

examples.text: 他一边打电话一边走来走去。
examples.translation: tā yì biān dǎ diàn huà yì biān zǒu lái zǒu qù — He talked on the phone while walking back and forth.

examples.text: 昨天，他们在老王家聊天一直聊到晚上十点半。
examples.translation: zuó tiān tā men zài lǎo wáng jiā liáo tiān yì zhí liáo dào wǎn shàng shí diǎn bàn — Yesterday they chatted at Lao Wang’s home until ten thirty at night.

examples.text: 我们新租的公寓不大不小，很合适。
examples.translation: wǒ men xīn zū de gōng yù bú dà bù xiǎo hěn hé shì — The apartment we newly rented is neither big nor small, very suitable.

examples.text: 吃完烤肉以后，孩子们开心地在草地上跑来跑去。
examples.translation: chī wán kǎo ròu yǐ hòu hái zi men kāi xīn de zài cǎo dì shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù — After the barbecue the children ran around on the lawn happily.

examples.text: 大家有的烤肉，有的准备甜点，有的切水果。
examples.translation: dà jiā yǒu de kǎo ròu yǒu de zhǔn bèi tián diǎn yǒu de qiè shuǐ guǒ — Some grilled meat, some prepared dessert, some cut fruit.

explanations.title: Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking). A. Listen to a dialog and answer in English. New words: 羊肉串 (yángròu chuàn; kebab), 家长 (jiāzhǎng; parents). 1. Where and when did the gathering take place and who were the participants? 2. Why didn’t Xiao Zhang join them? 3. What did those at the gathering do after the meal? 4. What did Lao Li and his wife do? B. Pair up; take turns translating the underlined sentences into English. (Audio, not included.) Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking, and Reading). A. Pair up. Put the following sentences in order to create a logical passage; consult your dictionary if necessary. The seven sentences in the book’s order (a to g):

examples.text: 客人们在我们家一直玩到下午四点多才离开。
examples.translation: kè rén men zài wǒ men jiā yì zhí wán dào xià wǔ sì diǎn duō cái lí kāi — b. The guests played at our home until after four in the afternoon before they left.

examples.text: 我们准备了很多吃的东西，比如烤火鸡、南瓜饼、红薯。
examples.translation: wǒ men zhǔn bèi le hěn duō chī de dōng xī bǐ rú kǎo huǒ jī nán guā bǐng hóng shǔ — c. We prepared lots of food, such as roast turkey, pumpkin pie and sweet potatoes.

examples.text: 上个星期四是感恩节，我们请了几位朋友来和我们一起过节。
examples.translation: shàng gè xīng qī sì shì gǎn ēn jié wǒ men qǐng le jǐ wèi péng yǒu lái hé wǒ men yì qǐ guò jié — d. Last Thursday was Thanksgiving, and we invited several friends to celebrate with us.

lessons.title: 383. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the V + 来 + V + 去 construction
lessons.subtitle: 飞来飞去 · 挑来选去 · 走来走去 · 想来想去

explanations.title: The V + 来 + V + 去 construction
explanations.body: This construction indicates that an action happens repeatedly or moves back and forth. It is generally used with two verbs that are either identical or synonymous, for example 飞来飞去 and 挑来选去. Subject + V + 来 + V + 去. (Note: if the verb has an object, the object is usually at the beginning of the sentence.)

examples.text: 很多鸟在天上飞来飞去。
examples.translation: hěn duō niǎo zài tiān shàng fēi lái fēi qù — Many birds fly back and forth in the sky.

examples.text: 他看来看去，都看不出那位医生写了什么。
examples.translation: tā kàn lái kàn qù dōu kàn bù chū nà wèi yī shēng xiě le shén me — He looked this way and that, but could not make out what the doctor had written.

examples.text: 我不喜欢靠过道的座位，因为总有人在旁边走来走去。
examples.translation: wǒ bù xǐ huān kào guò dào de zuò wèi yīn wèi zǒng yǒu rén zài páng biān zǒu lái zǒu qù — I don’t like aisle seats, because there are always people walking back and forth next to them.

examples.text: 他把沙发搬来搬去，也没找到合适的地方。
examples.translation: tā bǎ shā fā bān lái bān qù yě méi zhǎo dào hé shì de dì fāng — He moved the sofa around, but still didn’t find a suitable place.

examples.text: 这件事他想来想去，不知道应该怎么办。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn shì tā xiǎng lái xiǎng qù bù zhī dào yīng gāi zěn me bàn — He thought it over and over, and didn’t know what to do.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Work in pairs to rewrite the following sentences using the V + 来 + V + 去 construction. The originals: 爸爸做了很多菜，她尝尝这个，又尝尝那个，还是觉得烤鸭最好吃。 早上很多人在公园里来回走路。 这句话我听了一遍又一遍，还是听不懂。 我在公共汽车站等了很长时间，还是没有车过来。 这些肉他烤了又烤。因为烤得时间太长，已经不好吃了。 The book leaves the rewritten column empty; my rewrites (mine):

examples.text: 爸爸做了很多菜，她尝来尝去，还是觉得烤鸭最好吃。
examples.translation: bà bà zuò le hěn duō cài tā cháng lái cháng qù hái shì jué de kǎo yā zuì hǎo chī — Dad made many dishes; she tasted this and that, and still felt the roast duck was the best. (mine)

examples.text: 早上很多人在公园里走来走去。
examples.translation: zǎo shàng hěn duō rén zài gōng yuán lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù — In the morning many people walk back and forth in the park. (mine)

examples.text: 这句话我听来听去，还是听不懂。
examples.translation: zhè jù huà wǒ tīng lái tīng qù hái shì tīng bù dǒng — I listened to this sentence over and over and still couldn’t understand it. (mine)

examples.text: 我在公共汽车站等来等去，还是没有车过来。
examples.translation: wǒ zài gōng gòng qì chē zhàn děng lái děng qù hái shì méi yǒu chē guò lái — I waited at the bus stop for a long time and still no bus came. (mine)

examples.text: 这些肉他烤来烤去。因为烤得时间太长，已经不好吃了。
examples.translation: zhè xiē ròu tā kǎo lái kǎo qù yīn wèi kǎo de shí jiān tài cháng yǐ jīng bù hǎo chī le — He grilled this meat over and over. Because it was grilled for too long, it’s no longer tasty. (mine)

lessons.title: 384. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the 不…不… construction
lessons.subtitle: 不大不小 · 不冷不热 · 不急不慢 · 不快不慢地散步

explanations.title: The 不…不… construction
explanations.body: The 不…不… construction is used to express that neither A nor B are true; in colloquial Chinese it is often used to indicate a desirable state, such as 这双皮鞋不大不小 (neither too big nor too small) or 蒙特雷的天气不冷不热 (not too cold, not too hot). 不…不… + 的 + Noun (Noun Phrase). 不…不… + 地 + Verb (Verb Phrase).

examples.text: 这部电影不长不短。
examples.translation: zhè bù diàn yǐng bù cháng bù duǎn — This movie is neither long nor short.

examples.text: 这个房子不大不小。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng zi bú dà bù xiǎo — This house is neither big nor small.

examples.text: 他是一个做事不急不慢的人。
examples.translation: tā shì yí gè zuò shì bù jí bú màn de rén — He is a person who does things neither hurriedly nor slowly.

examples.text: 爸爸给他买了一张不高不矮的书桌。
examples.translation: bà bà gěi tā mǎi le yì zhāng bù gāo bù ǎi de shū zhuō — Dad bought him a desk that is neither tall nor short.

examples.text: 小李说话不快不慢。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ shuō huà bú kuài bú màn — Xiao Li speaks neither fast nor slow.

examples.text: 老王不言不语地看着电视。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng bù yán bù yǔ de kàn zhe diàn shì — Lao Wang watched TV without saying a word.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In the passage the book gives, fill in the blanks with the words provided in parentheses using the 不…不… construction: 高、矮; 胖、瘦; 早、晚; 大、小; 多、少; 快、慢; 大、小; 远、近. B. Answer the questions: 1. 王丽长得什么样？ 2. 王丽什么时候去的电影院？ 3. 他们的晚饭吃得怎么样？ 4. 吃完晚饭以后他们做什么了？ (Mine: 不高不矮，不胖不瘦，爱笑; 三点半; 菜有点儿咸，但味道不错，四个菜八十元; 去海边不快不慢地散步，然后小李送她回公寓.) C. Check your work against the complete passage:

examples.text: 小李的女朋友王丽今年二十四岁，长得不高不矮，不胖不瘦，说话的时候总是笑。今天小李和她去看了一场电影。他们约好三点半在电影院门口见面，可是小李三点就在电影院门口等。王丽呢，不早不晚三点半到那儿。看完电影，小李带王丽去一家不大不小的饭馆吃晚饭。那儿的菜虽然有点儿咸，但味道不错。他们点了四个菜，花了不多不少八十元钱。吃完饭，他们又到了海边，不快不慢地散了一会儿步。然后，小李送王丽回到她那套不大不小离海边不远不近的公寓。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ de nǚ péng yǒu wáng lì jīn nián èr shí sì suì zhǎng de bù gāo bù ǎi bú pàng bú shòu shuō huà de shí hòu zǒng shì xiào jīn tiān xiǎo lǐ hé tā qù kàn le yì cháng diàn yǐng tā men yuē hǎo sān diǎn bàn zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu jiàn miàn kě shì xiǎo lǐ sān diǎn jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu děng wáng lì ne bù zǎo bù wǎn sān diǎn bàn dào nàr kàn wán diàn yǐng xiǎo lǐ dài wáng lì qù yì jiā bú dà bù xiǎo de fàn guǎn chī wǎn fàn nàr de cài suī rán yǒu diǎnr xián dàn wèi dào bú cuò tā men diǎn le sì gè cài huā le bù duō bù shǎo bā shí yuán qián chī wán fàn tā men yòu dào le hǎi biān bú kuài bú màn de sàn le yí huìr bù rán hòu xiǎo lǐ sòng wáng lì huí dào tā nà tào bú dà bù xiǎo lí hǎi biān bù yuǎn bú jìn de gōng yù — Xiao Li’s girlfriend Wang Li is twenty-four this year; she is neither tall nor short, neither fat nor thin, and always smiles when she talks. Today Xiao Li and she went to see a movie. They had agreed to meet at the movie theater entrance at three thirty, but Xiao Li was already waiting there at three. Wang Li arrived there neither early nor late, at three thirty. After the movie, Xiao Li took Wang Li to a restaurant that was neither big nor small for dinner. Although the food there was a bit salty, the taste was good. They ordered four dishes, which cost exactly eighty yuan. After eating they went to the seaside and took a walk neither fast nor slow. Then Xiao Li took Wang Li back to her apartment, which is neither big nor small and neither far nor near the sea.

lessons.title: 385. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the adverbial modifier marker 地
lessons.subtitle: 高兴地告诉我 · 慢慢地走 · 你跑得很慢 vs. 你慢慢地跑过去

explanations.title: The adverbial modifier marker 地
explanations.body: An adverb is a part of speech that modifies (i.e., describes) a verb. When an adverb describes the manner of a verb, it is often formed with an adjective and marked by the adverbial modifier 地. Example: 小王高兴地告诉我，她考上北京大学了。 An adverbial expression is different from a complement expression. A complement expression is descriptive in nature, whereas an adverbial expression tells the “attitude” or manner of an action. Also, a complement is most often used in connection with a habitual action, or an action that has already taken place, whereas an adverbial modifier may also refer to an action that has yet to happen. Example: 你跑得很慢 vs. 你慢慢地跑过去。 Adjective + 地 + Verb (+ Object).

examples.text: 小王高兴地告诉我，她考上北京大学了。
examples.translation: xiǎo wáng gāo xìng de gào sù wǒ tā kǎo shàng běi jīng dà xué le — Xiao Wang happily told me that she got into Peking University.

examples.text: 他开心地笑了。
examples.translation: tā kāi xīn de xiào le — He laughed happily.

examples.text: 我们慢慢地走到公园。

examples.text: 大家都在认真地做作业。

lessons.title: 386. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the aspect particle 着
lessons.subtitle: 客厅里摆着沙发 · 带着孩子们踢球 · 忙着收拾垃圾 · 笑着说

explanations.title: The aspect particle 着
explanations.body: The aspect particle 着 appears after a verb indicating the state or continuation of an action in a static mode. Example: 大明在院子里站着；客厅里放着一张沙发。 We can use the pattern verb + 着 to modify the following verb, thus indicating the state or manner in which the action is carried out. Example: 她坐着讲课。 In Lesson 10 Presentation 3 we learned: 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发。主卧室里面放着一张双人床。后院种着很多果树。 In the current presentation: 爸爸们又带着孩子们踢球，而妈妈们忙着收拾垃圾。 In all these sentences, the aspect particle 着 appears after a verb indicating continuation, either a) indicating an existing state, such as sentences 1 to 3; or b) indicating the manner of carrying out an action, such as sentences 4 and 5. Manner and action: 带着孩子们 (taking the kids) + 踢球 (to play soccer); 忙着 (being busy) + 收拾垃圾 (to clean up). *着 can also be a suffix for some words to form a preposition, such as 沿着 in this presentation.

examples.text: 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发。
examples.translation: kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng sān rén shā fā — In the living room is placed a three-person sofa.

examples.text: 主卧室里面放着一张双人床。
examples.translation: zhǔ wò shì lǐ miàn fàng zhe yì zhāng shuāng rén chuáng — In the master bedroom is placed a double bed.

examples.text: 后院种着很多果树。

examples.text: 爸爸们又带着孩子们踢球。

examples.text: 妈妈们忙着收拾垃圾。
examples.translation: mā mā men máng zhe shōu shí lā jī — The moms were busy tidying up the trash.

examples.text: 大明在院子里站着。
examples.translation: dà míng zài yuàn zi lǐ zhàn zhe — Daming is standing in the yard.

examples.text: 他穿着军服。
examples.translation: tā chuān zhe jūn fú — He is wearing a military uniform.

examples.text: 军服上写着他的名字。
examples.translation: jūn fú shàng xiě zhe tā de míng zì — His name is written on the uniform.

examples.text: 她坐着讲课。

examples.translation: yǒu de rén yán zhe xiǎo lù qí zì xíng chē — Some people ride bicycles along the trail.

explanations.title: Patterns and examples
explanations.body: Affirmative: Subject + Verb + 着; Subject + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object). Negative: Subject + 不/没有 + verb + 着 (+ Object); Subject + 不是/没有 + verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object). Interrogative: Subject + Verb + 着 + 吗？; Subject + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object) + 吗？ Affirmative-Negative: Subject + 有没有/是不是 + verb + 着？; Subject + 有没有/是不是 + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object)？ The eight examples:

examples.text: 李老师在教室里坐着。
examples.translation: lǐ lǎo shī zài jiào shì lǐ zuò zhe — Teacher Li is sitting in the classroom.

examples.text: 教室里放着四张桌子和十把椅子。

examples.text: 李老师在教室里坐着讲课吗？

examples.translation: jiào shì lǐ shì bú shì fàng zhe sì zhāng zhuō zi hé shí bǎ yǐ zi — Are there four tables and ten chairs placed in the classroom?

lessons.title: 387. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the (一)直到…才… construction

explanations.title: The (一)直到…才… construction
explanations.body: This construction expresses the idea of “not until….” Example: 昨天他一直到十点才回家。 Affirmative: (一)直到 + Time/Event + Subject + 才…; Subject + (一)直到 + Time/Event + 才… Negative: (一)直到 + Time/Event + Subject + 都/还 + 不/没…; Subject + (一)直到 + Time/Event + 都/还 + 不/没… The eight examples (the book prints them in two columns, 1 to 8; the first example is repeated at the end):

examples.text: 昨天晚上一直到十点半我才做完作业。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǎn shàng yì zhí dào shí diǎn bàn wǒ cái zuò wán zuò yè — Last night I didn’t finish my homework until ten thirty.

examples.text: 昨天晚上我一直到十点半才做完作业。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ yì zhí dào shí diǎn bàn cái zuò wán zuò yè — Last night I didn’t finish my homework until ten thirty.

examples.text: 他直到十岁还没上小学。

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, and Writing): Erlin’s email
explanations.body: A. Read the email below (the book prints TO, CC and Subject lines empty). Look up any unfamiliar words, then answer in English: 1. Why did Erlin write this message? 2. How did his family in China celebrate Chinese New Year? 3. What did the Chinese community do to celebrate Chinese New Year on Sunday? 4. What did Erlin, his wife, and children do respectively for the gathering? (Mine: to say Happy New Year to his parents and tell them about his celebration; over ten people gathered, eating, drinking, talking and laughing; they gathered in the school auditorium, each bringing dishes, drinks, fruit and dessert, with performances; Erlin made red-braised pork and boiled fish, Pingping organized the performances, and the children danced.) B. Pair up and compare; ask each other three questions in Chinese about the details. C. Work with your partner to rewrite the passage as a dialog between Erlin and his father (five exchanges) and act it out.

examples.text: 爸爸、妈妈过年好！刚才看到爸爸发来的视频。全家十几口人在一起过年，又吃又喝又说又笑，真热闹。爸爸、妈妈的身体看上去也不错，太好了！美国加州春节不放假，但今年春节是个星期天，大家不上班，很多华人朋友在我们学校的礼堂聚了聚。那天，大家每个人都带了一两个菜，还准备了各种饮料、水果、甜点。我做了一个红烧肉，还有一个水煮鱼，大家都很喜欢。那天最忙的要数您儿媳萍萍了。她组织了一些朋友给大家表演节目。有的唱歌，有的跳舞，很受欢迎。我最喜欢的节目是孩子们的舞蹈，里面也有您的孙子和孙女。看他们在舞台上高兴地跳来跳去，觉得特别开心。聚会从中午十二点开始，一直到下午四点才结束。明年我和萍萍打算带着两个孩子回老家，和爸爸妈妈还有其他家人一起过年。多多保重！您的儿媳、孙子、孙女也祝您身体健康！二林
examples.translation: bà bà mā mā guò nián hǎo gāng cái kàn dào bà bà fā lái de shì pín quán jiā shí jǐ kǒu rén zài yì qǐ guò nián yòu chī yòu hē yòu shuō yòu xiào zhēn rè nào bà bà mā mā de shēn tǐ kàn shàng qù yě bú cuò tài hǎo le měi guó jiā zhōu chūn jié bú fàng jià dàn jīn nián chūn jié shì gè xīng qī tiān dà jiā bú shàng bān hěn duō huá rén péng yǒu zài wǒ men xué xiào de lǐ táng jù le jù nà tiān dà jiā měi gè rén dōu dài le yì liǎng gè cài hái zhǔn bèi le gè zhǒng yǐn liào shuǐ guǒ tián diǎn wǒ zuò le yí gè hóng shāo ròu hái yǒu yí gè shuǐ zhǔ yú dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huān nà tiān zuì máng de yào shǔ nín ér xí píng píng le tā zǔ zhī le yì xiē péng yǒu gěi dà jiā biǎo yǎn jié mù yǒu de chàng gē yǒu de tiào wǔ hěn shòu huān yíng wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jié mù shì hái zi men de wǔ dǎo lǐ miàn yě yǒu nín de sūn zi hé sūn nǚ kàn tā men zài wǔ tái shàng gāo xìng de tiào lái tiào qù jué de tè bié kāi xīn jù huì cóng zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn kāi shǐ yì zhí dào xià wǔ sì diǎn cái jié shù míng nián wǒ hé píng píng dǎ suàn dài zhe liǎng gè hái zi huí lǎo jiā hé bà bà mā mā hái yǒu qí tā jiā rén yì qǐ guò nián duō duō bǎo zhòng nín de ér xí sūn zi sūn nǚ yě zhù nín shēn tǐ jiàn kāng èr lín — Dad and Mom, happy New Year! I just saw the video Dad sent. The whole family, over ten people, spent the New Year together, eating, drinking, talking and laughing; so lively. Dad and Mom look well too, which is great! In California, the US, there is no holiday for Spring Festival, but this year Spring Festival was on a Sunday and nobody was at work, so many Chinese friends gathered in our school’s auditorium. That day everyone brought one or two dishes, and there were also all kinds of drinks, fruit and desserts. I made a red-braised pork and a boiled fish, which everyone liked. The busiest that day was your daughter-in-law Pingping. She organized some friends to perform for everyone. Some sang, some danced, and it was very popular. My favorite item was the children’s dance, which included your grandson and granddaughter. Watching them jump around happily on the stage, I felt especially happy. The party started at twelve noon and did not end until four in the afternoon. Next year Pingping and I plan to take our two children back to our hometown to spend the New Year with you and our other family. Take good care! Your daughter-in-law, grandson and granddaughter also wish you good health! Erlin

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking): Sun Laoshi’s email
explanations.body: Last Wednesday your class had a very successful picnic. You invited both Sun Laoshi and Gao Laoshi, but only Sun was able to attend. A. Both teachers contacted you after the event. In pairs, you read Sun Laoshi’s email (subject 孙老师的邮件), and your partner listens to Gao Laoshi’s message (audio, not included). B. Share the main idea of your message with your partner and write down what you heard; to double-check, read the script of Gao Laoshi’s message while your partner reads Sun Laoshi’s email, and give each other feedback. C. Work together to write an email to Gao Laoshi (subject 给高老师的邮件) and describe what happened at the picnic last Wednesday; include the EEIs plus information about the weather, food, and what attendees were talking about. D. Share your email with the class.

examples.text: 马龙：你好！谢谢你邀请我参加星期三的聚会！很长时间没见到同学们，这次见面，发现大家的中文比以前更好了，我非常高兴。那天的活动组织得真不错。我在系里开会一直开到十一点半才过去，到那儿一看，啊，你们准备了那么多又好吃又好看的菜，还有各种饮料和水果，太棒了！我特别喜欢同学们做的苹果派，王老师做的牛肉也好吃，很受欢迎。西瓜是你买的吧？那么甜，我吃了可不少呢。大家坐着边吃边聊，都是讲中文。看来同学们都喜欢学中文，学习也很努力，这是让老师们最开心的事儿。很高兴见到你太太和你们的儿子。你儿子我以前见过，这次又看到他，发现这孩子比上次高了很多，也更可爱了。再次感谢你邀请我参加这次活动！孙老师
examples.translation: mǎ lóng nǐ hǎo xiè xiè nǐ yāo qǐng wǒ cān jiā xīng qī sān de jù huì hěn cháng shí jiān méi jiàn dào tóng xué men zhè cì jiàn miàn fā xiàn dà jiā de zhōng wén bǐ yǐ qián gèng hǎo le wǒ fēi cháng gāo xìng nà tiān de huó dòng zǔ zhī de zhēn bú cuò wǒ zài xì lǐ kāi huì yì zhí kāi dào shí yī diǎn bàn cái guò qù dào nàr yí kàn a nǐ men zhǔn bèi le nà me duō yòu hǎo chī yòu hǎo kàn de cài hái yǒu gè zhǒng yǐn liào hé shuǐ guǒ tài bàng le wǒ tè bié xǐ huān tóng xué men zuò de píng guǒ pài wáng lǎo shī zuò de niú ròu yě hǎo chī hěn shòu huān yíng xī guā shì nǐ mǎi de ba nà me tián wǒ chī le kě bù shǎo ne dà jiā zuò zhe biān chī biān liáo dōu shì jiǎng zhōng wén kàn lái tóng xué men dōu xǐ huān xué zhōng wén xué xí yě hěn nǔ lì zhè shì ràng lǎo shī men zuì kāi xīn de shìr hěn gāo xìng jiàn dào nǐ tài tài hé nǐ men de ér zi nǐ ér zi wǒ yǐ qián jiàn guò zhè cì yòu kàn dào tā fā xiàn zhè hái zi bǐ shàng cì gāo le hěn duō yě gèng kě ài le zài cì gǎn xiè nǐ yāo qǐng wǒ cān jiā zhè cì huó dòng sūn lǎo shī — Ma Long: Hello! Thank you for inviting me to Wednesday’s gathering! I hadn’t seen the students for a long time; meeting this time, I found everyone’s Chinese better than before, and I’m very happy. The event was really well organized. My meeting at the department went on until eleven thirty before I could come over; when I got there, ah, you had prepared so many delicious and good-looking dishes, plus all kinds of drinks and fruit; wonderful! I especially liked the apple pie the students made, and the beef Teacher Wang made was also tasty and popular. The watermelon was bought by you, right? So sweet; I ate quite a lot. Everyone sat eating and chatting while speaking Chinese. It seems the students all like learning Chinese and study very hard, which is what makes teachers happiest. I was very glad to see your wife and your son. I had seen your son before; seeing him again this time, I found he is much taller than last time and cuter. Thank you again for inviting me to this event! Teacher Sun

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Reading, and Speaking): the potluck
explanations.body: You are a graduate student at Shenzhen University in China; the president of the Graduate Student Club wants you to help organize an American-style potluck during the coming weekend. A. First, listen to an audio file you found online, then write in Chinese a brief description of potlucks in the United States (audio, not included). B. The potluck took place yesterday. You want to write an article for the Graduate Students Newsletter about the event (title 我们的百乐餐). Use your past experiences and imagination. The following passage may also help. C. Share your work in pairs.

examples.text: 前几天同学老王打来电话，说小钱从美国回来了，想和老同学们一起吃个饭。我说，这次不去饭店吃了，咱们去海边来一次百乐餐怎么样？老王说，好啊，你来组织吧。我马上发邮件给每个同学，告诉他们我的计划，请他们到时候每人带一个菜去海边。老王准备喝的东西，我准备餐具和甜点。聚会那天，我早早地坐公共汽车到了海边，发现有一半的同学早就到了。他们边喝茶边聊天，十分热闹。小钱和他太太也在，还给大家带来了美国巧克力。一会儿大家就都到了，各种各样的饭菜放在一起，差不多有二十个，有鱼、牛肉、猪肉、素菜……，还有饺子和面条。我买了一个大蛋糕，老王带了啤酒、葡萄酒和饮料。大家边吃边聊天，说了很多上大学时候的事。最后，小钱说，欢迎大家明年去美国，到加州玩儿几天。到时候，他会请大家到他们家吃烤肉，大家一起热闹热闹。
examples.translation: qián jǐ tiān tóng xué lǎo wáng dǎ lái diàn huà shuō xiǎo qián cóng měi guó huí lái le xiǎng hé lǎo tóng xué men yì qǐ chī gè fàn wǒ shuō zhè cì bú qù fàn diàn chī le zán men qù hǎi biān lái yí cì bǎi lè cān zěn me yàng lǎo wáng shuō hǎo a nǐ lái zǔ zhī ba wǒ mǎ shàng fā yóu jiàn gěi měi gè tóng xué gào sù tā men wǒ de jì huà qǐng tā men dào shí hòu měi rén dài yí gè cài qù hǎi biān lǎo wáng zhǔn bèi hē de dōng xī wǒ zhǔn bèi cān jù hé tián diǎn jù huì nà tiān wǒ zǎo zǎo de zuò gōng gòng qì chē dào le hǎi biān fā xiàn yǒu yí bàn de tóng xué zǎo jiù dào le tā men biān hē chá biān liáo tiān shí fēn rè nào xiǎo qián hé tā tài tài yě zài hái gěi dà jiā dài lái le měi guó qiǎo kè lì yí huìr dà jiā jiù dōu dào le gè zhǒng gè yàng de fàn cài fàng zài yì qǐ chà bu duō yǒu èr shí gè yǒu yú niú ròu zhū ròu sù cài hái yǒu jiǎo zi hé miàn tiáo wǒ mǎi le yí gè dà dàn gāo lǎo wáng dài le pí jiǔ pú táo jiǔ hé yǐn liào dà jiā biān chī biān liáo tiān shuō le hěn duō shàng dà xué shí hòu de shì zuì hòu xiǎo qián shuō huān yíng dà jiā míng nián qù měi guó dào jiā zhōu wánr jǐ tiān dào shí hòu tā huì qǐng dà jiā dào tā men jiā chī kǎo ròu dà jiā yì qǐ rè nào rè nào — A few days ago my classmate Lao Wang called and said Xiao Qian had come back from the US and wanted to have a meal with old classmates. I said, this time let’s not eat at a restaurant; how about having a potluck by the sea? Lao Wang said, good, you organize it. I immediately emailed every classmate to tell them my plan and ask each to bring a dish to the seaside. Lao Wang would prepare the drinks and I would prepare tableware and dessert. On the day of the gathering I took the bus early to the seaside and found that half of the classmates had arrived long before. They were drinking tea and chatting; very lively. Xiao Qian and his wife were also there and had brought American chocolate for everyone. Soon everybody had arrived; all kinds of food were put together, almost twenty dishes, including fish, beef, pork, vegetables…, as well as dumplings and noodles. I bought a big cake, and Lao Wang brought beer, wine and drinks. Everyone ate and chatted and talked about many things from their university days. In the end Xiao Qian said, everyone is welcome to come to the US next year and play for a few days in California. By then he will invite everyone to his home to have a barbecue and have fun together.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Writing and Speaking): the Chinese New Year report
explanations.body: The local Chinese community celebrated the Chinese New Year last Saturday, and you did your part by helping to prepare a flyer in Chinese for the event. A. Below is a report about the event in the local newspaper. Write a summary in Chinese to share with your classmates, including the EEIs plus several important details. The report: “Around 500 people crowded the Monterey Community Center on Saturday afternoon to celebrate the Chinese New Year, with Monterey’s Mayor as special guest. The event started at 11:30. Speaking at the celebration, Mayor Smith congratulated the Chinese community on the arrival of the Chinese New Year, and he also thanked them for their contribution to the local community. Following the speeches were cultural performances. The performers sang songs and performed traditional Chinese dances. The audience loved the performances so much that they kept cheering and applauding, especially for those done by students from DLI. The organizers ordered food from local Chinese restaurants, and many participants brought their home-made food as well. One elderly lady, Mrs. Liu, brought dumplings she had made. She told the reporter that people in her hometown have to eat dumplings on Chinese New Year’s Eve. The celebrations ended around 3:30 pm. Monterey has been hosting annual celebrations of Chinese Lunar New Year for the last seven years.” B. Pair up and, in Chinese, ask each other about the event. (Pictures, not included.) My Chinese summary:

examples.text: 星期六下午，大约五百人来到蒙特雷社区中心庆祝春节，市长是特别客人。活动十一点半开始，市长向华人社区祝贺春节，也感谢他们对本地社区的贡献。接着是文化表演，大家唱歌，跳传统舞蹈，观众不停地欢呼鼓掌，特别是学生们的表演。主办方在当地的中餐馆订了菜，很多人也带来了自己做的菜。刘奶奶带来了她包的饺子，她说她老家的人除夕一定要吃饺子。庆祝活动三点半左右结束。蒙特雷已经连续七年举办春节庆祝活动。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù xià wǔ dà yuē wǔ bǎi rén lái dào méng tè léi shè qū zhōng xīn qìng zhù chūn jié shì zhǎng shì tè bié kè rén huó dòng shí yī diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shì zhǎng xiàng huá rén shè qū zhù hè chūn jié yě gǎn xiè tā men duì běn dì shè qū de gòng xiàn jiē zhe shì wén huà biǎo yǎn dà jiā chàng gē tiào chuán tǒng wǔ dǎo guān zhòng bù tíng de huān hū gǔ zhǎng tè bié shì xué shēng men de biǎo yǎn zhǔ bàn fāng zài dāng dì de zhōng cān guǎn dìng le cài hěn duō rén yě dài lái le zì jǐ zuò de cài liú nǎi nǎi dài lái le tā bāo de jiǎo zi tā shuō tā lǎo jiā de rén chú xī yí dìng yào chī jiǎo zi qìng zhù huó dòng sān diǎn bàn zuǒ yòu jié shù méng tè léi yǐ jīng lián xù qī nián jǔ bàn chūn jié qìng zhù huó dòng — Mine: On Saturday afternoon about five hundred people came to Monterey Community Center to celebrate Chinese New Year, with the mayor as special guest. The event started at eleven thirty; the mayor congratulated the Chinese community and thanked it for its contribution. Next came cultural performances: singing and traditional dances, and the audience kept cheering and applauding, especially for the students. The organizers ordered food from local Chinese restaurants and many people brought home-made food. Mrs. Liu brought dumplings, saying people in her hometown must eat dumplings on New Year’s Eve. The event ended around three thirty. Monterey has hosted the celebration for seven years.

lessons.title: 391. Lesson 15 Area Studies: Invitations and Parties
lessons.subtitle: 邀请和聚会 · family celebrations · weddings · business receptions

explanations.title: Invitations and Parties
explanations.body: Like all cultures, the Chinese have parties and celebrations to mark rites of passage or important transitions and passages from one stage of life to another. These celebrations share the good fortune of families, promote the success of firms and reaffirm the value of traditions to Chinese both in China and overseas. In general, formal invitations are not very common for Chinese family celebrations, which include housewarming, birthdays, funerals, annual family get-togethers during the autumn, and spring festivals. This is not to say that anyone can attend the celebrations, but the custom of delivering a formal written invitation for family activities is less popular in China than it is in the U.S. Family celebrations are frequently coordinated by word of mouth, phone calls or text messaging. Formal business dinners and government-sponsored banquets, on the other hand, often use written invitations similar to those used in Western cultures. Whether it is an informal phone call or a formal invitation card, the information given is essentially the same. The invitee is informed of the special occasion, when and where the celebration will be held and (often) what to wear or bring. (Photographs, not included.)

explanations.title: Family parties and weddings
explanations.body: Family parties are usually held for culturally identified special occasions. In China these include special birthdays, like celebrating the first month anniversary of a new baby’s birth or the 60th birthday of an adult. For these types of celebrations families invite relatives from near and far and prepare special dishes that are usually eaten only at these special occasions. These parties are likely to be held in the family’s home or the home of a close relative that is large enough to accommodate all the guests. Weddings also are an occasion for large family gatherings. Traditional Chinese society has many wedding rituals and party customs. These elaborate traditions were practiced less frequently in the twentieth century, because of war and internal strife that faced China in the first half of the century. After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, weddings in the city remained low key and were a smaller scale than the large gatherings of the past, which were still common in many parts of the countryside. Today, with China’s economic reforms, increased stability and growing wealth, weddings are again becoming larger and more complex. Some couples have traditional Chinese weddings, some follow Western ceremonies, and some do both!

explanations.title: Business receptions and conclusion
explanations.body: Business receptions and dinners are another sort of party. A foreign businessman or businesswoman may receive an invitation from a senior representative of a Chinese company who will host a dinner or evening reception to which the businessperson is invited. These invitations might also include a reference to attire and even the end time for the function, particularly if it is a reception and not a dinner. Some large enterprises or manufacturing corporations in China also host parties to celebrate their success or any positive changes that occur in their business and the surrounding community. These firms will post announcements on their public bulletin boards to tell their employees where and when to go for the celebration. They also may use invitation letters or even faxes and phone calls to invite local officials to participate as well. In conclusion, Chinese culture shares a link to Western culture in the use of parties and invitations to celebrate significant cultural events. Even though the holidays, foods and customs are unique to China, the activity is one common to the whole world. While formal invitations are less popular in China today than in the West, businesspeople, academics and other professionals who travel to China may well receive a formal dinner, banquet or even a party invitation from a firm or government organization’s representative that they work with. References: “Chinese Festivals and Events” (chinahighlights.com); “Cultural Atlas-China Etiquette” (culturalatlas.sbs.com.au).

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Collocation practice: match the verbs with their most likely objects by writing the object numbers. More than one object may match a verb. Verbs: 点, 下载, 看, 查, 玩, 上, 中, 装, 听. The book leaves the key out; my matches (mine): 点 → 8 鼠标; 下载 → 7 音乐, 4 视频, 9 软件, 2 游戏; 看 → 1 新闻, 4 视频; 查 → 3 邮件; 玩 → 2 游戏; 上 → 5 网瘾; 中 → 6 病毒; 装 → 9 软件; 听 → 7 音乐. B. What did you hear that led to your answer? B. Detailed listening: listen again and list the activities the speakers enjoy online and the issues they encountered (columns 大卫 and 马克). C. Pair up; in Chinese, Student A reports David’s experiences and Student B reports Mark’s. D. With your partner, read Presentation 1 aloud. (Audio, not included.) Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking). Pair up; Student A reports on one half of the family’s internet habits and Student B the other half. C. Survey your classmates on their internet activities and find classmates who match: 1. who spends most of their time online on the weekend; 2. who plays Chinese computer games; 3. who shops online at least five times per month; 4. who has a Facebook account; 5. who makes friends via the internet; 6. who knows how to download a video; 7. whose computer has been infected by a virus. lessons.title: 393. Lesson 16 Presentation 1 grammar: the progressive aspect 正在/在
lessons.subtitle: 我正在学习呢 · 正在 + Predicate + 呢 · 没有在… · 正做着饭呢

explanations.title: The progressive aspect 正在/在
explanations.body: In this presentation, David says 我正在学习呢 to indicate he is studying. Therefore 正在 V(P) 呢 is a pattern that indicates an action (VP) is going on. This pattern has three alternative forms, with no difference in meaning. Statement: 正在 + Predicate + (呢); 正 + Predicate + 呢; 在 + Predicate + (呢); Predicate + 呢. Question: (正)在 + Predicate + 吗？ Negation: 没有(+ 在) + Predicate.

examples.text: 我正在吃饭(呢)。
examples.translation: wǒ zhèng zài chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我正吃饭呢。
examples.translation: wǒ zhèng chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我在吃饭(呢)。
examples.translation: wǒ zài chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我吃饭呢。
examples.translation: wǒ chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我正在学习英文呢！

examples.text: 妈妈正在打电话吗？

examples.translation: lǎo shī méi yǒu zài shàng kè — The teacher is not teaching.

explanations.title: Past, present and future
explanations.body: An action in the progressive aspect may take place at the present time, in the past or the future. 着 used in the continuation of an action sometimes accompanies 正 or 呢.

examples.text: 昨天我给你打电话的时候，你在做什么？

examples.translation: nǐ děng yí huìr zài zǒu wài biān zhèng xià zhe yǔ ne — Wait a while before you leave; it’s raining outside.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking, Listening and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Student A chooses one word from the table (散步, 聊天, 看电影, 上网, 游泳, 照相, 骑自行车 for A; 买东西, 滑雪, 踢球, 吃零食, 喝茶, 打乒乓球, 排队 for B) and acts it out. Student B observes and forms a yes/no question using (正)在 while guessing; Student A answers with the negation or affirmative form. For example: B: 你正在锻炼吗？ A: 我没有在锻炼。 B: 你正在跳舞吗？ A: 对。 B. Each partner takes turns completing the sentences below; the other partner translates the entire sentence into English: 1. 我去他宿舍的时候，____。 2. 老师进教室的时候，____。 3. 我刚才给我女朋友打电话，____。 4. 我昨天下课回家的时候，____。 5. 明天中午的这个时候，____。 My completions (mine):
