lessons.title: 410. Lesson 16 Presentation 3 grammar: 虽然…，但是/可是…
lessons.subtitle: 虽然中文很难，但是我越学越有意思 · 虽然…可是… · 同一个主语

explanations.title: 虽然…，但是/可是…
explanations.body: This pattern means “although…, but…”. In English you wouldn’t normally use “but”, but it is required in Chinese. Both 但是 and 可是 precede the subject in a clause. 虽然…，但是/可是… If both clauses share the same subject, then the subject is generally placed at the beginning of the sentence. If the two clauses do not have a common subject, 虽然 and 但是/可是 are usually placed before the subjects in each clause.

examples.text: 虽然我很想去舞厅跳舞，可是我们明天有考试，得在家准备。
examples.translation: suī rán wǒ hěn xiǎng qù wǔ tīng tiào wǔ kě shì wǒ men míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì děi zài jiā zhǔn bèi — Although I really want to go dancing at a dance hall, we have an exam tomorrow and I have to prepare at home.

examples.text: 爷爷虽然八十岁了，但是身体还很好。
examples.translation: yé yé suī rán bā shí suì le dàn shì shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo — Although Grandpa is eighty, his health is still very good.

examples.text: 虽然中文很难，但是我越学越有意思。
examples.translation: suī rán zhōng wén hěn nán dàn shì wǒ yuè xué yuè yǒu yì si — Although Chinese is hard, the more I study the more interesting it gets.

examples.text: 虽然今天下雨，但是我还得去操场锻炼身体。
examples.translation: suī rán jīn tiān xià yǔ dàn shì wǒ hái děi qù cāo chǎng duàn liàn shēn tǐ — Although it’s raining today, I still have to go to the field to exercise.

examples.text: 虽然他家很有钱，但是他从来不多花钱。
examples.translation: suī rán tā jiā hěn yǒu qián dàn shì tā cóng lái bù duō huā qián — Although his family is rich, he never spends extra money.

examples.text: 他虽然总是准备得很好，但是每次考试还是很紧张。
examples.translation: tā suī rán zǒng shì zhǔn bèi de hěn hǎo dàn shì měi cì kǎo shì hái shì hěn jǐn zhāng — Although he always prepares very well, he is still very nervous at every exam.

examples.text: 这双皮鞋虽然很贵，可是质量很好。
examples.translation: zhè shuāng pí xié suī rán hěn guì kě shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo — Although this pair of shoes is expensive, the quality is very good. (same subject at the beginning)

examples.text: 虽然王英学得很好，可是李明比她学得更好。
examples.translation: suī rán wáng yīng xué de hěn hǎo kě shì lǐ míng bǐ tā xué de gèng hǎo — Although Wang Ying studies very well, Li Ming studies even better. (different subjects)

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening). A. Read the sentences next to each of four illustrations (pictures, not included), rewrite each sentence with 虽然…但是/可是… and then translate them. The first one has been done for you. B. Pair up; go over your rewritten sentences and take turns translating them. C. Each student creates one sentence about one classmate or teacher using 虽然…但是; the other students listen and guess who the person is. Activity 6 (Reading, Speaking and Listening). A. Listen to a conversation between two friends; in Chinese write the strengths and weaknesses of 林强, 李东, 张大年 and 陈华 in the table, then answer: What final decision was made? (Audio, not included.) The originals are: 1. 大卫唱歌的时候有点紧张。大家都觉得大卫唱得很好听。 2. 王明很喜欢陈丽，常常送花儿给她。王明还没请陈丽出去吃过饭。 3. 小华是班里最好的学生。小华的妈妈觉得小华可以学得更好。 4. 王太太每天下班以后都很累，她每天都要给全家准备可口的晚餐。 The book’s example and my rewrites (mine):

examples.text: 林红有两个孩子。林红还想再生一个。
examples.translation: lín hóng yǒu liǎng gè hái zi lín hóng hái xiǎng zài shēng yí gè — Example, the original: Lin Hong has two children. Lin Hong still wants another one.

examples.text: 虽然林红已经有两个孩子，可是她还想再生一个。
examples.translation: suī rán lín hóng yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng gè hái zi kě shì tā hái xiǎng zài shēng yí gè — Rewritten (the book’s example): Although Lin Hong already has two children, she still wants another.

examples.text: 虽然大卫唱歌的时候有点紧张，但是大家都觉得大卫唱得很好听。
examples.translation: suī rán dà wèi chàng gē de shí hòu yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng dàn shì dà jiā dōu jué de dà wèi chàng de hěn hǎo tīng — 1. Although David was a bit nervous singing, everyone thought he sang well. (mine)

examples.text: 虽然王明很喜欢陈丽，常常送花儿给她，但是他还没请陈丽出去吃过饭。
examples.translation: suī rán wáng míng hěn xǐ huān chén lì cháng cháng sòng huār gěi tā dàn shì tā hái méi qǐng chén lì chū qù chī guò fàn — 2. Although Wang Ming likes Chen Li a lot and often sends her flowers, he hasn’t yet taken her out to dinner. (mine)

examples.text: 虽然小华是班里最好的学生，但是小华的妈妈觉得小华可以学得更好。
examples.translation: suī rán xiǎo huá shì bān lǐ zuì hǎo de xué shēng dàn shì xiǎo huá de mā mā jué de xiǎo huá kě yǐ xué de gèng hǎo — 3. Although Xiaohua is the best student in the class, Xiaohua’s mother thinks she can do even better. (mine)

examples.text: 虽然王太太每天下班以后都很累，但是她每天都要给全家准备可口的晚餐。
examples.translation: suī rán wáng tài tài měi tiān xià bān yǐ hòu dōu hěn lèi dàn shì tā měi tiān dōu yào gěi quán jiā zhǔn bèi kě kǒu de wǎn cān — 4. Although Mrs. Wang is tired every day after work, she still has to prepare a tasty dinner for the whole family every day. (mine)

examples.text: 这个同学虽然没上过吉他课，但是吉他弹得非常好。
examples.translation: zhè ge tóng xué suī rán méi shàng guò jí tā kè dàn shì jí tā tán de fēi cháng hǎo — Part C example: Although this classmate has never taken a guitar class, he plays guitar extremely well.

examples.text: 你们猜猜他是谁？
examples.translation: nǐ men cāi cāi tā shì shuí — Can you guess who he is? (猜 cāi; guess)

exercises.prompt: What does 虽然…，但是… mean?
Is 但是 required in Chinese?
Where does 但是/可是 go?
options: Before the subject of its clause

exercises.prompt: What does 爷爷虽然八十岁了，但是身体还很好 mean?
options: Although Grandpa is eighty, his health is still good
Grandpa is eighty because he is well

exercises.prompt: What does 虽然中文很难，但是我越学越有意思 mean?
options: Although Chinese is hard, the more I study the more interesting

exercises.prompt: What does 他虽然总是准备得很好，但是每次考试还是很紧张 mean?
options: He always prepares well but is still nervous at each exam

exercises.prompt: Which subject placement is correct when both clauses share a subject?
options: Subject at the beginning (这双皮鞋虽然很贵，可是质量很好)

exercises.prompt: 虽然今天下雨，___是我还得去操场锻炼身体。
这双皮鞋虽然很贵，___是质量很好。

lessons.title: 411. Lesson 16 Presentation 3 grammar: the modal verb 会 (will)
lessons.subtitle: 她就会打开电视 · 他明天会参加演出吗 · 这个周末我不会去看电影

explanations.title: The modal verb 会
explanations.body: In Lesson 8, you learned how to use the modal verb 会 when expressing a learned skill. In this lesson the modal verb 会 is used to indicate that something will happen or something that someone will do. Statement: Subject + 会 + Verb + Object. Negation: Subject + 不 + 会 + Verb + Object.

examples.text: 每天晚上吃完晚饭，她就会打开电视，一集接一集地看。
examples.translation: měi tiān wǎn shàng chī wán wǎn fàn tā jiù huì dǎ kāi diàn shì yì jí jiē yì jí de kàn — Every evening after dinner she turns on the TV and watches episode after episode.

examples.text: 你想他明天会参加演出吗？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng tā míng tiān huì cān jiā yǎn chū ma — Do you think he will take part in the performance tomorrow?

examples.text: 天这么黑，等一会儿会下雨吗？
examples.translation: tiān zhè me hēi děng yí huìr huì xià yǔ ma — It’s so dark; will it rain in a while?

examples.text: 下班以后我会给你打电话。
examples.translation: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà — After work I will call you.

examples.text: 下个星期要考试，这个周末我不会去看电影。
examples.translation: xià gè xīng qī yào kǎo shì zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ bú huì qù kàn diàn yǐng — There is an exam next week, so I won’t go to the movies this weekend.

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8
explanations.body: Activity 7 (Speaking, Listening and Reading). A. Complete “my” sentence. Pair up. Student A begins the sentence by giving a specific time, and Student B finishes it using 会 to indicate what they will do at that time; then switch. B. Listen to the conversation and mark each statement True or False: 1. Xiao Zhang believes that David will come to the party if he can. 2. Xiao Zhang believes that David’s girlfriend may not speak Chinese. 3. Xiao Zhang believes that even if David’s girlfriend won’t come to the party, David will still come. C. Check your answers with your partner. D. Read the script with your partner and differentiate the usages of 会 in the conversation. (Audio, not included.) Activity 8 (Speaking, Listening and Writing). Your class is making a class profile page on the MS Teams Wiki. Select one classmate and interview them about their life at DLI as a student: their recreational activities, future plans and any other topic of interest; write a brief report using grammar points such as 给, 会, 不是…就是, 虽然…但是, 对…来说, 甚至…也/都; post it to the MS Teams Wiki (我的同学 XXX). The book’s example and my sentences:

examples.text: 每次你去看电影以前，
examples.translation: měi cì nǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng yǐ qián — Student A: Before every time you go to the movies, (the book’s example)

examples.text: 每次我去看电影以前，我都会先上网买票。
examples.translation: měi cì wǒ qù kàn diàn yǐng yǐ qián wǒ dōu huì xiān shàng wǎng mǎi piào — Student B: Before every time I go to the movies, I will buy tickets online first. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 每天下课以后，我会去图书馆。
examples.translation: měi tiān xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ huì qù tú shū guǎn — After class every day, I will go to the library. (mine)

examples.text: 明年夏天我会去中国。
examples.translation: míng nián xià tiān wǒ huì qù zhōng guó — Next summer I will go to China. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does 会 indicate in this lesson?
What does 下班以后我会给你打电话 mean?
options: After work I will call you

exercises.prompt: What does 你想他明天会参加演出吗？ ask?
options: Do you think he will take part tomorrow?

exercises.prompt: What does 这个周末我不会去看电影 mean?
options: I won’t go to the movies this weekend

exercises.prompt: What does 天这么黑，等一会儿会下雨吗？ ask?
options: Will it rain in a while?

exercises.prompt: 下班以后我___给你打电话。
下个星期要考试，这个周末我不___去看电影。

lessons.title: 412. Lesson 16 Presentation 3 grammar: the adverb 甚至
lessons.subtitle: 甚至看到半夜 · 甚至不吃不喝 · 甚至…都/也… and 连…都/也…

explanations.title: Adverb 甚至
explanations.body: In the presentation: 我太太喜欢看肥皂剧…，有时候，甚至看到半夜还不睡觉。 In this sentence, 甚至 is used to highlight the severeness of a behavior. 甚至 is used in the following pattern to highlight a high degree of a certain behavior or situation: …，甚至 N/VP + (还/都/也) VP; …，甚至 + Sentence.

examples.text: 我太太喜欢看肥皂剧……，有时候，甚至看到半夜还不睡觉。
examples.translation: wǒ tài tài xǐ huān kàn féi zào jù yǒu shí hòu shèn zhì kàn dào bàn yè hái bú shuì jiào — My wife likes soap operas…; sometimes she even watches until midnight without sleeping.

examples.text: 他玩游戏上瘾，甚至不吃不喝也要玩游戏。
examples.translation: tā wán yóu xì shàng yǐn shèn zhì bù chī bù hē yě yào wán yóu xì — He is addicted to computer games and doesn’t even care about eating and drinking.

examples.text: 唐朝乐队非常有名，甚至有人说它是中国最好的摇滚乐队。
examples.translation: táng cháo yuè duì fēi cháng yǒu míng shèn zhì yǒu rén shuō tā shì zhōng guó zuì hǎo de yáo gǔn yuè duì — The Tang Dynasty band is very famous; some people even say it is the best rock band in China.

explanations.title: 甚至…都/也… vs 连…都/也…
explanations.body: 甚至…都/也… focuses on highlighting a “high degree”; 连…都/也… focuses on emphasizing inclusiveness (including the out of the ordinary). In Lesson 9, Presentation 3, we learned 连…都/也…, which emphasizes inclusiveness; in such sentences, 连 can be replaced or reinforced with 甚至 to highlight the high degree. However, 连 cannot be used to replace 甚至 in sentences that focus on highlighting a high degree of a certain behavior or situation, for example: *我太太喜欢看肥皂剧……，有时候，连看到半夜还不睡觉。 *他玩游戏上瘾，连不吃不喝也要玩游戏。 *唐朝乐队非常有名，连有人说它是中国最好的摇滚乐队。 Activity 9 (Speaking): 1. Think of a person you know well who is indulging in certain hobbies; use 甚至 to report his/her actions or behaviors. 2. Think of something you extremely dislike; use 甚至 and 连…都/也… to talk about it. 3. Think of something you admire very much; use 甚至 and 连…都/也… to talk about it. More examples:

examples.text: 大卫连牙刷、毛巾都在网上买。
examples.translation: dà wèi lián yá shuā máo jīn dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi — David buys even toothbrushes and towels online. (连…都…, Lesson 9)

examples.text: 大卫甚至牙刷、毛巾都在网上买。
examples.translation: dà wèi shèn zhì yá shuā máo jīn dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi — (连 replaced by 甚至)

examples.text: 大卫甚至连牙刷、毛巾都在网上买。
examples.translation: dà wèi shèn zhì lián yá shuā máo jīn dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi — (连 reinforced by 甚至)

examples.text: 他喜欢看电影，动作片，搞笑片，连动画片他都喜欢看。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng dòng zuò piàn gǎo xiào piàn lián dòng huà piàn tā dōu xǐ huān kàn — 1. He likes movies: action films, comedies, even animated films he likes to watch.

examples.text: 他喜欢看电影，动作片，搞笑片，甚至动画片他都喜欢看。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng dòng zuò piàn gǎo xiào piàn shèn zhì dòng huà piàn tā dōu xǐ huān kàn — 2. (甚至)

examples.text: 他喜欢看电影，动作片，搞笑片，甚至连动画片他都喜欢看。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng dòng zuò piàn gǎo xiào piàn shèn zhì lián dòng huà piàn tā dōu xǐ huān kàn — 3. (甚至连)

options: A high degree of a behavior or situation
exercises.explanation: 甚至 highlights a high degree.

exercises.prompt: What does 他玩游戏上瘾，甚至不吃不喝也要玩游戏 mean?
options: He is addicted and will even play without eating or drinking

exercises.prompt: What does 唐朝乐队…甚至有人说它是中国最好的摇滚乐队 mean?
options: Some people even say it is the best rock band in China

exercises.prompt: Can 连 replace 甚至 in 甚至看到半夜还不睡觉?

options: 大卫连甚至牙刷、毛巾在网上买
大卫连牙刷、毛巾甚至在网上买
大卫甚至连牙刷、毛巾都在网上买
大卫甚至牙刷、毛巾在网上都买

exercises.prompt: 他喜欢看电影，动作片，搞笑片，___至动画片他都喜欢看。
大卫连牙刷、毛巾___在网上买。

lessons.title: 413. Lesson 16 Presentation 3: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 二十个问题 · 买电影票 · 电视的变化 · 电视迷、舞迷、球迷

explanations.title: Activity 1: Play 20 Questions, Who am I?
explanations.body: A. Each student walks around the classroom and asks each classmate yes/no questions to acquire information about that person until the student guesses the correct actor (six photographs of actors, not included). The book’s example questions are below. B. Each student posts his/her favorite actor or actress’s picture, writes a short intro about the celebrity on Linoit, and shares it with the class.

examples.text: 我是中国人吗？
examples.translation: wǒ shì zhōng guó rén ma — Am I Chinese?

examples.text: 我是男演员/男明星吗？
examples.translation: wǒ shì nán yǎn yuán nán míng xīng ma — Am I a male actor/male star?

examples.text: 我常演动作片吗？
examples.translation: wǒ cháng yǎn dòng zuò piàn ma — Do I often act in action movies?

examples.text: 我很好看吗？
examples.translation: wǒ hěn hǎo kàn ma — Am I good-looking?

examples.text: 我差不多三十几岁吗？
examples.translation: wǒ chà bu duō sān shí jǐ suì ma — Am I about in my thirties?

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking): buying movie tickets in Taiwan
explanations.body: Li Xiaowen just moved to Taiwan. He is taking his family to a movie theater for the first time. A. Listen to the conversation and write the EEIs: What did they see? How many tickets were bought? What kinds of tickets were bought? When was the movie shown? Where did they sit? How much did the tickets cost? What payment method was used? B. Guess the meaning of the following words: 全票 and 早场 (mine: full-price ticket; morning show). C. Pair up, read the script aloud and check your answers. D. Role-play: find a movie you want to see this weekend, follow the format of the conversation, and purchase a ticket; your partner plays the person in the ticket booth; switch roles. (Audio and script, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Listening): three segments
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Each member chooses one of the segments to read. B. Within your group, explain the content of your segment in Chinese; take notes on the other members’ reports. C. As a team, use the information you gathered to note the correct order of the segments in the passage, and provide your rationale and summary (one sentence). My key (mine): the order is Segment 3 (the past), Segment 2 (now, many TVs), Segment 1 (the newest trend, phones and laptops); the passage describes how TV watching in the US went from one shared family TV to many TVs and to mobile streaming.

examples.text: 除了在家看电视看电影以外，现在的年轻人也流行用手机、用笔记本电脑看。他们每个月付费，用网上的软件下载电影和电视节目。这样不管他们在什么地方，什么时候都能看到想看的电视和电影。
examples.translation: chú le zài jiā kàn diàn shì kàn diàn yǐng yǐ wài xiàn zài de nián qīng rén yě liú xíng yòng shǒu jī yòng bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo kàn tā men měi gè yuè fù fèi yòng wǎng shàng de ruǎn jiàn xià zài diàn yǐng hé diàn shì jié mù zhè yàng bù guǎn tā men zài shén me dì fāng shén me shí hòu dōu néng kàn dào xiǎng kàn de diàn shì hé diàn yǐng — Segment 1: Besides watching TV and movies at home, young people now also like to watch on phones and laptops. They pay a monthly fee and use online software to download movies and TV programs. This way, wherever and whenever they are, they can watch the TV and movies they want.

examples.text: 现在许多人家里有好几台电视。有些人家里甚至一个房间就有一台电视。所以家里人常常不在同一个房间看电视，他们想看什么节目就看什么节目。美国人家里的电视也很大，很多人家里都装了家庭影院，而且因为在电影院看电影越来越贵，所以越来越多人喜欢在家看电影了。
examples.translation: xiàn zài xǔ duō rén jiā lǐ yǒu hǎo jǐ tái diàn shì yǒu xiē rén jiā lǐ shèn zhì yí gè fáng jiān jiù yǒu yì tái diàn shì suǒ yǐ jiā lǐ rén cháng cháng bú zài tóng yí gè fáng jiān kàn diàn shì tā men xiǎng kàn shén me jié mù jiù kàn shén me jié mù měi guó rén jiā lǐ de diàn shì yě hěn dà hěn duō rén jiā lǐ dōu zhuāng le jiā tíng yǐng yuàn ér qiě yīn wèi zài diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng yuè lái yuè guì suǒ yǐ yuè lái yuè duō rén xǐ huān zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng le — Segment 2: Now many families have several TVs. Some families even have a TV in every room. So family members often don’t watch TV in the same room; they watch whatever program they want. American families’ TVs are also big, many have installed home theaters, and because going to the theater is getting more and more expensive, more and more people like to watch movies at home.

examples.text: 以前在美国白天看电视的多半是家庭主妇，所以那个时候肥皂剧很流行。妈妈们喜欢一边做家事，一边看电视。那个时候美国人家里只有一台电视，孩子下课，先生下班以后大家会一起看电视，而且看的是同一个电视节目。

lessons.title: 416. Lesson 16 Area Studies: Chinese Entertainment and Leisure
lessons.subtitle: 中国人的娱乐和休闲 · travel · the internet · live entertainment · sports · seniors

explanations.title: Chinese Entertainment and Leisure
explanations.body: In the past in China, television was the first choice of leisure activity after work or on the weekend. With the increase in disposable income and changing lifestyles, Chinese leisure activities are becoming more diverse. Travelling ranks #1 on the billboard chart of “Ten most popular leisure activities among Chinese.” Nearly 50% of people spend their leisure time travelling. In 2008, Chinese travelers took over 45 million foreign trips. That figure increased to 162 million in 2018. Domestic tourism has also tripled over this period. Using the internet is the second most common leisure activity for Chinese people. The digital revolution, especially the rise of social media and e-commerce, has had a deep impact on the leisure habits of the Chinese. Like the rest of the developed world, China has grown fond of smartphones that can perform an endless list of tasks, from talking to friends, shopping, and playing games. Chinese internet users now spend an average of 4.7 hours per day on their phones for entertainment like e-reading, music streaming, karaoke, video streaming, mobile gaming, live streaming, and, of course, watching short videos.

explanations.title: Shopping, karaoke, movies and the performing arts
explanations.body: Although technology has allowed people to spend their free time browsing the internet, other leisure activities are still popular. Shopping is very popular in China, particularly among women. The other leisure-related area that has been growing is dining out, particularly foreign food and restaurants alongside the homegrown ones. Karaoke is also a common social activity in China. It is often conducted in a small room with close friends and combined with alcoholic drinks. China now has more than 60,000 movie screens, the most of any nation on earth, almost all built within the last 10 years. Chinese moviegoers are young and tend to be centered in the cities. Young Chinese are showing more interest in the performing arts like theater, dance, and music, to name a few. Live entertainment is in demand as young people are more willing to pay for it than previous generations. By 2019, China had over 10,000 performing groups, more than 10,000 brokerage firms and 1,800 professional theaters, whose number is growing every year, according to the secretary-general of the China Association of Performing Arts.

explanations.title: Sports and seniors
explanations.body: Sports is a large part of the Chinese people’s lives. Sports fans fill the whole spectrum of sporting venues. According to data from the National Bureau of Statistics, in 2019, there were 3.162 million sports venues in China, with an average of 1.86 square meters per person. From traditional gyms, swimming pools, and badminton halls to emerging climbing gyms and ski resorts, the Chinese have more choices than ever for fitness. Chinese people prefer outdoor sporting activities, but even indoors many people are getting into shape using various types of body-building equipment or by practicing aerobic exercise following TV instruction. Roller skating and golf have recently gained popularity as well. Elderly people like practicing Taijiquan, Qi Gong or Square Dancing in parks. They go very early in the morning or near dusk. Public square dance is an exercise routine performed to music in squares, parks, or open spaces. These activities are popular with middle-aged and retired women, with over 100 million practitioners due to the low cost and ease of participation. It has become increasingly common for governments at different levels to set up special places for seniors to engage in recreational activities for the newly retired to make new social contacts. There are many senior recreational centers with various types of recreational facilities in both cities and rural areas. Seniors play cards, chess, and practice calligraphy. There are different types of senior universities and night schools that retired people attend. Chinese people are no longer content with merely good food and an easy life but are pursuing a healthier and higher quality of life. (Pictures, not included.)

Detailed listening: 1. What does Zhang Ying say to Wang Lin at the beginning? 2. How does Wang Lin respond? 3. What are the benefits for new members? 4. What kind of exercise does Wang Lin think would be good for Zhang Ying? 5. When Zhang Ying expresses concerns about injury, what does Wang Lin say? 6. What does Zhang Ying ask Wang Lin to do? C. Pair up, compare answers and share them with the class; conduct this conversation with your partner and share your experiences at the gym. (Audio, not included. From the dialog, mine: a gym; colleagues, since they say 咱们公司; new members get one month free for each month bought; a coach.) Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to Dialog 1 and answer: 1. What are the two speakers talking about? 2. What information did Zhang Ying find useful? 3. What action do you think Zhang Ying will take next? B–C. Compare and conduct a similar conversation. D. Listen to Dialog 2: 1. What topic is discussed? 2. Why does Zhang Ying not do weightlifting at the gym? 3. What did you hear about the weightlifting coach? E–F. Compare and conduct a similar conversation. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activities 3 and 4
explanations.body: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing). Pair up and discuss the nouns, verbs and adjectives used in Presentation 1 that are related to a gym; write them in the table by category: 健身房里有什么; 为什么去健身房; 可以做什么运动; 做运动会怎么样. (Mine: 器械, 跑步机, 温水游泳池, 教练; 减肥, 力量训练; 举重, 跑步, 瑜伽, 游泳; 变瘦, 有力量, 受伤.) Activity 4 (Speaking and Writing). How many words can you say using 卡? Write the words you know in the diagram (the book starts it with 生日卡). Mine: 生日卡, 年卡, 信用卡, 银行卡, 会员卡, 健身卡, 电话卡, 贺卡, 学生卡.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the verbs: 办, 怕, 记下来, 推荐, 试试, 适合, 受伤, 制定. B. Pair up, check your work, read each sentence aloud and translate it into English. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine):

examples.text: 如果要学好中文，你需要制定一个学习计划。
examples.translation: rú guǒ yào xué hǎo zhōng wén nǐ xū yào zhì dìng yí gè xué xí jì huà — 1. If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to make a study plan. (制定; key mine)

examples.text: 马克，谢谢你给我推荐了一个举重教练。
examples.translation: mǎ kè xiè xiè nǐ gěi wǒ tuī jiàn le yí gè jǔ zhòng jiào liàn — 2. Mark, thanks for recommending a weightlifting coach to me. (推荐)

examples.text: 听说你要去中国教英文了，这个工作很适合你。
examples.translation: tīng shuō nǐ yào qù zhōng guó jiāo yīng wén le zhè ge gōng zuò hěn shì hé nǐ — 3. I heard you’re going to teach English in China; this job suits you very well. (适合)

examples.text: 我想成为你们的会员，能不能告诉我怎么办年卡？
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi nǐ men de huì yuán néng bù néng gào sù wǒ zěn me bàn nián kǎ — 4. I want to become a member; could you tell me how to get an annual card? (办)

examples.translation: zuì jìn lín dá méi zài pǎo bù jī shàng pǎo bù yīn wèi tā de tuǐ shòu shāng le — 5. Linda hasn’t been running on the treadmill lately because her leg is injured. (受伤)

examples.text: 张英每天吃很多蔬菜，很少吃米饭，因为她怕变胖了。
examples.translation: zhāng yīng měi tiān chī hěn duō shū cài hěn shǎo chī mǐ fàn yīn wèi tā pà biàn pàng le — 6. Zhang Ying eats lots of vegetables and little rice every day because she is afraid of getting fat. (怕)

examples.text: 李丽刚告诉我怎么做运动减肥，你要不要试试？
examples.translation: lǐ lì gāng gào sù wǒ zěn me zuò yùn dòng jiǎn féi nǐ yào bú yào shì shì — 7. Li Li just told me how to lose weight through exercise; do you want to try? (试试)

examples.translation: nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ wǒ méi yǒu jì xià lái nǐ néng bù néng zài shuō yí biàn — 8. I didn’t write down your phone number; could you say it again? (记下来)

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Speaking, Writing and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Interview a classmate using the following questions and write their responses in the right-hand column; the interviewee can use 或者 or 要是…就… to answer. 1. 你平时喜欢做什么运动？ 2. 你常常什么时候健身？ 3. 你一个人健身还是和别人一起？ 4. 你学校的健身房怎么样？ 5. 你常常选择什么器械健身？ 6. 你的健身教练教得怎么样？ 7. 运动的时候你饿了，怎么办？ 8. 你喜欢举重吗？为什么？ B. Consolidate your interview answers and report them to the class.

lessons.title: 418. Lesson 17 Presentation 1 grammar: the adverb 好 (many)
lessons.subtitle: 好几次 · 好几十个 · 好累 · 好贵

explanations.title: The adverb 好 (表示多)
explanations.body: The adverb 好 can express “many,” “much,” or “a lot.” It is usually used with 几 before measure words to indicate “quite a few.” Here 几 means “several,” “a couple of,” or “a few.” 好几 + Measure Word + Noun. The adverb 好 also means “very” or “so” to describe the degree of an adjective. Subject + 好 + Adjective.

examples.text: 这家健身房我都去过好几次了。
examples.translation: zhè jiā jiàn shēn fáng wǒ dōu qù guò hǎo jǐ cì le — I have been to this gym a couple of times.

examples.text: 这个健身房有好几十个跑步机。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng yǒu hǎo jǐ shí gè pǎo bù jī — This gym has several dozen treadmills.

examples.text: 我现在感觉好累。我想休息一会儿再写作业。
examples.translation: wǒ xiàn zài gǎn jué hǎo lèi wǒ xiǎng xiū xī yí huìr zài xiě zuò yè — I feel so tired now. I want to rest a while and then do homework.

examples.text: 这个房子好贵，我可买不起。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng zi hǎo guì wǒ kě mǎi bù qǐ — This house is very expensive; I can’t afford it.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to six sentences that use 好 and translate them into English. B. Pair up, check your translations and repeat the sentences in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking). Write sentences using the adverb 好 and the words in parentheses: 1. (跑步，小时) 2. (睡觉，晚上) 3. (放，书桌) 4. (滑雪，次) 5. (记下来，遍) 6. (吃，顿) 7. (堵，小时) 8. (住着，百). Then pair up and read your sentences to your partner. The book’s example and my sentences (mine):

examples.text: 这本书太有意思了，我已经看了好几遍了。
examples.translation: zhè běn shū tài yǒu yì si le wǒ yǐ jīng kàn le hǎo jǐ biàn le — The book’s example: This book is so interesting; I’ve already read it several times.

examples.text: 他每天跑步，一跑就是好几个小时。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān pǎo bù yì pǎo jiù shì hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí — 1. He runs every day, and each run lasts several hours. (跑步，小时; mine)

examples.text: 我好几个晚上没睡觉了。
examples.translation: wǒ hǎo jǐ gè wǎn shàng méi shuì jiào le — 2. I haven’t slept for several nights. (睡觉，晚上; mine)

examples.text: 他的房间里放着好几张书桌。
examples.translation: tā de fáng jiān lǐ fàng zhe hǎo jǐ zhāng shū zhuō — 3. His room has several desks. (放，书桌; mine)

examples.text: 我去滑雪滑过好几次了。
examples.translation: wǒ qù huá xuě huá guò hǎo jǐ cì le — 4. I have gone skiing several times. (滑雪，次; mine)

examples.text: 这个号码我读了好几遍才记下来。
examples.translation: zhè ge hào mǎ wǒ dú le hǎo jǐ biàn cái jì xià lái — 5. I read this number several times before I wrote it down. (记下来，遍; mine)

examples.text: 这个星期我吃了好几顿中国菜。
examples.translation: zhè ge xīng qī wǒ chī le hǎo jǐ dùn zhōng guó cài — 6. This week I had Chinese food several times. (吃，顿; mine)

examples.text: 路上堵了好几个小时。
examples.translation: lù shàng dǔ le hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí — 7. The road was jammed for several hours. (堵，小时; mine)

examples.text: 这个小区住着好几百人。
examples.translation: zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù zhe hǎo jǐ bǎi rén — 8. Several hundred people live in this neighborhood. (住着，百; mine)

lessons.title: 419. Lesson 17 Presentation 1 grammar: the modal particle 呢 (emphasis)
lessons.subtitle: 还办了一张年卡呢 · 外面的雨还很大呢 · 可冷呢

explanations.title: The modal particle 呢 (表示强调)
explanations.body: The modal particle 呢 is used to ask questions, but it can also be used at the end of a statement to express a certain mood or attitude. It is used by the speaker to sound more confident and convincing. Statement + 呢.

examples.text: 这个健身房我都去过好几次了，还办了一张年卡呢。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng wǒ dōu qù guò hǎo jǐ cì le hái bàn le yì zhāng nián kǎ ne — I have been to this gym several times and I even have an annual card.

examples.text: 外面的雨还很大呢，咱们不要出去了。
examples.translation: wài miàn de yǔ hái hěn dà ne zán men bú yào chū qù le — It is raining so hard outside; let’s not go out.

explanations.title: Activities 3 and 4
explanations.body: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to six sentences with 呢 and translate them into English. B. Work in pairs to check your translations and repeat the sentences in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking). What would you say using 呢 in the following situations? 1. Your friend makes a comment on the equipment in the new gym. 2. Your teacher asks whether there is a college in your hometown. 3. Your classmates ask you how many courses you have taken this semester. 4. Your host asks you to eat and drink more, but you have already eaten and drunk a lot. 5. Your friend comments on the equipment in the gym. 6. Your friend asks you what you bought in China; you name several things. The book’s example and my dialogs (mine):

examples.text: 今天外面可冷呢，我不想出去。
examples.translation: jīn tiān wài miàn kě lěng ne wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù — Example, B: It’s really cold outside today; I don’t want to go out.

examples.text: 咱们去看电影吧。
examples.translation: zán men qù kàn diàn yǐng ba — Example, A: Let’s go see a movie.

examples.text: 这个健身房的器械真全。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng de qì xiè zhēn quán — 1. A: This gym’s equipment is really complete. (mine)

examples.text: 对，还有温水游泳池呢！
examples.translation: duì hái yǒu wēn shuǐ yóu yǒng chí ne — B: Yes, and there’s even a warm-water pool! (mine)

examples.text: 你家乡有大学吗？
examples.translation: nǐ jiā xiāng yǒu dà xué ma — 2. A: Is there a college in your hometown? (mine)

examples.text: 有，还有好几所呢。
examples.translation: yǒu hái yǒu hǎo jǐ suǒ ne — B: Yes, there are several. (mine)

examples.text: 这个学期你上了几门课？
examples.translation: zhè ge xué qī nǐ shàng le jǐ mén kè — 3. A: How many courses have you taken this semester? (mine)

examples.text: 我上了六门课呢！
examples.translation: wǒ shàng le liù mén kè ne — B: I’ve taken six courses! (mine)

examples.text: 再多吃点儿，多喝点儿。
examples.translation: zài duō chī diǎnr duō hē diǎnr — 4. A: Please eat and drink more. (mine)

examples.text: 我已经吃了好多呢，吃不下了。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ jīng chī le hǎo duō ne chī bú xià le — B: I’ve already eaten a lot; I can’t eat any more. (mine)

examples.text: 这些器械真新。
examples.translation: zhè xiē qì xiè zhēn xīn — 5. A: These machines are really new. (mine)

examples.text: 是啊，我昨天用了好几个呢。
examples.translation: shì a wǒ zuó tiān yòng le hǎo jǐ gè ne — B: Yes, I used several of them yesterday. (mine)

examples.text: 你在中国买了什么？
examples.translation: nǐ zài zhōng guó mǎi le shén me — 6. A: What did you buy in China? (mine)

examples.text: 我买了茶叶、丝巾，还有好多别的东西呢。
examples.translation: wǒ mǎi le chá yè sī jīn hái yǒu hǎo duō bié de dōng xī ne — B: I bought tea, silk scarves, and lots of other things. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does 呢 do at the end of a statement?
options: Makes the speaker sound confident and convincing

exercises.prompt: What does 外面的雨还很大呢 convey?
options: It’s raining hard, so let’s not go

exercises.prompt: What does 还办了一张年卡呢 add?
options: Emphasis: I even got an annual card

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 呢 for emphasis?
Which use of 呢 is NOT emphasis?

lessons.title: 420. Lesson 17 Presentation 1 grammar: the modal verb 能
lessons.subtitle: 能给我推荐一个好教练吗 · 能不能再说一遍 · 能 = capability, permission, possibility, request

explanations.title: The modal verb 能
explanations.body: The modal verb 能 in Chinese can express different meanings. We have learned two so far: 1. 能 indicates possibility. 2. In this presentation, 张英 asked 王林 能给我推荐一个好教练吗？ and 能不能再说一遍，我没记下来。 In these two sentences, 能 is used to make a request; its meaning is similar to “could you please…?” in English. When responding to such requests, you may use 能, 好, 行 or 可以. The Meaning Development of 能: Chinese modal verbs are derived from verbs with substantial meanings. The original meaning of 能 is capability, and it has developed into many other related meanings: capability (noun) → able to (verb) → good at (modal verb) → permission (may, allow) → possibility → make a request (could you please…?). All these usages can be interchangeable with 可以 except for the meaning “good at.”

examples.text: 大卫告诉张文，他还没有中国的信用卡，不能在网上买东西。
examples.translation: dà wèi gào sù zhāng wén tā hái méi yǒu zhōng guó de xìn yòng kǎ bù néng zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī — David told Zhang Wen that he doesn’t have a Chinese credit card yet and can’t shop online. (L9 Presentation 3, possibility)

examples.text: 网上能做的事可多了。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng néng zuò de shì kě duō le — There’s a lot you can do online. (L16 Presentation 1, possibility)

examples.text: 你能给我推荐一个好教练吗？
examples.translation: nǐ néng gěi wǒ tuī jiàn yí gè hǎo jiào liàn ma — Could you recommend a good coach to me? (request)

examples.text: 你能不能再说一遍，我没记下来。
examples.translation: nǐ néng bù néng zài shuō yí biàn wǒ méi jì xià lái — Could you say it once more? I didn’t write it down. (request)

examples.text: 能给我拿一双筷子吗？
examples.translation: néng gěi wǒ ná yì shuāng kuài zi ma — A: Could you get me a pair of chopsticks?

examples.text: 好。/行。/可以。
examples.translation: hǎo xíng kě yǐ — B: OK. / Sure. / Fine.

examples.text: 你能快点儿吗？
examples.translation: nǐ néng kuài diǎnr ma — A: Could you hurry?

examples.text: 不行，我受伤了。
examples.translation: bù xíng wǒ shòu shāng le — B: No, I’m injured.

examples.text: 他体能很好。
examples.translation: tā tǐ néng hěn hǎo — His physical fitness is good. (capability, noun)

examples.text: 他体能好，能跑马拉松。
examples.translation: tā tǐ néng hǎo néng pǎo mǎ lā sōng — He is fit and capable of running a marathon. (able to, verb)

examples.text: 他很能说。
examples.translation: tā hěn néng shuō — He is talkative and well spoken. (good at)

examples.text: 不到十六岁不能跑马拉松。
examples.translation: bú dào shí liù suì bù néng pǎo mǎ lā sōng — You are not allowed to run a marathon if you are under sixteen. (permission)

examples.text: 这种天气，能跑马拉松吗？
examples.translation: zhè zhǒng tiān qì néng pǎo mǎ lā sōng ma — Is it possible to run a marathon in such weather? (possibility)

examples.text: 你能和我一起跑马拉松吗？
examples.translation: nǐ néng hé wǒ yì qǐ pǎo mǎ lā sōng ma — Could you please run a marathon with me? (request)

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Listening). Listen to the conversation and answer: 1. What does the man ask the woman to do? 2. What is said about Li Jian? 3. What is the woman’s concern? 4. What will they do after the band’s performance ends? (Audio, not included.) Activity 6 (Speaking and Listening). A. Individually write one request for each of your classmates in your small class; walk around, propose your request to each of them, and take notes of their answers (同学一 to 同学五). B. Pair up. Imagine you are in the following scenarios: 在公园里烧烤; 在网上玩游戏; 在健身房健身. Student A asks whether it is possible to do something in the scenario and Student B responds. The book’s example: 我们能烧烤水果吗？ 不能。/不行。 My questions (mine):

examples.text: 我们能烧烤水果吗？
examples.translation: wǒ men néng shāo kǎo shuǐ guǒ ma — Can we barbecue fruit? (the book’s example)

examples.text: 不能。
examples.translation: bù néng — No. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 我们能在公园里烧烤吗？
examples.translation: wǒ men néng zài gōng yuán lǐ shāo kǎo ma — Can we barbecue in the park? (mine)

examples.text: 能，可是要先打电话问一问。
examples.translation: néng kě shì yào xiān dǎ diàn huà wèn yí wèn — Yes, but we have to call and ask first. (mine)

examples.text: 我们能在网上玩游戏吗？
examples.translation: wǒ men néng zài wǎng shàng wán yóu xì ma — Can we play games online? (mine)

examples.text: 可以，但是不能玩太久。
examples.translation: kě yǐ dàn shì bù néng wán tài jiǔ — Yes, but not for too long. (mine)

examples.text: 我们能在健身房吃东西吗？
examples.translation: wǒ men néng zài jiàn shēn fáng chī dōng xī ma — Can we eat in the gym? (mine)

examples.text: 不行，只能喝水。
examples.translation: bù xíng zhǐ néng hē shuǐ — No, only water. (mine)

exercises.prompt: How does 能给我推荐一个好教练吗？ use 能?
How can you agree to a request with 能?
options: 好, 行, or 可以
exercises.explanation: Responses: 能, 好, 行, 可以.

exercises.prompt: What does 他很能说 mean?
options: He is talkative and well spoken

exercises.prompt: What does 不到十六岁不能跑马拉松 express?
What does 他体能很好 mean?
What does 这种天气，能跑马拉松吗？ ask?
options: Is it possible to run a marathon in such weather?

exercises.prompt: What can 能 NOT be interchanged with 可以 for?
你能快点儿吗？ 不行，我受___了。

lessons.title: 421. Lesson 17 Presentation 1 grammar: the verbal measure words 次/遍
lessons.subtitle: 看过三遍 · 去过三次医院 · 看过他三次 · 次 and 遍

explanations.title: The verbal measure words 次/遍
explanations.body: The verbal measure words 次/遍 are used to form an action-measure complement. As a complement, the numeral-measure unit appears after the verb. When the verb takes an object, the placement of the action-measure varies according to the nature of the object: if the object is a noun, it appears after the measure word; if it is a pronoun, it appears before the measure word. Verb + Number + Measure Word; Verb + Number + Measure Word + Noun; Verb + Pronoun + Number + Measure Word. Both 次 and 遍 indicate the frequency of an action, but 次 indicates the frequency of an action, whereas 遍 emphasizes the entire process of doing something. 这部电影我看了三遍 expresses “I watched a movie three times and every time from the beginning to the end,” while 看了三次 does not emphasize the process of watching at all.

examples.text: 我看过三遍。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn guò sān biàn — I have seen it three times. (Verb + Number + Measure Word)

examples.text: 我去过三次医院。
examples.translation: wǒ qù guò sān cì yī yuàn — I have been to the hospital three times. (Verb + Number + Measure Word + Noun)

examples.text: 我看过他三次。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn guò tā sān cì — I have seen him three times. (Verb + Pronoun + Number + Measure Word)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a news report about Li Kai and write a summary, including three EEIs. B. Pair up and discuss the summary; with your partner, talk about a private fitness studio and private coach in the U.S. that you are familiar with. C. Listen to the sentences and transcribe the missing information (in pinyin), then translate each into English. Sentence 1: 尽管他每小时三百五十到四百五十元，但是李凯的课____。 Sentence 2: 那时候，人们来____，觉得____。 D. Pair up and check your transcriptions and translations. E. Write a sentence using the pattern 尽管…，但是…，and provide an example of how the expression 有面子 is used. F. With your partner, discuss: 1. 美国的健身房多不多？哪些人去健身房运动？ 2. 他们为什么去健身房？ 3. 美国健身房的收费贵不贵？需要办会员卡吗？每月多少钱？ 4. 美国有私人教练吗？你知道一个小时多少钱？ 5. 你常常去学校的健身房吗？你在那儿做什么运动？你觉得那儿怎么样？ (Audio, not included. The book prints the prices as digits.)

examples.text: 尽管他每小时要三百五十到四百五十元，但是李凯的课还是很受欢迎。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tā měi xiǎo shí yào sān bǎi wǔ shí dào sì bǎi wǔ shí yuán dàn shì lǐ kǎi de kè hái shì hěn shòu huān yíng — Although he charges 350 to 450 yuan per hour, Li Kai’s classes are still very popular. (my own sentence, since the audio is not included; mine)

examples.text: 请这么有名的教练给他上课，他觉得很有面子。
examples.translation: qǐng zhè me yǒu míng de jiào liàn gěi tā shàng kè tā jué de hěn yǒu miàn zi — Having such a famous coach teach him, he feels he has “face”. (my example of 有面子; mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): Lao Zhang’s story
explanations.body: A. Read the following passages and answer the questions. Passage 1: 1. What did Lao Zhang do for exercise before? 2. Why did he become heavier in recent years? 3. What prompted him to get an annual fitness card? Passage 2: 1. What activities did Lao Zhang do at the gym? 2. What physical changes did Lao Zhang notice after exercising? 3. Why did Lao Zhang feel that life was becoming more interesting? B. Pair up, compare your answers and share them with the class. C. Discuss: 1. 你还有什么好的健身方法推荐给老张？至少说出两个方法。 2. 如果你每个月有五百美元的健身费，你想怎么健身？为什么要这么做？ D. Report the results of your discussion to the class. The book gives the amount as digits; the new words are 瘦 (shòu; thin), 广场舞 (square dance), 太极拳 (tàijíquán; Tai Chi), 下棋 (xiàqí; chess).

examples.text: 老张是一个电脑工程师。以前，因为工作忙没有时间去运动。他家住六楼，每天下班回家时，他不坐电梯，而是走楼梯来锻炼身体。最近几年，他感觉天天爬楼梯回家有点儿累，就开始坐电梯了，结果身体变得越来越胖。上个星期，公司为了大家的健康，给每个人一个月发五百块钱，让大家去健身房办一张健身卡。老张不想去，可是如果不办健身卡，公司就不发这五百块了。为了能拿到这些钱，也为了自己的健康，老张只好去办个年卡。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng shì yí gè diàn nǎo gōng chéng shī yǐ qián yīn wèi gōng zuò máng méi yǒu shí jiān qù yùn dòng tā jiā zhù liù lóu měi tiān xià bān huí jiā shí tā bú zuò diàn tī ér shì zǒu lóu tī lái duàn liàn shēn tǐ zuì jìn jǐ nián tā gǎn jué tiān tiān pá lóu tī huí jiā yǒu diǎnr lèi jiù kāi shǐ zuò diàn tī le jié guǒ shēn tǐ biàn de yuè lái yuè pàng shàng gè xīng qī gōng sī wèi le dà jiā de jiàn kāng gěi měi gè rén yí gè yuè fā wǔ bǎi kuài qián ràng dà jiā qù jiàn shēn fáng bàn yì zhāng jiàn shēn kǎ lǎo zhāng bù xiǎng qù kě shì rú guǒ bú bàn jiàn shēn kǎ gōng sī jiù bù fā zhè wǔ bǎi kuài le wèi le néng ná dào zhè xiē qián yě wèi le zì jǐ de jiàn kāng lǎo zhāng zhǐ hǎo qù bàn gè nián kǎ — Lao Zhang is a computer engineer. In the past, because work was busy he had no time to exercise. His home is on the sixth floor, and every day when he came home from work he didn’t take the elevator but walked the stairs to exercise. In recent years he felt that climbing the stairs every day was a bit tiring, so he started taking the elevator, and as a result he got fatter and fatter. Last week the company, for everyone’s health, gave each person 500 yuan a month and asked them to get a gym card at a gym. Lao Zhang didn’t want to go, but if he didn’t get a gym card the company wouldn’t pay out the 500 yuan. In order to get the money, and for his own health, Lao Zhang had no choice but to get an annual card.

examples.text: 老张有了健身卡以后，每天下班以后就去他家附近的健身房。这家健身房刚开不久，里面非常干净漂亮，而且什么器械都有。老张有时候在跑步机上跑步，或者练习举重，有时候还去温水游泳池游泳。几个星期以后，老张感觉身体有力量了，人也瘦了很多，而且每天回家又开始爬楼梯了。周末的时候，他和太太一起去公园锻炼。他太太和朋友们跳广场舞，他就和他的朋友一起打太极拳、下棋。老张觉得生活越来越有意思了。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng yǒu le jiàn shēn kǎ yǐ hòu měi tiān xià bān yǐ hòu jiù qù tā jiā fù jìn de jiàn shēn fáng zhè jiā jiàn shēn fáng gāng kāi bù jiǔ lǐ miàn fēi cháng gān jìng piào liàng ér qiě shén me qì xiè dōu yǒu lǎo zhāng yǒu shí hòu zài pǎo bù jī shàng pǎo bù huò zhě liàn xí jǔ zhòng yǒu shí hòu hái qù wēn shuǐ yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng jǐ gè xīng qī yǐ hòu lǎo zhāng gǎn jué shēn tǐ yǒu lì liàng le rén yě shòu le hěn duō ér qiě měi tiān huí jiā yòu kāi shǐ pá lóu tī le zhōu mò de shí hòu tā hé tài tài yì qǐ qù gōng yuán duàn liàn tā tài tài hé péng yǒu men tiào guǎng chǎng wǔ tā jiù hé tā de péng yǒu yì qǐ dǎ tài jí quán xià qí lǎo zhāng jué de shēng huó yuè lái yuè yǒu yì si le — After Lao Zhang got the gym card, every day after work he went to the gym near his home. This gym had just opened not long before; it was very clean and pretty inside, and had every kind of equipment. Sometimes Lao Zhang ran on the treadmill or practiced weightlifting, and sometimes he also swam in the warm-water pool. A few weeks later he felt his body had strength, he had become much thinner, and he began climbing the stairs home again every day. On weekends he went to the park with his wife to exercise. His wife and her friends danced square dances while he and his friends practiced Tai Chi and played chess. Lao Zhang felt that life was becoming more and more interesting.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and answer the questions in pinyin or characters. New words: 气功 (qìgōng; qigong), 羽毛球 (yǔmáoqiú; badminton), 抱怨 (bàoyuàn; complain), 影响 (yǐngxiǎng; influence, affect). Questions: 中国人在公园里做什么？ 美国人在公园里做什么？ 为什么有的人不喜欢广场舞？ B. Pair up, discuss your answers, identify any unknown words and determine their meanings. C. Discuss: 1. 美国人喜欢什么时候健身？他们怎么健身？ 2. 美国有没有广场舞？他们在哪儿跳广场舞？哪些人喜欢跳广场舞？ (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage. B. In pairs, discuss the topics listed in the table (the purpose 目的: 放松, 减肥, 长肉, 不变胖) and provide at least two solutions for each (你认为适合的方法). C. Report the results of your discussion to the class. New words: 目的 (mùdì; purpose), 瘦 (shòu; thin).

examples.text: 每个到健身房运动的人都有不同的目的，有的人生活和工作太紧张，运动可以让他们放松。有的人是因为太胖了，想要减肥。还有一些人觉得自己太瘦了，想要用运动让自己多长肉。也有一些人不是很胖，但是希望运动可以让自己永远都不胖。请谈谈你的看法：你认为除了去健身房，还有别的方法可以让人们放松，减肥，长肉，不变胖吗？
examples.translation: měi gè dào jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng de rén dōu yǒu bù tóng de mù dì yǒu de rén shēng huó hé gōng zuò tài jǐn zhāng yùn dòng kě yǐ ràng tā men fàng sōng yǒu de rén shì yīn wèi tài pàng le xiǎng yào jiǎn féi hái yǒu yì xiē rén jué de zì jǐ tài shòu le xiǎng yào yòng yùn dòng ràng zì jǐ duō zhǎng ròu yě yǒu yì xiē rén bú shì hěn pàng dàn shì xī wàng yùn dòng kě yǐ ràng zì jǐ yǒng yuǎn dōu bú pàng qǐng tán tán nǐ de kàn fǎ nǐ rèn wéi chú le qù jiàn shēn fáng hái yǒu bié de fāng fǎ kě yǐ ràng rén men fàng sōng jiǎn féi zhǎng ròu bú biàn pàng ma — Everyone who goes to the gym has a different purpose: some people’s life and work are too tense, and exercise lets them relax. Some are too fat and want to lose weight. Still others feel they are too thin and want to use exercise to put on muscle. Some are not very fat but hope exercise will keep them from ever getting fat. Please give your view: besides going to the gym, do you think there are other ways for people to relax, lose weight, gain muscle and not get fat?

explanations.body: Role-play: You have been studying Chinese in Beijing for over three months. The Chinese course is very intensive, and you feel tired every day, so you are thinking about finding a gym so that you can energize yourself and stay fit. You’ve learned that your Chinese friend has been going to a gym for a long time and you’d like to join it. Ask your friend about joining the gym. A. Pair up. Your partner plays the role of your Chinese friend and you ask about joining the gym, using the information below as a reference. B. Write your partner’s responses below for your reference. C. Switch roles with your partner and repeat the conversation.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): a fitness plan
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at a military language institute in Monterey, California. In a recent physical test, one of your classmates failed due to his weight. In order to help him lose the excess weight, you are tasked by your supervisor to make a fitness plan for him. Divide the class into two groups. Each group designs a plan and presents it to the class. Select the best one and then email it to your supervisor. A. In groups, brainstorm and discuss a fitness plan for your overweight classmate. Your plan can include: 1. 这个同学的身体有什么问题？ 2. 他每天应该几点起床，几点睡觉？ 3. 他适合做什么运动？什么时候做？ 4. 做这些运动为什么对他好？ 5. 他每天应该吃什么、喝什么？ 6. 他不应该吃什么、喝什么？ 7. 除了这些以外，他还应该做什么？ B. Note the details of your plan with your group members (健身计划). C. Each group takes turns presenting their fitness plan to the class, and the class selects the best one. D. Write an email to your supervisor and submit your best fitness plan.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Reading and Speaking): the coach’s commercial
explanations.body: Scenario: You have been working in the U.S. Embassy in Beijing for more than three months and you are very tired after work, so you’d like to find a gym and work out with a coach. Yesterday, on your way home, you heard a commercial on the radio about a fitness coach. You call this coach and ask him about the gym and his program. A. Listen to the commercial and answer the questions: 1. 这个广告主要说什么？ 2. 李刚是什么样的人？他会帮你做什么？ 3. 你觉得你会去这个健身馆吗？为什么？ B. Pair up and discuss your answers; read the script if necessary. C. Role-play. With your partner, call the fitness coach about the gym and fitness program; your partner plays the coach. You may ask: 你的健身馆在哪儿？ 你在那儿当健身教练多久了？ 你们那里都有什么运动器械？ 你怎么帮我制定健身计划？ 如果你帮我训练，每天多长时间？ 你怎么收费？ 我可以不可以先试试你的课？ D. Note your partner’s responses below for your reference. E. Switch roles and repeat the role-play. (Audio and script, not included.)

examples.text: 李明：张文，一个暑假没见，你怎么晒得这么黑？

Except for swimming and surfing, we can’t do any other activities. Li Ming, how is your hometown?

examples.text: 李明：我的老家四季分明，每个季节都可以做不同的活动，不但可以滑雪、滑冰，而且可以爬山、露营。
examples.translation: lǐ míng wǒ de lǎo jiā sì jì fēn míng měi gè jì jié dōu kě yǐ zuò bù tóng de huó dòng bú dàn kě yǐ huá xuě huá bīng ér qiě kě yǐ pá shān lù yíng — My hometown has four distinct seasons, and each season you can do different activities: not only can you ski and ice-skate, but you can also hike and camp.

examples.text: 张文：那你最喜欢干什么呢？
examples.translation: zhāng wén nà nǐ zuì xǐ huān gàn shén me ne — Then what do you like to do most?

examples.text: 李明：我最大的爱好是滑雪，从六岁起就开始了。每年冬天，我们全家都去滑雪场度假。
examples.translation: lǐ míng wǒ zuì dà de ài hào shì huá xuě cóng liù suì qǐ jiù kāi shǐ le měi nián dōng tiān wǒ men quán jiā dōu qù huá xuě chǎng dù jià — My biggest hobby is skiing; I started at the age of six. Every winter our whole family goes to a ski resort for vacation.

examples.text: 张文：听起来很有意思。有空儿的时候，你能不能教我滑雪？
examples.translation: zhāng wén tīng qǐ lái hěn yǒu yì si yǒu kòngr de shí hòu nǐ néng bù néng jiāo wǒ huá xuě — That sounds interesting. When you have time, could you teach me to ski?

examples.text: 李明：没问题。
examples.translation: lǐ míng méi wèn tí — No problem.

examples.text: 张文：滑雪都需要什么装备？
examples.translation: zhāng wén huá xuě dōu xū yào shén me zhuāng bèi — What equipment do you need for skiing?

examples.text: 李明：你得有滑雪板，还得有滑雪服，滑雪鞋，滑雪眼镜，头盔什么的。不过，不用担心，这些东西都可以在滑雪场租到。
examples.translation: lǐ míng nǐ děi yǒu huá xuě bǎn hái děi yǒu huá xuě fú huá xuě xié huá xuě yǎn jìng tóu kuī shén me de bú guò bú yòng dān xīn zhè xiē dōng xī dōu kě yǐ zài huá xuě chǎng zū dào — You need skis, and a ski suit, ski boots, ski goggles, a helmet and so on. But don’t worry; you can rent all of these at the ski resort.

examples.text: 张文：太棒了，我简直都等不及啦。
examples.translation: zhāng wén tài bàng le wǒ jiǎn zhí dōu děng bù jí la — Great, I simply can’t wait.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2 (listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Global listening: 1. What is discussed in this conversation? 2. What season is it now? How could you tell? B. Detailed listening: 1. How did Zhang Wen get a tan? 2. What kind of outdoor activities can the people in his hometown do during the summer? 3. How different is Li Ming’s hometown from Zhang Wen’s? 4. What does Zhang Wen ask Li Ming to do? 5. What things do you think Zhang Wen will buy after their conversation? C. Pair up, discuss and share with the class. (From the dialog, mine: outdoor activities and hometowns; it has just become the start of a new term after the summer vacation; he went surfing every weekend; swimming and surfing; Li Ming’s hometown has four distinct seasons and Zhang Wen’s is hot all year; to teach him to ski; ski gear such as a ski board and goggles.) Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to Dialog 1 and answer: 1. What did the two speakers talk about? 2. What did Wang Lin say about his hometown? 3. What did Linda say about her hometown? 4. What is Linda’s favorite outdoor activity? Can Wang Lin do it too? How do you know? B–C. Discuss and conduct the same conversation with your partner. D. Listen to Dialog 1 again: 1. What did the two speakers talk about? 2. What did you hear about Linda? 3. What do you think Wang Lin will probably do after their conversation? E–F. Discuss and conduct the same conversation. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): 举一反三
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Using the words in the first column as a cue, write the words that show what is needed for the activities shown in the other columns: 滑雪 (skiing), 滑冰 (ice skating), 冲浪 (surfing), 游泳 (swimming). The cue words are 滑雪板, 滑雪服, 滑雪鞋, 滑雪眼镜, 滑雪帽, 滑雪场. B. With your partner, discuss the characteristics of these words and analyze how they are formed. For example, 滑雪板 = 滑雪 + 板 (snowboard = snow + board): the activity plus the thing it needs. C. Report your analyses to the class. My completed words (mine): 滑冰鞋, 滑冰帽, 滑冰场; 冲浪板, 冲浪服, 冲浪帽; 游泳衣, 游泳帽, 游泳眼镜, 游泳池 (the book leaves the table blank).

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Using the words 担心, 头盔, 简直, 有空儿, 等不及, 度假, 装备, 租到, 爬山, 露营, complete the sentences and translate them into English. B. Pair up and explain which strategies you used. C. One partner reads the sentences and the other translates them. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine). In sentence 9 the book writes Jackie Chan’s name in English as well:

examples.text: 今年春节，你们全家打算去哪里度假？
examples.translation: jīn nián chūn jié nǐ men quán jiā dǎ suàn qù nǎ lǐ dù jià — 1. Where is your whole family planning to go on vacation this Spring Festival? (度假; key mine)

examples.text: 你有空儿的时候，能不能陪我去渔人码头看看海景？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu kòngr de shí hòu néng bù néng péi wǒ qù yú rén mǎ tóu kàn kàn hǎi jǐng — 2. When you have time, could you go with me to Fisherman’s Wharf to look at the sea view? (有空儿)

examples.text: 这个地方风景很美，有很多树，也很安静，很适合露营。
examples.translation: zhè ge dì fāng fēng jǐng hěn měi yǒu hěn duō shù yě hěn ān jìng hěn shì hé lù yíng — 3. This place has beautiful scenery, lots of trees and is quiet; it’s very suitable for camping. (露营)

examples.text: 下个周末我们就要去滑雪了。你的滑雪装备都准备好了吗？
examples.translation: xià gè zhōu mò wǒ men jiù yào qù huá xuě le nǐ de huá xuě zhuāng bèi dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma — 4. We’re going skiing next weekend. Is all your ski equipment ready? (装备)

examples.text: 不用担心，滑雪用的东西，我在网上已经买了，明天就到了。
examples.translation: bú yòng dān xīn huá xuě yòng de dōng xī wǒ zài wǎng shàng yǐ jīng mǎi le míng tiān jiù dào le — 5. Don’t worry; I already bought the skiing things online and they’ll arrive tomorrow. (担心)

examples.text: 骑自行车的时候，不要忘了戴头盔，这样你不会受伤。
examples.translation: qí zì xíng chē de shí hòu bú yào wàng le dài tóu kuī zhè yàng nǐ bú huì shòu shāng — 6. When riding a bike, don’t forget to wear a helmet; that way you won’t get hurt. (头盔)

examples.text: 我们学校附近有很多山，周末的时候，我们常常去爬山。
examples.translation: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn yǒu hěn duō shān zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ men cháng cháng qù pá shān — 7. There are many mountains near our school, and on weekends we often go hiking. (爬山)

examples.text: 我最好的朋友明天要来蒙特雷看我。我高兴得等不及了。
examples.translation: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu míng tiān yào lái méng tè léi kàn wǒ wǒ gāo xìng de děng bù jí le — 8. My best friend is coming to Monterey tomorrow to see me. I’m so happy I can’t wait. (等不及; the book’s blank is 我高兴地____; mine)

examples.text: 成龙的新动作片简直太好看了。我都看了三遍了。
examples.translation: chéng lóng de xīn dòng zuò piàn jiǎn zhí tài hǎo kàn le wǒ dōu kàn le sān biàn le — 9. Jackie Chan’s new action movie is simply so good. I’ve already watched it three times. (简直)

examples.text: 大卫昨天租到了一辆车。我们可以一起开车去旧金山。
examples.translation: dà wèi zuó tiān zū dào le yí liàng chē wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ kāi chē qù jiù jīn shān — 10. David rented a car yesterday. We can drive to San Francisco together. (租到)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Interview a classmate about their hobbies. Use the patterns 除了…以外, 不但…，而且… or 从…起 and …什么的 to ask and answer the interview questions. Interview at least one student in your class. The questions (the right-hand column is for the interviewee’s answers); question 7 is 其他问题 (other questions). B. Consolidate your interviewee’s answers and report to the class.

examples.text: 1. 你最喜欢什么户外运动？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì xǐ huān shén me hù wài yùn dòng — What outdoor sport do you like best?

examples.text: 2. 你从几岁开始做这个运动？
examples.translation: nǐ cóng jǐ suì kāi shǐ zuò zhè ge yùn dòng — At what age did you begin this sport?

examples.text: 3. 你常常在什么季节做这个运动？
examples.translation: nǐ cháng cháng zài shén me jì jié zuò zhè ge yùn dòng — In which season do you usually do this sport?

examples.text: 4. 做这个活动需要什么装备？
examples.translation: zuò zhè ge huó dòng xū yào shén me zhuāng bèi — What equipment does this activity need?

examples.text: 5. 你在哪儿买这些装备？
examples.translation: nǐ zài nǎr mǎi zhè xiē zhuāng bèi — Where do you buy this equipment?

examples.text: 6. 除了这个以外你还喜欢什么？
examples.translation: chú le zhè ge yǐ wài nǐ hái xǐ huān shén me — Besides this, what else do you like?

exercises.prompt: Why is Zhang Wen so tanned?
What is Zhang Wen’s hometown like?
options: By the sea and hot and stuffy all year

exercises.prompt: What can Zhang Wen do in summer at home?
exercises.explanation: 除了游泳、冲浪以外，其他活动都做不了.

exercises.prompt: What is Li Ming’s hometown like?
What is Li Ming’s biggest hobby?
When did Li Ming start skiing?
What does Zhang Wen ask Li Ming?
Where can the ski gear be rented?
What does 滑雪板 break down into?
What does 简直都等不及啦 express?
我的老家四季___明，每个季节都可以做不同的活动。
这些东西都可以在滑雪场租___。

lessons.title: 426. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: more uses of the adverb 才
lessons.subtitle: 所以才晒得这么黑 · 这个班才两个学生 · 才 = cause and effect, only

explanations.title: More Uses of the Adverb 才
explanations.body: The adverb 才 in Chinese has many meanings. We have learned two of them so far: in Lesson 8 and Lesson 15, the adverb 才 indicates that something happened later than expected. In this lesson the adverb 才 is used to connect cause and effect. 才 can also mean “only” and be used to express how few in quantity something is. 才 + Predicate. (The book labels the first example “L18 Presentation 1”; the sentence 我们四点才下课 is from the earlier lessons.)

examples.text: 我们四点才下课。
examples.translation: wǒ men sì diǎn cái xià kè — We don’t finish class until four. (L8 and L15: later than expected)

examples.text: 大家一直玩到天黑才回家。
examples.translation: dà jiā yì zhí wán dào tiān hēi cái huí jiā — Everybody played until dark before going home. (L15 Presentation 3)

examples.text: 我每个周末都去冲浪，所以才晒得这么黑。
examples.translation: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù chōng làng suǒ yǐ cái shài de zhè me hēi — I went surfing every weekend, so I got tanned. (cause and effect)

examples.text: 下个星期，我要去滑冰，所以我才想去买滑冰鞋。
examples.translation: xià gè xīng qī wǒ yào qù huá bīng suǒ yǐ wǒ cái xiǎng qù mǎi huá bīng xié — I’ll go ice skating next week. That’s why I want to buy skates.

examples.text: 这个班才两个学生。
examples.translation: zhè ge bān cái liǎng gè xué shēng — There are only two students in this class. (only)

examples.text: 她才学了三个月中文。
examples.translation: tā cái xué le sān gè yuè zhōng wén — She only studied Chinese for three months.

examples.text: 现在才七点。还不到上课时间。
examples.translation: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn hái bú dào shàng kè shí jiān — Now it is only seven o’clock. It is not time for class yet.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to eight sentences that use 才 and translate them into English. B. Work in pairs to check your translation and repeat the sentences in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking). What would you say in the following situations? Work in pairs and explain the situations by using “…，所以我才…”. 1. I don’t have money to pay the rent. That’s why I borrowed money from you. 2. This gym has all kinds of equipment. That’s why I come here to work out. 3. This tie is only $10. That’s why I bought it. 4. Li Hua doesn’t like to jog outdoors, so she bought a treadmill to work out at home. 5. Jane will vacation in Hawaii next weekend, so she bought a swimming suit. My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 我没有钱付房租，所以我才向你借钱。
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu qián fù fáng zū suǒ yǐ wǒ cái xiàng nǐ jiè qián — 1. I don’t have money to pay the rent. That’s why I borrowed money from you. (key mine)

examples.text: 这个健身房什么器械都有，所以我才来这儿锻炼。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng shén me qì xiè dōu yǒu suǒ yǐ wǒ cái lái zhèr duàn liàn — 2. This gym has all kinds of equipment. That’s why I come here to work out.

examples.text: 这条领带才十美元，所以我才买了。
examples.translation: zhè tiáo lǐng dài cái shí měi yuán suǒ yǐ wǒ cái mǎi le — 3. This tie is only ten dollars. That’s why I bought it.

examples.text: 李华不喜欢在户外慢跑，所以她才买了一个跑步机在家锻炼。
examples.translation: lǐ huá bù xǐ huān zài hù wài màn pǎo suǒ yǐ tā cái mǎi le yí gè pǎo bù jī zài jiā duàn liàn — 4. Li Hua doesn’t like to jog outdoors, so she bought a treadmill to work out at home.

examples.text: 简下个周末要去夏威夷度假，所以她才买了一件游泳衣。
examples.translation: jiǎn xià gè zhōu mò yào qù xià wēi yí dù jià suǒ yǐ tā cái mǎi le yí jiàn yóu yǒng yī — 5. Jane will vacation in Hawaii next weekend, so she bought a swimming suit.

exercises.prompt: What does 才 connect in 所以才晒得这么黑?
What does 这个班才两个学生 mean?
options: There are only two students in this class

exercises.prompt: What does 才 mean in 我们四点才下课?
What does 她才学了三个月中文 mean?
options: She has studied Chinese for only three months

exercises.prompt: What does 现在才七点 imply?
Which fits “I bought skates because I’ll go skating”?
options: 我才要去滑冰，所以买鞋
我要去滑冰，所以我才想去买滑冰鞋
我要去滑冰，但是我才想去买滑冰鞋

exercises.prompt: 现在___七点。还不到上课时间。

lessons.title: 427. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: the demonstrative pronoun 其他/别的
lessons.subtitle: 其他活动 · 别的爱好 · 其他的 · 有别的

explanations.title: The Demonstrative Pronoun 其他/别的
explanations.body: The demonstrative pronouns 其他 and 别的 are almost the same as “other.” They can be placed before nouns and used as subjects and objects, but there are slight differences between them. 其他 can be used with numbers and measure words, but 别的 cannot. 其他 can also be used with or without 的. 其他 + Number + Measure Word + Noun; 别的 + Noun. When 其他 is used as an object, it is usually accompanied by 的 (as a subject 其他 can stand without 的; 别的 can be used as a subject, an object and an attribute, with or without 的). 别的 is usually used as an object instead of 其他 if the verb is “有” or “没有”.

examples.text: 除了游泳、冲浪以外，其他活动都做不了。
examples.translation: chú le yóu yǒng chōng làng yǐ wài qí tā huó dòng dōu zuò bù liǎo — Except for swimming and surfing, people cannot do any other activities.

examples.text: 这几本书我拿走，其他几本送给你。
examples.translation: zhè jǐ běn shū wǒ ná zǒu qí tā jǐ běn sòng gěi nǐ — I will take these books and the other books are given to you.

examples.text: 除了唱歌跳舞，我没有别的爱好。
examples.translation: chú le chàng gē tiào wǔ wǒ méi yǒu bié de ài hào — Except for singing and dancing, I don’t have other hobbies.

examples.text: 这家商店没有你要的眼镜，咱们去别的商店看看吧。
examples.translation: zhè jiā shāng diàn méi yǒu nǐ yào de yǎn jìng zán men qù bié de shāng diàn kàn kàn ba — This store does not have the glasses you want. Let’s go to other stores to have a look.

examples.text: 我现在不去想其他的，只想好好睡一觉。
examples.translation: wǒ xiàn zài bú qù xiǎng qí tā de zhǐ xiǎng hǎo hǎo shuì yí jiào — I don’t think about other things now; I just want a good night’s sleep. (其他 as an object takes 的)

examples.text: 除了这些东西以外，我还有别的。
examples.translation: chú le zhè xiē dōng xī yǐ wài wǒ hái yǒu bié de — In addition to these things, I have other things. (verb 有: 别的)

examples.text: 我没有别的，只有一个箱子。
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu bié de zhǐ yǒu yí gè xiāng zi — I have nothing else, only a box. (verb 没有: 别的)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking): 考考你
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using 其他 or 别的. B. Discuss the answers with a classmate and explain why you chose either 其他 or 别的 in the sentences. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine):

examples.text: 家里其他人都去了国外，只有他一个人在国内。
examples.translation: jiā lǐ qí tā rén dōu qù le guó wài zhǐ yǒu tā yí gè rén zài guó nèi — 1. All the other family members went abroad; only he is in the country. (其他; key mine)

examples.text: 除了中文，你还会说别的外语吗？
examples.translation: chú le zhōng wén nǐ hái huì shuō bié de wài yǔ ma — 2. Besides Chinese, can you speak other foreign languages? (别的)

examples.text: 要想健康，最好多吃水果蔬菜。还有别的方法吗？
examples.translation: yào xiǎng jiàn kāng zuì hǎo duō chī shuǐ guǒ shū cài hái yǒu bié de fāng fǎ ma — 3. To be healthy, it’s best to eat more fruit and vegetables. Are there other ways? (别的; verb 有)

examples.text: 这次单元考试，只有一个同学不及格，其他五个人都通过了。
examples.translation: zhè cì dān yuán kǎo shì zhǐ yǒu yí gè tóng xué bù jí gé qí tā wǔ gè rén dōu tōng guò le — 4. In this unit test only one student failed; the other five all passed. (其他 + number + measure word)

examples.text: 这种颜色的衣服不太适合我，你有别的颜色的吗？
examples.translation: zhè zhǒng yán sè de yī fú bú tài shì hé wǒ nǐ yǒu bié de yán sè de ma — 5. Clothes in this color don’t suit me very well; do you have other colors? (别的)

examples.text: 这些水果我吃不了。给我留两个桔子，其他的，你拿走吧。
examples.translation: zhè xiē shuǐ guǒ wǒ chī bù liǎo gěi wǒ liú liǎng gè jú zi qí tā de nǐ ná zǒu ba — 6. I can’t finish this fruit. Leave me two tangerines; you take the rest. (其他的; object)

examples.text: 你有这么多问题，我现在只能回答一个，明天再回答其他的。
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu zhè me duō wèn tí wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ néng huí dá yí gè míng tiān zài huí dá qí tā de — 7. You have so many questions; I can only answer one now and will answer the others tomorrow. (其他的; object)

examples.text: 除了这些问题，还有别的吗？
examples.translation: chú le zhè xiē wèn tí hái yǒu bié de ma — 8. Besides these questions, are there any others? (别的; verb 有)

exercises.prompt: Which can be used with a number and a measure word?
exercises.explanation: 其他 + number + measure word + noun.

exercises.prompt: Which is usually used as the object after 有 or 没有?
What does 其他 take when it is an object?
Which fits 其他___五个人都通过了 (the other five)?
Which fits 你有___颜色的吗？
Which fits 除了中文，你还会说___外语吗？
家里___人都去了国外，只有他一个人在国内。
这些水果我吃不了。给我留两个桔子，___的，你拿走吧。

lessons.title: 428. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: the prepositional structure 从……起
lessons.subtitle: 从一月一号起 · 从三楼起才有电梯 · 从…开始

explanations.title: The Prepositional Structure 从……起
explanations.body: 从……起 means “from … on” and indicates the beginning of something. It is used as an adverbial adjunct between the subject and the predicate. It can also be placed at the beginning of a sentence. Subject + 从…起，+ Predicate; 从…起，Subject + Predicate. 从……起 can be replaced by 从……开始 and carry the same meaning.

examples.text: 我从一月一号起，每天会去健身房运动。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng yī yuè yī hào qǐ měi tiān huì qù jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng — Starting from January 1st, I will go to the gym every day. (Subject + 从…起)

examples.text: 从一月一号起，我每天会去健身房运动。
examples.translation: cóng yī yuè yī hào qǐ wǒ měi tiān huì qù jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng — From January 1st on, I will go to the gym every day. (从…起 at the beginning)

examples.text: 这个大楼不太方便，从三楼起才有电梯。
examples.translation: zhè ge dà lóu bú tài fāng biàn cóng sān lóu qǐ cái yǒu diàn tī — This building is not very convenient; there are elevators only from the third floor up.

examples.text: 从明天开始，我每天去体育馆游泳。
examples.translation: cóng míng tiān kāi shǐ wǒ měi tiān qù tǐ yù guǎn yóu yǒng — From tomorrow on, I will go swimming at the gym every day. (从…开始 = 从…起)

examples.text: 从下个星期开始，我们要学习第四单元的课本。
examples.translation: cóng xià gè xīng qī kāi shǐ wǒ men yào xué xí dì sì dān yuán de kè běn — From next week on, we will study the textbook of Unit 4.

explanations.title: Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to the dialogs and write responses using the pattern 从…起. B. Work in pairs to practice the dialogs (you can also read from the script provided by the teacher). The five questions are printed in the book; the answers are blank, so mine follow. Activity 5 (Writing and Speaking). In groups, write at least five sentences about your favorite hobby using 从…起 and tell your story to your group; the book’s starter is 我的爱好是游泳。从五岁起我就开始… My story (mine):

examples.text: 你最近胖了不少，得减肥了。
examples.translation: nǐ zuì jìn pàng le bù shǎo děi jiǎn féi le — 1. A: You’ve gotten quite a bit fatter recently; you have to lose weight.

examples.text: 从明天起，我每天早上去跑步。
examples.translation: cóng míng tiān qǐ wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qù pǎo bù — B: From tomorrow on, I’ll go running every morning. (mine)

examples.text: 你几岁开始学滑冰的？
examples.translation: nǐ jǐ suì kāi shǐ xué huá bīng de — 2. A: At what age did you start to learn ice skating?

examples.text: 我从七岁起就开始学滑冰了。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng qī suì qǐ jiù kāi shǐ xué huá bīng le — B: I started learning ice skating at the age of seven. (mine)

examples.text: 这个小区环境怎么样？
examples.translation: zhè ge xiǎo qū huán jìng zěn me yàng — 3. A: How is the environment in this neighborhood?

examples.text: 很不错，从搬来这里起，我每天早上都能听到小鸟唱歌。
examples.translation: hěn bú cuò cóng bān lái zhè lǐ qǐ wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu néng tīng dào xiǎo niǎo chàng gē — B: Very nice; ever since I moved here I can hear the birds sing every morning. (mine)

examples.text: 听说这个周末梅西百货商店的衣服大降价。
examples.translation: tīng shuō zhè ge zhōu mò méi xī bǎi huò shāng diàn de yī fú dà jiàng jià — 4. A: I heard the clothes at Macy’s will be on sale this weekend.

examples.text: 对，从这个周末起，所有的衣服都打五折。
examples.translation: duì cóng zhè ge zhōu mò qǐ suǒ yǒu de yī fú dōu dǎ wǔ zhé — B: Yes, from this weekend on all the clothes are half price. (mine)

examples.text: 中国的学生从什么时候开始学外语？
examples.translation: zhōng guó de xué shēng cóng shén me shí hòu kāi shǐ xué wài yǔ — 5. A: From when do students in China start to learn foreign languages?

examples.text: 从小学三年级起就开始学英语了。
examples.translation: cóng xiǎo xué sān nián jí qǐ jiù kāi shǐ xué yīng yǔ le — B: They begin learning English from the third grade of elementary school. (mine)

examples.text: 我的爱好是游泳。从五岁起我就开始学游泳了。
examples.translation: wǒ de ài hào shì yóu yǒng cóng wǔ suì qǐ wǒ jiù kāi shǐ xué yóu yǒng le — My hobby is swimming. I began learning to swim from the age of five. (the book’s starter; the continuation is mine)

examples.text: 我每年夏天都去海边游泳。
examples.translation: wǒ měi nián xià tiān dōu qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng — I go swimming at the beach every summer. (mine)

examples.text: 从去年起，我每个星期都去学校的游泳馆练习两次。
examples.translation: cóng qù nián qǐ wǒ měi gè xīng qī dōu qù xué xiào de yóu yǒng guǎn liàn xí liǎng cì — Since last year, I have practiced at the school pool twice every week. (mine)

examples.text: 游泳不但对身体好，而且可以让我放松。
examples.translation: yóu yǒng bú dàn duì shēn tǐ hǎo ér qiě kě yǐ ràng wǒ fàng sōng — Swimming is not only good for the body but also lets me relax. (mine)

examples.text: 除了游泳以外，我还喜欢爬山和露营什么的。
examples.translation: chú le yóu yǒng yǐ wài wǒ hái xǐ huān pá shān hé lù yíng shén me de — Besides swimming, I also like hiking, camping and so on. (mine)

options: Before the subject or between subject and predicate

exercises.prompt: What does 从三楼起才有电梯 mean?
options: There are elevators only from the third floor up
Elevators on the third floor only
我七岁从起就学滑冰了
