examples.translation: wǒ wù le fēi jī yīn wèi wǒ dào le jī chǎng cái zhī dào jī chǎng zhè me máng — 4. I missed the plane because I didn’t know the airport was so busy until I arrived there. (误机，因为，到了…才…)

examples.text: 你去过南京吗？没去过的话，最好去看看。那儿有很多名胜古迹。
examples.translation: nǐ qù guò nán jīng ma méi qù guò de huà zuì hǎo qù kàn kàn nàr yǒu hěn duō míng shèng gǔ jì — 5. Have you ever been to Nanjing? If you haven’t, you’d better go and see it. There are a lot of famous tourist attractions there. (去过…，最好，名胜古迹)

examples.text: 我在蒙特雷已经住了快两年了，可是这是我第一次来参观水族馆。
examples.translation: wǒ zài méng tè léi yǐ jīng zhù le kuài liǎng nián le kě shì zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái cān guān shuǐ zú guǎn — 6. I have been living in Monterey for almost two years, but this is my first visit to the aquarium. (…了…了，次，参观)

examples.text: 我们在老王的新家聚会。这儿很热闹，请你也来参加。你十二点以前来得了吗？
examples.translation: wǒ men zài lǎo wáng de xīn jiā jù huì zhèr hěn rè nào qǐng nǐ yě lái cān jiā nǐ shí èr diǎn yǐ qián lái de liǎo ma — 7. We are having a party at Lao Wang’s new home. It’s a lot of fun here, so please come and join us. Will you be able to come before twelve? (热闹，参加，来得了)

examples.text: 我跟你说了什么也不用带。好吧，这里有饮料和零食，你们喜欢什么就吃什么。
examples.translation: wǒ gēn nǐ shuō le shén me yě bú yòng dài hǎo ba zhè lǐ yǒu yǐn liào hé líng shí nǐ men xǐ huān shén me jiù chī shén me — 8. I told you not to bring anything. OK, here are some drinks and snacks; help yourselves to whatever you like. (什么也…，什么…什么…)

examples.text: 有的人在烤肉，有的人坐在长椅上聊天，有的人在草地上踢足球。
examples.translation: yǒu de rén zài kǎo ròu yǒu de rén zuò zài cháng yǐ shàng liáo tiān yǒu de rén zài cǎo dì shàng tī zú qiú — 9. Some are barbecuing, some are sitting on a bench and chatting, and some are playing soccer on the grass. (有的…有的…，在+verb)

examples.text: 我从来没有在网上跟别人玩过游戏。我一个星期只玩两个小时，一个人玩，因为我不想让自己上瘾。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu zài wǎng shàng gēn bié rén wán guò yóu xì wǒ yí gè xīng qī zhǐ wán liǎng gè xiǎo shí yí gè rén wán yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng ràng zì jǐ shàng yǐn — 10. I have never played games online against other people. I only play two hours a week, by myself, because I don’t want to become addicted. (从来没…，因为，让，上瘾)

examples.text: 我空闲的时候喜欢唱歌，我还参加了一个合唱团。我们合唱团每个星期练习一次。要是你感兴趣，也可以参加我们。
examples.translation: wǒ kòng xián de shí hòu xǐ huān chàng gē wǒ hái cān jiā le yí gè hé chàng tuán wǒ men hé chàng tuán měi gè xīng qī liàn xí yí cì yào shì nǐ gǎn xìng qù yě kě yǐ cān jiā wǒ men — 11. I like to sing when I have free time, and I’ve also joined a choir. Our choir practices once a week. If you are interested, you can also join us. (空闲，参加，次，要是，感兴趣)

examples.text: 虽然我喜欢看恐怖片，但是我很少一个人看，因为我会害怕得晚上几乎睡不着觉。
examples.translation: suī rán wǒ xǐ huān kàn kǒng bù piàn dàn shì wǒ hěn shǎo yí gè rén kàn yīn wèi wǒ huì hài pà de wǎn shàng jī hū shuì bù zháo jiào — 12. Although I like to watch horror movies, I seldom watch them alone because I would become so scared that I can hardly sleep at night. (虽然…但是…，很少，因为，害怕)

examples.text: 你可以买一个跑步机在家锻炼，或是来我们的健身房用我们的。我还是觉得你需要一个教练帮你制定一个锻炼计划。
examples.translation: nǐ kě yǐ mǎi yí gè pǎo bù jī zài jiā duàn liàn huò shì lái wǒ men de jiàn shēn fáng yòng wǒ men de wǒ hái shì jué de nǐ xū yào yí gè jiào liàn bāng nǐ zhì dìng yí gè duàn liàn jì huà — 13. You can buy a treadmill to work out at home or come to the gym to use ours. I still think you need a coach to help you make an exercise plan. (或是，还是，制定)

examples.text: 我不但喜欢滑雪，而且喜欢教别人滑雪。我从小学起就开始滑雪了。
examples.translation: wǒ bú dàn xǐ huān huá xuě ér qiě xǐ huān jiāo bié rén huá xuě wǒ cóng xiǎo xué qǐ jiù kāi shǐ huá xuě le — 14. Not only do I like to ski, I also like to teach other people to ski. I started skiing when I was in elementary school. (不但…而且…，别人，从…起)

examples.text: 要是他最喜欢的美国篮球队在中国时间半夜有比赛，不管第二天要不要上班，他都会熬夜看球赛。
examples.translation: yào shì tā zuì xǐ huān de měi guó lán qiú duì zài zhōng guó shí jiān bàn yè yǒu bǐ sài bù guǎn dì èr tiān yào bú yào shàng bān tā dōu huì áo yè kàn qiú sài — 15. If his favorite American basketball team plays a game in the middle of the night in China time, he will stay up late to watch the game even if he needs to go to work the next day. (半夜，不管…都…，熬夜)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): match the sentences
explanations.body: A. Match the sentences in Column B with those in Column A by writing the letters in the leftmost column (the book leaves the key out; mine follows each pair). B. Pair up, check your work and take turns translating each sentence into English.

rows: 请问，出国旅游需要办什么手续？
让我看一下您的登机牌好吗？
好的。能不能给我换成靠窗的座位？
您准备在蒙特雷住多长时间？
差不多三个月，然后去纽约看儿子。
谁知道过安检花了那么长时间啊！
坐飞机从上海去纽约需要多长时间？
上次我花了差不多十五个小时。
从车站到公园只要十分钟，你怎么开了这么久？
路上太堵了，我想开快也开不快呀。
今天这儿怎么到处都是人？
现在哪个名胜古迹都有很多人。
你开车开了四五个小时了，累了吧？
还好，再过二十多分钟就到机场了。

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking): the choir party
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and mark each statement as True or False (audio, not included; the script is printed below and my answers come from it). B. Pair up and discuss your answers and why you chose them; go over the script to check your work.

examples.text: 李：王老师，谢谢邀请大家来你这儿聚会。你做的菜太好吃了！
examples.translation: lǐ wáng lǎo shī xiè xiè yāo qǐng dà jiā lái nǐ zhèr jù huì nǐ zuò de cài tài hǎo chī le — Teacher Wang, thank you for inviting everyone to your place for the party. The food you made is so delicious!

examples.text: 王：哪里哪里，李老师。马上就要过年了，大家在一起热闹热闹。哎，这是你们合唱团的照片吧？好漂亮啊！你在这儿，后边这位是你先生，对不对？
examples.translation: wáng nǎ lǐ nǎ lǐ lǐ lǎo shī mǎ shàng jiù yào guò nián le dà jiā zài yì qǐ rè nào rè nào āi zhè shì nǐ men hé chàng tuán de zhào piān ba hǎo piào liàng a nǐ zài zhèr hòu biān zhè wèi shì nǐ xiān shēng duì bú duì — Not at all, Teacher Li. The New Year is coming soon, so let’s have fun together. Hey, is this a photo of your choir? So beautiful! You’re here, and the one behind is your husband, right? (the book’s layout is garbled here; the speakers follow the sense)

examples.text: 李：对。我们合唱团差不多每个周末都活动。除了唱歌，我们也跳舞。
examples.translation: lǐ duì wǒ men hé chàng tuán chà bu duō měi gè zhōu mò dōu huó dòng chú le chàng gē wǒ men yě tiào wǔ — Right. Our choir meets almost every weekend. Besides singing we also dance.

examples.text: 王：上次你们演出，一个女生唱《我爱你中国》唱得太好了。
examples.translation: wáng shàng cì nǐ men yǎn chū yí gè nǚ shēng chàng wǒ ài nǐ zhōng guó chàng de tài hǎo le — At your last performance a girl sang “I Love You, China” so well.

examples.text: 李：对，她是我们班上的学生。我们那次演出还上了电视呢。
examples.translation: lǐ duì tā shì wǒ men bān shàng de xué shēng wǒ men nà cì yǎn chū hái shàng le diàn shì ne — Yes, she’s a student in our class. Our performance even was on TV.

examples.text: 王：真棒！我有空儿的时候，不是在微信上看东西，就是上网玩儿游戏，很少活动，身体经常不舒服。看来得多参加活动。
examples.translation: wáng zhēn bàng wǒ yǒu kòngr de shí hòu bú shì zài wēi xìn shàng kàn dōng xī jiù shì shàng wǎng wánr yóu xì hěn shǎo huó dòng shēn tǐ jīng cháng bù shū fú kàn lái děi duō cān jiā huó dòng — Great! When I have free time I’m either looking at things on WeChat or playing games online and seldom move, and my body often feels unwell. It seems I should take part in more activities.

examples.text: 李：我听你弹过钢琴，弹得非常好，你先生弹吉他也弹得不错。你们参加我们合唱团的乐队吧。
examples.translation: lǐ wǒ tīng nǐ tán guò gāng qín tán de fēi cháng hǎo nǐ xiān shēng tán jí tā yě tán de bú cuò nǐ men cān jiā wǒ men hé chàng tuán de yuè duì ba — I’ve heard you play the piano, and you play very well, and your husband plays the guitar quite well too. Join our choir’s band.

examples.text: 王：我没问题，可是我先生不一定感兴趣。他只要有时间就看电视，最喜欢看搞笑的。
examples.translation: wáng wǒ méi wèn tí kě shì wǒ xiān shēng bù yí dìng gǎn xìng qù tā zhǐ yào yǒu shí jiān jiù kàn diàn shì zuì xǐ huān kàn gǎo xiào de — I have no problem, but my husband may not be interested. As long as he has time he watches TV, and likes comedy best.

examples.text: 李：哈哈，我也喜欢看电视，不过我最喜欢看的是动画。这样吧，我让我先生给他打个电话，要他一定参加！
examples.translation: lǐ hā hā wǒ yě xǐ huān kàn diàn shì bú guò wǒ zuì xǐ huān kàn de shì dòng huà zhè yàng ba wǒ ràng wǒ xiān shēng gěi tā dǎ gè diàn huà yào tā yí dìng cān jiā — Ha ha, I also like TV, but what I like to watch most is animation. How about this: I’ll have my husband call him and tell him he must join!

examples.text: 王老师搬家了。她请朋友们到她的新家聚了聚。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī bān jiā le tā qǐng péng yǒu men dào tā de xīn jiā jù le jù — 1. Teacher Wang moved house. She invited friends to her new home. — False (the script never mentions a move; it is a Chinese New Year gathering; key mine)

examples.text: 王老师和她先生经常参加合唱团的活动。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī hé tā xiān shēng jīng cháng cān jiā hé chàng tuán de huó dòng — 2. Teacher Wang and her husband often take part in the choir’s activities. — True (photo and 差不多每个周末都活动)

examples.text: 李老师有一张合唱团的照片。
examples.translation: lǐ lǎo shī yǒu yì zhāng hé chàng tuán de zhào piān — 3. Teacher Li has a photo of the choir. — False (the photo is at the speaker’s place)

examples.text: 王老师的一个美国朋友唱中国歌唱得非常好。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī de yí gè měi guó péng yǒu chàng zhōng guó gē chàng de fēi cháng hǎo — 4. One of Teacher Wang’s American friends sings Chinese songs very well. — False (a female student in the class)

examples.text: 李老师很喜欢上网玩儿游戏。
examples.translation: lǐ lǎo shī hěn xǐ huān shàng wǎng wánr yóu xì — 5. Teacher Li likes playing online games very much. — False (she does it in her free time but regrets not being active)

examples.text: 王老师的先生可能会给李老师的先生打电话。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī de xiān shēng kě néng huì gěi lǐ lǎo shī de xiān shēng dǎ diàn huà — 6. Teacher Wang’s husband may call Teacher Li’s husband. — True (让我先生给他打个电话)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Listen to the statements and fill in the table in Chinese using the information you heard: for 哥哥, 姐姐, 弟弟 and 我 write 什么运动, 什么时间, 什么地方 and 其他. (Audio and a picture, not included.)

exercises.prompt: Which answer matches 请问，出国旅游需要办什么手续？
options: 上次我花了十五个小时。

exercises.prompt: Which answer matches 你怎么会误了航班呢？
options: 还好，再过二十分钟就到。
谁知道过安检花了那么长时间啊！
exercises.explanation: The security check took so long.

exercises.prompt: Which answer matches 今天这儿怎么到处都是人？
options: 上次我花了十五个小时。
现在哪个名胜古迹都有很多人。

exercises.prompt: Which answer matches 你开车开了四五个小时了，累了吧？
options: 还好，再过二十多分钟就到机场了。
exercises.explanation: Another twenty minutes to the airport.

exercises.prompt: What are Teacher Li and Teacher Wang celebrating?
options: A get-together before the New Year
exercises.explanation: 马上就要过年了，大家在一起热闹热闹.

exercises.prompt: How often does the choir meet?
exercises.explanation: 差不多每个周末都活动.

exercises.prompt: What does Teacher Wang do in her free time?
options: Looks at WeChat or plays games online
exercises.explanation: 不是在微信上看东西，就是上网玩儿游戏.

exercises.prompt: What does Teacher Wang’s husband like to watch?
What will Teacher Li have her husband do?
options: Call Teacher Wang’s husband and ask him to join
exercises.explanation: 让我先生给他打个电话.

exercises.prompt: 请问，出国旅游需要办什么手___？
我们合唱团差不多每个周末都活___。

lessons.title: 444. Lesson 18 (Unit 3 review): grammar and usage review, part 1
lessons.subtitle: 的/得/地 · 什么 · 越来越 · 六组句型 · 以后/然后/后来 · 又/再

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing): 的, 得 or 地
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the possessive marker 的, the degree complement marker 得, or the adverbial modifier marker 地. Compare your work with a classmate. Note: numbers 10 and 11 can be completed in different ways; how do their meanings differ? (Mine: 地 describes the manner, “smiled happily”; 得 gives the result, “so happy that she laughed.”) The book leaves the key out; mine follows (the book’s blanks sit where 的, 得 and 地 are).

examples.text: 我订的是靠窗户的座位。
examples.translation: wǒ dìng de shì kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi — 1. What I booked is a window seat. (的; key mine)

examples.text: 她的英语说得怎么样？
examples.translation: tā de yīng yǔ shuō de zěn me yàng — 2. How well does she speak English? (得)

examples.text: 孩子们学什么都学得很快。
examples.translation: hái zi men xué shén me dōu xué de hěn kuài — 3. Children learn whatever they study very fast. (得)

examples.text: 考试前她紧张得睡不着觉。
examples.translation: kǎo shì qián tā jǐn zhāng de shuì bù zháo jiào — 4. Before the test she was so nervous that she couldn’t sleep. (得)

examples.text: 世界杯的时候，我先生一晚一晚地看球赛，觉也不睡了。
examples.translation: shì jiè bēi de shí hòu wǒ xiān shēng yì wǎn yì wǎn de kàn qiú sài jiào yě bú shuì le — 5. During the World Cup, my husband watched games night after night and didn’t even sleep. (地)

examples.text: 聚会的时候，最忙的就是妈妈们了。她们忙得连饭也没时间吃。
examples.translation: jù huì de shí hòu zuì máng de jiù shì mā mā men le tā men máng de lián fàn yě méi shí jiān chī — 6. At a party, the busiest are the mothers. They are so busy that they don’t even have time to eat. (的, 得)

examples.text: 字太小了，你看得清看不清？
examples.translation: zì tài xiǎo le nǐ kàn de qīng kàn bù qīng — 7. The characters are too small; can you see them clearly or not? (得)

examples.text: 她急得哭了起来。
examples.translation: tā jí de kū le qǐ lái — 8. She got so anxious that she began to cry. (得)

examples.text: 他每天在跑步机上跑一个小时的步，现在他跑得越来越快了。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān zài pǎo bù jī shàng pǎo yí gè xiǎo shí de bù xiàn zài tā pǎo de yuè lái yuè kuài le — 9. He runs on the treadmill for an hour every day, and now he runs faster and faster. (的, 得)

examples.text: 她开心地笑了。
examples.translation: tā kāi xīn de xiào le — 10. She smiled happily. (地; or 她开心得笑了, so happy that she laughed)

examples.text: 他高兴地唱起歌来。
examples.translation: tā gāo xìng de chàng qǐ gē lái — 11. He happily began to sing. (地; or 他高兴得唱起歌来, so happy that he started to sing)

explanations.title: Activity 1, Optional: two stories
explanations.body: B. Optional. Complete the two stories (The Little Bird; The Fox and the Crow) with 的, 得 or 地; the completed texts are mine.

examples.text: 小鸟飞到了大树的上面，它高兴地叫起来：“我会飞啦！”小鸟飞到了大山的上空，它又高兴地喊起来：“我真的会飞啦！”
examples.translation: xiǎo niǎo fēi dào le dà shù de shàng miàn tā gāo xìng de jiào qǐ lái wǒ huì fēi la xiǎo niǎo fēi dào le dà shān de shàng kōng tā yòu gāo xìng de hǎn qǐ lái wǒ zhēn de huì fēi la — The little bird flew above the big tree and happily began to cry out, “I can fly!” The bird flew into the sky over the big mountain and happily shouted again, “I really can fly!” (completed with 的/地; mine)

examples.text: 狐狸在树林里找吃的，他看见乌鸦的嘴里有一块肉。狐狸馋得流口水。他对乌鸦说：“亲爱的乌鸦，你的羽毛真好看！”乌鸦不说话。狐狸又说：“您的孩子们都好吗？”乌鸦还是不说话。狐狸想了想，说：“您的歌唱得好极了！”乌鸦高兴地唱起来，她嘴里的肉掉下来。狐狸叼起肉，飞快地跑了。
examples.translation: hú lí zài shù lín lǐ zhǎo chī de tā kàn jiàn wū yā de zuǐ lǐ yǒu yí kuài ròu hú lí chán de liú kǒu shuǐ tā duì wū yā shuō qīn ài de wū yā nǐ de yǔ máo zhēn hǎo kàn wū yā bù shuō huà hú lí yòu shuō nín de hái zi men dōu hǎo ma wū yā hái shì bù shuō huà hú lí xiǎng le xiǎng shuō nín de gē chàng de hǎo jí le wū yā gāo xìng de chàng qǐ lái tā zuǐ lǐ de ròu diào xià lái hú lí diāo qǐ ròu fēi kuài de pǎo le — The fox was looking for food in the woods when he saw a piece of meat in the crow’s mouth. The fox was so greedy that he drooled. He said to the crow, “Dear Crow, your feathers are so beautiful!” The crow said nothing. The fox said again, “How are your children?” The crow still said nothing. The fox thought for a moment and said, “You sing extremely well!” The crow happily began to sing, and the meat in her mouth fell down. The fox picked up the meat and ran away quickly. (completed with 的/得/地; mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): the uses of 什么
explanations.body: Pair up. Read the following sentences and discuss the meanings of the different uses of 什么 with your partner. The book gives no explanations; mine are in the translations.

examples.text: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？
examples.translation: shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn — 1. The summer vacation is coming; what are your plans? (interrogative: what)

examples.text: 你不想说点儿什么吗？
examples.translation: nǐ bù xiǎng shuō diǎnr shén me ma — 2. Don’t you want to say something? (indefinite: something)

examples.text: 参加旅行团有什么意思啊？一点儿都不自由。
examples.translation: cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán yǒu shén me yì si a yì diǎnr dōu bú zì yóu — 3. What’s the point of joining a tour group? There’s no freedom at all. (rhetorical: there’s no point)

examples.text: 聚会以前，我得去买点儿什么。
examples.translation: jù huì yǐ qián wǒ děi qù mǎi diǎnr shén me — 4. Before the party I have to go and buy something. (indefinite: something)

examples.text: 我男朋友什么运动都喜欢。
examples.translation: wǒ nán péng yǒu shén me yùn dòng dōu xǐ huān — 5. My boyfriend likes every kind of sport. (any/every)

examples.text: 放假了！我想什么时候起床就什么时候起床。
examples.translation: fàng jià le wǒ xiǎng shén me shí hòu qǐ chuáng jiù shén me shí hòu qǐ chuáng — 6. It’s vacation! I’ll get up whenever I want. (whatever/whenever: 什么…就什么…)

examples.text: 我对游泳滑雪什么的都很感兴趣。
examples.translation: wǒ duì yóu yǒng huá xuě shén me de dōu hěn gǎn xìng qù — 7. I’m interested in swimming, skiing and so on. (什么的: etc.)

examples.text: 什么时候到我的新家来玩儿吧。
examples.translation: shén me shí hòu dào wǒ de xīn jiā lái wánr ba — 8. Come to my new home some time. (什么时候: some time)

examples.text: 马上就要考试了，看什么电影啊？
examples.translation: mǎ shàng jiù yào kǎo shì le kàn shén me diàn yǐng a — 9. The exam is coming up soon; why watch a movie? (rhetorical: don’t)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking): 越来越/越…越…
explanations.body: In two groups, use 越来越 or 越…越… to describe the changes in nature when winter gives way to spring. The group that comes up with the most ideas wins. (Two photographs, not included.) My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 天气越来越暖和了。
examples.translation: tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo le — The weather is getting warmer and warmer. (越来越)

examples.text: 白天越来越长，晚上越来越短。
examples.translation: bái tiān yuè lái yuè cháng wǎn shàng yuè lái yuè duǎn — The days are getting longer and the nights shorter.

examples.text: 树叶越长越绿，花越开越多。
examples.translation: shù yè yuè zhǎng yuè lǜ huā yuè kāi yuè duō — The leaves grow greener and greener, and the more the flowers open. (越…越…)

examples.text: 雪越下越少，天气越暖和，小鸟就越来越多了。
examples.translation: xuě yuè xià yuè shǎo tiān qì yuè nuǎn huo xiǎo niǎo jiù yuè lái yuè duō le — The snow falls less and less; the warmer the weather, the more birds there are.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking): six groups of patterns
explanations.body: A. For each of the six groups of sentences: 1. Translate the sentence. 2. Complete the sentence. 3. Create your own sentence using the same structure. B. Pair up and share your work with your partner. The patterns are 不是…就是…, 虽然…但是/可是…, 因此, 要是…就…, 不管…都… and 原来 (the book heads the last group 不管…都… by mistake). The first sentence of each group is the book’s; the completions and my own sentences are mine:

examples.text: 他每天不是打游戏就是睡觉。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān bú shì dǎ yóu xì jiù shì shuì jiào — Group 1 不是…就是… — 1. Every day he is either playing games or sleeping.

examples.text: 我吃得很简单，不是面条就是米饭。
examples.translation: wǒ chī de hěn jiǎn dān bú shì miàn tiáo jiù shì mǐ fàn — 2. I eat very simply: it’s either noodles or rice. (mine)

examples.text: 周末我不是去爬山就是去游泳。
examples.translation: zhōu mò wǒ bú shì qù pá shān jiù shì qù yóu yǒng — 3. On weekends I either go hiking or go swimming. (mine)

examples.text: 他虽然每天锻炼，可还是很胖。
examples.translation: tā suī rán měi tiān duàn liàn kě hái shì hěn pàng — Group 2 虽然…但是/可是… — 1. Although he exercises every day, he is still very fat.

examples.text: 加拿大虽然地方大，但是人口不多。
examples.translation: jiā ná dà suī rán dì fāng dà dàn shì rén kǒu bù duō — 2. Although Canada is large, its population is not big. (mine)

examples.text: 这个手机虽然很贵，但是质量很好。
examples.translation: zhè ge shǒu jī suī rán hěn guì dàn shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo — 3. Although this phone is expensive, its quality is very good. (mine)

examples.text: 天气不好，很多航班因此停飞了。
examples.translation: tiān qì bù hǎo hěn duō háng bān yīn cǐ tíng fēi le — Group 3 因此 — 1. The weather was bad, so many flights were canceled as a result.

examples.text: 我太太对恐怖片又喜欢又害怕，因此她常常看完以后睡不着觉。
examples.translation: wǒ tài tài duì kǒng bù piàn yòu xǐ huān yòu hài pà yīn cǐ tā cháng cháng kàn wán yǐ hòu shuì bù zháo jiào — 2. My wife both likes and fears horror movies; therefore she often can’t sleep after watching. (mine)

examples.text: 他每天锻炼身体，因此很少生病。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān duàn liàn shēn tǐ yīn cǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng — 3. He exercises every day and therefore rarely gets sick. (mine)

examples.text: 要是写不完作业的话，我就睡不着觉。
examples.translation: yào shì xiě bù wán zuò yè de huà wǒ jiù shuì bù zháo jiào — Group 4 要是…就… — 1. If I can’t finish my homework, I can’t fall asleep.

examples.text: 要是坐地铁，就不会迟到了。
examples.translation: yào shì zuò dì tiě jiù bú huì chí dào le — 2. If you take the subway, you won’t be late. (mine)

examples.text: 要是明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
examples.translation: yào shì míng tiān bú xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù pá shān — 3. If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we’ll go hiking. (mine)

examples.text: 你不管穿什么都好看。
examples.translation: nǐ bù guǎn chuān shén me dōu hǎo kàn — Group 5 不管…都… — 1. No matter what you wear, you look good.

examples.text: 不管多忙，他每天都去健身房。
examples.translation: bù guǎn duō máng tā měi tiān dōu qù jiàn shēn fáng — 2. No matter how busy, he goes to the gym every day. (mine)

examples.text: 不管天气怎么样，我们都要去野餐。
examples.translation: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng wǒ men dōu yào qù yě cān — 3. No matter what the weather is like, we’ll go on a picnic. (mine)

examples.text: 我一直觉得你们有点像，原来他是你弟弟！
examples.translation: wǒ yì zhí jué de nǐ men yǒu diǎn xiàng yuán lái tā shì nǐ dì di — Group 6 原来 (the book numbers it Group 5 again) — 1. I always thought you two looked alike; it turns out he’s your younger brother!

examples.text: 我以前不知道为什么有一个北京，还有一个南京，后来才知道，原来北京在北方，南京在南方。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào wèi shén me yǒu yí gè běi jīng hái yǒu yí gè nán jīng hòu lái cái zhī dào yuán lái běi jīng zài běi fāng nán jīng zài nán fāng — 2. I didn’t know before why there is a Beijing and also a Nanjing; later I found out that Beijing is in the north and Nanjing in the south. (mine; the book’s sentence is left unfinished)

examples.text: 我找了半天手机，原来它在我的包里。
examples.translation: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān shǒu jī yuán lái tā zài wǒ de bāo lǐ — 3. I looked for my phone for ages; it turns out it was in my bag. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Writing, Reading, Speaking and Listening): the young cashier
explanations.body: Read the story of a young cashier who wants to advance her studies. Complete the sentences using 以后, 然后, 后来, 从…到…, 从…起, 到…去… and 离. Then pair up and compare your work; discuss any differences. My completed story:

examples.text: 从今年六月起，我就在一家小商店做服务员。后来我发现，离商店不太远的地方有一所社区大学。从我工作的地方开车到那儿只要十五分钟。所以，每天下班以后，我就在附近的快餐店随便吃点儿东西，然后就开车到学校去上课。我每周有四次课，上课的时间是从晚上六点到九点，下课以后再开车回家。每天这样跑来跑去，简直太累了。但是我想，以后我一定能找到更好的工作。
examples.translation: cóng jīn nián liù yuè qǐ wǒ jiù zài yì jiā xiǎo shāng diàn zuò fú wù yuán hòu lái wǒ fā xiàn lí shāng diàn bú tài yuǎn de dì fāng yǒu yì suǒ shè qū dà xué cóng wǒ gōng zuò de dì fāng kāi chē dào nàr zhǐ yào shí wǔ fēn zhōng suǒ yǐ měi tiān xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ jiù zài fù jìn de kuài cān diàn suí biàn chī diǎnr dōng xī rán hòu jiù kāi chē dào xué xiào qù shàng kè wǒ měi zhōu yǒu sì cì kè shàng kè de shí jiān shì cóng wǎn shàng liù diǎn dào jiǔ diǎn xià kè yǐ hòu zài kāi chē huí jiā měi tiān zhè yàng pǎo lái pǎo qù jiǎn zhí tài lèi le dàn shì wǒ xiǎng yǐ hòu wǒ yí dìng néng zhǎo dào gèng hǎo de gōng zuò — Since this June I have been working as a clerk in a small store. Later I found out that not far from the store there is a community college. It is only fifteen minutes by car from where I work to there. So every day after work I grab something to eat at a fast-food place nearby, and then I drive to school to attend class. I have class four times a week, from six to nine in the evening, and I drive home after class. Running around like this every day is simply too tiring. But I think that in the future I will certainly find a better job. (The completed story is mine; the book blanks the words 后来, 以后, 然后, 从…到…, 从…起, 到…去… and 离, and glosses 社区大学 and 快餐店 in English.)

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading and Writing): 又 or 再
explanations.body: Use either 又 or 再 to correctly complete the sentences. The key is mine:

examples.text: 她昨天来晚了，今天又来晚了。
examples.translation: tā zuó tiān lái wǎn le jīn tiān yòu lái wǎn le — 1. She was late yesterday and was late again today. (又)

examples.text: 王老师不在，你明天再来吧。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī bú zài nǐ míng tiān zài lái ba — 2. Teacher Wang isn’t in; come again tomorrow. (再)

examples.text: 我昨天已经跑过步了，今天不想再跑了。
examples.translation: wǒ zuó tiān yǐ jīng pǎo guò bù le jīn tiān bù xiǎng zài pǎo le — 3. I already ran yesterday and don’t want to run again today. (再)

examples.text: 太晚了，快睡觉吧。作业明天再做也行。
examples.translation: tài wǎn le kuài shuì jiào ba zuò yè míng tiān zài zuò yě xíng — 4. It’s too late; go to bed. The homework can be done tomorrow. (再)

examples.text: 他下星期又要出差了。
examples.translation: tā xià xīng qī yòu yào chū chāi le — 5. He is going on a business trip again next week. (又)

examples.text: 在饭店吃完饭以后，我们又散了半个小时的步才回家。
examples.translation: zài fàn diàn chī wán fàn yǐ hòu wǒ men yòu sàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí de bù cái huí jiā — 6. After eating at the restaurant we also strolled for half an hour before going home. (又)

examples.text: 你等一会儿再走吧，外边正下着雨呢。
examples.translation: nǐ děng yí huìr zài zǒu ba wài biān zhèng xià zhe yǔ ne — 7. Wait a while before you leave; it’s raining outside. (再)

exercises.prompt: Which marker completes 她的英语说___怎么样？
Which marker completes 我订___是靠窗户的座位？
Which marker completes 他高兴___唱起歌来？ (happily began to sing)
What is the difference between 她开心地笑了 and 她开心得笑了?
options: 地 = laughed happily; 得 = so happy that she laughed

exercises.prompt: What does 什么 mean in 你不想说点儿什么吗？
What does 什么 mean in 参加旅行团有什么意思啊？
What does 我男朋友什么运动都喜欢 mean?
What does 什么的 mean in 游泳滑雪什么的?
Which fits “It turns out he’s your brother!”?
Which fits 今天又来晚了 (late again)?
exercises.explanation: 又 for a repeated past action.

exercises.prompt: Which fits 明天___来吧 (come again tomorrow)?
孩子们学什么都学___很快。
考试前她紧张___睡不着觉。
世界杯的时候，我先生一晚一晚___看球赛。
每天下班以后，我就在附近的快餐店随便吃点儿东西，___就开车到学校去上课。

lessons.title: 445. Lesson 18 (Unit 3 review): grammar and usage review, part 2
lessons.subtitle: 时态翻译 · 为了/为/给/对 · 就的九种用法 · 或者/还是 · 才 · 完到好成 · 次/遍 · 刚/刚才 · 着 · 上

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading and Speaking): verb tenses
explanations.body: A. Translate the sentences into English, paying careful attention to the verb tenses. The book glosses 谈恋爱, 婚礼, 乒乓球 and 生蘑菇 in pinyin and writes 25 as a digit. B. Now it is your turn to talk about David: translate six English sentences into Chinese and compare with a classmate. The translations in part A and my Chinese for part B are mine:

examples.text: 我在蒙特雷住了三年了，去过很多风景美丽的地方，但是我还没去过水族馆。昨天我和朋友去了那里，真的不错！
examples.translation: wǒ zài méng tè léi zhù le sān nián le qù guò hěn duō fēng jǐng měi lì de dì fāng dàn shì wǒ hái méi qù guò shuǐ zú guǎn zuó tiān wǒ hé péng yǒu qù le nà lǐ zhēn de bú cuò — 1. I have lived in Monterey for three years and have been to many places with beautiful scenery, but I hadn’t been to the aquarium yet. Yesterday I went there with a friend, and it was really good! (translation mine)

examples.text: 我直到二十五岁才开始谈恋爱。下个月我要结婚了。我和他是在北京认识的。你会来参加我的婚礼吗？
examples.translation: wǒ zhí dào èr shí wǔ suì cái kāi shǐ tán liàn ài xià gè yuè wǒ yào jié hūn le wǒ hé tā shì zài běi jīng rèn shí de nǐ huì lái cān jiā wǒ de hūn lǐ ma — 2. I didn’t start dating until I was twenty-five. Next month I’m getting married. He and I met in Beijing. Will you come to my wedding?

examples.text: 你等会儿再打电话来吧。我正在和我弟弟打乒乓球呢，我们快打完了。
examples.translation: nǐ děng huìr zài dǎ diàn huà lái ba wǒ zhèng zài hé wǒ dì di dǎ pīng pāng qiú ne wǒ men kuài dǎ wán le — 3. Call again in a little while. I’m playing table tennis with my younger brother and we’re almost done.

examples.text: 我吃过生鱼片，可是从来没吃过生蘑菇，也从来不知道那么多菜都可以生吃。
examples.translation: wǒ chī guò shēng yú piàn kě shì cóng lái méi chī guò shēng mó gū yě cóng lái bù zhī dào nà me duō cài dōu kě yǐ shēng chī — 4. I’ve eaten sashimi, but I’ve never eaten raw mushrooms, and never knew that so many dishes can be eaten raw.

examples.text: 大卫上星期去了加拿大。
examples.translation: dà wèi shàng xīng qī qù le jiā ná dà — 1. David went to Canada last week. (mine)

examples.text: 他是坐飞机去的。
examples.translation: tā shì zuò fēi jī qù de — 2. He went there by plane.

examples.text: 他以前从来没去过中国。
examples.translation: tā yǐ qián cóng lái méi qù guò zhōng guó — 3. He has never been to China before.

examples.text: 他今天要去中国。
examples.translation: tā jīn tiān yào qù zhōng guó — 4. He is going to China today.

examples.text: 他正在等他的航班。
examples.translation: tā zhèng zài děng tā de háng bān — 5. He is waiting for his flight.

examples.text: 飞机就要起飞了。
examples.translation: fēi jī jiù yào qǐ fēi le — 6. The plane is about to take off.

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading and Speaking): 为了, 为, 给, 对
explanations.body: Complete the sentences using 为了, 为, 给 and 对. Read your work to a classmate and discuss any differences you find. The book leaves the key out (and glosses 机会 as “opportunity”); mine:

examples.text: 为了让大家听清楚，老师又慢慢地说了一遍。
examples.translation: wèi le ràng dà jiā tīng qīng chǔ lǎo shī yòu màn màn de shuō le yí biàn — 1. In order to let everyone hear clearly, the teacher slowly said it again. (为了; key mine)

examples.text: 我想为你唱一首歌。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng wèi nǐ chàng yì shǒu gē — 2. I want to sing a song for you. (为)

examples.text: 我再给你一次机会。
examples.translation: wǒ zài gěi nǐ yí cì jī huì — 3. I’ll give you one more chance. (给)

examples.text: 班长给同学们发了一个邮件。
examples.translation: bān zhǎng gěi tóng xué men fā le yí gè yóu jiàn — 4. The class monitor sent an email to the classmates. (给)

examples.text: 你怎么这样对父母说话？
examples.translation: nǐ zěn me zhè yàng duì fù mǔ shuō huà — 5. How can you talk to your parents like this? (对)

examples.text: 她给了我很多的帮助。
examples.translation: tā gěi le wǒ hěn duō de bāng zhù — 6. She gave me a lot of help. (给)

examples.text: 他对学外语很有兴趣。
examples.translation: tā duì xué wài yǔ hěn yǒu xìng qù — 7. He is very interested in learning foreign languages. (对)

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading): the functions of 就
explanations.body: Match the 就 in each sentence with its function by writing the letters in the leftmost column: a. earliest; b. as soon as; c. exactly; d. if…then…; e. just/small quantity; f. about to; g. easiness; h. as long as…then…; i. expressing the only two possibilities. The key is mine:

examples.text: 他就是你要找的人。
examples.translation: tā jiù shì nǐ yào zhǎo de rén — 1. He is exactly the person you’re looking for. — c, exactly (key mine)

examples.text: 我一下课就给你打电话。
examples.translation: wǒ yí xià kè jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà — 2. I’ll call you as soon as class is over. — b, as soon as

examples.text: 还有半个小时飞机就起飞了。
examples.translation: hái yǒu bàn gè xiǎo shí fēi jī jiù qǐ fēi le — 3. In half an hour the plane will take off. — f, about to

examples.text: 其他的菜都很好，就这个有点儿咸。
examples.translation: qí tā de cài dōu hěn hǎo jiù zhè ge yǒu diǎnr xián — 4. The other dishes are all good; only this one is a bit salty. — e, just/small quantity

examples.text: 飞机九点起飞，我七点就到机场了。
examples.translation: fēi jī jiǔ diǎn qǐ fēi wǒ qī diǎn jiù dào jī chǎng le — 5. The plane takes off at nine, and I was at the airport as early as seven. — a, earliest

examples.text: 我弟弟不是玩手机就是看电脑。
examples.translation: wǒ dì di bú shì wán shǒu jī jiù shì kàn diàn nǎo — 6. My younger brother is either on his phone or looking at the computer. — i, only two possibilities

examples.text: 只要你高兴就行。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ gāo xìng jiù xíng — 7. As long as you’re happy, it’s fine. — h, as long as … then

examples.text: 如果累了，就早点睡吧。
examples.translation: rú guǒ lèi le jiù zǎo diǎn shuì ba — 8. If you’re tired, go to bed early. — d, if … then

examples.text: 住在这里很方便，商店就有好几家。
examples.translation: zhù zài zhè lǐ hěn fāng biàn shāng diàn jiù yǒu hǎo jǐ jiā — 9. Living here is convenient; there are several stores alone. — g, easiness

explanations.title: Activity 10 (Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Use 或者/或是 and 还是 to complete the sentences; then translate them into English orally. B. Translate the sentences into English, paying attention to the different use of 才. C. Use the resultative complements 好, 到, 完 and 成 to complete the sentences. D. Complete the dialogs using the action measure words 次 and 遍. E. Fill the blanks with either 刚 or 刚才 where appropriate. The book leaves the key out (and writes 11 点 as a digit); mine:

examples.text: 你喜欢我还是我的钱？
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān wǒ hái shì wǒ de qián — A1. Do you like me or my money? (还是; key mine)

examples.text: 快十一点了，你们还是先睡觉吧，作业可以明天再做。
examples.translation: kuài shí yī diǎn le nǐ men hái shì xiān shuì jiào ba zuò yè kě yǐ míng tiān zài zuò — A2. It’s almost eleven; you’d better go to bed first and do the homework tomorrow. (还是: had better)

examples.text: 用手机或者电脑都可以上网。
examples.translation: yòng shǒu jī huò zhě diàn nǎo dōu kě yǐ shàng wǎng — A3. You can go online with a phone or a computer. (或者/或是)

examples.text: 星期六早上我十点才起床。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù zǎo shàng wǒ shí diǎn cái qǐ chuáng — B1. On Saturday morning I didn’t get up until ten. (才: later than expected)

examples.text: 我们才学了三个月的中文。
examples.translation: wǒ men cái xué le sān gè yuè de zhōng wén — B2. We have only studied Chinese for three months. (才: only)

examples.text: 怎么才能减肥？
examples.translation: zěn me cái néng jiǎn féi — B3. How can one lose weight? / What does it take to lose weight? (才: only if)

examples.text: 就是因为下雨，所以他才没去小王家。
examples.translation: jiù shì yīn wèi xià yǔ suǒ yǐ tā cái méi qù xiǎo wáng jiā — B4. It was precisely because of the rain that he didn’t go to Xiao Wang’s home. (才: cause and effect)

examples.text: 逛完水族馆以后，我们还去了渔人码头。
examples.translation: guàng wán shuǐ zú guǎn yǐ hòu wǒ men hái qù le yú rén mǎ tóu — C1. After we finished visiting the aquarium, we also went to Fisherman’s Wharf. (完)

examples.text: 各种装备都可以在滑雪场租到。
examples.translation: gè zhǒng zhuāng bèi dōu kě yǐ zài huá xuě chǎng zū dào — C2. All kinds of equipment can be rented at the ski resort. (到)

examples.text: 我订的是靠过道的座位，我想换成靠窗户的。
examples.translation: wǒ dìng de shì kào guò dào de zuò wèi wǒ xiǎng huàn chéng kào chuāng hù de — C3. I booked an aisle seat and want to change it to a window seat. (成)

examples.text: 大家一直玩儿到天黑才回家。
examples.translation: dà jiā yì zhí wánr dào tiān hēi cái huí jiā — C4. Everyone played until dark before going home. (到)

examples.text: 肉烤好了以后，大家就坐下来一起野餐。
examples.translation: ròu kǎo hǎo le yǐ hòu dà jiā jiù zuò xià lái yì qǐ yě cān — C5. After the meat was cooked, everyone sat down for a picnic together. (好)

examples.text: 网上买东西真方便，鼠标一点，东西就送到家门口了。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī zhēn fāng biàn shǔ biāo yì diǎn dōng xī jiù sòng dào jiā mén kǒu le — C6. Shopping online is really convenient: one click of the mouse and the things are delivered to your doorstep. (到)

examples.text: 你去过长城吗？去过，我去过三次。
examples.translation: nǐ qù guò cháng chéng ma qù guò wǒ qù guò sān cì — D1. Have you been to the Great Wall? Yes, I’ve been three times. (次)

examples.text: 你的电话号码是多少？我以前给过你一遍吧？我忘了，你再说一遍吧！
examples.translation: nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo wǒ yǐ qián gěi guò nǐ yí biàn ba wǒ wàng le nǐ zài shuō yí biàn ba — D2. What’s your phone number? I gave it to you once before, didn’t I? I forgot; say it again! (遍; the book’s first blank here is 一次 or 一遍; mine uses 遍 for repeating the number)

examples.text: 听说你最近身体不太好，常常去医院。对，这个月我已经去过四次医院了。
examples.translation: tīng shuō nǐ zuì jìn shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo cháng cháng qù yī yuàn duì zhè ge yuè wǒ yǐ jīng qù guò sì cì yī yuàn le — D3. I heard you haven’t been well lately and often go to the hospital. Yes, this month I’ve already been to the hospital four times. (次)

examples.text: 你看过这部电影吗？看过。我都看了三遍了。
examples.translation: nǐ kàn guò zhè bù diàn yǐng ma kàn guò wǒ dōu kàn le sān biàn le — D4. Have you seen this movie? Yes, I’ve watched it three times already. (遍)

examples.text: 王老师刚才还在这儿，现在去哪儿了？他刚开会去了。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī gāng cái hái zài zhèr xiàn zài qù nǎr le tā gāng kāi huì qù le — E1. Teacher Wang was just here; where has he gone now? He just went to a meeting. (刚才, 刚)

examples.text: 刚才的事儿你看见了吗？我刚到，没看见。
examples.translation: gāng cái de shìr nǐ kàn jiàn le ma wǒ gāng dào méi kàn jiàn — E2. Did you see what just happened? I just arrived and didn’t see. (刚才, 刚)

explanations.title: Activity 11 (Reading and Speaking): unnecessary 的; the painting
explanations.body: A. The passage below is the description of a picture. Read it, highlight any unnecessary uses of 的, and translate it into English. B. Examine the image of “The Night Café” by Vincent van Gogh. Use the verb + aspect particle 着 to describe the painting. Form two groups; each group creates five sentences and reports to the class; after listening, combine the descriptions. (The painting is a picture, so it is not included.)

examples.text: 画上有一条大河，河上有一座长长的桥，桥下有好几条小小的船。有一条船是白色的，其他的都是黑色的。河边有一棵很高的树，树上长着很多苹果，个个都很红。树下躺着一个可爱的小男孩儿，看起来很开心的样子。孩子的身边有两只小白狗。
examples.translation: huà shàng yǒu yì tiáo dà hé hé shàng yǒu yí zuò cháng cháng de qiáo qiáo xià yǒu hǎo jǐ tiáo xiǎo xiǎo de chuán yǒu yì tiáo chuán shì bái sè de qí tā de dōu shì hēi sè de hé biān yǒu yì kē hěn gāo de shù shù shàng zhǎng zhe hěn duō píng guǒ gè gè dōu hěn hóng shù xià tǎng zhe yí gè kě ài de xiǎo nán háir kàn qǐ lái hěn kāi xīn de yàng zi hái zi de shēn biān yǒu liǎng zhī xiǎo bái gǒu — In the picture there is a big river; over the river there is a long bridge; under the bridge there are several tiny boats. One boat is white and the others are black. By the river there is a very tall tree with many apples growing on it, each very red. Under the tree lies a lovable little boy who looks very happy. Beside the child are two little white dogs. (This is the passage with the unnecessary 的 removed, which is the book’s task; the book’s original has 大的河, 很多的苹果, 很红的, 小的男孩儿 and 小的白的狗, and glosses 河, 桥 and 船 in pinyin; mine.)

examples.text: 房间中间放着一张台球桌。
examples.translation: fáng jiān zhōng jiān fàng zhe yì zhāng tái qiú zhuō — A billiard table stands in the middle of the room. (mine; the picture is not included, so these describe the painting as I know it)

examples.text: 墙上挂着一个钟。
examples.translation: qiáng shàng guà zhe yí gè zhōng — A clock hangs on the wall.

examples.text: 天花板上吊着几盏黄色的灯。
examples.translation: tiān huā bǎn shàng diào zhe jǐ zhǎn huáng sè de dēng — Several yellow lamps hang from the ceiling.

examples.text: 几个人坐在桌子旁边，低着头。
examples.translation: jǐ gè rén zuò zài zhuō zi páng biān dī zhe tóu — A few people sit at the tables with their heads down.

examples.text: 一个穿白衣服的男人站着，看着前面。
examples.translation: yí gè chuān bái yī fú de nán rén zhàn zhe kàn zhe qián miàn — A man in white stands, looking ahead.

explanations.title: Activity 12 (Reading and Speaking): (在) noun + 上
explanations.body: Pair up. Take turns verbally translating the following (在) noun + 上 phrases into English. The translations are mine:

examples.text: 那本书在桌子上。
examples.translation: nà běn shū zài zhuō zi shàng — 1. The book is on the table. (key mine)

examples.text: 书上是怎么说的？
examples.translation: shū shàng shì zěn me shuō de — 2. What does the book say?

examples.text: 画上有什么？
examples.translation: huà shàng yǒu shén me — 3. What is in the picture?

examples.text: 在飞机上除了睡觉还能做什么？
examples.translation: zài fēi jī shàng chú le shuì jiào hái néng zuò shén me — 4. Besides sleeping, what else can you do on a plane?

examples.text: 在火车上也可以上网。
examples.translation: zài huǒ chē shàng yě kě yǐ shàng wǎng — 5. You can also go online on a train.

examples.text: 你可以在网上查一下。
examples.translation: nǐ kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng chá yí xià — 6. You can look it up online.

examples.text: 车在半路上坏了。
examples.translation: chē zài bàn lù shàng huài le — 7. The car broke down halfway.

examples.text: 他在学习上给了我很多帮助。
examples.translation: tā zài xué xí shàng gěi le wǒ hěn duō bāng zhù — 8. He gave me a lot of help with my studies.

examples.text: 我在语法上还有很多问题。
examples.translation: wǒ zài yǔ fǎ shàng hái yǒu hěn duō wèn tí — 9. I still have many problems with grammar.

exercises.prompt: What does 我直到二十五岁才开始谈恋爱 mean?
options: I didn’t start dating until I was twenty-five

exercises.prompt: Which fits 为了___大家听清楚，老师又说了一遍？
exercises.explanation: 为了让大家听清楚: in order to let everyone hear.

exercises.prompt: Which fits 我想___你唱一首歌？
Which fits 他___学外语很有兴趣？
What does 就 mean in 我一下课就给你打电话？
What does 就 mean in 还有半个小时飞机就起飞了？
What does 就 mean in 他就是你要找的人？
What does 就 mean in 我弟弟不是玩手机就是看电脑？
Which fits 你喜欢我___我的钱？
exercises.explanation: 还是 in a question: or.

exercises.prompt: Which fits 用手机___电脑都可以上网？
What does 怎么才能减肥？ mean?
Which complement fits 各种装备都可以在滑雪场租___？
Which complement fits 我想换___靠窗户的？
What is wrong with 大的河 in the picture description?
options: The 的 is unnecessary: 大河
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives go straight before the noun.

exercises.prompt: What does 在语法上 mean in 我在语法上还有很多问题?
exercises.explanation: (在) noun + 上 = in the aspect of.

exercises.prompt: 王老师___才还在这儿，现在去哪儿了？
我吃过生鱼片，可是从来没吃过生蘑菇，也从来不知道那么多菜都可以生___。

units.title: 第十八课 Unit 3 review: skills integration and using Chinese in context

lessons.title: 446. Lesson 18 (Unit 3 review): skills integration review, the airport dialogs
lessons.subtitle: 办理登机手续 · 托运行李 · 快速通道 · 刷脸安检

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading): check-in
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog once and answer: 1. Where does the dialog take place? What is the second speaker doing there? 2. What is the urgency for the second speaker? 3. What trouble is the second speaker having? B. Listen again and answer the detailed questions: 1. Where does the second speaker want to go? 2. What does the first speaker check with the second speaker about? 3. What kind of seat would the second speaker prefer? 4. Provide two details of the second speaker’s flight. 5. What’s the solution for the second speaker’s luggage? 6. Where can the second speaker board the flight? C. Read the script together; share how you usually check in at airports. (Audio and two photographs, not included; the script is below.) My answers from the script: at an airport check-in counter, the passenger is checking in; her plane takes off in about an hour; she has two bags to check but baggage check has closed; she wants Shanghai; the agent asks about the seat; she prefers a window seat; flight 322, seat 42A, boarding at four p.m. from Gate 15; one big bag is checked this one time and she carries the small one.

examples.text: 机场地勤：小姐，下午好！请问您要办理登机手续吗？
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín xiǎo jiě xià wǔ hǎo qǐng wèn nín yào bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù ma — Miss, good afternoon! Do you want to check in?

examples.text: 乘客：你好。对，我要办理登机手续。我的飞机好像还有一个小时就要起飞了。可不可以请你办快点儿？
examples.translation: chéng kè nǐ hǎo duì wǒ yào bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù wǒ de fēi jī hǎo xiàng hái yǒu yí gè xiǎo shí jiù yào qǐ fēi le kě bù kě yǐ qǐng nǐ bàn kuài diǎnr — Hello. Yes, I want to check in. My plane seems to take off in an hour. Could you please be quick?

examples.text: 机场地勤：我试试。请问您要飞往哪里呢？
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín wǒ shì shì qǐng wèn nín yào fēi wǎng nǎ lǐ ne — I’ll try. Where are you flying to?

examples.text: 乘客：飞往上海。
examples.translation: chéng kè fēi wǎng shàng hǎi — To Shanghai.

examples.text: 机场地勤：请出示您的电子机票和护照。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín qǐng chū shì nín de diàn zi jī piào hé hù zhào — Please show your e-ticket and passport.

examples.text: 乘客：好的，这是我的电子机票，在手机上。这是我的护照。
examples.translation: chéng kè hǎo de zhè shì wǒ de diàn zi jī piào zài shǒu jī shàng zhè shì wǒ de hù zhào — OK, this is my e-ticket, on my phone. This is my passport.

examples.text: 机场地勤：好，我看一下。请问您要靠窗户的座位还是靠过道的座位？
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín hǎo wǒ kàn yí xià qǐng wèn nín yào kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi hái shì kào guò dào de zuò wèi — OK, let me look. Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?

examples.text: 乘客：我喜欢靠窗户的座位，可以看到外面的景色。
examples.translation: chéng kè wǒ xǐ huān kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi kě yǐ kàn dào wài miàn de jǐng sè — I like a window seat so I can see the view outside.

examples.text: 机场地勤：好的。您是飞往上海的三二二号航班。座位号是四十二Ａ。这是您的登机牌。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín hǎo de nín shì fēi wǎng shàng hǎi de sān èr èr hào háng bān zuò wèi hào shì sì shí èr zhè shì nín de dēng jī pái — OK. You are on flight 322 to Shanghai. Your seat number is 42A. Here is your boarding pass. (the book writes 322 and 42A in digits and letters)

examples.text: 乘客：请问几点登机呢？
examples.translation: chéng kè qǐng wèn jǐ diǎn dēng jī ne — What time is boarding?

examples.text: 机场地勤：登机的时间为下午四点。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín dēng jī de shí jiān wèi xià wǔ sì diǎn — Boarding is at four p.m.

examples.text: 乘客：太好了。对了，我还有两件行李需要托运。
examples.translation: chéng kè tài hǎo le duì le wǒ hái yǒu liǎng jiàn xíng li xū yào tuō yùn — Great. Oh, I also have two pieces of luggage to check.

examples.text: 机场地勤：对不起小姐。我们的行李托运服务在登机前一小时关闭。现在不能办理托运。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín duì bù qǐ xiǎo jiě wǒ men de xíng li tuō yùn fú wù zài dēng jī qián yì xiǎo shí guān bì xiàn zài bù néng bàn lǐ tuō yùn — Sorry, miss. Our baggage check service closes an hour before boarding. We can’t check luggage now.

examples.text: 乘客：哎呀，那我怎么办啊！我能带上飞机吗？
examples.translation: chéng kè āi yā nà wǒ zěn me bàn a wǒ néng dài shàng fēi jī ma — Oh no, what do I do! Can I take it on the plane?

examples.text: 机场地勤：不行。上飞机只能带一件随身行李。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín bù xíng shàng fēi jī zhǐ néng dài yí jiàn suí shēn xíng li — No. You can only bring one carry-on piece on the plane.

examples.text: 乘客：那，这件小的我随身带。这件大的请您帮我办一下托运。我真地没有很多时间了。
examples.translation: chéng kè nà zhè jiàn xiǎo de wǒ suí shēn dài zhè jiàn dà de qǐng nín bāng wǒ bàn yí xià tuō yùn wǒ zhēn de méi yǒu hěn duō shí jiān le — Then I’ll carry this small one with me. Please check this big one for me. I really don’t have much time. (the book writes 真地)

examples.text: 机场地勤：好吧。就这一次。下次您一定要早来机场。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín hǎo ba jiù zhè yí cì xià cì nín yí dìng yào zǎo lái jī chǎng — All right. Just this once. Next time you must come to the airport early.

examples.text: 乘客：好的好的，我一定早来。请问，我需要从几号登机口登机呢？
examples.translation: chéng kè hǎo de hǎo de wǒ yí dìng zǎo lái qǐng wèn wǒ xū yào cóng jǐ hào dēng jī kǒu dēng jī ne — Yes, yes, I will definitely come early. Which gate do I board from?

examples.text: 机场地勤：您的航班从十五号登机口起飞。
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín nín de háng bān cóng shí wǔ hào dēng jī kǒu qǐ fēi — Your flight departs from Gate 15.

examples.text: 乘客：谢谢！
examples.translation: chéng kè xiè xiè — Thank you!

examples.text: 机场地勤：祝您旅途愉快！
examples.translation: jī chǎng dì qín zhù nín lǚ tú yú kuài — Have a pleasant trip!

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading): security
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. What is the dialog about? 2. What new service was the second speaker able to use? List three details about the service. B. Draw a diagram in your notebook according to the first speaker’s instructions at the end of the dialog. C. Share your answers with a classmate. D. Read the script and compare your information. (Audio, not included; the script is below.) My answers: the dialog is about getting through airport security; the new service is the face-scan fast lane: you stand while the machine scans your face, you need not show a passport or boarding pass, and you need not open your luggage. The route to Gate 15: turn right, walk fifty meters past shops and restaurants, take the elevator down beside the coffee shop, and Gate 15 is the fifth gate on the left.

examples.text: 机场安检：小姐，你得到后面去排队等候安检。你看，大家都在排队。
examples.translation: jī chǎng ān jiǎn xiǎo jiě nǐ děi dào hòu miàn qù pái duì děng hòu ān jiǎn nǐ kàn dà jiā dōu zài pái duì — Miss, you have to go to the back and line up for security. See, everyone is in line.

examples.text: 乘客：对不起啊，我的航班还有四十分钟就要起飞了。我可不可以先安检啊？
examples.translation: chéng kè duì bù qǐ a wǒ de háng bān hái yǒu sì shí fēn zhōng jiù yào qǐ fēi le wǒ kě bù kě yǐ xiān ān jiǎn a — Sorry, my flight takes off in forty minutes. Can I go through security first?

examples.text: 机场安检：这样啊，你跟我来。你得走快速通道。这边就是。
examples.translation: jī chǎng ān jiǎn zhè yàng a nǐ gēn wǒ lái nǐ děi zǒu kuài sù tōng dào zhè biān jiù shì — I see; come with me. You have to take the fast lane. It’s over here.

examples.text: 乘客：太感谢你啦。
examples.translation: chéng kè tài gǎn xiè nǐ la — Thank you so much.

examples.text: 机场安检：在这个快速通道，你只要让我们的机器扫一下你的脸，机器识别后，你就可以通过安检。这是我们机场最新的“刷脸”安检服务。
examples.translation: jī chǎng ān jiǎn zài zhè ge kuài sù tōng dào nǐ zhǐ yào ràng wǒ men de jī qì sǎo yí xià nǐ de liǎn jī qì shí bié hòu nǐ jiù kě yǐ tōng guò ān jiǎn zhè shì wǒ men jī chǎng zuì xīn de shuā liǎn ān jiǎn fú wù — In this fast lane, you only have to let our machine scan your face, and after the machine recognizes you, you can pass security. This is our airport’s newest “face-scan” security service.

examples.text: 乘客：真是太方便了。我就站在这儿让机器刷脸吗？
examples.translation: chéng kè zhēn shì tài fāng biàn le wǒ jiù zhàn zài zhèr ràng jī qì shuā liǎn ma — That’s really convenient. Do I just stand here and let the machine scan my face?

examples.text: 机场安检：对，已经通过了。你可以往前走了。
examples.translation: jī chǎng ān jiǎn duì yǐ jīng tōng guò le nǐ kě yǐ wǎng qián zǒu le — Yes, you’ve already passed. You can go ahead.

examples.text: 机场安检：不需要。同时，快速通道也不需要你打开行李检查。
examples.translation: jī chǎng ān jiǎn bù xū yào tóng shí kuài sù tōng dào yě bù xū yào nǐ dǎ kāi xíng li jiǎn chá — No need. At the same time, the fast lane doesn’t need you to open your luggage for inspection either.

examples.text: 乘客：这是我第一次走快速通道和使用刷脸安检。太快了。对了，请问十五号登机口怎么走？
examples.translation: chéng kè zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zǒu kuài sù tōng dào hé shǐ yòng shuā liǎn ān jiǎn tài kuài le duì le qǐng wèn shí wǔ hào dēng jī kǒu zěn me zǒu — This is my first time using the fast lane and the face-scan security. So fast. By the way, how do I get to Gate 15?

examples.text: 机场安检：从这儿往右拐，往前走五十米，你会看到很多商店、小卖部和饭馆。在星巴克咖啡馆的旁边，有一个下楼的电梯。从电梯出去，就是十到二十号登机口的候机室。左边的第五个登机口就是十五号登机口。

Next to the Starbucks coffee shop there is an elevator down. Going out from the elevator is the waiting hall for Gates 10 to 20. The fifth gate on the left is Gate 15.

examples.text: 乘客：谢谢，谢谢！今天如果没有你的帮助，我可能坐不上我的飞机了。
examples.translation: chéng kè xiè xiè xiè xiè jīn tiān rú guǒ méi yǒu nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ kě néng zuò bú shàng wǒ de fēi jī le — Thank you, thank you! Without your help today I might not have been able to get on my plane.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking and Reading): the travel video
explanations.body: Form groups of three. Watch a video online and complete the tasks. A. Watch the first segment (0:00–2:06) and the last segment (6:46–end) together or individually and answer: 1. What is the video about? 2. What different topics does the speaker describe in the video? List all the topics. 3. What is the last segment about? What does the speaker suggest travelers do, and why? B. Share your answers with your group members. C. Individually, each student watches a different segment (Student A 2:06–2:53; Student B 2:53–4:46; Student C 4:46–6:46) and completes a table with 景点, 活动, 餐饮, 买票 and 其它. D. Share your information with your partners and take notes. E. Together, complete the 旅行计划 (a table with 目的地, 为什么去那儿, 景点&活动 for 第一天, 第二天 and 第三天, and then 买票, 餐饮, 交通 and 住宿). F. Share your completed travel plan with the class. Do you think this is a good travel plan? (The video and its link are not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Speaking and Reading): a visit to a friend
explanations.body: A. Use the images to predict what you will hear in the dialog. B. Listen to the dialog and select the correct answers: 1. What kinds of gifts did Mr. Zhou and Mrs. Zhou bring for their friend? (Flowers / A painting / Tea) 2. What kind of food did Li Ming and his wife like? (Cantonese / Sichuan / Shanghai food) 3. Which of the following is FALSE about Li Ming’s neighborhood? (It’s not only beautiful, but also very convenient. / It’s close to restaurants, supermarkets, a gas station and the ocean. / It’s a bit far from his friend’s house.) 4. What did Li Ming do to his new house? (Added a reading room. / Bought some furniture. / Replaced the carpet on the first floor with wooden flooring.) 5. What does Mrs. Li prefer? (To chat with friends in the living room. / To cook alone in the kitchen. / To show her friends around the house.) C. Pair up and share your answers. D. Read the script and check your information with the class. E. With your partner, share a gathering you recently attended. (This is a listening activity; the audio and the script are not in the book’s text, so there is no key.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking): supplementary words
explanations.body: A. Before listening, work with a classmate to guess the meaning of these words, then look them up and write them in pinyin with tone marks and their English meanings: 补充词汇 宅男, 白马王子, 睡袋. B. In groups of three, listen to three speakers talk about their casual or sports activities; each student listens to one speaker and writes a summary. C. After listening, exchange information and match each speaker to one of three images. D. Read the scripts and check. E. Compare all the stories and tell each other whose story you liked the most. (Audio and pictures, not included.) My look-ups: 宅男 zhái nán, “homebody guy; a man who stays home”; 白马王子 báimǎ wángzǐ, “Prince Charming; a girl’s dream partner”; 睡袋 shuìdài, “sleeping bag”.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): arriving in Shanghai
explanations.body: Read the procedures for foreign travelers arriving at Shanghai Pudong International Airport and complete the tasks. A. After you arrive, you see six signs (pictures, not included). Pair up and discuss what each sign means and what you should do at each step. B. Each partner reads three steps and summarizes the main points of each step in Chinese characters or pinyin in the table: 上海浦东机场入关流程 (一): 1. 航班到达, 2. 检验检疫, 3. 边防检查; (二): 4. 提取行李, 5. 海关检查, 6. 离开机场. C. Exchange information with your partner. D. Share your answers with the class. My summary of the six steps:

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): 畅游旧金山
explanations.body: Read the following post from a Chinese blogger and complete the tasks. A. Read the title of the blog post and predict what you will read about; in Chinese, share your prediction with a classmate. B. Work in groups of three. Each group member reads two paragraphs and takes notes of the blogger’s itinerary in the table, using Chinese characters or pinyin (段落, 时间, 景点, 活动 for Paragraphs 1–6). C. Ask for information from your partners to complete the itinerary. D. Post your complete itinerary online and share with the class. The post (the book credits it as adapted from a travel website, and prints “改遍”) in six paragraphs; the blank table is filled in by me below.

rows: 吃海鲜，看海狮，逛街头的商店
拍照，沿着桥边走，在海风中散步一个小时
吃广式点心，喝广东早茶
看花和不同的房子，拍照
有名的酒吧，市内观光车
喝酒，看别的名胜古迹和街道
tables.title: 畅游旧金山日程表 (my itinerary; the book leaves the table blank)

examples.text: 说到这次到美国的旅行，我们旅行的第一站是旧金山。当天到达旧金山的时候是早上的九点半，我们没有休息，就直接去了第一个目的地——渔人码头。
examples.translation: shuō dào zhè cì dào měi guó de lǚ xíng wǒ men lǚ xíng de dì yī zhàn shì jiù jīn shān dàng tiān dào dá jiù jīn shān de shí hòu shì zǎo shàng de jiǔ diǎn bàn wǒ men méi yǒu xiū xī jiù zhí jiē qù le dì yī gè mù dì dì yú rén mǎ tóu — 1. Speaking of this trip to America, the first stop of our trip was San Francisco. We arrived in San Francisco at nine-thirty in the morning that day, and without resting we went straight to the first destination, Fisherman’s Wharf.

examples.text: 旧金山的渔人码头离市区很近，交通非常方便，也是每个去旧金山的游客一定会去的地方，而且那儿的海鲜真的很好吃！我们吃饭的餐馆在码头上，从窗户就可以看到著名的金门大桥，而且还可以看到附近成群的海狮。这是我第一次看到海狮，它们懒洋洋地晒着太阳，显得非常舒服，只是不知道它们喜不喜欢被人看的感觉。渔人码头这边的街头还有很多商店，可以逛逛。
examples.translation: jiù jīn shān de yú rén mǎ tóu lí shì qū hěn jìn jiāo tōng fēi cháng fāng biàn yě shì měi gè qù jiù jīn shān de yóu kè yí dìng huì qù de dì fāng ér qiě nàr de hǎi xiān zhēn de hěn hǎo chī wǒ men chī fàn de cān guǎn zài mǎ tóu shàng cóng chuāng hù jiù kě yǐ kàn dào zhù míng de jīn mén dà qiáo ér qiě hái kě yǐ kàn dào fù jìn chéng qún de hǎi shī zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì kàn dào hǎi shī tā men lǎn yáng yáng de shài zhe tài yáng xiǎn de fēi cháng shū fú zhǐ shì bù zhī dào tā men xǐ bù xǐ huān bèi rén kàn de gǎn jué yú rén mǎ tóu zhè biān de jiē tóu hái yǒu hěn duō shāng diàn kě yǐ guàng guàng — 2. Fisherman’s Wharf in San Francisco is very close to downtown and transportation is very convenient; it is a place every tourist to San Francisco is sure to go, and the seafood there is really delicious! The restaurant where we ate was on the pier, and from the window you could see the famous Golden Gate Bridge and also the herds of sea lions nearby. It was my first time seeing sea lions; they lazily bask in the sun and look very comfortable, but I don’t know whether they like being looked at. On the streets by the Wharf there are also many shops to browse.

examples.text: 然后我们去看了金门大桥，这座大桥已经成了美国一个著名的景点。在桥上有很多可以拍照的地方，我们在桥上看到的景色非常美。沿着桥边往下走，可以看到大桥、沙滩和海水。我们还在海风中散了一个小时的步。
examples.translation: rán hòu wǒ men qù kàn le jīn mén dà qiáo zhè zuò dà qiáo yǐ jīng chéng le měi guó yí gè zhù míng de jǐng diǎn zài qiáo shàng yǒu hěn duō kě yǐ pāi zhào de dì fāng wǒ men zài qiáo shàng kàn dào de jǐng sè fēi cháng měi yán zhe qiáo biān wǎng xià zǒu kě yǐ kàn dào dà qiáo shā tān hé hǎi shuǐ wǒ men hái zài hǎi fēng zhōng sàn le yí gè xiǎo shí de bù — 3. Then we went to see the Golden Gate Bridge, which has become a famous American sight. There are many photo spots on the bridge and the scenery we saw from it was very beautiful. Walking down along the side of the bridge, you can see the bridge, the beach and the sea. We also strolled for an hour in the sea breeze.

examples.text: 第二天，我们去了旧金山的唐人街，也就是中国城。旧金山的唐人街是美国西部最大的，和纽约的唐人街差不多，街头都是汉字，两边有很多的中国饭馆、商店、书店和茶店什么的。唐人街有不少地道的中餐，我们选了一家最老的广东饭馆，吃了广式点心、喝了广东早茶。
examples.translation: dì èr tiān wǒ men qù le jiù jīn shān de táng rén jiē yě jiù shì zhōng guó chéng jiù jīn shān de táng rén jiē shì měi guó xī bù zuì dà de hé niǔ yuē de táng rén jiē chà bu duō jiē tóu dōu shì hàn zì liǎng biān yǒu hěn duō de zhōng guó fàn guǎn shāng diàn shū diàn hé chá diàn shén me de táng rén jiē yǒu bù shǎo dì dào de zhōng cān wǒ men xuǎn le yì jiā zuì lǎo de guǎng dōng fàn guǎn chī le guǎng shì diǎn xīn hē le guǎng dōng zǎo chá — 4. On the second day we went to San Francisco’s Chinatown. San Francisco’s Chinatown is the largest in the western U.S. and similar to New York’s; the streets are full of Chinese characters, and on both sides are many Chinese restaurants, shops, bookstores, tea shops and so on. Chinatown has quite a lot of authentic Chinese food; we chose the oldest Cantonese restaurant and had Cantonese dim sum and Cantonese morning tea.

examples.text: 后来，我们又去了比较有名的九曲花街，我在网上看到过很多这条街的照片，所以就对这条街非常感兴趣。九曲花街，就是一条有很多花的街，景色很特别。两边的房屋有公寓、有单栋楼，每个房子都有自己的特色，高度、颜色和大门都不同。
examples.translation: hòu lái wǒ men yòu qù le bǐ jiào yǒu míng de jiǔ qū huā jiē wǒ zài wǎng shàng kàn dào guò hěn duō zhè tiáo jiē de zhào piān suǒ yǐ jiù duì zhè tiáo jiē fēi cháng gǎn xìng qù jiǔ qū huā jiē jiù shì yì tiáo yǒu hěn duō huā de jiē jǐng sè hěn tè bié liǎng biān de fáng wū yǒu gōng yù yǒu dān dòng lóu měi gè fáng zi dōu yǒu zì jǐ de tè sè gāo dù yán sè hé dà mén dōu bù tóng — 5. Later we went to the rather famous Lombard Street (“Nine-Bend Flower Street”). I had seen many photos of this street online, so I was very interested in it. It is a street with a lot of flowers and special scenery. The houses on both sides include apartments and single buildings; each has its own character, with different heights, colors and doors.

examples.text: 下次要是再去旧金山，我们打算去一些有名的酒吧喝喝酒或是坐市内观光车看看别的名胜古迹和街道。
examples.translation: xià cì yào shì zài qù jiù jīn shān wǒ men dǎ suàn qù yì xiē yǒu míng de jiǔ bā hē hē jiǔ huò shì zuò shì nèi guān guāng chē kàn kàn bié de míng shèng gǔ jì hé jiē dào — 6. Next time we go to San Francisco, we plan to go to some famous bars for a drink or take a city sightseeing bus to see other sights and streets.

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): the DLI teacher’s journal
explanations.body: Read the following journal of a teacher at the Defense Language Institute and complete the tasks. A. Make a list of things you often bring to social gatherings (我常常带去派对或聚会的东西), then pair up and share it. B. Each partner reads two paragraphs of the passage and writes a summary of that part. C. Exchange the information and together mark each of the statements True or False (my key follows the passage). D. Share your answers with the class.

examples.text: 上个周末是一个长周末，所以我们请了一些朋友到家里来聚一聚。星期六那天是个阳光灿烂、风和日丽的日子，气温大约七十华氏度，不冷不热，非常适合聚会。我们大概请了十几个朋友，他们有的带来了自己的孩子，有的带来了男朋友或女朋友，甚至有的还把爸妈也带来了，一下子我们家后院到处都是人，热闹极了。
examples.translation: shàng gè zhōu mò shì yí gè cháng zhōu mò suǒ yǐ wǒ men qǐng le yì xiē péng yǒu dào jiā lǐ lái jù yí jù xīng qī liù nà tiān shì gè yáng guāng càn làn fēng hé rì lì de rì zi qì wēn dà yuē qī shí huá shì dù bù lěng bú rè fēi cháng shì hé jù huì wǒ men dà gài qǐng le shí jǐ gè péng yǒu tā men yǒu de dài lái le zì jǐ de hái zi yǒu de dài lái le nán péng yǒu huò nǚ péng yǒu shèn zhì yǒu de hái bǎ bà mā yě dài lái le yí xià zi wǒ men jiā hòu yuàn dào chù dōu shì rén rè nào jí le — 1. Last weekend was a long weekend, so we invited some friends to our home to get together. Saturday was a sunny, bright and pleasant day, with a temperature of about seventy degrees Fahrenheit, neither cold nor hot, perfect for a party. We invited about a dozen or so friends; some brought their own children, some brought boyfriends or girlfriends, and some even brought their parents too, so all at once our backyard was full of people everywhere, extremely lively.

examples.text: 我和太太准备了餐具、桌子、椅子和一些饮料、果汁和冰块。在客人们到以前，我已经把烧烤的东西准备好了，烤羊肉和烤鸡腿、鸡翅是我的拿手菜。我太太还亲自做了一个苹果派作为大家的甜点。
examples.translation: wǒ hé tài tài zhǔn bèi le cān jù zhuō zi yǐ zi hé yì xiē yǐn liào guǒ zhī hé bīng kuài zài kè rén men dào yǐ qián wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ shāo kǎo de dōng xī zhǔn bèi hǎo le kǎo yáng ròu hé kǎo jī tuǐ jī chì shì wǒ de ná shǒu cài wǒ tài tài hái qīn zì zuò le yí gè píng guǒ pài zuò wéi dà jiā de tián diǎn — 2. My wife and I prepared tableware, tables, chairs and some drinks, juice and ice cubes. Before the guests arrived I had already gotten the barbecue things ready; grilled lamb, grilled chicken legs and wings are my specialties. My wife also personally made an apple pie as everyone’s dessert.

examples.text: 马克和他的女朋友带来了一些啤酒和热狗。张林和他的爸妈准备了很多中式的食品：烧牛肉、鸡蛋饼和饺子。我太太的同学安娜买了两大盒水果，有草莓、菠萝、西瓜等等，另外她还做了一个意大利面。
examples.translation: mǎ kè hé tā de nǚ péng yǒu dài lái le yì xiē pí jiǔ hé rè gǒu zhāng lín hé tā de bà mā zhǔn bèi le hěn duō zhōng shì de shí pǐn shāo niú ròu jī dàn bǐng hé jiǎo zi wǒ tài tài de tóng xué ān nà mǎi le liǎng dà hé shuǐ guǒ yǒu cǎo méi bō luó xī guā děng děng lìng wài tā hái zuò le yí gè yì dà lì miàn — 3. Mark and his girlfriend brought some beer and hot dogs. Zhang Lin and his parents prepared lots of Chinese food: braised beef, egg pancakes and dumplings. My wife’s classmate Anna bought two big boxes of fruit, including strawberries, pineapple, watermelon and so on, and she also made a pasta dish.

examples.text: 大家都到了以后，我们把所有的饭菜、酒、饮料、水果、餐具等摆到了桌子上，然后大家就开始一边吃、一边喝、一边聊天。在大家吃着的时候，我还忙着我的烧烤，因为我想给大家吃热的烤肉。孩子们很快就吃好了，然后他们就在院子里的草地上跑来跑去地玩。我们大人们则围坐在桌边，开心地喝酒聊天。大家一直玩到下午五点才回家。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu dào le yǐ hòu wǒ men bǎ suǒ yǒu de fàn cài jiǔ yǐn liào shuǐ guǒ cān jù děng bǎi dào le zhuō zi shàng rán hòu dà jiā jiù kāi shǐ yì biān chī yì biān hē yì biān liáo tiān zài dà jiā chī zhe de shí hòu wǒ hái máng zhe wǒ de shāo kǎo yīn wèi wǒ xiǎng gěi dà jiā chī rè de kǎo ròu hái zi men hěn kuài jiù chī hǎo le rán hòu tā men jiù zài yuàn zi lǐ de cǎo dì shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù de wán wǒ men dà rén men zé wéi zuò zài zhuō biān kāi xīn de hē jiǔ liáo tiān dà jiā yì zhí wán dào xià wǔ wǔ diǎn cái huí jiā — 4. After everyone had arrived, we set all the dishes, wine, drinks, fruit and tableware on the table, and then everyone began eating, drinking and chatting. While everyone was eating I was still busy with my barbecue because I wanted everyone to eat hot grilled meat. The children finished eating quickly, then ran around playing on the grass in the yard. We adults sat around the table drinking and chatting happily. Everyone played until five in the afternoon before going home. (The book writes 70 as digits.)

examples.text: 作者邀请朋友们到他家参加一个生日聚会。
examples.translation: zuò zhě yāo qǐng péng yǒu men dào tā jiā cān jiā yí gè shēng rì jù huì — 1. The author invited friends to a birthday party at his home. — False (it was a get-together over the long weekend; key mine)

examples.text: 那天的天气晴朗，不冷不热。
examples.translation: nà tiān de tiān qì qíng lǎng bù lěng bú rè — 2. The weather that day was clear, neither cold nor hot. — True

examples.text: 参加聚会的都是作者和他太太的朋友。
examples.translation: cān jiā jù huì de dōu shì zuò zhě hé tā tài tài de péng yǒu — 3. Everyone at the party was a friend of the author and his wife. — False (some brought their children and even parents)

examples.text: 作者最喜欢烤牛肉、羊肉和鸡肉，都是他的拿手菜。
examples.translation: zuò zhě zuì xǐ huān kǎo niú ròu yáng ròu hé jī ròu dōu shì tā de ná shǒu cài — 4. The author likes grilling beef, lamb and chicken, all his specialties. — False (his specialties are lamb, chicken legs and wings; no beef)

examples.text: 聚会上，安娜带来了水果和甜点，还有意大利面。
examples.translation: jù huì shàng ān nà dài lái le shuǐ guǒ hé tián diǎn hái yǒu yì dà lì miàn — 5. At the party Anna brought fruit and dessert, and also pasta. — False (the dessert, an apple pie, was made by the author’s wife)

examples.text: 聚会开始以后，作者和大家一起围着桌子坐下来，边吃边聊。
examples.translation: jù huì kāi shǐ yǐ hòu zuò zhě hé dà jiā yì qǐ wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò xià lái biān chī biān liáo — 6. After the party started, the author sat around the table with everyone eating and chatting. — False (he was busy with the barbecue)

examples.text: 孩子们很饿，他们跟大人们吃得时间一样长。
examples.translation: hái zi men hěn è tā men gēn dà rén men chī de shí jiān yí yàng cháng — 7. The children were hungry and ate for as long as the adults. — False (they finished quickly)

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): two families
explanations.body: Read the passages about two families and complete the tasks. A. Pair up; one partner reads Passage 1 and the other reads Passage 2; take notes in the table below each passage (家人的休闲娱乐: 爸爸, 妈妈, 我 for Passage 1; 爸爸, 妈妈, 哥哥, 我 for Passage 2). B. Exchange information with your partner and complete the table for that passage. C. Compare the two families with your own and find any differences or similarities. The two passages (the tables are filled in by me):

rows: 看电视，更爱看书，下棋，打牌
橄榄球迷，打橄榄球，看球赛，去现场看球
做饭，看肥皂剧，用微信聊天，散步
去海边散步或跑步，带狗散步，种花种草
摇滚迷，有乐队，练习，表演，收集海报
看电影，打游戏，打篮球，看职业篮球比赛
tables.title: Activity 9: what each family member does for fun (the book leaves the tables blank)

examples.text: 我们家是一个非常中式的家庭，只有三口人，我爸爸、妈妈和我。我爸妈都是爱静不爱动的人，他们喜欢呆在家里，做他们喜欢的事情。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiā shì yí gè fēi cháng zhōng shì de jiā tíng zhǐ yǒu sān kǒu rén wǒ bà bà mā mā hé wǒ wǒ bà mā dōu shì ài jìng bú ài dòng de rén tā men xǐ huān dāi zài jiā lǐ zuò tā men xǐ huān de shì qíng — Passage 1. Our family is a very Chinese-style family, with only three people: my dad, my mom and me. My parents both love quiet rather than activity; they like to stay at home and do the things they like.

examples.text: 我妈妈是个家庭主妇，所以她特别喜欢做饭，而且她做的饭也特别好吃。另外，她也喜欢看电视。肥皂剧，她可以一部接一部地看，她不但晚上看，白天有空的时候也看。有时候，甚至还让我陪着她一起看。最近呢，她迷上了用微信跟她的朋友们聊天，视频聊天、语音聊天什么的，她都会。
examples.translation: wǒ mā mā shì gè jiā tíng zhǔ fù suǒ yǐ tā tè bié xǐ huān zuò fàn ér qiě tā zuò de fàn yě tè bié hǎo chī lìng wài tā yě xǐ huān kàn diàn shì féi zào jù tā kě yǐ yí bù jiē yí bù de kàn tā bú dàn wǎn shàng kàn bái tiān yǒu kòng de shí hòu yě kàn yǒu shí hòu shèn zhì hái ràng wǒ péi zhe tā yì qǐ kàn zuì jìn ne tā mí shàng le yòng wēi xìn gēn tā de péng yǒu men liáo tiān shì pín liáo tiān yǔ yīn liáo tiān shén me de tā dōu huì — My mom is a housewife, so she especially likes cooking, and what she cooks is especially delicious. She also likes watching TV. Soap operas she can watch one after another, not only in the evening but also in the daytime when she has time. Sometimes she even makes me watch with her. Recently she has gotten into chatting with her friends on WeChat; video chat, voice chat and so on, she can do all of it.

examples.text: 我爸呢，虽然他也喜欢看电视，但是他更爱看书。在他的书房里有很多书，国内的、国外的都有。因为我爸是医生，所以他也看很多医学的书。除了看书以外，我爸也喜欢在周末的时候跟邻居们或老朋友们一起下下棋，打打牌。我妈害怕我爸出去打牌，因为他打牌可以打两三个小时，甚至忘了回家。可我爸说打牌是他难得的放松的机会。
examples.translation: wǒ bà ne suī rán tā yě xǐ huān kàn diàn shì dàn shì tā gèng ài kàn shū zài tā de shū fáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō shū guó nèi de guó wài de dōu yǒu yīn wèi wǒ bà shì yī shēng suǒ yǐ tā yě kàn hěn duō yī xué de shū chú le kàn shū yǐ wài wǒ bà yě xǐ huān zài zhōu mò de shí hòu gēn lín jū men huò lǎo péng yǒu men yì qǐ xià xià qí dǎ dǎ pái wǒ mā hài pà wǒ bà chū qù dǎ pái yīn wèi tā dǎ pái kě yǐ dǎ liǎng sān gè xiǎo shí shèn zhì wàng le huí jiā kě wǒ bà shuō dǎ pái shì tā nán dé de fàng sōng de jī huì — My dad, although he also likes TV, loves reading even more. In his study there are many books, both domestic and foreign. Because my dad is a doctor he also reads many medical books. Besides reading, my dad also likes to play chess and cards with neighbors or old friends on weekends. My mom worries about his going out to play cards, because he can play for two or three hours and even forget to come home. But my dad says playing cards is his rare chance to relax.

examples.text: 对我爸妈来说，他们仅有的运动就是散步。我们小区的对面就是一个大公园，他们喜欢早上或是晚饭后去公园里一边散步一边聊天，有时候也看看广场上的大妈们跳广场舞。
examples.translation: duì wǒ bà mā lái shuō tā men jǐn yǒu de yùn dòng jiù shì sàn bù wǒ men xiǎo qū de duì miàn jiù shì yí gè dà gōng yuán tā men xǐ huān zǎo shàng huò shì wǎn fàn hòu qù gōng yuán lǐ yì biān sàn bù yì biān liáo tiān yǒu shí hòu yě kàn kàn guǎng chǎng shàng de dà mā men tiào guǎng chǎng wǔ — For my parents, their only exercise is walking. Across from our neighborhood is a big park, and they like to go to the park in the morning or after dinner to walk and chat, and sometimes watch the aunties on the square dance.

examples.text: 我自己喜欢看电影，常常跟我的同学或朋友们一起去电影院看电影。我们不是看恐怖片，就是看动作片，有时候也看看搞笑片。还有，我也喜欢打游戏。我不但跟同学一起打游戏，而且也在网上跟网友一起打游戏。别的空闲时间，我会去体育馆或学校的操场打打篮球，我也喜欢看美国的职业篮球比赛。
examples.translation: wǒ zì jǐ xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng cháng cháng gēn wǒ de tóng xué huò péng yǒu men yì qǐ qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng wǒ men bú shì kàn kǒng bù piàn jiù shì kàn dòng zuò piàn yǒu shí hòu yě kàn kàn gǎo xiào piàn hái yǒu wǒ yě xǐ huān dǎ yóu xì wǒ bú dàn gēn tóng xué yì qǐ dǎ yóu xì ér qiě yě zài wǎng shàng gēn wǎng yǒu yì qǐ dǎ yóu xì bié de kòng xián shí jiān wǒ huì qù tǐ yù guǎn huò xué xiào de cāo chǎng dǎ dǎ lán qiú wǒ yě xǐ huān kàn měi guó de zhí yè lán qiú bǐ sài — I like watching movies myself and often go to the cinema with classmates or friends. We watch either horror movies or action movies, and sometimes comedies. Also I like playing games; I play not only with classmates but also online with online friends. In other free time I go to the gym or the school’s playground to play basketball, and I also like watching American professional basketball games.

examples.text: 我们家有四口人，在美国我们这样的家庭很多。我们家有我爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。我们家的人都喜欢玩、喜欢动。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén zài měi guó wǒ men zhè yàng de jiā tíng hěn duō wǒ men jiā yǒu wǒ bà bà mā mā gē gē hé wǒ wǒ men jiā de rén dōu xǐ huān wán xǐ huān dòng — Passage 2. Our family has four people; in America there are many families like ours. In our family there are my dad, my mom, my older brother and me. Everyone in our family likes to play and likes to be active.

examples.text: 我爸是个美式足球迷，也就是美国人说的橄榄球迷。他周末的时候不是约朋友一起去打橄榄球，就是喜欢在电视上看橄榄球比赛。有时候他也带着我们全家去现场看球赛，因为比赛现场人山人海，非常热闹。比赛的输赢对他来说没有关系，重要的是可以和那么多球迷一起看球，一起为球队加油，那就是他最开心的事。
examples.translation: wǒ bà shì gè měi shì zú qiú mí yě jiù shì měi guó rén shuō de gǎn lǎn qiú mí tā zhōu mò de shí hòu bú shì yuē péng yǒu yì qǐ qù dǎ gǎn lǎn qiú jiù shì xǐ huān zài diàn shì shàng kàn gǎn lǎn qiú bǐ sài yǒu shí hòu tā yě dài zhe wǒ men quán jiā qù xiàn chǎng kàn qiú sài yīn wèi bǐ sài xiàn chǎng rén shān rén hǎi fēi cháng rè nào bǐ sài de shū yíng duì tā lái shuō méi yǒu guān xì zhòng yào de shì kě yǐ hé nà me duō qiú mí yì qǐ kàn qiú yì qǐ wèi qiú duì jiā yóu nà jiù shì tā zuì kāi xīn de shì — My dad is an American-football fan, that is, a football fan as Americans say. On weekends he either invites friends to play football or likes to watch football games on TV. Sometimes he also takes the whole family to watch games live, because the venue is a sea of people and very lively. Winning or losing doesn’t matter to him; what matters is being able to watch with so many fans and cheer on the team together, and that is his happiest thing.

examples.text: 在我们家，我妈喜欢去海边散步或跑步。有时候她也喜欢带着我们家的狗一起去散步。只要天气好，她就会出门，因为海边的景色太美，她不想错过。要是我妈不出门，她喜欢在后院里种花、种草，我们家花园里有她种的各种各样的花，美极了。
examples.translation: zài wǒ men jiā wǒ mā xǐ huān qù hǎi biān sàn bù huò pǎo bù yǒu shí hòu tā yě xǐ huān dài zhe wǒ men jiā de gǒu yì qǐ qù sàn bù zhǐ yào tiān qì hǎo tā jiù huì chū mén yīn wèi hǎi biān de jǐng sè tài měi tā bù xiǎng cuò guò yào shì wǒ mā bù chū mén tā xǐ huān zài hòu yuàn lǐ zhòng huā zhòng cǎo wǒ men jiā huā yuán lǐ yǒu tā zhòng de gè zhǒng gè yàng de huā měi jí le — In our family, my mom likes to walk or run by the sea. Sometimes she also likes to take our dog along for a walk. As long as the weather is good she goes out, because the seaside scenery is so beautiful that she doesn’t want to miss it. If my mom doesn’t go out, she likes to plant flowers and grass in the backyard; in our garden are all kinds of flowers she planted, extremely beautiful.

examples.text: 我哥是个摇滚迷，他和他的大学同学有一个乐队，平时有空的时候，他们就一起练习、一起参加音乐会的表演。在他的房间里，他收集了很多摇滚明星的海报，墙上贴满了著名乐队的照片。不管是哪个乐队或歌手，他都知道。我很高兴，因为在家里可以常常听到我哥免费的音乐会。
examples.translation: wǒ gē shì gè yáo gǔn mí tā hé tā de dà xué tóng xué yǒu yí gè yuè duì píng shí yǒu kòng de shí hòu tā men jiù yì qǐ liàn xí yì qǐ cān jiā yīn yuè huì de biǎo yǎn zài tā de fáng jiān lǐ tā shōu jí le hěn duō yáo gǔn míng xīng de hǎi bào qiáng shàng tiē mǎn le zhù míng yuè duì de zhào piān bù guǎn shì nǎ ge yuè duì huò gē shǒu tā dōu zhī dào wǒ hěn gāo xìng yīn wèi zài jiā lǐ kě yǐ cháng cháng tīng dào wǒ gē miǎn fèi de yīn yuè huì — My brother is a rock fan; he and his college classmates have a band, and when they have free time they practice together and take part in concert performances together. In his room he has collected many posters of rock stars and the wall is covered with photos of famous bands. No matter which band or singer, he knows them. I’m very glad, because at home I can often hear my brother’s free concerts.

examples.text: 我自己呢，喜欢很多户外活动，比如：冲浪、爬山、滑雪等等。因为我在海边长大，所以从小就喜欢游泳，然后开始学冲浪。我们这个州有很多有名的国家公园，我喜欢和朋友或是家人一起去国家公园爬山。冬天的时候，我们家喜欢一起去滑雪场滑雪。

lessons.title: 450. Lesson 18 (Unit 3 review): using Chinese in context review
lessons.subtitle: 给女儿的出国建议 · 北京西安旅行计划 · 烧烤派对 · 问卷调查 · 室友聊天

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): the voice mail from your teacher
explanations.body: Scenario: You received a voice mail from your Chinese teacher in China. Her daughter is going to America to study at a high school, but she is concerned about her trip to the U.S. Your teacher asks you to write and explain the procedures for boarding a plane, the security check and passing through U.S. customs. A. Listen to the voice mail and write a summary in pinyin or characters (张老师留言的主要意思是什么？). B. Form three groups. Each group explains one procedure and writes notes in the table: 第一组 登机前需要做什么; 第二组 安检时候做什么; 第三组 入美国海关时做什么. C. After your discussion, consolidate all three groups’ work into one document and email it to your teacher (TO: 张老师; Subject:). (Audio and pictures, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): Beijing and Xi’an
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at Tianjin University. Your class plans to take a field trip to Beijing and Xi’an next month. You can only stay in Beijing for two days and Xi’an for one day. You are tasked by your teacher to make an itinerary for this trip and decide what you would like to see, given your time constraints. Divide into two groups and write up an itinerary; your teacher will select the best one. The places shown: 天安门广场, 长城, 北海公园, 西安古城, 秦始皇兵马俑, 大雁塔. A. In your group, discuss and choose your itinerary by following the considerations in the diagram: for 天津: 旅游团/自己去, 什么时候出发, 怎么去北京 (开车, 坐火车, 坐飞机); for 北京 and 西安: 时间怎么安排, 游览哪个地方, 要不要导游, 交通工具, 在哪儿吃饭, 住民宿/旅馆. B. In your group, create your itinerary and submit it to your teacher by email (TO: 老师; Subject: 旅游计划). (Photographs of 中国民宿, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the barbecue party
explanations.body: Scenario: Your class just completed Unit 3 and would like to have a party to celebrate. Your teacher suggests having a barbecue party at her house, which she recently bought because it is a big house where you can have a lot of fun. To ensure a successful party, you and your classmates must prepare for it. A. Pair up, read the email below and verbally summarize it for your partner. B. With your partner, think of what you will need for the party and fill in the table. C. Summarize your findings and write them in an email to Professor Wang (TO:; Subject:). The email (the book writes “卡拉 OK”) and my sample table:

rows: 希望王老师做什么中国菜
饺子，炒面，宫爆鸡丁，红烧肉
牛肉，羊肉，鸡翅，玉米，蔬菜

examples.text: 同学们，大家好，

examples.text: 祝贺你们完成了第三单元的学习并取得了优异的成绩。这个周末我想请同学们到我家来烧烤，放松一下。我最近刚买了一个房子，上个星期才搬进来。我家房子很大，有很多好玩的东西，比如卡拉ＯＫ机，乒乓球台等。我想请你们一起想一想烧烤需要准备什么，你们会带什么吃的，你们希望我给你们做什么中国菜，还有饭后我们做什么娱乐活动。想好了以后，请给我发一个电子邮件告诉我，我好提前做准备。
examples.translation: zhù hè nǐ men wán chéng le dì sān dān yuán de xué xí bìng qǔ dé le yōu yì de chéng jì zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qǐng tóng xué men dào wǒ jiā lái shāo kǎo fàng sōng yí xià wǒ zuì jìn gāng mǎi le yí gè fáng zi shàng gè xīng qī cái bān jìn lái wǒ jiā fáng zi hěn dà yǒu hěn duō hǎo wán de dōng xī bǐ rú kǎ lā jī pīng pāng qiú tái děng wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ men yì qǐ xiǎng yì xiǎng shāo kǎo xū yào zhǔn bèi shén me nǐ men huì dài shén me chī de nǐ men xī wàng wǒ gěi nǐ men zuò shén me zhōng guó cài hái yǒu fàn hòu wǒ men zuò shén me yú lè huó dòng xiǎng hǎo le yǐ hòu qǐng gěi wǒ fā yí gè diàn zi yóu jiàn gào sù wǒ wǒ hǎo tí qián zuò zhǔn bèi — Congratulations on completing Unit 3 and achieving excellent results. This weekend I’d like to invite you to my home for a barbecue to relax. I just bought a house recently and only moved in last week. My house is big and has lots of fun things, such as a karaoke machine, a table tennis table and so on. I’d like you to think together about what we need to prepare for the barbecue, what food you’ll bring, what Chinese dishes you’d like me to make for you, and what entertainment we’ll do after the meal. After you’ve thought it through, please email me so I can prepare in advance.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the survey
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at a university in China and work part-time in the International Students Office. The university would like to know what the international students like to do in their spare time so that they can better serve their needs. You and your classmates are asked to conduct a survey about your activities, and to analyze it and write a report to the International Students Office. A. Pair up. Ask your partner the questions in the table and note their answers. B. Each pair reports their survey results in turn by posting their responses on the wall. C. Analyze your class’s responses; write a report (问卷调查结果分析) and submit it to the International Students Office.
