lessons.title: 551. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 grammar: taking the subway and the bus
lessons.subtitle: 从/在 · 乘/坐 地铁几号线 · 坐几站 · 到/在…站下车 · 换…线 · …就到了

explanations.title: Common Expressions Used When Taking Public Transportation
explanations.body: In China, subway routes are often coded with numbers, colors, or the name of the main destination. As you can see on the Beijing subway map (not included), there are 地铁4号线, 地铁5号线, 地铁8号线, 地铁大兴线, 地铁大兴机场线 and 地铁亦庄线. The expressions for taking a bus are the same as those for the subway. Buses are usually marked with 路 instead of 线.

rows: 乘/坐 + 地铁 + 几号线
Taking a subway (乘 is more formal than 坐)
到/在 + 某站 + 下车
Getting off the subway at a certain stop
tables.title: Common expressions for taking the subway (the book writes the blanks with ～ and #; I used 某地, 几号线 and 几)

examples.text: 到对面的地铁站，乘二号线，坐四站到东直门。
examples.translation: dào duì miàn de dì tiě zhàn chéng èr hào xiàn zuò sì zhàn dào dōng zhí mén — From the dialog: Go to the subway station opposite, take Line 2, go four stops to Dongzhimen.

examples.text: 在那儿坐二号线到东直门，然后换四一八路公交车，坐到安家楼站下车。
examples.translation: zài nàr zuò èr hào xiàn dào dōng zhí mén rán hòu huàn sì yī bā lù gōng jiāo chē zuò dào ān jiā lóu zhàn xià chē — Take Line 2 there to Dongzhimen, then change to bus 418 and ride to Anjialou Station and get off. (the same expressions work for buses, which are marked with 路 instead of 线)

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8 (Speaking)
explanations.body: Activity 7: A. 马克 is at Terminal 3 at the Beijing Capital International Airport. Tell him how to get to 建国门 by subway, using the map and search results as a reference (Map A). B. 马克 wants to go to the 王府井 shopping center from 北京大学. Tell him how to get there by subway, using Map B. Activity 8: A. Use the bus routes below to find a way to get from 火车站 to 钟楼站 in Xi’an. B. Use the bus route below to find a way to get from 钟楼站 to the Terracotta Warriors Museum (兵马俑) in Xi’an. New word: 终点站 (zhōngdiǎn zhàn; last stop; terminal). (The subway maps, search results and bus-route screenshots are not included.)

explanations.body: Pair up. Listen to each audio segment (eight segments) and use the map to find the destination it describes. Mark the number of the corresponding segment on the map. Compare your work with your partner’s. The map’s labels (the picture is not included) are: 人民南路, 商场, 医院, 体育馆, 公共汽车站, 书店, 西大街, 电影院, 理发店, 停车场, 咖啡厅, 中国饭馆, 东大街, 邮局, 图书馆, 银行, 学校, with traffic lights at the crossings.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the passage and complete the tasks. A. Using what you read, draw the bus route in your notebook and circle the buses David needs to take (a Beijing bus-route map around 天安门, 西单, 东单, 建国门, 王府井, 前门大街; the map is not included). B. Using the instructions from the passerby, how should David get to the American Embassy after leaving the bus? The book prints the bus numbers 320 and 1 in digits; I spelled them out.

examples.text: 大卫：请问，从这儿到美国大使馆怎么走？
examples.translation: dà wèi qǐng wèn cóng zhèr dào měi guó dà shǐ guǎn zěn me zǒu — Excuse me, how do I get to the American Embassy from here?

examples.text: 路人：你从这儿过马路，到对面坐三二零路公交车，然后在天安门换往东开的一路公共汽车，坐五站到建国门下车。

examples.text: 大卫：在哪儿下车？我没听清楚。您能不能再说一遍？
examples.translation: dà wèi zài nǎr xià chē wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ nín néng bù néng zài shuō yí biàn — Where do I get off? I didn’t hear clearly. Could you say it once more?

examples.text: 路人：在建国门下车。下车后再走二十多分钟就到了。
examples.translation: lù rén zài jiàn guó mén xià chē xià chē hòu zài zǒu èr shí duō fēn zhōng jiù dào le — Get off at Jianguomen. After you get off, walk another twenty-odd minutes and you will be there.

examples.text: 大卫：那在建国门下了车怎么走？
examples.translation: dà wèi nà zài jiàn guó mén xià le chē zěn me zǒu — And how do I walk after getting off at Jianguomen?

examples.text: 路人：下了车，你会看到一座立交桥，你在红绿灯那儿过马路，然后沿着那条路往北走，在第二个十字路口向右拐，再一直往前走就到了。
examples.translation: lù rén xià le chē nǐ huì kàn dào yí zuò lì jiāo qiáo nǐ zài hóng lǜ dēng nàr guò mǎ lù rán hòu yán zhe nà tiáo lù wǎng běi zǒu zài dì èr gè shí zì lù kǒu xiàng yòu guǎi zài yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le — After getting off you will see an overpass. Cross the road at the traffic light, then walk north along that road, turn right at the second crossroads, and keep going straight ahead; you’ll be there.

examples.text: 大卫：大使馆在路的左边还是右边？
examples.translation: dà wèi dà shǐ guǎn zài lù de zuǒ biān hái shì yòu biān — Is the embassy on the left or the right side of the road?

examples.text: 路人：我不太清楚，不过大楼前有美国国旗。你到那儿就知道了。
examples.translation: lù rén wǒ bú tài qīng chǔ bú guò dà lóu qián yǒu měi guó guó qí nǐ dào nàr jiù zhī dào le — I’m not too sure, but there is an American flag in front of the building. You’ll know when you get there.

examples.text: 大卫：谢谢您！
examples.translation: dà wèi xiè xiè nín — Thank you!

examples.text: 路人：不客气。
examples.translation: lù rén bú kè qì — You’re welcome.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog (Conversation 1). In your notebook, draw the route to the American embassy from where the speaker and the traffic police are, and mark the location of the embassy (audio and map not included). B. Pair up. Using your drawing, give your partner directions. Then compare your drawings. C. Read Conversation 2. Draw the route to the intended destination in your notebook and mark the destination on the map (the map shows 立交桥, 菜市场 and 农贸市场). B. Pair up and compare your drawings.

examples.text: 甲：请问到大华旅行社怎么走？

examples.text: 乙：您从前边儿那个立交桥底下一直往北走，到了十字路口往西拐，路北有个菜市场，菜市场的旁边是个银行，在银行那儿向北拐，沿着那条街往北走不远，有个农贸市场，农贸市场的对面就是大华旅行社。
examples.translation: yǐ nín cóng qián biānr nà ge lì jiāo qiáo dǐ xià yì zhí wǎng běi zǒu dào le shí zì lù kǒu wǎng xī guǎi lù běi yǒu gè cài shì chǎng cài shì chǎng de páng biān shì gè yín háng zài yín háng nàr xiàng běi guǎi yán zhe nà tiáo jiē wǎng běi zǒu bù yuǎn yǒu gè nóng mào shì chǎng nóng mào shì chǎng de duì miàn jiù shì dà huá lǚ xíng shè — From under that overpass ahead, go straight north; at the crossroads turn west; on the north side of the road there is a vegetable market, next to the vegetable market is a bank; at the bank turn north, walk north along that street not far, and there is a farmers’ market; Dahua Travel Agency is right opposite the farmers’ market.

examples.text: 甲：谢谢！哎，坐公共汽车能不能到那儿？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiè xiè āi zuò gōng gòng qì chē néng bù néng dào nàr — Thanks! Oh, can I get there by bus?

examples.text: 乙：可以，不过您得到马路对面去坐车。您要是在马路这边儿坐车，您就坐到别的地方去了。

lessons.title: 553. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 using Chinese in context: subway maps, Nanjing and Zaicheng in Qingdao

explanations.title: Activity 1 and Activity 2 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1: You are planning to visit several tourist attractions (yellow frames on the map) in Beijing from 人民大学 (with the person icon). Pair up and take turns giving directions on how to take the subway and transfer to an attraction without revealing your destination to your partner. Your partner will listen to your instructions and figure out your destination. Activity 2: Go to map.bjsubway.com, click on the two stations of your interest to set as 起点 and 终点 (zhōngdiǎn; destinations) and describe the route. A. 三号航站楼 to 中国美术馆. B. 人民大学 to 奥林匹克公园. C. Click on any two stations of interest and describe the route. (Maps and the website are not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking)
explanations.body: You are in Nanjing and are staying at the Jinling Hotel. You want to travel to the places listed below from your hotel. Pair up. Work with your partner to choose five destinations you both want to visit and describe the route to each. Listen to each other to see whose description is clearer. Destinations: 工商银行, 胜利电影院, 老广东菜馆, 新街口百货商店, 大华电影院, 人民商场, 同庆楼菜馆, 动物商场, 延安影剧院. (The map is not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the short passages and listen to the conversations between Zaicheng and local Chinese people; then answer the questions. Part 1 questions (conversation with the ticket-booth clerk): 1. Where is he from? 2. Where does he want to go? 3. According to the clerk, what route should he take? 4. Where is the bus station? Part 2 questions (conversation with an old man): 1. How does Zaicheng know he is closer to downtown? 2. What is Zaicheng’s usual way to navigate? Why must he use the “old way”? 3. What is his alternate destination? 4. How will Zaicheng get to his destination (list at least three details)? Part 3 questions (taxi driver and police): 1. How will he get to the hotel from where he is? 2. Why don’t people know the street Zaicheng is looking for? (Audio, not included; the passages are:)

examples.text: 大家好，我叫在成。我现在在中国青岛。这里离韩国很近，从首尔坐飞机一个小时就到了。我现在在机场，我要去青岛市区。刚才我问怎么去市区，他们说我需要坐大巴。
examples.translation: dà jiā hǎo wǒ jiào zài chéng wǒ xiàn zài zài zhōng guó qīng dǎo zhè lǐ lí hán guó hěn jìn cóng shǒu ěr zuò fēi jī yí gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le wǒ xiàn zài zài jī chǎng wǒ yào qù qīng dǎo shì qū gāng cái wǒ wèn zěn me qù shì qū tā men shuō wǒ xū yào zuò dà bā — Part 1: Hello everyone, my name is Zaicheng. I am in Qingdao, China now. It is very close to Korea; from Seoul it takes one hour by plane. I am at the airport now and I want to go to downtown Qingdao. Just now I asked how to get to the city and they said I need to take the shuttle bus. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我坐上了大巴，窗外的景色很美。慢慢地我看见很多高楼，好像到了市区。我下了车，可是不知道这是什么地方。因为没有网络，所以我不能查地图问路。啊，马路对面就有一个公交车站，我去问问等车的人。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò shàng le dà bā chuāng wài de jǐng sè hěn měi màn màn de wǒ kàn jiàn hěn duō gāo lóu hǎo xiàng dào le shì qū wǒ xià le chē kě shì bù zhī dào zhè shì shén me dì fāng yīn wèi méi yǒu wǎng luò suǒ yǐ wǒ bù néng chá dì tú wèn lù a mǎ lù duì miàn jiù yǒu yí gè gōng jiāo chē zhàn wǒ qù wèn wèn děng chē de rén — Part 2: I got on the shuttle bus and the scenery outside the window was beautiful. Gradually I saw many tall buildings, as if I had reached the city. I got off, but I didn’t know where this was. Because there was no network, I couldn’t check the map to ask the way. Ah, there is a bus stop across the road; I’ll go and ask the people waiting for the bus. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我坐到山东路以后下了车，可是还没有找到我要去的酒店。我问了两三个人，谁都不知道西吴路在哪儿。我只好坐出租车。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò dào shān dōng lù yǐ hòu xià le chē kě shì hái méi yǒu zhǎo dào wǒ yào qù de jiǔ diàn wǒ wèn le liǎng sān gè rén shéi dōu bù zhī dào xī wú lù zài nǎr wǒ zhǐ hǎo zuò chū zū chē — Part 3: After riding to Shandong Road I got off, but I still hadn’t found the hotel I was going to. I asked two or three people, and nobody knew where Xiwu Road was. I had no choice but to take a taxi. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我终于到了酒店。你们都看到我在中国没有网络，迷路的样子了。
examples.translation: wǒ zhōng yú dào le jiǔ diàn nǐ men dōu kàn dào wǒ zài zhōng guó méi yǒu wǎng luò mí lù de yàng zi le — I finally reached the hotel. You have all seen how I got lost in China without a network. (the book’s closing line; the book’s credit line reads 宰成-米达: 一个韩国男生在中国迷路了, “a Korean boy gets lost in China”)

lessons.title: 555. Lesson 22 Presentation 2: directions to a friend’s home
lessons.subtitle: 周末聚聚 · 百度地图 · 沿着卫国路往南开 · 丁字路口 停车牌 · 上二号高速 下高速

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. How have methods of navigation changed over time? B. What are the possible ways for a driver to get directions? C. What are the popular online maps in the U.S.? Can you use these apps overseas? D. When was the last time you hand-drew a map? Why? E. What road signs may you need to refer to when giving directions to a driver? (Two photographs are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 到张文家怎么走
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters; the digits 2, 20, 21 and 15 are spelled out in the Chinese text. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 张文：马克，周末有什么安排吗？我想请几个朋友到家里聚聚。
examples.translation: zhāng wén mǎ kè zhōu mò yǒu shén me ān pái ma wǒ xiǎng qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu dào jiā lǐ jù jù — Mark, do you have any plans for the weekend? I’d like to invite a few friends over to my home to get together. (translation mine)

examples.text: 马克：太好了！我一定去。你家住哪儿？
examples.translation: mǎ kè tài hǎo le wǒ yí dìng qù nǐ jiā zhù nǎr — Great! I’ll definitely come. Where do you live?

examples.text: 张文：我把地址发给你，你在百度地图上一查就知道怎么走了。
examples.translation: zhāng wén wǒ bǎ dì zhǐ fā gěi nǐ nǐ zài bǎi dù dì tú shàng yì chá jiù zhī dào zěn me zǒu le — I’ll send you the address, and you’ll know how to get there as soon as you look it up on Baidu Maps.

examples.text: 马克：我的手机还不能用百度地图。这样吧，你告诉我怎么走，我画个图。
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ de shǒu jī hái bù néng yòng bǎi dù dì tú zhè yàng ba nǐ gào sù wǒ zěn me zǒu wǒ huà gè tú — My phone still can’t use Baidu Maps. Tell you what: you tell me how to get there and I’ll draw a map.

examples.text: 张文：好吧。你出了学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开，过两个红绿灯……
examples.translation: zhāng wén hǎo ba nǐ chū le xué xiào yǐ hòu yán zhe wèi guó lù wǎng nán kāi guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — OK. After you leave the school, drive south along Weiguo Road and pass two traffic lights…

examples.text: 马克：慢点，慢点，过两个红绿灯…
examples.translation: mǎ kè màn diǎn màn diǎn guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — Slow down, slow down, pass two traffic lights…

examples.text: 张文：对，在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华街。沿着兴华街一直往前开，就到了一个丁字路口。
examples.translation: zhāng wén duì zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá jiē yán zhe xīng huá jiē yì zhí wǎng qián kāi jiù dào le yí gè dīng zì lù kǒu — Right, turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Street. Drive straight ahead along Xinghua Street and you’ll come to a T-junction.

examples.text: 马克：什么路口？
examples.translation: mǎ kè shén me lù kǒu — What kind of junction?

examples.text: 张文：丁字路口。那儿有一个停车牌。
examples.translation: zhāng wén dīng zì lù kǒu nàr yǒu yí gè tíng chē pái — A T-junction. There is a stop sign there.

examples.text: 马克：哦，知道了。你接着说。
examples.translation: mǎ kè ó zhī dào le nǐ jiē zhe shuō — Oh, I see. Go on.

examples.text: 张文：在那儿往左拐，你会看到一个很大的绿色路牌，从那儿上二号高速公路，往北开二十分钟左右。
examples.translation: zhāng wén zài nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè hěn dà de lǜ sè lù pái cóng nàr shàng èr hào gāo sù gōng lù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu — Turn left there and you’ll see a big green road sign; get on Highway 2 from there and drive north for about twenty minutes.

examples.text: 马克：上二号高速，往北开。然后呢？
examples.translation: mǎ kè shàng èr hào gāo sù wǎng běi kāi rán hòu ne — Get on Highway 2, drive north. And then?

examples.text: 张文：然后从二十一号出口下高速路。下了高速，就是中山路，我家就在中山路十五号。
examples.translation: zhāng wén rán hòu cóng èr shí yī hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù lù xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù wǒ jiā jiù zài zhōng shān lù shí wǔ hào — Then take Exit 21 off the highway. Once you’re off the highway that’s Zhongshan Road, and my home is at 15 Zhongshan Road.

examples.text: 马克：你看看，我画得对不对？
examples.translation: mǎ kè nǐ kàn kàn wǒ huà de duì bú duì — Take a look: did I draw it right?

examples.text: 张文：（仔细看了一下）真不错！没想到你不光中文好，图也画得这么漂亮。
examples.translation: zhāng wén zǐ xì kàn le yí xià zhēn bú cuò méi xiǎng dào nǐ bù guāng zhōng wén hǎo tú yě huà de zhè me piào liàng — (looks carefully) Really good! I didn’t expect that you were not only good at Chinese but could also draw such a beautiful map. (the book has an interjection of agreement here, “ń”, which I left out because the app cannot speak it)

examples.text: 马克：你过奖了！
examples.translation: mǎ kè nǐ guò jiǎng le — You flatter me!

examples.text: 张文：不过说真的，你还是想办法装个地图软件吧，那以后不管上哪儿你都不会迷路了。
examples.translation: zhāng wén bú guò shuō zhēn de nǐ hái shì xiǎng bàn fǎ zhuāng gè dì tú ruǎn jiàn ba nà yǐ hòu bù guǎn shàng nǎr nǐ dōu bú huì mí lù le — But seriously, you’d better find a way to install a map app; then wherever you go you won’t get lost.

lessons.title: 556. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 activities: landmarks, road signs and the route to Zhang Wen’s home
lessons.subtitle: Activities 1 to 4 · 人行道 单行道 · 出了 沿着 过 · 往右拐 · 上二号高速

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 2 once and answer: 1. Why is Mike going to Zhang Wen’s house? (to a get-together with friends) 2. How does Zhang Wen usually navigate? (with a map app such as Baidu Maps) 3. How does Mike plan to find Zhang Wen’s house? (he will draw a map from Zhang Wen’s directions) 4. What mode of transportation will Mike use? (driving) 5. What kind of landmarks are mentioned in their conversation? (traffic lights, a T-junction, a stop sign, a green road sign, a highway exit). B. Detailed listening: listen again, draw a map of the route to Zhang Wen’s house in your notebook (the book’s blank map shows 学校, Weiguo Road, Xinghua Street, Highway 2, Exit 21 and Zhongshan Road 15), and in groups of three compare your work. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. With your partner, name the following landmarks (eight pictures; the first example is 人行道, the sidewalk). B. Name each sign correctly (twelve road-sign pictures; the first example is 单行道, one-way street). (All the pictures are not included, so the answers are not given.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the English translation. B. Pair up. Take turns reading the sentences of the completed passage. Listen to each other’s work and discuss any differences. The book prints the six sentences with blanks; the completed Chinese (key mine) with the book’s English:

examples.text: 出了学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开，过两个红绿灯。
examples.translation: chū le xué xiào yǐ hòu yán zhe wèi guó lù wǎng nán kāi guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — 1. After leaving school, drive south along Weiguo Street and pass two traffic lights. (the book’s English; the blanks are 出了, 沿着, 过; key mine)

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华街。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá jiē — 2. Turn right at the third traffic light onto Xinghua Street. (往右拐)

examples.text: 沿着兴华街一直往前开，就到了一个丁字路口。
examples.translation: yán zhe xīng huá jiē yì zhí wǎng qián kāi jiù dào le yí gè dīng zì lù kǒu — 3. Go straight along Xinghua Street until you reach a T-junction. (一直往前开)

examples.text: 在那儿往左拐，你会看到一个很大的绿色路牌，从那儿上二号高速公路，往北开二十分钟左右。
examples.translation: zài nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè hěn dà de lǜ sè lù pái cóng nàr shàng èr hào gāo sù gōng lù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu — 4. Turn left at the T-junction, you will see a large green sign, take Highway 2 and drive north for about 20 minutes. (会看到, 上, 往北开)

examples.text: 然后从二十一号出口下高速路。
examples.translation: rán hòu cóng èr shí yī hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù lù — 5. Take exit 21 to get off the highway onto Zhongshan Road. (从, 下高速)

examples.text: 下了高速，就是中山路，我家就在中山路十五号。
examples.translation: xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù wǒ jiā jiù zài zhōng shān lù shí wǔ hào — 6. My home is at 15 Zhongshan Road. (就在)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Listen to the conversation. Write step-by-step instructions in English on how to get from Xiao Wen’s house to Zhuang Hua’s house. In Chinese, explain your notes to your partner and compare your work. (Audio, not included.)

exercises.prompt: Which fills “___学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开”?
Which fills “在第三个红绿灯___，就是兴华街”?
Which fills “沿着兴华街一直往前开，___到了一个丁字路口”?
Which fills “从那儿___二号高速公路”?
Which fills “然后从二十一号出口___高速路”?
Which fills “我家___在中山路十五号”?
exercises.explanation: 我家就在中山路十五号.

exercises.prompt: 在那儿往左拐，你会看___一个很大的绿色路牌。

lessons.title: 557. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: asking for and giving directions (1)
lessons.subtitle: 请问怎么走 · 离这儿…公里 · 出了…以后 · 沿着…往…开/走

explanations.title: Asking for Directions
explanations.body: Asking for directions is still inevitable, even in this digital age. There are two basic ways to ask for direction in Chinese: for a particular place, “This Place + 在哪儿？”, “（到）This Place + 怎么走？” and “怎么去 + This Place？”; for a particular kind of place, “哪儿有 This Kind of Place？” and “这附近有 This Kind of Place 吗？”. Speakers usually begin with polite phrases like 请问；你好，我想问一下…；不好意思，你能告诉我…；劳驾, etc.

tables.title: Two basic ways to ask for directions

examples.text: 请问，这附近有地铁站吗？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn zhè fù jìn yǒu dì tiě zhàn ma — 1. Excuse me, is there a subway station nearby?

examples.text: 我想问一下，到美国大使馆怎么走？
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng wèn yí xià dào měi guó dà shǐ guǎn zěn me zǒu — 2. I’d like to ask, how do I get to the American Embassy?

examples.text: 你好！你能告诉我怎么去机场吗？
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo nǐ néng gào sù wǒ zěn me qù jī chǎng ma — 3. Hello! Can you tell me how to get to the airport?

examples.text: 劳驾，请问哪儿有厕所？
examples.translation: láo jià qǐng wèn nǎr yǒu cè suǒ — 4. Excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.text: 不好意思，请问，金河饭店在哪儿？
examples.translation: bù hǎo yì sī qǐng wèn jīn hé fàn diàn zài nǎr — 5. Sorry to bother you, where is the Jinhe Hotel?

explanations.title: Giving directions: distance and time
explanations.body: Giving directions for walking or driving are the same, except the verbs used are 走 for walking and 开 for driving. Before giving detailed directions, it’s always useful to explain how far the destination is and how long it will take to get there. Patterns: 某地离这儿几公里; 从某地到某地开车需要多长时间; 从某地到某地开车多长时间就到了.

examples.text: 文化公园离这儿不太远，走路二十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: wén huà gōng yuán lí zhèr bú tài yuǎn zǒu lù èr shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — 1. Culture Park is not too far from here; it takes twenty minutes on foot.

examples.text: 就在前面不远。走到停车牌那儿右拐就到了。
examples.translation: jiù zài qián miàn bù yuǎn zǒu dào tíng chē pái nàr yòu guǎi jiù dào le — 2. It’s just ahead, not far. Walk to the stop sign, turn right and you’re there.

examples.text: 我家离学校二十多公里，开车需要半个小时左右。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào èr shí duō gōng lǐ kāi chē xū yào bàn gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu — 3. My home is more than twenty kilometers from school; it takes about half an hour by car.

examples.text: 从市中心到机场有七十多公里，坐地铁要一个多小时。
examples.translation: cóng shì zhōng xīn dào jī chǎng yǒu qī shí duō gōng lǐ zuò dì tiě yào yí gè duō xiǎo shí — 4. From downtown to the airport is more than seventy kilometers; it takes over an hour by subway.

explanations.title: Leaving a place
explanations.body: If leaving from an airport, train station, school, or similar place: 出了某地以后; 从某地出来/出去以后.

examples.text: 出了北京大学东门以后，往右转。
examples.translation: chū le běi jīng dà xué dōng mén yǐ hòu wǎng yòu zhuǎn — 1. After going out of the East Gate of Peking University, turn right.

examples.text: 出了三号航站楼以后，过马路。
examples.translation: chū le sān hào háng zhàn lóu yǐ hòu guò mǎ lù — 2. After leaving Terminal 3, cross the road.

examples.text: 从地铁站八号出口出来以后，一直往前走。
examples.translation: cóng dì tiě zhàn bā hào chū kǒu chū lái yǐ hòu yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu — 3. After coming out of Exit 8 of the subway station, go straight ahead.

examples.text: 从我家出来就是文华街。
examples.translation: cóng wǒ jiā chū lái jiù shì wén huá jiē — 4. Coming out of my home is Wenhua Street.

examples.text: 请问，在哪儿坐出租车？——从三号门出去，往左拐就是。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn zài nǎr zuò chū zū chē cóng sān hào mén chū qù wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì — 5. Excuse me, where do I get a taxi? — Go out of Gate 3 and turn left; that’s it.

examples.text: 请问邮局在哪儿？——出了学校西门以后，过马路就是。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn yóu jú zài nǎr chū le xué xiào xī mén yǐ hòu guò mǎ lù jiù shì — 6. Where is the post office? — After going out of the West Gate of the school, cross the road and that’s it.

explanations.title: 沿着 … 往/向 … 开/走
explanations.body: Patterns: 沿着 street + 往/向 + direction + 开/走 + a certain distance or time; 沿着 street + 往/向 + direction + 开/走到 + landmark. Notes: 1. When giving directions, 往 and 向 are interchangeable. 2. In Southern China, the relative directions 左/右 are more commonly used, while in Northern China, the cardinal directions 东/西/南/北 are more commonly used. 3. The commonly used measurement unit is 公里 for longer distances and 米 for shorter and more precise distances. You can also use “mile” 英里 and “foot” 英尺.

examples.text: 沿着红星路往前开。
examples.translation: yán zhe hóng xīng lù wǎng qián kāi — 1. Drive forward along Hongxing Road.

examples.text: 沿着人民路往西开五公里。
examples.translation: yán zhe rén mín lù wǎng xī kāi wǔ gōng lǐ — 2. Drive west along Renmin Road for five kilometers.

examples.text: 沿着三号高速往北开二十分钟。
examples.translation: yán zhe sān hào gāo sù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng — 3. Drive north along Highway 3 for twenty minutes.

examples.text: 沿着这条小路走二百米左右。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo xiǎo lù zǒu èr bǎi mǐ zuǒ yòu — 4. Walk about two hundred meters along this lane.

examples.text: 沿着这条路一直走到红绿灯那儿。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù yì zhí zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr — 5. Keep walking along this road to the traffic light.

exercises.prompt: Which verb is used for walking directions, and which for driving?
options: 开 for walking, 走 for driving
走 for walking, 开 for driving
exercises.explanation: 走 for walking and 开 for driving.

exercises.prompt: Which question asks for a kind of place?
Which polite phrase means “Excuse me” (get someone’s attention)?
exercises.explanation: 劳驾 is a polite opener.

exercises.prompt: How do you say “it takes about half an hour by car”?
options: 开车需要半个小时左右

exercises.prompt: What does 沿着人民路往西开五公里 mean?
options: Drive west along Renmin Road for five kilometers

exercises.prompt: Which units are used for long and short distances?
options: 米 for long, 公里 for short
公里 for long, 米 for short

exercises.prompt: Are 往 and 向 interchangeable in directions?
In which part of China are 左/右 more common?
请问邮局在哪儿？——出了学校西门以后，过马路___是。
我想问一___，到美国大使馆怎么走？

lessons.title: 558. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: asking for and giving directions (2)
lessons.subtitle: 过…个红绿灯 · 往左拐 往右转 · 就是 你会看到 · 继续往前开 · …就到了 · 开到底

explanations.title: Passing traffic lights and intersections
explanations.body: Pattern: 过 + number + 个红绿灯/路口. The difference between 经过 and 穿过: 经过 means “to pass by”, whereas 穿过 means “to pass through”. On the book’s map (not included) you 经过 a coffee shop and then 穿过 a park.

examples.text: 过三个路口。
examples.translation: guò sān gè lù kǒu — 1. Pass three intersections.

examples.text: 过两个红绿灯，到第三个往右拐。
examples.translation: guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng dào dì sān gè wǎng yòu guǎi — 2. Pass two traffic lights and turn right at the third.

examples.text: 走过两个街区，看到红绿灯时往左拐。
examples.translation: zǒu guò liǎng gè jiē qū kàn dào hóng lǜ dēng shí wǎng zuǒ guǎi — 3. Walk past two blocks and turn left when you see a traffic light.

explanations.title: Turning
explanations.body: Notes: 1. 转 and 拐 are interchangeable when giving directions. 2. 那儿 is optional. 3. 往/向 can be omitted in this situation.

examples.text: 一直往前走，在红绿灯那儿往左拐。
examples.translation: yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu zài hóng lǜ dēng nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi — 1. Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic light.

examples.text: 在第二个十字路口向右转。
examples.translation: zài dì èr gè shí zì lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 2. Turn right at the second crossroads.

examples.text: 在停车牌那儿左转，或者在丁字路口那儿左转。
examples.translation: zài tíng chē pái nàr zuǒ zhuǎn huò zhě zài dīng zì lù kǒu nàr zuǒ zhuǎn — 3. Turn left at the stop sign or at the T-junction. (the book writes 停车牌/丁字路口)

examples.text: 沿着北街走到红绿灯，然后向右转。
examples.translation: yán zhe běi jiē zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng rán hòu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 4. Walk along North Street to the traffic light, then turn right.

examples.text: 请问地铁站在哪儿？——一直往前走，走到红绿灯那儿左拐。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zài nǎr yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr zuǒ guǎi — 5. Where is the subway station? — Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic light.

examples.text: 沿着这条街一直走到红绿灯那儿，然后向右拐。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo jiē yì zhí zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr rán hòu xiàng yòu guǎi — 6. Keep walking along this street to the traffic light, then turn right.

explanations.title: Pointing out a landmark
explanations.body: Patterns: 就是 + landmark; 你会看到 + landmark. And “过了 landmark 以后，继续往前走/开”.

examples.text: 出了学校大门，就是富兰克林大街。
examples.translation: chū le xué xiào dà mén jiù shì fù lán kè lín dà jiē — 1. Out of the school gate is Franklin Street.

examples.text: 下了高速，就是中山路。
examples.translation: xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù — 2. Once you get off the highway, that’s Zhongshan Road.

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华路。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá lù — 3. Turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Road.

examples.text: 一直往前走，你会看到一个停车牌。
examples.translation: yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè tíng chē pái — 4. Keep going straight and you will see a stop sign.

examples.text: 再走五十米左右，你会看到左边有一个蓝色的路牌。
examples.translation: zài zǒu wǔ shí mǐ zuǒ yòu nǐ huì kàn dào zuǒ biān yǒu yí gè lán sè de lù pái — 5. Walk about fifty meters more and you will see a blue street sign on the left.

examples.text: 过了邮局以后，继续往前走。
examples.translation: guò le yóu jú yǐ hòu jì xù wǎng qián zǒu — 1. After passing the post office, keep going straight.

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华路，沿着兴华路继续往前开。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá lù yán zhe xīng huá lù jì xù wǎng qián kāi — 2. Turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Road; keep driving along Xinghua Road.

explanations.title: Arriving at the destination, naming an intersection, and the end of the road
explanations.body: Arriving: destination 就到了; destination 就在你的右手边/左手边/前面; destination 就在 landmark 的 direction. Naming an intersection: A路和B路的（十字）路口. To the end of the road: 开/走 + 到 + 底/头.

examples.text: 再走不远就到了。王府井大饭店就在路的西边。
examples.translation: zài zǒu bù yuǎn jiù dào le wáng fǔ jǐng dà fàn diàn jiù zài lù de xī biān — 1. Go a little farther and you’re there. The Wangfujing Hotel is on the west side of the road.

examples.text: 大华旅行社就在农贸市场的对面。
examples.translation: dà huá lǚ xíng shè jiù zài nóng mào shì chǎng de duì miàn — 2. The Dahua Travel Agency is right opposite the farmers’ market.

examples.text: 中国银行就在你的右手边。
examples.translation: zhōng guó yín háng jiù zài nǐ de yòu shǒu biān — 3. The Bank of China is right on your right.

examples.text: 人民北路和文太西街的十字路口
examples.translation: rén mín běi lù hé wén tài xī jiē de shí zì lù kǒu — 1. the intersection of Renmin North Road and Wentai West Street

examples.text: 文太正街和人民中路的十字路口
examples.translation: wén tài zhèng jiē hé rén mín zhōng lù de shí zì lù kǒu — 2. the intersection of Wentai Main Street and Renmin Middle Road

examples.text: 沿着文华路一直往北开，开到文化路和红星路的路口向右转。
examples.translation: yán zhe wén huá lù yì zhí wǎng běi kāi kāi dào wén huà lù hé hóng xīng lù de lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 3. Drive straight north along Wenhua Road; at the junction of Wenhua Road and Hongxing Road turn right.

examples.text: 离开停车场以后，沿着白云巷一直往前开，开到底，往左拐。
examples.translation: lí kāi tíng chē chǎng yǐ hòu yán zhe bái yún xiàng yì zhí wǎng qián kāi kāi dào dǐ wǎng zuǒ guǎi — Example 1 (a map): After leaving the parking lot, drive straight ahead along Baiyun Lane, to the end, then turn left.

examples.text: 你沿着玉林三巷一直往南走，走到头往右拐，就是玉林东街，再走到头，然后往左拐，就是玉林街。
examples.translation: nǐ yán zhe yù lín sān xiàng yì zhí wǎng nán zǒu zǒu dào tóu wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì yù lín dōng jiē zài zǒu dào tóu rán hòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yù lín jiē — Example 2 (a map): Walk straight south along Yulin Third Lane, to the end, turn right, that’s Yulin East Street; walk to the end again and then turn left, and that’s Yulin Street.

exercises.prompt: What is the difference between 经过 and 穿过?
options: Only 穿过 is used for roads
经过 is through; 穿过 is by
经过 is passing by; 穿过 is passing through

exercises.prompt: How do you say “pass three intersections”?
Are 转 and 拐 interchangeable?
What does 出了学校大门，就是富兰克林大街 mean?
options: The school is on Franklin Street
Franklin Street is far from school
Out of the school gate is Franklin Street

exercises.prompt: Which means “you will see a stop sign”?
What does 过了邮局以后，继续往前走 mean?
options: Turn left at the post office
After passing the post office keep going straight
Go back to the post office

exercises.prompt: Which means “is right opposite the farmers’ market”?

options: Walk to the head of the bus
Walk to the end of the road
exercises.explanation: 到底/到头: to the end.

options: 人民北路和文太西街的十字路口
人民北路在文太西街里

exercises.prompt: 在第二个十字路口向右___。
再走五十米左右，你会看___左边有一个蓝色的路牌。

lessons.title: 559. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: highways, and activities on giving directions
lessons.subtitle: 上高速公路 · 从…号出口下高速 · 往东行驶 · 十一个方向翻译 · 蒙特雷到圣何塞

explanations.title: Getting on a highway
explanations.body: The specific verbs for getting on and off a highway are 上 and 下. Pattern: 上高速公路 / 上往 + direction + 开的 + number + 号高速公路. (The book illustrates these with road-sign photos, not included.)

examples.text: 上京沪高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng jīng hù gāo sù gōng lù — 1. Get on the Beijing–Shanghai Expressway. (a picture of the sign, not included)

examples.text: 上三十三号高速。
examples.translation: shàng sān shí sān hào gāo sù — 2. Get on Highway 33.

examples.text: 上一号高速。
examples.translation: shàng yī hào gāo sù — 3. Get on Highway 1.

examples.text: 上往东行驶的四十号高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng wǎng dōng xíng shǐ de sì shí hào gāo sù gōng lù — 4. Get on Highway 40 going east.

examples.text: 上往北行驶的八十五号高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng wǎng běi xíng shǐ de bā shí wǔ hào gāo sù gōng lù — 5. Get on Highway 85 going north.

explanations.title: Getting off a highway
explanations.body: Pattern: 从 + number + 号出口下高速公路.

examples.text: 从一百八十九号出口下高速公路。
examples.translation: cóng yì bǎi bā shí jiǔ hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù gōng lù — 1. Get off the highway at Exit 189.

examples.text: 去斗南走一百五十八号公路，从二百四十号出口下高速。
examples.translation: qù dòu nán zǒu yì bǎi wǔ shí bā hào gōng lù cóng èr bǎi sì shí hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù — 2. To go to Dounan, take Highway 158 and get off at Exit 240.

examples.text: 再往前开两公里就是二百四十号出口，从那里下高速公路。
examples.translation: zài wǎng qián kāi liǎng gōng lǐ jiù shì èr bǎi sì shí hào chū kǒu cóng nà lǐ xià gāo sù gōng lù — 3. Drive two more kilometers and that’s Exit 240; get off the highway there.

examples.text: 从二号出口下高速公路，就到了重庆北路。
examples.translation: cóng èr hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù gōng lù jiù dào le chóng qìng běi lù — 4. Get off the highway at Exit 2 and you reach Chongqing North Road.

examples.text: 从四号出口下高速，下了高速以后，就是松江路。

lessons.title: 560. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 skill integration: highway numbers, a museum route and getting lost in Germany
lessons.subtitle: 中国高速公路小知识 · 三星堆博物馆 · 在德国迷路 · 移民局 · 如果我在你的国家迷路

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking): 中国高速公路小知识
explanations.body: A. Read the passage without the help of your dictionary. Highlight any unknown words and try to guess their meanings. B. Choose three unknown words you think are most critical for understanding the passage and guess their meanings. Pair up. Compare your guesses to your partner’s. C. In Chinese, talk with your partner about what you can understand from the following highway signs (four photographs, not included).

examples.text: 每条高速公路都有自己的名字。例如，北京到哈尔滨的高速公路叫“北京－哈尔滨高速公路”，简称“京哈高速”。除了名字以外，高速公路还有自己的编号。京哈高速的编号是Ｇ一。中国高速公路的编号里面有字母和数字，例如Ｇ一，Ｇ二，Ｓ六三。Ｇ是国家高速公路，Ｓ是省高速公路。
examples.translation: měi tiáo gāo sù gōng lù dōu yǒu zì jǐ de míng zì lì rú běi jīng dào hā ěr bīn de gāo sù gōng lù jiào běi jīng hā ěr bīn gāo sù gōng lù jiǎn chēng jīng hā gāo sù chú le míng zì yǐ wài gāo sù gōng lù hái yǒu zì jǐ de biān hào jīng hā gāo sù de biān hào shì yì zhōng guó gāo sù gōng lù de biān hào lǐ miàn yǒu zì mǔ hé shù zì lì rú yī èr liù sān shì guó jiā gāo sù gōng lù shì shěng gāo sù gōng lù — Every expressway has its own name. For example, the expressway from Beijing to Harbin is called the “Beijing–Harbin Expressway”, abbreviated 京哈高速. Besides the name, an expressway also has its own number. The number of the Beijing–Harbin Expressway is G1. Chinese expressway numbers contain a letter and digits, for example G1, G2, S63. G is a national expressway, S is a provincial expressway. (the book writes the numbers as G1, G2, S63; I wrote the letters in full-width form and the digits in hanzi; translation mine)

examples.text: 如果编号是Ｇ和一位数字，那这条高速公路就是从北京出发的。例如，Ｇ二是从北京到上海，Ｇ四是从北京到香港。如果一条高速是南北方向的，那它的编号就有两位数字，而且第二个数字会是一，三，五，七，九，例如Ｇ十一，Ｇ十五，Ｇ六十九。如果高速公路是东西方向的，那它的编号就是Ｇ十，Ｇ三十六，Ｇ四十二……
examples.translation: rú guǒ biān hào shì hé yí wèi shù zì nà zhè tiáo gāo sù gōng lù jiù shì cóng běi jīng chū fā de lì rú èr shì cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi sì shì cóng běi jīng dào xiāng gǎng rú guǒ yì tiáo gāo sù shì nán běi fāng xiàng de nà tā de biān hào jiù yǒu liǎng wèi shù zì ér qiě dì èr gè shù zì huì shì yī sān wǔ qī jiǔ lì rú shí yī shí wǔ liù shí jiǔ rú guǒ gāo sù gōng lù shì dōng xī fāng xiàng de nà tā de biān hào jiù shì shí sān shí liù sì shí èr — If the number is G plus one digit, then that expressway starts from Beijing. For example G2 goes from Beijing to Shanghai and G4 from Beijing to Hong Kong. If an expressway runs north–south, its number has two digits and the second digit will be 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9, for example G11, G15, G69. If an expressway runs east–west, its number is G10, G36, G42… (translation mine)

examples.text: 高速公路出口的编号是从高速公路的起点到这个出口的公里数。有多少公里，出口就是多少号。例如，二十五号出口离起点有二十五公里，九十八号出口离起点有九十八公里。开车的人看到现在经过的出口，就能知道离他想去的出口还有多远了。
examples.translation: gāo sù gōng lù chū kǒu de biān hào shì cóng gāo sù gōng lù de qǐ diǎn dào zhè ge chū kǒu de gōng lǐ shù yǒu duō shǎo gōng lǐ chū kǒu jiù shì duō shǎo hào lì rú èr shí wǔ hào chū kǒu lí qǐ diǎn yǒu èr shí wǔ gōng lǐ jiǔ shí bā hào chū kǒu lí qǐ diǎn yǒu jiǔ shí bā gōng lǐ kāi chē de rén kàn dào xiàn zài jīng guò de chū kǒu jiù néng zhī dào lí tā xiǎng qù de chū kǒu hái yǒu duō yuǎn le — The number of an expressway exit is the number of kilometers from the start of the expressway to that exit. Whatever the kilometers are, that is the exit number. For example Exit 25 is 25 kilometers from the start and Exit 98 is 98 kilometers from the start. A driver who sees the exit he is now passing can tell how far he still is from the exit he wants. (translation mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a phone call between 小王 and 马克 and sketch the route described. B. Pair up. Explain the route to your partner using a sketch. Compare your notes to see if there are any inconsistencies. (The sketch has building 32, a new North Road and an East Gate; audio is not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the directions on how to get to a famous museum (博物馆 Bówùguǎn) from a hotel in downtown Chengdu and answer: 1. What’s the location of the museum relative to downtown Chengdu? 2. In your notebook, draw a map of the directions from the hotel to the museum. Compare your map with your partner’s. (The map shows 人民南路, the Highway 5 and 广汉路, an Exit 39 and the hotel; audio is not included.) B. Below is a list of driving directions in English (the Sanxingdui Museum, 三星堆博物馆). Pair up and, in Chinese, take turns explaining the route to your partner. My Chinese:

examples.text: 出了酒店以后，沿着人民南路往北开。
examples.translation: chū le jiǔ diàn yǐ hòu yán zhe rén mín nán lù wǎng běi kāi — 1. After leaving the hotel, drive north along South Renmin Road. (Activity 3B, my Chinese)

examples.text: 过两个路口，在第三个路口往右拐。
examples.translation: guò liǎng gè lù kǒu zài dì sān gè lù kǒu wǎng yòu guǎi — 2. Pass two intersections and turn right at the third intersection.

examples.text: 一直往前开，你会看到五号高速的路牌。
examples.translation: yì zhí wǎng qián kāi nǐ huì kàn dào wǔ hào gāo sù de lù pái — 3. Go straight ahead; you will see the sign for Highway 5.

examples.text: 上五号高速往北开四十公里左右。
examples.translation: shàng wǔ hào gāo sù wǎng běi kāi sì shí gōng lǐ zuǒ yòu — 4. Take Highway 5 and drive north for about 40 km.

examples.text: 从十四号出口下高速，就到了广汉路。
examples.translation: cóng shí sì hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù jiù dào le guǎng hàn lù — 5. Take Exit 14 to get off the highway at Guanghan Avenue.

examples.text: 三星堆博物馆就在广汉路三四七号。
examples.translation: sān xīng duī bó wù guǎn jiù zài guǎng hàn lù sān sì qī hào — 6. The museum, the Sanxingdui Museum, is located at 347 Guanghan Avenue.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage without the help of your dictionary. Underline any unknown words and try to guess their meanings. B. Choose three unknown words you think are most critical for understanding the passage. Pair up and compare your guessed meanings with those of your partner. C. Take turns verbally answering the following questions. 1. “我”记忆中的路是怎么走的？ 2. 这位德国妇女是怎么帮“我”的？ 3. 最后“我们”是怎么找到地址的？ 4. “我”为什么会迷路？ 5. 这位德国妇女为什么会觉得抱歉？ 6. 文中的最后一句话是什么意思？ Answers from the text (mine): 1. After getting off, walk along the road a few minutes to a big river, cross the bridge, turn left and walk about ten more minutes. 2. She drove him to places with people to ask and finally to the police station and to a subway station. 3. At the police station. 4. He got off several stops too early. 5. She had to go back to work and could not take him to the office. 6. People should help each other wherever they are, and she assumes he would do the same for her abroad.

examples.text: 十年前，我在德国留学。一个冬天的早上，我得去移民局办签证延期。我以前去过那儿，记得下车后沿着路走几分钟就有一条大河，过了桥往左拐，再走十分钟左右就可以看到移民局的大楼。
examples.translation: shí nián qián wǒ zài dé guó liú xué yí gè dōng tiān de zǎo shàng wǒ děi qù yí mín jú bàn qiān zhèng yán qī wǒ yǐ qián qù guò nàr jì de xià chē hòu yán zhe lù zǒu jǐ fēn zhōng jiù yǒu yì tiáo dà hé guò le qiáo wǎng zuǒ guǎi zài zǒu shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu jiù kě yǐ kàn dào yí mín jú de dà lóu — Ten years ago I was studying in Germany. One winter morning I had to go to the immigration office (移民局, Yímínjú) to renew my visa (签证延期, yánqí). I had been there before and remembered that after getting off I would walk along the road for a few minutes to a big river, cross the bridge and turn left, then walk about ten more minutes and could see the immigration office building. (translation mine)

examples.text: 可是，一出地铁口我就迷了路，走了几条街，也没看到桥，连河也没看见。天还很黑，路上根本没有人。正在这时，我突然看见对面走来一位德国妇女。那时候我的德语很不好，我说了三遍“移民局”，又拿出护照给她看，她才明白。可是她也不知道移民局在哪儿，而且她还告诉我，这附近也没有桥。
examples.translation: kě shì yì chū dì tiě kǒu wǒ jiù mí le lù zǒu le jǐ tiáo jiē yě méi kàn dào qiáo lián hé yě méi kàn jiàn tiān hái hěn hēi lù shàng gēn běn méi yǒu rén zhèng zài zhè shí wǒ tū rán kàn jiàn duì miàn zǒu lái yí wèi dé guó fù nǚ nà shí hòu wǒ de dé yǔ hěn bù hǎo wǒ shuō le sān biàn yí mín jú yòu ná chū hù zhào gěi tā kàn tā cái míng bái kě shì tā yě bù zhī dào yí mín jú zài nǎr ér qiě tā hái gào sù wǒ zhè fù jìn yě méi yǒu qiáo — But as soon as I came out of the subway exit I got lost; I walked several streets and saw no bridge, not even the river. It was still very dark and there was nobody on the road. Just then I suddenly saw a German woman walking toward me from across the road. My German was very poor then; I said “immigration office” three times and took out my passport to show her before she understood. But she didn’t know where the immigration office was either, and she also told me there was no bridge nearby. (mine)

examples.text: 看到我着急的样子，她到停车场把车开来，说：“我带你到人多的地方去问问。”因为太早，我们开了很久才问了两个人，可他们也不知道。最后，她把车开到警察局，才问到了移民局的地址。拿到地址后我才知道，原来，我提前了好几站下车。
examples.translation: kàn dào wǒ zháo jí de yàng zi tā dào tíng chē chǎng bǎ chē kāi lái shuō wǒ dài nǐ dào rén duō de dì fāng qù wèn wèn yīn wèi tài zǎo wǒ men kāi le hěn jiǔ cái wèn le liǎng gè rén kě tā men yě bù zhī dào zuì hòu tā bǎ chē kāi dào jǐng chá jú cái wèn dào le yí mín jú de dì zhǐ ná dào dì zhǐ hòu wǒ cái zhī dào yuán lái wǒ tí qián le hǎo jǐ zhàn xià chē — Seeing how anxious I was, she went to the parking lot, brought her car and said, “I’ll take you to a place with more people to ask.” Because it was so early, we drove a long time before we asked two people, and they didn’t know either. In the end she drove to the police station and only then found out the address of the immigration office. After I got the address I realized that I had gotten off several stops too early. (mine)

examples.text: 她抱歉地告诉我，她还要回去上班，要是有时间，她一定会送我去移民局。不过，她还是开车把我送到了附近的地铁站。我再三向她表示谢意，她却说：“如果我在你的国家迷路，你一定也会这样帮助我，对吗？”
examples.translation: tā bào qiàn de gào sù wǒ tā hái yào huí qù shàng bān yào shì yǒu shí jiān tā yí dìng huì sòng wǒ qù yí mín jú bú guò tā hái shì kāi chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào le fù jìn de dì tiě zhàn wǒ zài sān xiàng tā biǎo shì xiè yì tā què shuō rú guǒ wǒ zài nǐ de guó jiā mí lù nǐ yí dìng yě huì zhè yàng bāng zhù wǒ duì ma — She told me apologetically that she still had to go back to work and that if she had time she would certainly have taken me to the immigration office. Still, she drove me to a nearby subway station. I thanked her again and again, but she said, “If I got lost in your country, you would certainly help me like this too, right?” (mine)

lessons.title: 561. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: map apps, routes and your weekend
lessons.subtitle: 地图软件 · 谷歌 百度 高德 · 驾车路线 · 蒙特雷到洛杉矶 · 周末去哪儿

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. The passage below is translated from the English website The China Guide. Read its introduction on using a map app in China. B. Form groups of three. Discuss the following questions using the above information: 1. What makes traveling in China easy and difficult for foreigners? 2. What are the best ways to find directions in China?

examples.text: 在中国的大城市旅行不太难，地铁和机场都有英文标志。但是离开地铁和机场以后就会有麻烦了。在中国，很少有出租车司机会说英文，会读的就更少了。所以，如果你想到中国旅行，最好在出发以前就在手机上装上地图。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó de dà chéng shì lǚ xíng bú tài nán dì tiě hé jī chǎng dōu yǒu yīng wén biāo zhì dàn shì lí kāi dì tiě hé jī chǎng yǐ hòu jiù huì yǒu má fán le zài zhōng guó hěn shǎo yǒu chū zū chē sī jī huì shuō yīng wén huì dú de jiù gèng shǎo le suǒ yǐ rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng dào zhōng guó lǚ xíng zuì hǎo zài chū fā yǐ qián jiù zài shǒu jī shàng zhuāng shàng dì tú — Traveling in big cities in China is not too hard; the subways and airports have English signs. But once you leave the subway and the airport there will be trouble. In China few taxi drivers can speak English and even fewer can read it. So if you want to travel to China, it is best to install a map on your phone before you set out. (translation mine, from the Chinese text translated from The China Guide)

examples.text: 谷歌地图可能是最好的手机地图了。但是，谷歌所有的服务都不能在中国使用。如果你用的是苹果手机，那就比较方便了。苹果地图在中国也可以运行。中国人自己用得最多的是百度地图和高德地图。这两个地图软件都很不错，问题是，它们都只有中文。对外国人来说，要看懂可不是一件容易的事。
examples.translation: gǔ gē dì tú kě néng shì zuì hǎo de shǒu jī dì tú le dàn shì gǔ gē suǒ yǒu de fú wù dōu bù néng zài zhōng guó shǐ yòng rú guǒ nǐ yòng de shì píng guǒ shǒu jī nà jiù bǐ jiào fāng biàn le píng guǒ dì tú zài zhōng guó yě kě yǐ yùn xíng zhōng guó rén zì jǐ yòng de zuì duō de shì bǎi dù dì tú hé gāo dé dì tú zhè liǎng gè dì tú ruǎn jiàn dōu hěn bú cuò wèn tí shì tā men dōu zhǐ yǒu zhōng wén duì wài guó rén lái shuō yào kàn dǒng kě bú shì yí jiàn róng yì de shì — Google Maps may be the best phone map. But none of Google’s services can be used in China. If you use an Apple phone it is more convenient: Apple Maps also works in China. The ones Chinese people use most are Baidu Maps and Gaode Maps. Both are very good; the problem is that they are only in Chinese. For foreigners, reading and understanding them is not an easy thing. (mine; the book writes “谷歌地图(Google Map)”; I left out the English in brackets)

lessons.title: 563. Lesson 22 Presentation 3: Beijing Capital International Airport
lessons.subtitle: 首都国际机场 · 位于东北郊 · 三号航站楼 · 一层到四层 · 巴士线路 地铁专线

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. What are the main facilities you can find in an airport? B. What are some modes of transportation in use today? C. Watch the promo of Beijing Capital International Airport. (Two photographs and the video are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 首都国际机场
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters; the numbers are spelled out in the Chinese text as the book does. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 首都国际机场位于北京市东北郊，离北京市中心二十五公里左右，是中国最大、最繁忙的机场。它每周有一万多个航班，仅次于美国的亚特兰大机场。
examples.translation: shǒu dū guó jì jī chǎng wèi yú běi jīng shì dōng běi jiāo lí běi jīng shì zhōng xīn èr shí wǔ gōng lǐ zuǒ yòu shì zhōng guó zuì dà zuì fán máng de jī chǎng tā měi zhōu yǒu yí wàn duō gè háng bān jǐn cì yú měi guó de yà tè lán dà jī chǎng — Capital International Airport is located in the northeast suburbs of Beijing, about 25 kilometers from the center of Beijing, and is the largest and busiest airport in China. It has more than 10,000 flights a week, second only to Atlanta’s airport in the United States. (translation mine)

examples.text: 首都机场有三个航站楼，最新建成的三号航站楼有地上四层，地下两层。主楼一层是国际出发大厅，这里有行李托运处、国际候机厅、海关和上百个登机口。大厅外停着很多接送旅客的出租汽车和机场巴士。二层是旅客到达大厅和行李提取大厅；三层为国内旅客出发大厅和地铁站台，从北京市区出发的地铁机场专线就直接开到这里；四层是餐饮区，这里有中西餐厅、酒吧、商场等各种服务设施。在航站楼各处都有服务台、自动提款机和外币兑换机。
examples.translation: shǒu dū jī chǎng yǒu sān gè háng zhàn lóu zuì xīn jiàn chéng de sān hào háng zhàn lóu yǒu dì shàng sì céng dì xià liǎng céng zhǔ lóu yì céng shì guó jì chū fā dà tīng zhè lǐ yǒu xíng li tuō yùn chù guó jì hòu jī tīng hǎi guān hé shàng bǎi gè dēng jī kǒu dà tīng wài tíng zhe hěn duō jiē sòng lǚ kè de chū zū qì chē hé jī chǎng bā shì èr céng shì lǚ kè dào dá dà tīng hé xíng li tí qǔ dà tīng sān céng wéi guó nèi lǚ kè chū fā dà tīng hé dì tiě zhàn tái cóng běi jīng shì qū chū fā de dì tiě jī chǎng zhuān xiàn jiù zhí jiē kāi dào zhè lǐ sì céng shì cān yǐn qū zhè lǐ yǒu zhōng xī cān tīng jiǔ bā shāng chǎng děng gè zhǒng fú wù shè shī zài háng zhàn lóu gè chù dōu yǒu fú wù tái zì dòng tí kuǎn jī hé wài bì duì huàn jī — Capital Airport has three terminals; the newest, Terminal 3, has four floors above ground and two below. The first floor of the main building is the international departure hall, which has the baggage check-in (consignment) counters, the international departure lounge, customs and up to a hundred boarding gates. Outside the hall many taxis and airport buses stand picking up and dropping off passengers. The second floor is the arrival hall and baggage claim hall; the third floor is the domestic departure hall and the subway platform, to which the dedicated airport subway line from the city directly runs; the fourth floor is the dining area, with Chinese and Western restaurants, bars, shopping malls and all kinds of service facilities. Throughout the terminal there are service desks, ATMs and foreign-currency exchange machines. (mine)

examples.text: 首都机场有十八条巴士线路开往北京市区和近郊地区，交通十分方便。另外，还有一条地铁专线往返于市区东直门和首都机场之间。
examples.translation: shǒu dū jī chǎng yǒu shí bā tiáo bā shì xiàn lù kāi wǎng běi jīng shì qū hé jìn jiāo dì qū jiāo tōng shí fēn fāng biàn lìng wài hái yǒu yì tiáo dì tiě zhuān xiàn wǎng fǎn yú shì qū dōng zhí mén hé shǒu dū jī chǎng zhī jiān — Capital Airport has eighteen bus lines going to the Beijing urban area and the nearby suburbs, so transportation is very convenient. In addition, there is a dedicated subway line running back and forth between Dongzhimen in the city and Capital Airport. (mine)

lessons.title: 565. Lesson 22 Presentation 3 grammar: simple explanatory text
lessons.subtitle: 我家的房子 · 楼下 楼上 · 旁边 对面 中间 · 后边 前边 · 空间顺序

explanations.title: Simple Explanatory Text
explanations.body: An explanatory text is a type of non-fiction text that explains a process (for example, how something works or why something happens). Activity 1 (Reading): Read the space-oriented explanatory passage 我家的房子 and answer the questions: 1. What’s the structure of the passage? 2. What’s the specific order of the content part? 3. Highlight the main spatial transfer words in the passage. My answers: 1. A general statement first (my hometown, the house has two floors and is beautiful) and then the details, floor by floor and then outside. 2. From the inside to the outside and from the bottom to the top: downstairs (living room, kitchen, study), upstairs (three bedrooms, left, right, middle), basement and garage, the yard behind, the garden in front. 3. 楼下, 旁边, 对面, 楼上, 左边, 右边, 中间, 后边, 前边, 里边.

examples.text: 我的老家在纽约。我们家的房子有两层楼，非常漂亮。楼下有一个大客厅。客厅旁边是厨房，对面是书房。楼上有三个卧室。我父母的卧室在左边，妹妹的卧室在右边，中间那个小一点儿的是我的。我们家还有一个地下室和一个车库。房子后边有一个大院子，院子里有两棵苹果树。房子前边有一个小花园，里边种着很多花。
examples.translation: wǒ de lǎo jiā zài niǔ yuē wǒ men jiā de fáng zi yǒu liǎng céng lóu fēi cháng piào liàng lóu xià yǒu yí gè dà kè tīng kè tīng páng biān shì chú fáng duì miàn shì shū fáng lóu shàng yǒu sān gè wò shì wǒ fù mǔ de wò shì zài zuǒ biān mèi mèi de wò shì zài yòu biān zhōng jiān nà ge xiǎo yì diǎnr de shì wǒ de wǒ men jiā hái yǒu yí gè dì xià shì hé yí gè chē kù fáng zi hòu biān yǒu yí gè dà yuàn zi yuàn zi lǐ yǒu liǎng kē píng guǒ shù fáng zi qián biān yǒu yí gè xiǎo huā yuán lǐ biān zhòng zhe hěn duō huā — My hometown is New York. Our house has two floors and is very beautiful. Downstairs there is a big living room. Next to the living room is the kitchen, and opposite is the study. Upstairs there are three bedrooms. My parents’ bedroom is on the left, my sister’s bedroom is on the right, and the smaller one in the middle is mine. Our house also has a basement and a garage. Behind the house is a big yard with two apple trees in it. In front of the house is a small garden with many flowers planted in it. (translation mine)

After reading the passage, draw a layout of the airport terminal in your notebook (the book gives a three-level frame: 三楼, 二楼到达大厅, 一楼迎宾大厅), and note any additional information. When you are done, discuss the passage with your group to ensure you understand it thoroughly. B. Pair up with a student from the other group. examples.text: 上海浦东国际机场是中国最大的国际机场之一，离上海市中心三十公里。浦东机场的候机楼有三层楼。一楼是迎宾大厅，二楼是到达大厅，三楼是出发大厅。走进迎宾大厅，你可以看到国际行李提取处在一楼的左边，国内行李提取处在一楼的右边。从一楼走上二楼去，在到达大厅，你可以看到国内到达通道在大厅的右边，国际到达通道在大厅的左边。走上三楼去，你可以看到左边是国内登机服务处，右边是国际登机服务处。中间是医疗急救服务处。出发大厅的两边都有邮局、餐厅和商店等服务设施。

Going up to the third floor you can see the domestic check-in service on the left and the international one on the right. In the middle is the medical emergency service. On both sides of the departure hall there are service facilities such as a post office, restaurants and shops. explanations.title: China’s Tourism (1): outbound tourism
explanations.body: China tourism has seen unprecedented development in recent years due to the sustainable economic growth and the great improvement in Chinese people’s living standards and consumption level. Outbound Tourism: In the past ten years, China’s outbound tourism has maintained a double-digit growth, and China has become the world’s largest source of outbound tourists since 2013. In the year of 2018, there were 149.72 million outbound trips, which created a tremendous market for foreign countries. The hottest destinations include South Korea, Japan, Thailand, France, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, USA, Singapore and Maldives. According to the statistics of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism of China, less than 5 out of 100 mainland residents travel abroad, which indicates the great potential of the overseas tourism market. Based on China’s huge population, a further and sustained growth of outbound visitors is expected.

explanations.title: (2) Domestic tourism
explanations.body: Chinese domestic tourism keeps expanding steadily. In 2018, there were 5,539 million domestic tourist trips. As an important element of China’s tourist market, the domestic market benefits a lot from the large population. In the recent decades, domestic traveling greatly enhances the employment, consumption and economic development of the country. Currently, the most popular destinations for domestic travelers include Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Xi’an, Guilin, Hangzhou, Sanya, Lhasa, Chengdu, Lijiang, Hong Kong, and Macau. The visitor quantity soars to amazing numbers during the peak seasons, especially the two golden weeks (the National Day Holiday and the Chinese New Year). In the seven days of the National Day Holiday in 2019, the country received a total of 802 million domestic tourists, and the domestic tourism revenue reached ¥649.71 billion. Associated with this prosperity might be the problems of traffic and the tourist service capacity, so foreigners who plan a visit to China should try to avoid these rush periods.

explanations.title: (3) Inbound tourism and the top 20 destinations
explanations.body: Inbound Tourism: China is a vast land rich in tourism resources. The country’s wide variety of terrain and climate shape numerous natural attractions. On top of that, her long history, resplendent culture and distinctive customs are always appealing to foreign visitors. China has steadily been the fourth largest international travel destination, after France, Spain, and the United States. The inbound tourism trips rocketed to an impressive 141.2 million in the year of 2018. The top 20 destinations in China for overseas tourists: 1. Hong Kong 2. Shanghai 3. Beijing 4. Macau 5. Guangzhou 6. Shenzhen 7. Sanya 8. Xi’an 9. Hangzhou 10. Chengdu 11. Qingdao 12. Dalian 13. Xiamen 14. Zhuhai 15. Nanjing 16. Haikou 17. Guilin 18. Suzhou 19. Chongqing 20. Tianjin. Some of these destinations are renowned for their glorious history, boast picturesque landscapes, are endowed with very colorful ethnic features or are economically prosperous (the Forbidden City, the Li River, Shanghai and Inner Mongolia are shown in photographs, not included). In 1995, the World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) predicted that by 2020 China would be the fourth largest market in the world (UNWTO Tourism 2020 Vision). China will have reached this target well before 2020 and there is still great potential for China’s inbound tourism. Source: Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People’s Republic of China.

explanations.body: Lesson 23 topic: Studying in China. Tasks and functions: discuss the experience of learning Chinese; describe work and life in China; narrate life and studying in China. Grammar: 对…来说 vs. 对; the adverb 刚 (at first); the verbal phrase as subject; Verb + 着 + Verb + 着; the use of 每 as a demonstrative; the use of 的 (a soothing tone); the adverbs 差不多, 左右, 大约, 大概; the phrase 和…相比; 尽管…, 可是…; the expression …极了; the existence of 有 and 是; simple compound-complex sentences 多重复句. Area Studies: International Students in China. Upon completion of this lesson you will be able to: discuss the experience of learning Chinese; describe work and life in China via email; describe living and studying in China.

examples.text: 主持人：大卫，琳达，你们中文学得都不错，今天请你们来和我们交流一下学中文的体会。大卫，你先说吧。
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén dà wèi lín dá nǐ men zhōng wén xué de dōu bú cuò jīn tiān qǐng nǐ men lái hé wǒ men jiāo liú yí xià xué zhōng wén de tǐ huì dà wèi nǐ xiān shuō ba — David, Linda, you both do well in Chinese. Today we have invited you to share your experience of learning Chinese. David, you go first. (translation mine)

examples.text: 大卫：我觉得学好中文，兴趣最重要。我从小就对中国文化感兴趣，喜欢看中国的功夫片，所以我特别喜欢学中文。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ jué de xué hǎo zhōng wén xìng qù zuì zhòng yào wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù duì zhōng guó wén huà gǎn xìng qù xǐ huān kàn zhòng guó de gōng fū piàn suǒ yǐ wǒ tè bié xǐ huān xué zhōng wén — I think interest is the most important thing in learning Chinese well. Since I was little I have been interested in Chinese culture and liked watching Chinese kung fu movies, so I especially like learning Chinese.

examples.text: 主持人：对很多人来说，中文是世界上最难学的语言，你觉得呢？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén duì hěn duō rén lái shuō zhōng wén shì shì jiè shàng zuì nán xué de yǔ yán nǐ jué de ne — For many people Chinese is the hardest language in the world to learn. What do you think?

examples.text: 大卫：刚开始是有点儿难，可是我很有兴趣，就不觉得那么难了，而且越学越爱学。
examples.translation: dà wèi gāng kāi shǐ shì yǒu diǎnr nán kě shì wǒ hěn yǒu xìng qù jiù bù jué de nà me nán le ér qiě yuè xué yuè ài xué — At the beginning it was a bit hard, but I was very interested, so I didn’t find it so hard, and the more I learned the more I loved learning.

examples.text: 主持人：琳达，你的中文说得非常好，一定也有很多学习体会吧？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén lín dá nǐ de zhōng wén shuō de fēi cháng hǎo yí dìng yě yǒu hěn duō xué xí tǐ huì ba — Linda, you speak very good Chinese; you must have a lot of learning experience too?

examples.text: 琳达：我觉得多说多练很重要。一开始就主动和中国人说中文，说不好，说不多都没关系，慢慢地你的中文表达能力就提高了。
examples.translation: lín dá wǒ jué de duō shuō duō liàn hěn zhòng yào yì kāi shǐ jiù zhǔ dòng hé zhōng guó rén shuō zhōng wén shuō bù hǎo shuō bù duō dōu méi guān xì màn màn de nǐ de zhōng wén biǎo dá néng lì jiù tí gāo le — I think speaking and practicing a lot is important. Speak Chinese with Chinese people on your own initiative from the start; it doesn’t matter if you can’t speak well or much, and slowly your Chinese expression ability will improve.

examples.text: 大卫：我觉得经常看真实语料，对学中文最有帮助。我常常看电影、新闻、综艺节目什么的。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ jué de jīng cháng kàn zhēn shí yǔ liào duì xué zhōng wén zuì yǒu bāng zhù wǒ cháng cháng kàn diàn yǐng xīn wén zōng yì jié mù shén me de — I think often watching authentic materials helps the most in learning Chinese. I often watch movies, news, variety shows and so on.

examples.text: 主持人：真实语料很难，你能看得懂吗？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén zhēn shí yǔ liào hěn nán nǐ néng kàn de dǒng ma — Authentic materials are hard; can you understand them?

examples.text: 大卫：看不懂时我就看字幕，看着看着，也就看懂了。
examples.translation: dà wèi kàn bù dǒng shí wǒ jiù kàn zì mù kàn zhe kàn zhe yě jiù kàn dǒng le — When I can’t understand, I read the subtitles, and as I watch, I come to understand.

examples.text: 琳达：我再说一点，就是要常常学习别人的好方法。前两天，我在网上看到了一位美国老大爷谈学习中文的经验，讲得很好。
examples.translation: lín dá wǒ zài shuō yì diǎn jiù shì yào cháng cháng xué xí bié rén de hǎo fāng fǎ qián liǎng tiān wǒ zài wǎng shàng kàn dào le yí wèi měi guó lǎo dà yé tán xué xí zhōng wén de jīng yàn jiǎng de hěn hǎo — Let me add one more point: you should often learn from other people’s good methods. A couple of days ago I saw online an old American man talking about his experience of learning Chinese, and he spoke very well.

examples.text: 大卫：对，我也看过，他一共讲了七条经验，我都试了一下，效果还不错。
examples.translation: dà wèi duì wǒ yě kàn guò tā yí gòng jiǎng le qī tiáo jīng yàn wǒ dōu shì le yí xià xiào guǒ hái bú cuò — Yes, I watched it too. He gave seven pieces of advice in all; I tried them all and the results were quite good.

examples.text: 主持人：你们今天讲得都很好，希望能对学中文的朋友有一些帮助。谢谢你们。
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén nǐ men jīn tiān jiǎng de dōu hěn hǎo xī wàng néng duì xué zhōng wén de péng yǒu yǒu yì xiē bāng zhù xiè xiè nǐ men — You both spoke very well today, and I hope it will help friends who are learning Chinese. Thank you.

What has David been interested in since he was little?

lessons.title: 571. Lesson 23 Presentation 1 activities: the table, word comparisons and word choice
lessons.subtitle: Activities 1 to 5 · 体会 体验 经验 · 效果 结果 · 表达 表示 · 方法 办法 · 希望 愿望

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 1 and answer: 1. What is the relationship between the three speakers? (a host and two guests, David and Linda) 2. What are they talking about? (their experience of learning Chinese). B. Detailed listening: listen again and, in the table (怎么才能学好中文, 关于真实语料, 关于美国老大爷; columns 大卫, 琳达, 他们怎么做的, 其他信息), write what David and Linda said (from the text: David: interest; authentic materials and subtitles; he tried the old man’s seven tips with good results. Linda: speak and practice a lot, take the initiative; learn from other people’s methods). C. Pair up, discuss and share. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Dialog 1: A. Listen and answer: 1. What did the two speakers chiefly discuss? 2. What does Peter say at the beginning about learning Chinese? How does he support his view? 3. What are Lisa’s concerns about learning Chinese? 4. What does Peter say in response? B. Pair up and discuss. C. Conduct the same conversation with your partner. Dialog 2: D. Listen and answer: 1. What is the main idea of this audio? 2. List at least three details about Anna’s speaking Chinese. 3. What are the benefits of Anna’s methods? E. Pair up and discuss. F. Conduct the same conversation, discussing how to improve speaking. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): 词汇对比
explanations.body: A. Pair up and compare the provided words. Discuss their differences with your partner. Decide which words will best complete the sentences and provide your reasons: 1. 体会, 体验, 经验 2. 效果, 结果 3. 表达, 表示 4. 方法, 办法 5. 希望, 愿望. B. Report your work to the class and request feedback. The book gives the blanks without a key; my notes and completed sentences:

rows: insight gained from experience; 学中文的体会
to experience firsthand; 体验中国人的生活
accumulated experience; 有经验的老师
effect, result of a method; 学习效果
outcome, result of an event or exam; 考试的结果
to express (thoughts, feelings in words); 表达能力
to show, to mean; 表示爱, 表示什么意思
method, way of doing; 学习方法
way out, means to solve a problem; 想办法
to hope (verb or noun); 希望你来
tables.title: Activity 3: comparing the five word groups (the book asks you to discuss; my notes)

examples.text: 比尔在中国住了一年多，对中国文化和中国人的生活有了很多体验。
examples.translation: bǐ ěr zài zhōng guó zhù le yì nián duō duì zhōng guó wén huà hé zhōng guó rén de shēng huó yǒu le hěn duō tǐ yàn — 1a. Bill has lived in China for more than a year and has had many experiences of Chinese culture and the life of Chinese people. (key mine: 体验; 体会 would also be possible)

examples.text: 大卫已经学了一年的中文，他会跟你谈谈他学中文的体会。
examples.translation: dà wèi yǐ jīng xué le yì nián de zhōng wén tā huì gēn nǐ tán tán tā xué zhōng wén de tǐ huì — 1b. David has studied Chinese for a year and will talk with you about his insights into learning Chinese. (体会)

examples.text: 高老师是一个非常有经验的老师，她教中文已经教了二十多年了。
examples.translation: gāo lǎo shī shì yí gè fēi cháng yǒu jīng yàn de lǎo shī tā jiāo zhōng wén yǐ jīng jiāo le èr shí duō nián le — 1c. Teacher Gao is a very experienced teacher; she has been teaching Chinese for more than twenty years. (经验)

examples.text: 我用了琳达介绍的学习方法后，我的学习效果提高了很多。
examples.translation: wǒ yòng le lín dá jiè shào de xué xí fāng fǎ hòu wǒ de xué xí xiào guǒ tí gāo le hěn duō — 2a. After using the learning method Linda introduced, my learning results have improved a lot. (效果)

examples.text: 期中考试的结果出来了。我考得不太好。
examples.translation: qī zhōng kǎo shì de jié guǒ chū lái le wǒ kǎo de bú tài hǎo — 2b. The mid-term exam results are out. I didn’t do very well. (结果)

examples.text: 他常常给父母打电话或是发短信来表达对他们的爱。
examples.translation: tā cháng cháng gěi fù mǔ dǎ diàn huà huò shì fā duǎn xìn lái biǎo dá duì tā men de ài — 3a. He often phones or texts his parents to express his love for them. (表达)

examples.text: 你知道这句话表示什么意思吗？
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào zhè jù huà biǎo shì shén me yì si ma — 3b. Do you know what this sentence means? (表示)

examples.text: 那个美国老人介绍了很多学中文的好方法，我打算试一下。
examples.translation: nà ge měi guó lǎo rén jiè shào le hěn duō xué zhōng wén de hǎo fāng fǎ wǒ dǎ suàn shì yí xià — 4a. That old American man introduced many good methods of learning Chinese and I plan to try them. (方法)

examples.text: 你知道有什么办法能让学生们都喜欢学中文吗？
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào yǒu shén me bàn fǎ néng ràng xué shēng men dōu xǐ huān xué zhōng wén ma — 4b. Do you know any way to make all students like learning Chinese? (办法)

examples.text: 我希望下个月能在蒙特雷见到我的父母。
examples.translation: wǒ xī wàng xià gè yuè néng zài méng tè léi jiàn dào wǒ de fù mǔ — 5a. I hope to see my parents in Monterey next month. (希望)

examples.text: 快过年了。你新年的愿望是什么？
examples.translation: kuài guò nián le nǐ xīn nián de yuàn wàng shì shén me — 5b. The New Year is coming. What is your New Year’s wish? (愿望)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the following words: 交流, 主动, 提高, 能力, 字幕, 真实语料, 综艺节目, 新闻. B. Pair up and check your work with that of your partner; then take turns reading each sentence aloud and translating it into English. The completed sentences (key mine):

examples.text: 我喜欢看中国电影来学中文，看不懂时，就看一下字幕。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān kàn zhòng guó diàn yǐng lái xué zhōng wén kàn bù dǒng shí jiù kàn yí xià zì mù — 1. I like to watch Chinese movies to learn Chinese; when I can’t understand, I look at the subtitles. (key mine: 字幕)

examples.text: 近几年中国有很多搞笑的综艺节目，非常有意思，我很爱看。
examples.translation: jìn jǐ nián zhōng guó yǒu hěn duō gǎo xiào de zōng yì jié mù fēi cháng yǒu yì si wǒ hěn ài kàn — 2. In recent years China has had many funny variety shows; they are very interesting and I love watching them. (综艺节目)

examples.text: 想学好中文，应该多和老师和同学交流一下学习方法。
examples.translation: xiǎng xué hǎo zhōng wén yīng gāi duō hé lǎo shī hé tóng xué jiāo liú yí xià xué xí fāng fǎ — 3. If you want to learn Chinese well, you should talk with teachers and classmates about learning methods. (交流)

examples.text: 李军每天起床后一定得看新闻，想了解世界上发生了什么事。
examples.translation: lǐ jūn měi tiān qǐ chuáng hòu yí dìng děi kàn xīn wén xiǎng liǎo jiě shì jiè shàng fā shēng le shén me shì — 4. Li Jun has to watch the news every day after getting up; he wants to know what is happening in the world. (新闻)

examples.text: 保罗的中文非常好，也很热心，常常主动帮助其他同学。
examples.translation: bǎo luó de zhōng wén fēi cháng hǎo yě hěn rè xīn cháng cháng zhǔ dòng bāng zhù qí tā tóng xué — 5. Paul’s Chinese is very good and he is warmhearted; he often volunteers to help other students. (主动)

examples.text: 我最近说话能力比以前强了很多，因为我天天都练说话。
examples.translation: wǒ zuì jìn shuō huà néng lì bǐ yǐ qián qiáng le hěn duō yīn wèi wǒ tiān tiān dōu liàn shuō huà — 6. My speaking ability has become much stronger than before recently, because I practice speaking every day. (能力)

examples.text: 每天上课，老师都给我们听一个真实语料来训练我们的听力。
examples.translation: měi tiān shàng kè lǎo shī dōu gěi wǒ men tīng yí gè zhēn shí yǔ liào lái xùn liàn wǒ men de tīng lì — 7. Every class the teacher has us listen to one piece of authentic material to train our listening. (真实语料)

examples.text: 由于我每天都听中文，我的听力水平有了很大的提高。
examples.translation: yóu yú wǒ měi tiān dōu tīng zhōng wén wǒ de tīng lì shuǐ píng yǒu le hěn dà de tí gāo — 8. Because I listen to Chinese every day, my listening level has improved greatly. (提高)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and ask each other “对你来说，什么最难学？” Give advice using the patterns “越学越爱学”, “看着看着，也就看懂了” or “多说多练”, etc. Each partner asks at least three questions. Write your questions, your partner’s responses and your suggestions in the table. The book’s example: A: 对你来说，学中文什么最难学？ B: 对我来说，听力最难学。 A: 你应该多听真实语料，你的听力就会提高。 B. Report your partner’s responses and your suggestions to the class.
