lessons.title: 604. Lesson 24 Grammar and Usage Review: translating wise sayings and complex sentences
lessons.subtitle: 读书使人更有智慧 · 被称为银行家 · 到达终点 · 不但…而且… · 虽然 · 尽管…但…

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Translate the following sentences into English, using your dictionary when necessary. Compare your work with that of a classmate. The English is mine.

examples.text: 读书使人更有智慧。
examples.translation: dú shū shǐ rén gèng yǒu zhì huì — 1. Reading makes people wiser. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 年轻时，我被叫做赌徒，现在我被称为银行家，但我一直在做同样的工作。
examples.translation: nián qīng shí wǒ bèi jiào zuò dǔ tú xiàn zài wǒ bèi chēng wéi yín háng jiā dàn wǒ yì zhí zài zuò tóng yàng de gōng zuò — 2. When I was young I was called a gambler; now I am called a banker, but I have always been doing the same work.

examples.text: 社会应该让富人、勤快人和聪明人都能同时到达终点，才是公平的。
examples.translation: shè huì yīng gāi ràng fù rén qín kuài rén hé cōng míng rén dōu néng tóng shí dào dá zhōng diǎn cái shì gōng píng de — 3. Society should let the rich, the diligent and the clever all reach the finish line at the same time; only then is it fair.

examples.text: 我心中的欢乐不是我自己的，我把欢乐写进音乐，是为了让全世界都感到欢乐。
examples.translation: wǒ xīn zhōng de huān lè bú shì wǒ zì jǐ de wǒ bǎ huān lè xiě jìn yīn yuè shì wèi le ràng quán shì jiè dōu gǎn dào huān lè — 4. The joy in my heart is not mine alone; I write joy into music in order to let the whole world feel joy.

explanations.title: Activity 10 (Reading)
explanations.body: Use your own words to explain the relationship between the clauses in each complex sentence. The book gives no key; my answers:

examples.text: 越来越多的人去看中医，有的人是因为中药不但副作用小，而且价钱也比较便宜，还有的人是想试试新的治疗方法。
examples.translation: yuè lái yuè duō de rén qù kàn zhòng yī yǒu de rén shì yīn wèi zhōng yào bú dàn fù zuò yòng xiǎo ér qiě jià qián yě bǐ jiào pián yi hái yǒu de rén shì xiǎng shì shì xīn de zhì liáo fāng fǎ — 1. 有的人…，还有的人… are parallel reasons; inside the first reason 因为 gives a cause and 不但…而且… is progressive. (my answers in this card)

examples.text: 北京是美丽的，我知道，因为我不但是北京人，而且到过欧美，看见过很多西方的名城。
examples.translation: běi jīng shì měi lì de wǒ zhī dào yīn wèi wǒ bú dàn shì běi jīng rén ér qiě dào guò ōu měi kàn jiàn guò hěn duō xī fāng de míng chéng — 2. 因为 gives the cause of “I know”; 不但…而且… adds a second reason, a progressive link.

examples.text: 地方那么大，事情那么多，我知道的真是太少了，虽然我就出生在那里，一直到二十多岁才离开。
examples.translation: dì fāng nà me dà shì qíng nà me duō wǒ zhī dào de zhēn shì tài shǎo le suī rán wǒ jiù chū shēng zài nà lǐ yì zhí dào èr shí duō suì cái lí kāi — 3. The first two clauses are parallel and lead to the result “I know too little”; 虽然… is a concession placed after the main clause: although I was born there and left only after twenty.

examples.text: 这个培训很受欢迎，参加的人非常多，不但有本校的学生，还有外校的学生，甚至还有外国学生。
examples.translation: zhè ge péi xùn hěn shòu huān yíng cān jiā de rén fēi cháng duō bú dàn yǒu běn xiào de xué shēng hái yǒu wài xiào de xué shēng shèn zhì hái yǒu wài guó xué shēng — 4. The first clause is the cause and the second the result; 不但…还…甚至还… is a progressive series, each one going further.

examples.text: 我想回到我自己的家里去，尽管它简陋，尽管它破旧，但在那里我是自由的。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng huí dào wǒ zì jǐ de jiā lǐ qù jǐn guǎn tā jiǎn lòu jǐn guǎn tā pò jiù dàn zài nà lǐ wǒ shì zì yóu de — 5. 尽管…，尽管…，但… is a transition: although the home is simple and shabby, there I am free.

exercises.prompt: What does 读书使人更有智慧 mean?
In sentence 2, what has stayed the same?
What does the sentence about fairness say?
options: Everyone should reach the finish line together

exercises.prompt: Why does the speaker write joy into music?
options: To let the whole world feel joy
exercises.explanation: 为了让全世界都感到欢乐.

exercises.prompt: What kind of link is 不但…而且…?
What kind of link is 尽管…但…?
What kind of link is 因为…?
In 越来越多的人去看中医, how many reasons are given?
exercises.explanation: 价钱便宜, 副作用小, 想试新方法 (the first has two parts).

exercises.prompt: 年轻时，我___叫做赌徒，现在我被称为银行家。
我想回到我自己的家里去，尽___它简陋，但在那里我是自由的。

units.title: 第二十四课 Unit 4 review: skills integration review, part 1

lessons.title: 605. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: Jack asks about the high-speed train
lessons.subtitle: 坐飞机还是坐高铁 · 北京到上海 · 座位 票价 · 订票 · 服务 设施

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog once and answer the questions: 1. What’s the male speaker’s plan? 2. Is he familiar with China? How do you know? 3. What is his concern? 4. What do you think he will do tonight? (audio and four pictures, not included) B. Listen to the dialog again and complete the table with details about high-speed trains in China. Write your answers in Pinyin or Chinese characters. Then share your answers with your partners in groups of three. C. Read the script together and check your answers. D. If anyone in class has travelled by train, they should share their experience with the class.

rows: 飞机快一些；加上去机场和安检，时间差不多；高铁站在市区，车次多
北京到上海需要的时间
最快四个半小时，最慢不超过六个小时
一等座，二等座，商务座，特等座；一等座二等座分硬座和软座
一等座二等座便宜一些，商务座特等座稍微贵一些
高铁网上订票；下载订票应用软件，在手机上订；订票需要护照号码
跟飞机差不多，一流；服务员有礼貌，热情；有餐车和售货车
宽敞舒适的座位；无线上网；每节车厢有热水器；卫生间干净
tables.title: Activity 1B: the table about China’s high-speed trains (the book leaves it blank; the contents are mine, from the script)

explanations.title: Script: 杰克问高铁
explanations.body: The book writes the numbers in digits; here they are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 杰克：张华，五一长假的时候，我想去上海玩几天。你觉得我是坐飞机呢还是坐高铁？
examples.translation: jié kè zhāng huá wǔ yī cháng jià de shí hòu wǒ xiǎng qù shàng hǎi wán jǐ tiān nǐ jué de wǒ shì zuò fēi jī ne hái shì zuò gāo tiě — Jack: Zhang Hua, during the May Day holiday I want to go to Shanghai for a few days. Do you think I should fly or take the high-speed train?

examples.text: 张华：一般来说，坐飞机快一些。但是加上去机场和安检，时间和坐高铁差不多。另外，高铁站都在市区，车次也多，非常方便。所以很多中国人更喜欢坐高铁。
examples.translation: zhāng huá yì bān lái shuō zuò fēi jī kuài yì xiē dàn shì jiā shàng qù jī chǎng hé ān jiǎn shí jiān hé zuò gāo tiě chà bu duō lìng wài gāo tiě zhàn dōu zài shì qū chē cì yě duō fēi cháng fāng biàn suǒ yǐ hěn duō zhōng guó rén gèng xǐ huān zuò gāo tiě — Zhang Hua: Generally speaking, flying is a bit faster. But once you add the trip to the airport and the security check, the time is about the same as the high-speed train. Besides, high-speed train stations are all in the city and there are more trains, so it is very convenient. So many Chinese people prefer the high-speed train.

examples.text: 杰克：这样啊，那我得坐坐高铁了。对了，从北京坐高铁到上海需要几个小时？
examples.translation: jié kè zhè yàng a nà wǒ děi zuò zuò gāo tiě le duì le cóng běi jīng zuò gāo tiě dào shàng hǎi xū yào jǐ gè xiǎo shí — Jack: I see, then I have to try the high-speed train. By the way, how many hours does it take from Beijing to Shanghai?

examples.text: 张华：从北京到上海最快只要四个半小时，最慢也不超过六个小时。
examples.translation: zhāng huá cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi zuì kuài zhǐ yào sì gè bàn xiǎo shí zuì màn yě bù chāo guò liù gè xiǎo shí — Zhang Hua: From Beijing to Shanghai it takes only four and a half hours at the fastest and no more than six hours at the slowest.

examples.text: 杰克：那么快啊？坐在车上稳不稳呢？我有点担心安全。
examples.translation: jié kè nà me kuài a zuò zài chē shàng wěn bù wěn ne wǒ yǒu diǎn dān xīn ān quán — Jack: That fast? Is it steady sitting on the train? I am a bit worried about safety.

examples.text: 张华：中国的高铁非常安全，而且特别平稳。
examples.translation: zhāng huá zhōng guó de gāo tiě fēi cháng ān quán ér qiě tè bié píng wěn — Zhang Hua: China’s high-speed trains are very safe, and especially smooth.

examples.text: 杰克：高铁上有什么样的座位？
examples.translation: jié kè gāo tiě shàng yǒu shén me yàng de zuò wèi — Jack: What kinds of seats are there on the high-speed train?

examples.text: 张华：有一等座、二等座，还有商务座和特等座。一等座和二等座的座位又分硬座和软座。
examples.translation: zhāng huá yǒu yì děng zuò èr děng zuò hái yǒu shāng wù zuò hé tè děng zuò yì děng zuò hé èr děng zuò de zuò wèi yòu fēn yìng zuò hé ruǎn zuò — Zhang Hua: There are first class and second class, and also business class and premium class. The first- and second-class seats are further divided into hard seats and soft seats.

examples.text: 杰克：那票价贵不贵？
examples.translation: jié kè nà piào jià guì bú guì — Jack: Then are the tickets expensive?

examples.text: 张华：一等座、二等座的座位便宜一些，商务座和特等座稍微贵一些。
examples.translation: zhāng huá yì děng zuò èr děng zuò de zuò wèi pián yi yì xiē shāng wù zuò hé tè děng zuò shāo wēi guì yì xiē — Zhang Hua: First- and second-class seats are cheaper; business and premium class are somewhat more expensive.

examples.text: 杰克：我该怎么买票呢？去高铁站吗？
examples.translation: jié kè wǒ gāi zěn me mǎi piào ne qù gāo tiě zhàn ma — Jack: How should I buy a ticket? Do I go to the station?

examples.text: 张华：不用。现在买票特别容易，你可以在高铁网上订票，或是下载一个订票应用软件，在手机上就可以订。因为你是个老外，订票的时候还得需要你的护照号码。
examples.translation: zhāng huá bú yòng xiàn zài mǎi piào tè bié róng yì nǐ kě yǐ zài gāo tiě wǎng shàng dìng piào huò shì xià zài yí gè dìng piào yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn zài shǒu jī shàng jiù kě yǐ dìng yīn wèi nǐ shì gè lǎo wài dìng piào de shí hòu hái děi xū yào nǐ de hù zhào hào mǎ — Zhang Hua: No need. Buying tickets is especially easy now; you can book on the high-speed rail website, or download a booking app and book on your phone. Because you are a foreigner you will also need your passport number when booking.

examples.text: 杰克：高铁上的服务怎么样？
examples.translation: jié kè gāo tiě shàng de fú wù zěn me yàng — Jack: How is the service on the train?

examples.text: 张华：高铁上的服务跟飞机上的服务差不多一样，可以说是一流的。服务员特别有礼貌也很热情。另外，他们也有餐车和售货车服务，什么吃的、喝的都有。
examples.translation: zhāng huá gāo tiě shàng de fú wù gēn fēi jī shàng de fú wù chà bu duō yí yàng kě yǐ shuō shì yì liú de fú wù yuán tè bié yǒu lǐ mào yě hěn rè qíng lìng wài tā men yě yǒu cān chē hé shòu huò chē fú wù shén me chī de hē de dōu yǒu — Zhang Hua: The service on the train is about the same as on a plane; you could say it is first-rate. The attendants are especially polite and very friendly. Also there is a dining car and a sales cart, with every kind of food and drink.

examples.text: 杰克：他们的设施怎么样？
examples.translation: jié kè tā men de shè shī zěn me yàng — Jack: How are the facilities?

examples.text: 张华：高铁上的设施也非常先进。他们不仅有宽敞、舒适的座位，而且还可以无线上网。每节车厢都有热水器，卫生间也非常干净。
examples.translation: zhāng huá gāo tiě shàng de shè shī yě fēi cháng xiān jìn tā men bù jǐn yǒu kuān chǎng shū shì de zuò wèi ér qiě hái kě yǐ wú xiàn shàng wǎng měi jié chē xiāng dōu yǒu rè shuǐ qì wèi shēng jiān yě fēi cháng gān jìng — Zhang Hua: The facilities are also very advanced. They have not only spacious, comfortable seats but also wireless internet. Every car has a water heater and the toilets are very clean.

examples.text: 杰克：听你这么说，我都等不及要去体验一下了。今天晚上我就买票。
examples.translation: jié kè tīng nǐ zhè me shuō wǒ dōu děng bù jí yào qù tǐ yàn yí xià le jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ jiù mǎi piào — Jack: Hearing you say that, I can’t wait to try it. I’ll buy my ticket tonight.

exercises.prompt: When does Jack want to go to Shanghai?
Why do many Chinese prefer the high-speed train?
options: Stations are in the city, many trains, convenient
exercises.explanation: 高铁站都在市区，车次也多.

exercises.prompt: How long does the trip from Beijing to Shanghai take at the fastest?

exercises.explanation: 一等座，二等座，商务座，特等座.
一等座、二等座便宜一些.

exercises.prompt: Why does Jack need his passport number?
options: He is a foreigner booking a ticket
exercises.explanation: 你是个老外，订票的时候还得需要护照号码.

exercises.prompt: How is the service on the high-speed train?
options: About the same as on a plane, first-rate
Much worse than on a plane

exercises.explanation: 无线上网, 热水器, 卫生间.

exercises.prompt: When will Jack buy his ticket?
订票的时候___得需要你的护照号码。

lessons.title: 606. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: Mark sends a package to Los Angeles
lessons.subtitle: 普通包裹 特快专递 · 保险 · 包裹单 海关申报单 · 微信支付 · 电子收据

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog once and answer the questions. Share your answers with a partner. 1. Where does the conversation take place? 2. What does the first speaker want to do? 3. What method did the first speaker choose? 4. What’s the first speaker’s impression of the whole process? Why does he think so? B. Listen to the dialog again and choose the best answer for each of the seven multiple-choice questions (they are the exercises below). Then, share your answers with a partner. C. Read the script and compare it with the information you received. (Audio and picture, not included.)

explanations.title: Script: 马克在邮局
explanations.body: The book writes the amounts in digits (420, 186, 20 张 5 毛, 606, 10, 616); here they are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 马克：您好，我有个包裹要寄到洛杉矶给我的父母。
examples.translation: mǎ kè nín hǎo wǒ yǒu gè bāo guǒ yào jì dào luò shān jī gěi wǒ de fù mǔ — Mark: Hello, I have a package to send to my parents in Los Angeles.

examples.text: 营业员：你想怎么寄？寄普通包裹还是特快专递？
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán nǐ xiǎng zěn me jì jì pǔ tōng bāo guǒ hái shì tè kuài zhuān dì — Clerk: How do you want to send it? A regular package or express mail?

examples.text: 马克：普通包裹和特快专递有什么不同？
examples.translation: mǎ kè pǔ tōng bāo guǒ hé tè kuài zhuān dì yǒu shén me bù tóng — Mark: What is the difference between a regular package and express mail?

examples.text: 营业员：一般来说，特快专递比普通包裹贵得多，不过也快多了。特快专递一个星期就可以寄到，但是普通包裹得两三个星期。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán yì bān lái shuō tè kuài zhuān dì bǐ pǔ tōng bāo guǒ guì de duō bú guò yě kuài duō le tè kuài zhuān dì yí gè xīng qī jiù kě yǐ jì dào dàn shì pǔ tōng bāo guǒ děi liǎng sān gè xīng qī — Clerk: Generally speaking, express mail is much more expensive than a regular package, but also much faster. Express mail can arrive in a week, but a regular package takes two or three weeks.

examples.text: 马克：特快专递得多少钱？
examples.translation: mǎ kè tè kuài zhuān dì děi duō shǎo qián — Mark: How much does express mail cost?

examples.text: 营业员：要看你的包裹有多重？另外，还得看你寄什么东西，要不要买保险？
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán yào kàn nǐ de bāo guǒ yǒu duō zhòng lìng wài hái děi kàn nǐ jì shén me dōng xī yào bú yào mǎi bǎo xiǎn — Clerk: It depends on how heavy your package is. Also it depends on what you send and whether you want insurance.

examples.text: 马克：我给我父母买了一些中国的茶叶，一套茶具和两条围巾。
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ gěi wǒ fù mǔ mǎi le yì xiē zhōng guó de chá yè yí tào chá jù hé liǎng tiáo wéi jīn — Mark: I bought my parents some Chinese tea leaves, a tea set and two scarves.

examples.text: 营业员：来，先让我称一下你的包裹。看来茶具挺重的，你的包裹有点超重。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán lái xiān ràng wǒ chēng yí xià nǐ de bāo guǒ kàn lái chá jù tǐng zhòng de nǐ de bāo guǒ yǒu diǎn chāo zhòng — Clerk: Come, let me weigh your package first. It seems the tea set is quite heavy; your package is a bit overweight.

examples.text: 马克：特快专递的邮费是多少？
examples.translation: mǎ kè tè kuài zhuān dì de yóu fèi shì duō shǎo — Mark: How much is the postage for express mail?

examples.text: 营业员：按你包裹的重量，现在邮费是四百二十块。还有，因为茶具是易碎物品，我觉得你最好买个保险。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán àn nǐ bāo guǒ de zhòng liàng xiàn zài yóu fèi shì sì bǎi èr shí kuài hái yǒu yīn wèi chá jù shì yì suì wù pǐn wǒ jué de nǐ zuì hǎo mǎi gè bǎo xiǎn — Clerk: By the weight of your package, the postage is now 420 yuan. Also, because the tea set is a fragile item, I think you had better buy insurance.

examples.text: 马克：保险费是多少？
examples.translation: mǎ kè bǎo xiǎn fèi shì duō shǎo — Mark: How much is the insurance?

examples.text: 营业员：保险费差不多一百八十六块。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán bǎo xiǎn fèi chà bu duō yì bǎi bā shí liù kuài — Clerk: The insurance is about 186 yuan.

examples.text: 马克：我还需要买二十张五毛的邮票。一共多少钱？
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ hái xū yào mǎi èr shí zhāng wǔ máo de yóu piào yí gòng duō shǎo qián — Mark: I also need to buy twenty five-mao stamps. How much is it altogether?

examples.text: 营业员：邮费加上保险费一共六百零六块，再加上邮票十块，你得付六百一十六块。现在，请你先填一下包裹单和海关申报单。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán yóu fèi jiā shàng bǎo xiǎn fèi yí gòng liù bǎi líng liù kuài zài jiā shàng yóu piào shí kuài nǐ děi fù liù bǎi yī shí liù kuài xiàn zài qǐng nǐ xiān tián yí xià bāo guǒ dān hé hǎi guān shēn bào dān — Clerk: Postage plus insurance is 606 yuan altogether, plus 10 yuan for the stamps, so you have to pay 616 yuan. Now, please fill in the package form and the customs declaration form first.

examples.text: 马克：好的。对了，我怎么追踪我的包裹寄到哪儿了？
examples.translation: mǎ kè hǎo de duì le wǒ zěn me zhuī zōng wǒ de bāo guǒ jì dào nǎr le — Mark: OK. By the way, how do I track where my package has got to?

examples.text: 营业员：我们会给你一个代码，你只要用手机扫描一下，就可以看到包裹到什么地方了。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán wǒ men huì gěi nǐ yí gè dài mǎ nǐ zhǐ yào yòng shǒu jī sǎo miáo yí xià jiù kě yǐ kàn dào bāo guǒ dào shén me dì fāng le — Clerk: We will give you a code; just scan it with your phone and you can see where the package has got to.

examples.text: 马克：这倒是很方便。好了，包裹单填好了。我怎么付费？
examples.translation: mǎ kè zhè dǎo shì hěn fāng biàn hǎo le bāo guǒ dān tián hǎo le wǒ zěn me fù fèi — Mark: That is actually very convenient. All right, the package form is filled in. How do I pay?

examples.text: 营业员：你可以付现金，信用卡或是手机支付。手机支付最方便。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán nǐ kě yǐ fù xiàn jīn xìn yòng kǎ huò shì shǒu jī zhī fù shǒu jī zhī fù zuì fāng biàn — Clerk: You can pay cash, by credit card or by mobile payment. Mobile payment is the most convenient.

examples.text: 马克：好的，我用微信支付吧。可以给我一张收据吗？
examples.translation: mǎ kè hǎo de wǒ yòng wēi xìn zhī fù ba kě yǐ gěi wǒ yì zhāng shōu jù ma — Mark: OK, I’ll use WeChat Pay. Can you give me a receipt?

examples.text: 营业员：你不需要打印收据，在微信支付上你会看到一张电子收据，非常方便保存和查看。
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán nǐ bù xū yào dǎ yìn shōu jù zài wēi xìn zhī fù shàng nǐ huì kàn dào yì zhāng diàn zi shōu jù fēi cháng fāng biàn bǎo cún hé chá kàn — Clerk: You don’t need to print a receipt; in WeChat Pay you will see an electronic receipt, very convenient to save and look up.

examples.text: 马克：在中国寄包裹真是太容易了。谢谢你！
examples.translation: mǎ kè zài zhōng guó jì bāo guǒ zhēn shì tài róng yì le xiè xiè nǐ — Mark: Sending a package in China is really too easy. Thank you!

examples.text: 营业员：不客气。再见！
examples.translation: yíng yè yuán bú kè qì zài jiàn — Clerk: You’re welcome. Goodbye!

exercises.prompt: 1. Which of the following is NOT a difference between express and regular mail?
options: Express mail can be delivered within a week

exercises.prompt: 2. How is the postage for express mail calculated?
options: By whom you send it to
By the weight, the items and the insurance
By the number of items only
exercises.explanation: 要看你的包裹有多重，寄什么东西，要不要买保险.

exercises.prompt: 3. What is NOT in the package?
exercises.explanation: 茶叶, 茶具, 围巾.

exercises.prompt: 5. How much must Mark pay altogether?
6. What form does Mark need to fill out?
options: A customs claim form and a package form
A package form and a registered mail slip
A customs claim form and a return slip
A package form and a return slip

exercises.prompt: Where does the conversation take place?
How long does express mail take?
How does Mark track his package?
options: Scan a code with his phone

exercises.prompt: 特快专递比普通包裹贵___多。
你不需要打印收据，在微信支付上你会看到一张电子___据。

lessons.title: 607. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: Wang Wen sees Dr. Zhang
lessons.subtitle: 咳嗽 流鼻涕 发烧 · 量体温 听心脏 · 流感 肺炎 · 一天三次一次两片 · 药房 输液室

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the first part of the dialog and answer the questions: 1. What’s the first speaker asking about? 2. What did the first speaker do before she arrived? 3. According to the second speaker, what did the first speaker need to do? List three details. 4. What is said in the dialog about the doctor? List three details. (audio and pictures, not included) B. Share your answers with your partner. C. Listen to the second part of the dialog and decide whether the following statements are True or False. D. Listen to the conversation again and complete the table with details in Pinyin or Chinese characters. E. Share your answers in groups of three. F. Read the script and check if you have questions. Act out the dialog if time permits.

rows: 咳嗽，流鼻涕，发烧，口干，头晕，没有力气
量体温（三十九度），听心脏，量血压，看嗓子（肿了）
打一针；开药，一天三次，一次两片，用温开水服用
三天后要是还不好，验血、验尿、透视
最好在家休息，多喝热水，少动，不要外出，按时吃药
tables.title: Activity 3D: the table of the visit (the book leaves it blank; the contents are mine, from the script)

examples.text: 病人吃了一些自己买的药，感觉好多了。
examples.translation: bìng rén chī le yì xiē zì jǐ mǎi de yào gǎn jué hǎo duō le — 1. False: the patient took cold medicine for two days but started running a fever last night. (key mine)

examples.text: 病人早上量了体温，是三十八度五。
examples.translation: bìng rén zǎo shàng liáng le tǐ wēn shì sān shí bā dù wǔ — 2. False: 38.5 was last night; this morning he had not measured yet, and the doctor then found 39. (mine)

examples.text: 病人的心脏跳得有点快，但是血压很稳定。
examples.translation: bìng rén de xīn zàng tiào de yǒu diǎn kuài dàn shì xuè yā hěn wěn dìng — 3. True: the heart beats a bit fast but counts as normal, and the blood pressure is stable. (mine)

examples.text: 病人的病三天后会转成肺炎。
examples.translation: bìng rén de bìng sān tiān hòu huì zhuǎn chéng fèi yán — 4. False: the doctor only hopes it will not turn into pneumonia. (mine)

examples.text: 病人可以在一楼取药，二楼输液室打针。
examples.translation: bìng rén kě yǐ zài yì lóu qǔ yào èr lóu shū yè shì dǎ zhēn — 5. True: the pharmacy is in the first-floor hall and the injection is beside the second-floor infusion room. (mine)

explanations.title: Script: 看病
explanations.body: The book writes the temperatures as 38 度 5 and 39 度; here they are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 病人：张大夫吗？您好，我是跟您约好看病的王文。
examples.translation: bìng rén zhāng dà fū ma nín hǎo wǒ shì gēn nín yuē hǎo kàn bìng de wáng wén — Patient: Dr. Zhang? Hello, I am Wang Wen, who made an appointment to see you.

examples.text: 医生：好的。请坐，你哪儿不舒服？
examples.translation: yī shēng hǎo de qǐng zuò nǐ nǎr bù shū fú — Doctor: Good. Please sit down. What is wrong?

examples.text: 病人：我两天前开始咳嗽，流鼻涕，就去药店买了一些感冒药，吃了两天。但是昨天晚上开始发烧、口干，而且头也有点晕。今天早上感觉特别没有力气。
examples.translation: bìng rén wǒ liǎng tiān qián kāi shǐ ké sòu liú bí tì jiù qù yào diàn mǎi le yì xiē gǎn mào yào chī le liǎng tiān dàn shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng kāi shǐ fā shāo kǒu gān ér qiě tóu yě yǒu diǎn yūn jīn tiān zǎo shàng gǎn jué tè bié méi yǒu lì qì — Patient: Two days ago I started coughing and had a runny nose, so I went to a pharmacy, bought some cold medicine and took it for two days. But last night I started running a fever, my mouth was dry, and my head was a bit dizzy too. This morning I felt especially weak.

examples.text: 医生：你发烧多少度？
examples.translation: yī shēng nǐ fā shāo duō shǎo dù — Doctor: How high was your fever?

examples.text: 病人：昨晚三十八度五。今天早上还没量。
examples.translation: bìng rén zuó wǎn sān shí bā dù wǔ jīn tiān zǎo shàng hái méi liáng — Patient: Thirty-eight point five last night. I haven’t taken it yet this morning.

examples.text: 医生：那，现在我先给你量一下体温。三十九度，发高烧。
examples.translation: yī shēng nà xiàn zài wǒ xiān gěi nǐ liáng yí xià tǐ wēn sān shí jiǔ dù fā gāo shāo — Doctor: Then let me take your temperature now. Thirty-nine degrees, a high fever. (the book has 嗯 before the number; it is left out in the Chinese)

examples.text: 病人：怪不得我觉得热，还脸红。
examples.translation: bìng rén guài bù de wǒ jué de rè hái liǎn hóng — Patient: No wonder I feel hot and my face is red.

examples.text: 医生：让我听听你的心脏、量量血压。
examples.translation: yī shēng ràng wǒ tīng tīng nǐ de xīn zàng liáng liáng xuè yā — Doctor: Let me listen to your heart and take your blood pressure.

examples.text: 病人：都正常吗？
examples.translation: bìng rén dōu zhèng cháng ma — Patient: Is it all normal?

examples.text: 医生：心脏跳动得有点快，但还算正常。血压很稳定。让我看一下你的嗓子。
examples.translation: yī shēng xīn zàng tiào dòng de yǒu diǎn kuài dàn hái suàn zhèng cháng xuè yā hěn wěn dìng ràng wǒ kàn yí xià nǐ de sǎng zi — Doctor: Your heart is beating a bit fast, but it still counts as normal. Your blood pressure is stable. Let me look at your throat.

examples.text: 病人：啊……
examples.translation: bìng rén a — Patient: Ahh… (the patient opens his mouth; the book marks this with 张口 in brackets)

examples.text: 医生：你嗓子肿了。现在看来你得的是流感。
examples.translation: yī shēng nǐ sǎng zi zhǒng le xiàn zài kàn lái nǐ dé de shì liú gǎn — Doctor: Your throat is swollen. From what I can see you have the flu.

examples.text: 病人：严重吗？
examples.translation: bìng rén yán zhòng ma — Patient: Is it serious?

examples.text: 医生：不算轻。今天先打一针，再开点儿药吃一吃。三天后要是还不好，就再去验血、验尿和透视，希望不要转成肺炎。
examples.translation: yī shēng bú suàn qīng jīn tiān xiān dǎ yì zhēn zài kāi diǎnr yào chī yì chī sān tiān hòu yào shì hái bù hǎo jiù zài qù yàn xiě yàn niào hé tòu shì xī wàng bú yào zhuǎn chéng fèi yán — Doctor: It is not light. Today first an injection, then I will prescribe some medicine for you to take. If in three days it is still not better, then go for a blood test, a urine test and an X-ray; I hope it doesn’t turn into pneumonia.

examples.text: 病人：我可不想得肺炎。张大夫，你开的药我怎么吃？
examples.translation: bìng rén wǒ kě bù xiǎng dé fèi yán zhāng dà fū nǐ kāi de yào wǒ zěn me chī — Patient: I definitely don’t want pneumonia. Dr. Zhang, how should I take the medicine you prescribed?

examples.text: 医生：一天三次，一次两片。最好早晚和中午各吃一次。用温开水服用。
examples.translation: yī shēng yì tiān sān cì yí cì liǎng piàn zuì hǎo zǎo wǎn hé zhōng wǔ gè chī yí cì yòng wēn kāi shuǐ fú yòng — Doctor: Three times a day, two tablets each time. Best once each in the morning, at noon and in the evening. Take it with warm water.

examples.text: 病人：我可以去上班吗？
examples.translation: bìng rén wǒ kě yǐ qù shàng bān ma — Patient: Can I go to work?

examples.text: 医生：最好在家休息。多喝热水，少动，不要外出。按时吃药。
examples.translation: yī shēng zuì hǎo zài jiā xiū xī duō hē rè shuǐ shǎo dòng bú yào wài chū àn shí chī yào — Doctor: It is best to rest at home. Drink more hot water, move less and don’t go out. Take your medicine on time.

examples.text: 病人：好的。我去哪儿打针和取药？
examples.translation: bìng rén hǎo de wǒ qù nǎr dǎ zhēn hé qǔ yào — Patient: OK. Where do I go for the injection and to pick up the medicine?

examples.text: 医生：药房，就在一楼大厅的左边。打针在二楼输液室的旁边。
examples.translation: yī shēng yào fáng jiù zài yì lóu dà tīng de zuǒ biān dǎ zhēn zài èr lóu shū yè shì de páng biān — Doctor: The pharmacy is right on the left of the first-floor hall. The injection is next to the infusion room on the second floor.

examples.text: 病人：谢谢您，张大夫。
examples.translation: bìng rén xiè xiè nín zhāng dà fū — Patient: Thank you, Dr. Zhang.

exercises.prompt: What did the patient do first when the cough started?
exercises.explanation: 去药店买了一些感冒药.

exercises.prompt: What was the temperature at the doctor’s?
What did the doctor find about the heart?
options: A bit fast but still normal

exercises.prompt: What did the doctor see in the throat?
What will the doctor do today?
options: Give an injection and prescribe medicine
exercises.explanation: 今天先打一针，再开点儿药.

exercises.prompt: What tests are for after three days if he is not better?
How should he take the medicine?
options: Three times a day, two tablets each time
No, it’s best to rest at home
On the left of the first-floor hall

exercises.prompt: 我两天前开始咳嗽，流鼻___，就去药店买了一些感冒药。
三天后要是还不好，就再去验血、验尿和透___。

lessons.title: 608. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: three conversations about directions
lessons.subtitle: 中山路五零九号 · 建国饭店 · 地铁二号线 · 二零一路 · 半月花园 · 三十二号出口

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing, Reading, Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Work in groups of three and listen to three dialogs about directions. Each student listens to one dialog and writes the destination and directions in the space provided (问路 1, 问路 2, 问路 3). B. When you are done, exchange information with your partners. Your partners can draw a map according to your directions. C. Together, read the scripts and check your information. (Audio and three pictures, not included.)

rows: 小文家，中山路五零九号
出了学校大门往东走，过两个十字路口，在第三个十字路口往北拐，邮局对面
走到安定门站坐地铁二号线去东直门方向，在建国门站下车，从东北口出来坐二零一路车，三站
上四号环城高速路，开十五分钟，在三十二号出口下，沿右手边第一个车道开到底，大华超市旁边
tables.title: Activity 4A: the table of destinations and directions (the book leaves it blank; the contents are mine, from the scripts)

explanations.title: Script 问路 1
explanations.body: The book writes 509; here it is spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 小文：张华，有空儿到我家来玩玩。
examples.translation: xiǎo wén zhāng huá yǒu kòngr dào wǒ jiā lái wán wán — Xiao Wen: Zhang Hua, come over to my place when you have time.

examples.text: 张华：好的，小文。你家住哪儿？
examples.translation: zhāng huá hǎo de xiǎo wén nǐ jiā zhù nǎr — Zhang Hua: OK, Xiao Wen. Where do you live?

examples.text: 小文：我家在中山路五零九号。
examples.translation: xiǎo wén wǒ jiā zài zhōng shān lù wǔ líng jiǔ hào — Xiao Wen: My home is at 509 Zhongshan Road. (the book writes 509)

examples.text: 张华：去你家需要坐公共汽车吗？
examples.translation: zhāng huá qù nǐ jiā xū yào zuò gōng gòng qì chē ma — Zhang Hua: Do I need to take a bus to your home?

examples.text: 小文：不用。我家离学校很近，走十几分钟就到了。
examples.translation: xiǎo wén bú yòng wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn zǒu shí jǐ fēn zhōng jiù dào le — Xiao Wen: No. My home is very near the school; a walk of ten-odd minutes gets you there.

examples.text: 张华：那到你家怎么走？
examples.translation: zhāng huá nà dào nǐ jiā zěn me zǒu — Zhang Hua: Then how do I get to your home?

examples.text: 小文：出了学校大门往东走，过两个十字路口，在第三个十字路口那儿往北拐，路口有一个邮局。我家就在邮局的对面。
examples.translation: xiǎo wén chū le xué xiào dà mén wǎng dōng zǒu guò liǎng gè shí zì lù kǒu zài dì sān gè shí zì lù kǒu nàr wǎng běi guǎi lù kǒu yǒu yí gè yóu jú wǒ jiā jiù zài yóu jú de duì miàn — Xiao Wen: Leave the school gate and walk east, pass two intersections, and at the third intersection turn north; there is a post office at the corner. My home is right across from the post office.

examples.text: 张华：好，谢谢。我有空儿一定去你家坐坐。
examples.translation: zhāng huá hǎo xiè xiè wǒ yǒu kòngr yí dìng qù nǐ jiā zuò zuò — Zhang Hua: Good, thanks. When I have time I will certainly come to your place.

explanations.title: Script 问路 2
explanations.body: The book writes line 2 and bus 201; here they are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 琳达：请问，从这儿去建国饭店怎么走？
examples.translation: lín dá qǐng wèn cóng zhèr qù jiàn guó fàn diàn zěn me zǒu — Linda: Excuse me, how do I get to the Jianguo Hotel from here?

examples.text: 行人：你得先坐地铁，然后再转公共汽车。
examples.translation: xíng rén nǐ děi xiān zuò dì tiě rán hòu zài zhuǎn gōng gòng qì chē — Passer-by: You have to take the subway first and then transfer to a bus.

examples.text: 琳达：那我在哪儿坐地铁呢？
examples.translation: lín dá nà wǒ zài nǎr zuò dì tiě ne — Linda: Then where do I take the subway?

examples.text: 行人：这儿离地铁二号线安定门站很近。你沿着这条马路往前走，过了立交桥就可以看到地铁站口了。
examples.translation: xíng rén zhèr lí dì tiě èr hào xiàn ān dìng mén zhàn hěn jìn nǐ yán zhe zhè tiáo mǎ lù wǎng qián zǒu guò le lì jiāo qiáo jiù kě yǐ kàn dào dì tiě zhàn kǒu le — Passer-by: Line 2’s Andingmen station is very near here. Walk forward along this road, and after you pass the overpass you can see the subway entrance.

examples.text: 琳达：我应该坐去哪个方向的地铁？到哪一站下车呢？
examples.translation: lín dá wǒ yīng gāi zuò qù nǎ ge fāng xiàng de dì tiě dào nǎ yí zhàn xià chē ne — Linda: Which direction should I take, and at which stop do I get off?

examples.text: 行人：你坐去东直门方向的地铁，到建国门站下车。
examples.translation: xíng rén nǐ zuò qù dōng zhí mén fāng xiàng de dì tiě dào jiàn guó mén zhàn xià chē — Passer-by: Take the subway toward Dongzhimen and get off at Jianguomen station.

examples.text: 琳达：出了地铁以后，要坐几路公车？
examples.translation: lín dá chū le dì tiě yǐ hòu yào zuò jǐ lù gōng chē — Linda: After leaving the subway, which bus do I take?

examples.text: 行人：从地铁东北口出来，在公车站台坐二零一路车，三站路就到了。
examples.translation: xíng rén cóng dì tiě dōng běi kǒu chū lái zài gōng chē zhàn tái zuò èr líng yī lù chē sān zhàn lù jiù dào le — Passer-by: Come out of the subway’s northeast exit and take bus 201 at the bus stop; three stops and you are there.

explanations.title: Script 问路 3
explanations.body: The book writes the Fourth Ring road, 15 minutes and Exit 32; here they are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 李明：陈老师，这个周末我打算请几个朋友来聚聚，你也来热闹热闹吧？
examples.translation: lǐ míng chén lǎo shī zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu lái jù jù nǐ yě lái rè nào rè nào ba — Li Ming: Teacher Chen, this weekend I plan to invite a few friends over for a get-together. Will you come and join the fun?

examples.text: 陈老师：好啊，这个周末我正好没什么事。你家在哪个小区，我开车怎么去那儿？
examples.translation: chén lǎo shī hǎo a zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ zhèng hǎo méi shén me shì nǐ jiā zài nǎ ge xiǎo qū wǒ kāi chē zěn me qù nàr — Teacher Chen: Sure, this weekend I happen to have nothing on. Which residential community do you live in, and how do I drive there?

examples.text: 李明：我家住在半月花园，很好找。从你家出来，上四号环城高速路。沿着高速路，开十五分钟。
examples.translation: lǐ míng wǒ jiā zhù zài bàn yuè huā yuán hěn hǎo zhǎo cóng nǐ jiā chū lái shàng sì hào huán chéng gāo sù lù yán zhe gāo sù lù kāi shí wǔ fēn zhōng — Li Ming: I live in Half Moon Garden; it is easy to find. Leaving your home, get on the Fourth Ring Expressway. Drive along the expressway for fifteen minutes.

examples.text: 陈老师：在哪儿下高速呢？
examples.translation: chén lǎo shī zài nǎr xià gāo sù ne — Teacher Chen: Where do I leave the expressway?

examples.text: 李明：在三十二号出口下高速。然后，沿着右手边的第一个车道一直开到底，你就会看到一家大华超市。我们小区就在超市的旁边。
examples.translation: lǐ míng zài sān shí èr hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù rán hòu yán zhe yòu shǒu biān de dì yī gè chē dào yì zhí kāi dào dǐ nǐ jiù huì kàn dào yì jiā dà huá chāo shì wǒ men xiǎo qū jiù zài chāo shì de páng biān — Li Ming: Leave at Exit 32. Then drive along the first lane on the right-hand side all the way to the end and you will see a Dahua supermarket. Our community is right next to the supermarket.

examples.text: 陈老师：听上去不太远。到时候你把地址也发给我，如果我忘了怎么走，还可以用一下手机地图和导航。
examples.translation: chén lǎo shī tīng shàng qù bú tài yuǎn dào shí hòu nǐ bǎ dì zhǐ yě fā gěi wǒ rú guǒ wǒ wàng le zěn me zǒu hái kě yǐ yòng yí xià shǒu jī dì tú hé dǎo háng — Teacher Chen: It sounds not too far. When the time comes send me the address too; if I forget the way I can also use the phone map and navigation.

examples.text: 李明：没问题，我一会儿就发给你。
examples.translation: lǐ míng méi wèn tí wǒ yí huìr jiù fā gěi nǐ — Li Ming: No problem, I will send it to you in a moment.

lessons.title: 609. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: a travel journal about the high-speed train
lessons.subtitle: 第一次坐高铁 · 北京到西安 · 取票 进站 · 对号入座 · 二等座 · 开水机 · 刷卡出站

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Watch a YouTube video and complete the following tasks. A. Pair up. One partner listens to the first segment (start to 4m06s) and the other partner listens to the second segment (4m06s to end) without watching the video. Complete the tasks. Main Idea: What is the video segment about? B. Listen to your segment again and write down detailed information. Student A (start to 4:06): 为什么学中文, 学中文的体会, 台湾 vs 中国大陆, 建议, New Words. Student B (4:06 to the end): 中文为什么难学, 最喜欢的学习方式, New Words. C. Share your information with your partner and take notes on their part. D. Watch the video together and read the subtitles on the screen. Compare your answers. (The video and its pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the travel journal written by an American student who is studying in China and complete the tasks. A. Skim the first paragraph and the last paragraph, then create an appropriate title for the following article. Share your title with a classmate. (My title: 我的第一次高铁旅行.) The journal in seven paragraphs, with the numbers spelled out and the X-ray written with a full-width letter:

examples.text: 前几天在中国，我第一次坐了高铁旅行。一路上，我非常兴奋，聊天、看风景、拍照等等，忙个不停。
examples.translation: qián jǐ tiān zài zhōng guó wǒ dì yī cì zuò le gāo tiě lǚ xíng yí lù shàng wǒ fēi cháng xīng fèn liáo tiān kàn fēng jǐng pāi zhào děng děng máng gè bù tíng — Paragraph 1: A few days ago in China I took a high-speed train trip for the first time. All the way I was very excited, chatting, looking at the scenery, taking photos and so on, busy non-stop. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 我对高铁的印象非常好。在中国坐高铁，你几乎可以去中国的任何地方。虽然高铁的速度没有飞机快，可是坐飞机很麻烦，因为要托运行李，过安检什么的。我的旅行路线是从北京到西安，路程是七百四十六英里，四个半小时就到了。途中虽然车速特别快，但是我的感觉并不那么明显，因为高铁稳得很。
examples.translation: wǒ duì gāo tiě de yìn xiàng fēi cháng hǎo zài zhōng guó zuò gāo tiě nǐ jī hū kě yǐ qù zhōng guó de rèn hé dì fāng suī rán gāo tiě de sù dù méi yǒu fēi jī kuài kě shì zuò fēi jī hěn má fán yīn wèi yào tuō yùn xíng li guò ān jiǎn shén me de wǒ de lǚ xíng lù xiàn shì cóng běi jīng dào xī ān lù chéng shì qī bǎi sì shí liù yīng lǐ sì gè bàn xiǎo shí jiù dào le tú zhōng suī rán chē sù tè bié kuài dàn shì wǒ de gǎn jué bìng bú nà me míng xiǎn yīn wèi gāo tiě wěn de hěn — Paragraph 2: My impression of the high-speed train is very good. By high-speed train in China you can go almost anywhere in China. Although the train is not as fast as a plane, flying is a hassle because you have to check luggage, go through security and so on. My route was from Beijing to Xi’an; the distance was 746 miles and it took four and a half hours. Although the speed was very high on the way, I did not feel it that much, because the train is very steady. (the book writes 746 in digits)

examples.text: 那天我的出发时间是下午两点，但是我提前一个多小时就到了北京西站，车站里人很多。因为我已经在网上订了票，到站后只要从取票口取票就行了。进站的时候，我出示了车票和护照，在Ｘ光机上检查了行李。进站之后，我按照车票上的站台号和车次，非常容易就找到了自己要坐的高铁。和飞机一样，高铁上也是对号入座的，我的座位在四号车厢，是二等座，票价大概八十一美元。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǒ de chū fā shí jiān shì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn dàn shì wǒ tí qián yí gè duō xiǎo shí jiù dào le běi jīng xī zhàn chē zhàn lǐ rén hěn duō yīn wèi wǒ yǐ jīng zài wǎng shàng dìng le piào dào zhàn hòu zhǐ yào cóng qǔ piào kǒu qǔ piào jiù xíng le jìn zhàn de shí hòu wǒ chū shì le chē piào hé hù zhào zài guāng jī shàng jiǎn chá le xíng li jìn zhàn zhī hòu wǒ àn zhào chē piào shàng de zhàn tái hào hé chē cì fēi cháng róng yì jiù zhǎo dào le zì jǐ yào zuò de gāo tiě hé fēi jī yí yàng gāo tiě shàng yě shì duì hào rù zuò de wǒ de zuò wèi zài sì hào chē xiāng shì èr děng zuò piào jià dà gài bā shí yī měi yuán — Paragraph 3: That day my departure time was two in the afternoon, but I arrived at Beijing West Station more than an hour early, and the station was crowded. Because I had already booked the ticket online, after arriving I only had to collect it at the ticket window. When entering the station I showed my ticket and passport, and my luggage was checked on the X-ray machine. After entering, following the platform number and train number on the ticket, I very easily found the train I was to take. Like on a plane, seats on the high-speed train are assigned; my seat was in car four, second class, and the ticket was about 81 dollars. (the book writes 2, X, 4 and 81 in digits or letters)

examples.text: 二等座的车厢有点像飞机的机舱，但是行李箱比飞机上的要大，车厢尾部还有行李柜。我的座椅又宽敞又舒服；空间也很大，身前放了一个包以后，还能完全伸开腿。另外，座椅下还有插座，可以给手机和笔记本电脑充电。
examples.translation: èr děng zuò de chē xiāng yǒu diǎn xiàng fēi jī de jī cāng dàn shì xíng li xiāng bǐ fēi jī shàng de yào dà chē xiāng wěi bù hái yǒu xíng li guì wǒ de zuò yǐ yòu kuān chǎng yòu shū fú kōng jiān yě hěn dà shēn qián fàng le yí gè bāo yǐ hòu hái néng wán quán shēn kāi tuǐ lìng wài zuò yǐ xià hái yǒu chā zuò kě yǐ gěi shǒu jī hé bǐ jì běn diàn nǎo chōng diàn — Paragraph 4: The second-class car is a bit like an airplane cabin, but the luggage racks are bigger than on a plane, and at the rear of the car there is also a luggage cabinet. My seat was both spacious and comfortable; the space was large too, and even after putting a bag in front of me I could still stretch my legs out fully. In addition, there were sockets under the seats for charging phones and laptops. (mine)

examples.text: 在车厢里，我还看到列车员推着手推车，售卖零食、饮料和方便面。听说现在高铁上甚至也可以订外卖了。每个车厢都有一个开水机，很好用，泡茶、泡方便面特别方便。高铁上也有餐车供乘客使用。
examples.translation: zài chē xiāng lǐ wǒ hái kàn dào liè chē yuán tuī zhuó shǒu tuī chē shòu mài líng shí yǐn liào hé fāng biàn miàn tīng shuō xiàn zài gāo tiě shàng shèn zhì yě kě yǐ dìng wài mài le měi gè chē xiāng dōu yǒu yí gè kāi shuǐ jī hěn hǎo yòng pào chá pào fāng biàn miàn tè bié fāng biàn gāo tiě shàng yě yǒu cān chē gōng chéng kè shǐ yòng — Paragraph 5: In the car I also saw an attendant pushing a hand cart, selling snacks, drinks and instant noodles. I heard that now you can even order takeout on the high-speed train. Every car has a boiling-water dispenser, which is very handy; making tea or instant noodles is especially convenient. There is also a dining car for passengers. (mine)

examples.text: 跟普通火车不一样的是，在高铁上乘客不可以吸烟。车上西式的卫生间也让我感到特别方便，而且非常干净。
examples.translation: gēn pǔ tōng huǒ chē bù yí yàng de shì zài gāo tiě shàng chéng kè bù kě yǐ xī yān chē shàng xī shì de wèi shēng jiān yě ràng wǒ gǎn dào tè bié fāng biàn ér qiě fēi cháng gān jìng — Paragraph 6: Unlike regular trains, passengers may not smoke on the high-speed train. The Western-style toilets on board also felt especially convenient to me and are very clean. (mine)

examples.text: 下车之后，我直接刷卡出了站，旁边就是西安的地铁站，在中国坐高铁简直太方便了！不知不觉，我的北京西安之旅就这样愉快地结束了。
examples.translation: xià chē zhī hòu wǒ zhí jiē shuā kǎ chū le zhàn páng biān jiù shì xī ān de dì tiě zhàn zài zhōng guó zuò gāo tiě jiǎn zhí tài fāng biàn le bù zhī bù jué wǒ de běi jīng xī ān zhī lǚ jiù zhè yàng yú kuài de jié shù le — Paragraph 7: After getting off I went straight out of the station by swiping my card, and right beside it was Xi’an’s subway station; taking the high-speed train in China is simply too convenient! Before I knew it my Beijing–Xi’an trip had ended happily like this. (the book notes: adapted from China Daily’s Chinese website; the address is left out) (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 6, parts B to D
explanations.body: B. Read the passage and, in Chinese, summarize it in your own words in the table. Then share your information with your partner. C. Read the journal again with your partner. Each student is responsible for finding detailed information for the six steps in the diagram (去火车站, 取票, 进站检查, 上车, 途中, 出站). Take notes and write key words or information under each step. D. Exchange information with your partner and determine the complete procedure for the writer’s trip. The book leaves the tables blank; mine:

rows: 车厢尾部有行李柜；座椅下有插座；每个车厢有开水机；有餐车
又宽敞又舒服；空间很大，放了包还能伸开腿

西式的，特别方便，非常干净
tables.title: Activity 6B: the summary table (the book leaves it blank; my answers)

rows: 下午两点出发，提前一个多小时到北京西站，车站里人很多
已经在网上订了票，从取票口取票
出示车票和护照，行李过安检
按照车票上的站台号和车次找到高铁，对号入座，四号车厢，二等座
聊天、看风景、拍照；车速很快但是很平稳；看到列车员推手推车

tables.title: Activity 6C: the six steps of the trip (the book gives the diagram with the six step names; the notes are mine)

What is different from regular trains?

lessons.title: 610. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: China Post then and now
lessons.subtitle: 中国邮政的过去 · 基本靠走 · 国际特快专递 · 中国邮政的现在 · 网上营业厅 · 邮政无人机 · 世界第一

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the following news articles and complete the tasks. A. Pair up. Each partner reads one part of the news article. From the subtitle of the news article in your part, guess the type of information being reported. B. Read your part and write a summary of it in the space provided. C. Share your information with your partner when you are done. D. Compare the services of China Post with the services of the United States Postal Services (中国邮政服务 / 美国邮政服务; the book leaves the two-column table blank). Tell your class what postal services you usually use. (Two pictures and the China Post logo are not included.)

explanations.title: Part 1: 中国邮政的过去
explanations.body: The dates and numbers are spelled out in characters. Summary (mine): in the past the post office mainly handled letters, parcels, remittances and papers, often delivered on foot; later bicycles and vehicles; fewer letters after phones; and in 1980 and 1984 express mail began.

examples.text: 以前，中国邮政能够办理的业务主要就是信件、包裹、汇款和报纸杂志的递送。那个时候没有手机应用，没有智能快递箱，电信、广播、电视也不普遍，很多在偏远地区的邮递员“基本靠走”来投递。有的邮递员甚至要背着二十多公斤重的邮包，为住在山里的村民服务，给他们送去包裹、报纸以及远方寄来的汇款单。后来，邮递员可以骑自行车或是坐车去送邮件了。人们有了电话、手机以后，信件少了很多，有一段时期，因为邮局的设施差、等候时间长，很多中国人不愿到邮局办业务。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó yóu zhèng néng gòu bàn lǐ de yè wù zhǔ yào jiù shì xìn jiàn bāo guǒ huì kuǎn hé bào zhǐ zá zhì de dì sòng nà ge shí hòu méi yǒu shǒu jī yìng yòng méi yǒu zhì néng kuài dì xiāng diàn xìn guǎng bō diàn shì yě bù pǔ biàn hěn duō zài piān yuǎn dì qū de yóu dì yuán jī běn kào zǒu lái tóu dì yǒu de yóu dì yuán shèn zhì yào bēi zhe èr shí duō gōng jīn zhòng de yóu bāo wèi zhù zài shān lǐ de cūn mín fú wù gěi tā men sòng qù bāo guǒ bào zhǐ yǐ jí yuǎn fāng jì lái de huì kuǎn dān hòu lái yóu dì yuán kě yǐ qí zì xíng chē huò shì zuò chē qù sòng yóu jiàn le rén men yǒu le diàn huà shǒu jī yǐ hòu xìn jiàn shǎo le hěn duō yǒu yí duàn shí qī yīn wèi yóu jú de shè shī chà děng hòu shí jiān cháng hěn duō zhōng guó rén bú yuàn dào yóu jú bàn yè wù — Part 1, paragraph 1 (中国邮政的过去): In the past the business that China Post could handle was mainly the delivery of letters, packages, remittances, and newspapers and magazines. At that time there were no mobile apps and no smart express boxes, telecommunications, broadcasting and television were not widespread either, and many postmen in remote areas delivered “basically by walking”. Some postmen even had to carry mail bags of more than twenty kilograms on their backs to serve villagers living in the mountains, delivering packages, newspapers and remittance slips sent from far away. Later, postmen could ride bicycles or take vehicles to deliver mail. After people had telephones and mobile phones there were far fewer letters, and for a period, because post offices had poor facilities and long waiting times, many Chinese were unwilling to go to the post office for business. (the book writes 20 in digits; translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 一九八零年七月十五日，中国邮政收到了一封从新加坡寄来的快件。快件是寄往北京市海淀区的，当时是由四名邮递员一起投递的。也就是那一年，北京、上海、广州、深圳等城市首先开办了国际特快专递业务，特快专递从此开始。国际特快专递业务开办四年后的一九八四年，中国邮政又开办了国内特快专递业务。
examples.translation: yī jiǔ bā líng nián qī yuè shí wǔ rì zhōng guó yóu zhèng shōu dào le yì fēng cóng xīn jiā pō jì lái de kuài jiàn kuài jiàn shì jì wǎng běi jīng shì hǎi diàn qū de dāng shí shì yóu sì míng yóu dì yuán yì qǐ tóu dì de yě jiù shì nà yì nián běi jīng shàng hǎi guǎng zhōu shēn zhèn děng chéng shì shǒu xiān kāi bàn le guó jì tè kuài zhuān dì yè wù tè kuài zhuān dì cóng cǐ kāi shǐ guó jì tè kuài zhuān dì yè wù kāi bàn sì nián hòu de yī jiǔ bā sì nián zhōng guó yóu zhèng yòu kāi bàn le guó nèi tè kuài zhuān dì yè wù — Part 1, paragraph 2: On July 15, 1980, China Post received an express item sent from Singapore. It was addressed to Haidian District, Beijing, and at the time was delivered by four postmen together. In that same year Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen and other cities were the first to start international express mail, and express mail began from then on. Four years after international express began, in 1984, China Post also started domestic express business. (the book writes the dates in digits)

explanations.title: Part 2: 中国邮政的现在
explanations.body: The year and the hours are spelled out in characters. Summary (mine): today China Post offers online and phone services, new kinds of postcards and stamps, drones and robots, and everyday services; its express volume has been first in the world since 2014, and fresh farm products reach the table in one to two days.

examples.text: 现在中国邮局的变化很大，不仅业务种类丰富多样，服务也越来越方便、越来越快捷！中国邮政已经开通网上营业厅、手机邮局、微信邮局、网上银行、手机银行等电子服务。寄快件、订报纸、买邮票，或是办理交费、转账、信用卡还款，都不用走出家门，轻松地在手机上就可以完成。邮局还有会“动”的明信片、能发声的邮票、可自己设计的邮政纪念品……更是吸引着年轻的用户，体验新鲜事物。邮政无人机、邮政无人投递车也将开始使用，机器人还可以分快递包裹。近年来，中国邮政还开始了形式多样的便民服务，包括寄送身份证、社保和医保卡、体检报告等等。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zhōng guó yóu jú de biàn huà hěn dà bù jǐn yè wù zhǒng lèi fēng fù duō yàng fú wù yě yuè lái yuè fāng biàn yuè lái yuè kuài jié zhōng guó yóu zhèng yǐ jīng kāi tōng wǎng shàng yíng yè tīng shǒu jī yóu jú wēi xìn yóu jú wǎng shàng yín háng shǒu jī yín háng děng diàn zi fú wù jì kuài jiàn dìng bào zhǐ mǎi yóu piào huò shì bàn lǐ jiāo fèi zhuǎn zhàng xìn yòng kǎ huán kuǎn dōu bú yòng zǒu chū jiā mén qīng sōng de zài shǒu jī shàng jiù kě yǐ wán chéng yóu jú hái yǒu huì dòng de míng xìn piàn néng fā shēng de yóu piào kě zì jǐ shè jì de yóu zhèng jì niàn pǐn gèng shì xī yǐn zhe nián qīng de yòng hù tǐ yàn xīn xiān shì wù yóu zhèng wú rén jī yóu zhèng wú rén tóu dì chē yě jiāng kāi shǐ shǐ yòng jī qì rén hái kě yǐ fēn kuài dì bāo guǒ jìn nián lái zhōng guó yóu zhèng hái kāi shǐ le xíng shì duō yàng de biàn mín fú wù bāo kuò jì sòng shēn fèn zhèng shè bǎo hé yī bǎo kǎ tǐ jiǎn bào gào děng děng — Part 2, paragraph 1 (中国邮政的现在): Today the post offices in China have changed greatly: not only is the business rich and varied, the service is also more and more convenient and fast! China Post has already opened online business halls, mobile post offices, WeChat post offices, online banking, mobile banking and other electronic services. Sending express items, subscribing to newspapers, buying stamps, or paying fees, transferring money and repaying credit cards can all be done easily on a phone without leaving home. The post office also has “moving” postcards, stamps that can make sounds and postal souvenirs you can design yourself… which even more attract young users to experience new things. Postal drones and unmanned delivery vehicles will also begin to be used, and robots can even sort express packages. In recent years China Post has also begun many forms of services for the convenience of the people, including sending ID cards, social security and medical insurance cards, physical examination reports and so on. (mine)

examples.text: 另外，邮局的快递业务量从二零一四年起超过美国后，一直是世界第一。现在的中国人在手机应用上看看水果的图片，选好付款后，几天甚至几小时之内，快递就可以直接送到家门口了，极大地方便了人们的生活。很多新鲜的农产品通过邮航专机只需要二十四到四十八小时就能送到家中的餐桌上。
examples.translation: lìng wài yóu jú de kuài dì yè wù liàng cóng èr líng yī sì nián qǐ chāo guò měi guó hòu yì zhí shì shì jiè dì yī xiàn zài de zhōng guó rén zài shǒu jī yìng yòng shàng kàn kàn shuǐ guǒ de tú piàn xuǎn hǎo fù kuǎn hòu jǐ tiān shèn zhì jǐ xiǎo shí zhī nèi kuài dì jiù kě yǐ zhí jiē sòng dào jiā mén kǒu le jí dà de fāng biàn le rén men de shēng huó hěn duō xīn xiān de nóng chǎn pǐn tōng guò yóu háng zhuān jī zhǐ xū yào èr shí sì dào sì shí bā xiǎo shí jiù néng sòng dào jiā zhōng de cān zhuō shàng — Part 2, paragraph 2: Besides, since the post office’s express volume passed that of the United States in 2014 it has always been first in the world. Chinese people now look at pictures of fruit on a phone app, pay after choosing, and within a few days or even a few hours the express delivery can be sent right to the door, which greatly eases people’s lives. Many fresh farm products need only twenty-four to forty-eight hours by postal air freight to reach the dining table at home. (the book writes the year and the hours in digits; mine)

exercises.prompt: In the past, what was China Post’s main business?
options: Letters, packages, remittances, newspapers and magazines
exercises.explanation: 信件、包裹、汇款和报纸杂志的递送.

exercises.explanation: 机器人还可以分快递包裹.

How long do fresh farm products need by postal air freight?

lessons.title: 611. Lesson 24 Skills Integration Review: Nanjing Lukou International Airport
lessons.subtitle: 南京禄口国际机场 · 机场办票 · 出港流程 · 设施和服务 · 机场交通

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Read the following website information and complete the tasks. A. Skim the title of the webpage and predict what you are expecting to read. Share your guess in Chinese with a classmate. B. Work in groups of three. Each student reads one or two paragraphs of the passage and, in Chinese, writes down the main idea and key information in the table. C. Share information with your partners. Ask for information from the parts that your partners read and complete the table with the information they collected. The book titles the page 南京禄口国际机场 and prints it under the headings 机场办票, 出港流程, 设施和服务 and 机场交通. The numbers are spelled out in characters and the terminal name is written with a full-width letter. (The picture is not included.)

rows: 南京禄口国际机场的位置和规模：在江宁区禄口镇，距市中心约四十一公里，一百三十五条国内航线，二十三条国际航线
机场办票：有办票柜台和自助办票设备，国内航班起飞前四十分钟、国际航班起飞前四十五分钟停止办理
出港流程：国内出发四步，国际出发七步，国内到达两步，国际到达五步
设施和服务：商店，免税店，快餐店，无线上网，充电，热水，母婴室，酒店，医疗，问询，银行，行李服务
机场交通：机场班车一号线和二号线，每二十到三十分钟一班，也可以坐地铁和出租车
tables.title: Activity 8B: the paragraph table (the book leaves it blank; my answers)

examples.text: 南京禄口国际机场座落于南京市江宁区禄口镇，距市中心约四十一公里。机场有两条三千六百米跑道、两座航站楼、两座货运站和一座交通中心，候机楼面积四十二点五万平方米。禄口国际机场拥有一百三十五条国内航线和二十三条国际航线，通往五十四个国内主要城市和二十个国际城市及地区。机场的Ｔ二航站楼是国际型航站楼，年旅客量一千八百万人次，航站楼有出发层和到达层。
examples.translation: nán jīng lù kǒu guó jì jī chǎng zuò luò yú nán jīng shì jiāng níng qū lù kǒu zhèn jù shì zhōng xīn yuē sì shí yī gōng lǐ jī chǎng yǒu liǎng tiáo sān qiān liù bǎi mǐ pǎo dào liǎng zuò háng zhàn lóu liǎng zuò huò yùn zhàn hé yí zuò jiāo tōng zhōng xīn hòu jī lóu miàn jī sì shí èr diǎn wǔ wàn píng fāng mǐ lù kǒu guó jì jī chǎng yōng yǒu yì bǎi sān shí wǔ tiáo guó nèi háng xiàn hé èr shí sān tiáo guó jì háng xiàn tōng wǎng wǔ shí sì gè guó nèi zhǔ yào chéng shì hé èr shí gè guó jì chéng shì jí dì qū jī chǎng de èr háng zhàn lóu shì guó jì xíng háng zhàn lóu nián lǚ kè liàng yì qiān bā bǎi wàn rén cì háng zhàn lóu yǒu chū fā céng hé dào dá céng — Paragraph 1 (the airport): Nanjing Lukou International Airport is located in Lukou Town, Jiangning District, Nanjing, about 41 kilometers from the city center. The airport has two 3,600-meter runways, two terminals, two cargo stations and a transport center, and the terminal building covers 425,000 square meters. Lukou International Airport has 135 domestic routes and 23 international routes, leading to 54 major domestic cities and 20 international cities and regions. The airport’s Terminal T2 is an international terminal with 18 million passenger trips a year, and has a departure level and an arrival level. (the book writes the numbers and T2 in digits; translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 机场办票。旅客进入候机楼大厅后，可以直接看到办票柜台。机场有很多自助办票设备，方便无托运行李旅客办理登机手续。国内航班起飞前四十分钟停止办理登机手续；国际航班起飞前四十五分钟停止办理登机手续。
examples.translation: jī chǎng bàn piào lǚ kè jìn rù hòu jī lóu dà tīng hòu kě yǐ zhí jiē kàn dào bàn piào guì tái jī chǎng yǒu hěn duō zì zhù bàn piào shè bèi fāng biàn wú tuō yùn xíng li lǚ kè bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù guó nèi háng bān qǐ fēi qián sì shí fēn zhōng tíng zhǐ bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù guó jì háng bān qǐ fēi qián sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng tíng zhǐ bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù — Paragraph 2 (check-in): After entering the terminal hall, passengers can see the check-in counters directly. The airport has many self-service check-in machines, convenient for passengers without checked luggage to go through boarding procedures. Check-in for domestic flights closes forty minutes before takeoff; for international flights, forty-five minutes before takeoff.

examples.text: 出港流程。国内出发流程：一、托运行李；二、换登机牌；三、安全检查；四、候机及登机。国际出发流程：一、托运行李；二、换登机牌；三、检验检疫；四、海关；五、边防检查；六、安全检查；七、候机及登机。国内到达流程：一、提取行李；二、离开机场。国际到达流程：一、检验检疫；二、边防检查；三、提取行李；四、海关检查；五、离开机场。
examples.translation: chū gǎng liú chéng guó nèi chū fā liú chéng yì tuō yùn xíng li èr huàn dēng jī pái sān ān quán jiǎn chá sì hòu jī jí dēng jī guó jì chū fā liú chéng yì tuō yùn xíng li èr huàn dēng jī pái sān jiǎn yàn jiǎn yì sì hǎi guān wǔ biān fáng jiǎn chá liù ān quán jiǎn chá qī hòu jī jí dēng jī guó nèi dào dá liú chéng yì tí qǔ xíng li èr lí kāi jī chǎng guó jì dào dá liú chéng yì jiǎn yàn jiǎn yì èr biān fáng jiǎn chá sān tí qǔ xíng li sì hǎi guān jiǎn chá wǔ lí kāi jī chǎng — Paragraph 3 (departure and arrival procedures): Domestic departure: 1 check luggage; 2 get the boarding pass; 3 security check; 4 wait and board. International departure: 1 check luggage; 2 boarding pass; 3 inspection and quarantine; 4 customs; 5 border control; 6 security check; 7 wait and board. Domestic arrival: 1 pick up luggage; 2 leave the airport. International arrival: 1 inspection and quarantine; 2 border control; 3 pick up luggage; 4 customs check; 5 leave the airport. (the book prints the steps with numerals in a flow chart)

examples.text: 设施和服务。Ｔ二航站楼出发大厅和到达大厅有各类百货和便利店，提供各类商品百货供旅客选择。机场免税店位于国际出发大厅内。国内、国际出发大厅还有肯德基、汉堡王、大娘水饺等中西式快餐店。Ｔ二航站楼内有无线上网服务，在候机室内，旅客可以很方便地上网，还可以给手机充电、饮用热水、使用母婴室等。同时，机场也有酒店住宿服务、医疗服务、问询服务、银行服务和行李服务。
examples.translation: shè shī hé fú wù èr háng zhàn lóu chū fā dà tīng hé dào dá dà tīng yǒu gè lèi bǎi huò hé biàn lì diàn tí gōng gè lèi shāng pǐn bǎi huò gōng lǚ kè xuǎn zé jī chǎng miǎn shuì diàn wèi yú guó jì chū fā dà tīng nèi guó nèi guó jì chū fā dà tīng hái yǒu kěn dé jī hàn bǎo wáng dà niáng shuǐ jiǎo děng zhōng xī shì kuài cān diàn èr háng zhàn lóu nèi yǒu wú xiàn shàng wǎng fú wù zài hòu jī shì nèi lǚ kè kě yǐ hěn fāng biàn de shàng wǎng hái kě yǐ gěi shǒu jī chōng diàn yǐn yòng rè shuǐ shǐ yòng mǔ yīng shì děng tóng shí jī chǎng yě yǒu jiǔ diàn zhù sù fú wù yī liáo fú wù wèn xún fú wù yín háng fú wù hé xíng li fú wù — Paragraph 4 (facilities and services): The T2 departure and arrival halls have all kinds of department stores and convenience stores, offering all kinds of goods for passengers to choose from. The airport’s duty-free shop is in the international departure hall. The domestic and international departure halls also have Chinese and Western fast-food restaurants such as KFC, Burger King and Daniang Dumplings. Terminal T2 has wireless internet; in the waiting rooms passengers can get online very conveniently and also charge their phones, drink hot water, use the mother-and-baby room and so on. At the same time the airport also has hotel, medical, inquiry, banking and luggage services. (mine)

examples.text: 机场交通。机场班车机场一号线和机场二号线，每二十到三十分钟一班。旅客也可以选择坐机场线地铁和出租车到达市内和其它地方。
examples.translation: jī chǎng jiāo tōng jī chǎng bān chē jī chǎng yī hào xiàn hé jī chǎng èr hào xiàn měi èr shí dào sān shí fēn zhōng yì bān lǚ kè yě kě yǐ xuǎn zé zuò jī chǎng xiàn dì tiě hé chū zū chē dào dá shì nèi hé qí tā dì fāng — Paragraph 5 (airport transport): The airport shuttle buses, Airport Line 1 and Airport Line 2, run every twenty to thirty minutes. Passengers can also choose the airport subway line and taxis to reach the city and other places. (the book notes: adapted from an airline website; the address is left out) (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pre-Reading: make a list of unexpected things that can happen during travel (旅途中可能发生的意外). Then share your list with a classmate. (Two pictures are not included.) B. Read the blog post and summarize the required EEIs in the table: When, Who, What, How, Where, Why (cause). Exchange your information with a classmate when you are done. C. With your partner, number the following activities in the correct sequence, as related in the story: A. 吃蚕豆 B. 医院急诊部挂号 C. 去牙医诊所 D. 打止痛针 E. 交治疗费和药费 F. 拔牙 G. 牙医检查牙齿 H. 牙齿变成两半. D. Retell the story in your own words using the information from Steps B and C. The numbers in the blog are spelled out in characters.

rows: 最近，坐火车去天津的时候
一个英国人和他的朋友

examples.text: 最近我和朋友在中国乘火车出门的时候，因为吃了一枚蚕豆而不得不去亲身体验了一下中国医院的急诊部！
examples.translation: zuì jìn wǒ hé péng yǒu zài zhōng guó chéng huǒ chē chū mén de shí hòu yīn wèi chī le yì méi cán dòu ér bù dé bú qù qīn shēn tǐ yàn le yí xià zhōng guó yī yuàn de jí zhěn bù — Paragraph 1 (the title is 英国老外在中国看急诊, “A British foreigner in a Chinese emergency room”): Recently, when a friend and I were traveling by train in China, because I ate one broad bean I had to personally experience the emergency department of a Chinese hospital! (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 那天我们坐火车去天津。出发前我们在商店里买了各种零食，方便面、花生瓜子、巧克力，还有脆脆的蚕豆。火车开动以后，我打开那包蚕豆吃起来，没想到用劲一咬，我的一颗牙齿变成了两半儿。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǒ men zuò huǒ chē qù tiān jīn chū fā qián wǒ men zài shāng diàn lǐ mǎi le gè zhǒng líng shí fāng biàn miàn huā shēng guā zi qiǎo kè lì hái yǒu cuì cuì de cán dòu huǒ chē kāi dòng yǐ hòu wǒ dǎ kāi nà bāo cán dòu chī qǐ lái méi xiǎng dào yòng jìn yì yǎo wǒ de yì kē yá chǐ biàn chéng le liǎng bànr — Paragraph 2: That day we took the train to Tianjin. Before departure we bought all kinds of snacks in a shop: instant noodles, peanuts and sunflower seeds, chocolate and crunchy broad beans. After the train started I opened the bag of broad beans and began eating, and never expected that biting hard would split one of my teeth in two.

examples.text: 到了天津后，当地的一名出租车司机开车把我们送到了一个牙医诊所。牙医很快地检查了我的牙以后，说，“不行，这个我看不了。你得去医院的急诊部。”幸亏，医院就在马路对面。
examples.translation: dào le tiān jīn hòu dāng dì de yì míng chū zū chē sī jī kāi chē bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le yí gè yá yī zhěn suǒ yá yī hěn kuài de jiǎn chá le wǒ de yá yǐ hòu shuō bù xíng zhè ge wǒ kàn bù liǎo nǐ děi qù yī yuàn de jí zhěn bù xìng kuī yī yuàn jiù zài mǎ lù duì miàn — Paragraph 3: After arriving in Tianjin a local taxi driver drove us to a dental clinic. After quickly examining my tooth the dentist said, “No, I can’t handle this. You have to go to the hospital’s emergency department.” Luckily the hospital was just across the road.

examples.text: 到了急诊部，我付了六块钱人民币挂号，然后就被带进了牙医诊室。给我看病的牙医让我坐到升降椅子上，开始检查我的牙齿。每次牙医碰到我的牙齿，我都痛苦地大叫。牙医问我牙齿是怎么变成两半的。
examples.translation: dào le jí zhěn bù wǒ fù le liù kuài qián rén mín bì guà hào rán hòu jiù bèi dài jìn le yá yī zhěn shì gěi wǒ kàn bìng de yá yī ràng wǒ zuò dào shēng jiàng yǐ zi shàng kāi shǐ jiǎn chá wǒ de yá chǐ měi cì yá yī pèng dào wǒ de yá chǐ wǒ dōu tòng kǔ de dà jiào yá yī wèn wǒ yá chǐ shì zěn me biàn chéng liǎng bàn de — Paragraph 4: At the emergency department I paid six yuan to register and was then taken into the dentist’s room. The dentist who treated me had me sit on an adjustable chair and began to examine my teeth. Every time the dentist touched my tooth I cried out in pain. The dentist asked how my tooth had come to be in two halves. (the book writes 6 in digits)

examples.text: 后来他问我：“啊，这颗牙，你想不想拔掉？”我告诉他当然想拔。所以，牙医让护士给我打上止痛针，然后他大手一动，那颗牙马上就被拔了出来！他举着那颗牙，给我看了看。最后还给我开了一些止痛药，让我回去以后吃。
examples.translation: hòu lái tā wèn wǒ a zhè kē yá nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng bá diào wǒ gào sù tā dāng rán xiǎng bá suǒ yǐ yá yī ràng hù shì gěi wǒ dǎ shàng zhǐ tòng zhēn rán hòu tā dà shǒu yí dòng nà kē yá mǎ shàng jiù bèi bá le chū lái tā jǔ zhe nà kē yá gěi wǒ kàn le kàn zuì hòu hái gěi wǒ kāi le yì xiē zhǐ tòng yào ràng wǒ huí qù yǐ hòu chī — Paragraph 5: Later he asked me, “Ah, this tooth, do you want to pull it out?” I told him of course I wanted it pulled. So the dentist had a nurse give me a painkilling injection, then with one move of his big hand the tooth was pulled out at once! He held the tooth up and showed it to me. Finally he also prescribed some painkillers for me to take after I got back.

examples.text: 拔牙以后，我付了五十元的治疗费和药费，大约相当于五英镑。
examples.translation: bá yá yǐ hòu wǒ fù le wǔ shí yuán de zhì liáo fèi huò yào fèi dà yuē xiāng dāng yú wǔ yīng bàng — Paragraph 6: After the extraction I paid 50 yuan for the treatment and medicine, roughly equivalent to five pounds. (the book writes 50 and 5 in digits)

lessons.title: 613. Lesson 24 Using Chinese in Context Review: a class trip to Xi’an, by plane or by train?
lessons.subtitle: 去西安实习 · 高铁还是飞机 · 商务座 一等座 二等座 · 优点 缺点 · 最后的决定

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at a university in Beijing. Your class is going to take a field trip to Xi’an next month. Your teacher asks you to decide whether your class should take a plane or a high-speed train to get to Xi’an from Beijing. You need to compare these two types of transportation to make a final decision, and then report your decision to your teacher. A. Listen to the teacher’s information and fill in the table. B. Pair up and check the details of what you hear with your partner. Read the script if needed. C. With your partner, discuss the advantages and disadvantages of flying vs. travelling by high-speed rail. Consider the following details in your comparisons: 1. 时间 2. 票价 3. 买票和取票是不是很方便 4. 去机场和高铁站哪个更方便 5. 行李托运 6. 飞机和高铁的服务怎样 7. 自己是不是有足够的钱 8. 怎么付费 9. 可不可以看风景 10. 其它方面. D. Present your decision to the class and explain your reasoning. (Audio and two pictures, not included.)

examples.text: 同学们，下个月，我们班要去西安实习，体验中国历史和文化。我想让你们决定我们是坐高铁去还是坐飞机去。从北京到西安，如果坐高铁去，最快要四个半小时。商务座票价是人民币一千六百二十八元左右，一等座是八百二十五元，二等座是五百一十五元。如果坐飞机去，两个多小时就到了，票价是人民币一千五百元左右。请你们比较一下，坐哪一种交通工具对你们来说更好。你们讨论好了以后告诉我。谢谢。
examples.translation: tóng xué men xià gè yuè wǒ men bān yào qù xī ān shí xí tǐ yàn zhōng guó lì shǐ hé wén huà wǒ xiǎng ràng nǐ men jué dìng wǒ men shì zuò gāo tiě qù hái shì zuò fēi jī qù cóng běi jīng dào xī ān rú guǒ zuò gāo tiě qù zuì kuài yào sì gè bàn xiǎo shí shāng wù zuò piào jià shì rén mín bì yì qiān liù bǎi èr shí bā yuán zuǒ yòu yì děng zuò shì bā bǎi èr shí wǔ yuán èr děng zuò shì wǔ bǎi yī shí wǔ yuán rú guǒ zuò fēi jī qù liǎng gè duō xiǎo shí jiù dào le piào jià shì rén mín bì yì qiān wǔ bǎi yuán zuǒ yòu qǐng nǐ men bǐ jiào yí xià zuò nǎ yì zhǒng jiāo tōng gōng jù duì nǐ men lái shuō gèng hǎo nǐ men tǎo lùn hǎo le yǐ hòu gào sù wǒ xiè xiè — Classmates, next month our class is going to Xi’an for an internship, to experience Chinese history and culture. I want you to decide whether we go by high-speed train or by plane. From Beijing to Xi’an, by high-speed train it takes four and a half hours at the fastest. A business-class ticket is about 1,628 yuan, first class is 825 yuan and second class is 515 yuan. By plane it takes just over two hours and the ticket is about 1,500 yuan. Please compare, and decide which means of transport is better for you. Tell me once you have discussed it. Thank you. (the book writes the prices in digits and, in its first sentence, 我想让决定我们是…, with 你们 missing, which I added; translation mine)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: Your Chinese friend comes to visit you and he wants to visit the Monterey Bay Aquarium. Since you must go to school and have no time to go with your friend, you will give him/her clear directions on how to get to the Aquarium, either from your house or from your school. When you give directions, your friend will draw a simple map based on your descriptions. Your partner will play the role of your Chinese friend. A. Pair up. Student 1 gives directions to Student 2 on how to get to the Aquarium. Student 2 will draw a simple map in their workbook using Student 1’s descriptions. Use the words and phrases below for your directions (我说你画). B. Check your partner’s drawing and verify the directions. C. Now Student 2 gives directions to Student 1 on how to get to the Aquarium. Student 1 will draw a simple map in their workbook. Check the drawing against the directions upon completion. (Pictures not included.)

rows: 沿着第一大街一直往前走

examples.text: 从学校大门出发，沿着第一大街一直往前走，过了三个红绿灯，在十字路口往左拐。过了两个街区，继续往前走，走到底，再走五分钟就到了。你会看到一家咖啡店，水族馆就在你的右手边。
examples.translation: cóng xué xiào dà mén chū fā yán zhe dì yī dà jiē yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu guò le sān gè hóng lǜ dēng zài shí zì lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi guò le liǎng gè jiē qū jì xù wǎng qián zǒu zǒu dào dǐ zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le nǐ huì kàn dào yì jiā kā fēi diàn shuǐ zú guǎn jiù zài nǐ de yòu shǒu biān — Leave from the school gate and go straight along First Street; pass three traffic lights and turn left at the intersection. After two blocks, keep going to the end, and five more minutes and you are there. You will see a coffee shop, and the aquarium is on your right. (a sample route; the book gives only the ten phrases; mine)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: Your college classmate is currently teaching English in China. He recently emailed you about his life and work in China. You will email him back to tell him about your life and studies. A. Listen to your friend’s email and answer the questions. New words: 熊猫 (panda) and 乐山大佛 (Leshan Giant Buddha); the book gives their pinyin in brackets, which I left out. The questions: 1. 杰克每天上班做什么？ 2. 下班以后，杰克去哪儿吃饭？昨天晚上吃的什么菜？ 3. 周末的时候，杰克喜欢做什么？上个周末他去哪儿了？ 4. 下个星期，他想去看什么？他为什么要去那个地方？ B. Pair up, discuss your answers with your partner. Read the script if necessary. C. Pair up, write an email to Jack about your life and studies in Monterey (TO, CC, Subject). The script:

examples.text: 杰克，你好，好久不见，希望你一切都好！我来成都教书已经半年了，我非常喜欢这里。成都不仅气候好，而且风景也美。这里的老师和学生对我特别友好。我每天给学生上两节英语课，下课以后我得改作业，备课。其他时间我自己学习中文。下班以后，我有时候和同事一起出去吃饭。成都有各种各样的餐馆，不过，大部分餐馆的菜都很辣。昨天晚上我和同事一起去吃饭，我们吃了麻婆豆腐和辣子鸡。如果你来成都，我请你吃麻辣火锅，你一定喜欢吃。
examples.translation: jié kè nǐ hǎo hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn xī wàng nǐ yí qiè dōu hǎo wǒ lái chéng dū jiāo shū yǐ jīng bàn nián le wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huān zhè lǐ chéng dū bù jǐn qì hòu hǎo ér qiě fēng jǐng yě měi zhè lǐ de lǎo shī hé xué shēng duì wǒ tè bié yǒu hǎo wǒ měi tiān gěi xué shēng shàng liǎng jié yīng yǔ kè xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ děi gǎi zuò yè bèi kè qí tā shí jiān wǒ zì jǐ xué xí zhōng wén xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ yǒu shí hòu hé tóng shì yì qǐ chū qù chī fàn chéng dū yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de cān guǎn bú guò dà bù fèn cān guǎn de cài dōu hěn là zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ hé tóng shì yì qǐ qù chī fàn wǒ men chī le má pó dòu fǔ hé là zi jī rú guǒ nǐ lái chéng dū wǒ qǐng nǐ chī má là huǒ guō nǐ yí dìng xǐ huān chī — Email, paragraph 1: Hello Jack, long time no see; I hope everything is fine with you! I have been teaching in Chengdu for half a year now and I like it here very much. Chengdu not only has a good climate but also beautiful scenery. The teachers and students here are especially friendly to me. Every day I teach two English classes, and after class I have to grade homework and prepare lessons. In my other time I study Chinese myself. After work I sometimes go out to eat with colleagues. Chengdu has all kinds of restaurants, but most of the restaurants’ dishes are very spicy. Last night I went out to eat with colleagues and we had mapo tofu and spicy chicken. If you come to Chengdu I will treat you to spicy hot pot; you will certainly like it. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 周末的时候，我常常去成都一些有名的地方去逛逛。上个周末我去了成都大熊猫基地。那里的熊猫太可爱了。下个星期我打算去看乐山大佛。那个大佛在长江旁边，有七十一米高，脚上可以坐一百多个人。到时候，我给你发一些照片。你的中文学习怎么样了？有空儿给我讲讲你那里的学习和生活。谢谢。彼得
examples.translation: zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ cháng cháng qù chéng dū yì xiē yǒu míng de dì fāng qù guàng guàng shàng gè zhōu mò wǒ qù le chéng dū dà xióng māo jī dì nà lǐ de xióng māo tài kě ài le xià gè xīng qī wǒ dǎ suàn qù kàn lè shān dà fú nà ge dà fú zài cháng jiāng páng biān yǒu qī shí yī mǐ gāo jiǎo shàng kě yǐ zuò yì bǎi duō gè rén dào shí hòu wǒ gěi nǐ fā yì xiē zhào piān nǐ de zhōng wén xué xí zěn me yàng le yǒu kòngr gěi wǒ jiǎng jiǎng nǐ nà lǐ de xué xí hé shēng huó xiè xiè bǐ dé — Paragraph 2: On weekends I often go to look around some famous places in Chengdu. Last weekend I went to the Chengdu Giant Panda Base. The pandas there are so cute. Next week I plan to see the Leshan Giant Buddha. That Buddha is beside the Yangtze River, is 71 meters tall, and more than a hundred people can sit on its feet. By then I will send you some photos. How is your Chinese study going? When you have time, tell me about your studies and life where you are. Thanks. Peter (the book writes 71 in digits and, after 熊猫 and 乐山大佛, glosses them in pinyin and English in a vocabulary note; the book’s river name is kept as printed)

lessons.title: 634. Lesson 25 Presentation 1: ordering takeout with Mom
lessons.subtitle: 咱们叫外卖吧 · 外卖平台 · 美团 饿了么 · 先选餐馆 然后点餐 最后下单 · 定位服务

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. How often do you order food delivery or takeout? B. How do you order? C. What apps do you use? D. What do you like about them? (Four pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 1: 叫外卖
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 女儿：妈，我饿了，咱们叫外卖吧。
examples.translation: nǚ ér mā wǒ è le zán men jiào wài mài ba — Daughter: Mom, I’m hungry; let’s order takeout. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 妈妈：叫外卖？外卖能比我做得快吗？
examples.translation: mā mā jiào wài mài wài mài néng bǐ wǒ zuò de kuài ma — Mom: Order takeout? Can takeout be faster than my cooking?

examples.text: 女儿：当然能啦。现在用手机叫外卖又快又便宜，还不用洗碗。
examples.translation: nǚ ér dāng rán néng la xiàn zài yòng shǒu jī jiào wài mài yòu kuài yòu pián yi hái bú yòng xǐ wǎn — Daughter: Of course it can. Ordering takeout on a phone now is fast and cheap, and you don’t even have to wash dishes.

examples.text: 妈妈：可是，他们送的餐既没有营养又没有味道。
examples.translation: mā mā kě shì tā men sòng de cān jì méi yǒu yíng yǎng yòu méi yǒu wèi dào — Mom: But the meals they deliver have neither nutrition nor flavor.

examples.text: 女儿：妈，你不知道，现在外卖平台上什么饭都可以点，连五星级饭店的餐，都可以点。
examples.translation: nǚ ér mā nǐ bù zhī dào xiàn zài wài mài píng tái shàng shén me fàn dōu kě yǐ diǎn lián wǔ xīng jí fàn diàn de cān dōu kě yǐ diǎn — Daughter: Mom, you don’t know: on takeout platforms now you can order any food, even meals from five-star hotels.

examples.text: 妈妈：真的吗？除了点餐以外，还能点别的吗？
examples.translation: mā mā zhēn de ma chú le diǎn cān yǐ wài hái néng diǎn bié de ma — Mom: Really? Besides ordering meals, can you order other things too?

examples.text: 女儿：可以，蔬菜、水果、饮料，外卖平台上都可以点。
examples.translation: nǚ ér kě yǐ shū cài shuǐ guǒ yǐn liào wài mài píng tái shàng dōu kě yǐ diǎn — Daughter: Yes, vegetables, fruit, drinks — you can order them all on the takeout platform.

examples.text: 妈妈：你都是怎么点的呢？教教妈妈吧。
examples.translation: mā mā nǐ dōu shì zěn me diǎn de ne jiāo jiāo mā mā ba — Mom: How do you order them? Teach Mom.

examples.text: 女儿：你看，在手机上下载一个应用软件，比如“美团”或是“饿了么”，就可以点啦。
examples.translation: nǚ ér nǐ kàn zài shǒu jī shàng xià zài yí gè yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn bǐ rú měi tuán huò shì è le me jiù kě yǐ diǎn la — Daughter: Look, download an app on your phone, such as Meituan or Ele.me, and then you can order.

examples.text: 妈妈：点开这个应用后，我先做什么？
examples.translation: mā mā diǎn kāi zhè ge yìng yòng hòu wǒ xiān zuò shén me — Mom: After I open this app, what do I do first?

examples.text: 女儿：当然是先选餐馆啦，然后就是点餐，确认信息，最后下单。
examples.translation: nǚ ér dāng rán shì xiān xuǎn cān guǎn la rán hòu jiù shì diǎn cān què rèn xìn xī zuì hòu xià dān — Daughter: Of course first choose a restaurant, then order dishes, confirm the information, and finally place the order.

examples.text: 妈妈：点了以后，怎么付款呢？
examples.translation: mā mā diǎn le yǐ hòu zěn me fù kuǎn ne — Mom: After ordering, how do I pay?

examples.text: 女儿：下单后，直接用微信支付就可以了，而且还有电子发票和账单。
examples.translation: nǚ ér xià dān hòu zhí jiē yòng wēi xìn zhī fù jiù kě yǐ le ér qiě hái yǒu diàn zi fā piào hé zhàng dān — Daughter: After placing the order, just pay with WeChat Pay, and there are also electronic invoices and bills.

examples.text: 妈妈：不过，多长时间能送到呢？
examples.translation: mā mā bú guò duō cháng shí jiān néng sòng dào ne — Mom: But how long will it take to arrive?

examples.text: 女儿：很快。而且有定位服务，可以追踪，你随时可以查看外卖小哥到了哪儿，几分钟能到。
examples.translation: nǚ ér hěn kuài ér qiě yǒu dìng wèi fú wù kě yǐ zhuī zōng nǐ suí shí kě yǐ chá kàn wài mài xiǎo gē dào le nǎr jǐ fēn zhōng néng dào — Daughter: Very fast. And there is a location service so you can track it; at any time you can check where the delivery guy has got to and in how many minutes he will arrive.

examples.text: 妈妈：那太好了，咱们就点吧。
examples.translation: mā mā nà tài hǎo le zán men jiù diǎn ba — Mom: That’s great, then; let’s order.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 1 once through and answer the questions. 1. What is the relationship between the two speakers? (mother and daughter) 2. What do they want to do? (order takeout) 3. How are they going to do it? (with a phone app) B. Detailed Listening: Listen to Presentation 1 again and answer the questions. 1. What are three benefits of the delivery service that the first speaker mentions? (fast, cheap, no dishes to wash) 2. What is the second speaker’s concern? (the food has no nutrition or flavor) 3. What are four details about what can be ordered with the app? (any meal, even five-star hotel meals; vegetables; fruit; drinks) 4. What instructions does the first speaker give to the second speaker on how to use the platform? (download an app, open it, choose a restaurant, order dishes, confirm the information, place the order) 5. How do the speakers pay for the service? (WeChat Pay) 6. How can the speakers track their order? (the location service: see where the delivery guy is). (Audio, not included; the answers in brackets are mine, from the text.)

lessons.subtitle: 叫外卖 叫车 · 下载 下单 · 点餐 点开 · 外卖小哥 · 应用软件 · 外卖平台 · 菜单 发票 账单

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading)
explanations.body: Pair up. Check the odd word out in each row and explain your reasoning. 1. 叫外卖 / 叫琳达 / 叫车 / 叫出租. 2. 下载 / 下单 / 下课 / 下雾. 3. 点餐 / 点菜 / 点酒水 / 点开. 4. 营养 / 味道 / 便宜 / 水果. The book gives no key; my answers: 1. 叫琳达 (calling a person by name, not ordering or hailing a service). 2. 下雾 (weather, not something a person does). 3. 点开 (to click open, not ordering food). 4. 水果 (a food item; the others are qualities of food or service).

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Examine the following words: 外卖小哥, 点开, 确认, 应用, 菜单, 叫外卖, 送餐, 定位, 应用软件, 外卖平台, 付款, 发票, 下单, 营养, 下载, 账单, 追踪, 外卖. B. In groups of three, complete the sentences below using the word bank above (Students A, B and C each have a passage with blanks). C. Check your work with your teammates. D. Order the three segments to form a coherent paragraph, then take turns reading it aloud. My completed passages, and my order of the segments (B, then C, then A):

examples.text: 如果你想知道外卖小哥到了哪儿，就打开平台上的定位服务，可以追踪和知道你的外卖什么时候可以到。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng zhī dào wài mài xiǎo gē dào le nǎr jiù dǎ kāi píng tái shàng de dìng wèi fú wù kě yǐ zhuī zōng hé zhī dào nǐ de wài mài shén me shí hòu kě yǐ dào — Student A (my key): If you want to know where the delivery guy has got to, open the platform’s location service; you can track it and know when your takeout will arrive.

examples.text: 在中国留学的时候，我没有时间做饭，所以常常叫外卖。中国的送餐服务特别方便。我在手机上下载了一个应用软件。在这个外卖平台上，你什么都可以点，披萨，意大利面，中餐等等。要想吃更有营养的饭，你也可以找到。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó liú xué de shí hòu wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān zuò fàn suǒ yǐ cháng cháng jiào wài mài zhōng guó de sòng cān fú wù tè bié fāng biàn wǒ zài shǒu jī shàng xià zài le yí gè yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn zài zhè ge wài mài píng tái shàng nǐ shén me dōu kě yǐ diǎn pī sà yì dà lì miàn zhōng cān děng děng yào xiǎng chī gèng yǒu yíng yǎng de fàn nǐ yě kě yǐ zhǎo dào — Student B (my key): When I studied in China I had no time to cook, so I often ordered takeout. China’s meal-delivery service is especially convenient. I downloaded an app on my phone. On this takeout platform you can order anything: pizza, pasta, Chinese food and so on. If you want food with more nutrition, you can find that too.

examples.text: 这个应用点开后，你可以选你喜欢的餐馆，然后看他们的菜单，所有的信息都对了，就可以确认，然后下单。你的手机上会看到电子发票和账单。
examples.translation: zhè ge yìng yòng diǎn kāi hòu nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn nǐ xǐ huān de cān guǎn rán hòu kàn tā men de cài dān suǒ yǒu de xìn xī dōu duì le jiù kě yǐ què rèn rán hòu xià dān nǐ de shǒu jī shàng huì kàn dào diàn zi fā piào hé zhàng dān — Student C (my key): After you open this app, you can choose the restaurant you like and look at their menu; when all the information is right you can confirm and then place the order. On your phone you will see the electronic invoice and the bill. (the bank has one word left over: 付款)

explanations.body: A. Pair up. Partner 1 listens to the first two dialogs, Partner 2 listens to the last two, and they both fill in the EEIs (relationship of speakers, topic, EEIs) from their dialogs in a table of four rows. B.
