(Audio; the dialogs are on a page that is blank in this edition.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and study the following patterns. Partner 1 writes a three to four sentence paragraph with the first two patterns while Partner 2 does the same for the last two: 1. 又…又…，还… 2. 什么都…，连…也… 3. 先…，然后…，最后… 4. …。而且… B. Share your work with your partner and make any necessary corrections or improvements. C. Post your paragraphs on a website to share with the class (the website is not used here). One sample sentence for each pattern:

examples.text: 我今天又累又饿，还没有时间做饭。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān yòu lèi yòu è hái méi yǒu shí jiān zuò fàn — 又…又…，还…: I am tired and hungry today, and I don’t have time to cook either. (a sample sentence in the pattern; mine)

examples.text: 现在手机上什么都可以买，连水果也可以。
examples.translation: xiàn zài shǒu jī shàng shén me dōu kě yǐ mǎi lián shuǐ guǒ yě kě yǐ — 什么都…，连…也…: These days you can buy anything on a phone, even fruit. (mine)

examples.text: 做饭时，先洗菜，然后切菜，最后炒菜。
examples.translation: zuò fàn shí xiān xǐ cài rán hòu qiè cài zuì hòu chǎo cài — 先…，然后…，最后…: When cooking, first wash the vegetables, then cut them, and finally stir-fry them. (mine)

examples.text: 外卖很方便。而且价格不贵。
examples.translation: wài mài hěn fāng biàn ér qiě jià gé bú guì — …。而且…: Takeout is very convenient. And the price is not high. (mine)

lessons.title: 636. Lesson 25 Presentation 1 grammar: rhetorical questions with 吗
lessons.subtitle: 能不感冒吗 · 能不胖吗 · 不是在桌子上吗 · 不是已经告诉你了吗 · 能……吗 · 不是……吗

explanations.title: Rhetorical Questions with 吗
explanations.body: A rhetorical question is a figure of speech in which a question is asked not to get an answer but to make a persuasive point, e.g., the English “how could...?” or “isn’t…?” It is similar in Chinese: 外卖能比我做得快吗？ (How could food delivery possibly be faster than I can cook?) In rhetorical questions, 吗 is often used together with 能 and 不是. As with regular questions, 吗 always comes at the end of a sentence.

rows: Gently reminds someone of a fact they seem to have forgotten
tables.title: Rhetorical Questions with 吗, 能 and 不是

examples.text: 甲：他又感冒了。
examples.translation: jiǎ tā yòu gǎn mào le — 1. A: He has caught a cold again.

examples.text: 乙：他每天穿得都很少，能不感冒吗？
examples.translation: yǐ tā měi tiān chuān de dōu hěn shǎo néng bù gǎn mào ma — B: He wears so little every day; how could he not catch cold?

examples.text: 甲：今天我可能会迟到。
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān wǒ kě néng huì chí dào — 2. A: I might be late today.

examples.text: 乙：你起得这么晚。能不迟到吗？
examples.translation: yǐ nǐ qǐ de zhè me wǎn néng bù chí dào ma — B: You got up so late. How could you not be late?

examples.text: 甲：我点了很多菜，都是你爱吃的。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ diǎn le hěn duō cài dōu shì nǐ ài chī de — 3. A: I ordered many dishes, all ones you love.

examples.text: 乙：晚上吃这么多菜。能不胖吗？
examples.translation: yǐ wǎn shàng chī zhè me duō cài néng bú pàng ma — B: Eating this many dishes at night, how could one not gain weight? (the book’s English says “I”; the Chinese has no subject)

examples.text: 甲：你看到我手机了吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ kàn dào wǒ shǒu jī le ma — 4. A: Have you seen my phone?

examples.text: 乙：不是在桌子上吗？

lessons.title: 637. Lesson 25 Presentation 1 grammar: providing additional information with 除了
lessons.subtitle: 除了点餐以外 · 除了这些以外 · 除了多听多说多看以外 · 除了……之外 · 除此之外 · 滴滴

explanations.title: 话语语法: Providing Additional Information with 除了
explanations.body: 除了 can be used to provide more arguments, alternatives, or facts to strengthen an assertion or proposition. It can also provide listeners a pause to digest the information. 除了……（以外） can be used within a paragraph after initial information has been introduced, or to begin a new paragraph containing much more information. Note: The more formal or literary versions of 除了……（以外） are 除了……（之外）, 除此之外 and 除此以外.

rows: 除了……之外，除此之外，除此以外
the more formal or literary versions
tables.title: Providing Additional Information with 除了 (the structure and the formal versions)

examples.text: 现在外卖平台上什么饭都可以点，连五星级饭店的餐，你也可以点。
examples.translation: xiàn zài wài mài píng tái shàng shén me fàn dōu kě yǐ diǎn lián wǔ xīng jí fàn diàn de cān nǐ yě kě yǐ diǎn — Assertion: Now on takeout platforms you can order any food, even meals from five-star hotels.

examples.text: 除了点餐以外，外卖平台上还可以点蔬菜、水果和饮料。
examples.translation: chú le diǎn cān yǐ wài wài mài píng tái shàng hái kě yǐ diǎn shū cài shuǐ guǒ hé yǐn liào — Additional facts that strengthen the assertion: Besides ordering meals, on takeout platforms you can also order vegetables, fruit and drinks.

explanations.title: Examples with 除了
explanations.body: The brackets of the book’s 除了……（以外） are kept in example 2. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 下载外卖平台的手机应用以后，你就可以直接在手机上点餐、下单。然后也可以用手机付款。除了这些以外，你也可以用手机追踪外卖小哥的定位，看他们到了哪儿。
examples.translation: xià zài wài mài píng tái de shǒu jī yìng yòng yǐ hòu nǐ jiù kě yǐ zhí jiē zài shǒu jī shàng diǎn cān xià dān rán hòu yě kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn chú le zhè xiē yǐ wài nǐ yě kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī zhuī zōng wài mài xiǎo gē de dìng wèi kàn tā men dào le nǎr — 1. After downloading the takeout platform’s app you can order and place the order directly on your phone. Then you can also pay by phone. Besides these, you can also use your phone to track the delivery guy’s location and see where he has got to. (additional information + pause)

examples.text: 学习中文有很多不同的方法。有的学生喜欢看中文电影、听中文歌；也有的学生喜欢读中文报纸和杂志。还有的喜欢跟中国人交朋友，练习口语。除了多听、多说、多看（以外），也要多写。比如，要常写中文汉字或是写周记什么的。
examples.translation: xué xí zhōng wén yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de fāng fǎ yǒu de xué shēng xǐ huān kàn zhòng wén diàn yǐng tīng zhōng wén gē yě yǒu de xué shēng xǐ huān dú zhōng wén bào zhǐ hé zá zhì hái yǒu de xǐ huān gēn zhōng guó rén jiāo péng yǒu liàn xí kǒu yǔ chú le duō tīng duō shuō duō kàn yǐ wài yě yào duō xiě bǐ rú yào cháng xiě zhōng wén hàn zì huò shì xiě zhōu jì shén me de — 2. There are many different ways to learn Chinese. Some students like to watch Chinese films and listen to Chinese songs; others like to read Chinese newspapers and magazines. Still others like to make Chinese friends and practice speaking. Besides listening, speaking and reading more, you should also write more. For example, often write Chinese characters or a weekly journal. (additional information + pause)

examples.text: “滴滴”除了为人们提供便利的出行服务以外，也为很多人提供了工作机会，增加了他们的收入。一般来说，“滴滴”司机每月的收入能有四千到五千元人民币。

Besides providing people with convenient travel services, Didi has also provided jobs for many people and increased their income. Generally speaking, a Didi driver’s monthly income can reach 4,000 to 5,000 yuan. (additional information; the book writes the numbers in digits)

explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. The first student makes an assertion about a topic of their choosing. The second student adds to the information with 除了……（以外）. The third student adds more information. Keep going for two more rounds. Study the following example before you begin. B. explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Write a paragraph 4–6 sentences in length on one of the topics below using 除了……（以外） while your teammates do the same for the other two: 1. 学习中文 2. 锻炼身体 3. 兴趣爱好. B. lessons.title: 638. Lesson 25 Presentation 1 grammar: simple instructions with 先…然后…最后
lessons.subtitle: 先…然后…最后 · 先…再…然后…最后 · 第一步…第二步… · 煮饺子 · 国际长途 · 骑自行车锻炼

explanations.title: 段落语法: Giving Simple Instructions Using 先…然后…最后
explanations.body: For simple instructions, 先…然后…最后 are equivalent to the English adverbs “first…then (after that)…finally.” Example: 当然是先选餐馆啦，然后就是点餐，确认信息，最后下单。 (Naturally, first choose a restaurant, then order dishes and confirm your information, and finally submit the order.) 先…然后…最后 is for three-step instructions. If there are four steps, simply add 再 after 先, as in 先…再…然后…最后, that is, “first…then…after that…finally.” Alternatively, you can use ordinal numbers for each step, e.g., 第一步…第二步…第三步…最后（一步）. Note: 先…然后…最后 or 先…再…然后…最后 can also be used to describe sequential past events or future actions.

rows: 第一步…第二步…第三步…最后（一步）…
tables.title: Simple Instructions Using 先…然后…最后… (first…then…finally…)

examples.text: 煮饺子很容易，你先把水烧开，再把饺子放进锅里，然后煮十分钟左右，等饺子都到水面上，最后把饺子捞出来放进盘子里。这样，你的饺子就煮好啦。
examples.translation: zhǔ jiǎo zi hěn róng yì nǐ xiān bǎ shuǐ shāo kāi zài bǎ jiǎo zi fàng jìn guō lǐ rán hòu zhǔ shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu děng jiǎo zi dōu dào shuǐ miàn shàng zuì hòu bǎ jiǎo zi lāo chū lái fàng jìn pán zi lǐ zhè yàng nǐ de jiǎo zi jiù zhǔ hǎo la — 1. Boiling dumplings is easy: first bring the water to a boil, then put the dumplings into the pot, then cook for about ten minutes, and when all the dumplings have come up to the surface, finally scoop them out into a plate. That way your dumplings are done. (the book writes 再把放饺子进锅里; the word order is corrected here)

examples.text: 考试的时候，要先把试卷快快地看一遍，再开始做简单的问题，然后做比较难的问题，最后再检查一遍。
examples.translation: kǎo shì de shí hòu yào xiān bǎ shì juàn kuài kuài de kàn yí biàn zài kāi shǐ zuò jiǎn dān de wèn tí rán hòu zuò bǐ jiào nán de wèn tí zuì hòu zài jiǎn chá yí biàn — 2. In an exam, first read through the paper quickly, then start with the simple questions, then do the harder ones, and finally check it once more.

examples.text: 给中国打国际长途，你得先拨零，然后再拨中国的国际区号八六，最后是拨打国内的区号和电话号码或是直接拨手机号码。
examples.translation: gěi zhōng guó dǎ guó jì cháng tú nǐ děi xiān bō líng rán hòu zài bō zhōng guó de guó jì qū hào bā liù zuì hòu shì bō dǎ guó nèi de qū hào hé diàn huà hào mǎ huò shì zhí jiē bō shǒu jī hào mǎ — 3. To make an international call to China, first dial zero, then the country code for China, eighty-six, and finally the domestic area code and phone number or directly the mobile number. (the book writes 0 and 86 in digits, and 播 for 拨, which is corrected)

examples.text: 在骑自行车锻炼时，先慢骑几分钟，再快骑几分钟，然后再慢骑，最后再快骑。这样，可以锻炼人的心脏功能。
examples.translation: zài qí zì xíng chē duàn liàn shí xiān màn qí jǐ fēn zhōng zài kuài qí jǐ fēn zhōng rán hòu zài màn qí zuì hòu zài kuài qí zhè yàng kě yǐ duàn liàn rén de xīn zàng gōng néng — 4. When exercising on a bicycle, first ride slowly for a few minutes, then fast for a few minutes, then slowly again, and finally fast again. This way you can exercise the function of the heart.

examples.text: 我们打算先去北京，然后去上海，最后去香港。

lessons.title: 639. Lesson 25 Presentation 1 grammar: additional or more important information with 而且
lessons.subtitle: 而且 · 他会讲英语而且讲得好 · 天黑了而且又下雨 · 邮局的快递业务 · 外卖已经成为了必需品

explanations.title: 话语语法: Providing Additional or More Important Information with 而且
explanations.body: 而且 can be used to provide additional or more important information. It is similar to English “and,” “moreover,” “furthermore,” or “in addition to.” When 而且 occurs in a complex sentence, it normally begins the second clause or predicate to connect the two parts of the sentence. When 而且 functions as a progressive conjunction to connect two sentences, it usually begins the second sentence and means “in addition to.”

rows: connects clauses or predicates within a complex sentence
connects clauses within a complex sentence
tables.title: Additional or More Important Information with 而且 (and; moreover; furthermore; in addition to)

examples.text: 下单后，直接用微信支付就可以了，而且还有电子发票和账单。
examples.translation: xià dān hòu zhí jiē yòng wēi xìn zhī fù jiù kě yǐ le ér qiě hái yǒu diàn zi fā piào hé zhàng dān — From the dialog: After placing the order, just pay with WeChat Pay, and there are also electronic invoices and bills.

examples.text: 用手机叫外卖很快。而且有定位服务，可以追踪，你随时可以查看外卖小哥到了哪儿，几分钟能到。

And there is a location service so you can track it; at any time you can check where the delivery guy has got to and in how many minutes he will arrive.

explanations.title: Examples with 而且
explanations.body: The book prints these eight examples with a few traditional characters and missing full stops; both are fixed here. The English is mine.

examples.text: 他会讲英语，而且讲得好。
examples.translation: tā huì jiǎng yīng yǔ ér qiě jiǎng de hǎo — 1. He can speak English, and speaks it well.

examples.text: 他学习很好，而且对人很热情。
examples.translation: tā xué xí hěn hǎo ér qiě duì rén hěn rè qíng — 2. He studies well, and is warm toward people.

examples.text: 我的作业做完了，而且全部正确。
examples.translation: wǒ de zuò yè zuò wán le ér qiě quán bù zhèng què — 3. I have finished my homework, and it is all correct. (the book writes 作業 and 正確 in traditional characters; converted here, with a full stop added)

examples.text: 我不知道，而且我也不想知道。
examples.translation: wǒ bù zhī dào ér qiě wǒ yě bù xiǎng zhī dào — 4. I don’t know, and I don’t want to know either. (full stop added)

examples.text: 天黑了，而且又下雨，别出去了。
examples.translation: tiān hēi le ér qiě yòu xià yǔ bié chū qù le — 5. It’s dark, and it’s raining again; don’t go out. (full stop added)

examples.text: 我很少出去旅游，因为我的假期很少，而且我也没有钱。
examples.translation: wǒ hěn shǎo chū qù lǚ yóu yīn wèi wǒ de jià qī hěn shǎo ér qiě wǒ yě méi yǒu qián — 6. I seldom go traveling, because I have few holidays, and I have no money either. (full stop added)

examples.text: 我觉得学好中文，兴趣最重要。我从小就对中国文化感兴趣，喜欢看中国的功夫片。而且有了兴趣后就不觉得那么难学，还越学越爱学。
examples.translation: wǒ jué de xué hǎo zhōng wén xìng qù zuì zhòng yào wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù duì zhōng guó wén huà gǎn xìng qù xǐ huān kàn zhòng guó de gōng fū piàn ér qiě yǒu le xìng qù hòu jiù bù jué de nà me nán xué hái yuè xué yuè ài xué — 7. I think that to learn Chinese well, interest is the most important thing. Since I was little I have been interested in Chinese culture and liked watching Chinese kung fu films. And once you have interest you don’t find it so hard to learn, and you like learning more and more. (full stop added)

examples.text: 为了“活”下去，邮局扩大了自己的业务，开始了各种代理业务。而且邮局还改进了自己的快递业务，使年快递量达到四百亿件。
examples.translation: wèi le huó xià qù yóu jú kuò dà le zì jǐ de yè wù kāi shǐ le gè zhǒng dài lǐ yè wù ér qiě yóu jú hái gǎi jìn le zì jǐ de kuài dì yè wù shǐ nián kuài dì liàng dá dào sì bǎi yì jiàn — 8. In order to “survive,” the post office expanded its business and started all kinds of agency businesses. And the post office also improved its express delivery business, so that the annual express volume reached 40 billion items. (the book writes 400 亿 in digits and has an unmatched quotation mark; both fixed)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Write three sentences in Chinese characters in the table below (句子 | 而且), then read them to your partner. Your partner will then add more information to the sentence using 而且 while you transcribe what they say. B. Convert your transcriptions into characters, then read your jointly completed sentences to the class. The book’s table is blank; three sample pairs (mine):

examples.text: 我喜欢住民宿。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān zhù mín sù — Sample sentence 1 (mine): I like staying in homestays.

examples.text: 而且民宿比酒店便宜。
examples.translation: ér qiě mín sù bǐ jiǔ diàn pián yi — My partner adds with 而且 (mine): And homestays are cheaper than hotels.

examples.text: 我昨天晚上在宿舍点了外卖。
examples.translation: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng zài sù shè diǎn le wài mài — Sample sentence 2 (mine): Last night I ordered takeout in the dorm.

examples.text: 而且外卖一会儿就送到了。
examples.translation: ér qiě wài mài yí huìr jiù sòng dào le — Added with 而且 (mine): And it was delivered in no time.

examples.text: 这个应用很好用。
examples.translation: zhè ge yìng yòng hěn hǎo yòng — Sample sentence 3 (mine): This app is easy to use.

examples.text: 而且还有中文版本。
examples.translation: ér qiě hái yǒu zhōng wén bǎn běn — Added with 而且 (mine): And there is a Chinese version too.

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. In English, summarize one part of the news report below while your teammates summarize the other two parts. B. Verbally relate your summary to your teammates in Chinese. C. Translate the sentences with 而且: 1. ……，而且点外卖价格不贵，既便宜又方便。 2. ……，而且外卖的形式也变得多种多样，人们不仅可以在网上订餐，也可以用手机应用订餐。 3. ……，而且如果没课，除了下楼拿外卖，可以一天都在宿舍床上呆着。 (Two pictures are not included.) The three parts follow, with my English:

examples.text: 外卖已经成为了人们生活的必需品，现在人们点外卖不仅仅满足于简单的吃饱，更在乎哪家餐馆的饭更健康，更好吃。而且点外卖价格不贵，既便宜又方便。
examples.translation: wài mài yǐ jīng chéng wéi le rén men shēng huó de bì xū pǐn xiàn zài rén men diǎn wài mài bù jǐn jǐn mǎn zú yú jiǎn dān de chī bǎo gèng zài hū nǎ jiā cān guǎn de fàn gèng jiàn kāng gèng hǎo chī ér qiě diǎn wài mài jià gé bú guì jì pián yi yòu fāng biàn — Part 1: Takeout has become a necessity of people’s lives. Now when people order takeout they are not satisfied with simply being full; they care more about which restaurant’s food is healthier and tastier. And the price of takeout is not high, both cheap and convenient. (my English; summary in English: takeout is a necessity, people want healthy tasty food, and it is cheap and convenient)

examples.text: 现在外卖在中国人的生活中非常流行，你总是可以看到外卖小哥骑着摩托车飞奔在中国的大街上。而且外卖的形式也变得多种多样，人们不仅可以在网上订餐，也可以用手机应用订餐。
examples.translation: xiàn zài wài mài zài zhōng guó rén de shēng huó zhōng fēi cháng liú xíng nǐ zǒng shì kě yǐ kàn dào wài mài xiǎo gē qí zhe mó tuō chē fēi bēn zài zhōng guó de dà jiē shàng ér qiě wài mài de xíng shì yě biàn de duō zhǒng duō yàng rén men bù jǐn kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng dìng cān yě kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī yìng yòng dìng cān — Part 2: Takeout is now very popular in Chinese people’s lives; you can always see delivery guys speeding on motorbikes along China’s streets. And the forms of takeout have become diverse: people can order not only online but also with a phone app. (the book prints 飞奔在在中国的大街上 with a doubled 在; corrected)

examples.text: 在大学校园中，很多学生常常叫外卖。张华是大一的女生，她说：“冬天的时候，除了早饭，别的饭都是叫外卖，都不去食堂吃饭了。太懒了。而且如果没课，除了下楼拿外卖，可以一天都在宿舍床上呆着。”
examples.translation: zài dà xué xiào yuán zhōng hěn duō xué shēng cháng cháng jiào wài mài zhāng huá shì dà yì de nǚ shēng tā shuō dōng tiān de shí hòu chú le zǎo fàn bié de fàn dōu shì jiào wài mài dōu bú qù shí táng chī fàn le tài lǎn le ér qiě rú guǒ méi kè chú le xià lóu ná wài mài kě yǐ yì tiān dōu zài sù shè chuáng shàng dāi zhe — Part 3: On university campuses many students often order takeout. Zhang Hua is a first-year girl; she says: “In winter, apart from breakfast, I order takeout for every other meal and don’t go to the canteen at all. Too lazy. And if I have no class, apart from going downstairs to pick up the takeout, I can stay on my dorm bed all day.”

explanations.title: Activity 9C: my translations
explanations.body: The three 而且 clauses without the ellipsis, with my English.

examples.text: 点外卖价格不贵，既便宜又方便。
examples.translation: diǎn wài mài jià gé bú guì jì pián yi yòu fāng biàn — 1. …and the price of takeout is not high; it is both cheap and convenient. (translation of the 而且 clause of Part 1; mine)

examples.text: 外卖的形式也变得多种多样，人们不仅可以在网上订餐，也可以用手机应用订餐。
examples.translation: wài mài de xíng shì yě biàn de duō zhǒng duō yàng rén men bù jǐn kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng dìng cān yě kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī yìng yòng dìng cān — 2. …and the forms of takeout have also become diverse; people can order not only online but also with a phone app. (Part 2; mine)

examples.text: 如果没课，除了下楼拿外卖，可以一天都在宿舍床上呆着。
examples.translation: rú guǒ méi kè chú le xià lóu ná wài mài kě yǐ yì tiān dōu zài sù shè chuáng shàng dāi zhe — 3. …and if there is no class, apart from going downstairs to pick up takeout, I can stay on the dorm bed all day. (Part 3; mine)

exercises.prompt: Where does 而且 usually come in a complex sentence?
options: At the start of the second clause or predicate
Before the subject of the first clause

exercises.prompt: When 而且 connects two sentences, where does it go?
options: At the end of the first
In the middle of the first
At the start of the second sentence

exercises.prompt: What does 他会讲英语，而且讲得好 mean?
options: He can speak English, and speaks it well

exercises.prompt: What does 天黑了，而且又下雨，别出去了 mean?
options: It’s dark and raining again; don’t go out

exercises.prompt: Why does the speaker seldom travel (example 6)?
exercises.explanation: 假期很少，而且我也没有钱.

exercises.prompt: What does the post office do in example 8?
options: Expands its business and improves express delivery

exercises.prompt: According to Part 1, what do people care more about now?
options: Which restaurant’s food is healthier and tastier
exercises.explanation: 更在乎哪家餐馆的饭更健康，更好吃.

exercises.prompt: Who rides motorbikes along China’s streets in Part 2?
What does Zhang Hua say about breakfast in winter?
options: She eats it at a restaurant
She is the only meal she does not order
exercises.explanation: 除了早饭，别的饭都是叫外卖.

exercises.prompt: 他学习很好，___且对人很热情。
点外卖价格不贵，既便宜___方便。
人们不___可以在网上订餐，也可以用手机应用订餐。

lessons.subtitle: 小菜一碟 · 连歪果仁都开始在中国送外卖了 · 美团外卖早晨集合 · 外卖第一单 · 叫外卖的各种人

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog once through and answer the questions. 1. How are the two speakers related? 2. What are their dining preferences? 3. What do they decide to do together? 4. From the context, what does 小菜一碟 (xiǎocài yìdié) mean? (In Chinese it is a small side dish of food, used for “a piece of cake”: something very easy; the audio is not included, so this answer is mine.) B. Listen to the conversation again and fill in the table below using Chinese characters: Benefits of Service; What Can Be Ordered; Prices Mentioned; Mobile Apps; Payment; Delivery Time; How to Use Apps. C. Read your information to a partner, make any necessary changes or additions, then read it to the class. D. Read the script your teacher provides, then perform it with your partner. E. Pair up with a new partner and share your recent experiences ordering food delivery. (Two pictures and the audio are not included; the script is not in the book.)

examples.text: 这个小菜一碟。
examples.translation: zhè ge xiǎo cài yì dié — 小菜一碟: a piece of cake, very easy. (sample line; mine)

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Form two groups. Group 1 watches the first part of the following video while Group 2 watches the second. Take notes and fill in your group’s part of the table below. The video title: 连歪果仁都开始在中国送外卖了！ B. Compare information with your teammates in Chinese. C. Pair off with the other group members. Read your information to your partner while they complete the rest of their table. D. In your own Chinese, retell this food delivery story to your partner. E. Watch the entire video again in class or as homework. (The video and two pictures are not included; the book writes 午饭 + 聊天 with a plus sign, which is written 午饭和聊天 here.)

lessons.title: 641. Lesson 25 Presentation 1 skill integration: foreigners and Chinese takeout; an Ele.me journal
lessons.subtitle: 越来越多的外国人喜欢住在中国 · 外卖美食 · 云南汽锅鸡 · 不用给小费 · 上海交通大学 · 饿了么 · 懒得去食堂

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read the first paragraph in the news article below while your partner reads the last. Answer your respective questions, share information, then discuss what you think the main content of the article covers: 1. What is the first paragraph about? 2. What is the last paragraph about? 3. What do you think the main content of the article covers? B. Share your conclusions with the class. C. Divide into two groups. Group 1 reads paragraphs two to four while Group 2 reads paragraphs five and six. Write the main idea of each paragraph and its EEIs in tables (Paragraph | Topic and Details), then share your information with your teammates. D. Pair off with the other group, exchange information about your paragraphs in Chinese, then complete your table with your partner’s information. E. Write three new words from the article with their English meanings. (Three pictures are not included.) The seven paragraphs, with my English:

examples.text: 现在，越来越多的外国人喜欢住在中国，他们爱上中国有千百个理由，而便宜、方便的外卖美食却是吸引他们的一个非常重要的原因。许多在中国的外国人都说，中国的外卖又好吃又便宜，同时还可以保证按时送到，真是让人无法拒绝。
examples.translation: xiàn zài yuè lái yuè duō de wài guó rén xǐ huān zhù zài zhōng guó tā men ài shàng zhōng guó yǒu qiān bǎi gè lǐ yóu ér pián yi fāng biàn de wài mài měi shí què shì xī yǐn tā men de yí gè fēi cháng zhòng yào de yuán yīn xǔ duō zài zhōng guó de wài guó rén dōu shuō zhōng guó de wài mài yòu hǎo chī yòu pián yi tóng shí hái kě yǐ bǎo zhèng àn shí sòng dào zhēn shì ràng rén wú fǎ jù jué — 1. More and more foreigners like living in China, and they have hundreds of reasons for loving China, but cheap and convenient takeout food is a very important reason that attracts them. Many foreigners in China say that China’s takeout is both tasty and cheap and is guaranteed to arrive on time, which really makes it impossible to refuse. (the book’s first paragraph; English mine)

examples.text: 最近，有外国网友问：“为什么那么多人喜欢中国？”住在中国的外国人给出了各种答案，比如“出租车特别便宜”、“高速火车可通往任何一个地方”、“很安全，半夜出门都不必担心”、“二十四小时有地方可以吃饭”等等。但是，提到最多的还是方便的外卖平台和服务。
examples.translation: zuì jìn yǒu wài guó wǎng yǒu wèn wèi shén me nà me duō rén xǐ huān zhōng guó zhù zài zhōng guó de wài guó rén gěi chū le gè zhǒng dá àn bǐ rú chū zū chē tè bié pián yi gāo sù huǒ chē kě tōng wǎng rèn hé yí gè dì fāng hěn ān quán bàn yè chū mén dōu bú bì dān xīn èr shí sì xiǎo shí yǒu dì fāng kě yǐ chī fàn děng děng dàn shì tí dào zuì duō de hái shì fāng biàn de wài mài píng tái hé fú wù — 2. Recently a foreign netizen asked: “Why do so many people like China?” Foreigners living in China gave all kinds of answers, such as “taxis are especially cheap,” “high-speed trains can go to any place,” “it is very safe, and you needn’t worry about going out in the middle of the night,” “there are places to eat twenty-four hours a day,” and so on. But the one mentioned most was the convenient takeout platforms and service. (the book writes 24 in digits)

examples.text: 在中国，人们用手机应用软件和手机支付系统可以找到、订到各种美食，而且还总是能在预约时间内送到。这让很多外国人不能相信。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó rén men yòng shǒu jī yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn hé shǒu jī zhī fù xì tǒng kě yǐ zhǎo dào dìng dào gè zhǒng měi shí ér qiě hái zǒng shì néng zài yù yuē shí jiān nèi sòng dào zhè ràng hěn duō wài guó rén bù néng xiāng xìn — 3. In China, people can use phone apps and mobile payment systems to find and order all kinds of food, and it can always be delivered within the appointed time. This makes many foreigners unable to believe it.

examples.text: 另外，网络外卖平台上什么餐点都有、什么都不奇怪。有外国人订过云南汽锅鸡，有人订过烤鸭，带面皮、甜面酱，还有人订过麻辣火锅，不含锅。对于卖披萨、面条、水饺什么的，外国朋友说点那些餐太容易，不值得一提。
examples.translation: lìng wài wǎng luò wài mài píng tái shàng shén me cān diǎn dōu yǒu shén me dōu bù qí guài yǒu wài guó rén dìng guò yún nán qì guō jī yǒu rén dìng guò kǎo yā dài miàn pí tián miàn jiàng hái yǒu rén dìng guò má là huǒ guō bù hán guō duì yú mài pī sà miàn tiáo shuǐ jiǎo shén me de wài guó péng yǒu shuō diǎn nà xiē cān tài róng yì bù zhí de yì tí — 4. Besides, online takeout platforms have every kind of dish and nothing is strange. Some foreigners have ordered Yunnan steam-pot chicken, some have ordered roast duck, with pancakes and sweet bean sauce, and some have ordered spicy hot pot, without the pot. As for those selling pizza, noodles, dumplings and so on, foreign friends say that ordering those is too easy to be worth mentioning. (the book puts the brackets around 带面皮、甜面酱 and 不含锅; they are turned into commas)

examples.text: 对于在中国读书的众多外国留学生们，他们在宿舍内就可以吃到各省甚至各国的美食。外卖小哥会“用尽一切办法”把美食送到校园里。然后在接到食物的时候，再用手机一扫，钱就支付了。有时候外国留学生发现自己叫外卖还有打折，让他们非常惊讶。
examples.translation: duì yú zài zhōng guó dú shū de zhòng duō wài guó liú xué shēng men tā men zài sù shè nèi jiù kě yǐ chī dào gè shěng shèn zhì gè guó de měi shí wài mài xiǎo gē huì yòng jǐn yí qiè bàn fǎ bǎ měi shí sòng dào xiào yuán lǐ rán hòu zài jiē dào shí wù de shí hòu zài yòng shǒu jī yì sǎo qián jiù zhī fù le yǒu shí hòu wài guó liú xué shēng fā xiàn zì jǐ jiào wài mài hái yǒu dǎ zhé ràng tā men fēi cháng jīng yà — 5. For the many international students studying in China, they can eat the food of every province and even every country in their dorms. Delivery guys will “use every means” to get the food to the campus. Then when you receive the food, you scan with your phone and the money is paid. Sometimes international students find that their takeout even has a discount, which surprises them very much.

examples.text: 一位美国来的朋友说，他已经在中国住了六年了，中国街头的各种美食多到让人数都数不过来，而价格却要比美国便宜得多。他还说，要是和朋友一起合点三个外卖中国菜，平均只要三到四点五美元，有时甚至只需要两美元。
examples.translation: yí wèi měi guó lái de péng yǒu shuō tā yǐ jīng zài zhōng guó zhù le liù nián le zhōng guó jiē tóu de gè zhǒng měi shí duō dào ràng rén shǔ dōu shǔ bú guò lái ér jià gé què yào bǐ měi guó pián yi de duō tā hái shuō yào shì hé péng yǒu yì qǐ hé diǎn sān gè wài mài zhōng guó cài píng jūn zhǐ yào sān dào sì diǎn wǔ měi yuán yǒu shí shèn zhì zhǐ xū yào liǎng měi yuán — 6. A friend from America said that he has already lived in China for six years, that the many kinds of food on China’s streets are too many to count, and that the prices are much cheaper than in America. He also said that if you order three Chinese takeout dishes together with friends, it only costs three to four and a half dollars on average, and sometimes as little as two dollars. (the book writes 6, 3, 4.5 and 2 in digits)

examples.text: 食物既能够准时送达，又好吃，而且也不像在美国那样需要另外给小费，这真是让在中国的外国人感到开心极了。

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the entry from a college student’s journal below, then mark the following statements as true or false: 1. “饿了么”对作者来说很重要，他四年大学期间都在用。 2. 作者和他的同学们觉得用“饿了么”比较麻烦，需要比较很多餐厅。 3. 大部分的时间大家只有饿的时候才用“饿了么”。 4. “饿了么”既可以满足大家吃的需要，也可以满足大家玩的需要。 Compare answers with a partner. B. Form groups of three. Write your answer to the first question in the table while your teammates answer the other two: 作者和同学用“饿了么”的原因 / 为什么作者说“饿了么”是个快速订餐网站？ / 不饿的时候，学生们在“饿了么”上做什么？ Read your answer to your teammates, complete the table with their answers, then read all three answers to the class. C. Write down the reasons why you like or dislike ordering delivery in the table (我喜欢点外卖的原因), then read them to your teammates. (Two pictures are not included.)

examples.text: 我在上海交通大学读了四年书，就用了三年的“饿了么”。可以说，我的生活不能没有“饿了么”。
examples.translation: wǒ zài shàng hǎi jiāo tōng dà xué dú le sì nián shū jiù yòng le sān nián de è le me kě yǐ shuō wǒ de shēng huó bù néng méi yǒu è le me — I studied for four years at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and used Ele.me for three. It can be said that my life cannot do without Ele.me.

examples.text: 那么，对于我和我的同学们来说，“饿了么”是什么呢？答案就是“我们饿了，懒得去食堂吃饭；或者因为玩游戏、考试、睡过头等等各种原因错过了食堂的饭点，不得不叫外卖；或者更直接，不想吃食堂的饭了，就叫外卖。”
examples.translation: nà me duì yú wǒ hé wǒ de tóng xué men lái shuō è le me shì shén me ne dá àn jiù shì wǒ men è le lǎn de qù shí táng chī fàn huò zhě yīn wèi wán yóu xì kǎo shì shuì guò tóu děng děng gè zhǒng yuán yīn cuò guò le shí táng de fàn diǎn bù dé bú jiào wài mài huò zhě gèng zhí jiē bù xiǎng chī shí táng de fàn le jiù jiào wài mài — So for me and my classmates, what is Ele.me? The answer is: “We are hungry and too lazy to go to the canteen; or, for all kinds of reasons such as playing games, exams or oversleeping, we missed the canteen’s mealtime and have to order takeout; or, more directly, we don’t want to eat canteen food any more, so we order takeout.”

examples.text: 所以，我们用“饿了么”非常简单。一般来说，大家用了几年后，都有自己喜欢的餐厅了，直接点开“饿了么”的应用，选餐厅，下单，关窗口，前后一分钟搞定。对于我们来说，“饿了么”就是一个快速订餐网站，因为我们都是饿了的时候去订餐的，感觉好像已经快饿死了的样子，所以总想以最快的速度完成订餐、下单、付款的操作。然后，第一时间可以拿到饭，赶紧吃了。
examples.translation: suǒ yǐ wǒ men yòng è le me fēi cháng jiǎn dān yì bān lái shuō dà jiā yòng le jǐ nián hòu dōu yǒu zì jǐ xǐ huān de cān tīng le zhí jiē diǎn kāi è le me de yìng yòng xuǎn cān tīng xià dān guān chuāng kǒu qián hòu yì fēn zhōng gǎo dìng duì yú wǒ men lái shuō è le me jiù shì yí gè kuài sù dìng cān wǎng zhàn yīn wèi wǒ men dōu shì è le de shí hòu qù dìng cān de gǎn jué hǎo xiàng yǐ jīng kuài è sǐ le de yàng zi suǒ yǐ zǒng xiǎng yǐ zuì kuài de sù dù wán chéng dìng cān xià dān fù kuǎn de cāo zuò rán hòu dì yī shí jiān kě yǐ ná dào fàn gǎn jǐn chī le — So using Ele.me is very simple for us. Generally, after using it for a few years everyone has favorite restaurants, so they directly open the Ele.me app, choose the restaurant, place the order and close the window, all done in a minute. To us Ele.me is a quick food-ordering website, because we order when we are hungry, feeling as if we are starving, so we always want to complete ordering, placing the order and paying as fast as possible. Then we can get the food right away and eat it quickly.

examples.text: 我们不饿的时候都去玩别的网站。吃，很吸引我们大学生，但外卖，就显然只有饿了的时候才吸引我们。因此，我们不会花费大量的时间在平台上比较商家的价格和饭菜。但是，有时我们也会关注哪家新店开了，有团购，比如火锅啊，烧烤啊之类的，或者新开的蛋糕店啊，有打折啊等等。
examples.translation: wǒ men bú è de shí hòu dōu qù wán bié de wǎng zhàn chī hěn xī yǐn wǒ men dà xué shēng dàn wài mài jiù xiǎn rán zhǐ yǒu è le de shí hòu cái xī yǐn wǒ men yīn cǐ wǒ men bú huì huā fèi dà liàng de shí jiān zài píng tái shàng bǐ jiào shāng jiā de jià gé hé fàn cài dàn shì yǒu shí wǒ men yě huì guān zhù nǎ jiā xīn diàn kāi le yǒu tuán gòu bǐ rú huǒ guō a shāo kǎo a zhī lèi de huò zhě xīn kāi de dàn gāo diàn a yǒu dǎ zhé a děng děng — When we are not hungry we all go and play on other websites. Eating attracts us university students, but takeout obviously attracts us only when we are hungry. So we don’t spend a lot of time on the platform comparing merchants’ prices and dishes. But sometimes we also pay attention to which new shop has opened and has group-buy deals, such as hot pot or barbecue, or a newly opened cake shop with discounts and so on. (the book’s English heading is “journal entry”; the English is mine)

examples.text: 随着手机支付和短租平台的出现，民宿和短租房渐渐成了新的旅行住宿方式，特别受到年轻人的欢迎。
examples.translation: suí zhe shǒu jī zhī fù hé duǎn zū píng tái de chū xiàn mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng jiàn jiàn chéng le xīn de lǚ xíng zhù sù fāng shì tè bié shòu dào nián qīng rén de huān yíng — Paragraph 1: With the appearance of mobile payment and short-term rental platforms, homestays and short-term rentals have gradually become a new way to lodge when traveling, and are especially welcomed by young people. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 很多年轻人都在手机上安装了民宿、短租平台的应用软件。旅行前，只要动动手指，滑动一下页面，看看照片和用户评价，很快就可以选择到满意的民宿。接下来，就是确认住宿时间和个人信息，然后用手机付款，基本上就是“一键完成”。
examples.translation: hěn duō nián qīng rén dōu zài shǒu jī shàng ān zhuāng le mín sù duǎn zū píng tái de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn lǚ xíng qián zhǐ yào dòng dòng shǒu zhǐ huá dòng yí xià yè miàn kàn kàn zhào piān hé yòng hù píng jià hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ xuǎn zé dào mǎn yì de mín sù jiē xià lái jiù shì què rèn zhù sù shí jiān hé gè rén xìn xī rán hòu yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn jī běn shàng jiù shì yí jiàn wán chéng — Paragraph 2: Many young people have installed homestay and short-term rental platform apps on their phones. Before traveling, they only need to move their fingers, swipe the page, and look at the photos and user reviews, and they can soon choose a homestay they are satisfied with. Next comes confirming the dates and personal information and then paying by phone; basically it is “done with one key.”

examples.text: 民宿和短租屋的价格比较便宜，是年轻人喜欢住的主要原因。另外，和一般的宾馆相比，民宿和短租房更有特色，有家的感觉，可以自己买菜做饭，也可以跟房主聊天。还有，民宿和短租屋的房客来自不同的国家、不同的地区，可以结交到很多新朋友，了解不同的文化和习俗。
examples.translation: mín sù hé duǎn zū wū de jià gé bǐ jiào pián yi shì nián qīng rén xǐ huān zhù de zhǔ yào yuán yīn lìng wài hé yì bān de bīn guǎn xiāng bǐ mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng gèng yǒu tè sè yǒu jiā de gǎn jué kě yǐ zì jǐ mǎi cài zuò fàn yě kě yǐ gēn fáng zhǔ liáo tiān hái yǒu mín sù hé duǎn zū wū de fáng kè lái zì bù tóng de guó jiā bù tóng de dì qū kě yǐ jié jiāo dào hěn duō xīn péng yǒu liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà hé xí sú — Paragraph 3: The comparatively low price of homestays and short-term rental houses is the main reason young people like to stay in them. In addition, compared with ordinary guesthouses, homestays and short-term rentals have more character and a feeling of home; you can buy groceries and cook yourself, and you can also chat with the host. Also, the guests in homestays and short-term rentals come from different countries and different regions, so you can make many new friends and learn about different cultures and customs.

examples.text: 旅行中大家每天可以发送照片，分享自己的经历，或是在平台上给房主打分。这样的旅行更有特点，会留下更多、更美好的回忆。
examples.translation: lǚ xíng zhōng dà jiā měi tiān kě yǐ fā sòng zhào piān fēn xiǎng zì jǐ de jīng lì huò shì zài píng tái shàng gěi fáng zhǔ dǎ fēn zhè yàng de lǚ xíng gèng yǒu tè diǎn huì liú xià gèng duō gèng měi hǎo de huí yì — Paragraph 4: During the trip everyone can send photos every day, share their experiences, or rate the host on the platform. This kind of trip has more distinctive features and will leave more and more beautiful memories.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to three speakers discuss why they like Bed & Breakfasts and other short-term rentals, then complete the table below in Chinese: Speaker 1, 2, 3 | Reasons. (The three pictures and the audio are not included, and the speakers’ script is not in the book.) B. Form groups of three. Read your answers to each other, then take turns reading the script aloud so that each member reads one of the speaker’s parts. C. Summarize why the speakers choose Airbnb and other short-term rentals. Write five to six sentences that use 是…的主要原因, 另外, 还有 and 除了. Then read your summary to your teammates, get their feedback, and make any necessary corrections or improvements. A sample summary (mine):

examples.text: 民宿价格便宜，是我们选择短租的主要原因。另外，住在民宿里可以自己做饭，也可以跟房主聊天。还有，除了认识房主以外，还可以认识来自不同地方的房客。
examples.translation: mín sù jià gé pián yi shì wǒ men xuǎn zé duǎn zū de zhǔ yào yuán yīn lìng wài zhù zài mín sù lǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ zuò fàn yě kě yǐ gēn fáng zhǔ liáo tiān hái yǒu chú le rèn shí fáng zhǔ yǐ wài hái kě yǐ rèn shí lái zì bù tóng dì fāng de fáng kè — Sample summary (mine, using 是…的主要原因, 另外, 还有 and 除了): The low price of homestays is the main reason we choose short-term rentals. In addition, you can cook for yourself in a homestay and chat with the host. Also, besides getting to know the host, you can meet guests from different places.

Enter your personal information, and finally choose to pay by phone. (the book writes “爱比迎” in this passage and “爱彼迎” elsewhere; the usual name 爱彼迎 is used)

lessons.subtitle: 特别受到年轻人的欢迎 · 最受欢迎的是 · 最重要的是 · 特别是 · 三烀一蒸 · 农民工子女

explanations.title: 话语语法: The Superlatives 特别 and 最
explanations.body: A. 特别 and 最 are similar to the English “especially” and “the most.” They single out something as the most extreme or quintessential example of its kind. B. These two superlatives often come at the end of a sentence, followed by elaboration, or begin a new sentence that elaborates the preceding one. Commonly used phrases are “最重要的是…,” “特别是…,” “最受欢迎的是…” and “特别受欢迎的是…”.

rows: aspect in common + 最重要的是… / 特别是… + 人/事 + elaboration
singles out the most important aspect or the extreme example, then elaborates
aspect in common + 人/事 + 最受欢迎的是… / 特别受欢迎的是… + elaboration
singles out the most popular thing or person, then elaborates
tables.title: Superlatives 特别 and 最

examples.text: 随着手机支付和短租平台的出现，民宿和短租房渐渐成了新的旅行住宿方式，特别受到年轻人的欢迎。
examples.translation: suí zhe shǒu jī zhī fù hé duǎn zū píng tái de chū xiàn mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng jiàn jiàn chéng le xīn de lǚ xíng zhù sù fāng shì tè bié shòu dào nián qīng rén de huān yíng — 1. With the appearance of mobile payment and short-term rental platforms, homestays and short-term rentals have gradually become a new way to lodge when traveling, especially welcomed by young people.

examples.text: 以前在中国，大家出行主要靠公交车和出租车。现在有了更方便的选择，最受欢迎的就是“滴滴出行”。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zài zhōng guó dà jiā chū xíng zhǔ yào kào gōng jiāo chē hé chū zū chē xiàn zài yǒu le gèng fāng biàn de xuǎn zé zuì shòu huān yíng de jiù shì dī dī chū xíng — 2. In the past in China, everyone traveled mainly by bus and taxi. Now there are more convenient choices, and the most popular is “Didi Chuxing.” (the book marks this as from Presentation 3)

explanations.title: Examples with 特别 and 最
explanations.body: The book’s digits are spelled out and one missing character is fixed (see example 4). The English is mine.

examples.text: 夏季的东北，农家菜特别受欢迎，地道东北味，外地吃不到。最受欢迎的一道菜就是“三烀一蒸”。这道菜少油，少盐，是非常健康的菜。
examples.translation: xià jì de dōng běi nóng jiā cài tè bié shòu huān yíng dì dào dōng běi wèi wài dì chī bú dào zuì shòu huān yíng de yí dào cài jiù shì sān hū yì zhēng zhè dào cài shǎo yóu shǎo yán shì fēi cháng jiàn kāng de cài — 1. In summer in the Northeast, farmhouse dishes are especially popular, with an authentic Northeastern taste you can’t get elsewhere. The most popular dish is “three stews and one steam.” This dish has little oil and little salt and is a very healthy dish.

examples.text: 最新的小米手机有很多新的功能。最受欢迎的功能就是拍完文字照片以后，能够智能去阴影，很多上网课的大学生都爱用这个新功能。
examples.translation: zuì xīn de xiǎo mǐ shǒu jī yǒu hěn duō xīn de gōng néng zuì shòu huān yíng de gōng néng jiù shì pāi wán wén zì zhào piān yǐ hòu néng gòu zhì néng qù yīn yǐng hěn duō shàng wǎng kè de dà xué shēng dōu ài yòng zhè ge xīn gōng néng — 2. The newest Xiaomi phone has many new functions. The most popular function is that after you photograph text it can intelligently remove shadows, and many university students who take online classes love to use this new function.

examples.text: 对于人生，什么是重要的呢？好像有很多，比如：亲情啊，爱情啊，金钱啊或者什么东西。但是，最重要的就是人生自己，无论怎样的变化，一直拥有的就是你自己。
examples.translation: duì yú rén shēng shén me shì zhòng yào de ne hǎo xiàng yǒu hěn duō bǐ rú qīn qíng a ài qíng a jīn qián a huò zhě shén me dōng xī dàn shì zuì zhòng yào de jiù shì rén shēng zì jǐ wú lùn zěn yàng de biàn huà yì zhí yōng yǒu de jiù shì nǐ zì jǐ — 3. As for life, what is important? There seem to be many things, for example: family love, romantic love, money or some such thing. But the most important is life itself; however things change, what you always have is yourself. (the book prints 人生自己 as it stands)

examples.text: 春暖花开，“五一”小长假马上就要到了，喜欢旅游的朋友们要开始计划出国游了。那么到国外旅游最重要的是什么呢？出门在外最重要的是出游安全。外国游客，特别是老人、妇女较容易成为小偷的目标。大家最好结伴出游，相互照看。
examples.translation: chūn nuǎn huā kāi wǔ yī xiǎo cháng jià mǎ shàng jiù yào dào le xǐ huān lǚ yóu de péng yǒu men yào kāi shǐ jì huà chū guó yóu le nà me dào guó wài lǚ yóu zuì zhòng yào de shì shén me ne chū mén zài wài zuì zhòng yào de shì chū yóu ān quán wài guó yóu kè tè bié shì lǎo rén fù nǚ jiào róng yì chéng wéi xiǎo tōu de mù biāo dà jiā zuì hǎo jié bàn chū yóu xiāng hù zhào kàn — 4. Spring is warm and flowers are blooming, the short May Day holiday is about to arrive, and friends who like to travel are starting to plan trips abroad. So what matters most when traveling abroad? What matters most away from home is safety while traveling. Foreign tourists, especially the elderly and women, more easily become the targets of thieves. It is best to travel in groups and look after one another. (the book prints 最要的是什么, a missing 重; written 最重要的是什么 here)

examples.text: 我喜欢吃水果，草莓啊，橘子啊，苹果啊什么的，特别是热带水果。每到夏天我都特别开心，因为又可以吃到美味的热带水果啦。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān chī shuǐ guǒ cǎo méi a jú zi a píng guǒ a shén me de tè bié shì rè dài shuǐ guǒ měi dào xià tiān wǒ dōu tè bié kāi xīn yīn wèi yòu kě yǐ chī dào měi wèi de rè dài shuǐ guǒ la — 5. I like eating fruit, strawberries, oranges, apples and so on, especially tropical fruit. Every summer I am especially happy, because I can eat delicious tropical fruit again.

examples.text: 这次在美国旅行，吃到了很多好吃的美国饭菜！特别是第一顿饭只有五十五美金，量适中，但是味道超好！
examples.translation: zhè cì zài měi guó lǚ xíng chī dào le hěn duō hǎo chī de měi guó fàn cài tè bié shì dì yī dùn fàn zhǐ yǒu wǔ shí wǔ měi jīn liàng shì zhōng dàn shì wèi dào chāo hǎo — 6. On this trip in America I ate a lot of delicious American food! Especially the first meal cost only fifty-five dollars, with a moderate portion, but the flavor was super good! (the book writes 55 in digits)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Study the following example of 特别, then discuss it with a partner. B. Read the following passage with your partner and answer the questions in Chinese: 1. What is the broad category of people discussed here? 2. Which particular aspect of them is being discussed? 3. Who is singled out as an extreme example? 4. What does the author say to elaborate their point? C. Read your answers to the class. The book gives no key; the answers are mine.

examples.text: 我们班同学学习都很努力，特别是班长，他除了有很多社会工作，还有一个五岁的儿子，可是每次功课都做得很好。有一次……
examples.translation: wǒ men bān tóng xué xué xí dōu hěn nǔ lì tè bié shì bān zhǎng tā chú le yǒu hěn duō shè huì gōng zuò hái yǒu yí gè wǔ suì de ér zi kě shì měi cì gōng kè dōu zuò de hěn hǎo yǒu yí cì — A. The example: The students in our class all study very hard, especially the class monitor: besides having a lot of social work, he has a five-year-old son, but he does his homework well every time. Once… (the book labels the parts: aspect of a class, single out, elaboration; it writes 5 in digits)

examples.text: 城乡教育不公平一直是中国社会的一个大问题，特别是农民工子女，因为没有户口，他们不能在当地上小学，上中学，更别说参加高考了。为了让子女上学，不得不把自己大部分的工资用来请老师。
examples.translation: chéng xiāng jiào yù bù gōng píng yì zhí shì zhōng guó shè huì de yí gè dà wèn tí tè bié shì nóng mín gōng zǐ nǚ yīn wèi méi yǒu hù kǒu tā men bù néng zài dāng dì shàng xiǎo xué shàng zhōng xué gèng bié shuō cān jiā gāo kǎo le wèi le ràng zǐ nǚ shàng xué bù dé bù bǎ zì jǐ dà bù fèn de gōng zī yòng lái qǐng lǎo shī — B. The passage: Unequal education between city and countryside has always been a big problem in Chinese society, especially the children of migrant workers, who, because they have no household registration, cannot attend primary or middle school locally, let alone take the college entrance exam. To let their children go to school, parents have no choice but to spend most of their wages on hiring teachers.

examples.text: 这里谈的是城乡教育不公平，涉及的是城市和农村的孩子。
examples.translation: zhè lǐ tán de shì chéng xiāng jiào yù bù gōng píng shè jí de shì chéng shì hé nóng cūn de hái zi — 1. (my answer) The broad topic is unequal education between city and countryside, concerning city and rural children.

examples.text: 谈的是孩子上学的机会。
examples.translation: tán de shì hái zi shàng xué de jī huì — 2. (my answer) The aspect discussed is children’s chances of going to school.

examples.text: 被特别指出来的是农民工子女。
examples.translation: bèi tè bié zhǐ chū lái de shì nóng mín gōng zǐ nǚ — 3. (my answer) The one singled out is the children of migrant workers.

examples.text: 作者说他们没有户口，不能在当地上学，父母不得不把大部分的工资用来请老师。
examples.translation: zuò zhě shuō tā men méi yǒu hù kǒu bù néng zài dāng dì shàng xué fù mǔ bù dé bù bǎ dà bù fèn de gōng zī yòng lái qǐng lǎo shī — 4. (my answer) The author says they have no household registration and cannot attend school locally, so their parents have to spend most of their wages on hiring teachers.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, choose two pictures each to talk about. Using your imagination, try to point out the most important or special information using 最重要的是…/特别是… or 最受欢迎的是…/特别受欢迎的是…. B. Pair up with a student from another group to relate your group’s information to them. (Six pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Write a short paragraph (five or six sentences) about popular trends among American youth, while a partner does the same for Chinese youth. Use 最重要的是… / 特别是… or 最受欢迎的是… / 特别受欢迎的是… and add as much elaborative information as you can. B. Read your paragraph to your partner, critique each other’s work, and make any necessary corrections or improvements. C. Divide the class into an American group and a Chinese group. In a table (Popular Trends in the U.S. | Popular Trends in China), compile your information to report on your respective popular trends. D. Report your findings to the class in Chinese. (Three pictures are not included.) Two sample sentences, mine:

examples.text: 在美国年轻人中，最受欢迎的是手机游戏。特别是在周末，很多人一玩就是几个小时。
examples.translation: zài měi guó nián qīng rén zhōng zuì shòu huān yíng de shì shǒu jī yóu xì tè bié shì zài zhōu mò hěn duō rén yì wán jiù shì jǐ gè xiǎo shí — Sample for American youth (mine): Among young Americans, the most popular thing is mobile games. Especially at weekends, many people play for hours at a stretch.

examples.text: 在中国年轻人中，最受欢迎的是网上购物。特别是在“双十一”，很多人半夜还在买东西。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó nián qīng rén zhōng zuì shòu huān yíng de shì wǎng shàng gòu wù tè bié shì zài shuāng shí yī hěn duō rén bàn yè hái zài mǎi dōng xī — Sample for Chinese youth (mine): Among young Chinese, the most popular thing is online shopping. Especially on Singles’ Day, many people are still shopping in the middle of the night.

exercises.prompt: What do 特别 and 最 single out?
options: The most extreme or quintessential example

exercises.prompt: What does 最受欢迎的是… mean?
Which is the commonly used phrase for “what matters most”?
What is the most popular dish in the Northeast example?
exercises.explanation: 最受欢迎的一道菜就是“三烀一蒸”.

exercises.prompt: What is the most popular function of the new Xiaomi phone?
Who are singled out as easy targets for thieves?
options: Foreign tourists, especially the elderly and women

exercises.prompt: Who is singled out in the education passage?
What is the aspect of children discussed in the education passage?
options: Their chances of going to school
exercises.explanation: 不能在当地上小学，上中学.

exercises.prompt: 我喜欢吃水果，___别是热带水果。
最受欢迎的一道菜就是“三烀一___”。
这次在美国旅行，吃到了很多好吃的美国饭___！

lessons.title: 647. Lesson 25 Presentation 2 grammar: complex instructions with 接下来
lessons.subtitle: 接下来 · 首先…接下来…然后…最后 · 首先…其次…然后…最后 · 洗衣服的方法 · 先是刮起大风 · 怎么练习瑜伽

explanations.title: Complex Instructions with 接下来
explanations.body: 接下来 is similar to the English “(and) next” in a series of actions. At the beginning of a sentence, it resembles the English “moving right along” to indicate you are “moving on” from one topic to the next. Earlier in the course, you learned to give simple instructions using 先…然后…最后 or 先…再…然后…最后. The more formal version of this is 首先…接下来…然后…最后 (first…next…then…last) or 首先…然后…接下来…最后 (first…then…next…last).

rows: 首先…其次…然后…接着…最后
tables.title: Complex Sequential Patterns

examples.text: 旅行前，只要动动手指，滑动一下页面，看看照片和用户评价，很快就可以选择到满意的民宿。接下来，就是确认住宿时间和个人信息，然后用手机付款，基本上就是“一键完成”。
examples.translation: lǚ xíng qián zhǐ yào dòng dòng shǒu zhǐ huá dòng yí xià yè miàn kàn kàn zhào piān hé yòng hù píng jià hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ xuǎn zé dào mǎn yì de mín sù jiē xià lái jiù shì què rèn zhù sù shí jiān hé gè rén xìn xī rán hòu yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn jī běn shàng jiù shì yí jiàn wán chéng — Examine: Before traveling, you only need to move your fingers, swipe the page and look at the photos and user reviews, and you can soon choose a satisfying homestay. Next comes confirming the dates and personal information and then paying by phone; basically it is “done with one key.”

explanations.title: Examples of the complex patterns
explanations.body: The book gives 接下来/接着 in examples 1 and 2; 接下来 is written here, and 接着 works in the same place. The English is mine.

examples.text: 学习习惯非常重要，首先要做好预习，然后专心听讲，接下来认真完成作业，最后做好复习工作。
examples.translation: xué xí xí guàn fēi cháng zhòng yào shǒu xiān yào zuò hǎo yù xí rán hòu zhuān xīn tīng jiǎng jiē xià lái rèn zhēn wán chéng zuò yè zuì hòu zuò hǎo fù xí gōng zuò — 1. Study habits are very important: first prepare well, then listen attentively, next do your homework carefully, and finally do the review well. (the book prints 接下来/接着, either word)

examples.text: 洗衣服的方法是：首先将洗衣液倒入适量的水中，接下来让衣服在水中泡上十分钟，然后用手洗或机洗，最后晾干。
examples.translation: xǐ yī fú de fāng fǎ shì shǒu xiān jiāng xǐ yī yè dào rù shì liàng de shuǐ zhōng jiē xià lái ràng yī fú zài shuǐ zhōng pào shàng shí fēn zhōng rán hòu yòng shǒu xǐ huò jī xǐ zuì hòu liàng gān — 2. The way to wash clothes: first pour the detergent into a suitable amount of water, next let the clothes soak in the water for ten minutes, then wash by hand or machine, and finally hang them to dry. (the book prints 接下来/接着 and 10 in digits)

examples.text: 首先我们要努力学习，其次要热爱劳动，然后坚持锻炼身体，最后才能成为一个全面发展的好学生。
examples.translation: shǒu xiān wǒ men yào nǔ lì xué xí qí cì yào rè ài láo dòng rán hòu jiān chí duàn liàn shēn tǐ zuì hòu cái néng chéng wéi yí gè quán miàn fā zhǎn de hǎo xué shēng — 3. First we must study hard, second love labor, then keep exercising, and only finally can we become a good all-round student.

examples.text: 在学习中，首先要对学习充满热情，其次是要有好的学习态度，然后在学习中学会思考，最后要找到适合自己的学习方法。
examples.translation: zài xué xí zhōng shǒu xiān yào duì xué xí chōng mǎn rè qíng qí cì shì yào yǒu hǎo de xué xí tài dù rán hòu zài xué xí zhōng xué huì sī kǎo zuì hòu yào zhǎo dào shì hé zì jǐ de xué xí fāng fǎ — 4. In studying, first you must be full of enthusiasm for it, second have a good attitude, then learn to think while studying, and finally find the study method that suits you.

examples.text: 我们要做一个有用的人，首先是要对自己有用，自己的事情能够自己解决，接下来是对家人有用，能够帮助家庭和家人，然后是对身边的人有用，最后是对整个社会有用。
examples.translation: wǒ men yào zuò yí gè yǒu yòng de rén shǒu xiān shì yào duì zì jǐ yǒu yòng zì jǐ de shì qíng néng gòu zì jǐ jiě jué jiē xià lái shì duì jiā rén yǒu yòng néng gòu bāng zhù jiā tíng hé jiā rén rán hòu shì duì shēn biān de rén yǒu yòng zuì hòu shì duì zhěng gè shè huì yǒu yòng — 5. We should be useful people: first useful to ourselves, able to solve our own affairs; next useful to our family, able to help the household and relatives; then useful to the people around us; and finally useful to the whole society.

explanations.title: Note: past and future events
explanations.body: Besides their use in instructions, these patterns can also be used for sequential past or future events or actions.

examples.text: 小明先放好自行车，接着走进教室。然后放好书包，最后等老师来上课。
examples.translation: xiǎo míng xiān fàng hǎo zì xíng chē jiē zhe zǒu jìn jiào shì rán hòu fàng hǎo shū bāo zuì hòu děng lǎo shī lái shàng kè — Note, example 1: Xiao Ming first parked his bicycle, then walked into the classroom, then put down his schoolbag, and finally waited for the teacher to come to class.

examples.text: 天气突然变了，先是刮起大风，接着乌云密布，然后响起阵阵雷声，最后大雨倾盆而下。
examples.translation: tiān qì tū rán biàn le xiān shì guā qǐ dà fēng jiē zhe wū yún mì bù rán hòu xiǎng qǐ zhèn zhèn léi shēng zuì hòu dà yǔ qīng pén ér xià — Note, example 2: The weather suddenly changed: first a strong wind arose, then dark clouds gathered, then peals of thunder sounded, and finally the rain poured down.

examples.text: 早晨起床，首先刷牙，接着洗脸，然后吃早餐，最后出门上学。
examples.translation: zǎo chén qǐ chuáng shǒu xiān shuā yá jiē zhe xǐ liǎn rán hòu chī zǎo cān zuì hòu chū mén shàng xué — Note, example 3: In the morning after getting up, first brush your teeth, then wash your face, then eat breakfast, and finally go out to school.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Using 首先…接下来…然后…最后 or one of its variants, write down what you did after class yesterday and after getting up this morning (昨天下课以后，… / 今天早上起床以后，…). B. Read your narration to a partner, then tell the class what your partner did in Chinese. My two sample narrations:

examples.text: 昨天下课以后，我首先去食堂吃了午饭，接下来去图书馆做作业，然后回宿舍洗澡，最后跟朋友打了一个小时的游戏。
examples.translation: zuó tiān xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ shǒu xiān qù shí táng chī le wǔ fàn jiē xià lái qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè rán hòu huí sù shè xǐ zǎo zuì hòu gēn péng yǒu dǎ le yí gè xiǎo shí de yóu xì — After class yesterday (mine): After class yesterday I first went to the canteen for lunch, next went to the library to do homework, then went back to the dorm to shower, and finally played games with a friend for an hour.

examples.text: 今天早上起床以后，我首先刷牙洗脸，然后吃早饭，接下来看了一会儿手机，最后去上课。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu wǒ shǒu xiān shuā yá xǐ liǎn rán hòu chī zǎo fàn jiē xià lái kàn le yí huìr shǒu jī zuì hòu qù shàng kè — After getting up this morning (mine): After getting up this morning I first brushed my teeth and washed my face, then ate breakfast, next looked at my phone for a while, and finally went to class.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three and divide up the topics below: Topic 1: 怎么练习瑜伽; Topic 2: 怎么学习滑雪; Topic 3: 怎么练习举重. Using 首先…接下来…然后…最后, 首先…然后…接下来…最后 or another variant, write the instructions for your topic in Chinese characters in the table provided. B. Read your instructions to your teammates, then take notes while they read theirs. C. Report one of your teammate’s instructions to the class in Chinese so that all three sets are covered. (Three pictures are not included.) The book’s table is blank; my sample instructions:

examples.text: 怎么练习瑜伽：首先找一个安静的地方，铺好瑜伽垫，然后慢慢做热身动作，接下来练习几个简单的动作，最后躺下来休息。
examples.translation: zěn me liàn xí yú jiā shǒu xiān zhǎo yí gè ān jìng de dì fāng pū hǎo yú jiā diàn rán hòu màn màn zuò rè shēn dòng zuò jiē xià lái liàn xí jǐ gè jiǎn dān de dòng zuò zuì hòu tǎng xià lái xiū xī — Topic 1, 怎么练习瑜伽 (mine): How to practice yoga: first find a quiet place and lay out the yoga mat, then slowly do warm-up moves, next practice a few simple poses, and finally lie down and rest.

examples.text: 怎么学习滑雪：首先要穿好雪鞋，戴好帽子和手套，然后学习怎么站稳，接下来学习怎么转弯，最后学习怎么停下来。
examples.translation: zěn me xué xí huá xuě shǒu xiān yào chuān hǎo xuě xié dài hǎo mào zi hé shǒu tào rán hòu xué xí zěn me zhàn wěn jiē xià lái xué xí zěn me zhuǎn wān zuì hòu xué xí zěn me tíng xià lái — Topic 2, 怎么学习滑雪 (mine): How to learn skiing: first put on your ski boots and wear a hat and gloves, then learn how to stand steadily, next learn how to turn, and finally learn how to stop.

examples.text: 怎么练习举重：首先要做热身，然后选一个轻一点的重量，接下来慢慢举起来，最后放下来休息一会儿。
examples.translation: zěn me liàn xí jǔ zhòng shǒu xiān yào zuò rè shēn rán hòu xuǎn yí gè qīng yì diǎn de zhòng liàng jiē xià lái màn màn jǔ qǐ lái zuì hòu fàng xià lái xiū xī yí huìr — Topic 3, 怎么练习举重 (mine): How to practice weightlifting: first warm up, then choose a lighter weight, next slowly lift it, and finally put it down and rest for a while.

exercises.prompt: What is 接下来 like in English?
options: “(And) next” in a series of actions

exercises.prompt: What does 接下来 at the start of a sentence signal?
options: Moving on to the next topic

exercises.prompt: Which is the formal version of 先…然后…最后?
What does 首先…其次…然后…最后 mean?
Which word can replace 接下来 in 首先…接下来…然后…最后?
In the washing example, how long do the clothes soak?
Can the patterns describe past events too?

options: Wind, dark clouds, thunder, heavy rain
exercises.explanation: 先是刮起大风，接着乌云密布….

exercises.prompt: 洗衣服的方法是：首先将洗衣液倒入适量的水中，接下___让衣服在水中泡上十分钟。
首先我们要努力学习，___次要热爱劳动，然后坚持锻炼身体。

lessons.title: 648. Lesson 25 Presentation 2 grammar: 另外 and 还有 for additional information as an afterthought
lessons.subtitle: 另外 · 还有 · 航班经常晚点 另外 飞机餐也很难吃 · 你需要吃药 还有 要多休息 · 使用智能手机的好处

explanations.title: 话语语法: 另外 and 还有 for Providing Additional Information as an Afterthought
explanations.body: 另外 is similar to the English “in addition” or “besides,” while 还有 is closer to “also...” or “as well as....” Both introduce new information as an afterthought. As a conjunction, 另外 can link two sentences and is often followed by 还 or 也. 还有 can be used before the new clause or sentence. 还有 can also be used with a comma, similar to how you can say “in addition...” in English.

rows: 另外: information + 另外, …. (还/也… )
adds new information as an afterthought; may be followed by 还 or 也
还有: …., 还有, + additional information
adds new information; can follow a comma
tables.title: 另外 and 还有

examples.text: 另外，和一般的宾馆相比，民宿和短租房更有特色，有家的感觉，可以自己买菜做饭，也可以跟房主聊天。
examples.translation: lìng wài hé yì bān de bīn guǎn xiāng bǐ mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng gèng yǒu tè sè yǒu jiā de gǎn jué kě yǐ zì jǐ mǎi cài zuò fàn yě kě yǐ gēn fáng zhǔ liáo tiān — 1. In addition, compared with ordinary guesthouses, homestays and short-term rentals have more character and a feeling of home; you can buy groceries and cook yourself, and you can also chat with the host.

examples.text: 还有，民宿和短租屋的房客来自不同的国家、不同的地区，可以结交到很多新朋友，了解不同的文化和习俗。
examples.translation: hái yǒu mín sù hé duǎn zū wū de fáng kè lái zì bù tóng de guó jiā bù tóng de dì qū kě yǐ jié jiāo dào hěn duō xīn péng yǒu liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà hé xí sú — 2. Also, the guests in homestays and short-term rentals come from different countries and different regions, so you can make many new friends and learn about different cultures and customs.

explanations.title: Examples with 另外 and 还有
explanations.body: The English is mine.

examples.text: 这个航班经常晚点。另外，他们的飞机餐也很难吃。
examples.translation: zhè ge háng bān jīng cháng wǎn diǎn lìng wài tā men de fēi jī cān yě hěn nán chī — 1. This flight is often late. In addition, their in-flight meals are hard to eat too.

examples.text: 我没时间参加这个活动。另外，我也不太感兴趣。
examples.translation: wǒ méi shí jiān cān jiā zhè ge huó dòng lìng wài wǒ yě bú tài gǎn xìng qù — 2. I don’t have time to attend this event. Besides, I’m not very interested either.

examples.text: 幼儿园提供午餐。另外，每天下午还有点心和水果。
examples.translation: yòu ér yuán tí gōng wǔ cān lìng wài měi tiān xià wǔ hái yǒu diǎn xīn hé shuǐ guǒ — 3. The kindergarten provides lunch. In addition, there are snacks and fruit every afternoon.

examples.text: 你需要吃药。还有，要多休息。
examples.translation: nǐ xū yào chī yào hái yǒu yào duō xiū xī — 4. You need to take medicine. Also, you need to rest more.

examples.text: 我要大杯，不要冰，还有，少放糖。
examples.translation: wǒ yào dà bēi bú yào bīng hái yǒu shǎo fàng táng — 5. I want a large, no ice, and also, less sugar.

examples.text: 不要一边吃饭，一边说话。还有，别吃那么快。
examples.translation: bú yào yì biān chī fàn yì biān shuō huà hái yǒu bié chī nà me kuài — 6. Don’t talk while eating. And don’t eat so fast.

examples.text: 酒店谁来订？还有，机票买了吗？
examples.translation: jiǔ diàn shuí lái dìng hái yǒu jī piào mǎi le ma — 7. Who will book the hotel? Also, have the plane tickets been bought? (the book prints these examples with spaces before the punctuation; removed)

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Complete three of the following sentences with 另外 or 还有, while a partner does the other three: 1. 先生，这里不能吸烟。 2. 下班以后早点回来。 3. 考试的时候不要说话。 4. 他们不想要孩子。 5. 希望你不要再迟到了。 6. 课堂上要注意听老师讲课。 B. Read your sentences to your partner while they transcribe them, then convert your transcriptions to Chinese characters. My completions:

examples.text: 先生，这里不能吸烟。另外，也不要在这里打电话。
examples.translation: xiān shēng zhè lǐ bù néng xī yān lìng wài yě bú yào zài zhè lǐ dǎ diàn huà — 1. Sir, you can’t smoke here. In addition, please don’t make phone calls here either. (my completion)

examples.text: 下班以后早点回来。还有，别忘了买菜。
examples.translation: xià bān yǐ hòu zǎo diǎn huí lái hái yǒu bié wàng le mǎi cài — 2. Come back early after work. Also, don’t forget to buy groceries. (my completion)

examples.text: 考试的时候不要说话。另外，也不能看手机。
examples.translation: kǎo shì de shí hòu bú yào shuō huà lìng wài yě bù néng kàn shǒu jī — 3. Don’t talk during the exam. In addition, you can’t look at your phone either. (my completion)

examples.text: 他们不想要孩子。另外，他们也不想买房子。
examples.translation: tā men bù xiǎng yào hái zi lìng wài tā men yě bù xiǎng mǎi fáng zi — 4. They don’t want children. Besides, they don’t want to buy a house either. (my completion)

examples.text: 希望你不要再迟到了。还有，上课要认真听讲。
examples.translation: xī wàng nǐ bú yào zài chí dào le hái yǒu shàng kè yào rèn zhēn tīng jiǎng — 5. I hope you won’t be late again. Also, listen carefully in class. (my completion)

examples.text: 课堂上要注意听老师讲课。另外，也要认真做笔记。
examples.translation: kè táng shàng yào zhù yì tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè lìng wài yě yào rèn zhēn zuò bǐ jì — 6. Pay attention to the teacher’s lecture in class. In addition, take notes carefully too. (my completion)

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the following three speakers, then fill in the table in Chinese with the particular benefits each one mentions (Speakers 1, 2, 3 | Benefits Mentioned). B. Compare information with a partner, then report your answers to the class in Chinese. C. Read the script and check your answers against it. (Audio; the script is not in the book.)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three and divide up the topics below: 使用智能手机的好处; 参军入伍的好处; 住在蒙特雷的好处. Using 另外, 还有 and/or 除了, write a four to six sentence summary of the benefits of your particular topic. B. Read your summary to your partners. My samples:

examples.text: 使用智能手机有很多好处。除了可以打电话以外，还可以上网、拍照和导航。另外，用手机付款也特别方便。还有，手机里有很多应用软件，可以学习外语。
examples.translation: shǐ yòng zhì néng shǒu jī yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù chú le kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà yǐ wài hái kě yǐ shàng wǎng pāi zhào hé dǎo háng lìng wài yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn yě tè bié fāng biàn hái yǒu shǒu jī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn kě yǐ xué xí wài yǔ — Smartphones (mine): Using a smartphone has many benefits. Besides making phone calls, you can also go online, take photos and navigate. In addition, paying by phone is especially convenient. Also, a phone has many apps and you can study a foreign language.

examples.text: 参军入伍有很多好处。除了可以锻炼身体以外，还可以学到很多技术。另外，当兵的人可以得到学习的机会。还有，军人受到大家的尊重。
examples.translation: cān jūn rù wǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù chú le kě yǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ yǐ wài hái kě yǐ xué dào hěn duō jì shù lìng wài dāng bīng de rén kě yǐ dé dào xué xí de jī huì hái yǒu jūn rén shòu dào dà jiā de zūn zhòng — Joining the army (mine): Joining the army has many benefits. Besides keeping your body in shape, you can also learn many skills. In addition, soldiers can get chances to study. Also, soldiers are respected by everyone.

examples.text: 住在蒙特雷有很多好处。除了风景美以外，天气也很好。另外，这里有很多好吃的海鲜。还有，去海边很方便。
examples.translation: zhù zài méng tè léi yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù chú le fēng jǐng měi yǐ wài tiān qì yě hěn hǎo lìng wài zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de hǎi xiān hái yǒu qù hǎi biān hěn fāng biàn — Living in Monterey (mine): Living in Monterey has many benefits. Besides the beautiful scenery, the weather is good too. In addition, there is lots of delicious seafood here. Also, it is easy to get to the seaside.

exercises.prompt: What is 另外 like in English?
What is 还有 closer to?
What kind of information do both introduce?

options: 你需要吃药。还有，要多休息。
你需要吃药。因为，要多休息。
你需要吃药。吗，要多休息。

Read the first part of the blog post, while the other group reads the second part. Fill in the table (Paragraph | Main Idea & EEIs) for your respective part, then compare work with your teammates. tables.title: Activity 3A: supplementary vocabulary (the book prints pinyin and English)

explanations.title: 一次奇妙的短租经历 (一)
explanations.body: The first part, with my English.

examples.text: 记得看到过这样一句话：现在大家的旅行就像快餐，钱都花在当地和自己熟悉的东西上，但是，如果旅行更像是当地风味的豪华自助餐呢？你会更喜欢吗？
examples.translation: jì de kàn dào guò zhè yàng yí jù huà xiàn zài dà jiā de lǚ xíng jiù xiàng kuài cān qián dōu huā zài dāng dì hé zì jǐ shú xī de dōng xī shàng dàn shì rú guǒ lǚ xíng gèng xiàng shì dāng dì fēng wèi de háo huá zì zhù cān ne nǐ huì gèng xǐ huān ma — 1) I remember seeing a saying like this: these days everyone’s travel is like fast food, with the money all spent on local things and things you are familiar with; but what if travel were more like a luxury buffet of local flavors? Would you like it more?

examples.text: 这一次因为出差，我和同事两个人需要在上海住三天。来之前，我们已经在木鸟短租上订了一间民宿。通过跟房东的线上交谈，我们觉得房东是一个非常细心的人。当他了解到我们是两个女生，而且是晚上十一点才到车站，就告诉我们，他会去车站接我们。然后，又把房间的密码发给了我。我们到车站的时候，接到一个司机打来的电话，他告诉我们因为房东先生工作太忙，不能亲自来接站，所以特地叫了专车来接我们。
examples.translation: zhè yí cì yīn wèi chū chāi wǒ hé tóng shì liǎng gè rén xū yào zài shàng hǎi zhù sān tiān lái zhī qián wǒ men yǐ jīng zài mù niǎo duǎn zū shàng dìng le yì jiān mín sù tōng guò gēn fáng dōng de xiàn shàng jiāo tán wǒ men jué de fáng dōng shì yí gè fēi cháng xì xīn de rén dāng tā liǎo jiě dào wǒ men shì liǎng gè nǚ shēng ér qiě shì wǎn shàng shí yī diǎn cái dào chē zhàn jiù gào sù wǒ men tā huì qù chē zhàn jiē wǒ men rán hòu yòu bǎ fáng jiān de mì mǎ fā gěi le wǒ wǒ men dào chē zhàn de shí hòu jiē dào yí gè sī jī dǎ lái de diàn huà tā gào sù wǒ men yīn wèi fáng dōng xiān shēng gōng zuò tài máng bù néng qīn zì lái jiē zhàn suǒ yǐ tè dì jiào le zhuān chē lái jiē wǒ men — 2) This time, because of a business trip, my colleague and I needed to stay in Shanghai for three days. Before coming, we had already booked a homestay on Mumian Short-term Rentals. From our online chat with the landlord we felt that he was a very attentive person. When he learned that we were two girls and would not reach the station until eleven at night, he told us that he would pick us up at the station. Then he sent me the room’s password. When we reached the station we got a call from a driver, who told us that because the landlord was too busy at work to come and meet us in person, he had specially called a car to pick us up.

examples.text: 到了目的地，房间的锁是密码锁，而且密码已经发到我的手机上，所以进入房间超级容易。房间里比我们原来想象的要好得多，因为在短租平台上看到的图片，房间是冷色的，但是到了晚上开灯之后才发现原来房间是如此温馨。橘色的灯光，让整个房间温暖、舒适。那天晚上，还没见到面的房东竟然帮我们叫了外卖！而且是一家高档餐厅的外卖！这让我对房东充满了好奇心。
examples.translation: dào le mù dì dì fáng jiān de suǒ shì mì mǎ suǒ ér qiě mì mǎ yǐ jīng fā dào wǒ de shǒu jī shàng suǒ yǐ jìn rù fáng jiān chāo jí róng yì fáng jiān lǐ bǐ wǒ men yuán lái xiǎng xiàng de yào hǎo de duō yīn wèi zài duǎn zū píng tái shàng kàn dào de tú piàn fáng jiān shì lěng sè de dàn shì dào le wǎn shàng kāi dēng zhī hòu cái fā xiàn yuán lái fáng jiān shì rú cǐ wēn xīn jú sè de dēng guāng ràng zhěng gè fáng jiān wēn nuǎn shū shì nà tiān wǎn shàng hái méi jiàn dào miàn de fáng dōng jìng rán bāng wǒ men jiào le wài mài ér qiě shì yì jiā gāo dàng cān tīng de wài mài zhè ràng wǒ duì fáng dōng chōng mǎn le hào qí xīn — 3) On arrival, the room had a combination lock and the password had already been sent to my phone, so getting in was super easy. The room was much better than we had imagined, because in the pictures on the short-term rental platform the room had cool colors, but after turning on the lights in the evening we found that the room was in fact this warm and cozy. The orange light made the whole room warm and comfortable. That night the landlord, whom we had not yet met, even ordered takeout for us! And it was takeout from a high-end restaurant! This filled me with curiosity about the landlord. (source note: adapted from a post on the Jianshu website; the English is mine)

explanations.title: 一次奇妙的短租经历 (二)
explanations.body: The second part, with my English.

examples.text: 白天忙工作，晚上回到家，可以做做饭，看看书，听听音乐，和同事一起到楼下散步，找些当地的小吃。房间里边有很多关于美食的书，我想房东一定很爱美食吧。说来奇怪，这谜一样的房东在我们入住这三天的时间里，完全没有露面，但是细心的安排让我们却非常感动。
examples.translation: bái tiān máng gōng zuò wǎn shàng huí dào jiā kě yǐ zuò zuò fàn kàn kàn shū tīng tīng yīn yuè hé tóng shì yì qǐ dào lóu xià sàn bù zhǎo xiē dāng dì de xiǎo chī fáng jiān lǐ biān yǒu hěn duō guān yú měi shí de shū wǒ xiǎng fáng dōng yí dìng hěn ài měi shí ba shuō lái qí guài zhè mí yí yàng de fáng dōng zài wǒ men rù zhù zhè sān tiān de shí jiān lǐ wán quán méi yǒu lòu miàn dàn shì xì xīn de ān pái ràng wǒ men què fēi cháng gǎn dòng — 1) Busy with work in the daytime, in the evening we could come home and cook, read, listen to music, and take a walk downstairs with my colleague to find some local snacks. The room had many books about food, and I thought the landlord must love food. Strangely, this mysterious landlord did not show his face at all during our three days of staying, but his attentive arrangements moved us a lot.

examples.text: 退房当天，我给房东发了短信，告诉他我们下午就要走了，谢谢他的照顾。房间也简单收拾好了。没想到房东马上回了我的短信：中午见，等我吃饭。见到房东才知道，原来他是餐厅的大厨，平时工作忙，住在单位的宿舍里，这间房子就空了出来。那天的外卖也是他特别为我们做的，今天中午是请假回来，想给我们两个做一顿午餐，表示欢迎。房东先生还教了我一道他的拿手菜，真地感谢。
examples.translation: tuì fáng dàng tiān wǒ gěi fáng dōng fā le duǎn xìn gào sù tā wǒ men xià wǔ jiù yào zǒu le xiè xiè tā de zhào gù fáng jiān yě jiǎn dān shōu shí hǎo le méi xiǎng dào fáng dōng mǎ shàng huí le wǒ de duǎn xìn zhōng wǔ jiàn děng wǒ chī fàn jiàn dào fáng dōng cái zhī dào yuán lái tā shì cān tīng de dà chú píng shí gōng zuò máng zhù zài dān wèi de sù shè lǐ zhè jiān fáng zi jiù kōng le chū lái nà tiān de wài mài yě shì tā tè bié wèi wǒ men zuò de jīn tiān zhōng wǔ shì qǐng jià huí lái xiǎng gěi wǒ men liǎng gè zuò yí dùn wǔ cān biǎo shì huān yíng fáng dōng xiān shēng hái jiāo le wǒ yí dào tā de ná shǒu cài zhēn de gǎn xiè — 2) On the day of checking out, I sent the landlord a text message to tell him that we were leaving in the afternoon and to thank him for looking after us. The room was also tidied up simply. Unexpectedly the landlord replied to my message right away: see you at noon, wait for me to eat. Only when we met him did we learn that he is a chef at a restaurant; he is usually busy with work and lives in his workplace’s dormitory, so this house was left empty. The takeout that day had also been made by him specially for us, and today he had taken leave and come back at noon to make lunch for the two of us as a welcome. Mr. Landlord also taught me one of his signature dishes; I am truly grateful. (the book prints 真地感谢 as it stands)

examples.text: 我和同事都被这位房东迷住了，跟他聊天，就像一家人一样，很是温暖和自在。这次奇妙的短租经历，让我从此爱上了民宿。
examples.translation: wǒ hé tóng shì dōu bèi zhè wèi fáng dōng mí zhù le gēn tā liáo tiān jiù xiàng yì jiā rén yí yàng hěn shì wēn nuǎn hé zì zài zhè cì qí miào de duǎn zū jīng lì ràng wǒ cóng cǐ ài shàng le mín sù — 3) My colleague and I were both charmed by this landlord; chatting with him was like being one family, very warm and at ease. This wonderful short-term rental experience made me love homestays from then on. (source note: edited from a post on the Jianshu website)

explanations.title: Activity 3: my notes and table

Pair up with a student from the other group, exchange information in Chinese, then fill in the table (Information | Short-Term Rental Experience: Where; Duration; Reason; Booking Method; Rental Information; Owner Information; Activities During Stay; Impressions). D. In Chinese, tell your partner about a short-term rental experience you, your family or friends have had. The book’s tables are blank; these notes are mine.
