lessons.title: 650. Lesson 25 Presentation 2 skill integration: a travel article about homestays in America
lessons.subtitle: 在美国住民宿 · 爱彼迎 · 注册成为会员 · 一键完成 · 地理位置 · 省钱的住宿方式 · 留下美好的回忆

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Your teacher will give each of you one or two paragraphs from a travel article. Read your paragraphs and write a summary based on the main idea and EEIs. B. Share your summary with your teammates in Chinese. C. Reconstruct the article by putting the strips in their correct order. Share your arrangement with the class. D. Read the article together, then give it an appropriate title in Chinese. The four slips follow; the book’s own full text of the article (page 60) puts them in the order Slip 3, Slip 1, Slip 2, Slip 4. (Two pictures are not included.)

examples.text: 在美国住民宿，首先你需要用“爱彼迎”这个网站，这是个专门预定民宿的网站，有中文网页，而且世界各地的民宿都有。旅行前，你可以先下载手机应用或在它的网站上注册成为会员，并确认邮箱和电话，然后就可以按自己的旅行地点和时间选择想要住宿的房子了。接下来，就是输入自己的个人信息，选择付款方式，我用的是支付宝。最后，提交你的订单就可以了。整个过程，基本上不超过二十分钟，而且是“一键完成”。
examples.translation: zài měi guó zhù mín sù shǒu xiān nǐ xū yào yòng ài bǐ yíng zhè ge wǎng zhàn zhè shì gè zhuān mén yù dìng mín sù de wǎng zhàn yǒu zhōng wén wǎng yè ér qiě shì jiè gè dì de mín sù dōu yǒu lǚ xíng qián nǐ kě yǐ xiān xià zài shǒu jī yìng yòng huò zài tā de wǎng zhàn shàng zhù cè chéng wéi huì yuán bìng què rèn yóu xiāng hé diàn huà rán hòu jiù kě yǐ àn zì jǐ de lǚ xíng dì diǎn hé shí jiān xuǎn zé xiǎng yào zhù sù de fáng zi le jiē xià lái jiù shì shū rù zì jǐ de gè rén xìn xī xuǎn zé fù kuǎn fāng shì wǒ yòng de shì zhī fù bǎo zuì hòu tí jiāo nǐ de dìng dān jiù kě yǐ le zhěng gè guò chéng jī běn shàng bù chāo guò èr shí fēn zhōng ér qiě shì yí jiàn wán chéng — Slip 1: To stay in a homestay in America, first you need to use the “Airbnb” website, a website specializing in booking homestays, with Chinese web pages, and with homestays all over the world. Before traveling you can first download the phone app or register as a member on its website and confirm your email and phone, and then you can choose the place you want to stay by your travel location and dates. Next is entering your personal information and choosing the payment method; I used Alipay. Finally, submit your order. The whole process basically takes no more than twenty minutes and is “done with one key.”

examples.text: “爱彼迎”上面的民宿很多，你得小心的选择，这样才能找到满意的民宿。通常来说，房子的地理位置是我选择民宿的首要原因。预定以前，我在平台上看网友的评价或是跟房主了解附近是否安全，有没有方便的交通和超市，或是免费停车的地方。另外，再看看房型是否合适。这次我们是一家三口，所以选择了比较大的独立房间。接下来，就是比较价格。通常地理位置好的民宿，价格都会高一些，但是更方便。我们这次选择的房间基本上都是在六十到八十美金一晚上的。还有，一定要仔细阅读游客给房主的打分和评价。只有大多数方面房客给打满五分的才可以是真正好的民宿。
examples.translation: ài bǐ yíng shàng miàn de mín sù hěn duō nǐ děi xiǎo xīn de xuǎn zé zhè yàng cái néng zhǎo dào mǎn yì de mín sù tōng cháng lái shuō fáng zi de dì lǐ wèi zhì shì wǒ xuǎn zé mín sù de shǒu yào yuán yīn yù dìng yǐ qián wǒ zài píng tái shàng kàn wǎng yǒu de píng jià huò shì gēn fáng zhǔ liǎo jiě fù jìn shì fǒu ān quán yǒu méi yǒu fāng biàn de jiāo tōng hé chāo shì huò shì miǎn fèi tíng chē de dì fāng lìng wài zài kàn kàn fáng xíng shì fǒu hé shì zhè cì wǒ men shì yì jiā sān kǒu suǒ yǐ xuǎn zé le bǐ jiào dà de dú lì fáng jiān jiē xià lái jiù shì bǐ jiào jià gé tōng cháng dì lǐ wèi zhì hǎo de mín sù jià gé dōu huì gāo yì xiē dàn shì gèng fāng biàn wǒ men zhè cì xuǎn zé de fáng jiān jī běn shàng dōu shì zài liù shí dào bā shí měi jīn yì wǎn shàng de hái yǒu yí dìng yào zǐ xì yuè dú yóu kè gěi fáng zhǔ de dǎ fēn hé píng jià zhǐ yǒu dà duō shù fāng miàn fáng kè gěi dǎ mǎn wǔ fēn de cái kě yǐ shì zhēn zhèng hǎo de mín sù — Slip 2: There are many homestays on Airbnb; you have to choose carefully so you can find a homestay you are satisfied with. Generally speaking, the location of the house is my first reason for choosing a homestay. Before booking I look at netizens’ reviews on the platform or ask the host whether the neighborhood is safe, whether there is convenient transportation and a supermarket, or a place for free parking. In addition, look again at whether the room type is suitable. This time we were a family of three, so we chose a fairly large private room. Next comes comparing prices. Usually homestays in good locations cost a bit more, but are more convenient. The rooms we chose this time were basically all sixty to eighty dollars a night. Also, you must read carefully the ratings and reviews that tourists give the host. Only one that most guests have given a full five points in most respects can be a truly good homestay. (the book writes 60, 80 and 5 in digits)

examples.text: 旅行中住宿的费用是非常大的一笔钱。这次去美国旅行，我们尝试了住美国的民宿，中部、东海岸、西海岸，前后住了七个美国民宿。和以前住过的各种酒店、家庭旅馆和青年旅社相比，我们发现这是特别省钱的一种住宿方式，而且还可以近距离地跟当地人接触，了解美国文化和习俗，特别有趣。
examples.translation: lǚ xíng zhōng zhù sù de fèi yòng shì fēi cháng dà de yì bǐ qián zhè cì qù měi guó lǚ xíng wǒ men cháng shì le zhù měi guó de mín sù zhōng bù dōng hǎi àn xī hǎi àn qián hòu zhù le qī gè měi guó mín sù hé yǐ qián zhù guò de gè zhǒng jiǔ diàn jiā tíng lǚ guǎn hé qīng nián lǚ shè xiāng bǐ wǒ men fā xiàn zhè shì tè bié shěng qián de yì zhǒng zhù sù fāng shì ér qiě hái kě yǐ jìn jù lí de gēn dāng dì rén jiē chù liǎo jiě měi guó wén huà hé xí sú tè bié yǒu qù — Slip 3: The cost of lodging on a trip is a very large sum of money. On this trip to America we tried staying in American homestays, in the Midwest, the East Coast and the West Coast, and altogether stayed in seven American homestays. Compared with the various hotels, family inns and youth hostels we have stayed in before, we found this a particularly money-saving way of lodging, and we could also be close to local people and learn about American culture and customs, which was especially interesting. (the book writes 7 in digits)

examples.text: 总之，在外国住民宿是非常难得的一种体会。希望大家都去体验一下，我相信一定会给你留下更多、更美好的回忆。
examples.translation: zǒng zhī zài wài guó zhù mín sù shì fēi cháng nán dé de yì zhǒng tǐ huì xī wàng dà jiā dōu qù tǐ yàn yí xià wǒ xiāng xìn yí dìng huì gěi nǐ liú xià gèng duō gèng měi hǎo de huí yì — Slip 4: In short, staying in a homestay abroad is a very rare kind of experience. I hope everyone will go and try it; I believe it will certainly leave you with more and more beautiful memories.

explanations.title: Activity 4: my summary and title
explanations.body: The book leaves the summary and the title blank; mine are below. The correct order from the book’s full text is 3, 1, 2, 4.

examples.text: 在美国住民宿又省钱又有趣，要先在网站上注册，选房子，输入信息，付款，选地理位置好的房子，看评价，比较价格，值得一试。
examples.translation: zài měi guó zhù mín sù yòu shěng qián yòu yǒu qù yào xiān zài wǎng zhàn shàng zhù cè xuǎn fáng zi shū rù xìn xī fù kuǎn xuǎn dì lǐ wèi zhì hǎo de fáng zi kàn píng jià bǐ jiào jià gé zhí de yí shì — Summary (mine): Staying in a homestay in America is both cheap and interesting: register on the website, choose a house, enter your information and pay; choose a house in a good location, read reviews and compare prices; it is worth a try.

lessons.title: 651. Lesson 25 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: Airbnb, a debate and hosting advice
lessons.subtitle: 爱彼迎推广大使 · 民宿、短租好还是宾馆、酒店好 · 当好民宿主的建议 · 微信直播

explanations.title: 爱彼迎推广大使 (Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. You and an expat colleague are hired by Airbnb China (爱彼迎) to market their services to Chinese travelers planning to visit the U.S. Visit the Chinese Airbnb website. Take notes on its platform and services in the table provided and search for any relevant information you may need. B. You plan to livestream on WeChat and other platforms to introduce Airbnb services and their advantages, the platform and its app, and how to book accommodations via smartphone apps. Decide who will say what during the livestream and practice your presentation together. C. Livestream to your Chinese audience (your classmates), who will ask you questions about Airbnb. D. When all pairs have finished, vote as a class for the best livestream performance. (Three pictures and the website are not used.)

tables.title: Activity 1A: the table to fill in

examples.text: 大家好！今天我们来介绍爱彼迎。在这个平台上，你可以在手机上订世界各地的民宿，而且价格比宾馆便宜。
examples.translation: dà jiā hǎo jīn tiān wǒ men lái jiè shào ài bǐ yíng zài zhè ge píng tái shàng nǐ kě yǐ zài shǒu jī shàng dìng shì jiè gè dì de mín sù ér qiě jià gé bǐ bīn guǎn pián yi — Livestream sample (mine): Hello everyone! Today we introduce Airbnb. On this platform you can book homestays all over the world on your phone, and the prices are cheaper than guesthouses.

examples.text: 使用爱彼迎很简单，首先下载应用，然后选地方，接下来确认时间，最后用手机付款。
examples.translation: shǐ yòng ài bǐ yíng hěn jiǎn dān shǒu xiān xià zài yìng yòng rán hòu xuǎn dì fāng jiē xià lái què rèn shí jiān zuì hòu yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn — Livestream sample (mine): Using Airbnb is simple: first download the app, then choose a place, next confirm the dates, and finally pay by phone.

explanations.title: 民宿、短租好还是宾馆、酒店好 (Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2)
explanations.body: A. Divide the class into two groups to debate which accommodations are better: Airbnb or short-term rentals, and hotels. As long as the two groups are fairly even in number, divide up according to your preference when traveling. B. Write down the reasons for your preference in Chinese characters in the appropriate table. C. In Chinese, discuss why you think your opponents’ choice is bad. List your reasons or arguments in the tables 宾馆、酒店不好 (Group 1) and 民宿、短租不好 (Group 2). D. Debate when you are ready. Use such patterns as 是…的主要原因, 另外, 还有 and 特别是 as much as possible. E. Your teacher will chair the debate and critique your performance afterwards. (Three pictures are not included.)

examples.text: 住民宿是很好的选择，因为价格便宜，还可以跟房主聊天。

examples.text: 住宾馆更好，因为宾馆更干净，而且有人打扫房间。

explanations.body: A. Pair up. A friend who owns a house in Monterey wants to start an Airbnb or other short-term rental service. They ask for your advice on attracting Chinese tourists. In Chinese, ask your teacher and classmates for their opinion, covering at least the following points: reasons Chinese tourists like Airbnb or short-term rentals; what tools, platforms and payment methods they use; their travel habits and preferences; how the homeowner should prepare their rooms, kitchen, living room, etc.; advice on room decoration, food choices and cultural considerations. B. Based on their opinions and advice, fill in the table below. C. Use the information you have gathered to list your advice (当一个好民宿主的建议). D. Read your suggestions to your teacher and classmates and solicit their comments. (Three pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 滴滴出行
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 以前在中国，大家出行主要靠公交车和出租车。现在有了更方便的选择，最受欢迎的就是“滴滴出行”。“滴滴出行”是一个网约车平台，提供出租车、顺风车、拼车等服务。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zài zhōng guó dà jiā chū xíng zhǔ yào kào gōng jiāo chē hé chū zū chē xiàn zài yǒu le gèng fāng biàn de xuǎn zé zuì shòu huān yíng de jiù shì dī dī chū xíng dī dī chū xíng shì yí gè wǎng yuē chē píng tái tí gōng chū zū chē shùn fēng chē pīn chē děng fú wù — Paragraph 1: In the past in China, everyone traveled mainly by bus and taxi. Now there are more convenient choices, and the most popular is “Didi Chuxing.” Didi Chuxing is a ride-hailing platform that provides taxi, hitchhiking, carpooling and other services. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: “滴滴”出现以后，乘客可以用智能手机直接预约叫车，省去了很多等候的时间，因为“滴滴”能够精确定位，准时到达，让你轻松出发。另外，“滴滴”还可以根据乘客需要，提供特别的服务，比如大件行李、宠物或是儿童座椅。他们甚至还有代驾服务，就是代驾司机开着车主的车，把喝过酒或醉酒的车主送回家。
examples.translation: dī dī chū xiàn yǐ hòu chéng kè kě yǐ yòng zhì néng shǒu jī zhí jiē yù yuē jiào chē shěng qù le hěn duō děng hòu de shí jiān yīn wèi dī dī néng gòu jīng què dìng wèi zhǔn shí dào dá ràng nǐ qīng sōng chū fā lìng wài dī dī hái kě yǐ gēn jù chéng kè xū yào tí gōng tè bié de fú wù bǐ rú dà jiàn xíng li chǒng wù huò shì ér tóng zuò yǐ tā men shèn zhì hái yǒu dài jià fú wù jiù shì dài jià sī jī kāi zhe chē zhǔ de chē bǎ hē guò jiǔ huò zuì jiǔ de chē zhǔ sòng huí jiā — Paragraph 2: After Didi appeared, passengers can use a smartphone to book a ride directly, saving a lot of waiting time, because Didi can locate accurately and arrive on time, letting you set off with ease. In addition, Didi can also provide special services according to passengers’ needs, such as large pieces of luggage, pets or child seats. They even have a designated-driver service, that is, the designated driver drives the car owner’s car and takes an owner who has been drinking or is drunk home.

examples.text: “滴滴”除了为人们提供便利的出行服务以外，也为很多人提供了工作机会，增加了他们的收入。一般来说，“滴滴”司机每月的收入能有四千到五千元人民币。
examples.translation: dī dī chú le wèi rén men tí gōng biàn lì de chū xíng fú wù yǐ wài yě wèi hěn duō rén tí gōng le gōng zuò jī huì zēng jiā le tā men de shōu rù yì bān lái shuō dī dī sī jī měi yuè de shōu rù néng yǒu sì qiān dào wǔ qiān yuán rén mín bì — Paragraph 3: Besides providing people with convenient travel services, Didi has also provided jobs for many people and increased their income. Generally speaking, a Didi driver’s monthly income can reach four to five thousand yuan. (the book writes 4000 and 5000 in digits)

examples.text: 以后的网约车会更加智能化，现在上海已经出现了“滴滴”无人驾驶出租车。新的人工智能会更好地为乘客和司机服务。
examples.translation: yǐ hòu de wǎng yuē chē huì gèng jiā zhì néng huà xiàn zài shàng hǎi yǐ jīng chū xiàn le dī dī wú rén jià shǐ chū zū chē xīn de rén gōng zhì néng huì gèng hǎo de wèi chéng kè hé sī jī fú wù — Paragraph 4: In future ride-hailing will become even more intelligent; driverless Didi taxis have already appeared in Shanghai. lessons.subtitle: 根据乘客需要 · 据说 · 根据老师的要求 · 据我看 · 据传 · 据报道 据统计 据估计 · 根据新华社报道

explanations.title: Prepositions 根据 and 据
explanations.body: Both 根据 and 据 are prepositions that mean “according to” or “based on.” 根据 can also be a noun meaning “basis” or “foundation.” As prepositions, 根据 and 据 often precede a noun or noun phrase, but, while 据 can be followed by a sentence, 根据 cannot.

rows: 据 can be followed by a sentence; 根据 cannot
tables.title: 根据 and 据

examples.text: 另外，“滴滴”还可以根据乘客需要，提供特别的服务。
examples.translation: lìng wài dī dī hái kě yǐ gēn jù chéng kè xū yào tí gōng tè bié de fú wù — 1. In addition, Didi can also provide special services according to passengers’ needs.

examples.text: 据说，他明年要到中国去留学。
examples.translation: jù shuō tā míng nián yào dào zhōng guó qù liú xué — 2. It is said that he is going to study in China next year.

examples.text: 你说话要有根据，我什么时候不认真学习了？
examples.translation: nǐ shuō huà yào yǒu gēn jù wǒ shén me shí hòu bú rèn zhēn xué xí le — 3. You must have a basis when you speak: when did I not study seriously? (根据 as a noun, “basis”)

explanations.title: Examples with 根据 and 据
explanations.body: The English is mine.

examples.text: 根据老师的要求，我们明天要早点到学校。
examples.translation: gēn jù lǎo shī de yāo qiú wǒ men míng tiān yào zǎo diǎn dào xué xiào — 1. According to the teacher’s request, we have to get to school a bit earlier tomorrow.

examples.text: 根据他的能力，她可以当经理。
examples.translation: gēn jù tā de néng lì tā kě yǐ dāng jīng lǐ — 2. Based on his ability, she can be a manager. (the book’s pronouns are as printed)

examples.text: 根据她的脸色，我就知道她一点都不高兴。
examples.translation: gēn jù tā de liǎn sè wǒ jiù zhī dào tā yì diǎn dōu bù gāo xìng — 3. From the look on her face I knew she was not happy at all.

examples.text: 据说，张华的女朋友很漂亮。
examples.translation: jù shuō zhāng huá de nǚ péng yǒu hěn piào liàng — 4. It is said that Zhang Hua’s girlfriend is very pretty.

examples.text: 据我看，他很聪明，就是不努力。
examples.translation: jù wǒ kàn tā hěn cōng míng jiù shì bù nǔ lì — 5. In my view he is very clever, he just doesn’t work hard.

examples.text: 据传，她要去北京工作了。
examples.translation: jù chuán tā yào qù běi jīng gōng zuò le — 6. It is rumored that she is going to work in Beijing.

explanations.title: Differences between 根据 and 据
explanations.body: • 据 can precede words with only one character, while 根据 must precede words with at least two characters. • 据 is often used with the verbs 说, 闻, 悉, 传, while 根据 cannot be. 根据 is commonly used with sets of two-character phrases found in formal and written Chinese, especially in news reports. • 据 is frequently used with word sets like 据报道, 据统计 (statistics) and 据估计 (estimates). • 据 is often used when referring to people, as in 据某人说, 据某人看来 or 据习近平说. However, 根据 can only be used with a personal name or pronoun followed by a noun phrase. • 据 can precede a sentence, while 根据 can only precede a noun or noun phrase.

rows: 根据 + two or more characters: ✓
据 + 说, 闻, 悉, 传: ✓
根据 + 报道, 新闻报道, 新华社: ✓
据 + 某人说 / 某人看来: ✓

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Determine whether the following sentences are correct, then rewrite the incorrect sentences in Chinese characters: 1. 根据说，她很友好。 2. 根据老师的说法，我们班这次考试成绩很好。 3. 根据我看，他虽然有很多钱，可是不幸福。 4. 据报道，现在学校里每个学生都有一台电脑。 5. 根据传，她准备结婚了。 6. 据统计，80% 的学生都觉得早上 7:55 就上课，太早了。 B. In Chinese, share your answers with the class and explain your reasoning. The book gives no key; the answers are mine:

examples.text: 据说，她很友好。
examples.translation: jù shuō tā hěn yǒu hǎo — 1. (corrected) It is said that she is very friendly. The book’s 根据说 is wrong: 根据 cannot go with 说.

examples.text: 根据老师的说法，我们班这次考试成绩很好。
examples.translation: gēn jù lǎo shī de shuō fǎ wǒ men bān zhè cì kǎo shì chéng jì hěn hǎo — 2. (correct) According to the teacher, our class’s exam results this time were very good.

examples.text: 据我看，他虽然有很多钱，可是不幸福。
examples.translation: jù wǒ kàn tā suī rán yǒu hěn duō qián kě shì bú xìng fú — 3. (corrected) In my view, although he has a lot of money, he is not happy. The book’s 根据我看 is wrong: 据 is used with 我看.

examples.text: 据报道，现在学校里每个学生都有一台电脑。
examples.translation: jù bào dào xiàn zài xué xiào lǐ měi gè xué shēng dōu yǒu yì tái diàn nǎo — 4. (correct) According to reports, every student in schools now has a computer.

examples.text: 据传，她准备结婚了。
examples.translation: jù chuán tā zhǔn bèi jié hūn le — 5. (corrected) It is rumored that she is getting married. The book’s 根据传 is wrong: 传 goes with 据.

examples.text: 据统计，百分之八十的学生都觉得早上七点五十五分就上课，太早了。
examples.translation: jù tǒng jì bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de xué shēng dōu jué de zǎo shàng qī diǎn wǔ shí wǔ fēn jiù shàng kè tài zǎo le — 6. (correct) According to statistics, eighty percent of the students feel that starting class at 7:55 in the morning is too early. (the book writes 80% and 7:55 in digits)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Starting with 根据 or 据, write a short report (three or more sentences), in the formal style, on current issues or everyday life, while a partner writes a report in the informal style. B. Read your report to your partner, then work together to improve your reports. C. Read your finished reports to the class. (Three pictures are not included.) One formal and one informal sample sentence, mine:

examples.text: 根据天气预报，明天会下大雨，所以学校决定停课一天。
examples.translation: gēn jù tiān qì yù bào míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ suǒ yǐ xué xiào jué dìng tíng kè yì tiān — Formal sample (mine): According to the weather forecast it will rain heavily tomorrow, so the school has decided to cancel classes for one day.

examples.text: 据说，学校旁边新开了一家餐馆，菜做得特别好吃。
examples.translation: jù shuō xué xiào páng biān xīn kāi le yì jiā cān guǎn cài zuò de tè bié hǎo chī — Informal sample (mine): It is said that a new restaurant has opened next to the school, and the food is especially good.

exercises.prompt: What do 根据 and 据 mean as prepositions?
Which one can be followed by a whole sentence?
Which one needs at least two characters after it?
Which register is 根据 commonly used in?
What does 你说话要有根据 use 根据 as?
根___老师的要求，我们明天要早点到学校。

lessons.title: 656. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 grammar: 就是 and 也就是 (说) for elaboration and explanation
lessons.subtitle: 就是 也就是 那就是 就是说 · 代驾服务 · 失眠症 · 素食者 · 剩女 · 宅男 · 小鲜肉 数码小偷 脑雾 吃瓜群众 剁手 带货

explanations.title: 话语语法: 就是/也就是 (说) for Elaboration and Explanation
explanations.body: 就是, 也就是说, 那就是 and 就是说 mean “that is,” “in other words,” “that is to say,” etc. These are used to provide further clarification, definition, explication, or information. When used for explication or definition, 就是 comes after a noun, noun phrase or sentence, all preceded by a comma.

rows: Noun, Noun Phrase or Sentence + 就是, + Explanation
the common variants; 那就是 and 也就是说 also work
tables.title: 就是/也就是 (说)

examples.text: 他们甚至还有代驾服务，就是代驾司机开着车主的车，把喝过酒或醉酒的车主送回家。
examples.translation: tā men shèn zhì hái yǒu dài jià fú wù jiù shì dài jià sī jī kāi zhe chē zhǔ de chē bǎ hē guò jiǔ huò zuì jiǔ de chē zhǔ sòng huí jiā — Example: They even have a designated-driver service, that is, the designated driver drives the car owner’s car and takes an owner who has been drinking or is drunk home.

explanations.title: Examples with 就是 and 也就是 (说)
explanations.body: The book’s date in example 4 is spelled out. The English is mine.

examples.text: 昨天晚上，我在宿舍里什么都没做，就是在网上看看新闻，打打游戏什么的。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ zài sù shè lǐ shén me dōu méi zuò jiù shì zài wǎng shàng kàn kàn xīn wén dǎ dǎ yóu xì shén me de — 1. Last night I didn’t do anything in the dorm, just read the news online, played games and so on.

examples.text: 学好中文没有什么秘密，基本上就是多听多练。
examples.translation: xué hǎo zhōng wén méi yǒu shén me mì mì jī běn shàng jiù shì duō tīng duō liàn — 2. There is no secret to learning Chinese well; basically it is listening and practicing a lot.

examples.text: 她学习生物学，就是生命科学。
examples.translation: tā xué xí shēng wù xué jiù shì shēng mìng kē xué — 3. She studies biology, that is, the science of life.

examples.text: 下次开会是下个星期一，也就是三月一日。
examples.translation: xià cì kāi huì shì xià gè xīng qī yī yě jiù shì sān yuè yí rì — 4. The next meeting is next Monday, that is, March 1st. (the book writes 3 月 1 日 in digits)

examples.text: 明天是星期六，也就是说，我们不用去上班。
examples.translation: míng tiān shì xīng qī liù yě jiù shì shuō wǒ men bú yòng qù shàng bān — 5. Tomorrow is Saturday, which means we don’t have to go to work.

examples.text: “滴滴出行”，也就是中国的一个网约车平台。
examples.translation: dī dī chū xíng yě jiù shì zhōng guó de yí gè wǎng yuē chē píng tái — 6. “Didi Chuxing,” that is, a ride-hailing platform in China.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read the sentences below, then supply the English meaning of the underlined words by guessing them from context or looking them up: 失眠症, 规律, AA 制, 素食者, 剩女, 宅男. B. Compare work with the class. The book gives no key; my meanings are inside the translations:

examples.text: 她有失眠症，也就是说，她常常夜里睡不着觉。
examples.translation: tā yǒu shī mián zhèng yě jiù shì shuō tā cháng cháng yè lǐ shuì bù zháo jiào — 1. She has insomnia, that is, she often can’t sleep at night. 失眠症 (my answer): insomnia.

examples.text: 我们每天的生活都需要有规律，就是说要早睡早起，按时吃饭、工作和锻炼。
examples.translation: wǒ men měi tiān de shēng huó dōu xū yào yǒu guī lǜ jiù shì shuō yào zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ àn shí chī fàn gōng zuò hé duàn liàn — 2. Our daily life needs to be regular, that is, going to bed and getting up early and eating, working and exercising on time. 规律 (my answer): regularity, a regular routine.

examples.text: 今天我们吃饭实行ＡＡ制，就是我们大家每个人平分账单。
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ men chī fàn shí xíng zhì jiù shì wǒ men dà jiā měi gè rén píng fēn zhàng dān — 3. Today we are going Dutch, that is, each of us splits the bill equally. ＡＡ制 (my answer): going Dutch, splitting the bill equally. (the book writes AA in Latin letters; written full-width here)

examples.text: 他是个素食者，也就是说，他从来不吃肉。
examples.translation: tā shì gè sù shí zhě yě jiù shì shuō tā cóng lái bù chī ròu — 4. He is a vegetarian, that is, he never eats meat. 素食者 (my answer): vegetarian.

examples.text: 在中国，“剩女”就是那些到了三十岁以上还没有结婚的女性。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó shèng nǚ jiù shì nà xiē dào le sān shí suì yǐ shàng hái méi yǒu jié hūn de nǚ xìng — 5. In China “leftover women” are those women who are over thirty and still not married. 剩女 (my answer): “leftover woman,” an unmarried woman over about thirty.

examples.text: 我哥是一个宅男，就是说他每天呆在家里，除了上网打游戏，或是看书，听音乐，别的时间很少出门。
examples.translation: wǒ gē shì yí gè zhái nán jiù shì shuō tā měi tiān dāi zài jiā lǐ chú le shàng wǎng dǎ yóu xì huò shì kàn shū tīng yīn yuè bié de shí jiān hěn shǎo chū mén — 6. My brother is a homebody, that is, he stays at home every day and, apart from going online to play games or reading and listening to music, seldom goes out. 宅男 (my answer): a man who stays at home; homebody.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Listen to the first speaker, while your teammates listen to the other two. Fill in the EEIs in Chinese in the table (Topic | EEIs, rows 1, 2, 3). B. Exchange intel with your teammates in Chinese, then read your group’s EEIs to the class. C. Read the script to check your information. (Audio; the script is not in the book.)

explanations.title: 网络新词热词 (Activity 6, Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Draw a slip from your teacher with a popular Chinese term from the Internet. Read the definition carefully, using a dictionary if necessary. B. Explain your term to your classmates in Chinese using 就是, 也就是, 也就是说, 那就是 or 就是说. Listen to your classmates explain their terms and write their English meanings in the table. C. As a class, compare meanings, then choose the best English version of each term. (Three pictures are not included.) The six slips, with my English:

rows: young, handsome, muscular guys (“young fresh meat”)
digital thieves who steal card data by technology from a distance
brain fog: forgetting something you knew and remembering later
melon-eating onlookers: people who watch online drama from the sidelines
“chop your hands”: compulsive online shopping you regret afterward
“bring goods”: celebrities promoting products so fans buy them
tables.title: Activity 6: the six terms and my English meanings (the book’s Meaning column is blank)

examples.text: 小鲜肉：网络用语。也就是一些年轻、帅气、有肌肉的男生，他们一般年龄在十二到二十五岁之间，感情经历简单，长得很好看，很帅气。
examples.translation: xiǎo xiān ròu wǎng luò yòng yǔ yě jiù shì yì xiē nián qīng shuài qì yǒu jī ròu de nán shēng tā men yì bān nián líng zài shí èr dào èr shí wǔ suì zhī jiān gǎn qíng jīng lì jiǎn dān zhǎng de hěn hǎo kàn hěn shuài qì — 1. 小鲜肉: Internet slang. That is, some young, handsome, muscular boys, generally between twelve and twenty-five years old, with simple romantic histories, who are good-looking and handsome. (the book writes 12 and 25 in digits and puts the term in 【】, written here with a colon)

examples.text: 数码小偷：就是使用最新科技的小偷。也就是说，这些小偷不用碰到你的钱包，站在十五厘米以外的地方，就可以用新科技偷走你的信用卡或是银行信息，他们被称为“数码小偷”。
examples.translation: shù mǎ xiǎo tōu jiù shì shǐ yòng zuì xīn kē jì de xiǎo tōu yě jiù shì shuō zhè xiē xiǎo tōu bú yòng pèng dào nǐ de qián bāo zhàn zài shí wǔ lí mǐ yǐ wài de dì fāng jiù kě yǐ yòng xīn kē jì tōu zǒu nǐ de xìn yòng kǎ huò shì yín háng xìn xī tā men bèi chēng wéi shù mǎ xiǎo tōu — 2. 数码小偷: Thieves who use the latest technology. That is, these thieves don’t need to touch your wallet; standing fifteen centimeters away they can steal your credit card or bank information with new technology, and they are called “digital thieves.” (the book writes 15 in digits)

examples.text: 脑雾：就是有些事情，你原来很清楚，现在却变得不清楚，一时间你怎么都想不起来，过一段时间后你又会突然想起。
examples.translation: nǎo wù jiù shì yǒu xiē shì qíng nǐ yuán lái hěn qīng chǔ xiàn zài què biàn de bù qīng chǔ yì shí jiān nǐ zěn me dōu xiǎng bù qǐ lái guò yí duàn shí jiān hòu nǐ yòu huì tū rán xiǎng qǐ — 3. 脑雾: That is, something you used to know clearly has become unclear, and for a while you can’t remember it however you try, but after some time you suddenly remember again.

examples.text: 吃瓜群众：网络用语，也就是一些网民或是社交媒体的粉丝，网上有新闻或事情发生，他们不太明白，但是却喜欢在旁边观看，或是看别的网友说什么。
examples.translation: chī guā qún zhòng wǎng luò yòng yǔ yě jiù shì yì xiē wǎng mín huò shì shè jiāo méi tǐ de fěn sī wǎng shàng yǒu xīn wén huò shì qíng fā shēng tā men bú tài míng bái dàn shì què xǐ huān zài páng biān guān kàn huò shì kàn bié de wǎng yǒu shuō shén me — 4. 吃瓜群众: Internet slang, that is, some netizens or social-media fans who, when news or something happens online, don’t quite understand it but like to watch from the side or see what other netizens say.

examples.text: 剁手：就是没有想清楚就在网上购物，不知不觉就花了大量的金钱。买完后一看账单，对自己很生气，要剁自己的手。也就是说，这些人都是特别喜欢网络购物的人。
examples.translation: duò shǒu jiù shì méi yǒu xiǎng qīng chǔ jiù zài wǎng shàng gòu wù bù zhī bù jué jiù huā le dà liàng de jīn qián mǎi wán hòu yí kàn zhàng dān duì zì jǐ hěn shēng qì yào duò zì jǐ de shǒu yě jiù shì shuō zhè xiē rén dōu shì tè bié xǐ huān wǎng luò gòu wù de rén — 5. 剁手: That is, shopping online without thinking clearly and unknowingly spending a large amount of money. After buying, you look at the bill and are so angry with yourself that you want to chop off your own hands. That is, these people are people who especially like online shopping.

examples.text: 带货：网络新词，就是一些名人或明星们在网上帮助卖商品、卖货。因为粉丝们会对明星们使用的商品或销售的商品更加感兴趣，所以也会跟着买，这种商品也就变得非常流行和受欢迎。
examples.translation: dài huò wǎng luò xīn cí jiù shì yì xiē míng rén huò míng xīng men zài wǎng shàng bāng zhù mài shāng pǐn mài huò yīn wèi fěn sī men huì duì míng xīng men shǐ yòng de shāng pǐn huò xiāo shòu de shāng pǐn gèng jiā gǎn xìng qù suǒ yǐ yě huì gēn zhe mǎi zhè zhǒng shāng pǐn yě jiù biàn de fēi cháng liú xíng hé shòu huān yíng — 6. 带货: A new Internet word, that is, some celebrities or stars helping to sell goods online. Because fans become more interested in the goods that stars use or sell, they also follow and buy, and such goods become very popular and welcome.

exercises.prompt: What do 就是 and 也就是说 mean in explaining?
Where does 就是 come when explaining?
options: After a noun, noun phrase or sentence, preceded by a comma
At the start of a text

exercises.prompt: What does 下次开会是下个星期一，也就是三月一日 do?

options: An unmarried woman over about thirty
exercises.explanation: 三十岁以上还没有结婚的女性.

options: A man who stays at home a lot
A thief who uses the latest technology
Shopping online without thinking, then regretting it
exercises.explanation: 没有想清楚就在网上购物.

options: Celebrities helping to sell goods online
exercises.explanation: 名人或明星们在网上帮助卖商品.

exercises.prompt: 学好中文没有什么秘密，基本上___是多听多练。
明天是星期六，也就是___，我们不用去上班。
exercises.explanation: 也就是说: that is to say.

lessons.title: 657. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 grammar: …来说 for indicating scale or applicability
lessons.subtitle: 一般来说 · 总的来说 · 相对来说 · 严格来说 · 具体来说 · 对某人来说 · 当书虫 · 国防语言学院

explanations.title: 话语语法: ……来说 for Indicating Scale or Applicability
explanations.body: 来说 is always preceded by a qualifier, e.g., 一般来说, 总的来说, 相对来说 and 对某人来说. A …来说 phrase precedes a statement or comment to indicate its scale, scope or applicability.

rows: the qualifier indicates the scale, scope or applicability of the statement
tables.title: 来说

rows: from X’s perspective/point of view; as far as X is concerned
tables.title: Common variants

examples.text: 一般来说，“滴滴”司机每月的收入能有四千到五千元人民币。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō dī dī sī jī měi yuè de shōu rù néng yǒu sì qiān dào wǔ qiān yuán rén mín bì — Example: Generally speaking, a “DiDi” driver’s monthly income can range from 4,000 to 5,000 RMB. (the book writes the figures in digits)

explanations.title: Examples with 来说
explanations.body: The English is mine.

examples.text: 一般来说，“滴滴”的出租车要比普通的出租车快得多。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō dī dī de chū zū chē yào bǐ pǔ tōng de chū zū chē kuài de duō — 1. Generally speaking, Didi taxis are much faster than ordinary taxis.

examples.text: 一般来说，大城市有更多工作机会。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō dà chéng shì yǒu gèng duō gōng zuò jī huì — 2. Generally speaking, big cities have more job opportunities.

examples.text: 总的来说，这次的活动很成功。
examples.translation: zǒng de lái shuō zhè cì de huó dòng hěn chéng gōng — 3. On the whole, this event was very successful.

examples.text: 相对来说，我更喜欢学习西班牙文。
examples.translation: xiāng duì lái shuō wǒ gèng xǐ huān xué xí xī bān yá wén — 4. Relatively speaking, I prefer studying Spanish.

examples.text: 严格来说，你的答案不能算对，所以不能得分。
examples.translation: yán gé lái shuō nǐ de dá àn bù néng suàn duì suǒ yǐ bù néng dé fēn — 5. Strictly speaking, your answer can’t count as correct, so you can’t get a point.

examples.text: 具体来说，住民宿和短租房有三个好处。
examples.translation: jù tǐ lái shuō zhù mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng yǒu sān gè hǎo chù — 6. Specifically, staying in homestays and short-term rentals has three benefits.

examples.text: 对你来说，家庭重要还是工作重要？
examples.translation: duì nǐ lái shuō jiā tíng zhòng yào hái shì gōng zuò zhòng yào — 7. For you, which is more important, family or work?

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. For the first three sentences below, write your own logical follow-up sentence in Chinese characters. A partner will do the same for the remaining three sentences: 1. 一般来说，周末我通常都待在家里当书虫。 2. 总的来说，这篇文章分为四个部分。 3. 对我来说，学习中文有些难，但是也很有意思。 4. 相对来说，坐高铁要比坐飞机更方便。 5. 严格来说，国防语言学院的学生每天都应该锻炼身体。 6. 具体来说，要想身体健康，你每天得做三件事。 B. Read your original and follow-up sentences to your partner. Listen to your partner’s sentences and transcribe their follow-up sentences. Then convert them to Chinese characters. My follow-ups (the book’s “Follow-up:” lines are blank):

examples.text: 周末我通常都待在家里当书虫，不太出门。
examples.translation: zhōu mò wǒ tōng cháng dōu dài zài jiā lǐ dāng shū chóng bú tài chū mén — 1. 一般来说，周末我通常都待在家里当书虫。 Follow-up (mine): …I usually stay at home and read at weekends and don’t go out much.

examples.text: 第一部分讲网约车的出现，第二部分讲我的经历。
examples.translation: dì yī bù fèn jiǎng wǎng yuē chē de chū xiàn dì èr bù fèn jiǎng wǒ de jīng lì — 2. 总的来说，这篇文章分为四个部分。 Follow-up (mine): …the first part is about the appearance of ride-hailing and the second about my experience.

examples.text: 每次做作业都要花很长时间，不过我很喜欢写汉字。
examples.translation: měi cì zuò zuò yè dōu yào huā hěn cháng shí jiān bú guò wǒ hěn xǐ huān xiě hàn zì — 3. 对我来说，学习中文有些难，但是也很有意思。 Follow-up (mine): …each time I do homework it takes a long time, but I enjoy writing characters.

examples.text: 坐高铁不用提前很久到车站，也不会晚点。
examples.translation: zuò gāo tiě bú yòng tí qián hěn jiǔ dào chē zhàn yě bú huì wǎn diǎn — 4. 相对来说，坐高铁要比坐飞机更方便。 Follow-up (mine): …with the high-speed train you don’t need to get to the station long beforehand, and it doesn’t run late.

examples.text: 他们是军人，身体一定要好。
examples.translation: tā men shì jūn rén shēn tǐ yí dìng yào hǎo — 5. 严格来说，国防语言学院的学生每天都应该锻炼身体。 Follow-up (mine): …they are servicemembers, so their health has to be good.

examples.text: 第一要早睡，第二要多喝水，第三要多运动。
examples.translation: dì yī yào zǎo shuì dì èr yào duō hē shuǐ dì sān yào duō yùn dòng — 6. 具体来说，要想身体健康，你每天得做三件事。 Follow-up (mine): …first sleep early, second drink more water, third exercise more.

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Divvy up the 来说 phrases below, two per person (对…来说, 一般来说, 总的来说, 相对来说, 严格来说, 具体来说). Write a sentence for each of your two phrases, then add one or two sentences to explain or elaborate on it. B. Read your sentences to your teammates, transcribe their sentences in the appropriate boxes, then convert your transcriptions into Chinese characters. C. Read a teammate’s sentences to the class. My samples, one for each phrase:

examples.text: 对我来说，周末最重要的是休息。我喜欢睡到中午，然后去海边走一走。
examples.translation: duì wǒ lái shuō zhōu mò zuì zhòng yào de shì xiū xī wǒ xǐ huān shuì dào zhōng wǔ rán hòu qù hǎi biān zǒu yì zǒu — 对…来说 (mine): For me the most important thing at the weekend is rest. I like to sleep until noon and then go for a walk by the sea.

examples.text: 一般来说，我每天六点起床。起得早的话，一天都很有精神。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng qǐ de zǎo de huà yì tiān dōu hěn yǒu jīng shén — 一般来说 (mine): Generally speaking I get up at six every day. If I get up early I am full of energy all day.

examples.text: 总的来说，这个学期过得很快。我学到了很多新的词语。
examples.translation: zǒng de lái shuō zhè ge xué qī guò de hěn kuài wǒ xué dào le hěn duō xīn de cí yǔ — 总的来说 (mine): On the whole this semester went quickly. I learned many new words.

examples.text: 相对来说，中文的语法比较简单。可是汉字很难写。
examples.translation: xiāng duì lái shuō zhōng wén de yǔ fǎ bǐ jiào jiǎn dān kě shì hàn zì hěn nán xiě — 相对来说 (mine): Relatively speaking Chinese grammar is simple. But the characters are hard to write.

examples.text: 严格来说，这个办法不太对。因为它要花很多钱。
examples.translation: yán gé lái shuō zhè ge bàn fǎ bú tài duì yīn wèi tā yào huā hěn duō qián — 严格来说 (mine): Strictly speaking, this method is not quite right, because it costs a lot of money.

examples.text: 具体来说，网约车有三个好处。第一是方便，第二是便宜，第三是安全。
examples.translation: jù tǐ lái shuō wǎng yuē chē yǒu sān gè hǎo chù dì yī shì fāng biàn dì èr shì pián yi dì sān shì ān quán — 具体来说 (mine): Specifically, ride-hailing has three benefits. First, convenient; second, cheap; third, safe.

exercises.prompt: What does 来说 need before it?

options: The scale, scope or applicability of a statement

exercises.prompt: What does 一般来说 mean?
What does 总的来说 mean?
What does 相对来说 mean?
What does 严格来说 mean?
What does 具体来说 mean?
options: As far as you are concerned

exercises.prompt: What does 对你来说 mean?
options: As far as you are concerned

exercises.prompt: What is 对你来说，家庭重要还是工作重要？ asking?
options: Which is more important to you, family or work

exercises.prompt: 一般来说，大城市有更多工作机___。
___体来说，住民宿和短租房有三个好处。

lessons.title: 658. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 grammar: the suffix 化
lessons.subtitle: 智能化 · 美国化 本地化 数字化 · 美化 绿化 软化 强化 · 全球化 国际化 · 城市化 老龄化

explanations.title: The Suffix 化
explanations.body: As in English, a Chinese suffix (后缀 hòuzhuì) attaches to the end of the word it modifies. The suffix 化 is equivalent to the English “-ize,” “-ify,” “-ization” or “-ification.” 化 attaches to a noun or adjective to form a disyllabic or polysyllabic word, although most are disyllabic.

tables.title: Suffix 化 (-ize, -ify, -ization, -ification)
Some common 化 terms currently in use

examples.text: 以后的网约车会更加智能化，现在上海已经出现了“滴滴”无人驾驶出租车。
examples.translation: yǐ hòu de wǎng yuē chē huì gèng jiā zhì néng huà xiàn zài shàng hǎi yǐ jīng chū xiàn le dī dī wú rén jià shǐ chū zū chē — Example: In future ride-hailing will become even more intelligent; driverless Didi taxis have already appeared in Shanghai.

explanations.title: Examples with 化
explanations.body: The English is mine.

examples.text: 中国的年轻人已经习惯了智能化的生活。出门在外，时刻得带着智能手机。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de nián qīng rén yǐ jīng xí guàn le zhì néng huà de shēng huó chū mén zài wài shí kè děi dài zhe zhì néng shǒu jī — 1. Young people in China have become used to an intelligent way of life. Away from home they have to carry a smartphone at all times.

examples.text: 在美国生活了二十多年以后，他已经美国化了，早上起来要喝咖啡，吃饭要吃西餐。
examples.translation: zài měi guó shēng huó le èr shí duō nián yǐ hòu tā yǐ jīng měi guó huà le zǎo shàng qǐ lái yào hē kā fēi chī fàn yào chī xī cān — 2. After living in America for more than twenty years he has already become Americanized: he has to drink coffee when he gets up in the morning and eats Western food.

examples.text: 中国每年的三月有植树节，希望种下的树越来越多，既可绿化山林，又可美化环境。
examples.translation: zhōng guó měi nián de sān yuè yǒu zhí shù jié xī wàng zhòng xià de shù yuè lái yuè duō jì kě lǜ huà shān lín yòu kě měi huà huán jìng — 3. China has Arbor Day every March, hoping that more and more trees will be planted, which can both green the mountain forests and beautify the environment.

examples.text: 很多美国大公司进入中国以后，没有做好本地化的工作，最后只能关门。
examples.translation: hěn duō měi guó dà gōng sī jìn rù zhōng guó yǐ hòu méi yǒu zuò hǎo běn dì huà de gōng zuò zuì hòu zhǐ néng guān mén — 4. After many big American companies entered China they did not do the localization work well and in the end could only close down.

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Write all the adjectives from the word bank below in their respective column in the table. Your partner will do the same for the nouns. B. Apply the suffix 化 to each word, then fill in the English equivalents. C. Read your answers to your partner so they can complete their table. D. Share your work with the class. explanations.title: Activity 10 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three and read the following passage. B. Individually, write a short paragraph, three to five sentences, about a social trend or phenomenon. Use the passage as a model and include as many 化 words as possible. C. Read your paragraphs to each other. Fill in the table with your teammates’ information (Teammate | Social Trend/Phenomenon | EEIs). D. Upload your paragraphs to a website to share them with the class. The model passage, then my sample paragraph:

examples.text: 全球化给我们的日常生活带来了明显的变化，让个人的生活更加国际化。日常生活中，我们可以去沃尔玛超市，买国外牌子的日用品，也可以去电影院看最新的美国大片，还可以去国外快餐店或是西餐厅，品尝国外的美食。这些都是全球化给我们生活上带来的便利。
examples.translation: quán qiú huà gěi wǒ men de rì cháng shēng huó dài lái le míng xiǎn de biàn huà ràng gè rén de shēng huó gèng jiā guó jì huà rì cháng shēng huó zhōng wǒ men kě yǐ qù wò ěr mǎ chāo shì mǎi guó wài pái zi de rì yòng pǐn yě kě yǐ qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn zuì xīn de měi guó dà piàn hái kě yǐ qù guó wài kuài cān diàn huò shì xī cān tīng pǐn cháng guó wài de měi shí zhè xiē dōu shì quán qiú huà gěi wǒ men shēng huó shàng dài lái de biàn lì — The model passage: Globalization has brought obvious changes to our daily life and made personal life more international. In daily life we can go to Walmart, buy foreign-brand daily goods, go to the cinema to see the latest American blockbusters, and go to foreign fast-food places or Western restaurants to taste foreign food. These are all conveniences that globalization has brought to our life.

examples.text: 现在很多人习惯了网络化的生活。我们在网上买东西，在网上看病，也在网上学习。城市化和老龄化也给社会带来了很多变化。
examples.translation: xiàn zài hěn duō rén xí guàn le wǎng luò huà de shēng huó wǒ men zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī zài wǎng shàng kàn bìng yě zài wǎng shàng xué xí chéng shì huà hé lǎo líng huà yě gěi shè huì dài lái le hěn duō biàn huà — A sample paragraph (mine): Many people are now used to a networked life. We buy things online, see doctors online and study online. Urbanization and population aging have also brought many changes to society.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to three speakers talk about transportation in China, then answer the following questions: 1. Who are the speakers? 2. What is each speaker’s preferred mode of transportation? B. Listen again and fill in the table (Speaker 1, 2, 3 | Mode of Transportation | Pros & Cons) in Chinese. C. Form groups of three and read your information to your teammates. D. Read the script and check your work against it. E. Discuss in Chinese: your favorite modes of transportation; pros and cons of your preferred modes. F. Report the results of your discussion to the class in Chinese. (Three pictures and the audio are not included; the script is not in the book.)

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the radio interview and determine whether the statements that follow are true or false. Compare answers with a partner and explain your reasoning. B. Listen again, take notes, and fill in the table: Identity of driver; How he got started in the business; Pros of being a Hitch driver; How it changed his life; Special experiences; Qualities of a good Hitch driver. C. In groups of three, compare information in Chinese. D. Read the script and check your information. (Two pictures and the audio are not included, and the script is not in the book, so the answers depend on the audio and are not given here.) The six statements:

examples.text: 车主是一名专职的“滴滴”司机。
examples.translation: chē zhǔ shì yì míng zhuān zhí de dī dī sī jī — 1. The car owner is a full-time “Didi” driver.

examples.text: 车主开顺风车主要是为了增加收入。
examples.translation: chē zhǔ kāi shùn fēng chē zhǔ yào shì wèi le zēng jiā shōu rù — 2. The car owner drives hitchhiking rides mainly to increase his income.

examples.text: 车主只有在上下班的时候才会接送乘客。
examples.translation: chē zhǔ zhǐ yǒu zài shàng xià bān de shí hòu cái huì jiē sòng chéng kè — 3. The car owner picks up passengers only when going to and from work.

examples.text: 北京的交通很好，开顺风车很方便。
examples.translation: běi jīng de jiāo tōng hěn hǎo kāi shùn fēng chē hěn fāng biàn — 4. Beijing’s traffic is good, so driving hitchhiking rides is convenient.

examples.text: 车主送过的一位乘客是他朋友孩子的老师。
examples.translation: chē zhǔ sòng guò de yí wèi chéng kè shì tā péng yǒu hái zi de lǎo shī — 5. A passenger the car owner has driven is the teacher of his friend’s child.

examples.text: 能够给顾客提供满意的服务就是最好的顺风车车主。
examples.translation: néng gòu gěi gù kè tí gōng mǎn yì de fú wù jiù shì zuì hǎo de shùn fēng chē chē zhǔ — 6. Being able to provide customers with satisfying service makes the best hitchhike car owner.

lessons.title: 660. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 skill integration: a ride-hailing driver’s story
lessons.subtitle: 网络化时代 · 新移民 · 零工 · 羡慕 · 收入不稳定 · 全中文的操作 · 无人驾驶出租车 取代

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Guess the meaning of the following words or look them up. Compare work with a partner. B. Form groups of three. Each teammate reads two consecutive paragraphs in the following article. Write the main idea of each paragraph and its EEIs in the table (Teammate 1, 2, 3 | Paragraph 1, 2). C. Verbally convey your information to your teammates in Chinese. Fill in their information to complete the tables. D. As a group, determine whether the following statements are true or false. Consult the article if necessary. (Two pictures are not included.)

tables.title: Activity 3A: supplementary vocabulary (the book gives the words and pinyin and leaves the English blank; the English is mine)

explanations.title: The article
explanations.body: The six paragraphs, with my English.

examples.text: 现在是网络化时代，信息交流越来越方便。新型的网约车服务受到越来越多人的欢迎，人们利用互联网和手机就可以轻松预约出租车业务。网约车平台除了提供出租车服务以外，也提供拼车、专车等别的服务。
examples.translation: xiàn zài shì wǎng luò huà shí dài xìn xī jiāo liú yuè lái yuè fāng biàn xīn xíng de wǎng yuē chē fú wù shòu dào yuè lái yuè duō rén de huān yíng rén men lì yòng hù lián wǎng hé shǒu jī jiù kě yǐ qīng sōng yù yuē chū zū chē yè wù wǎng yuē chē píng tái chú le tí gōng chū zū chē fú wù yǐ wài yě tí gōng pīn chē zhuān chē děng bié de fú wù — 1) This is the age of networking, and information exchange is more and more convenient. New-style ride-hailing services are welcomed by more and more people, and people can easily book taxi service with the Internet and a phone. Besides taxi service, ride-hailing platforms also provide carpooling, private cars and other services.

examples.text: 二零一二年，我从中国来到了美国旧金山。那时我既没钱，英文也不好，根本找不到合适的工作，只能做零工或是帮餐馆送外卖。因为这些工作既不要求语言，也不需要技能。那时的我，交通出行近的地方靠走路，远的靠公交车，从没想过乘坐网约车出行。
examples.translation: èr líng yī èr nián wǒ cóng zhōng guó lái dào le měi guó jiù jīn shān nà shí wǒ jì méi qián yīng wén yě bù hǎo gēn běn zhǎo bú dào hé shì de gōng zuò zhǐ néng zuò líng gōng huò shì bāng cān guǎn sòng wài mài yīn wèi zhè xiē gōng zuò jì bú yào qiú yǔ yán yě bù xū yào jì néng nà shí de wǒ jiāo tōng chū xíng jìn de dì fāng kào zǒu lù yuǎn de kào gōng jiāo chē cóng méi xiǎng guò chéng zuò wǎng yuē chē chū xíng — 2) In 2012 I came from China to San Francisco in America. I had no money then and my English was not good; I simply couldn’t find a suitable job and could only do odd jobs or deliver takeout for restaurants, because these jobs neither require language nor need skills. In those days, for getting around I relied on walking for near places and the bus for far ones, and I had never thought of taking a ride-hailing car. (the book writes 2012 in digits)

examples.text: 直到二零一四年的一天，我的一个好朋友说起他做网约车司机的事，我很好奇。当时，我马上就下载了叫车应用软件，然后当场注册，叫车体验了一下。只有两百米左右的路程，我付了五美元的服务费。我很羡慕这份工作，轻松、自由，还有很高的奖金。
examples.translation: zhí dào èr líng yī sì nián de yì tiān wǒ de yí gè hǎo péng yǒu shuō qǐ tā zuò wǎng yuē chē sī jī de shì wǒ hěn hào qí dāng shí wǒ mǎ shàng jiù xià zài le jiào chē yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn rán hòu dāng chǎng zhù cè jiào chē tǐ yàn le yí xià zhǐ yǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ zuǒ yòu de lù chéng wǒ fù le wǔ měi yuán de fú wù fèi wǒ hěn xiàn mù zhè fèn gōng zuò qīng sōng zì yóu hái yǒu hěn gāo de jiǎng jīn — 3) Until one day in 2014, a good friend of mine talked about his work as a ride-hailing driver and I was curious. At that time I immediately downloaded a car-hailing app, registered on the spot and tried calling a car. It was only about two hundred meters, and I paid five dollars in service fees. I envied this job: relaxed, free, and with a high bonus.

examples.text: 两年以后，我觉得收入不稳定，所以就买了一辆新车，开始当起了网约车司机。那个时候的网约车已经能够提供快速、便捷、低费、优质的出行服务了，越来越多的年轻人开始选择乘坐网约车出行。
examples.translation: liǎng nián yǐ hòu wǒ jué de shōu rù bù wěn dìng suǒ yǐ jiù mǎi le yí liàng xīn chē kāi shǐ dāng qǐ le wǎng yuē chē sī jī nà ge shí hòu de wǎng yuē chē yǐ jīng néng gòu tí gōng kuài sù biàn jié dī fèi yōu zhì dì chū xíng fú wù le yuè lái yuè duō de nián qīng rén kāi shǐ xuǎn zé chéng zuò wǎng yuē chē chū xíng — 4) Two years later I felt my income was unstable, so I bought a new car and started working as a ride-hailing driver. By then ride-hailing could already provide fast, convenient, low-cost and high-quality travel service, and more and more young people began to choose to ride in ride-hailing cars.

examples.text: 我觉得刚到美国的新移民特别适合做网约车司机，原因就是不需要英文，入门很容易，操作也简单。你只需要简单的英文交流能力，然后下载一个网约车软件，而且他们有全中文的操作，简单培训一下，就可以接送乘客了。另外，网约车司机的收入也比在餐馆打工多一些。一般来说，每小时至少可以有二十六美元的收入，高于旧金山十五美元的最低小时工资。还有，网约车的工作时间自由，可根据你个人的需要选择工作时间和地点。所以比较轻松，时间也随意。
examples.translation: wǒ jué de gāng dào měi guó de xīn yí mín tè bié shì hé zuò wǎng yuē chē sī jī yuán yīn jiù shì bù xū yào yīng wén rù mén hěn róng yì cāo zuò yě jiǎn dān nǐ zhǐ xū yào jiǎn dān de yīng wén jiāo liú néng lì rán hòu xià zài yí gè wǎng yuē chē ruǎn jiàn ér qiě tā men yǒu quán zhōng wén de cāo zuò jiǎn dān péi xùn yí xià jiù kě yǐ jiē sòng chéng kè le lìng wài wǎng yuē chē sī jī de shōu rù yě bǐ zài cān guǎn dǎ gōng duō yì xiē yì bān lái shuō měi xiǎo shí zhì shǎo kě yǐ yǒu èr shí liù měi yuán de shōu rù gāo yú jiù jīn shān shí wǔ měi yuán de zuì dī xiǎo shí gōng zī hái yǒu wǎng yuē chē de gōng zuò shí jiān zì yóu kě gēn jù nǐ gè rén de xū yào xuǎn zé gōng zuò shí jiān hé dì diǎn suǒ yǐ bǐ jiào qīng sōng shí jiān yě suí yì — 5) I think new immigrants who have just arrived in America are especially suited to be ride-hailing drivers, because no English is needed, it is easy to get into and the operation is simple. You only need simple English communication ability, then download a ride-hailing app, and there is an all-Chinese version of the operation; with a little training you can pick up and drop off passengers. In addition, a ride-hailing driver’s income is also a bit more than working in a restaurant. Generally speaking, you can earn at least 26 dollars an hour, above San Francisco’s minimum hourly wage of 15 dollars. Also, the working hours of ride-hailing are free, and you can choose working time and place according to your own needs. So it is fairly relaxed and the time is flexible. (the book writes 26 and 15 in digits)

examples.text: 以后的网约车会更加智能化，不知道网约车司机的工作会不会被“无人驾驶”出租车所取代。
examples.translation: yǐ hòu de wǎng yuē chē huì gèng jiā zhì néng huà bù zhī dào wǎng yuē chē sī jī de gōng zuò huì bú huì bèi wú rén jià shǐ chū zū chē suǒ qǔ dài — 6) In future ride-hailing will become more intelligent, and I don’t know whether the ride-hailing driver’s job will be replaced by “driverless” taxis.

explanations.title: Activity 3: my notes
explanations.body: The book’s tables are blank; the notes are mine.

examples.text: 第一段：网约车服务越来越受欢迎，用手机就能预约。
examples.translation: dì yī duàn wǎng yuē chē fú wù yuè lái yuè shòu huān yíng yòng shǒu jī jiù néng yù yuē — Paragraph 1 (my notes): ride-hailing is more and more popular and can be booked with a phone.

examples.text: 第二段：二零一二年作者来到旧金山，没钱，英文不好，只能做零工和送外卖，没有想过坐网约车。
examples.translation: dì èr duàn èr líng yī èr nián zuò zhě lái dào jiù jīn shān méi qián yīng wén bù hǎo zhǐ néng zuò líng gōng hé sòng wài mài méi yǒu xiǎng guò zuò wǎng yuē chē — Paragraph 2 (my notes): the author came to San Francisco in 2012, had no money and little English, and could only do odd jobs and deliveries; he had never thought of ride-hailing.

examples.text: 第三段：二零一四年朋友做网约车司机，作者好奇，试着叫了一次车，很羡慕这份工作。
examples.translation: dì sān duàn èr líng yī sì nián péng yǒu zuò wǎng yuē chē sī jī zuò zhě hào qí shì zhe jiào le yí cì chē hěn xiàn mù zhè fèn gōng zuò — Paragraph 3 (my notes): in 2014 a friend became a driver; the author was curious, tried one ride and envied the job.

examples.text: 第四段：两年以后收入不稳定，他买了新车，开始当网约车司机。
examples.translation: dì sì duàn liǎng nián yǐ hòu shōu rù bù wěn dìng tā mǎi le xīn chē kāi shǐ dāng wǎng yuē chē sī jī — Paragraph 4 (my notes): two years later his income was unstable, so he bought a new car and became a driver.

examples.text: 第五段：新移民适合当网约车司机，因为不需要英文，收入高，时间自由。
examples.translation: dì wǔ duàn xīn yí mín shì hé dāng wǎng yuē chē sī jī yīn wèi bù xū yào yīng wén shōu rù gāo shí jiān zì yóu — Paragraph 5 (my notes): new immigrants suit the job because no English is needed, the income is higher and the hours are flexible.

examples.text: 第六段：以后的网约车会更智能，司机的工作可能会被无人驾驶出租车取代。
examples.translation: dì liù duàn yǐ hòu de wǎng yuē chē huì gèng zhì néng sī jī de gōng zuò kě néng huì bèi wú rén jià shǐ chū zū chē qǔ dài — Paragraph 6 (my notes): in future ride-hailing will be smarter and drivers’ jobs may be replaced by driverless taxis.

explanations.title: Activity 3D: true or false
explanations.body: The statements are the book’s; the answers are mine.

examples.text: 网络和手机让大家可以轻松预约叫车，受到越来越多人的喜爱。
examples.translation: wǎng luò hé shǒu jī ràng dà jiā kě yǐ qīng sōng yù yuē jiào chē shòu dào yuè lái yuè duō rén de xǐ ài — 1. The Internet and phones let everyone easily book a ride, and it is liked by more and more people. — True (mine): paragraph 1.

examples.text: 作者刚到美国的时候，喜欢在餐馆送外卖。
examples.translation: zuò zhě gāng dào měi guó de shí hòu xǐ huān zài cān guǎn sòng wài mài — 2. When the author first arrived in America he liked delivering takeout at restaurants. — False (mine): he could only do it because it needed no language and no skills.

examples.text: 因为网约车已经能够提供很好的服务，所以他开始当网约车司机。

examples.text: 新移民非常适合开网约车，因为他们有很多开车的经验。
examples.translation: xīn yí mín fēi cháng shì hé kāi wǎng yuē chē yīn wèi tā men yǒu hěn duō kāi chē de jīng yàn — 5. New immigrants are very suited to driving for ride-hailing because they have a lot of driving experience. — False (mine): the reasons are no English needed, easy entry and simple operation.

examples.text: 车主很希望网约车越来越智能化。
examples.translation: chē zhǔ hěn xī wàng wǎng yuē chē yuè lái yuè zhì néng huà — 6. The car owner very much hopes ride-hailing will become more and more intelligent. — False (mine): he worries that driverless taxis may replace drivers.

lessons.title: 661. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 skill integration: an American businessman uses Didi in Beijing
lessons.subtitle: 老外在中国 · 滴滴出行的英文版 · 快速回复 自动翻译成中文 · 就连我也成为了他们的粉丝 · 排着长长的队

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Speaking, Writing, Reading and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. In Chinese, discuss problems you might encounter in China, especially with transportation. Then write them down in Chinese in the table (在中国可能会有的困难). B. Individually, skim the following translation of an American businessman’s experience in China and summarize each paragraph. Then match the Chinese summaries in the chart below to their source paragraph. Compare work with your partner. C. Form groups of three. Student 1 reads paragraphs one and two of the passage, Student 2 reads paragraph three and four, and Student 3 reads paragraph five. Then fill in the EEIs for each paragraph in the table. D. Report your EEIs to your teammates in Chinese, then complete the table with their information. E. Translate the three paragraphs that follow the article. (Two pictures are not included.) A sample for 4A, mine:

examples.text: 在中国可能会有的困难：不会说中文，找不到路，不知道怎么叫车，也不知道怎么付款。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó kě néng huì yǒu de kùn nán bú huì shuō zhōng wén zhǎo bú dào lù bù zhī dào zěn me jiào chē yě bù zhī dào zěn me fù kuǎn — Activity 4A, problems you might encounter in China (my sample): not speaking Chinese, not finding the way, not knowing how to call a car, and not knowing how to pay.

explanations.title: The businessman’s five paragraphs
explanations.body: With my English.

examples.text: 如果你是已经到过中国的外国人，你一定有过这样的经历：你和一群老外排着长长的队在酒店门口等出租车，而聪明的中国人却一个一个从你身边悠闲地走过，坐上他们用手机应用叫来的网约车。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ shì yǐ jīng dào guò zhōng guó de wài guó rén nǐ yí dìng yǒu guò zhè yàng de jīng lì nǐ hé yì qún lǎo wài pái zhe cháng cháng de duì zài jiǔ diàn mén kǒu děng chū zū chē ér cōng míng de zhōng guó rén què yí gè yí gè cóng nǐ shēn biān yōu xián de zǒu guò zuò shàng tā men yòng shǒu jī yìng yòng jiào lái de wǎng yuē chē — 1) If you are a foreigner who has already been to China, you must have had this experience: you and a group of foreigners line up in a long queue at the hotel door waiting for a taxi, while clever Chinese people walk past you one by one at leisure and get into the ride-hailing cars they called with their phone apps.

examples.text: 近日，我这个老外就在中国亲身体验了一下“滴滴出行”的服务。这次去北京参加车展以前，我就提前做好了准备，在手机上下载好了“滴滴”的手机应用英文版，现在在中国甚至就连出租车司机也开始使用“滴滴”的打车应用。如果没有这个应用，我真不知道该怎么办。
examples.translation: jìn rì wǒ zhè ge lǎo wài jiù zài zhōng guó qīn shēn tǐ yàn le yí xià dī dī chū xíng de fú wù zhè cì qù běi jīng cān jiā chē zhǎn yǐ qián wǒ jiù tí qián zuò hǎo le zhǔn bèi zài shǒu jī shàng xià zài hǎo le dī dī de shǒu jī yìng yòng yīng wén bǎn xiàn zài zài zhōng guó shèn zhì jiù lián chū zū chē sī jī yě kāi shǐ shǐ yòng dī dī de dǎ chē yìng yòng rú guǒ méi yǒu zhè ge yìng yòng wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn — 2) Recently I, this foreigner, personally tried the Didi Chuxing service in China. Before going to Beijing for the auto show, I prepared in advance and downloaded the English version of the Didi phone app; now in China even taxi drivers have begun to use Didi’s taxi app. Without this app I really wouldn’t know what to do.

examples.text: 因为我不会说中文，所以要是需要告诉司机在哪儿接送我，我会感到很紧张。第一次开始叫车以前我很担心，怕司机找不到我。但最后还是很顺利，一辆“滴滴”出租车在不到三分钟的时间就到了我所在的地方。
examples.translation: yīn wèi wǒ bú huì shuō zhōng wén suǒ yǐ yào shì xū yào gào sù sī jī zài nǎr jiē sòng wǒ wǒ huì gǎn dào hěn jǐn zhāng dì yī cì kāi shǐ jiào chē yǐ qián wǒ hěn dān xīn pà sī jī zhǎo bú dào wǒ dàn zuì hòu hái shì hěn shùn lì yí liàng dī dī chū zū chē zài bú dào sān fēn zhōng de shí jiān jiù dào le wǒ suǒ zài de dì fāng — 3) Because I can’t speak Chinese, if I need to tell the driver where to pick me up and drop me off I feel very nervous. Before calling a car for the first time I was very worried, afraid the driver couldn’t find me. But in the end it went very smoothly, and a Didi taxi arrived where I was in less than three minutes. (the book writes 3 in digits)

examples.text: 其实，“滴滴”的应用操作起来很容易。它把所有的信息都翻译成英语，并通过汽车图片、车牌号码和司机的照片帮助乘客找到司机。随着我预约的车越来越近，我开始看到司机发给我的中文消息出现在手机上，我只能猜一猜他想要告诉我什么。不过，因为这个应用非常智能化，可以提供英文的快速回复，也就是说，你可以直接输入英文信息，点击发送时，这些信息和回复就会自动翻译成中文，再发给司机。这样你和司机的沟通就不会有问题了。真是太方便、太聪明了。
examples.translation: qí shí dī dī de yìng yòng cāo zuò qǐ lái hěn róng yì tā bǎ suǒ yǒu de xìn xī dōu fān yì chéng yīng yǔ bìng tōng guò qì chē tú piàn chē pái hào mǎ hé sī jī de zhào piān bāng zhù chéng kè zhǎo dào sī jī suí zhe wǒ yù yuē de chē yuè lái yuè jìn wǒ kāi shǐ kàn dào sī jī fā gěi wǒ de zhōng wén xiāo xī chū xiàn zài shǒu jī shàng wǒ zhǐ néng cāi yì cāi tā xiǎng yào gào sù wǒ shén me bú guò yīn wèi zhè ge yìng yòng fēi cháng zhì néng huà kě yǐ tí gōng yīng wén de kuài sù huí fù yě jiù shì shuō nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē shū rù yīng wén xìn xī diǎn jī fā sòng shí zhè xiē xìn xī hé huí fù jiù huì zì dòng fān yì chéng zhōng wén zài fā gěi sī jī zhè yàng nǐ hé sī jī de gōu tōng jiù bú huì yǒu wèn tí le zhēn shì tài fāng biàn tài cōng míng le — 4) In fact, the Didi app is very easy to operate. It translates all the information into English and helps passengers find the driver through the picture of the car, the license plate number and the driver’s photo. As the car I booked came nearer, I began to see the driver’s Chinese messages appear on my phone, and I could only guess what he wanted to tell me. But because the app is so intelligent it can offer quick replies in English; that is, you can type English messages directly, and when you click send these messages and replies are automatically translated into Chinese and sent to the driver. This way there is no problem in communicating with the driver. It is really so convenient and so clever.

examples.text: “滴滴”在中国，除了为人们提供了非常便利和省时的出行服务以外，同时也为很多人提供了新的就业机会，增加了很多人的收入，所以他们的服务也受到越来越多人的欢迎。甚至，就连我这样不会说中文的老外也成为了他们的粉丝。
examples.translation: dī dī zài zhōng guó chú le wèi rén men tí gōng le fēi cháng biàn lì hé shěng shí de chū xíng fú wù yǐ wài tóng shí yě wèi hěn duō rén tí gōng le xīn de jiù yè jī huì zēng jiā le hěn duō rén de shōu rù suǒ yǐ tā men de fú wù yě shòu dào yuè lái yuè duō rén de huān yíng shèn zhì jiù lián wǒ zhè yàng bú huì shuō zhōng wén de lǎo wài yě chéng wéi le tā men de fěn sī — 5) Besides providing people with very convenient, time-saving travel services in China, Didi has also provided new jobs for many people and increased many people’s income, so its service is welcomed by more and more people. Even a foreigner like me who can’t speak Chinese has become one of its fans.

explanations.title: Activity 4B: my matching and 4E notes
explanations.body: The book’s chart and the translations are open; the matching and my translation of the second item are below. Items 1 and 3 are the businessman’s first and last paragraphs, translated above.

tables.title: Activity 4B: matching the Chinese summaries to their paragraphs (the book’s Paragraph No. column is blank; the matches are mine)

examples.text: 不过，因为这个应用非常智能化，可以提供英文的快速回复，也就是说，你可以直接输入英文信息，点击发送时，这些信息和回复就会自动翻译成中文，再发给司机。
examples.translation: bú guò yīn wèi zhè ge yìng yòng fēi cháng zhì néng huà kě yǐ tí gōng yīng wén de kuài sù huí fù yě jiù shì shuō nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē shū rù yīng wén xìn xī diǎn jī fā sòng shí zhè xiē xìn xī hé huí fù jiù huì zì dòng fān yì chéng zhōng wén zài fā gěi sī jī — Translation 2: But because the app is so intelligent it can offer quick replies in English; that is, you can type English messages directly, and when you click send these messages and replies are automatically translated into Chinese and then sent to the driver. lessons.title: 662. Lesson 25 Presentation 3 using Chinese in context: American ride-hailing and a ride story
lessons.subtitle: 美国的网约车 · 上海交通广播电台 · 网约车的现在和未来 · 网约车的问题、解决方案和未来趋向 · 坐网约车的故事

explanations.title: 美国的网约车 (Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1, Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. A Shanghai radio program invites you and an expat colleague to talk about popular American mobile transportation platforms and apps. Read the following talking points the station has provided to you in advance: 《美国的网约车平台和使用》节目要点 (上海交通广播电台). B. Divide up the talking points and research online for information to help you address them. Fill in the table with your findings. C. Exchange information with your partner. D. Present your talking points to your Chinese officemates (the class) to prepare for the radio program. (Three pictures are not included.) The six talking points:

rows: 美国流行的网约车平台和应用
使用这些产品和服务的原因
怎么使用这些平台和应用
中国用户需要注意的事情
tables.title: Activity 1B: the table to fill in (the book writes the headings in English: Popular U.S. mobile transportation platforms and apps; Services provided; Reasons for using these products and services; How to use these platforms and apps; Other benefits and advantages; Things Chinese users need to pay attention to; the Chinese here is mine)

examples.text: 美国有哪些流行的网约车平台和手机应用？
examples.translation: měi guó yǒu nǎ xiē liú xíng de wǎng yuē chē píng tái hé shǒu jī yìng yòng — Talking point 1: Which popular ride-hailing platforms and phone apps are there in America?

examples.text: 美国的网约车平台提供哪些服务？有什么特别的服务吗？
examples.translation: měi guó de wǎng yuē chē píng tái tí gōng nǎ xiē fú wù yǒu shén me tè bié de fú wù ma — Talking point 2: What services do America’s ride-hailing platforms provide? Are there any special services?

explanations.title: 网约车的现在和未来 (Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2, Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Divide the class into three pairs to answer the following questions, one question per pair: 1. What problems do mobile transportation platforms and services have? 2. How could we improve mobile transportation services and platforms? 3. What mobile transportation trends do you foresee in the near future (modes, systems, platforms, services, AI, etc.)? B. Conduct research and write down key terms and information in Chinese characters in the table (Pair 1 – Problems with Mobile Transportation Platforms and Services; Pair 2 – How to Improve Mobile Transportation Platforms and Services; Pair 3 – Future Mobile Transportation Modes, Systems, Platforms and Services). C. Using appropriate connectives, write four to six Chinese sentences to answer your question. D. Form groups of three with one member from each pair. Read your answer to your teammates. E. Write a group report on the problems, solutions and future direction of mobile transportation (网约车的问题、解决方案和未来趋向). Read it to the class, then email it to your teacher. (Three pictures are not included.) One sample answer for each pair, mine:

examples.text: 可以让价格更透明，还可以让乘客给司机打分，这样服务会更好。

examples.text: 以后，无人驾驶汽车会越来越多，网约车会更加智能化。

Because we had no car, we called a ride-hailing car with our phone. First I downloaded the app and then entered the place; next, the driver came very quickly. On the way the driver told us about many fun places. All in all, this experience was very good.

lessons.title: 664. Lesson 25 Area Studies: Tourism and Transportation in China
lessons.subtitle: 旅游业 · 微信支付 · 途家网 · 滴滴出行 · 神州专车 · 首汽约车 · 曹操出行 · 美团打车

explanations.title: Tourism and Transportation in China (1)
explanations.body: The tourist industry in China grew rapidly with the advent of economic reform and the opening-up to international trade, commerce, and investment in the 1980s and 1990s. In 2019, the total income from domestic and foreign tourism was $95 billion, 11.05% of GDP. In recent years, mobile transportation apps and online homestay platforms have flourished. Among the hundreds of apps used for daily living and recreational activities, the most popular are WeChat Pay (微信支付 Wēixìn Zhīfù), Tujia (途家网 Tújiāwǎng) and Didi Travel (滴滴出行 Dīdī Chūxíng).

explanations.title: (2) WeChat Pay and short-term lodging
explanations.body: WeChat Pay is a digital wallet service with which customers make mobile payments and exchange money between contacts. Although Alibaba retained a 54 % share of the Chinese mobile online payment market compared to WeChat’s 37 %, WeChat overtook Alibaba in 2019 with 800 million active users compared to Alipay’s 520 million. WeChat Pay can also be used for bus or subway rides by scanning the ride code into barcode scanners. Online platforms for short-term lodging also abound. The current estimated market share is 42% for Tujia, 31% for Muniao and 8% for Airbnb. Launched in 2011, Tujia is now the world’s leading short-term rental platform. It offers 400 domestic and 1,037 overseas destinations, and over 10 million online housing units including homestays, houses and apartments. Tujia’s GMV (gross merchandise value) reached $2.5 billion in 2019.

explanations.title: (3) Online ride-hailing
explanations.body: As of August 2018, over 80 online ride-hailing companies held operating licenses. The major platforms include DiDi Travel (滴滴出行 Dīdī Chūxíng), UCAR Inc. (神州专车 Shénzhōu Zhuānchē), Shouqi Taxi (首汽约车 Shǒuqì Yuēchē), CAOCAO (曹操出行 Cáocāo Chūxíng), Dida Travel (嘀嗒出行 Dídā Chūxíng), Yidao (易到 Yìdào) and Us Regiment Taxi (美团打车 Měituán Dǎchē). Among these, Didi Chuxing occupies more than 90% of market share with the most users. As of June 2019, the number of ride-hailing users in China reached 337 million, an increase of 6.7 million from 2018, accounting for 39.4% of total Internet users. The number of online taxi-hailing or express taxi users in China reached 339 million, an increase of 6.33 million from 2018, constituting 39.7% of all netizens.

explanations.title: (4) DiDi Travel and the conclusion
explanations.body: DiDi Travel (滴滴出行 Dīdī Chūxíng) is a Chinese transportation company headquartered in Beijing. The company provides app-based transportation services, including taxi-hailing, private car-hailing, social ridesharing and bike-sharing; on-demand delivery services; and automobile services, including sales, leasing, financing, maintenance, fleet operation, electric vehicle charging, and co-development of vehicles with automakers. In 2018, Didi boasted more than 550 million platform users, tens of millions of drivers, and a GMV of $45.11 billion. These burgeoning platforms and app companies contribute significantly to the economy and make travel, lodging and daily life in China far more convenient. (The book’s reference list names three websites; they are left out here. Two pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Learning objectives and grammar of Lesson 26 (Study and Travel Abroad, 出国热)
explanations.body: Unit 5, Social Factors. Lesson 26 topic: Describe characteristics of overseas Chinese students; discuss issues overseas Chinese students face; compare overseas Chinese students at different periods in their studies; analyze Chinese tourist travel methods and purposes. Grammar: 这么 + adj. + further explanation; 主题句; 比如…, 等等; 可不是嘛 / 可不是吗?; 并; 多半儿; 被 Verb 为; 尽管 vs. 不管; 多重复句; 有些人…有些人…还有些人; 总之. Area Studies: Overseas Chinese Students.

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. What do you consider the pros and cons of sending children abroad to study? B. What issues do you think a child or teenager might face when studying abroad? C. How would you help your children cope with their new environment? (Three pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 1: 妞妞出国
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 张太太：李姐，听说你家妞妞去国外上学了？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài lǐ jiě tīng shuō nǐ jiā niū niū qù guó wài shàng xué le — Mrs. Zhang: Sister Li, I heard your Niuniu has gone abroad to school? (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 李太太：对，她现在在美国上中学。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài duì tā xiàn zài zài měi guó shàng zhōng xué — Mrs. Li: Yes, she is in middle school in America now.

examples.text: 张太太：这么小，你们就把她送出国啊？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài zhè me xiǎo nǐ men jiù bǎ tā sòng chū guó a — Mrs. Zhang: So young, and you sent her abroad?

examples.text: 李太太：唉，还不是因为国内学习压力大，怕孩子太辛苦！
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài āi hái bú shì yīn wèi guó nèi xué xí yā lì dà pà hái zi tài xīn kǔ — Mrs. Li: Sigh, isn’t it because the study pressure at home is great and we were afraid the child would be too worn out!

examples.text: 张太太：她一个人在国外生活能适应吗？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài tā yí gè rén zài guó wài shēng huó néng shì yìng ma — Mrs. Zhang: Can she adapt to living abroad alone?

examples.text: 李太太：她从小没离开过我们，刚开始确实不适应，我还过去陪读了好几个月。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài tā cóng xiǎo méi lí kāi guò wǒ men gāng kāi shǐ què shí bú shì yìng wǒ hái guò qù péi dú le hǎo jǐ gè yuè — Mrs. Li: She had never left us since she was little, and at the beginning she really didn’t adapt; I even went over to accompany her studies for several months.

examples.text: 张太太：你回国后，妞妞现在住在哪儿？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài nǐ huí guó hòu niū niū xiàn zài zhù zài nǎr — Mrs. Zhang: After you came back, where does Niuniu live now?

examples.text: 李太太：我们帮她找了个寄宿家庭。有寄宿家庭照顾她，我就比较放心了。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài wǒ men bāng tā zhǎo le gè jì sù jiā tíng yǒu jì sù jiā tíng zhào gù tā wǒ jiù bǐ jiào fàng xīn le — Mrs. Li: We found her a homestay family. With a homestay family looking after her, I feel rather relieved.

examples.text: 张太太：她跟寄宿家庭能沟通吗？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài tā gēn jì sù jiā tíng néng gōu tōng ma — Mrs. Zhang: Can she communicate with the homestay family?

examples.text: 李太太：一开始是挺困难的，现在好多了。那家有两个女儿，和她的年龄差不多，常常在生活上和学习上帮助她。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài yì kāi shǐ shì tǐng kùn nán de xiàn zài hǎo duō le nà jiā yǒu liǎng gè nǚ ér hé tā de nián líng chà bu duō cháng cháng zài shēng huó shàng hé xué xí shàng bāng zhù tā — Mrs. Li: At the beginning it was quite difficult; now it’s much better. That family has two daughters about her age, who often help her in life and in study.

examples.text: 张太太：那太好了，听说一些小留学生由于没有人照顾，养成了一些坏习惯，比如逃学，喝酒，抽烟什么的。
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài nà tài hǎo le tīng shuō yì xiē xiǎo liú xué shēng yóu yú méi yǒu rén zhào gù yǎng chéng le yì xiē huài xí guàn bǐ rú táo xué hē jiǔ chōu yān shén me de — Mrs. Zhang: That’s great. I heard that some young international students, because nobody looks after them, develop bad habits, such as skipping school, drinking and smoking.

examples.text: 李太太：是啊，他们还小，很多地方都不成熟。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài shì a tā men hái xiǎo hěn duō dì fāng dōu bù chéng shú — Mrs. Li: Yes, they are still young and in many ways not mature.

examples.text: 张太太：你们分隔两地，还是会担心吧？
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài nǐ men fēn gé liǎng dì hái shì huì dān xīn ba — Mrs. Zhang: You are separated in two places; you still worry, don’t you?

examples.text: 李太太：当然，所以我们常常和她视频聊天，而且我和先生一有空儿，就做“空中飞人”飞过去看她。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài dāng rán suǒ yǐ wǒ men cháng cháng hé tā shì pín liáo tiān ér qiě wǒ hé xiān shēng yì yǒu kòngr jiù zuò kōng zhōng fēi rén fēi guò qù kàn tā — Mrs. Li: Of course, so we often video chat with her, and whenever my husband and I have time we become “trapeze artists” and fly over to see her.

examples.text: 张太太：可怜天下父母心，一切都是为了孩子。
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài kě lián tiān xià fù mǔ xīn yí qiè dōu shì wèi le hái zi — Mrs. Zhang: Pitiful are the hearts of parents everywhere; everything is for the children.

examples.text: 李太太：可不是嘛！车来了，我得走了。
examples.translation: lǐ tài tài kě bú shì ma chē lái le wǒ děi zǒu le — Mrs. Li: You said it! The bus is here, I have to go.

examples.text: 张太太：好。下次再聊！
examples.translation: zhāng tài tài hǎo xià cì zài liáo — Mrs. Zhang: OK. Let’s chat next time!
