explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 1 once through and answer the questions. 1. What is the likely relationship between the two speakers? 2. What information is exchanged in the conversation? B. Detailed Listening: 1. Who is 妞妞? What three things have you learned about her? 2. What three difficulties might overseas Chinese students like 妞妞 face? 3. What are three ways her parents have helped her to adapt? Then share your answers with a partner in Chinese and perform the presentation together. (Audio; my answers from the text:)

examples.text: 她们可能是朋友或者邻居，李太太的女儿去美国上中学了。
examples.translation: tā men kě néng shì péng yǒu huò zhě lín jū lǐ tài tài de nǚ ér qù měi guó shàng zhōng xué le — Activity 2A (my answers): The two speakers are probably friends or neighbors; Mrs. Li’s daughter has gone to middle school in America.

examples.text: 妞妞是李太太的女儿，在美国上中学，一开始不适应，现在住在寄宿家庭。
examples.translation: niū niū shì lǐ tài tài de nǚ ér zài měi guó shàng zhōng xué yì kāi shǐ bú shì yìng xiàn zài zhù zài jì sù jiā tíng — 2B-1 (mine): Niuniu is Mrs. Li’s daughter; she is in middle school in America, didn’t adapt at the beginning, and now lives with a homestay family.

examples.text: 语言沟通有困难，不适应生活，也可能养成坏习惯。
examples.translation: yǔ yán gōu tōng yǒu kùn nán bú shì yìng shēng huó yě kě néng yǎng chéng huài xí guàn — 2B-2 (mine): language difficulties, not adapting to life, and possibly developing bad habits.

examples.text: 帮她找了寄宿家庭，过去陪读，常常视频聊天，还飞过去看她。
examples.translation: bāng tā zhǎo le jì sù jiā tíng guò qù péi dú cháng cháng shì pín liáo tiān hái fēi guò qù kàn tā — 2B-3 (mine): they found her a homestay family, went over to accompany her studies, often video chat and fly over to see her.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Complete the following dialog, then practice performing it together. B. Perform your dialog for the class. The five questions are the book’s; the answers are mine:

examples.text: 怎么这么小就把孩子送出国啊？
examples.translation: zěn me zhè me xiǎo jiù bǎ hái zi sòng chū guó a — Q1: How come you sent your child abroad so young?

examples.text: 你孩子现在住在哪儿？
examples.translation: nǐ hái zi xiàn zài zhù zài nǎr — Q2: Where does your child live now?

examples.text: 她跟寄宿家庭能沟通吗？
examples.translation: tā gēn jì sù jiā tíng néng gōu tōng ma — Q3: Can she communicate with the homestay family?

examples.text: 你们不在身边，不担心她养成什么坏习惯吗？
examples.translation: nǐ men bú zài shēn biān bù dān xīn tā yǎng chéng shén me huài xí guàn ma — Q4: With you not around, aren’t you worried she will develop some bad habits?

examples.text: 你和孩子分隔两地，还是会担心吧？
examples.translation: nǐ hé hái zi fēn gé liǎng dì hái shì huì dān xīn ba — Q5: You and your child are separated in two places; you still worry, don’t you?

examples.text: 因为国内学习压力大，怕孩子太辛苦。
examples.translation: yīn wèi guó nèi xué xí yā lì dà pà hái zi tài xīn kǔ — A (my completion): Because the study pressure at home is great and we were afraid the child would be too tired.

examples.text: 她住在一个寄宿家庭里。
examples.translation: tā zhù zài yí gè jì sù jiā tíng lǐ — A (mine): She lives in a homestay family.

examples.text: 一开始有点困难，现在好多了。
examples.translation: yì kāi shǐ yǒu diǎn kùn nán xiàn zài hǎo duō le — A (mine): It was a bit difficult at the beginning; now it’s much better.

examples.text: 担心，所以我们常常和她视频聊天。
examples.translation: dān xīn suǒ yǐ wǒ men cháng cháng hé tā shì pín liáo tiān — A (mine): We do worry, so we often video chat with her.

examples.text: 是啊，还是会担心，所以一有空儿我就飞过去看她。
examples.translation: shì a hái shì huì dān xīn suǒ yǐ yì yǒu kòngr wǒ jiù fēi guò qù kàn tā — A (mine): Yes, we still worry, so whenever I have time I fly over to see her.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the interview with a homestay host. After listening through once, write down as many of the interviewer’s questions as you can remember. After listening through a second time do the same for the host’s replies (Interview Questions | Responses, rows 1–4). B. Work with a partner to complete and correct your questions and responses as much as possible. C. Listen to the interview a third time and make any necessary corrections or additions. D. Perform the interview script with your partner. Switch roles and repeat. (Audio; the script is not in the book.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Fill in the blanks with the correct choice from the word pairs: 适应/适合; 一切/所有; 放心/担心; 辛苦/努力; 成熟/养成; 沟通/聊天. B. Compare work with a partner. C. Write a story with at least five sentences using five of the vocabulary items from above. D. Read your story to your partner and ask each other questions about your stories in Chinese. The completed sentences (my key):

tables.title: Activity 5: the word pairs

examples.text: 很多寄宿学校的学生一开始很难适应离开家住校的生活，因为样样事都得自己来。
examples.translation: hěn duō jì sù xué xiào de xué shēng yì kāi shǐ hěn nán shì yìng lí kāi jiā zhù xiào de shēng huó yīn wèi yàng yàng shì dōu děi zì jǐ lái — 1a. Many boarding-school students find it hard at first to adapt to the life of leaving home and living at school, because they have to do everything themselves. (my key: 适应)

examples.text: 选择一个适合自己的寄宿家庭才能顺利在国外求学、生活。
examples.translation: xuǎn zé yí gè shì hé zì jǐ de jì sù jiā tíng cái néng shùn lì zài guó wài qiú xué shēng huó — 1b. Only by choosing a homestay family that suits you can you study and live abroad smoothly. (my key: 适合)

examples.text: 中国父母从小关心孩子的一切，照顾他们生活上、学习上大大小小的事。
examples.translation: zhōng guó fù mǔ cóng xiǎo guān xīn hái zi de yí qiè zhào gù tā men shēng huó shàng xué xí shàng dà dà xiǎo xiǎo de shì — 2a. Chinese parents care about everything of their child from an early age and look after big and small matters in life and study. (my key: 一切)

examples.text: 我父母把他们所有的钱都花在我们的教育上，我们才能上好学校，才能出国念书。
examples.translation: wǒ fù mǔ bǎ tā men suǒ yǒu de qián dōu huā zài wǒ men de jiào yù shàng wǒ men cái néng shàng hǎo xué xiào cái néng chū guó niàn shū — 2b. My parents spent all their money on our education, so we could go to good schools and study abroad. (my key: 所有)

examples.text: 因为担心在寄宿家庭的生活，很多父母常常给孩子打电话关心他们。
examples.translation: yīn wèi dān xīn zài jì sù jiā tíng de shēng huó hěn duō fù mǔ cháng cháng gěi hái zi dǎ diàn huà guān xīn tā men — 3a. Because they worry about life in the homestay, many parents often call their children to show concern. (my key: 担心)

examples.text: 从小我就能自己照顾自己，所以出国念书，我父母很放心。
examples.translation: cóng xiǎo wǒ jiù néng zì jǐ zhào gù zì jǐ suǒ yǐ chū guó niàn shū wǒ fù mǔ hěn fàng xīn — 3b. I could look after myself from an early age, so when I went abroad to study my parents were very relieved. (my key: 放心)

examples.text: 不管在哪里学习都得努力，这样才会有好的前途。
examples.translation: bù guǎn zài nǎ lǐ xué xí dōu děi nǔ lì zhè yàng cái huì yǒu hǎo de qián tú — 4a. No matter where you study you have to work hard; only then will you have a good future. (my key: 努力)

examples.text: 不管我的父母工作多辛苦，他们都要让我出国念书。
examples.translation: bù guǎn wǒ de fù mǔ gōng zuò duō xīn kǔ tā men dōu yào ràng wǒ chū guó niàn shū — 4b. No matter how hard my parents worked, they wanted me to study abroad. (my key: 辛苦)

examples.text: 小时候要养成好的生活习惯，长大才能自己照顾自己。
examples.translation: xiǎo shí hòu yào yǎng chéng hǎo de shēng huó xí guàn zhǎng dà cái néng zì jǐ zhào gù zì jǐ — 5a. You have to form good living habits when you are little to be able to look after yourself when you grow up. (my key: 养成)

examples.text: 要是没有成熟的身心，很难适应国外辛苦的留学生活。
examples.translation: yào shì méi yǒu chéng shú de shēn xīn hěn nán shì yìng guó wài xīn kǔ de liú xué shēng huó — 5b. Without a mature body and mind it is hard to adapt to the hard life of studying abroad. (my key: 成熟)

examples.text: 如果有学习上的困难，要随时和老师沟通。
examples.translation: rú guǒ yǒu xué xí shàng de kùn nán yào suí shí hé lǎo shī gōu tōng — 6a. If there are difficulties in study, communicate with the teacher at any time. (my key: 沟通)

examples.text: 现在的人除了打电话也喜欢用视频聊天。
examples.translation: xiàn zài de rén chú le dǎ diàn huà yě xǐ huān yòng shì pín liáo tiān — 6b. Besides phone calls, people now also like to video chat. (my key: 聊天)

exercises.prompt: What does Mrs. Zhang ask about at the start?
options: Whether Niuniu has gone abroad to school
exercises.explanation: 听说你家妞妞去国外上学了？

exercises.prompt: Why did Mrs. Li send her daughter abroad so young?
options: The study pressure at home is great
exercises.explanation: 国内学习压力大，怕孩子太辛苦.

exercises.prompt: What did Mrs. Li do for several months?
options: Went over to accompany her studies (陪读)

exercises.prompt: Who lives in the homestay family with Niuniu?
exercises.explanation: 两个女儿，和她的年龄差不多.

exercises.prompt: Which bad habits do some young students develop?
How do they keep in touch with Niuniu?
options: Video chat and flying over (空中飞人)

exercises.prompt: What does 可不是嘛 mean?
Which word fits “选择一个___自己的寄宿家庭”?
Which word fits “一开始很难___离开家的生活”?
Which word fits “小时候要___好的生活习惯”?
现在的人除了打电话也喜欢用视频___天。
不管我的父母工作多___苦，他们都要让我出国念书。
因为担心在寄宿家庭的生活，很多父母常常给孩子打电话___心他们。

lessons.title: 666. Lesson 26 Presentation 1 grammar: 这么 + adjective for remarking on a surprising fact
lessons.subtitle: 这么小 你们就把她送出国啊 · 这么年轻 · 这么贵 你还要买啊 · 这么困难 你还要继续做啊 · 这么麻烦

explanations.title: 话语语法: 这么 + Adjective
explanations.body: A speaker uses 这么 + adjective to remark on a significant or surprising fact or aspect. It is often followed by a comment or question.

rows: remarks on a significant or surprising fact or aspect, often followed by a comment or question
tables.title: 话语语法: 这么 + Adjective

examples.text: 她现在在美国上中学。
examples.translation: tā xiàn zài zài měi guó shàng zhōng xué — 1. Q: She is in middle school in America now.

examples.text: 这么小，你们就把她送出国啊？
examples.translation: zhè me xiǎo nǐ men jiù bǎ tā sòng chū guó a — A: So young, and you sent her abroad?

examples.text: 李华最近开了一家公司，当上了老板。
examples.translation: lǐ huá zuì jìn kāi le yì jiā gōng sī dāng shàng le lǎo bǎn — 2. Q: Li Hua recently opened a company and became a boss.

examples.text: 这么年轻，他就当了老板。
examples.translation: zhè me nián qīng tā jiù dāng le lǎo bǎn — A: So young, and he became a boss.

examples.text: 这件衬衫一件八百块。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn chèn shān yí jiàn bā bǎi kuài — 3. Q: This shirt costs 800 yuan each. (the book writes 800 in digits)

examples.text: 这么贵，你还要买啊？
examples.translation: zhè me guì nǐ hái yào mǎi a — A: So expensive, and you still want to buy it?

examples.text: 我要在一个月内减肥十公斤。可我现在只减了一公斤。
examples.translation: wǒ yào zài yí gè yuè nèi jiǎn féi shí gōng jīn kě wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ jiǎn le yì gōng jīn — 4. Q: I want to lose 10 kilos within a month, but I have only lost one so far. (the book writes 10 in digits)

examples.text: 这么困难，你还要继续做啊？
examples.translation: zhè me kùn nán nǐ hái yào jì xù zuò a — A: So difficult, and you still want to carry on?

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: A. For each statement below, write a response using the 这么 + adj. pattern. The first one has been done as an example for you. The book’s B lines for items 2 to 6 are blank; the answers are mine.

examples.text: 自由行得自己上网订票、订旅馆，还要自己安排行程。
examples.translation: zì yóu xíng děi zì jǐ shàng wǎng dìng piào dìng lǚ guǎn hái yào zì jǐ ān pái xíng chéng — 1. A: With independent travel you have to book tickets and hotels online yourself and arrange the itinerary yourself.

examples.text: 这么麻烦。我还是跟旅行团吧。
examples.translation: zhè me má fán wǒ hái shì gēn lǚ xíng tuán ba — B (the book’s example): So troublesome. I’d rather join a tour group.

examples.text: 送孩子出国念书一年得花上好几十万。
examples.translation: sòng hái zi chū guó niàn shū yì nián děi huā shàng hǎo jǐ shí wàn — 2. A: Sending a child abroad to study costs several hundred thousand a year.

examples.text: 这么贵，你们还要送孩子出国啊？
examples.translation: zhè me guì nǐ men hái yào sòng hái zi chū guó a — B (my answer): So expensive, and you still send your child abroad?

examples.text: 我五分钟前上“美团”下单点外卖，饭马上就送到了。
examples.translation: wǒ wǔ fēn zhōng qián shàng měi tuán xià dān diǎn wài mài fàn mǎ shàng jiù sòng dào le — 3. A: Five minutes ago I placed a takeout order on Meituan, and the food arrived right away.

examples.text: 这么快，我还以为要等半个小时呢。
examples.translation: zhè me kuài wǒ hái yǐ wéi yào děng bàn gè xiǎo shí ne — B (my answer): So fast; I thought I’d have to wait half an hour.

examples.text: 我奶奶九十岁了，天天去公园运动。
examples.translation: wǒ nǎi nǎi jiǔ shí suì le tiān tiān qù gōng yuán yùn dòng — 4. A: My grandmother is ninety and goes to the park to exercise every day. (the book writes 90 in digits)

examples.text: 这么大年纪，她还天天去运动啊？
examples.translation: zhè me dà nián jì tā hái tiān tiān qù yùn dòng a — B (my answer): At such an age, she still exercises every day?

examples.text: 住民宿有厨房可以自己做饭。
examples.translation: zhù mín sù yǒu chú fáng kě yǐ zì jǐ zuò fàn — 5. A: A homestay has a kitchen where you can cook yourself.

examples.text: 这么方便，我下次也要住民宿。
examples.translation: zhè me fāng biàn wǒ xià cì yě yào zhù mín sù — B (my answer): So convenient; next time I’ll stay in a homestay too.

examples.text: 这个健身房什么服务设施都有，所以会员很多。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng shén me fú wù shè shī dōu yǒu suǒ yǐ huì yuán hěn duō — 6. A: This gym has every kind of service and facility, so it has many members.

examples.text: 这么好，我也想办一张会员卡。
examples.translation: zhè me hǎo wǒ yě xiǎng bàn yì zhāng huì yuán kǎ — B (my answer): So good; I’d like to get a membership card too.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Interview a partner in Chinese to find out three significant, impressive, interesting or surprising facts about them. B. Write a sentence for each one of these facts using 这么 + adj. C. Read your sentences to your partner, then ask them a few follow-up questions in Chinese.

examples.text: 这么年轻，你就结婚了，还生了三个孩子。
examples.translation: zhè me nián qīng nǐ jiù jié hūn le hái shēng le sān gè hái zi — The book’s example: So young, and you got married and even had three children. (the book writes 3 in digits)

examples.text: 这么忙，你还每天学习中文啊？
examples.translation: zhè me máng nǐ hái měi tiān xué xí zhōng wén a — My sample: So busy, and you still study Chinese every day?

exercises.prompt: What does 这么 + adjective remark on?
What often follows 这么 + adj.?
What does 这么小，你们就把她送出国啊？ express?
options: Surprise that she is so young

exercises.prompt: Which is a response to “这件衬衫一件八百块”?
Which is a response to “我奶奶九十岁了，天天去公园运动”?
options: 这么大年纪，她还天天去运动啊？

exercises.prompt: Which is a response to “自由行得自己上网订票、订旅馆”?
Which fits a statement that someone became a boss very early?
options: 这么年轻，他就当了老板

exercises.prompt: 这么困难，你还要继___做啊？

lessons.title: 667. Lesson 26 Presentation 1 grammar: 主题句, topic-comment sentences
lessons.subtitle: 有寄宿家庭照顾她我就比较放心了 · 去中国旅游还是两个星期比较合适 · 怎样教育孩子 · 下星期我们考试

explanations.title: 主题句 Topic-Comment Sentences
explanations.body: In topic-comment sentences, the topic of the sentence is followed by a comment on it. Grammatically, the topic is not the subject of the sentence, but rather sets up what is going to be commented on in the sentence.

rows: the topic sets up what will be commented on; it is not the grammatical subject
tables.title: 主题句 Topic-Comment Sentences

examples.text: 有寄宿家庭照顾她，我就比较放心了。
examples.translation: yǒu jì sù jiā tíng zhào gù tā wǒ jiù bǐ jiào fàng xīn le — 1. With a homestay family looking after her, I feel rather relieved. (topic: 有寄宿家庭照顾她; comment: 我就比较放心了)

examples.text: 去中国旅游，我觉得还是两个星期比较合适。
examples.translation: qù zhōng guó lǚ yóu wǒ jué de hái shì liǎng gè xīng qī bǐ jiào hé shì — 2. As for traveling to China, I think two weeks is still more suitable.

examples.text: 在中国看病，还是挂专家门诊比较保险。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó kàn bìng hái shì guà zhuān jiā mén zhěn bǐ jiào bǎo xiǎn — 3. As for seeing a doctor in China, it is still safer to register for a specialist clinic.

examples.text: 出国读研究生，还是去英国念比较快拿到学位。
examples.translation: chū guó dú yán jiū shēng hái shì qù yīng guó niàn bǐ jiào kuài ná dào xué wèi — 4. As for going abroad for graduate school, it is still quicker to get the degree by studying in Britain.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Summarize each of the passages below in one sentence using a topic-comment structure. Example (the passage, then the summary):

examples.text: 中国的父母觉得孩子只有上好学校，以后才能有好的工作、好的生活。所以从小就帮孩子计划好以后的路，帮孩子报名上各种各样的学习班。除了学习，其他的事父母都包了。美国的父母从小让孩子从玩和游戏中学习，孩子长大后，让孩子从工作中、生活中学到很多经验，他们很少告诉孩子应该怎么做，总是让孩子自己做决定。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de fù mǔ jué de hái zi zhǐ yǒu shàng hǎo xué xiào yǐ hòu cái néng yǒu hǎo de gōng zuò hǎo de shēng huó suǒ yǐ cóng xiǎo jiù bāng hái zi jì huà hǎo yǐ hòu de lù bāng hái zi bào míng shàng gè zhǒng gè yàng de xué xí bān chú le xué xí qí tā de shì fù mǔ dōu bāo le měi guó de fù mǔ cóng xiǎo ràng hái zi cóng wán hé yóu xì zhōng xué xí hái zi zhǎng dà hòu ràng hái zi cóng gōng zuò zhōng shēng huó zhōng xué dào hěn duō jīng yàn tā men hěn shǎo gào sù hái zi yīng gāi zěn me zuò zǒng shì ràng hái zi zì jǐ zuò jué dìng — The book’s example passage: Chinese parents think that children can have good jobs and a good life later only if they go to good schools. So from early on they plan the child’s future path and sign the child up for all kinds of classes. Apart from study, parents take care of everything else. American parents let children learn through play and games from an early age, and when children grow up let them learn a lot of experience from work and life; they seldom tell children what to do and always let children make their own decisions.

examples.text: 怎样教育孩子，中国父母觉得学习比什么都重要。
examples.translation: zěn yàng jiào yù hái zi zhōng guó fù mǔ jué de xué xí bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào — The book’s summary: As for how to educate children, Chinese parents feel study is more important than anything.

examples.text: 怎样教育孩子，东西方的父母有不同的看法。

explanations.title: 比如… 等等/什么的
explanations.body: 比如…等等/什么的 is used to list nouns or verb phrases as examples of a particular entity or phenomenon. It is similar to “such as…, etc. / and so on” in English. While 等等 is more formal than the colloquial 什么的, both may be omitted. Similar expressions include 比如, 例如 and 譬如. When 比如 is followed by a sentence, 等等 and 什么的 are usually omitted.

lessons.title: 669. Lesson 26 Presentation 1 grammar: 可不是嘛/吗 for strong agreement
lessons.subtitle: 可不是吗 · 坐车要一个小时呢 · 五点以前就得起床 · 连续半个月气温都在三十五摄氏度以上 · 谁说不是呢 没错 的确 确实

explanations.title: 话语语法: 可不是嘛/吗
explanations.body: The colloquial expression 可不是嘛/吗 is used to strongly agree with an assertion someone just made. It is often followed by the speaker’s further elaboration, emphasis or testimony to echo the assertion. It is thus similar in meaning and function to the English “you can say that again,” “absolutely” or “that’s very/so true.” Similar Chinese expressions are 可不吗?, 可不(是), 谁说不是呢?, 说得对, 没错, 的确 and 确实, among others.

rows: an assertion that someone just made
B: 可不是嘛/吗 (+ further support to echo the assertion)
strongly agrees and often adds elaboration, emphasis or testimony
tables.title: 话语语法: 可不是嘛/吗

examples.text: 你想让你的孩子出国留学吗？那么找到适合你孩子的寄宿家庭是在国外顺利留学很重要的一步。你可以根据孩子的需要，为他们选择下面几种寄宿家庭。第一种是华人家庭。他们通常是已经住在国外多年的中国家庭。有些家长觉得孩子住在华人家庭，在语言、文化和生活习惯上差不多，所以沟通和适应比较没问题。但是也担心孩子在华人家庭不能锻炼英文，也不能真正认识美国文化。另一种寄宿家庭是一般的美国家庭，常常是一对父母带着两三个孩子住在大房子里。如果选择这样的家庭，孩子不但可以学习语言，可以跟着寄宿家庭了解当地的文化，还可以和寄宿家庭的其他孩子像兄弟姐妹一样生活。这是很多独生子女在国内体验不到的，但是也因为寄宿家庭自己已经有几个孩子，可能没有太多时间可以照顾你的孩子。第三种寄宿家庭是孩子都已经长大，离开家，自己也已经退休的家庭。这些人多半年纪较大，但是还愿意接受国际学生，了解不同的文化。他们跟一般的美国家庭比，生活没有那么忙，所以有更多的时间可以照顾学生，而且这些老人的生活比较健康，也喜欢安静，所以孩子在这种家庭可以专心学习。要是你的孩子喜欢热闹，可能就不适合这样的家庭。
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng ràng nǐ de hái zi chū guó liú xué ma nà me zhǎo dào shì hé nǐ hái zi de jì sù jiā tíng shì zài guó wài shùn lì liú xué hěn zhòng yào de yí bù nǐ kě yǐ gēn jù hái zi de xū yào wèi tā men xuǎn zé xià miàn jǐ zhǒng jì sù jiā tíng dì yī zhǒng shì huá rén jiā tíng tā men tōng cháng shì yǐ jīng zhù zài guó wài duō nián de zhōng guó jiā tíng yǒu xiē jiā zhǎng jué de hái zi zhù zài huá rén jiā tíng zài yǔ yán wén huà hé shēng huó xí guàn shàng chà bu duō suǒ yǐ gōu tōng hé shì yìng bǐ jiào méi wèn tí dàn shì yě dān xīn hái zi zài huá rén jiā tíng bù néng duàn liàn yīng wén yě bù néng zhēn zhèng rèn shí měi guó wén huà lìng yì zhǒng jì sù jiā tíng shì yì bān de měi guó jiā tíng cháng cháng shì yí duì fù mǔ dài zhe liǎng sān gè hái zi zhù zài dà fáng zi lǐ rú guǒ xuǎn zé zhè yàng de jiā tíng hái zi bú dàn kě yǐ xué xí yǔ yán kě yǐ gēn zhe jì sù jiā tíng liǎo jiě dāng dì de wén huà hái kě yǐ hé jì sù jiā tíng de qí tā hái zi xiàng xiōng dì jiě mèi yí yàng shēng huó zhè shì hěn duō dú shēng zǐ nǚ zài guó nèi tǐ yàn bú dào de dàn shì yě yīn wèi jì sù jiā tíng zì jǐ yǐ jīng yǒu jǐ gè hái zi kě néng méi yǒu tài duō shí jiān kě yǐ zhào gù nǐ de hái zi dì sān zhǒng jì sù jiā tíng shì hái zi dōu yǐ jīng zhǎng dà lí kāi jiā zì jǐ yě yǐ jīng tuì xiū de jiā tíng zhè xiē rén duō bàn nián jì jiào dà dàn shì hái yuàn yì jiē shòu guó jì xué shēng liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà tā men gēn yì bān de měi guó jiā tíng bǐ shēng huó méi yǒu nà me máng suǒ yǐ yǒu gèng duō de shí jiān kě yǐ zhào gù xué shēng ér qiě zhè xiē lǎo rén de shēng huó bǐ jiào jiàn kāng yě xǐ huān ān jìng suǒ yǐ hái zi zài zhè zhǒng jiā tíng kě yǐ zhuān xīn xué xí yào shì nǐ de hái zi xǐ huān rè nào kě néng jiù bú shì hé zhè yàng de jiā tíng — Do you want your child to study abroad? Then finding a homestay family that suits your child is a very important step for studying smoothly abroad. According to your child’s needs you can choose among the following kinds of homestay families. The first kind is a Chinese family, usually a Chinese family that has lived abroad for many years. Some parents feel that if the child lives in a Chinese family the language, culture and living habits are similar, so communication and adaptation are fairly unproblematic, but they also worry that the child cannot practice English in a Chinese family and cannot truly get to know American culture. Another kind of homestay family is an ordinary American family, often a couple with two or three children living in a big house. If you choose such a family, the child can not only learn the language and learn the local culture with the homestay family but also live like brothers and sisters with the family’s other children, which many only children cannot experience at home; but because the family already has several children, they may not have much time to look after your child. The third kind of homestay family is a family whose children have grown up and left home and who have retired themselves. These people are mostly older but still willing to accept international students and learn about different cultures. Compared with ordinary American families they are less busy, so they have more time to look after the student, and the old people live a healthier life and like quiet, so the child can concentrate on study in this kind of family. If your child likes liveliness, it may not suit such a family. (source note: adapted from a homestay website)

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Read the following email from a Chinese student to his parents, then answer the questions. 1. What do the first two lines of the email tell you about the student? 2. How does his homestay family treat him? 3. What are three EEIs about his school life? 4. How does he feel about his study abroad experience overall? B. In Chinese, discuss with a partner how to help 大明 adjust to his life abroad. C. Write a return email as 大明’s parents to comfort and advise him. The email, then my answers and a sample reply:

examples.text: 亲爱的爸妈：来美国留学已经三个月了，现在才有时间给你们写信。虽然你们从小让我上英语班为我出国做准备，可是到了国外我才发现自己没有办法马上和当地人交流。现在我天天和住宿家庭的爸妈人说英文。他们人很好，但在学习上完全不会帮助我，他们只管我的吃和住。但是每天吃的都是沙拉、汉堡或是热狗，我真不习惯。美国的学校虽然没有很多考试，但是每学期都有好几个报告要写，还要分小组和同学交流，还得自己上网学习。而且上课有时老师说得太快，我听不懂，也不好意思一直问。为了学习英语，你们帮我找了一所中国人很少的高中，但是因为我的英文不好，很难交到朋友。所以我现在的朋友都是几个跟我差不多的小留学生。唉，我真不知道为什么要出国，留在国内上学不是也很好吗？我想我的朋友，我想你们！你们的儿子，大明
examples.translation: qīn ài de bà mā lái měi guó liú xué yǐ jīng sān gè yuè le xiàn zài cái yǒu shí jiān gěi nǐ men xiě xìn suī rán nǐ men cóng xiǎo ràng wǒ shàng yīng yǔ bān wèi wǒ chū guó zuò zhǔn bèi kě shì dào le guó wài wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ méi yǒu bàn fǎ mǎ shàng hé dāng dì rén jiāo liú xiàn zài wǒ tiān tiān hé zhù sù jiā tíng de bà mā rén shuō yīng wén tā men rén hěn hǎo dàn zài xué xí shàng wán quán bú huì bāng zhù wǒ tā men zhǐ guǎn wǒ de chī hé zhù dàn shì měi tiān chī de dōu shì shā lā hàn bǎo huò shì rè gǒu wǒ zhēn bù xí guàn měi guó de xué xiào suī rán méi yǒu hěn duō kǎo shì dàn shì měi xué qī dōu yǒu hǎo jǐ gè bào gào yào xiě hái yào fēn xiǎo zǔ hé tóng xué jiāo liú hái děi zì jǐ shàng wǎng xué xí ér qiě shàng kè yǒu shí lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng yě bù hǎo yì sī yì zhí wèn wèi le xué xí yīng yǔ nǐ men bāng wǒ zhǎo le yì suǒ zhōng guó rén hěn shǎo de gāo zhōng dàn shì yīn wèi wǒ de yīng wén bù hǎo hěn nán jiāo dào péng yǒu suǒ yǐ wǒ xiàn zài de péng yǒu dōu shì jǐ gè gēn wǒ chà bu duō de xiǎo liú xué shēng āi wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào wèi shén me yào chū guó liú zài guó nèi shàng xué bú shì yě hěn hǎo ma wǒ xiǎng wǒ de péng yǒu wǒ xiǎng nǐ men nǐ men de ér zi dà míng — Dear Mom and Dad: It has been three months since I came to study in America, and only now do I have time to write to you. Although you had me attend English classes from childhood to prepare for going abroad, only when I got abroad did I find that I had no way of communicating with local people right away. Now I speak English every day with my homestay parents. They are very nice people, but they don’t help me at all with study; they only take care of my food and lodging. But every day what I eat is salad, hamburgers or hot dogs, and I really am not used to it. Although American schools don’t have many exams, every semester there are several reports to write, and I also have to exchange with classmates in groups and study online myself. And in class the teacher sometimes speaks too fast, I can’t understand, and I’m embarrassed to keep asking. To learn English you found me a high school with few Chinese people, but because my English is not good it’s hard to make friends, so my friends now are a few young students like me. Sigh, I really don’t know why I should go abroad; wouldn’t staying at home to go to school be good too? I miss my friends, I miss you! Your son, Daming. (the book prints 住宿家庭的爸妈人说英文 with a stray 人; kept as printed. The book’s header lines TO, CC and Subject are blank.)

examples.text: 他来美国三个月了，爸妈从小让他上英语班，为出国做准备。
examples.translation: tā lái měi guó sān gè yuè le bà mā cóng xiǎo ràng tā shàng yīng yǔ bān wèi chū guó zuò zhǔn bèi — 4A-1 (my answer): He has been in America for three months, and his parents had him attend English classes from childhood to prepare for going abroad.

examples.text: 他们人很好，但在学习上完全不会帮助他，只管他的吃和住。
examples.translation: tā men rén hěn hǎo dàn zài xué xí shàng wán quán bú huì bāng zhù tā zhǐ guǎn tā de chī hé zhù — 4A-2 (my answer): They are very nice but don’t help him with study at all; they only take care of his food and lodging.

examples.text: 没有很多考试，但是要写很多报告，要分小组交流，还得自己上网学习，老师有时说得太快。
examples.translation: méi yǒu hěn duō kǎo shì dàn shì yào xiě hěn duō bào gào yào fēn xiǎo zǔ jiāo liú hái děi zì jǐ shàng wǎng xué xí lǎo shī yǒu shí shuō de tài kuài — 4A-3 (my answer): There are not many exams but many reports to write, group work, and online self-study, and the teacher sometimes speaks too fast.

examples.text: 他觉得很不习惯，很难交到朋友，不知道为什么要出国。
examples.translation: tā jué de hěn bù xí guàn hěn nán jiāo dào péng yǒu bù zhī dào wèi shén me yào chū guó — 4A-4 (my answer): He feels very unsettled, finds it hard to make friends, and doesn’t know why he should go abroad.

examples.text: 亲爱的大明：收到你的信，我们很想你。刚到国外，一切都不容易，慢慢就会适应的。吃的方面，你可以自己学着做几个中国菜。学习上，你可以多问老师，也可以找同学一起学习。我们每个周末都会跟你视频聊天。你是个好孩子，我们相信你。爸爸妈妈
examples.translation: qīn ài de dà míng shōu dào nǐ de xìn wǒ men hěn xiǎng nǐ gāng dào guó wài yí qiè dōu bù róng yì màn màn jiù huì shì yìng de chī de fāng miàn nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ xué zhe zuò jǐ gè zhōng guó cài xué xí shàng nǐ kě yǐ duō wèn lǎo shī yě kě yǐ zhǎo tóng xué yì qǐ xué xí wǒ men měi gè zhōu mò dōu huì gēn nǐ shì pín liáo tiān nǐ shì gè hǎo hái zi wǒ men xiāng xìn nǐ bà bà mā mā — A reply from the parents (my sample): Dear Daming: Receiving your letter, we miss you very much. Just arrived abroad, nothing is easy, and you will adapt slowly. For food, you could learn to cook a few Chinese dishes yourself. In study, you can ask the teacher more and also find classmates to study with. Every weekend we will video chat with you. You are a good child and we believe in you. Dad and Mom

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage below, then list the suggestions (建议 jiànyì) the homestay host provides to parents who wish to send their children to school in the U.S. B. Share your list with your partner in Chinese. The passage: 寄宿家庭的妈妈王美香对要送孩子出国的中国家长们有几点建议：

examples.text: 第一、不要让孩子在读十一年级、十二年级时出国，如果孩子已经上十二年级，就读完高中再出国。因为高中最后两年，生活和学习的压力特别大，那个时候出国会遇到比较多的问题，而且新来的学生，要适应新的环境、文化，而且在美国读书并不轻松，特别是想进好学校，需要很大的努力。不要觉得来美国就不用吃苦、不用努力。
examples.translation: dì yī bú yào ràng hái zi zài dú shí yī nián jí shí èr nián jí shí chū guó rú guǒ hái zi yǐ jīng shàng shí èr nián jí jiù dú wán gāo zhōng zài chū guó yīn wèi gāo zhōng zuì hòu liǎng nián shēng huó hé xué xí de yā lì tè bié dà nà ge shí hòu chū guó huì yù dào bǐ jiào duō de wèn tí ér qiě xīn lái de xué shēng yào shì yìng xīn de huán jìng wén huà ér qiě zài měi guó dú shū bìng bù qīng sōng tè bié shì xiǎng jìn hǎo xué xiào xū yào hěn dà de nǔ lì bú yào jué de lái měi guó jiù bú yòng chī kǔ bú yòng nǔ lì — First: don’t let the child go abroad in the 11th or 12th grade; if the child is already in the 12th grade, finish high school before going abroad. Because in the last two years of high school the pressure of life and study is especially great, going abroad then runs into more problems, and a newly arrived student has to adapt to a new environment and culture; moreover studying in America is not easy, especially if you want to enter a good school, which takes great effort. Don’t think that coming to America means no hardship and no effort is needed. (the book writes 11 and 12 in digits)

examples.text: 第二、很多中国大陆的留学公司，没来过美国，也不了解美国。他们有时候会把学生安排到很“乡下”的地方，真到了这种地方，孩子会生活得很辛苦。美国人不重视吃，大多不会花太多时间在做饭上，更不会特别为孩子做中餐、注意孩子的营养。中国孩子吃不惯美国人做的西餐，在外面有时候也买不到中餐，自己又不能开车，有的学校连热食都不卖，天天吃冷餐，真的会过得非常辛苦。
examples.translation: dì èr hěn duō zhōng guó dà lù de liú xué gōng sī méi lái guò měi guó yě bù liǎo jiě měi guó tā men yǒu shí hòu huì bǎ xué shēng ān pái dào hěn xiāng xià de dì fāng zhēn dào le zhè zhǒng dì fāng hái zi huì shēng huó de hěn xīn kǔ měi guó rén bú zhòng shì chī dà duō bú huì huā tài duō shí jiān zài zuò fàn shàng gèng bú huì tè bié wèi hái zi zuò zhōng cān zhù yì hái zi de yíng yǎng zhōng guó hái zi chī bú guàn měi guó rén zuò de xī cān zài wài miàn yǒu shí hòu yě mǎi bú dào zhōng cān zì jǐ yòu bù néng kāi chē yǒu de xué xiào lián rè shí dōu bú mài tiān tiān chī lěng cān zhēn de huì guò de fēi cháng xīn kǔ — Second: many study-abroad companies in mainland China have never been to America and don’t know America. They sometimes arrange students in very “rural” places, and once they are really in such a place the children live a hard life. Americans don’t attach importance to eating, mostly don’t spend much time cooking, and especially won’t cook Chinese food for the child or watch the child’s nutrition. Chinese children can’t get used to the Western food Americans make, sometimes can’t buy Chinese food outside, can’t drive themselves, and some schools don’t even sell hot food, so eating cold meals every day really is very hard.

examples.text: 最后，父母最好多和孩子沟通，交流，常打电话、视频了解孩子在国外的生活，也能让孩子知道虽然分隔两地，父母还是很关心他或她。这样，孩子要是有什么事，也不会把事放在心里，不敢让父母知道，或是因此交上坏朋友，养成坏习惯。
examples.translation: zuì hòu fù mǔ zuì hǎo duō hé hái zi gōu tōng jiāo liú cháng dǎ diàn huà shì pín liǎo jiě hái zi zài guó wài de shēng huó yě néng ràng hái zi zhī dào suī rán fēn gé liǎng dì fù mǔ hái shì hěn guān xīn tā huò tā zhè yàng hái zi yào shì yǒu shén me shì yě bú huì bǎ shì fàng zài xīn lǐ bù gǎn ràng fù mǔ zhī dào huò shì yīn cǐ jiāo shàng huài péng yǒu yǎng chéng huài xí guàn — Finally, parents had better communicate and exchange more with the child, often calling and video chatting to learn about the child’s life abroad, which also lets the child know that although separated in two places the parents still care about him or her. This way, if something happens to the child, he or she won’t keep it in his or her heart and not dare let the parents know, or make bad friends and form bad habits because of it. (the book writes 他/她; here 他或她; source note: adapted from a newspaper website)

examples.text: 不要让孩子在十一年级、十二年级时出国，最好读完高中再出国。
examples.translation: bú yào ràng hái zi zài shí yī nián jí shí èr nián jí shí chū guó zuì hǎo dú wán gāo zhōng zài chū guó — Suggestion 1 (my list): Don’t let the child go abroad in grades eleven and twelve; it is best to finish high school first.

examples.text: 不要让留学公司随便安排很“乡下”的地方，要了解吃的和交通问题。
examples.translation: bú yào ràng liú xué gōng sī suí biàn ān pái hěn xiāng xià de dì fāng yào liǎo jiě chī de hé jiāo tōng wèn tí — Suggestion 2 (my list): Don’t let a study-abroad company arrange a very “rural” place carelessly; look into the food and transportation problems.

examples.text: 多和孩子沟通，常打电话、视频，让孩子知道父母很关心他或她。
examples.translation: duō hé hái zi gōu tōng cháng dǎ diàn huà shì pín ràng hái zi zhī dào fù mǔ hěn guān xīn tā huò tā — Suggestion 3 (my list): Communicate more with the child, call and video chat often, and let the child know the parents care.

exercises.prompt: What food is Daming not used to?
Why is it hard for Daming to make friends?

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read Passage 1 while a partner reads Passage 2, then fill in the table with the pros and cons of studying abroad in the country your passage addresses. B. In Chinese, share your findings with your partner and fill in the table for the other passage. C. In Chinese, discuss which country you would choose if you were a parent, and why. Passage 1: 英国的寄宿学校; Passage 2: 美国的寄宿家庭.

rows: 小班上课，设施和质量好，有人照顾，课外活动多，同学来自各国
学费贵，不容易进，多半在乡下，交通不方便
语言进步快，了解美国文化，兄弟姐妹帮助，训练自理能力
生活和饮食习惯不同，沟通有困难，环境不一样，安全问题
tables.title: Activity 1: the pros and cons of the two passages (the book’s table is blank; mine is below)

examples.text: 英国的寄宿学校通常是小班上课，有很好的设施和质量，所以寄宿学校的毕业生常常能顺利进入有名的大学学习。而且学生住在学校里，在学习上、生活上都有人照顾，家长可以比较放心。另外，寄宿学校提供多种多样的课，除了上课以外，还有很多课外活动，比方说划船、骑马等，可以发展学生的兴趣爱好。周末的时候，学校还会安排学生看演出，参观各地的名胜古迹或博物馆，丰富孩子的生活。最后，寄宿学校有来自各国的学生，学生可以和别的同学交流，了解不同的文化，还可以互相学习、互相帮助。但是寄宿学校通常是私立的，所以学费比较贵，还有要进寄宿学校也不容易，有很多条件，如果你的成绩不好，很难进到好的寄宿学校。另外，寄宿学校多半在乡下，虽然风景很美，但是交通和生活会有一些不方便。
examples.translation: yīng guó de jì sù xué xiào tōng cháng shì xiǎo bān shàng kè yǒu hěn hǎo de shè shī hé zhì liàng suǒ yǐ jì sù xué xiào de bì yè shēng cháng cháng néng shùn lì jìn rù yǒu míng de dà xué xué xí ér qiě xué shēng zhù zài xué xiào lǐ zài xué xí shàng shēng huó shàng dōu yǒu rén zhào gù jiā zhǎng kě yǐ bǐ jiào fàng xīn lìng wài jì sù xué xiào tí gōng duō zhǒng duō yàng de kè chú le shàng kè yǐ wài hái yǒu hěn duō kè wài huó dòng bǐ fāng shuō huá chuán qí mǎ děng kě yǐ fā zhǎn xué shēng de xìng qù ài hào zhōu mò de shí hòu xué xiào hái huì ān pái xué shēng kàn yǎn chū cān guān gè dì de míng shèng gǔ jì huò bó wù guǎn fēng fù hái zi de shēng huó zuì hòu jì sù xué xiào yǒu lái zì gè guó de xué shēng xué shēng kě yǐ hé bié de tóng xué jiāo liú liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà hái kě yǐ hù xiāng xué xí hù xiāng bāng zhù dàn shì jì sù xué xiào tōng cháng shì sī lì de suǒ yǐ xué fèi bǐ jiào guì hái yǒu yào jìn jì sù xué xiào yě bù róng yì yǒu hěn duō tiáo jiàn rú guǒ nǐ de chéng jì bù hǎo hěn nán jìn dào hǎo de jì sù xué xiào lìng wài jì sù xué xiào duō bàn zài xiāng xià suī rán fēng jǐng hěn měi dàn shì jiāo tōng hé shēng huó huì yǒu yì xiē bù fāng biàn — Passage 1, British boarding schools: British boarding schools usually have small classes and have very good facilities and quality, so graduates of boarding schools can often enter famous universities smoothly. Also, students live at school and are looked after in study and life, so parents can feel fairly relieved. In addition, boarding schools offer a variety of courses; besides classes there are many extracurricular activities, such as rowing and horse riding, which develop students’ interests and hobbies. At weekends the school also arranges for students to watch performances and visit scenic spots, historic sites or museums, enriching the children’s life. Finally, boarding schools have students from all countries, who can exchange with other classmates, learn about different cultures and learn from and help each other. But boarding schools are usually private, so the tuition is rather expensive; also getting into a boarding school is not easy and has many conditions, and if your grades are not good it is hard to get into a good one. In addition, boarding schools are mostly in the countryside, and although the scenery is beautiful, transportation and daily life are somewhat inconvenient.

examples.text: 很多父母会安排让孩子住在美国人的寄宿家庭，这样孩子上课还有下课都得讲英文，孩子的语言能力在很短的时间会有很大的进步。因为是住在美国人的家里，孩子天天和他们生活在一起，看电视聊天，参加家庭聚会，和他们一块过节等，这样可以比较快了解美国文化和适应当地的生活。如果寄宿家庭也有孩子，寄宿家庭的兄弟姐妹还可以在生活上、学习上帮助他或她。另外，寄宿家庭平常会让孩子自己收拾房间，洗碗，洗衣什么的，这些事可以训练孩子自己照顾自己的能力。但是对孩子来说，外国家庭的生活习惯和饮食习惯可能很不一样，有时也会有沟通上的困难，适应起来会不太容易。还有，寄宿家庭的环境和质量都不大一样，也不能像寄宿学校提供二十四小时的照顾，父母可能会比较担心孩子安全的问题。
examples.translation: hěn duō fù mǔ huì ān pái ràng hái zi zhù zài měi guó rén de jì sù jiā tíng zhè yàng hái zi shàng kè hái yǒu xià kè dōu děi jiǎng yīng wén hái zi de yǔ yán néng lì zài hěn duǎn de shí jiān huì yǒu hěn dà de jìn bù yīn wèi shì zhù zài měi guó rén de jiā lǐ hái zi tiān tiān hé tā men shēng huó zài yì qǐ kàn diàn shì liáo tiān cān jiā jiā tíng jù huì hé tā men yí kuài guò jié děng zhè yàng kě yǐ bǐ jiào kuài liǎo jiě měi guó wén huà hé shì yìng dāng dì de shēng huó rú guǒ jì sù jiā tíng yě yǒu hái zi jì sù jiā tíng de xiōng dì jiě mèi hái kě yǐ zài shēng huó shàng xué xí shàng bāng zhù tā huò tā lìng wài jì sù jiā tíng píng cháng huì ràng hái zi zì jǐ shōu shí fáng jiān xǐ wǎn xǐ yī shén me de zhè xiē shì kě yǐ xùn liàn hái zi zì jǐ zhào gù zì jǐ de néng lì dàn shì duì hái zi lái shuō wài guó jiā tíng de shēng huó xí guàn hé yǐn shí xí guàn kě néng hěn bù yí yàng yǒu shí yě huì yǒu gōu tōng shàng de kùn nán shì yìng qǐ lái huì bú tài róng yì hái yǒu jì sù jiā tíng de huán jìng hé zhì liàng dōu bú dà yí yàng yě bù néng xiàng jì sù xué xiào tí gōng èr shí sì xiǎo shí de zhào gù fù mǔ kě néng huì bǐ jiào dān xīn hái zi ān quán de wèn tí — Passage 2, American homestay families: Many parents arrange for their children to live in American homestay families, so the children must speak English both in and after class, and their language ability will improve greatly in a very short time. Because they live in Americans’ homes, the children live with them every day, watching TV and chatting, joining family gatherings and celebrating holidays together, so they can understand American culture and adapt to local life more quickly. If the homestay family also has children, the family’s brothers and sisters can also help him or her in life and study. In addition, homestay families usually let the child tidy the room, wash dishes and do laundry, which can train the child’s ability to look after himself or herself. But for the child, the living and eating habits of a foreign family may be very different, there may sometimes be communication difficulties, and adapting may not be easy. Also, the environment and quality of homestay families are not all the same, and they cannot provide twenty-four-hour care as a boarding school does, so parents may worry more about the child’s safety. (the book writes 24 in digits and 他/她, written 他或她 here)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Watch the VOA Chinese videos in the link and answer the questions. Clip 1 (0:59–1:36): 1. What is school life like for Chinese students in the U.S.? Clip 2 (4:42–5:32): 2. What contributions do Chinese students and their culture make to the school? Clip 3 (5:44–5:59): 3. What does the American student say about her Chinese friend? Clip 4 (6:00–6:17): 4. What does the American student say about his Chinese friend and their weekend activities together? B. Compare answers with a partner in Chinese. C. In Chinese, discuss with your partner any Chinese students you may have known in high school or college. (The videos and the link are not included.)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Watch the talk show at the following link and perform the tasks below: Clip 1 (1:06–2:02): 1. Describe the interviewee. Clip 2 (6:27–7:43): 2. Describe her experience abroad. B. Share your work with a partner in Chinese. C. Read the following advice on how to prepare children for study abroad. D. Summarizing this advice, write a list of suggestions in Chinese and post it on a website. (The talk show is not included.) The advice and my list:

examples.text: 在孩子出国前，父母可以为他们做好一些准备：
examples.translation: zài hái zi chū guó qián fù mǔ kě yǐ wèi tā men zuò hǎo yì xiē zhǔn bèi — Advice on preparing children for study abroad: Before the child goes abroad, parents can make some preparations: (the four numbered points follow; source note: adapted from a study-abroad website)

examples.text: 第一，锻炼孩子一个人生活的能力。在平时的生活中就要多让孩子自己动手，例如让他们自己整理自己的房间，收拾自己的学习用品，让他们自己做决定。如果有机会的话，还可以让他们参加夏令营等活动，这样不仅能锻炼他们自理的能力，还能让他们多和别人交流。
examples.translation: dì yī duàn liàn hái zi yí gè rén shēng huó de néng lì zài píng shí de shēng huó zhōng jiù yào duō ràng hái zi zì jǐ dòng shǒu lì rú ràng tā men zì jǐ zhěng lǐ zì jǐ de fáng jiān shōu shí zì jǐ de xué xí yòng pǐn ràng tā men zì jǐ zuò jué dìng rú guǒ yǒu jī huì de huà hái kě yǐ ràng tā men cān jiā xià lìng yíng děng huó dòng zhè yàng bù jǐn néng duàn liàn tā men zì lǐ de néng lì hái néng ràng tā men duō hé bié rén jiāo liú — 1. Train the child’s ability to live alone. In everyday life let the child do things himself or herself more, for example tidy his own room, put away his own study things and make his own decisions. If there is a chance, you can also let them join summer camps and the like, which not only trains their self-care but also lets them communicate more with others.

examples.text: 第二，提高外语交流能力。在平时的生活中让孩子多看一些国外的动画片，帮孩子报名上一些口语班，锻炼他们的开口说话的能力，或是在出国旅游的时候，让孩子多和外国人交流。
examples.translation: dì èr tí gāo wài yǔ jiāo liú néng lì zài píng shí de shēng huó zhōng ràng hái zi duō kàn yì xiē guó wài de dòng huà piàn bāng hái zi bào míng shàng yì xiē kǒu yǔ bān duàn liàn tā men de kāi kǒu shuō huà de néng lì huò shì zài chū guó lǚ yóu de shí hòu ràng hái zi duō hé wài guó rén jiāo liú — 2. Improve foreign-language communication ability. In everyday life let the child watch more foreign cartoons, sign the child up for some speaking classes to train the ability to open their mouths and speak, or, when traveling abroad, let the child communicate more with foreigners.

examples.text: 第三，了解国外文化，提高孩子的交往能力。出国前多让孩子了解国外的文化和习俗，例如外国的节日等，这样不但能增加孩子和外国孩子交流的话题，也能帮孩子更快地适应国外的生活。
examples.translation: dì sān liǎo jiě guó wài wén huà tí gāo hái zi de jiāo wǎng néng lì chū guó qián duō ràng hái zi liǎo jiě guó wài de wén huà hé xí sú lì rú wài guó de jié rì děng zhè yàng bú dàn néng zēng jiā hái zi hé wài guó hái zi jiāo liú de huà tí yě néng bāng hái zi gèng kuài de shì yìng guó wài de shēng huó — 3. Learn about foreign culture and improve the child’s social ability. Before going abroad let the child learn more about foreign culture and customs, such as foreign festivals, which not only gives the child more topics for talking with foreign children but also helps the child adapt to life abroad faster.

examples.text: 第四，锻炼孩子主动学习的能力。在国内许多同学做完作业需要家长帮助检查，甚至需要家长陪着做作业。有不会的问题，总是马上问老师或问父母，自己不会主动去想。所以训练孩子的自我学习的能力，让他们学会利用电脑网路查找信息。这样，要是有不懂的生词或是有想要了解的知识，都能很快的找到答案。
examples.translation: dì sì duàn liàn hái zi zhǔ dòng xué xí de néng lì zài guó nèi xǔ duō tóng xué zuò wán zuò yè xū yào jiā zhǎng bāng zhù jiǎn chá shèn zhì xū yào jiā zhǎng péi zhe zuò zuò yè yǒu bú huì de wèn tí zǒng shì mǎ shàng wèn lǎo shī huò wèn fù mǔ zì jǐ bú huì zhǔ dòng qù xiǎng suǒ yǐ xùn liàn hái zi de zì wǒ xué xí de néng lì ràng tā men xué huì lì yòng diàn nǎo wǎng lù chá zhǎo xìn xī zhè yàng yào shì yǒu bù dǒng de shēng cí huò shì yǒu xiǎng yào liǎo jiě de zhī shí dōu néng hěn kuài de zhǎo dào dá àn — 4. Train the child’s ability to learn on his own initiative. At home many students need parents to check their homework after finishing it and even need parents to sit with them while doing it. With problems they can’t do, they always ask the teacher or parents right away and don’t think actively themselves. So train the child’s self-study ability and let them learn to use computers and the Internet to look up information, so that if there are unknown new words or knowledge they want to learn, they can quickly find the answers.

examples.text: 锻炼孩子一个人生活的能力，提高外语交流能力，了解国外文化，锻炼主动学习的能力。
examples.translation: duàn liàn hái zi yí gè rén shēng huó de néng lì tí gāo wài yǔ jiāo liú néng lì liǎo jiě guó wài wén huà duàn liàn zhǔ dòng xué xí de néng lì — Activity 3D, my list of suggestions: train the ability to live alone, improve foreign-language communication, learn about foreign culture, and train active learning.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Read the following passage and answer the questions. 1. What does 李老师 think about Chinese children studying in the U.S., and why? 2. What are three examples she cites to support her opinion? 3. What does she think about the learning environment in U.S. high schools? B. Compare answers with a partner in Chinese. C. Form two groups for a Chinese debate on sending children abroad to study. The passage, my answers and the debate steps:

tables.title: Activity 4: new vocabulary

rows: Group 1 will brainstorm ideas, take notes and organize their arguments for children studying abroad. Group 2 will prepare to argue against studying abroad. (10 minutes)
Each group presents their argument while the other group takes notes.
Each group then rebuts the other. (This step may be repeated several times.)
Each group delivers their summation and closing arguments.
The teacher decides which group wins.
tables.title: Activity 4C: the debate steps (the book numbers them 1 to 5 in English; the Chinese step names are mine)

examples.text: 我觉得低龄留学不适合每个孩子，特别是孩子的身心都还不成熟。刚来英语不好，自主生活、自主学习的能力也不行，再加上没有父母陪在身边，所以很多孩子开始逃学、打游戏，最后，来了美国几年什么也没学到。而且就算家长可以出来陪读，父母长期分隔两地，妈妈在国外陪读，爸爸在国内赚钱，时间久了，对父母的感情也不好。再说，就算父母能每天和孩子视频也比不上天天陪在身边。虽然低龄留学也有好处，比如能更好的学习英语，能早一点适应当地的生活。但是年纪小的孩子在国外久了，想法越来越西化，之后父母虽然还能用中文和孩子交流，但是沟通起来可能有困难。我知道很多父母把孩子送出来读初中或高中就是为了想逃离国内中考和高考的压力，但是在这里念高中一点也不轻松，再加上上面提到的一些问题，我觉得让孩子低龄留学这件事，父母得好好想清楚。
examples.translation: wǒ jué de dī líng liú xué bú shì hé měi gè hái zi tè bié shì hái zi de shēn xīn dōu hái bù chéng shú gāng lái yīng yǔ bù hǎo zì zhǔ shēng huó zì zhǔ xué xí de néng lì yě bù xíng zài jiā shàng méi yǒu fù mǔ péi zài shēn biān suǒ yǐ hěn duō hái zi kāi shǐ táo xué dǎ yóu xì zuì hòu lái le měi guó jǐ nián shén me yě méi xué dào ér qiě jiù suàn jiā zhǎng kě yǐ chū lái péi dú fù mǔ cháng qī fēn gé liǎng dì mā mā zài guó wài péi dú bà bà zài guó nèi zhuàn qián shí jiān jiǔ le duì fù mǔ de gǎn qíng yě bù hǎo zài shuō jiù suàn fù mǔ néng měi tiān hé hái zi shì pín yě bǐ bú shàng tiān tiān péi zài shēn biān suī rán dī líng liú xué yě yǒu hǎo chù bǐ rú néng gèng hǎo de xué xí yīng yǔ néng zǎo yì diǎn shì yìng dāng dì de shēng huó dàn shì nián jì xiǎo de hái zi zài guó wài jiǔ le xiǎng fǎ yuè lái yuè xī huà zhī hòu fù mǔ suī rán hái néng yòng zhōng wén hé hái zi jiāo liú dàn shì gōu tōng qǐ lái kě néng yǒu kùn nán wǒ zhī dào hěn duō fù mǔ bǎ hái zi sòng chū lái dú chū zhōng huò gāo zhōng jiù shì wèi le xiǎng táo lí guó nèi zhōng kǎo hé gāo kǎo de yā lì dàn shì zài zhè lǐ niàn gāo zhōng yì diǎn yě bù qīng sōng zài jiā shàng shàng miàn tí dào de yì xiē wèn tí wǒ jué de ràng hái zi dī líng liú xué zhè jiàn shì fù mǔ děi hǎo hǎo xiǎng qīng chǔ — 李老师 is a counselor at a high school in New York. She talks in a program about her view of studying abroad at a young age. I think studying abroad at a young age is not suitable for every child, especially when the child’s body and mind are not yet mature. At the beginning the English is not good and the ability to live and study independently is also lacking; add to that no parents at the child’s side, so many children start skipping school and playing games, and in the end learn nothing after several years in America. And even if the parents can come out to accompany the studies, with parents separated for a long time, the mother accompanying abroad and the father earning money at home, after a long time the feelings toward the parents are also not good. Besides, even if the parents can video chat with the child every day, it is no match for being at the child’s side every day. Although studying abroad young has benefits, such as learning English better and adapting to local life earlier, children who are young and abroad for a long time become more and more Westernized in their thinking, and afterwards, although the parents can still talk with the child in Chinese, communication may be difficult. I know many parents send their children out to junior or senior high school to escape the pressure of the domestic high-school and college entrance exams, but studying high school here is not easy at all, and with the problems mentioned above, I think that as for letting a child study abroad young, parents must think it over carefully. (source note: adapted from a Q&A website)

examples.text: 她认为低龄留学不适合每个孩子，因为孩子的身心还不成熟。
examples.translation: tā rèn wéi dī líng liú xué bú shì hé měi gè hái zi yīn wèi hái zi de shēn xīn hái bù chéng shú — Activity 4A-1 (my answer): She thinks studying abroad young is not suitable for every child, because the child’s body and mind are not yet mature.

examples.text: 很多孩子逃学、打游戏，什么也没学到；父母分隔两地，感情不好；孩子越来越西化，沟通有困难。
examples.translation: hěn duō hái zi táo xué dǎ yóu xì shén me yě méi xué dào fù mǔ fēn gé liǎng dì gǎn qíng bù hǎo hái zi yuè lái yuè xī huà gōu tōng yǒu kùn nán — 4A-2 (my answer): Many children skip school and play games and learn nothing; parents separated in two places have strained feelings; children become more Westernized and communication is difficult.

examples.text: 她觉得在美国念高中一点也不轻松。
examples.translation: tā jué de zài měi guó niàn gāo zhōng yì diǎn yě bù qīng sōng — 4A-3 (my answer): She thinks high school in America is not easy at all.

exercises.prompt: What are class sizes usually like in British boarding schools?

lessons.title: 673. Lesson 26 Presentation 2: from 海龟 to 海带, the history of overseas Chinese students
lessons.subtitle: 出国留学 · 公费 自费 · 海归 海龟 海待 海带 · 降温 · 理想的工作 · 学位 优势 人才

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. Would you like to study in China or Taiwan someday? Why or why not? B. Would you like to work in China or Taiwan someday? If so, what kind of work? C. What are the pros and cons to you studying abroad? (Four pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 出国留学的历史
explanations.body: The three paragraphs of the presentation.

examples.text: 九十年代以前，出国留学的机会并不多，而且多半儿都是公费留学，毕业后都要回国服务。后来，中国经济发展了，自费出国留学的越来越多。条件稍微好一点的家庭，不管多辛苦，父母都会想办法送孩子出国。
examples.translation: jiǔ shí nián dài yǐ qián chū guó liú xué de jī huì bìng bù duō ér qiě duō bànr dōu shì gōng fèi liú xué bì yè hòu dōu yào huí guó fú wù hòu lái zhōng guó jīng jì fā zhǎn le zì fèi chū guó liú xué de yuè lái yuè duō tiáo jiàn shāo wēi hǎo yì diǎn de jiā tíng bù guǎn duō xīn kǔ fù mǔ dōu huì xiǎng bàn fǎ sòng hái zi chū guó — Before the nineties there were not many chances to study abroad, and most of it was at public expense; after graduating, everyone had to return home to serve. Later, China’s economy developed, and more and more people went abroad to study at their own expense. Families in slightly better circumstances, no matter how hard it was, would find a way to send their children abroad. (translations in this card are mine; the book also prints the passage in traditional characters)

examples.text: 开始的时候，大部分学生都是去读研究生。因为是自费的，而且当时国外的待遇和条件都比国内好得多，所以毕业后，许多人都选择留在国外生活和工作。可是也有一些人选择回国，他们被称为“海归”，“海龟”。在他们看来，国外的学位在国内很受欢迎，再加上会外语，不怕找不到好工作。但是由于国内的人才越来越多，“海归”们渐渐失去了以前的优势，所以有些回国以后找不到理想的工作，就成了“海待”，“海带”。
examples.translation: kāi shǐ de shí hòu dà bù fèn xué shēng dōu shì qù dú yán jiū shēng yīn wèi shì zì fèi de ér qiě dāng shí guó wài de dài yù hé tiáo jiàn dōu bǐ guó nèi hǎo de duō suǒ yǐ bì yè hòu xǔ duō rén dōu xuǎn zé liú zài guó wài shēng huó hé gōng zuò kě shì yě yǒu yì xiē rén xuǎn zé huí guó tā men bèi chēng wéi hǎi guī hǎi guī zài tā men kàn lái guó wài de xué wèi zài guó nèi hěn shòu huān yíng zài jiā shàng huì wài yǔ bú pà zhǎo bú dào hǎo gōng zuò dàn shì yóu yú guó nèi de rén cái yuè lái yuè duō hǎi guī men jiàn jiàn shī qù le yǐ qián de yōu shì suǒ yǐ yǒu xiē huí guó yǐ hòu zhǎo bú dào lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò jiù chéng le hǎi dài hǎi dài — At the beginning most students went to do graduate studies. Because it was at their own expense, and because the benefits and conditions abroad were then much better than at home, after graduating many people chose to stay abroad to live and work. But some people chose to return home, and they were called 海归 (returnees), or 海龟 (sea turtles, a pun on the same sound). In their view, foreign degrees were very welcome at home, and adding that they knew foreign languages, they were not afraid of failing to find a good job. But because the talent at home kept growing, the 海归 gradually lost their former advantage, so some, after returning, could not find an ideal job and became 海待 (waiting), or 海带 (kelp, again a pun). (the book prints the second name of each pair in brackets)

examples.text: 尽管这样，中国的出国热还是没有降温。现在除了到国外读研究生以外，去读大学、中学、甚至小学的也越来越多，而且更多的人是为了体验生活，丰富自己的经历。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn zhè yàng zhōng guó de chū guó rè hái shì méi yǒu jiàng wēn xiàn zài chú le dào guó wài dú yán jiū shēng yǐ wài qù dú dà xué zhōng xué shèn zhì xiǎo xué de yě yuè lái yuè duō ér qiě gèng duō de rén shì wèi le tǐ yàn shēng huó fēng fù zì jǐ de jīng lì — Even so, China’s craze for going abroad has still not cooled. Now, besides going abroad to do graduate studies, more and more people go to university, middle school and even primary school, and more people do it to experience life and enrich their own experience.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking, Listening, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, brainstorm words, expressions and phrases containing each of the three characters 热, 生 and 费. Post your work on a class website. B. After you post your lists, guess the meanings of additional words your teacher supplies. C. Choose from the word bank below to fill in the blanks in the sentences. Use each word only once; there is one more word than you will need. Word bank: 理想, 学位, 公费, 研究生, 条件, 优势, 人才, 毕业. D. Compare answers with a partner, then translate the sentences. My lists and my key:

tables.title: Activity 1A: words with 热, 生 and 费 (the class fills these in on a website; my lists)

examples.text: 一般来说，工资高的公司，工作的条件也不错。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō gōng zī gāo de gōng sī gōng zuò de tiáo jiàn yě bú cuò — 1. Generally speaking, at companies with high pay the working conditions are also good. (my key: 条件)

examples.text: 每个公司都希望找到最好的人才，所以很多工作都需要经过面试。
examples.translation: měi gè gōng sī dōu xī wàng zhǎo dào zuì hǎo de rén cái suǒ yǐ hěn duō gōng zuò dōu xū yào jīng guò miàn shì — 2. Every company hopes to find the best talent, so many jobs require an interview. (my key: 人才)

examples.text: 在工作申请表上，告诉公司你的优势可以帮你加分。
examples.translation: zài gōng zuò shēn qǐng biǎo shàng gào sù gōng sī nǐ de yōu shì kě yǐ bāng nǐ jiā fēn — 3. On a job application form, telling the company your strengths can earn you points. (my key: 优势)

examples.text: 理想的工作和你真正找到的工作有时候会不一样。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò hé nǐ zhēn zhèng zhǎo dào de gōng zuò yǒu shí hòu huì bù yí yàng — 4. The ideal job and the job you actually find are sometimes different. (my key: 理想)

examples.text: 在中国找到一个好工作需要一个好的学位。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó zhǎo dào yí gè hǎo gōng zuò xū yào yí gè hǎo de xué wèi — 5. To find a good job in China you need a good degree. (my key: 学位)

examples.text: 有研究生的学位对找工作有好处。
examples.translation: yǒu yán jiū shēng de xué wèi duì zhǎo gōng zuò yǒu hǎo chù — 6. Having a graduate degree is a benefit in looking for a job. (my key: 研究生)

examples.text: 公费念书，国家除了会帮你付学费以外，有时候连生活费国家也包了。
examples.translation: gōng fèi niàn shū guó jiā chú le huì bāng nǐ fù xué fèi yǐ wài yǒu shí hòu lián shēng huó fèi guó jiā yě bāo le — 7. Studying at public expense, besides paying your tuition the state sometimes even covers your living expenses. (my key: 公费; the unused word is 毕业)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: listen to Presentation 2 once through and write a summary of it. B. Detailed Listening: listen again and fill in the timeline with the relevant EEIs (九十年代以前, 经济发展时期, 最近几年). C. Perform the presentation with a partner, then answer individually: 1. Who are the 海龟? Why were 海龟 so welcome at first? 2. Who are the 海带? Why did 海龟 become 海带? D. Using your summary, timeline and answers, describe the historical changes to overseas Chinese students to your partner in Chinese. (Audio; my summary, timeline and answers follow.)

自费出国留学的越来越多

examples.text: 中国学生出国留学从公费到自费，越来越多；有些人回国成了海归，也有些成了海待；出国热还没有降温。
examples.translation: zhōng guó xué shēng chū guó liú xué cóng gōng fèi dào zì fèi yuè lái yuè duō yǒu xiē rén huí guó chéng le hǎi guī yě yǒu xiē chéng le hǎi dài chū guó rè hái méi yǒu jiàng wēn — Activity 2A (my summary): Chinese students going abroad went from public to private expense and kept growing in number; some returned and became 海归, some became 海待; the craze has not cooled.

examples.text: 海龟就是回国的留学生，也叫海归。他们一开始很受欢迎，因为国外的学位在国内很受欢迎，他们又会外语，不怕找不到好工作。
examples.translation: hǎi guī jiù shì huí guó de liú xué shēng yě jiào hǎi guī tā men yì kāi shǐ hěn shòu huān yíng yīn wèi guó wài de xué wèi zài guó nèi hěn shòu huān yíng tā men yòu huì wài yǔ bú pà zhǎo bú dào hǎo gōng zuò — 2C-1 (my answer): 海龟 are the students who returned home, also called 海归. At first they were very welcome, because foreign degrees were popular at home and they also knew foreign languages, so they were not afraid of failing to find a good job.

examples.text: 海带就是回国后找不到理想工作的留学生，也叫海待。因为国内的人才越来越多，海归渐渐失去了以前的优势。
examples.translation: hǎi dài jiù shì huí guó hòu zhǎo bú dào lǐ xiǎng gōng zuò de liú xué shēng yě jiào hǎi dài yīn wèi guó nèi de rén cái yuè lái yuè duō hǎi guī jiàn jiàn shī qù le yǐ qián de yōu shì — 2C-2 (my answer): 海带 are returned students who could not find an ideal job after coming home, also called 海待. Because the talent at home kept growing, the 海归 gradually lost their former advantage.

examples.text: 九十年代以前出国留学的机会不多，多半儿是公费，毕业后都要回国。后来经济发展了，自费留学的越来越多，大部分去读研究生，许多人留在国外。也有一些人回国，叫海归。最近几年，国内人才越来越多，海归失去优势，有些成了海待。现在去国外读大学、中学、甚至小学的也越来越多。
examples.translation: jiǔ shí nián dài yǐ qián chū guó liú xué de jī huì bù duō duō bànr shì gōng fèi bì yè hòu dōu yào huí guó hòu lái jīng jì fā zhǎn le zì fèi liú xué de yuè lái yuè duō dà bù fèn qù dú yán jiū shēng xǔ duō rén liú zài guó wài yě yǒu yì xiē rén huí guó jiào hǎi guī zuì jìn jǐ nián guó nèi rén cái yuè lái yuè duō hǎi guī shī qù yōu shì yǒu xiē chéng le hǎi dài xiàn zài qù guó wài dú dà xué zhōng xué shèn zhì xiǎo xué de yě yuè lái yuè duō — 2D (my description): Before the nineties there were few chances to study abroad, mostly at public expense, and everyone had to return after graduating. Later, with economic development, more and more studied at their own expense, mostly graduate studies, and many stayed abroad. Some returned and were called 海归. In recent years, with more and more talent at home, the 海归 lost their advantage and some became 海待. Now more and more go abroad for university, middle school and even primary school.

Translate the following sentences from the presentation. Pay attention to the omitted subject when translating. D. Scan the presentation and list the transitional time words. E. Pair up for 故事接龙: start a story with a sentence and then have your partner continue the story with their own sentence; switch back and forth until you have used at least four connectors. My answers:

rows: no matter…; the next clause has 都 or 还是
because of; gives the reason, often with 所以 later
although; the next clause has 可是 and 却 or 还是
besides, except; often with 以外 or 还

Activity 3D: the transitional time words in the presentation (my list)

examples.text: 最近几年，由于中国经济发展了，有越来越多父母选择让孩子出国留学。尽管不是所有的家庭都有好的经济条件，但是很多中国的父母不管多辛苦还是愿意把钱花在孩子的教育上。除了送孩子出国读研究生以外，不少家长让孩子去国外读高中、中学甚至小学。虽然孩子出国后不一定能马上适应当地的生活和学习，而且有外国的学位也不一定能找到理想的工作，但是对很多父母来说，出国念书不但可以让孩子多看看世界，还可以为孩子提供更多方面的发展。这些优势是在国内学习所没法比的。所以出国留学热一直没有降温。
examples.translation: zuì jìn jǐ nián yóu yú zhōng guó jīng jì fā zhǎn le yǒu yuè lái yuè duō fù mǔ xuǎn zé ràng hái zi chū guó liú xué jǐn guǎn bú shì suǒ yǒu de jiā tíng dōu yǒu hǎo de jīng jì tiáo jiàn dàn shì hěn duō zhōng guó de fù mǔ bù guǎn duō xīn kǔ hái shì yuàn yì bǎ qián huā zài hái zi de jiào yù shàng chú le sòng hái zi chū guó dú yán jiū shēng yǐ wài bù shǎo jiā zhǎng ràng hái zi qù guó wài dú gāo zhōng zhōng xué shèn zhì xiǎo xué suī rán hái zi chū guó hòu bù yí dìng néng mǎ shàng shì yìng dāng dì de shēng huó hé xué xí ér qiě yǒu wài guó de xué wèi yě bù yí dìng néng zhǎo dào lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò dàn shì duì hěn duō fù mǔ lái shuō chū guó niàn shū bú dàn kě yǐ ràng hái zi duō kàn kàn shì jiè hái kě yǐ wèi hái zi tí gōng gèng duō fāng miàn de fā zhǎn zhè xiē yōu shì shì zài guó nèi xué xí suǒ méi fǎ bǐ de suǒ yǐ chū guó liú xué rè yì zhí méi yǒu jiàng wēn — In recent years, because China’s economy has developed, more and more parents choose to let their children study abroad. Although not every family has good economic conditions, many Chinese parents, no matter how hard it is, are still willing to spend money on their children’s education. Besides sending children abroad for graduate studies, quite a few parents let their children go abroad for high school, middle school and even primary school. Although children abroad cannot necessarily adapt right away to local life and study, and moreover a foreign degree does not necessarily bring an ideal job, for many parents studying abroad can not only let the child see more of the world but also provide more all-round development. These advantages cannot be matched by studying at home. So the craze for studying abroad has never cooled. (my key: 由于, 尽管, 不管, 除了, 而且, 所以)

examples.text: 九十年代以前，出国留学的机会并不多，而且多半儿都是公费留学，毕业后都得回国服务。
examples.translation: jiǔ shí nián dài yǐ qián chū guó liú xué de jī huì bìng bù duō ér qiě duō bànr dōu shì gōng fèi liú xué bì yè hòu dōu děi huí guó fú wù — 1. Before the nineties there were not many chances to study abroad, and most of it was at public expense; (they) all had to return home to serve after graduating. (the omitted subject is “the students”)

examples.text: 因为是自费的，而且当时国外的待遇和条件都比国内好得多，所以毕业后，许多人都选择留在国外生活和工作。
examples.translation: yīn wèi shì zì fèi de ér qiě dāng shí guó wài de dài yù hé tiáo jiàn dōu bǐ guó nèi hǎo de duō suǒ yǐ bì yè hòu xǔ duō rén dōu xuǎn zé liú zài guó wài shēng huó hé gōng zuò — 2. Because (it) was at their own expense, and because the benefits and conditions abroad were then much better than at home, after graduating many people chose to stay abroad to live and work. (the omitted subject of “was at their own expense” is “the study”)

examples.text: 在他们看来，国外的学位在国内很受欢迎，再加上会外语，不怕找不到好工作。
examples.translation: zài tā men kàn lái guó wài de xué wèi zài guó nèi hěn shòu huān yíng zài jiā shàng huì wài yǔ bú pà zhǎo bú dào hǎo gōng zuò — 3. In their view, foreign degrees were very welcome at home, and (they) knew foreign languages besides, so (they) were not afraid of failing to find a good job. (the omitted subject is “they”)

examples.text: 小王想出国留学。
examples.translation: xiǎo wáng xiǎng chū guó liú xué — 3E story chain (my sample), line 1: Xiao Wang wants to study abroad.

examples.text: 可是由于他家的经济条件不太好，所以他得申请奖学金。
examples.translation: kě shì yóu yú tā jiā de jīng jì tiáo jiàn bú tài hǎo suǒ yǐ tā děi shēn qǐng jiǎng xué jīn — Line 2: But because his family’s economic conditions are not so good, he has to apply for a scholarship.

examples.text: 尽管申请很难，他还是每天努力准备。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn shēn qǐng hěn nán tā hái shì měi tiān nǔ lì zhǔn bèi — Line 3: Although applying is hard, he still prepares hard every day.

examples.text: 而且不管多忙，他都去图书馆学习。
examples.translation: ér qiě bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu qù tú shū guǎn xué xí — Line 4: Moreover, no matter how busy he is, he goes to the library to study.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to two Chinese students talk about their experiences abroad, then answer the questions. Dialog 1: 1. What happened to the student after graduation? 2. To what does he attribute his present state? 3. What does his friend think about it? 4. How does the student now feel about studying abroad, and why? Dialog 2: 1. What has the student decided to do after graduation? 2. What is his friend’s concern? 3. What is the student’s rationale for his decision? 4. What are his plans for the future? B. Using your answers as a guideline, report on Dialog 1 to a partner in Chinese, while they report on Dialog 2. (Audio; the scripts are not in the book.)

lessons.title: 675. Lesson 26 Presentation 2 grammar: the adverb 并 for emphasizing disagreement
lessons.subtitle: 并不 并没有 说得并不好 · 机会并不多 · 并不容易 · 并不喜欢 · 学得并不好

explanations.title: The Adverb 并
explanations.body: The adverb 并 is placed before 不 or 没 to emphasize disagreement, point out a flaw in an argument, or reveal the truth about a situation.

rows: S + V 得 + 并 + 不 + Adj.
并 goes before 不 after the 得 complement marker
tables.title: 并 patterns

examples.text: 他的中文说得不好。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén shuō de bù hǎo — Speaker’s observation or opinion: His Chinese is not good.

examples.text: 他的中文说得并不好。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén shuō de bìng bù hǎo — The speaker disagrees with those who think his Chinese is good: His Chinese is actually not good.

examples.text: 九十年代以前，出国留学的机会并不多。
examples.translation: jiǔ shí nián dài yǐ qián chū guó liú xué de jī huì bìng bù duō — 1. Before the nineties there were actually not many chances to study abroad.

examples.text: 年纪轻轻就出国留学并不容易，会有很多的困难。
examples.translation: nián jì qīng qīng jiù chū guó liú xué bìng bù róng yì huì yǒu hěn duō de kùn nán — 2. Going abroad to study at a young age is not easy at all and there will be many difficulties.

examples.text: 虽然我弹钢琴弹了十多年，但是我并不喜欢这种乐器。
examples.translation: suī rán wǒ tán gāng qín tán le shí duō nián dàn shì wǒ bìng bù xǐ huān zhè zhǒng yuè qì — 3. Although I have played the piano for more than ten years, I don’t actually like this instrument.

examples.text: 尽管我中文学了三年，但我的中文学得并不好。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn wǒ zhōng wén xué le sān nián dàn wǒ de zhōng wén xué de bìng bù hǎo — 4. Although I have studied Chinese for three years, my Chinese is not actually good.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Rewrite the following sentences using 并: 1. 你记错了，他是今年毕业的，不是去年毕业的。 2. 其实我去过法国，没有去过意大利。 3. 我们不是男女朋友，我们只是好朋友。 4. 谁说他跑得很慢，他跑得比我们快多了。 B. Read your sentences to a partner to compare work. My key:

examples.text: 你记错了，他并不是去年毕业的，是今年毕业的。
examples.translation: nǐ jì cuò le tā bìng bú shì qù nián bì yè de shì jīn nián bì yè de — 1. (my key) You remembered wrong; he did not graduate last year, he graduated this year.

examples.text: 其实我去过法国，并没有去过意大利。
examples.translation: qí shí wǒ qù guò fǎ guó bìng méi yǒu qù guò yì dà lì — 2. (my key) Actually I have been to France; I have not been to Italy.

examples.text: 我们并不是男女朋友，我们只是好朋友。
examples.translation: wǒ men bìng bú shì nán nǚ péng yǒu wǒ men zhǐ shì hǎo péng yǒu — 3. (my key) We are not boyfriend and girlfriend; we are just good friends.

examples.text: 谁说他跑得很慢，他跑得并不慢，比我们快多了。
examples.translation: shuí shuō tā pǎo de hěn màn tā pǎo de bìng bú màn bǐ wǒ men kuài duō le — 4. (my key) Who says he runs very slowly? He doesn’t run slowly at all; he is much faster than we are.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Role-play with a partner using 并. Switch roles and repeat. Scenario: During counseling, your teacher (partner) pinpoints some bad habits that led to your failing a test. Defend yourself and provide your side of the story. My sample dialog:

examples.text: 老师：你这次考试没考好，我觉得你没有认真复习。
examples.translation: lǎo shī nǐ zhè cì kǎo shì méi kǎo hǎo wǒ jué de nǐ méi yǒu rèn zhēn fù xí — Teacher (my sample role-play): You didn’t do well on this test; I think you didn’t review seriously.

examples.text: 学生：我并不是没有复习，我每天都复习两个小时。
examples.translation: xué shēng wǒ bìng bú shì méi yǒu fù xí wǒ měi tiān dōu fù xí liǎng gè xiǎo shí — Student: It isn’t that I didn’t review; I reviewed two hours every day.

examples.text: 老师：可是你常常上课迟到。
examples.translation: lǎo shī kě shì nǐ cháng cháng shàng kè chí dào — Teacher: But you are often late for class.

examples.text: 学生：我并没有常常迟到，我只迟到过一次。
examples.translation: xué shēng wǒ bìng méi yǒu cháng cháng chí dào wǒ zhǐ chí dào guò yí cì — Student: I am not often late; I have only been late once.

examples.text: 老师：你晚上打游戏打得太晚了吧？
examples.translation: lǎo shī nǐ wǎn shàng dǎ yóu xì dǎ de tài wǎn le ba — Teacher: Don’t you stay up too late playing games at night?

examples.text: 学生：我并不是天天打游戏，只是周末玩一会儿。
examples.translation: xué shēng wǒ bìng bú shì tiān tiān dǎ yóu xì zhǐ shì zhōu mò wán yí huìr — Student: I don’t play games every day, only a little at the weekend.

examples.text: 老师：那你觉得为什么没考好？
examples.translation: lǎo shī nà nǐ jué de wèi shén me méi kǎo hǎo — Teacher: Then why do you think you didn’t do well?

examples.text: 学生：因为这次的考试并不简单，很多同学都没考好。
examples.translation: xué shēng yīn wèi zhè cì de kǎo shì bìng bù jiǎn dān hěn duō tóng xué dōu méi kǎo hǎo — Student: Because this test was not easy; many classmates didn’t do well.

options: At the end of the sentence
exercises.explanation: 并 goes before 不 or 没.

options: Disagreement, a flaw in an argument, or the truth

It means his Chinese is good

exercises.prompt: Which is correct for “Actually I don’t like this instrument”?
Which is correct for “my Chinese is not actually good”?

In the role-play, what does 我并不是没有复习 mean?
options: It isn’t that I didn’t review

lessons.title: 676. Lesson 26 Presentation 2 grammar: the adverbs 多半(儿) and 大多
lessons.subtitle: 多半儿 大多 · 大部分 大多数 多数 · 多半是日本人 · 大多喜欢参加旅行团 · 看图表说话

explanations.title: The Adverbs 多半(儿) and 大多
explanations.body: Preceding the verb, the adverbs 多半(儿) and 大多 mean “mostly,” “most often,” “most of the time,” “most likely,” etc. Pattern: S + 多半(儿) / 大多 + V + O. 大部分, 大多数 and 多数 mean “most,” “for the most part,” “majority of,” etc. They differ from 多半(儿) and 大多 in that they are nouns and never mean “most often” or “most likely.”

rows: mostly, largely; frequently, often; most likely, probably
follows the subject and precedes the verb
大部分, 大多数, 多数
subject or object; may add another noun
tables.title: 多半, 大多 and 大部分, 大多数, 多数

examples.text: 到夏威夷游览的游客多半是日本人。
examples.translation: dào xià wēi yí yóu lǎn de yóu kè duō bàn shì rì běn rén — 1. (mostly) The tourists who visit Hawaii are mostly Japanese.

examples.text: 周末的时候我们全家人多半去爬山。
examples.translation: zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ men quán jiā rén duō bàn qù pá shān — 2. (most of the time) At weekends our whole family mostly goes hiking.

examples.text: 这件事多半是他做的。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn shì duō bàn shì tā zuò de — 3. (most likely) This was most likely done by him.

examples.text: 老年人出国旅游大多喜欢参加旅行团。
examples.translation: lǎo nián rén chū guó lǚ yóu dà duō xǐ huān cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán — 1. Old people traveling abroad mostly like to join tour groups.

examples.text: 大多数的中国人，特别是女人都不喜欢喝冰水。
examples.translation: dà duō shù de zhōng guó rén tè bié shì nǚ rén dōu bù xǐ huān hē bīng shuǐ — 2. Most Chinese people, especially women, don’t like to drink iced water.

examples.text: 中国的人口大部分都在东部。很少人住在西部。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de rén kǒu dà bù fèn dōu zài dōng bù hěn shǎo rén zhù zài xī bù — 3. Most of China’s population is in the east. Very few people live in the west.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Choose two groups of people from the options (国防语言学院的学生, 我们班的同学, 中文系的老师, 中国人/美国人, 陆军/海军/空军的军人), discuss them in Chinese, then list at least three of their common characteristics using 多半, 大多, 多数, 大多数 or 大部分. B. Post your list on a class website to share with the class. C. As a class, select the best list of characteristics. My model sentences:

examples.text: 中文系的老师大多数说话很清楚，多半喜欢和学生聊天，大部分老师每天都准备很多练习。
examples.translation: zhōng wén xì de lǎo shī dà duō shù shuō huà hěn qīng chǔ duō bàn xǐ huān hé xué shēng liáo tiān dà bù fèn lǎo shī měi tiān dōu zhǔn bèi hěn duō liàn xí — Activity 3A (my model sentences for the pattern, about the group 中文系的老师): Most Chinese-department teachers speak very clearly, mostly like chatting with students, and most teachers prepare many exercises every day.

examples.text: 中国人大多喜欢喝热水，多半不喜欢喝冰水，大部分人过春节都回家和家人团聚。
examples.translation: zhōng guó rén dà duō xǐ huān hē rè shuǐ duō bàn bù xǐ huān hē bīng shuǐ dà bù fèn rén guò chūn jié dōu huí jiā hé jiā rén tuán jù — (my model sentences, about the group 中国人): Chinese people mostly like to drink hot water, mostly don’t like iced water, and most go home to be with their family for the Spring Festival.

explanations.title: Activity 4: 看图表说话 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. For each of the four charts, write a sentence generalizing its information using 多半, 大多, 多数, 大多数 or 大部分. B. Read your sentences to a partner to compare work. The charts are graphics, so only their titles and categories are given here; the sentences are models of the pattern, not readings of the book’s data.

rows: 中国留学生毕业后回国原因: 无法融入外国文化, 没有得到签证, 更喜欢国内的环境, 家庭和爱情, 国内工作机会更多 (bar chart, scale 0 to 70)
中国学生留学目的地 (pie chart; the slices are not in the text)
中国游客2018年旅游目的地: 香港, 澳门, 泰国, 日本, 越南, 韩国, 美国, 台湾, 其他地区
2018年中国出境游客安排旅游路线的渠道: 网络, 旅行团, 亲友介绍, 其他 (bar chart, scale up to 160)
tables.title: Activity 4A: the four charts (the bars and slices are graphics and are not in the text)

examples.text: 中国留学生毕业后回国，多半是因为国内工作机会更多。
examples.translation: zhōng guó liú xué shēng bì yè hòu huí guó duō bàn shì yīn wèi guó nèi gōng zuò jī huì gèng duō — Chart 1 (my model sentence for the pattern; the book’s bars are not in the text): Chinese students returning after graduation do so mostly because there are more job opportunities at home.

examples.text: 中国学生留学，大多选择去英语国家。
examples.translation: zhōng guó xué shēng liú xué dà duō xuǎn zé qù yīng yǔ guó jiā — Chart 2 (my model sentence): Chinese students studying abroad mostly choose English-speaking countries.

examples.text: 大部分中国游客去亚洲的地方旅游。
examples.translation: dà bù fèn zhōng guó yóu kè qù yà zhōu de dì fāng lǚ yóu — Chart 3 (my model sentence): Most Chinese tourists travel to places in Asia.

examples.text: 大多数中国出境游客通过网络安排旅游路线。
examples.translation: dà duō shù zhōng guó chū jìng yóu kè tōng guò wǎng luò ān pái lǚ yóu lù xiàn — Chart 4 (my model sentence): Most Chinese tourists going abroad arrange their route through the Internet.

lessons.title: 677. Lesson 26 Presentation 2 grammar: 被 Verb 为 for “to be addressed as”
lessons.subtitle: 被称为 被叫做 被选为 被译为 被当成 被换成 被改成 被翻译成

explanations.title: 被 Verb 为
explanations.body: The formal equivalent of the colloquial 被…叫做 and 被…称为 means “to be addressed as.”

rows: Recipient of Action 被 (Agent) Verb 为
formal equivalent of 被…叫做 and 被…称为, “to be addressed as”
= Agent 把 Recipient + Verb 为
tables.title: 被 Verb 为

rows: 被选为, 被译为, 被当成, 被换成
tables.title: The three patterns

examples.text: 有一些人选择回国，他们被称为“海龟”。
examples.translation: yǒu yì xiē rén xuǎn zé huí guó tā men bèi chēng wéi hǎi guī — 1. Some people chose to return home, and they were called “sea turtles.”

examples.text: 人们把他们称为海龟。
examples.translation: rén men bǎ tā men chēng wéi hǎi guī — = People call them sea turtles.

examples.text: 乔治华盛顿被美国人称为国父。
examples.translation: qiáo zhì huá shèng dùn bèi měi guó rén chēng wéi guó fù — 2. George Washington is called the father of the country by Americans.

lessons.title: 678. Lesson 26 Presentation 2 grammar: 尽管 vs. 不管
lessons.subtitle: 尽管…可是 · 不管…都 · 让步复句 · 条件复句 · 不管多难我都要学会 · 尽管上网点餐又方便又便宜

explanations.title: 尽管 vs. 不管
explanations.body: Like 虽然, the conjunction 尽管 means “although” or “even though,” but is stronger in meaning than the more colloquial 虽然. It comes at the beginning of the sentence and is followed by 可(是) and 却 or 还(是) in the subsequent clause to further emphasize the focus on the latter clause. 不管 means “no matter (who/what/where/when/why/how),” “regardless of,” “despite,” etc. It comes at the beginning of the sentence and is followed by 都 or 还是 in the subsequent clause to stress that the action or decision in the initial clause will not change.

rows: 尽管 + S + V + O, 可(是) S + (却 or 还[是]) + Focus of the Sentence
尽管 means “although” or “even though”; stronger than the colloquial 虽然; at the beginning of the sentence; 可(是) and 却 or 还(是) in the next clause stress the focus on the latter clause
