examples.text: 尽管中文很难学，可我却对中文最感兴趣。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn zhōng wén hěn nán xué kě wǒ què duì zhōng wén zuì gǎn xìng qù — 1. Although Chinese is hard to learn, I am most interested in Chinese.

examples.text: 尽管购物是中国人出国旅游的重要活动，可中国人买的东西却越来越多样。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn gòu wù shì zhōng guó rén chū guó lǚ yóu de zhòng yào huó dòng kě zhōng guó rén mǎi de dōng xī què yuè lái yuè duō yàng — 2. Although shopping is an important activity of Chinese people traveling abroad, the things Chinese people buy are more and more varied.

examples.text: 尽管上网点餐外送又方便又便宜，可是我还是喜欢在家自己做饭。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn shàng wǎng diǎn cān wài sòng yòu fāng biàn yòu pián yi kě shì wǒ hái shì xǐ huān zài jiā zì jǐ zuò fàn — 3. Although ordering meals online for delivery is both convenient and cheap, I still like to cook at home myself.

examples.text: 尽管住民宿让你有家的感觉，可我还是喜欢旅馆的干净和舒适。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn zhù mín sù ràng nǐ yǒu jiā de gǎn jué kě wǒ hái shì xǐ huān lǚ guǎn de gān jìng hé shū shì — 4. Although staying in a homestay gives you the feeling of home, I still like the cleanliness and comfort of a hotel.

examples.text: 不管花多少钱，她的父母都要送她出国留学。
examples.translation: bù guǎn huā duō shǎo qián tā de fù mǔ dōu yào sòng tā chū guó liú xué — 1. No matter how much money it costs, her parents will send her abroad to study.

examples.text: 不管在国内读研究生还是去国外读，学生都得努力学习才能毕业。
examples.translation: bù guǎn zài guó nèi dú yán jiū shēng hái shì qù guó wài dú xué shēng dōu děi nǔ lì xué xí cái néng bì yè — 2. Whether doing graduate studies at home or abroad, students have to study hard to graduate.

examples.text: 不管待遇、条件好不好，他还是决定回国工作。
examples.translation: bù guǎn dài yù tiáo jiàn hǎo bù hǎo tā hái shì jué dìng huí guó gōng zuò — 3. Whether the benefits and conditions are good or not, he still decided to return home to work.

examples.text: 不管中文有多难，我都要学会。
examples.translation: bù guǎn zhōng wén yǒu duō nán wǒ dōu yào xué huì — 4. No matter how hard Chinese is, I am going to learn it.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Complete the following sentences with 不管 or 尽管 (six blanks). B. Read your completed sentences to a partner, then translate them together. My key:

examples.text: 不管离家多远，中国人都会在春节的时候回家和家人团聚。
examples.translation: bù guǎn lí jiā duō yuǎn zhōng guó rén dōu huì zài chūn jié de shí hòu huí jiā hé jiā rén tuán jù — 1. (my key: 不管) No matter how far from home, Chinese people will go home at the Spring Festival to reunite with their families.

examples.text: 尽管生活在国外多年，很多华人还是会庆祝许多传统的中国节日。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn shēng huó zài guó wài duō nián hěn duō huá rén hái shì huì qìng zhù xǔ duō chuán tǒng de zhōng guó jié rì — 2. (my key: 尽管) Although they have lived abroad for many years, many overseas Chinese still celebrate many traditional Chinese festivals.

examples.text: 尽管他家的经济条件不错，但是他还是半工半读赚他的学费。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tā jiā de jīng jì tiáo jiàn bú cuò dàn shì tā hái shì bàn gōng bàn dú zhuàn tā de xué fèi — 3. (my key: 尽管) Although his family’s economic conditions are good, he still works half-time and studies half-time to earn his tuition.

examples.text: 不管是参加旅行团还是自驾游，到各地看看都能了解世界，体验不同的生活和文化。
examples.translation: bù guǎn shì cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán hái shì zì jià yóu dào gè dì kàn kàn dōu néng liǎo jiě shì jiè tǐ yàn bù tóng de shēng huó hé wén huà — 4. (my key: 不管) Whether joining a tour group or driving yourself, going to see different places lets you understand the world and experience different lives and cultures. (the book prints stray spaces; removed)

examples.text: 尽管他有名校的学位，可因他少了工作经验，还是没找到工作。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tā yǒu míng xiào de xué wèi kě yīn tā shǎo le gōng zuò jīng yàn hái shì méi zhǎo dào gōng zuò — 5. (my key: 尽管) Although he has a degree from a famous school, because he lacks work experience he still hasn’t found a job. (the book prints 可因他; kept as printed)

examples.text: 不管有没有醉酒，只要喝了酒就不应该开车。
examples.translation: bù guǎn yǒu méi yǒu zuì jiǔ zhǐ yào hē le jiǔ jiù bù yīng gāi kāi chē — 6. (my key: 不管) Whether drunk or not, as long as you have drunk alcohol you should not drive.

lessons.subtitle: 申请研究生 · 四个步骤 · 奖学金 · 以前的留学生 现在的留学生 · 海归回国的原因 · 海归的工资待遇 · 为什么成了海带

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage, then create a mind map of the application process for a master’s degree program abroad (第一步, 第二步, 第三步, 第四步). B. Compare maps with a partner in Chinese. C. Create a similar mind map for class preparation and study at DLI (the Defense Language Institute). D. Based on your map, instruct your partner on how to prepare and study at DLI. Your partner will listen, write down the key steps, then read them back to you. The passage and my maps:

examples.text: 去美国念研究生不太难，但是你得做一些准备。首先，你得先决定你要去哪里念。一般来说公立学校比较便宜。私立学校比较贵。如果你选的学校在大城市，住宿费和生活费也会比较高。你可以多找几所学校，因为不是所有的学校申请了，都会被选上。第二步，找到了几家学校后，你可以上网查一下学校的信息，还有他们申请的要求。他们会告诉你需要准备哪些考试，要不要面试什么的。第三步就是准备好他们要的东西以后，你可以上网填他们的申请表，除了你的个人信息以外，你还得回答一些问题，让他们知道你为什么想申请这个学校，还有你的优势是什么。最后等几个月，他们就会寄信通知你是不是可以上他们的学校。
examples.translation: qù měi guó niàn yán jiū shēng bú tài nán dàn shì nǐ děi zuò yì xiē zhǔn bèi shǒu xiān nǐ děi xiān jué dìng nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ niàn yì bān lái shuō gōng lì xué xiào bǐ jiào pián yi sī lì xué xiào bǐ jiào guì rú guǒ nǐ xuǎn de xué xiào zài dà chéng shì zhù sù fèi hé shēng huó fèi yě huì bǐ jiào gāo nǐ kě yǐ duō zhǎo jǐ suǒ xué xiào yīn wèi bú shì suǒ yǒu de xué xiào shēn qǐng le dōu huì bèi xuǎn shàng dì èr bù zhǎo dào le jǐ jiā xué xiào hòu nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng chá yí xià xué xiào de xìn xī hái yǒu tā men shēn qǐng de yāo qiú tā men huì gào sù nǐ xū yào zhǔn bèi nǎ xiē kǎo shì yào bú yào miàn shì shén me de dì sān bù jiù shì zhǔn bèi hǎo tā men yào de dōng xī yǐ hòu nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng tián tā men de shēn qǐng biǎo chú le nǐ de gè rén xìn xī yǐ wài nǐ hái děi huí dá yì xiē wèn tí ràng tā men zhī dào nǐ wèi shén me xiǎng shēn qǐng zhè ge xué xiào hái yǒu nǐ de yōu shì shì shén me zuì hòu děng jǐ gè yuè tā men jiù huì jì xìn tōng zhī nǐ shì bú shì kě yǐ shàng tā men de xué xiào — Going to America for graduate school is not too hard, but you have to make some preparations. First, you have to decide where you want to study. Generally speaking, public schools are cheaper. Private schools are more expensive. If the school you choose is in a big city, lodging and living expenses will also be higher. You can look for several schools, because not every school you apply to will accept you. The second step, after finding a few schools, you can go online and look up the schools’ information and their application requirements. They will tell you which exams you need to prepare for and whether there is an interview and so on. The third step, after preparing what they want, you can fill in their application form online; besides your personal information you also have to answer some questions to let them know why you want to apply to this school and what your strengths are. Finally, wait a few months and they will send a letter to inform you whether you can attend their school.

examples.text: 以前的海归和最近几年的有什么不同？
examples.translation: yǐ qián de hǎi guī hé zuì jìn jǐ nián de yǒu shén me bù tóng — Group 1, Q1: What is the difference between the 海归 of the past and those of recent years?

examples.text: 海归们的工资待遇比国内的求职者有优势。海归的平均工资比国内聘用的高二千五百元左右，但是大多数海归对理想的工资还是比公司愿意提供的高得多，所以会有一些海龟回国后好几个月都还没找到工作。
examples.translation: hǎi guī men de gōng zī dài yù bǐ guó nèi de qiú zhí zhě yǒu yōu shì hǎi guī de píng jūn gōng zī bǐ guó nèi pìn yòng de gāo èr qiān wǔ bǎi yuán zuǒ yòu dàn shì dà duō shù hǎi guī duì lǐ xiǎng de gōng zī hái shì bǐ gōng sī yuàn yì tí gōng de gāo de duō suǒ yǐ huì yǒu yì xiē hǎi guī huí guó hòu hǎo jǐ gè yuè dōu hái méi zhǎo dào gōng zuò — Q3's answer B: The 海归’s pay and benefits have an advantage over domestic job seekers. The average salary of 海归 is about 2,500 yuan higher than that of those hired at home, but most 海归’s idea of an ideal salary is still much higher than what companies are willing to offer, so some 海龟 have not found a job for several months after returning.

examples.text: 你觉得海归回国的原因是什么？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de hǎi guī huí guó de yuán yīn shì shén me — Group 1, Q2: What do you think the reasons for the 海归 returning are?

examples.text: 我想主要是中国经济快速的发展，国内的工作机会多、而且工资和待遇条件也提高不少。另外，如果没有工作签证，要留在国外工作很困难。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng zhǔ yào shì zhōng guó jīng jì kuài sù de fā zhǎn guó nèi de gōng zuò jī huì duō ér qiě gōng zī hé dài yù tiáo jiàn yě tí gāo bù shǎo lìng wài rú guǒ méi yǒu gōng zuò qiān zhèng yào liú zài guó wài gōng zuò hěn kùn nán — Q2's answer A: I think mainly China’s rapid economic development: there are many job opportunities at home, and pay, benefits and conditions have also improved a lot. In addition, without a work visa it is very hard to stay abroad to work.

examples.text: 海归们的工资待遇怎么样？
examples.translation: hǎi guī men de gōng zī dài yù zěn me yàng — Group 1, Q3: How are the 海归’s pay and benefits?

examples.text: 最大的不同是以前回国的海归不多，很多都选择留在留学地工作和生活。现在回国的海归是出国的留学生人数的百分之八十。我想这是最大的不同。
examples.translation: zuì dà de bù tóng shì yǐ qián huí guó de hǎi guī bù duō hěn duō dōu xuǎn zé liú zài liú xué dì gōng zuò hé shēng huó xiàn zài huí guó de hǎi guī shì chū guó de liú xué shēng rén shù de bǎi fēn zhī bā shí wǒ xiǎng zhè shì zuì dà de bù tóng — Q1's answer C: The biggest difference is that in the past not many 海归 returned and many chose to stay and work and live where they studied. Now the returnees are eighty percent of the number of students who went abroad. I think this is the biggest difference.

examples.text: 海归回国后常去哪里找工作？
examples.translation: hǎi guī huí guó hòu cháng qù nǎ lǐ zhǎo gōng zuò — Group 2, Q1: Where do 海归 often go to look for work after returning?

examples.text: 海归们回国后，多半会先选择在经济发展快，国际化的大都市找工作。其中北京、上海、成都是他们选择的前三名。另外，他们找的工作也集中在几个行业，比方说，通信、科技、电子和互联网等是几个比较热门的海归工作。当然除了一些大城市，也有越来越多的海归选择回家乡发展。
examples.translation: hǎi guī men huí guó hòu duō bàn huì xiān xuǎn zé zài jīng jì fā zhǎn kuài guó jì huà de dà dū shì zhǎo gōng zuò qí zhōng běi jīng shàng hǎi chéng dū shì tā men xuǎn zé de qián sān míng lìng wài tā men zhǎo de gōng zuò yě jí zhōng zài jǐ gè háng yè bǐ fāng shuō tōng xìn kē jì diàn zi hé hù lián wǎng děng shì jǐ gè bǐ jiào rè mén de hǎi guī gōng zuò dāng rán chú le yì xiē dà chéng shì yě yǒu yuè lái yuè duō de hǎi guī xuǎn zé huí jiā xiāng fā zhǎn — Q1's answer B: After returning, 海归 mostly first choose to look for work in big cities with fast economic development that are international. Among them Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu are their top three choices. In addition, the jobs they look for are concentrated in a few industries; for example, communications, technology, electronics and the Internet are some rather popular jobs for 海归. Of course, besides some big cities, more and more 海归 choose to return to their hometowns to develop.

examples.text: 从哪里回来的海归比较受欢迎？
examples.translation: cóng nǎ lǐ huí lái de hǎi guī bǐ jiào shòu huān yíng — Group 2, Q2: Where do the returned students who are more welcome come from?

examples.text: 从地区来看，欧美国家的留学生普遍更受老板的欢迎。从法国、美国、德国毕业的海归平均竞争力最高，英国海归排名第五。
examples.translation: cóng dì qū lái kàn ōu měi guó jiā de liú xué shēng pǔ biàn gèng shòu lǎo bǎn de huān yíng cóng fǎ guó měi guó dé guó bì yè de hǎi guī píng jūn jìng zhēng lì zuì gāo yīng guó hǎi guī pái míng dì wǔ — Q2's answer A: By region, students from Europe and America are generally more welcomed by bosses. 海归 who graduated from France, America and Germany have the highest average competitiveness, and the British 海归 rank fifth.

examples.text: 为什么有些海归成了海带？
examples.translation: wèi shén me yǒu xiē hǎi guī chéng le hǎi dài — Group 2, Q3: Why did some 海归 become 海带?

examples.text: 主要是因为海归们在国外学习多年，对国内的市场信息了解得不够，而且也不知道国内公司的需要。第二，很多海归们觉得自己有国外留学的优势，所以常希望找到职位较高或是工资较高的工作，但是不一定能顺利找到。第三，有些海归自我感觉良好，不仅常对公司或老板提出要求，而且对公司不满意的时候，容易换工作。
examples.translation: zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi hǎi guī men zài guó wài xué xí duō nián duì guó nèi de shì chǎng xìn xī liǎo jiě de bú gòu ér qiě yě bù zhī dào guó nèi gōng sī de xū yào dì èr hěn duō hǎi guī men jué de zì jǐ yǒu guó wài liú xué de yōu shì suǒ yǐ cháng xī wàng zhǎo dào zhí wèi jiào gāo huò shì gōng zī jiào gāo de gōng zuò dàn shì bù yí dìng néng shùn lì zhǎo dào dì sān yǒu xiē hǎi guī zì wǒ gǎn jué liáng hǎo bù jǐn cháng duì gōng sī huò lǎo bǎn tí chū yāo qiú ér qiě duì gōng sī bù mǎn yì de shí hòu róng yì huàn gōng zuò — Q3's answer C: Mainly because the 海归 studied abroad for many years, don’t know enough about domestic market information, and also don’t know the needs of domestic companies. Second, many 海归 feel they have the advantage of foreign study, so they often hope to find jobs with higher positions or higher pay, but cannot necessarily find them smoothly. Third, some 海归 have a good opinion of themselves, not only often making demands on companies or bosses but also changing jobs easily when they are not satisfied with the company. (source note: adapted from a news website)

examples.text: 海归回国多半是因为国内经济发展快，工作机会多，而且没有工作签证很难留在国外。他们回国后多半先去北京、上海、成都这样的大城市找工作，常在通信、科技、电子和互联网行业。有些海归成了海带，因为不了解国内市场，要求太高，或者自我感觉太好。
examples.translation: hǎi guī huí guó duō bàn shì yīn wèi guó nèi jīng jì fā zhǎn kuài gōng zuò jī huì duō ér qiě méi yǒu gōng zuò qiān zhèng hěn nán liú zài guó wài tā men huí guó hòu duō bàn xiān qù běi jīng shàng hǎi chéng dū zhè yàng de dà chéng shì zhǎo gōng zuò cháng zài tōng xìn kē jì diàn zi hé hù lián wǎng háng yè yǒu xiē hǎi guī chéng le hǎi dài yīn wèi bù liǎo jiě guó nèi shì chǎng yāo qiú tài gāo huò zhě zì wǒ gǎn jué tài hǎo — Activity 4B (my oral-report summary): 海归 return mostly because the economy at home is developing fast, there are many job opportunities, and without a work visa it is hard to stay abroad. After returning they mostly first go to big cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu to find work, often in communications, technology, electronics and the Internet. Some become 海带 because they don’t know the domestic market, ask too much or think too well of themselves.

exercises.prompt: According to the passage, which schools are generally cheaper?
What is higher if the school is in a big city?
exercises.explanation: 住宿费和生活费也会比较高.

exercises.prompt: What is the third step in applying?
options: Fill in the application form online
exercises.explanation: 第三步…填他们的申请表.

exercises.prompt: What does the application form ask besides personal information?

exercises.explanation: 为什么想申请这个学校，还有你的优势是什么.

exercises.prompt: Why do 海归 return, according to the answer to question 2?
options: China’s economy is developing fast and there are more job opportunities
exercises.explanation: 中国经济快速的发展，国内的工作机会多.

exercises.prompt: What makes staying abroad hard, according to that answer?
exercises.explanation: 没有工作签证，要留在国外工作很困难.

exercises.prompt: Which three cities are the top choices for returning 海归?
Which students are generally most welcomed by bosses?
exercises.explanation: 欧美国家的留学生普遍更受老板的欢迎.

exercises.prompt: Which is NOT one of the reasons some 海归 became 海带?
options: They feel too good about themselves
They don’t know the domestic market enough
They hope for jobs that are too high

lessons.title: 680. Lesson 26 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: jokes, advice from four students and three study-abroad options
lessons.subtitle: 海龟变海带 · 留学热 回国潮 · 收拾行李 · 新朋友 · 同学会 · 清楚的计划 · 初中 高中 大学毕业后留学

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the exchanges and explain the social phenomena they refer to. B. Discuss your explanations with a partner in Chinese. The exchanges and my explanations:

examples.text: “你是怎么从海龟变成海带的？”留学生笑着说：我们只是留学热和回国潮都赶上了。
examples.translation: nǐ shì zěn me cóng hǎi guī biàn chéng hǎi dài de liú xué shēng xiào zhe shuō wǒ men zhǐ shì liú xué rè hé huí guó cháo dōu gǎn shàng le — Exchange 1: “How did you turn from a sea turtle into kelp?” The student said with a smile: We just caught both the study-abroad craze and the wave of returning home. (my explanation: the joke is about students who studied abroad at the peak of the craze and then returned at the peak of the return wave, when jobs were scarce; source note: selected from a website)

examples.text: 以前面试官知道你是海归：真厉害！现在面试官知道你是海归：真有钱！
examples.translation: yǐ qián miàn shì guān zhī dào nǐ shì hǎi guī zhēn lì hài xiàn zài miàn shì guān zhī dào nǐ shì hǎi guī zhēn yǒu qián — Exchange 2: In the past when the interviewer knew you were a 海归: Wow, impressive! Now when the interviewer knows you are a 海归: Wow, rich! (my explanation: a foreign degree used to show ability, but now it suggests mainly that the family could afford it)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Speaking, Listening, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, generate a list of questions in Chinese that Chinese students might have when studying abroad (five blanks). B. Read the post about four overseas Chinese students, then fill in the table with the advice derived from their experiences. C. Take turns with a partner summarizing or paraphrasing each student’s experience and advice in Chinese. D. Form groups of three. You play a U.S. university recruiter in China while your partners play two Chinese students. Conduct a Q&A session to provide them with practical information on attending your school. Switch roles and repeat. My questions, the post and my table:

rows: 出国前先查一下留学目的地入境时的要求，不要带肉类等不能入境的东西
到新的环境多交新朋友，丰富留学生活，体验不同国家的文化
出国前在网路上找同校的中国留学生，或和中国同学会联系，提前交流留学信息
对以后有清楚的计划，想好要走的每一步
tables.title: Activity 2B: the advice table (the book’s is blank)

examples.text: 在国外学习和生活，我该怎么适应当地的饮食？
examples.translation: zài guó wài xué xí hé shēng huó wǒ gāi zěn me shì yìng dāng dì de yǐn shí — Activity 2A (my sample questions): Studying and living abroad, how should I adapt to the local food?

examples.text: 我怎么才能交到当地的朋友？
examples.translation: wǒ zěn me cái néng jiāo dào dāng dì de péng yǒu — How can I make local friends?

examples.text: 如果听不懂老师说的话，我应该怎么办？
examples.translation: rú guǒ tīng bù dǒng lǎo shī shuō de huà wǒ yīng gāi zěn me bàn — If I can’t understand what the teacher says, what should I do?

examples.text: 我想家的时候，怎么办？
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng jiā de shí hòu zěn me bàn — When I miss home, what should I do?

examples.text: 留学期间我可以打工吗？
examples.translation: liú xué qī jiān wǒ kě yǐ dǎ gōng ma — Can I work part-time during my studies?

examples.text: 出国前收拾行李是每个留学生都会遇到的问题。有些人担心到新的环境会不适应，所以带些自己常用的东西，像是小丽第一次去美国留学，她担心当地的饮食和口味会不习惯，就在行李中带了不少中国食品，打算到了美国自己做饭，结果下飞机过海关的时候，才发现很多东西特别是肉类都不能带进美国。所以出国前最好先查一下留学的目的地入境时的要求，才不会有麻烦。而且现在国外许多地区都有中国超市，大部分吃的、用的都可以买到，不用担心。
examples.translation: chū guó qián shōu shí xíng li shì měi gè liú xué shēng dōu huì yù dào de wèn tí yǒu xiē rén dān xīn dào xīn de huán jìng huì bú shì yìng suǒ yǐ dài xiē zì jǐ cháng yòng de dōng xī xiàng shì xiǎo lì dì yī cì qù měi guó liú xué tā dān xīn dāng dì de yǐn shí hé kǒu wèi huì bù xí guàn jiù zài xíng li zhōng dài le bù shǎo zhōng guó shí pǐn dǎ suàn dào le měi guó zì jǐ zuò fàn jié guǒ xià fēi jī guò hǎi guān de shí hòu cái fā xiàn hěn duō dōng xī tè bié shì ròu lèi dōu bù néng dài jìn měi guó suǒ yǐ chū guó qián zuì hǎo xiān chá yí xià liú xué de mù dì dì rù jìng shí de yāo qiú cái bú huì yǒu má fán ér qiě xiàn zài guó wài xǔ duō dì qū dōu yǒu zhōng guó chāo shì dà bù fèn chī de yòng de dōu kě yǐ mǎi dào bú yòng dān xīn — Packing before going abroad is a problem every international student will meet. Some people worry they won’t adapt to a new environment, so they bring things they commonly use. For example, when 小丽 went to study in America for the first time, she worried she wouldn’t get used to the local food and taste, so she brought quite a lot of Chinese food in her luggage, intending to cook for herself in America; but when passing through customs after getting off the plane she found that many things, especially meat, could not be brought into America. So before going abroad it is best to first check the entry requirements of the study destination, so as not to have trouble. Moreover, many regions abroad now have Chinese supermarkets, and most things to eat and use can be bought, so there is no need to worry.

examples.text: 不管是不是第一次离家，自己一个人在国外留学生活，容易想家或有一些心理上的问题，在纽约读研究生的王同学就建议到新的环境，多交些新朋友，这样不但能丰富自己的留学生活，还能让自己从朋友那里体验到不同国家的文化。
examples.translation: bù guǎn shì bú shì dì yī cì lí jiā zì jǐ yí gè rén zài guó wài liú xué shēng huó róng yì xiǎng jiā huò yǒu yì xiē xīn lǐ shàng de wèn tí zài niǔ yuē dú yán jiū shēng de wáng tóng xué jiù jiàn yì dào xīn de huán jìng duō jiāo xiē xīn péng yǒu zhè yàng bú dàn néng fēng fù zì jǐ de liú xué shēng huó hái néng ràng zì jǐ cóng péng yǒu nà lǐ tǐ yàn dào bù tóng guó jiā de wén huà — Whether or not it is the first time away from home, living and studying abroad alone makes it easy to be homesick or to have some psychological problems; 王 (a student doing graduate studies in New York) suggests that in a new environment you make more new friends, which can not only enrich your life abroad but also let you experience the cultures of different countries from your friends.

examples.text: 另一位在英国读大学的张同学建议，出国前在一些网路平台上找和自己读同一所大学的中国留学生，或是和大学的中国同学会联系，提前和他们交流一些留学信息，到了留学地，他们也能在生活上和学习上帮助你尽快适应当地的生活。
examples.translation: lìng yí wèi zài yīng guó dú dà xué de zhāng tóng xué jiàn yì chū guó qián zài yì xiē wǎng lù píng tái shàng zhǎo hé zì jǐ dú tóng yì suǒ dà xué de zhōng guó liú xué shēng huò shì hé dà xué de zhōng guó tóng xué huì lián xì tí qián hé tā men jiāo liú yì xiē liú xué xìn xī dào le liú xué dì tā men yě néng zài shēng huó shàng hé xué xí shàng bāng zhù nǐ jǐn kuài shì yìng dāng dì de shēng huó — Another student, 张, who studies at a university in Britain, suggests that before going abroad you look on some online platforms for Chinese students at the same university as you, or contact the university’s Chinese student association, and exchange some study-abroad information with them in advance; once you arrive, they can also help you in life and study to adapt to local life as soon as possible.

examples.text: 最后，虽然留学生出国留学的目的不太一样，但每个留学生都需要对以后有清楚的计划，想好要走的每一步。比方说，在英国读研究生的李同学知道自己留学是为了增加专业知识，这样回国找工作时才能有更多的选择。所以他在出国前就已经计划好，要用一年拿到学位，顺利毕业，然后找到实习机会，他说虽然平时学习压力大，但因为他有清楚的计划让他能更好的利用时间，也让他的留学生活变得更加丰富。
examples.translation: zuì hòu suī rán liú xué shēng chū guó liú xué de mù dì bú tài yí yàng dàn měi gè liú xué shēng dōu xū yào duì yǐ hòu yǒu qīng chǔ de jì huà xiǎng hǎo yào zǒu de měi yí bù bǐ fāng shuō zài yīng guó dú yán jiū shēng de lǐ tóng xué zhī dào zì jǐ liú xué shì wèi le zēng jiā zhuān yè zhī shí zhè yàng huí guó zhǎo gōng zuò shí cái néng yǒu gèng duō de xuǎn zé suǒ yǐ tā zài chū guó qián jiù yǐ jīng jì huà hǎo yào yòng yì nián ná dào xué wèi shùn lì bì yè rán hòu zhǎo dào shí xí jī huì tā shuō suī rán píng shí xué xí yā lì dà dàn yīn wèi tā yǒu qīng chǔ de jì huà ràng tā néng gèng hǎo de lì yòng shí jiān yě ràng tā de liú xué shēng huó biàn de gèng jiā fēng fù — Finally, although international students go abroad with different purposes, every one needs a clear plan for the future and to think through each step to take. For example, 李, who does graduate studies in Britain, knows he is studying abroad to increase his professional knowledge, so that he will have more choices when looking for work after returning. So before going abroad he had already planned to get the degree in one year, graduate smoothly and then find an internship; he says that although the study pressure is usually great, his clear plan lets him make better use of time and also makes his life abroad richer. (source note: adapted from a news website)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, read one passage each, then fill in the pros and cons of your respective study abroad option. B. Convey your pros and cons to your teammates in Chinese so they can fill in the other two tables. C. As a group, brainstorm in Chinese any other pros and cons you can think of for each option, then decide which option is the best choice. D. Report your decision and reasoning to the class in Chinese. The three passages and my table:

rows: 初中毕业申请国外高中
语言学习快，外语能力很快提高；有当地的学位，申请大学比较容易
身心不成熟，适应有困难；没人照顾容易交坏朋友、养成坏习惯；父母担心
高中毕业申请国外本科
已经学到基本知识，身心基本成熟，适应比较顺利；大学选择多，环境和设备好，学习自由
国内高中生活紧张，要准备高考和出国，压力不小
大学毕业申请国外硕士
一到两年就能拿到学位，不需要花太多钱；成绩好可以拿奖学金；成熟，适应快
语言能力提高没有那么快；留学时间短，在当地找工作留下来不容易
tables.title: Activity 3A: the pros and cons of the three options (the book’s tables are blank)

examples.text: 孩子年龄越小，语言学习的速度也就越快，所以外语能力很快提高。再加上孩子如果在当地上高中，有了那里的学位，申请大学也比较容易。但是由于孩子年龄小，身心都不成熟，所以适应上会有比较多的困难。要是没人照顾，很容易交上坏朋友，养成坏习惯。父母会比较担心。
examples.translation: hái zi nián líng yuè xiǎo yǔ yán xué xí de sù dù yě jiù yuè kuài suǒ yǐ wài yǔ néng lì hěn kuài tí gāo zài jiā shàng hái zi rú guǒ zài dāng dì shàng gāo zhōng yǒu le nà lǐ de xué wèi shēn qǐng dà xué yě bǐ jiào róng yì dàn shì yóu yú hái zi nián líng xiǎo shēn xīn dōu bù chéng shú suǒ yǐ shì yìng shàng huì yǒu bǐ jiào duō de kùn nán yào shì méi rén zhào gù hěn róng yì jiāo shàng huài péng yǒu yǎng chéng huài xí guàn fù mǔ huì bǐ jiào dān xīn — Passage 1, applying to a high school abroad after middle school: The younger the child, the faster language learning is, so foreign-language ability improves quickly. In addition, if the child attends high school locally and has a degree from there, applying to university is also easier. But because the child is young and not mature in body and mind, there are more difficulties in adapting. If nobody looks after them it is easy to make bad friends and form bad habits. Parents will worry more.

examples.text: 高中毕业以后再留学，好处是孩子在国内高中已经学到一些基本知识，身心也基本成熟，所以适应上会比小留学生顺利一点。而且国外的大学教育有很多选择，除了公立学校以外，还有私立学校可选，学校的环境、设备都比较好，学习上也比较自由，学生可以按自己的兴趣发展。但是因为国内高中的生活比较紧张，除了准备高考以外，还要为出国做准备，孩子在这个时候申请留学会有不小的压力。
examples.translation: gāo zhōng bì yè yǐ hòu zài liú xué hǎo chù shì hái zi zài guó nèi gāo zhōng yǐ jīng xué dào yì xiē jī běn zhī shí shēn xīn yě jī běn chéng shú suǒ yǐ shì yìng shàng huì bǐ xiǎo liú xué shēng shùn lì yì diǎn ér qiě guó wài de dà xué jiào yù yǒu hěn duō xuǎn zé chú le gōng lì xué xiào yǐ wài hái yǒu sī lì xué xiào kě xuǎn xué xiào de huán jìng shè bèi dōu bǐ jiào hǎo xué xí shàng yě bǐ jiào zì yóu xué shēng kě yǐ àn zì jǐ de xìng qù fā zhǎn dàn shì yīn wèi guó nèi gāo zhōng de shēng huó bǐ jiào jǐn zhāng chú le zhǔn bèi gāo kǎo yǐ wài hái yào wèi chū guó zuò zhǔn bèi hái zi zài zhè ge shí hòu shēn qǐng liú xué huì yǒu bù xiǎo de yā lì — Passage 2, applying to a foreign undergraduate program after high school: The benefit of studying abroad after high school is that the child has learned some basic knowledge in high school at home and is basically mature in body and mind, so adapting is a bit smoother than for young students. Also, university education abroad has many choices: besides public schools there are private schools to choose from, the schools’ environment and facilities are rather good, study is freer, and students can develop according to their own interests. But because life in high school at home is rather tense, besides preparing for the college entrance exam they must also prepare for going abroad, so applying to study abroad at this time brings no small pressure.

examples.text: 大学毕业后到国外读硕士，只需一到两年时间就能拿到学位，所以不需要花太多钱，而且要是成绩好，还有机会拿到奖学金，所以比较适合家庭条件没有那么好的留学生。另外，大学毕业生已经是个成熟的大人，适应国外的生活可能比小留学生快，但是语言能力可能没有小留学生提高得那么快。再加上留学时间短，要在当地找到工作留下来也不那么容易，所以留学后回国的人较多。
examples.translation: dà xué bì yè hòu dào guó wài dú shuò shì zhǐ xū yí dào liǎng nián shí jiān jiù néng ná dào xué wèi suǒ yǐ bù xū yào huā tài duō qián ér qiě yào shì chéng jì hǎo hái yǒu jī huì ná dào jiǎng xué jīn suǒ yǐ bǐ jiào shì hé jiā tíng tiáo jiàn méi yǒu nà me hǎo de liú xué shēng lìng wài dà xué bì yè shēng yǐ jīng shì gè chéng shú de dà rén shì yìng guó wài de shēng huó kě néng bǐ xiǎo liú xué shēng kuài dàn shì yǔ yán néng lì kě néng méi yǒu xiǎo liú xué shēng tí gāo de nà me kuài zài jiā shàng liú xué shí jiān duǎn yào zài dāng dì zhǎo dào gōng zuò liú xià lái yě bú nà me róng yì suǒ yǐ liú xué hòu huí guó de rén jiào duō — Passage 3, applying to a foreign master’s program after university: Going abroad for a master’s after university takes only one to two years to get the degree, so you don’t need to spend too much money, and if your grades are good there is also a chance to get a scholarship, so it suits students whose family conditions are not so good. In addition, a university graduate is already a mature adult and may adapt to life abroad faster than young students, but language ability may not improve as fast as theirs. Add that the study time is short, so it is not so easy to find work locally and stay, and therefore more people return home after studying. (source note: adapted from a website)

lessons.title: 682. Lesson 26 Presentation 3: how Chinese people travel abroad
lessons.subtitle: 出国旅游 · 旅行团 自由行 自驾游 · 海岛游 定点游 · 度蜜月 · 扫货 · 总之

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. If you have traveled abroad, why did you go? What motivates people to travel abroad? B. Look at the pictures. What do you most like to do when traveling and why? C. Is shopping during your travels important? What do you usually buy (other than food)? (Four pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 中国人出国旅游
explanations.body: The four paragraphs of the presentation.

examples.text: 近些年，中国人变得越来越有钱，加上签证更容易，国际航线不断增加，所以很多中国人选择去国外旅游，而且旅游的方式和目的更是多种多样。
examples.translation: jìn xiē nián zhōng guó rén biàn de yuè lái yuè yǒu qián jiā shàng qiān zhèng gèng róng yì guó jì háng xiàn bú duàn zēng jiā suǒ yǐ hěn duō zhōng guó rén xuǎn zé qù guó wài lǚ yóu ér qiě lǚ yóu de fāng shì hé mù dì gèng shì duō zhǒng duō yàng — In recent years Chinese people have become richer and richer; add to that visas are easier and international air routes keep increasing, so many Chinese people choose to travel abroad, and moreover the ways and purposes of travel are even more varied. (translations in this card are mine; the book also prints the passage in traditional characters)

examples.text: 以前中国人出国旅游多半是参加旅行团，让旅行团安排所有的行程，但是现在许多人选择自由行，他们自己安排旅游路线，到了国外租车自驾游，边走边看，慢慢体验当地的文化和生活。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén chū guó lǚ yóu duō bàn shì cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán ràng lǚ xíng tuán ān pái suǒ yǒu de xíng chéng dàn shì xiàn zài xǔ duō rén xuǎn zé zì yóu xíng tā men zì jǐ ān pái lǚ yóu lù xiàn dào le guó wài zū chē zì jià yóu biān zǒu biān kàn màn màn tǐ yàn dāng dì de wén huà hé shēng huó — In the past Chinese people traveling abroad mostly joined tour groups and let the tour group arrange the whole itinerary, but now many people choose independent travel: they arrange their own routes, rent a car and drive themselves once abroad, looking as they go, slowly experiencing the local culture and life.

examples.text: 现在的中国人出国旅游的目的也不太一样。有些人是为了远离工作，放松身心，所以会选择海岛游或定点游。有些人出国是为了了解世界，学习新东西，他们会到比较古老的国家，参观名胜古迹或是博物馆。还有些人出国是为了庆祝特别的日子，比如结婚，度蜜月等等。
examples.translation: xiàn zài de zhōng guó rén chū guó lǚ yóu de mù dì yě bú tài yí yàng yǒu xiē rén shì wèi le yuǎn lí gōng zuò fàng sōng shēn xīn suǒ yǐ huì xuǎn zé hǎi dǎo yóu huò dìng diǎn yóu yǒu xiē rén chū guó shì wèi le liǎo jiě shì jiè xué xí xīn dōng xī tā men huì dào bǐ jiào gǔ lǎo de guó jiā cān guān míng shèng gǔ jì huò shì bó wù guǎn hái yǒu xiē rén chū guó shì wèi le qìng zhù tè bié de rì zi bǐ rú jié hūn dù mì yuè děng děng — The purposes of Chinese people traveling abroad now are also not quite the same. Some do it to get away from work and relax body and mind, so they choose island tours or set-destination tours. Some go abroad to learn about the world and learn new things; they go to rather ancient countries and visit scenic spots, historic sites or museums. Still others go abroad to celebrate special days, such as getting married, spending a honeymoon and so on.

examples.text: 不管旅游的方式和目的是什么，对中国人来说，购物一直都是一个重要的活动。以前中国人喜欢在世界各地“扫货”，购买国外的名牌，因为这些东西的价格比国内便宜得多。现在中国人更喜欢在旅游的时候，逛逛当地的农贸市场，买些有特色的商品或美食。总之，中国人的出国旅游越来越自由，越来越有特点。
examples.translation: bù guǎn lǚ yóu de fāng shì hé mù dì shì shén me duì zhōng guó rén lái shuō gòu wù yì zhí dōu shì yí gè zhòng yào de huó dòng yǐ qián zhōng guó rén xǐ huān zài shì jiè gè dì sǎo huò gòu mǎi guó wài de míng pái yīn wèi zhè xiē dōng xī de jià gé bǐ guó nèi pián yi de duō xiàn zài zhōng guó rén gèng xǐ huān zài lǚ yóu de shí hòu guàng guàng dāng dì de nóng mào shì chǎng mǎi xiē yǒu tè sè de shāng pǐn huò měi shí zǒng zhī zhōng guó rén de chū guó lǚ yóu yuè lái yuè zì yóu yuè lái yuè yǒu tè diǎn — Whatever the way and purpose of travel, for Chinese people shopping has always been an important activity. In the past Chinese people liked to go on shopping sprees all over the world and buy foreign brand names, because the prices of these things were much cheaper than at home. Now Chinese people prefer, while traveling, to stroll through local farmers’ markets and buy some distinctive goods or delicacies. In short, Chinese people’s travel abroad is more and more free and more and more distinctive.

examples.text: 以前中国人多半参加旅行团，现在许多人选择自由行；以前喜欢扫货，现在喜欢逛农贸市场。
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén duō bàn cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán xiàn zài xǔ duō rén xuǎn zé zì yóu xíng yǐ qián xǐ huān sǎo huò xiàn zài xǐ huān guàng nóng mào shì chǎng — 2D (my briefing): In the past Chinese people mostly joined tour groups, and now many choose independent travel; in the past they liked shopping sprees, and now they like to stroll through farmers’ markets.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to three guests on a talk show, then fill in the table with their travel preferences (Guest 1, 2, 3: Preference and Reasons). B. Form groups of three. In Chinese, brief your partners on the first guest’s preferences and reasons, while they brief you on the other two. C. Around the classroom, find the following types of travelers and ask them at least one question in Chinese related to their preference, then fill in the table with their response: applied for a visa; prefers tour groups; likes road trips; likes to see as many places as they can during a trip; likes to just relax in one place; would like to honeymoon abroad. D. In Chinese, tell the class about the people you found and what they told you. (The talk show is audio; my sample questions follow.)

examples.text: 你申请过签证吗？去哪个国家？
examples.translation: nǐ shēn qǐng guò qiān zhèng ma qù nǎ ge guó jiā — Activity 3C (my sample questions), for “applied for a visa”: Have you ever applied for a visa? For which country?

examples.text: 你喜欢参加旅行团吗？为什么？
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán ma wèi shén me — For “prefers tour groups”: Do you like joining tour groups? Why?

examples.text: 你喜欢开车去旅游吗？你去过哪里？
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān kāi chē qù lǚ yóu ma nǐ qù guò nǎ lǐ — For “likes road trips”: Do you like traveling by car? Where have you been?

examples.text: 旅行的时候，你喜欢多去几个地方吗？
examples.translation: lǚ xíng de shí hòu nǐ xǐ huān duō qù jǐ gè dì fāng ma — For “likes to see as many places as they can”: When traveling, do you like to go to several places?

examples.text: 你喜欢在一个地方休息吗？
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān zài yí gè dì fāng xiū xī ma — For “likes to just relax in one place”: Do you like to rest in one place?

examples.text: 你想去哪里度蜜月？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ dù mì yuè — For “would like to honeymoon abroad”: Where would you like to spend your honeymoon?

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences with the correct choice from the following word pairs: 签证/签名; 远离/离开; 结婚/度蜜月; 行程/路线; 自驾游/自由行. B. Compare work with a partner. C. Write a story using five of the words you filled in above, using one word per sentence. D. Read your story to the class. My key and my story:

examples.text: 用信用卡买完东西以后，你得在收据上签名。
examples.translation: yòng xìn yòng kǎ mǎi wán dōng xī yǐ hòu nǐ děi zài shōu jù shàng qiān míng — 1a. After buying things with a credit card you have to sign the receipt. (my key: 签名)

examples.text: 去一些国家旅行，你得去大使馆办签证。
examples.translation: qù yì xiē guó jiā lǚ xíng nǐ děi qù dà shǐ guǎn bàn qiān zhèng — 1b. To travel to some countries you have to go to the embassy to get a visa. (my key: 签证)

examples.text: 很多人工作压力大，一放假就会远离城市到国家公园去放松一下。
examples.translation: hěn duō rén gōng zuò yā lì dà yí fàng jià jiù huì yuǎn lí chéng shì dào guó jiā gōng yuán qù fàng sōng yí xià — 2a. Many people have great work pressure and, as soon as it is a holiday, get away from the city to a national park to relax. (my key: 远离)

examples.text: 我离开家乡到北京工作已经一年多了，可是还是不适应北京的生活。
examples.translation: wǒ lí kāi jiā xiāng dào běi jīng gōng zuò yǐ jīng yì nián duō le kě shì hái shì bú shì yìng běi jīng de shēng huó — 2b. It has been more than a year since I left my hometown to work in Beijing, but I still haven’t adapted to life in Beijing. (my key: 离开)

examples.text: 最近几年很多新人们选择婚后去海岛度蜜月。
examples.translation: zuì jìn jǐ nián hěn duō xīn rén men xuǎn zé hūn hòu qù hǎi dǎo dù mì yuè — 3a. In recent years many newlyweds choose to go to an island for their honeymoon after the wedding. (my key: 度蜜月)

examples.text: 现在的人生活压力大，再加上工作繁忙，不少人选择晚婚或是不结婚。
examples.translation: xiàn zài de rén shēng huó yā lì dà zài jiā shàng gōng zuò fán máng bù shǎo rén xuǎn zé wǎn hūn huò shì bù jié hūn — 3b. People now have great life pressure, and with busy work added, quite a few choose to marry late or not to marry. (my key: 结婚)

examples.text: 很多旅行社的行程包括购物和参观名胜古迹。
examples.translation: hěn duō lǚ xíng shè de xíng chéng bāo kuò gòu wù hé cān guān míng shèng gǔ jì — 4a. The itineraries of many travel agencies include shopping and visiting scenic spots and historic sites. (my key: 行程)

examples.text: 我这次自由行的路线是从旧金山出发，经过洛杉矶到拉斯维加斯，然后坐飞机到纽约。
examples.translation: wǒ zhè cì zì yóu xíng de lù xiàn shì cóng jiù jīn shān chū fā jīng guò luò shān jī dào lā sī wéi jiā sī rán hòu zuò fēi jī dào niǔ yuē — 4b. My route for this independent trip is to set out from San Francisco, pass through Los Angeles to Las Vegas, and then fly to New York. (my key: 路线)

examples.text: 要是你参加旅行社的自由行，他们会帮你订旅馆和机票，到了目的地，你可以选择自己想做的活动。
examples.translation: yào shì nǐ cān jiā lǚ xíng shè de zì yóu xíng tā men huì bāng nǐ dìng lǚ guǎn hé jī piào dào le mù dì dì nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé zì jǐ xiǎng zuò de huó dòng — 5a. If you join a travel agency’s independent-travel package, they will book your hotel and air tickets for you, and once at the destination you can choose the activities you want to do. (my key: 自由行)

examples.text: 很多美国人喜欢长周末开车到各个风景点自驾游。
examples.translation: hěn duō měi guó rén xǐ huān cháng zhōu mò kāi chē dào gè gè fēng jǐng diǎn zì jià yóu — 5b. Many Americans like to drive to various scenic spots for a self-drive tour on long weekends. (my key: 自驾游; the book prints the blank before the full stop)

examples.text: 我们打算去海岛度蜜月。
examples.translation: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi dǎo dù mì yuè — Activity 4C (my sample story, one key word per sentence): We plan to spend our honeymoon on an island. (度蜜月)

examples.text: 我们得先去办签证。
examples.translation: wǒ men děi xiān qù bàn qiān zhèng — We have to go and get a visa first. (签证)

examples.text: 我们不想参加旅行团，选择自由行。
examples.translation: wǒ men bù xiǎng cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán xuǎn zé zì yóu xíng — We don’t want to join a tour group and choose independent travel. (自由行)

examples.text: 我们自己安排了路线。
examples.translation: wǒ men zì jǐ ān pái le lù xiàn — We arranged the route ourselves. (路线)

examples.text: 离开家乡以前，朋友们都祝我们旅行愉快。
examples.translation: lí kāi jiā xiāng yǐ qián péng yǒu men dōu zhù wǒ men lǚ xíng yú kuài — Before leaving our hometown, our friends all wished us a pleasant trip. (离开)

lessons.title: 684. Lesson 26 Presentation 3 grammar: compound-complex sentences 多重复句 (2)
lessons.subtitle: 联合复句 偏正复句 · 并列 承接 递进 选择 · 因果 条件 假设 转折 目的 让步 · 因为…所以 · 不但…而且

explanations.title: Compound-Complex Sentences 多重复句 (2)
explanations.body: Compound-complex sentences 多重复句 are comprised of at least two independent clauses closely related in meaning. Understanding the relationship between these clauses can help you grasp the core meaning of long and complicated sentences. The two tables below list the kinds of relationship and their cohesive devices, and the two examples show them in use.

headers: 联合复句 (both clauses of equal weight)
rows: 又…又…; 一边…一边…; 不是…就是…
不但…而且…; 不仅…还…甚至; 连…也…
tables.title: 联合复句 (the first table)

headers: 偏正复句 (main clause + subordinate clause)
rows: 因为…所以; 由于…因此…
只要…就; 只有…才…; 不管…都…
tables.title: 偏正复句 (the second table)

examples.text: 近些年，中国人变得越来越有钱，加上签证更容易，国际航线不断增加，所以很多中国人选择去国外旅游，而且旅游的方式和目的更是多种多样。
examples.translation: jìn xiē nián zhōng guó rén biàn de yuè lái yuè yǒu qián jiā shàng qiān zhèng gèng róng yì guó jì háng xiàn bú duàn zēng jiā suǒ yǐ hěn duō zhōng guó rén xuǎn zé qù guó wài lǚ yóu ér qiě lǚ yóu de fāng shì hé mù dì gèng shì duō zhǒng duō yàng — Example 1: In recent years Chinese people have become richer and richer; add to that visas are easier, international air routes keep increasing, so many Chinese people choose to travel abroad, and moreover the ways and purposes of travel are even more varied. (Analysis: clause (1), 近些年…国际航线不断增加, causes the results in clauses (2) 所以很多中国人选择去国外旅游 and (3) 而且旅游的方式和目的更是多种多样, so the three clauses are in a causative relationship; 因为 is omitted from clause (1) but implied by 所以. Inside clause (1) the three factors (a) 中国人变得越来越有钱, (b) 签证更容易 and (c) 国际航线不断增加 are in a progressive relationship, marked by 加上. Clauses (2) and (3) are also progressive, because the latter provides additional information, marked by 而且.)

examples.text: 除了体验不同的生活和文化以外，有些人出国是为了远离工作，放松身心，所以会选择海岛游或定点游。
examples.translation: chú le tǐ yàn bù tóng de shēng huó hé wén huà yǐ wài yǒu xiē rén chū guó shì wèi le yuǎn lí gōng zuò fàng sōng shēn xīn suǒ yǐ huì xuǎn zé hǎi dǎo yóu huò dìng diǎn yóu — Example 2: Besides experiencing different lives and cultures, some people go abroad to get away from work and relax body and mind, so they choose island tours or set-destination tours. (Analysis: clauses (1) 除了体验不同的生活和文化以外 and (2) 有些人出国是为了远离工作，放松身心 are in a progressive relationship because they give two separate reasons why people travel; inside (2), (a) 远离工作 and (b) 放松身心 are in a purposive relationship, marked by 为了. Clauses (2) and (3) 所以会选择海岛游或定点游 are in a causative relationship because the reason in clause (2) leads to the result in clause (3).)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading)
explanations.body: A. Highlight the cohesive devices in the following compound-complex sentences and determine their function and relationships in the sentence. B. Translate the following sentences, then compare work with a partner. My analyses and translations:

examples.text: 因为上次的单元考试没考好，所以这次为了准备考试，他不但提早复习生词和课文，而且还跟老师做了很多的练习。
examples.translation: yīn wèi shàng cì de dān yuán kǎo shì méi kǎo hǎo suǒ yǐ zhè cì wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tā bú dàn tí zǎo fù xí shēng cí hé kè wén ér qiě hái gēn lǎo shī zuò le hěn duō de liàn xí — 1. Because he didn’t do well on the last unit test, this time, in order to prepare for the exam, he not only reviewed the new words and texts early but also did many exercises with the teacher. (my analysis: 因为…所以 causative; 为了 purposive; 不但…而且还 progressive; the book’s Activity 1B prints 提前 for 提早)

examples.text: 选择合适的运动，不仅能提高锻炼的效果，而且让你不会受伤，所以十分重要。
examples.translation: xuǎn zé hé shì de yùn dòng bù jǐn néng tí gāo duàn liàn de xiào guǒ ér qiě ràng nǐ bú huì shòu shāng suǒ yǐ shí fēn zhòng yào — 2. Choosing a suitable sport can not only improve the effect of exercise but also keep you from getting hurt, so it is very important. (my analysis: 不仅…而且 progressive; the two benefits lead to 所以十分重要, causative)

examples.text: 虽然有不少小留学生因为没人照顾养成了坏习惯，但是为了让孩子有更好的学习环境、更好的前途，还是有很多父母愿意把孩子送出国。
examples.translation: suī rán yǒu bù shǎo xiǎo liú xué shēng yīn wèi méi rén zhào gù yǎng chéng le huài xí guàn dàn shì wèi le ràng hái zi yǒu gèng hǎo de xué xí huán jìng gèng hǎo de qián tú hái shì yǒu hěn duō fù mǔ yuàn yì bǎ hái zi sòng chū guó — 3. Although quite a few young international students formed bad habits because nobody looked after them, in order to give their children a better learning environment and a better future, there are still many parents willing to send their children abroad. (my analysis: 虽然…但是 transitional; 因为 causative inside the first clause; 为了 purposive)

examples.text: 为了减肥，他不但每天上健身房锻炼，三餐还只吃蔬菜水果，但还是没见他瘦下来。
examples.translation: wèi le jiǎn féi tā bú dàn měi tiān shàng jiàn shēn fáng duàn liàn sān cān hái zhǐ chī shū cài shuǐ guǒ dàn hái shì méi jiàn tā shòu xià lái — 4. In order to lose weight, he not only goes to the gym every day but also eats only vegetables and fruit at his three meals, but he still hasn’t got thinner. (my analysis: 为了 purposive; 不但…还 progressive; 但还是 transitional)

examples.text: 不管是上网购物、订餐或是和朋友交流，人们的生活越来越离不开网路，有些人甚至因此得了网瘾。
examples.translation: bù guǎn shì shàng wǎng gòu wù dìng cān huò shì hé péng yǒu jiāo liú rén men de shēng huó yuè lái yuè lí bù kāi wǎng lù yǒu xiē rén shèn zhì yīn cǐ dé le wǎng yǐn — 5. Whether shopping online, ordering meals or communicating with friends, people’s lives increasingly cannot do without the Internet, and some people even got Internet addiction because of it. (my analysis: 不管…都-type conditional; 甚至因此 progressive and causative; the book’s Activity 1B prints 玩游戏, “playing games”, instead of 订餐)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. For five sentences, first listen for the relationships between the clauses, then listen again to translate them. B. Read the script with a partner to check your work. C. Take turns with your partner verbally translating your sentences back into Chinese. (Audio; the sentences and script are not in the book.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Choose two topics (你的生活, 你的工作, 你的学习, 你的家人, 其他话题) and write a compound-complex sentence about each one, focusing on the cohesive devices needed to express the relationships between your clauses. B. Read your sentences to a partner, make any changes they may suggest, then post your sentences on a class website for the class to read. My samples:

examples.text: 因为我想去中国工作，所以我每天都学中文，不但学生词，而且还听中文歌。
examples.translation: yīn wèi wǒ xiǎng qù zhōng guó gōng zuò suǒ yǐ wǒ měi tiān dōu xué zhōng wén bú dàn xué shēng cí ér qiě hái tīng zhōng wén gē — Activity 3A (my sample, topic 你的学习): Because I want to work in China, I study Chinese every day, learning not only new words but also listening to Chinese songs.

examples.text: 虽然我的生活很忙，但是为了身体健康，我还是每天运动。
examples.translation: suī rán wǒ de shēng huó hěn máng dàn shì wèi le shēn tǐ jiàn kāng wǒ hái shì měi tiān yùn dòng — (my sample, topic 你的生活): Although my life is busy, for the sake of health I still exercise every day.

exercises.prompt: What is a 并列复句?
Which pair marks a 递进复句?
Which pair marks a 因果复句?
exercises.explanation: 因为…所以: cause and effect.

exercises.prompt: Which pair marks a 条件复句?
Which pair marks a 假设复句?
Which marks a 转折复句?
Which marks a 目的复句?
Which marks a 让步复句?
Which kind of sentence is 先…然后…最后…?
In Example 1, what relationship do clauses (1), (2) and (3) have?
因为上次的单元考试没考好，所以这次___了准备考试，他不但提早复习。
选择合适的运动，不仅能提高锻炼的效果，而___让你不会受伤。

lessons.title: 685. Lesson 26 Presentation 3 grammar: 有些人…有些人…还有些人… for different aspects of a general assertion
lessons.subtitle: 有些人…有些人…还有些人… · 有些同学…有些同学…还有些同学… · 中文要学得好有很多办法 · 住民宿 · 出国留学的目的

explanations.title: 段落语法: 有些人…有些人…还有些人…
explanations.body: The sentence pattern 有些人…有些人…还有些人… (or 有些同学…有些同学…还有些同学…, etc.) means “some folks [are/do X], some folks [are/do Y], and there are also some folks [that are/do Z].” As in English, it is used to provide different aspects or examples of a general assertion. Pattern: General Assertion + 有些人…有些人…还有些人…

rows: General Assertion + 有些人…有些人…还有些人…
some folks [are/do X], some folks [are/do Y], and there are also some folks [that are/do Z]; also 有些同学…有些同学…还有些同学…, etc.
tables.title: 段落语法: 有些人…有些人…还有些人…

examples.text: 现在的中国人出国旅游的目的也不太一样。有些人是为了远离工作，放松身心，所以会选择海岛游或定点游。有些人出国是为了了解世界，学习新东西，他们会到比较古老的国家，参观名胜古迹或是博物馆。还有些人出国是为了庆祝特别的日子，比如结婚，度蜜月等等。
examples.translation: xiàn zài de zhōng guó rén chū guó lǚ yóu de mù dì yě bú tài yí yàng yǒu xiē rén shì wèi le yuǎn lí gōng zuò fàng sōng shēn xīn suǒ yǐ huì xuǎn zé hǎi dǎo yóu huò dìng diǎn yóu yǒu xiē rén chū guó shì wèi le liǎo jiě shì jiè xué xí xīn dōng xī tā men huì dào bǐ jiào gǔ lǎo de guó jiā cān guān míng shèng gǔ jì huò shì bó wù guǎn hái yǒu xiē rén chū guó shì wèi le qìng zhù tè bié de rì zi bǐ rú jié hūn dù mì yuè děng děng — Example: The purposes of Chinese people traveling abroad now are also not quite the same [general assertion]. Some do it to get away from work and relax body and mind, so they choose island tours or set-destination tours [aspect 1]. Some go abroad to learn about the world and learn new things; they go to rather ancient countries and visit scenic spots, historic sites or museums [aspect 2]. Still others go abroad to celebrate special days, such as getting married, spending a honeymoon and so on [aspect 3]. As in English, the pattern gives different aspects or examples of a general assertion.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Form groups of three. For each item below, read the general assertion aloud, then use the 有些人 pattern to provide three aspects or examples of it. Take turns until each classmate has done all five items. The assertions: 1. 中文要学得好有很多办法。 2. 住民宿最近越来越受到人们的欢迎。 3. 很多父母送孩子出国留学的目的不同。 4. 上网玩电子游戏有好处，也有坏处。 5. 出国旅游什么方式最好？ My samples:

examples.text: 有些人每天听中文广播，有些人跟中国朋友聊天，还有些人看中文电影。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē rén měi tiān tīng zhōng wén guǎng bō yǒu xiē rén gēn zhōng guó péng yǒu liáo tiān hái yǒu xiē rén kàn zhòng wén diàn yǐng — Activity 4, item 1 (my sample; the assertion is 中文要学得好有很多办法): Some people listen to Chinese radio every day, some chat with Chinese friends, and some watch Chinese movies.

examples.text: 有些人觉得民宿有家的感觉，有些人觉得民宿比旅馆便宜，还有些人喜欢可以自己做饭。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē rén jué de mín sù yǒu jiā de gǎn jué yǒu xiē rén jué de mín sù bǐ lǚ guǎn pián yi hái yǒu xiē rén xǐ huān kě yǐ zì jǐ zuò fàn — Item 2 (assertion: 住民宿最近越来越受到人们的欢迎): Some people feel a homestay gives the feeling of home, some think a homestay is cheaper than a hotel, and some like being able to cook for themselves.

examples.text: 有些父母想让孩子学好外语，有些父母想让孩子体验不同的文化，还有些父母希望孩子能进好的大学。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē fù mǔ xiǎng ràng hái zi xué hǎo wài yǔ yǒu xiē fù mǔ xiǎng ràng hái zi tǐ yàn bù tóng de wén huà hái yǒu xiē fù mǔ xī wàng hái zi néng jìn hǎo de dà xué — Item 3 (assertion: 很多父母送孩子出国留学的目的不同): Some parents want their children to learn foreign languages well, some want them to experience different cultures, and some hope their children can enter a good university.

examples.text: 有些人觉得玩游戏可以放松，有些人觉得可以认识新朋友，还有些人玩得太久，影响学习和健康。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē rén jué de wán yóu xì kě yǐ fàng sōng yǒu xiē rén jué de kě yǐ rèn shí xīn péng yǒu hái yǒu xiē rén wán de tài jiǔ yǐng xiǎng xué xí hé jiàn kāng — Item 4 (assertion: 上网玩电子游戏有好处，也有坏处): Some people feel playing games helps them relax, some feel they can meet new friends, and some play too long and it harms their study and health.

examples.text: 有些人觉得跟旅行团最方便，有些人觉得自由行最自由，还有些人觉得自驾游最好玩。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē rén jué de gēn lǚ xíng tuán zuì fāng biàn yǒu xiē rén jué de zì yóu xíng zuì zì yóu hái yǒu xiē rén jué de zì jià yóu zuì hǎo wán — Item 5 (assertion: 出国旅游什么方式最好？): Some people think a tour group is the most convenient, some think independent travel is the freest, and some think a self-drive tour is the most fun.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: Ask three of your classmates in Chinese why they chose to study the language, then write a sentence using the 有些人 pattern. For example, 我们班同学都很喜欢学中文，但他们的目的并不一样。有些同学… (three blank lines). My completion:

examples.text: 我们班同学都很喜欢学中文，但他们的目的并不一样。有些同学是为了工作，有些同学是为了去中国旅游，还有些同学是因为喜欢中国文化。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān tóng xué dōu hěn xǐ huān xué zhōng wén dàn tā men de mù dì bìng bù yí yàng yǒu xiē tóng xué shì wèi le gōng zuò yǒu xiē tóng xué shì wèi le qù zhōng guó lǚ yóu hái yǒu xiē tóng xué shì yīn wèi xǐ huān zhōng guó wén huà — Activity 5 (the first sentence is the book’s example; the rest is my completion): The students in our class all like studying Chinese, but their purposes are not the same. Some students do it for work, some to travel in China, and some because they like Chinese culture.

exercises.prompt: What does the pattern 有些人…有些人…还有些人… present?
options: Different aspects or examples of a general assertion

exercises.prompt: What comes first in the pattern?
How many aspects does the pattern usually give?
exercises.explanation: 有些人…有些人…还有些人…

exercises.prompt: In the book’s example, what is the general assertion?
options: The purposes of Chinese people traveling abroad now are not quite the same
exercises.explanation: 现在的中国人出国旅游的目的也不太一样.

exercises.prompt: What is aspect 1 in the example?
options: To get away from work and relax

exercises.prompt: What is aspect 3 in the example?
options: To celebrate special days such as a wedding or honeymoon
exercises.explanation: 还有些人出国是为了庆祝特别的日子.

exercises.prompt: Which word begins the third aspect?
What can be used instead of 有些人 for classmates?
exercises.explanation: 有些同学…有些同学…还有些同学…

exercises.prompt: 现在的中国人出国旅游的目的也不太一样。___些人是为了远离工作。
___有些人出国是为了庆祝特别的日子。

lessons.title: 686. Lesson 26 Presentation 3 grammar: 总之 for summing up
lessons.subtitle: 总之 · 每个人都有自己喜欢的爱好 · 每件事情都要努力才能做好 · 人人都有不错的工作 · 用手机

explanations.title: 话语语法: 总之
explanations.body: 总之 means “in short,” “in brief,” “to sum up,” “anyhow,” etc. It often comes at the end of a passage or paragraph to summarize or conclude the aforementioned points. Pattern: Various Points/Factors + 总之 + Conclusion/Summary.

rows: 总之 means “in short,” “in brief,” “to sum up,” “anyhow,” etc.; it often comes at the end of a passage or paragraph to summarize or conclude the aforementioned points
tables.title: 话语语法: 总之

examples.text: 你喜欢弹吉他。他喜欢唱歌。我喜欢跳舞。总之每个人都有自己喜欢的爱好。
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān tán jí tā tā xǐ huān chàng gē wǒ xǐ huān tiào wǔ zǒng zhī měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ xǐ huān de ài hào — 1. You like playing the guitar. He likes singing. I like dancing. In short, everyone has a hobby of their own.

examples.text: 学习要努力，工作要努力，生活也要努力。总之每件事情都要努力才能做好。
examples.translation: xué xí yào nǔ lì gōng zuò yào nǔ lì shēng huó yě yào nǔ lì zǒng zhī měi jiàn shì qíng dōu yào nǔ lì cái néng zuò hǎo — 2. Study takes effort, work takes effort, and life takes effort too. In short, everything takes effort to be done well.

examples.text: 我们班毕业以后，有人当老师，有人当医生。有人当老板。总之人人都有不错的工作。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān bì yè yǐ hòu yǒu rén dāng lǎo shī yǒu rén dāng yī shēng yǒu rén dāng lǎo bǎn zǒng zhī rén rén dōu yǒu bú cuò de gōng zuò — 3. After our class graduates, some become teachers, some become doctors, and some become bosses. In short, everyone has a decent job.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading and Writing)
explanations.body: Read the sentences below and write a concluding sentence for each one using 总之. The five given sentences and my conclusions:

examples.text: 要是你肚子饿了想吃东西，你可以打电话点外卖，你还可以上“美团”平台订餐。总之，现在想吃什么都很方便。
examples.translation: yào shì nǐ dù zi è le xiǎng chī dōng xī nǐ kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà diǎn wài mài nǐ hái kě yǐ shàng měi tuán píng tái dìng cān zǒng zhī xiàn zài xiǎng chī shén me dōu hěn fāng biàn — Activity 6, item 1 (my conclusion): If you are hungry and want to eat something, you can phone to order takeout, or order on the Meituan platform. In short, it is now convenient to eat whatever you want.

examples.text: 旅行的时候，你可以根据自己的需要选择住宿的地方。你可以露营，可以住旅馆，也可以住民宿。总之，住的地方有很多选择。
examples.translation: lǚ xíng de shí hòu nǐ kě yǐ gēn jù zì jǐ de xū yào xuǎn zé zhù sù de dì fāng nǐ kě yǐ lù yíng kě yǐ zhù lǚ guǎn yě kě yǐ zhù mín sù zǒng zhī zhù de dì fāng yǒu hěn duō xuǎn zé — Item 2: When traveling you can choose a place to stay according to your needs. You can camp, stay in a hotel or stay in a homestay. In short, there are many choices of where to stay.

examples.text: 父母在孩子小的时候，关心孩子的身体和学习，等孩子长大，也常担心孩子的工作和生活。总之，父母一辈子都在关心孩子。
examples.translation: fù mǔ zài hái zi xiǎo de shí hòu guān xīn hái zi de shēn tǐ hé xué xí děng hái zi zhǎng dà yě cháng dān xīn hái zi de gōng zuò hé shēng huó zǒng zhī fù mǔ yí bèi zi dōu zài guān xīn hái zi — Item 3: When children are small, parents care about their bodies and study; when children grow up, they also often worry about their work and life. In short, parents care about their children all their lives.

examples.text: 用短租平台订房，你得先选择你要的房间，确认信息，然后再付款。总之，在短租平台订房要一步一步来。
examples.translation: yòng duǎn zū píng tái dìng fáng nǐ děi xiān xuǎn zé nǐ yào de fáng jiān què rèn xìn xī rán hòu zài fù kuǎn zǒng zhī zài duǎn zū píng tái dìng fáng yào yí bù yí bù lái — Item 4: To book a room on a short-term rental platform, you first have to choose the room you want, confirm the information and then pay. In short, booking on a short-term rental platform goes step by step.

examples.text: 高铁列车不仅速度快而且很平稳，车上还能充电和无线上网。总之，坐高铁又快又舒服。
examples.translation: gāo tiě liè chē bù jǐn sù dù kuài ér qiě hěn píng wěn chē shàng hái néng chōng diàn hé wú xiàn shàng wǎng zǒng zhī zuò gāo tiě yòu kuài yòu shū fú — Item 5: High-speed trains are not only fast but also very smooth, and on board you can also charge your phone and use wireless Internet. In short, taking the high-speed train is both fast and comfortable.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. In Chinese, brainstorm the advantages and/or disadvantages of one of the following topics: 用手机; 住学校宿舍 vs. 住在校外; 参加陆军/海军/空军; 参加旅行团/自驾游/自由行. B. Write a short paragraph about the topic using 总之 to conclude your thoughts. My sample:

examples.text: 用手机有很多好处。我们可以用手机打电话，上网，买东西，还可以付钱。可是手机也有坏处，我们常常看手机看得太久，眼睛不舒服，也少了和家人朋友说话的时间。总之，手机很方便，但是我们要用得合适。
examples.translation: yòng shǒu jī yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù wǒ men kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī dǎ diàn huà shàng wǎng mǎi dōng xī hái kě yǐ fù qián kě shì shǒu jī yě yǒu huài chù wǒ men cháng cháng kàn shǒu jī kàn de tài jiǔ yǎn jīng bù shū fú yě shǎo le hé jiā rén péng yǒu shuō huà de shí jiān zǒng zhī shǒu jī hěn fāng biàn dàn shì wǒ men yào yòng de hé shì — Activity 7B (my sample paragraph on 用手机): Using a phone has many benefits. We can use it to make calls, go online, buy things and even pay. But phones also have drawbacks: we often look at them too long, our eyes feel uncomfortable, and we have less time to talk with family and friends. In short, phones are very convenient, but we should use them appropriately.

exercises.prompt: Where does 总之 usually come?
options: At the end, to summarize or conclude

exercises.prompt: What does the pattern say follows 总之?
Which conclusion fits “你喜欢弹吉他。他喜欢唱歌。我喜欢跳舞。”?
options: 总之每个人都有自己喜欢的爱好

exercises.prompt: Which conclusion fits “学习要努力，工作要努力，生活也要努力”?
options: 总之每件事情都要努力才能做好

exercises.prompt: Which conclusion fits the sentences about teachers, doctors and bosses?
options: 总之人人都有不错的工作

exercises.prompt: Which conclusion fits sentences about ordering takeout and meals online?
options: 总之，现在想吃什么都很方便

exercises.prompt: 学习要努力，工作要努力。___之每件事情都要努力才能做好。
高铁列车不仅速度快而___很平稳。

lessons.title: 687. Lesson 26 Presentation 3 skill integration: Chinese tourists, a graduation trip and weddings abroad
lessons.subtitle: 吸引 打卡 · 中国游客扫货 · 毕业旅行 · 难忘 婚礼 新人 · 到国外结婚 · 神话和事实

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and answer the questions: 1. What does the number 1.6 refer to in the first paragraph? 2. What are two things Chinese tourists tend to purchase abroad? 3. What are three kinds of services do other countries offer to Chinese tourists? 4. What does the author conclude about Chinese tourists today? B. Relate your answers to a partner in Chinese. C. Discuss with your partner in Chinese the differences and similarities between this passage and Presentation 3, then fill in the table. The passage, my answers and my table:

tables.title: Activity 1: new vocabulary

rows: 都说中国人出国旅游越来越多，购物是重要的活动，各国都有特色的旅游
这篇说中国游客最愿意花钱，各国推出吸引他们的服务；第三篇课文说旅游的方式和目的越来越多种多样
都说现在中国人更喜欢有特色的旅游
这篇说的是出境游客人数和购物单；第三篇课文说的是旅游的方式和目的
tables.title: Activity 1C: my table of similarities and differences (the book’s is blank)

examples.text: 近几年来，有越来越多中国人到国外去旅游。二零一九年中国出境游客人数已经达到一点六亿，而且中国游客也是各国游客中最愿意花钱的。对中国人来说，出国旅游最重要的行程之一就是购物。只要有中国游客的地方，你常会看到他们在疯狂地扫货，日本的电器品、法国的名牌包、意大利的名牌服装都是他们购物单上一定得买的东西。为了这些中国客人，各国也推出许多吸引他们的服务，比如，提供会说中文的服务员，旅馆接送服务，用手机付款，送来店礼什么的。不过随着中国人出国旅游的经验越来越丰富，最近中国游客不再只是购物或是在景点打卡了。现在他们更喜欢有特色，高质量的旅游。对他们来说，体验外国文化，认识世界才是旅行的真正目的。
examples.translation: jìn jǐ nián lái yǒu yuè lái yuè duō zhōng guó rén dào guó wài qù lǚ yóu èr líng yī jiǔ nián zhōng guó chū jìng yóu kè rén shù yǐ jīng dá dào yì diǎn liù yì ér qiě zhōng guó yóu kè yě shì gè guó yóu kè zhōng zuì yuàn yì huā qián de duì zhōng guó rén lái shuō chū guó lǚ yóu zuì zhòng yào de xíng chéng zhī yí jiù shì gòu wù zhǐ yào yǒu zhōng guó yóu kè de dì fāng nǐ cháng huì kàn dào tā men zài fēng kuáng de sǎo huò rì běn de diàn qì pǐn fǎ guó de míng pái bāo yì dà lì de míng pái fú zhuāng dōu shì tā men gòu wù dān shàng yí dìng děi mǎi de dōng xī wèi le zhè xiē zhōng guó kè rén gè guó yě tuī chū xǔ duō xī yǐn tā men de fú wù bǐ rú tí gōng huì shuō zhōng wén de fú wù yuán lǚ guǎn jiē sòng fú wù yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn sòng lái diàn lǐ shén me de bú guò suí zhe zhōng guó rén chū guó lǚ yóu de jīng yàn yuè lái yuè fēng fù zuì jìn zhōng guó yóu kè bú zài zhǐ shì gòu wù huò shì zài jǐng diǎn dǎ kǎ le xiàn zài tā men gèng xǐ huān yǒu tè sè gāo zhì liàng de lǚ yóu duì tā men lái shuō tǐ yàn wài guó wén huà rèn shí shì jiè cái shì lǚ xíng de zhēn zhèng mù dì — In recent years more and more Chinese people travel abroad. In 2019 the number of Chinese outbound tourists had already reached 160 million, and Chinese tourists are also the most willing to spend money among tourists from all countries. For Chinese people, one of the most important parts of the itinerary of travel abroad is shopping. Wherever there are Chinese tourists, you often see them shopping like mad: Japanese electrical goods, French brand-name bags and Italian brand-name clothing are all things on their shopping lists that they must buy. For these Chinese guests, countries have also introduced many services that attract them, for example Chinese-speaking waiters, hotel pickup service, mobile payment and welcome gifts. But as Chinese people’s experience of travel abroad becomes richer, recently Chinese tourists no longer only shop or check in at scenic spots. Now they prefer distinctive, high-quality travel. For them, experiencing foreign culture and getting to know the world is the real purpose of travel. (the book writes 2019 and 1.6 in digits)

examples.text: 二零一九年中国出境游客的人数是一点六亿。
examples.translation: èr líng yī jiǔ nián zhōng guó chū jìng yóu kè de rén shù shì yì diǎn liù yì — Activity 1A-1 (my answer): The 1.6 refers to the 160 million Chinese outbound tourists in 2019.

examples.text: 日本的电器品和法国的名牌包，还有意大利的名牌服装。
examples.translation: rì běn de diàn qì pǐn hé fǎ guó de míng pái bāo hái yǒu yì dà lì de míng pái fú zhuāng — 1A-2 (my answer): Japanese electrical goods and French brand-name bags (also Italian brand-name clothing).

examples.text: 会说中文的服务员，旅馆接送服务，用手机付款，送来店礼。
examples.translation: huì shuō zhōng wén de fú wù yuán lǚ guǎn jiē sòng fú wù yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn sòng lái diàn lǐ — 1A-3 (my answer): Chinese-speaking waiters, hotel pickup service, mobile payment, welcome gifts (any three).

examples.text: 现在中国游客更喜欢有特色、高质量的旅游，体验外国文化，认识世界才是旅行的真正目的。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zhōng guó yóu kè gèng xǐ huān yǒu tè sè gāo zhì liàng de lǚ yóu tǐ yàn wài guó wén huà rèn shí shì jiè cái shì lǚ xíng de zhēn zhèng mù dì — 1A-4 (my answer): Chinese tourists now prefer distinctive, high-quality travel; experiencing foreign culture and getting to know the world is the real purpose of travel.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and answer the questions: 1. What are two things 美华 did recently? 2. What does she plan to do next? 3. What are three services the company mentioned provides? 4. What special or extra services does this company provide? B. Relate your answers to a partner in Chinese. C. Write a class graduation trip plan with your partner in Chinese, then post it on a class website. D. As a class, decide on the best plan in Chinese. (The dialog is audio and not in the book; my sample plan follows.)

examples.text: 我们班打算毕业旅行去海岛。先去机场坐飞机，到了海岛以后，大家住民宿，白天在海边玩，晚上一起做饭。第一天休息，第二天潜水，第三天逛农贸市场，第四天坐飞机回家。总之，这次旅行不贵，也很好玩。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān dǎ suàn bì yè lǚ xíng qù hǎi dǎo xiān qù jī chǎng zuò fēi jī dào le hǎi dǎo yǐ hòu dà jiā zhù mín sù bái tiān zài hǎi biān wán wǎn shàng yì qǐ zuò fàn dì yī tiān xiū xī dì èr tiān qián shuǐ dì sān tiān guàng nóng mào shì chǎng dì sì tiān zuò fēi jī huí jiā zǒng zhī zhè cì lǚ xíng bú guì yě hěn hǎo wán — Activity 2C (my sample class graduation trip plan; the dialog about 美华 in 2A is audio and not in the book): Our class plans to go to an island for the graduation trip. First we fly from the airport; once on the island everyone stays in a homestay, plays at the seaside in the daytime and cooks together in the evening. The first day we rest, the second day we dive, the third day we stroll through the farmers’ market, and the fourth day we fly home. In short, this trip is not expensive and is a lot of fun.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and summarize it. B. Based on the passage content, write three questions in Chinese to ask a partner, then take turns asking and answering. C. Other than the U.S., what country would you consider getting married in and why? Discuss with your partner in Chinese. The passage, my summary and my questions:

tables.title: Activity 3: new vocabulary

examples.text: 有越来越多中国年轻人选择到国外结婚，虽然在国外结婚不一定便宜，但是可以有一个比较难忘的婚礼，而且还可以游览国外美丽的风景。结婚前半年到一年，他们会先找婚礼代办公司帮他们计划和安排海外结婚的手续。新人们会在婚礼前一到两天到达，休息几天后，他们会先在几个有名的风景点拍结婚照，然后办婚礼。婚礼以后，他们会在当地度蜜月。有时候也会租车到处看看。几个最近比较热门的海外结婚地点包括欧洲、海岛、澳洲和新西兰。海岛婚礼一般比欧洲或澳、新便宜，所以很多打算邀请家人朋友参加的新人会选择这样的地方。澳洲、新西兰有美丽的高山和大湖，去欧洲能体验丰富的文化生活，每对新人可以按他们的需要做选择。总之，出国结婚的选择多种多样，只要你有钱，都可以办到。
examples.translation: yǒu yuè lái yuè duō zhōng guó nián qīng rén xuǎn zé dào guó wài jié hūn suī rán zài guó wài jié hūn bù yí dìng pián yi dàn shì kě yǐ yǒu yí gè bǐ jiào nán wàng de hūn lǐ ér qiě hái kě yǐ yóu lǎn guó wài měi lì de fēng jǐng jié hūn qián bàn nián dào yì nián tā men huì xiān zhǎo hūn lǐ dài bàn gōng sī bāng tā men jì huà hé ān pái hǎi wài jié hūn de shǒu xù xīn rén men huì zài hūn lǐ qián yí dào liǎng tiān dào dá xiū xī jǐ tiān hòu tā men huì xiān zài jǐ gè yǒu míng de fēng jǐng diǎn pāi jié hūn zhào rán hòu bàn hūn lǐ hūn lǐ yǐ hòu tā men huì zài dāng dì dù mì yuè yǒu shí hòu yě huì zū chē dào chù kàn kàn jǐ gè zuì jìn bǐ jiào rè mén de hǎi wài jié hūn dì diǎn bāo kuò ōu zhōu hǎi dǎo ào zhōu hé xīn xī lán hǎi dǎo hūn lǐ yì bān bǐ ōu zhōu huò ào xīn pián yi suǒ yǐ hěn duō dǎ suàn yāo qǐng jiā rén péng yǒu cān jiā de xīn rén huì xuǎn zé zhè yàng de dì fāng ào zhōu xīn xī lán yǒu měi lì de gāo shān hé dà hú qù ōu zhōu néng tǐ yàn fēng fù de wén huà shēng huó měi duì xīn rén kě yǐ àn tā men de xū yào zuò xuǎn zé zǒng zhī chū guó jié hūn de xuǎn zé duō zhǒng duō yàng zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu qián dōu kě yǐ bàn dào — More and more young Chinese people choose to get married abroad. Although marrying abroad is not necessarily cheap, they can have a rather unforgettable wedding and also tour the beautiful scenery abroad. Half a year to a year before the wedding they first find a wedding-planning agency to help them plan and arrange the procedures for marrying overseas. The couple arrive one to two days before the wedding, and after resting a few days they first take wedding photos at several famous scenic spots and then hold the wedding. After the wedding they spend their honeymoon locally and sometimes also rent a car to look around. A few recently popular overseas wedding places include Europe, islands, Australia and New Zealand. Island weddings are generally cheaper than Europe or Australia and New Zealand, so many couples who plan to invite family and friends choose such places. Australia and New Zealand have beautiful high mountains and big lakes, and going to Europe lets you experience a rich cultural life; each couple can choose according to their needs. In short, the choices for marrying abroad are many and varied, and as long as you have money, you can do it. (the book writes 1-2 in digits)

examples.text: 越来越多中国年轻人到国外结婚，因为可以有难忘的婚礼，还可以游览风景。他们先找代办公司安排手续，到了以后先拍结婚照，再办婚礼，然后度蜜月。海岛便宜，澳洲、新西兰风景美，欧洲文化丰富。
examples.translation: yuè lái yuè duō zhōng guó nián qīng rén dào guó wài jié hūn yīn wèi kě yǐ yǒu nán wàng de hūn lǐ hái kě yǐ yóu lǎn fēng jǐng tā men xiān zhǎo dài bàn gōng sī ān pái shǒu xù dào le yǐ hòu xiān pāi jié hūn zhào zài bàn hūn lǐ rán hòu dù mì yuè hǎi dǎo pián yi ào zhōu xīn xī lán fēng jǐng měi ōu zhōu wén huà fēng fù — Activity 3A (my summary): More and more young Chinese people marry abroad, because they can have an unforgettable wedding and see the scenery. They first find an agency to arrange the procedures, and after arriving first take wedding photos, then hold the wedding and then go on honeymoon. Islands are cheap, Australia and New Zealand have beautiful scenery, and Europe has a rich culture.

examples.text: 他们为什么选择到国外结婚？

examples.text: 因为可以有一个比较难忘的婚礼，还可以游览国外美丽的风景。

examples.text: 结婚前半年到一年，新人们先做什么？
examples.translation: jié hūn qián bàn nián dào yì nián xīn rén men xiān zuò shén me — Q2: Half a year to a year before the wedding, what do the couple do first?

examples.text: 他们先找婚礼代办公司帮他们计划和安排海外结婚的手续。
examples.translation: tā men xiān zhǎo hūn lǐ dài bàn gōng sī bāng tā men jì huà hé ān pái hǎi wài jié hūn de shǒu xù — A2: They first find a wedding-planning agency to help plan and arrange the procedures.

examples.text: 为什么很多人选择海岛婚礼？
examples.translation: wèi shén me hěn duō rén xuǎn zé hǎi dǎo hūn lǐ — Q3: Why do many people choose island weddings?

examples.text: 因为海岛婚礼一般比欧洲或澳、新便宜，适合邀请家人朋友参加。
examples.translation: yīn wèi hǎi dǎo hūn lǐ yì bān bǐ ōu zhōu huò ào xīn pián yi shì hé yāo qǐng jiā rén péng yǒu cān jiā — A3: Because island weddings are generally cheaper than Europe or Australia and New Zealand and suit couples who invite family and friends.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the first two of four audios about Chinese tourist habits, while a partner listens to the last two. Then fill in your parts of the table with which habits are myths and which are true (Myth and Truth, rows 1 to 4). B. Convey your information to your partner in Chinese so they can fill in the rest of their table. C. Read the statements below and mark them true or false based on the audios. D. Discuss with your partner in Chinese what information most surprised you and why. (Audio; the four statements are:)

examples.text: 年轻的中国游客喜欢自由行，也比较常用移动支付。
examples.translation: nián qīng de zhōng guó yóu kè xǐ huān zì yóu xíng yě bǐ jiào cháng yòng yí dòng zhī fù — Activity 4C, statement 1: Young Chinese tourists like independent travel and also use mobile payment more often.

examples.text: 中国游客常去美国和欧洲购物，吃美食。
examples.translation: zhōng guó yóu kè cháng qù měi guó hé ōu zhōu gòu wù chī měi shí — Statement 2: Chinese tourists often go to America and Europe to shop and eat delicacies.

examples.text: 旅行团并没有因为自由行受欢迎而降温。
examples.translation: lǚ xíng tuán bìng méi yǒu yīn wèi zì yóu xíng shòu huān yíng ér jiàng wēn — Statement 3: Tour groups have not cooled down because independent travel is popular.

examples.text: 中国人参加旅行团多半是因为价钱便宜而且会安排吃美食。
examples.translation: zhōng guó rén cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán duō bàn shì yīn wèi jià qián pián yi ér qiě huì ān pái chī měi shí — Statement 4: Chinese people join tour groups mostly because the price is cheap and meals of delicacies are arranged. (true or false depends on the four audios, which are not in the book, so there is no key)
