explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the following instructions, then fill in the bubbles and boxes (Main Idea and Elaboration for 第一步, 第二步, 第三步, 第四步) to create a concept map. B. Using your concept map, tell the instructions to a partner in Chinese. C. Think of a road trip or foreign travel experience. Use the above format to instruct your partner on how to prepare for such a trip. Your partner will draw a concept map based on your instructions. The instructions and my concept map:

rows: 决定去哪里，去几天，安排路线
收拾行李，准备路上吃的和用的东西
上网查路上有意思的风景点或名胜古迹，晚上住在哪里，按照这些信息安排路线
没有车就跟租车公司预定，租一台适合的车；不想住旅馆就租房车睡在车上
先查天气，会下雨就带雨衣；带小吃和水；准备常用药
检查车子，带上地图，为手机充电，随时打电话找人帮忙；告诉家人路线，让他们放心
tables.title: Activity 1A: my concept map (the book’s bubbles and boxes are blank)

examples.text: 要是你想在美国开车自驾游很容易，但是出发前你得做一些准备。你得先决定你想去哪里，要去几天。你可以上网查一下，路上有哪些有意思的风景点或名胜古迹，晚上可以住在哪里。按照这些信息，你可以安排你的路线。安排好你的旅游路线后，你得准备你的车子，如果你没有自己的车，你可以跟租车公司预定，租一台适合你的车。如果你不想花太多钱住旅馆，你也可以租一辆房车睡在车上。接下来，你得收拾行李，准备路上吃的和用的东西。收拾行李以前最好查一下天气，如果会下雨，别忘了带雨衣。另外，在美国自驾游，在路上的时间很长，而且路上不一定能找到餐厅，所以最好带一些小吃和水。有时候在路上也会生病，所以最好也准备一些常用药。最后出发前，别忘了检查你的车子，带上地图，为你的手机充电，这样要是路上有什么问题，你可以随时打电话找人帮忙。另外，别忘了也告诉你的家人你的路线，让他们放心。
examples.translation: yào shì nǐ xiǎng zài měi guó kāi chē zì jià yóu hěn róng yì dàn shì chū fā qián nǐ děi zuò yì xiē zhǔn bèi nǐ děi xiān jué dìng nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ yào qù jǐ tiān nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng chá yí xià lù shàng yǒu nǎ xiē yǒu yì si de fēng jǐng diǎn huò míng shèng gǔ jì wǎn shàng kě yǐ zhù zài nǎ lǐ àn zhào zhè xiē xìn xī nǐ kě yǐ ān pái nǐ de lù xiàn ān pái hǎo nǐ de lǚ yóu lù xiàn hòu nǐ děi zhǔn bèi nǐ de chē zi rú guǒ nǐ méi yǒu zì jǐ de chē nǐ kě yǐ gēn zū chē gōng sī yù dìng zū yì tái shì hé nǐ de chē rú guǒ nǐ bù xiǎng huā tài duō qián zhù lǚ guǎn nǐ yě kě yǐ zū yí liàng fáng chē shuì zài chē shàng jiē xià lái nǐ děi shōu shí xíng li zhǔn bèi lù shàng chī de hé yòng de dōng xī shōu shí xíng li yǐ qián zuì hǎo chá yí xià tiān qì rú guǒ huì xià yǔ bié wàng le dài yǔ yī lìng wài zài měi guó zì jià yóu zài lù shàng de shí jiān hěn cháng ér qiě lù shàng bù yí dìng néng zhǎo dào cān tīng suǒ yǐ zuì hǎo dài yì xiē xiǎo chī hé shuǐ yǒu shí hòu zài lù shàng yě huì shēng bìng suǒ yǐ zuì hǎo yě zhǔn bèi yì xiē cháng yòng yào zuì hòu chū fā qián bié wàng le jiǎn chá nǐ de chē zi dài shàng dì tú wèi nǐ de shǒu jī chōng diàn zhè yàng yào shì lù shàng yǒu shén me wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ suí shí dǎ diàn huà zhǎo rén bāng máng lìng wài bié wàng le yě gào sù nǐ de jiā rén nǐ de lù xiàn ràng tā men fàng xīn — If you want to take a self-drive tour in America it is easy, but before setting out you have to make some preparations. You have to first decide where you want to go and for how many days. You can look online at which interesting scenic spots or historic sites there are on the way and where you can stay at night. According to this information you can arrange your route. After arranging your route, you have to prepare your car; if you don’t have your own car, you can reserve with a car rental company and rent a car that suits you. If you don’t want to spend too much on hotels, you can also rent an RV and sleep in the car. Next, you have to pack and prepare things to eat and use on the way. Before packing it is best to check the weather; if it will rain, don’t forget to bring a raincoat. In addition, on a self-drive tour in America the time on the road is long and you may not find a restaurant on the road, so it is best to bring some snacks and water. Sometimes you also get sick on the road, so it is best to also prepare some common medicines. Finally, before setting out, don’t forget to check your car, bring a map and charge your phone, so that if there is any problem on the road you can phone for help at any time. In addition, don’t forget to tell your family your route to put their minds at ease.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: You and some Chinese friends decide to go on an island trip. After researching online, you narrow it down to the three postings below. A. Form groups of three. Each member reads a different passage, then tells their partners about it. B. Discuss the pros and cons of each island, then fill in the table. C. Visit two travel sites (the book names 携程旅行 and 无二之旅; the web addresses are left out) to help plan your trip. D. Discuss the following: travel budget, transportation, itinerary, lodging. E. Post your travel plan on a class site, then present it to the class. F. As a class, decide on the best travel plan. The three postings, my table and my sample plan:

rows: 消费低，体验丰富，适合一家老小；水上运动和夜生活多；可以跳岛游
旺季是十一月到四月，其他时候不一定好
有最好的白沙滩，水上运动多，美景美食购物都在沙滩边；有豪华也有便宜的地方
岛不大，旺季只有十一月到二月，停留四天
岛大景点多，适合各种人；有丰富的文化；婚礼和蜜月都很有名
tables.title: Activity 2B: the pros and cons of the three islands (the book’s table is blank)

examples.text: 普吉岛，泰国：消费低，体验丰富，适合一家老小。旺季：十一月到四月。停留时间：四到五天。消费：机票便宜，物价不高。普吉岛特点：普吉发展得很早，有丰富的水上运动和夜生活，可以体验到泰国的文化。附近的几个小岛，包括大小ＰＰ岛、零零七岛等，海水很蓝，选择跳岛游非常不错。
examples.translation: pǔ jí dǎo tài guó xiāo fèi dī tǐ yàn fēng fù shì hé yì jiā lǎo xiǎo wàng jì shí yī yuè dào sì yuè tíng liú shí jiān sì dào wǔ tiān xiāo fèi jī piào pián yi wù jià bù gāo pǔ jí dǎo tè diǎn pǔ jí fā zhǎn de hěn zǎo yǒu fēng fù de shuǐ shàng yùn dòng hé yè shēng huó kě yǐ tǐ yàn dào tài guó de wén huà fù jìn de jǐ gè xiǎo dǎo bāo kuò dà xiǎo dǎo líng líng qī dǎo děng hǎi shuǐ hěn lán xuǎn zé tiào dǎo yóu fēi cháng bú cuò — 1. Phuket, Thailand: low cost, rich experiences, suits a whole family old and young. High season: November to April. Length of stay: four to five days. Cost: air tickets are cheap and prices are not high. Features of Phuket: Phuket developed very early and has rich water sports and nightlife, and you can experience Thai culture. The nearby small islands, including the big and small PP islands and 007 Island, have very blue sea, and an island-hopping tour is very good. (the book adds pinyin and Latin letters and numerals; spelled out here)

examples.text: 长滩岛，菲律宾：最好的白沙滩，超多水上运动。旺季：十一月到二月。停留时间：四天。消费：有豪华也有便宜的地方。长滩岛特点：世界上最有名最好的白沙滩，让长滩岛成为菲律宾最有名的旅游地之一。长滩岛不大，这里的美景、美食、购物、娱乐设施和酒店都在沙滩边。休闲运动成了这里最重要的体验活动。这里的购物街Ｄ－ＭＡＬＬ是整个长滩岛最热闹的地方。“星期五海滩”是长滩岛最美沙滩，在沙滩上散步非常舒服。
examples.translation: cháng tān dǎo fēi lǜ bīn zuì hǎo de bái shā tān chāo duō shuǐ shàng yùn dòng wàng jì shí yī yuè dào èr yuè tíng liú shí jiān sì tiān xiāo fèi yǒu háo huá yě yǒu pián yi de dì fāng cháng tān dǎo tè diǎn shì jiè shàng zuì yǒu míng zuì hǎo de bái shā tān ràng cháng tān dǎo chéng wéi fēi lǜ bīn zuì yǒu míng de lǚ yóu dì zhī yì cháng tān dǎo bú dà zhè lǐ de měi jǐng měi shí gòu wù yú lè shè shī hé jiǔ diàn dōu zài shā tān biān xiū xián yùn dòng chéng le zhè lǐ zuì zhòng yào de tǐ yàn huó dòng zhè lǐ de gòu wù jiē shì zhěng gè cháng tān dǎo zuì rè nào de dì fāng xīng qī wǔ hǎi tān shì cháng tān dǎo zuì měi shā tān zài shā tān shàng sàn bù fēi cháng shū fú — 2. Boracay, the Philippines: the best white sand beach, lots of water sports. High season: November to February. Length of stay: four days. Cost: there are both luxurious and cheap places. Features of Boracay: the world’s most famous and best white sand beach has made Boracay one of the Philippines’ most famous travel destinations. Boracay is not big; the beautiful scenery, delicacies, shopping, entertainment facilities and hotels are all by the beach. Leisure sports have become the most important experience here. The shopping street D-MALL here is the liveliest place on the whole of Boracay. “Friday Beach” is Boracay’s most beautiful beach, and strolling on the sand is very comfortable. (the book writes D-MALL in Latin letters, written here in full-width letters; the book prints the pinyin of 长滩岛 as zhǎngtāndǎo, but the standard reading, Chángtān Dǎo, is used here)

examples.text: 巴厘岛，印尼：岛大景点多，适合各种人，可安排多种多样的行程。旺季：四月到九月。停留时间：四天。消费：机票、酒店价钱贵一点，其他消费不高。巴厘岛特点：巴厘岛比较大，差不多跟国内一个省一样大，开发的比较早，所以有各种景点和水上活动。除了有美丽的海景、山景外，岛上还有丰富的文化。另外，这里也是有名的“婚礼之都”、“蜜月之岛”。不过亲子游、老人的休闲游、和一个人的旅行也很适合来这里。

lessons.title: 690. Lesson 26 Area Studies: Overseas Chinese Students
lessons.subtitle: 玄奘 · 容闳 · 留学生 · 1978年以来的留学 · 美国的中国留学生 · K-12

explanations.title: Overseas Chinese Students (1): Xuanzang and Yung Wing
explanations.body: China has engaged in cultural exchanges with other nations for centuries. One of the most important components of cultural exchange has been study abroad. Since the early 20th century, overseas Chinese students have contributed significantly to both their home and host nations. The first overseas Chinese student of note is Xuanzang (玄奘 Xuánzàng, 602–664), a Tang 唐 Dynasty (618–907) monk who crossed the vast Gobi Desert to study Buddhism in India in 631. He returned to the Tang capital of Chang’an 长安 (西安) in 645 after 18 years of study and travel. From 1847 to 1978, over 130,000 Chinese students studied abroad. Yung Wing (容闳 Róng Hóng, 1828–1912) came to the U.S. in 1847 with two other Chinese students. In 1854, he became the first Chinese student to graduate from an American university, Yale College. He helped China conduct business with the U.S., and brought students from China to study in the U.S. through the Chinese Educational Mission. He went on to become a naturalized American citizen, although his citizenship was later revoked under the Naturalization Act of 1870. (two portraits are not included)

explanations.title: (2) After 1949 and the figures since 1978
explanations.body: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, over 10,000 students studied overseas in the 1950s and 1960s. According to the PRC Ministry of Education, a total of 5.86 million Chinese studied abroad between 1978 and 2018; 4.32 million completed their studies, of which 3.65 million chose to return to China. In 2019, the number of Chinese students studying in the U.S. alone exceeded 1 million. The following table shows the distribution of new Chinese students studying in various countries during the 2018–19 academic year:

tables.title: The distribution of new Chinese students in ten countries during the 2018–19 academic year (the book prints Japan as 107, 269)

explanations.title: (3) Chinese students in the U.S. and fields of study
explanations.body: New Chinese students in the U.S. during the 2018–19 academic year numbered 363,341, a 1.7% increase over the prior year. In all, Chinese students accounted for 33.7% of international students in the U.S. In 2018–19, engineering remained the most popular field of study for overseas Chinese, with 230,780 students accounting for 21.1% of the total number in the U.S. Those studying mathematics and computer science increased by 9.4% over the previous year to 203,461, 18.6% of the U.S. total. Conversely, the number of students studying business administration decreased by 7.1% from the prior year to 182,170, 16.6% of the total.

explanations.title: (4) K-12 students, the effects of study abroad and the resources
explanations.body: In recent years, overseas Chinese K-12 students have been on the rise. In 2018, roughly 85,000 Chinese students enrolled in K-12 programs in the U.S., comprising half of all foreign K-12 students, according to INS, ICE and HSI statistics. Chinese students who have studied abroad continue to affect political, economic, military, technological, educational, social and cultural change and development in China. At the same time, education abroad programs are a valuable channel for the academic exchange of science, technology, medicine and culture between China and other countries, promoting mutual understanding and friendship among nations. Resources (titles only; the web addresses are left out): 40 年赴美留学史; 留学 近代中国的五次浪潮, 北京日报.

explanations.title: Learning objectives of Lesson 27 (New Careers, 新职业)
explanations.body: Upon completion of this lesson, you should be able to: discuss a career as a courier in China, including one’s life and work; discuss the popularity of internet influencers in China, and their impact; discuss China’s e-sports industry and professional e-sports players. To perform the above you must master the new words and phrases in the Core Vocabulary section and these patterns: the rhetorical question 难道……吗; the modal particle 的 (表示附加原因，补充说明); the pattern 跟……似的; the usage of 正是因为……; the pattern 把……叫做……; the discourse function 前解释和后解释; 说到/想到/提到……; the function of 主要是因为……; the usage of 随着……; 认识到/了解到/打听到; the structure 当(职业)需要……(表示条件); the structure 有了……后，…….

examples.text: 小张：特别在“双十一”的时候，快递员的生活就跟打仗似的，每天要送好几百单，连喝水的时间都没有。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng tè bié zài shuāng shí yī de shí hòu kuài dì yuán de shēng huó jiù gēn dǎ zhàng shì de měi tiān yào sòng hǎo jǐ bǎi dān lián hē shuǐ de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu — Xiao Zhang: Especially at “Double Eleven”, a courier’s life is just like a battle; they have to deliver several hundred orders a day with not even time to drink water.

examples.text: 老李：正是因为“快递小哥”的辛苦，我们的生活才变得方便多了。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ zhèng shì yīn wèi kuài dì xiǎo gē de xīn kǔ wǒ men de shēng huó cái biàn de fāng biàn duō le — Lao Li: It is precisely because of the “courier guys’” hard work that our lives have become so much more convenient.

examples.text: 小张：那当然。前两天，我要寄个包裹，一打电话，快递员就上门来收件，第二天包裹就寄到了，你说快不快。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng nà dāng rán qián liǎng tiān wǒ yào jì gè bāo guǒ yì dǎ diàn huà kuài dì yuán jiù shàng mén lái shōu jiàn dì èr tiān bāo guǒ jiù jì dào le nǐ shuō kuài bú kuài — Xiao Zhang: Of course. A couple of days ago I wanted to send a parcel; as soon as I phoned, the courier came to the door to collect it, and the next day the parcel had arrived. Isn’t that fast?

examples.text: 老李：快递既快捷又便利，而且什么东西都可以送。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ kuài dì jì kuài jié yòu biàn lì ér qiě shén me dōng xī dōu kě yǐ sòng — Lao Li: Express delivery is both fast and convenient, and anything can be sent.

examples.text: 小张：是啊。我太太常常在网上买菜买水果，每次下好单后，东西很快就送来了。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng shì a wǒ tài tài cháng cháng zài wǎng shàng mǎi cài mǎi shuǐ guǒ měi cì xià hǎo dān hòu dōng xī hěn kuài jiù sòng lái le — Xiao Zhang: Yes. My wife often buys vegetables and fruit online, and every time after she places the order the things arrive very soon.

examples.text: 老李：“快递小哥”真是我们生活的好帮手啊，可是有的人对快递员很不客气。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ kuài dì xiǎo gē zhēn shì wǒ men shēng huó de hǎo bāng shǒu a kě shì yǒu de rén duì kuài dì yuán hěn bú kè qì — Lao Li: The “courier guys” really are good helpers in our lives, but some people are very impolite to couriers.

examples.text: 小张：对啊，我也听说有人因为送货晚了一会儿，就给快递员差评，而且还说一些难听的话。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng duì a wǒ yě tīng shuō yǒu rén yīn wèi sòng huò wǎn le yí huìr jiù gěi kuài dì yuán chà píng ér qiě hái shuō yì xiē nán tīng de huà — Xiao Zhang: Right, I have also heard that some people, because a delivery was a little late, give the courier a bad review and even say some unpleasant things.

examples.text: 老李：这些人太不尊重“快递小哥”的劳动了。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ zhè xiē rén tài bù zūn zhòng kuài dì xiǎo gē de láo dòng le — Lao Li: These people don’t respect the “courier guys’” labor at all.

examples.text: 小张：下次看到小宋，我们要多鼓励他，希望他成为一个优秀的“快递小哥”。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng xià cì kàn dào xiǎo sòng wǒ men yào duō gǔ lì tā xī wàng tā chéng wéi yí gè yōu xiù de kuài dì xiǎo gē — Xiao Zhang: Next time we see Xiao Song, let’s encourage him more and hope he becomes an excellent “courier guy”.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: listen to Presentation 1 once through and answer the questions. 1. What is the relationship between Xiao Zhang and Lao Li? How do you know? 2. What are they talking about? B. Detailed Listening: listen again and answer: 1. Who is Xiao Song? What is his current occupation? 2. Provide three details about his job. 3. examples.text: 他们可能是邻居，住在同一个小区，老李问小张小区保安小宋去哪儿了。

examples.text: 他们在谈小宋换工作做快递员，快递员的辛苦，快递的方便，还有有的人对快递员不客气。

examples.translation: tā qǐ zǎo tān hēi fēng lǐ lái yǔ lǐ qù měi tiān zài lù shàng pǎo shí duō gè xiǎo shí yuè dào jié jià rì yuè máng shuāng shí yī měi tiān yào sòng hǎo jǐ bǎi dān — 1B-2 (my answer, three details): He works from dawn to night, braving wind and rain, over ten hours on the road a day; the closer to holidays the busier, and at “Double Eleven” he delivers several hundred orders a day.

examples.translation: dǎ gè diàn huà kuài dì yuán jiù shàng mén shōu jiàn dì èr tiān jiù jì dào shén me dōng xī dōu kě yǐ sòng zài wǎng shàng mǎi cài mǎi shuǐ guǒ hěn kuài jiù sòng lái — 1B-3 (my answer, two details): Phone and the courier comes to the door to collect, and it arrives the next day; anything can be sent, and vegetables and fruit bought online arrive soon.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and think of three words that each contain at least one character similar to the characters in the provided words (example: 保安 → 保护, 安全, 安静; then 快递, 送单, 收件, 难听, 帮手, 客气). B. With your partner, discuss the parts of speech of the words you wrote, and translate them into English. My words:

rows: 保护, 安全, 安静
example from the book: n., security guard
快乐, 快速, 传递
送货, 送礼, 简单
收到, 收入, 邮件
困难, 难过, 听力
帮助, 帮忙, 手机

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read the passage and complete the sentences with the words and expressions below: 起早贪黑, 下单, 风里来雨里去, 跑, 便利, 打仗, 双十一, 辛苦, 快捷. B. With your partner, discuss your answers and explain the strategies you used in making your choices. C. Talk about the couriers on the busiest shopping day in the U.S. with your partner. The completed passage (my key):

examples.text: 十一月十一日是快递行业最忙的一天，因为在双十一这天很多人在网上购物。为了能按时把货送给顾客，快递员常常要起早贪黑，早上五点就开始工作，晚上九点才能回家。这一天的生活就跟打仗似的，连吃饭，喝水的时间都没有。虽然他们这天非常忙，在路上要跑十多个小时，风里来雨里去，但是看到顾客收到在网上买的东西后，笑得很开心的样子，快递员们就不觉得辛苦了。正是因为有了“快递小哥”的服务，中国的快递既快捷又便利，有时候顾客早上在网上下单，下午快递员就把货送到了。快递使我们的生活变得越来越方便。
examples.translation: shí yī yuè shí yī rì shì kuài dì háng yè zuì máng de yì tiān yīn wèi zài shuāng shí yī zhè tiān hěn duō rén zài wǎng shàng gòu wù wèi le néng àn shí bǎ huò sòng gěi gù kè kuài dì yuán cháng cháng yào qǐ zǎo tān hēi zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn jiù kāi shǐ gōng zuò wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn cái néng huí jiā zhè yì tiān de shēng huó jiù gēn dǎ zhàng shì de lián chī fàn hē shuǐ de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu suī rán tā men zhè tiān fēi cháng máng zài lù shàng yào pǎo shí duō gè xiǎo shí fēng lǐ lái yǔ lǐ qù dàn shì kàn dào gù kè shōu dào zài wǎng shàng mǎi de dōng xī hòu xiào de hěn kāi xīn de yàng zi kuài dì yuán men jiù bù jué de xīn kǔ le zhèng shì yīn wèi yǒu le kuài dì xiǎo gē de fú wù zhōng guó de kuài dì jì kuài jié yòu biàn lì yǒu shí hòu gù kè zǎo shàng zài wǎng shàng xià dān xià wǔ kuài dì yuán jiù bǎ huò sòng dào le kuài dì shǐ wǒ men de shēng huó biàn de yuè lái yuè fāng biàn — November 11th is the busiest day of the courier industry, because on this day many people shop online. To deliver goods to customers on time, couriers often have to work from dawn to night, starting work at five in the morning and getting home only at nine at night. Life on this day is just like a battle, with not even time to eat and drink. Although they are very busy that day, running more than ten hours on the road, braving wind and rain, when they see customers happy to receive what they bought online, the couriers don’t feel tired any more. It is precisely because of the “courier guys’” service that China’s express delivery is both fast and convenient; sometimes a customer places an order online in the morning and the courier has delivered the goods by the afternoon. Express delivery makes our lives more and more convenient. (my key: 双十一, 起早贪黑, 打仗, 跑, 风里来雨里去, 辛苦, 快捷, 便利, 下单; the book writes 11 月 11 日 in digits)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and use the following words and expressions to talk about couriers in the U.S. with your partner: 难道…吗, 跟打仗似的, 难听, 尊重, 劳动, 鼓励, 差评. Write your notes in the space provided. B. Share your discussion with the class. My sample:

examples.text: 在美国，快递员也很忙，特别是圣诞节前。

examples.text: 难道美国的快递员不辛苦吗？
examples.translation: nán dào měi guó de kuài dì yuán bù xīn kǔ ma — Isn’t the work of U.S. couriers hard?

examples.text: 有的人对快递员不客气，还说一些难听的话，这是不尊重他们的劳动。
examples.translation: yǒu de rén duì kuài dì yuán bú kè qì hái shuō yì xiē nán tīng de huà zhè shì bù zūn zhòng tā men de láo dòng — Some people are impolite to couriers and say unpleasant things, which does not respect their labor.

examples.text: 我们应该多鼓励他们，不要给差评。
examples.translation: wǒ men yīng gāi duō gǔ lì tā men bú yào gěi chà píng — We should encourage them more and not give bad reviews.

lessons.title: 693. Lesson 27 Presentation 1 grammar: the rhetorical question 难道…吗
lessons.subtitle: 难道你不知道他换工作了吗 · 难道你喜欢她 · 难道你忘了吗 · 难道你不想家吗 · 难道你不累吗

explanations.title: The Rhetorical Question 难道……吗
explanations.body: 难道 can be used in a rhetorical question to strengthen the tone. It can be placed before the subject or after the subject. 难道 can be used to turn a general, “yes/no” question into a rhetorical question; 吗 can be omitted. Pattern: 难道 + rhetorical question; 难道 + general question = rhetorical question.

rows: 难道 strengthens the tone of a rhetorical question and can be placed before or after the subject
难道 + general question = rhetorical question
tables.title: The Rhetorical Question 难道……吗

examples.text: 你不知道他换工作了吗？
examples.translation: nǐ bù zhī dào tā huàn gōng zuò le ma — 1. (a regular rhetorical question) Don’t you know he changed jobs?

examples.text: 难道你不知道他换工作了吗？
examples.translation: nán dào nǐ bù zhī dào tā huàn gōng zuò le ma — 2. (a rhetorical question with stronger tone) Don’t you know he changed jobs? (stronger)

examples.text: 你喜欢她吗？
examples.translation: nǐ xǐ huān tā ma — 1. (general question) Do you like her?

examples.text: 难道你喜欢她？
examples.translation: nán dào nǐ xǐ huān tā — 2. (rhetorical question; 吗 can be omitted) Could it be that you like her?

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and rewrite these general questions as rhetorical questions, using 难道: 1. 大卫写完作业了吗？ 2. 快递员送错包裹了吗？ 3. 琳达的爸爸是军人吗？ 4. 快递员可以来顾客家里收件吗？ 5. 当快递员比当保安辛苦吗？ B. With your partner, read the rhetorical questions in Step A and translate them into English. Together, discuss how the meaning changes when these sentences are cast as rhetorical questions. My key (the question turns from a plain request for information into a doubting or surprised remark):

examples.text: 难道大卫写完作业了吗？
examples.translation: nán dào dà wèi xiě wán zuò yè le ma — 1. (my key) Could David have finished his homework?

examples.text: 难道快递员送错包裹了吗？
examples.translation: nán dào kuài dì yuán sòng cuò bāo guǒ le ma — 2. (my key) Could the courier have delivered the wrong parcel?

examples.text: 难道琳达的爸爸是军人吗？
examples.translation: nán dào lín dá de bà bà shì jūn rén ma — 3. (my key) Could Linda’s father be a soldier?

examples.text: 难道快递员可以来顾客家里收件吗？
examples.translation: nán dào kuài dì yuán kě yǐ lái gù kè jiā lǐ shōu jiàn ma — 4. (my key) Could couriers really come to a customer’s home to collect parcels?

examples.text: 难道当快递员比当保安辛苦吗？
examples.translation: nán dào dāng kuài dì yuán bǐ dāng bǎo ān xīn kǔ ma — 5. (my key) Could being a courier really be harder than being a guard?

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the following dialogs. Write the rhetorical questions using 难道 in the spaces provided. B. Pair up and discuss the meanings of the rhetorical questions with 难道 in these audios and translate them into English. The six dialogs as printed, with my completions of the blanks:

examples.text: 甲：你会说中文吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ huì shuō zhōng wén ma — 1. A: Do you speak Chinese?

examples.text: 乙：对不起，我不会说。
examples.translation: yǐ duì bù qǐ wǒ bú huì shuō — B: Sorry, I don’t.

examples.text: 甲：难道你是美国人吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nán dào nǐ shì měi guó rén ma — A (my completion of the blank): Could you be an American?

examples.text: 乙：不是，我是韩国人。
examples.translation: yǐ bú shì wǒ shì hán guó rén — B: No, I am Korean.

examples.text: 安娜：比尔，这个字是什么意思？
examples.translation: ān nà bǐ ěr zhè ge zì shì shén me yì si — 2. Anna: Bill, what does this character mean?

examples.text: 比尔：安娜，这不是“祝”字吗？我们昨天才学的，难道你忘了吗？
examples.translation: bǐ ěr ān nà zhè bú shì zhù zì ma wǒ men zuó tiān cái xué de nán dào nǐ wàng le ma — Bill: Anna, isn’t this the character 祝? We only learned it yesterday; could you have forgotten? (my completion)

examples.text: 安娜：现在想起来了。昨天我们还一起庆祝你的生日呢。
examples.translation: ān nà xiàn zài xiǎng qǐ lái le zuó tiān wǒ men hái yì qǐ qìng zhù nǐ de shēng rì ne — Anna: I remember now. Yesterday we even celebrated your birthday together.

examples.text: 珍妮：李军，你有多久没回中国了？
examples.translation: zhēn nī lǐ jūn nǐ yǒu duō jiǔ méi huí zhōng guó le — 3. Jenny: Li Jun, how long has it been since you went back to China?

examples.text: 李军：差不多三年没回去了。
examples.translation: lǐ jūn chà bu duō sān nián méi huí qù le — Li Jun: Almost three years.

examples.text: 珍妮：这么久啊。难道你不想家吗？
examples.translation: zhēn nī zhè me jiǔ a nán dào nǐ bù xiǎng jiā ma — Jenny: That long! Could you not be homesick? (my completion)

examples.text: 李军：想啊，可是我工作太忙，走不开啊。
examples.translation: lǐ jūn xiǎng a kě shì wǒ gōng zuò tài máng zǒu bù kāi a — Li Jun: I am, but I’m too busy with work to get away.

examples.text: 王红：小丽，都已经十二点多了，你怎么还不去食堂吃午饭呢？难道你不饿吗？
examples.translation: wáng hóng xiǎo lì dōu yǐ jīng shí èr diǎn duō le nǐ zěn me hái bú qù shí táng chī wǔ fàn ne nán dào nǐ bú è ma — 4. Wang Hong: Xiao Li, it is already past twelve; why haven’t you gone to the cafeteria for lunch? Could you not be hungry? (my completion)

examples.text: 小丽：王红，你先去吃吧。我得把这个邮件写完发出去再去。
examples.translation: xiǎo lì wáng hóng nǐ xiān qù chī ba wǒ děi bǎ zhè ge yóu jiàn xiě wán fā chū qù zài qù — Xiao Li: Wang Hong, you go first. I have to finish writing this email and send it before I go.

examples.text: 张英：大卫，我做了这么多菜，可是你吃得很少，难道不好吃吗？
examples.translation: zhāng yīng dà wèi wǒ zuò le zhè me duō cài kě shì nǐ chī de hěn shǎo nán dào bù hǎo chī ma — 5. Zhang Ying: David, I made so many dishes, but you eat very little; could it be that it doesn’t taste good? (my completion)

examples.text: 大卫：张英，你的手艺很好，菜很好吃，不过，我这几天胃有点儿不舒服。
examples.translation: dà wèi zhāng yīng nǐ de shǒu yì hěn hǎo cài hěn hǎo chī bú guò wǒ zhè jǐ tiān wèi yǒu diǎnr bù shū fú — David: Zhang Ying, your cooking is very good and the food is tasty, but my stomach has been a little upset these days.

examples.text: 周阳：彼得，你在中国呆了一个月，难道没学会用筷子吗？
examples.translation: zhōu yáng bǐ dé nǐ zài zhōng guó dāi le yí gè yuè nán dào méi xué huì yòng kuài zi ma — 6. Zhou Yang: Peter, you stayed in China for a month; could you not have learned to use chopsticks? (my completion)

examples.text: 彼得：在中国时，我常常用筷子吃饭，可是回到美国后，我就不习惯用了。
examples.translation: bǐ dé zài zhōng guó shí wǒ cháng cháng yòng kuài zi chī fàn kě shì huí dào měi guó hòu wǒ jiù bù xí guàn yòng le — Peter: In China I often ate with chopsticks, but after returning to America I got out of the habit.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and complete the dialogs with rhetorical questions using 难道. B. With your partner, discuss how you were able to complete this task. Practice the dialogs with your partner. The example, then my completions:

examples.text: 甲：这篇课文昨天学过了，难道你看不懂吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè piān kè wén zuó tiān xué guò le nán dào nǐ kàn bù dǒng ma — Example: A: We studied this text yesterday; could it be you can’t understand it?

examples.text: 乙：昨天我生病了，没来上课，所以我看不懂。
examples.translation: yǐ zuó tiān wǒ shēng bìng le méi lái shàng kè suǒ yǐ wǒ kàn bù dǒng — B: Yesterday I was ill and missed class, so I can’t understand it.

examples.text: 甲：难道快递员会送错包裹吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nán dào kuài dì yuán huì sòng cuò bāo guǒ ma — 1. A (my completion): Could the courier deliver the wrong parcel?

examples.text: 乙：快递员不会送错包裹的，你再等等吧。
examples.translation: yǐ kuài dì yuán bú huì sòng cuò bāo guǒ de nǐ zài děng děng ba — B: The courier won’t deliver the wrong parcel; wait a bit longer.

examples.text: 甲：难道你忘了我的生日吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ nán dào nǐ wàng le wǒ de shēng rì ma — 2. A (my completion): Could you have forgotten my birthday?

examples.text: 乙：对不起，我最近工作太忙，没有想起来你的生日。
examples.translation: yǐ duì bù qǐ wǒ zuì jìn gōng zuò tài máng méi yǒu xiǎng qǐ lái nǐ de shēng rì — B: Sorry, I have been too busy with work recently and didn’t remember your birthday.

examples.text: 甲：已经这么晚了，难道你明天不用上班吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ yǐ jīng zhè me wǎn le nán dào nǐ míng tiān bú yòng shàng bān ma — 3. A (my completion): It is already so late; don’t you have to work tomorrow?

examples.text: 乙：今天我晚一点回家，明天公司放假，不用上班。
examples.translation: yǐ jīn tiān wǒ wǎn yì diǎn huí jiā míng tiān gōng sī fàng jià bú yòng shàng bān — B: Today I’ll get home a little later; the company has a holiday tomorrow and there is no work.

examples.text: 甲：“双十一”网上有很多优惠，难道你不想买吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ shuāng shí yī wǎng shàng yǒu hěn duō yōu huì nán dào nǐ bù xiǎng mǎi ma — 4. A (my completion): There are many discounts online at “Double Eleven”; don’t you want to buy?

examples.text: 乙：“双十一”网上有优惠也不行，我妈不让我买。
examples.translation: yǐ shuāng shí yī wǎng shàng yǒu yōu huì yě bù xíng wǒ mā bú ràng wǒ mǎi — B: Even with online discounts at “Double Eleven” it’s no good; my mom won’t let me buy.

examples.text: 甲：今天晚上咱们出去放松一下吧。你想去哪儿玩啊？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān wǎn shàng zán men chū qù fàng sōng yí xià ba nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr wán a — 5. A: Let’s go out and relax tonight. Where do you want to go?

examples.text: 乙：难道你不累吗？
examples.translation: yǐ nán dào nǐ bú lèi ma — B (my completion): Aren’t you tired?

exercises.prompt: What does 难道 do in a question?
options: It strengthens the tone, making it rhetorical

exercises.prompt: Where can 难道 be placed?
Can 吗 be omitted after 难道?
Which is the rhetorical version of 你喜欢她吗?
What does 难道你不知道他换工作了吗 express?
Which fits the blank: “你会说中文吗？ … 不是，我是韩国人。”?
Which fits the blank after “差不多三年没回去了。这么久啊。”?
Which fits “这篇课文昨天学过了，___”?

exercises.explanation: 难道: could it be that.

exercises.prompt: 难道快递员送错包裹了___？

lessons.title: 694. Lesson 27 Presentation 1 grammar: the modal particle 的 and the pattern 跟…似的
lessons.subtitle: 起早贪黑的 · 挺辛苦的 · 好得跟亲兄弟似的 · 跟打仗似的 · 好像…似的 · 红得跟苹果似的

explanations.title: The Modal Particle 的 (表示附加原因，解释说明)
explanations.body: The particle 的 is most often a structural particle, but it can also be used as a modal particle after a statement that provides an added explanation of what the speaker is saying. Pattern: Statement, …….的

rows: the particle 的 is most often a structural particle, but it can also be used as a modal particle after a statement that provides an added explanation of what the speaker is saying
tables.title: The Modal Particle 的 (表示附加原因，解释说明)

examples.text: 当快递员可比保安辛苦多了，起早贪黑的。
examples.translation: dāng kuài dì yuán kě bǐ bǎo ān xīn kǔ duō le qǐ zǎo tān hēi de — 1. Being a courier is much harder than being a guard, working from dawn to night.

examples.text: 我们得天天去操场集合，挺辛苦的。
examples.translation: wǒ men děi tiān tiān qù cāo chǎng jí hé tǐng xīn kǔ de — 2. We have to gather on the sports ground every day; it’s quite tiring.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and complete the sentences with the modal particle 的 (words in the box: 起早贪黑, 风里来雨里去, 便利, 辛苦, 快捷, 麻烦, 方便, 容易, 客气). B. With your partner, read the sentences aloud and translate them into English. My key:

examples.text: 快递员每天在路上要跑十多个小时，风里来雨里去的。
examples.translation: kuài dì yuán měi tiān zài lù shàng yào pǎo shí duō gè xiǎo shí fēng lǐ lái yǔ lǐ qù de — 1. (my key) Couriers run more than ten hours on the road every day, braving wind and rain.

examples.text: 现在寄包裹，快递员可以到你家里收件，挺方便的。
examples.translation: xiàn zài jì bāo guǒ kuài dì yuán kě yǐ dào nǐ jiā lǐ shōu jiàn tǐng fāng biàn de — 2. (my key) Now to send a parcel the courier can come to your home to collect it; it’s quite convenient.

examples.text: “快递小哥”每天要很早起来送货，晚上很晚才回家，起早贪黑的。
examples.translation: kuài dì xiǎo gē měi tiān yào hěn zǎo qǐ lái sòng huò wǎn shàng hěn wǎn cái huí jiā qǐ zǎo tān hēi de — 3. (my key) “Courier guys” get up very early every day to deliver and get home very late, working from dawn to night.

examples.text: 节假日时，快递员每天要送好几百单，挺辛苦的。
examples.translation: jié jià rì shí kuài dì yuán měi tiān yào sòng hǎo jǐ bǎi dān tǐng xīn kǔ de — 4. (my key) On holidays couriers deliver several hundred orders a day; it’s quite hard.

examples.text: 有些人给快递员差评，还说一些难听的话，挺不客气的。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē rén gěi kuài dì yuán chà píng hái shuō yì xiē nán tīng de huà tǐng bú kè qì de — 5. (my key) Some people give couriers bad reviews and say unpleasant things; that’s quite impolite.

examples.text: 以前我每天都去市场买菜，很麻烦的。现在我只在网上买。
examples.translation: yǐ qián wǒ měi tiān dōu qù shì chǎng mǎi cài hěn má fán de xiàn zài wǒ zhǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi — 6. (my key) I used to go to the market to buy vegetables every day, which was a lot of trouble. Now I only buy online. (unused words in the box: 便利, 快捷, 容易)

explanations.title: The Pattern 跟……似的
explanations.body: 跟……似的 expresses that something is similar to something else, very much the same as 像……一样. This pattern is often used in metaphors or similes. Pattern: 跟 + Noun/Pronoun/Verb/Sentence + 似的. 好像……似的 can replace 跟……似的 to express “it seems (as though)”: 好像 + Noun/Pronoun/Verb/Sentence + 似的.

rows: expresses that something is similar to something else, very much the same as 像……一样; often used in metaphors or similes
好像……似的 can replace 跟……似的 to express “it seems (as though)”
tables.title: The Pattern 跟……似的

examples.text: 他俩好得跟亲兄弟似的。
examples.translation: tā liǎ hǎo de gēn qīn xiōng dì shì de — 1. The two of them are as close as brothers.

examples.text: 你跟我似的，不爱自己做饭，喜欢叫外卖。
examples.translation: nǐ gēn wǒ shì de bú ài zì jǐ zuò fàn xǐ huān jiào wài mài — 2. You are like me: you don’t like cooking yourself and like ordering takeout.

examples.text: 在“双十一”的时候，快递员的生活就跟打仗似的，每天要送好几百单。
examples.translation: zài shuāng shí yī de shí hòu kuài dì yuán de shēng huó jiù gēn dǎ zhàng shì de měi tiān yào sòng hǎo jǐ bǎi dān — 3. At “Double Eleven” a courier’s life is just like a battle, with several hundred orders to deliver a day.

examples.text: 小宋做快递员跟他在小区做保安似的一样辛苦。
examples.translation: xiǎo sòng zuò kuài dì yuán gēn tā zài xiǎo qū zuò bǎo ān shì de yí yàng xīn kǔ — 4. Xiao Song is as hard-worked as a courier as he was as a guard in the compound.

examples.text: 他们兄弟俩长得好像一个人似的。
examples.translation: tā men xiōng dì liǎ zhǎng de hǎo xiàng yí gè rén shì de — 好像 1. The two brothers look as if they were one person.

examples.text: 我姐姐好像我似的，就喜欢吃苹果。
examples.translation: wǒ jiě jiě hǎo xiàng wǒ shì de jiù xǐ huān chī píng guǒ — 2. My older sister is like me; she just likes eating apples.

examples.text: 刚才我看到她拿着一个行李出去了，好像去旅游似的。
examples.translation: gāng cái wǒ kàn dào tā ná zhe yí gè xíng li chū qù le hǎo xiàng qù lǚ yóu shì de — 3. Just now I saw her go out carrying a piece of luggage, as if going traveling.

examples.text: 你怎么好像一个人过日子似的，家里什么家具都没有。
examples.translation: nǐ zěn me hǎo xiàng yí gè rén guò rì zi shì de jiā lǐ shén me jiā jù dōu méi yǒu — 4. How come you live as if you were living alone, with no furniture at all at home?

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and write sentences using each word pair with the pattern 跟/好像……似的: 1. 唱歌，哭 2. 走路，醉 3. 脸，苹果 4. 天气，夏天 5. 短租屋，旅馆 6. 建筑，西式. B. Pair up; Student A reads sentences 1, 3 and 5 while Student B translates them into English. Then Student B reads sentences 2, 4 and 6 and Student A translates them into English. My key:

examples.text: 他唱歌跟哭似的，一点也不好听。
examples.translation: tā chàng gē gēn kū shì de yì diǎn yě bù hǎo tīng — Activity 5, 1 (my key): He sings as if crying; it doesn’t sound good at all.

examples.text: 他走路好像喝醉了似的。
examples.translation: tā zǒu lù hǎo xiàng hē zuì le shì de — 2: He walks as if he were drunk.

examples.text: 她的脸红得跟苹果似的。
examples.translation: tā de liǎn hóng de gēn píng guǒ shì de — 3: Her face is as red as an apple.

examples.text: 今天的天气热得跟夏天似的。
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì rè de gēn xià tiān shì de — 4: Today’s weather is as hot as summer.

examples.text: 这个短租屋干净得跟旅馆似的。
examples.translation: zhè ge duǎn zū wū gān jìng de gēn lǚ guǎn shì de — 5: This short-term rental is as clean as a hotel.

examples.text: 这里的建筑好像西式建筑似的。
examples.translation: zhè lǐ de jiàn zhù hǎo xiàng xī shì jiàn zhù shì de — 6: The buildings here look like Western-style buildings.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and create five sentences about courier service in the U.S. using the pattern 跟/好像……似的. B. Share your sentences with the class. My samples:

examples.text: 美国的快递员好像也起早贪黑似的，圣诞节前特别忙。
examples.translation: měi guó de kuài dì yuán hǎo xiàng yě qǐ zǎo tān hēi shì de shèng dàn jié qián tè bié máng — Activity 6 (my samples about U.S. couriers): U.S. couriers also seem to work from dawn to night, and are especially busy before Christmas.

examples.text: 我的快递员对我跟朋友似的，每次都笑着打招呼。
examples.translation: wǒ de kuài dì yuán duì wǒ gēn péng yǒu shì de měi cì dōu xiào zhe dǎ zhāo hū — My courier treats me like a friend and greets me with a smile every time.

examples.text: 下雪的时候，快递员送货跟打仗似的。
examples.translation: xià xuě de shí hòu kuài dì yuán sòng huò gēn dǎ zhàng shì de — When it snows, delivering is like a battle for couriers.

exercises.prompt: What does the modal particle 的 at the end of 起早贪黑的 do?
options: It adds an explanation to what was said

exercises.prompt: Which sentence ends with the modal 的?
options: 我们得天天去操场集合，挺辛苦的

exercises.prompt: What can replace 跟……似的 to mean “it seems as though”?
What does 他俩好得跟亲兄弟似的 mean?
options: The two are as close as brothers

exercises.prompt: What does 快递员的生活就跟打仗似的 compare a courier’s life to?
Which fits “她的脸红得___苹果似的”?
Which fits “她走路好像___了似的”?
现在寄包裹，快递员可以到你家里收件，挺方便___。

lessons.title: 695. Lesson 27 Presentation 1 grammar: 正是因为 for “just because”
lessons.subtitle: 正是因为…才… · 正是因为快递既快捷又便利 · 正是因为外语很有用 · 手机叫外卖 网约车 醉酒代驾 民宿

explanations.title: 正是因为……
explanations.body: 因为 can act as a subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of cause and reason. 因为 also can act as a two-word preposition meaning “because of”. 正是 is used to emphasize 因为 to express “just because (of)”. Pattern: 正是因为……，…….  才 can be used in the main clause to emphasize a result.

rows: 因为 can introduce clauses of cause and reason, and can also be a two-word preposition meaning “because of”; 正是 emphasizes 因为 to express “just because (of)”
才 can be used in the main clause to emphasize a result
tables.title: 正是因为……

examples.text: 正是因为快递既快捷又便利，我们都喜欢用快递。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi kuài dì jì kuài jié yòu biàn lì wǒ men dōu xǐ huān yòng kuài dì — 1. It is precisely because express delivery is both fast and convenient that we all like to use it.

examples.text: 正是因为中国的经济发展了，中国人的生活越来越好。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi zhōng guó de jīng jì fā zhǎn le zhōng guó rén de shēng huó yuè lái yuè hǎo — 2. It is precisely because China’s economy has developed that Chinese people’s lives are getting better and better.

examples.text: 正是因为“快递小哥”的辛苦，我们的生活才变得方便多了。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi kuài dì xiǎo gē de xīn kǔ wǒ men de shēng huó cái biàn de fāng biàn duō le — With 才: It is precisely because of the “courier guys’” hard work that our lives have become so much more convenient.

examples.text: 正是因为外语很有用，你才更应该努力学习。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi wài yǔ hěn yǒu yòng nǐ cái gèng yīng gāi nǔ lì xué xí — With 才: It is precisely because foreign languages are very useful that you should study even harder.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the sentences with 正是因为 (six items) and translate them into English. B. Pair up and check your translation with your partner. Then repeat the sentences in Chinese with your partner. (Audio; the sentences are not in the book.)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and talk about the cause and effect of the following topics using 正是因为: 1. 手机叫外卖 2. 网约车 3. 醉酒代驾 4. 民宿和短租屋 5. 中国人出国旅游，自驾游，扫货. Write a short paragraph for each topic. B. Share your paragraphs with the class. My samples:

examples.text: 正是因为手机叫外卖又方便又快，很多人才喜欢用手机订餐。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi shǒu jī jiào wài mài yòu fāng biàn yòu kuài hěn duō rén cái xǐ huān yòng shǒu jī dìng cān — Activity 8, 1 (my paragraph on 手机叫外卖): It is precisely because ordering takeout by phone is both convenient and fast that many people like to order meals by phone.

examples.text: 正是因为网约车可以在手机上叫车，也不用现金，人们才越来越常坐网约车。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi wǎng yuē chē kě yǐ zài shǒu jī shàng jiào chē yě bú yòng xiàn jīn rén men cái yuè lái yuè cháng zuò wǎng yuē chē — 2 (网约车): It is precisely because ride-hailing lets you call a car on your phone, without cash, that people take them more and more often.

examples.text: 正是因为醉酒开车很危险，人们才找代驾送自己回家。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi zuì jiǔ kāi chē hěn wēi xiǎn rén men cái zhǎo dài jià sòng zì jǐ huí jiā — 3 (醉酒代驾): It is precisely because drunk driving is very dangerous that people find a designated driver to take them home.

examples.text: 正是因为民宿比旅馆便宜，又有家的感觉，才有越来越多的人喜欢住民宿。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi mín sù bǐ lǚ guǎn pián yi yòu yǒu jiā de gǎn jué cái yǒu yuè lái yuè duō de rén xǐ huān zhù mín sù — 4 (民宿和短租屋): It is precisely because homestays are cheaper than hotels and feel like home that more and more people like to stay in them.

examples.text: 正是因为中国人越来越有钱，才有越来越多的人出国旅游、自驾游、扫货。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi zhōng guó rén yuè lái yuè yǒu qián cái yǒu yuè lái yuè duō de rén chū guó lǚ yóu zì jià yóu sǎo huò — 5 (中国人出国旅游，自驾游，扫货): It is precisely because Chinese people are getting richer and richer that more and more of them travel abroad, take self-drive tours and go on shopping sprees.

lessons.subtitle: 快递的发展 · 大专 · 宋学文 · 五一劳动奖章 · 无人机 · 窦立国 · 中国最励志的快递小哥

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and write the main idea expressed. B. Pair up and discuss how you understood the main idea from the vocabulary and contextual clues. C. Listen to the recording again in segments and answer the questions. D. With your partner, discuss your answers and explain how you understood the questions. E. With your partner, talk about a U.S. courier company using the questions below. (The recording is not in the book, so there is no key; the questions are the book’s.)

examples.text: 为什么说中国的快递发展很快？举二个例子。
examples.translation: wèi shén me shuō zhōng guó de kuài dì fā zhǎn hěn kuài jǔ èr gè lì zi — Activity 1C, Segment 1: Why do we say China’s express delivery has developed fast? Give two examples.

examples.text: 大部分快递员的年龄有多大？

examples.text: 快递员都是高中毕业吗？猜一猜“大专”是什么教育水平？
examples.translation: kuài dì yuán dōu shì gāo zhōng bì yè ma cāi yì cāi dà zhuān shì shén me jiào yù shuǐ píng — 2: Did all couriers graduate from high school? Guess what educational level 大专 is.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and read an article about Song Xuewen and discuss the meaning of the phrases that follow (1. 稳定的工作 2. 有头脑 3. 提高效率 4. 无人机) using the context and your knowledge of the vocabulary. B. With your partner, read the article again and answer the questions. C. Share your answers with the class. Explain what strategies you used to comprehend the content. D. Talk about the following topics with your partner: What kind of medals are given to hard-working couriers in the U.S.? Must a courier in the U.S. hand the goods to the recipient in person; if the recipient is not at home, what does the courier do? Do U.S. courier companies use drones, and if so what for? The article, the glossed words and my answers:

tables.title: Activity 2A: the glossed words and the four phrases to guess

examples.text: 从一名普通的快递员，成长为全国五一劳动奖章获得者，需要多久？宋学文的答案是六年。作为一名快递小哥，从二零一一年到二零一七年，他送了二十二万个包裹，走了三十多万公里，得到零差评，成为了第一个获得全国“五一”劳动奖章的快递员。宋学文十六岁时从老家内蒙古来到北京。他只有一个愿望就是想找一个稳定的工作，多赚一些钱。刚开始他当保安，后来做了快递员。很多人认为送快递很容易，只需要有体力，不需要有头脑，可宋学文不这样认为。以前，他每次送货时，收货人有时不在家，他还得再跑一趟，把货当面交给他们。有的人一次买好几件商品，他送完一单还得再送一单。有的办公室下班时间也不一样，送货的要求也不一样。为了提高效率，他在笔记本上记下每个顾客的上班、下班时间和送货的要求，然后建立了一个送货工作法，帮助他按时把货送到。他还把这个工作法告诉给别的快递员，向他们介绍自己的经验，这大大地提高了他们送货的效率。去年，宋学文用四个月的时间，完成了无人机运营培训，以后，他可以用无人机把更多的包裹快速地送到顾客手里。
examples.translation: cóng yì míng pǔ tōng de kuài dì yuán chéng zhǎng wèi quán guó wǔ yī láo dòng jiǎng zhāng huò dé zhě xū yào duō jiǔ sòng xué wén de dá àn shì liù nián zuò wéi yì míng kuài dì xiǎo gē cóng èr líng yī yī nián dào èr líng yī qī nián tā sòng le èr shí èr wàn gè bāo guǒ zǒu le sān shí duō wàn gōng lǐ dé dào líng chà píng chéng wéi le dì yī gè huò dé quán guó wǔ yī láo dòng jiǎng zhāng de kuài dì yuán sòng xué wén shí liù suì shí cóng lǎo jiā nèi méng gǔ lái dào běi jīng tā zhǐ yǒu yí gè yuàn wàng jiù shì xiǎng zhǎo yí gè wěn dìng de gōng zuò duō zhuàn yì xiē qián gāng kāi shǐ tā dāng bǎo ān hòu lái zuò le kuài dì yuán hěn duō rén rèn wéi sòng kuài dì hěn róng yì zhǐ xū yào yǒu tǐ lì bù xū yào yǒu tóu nǎo kě sòng xué wén bú zhè yàng rèn wéi yǐ qián tā měi cì sòng huò shí shōu huò rén yǒu shí bú zài jiā tā hái děi zài pǎo yí tàng bǎ huò dāng miàn jiāo gěi tā men yǒu de rén yí cì mǎi hǎo jǐ jiàn shāng pǐn tā sòng wán yì dān hái děi zài sòng yì dān yǒu de bàn gōng shì xià bān shí jiān yě bù yí yàng sòng huò de yāo qiú yě bù yí yàng wèi le tí gāo xiào lǜ tā zài bǐ jì běn shàng jì xià měi gè gù kè de shàng bān xià bān shí jiān hé sòng huò de yāo qiú rán hòu jiàn lì le yí gè sòng huò gōng zuò fǎ bāng zhù tā àn shí bǎ huò sòng dào tā hái bǎ zhè ge gōng zuò fǎ gào sù gěi bié de kuài dì yuán xiàng tā men jiè shào zì jǐ de jīng yàn zhè dà dà de tí gāo le tā men sòng huò de xiào lǜ qù nián sòng xué wén yòng sì gè yuè de shí jiān wán chéng le wú rén jī yùn yíng péi xùn yǐ hòu tā kě yǐ yòng wú rén jī bǎ gèng duō de bāo guǒ kuài sù de sòng dào gù kè shǒu lǐ — “Courier Guy” wins the national May Day Labor Medal. How long does it take to grow from an ordinary courier into a winner of the national May Day Labor Medal? Song Xuewen’s answer is six years. As a courier, from 2011 to 2017 he delivered 220,000 parcels and traveled over 300,000 kilometers, got zero bad reviews, and became the first courier to win the national “May Day” Labor Medal. Song Xuewen came to Beijing at sixteen from his hometown of Inner Mongolia. He had only one wish: to find a stable job and earn a bit more money. At first he was a security guard and later became a courier. Many people think delivering is easy, that it takes only physical strength and no brains, but Song Xuewen doesn’t think so. Before, whenever he delivered, the recipient was sometimes not at home and he had to make another trip to hand over the goods in person. Some people buy several items at a time, and after delivering one order he had to deliver another. Some offices have different closing times and different delivery requirements. To raise efficiency, he wrote down in a notebook each customer’s work hours and delivery requirements, and then set up a delivery method that helped him deliver on time. He also told this method to other couriers and shared his experience, which greatly raised their delivery efficiency. Last year Song Xuewen spent four months completing drone operations training, and in future he can use drones to quickly deliver more parcels to customers’ hands. (source note: adapted from an article by 任敏 in the Beijing Daily of May 4, 2019; the book writes the years and figures in digits)

examples.text: 五一劳动奖章是中国颁发给优秀劳动者的奖章，通常在五月一日劳动节前后发。
examples.translation: wǔ yī láo dòng jiǎng zhāng shì zhōng guó bān fā gěi yōu xiù láo dòng zhě de jiǎng zhāng tōng cháng zài wǔ yuè yí rì láo dòng jié qián hòu fā — Activity 2B-1 (my answer; the book asks you to look it up online): The May Day Labor Medal is a medal China gives to outstanding workers, usually around Labor Day on May 1.

examples.text: 因为他六年送了二十二万个包裹，走了三十多万公里，得到零差评，还把自己的工作法告诉别的快递员。
examples.translation: yīn wèi tā liù nián sòng le èr shí èr wàn gè bāo guǒ zǒu le sān shí duō wàn gōng lǐ dé dào líng chà píng hái bǎ zì jǐ de gōng zuò fǎ gào sù bié de kuài dì yuán — 2B-2 (my answer): Because in six years he delivered 220,000 parcels, traveled over 300,000 kilometers, got zero bad reviews and shared his working method with other couriers.

examples.text: 因为很多人觉得送快递只需要有体力，不需要有头脑。
examples.translation: yīn wèi hěn duō rén jué de sòng kuài dì zhǐ xū yào yǒu tǐ lì bù xū yào yǒu tóu nǎo — 2B-3 (my answer): Because many people think delivering takes only physical strength and no brains.

examples.text: 他在笔记本上记下每个顾客的上班、下班时间和送货的要求，建立了一个送货工作法，还把它告诉别的快递员。
examples.translation: tā zài bǐ jì běn shàng jì xià měi gè gù kè de shàng bān xià bān shí jiān hé sòng huò de yāo qiú jiàn lì le yí gè sòng huò gōng zuò fǎ hái bǎ tā gào sù bié de kuài dì yuán — 2B-4 (my answer): He wrote down each customer’s work hours and delivery requirements in a notebook, set up a delivery method and shared it with other couriers.

examples.text: 他用四个月的时间完成了无人机运营培训。
examples.translation: tā yòng sì gè yuè de shí jiān wán chéng le wú rén jī yùn yíng péi xùn — 2B-5 (my answer): He spent four months completing drone operations training.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up, read the passages, and arrange them in a logical order. B. With your partner, discuss the order of the passages and explain what strategies you used for your ordering. C. In two groups of two, read the passages again and summarize each one. D. Re-group into three pairs by pairing up students from Group A with students from Group B. Summarize the passages you read for your new partner. The four passages are printed under the title 中国最励志的“快递小哥”; in the book they are out of order. My correct order: 1. Passage D (the happiest day), 2. Passage C (his first jobs and the courier company), 3. Passage A (the map and his success), 4. Passage B (recent charity). The passages in my order, then my summaries:

examples.text: 二零一四年九月十九日是窦立国最开心的日子。这一天，阿里巴巴在纽约证交所上市，窦立国是八个敲钟人之一，还和马云一起照了相。一个骑着小车在北京城到处送货的“快递小哥”，为什么会被阿里巴巴请来敲钟？
examples.translation: èr líng yī sì nián jiǔ yuè shí jiǔ rì shì dòu lì guó zuì kāi xīn de rì zi zhè yì tiān ā lǐ bā bā zài niǔ yuē zhèng jiāo suǒ shàng shì dòu lì guó shì bā gè qiāo zhōng rén zhī yì hái hé mǎ yún yì qǐ zhào le xiāng yí gè qí zhe xiǎo chē zài běi jīng chéng dào chù sòng huò de kuài dì xiǎo gē wèi shén me huì bèi ā lǐ bā bā qǐng lái qiāo zhōng — Passage D: September 19, 2014 was Dou Liguo’s happiest day. That day Alibaba listed on the New York Stock Exchange, and Dou Liguo was one of the eight bell-ringers and also had his picture taken with Jack Ma. Why would a “courier guy” riding a little cart delivering all over Beijing be invited by Alibaba to ring the bell? (the book writes the date in digits; 马云 is the founder of Alibaba)

examples.text: 窦立国在北京第一份工作是酒店保安，一个月六百元。干了几个月后，在经理的鼓励下，他在厨房学习做菜的手艺，当了酒店的厨师。厨师干了三年后，窦立国去了一家快递公司。为了让生意好起来，他印了一万张名片，天天在小区里发。有的人拿到了他的名片，就给他打电话，让他帮忙寄快递。几个月后，生意越来越好。
examples.translation: dòu lì guó zài běi jīng dì yī fèn gōng zuò shì jiǔ diàn bǎo ān yí gè yuè liù bǎi yuán gàn le jǐ gè yuè hòu zài jīng lǐ de gǔ lì xià tā zài chú fáng xué xí zuò cài de shǒu yì dāng le jiǔ diàn de chú shī chú shī gàn le sān nián hòu dòu lì guó qù le yì jiā kuài dì gōng sī wèi le ràng shēng yì hǎo qǐ lái tā yìn le yí wàn zhāng míng piàn tiān tiān zài xiǎo qū lǐ fā yǒu de rén ná dào le tā de míng piàn jiù gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ràng tā bāng máng jì kuài dì jǐ gè yuè hòu shēng yì yuè lái yuè hǎo — Passage C: Dou Liguo’s first job in Beijing was as a hotel security guard at 600 yuan a month. After a few months, encouraged by the manager, he learned cooking in the kitchen and became the hotel’s cook. After three years as a cook, Dou Liguo went to a courier company. To get business going he printed ten thousand business cards and handed them out in residential compounds every day. Some people who got his card phoned him to help send parcels. A few months later business was better and better. (the book writes 600 in digits)

examples.text: 为了能够快速地把货送给顾客，窦立国根据自己的经验，画了一个便捷的北京地图。根据这个地图送快递，可以节省一个半小时，比那些地图软件还好用。由于他工作好，能力强，很快成为了分公司的经理。在他的管理下，分公司的快递业务是全公司第一名。他用五年的时间就挣到了二百万元。赚到钱后，他在老家买了一个大房子，还买了宝马和奔驰车。
examples.translation: wèi le néng gòu kuài sù de bǎ huò sòng gěi gù kè dòu lì guó gēn jù zì jǐ de jīng yàn huà le yí gè biàn jié de běi jīng dì tú gēn jù zhè ge dì tú sòng kuài dì kě yǐ jié shěng yí gè bàn xiǎo shí bǐ nà xiē dì tú ruǎn jiàn hái hǎo yòng yóu yú tā gōng zuò hǎo néng lì qiáng hěn kuài chéng wéi le fēn gōng sī de jīng lǐ zài tā de guǎn lǐ xià fēn gōng sī de kuài dì yè wù shì quán gōng sī dì yī míng tā yòng wǔ nián de shí jiān jiù zhēng dào le èr bǎi wàn yuán zhuàn dào qián hòu tā zài lǎo jiā mǎi le yí gè dà fáng zi hái mǎi le bǎo mǎ hé bēn chí chē — Passage A: To deliver goods to customers quickly, Dou Liguo drew a convenient map of Beijing based on his own experience. Delivering by this map saves an hour and a half, and is better than those map apps. Because he worked well and was capable, he soon became the manager of a branch company. Under his management the branch’s express business ranked first in the whole company. In five years he earned two million yuan. After making money he bought a big house in his hometown and also bought a BMW and a Mercedes. (the book writes 200 万 in digits)

examples.text: 近几年，窦立国一直收集衣物和图书，然后送给农村的孩子，还给他们建了很多图书馆，让他们有机会读书。他希望这些孩子也能和他一样通过读书了解外面的世界，最后改变自己的命运。
examples.translation: jìn jǐ nián dòu lì guó yì zhí shōu jí yī wù hé tú shū rán hòu sòng gěi nóng cūn de hái zi hái gěi tā men jiàn le hěn duō tú shū guǎn ràng tā men yǒu jī huì dú shū tā xī wàng zhè xiē hái zi yě néng hé tā yí yàng tōng guò dú shū liǎo jiě wài miàn de shì jiè zuì hòu gǎi biàn zì jǐ de mìng yùn — Passage B: In recent years Dou Liguo has been collecting clothes and books, giving them to rural children, and has also built many libraries for them so that they have the chance to read. He hopes these children can also, like him, learn about the outside world through reading and finally change their own fate.

examples.text: 窦立国在北京第一份工作是酒店保安，后来学做菜当了厨师，三年后去快递公司，印名片发给小区的人，生意越来越好。

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You just received an email from a teacher who taught you Chinese during your studies at Beijing University. Your teacher needs your suggestions on using courier services in the United States. You will discuss this with your classmates and make suggestions for your teacher. A. Listen to the email from Mark’s teacher Professor Wang in Beijing and summarize the information he wants from Mark. B. Pair up and see if you and your partner arrived at the same conclusion. C. Divide into two groups. Read the information about international shipping services from USPS, UPS and FedEx and compare their delivery fees, speeds, times, insurance, etc. Decide which service your group would recommend for Professor Wang’s daughter. D. After discussing the choices, each group take turns presenting their decision and explains why they think it is the best choice. E. After completing your presentation, decide which group’s decision is preferred and write an email to Professor Wang with your recommendation. (The email is audio and not in the book.) The three services and my sample recommendation:

rows: USPS 美国邮局: Global Express Mail
可以查看, 有退款保证, 包括 $100 保险, 邮费 $67.80 以上

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You have been studying Chinese at Fudan University in Shanghai for several months. Christmas is approaching and you’d like to mail Christmas gifts to your family in the U.S. You just found a courier company on the Internet and need information about parcel delivery fees, arrival times, insurance, etc. A. Pair up and read about the Chinese courier company Shentong Delivery. Get to know the details of their services by answering the questions: 1. 这家快递公司有中国到美国门到门服务，这是什么意思？ 2. 寄包裹的价格是多少？ 3. 用这家快递公司寄包裹安全吗？ 4. 他们的快递服务包括美国所有的地方吗？ 5. 包裹通常多长时间能到？ B. With your partner, discuss the details of the courier service and list all the questions you will ask when you call the courier company for further information. C. Role-play: You plan to mail a parcel of Christmas gifts to your parents in Chicago, but you want to know how much it will cost and how long it will take to arrive via courier service from Shanghai to Chicago. Call the company; your partner plays the customer service agent. Then switch roles and repeat. The advertisement, my answers and my questions:

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. Do you know any famous internet influencers in the U.S.? What do they broadcast? B. Which social media platforms are they active on? C. How does one become an internet influencer? (Four pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 网路直播和“网红”
explanations.body: The three paragraphs of the presentation; the book also prints them in traditional characters.

examples.text: 你知道吗？在网上聊天，唱歌，吃饭也可以赚钱。随着互联网的发展，网路直播成了一个热门职业。主播们在直播平台上唱歌，跳舞，做饭，卖货，和观众互动。观众喜欢的话，就给他们打赏，他们再和网站分成。有不少主播特别受欢迎，有很多粉丝，人们把这些主播叫做“网红”。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào ma zài wǎng shàng liáo tiān chàng gē chī fàn yě kě yǐ zhuàn qián suí zhe hù lián wǎng de fā zhǎn wǎng lù zhí bō chéng le yí gè rè mén zhí yè zhǔ bō men zài zhí bō píng tái shàng chàng gē tiào wǔ zuò fàn mài huò hé guān zhòng hù dòng guān zhòng xǐ huān de huà jiù gěi tā men dǎ shǎng tā men zài hé wǎng zhàn fēn chéng yǒu bù shǎo zhǔ bō tè bié shòu huān yíng yǒu hěn duō fěn sī rén men bǎ zhè xiē zhǔ bō jiào zuò wǎng hóng — Do you know? Chatting, singing and eating online can also make money. With the development of the Internet, online live streaming has become a popular profession. On live-streaming platforms the streamers sing, dance, cook, sell goods and interact with the audience. If the audience likes it, they give the streamers rewards, and the streamers then share the profit with the website. Quite a few streamers are especially popular and have many fans; people call these streamers “internet celebrities” (网红). (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 说到“网红”，人们就会想到淘宝网的薇娅。每次直播时，她都有六百多万的粉丝观看，两个小时就可以卖到两亿多的商品。“网红主播”李子柒有最多的国外观众，她的粉丝超过千万。人们喜欢她的视频，主要是因为画面非常美，还可以了解到中国的美食和文化。不仅人可以当“网红”，而且一些名胜古迹也成了“网红”。比如，有六百年历史的故宫也在网上直播，成了“网红景点”，让更多的年轻人了解古代文物，爱上传统文化。
examples.translation: shuō dào wǎng hóng rén men jiù huì xiǎng dào táo bǎo wǎng de wēi yà měi cì zhí bō shí tā dōu yǒu liù bǎi duō wàn de fěn sī guān kàn liǎng gè xiǎo shí jiù kě yǐ mài dào liǎng yì duō de shāng pǐn wǎng hóng zhǔ bō lǐ zi qī yǒu zuì duō de guó wài guān zhòng tā de fěn sī chāo guò qiān wàn rén men xǐ huān tā de shì pín zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi huà miàn fēi cháng měi hái kě yǐ liǎo jiě dào zhōng guó de měi shí hé wén huà bù jǐn rén kě yǐ dāng wǎng hóng ér qiě yì xiē míng shèng gǔ jì yě chéng le wǎng hóng bǐ rú yǒu liù bǎi nián lì shǐ de gù gōng yě zài wǎng shàng zhí bō chéng le wǎng hóng jǐng diǎn ràng gèng duō de nián qīng rén liǎo jiě gǔ dài wén wù ài shàng chuán tǒng wén huà — Speaking of “internet celebrities”, people think of Viya of Taobao. Every time she streams, more than six million fans watch, and in two hours she can sell over 200 million yuan of goods. The “influencer streamer” Li Ziqi has the most foreign viewers, and her fans number over ten million. People like her videos mainly because the pictures are very beautiful and one can also learn about Chinese food and culture. Not only people can be “internet celebrities”; some famous scenic spots and historic sites have also become “internet celebrities”. For example, the Forbidden City, with a history of six hundred years, also streams online and has become an “internet-celebrity scenic spot”, letting more young people learn about ancient cultural relics and fall in love with traditional culture.

examples.text: 现在，网络直播已经成为很多人喜爱的工作，而且越来越火。
examples.translation: xiàn zài wǎng luò zhí bō yǐ jīng chéng wéi hěn duō rén xǐ ài de gōng zuò ér qiě yuè lái yuè huǒ — Now online live streaming has become a job that many people love, and it is getting hotter and hotter. (the book also prints the passage in traditional characters)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: listen to Presentation 2 once through and answer the question: 1. What is discussed in this presentation? B. Detailed Listening: listen again and answer: 1. What do the streamers usually do on social media platforms? 2. How do streamers monetize their content? 3. Why are influencers called “internet celebrities”? 4. What did you learn about Viya on Taobao? 5. Why are Li Ziqi’s videos so popular? How many followers does she have? 6. What was said about the Forbidden City? C. Pair up, discuss the answers and share them with the class. My answers, from the presentation: A. 1. Online live streaming and internet celebrities. B. 1. They sing, dance, cook, sell goods and interact with the audience. 2. The audience gives rewards, and the streamers share the profit with the website. 3. Because they are especially popular and have many fans. 4. She has over six million viewers each time and can sell over 200 million yuan of goods in two hours. 5. explanations.title: The Pattern 把……叫做……
explanations.body: The pattern 把……叫做 expresses the meaning “call … (as) …” or “… is known as …”. Subject + 把 + A + 叫做 + B. 把 can also be used with the verbs 看 and 当, which means “regard … as …”. Subject + 把 + A + 看做/当做 + B.

rows: Subject + 把 + A + 叫做 + B
expresses the meaning “call A (as) B” or “A is known as B”
Subject + 把 + A + 看做/当做 + B
把 can also be used with the verbs 看 and 当, which means “regard A as B”

explanations.title: 说到/想到/提到
explanations.body: 说到, 想到, 提到 are used at the beginning of a sentence to attract the audience’s attention to a topic mentioned earlier and elaborated upon. These terms are, respectively, equivalent to “speaking of,” “thinking of,” and “mentioning” or “referring to” in English. 说到/想到/提到……, elaboration. They can also be used as verbs in the middle of a sentence to mean “speak about/mention,” “think of,” and “mention/refer to,” respectively. Subject + 说到/想到/提到 + Object.

rows: at the beginning of a sentence, to attract the audience’s attention to a topic mentioned earlier and elaborated upon; equivalent to “speaking of”, “thinking of” and “mentioning/referring to”
Subject + 说到/想到/提到 + Object
in the middle of a sentence, as verbs meaning “speak about/mention”, “think of” and “mention/refer to”

lessons.title: 703. Lesson 27 Presentation 2 grammar: 主要是因为
lessons.subtitle: 主要是因为 · 为什么网路直播越来越火 · 为什么喜欢自驾游 · 扫货 · 民宿 · 回国工作

explanations.title: 主要是因为
explanations.body: 主要是因为 introduces a causal relationship and can be used if the speaker wants to state the effect before the cause. 主要是 is used before 因为 to emphasize that it is the main reason for the effect. Main Clause (effect), 是因为……

rows: 主要是因为 introduces a causal relationship and can be used if the speaker wants to state the effect before the cause; 主要是 is used before 因为 to emphasize that it is the main reason for the effect
tables.title: 主要是因为

examples.text: 人们喜欢她的视频，主要是因为画面非常美。
examples.translation: rén men xǐ huān tā de shì pín zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi huà miàn fēi cháng měi — 1. People like her videos mainly because the pictures are very beautiful.

examples.text: 很多游客都喜欢住民宿，主要是因为有些民宿既有特点又便宜。
examples.translation: hěn duō yóu kè dōu xǐ huān zhù mín sù zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi yǒu xiē mín sù jì yǒu tè diǎn yòu pián yi — 2. Many tourists like to stay in homestays, mainly because some homestays are both distinctive and cheap.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and write a short paragraph that explains the reasons for the following phenomena: 1. 这个“网红”有很多粉丝，主要是因为…… 2. 这个直播平台的观众特别多，主要是因为…… 3. 很多观众愿意给这个主播打赏，主要是因为…… 4. 很多人喜欢去淘宝网买东西，主要是因为…… 5. 李子柒在国外有很多粉丝，主要是因为…… 6. 现在故宫也成了“网红”，主要是因为…… B. Share your paragraphs with the class. My samples:

examples.text: 这个“网红”有很多粉丝，主要是因为她的视频画面很美，也很有意思。
examples.translation: zhè ge wǎng hóng yǒu hěn duō fěn sī zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tā de shì pín huà miàn hěn měi yě hěn yǒu yì si — Activity 4A-1 (my sample): This “internet celebrity” has many fans, mainly because her video pictures are beautiful and interesting.

examples.text: 这个直播平台的观众特别多，主要是因为很多受欢迎的主播都在这里直播。
examples.translation: zhè ge zhí bō píng tái de guān zhòng tè bié duō zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi hěn duō shòu huān yíng de zhǔ bō dōu zài zhè lǐ zhí bō — 4A-2: This streaming platform has an especially large audience, mainly because many popular streamers stream here.

examples.text: 很多观众愿意给这个主播打赏，主要是因为他唱歌唱得特别好听。
examples.translation: hěn duō guān zhòng yuàn yì gěi zhè ge zhǔ bō dǎ shǎng zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tā chàng gē chàng de tè bié hǎo tīng — 4A-3: Many viewers are willing to give this streamer rewards, mainly because he sings especially well.

examples.text: 很多人喜欢去淘宝网买东西，主要是因为东西多，价钱便宜，送货也快。
examples.translation: hěn duō rén xǐ huān qù táo bǎo wǎng mǎi dōng xī zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi dōng xī duō jià qián pián yi sòng huò yě kuài — 4A-4: Many people like to shop on Taobao, mainly because there are many goods, prices are cheap and delivery is fast.

examples.text: 李子柒在国外有很多粉丝，主要是因为她的视频让人们了解到中国的美食和文化。
examples.translation: lǐ zi qī zài guó wài yǒu hěn duō fěn sī zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tā de shì pín ràng rén men liǎo jiě dào zhōng guó de měi shí hé wén huà — 4A-5: Li Ziqi has many fans abroad, mainly because her videos let people learn about Chinese food and culture.

examples.text: 现在故宫也成了“网红”，主要是因为故宫在网上直播，让更多的年轻人了解古代文物。
examples.translation: xiàn zài gù gōng yě chéng le wǎng hóng zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi gù gōng zài wǎng shàng zhí bō ràng gèng duō de nián qīng rén liǎo jiě gǔ dài wén wù — 4A-6: The Forbidden City has now also become an “internet celebrity”, mainly because it streams online and lets more young people learn about ancient cultural relics.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and discuss the following topics; then provide answers for them by using 主要是因为: 1. 为什么网路直播越来越火？ 2. 为什么很多人喜欢自驾游？ 3. 为什么有些中国人喜欢去国外“扫货”？ 4. 为什么一些父母把孩子送到国外学习？ 5. 为什么很多中国留学生选择回国工作和生活？ B. Share your conclusions with the class. My answers:

examples.text: 网路直播越来越火，主要是因为人们可以在网上互动，也可以一边看一边买东西。
examples.translation: wǎng lù zhí bō yuè lái yuè huǒ zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi rén men kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng hù dòng yě kě yǐ yì biān kàn yì biān mǎi dōng xī — Activity 5A-1 (my answer): Online live streaming is getting hotter and hotter, mainly because people can interact online and can buy things while watching.

examples.text: 很多人喜欢自驾游，主要是因为自己开车去玩儿，时间和路线都比较自由。
examples.translation: hěn duō rén xǐ huān zì jià yóu zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi zì jǐ kāi chē qù wánr shí jiān hé lù xiàn dōu bǐ jiào zì yóu — 5A-2: Many people like self-drive tours, mainly because when you drive yourself, the time and route are fairly free.

examples.text: 有些中国人喜欢去国外扫货，主要是因为国外的有些东西比中国便宜，质量也好。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē zhōng guó rén xǐ huān qù guó wài sǎo huò zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi guó wài de yǒu xiē dōng xī bǐ zhōng guó pián yi zhì liàng yě hǎo — 5A-3: Some Chinese like to go on shopping sprees abroad, mainly because some things abroad are cheaper than in China and of good quality.

examples.text: 一些父母把孩子送到国外学习，主要是因为他们希望孩子学好外语，了解外面的世界。
examples.translation: yì xiē fù mǔ bǎ hái zi sòng dào guó wài xué xí zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tā men xī wàng hái zi xué hǎo wài yǔ liǎo jiě wài miàn de shì jiè — 5A-4: Some parents send their children abroad to study, mainly because they hope their children learn foreign languages well and learn about the outside world.

examples.text: 很多中国留学生选择回国工作和生活，主要是因为中国的经济发展很快，机会很多。
examples.translation: hěn duō zhōng guó liú xué shēng xuǎn zé huí guó gōng zuò hé shēng huó zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi zhōng guó de jīng jì fā zhǎn hěn kuài jī huì hěn duō — 5A-5: Many Chinese students abroad choose to return and work and live in China, mainly because China’s economy is developing fast and there are many opportunities.

exercises.prompt: What does 主要是因为 emphasize?
Where does 主要是因为 usually stand in the sentence?
Why do people like Li Ziqi’s videos, according to the sentence?

lessons.title: 704. Lesson 27 Presentation 2 grammar: 前解释 and 后解释
lessons.subtitle: 前解释 · 后解释 · 网红 · 快递小哥 · 海归 · 海待 · 民宿 · 代驾

explanations.title: 前解释和后解释
explanations.body: 前解释 refers to “pre-explanation”, meaning that a paragraph begins with a statement of fact that naturally leads to a concept. 后解释 refers to a “post-explanation”, meaning that a paragraph introduces a concept first and then explains it.

rows: a paragraph begins with a statement of fact that naturally leads to a concept
a paragraph introduces a concept first and then explains it
Introduction of a concept → simpler explanation
tables.title: 前解释和后解释 (jiěshì)

examples.text: 主播们在直播平台上唱歌，跳舞，做饭，卖货，和观众互动。观众喜欢的话，就给他们打赏，他们再和网站分成。有不少主播特别受欢迎，有很多粉丝，人们把这些主播叫做“网红”。
examples.translation: zhǔ bō men zài zhí bō píng tái shàng chàng gē tiào wǔ zuò fàn mài huò hé guān zhòng hù dòng guān zhòng xǐ huān de huà jiù gěi tā men dǎ shǎng tā men zài hé wǎng zhàn fēn chéng yǒu bù shǎo zhǔ bō tè bié shòu huān yíng yǒu hěn duō fěn sī rén men bǎ zhè xiē zhǔ bō jiào zuò wǎng hóng — 前解释 example: On streaming platforms the streamers sing, dance, cook, sell goods and interact with the audience. If the audience likes it, they give rewards, and the streamers then share the profit with the website. Quite a few streamers are especially popular and have many fans; people call these streamers “internet celebrities”.

examples.text: 我们常常提到的“网红”，就是那些特别受欢迎，有很多粉丝的网路直播的主播。
examples.translation: wǒ men cháng cháng tí dào de wǎng hóng jiù shì nà xiē tè bié shòu huān yíng yǒu hěn duō fěn sī de wǎng lù zhí bō de zhǔ bō — 后解释 example 1: The “internet celebrities” we often mention are just those live-stream hosts who are especially popular and have many fans.

examples.text: 大家说到的“海归”，是指那些有国外学习和工作经验的留学生回到中国的人。
examples.translation: dà jiā shuō dào de hǎi guī shì zhǐ nà xiē yǒu guó wài xué xí hé gōng zuò jīng yàn de liú xué shēng huí dào zhōng guó de rén — 后解释 example 2: The “sea turtles” (海归) that people talk about refers to those students who have study and work experience abroad and have returned to China.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up, identify 前解释 and 后解释 in the following passages, and explain the difference between them. B. With your partner, write a short paragraph on the following topics using the methods 前解释 and 后解释: 1. 什么是“民宿” 2. 什么是“代驾”. C. Share your work with the class. The two passages with my key, then my sample paragraphs:

examples.text: 现在，城市里总能看到这样一些人，穿着整齐的衣服，开着一个装满货物的车子，起早贪黑地把货物送给接收货物的顾客，他们就是我们熟悉的“快递小哥”。
examples.translation: xiàn zài chéng shì lǐ zǒng néng kàn dào zhè yàng yì xiē rén chuān zhe zhěng qí de yī fú kāi zhe yí gè zhuāng mǎn huò wù de chē zi qǐ zǎo tān hēi de bǎ huò wù sòng gěi jiē shōu huò wù de gù kè tā men jiù shì wǒ men shú xī de kuài dì xiǎo gē — Activity 6A-1: Now in cities we can always see such people, wearing neat clothes and driving a vehicle full of goods, delivering goods to the customers who receive them from dawn to night; they are the “courier guys” we are familiar with. (my key: 前解释, since it begins with facts and leads to the concept 快递小哥)

examples.text: 近几年，有一个很流行的词“海待”，也叫“海带”。“海待”或是“海带”指的是那些从国外留学回来，找不到合适工作的人。
examples.translation: jìn jǐ nián yǒu yí gè hěn liú xíng de cí hǎi dài yě jiào hǎi dài hǎi dài huò shì hǎi dài zhǐ de shì nà xiē cóng guó wài liú xué huí lái zhǎo bú dào hé shì gōng zuò de rén — 6A-2: In recent years there is a very popular word “海待”, also called “海带”. “海待” or “海带” refers to those who have come back from studying abroad and cannot find a suitable job. (my key: 后解释, since it introduces the term first and then explains it; the book’s quotation marks are misplaced and I have fixed them. 海待 and 海带 are both read hǎidài; 海带 also means kelp, a pun on 海归 “sea turtle”)

examples.text: 现在，越来越多的游客不住旅馆，而是住在普通人家里。房子干净，价钱便宜，还有家的感觉，这样的住处叫做“民宿”。
examples.translation: xiàn zài yuè lái yuè duō de yóu kè bú zhù lǚ guǎn ér shì zhù zài pǔ tōng rén jiā lǐ fáng zi gān jìng jià qián pián yi hái yǒu jiā de gǎn jué zhè yàng de zhù chù jiào zuò mín sù — Activity 6B-1 (my 前解释 for “民宿”): Now more and more tourists do not stay in hotels but in ordinary families’ homes. The houses are clean and cheap and feel like home; such places to stay are called “homestays”.

examples.text: “民宿”是指那些普通人家提供给游客住的房子。
examples.translation: mín sù shì zhǐ nà xiē pǔ tōng rén jiā tí gōng gěi yóu kè zhù de fáng zi — 6B-1 (my 后解释): “Homestay” refers to those houses that ordinary families provide for tourists to stay in.

examples.text: 有的人晚上喝了酒，不能开车，就在手机上找一个司机，帮他把车开回家，这样的司机叫做“代驾”。
examples.translation: yǒu de rén wǎn shàng hē le jiǔ bù néng kāi chē jiù zài shǒu jī shàng zhǎo yí gè sī jī bāng tā bǎ chē kāi huí jiā zhè yàng de sī jī jiào zuò dài jià — 6B-2 (my 前解释 for “代驾”): Some people have drunk alcohol at night and cannot drive, so they find a driver on the phone to drive their car home for them; such a driver is called a “designated driver”.

examples.text: “代驾”是指那些帮喝了酒的人把车开回家的司机。
examples.translation: dài jià shì zhǐ nà xiē bāng hē le jiǔ de rén bǎ chē kāi huí jiā de sī jī — 6B-2 (my 后解释): “Designated driver” refers to those drivers who help people who have been drinking drive their cars home.

exercises.prompt: How does a 前解释 paragraph begin?
How does a 后解释 paragraph begin?
Which kind of explanation is the passage about “快递小哥” in Activity 6A-1?
exercises.explanation: It starts with people we see.

options: People who came back from abroad and cannot find a suitable job

options: “民宿”是指那些普通人家提供给游客住的房子
