lessons.title: 705. Lesson 27 Presentation 2 skill integration: Viya and Li Ziqi
lessons.subtitle: 薇娅 · 淘宝第一女主播 · 竞争力 · 美食博主 · 李子柒 · 九零后 · 淘宝网店 · 手工

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and write the main idea you hear. B. Listen to the recording again, in segments, and answer the questions about each segment. C. Pair up and discuss the main idea and any questions about the details. Read the script if necessary. D. With your partner, discuss the following topics. E. Share your group discussion with the class. (The recording is not in the book, so there is no key; the questions are the book’s.)

examples.text: 为什么薇娅被称为“淘宝第一女主播”？
examples.translation: wèi shén me wēi yà bèi chēng wéi táo bǎo dì yī nǚ zhǔ bō — Activity 1B, Segment 1, 1 (audio): Why is Viya called the “No. 1 female streamer on Taobao”?

examples.text: 薇娅做直播以前做过什么工作？
examples.translation: wēi yà zuò zhí bō yǐ qián zuò guò shén me gōng zuò — Segment 2, 2: What jobs did Viya do before live streaming?

examples.text: 薇娅第一次做直播有多少人看？
examples.translation: wēi yà dì yī cì zuò zhí bō yǒu duō shǎo rén kàn — 3: How many people watched Viya’s first live stream?

examples.text: 她参加主播卖货比赛的结果怎样？
examples.translation: tā cān jiā zhǔ bō mài huò bǐ sài de jié guǒ zěn yàng — 4: What was the result of her taking part in a streamer sales contest?

examples.text: 薇娅在直播间里卖什么？她的商品好卖吗？
examples.translation: wēi yà zài zhí bō jiān lǐ mài shén me tā de shāng pǐn hǎo mài ma — Segment 3, 1: What does Viya sell in her live room? Do her goods sell well?

examples.text: 为什么说薇娅直播间里的商品很有竞争力？
examples.translation: wèi shén me shuō wēi yà zhí bō jiān lǐ de shāng pǐn hěn yǒu jìng zhēng lì — Segment 4, 1: Why do we say the goods in Viya’s live room are very competitive?

examples.text: 你知道美国有哪些卖商品的直播平台？
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào měi guó yǒu nǎ xiē mài shāng pǐn de zhí bō píng tái — Activity 1D: Do you know which live-streaming platforms selling goods there are in the U.S.?

examples.text: 你知道谁是最能卖货的主播？
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào shuí shì zuì néng mài huò de zhǔ bō — Do you know who the best-selling streamer is?

examples.text: 你最喜欢哪个主播？你常常在那个直播平台买什么？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì xǐ huān nǎ ge zhǔ bō nǐ cháng cháng zài nà ge zhí bō píng tái mǎi shén me — Which streamer do you like best? What do you often buy on that platform?

examples.text: 你觉得在直播平台买东西有什么好的地方和不好的地方？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de zài zhí bō píng tái mǎi dōng xī yǒu shén me hǎo de dì fāng hé bù hǎo de dì fāng — What do you think are the good points and the bad points of buying things on a streaming platform?

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and read the article about Li Ziqi and summarize the main idea in one sentence. B. Pair up and read the article again. Write the details about Li Ziqi in the table: 1. 她有多少粉丝？ 2. 她为什么和爷爷奶奶住？ 3. 她在城里做过什么？ 4. 她回老家后做了什么？ 5. 她的视频是什么内容？ 6. 为什么她的视频受欢迎？ 7. 她的美食在哪儿卖？ C. Discuss the answers with your partner. D. With your partner, talk about food influencers in the U.S. E. Share your discussion with the class. The article, my main idea and my answers:

examples.text: “美食博主”李子柒现在火了，油管上的粉丝超过千万，全球粉丝有一亿多，这位九零后女孩是怎么做到呢？李子柒家在四川农村。在她很小的时候，父母离婚了，她和爷爷奶奶一起生活。因为家里生活困难，她十四岁就去城里打工，做过饭馆的服务员，也在酒吧工作过。有一次，她奶奶病得很厉害，她决定回老家照顾奶奶。回来后，她开了一个淘宝网店。为了让生意好起来，她拍了一些视频介绍自己的网店。后来，她就把自己做饭的过程拍下来，放到网上，结果这些视频越来越受欢迎。因为没有时间做网店，她就把淘宝店关掉了。李子柒的视频大部分是做美食，不同的季节做不同的菜，也有一些视频是做手工的，比如手工造纸，用竹子做家具等。她的视频画面优美，还有好听的音乐，做出来的菜也漂亮，让人看了就想吃。很多人觉得看她做菜就是一种享受，她在视频里一句话也不说，静静地做菜，让人觉得特别放松。一个粉丝说，“看你的视频，是我一天中感到最安静的时候。”现在，李子柒有了自己的品牌，在淘宝网开了一个店，卖她自己做的各种美食。
examples.translation: měi shí bó zhǔ lǐ zi qī xiàn zài huǒ le yóu guǎn shàng de fěn sī chāo guò qiān wàn quán qiú fěn sī yǒu yí yì duō zhè wèi jiǔ líng hòu nǚ hái shì zěn me zuò dào ne lǐ zi qī jiā zài sì chuān nóng cūn zài tā hěn xiǎo de shí hòu fù mǔ lí hūn le tā hé yé yé nǎi nǎi yì qǐ shēng huó yīn wèi jiā lǐ shēng huó kùn nán tā shí sì suì jiù qù chéng lǐ dǎ gōng zuò guò fàn guǎn de fú wù yuán yě zài jiǔ bā gōng zuò guò yǒu yí cì tā nǎi nǎi bìng de hěn lì hài tā jué dìng huí lǎo jiā zhào gù nǎi nǎi huí lái hòu tā kāi le yí gè táo bǎo wǎng diàn wèi le ràng shēng yì hǎo qǐ lái tā pāi le yì xiē shì pín jiè shào zì jǐ de wǎng diàn hòu lái tā jiù bǎ zì jǐ zuò fàn de guò chéng pāi xià lái fàng dào wǎng shàng jié guǒ zhè xiē shì pín yuè lái yuè shòu huān yíng yīn wèi méi yǒu shí jiān zuò wǎng diàn tā jiù bǎ táo bǎo diàn guān diào le lǐ zi qī de shì pín dà bù fèn shì zuò měi shí bù tóng de jì jié zuò bù tóng de cài yě yǒu yì xiē shì pín shì zuò shǒu gōng de bǐ rú shǒu gōng zào zhǐ yòng zhú zi zuò jiā jù děng tā de shì pín huà miàn yōu měi hái yǒu hǎo tīng de yīn yuè zuò chū lái de cài yě piào liàng ràng rén kàn le jiù xiǎng chī hěn duō rén jué de kàn tā zuò cài jiù shì yì zhǒng xiǎng shòu tā zài shì pín lǐ yí jù huà yě bù shuō jìng jìng de zuò cài ràng rén jué de tè bié fàng sōng yí gè fěn sī shuō kàn nǐ de shì pín shì wǒ yì tiān zhōng gǎn dào zuì ān jìng de shí hòu xiàn zài lǐ zi qī yǒu le zì jǐ de pǐn pái zài táo bǎo wǎng kāi le yí gè diàn mài tā zì jǐ zuò de gè zhǒng měi shí — The “food blogger” Li Ziqi is hot now: she has over ten million fans on YouTube and over 100 million fans worldwide. How did this post-90s girl do it? Li Ziqi’s home is in the countryside of Sichuan. When she was very young her parents divorced and she lived with her grandparents. Because life at home was hard, she went to the city to work at fourteen, worked as a restaurant waitress and also worked in a bar. Once her grandmother was very sick, and she decided to go back to her hometown to take care of her. After coming back she opened a Taobao online shop. To make business better, she shot some videos to introduce her shop. Later she filmed her own cooking process and put it online, and as a result these videos became more and more popular. Because she had no time to run the shop, she closed her Taobao shop. Most of Li Ziqi’s videos are about food, making different dishes in different seasons; some videos are about handicrafts, such as making paper by hand and making furniture from bamboo. Her videos have beautiful pictures and nice music, and the dishes she makes are pretty, making people want to eat when they see them. Many people feel watching her cook is a kind of enjoyment; she says not one word in the videos and cooks quietly, which makes people feel especially relaxed. One fan said, “Watching your videos is the time of my day when I feel the quietest.” Now Li Ziqi has her own brand and has opened a shop on Taobao selling the various foods she makes herself. (translation mine; the book prints YouTube in Latin letters after 油管 and writes 90 and 14 in digits; it prints “做到呢”, which probably lacks 的)

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the following article and write the main idea in one sentence. B. Pair up and read the article again; then mark the statements as either True or False. C. Check and discuss your answers with your partner. The article, in two parts, the glosses and my key:

rows: Guo Jierui, the name of the American internet celebrity
tables.title: Activity 4A: the glosses in brackets (left out of the spoken text)

examples.text: 在中国，郭杰瑞被称为美国“网红”。他原名叫Ｊｅｒｒｙ　Ｋｏｗａｌ，是纽约人。小时候他和家人一起来过中国。上大学的时候，他在台湾大学做交换学生，毕业后回到纽约。二零一七年，郭杰瑞开始拍中文视频，介绍中美文化。在他的视频里，他不仅介绍各种中国美食，而且还和中国的美食博主一起合作，教大家怎么做菜。在他很多视频里，他很能吃辣的，他常常说“这个不辣”。有一次，他去吃特别辣的重庆火锅，可他一点也不觉得辣。这么一个又能吃辣的又热爱中国美食的美国人，很快在ｂｉｌｉｂｉｌｉ网站赢得了不少粉丝。他的视频特别受欢迎，到现在，他在今日头条有三百二十一万粉丝，在ｂｉｌｉｂｉｌｉ网站有二百五十万粉丝。有了粉丝的支持，郭杰瑞更有信心去发现中国美食和文化。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó guō jié ruì bèi chēng wéi měi guó wǎng hóng tā yuán míng jiào shì niǔ yuē rén xiǎo shí hòu tā hé jiā rén yì qǐ lái guò zhōng guó shàng dà xué de shí hòu tā zài tái wān dà xué zuò jiāo huàn xué shēng bì yè hòu huí dào niǔ yuē èr líng yī qī nián guō jié ruì kāi shǐ pāi zhōng wén shì pín jiè shào zhōng měi wén huà zài tā de shì pín lǐ tā bù jǐn jiè shào gè zhǒng zhōng guó měi shí ér qiě hái hé zhōng guó de měi shí bó zhǔ yì qǐ hé zuò jiāo dà jiā zěn me zuò cài zài tā hěn duō shì pín lǐ tā hěn néng chī là de tā cháng cháng shuō zhè ge bú là yǒu yí cì tā qù chī tè bié là de chóng qìng huǒ guō kě tā yì diǎn yě bù jué de là zhè me yí gè yòu néng chī là de yòu rè ài zhōng guó měi shí de měi guó rén hěn kuài zài wǎng zhàn yíng de le bù shǎo fěn sī tā de shì pín tè bié shòu huān yíng dào xiàn zài tā zài jīn rì tou tiáo yǒu sān bǎi èr shí yī wàn fěn sī zài wǎng zhàn yǒu èr bǎi wǔ shí wàn fěn sī yǒu le fěn sī de zhī chí guō jié ruì gèng yǒu xìn xīn qù fā xiàn zhōng guó měi shí hé wén huà — In China, Guo Jierui is called an American “internet celebrity”. His original name is Jerry Kowal and he is from New York. When he was little he came to China with his family. When he went to university he was an exchange student at National Taiwan University, and after graduating he returned to New York. In 2017 Guo Jierui began making Chinese videos introducing Chinese and American culture. In his videos he not only introduces all kinds of Chinese food but also collaborates with Chinese food bloggers, teaching everyone how to cook. In many of his videos he can eat spicy food and often says “This isn’t spicy”. Once he went to eat especially spicy Chongqing hotpot but didn’t feel it was spicy at all. Such an American who both can eat spicy food and loves Chinese food quickly won quite a few fans on the bilibili website. His videos are especially popular; up to now he has 3.21 million fans on Today’s Headlines and 2.5 million fans on bilibili. With his fans’ support, Guo Jierui is even more confident about discovering Chinese food and culture. (translation mine; the book writes the year and the fan counts in digits and Latin letters)

examples.text: 去年三月，郭杰瑞发现云南普洱不仅有普洱茶，而且咖啡豆的质量也非常好，一些国外大公司像星巴克、雀巢等都从云南买咖啡豆。很多人不知道自己喝的咖啡其实是从云南来的。了解到这一情况后，郭杰瑞就想把云南咖啡卖到外国去。经过大半年的准备，郭杰瑞的云南咖啡卖出去了。他说他不仅要让世界了解云南咖啡，还想帮助云南的咖啡农民过上更好的生活，这是非常有意义的事情。
examples.translation: qù nián sān yuè guō jié ruì fā xiàn yún nán pǔ ěr bù jǐn yǒu pǔ ěr chá ér qiě kā fēi dòu de zhì liàng yě fēi cháng hǎo yì xiē guó wài dà gōng sī xiàng xīng bā kè què cháo děng dōu cóng yún nán mǎi kā fēi dòu hěn duō rén bù zhī dào zì jǐ hē de kā fēi qí shí shì cóng yún nán lái de liǎo jiě dào zhè yì qíng kuàng hòu guō jié ruì jiù xiǎng bǎ yún nán kā fēi mài dào wài guó qù jīng guò dà bàn nián de zhǔn bèi guō jié ruì de yún nán kā fēi mài chū qù le tā shuō tā bù jǐn yào ràng shì jiè liǎo jiě yún nán kā fēi hái xiǎng bāng zhù yún nán de kā fēi nóng mín guò shàng gèng hǎo de shēng huó zhè shì fēi cháng yǒu yì yì de shì qíng — Last March Guo Jierui discovered that Pu’er in Yunnan has not only Pu’er tea but also coffee beans of very good quality, and some large foreign companies such as Starbucks and Nestlé buy coffee beans from Yunnan. Many people don’t know that the coffee they drink actually comes from Yunnan. After learning of this situation, Guo Jierui wanted to sell Yunnan coffee abroad. After more than half a year of preparation, Guo Jierui’s Yunnan coffee was sold. He said he not only wants the world to know Yunnan coffee but also wants to help Yunnan’s coffee farmers live a better life, which is a very meaningful thing.

examples.text: 郭杰瑞是一个在中国很有名的美国网红，他拍中文视频介绍中美文化和中国美食，还想把云南咖啡卖到外国去。

examples.text: 郭杰瑞在中国的粉丝非常多，所以他被称为美国网红。
examples.translation: guō jié ruì zài zhōng guó de fěn sī fēi cháng duō suǒ yǐ tā bèi chēng wéi měi guó wǎng hóng — 4B-3 (my key: True)

examples.text: 一些国外大公司像星巴克、雀巢等让他去云南买咖啡豆。

lessons.subtitle: 带货网红 · 淘宝一姐 · 口红一哥 · 李佳琦 · 化妆品 · 公益直播 · 福布斯 · 精英榜

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You are enrolled in a Chinese basic course and have been studying Chinese for a year. Your teacher assigns a group project asking you to write a report about streaming sales in China. You will present your group report to the class. A. Read the article and answer the following questions: 1. 现在为什么很多年轻人想成为网络主播？ 2. 李佳琦是谁？他为什么被叫做“口红一哥”？他有多少粉丝？ 3. 李佳琦在大学的成绩怎么样？毕业后，他去做什么？ 4. 除了自己直播赚钱，他还做了什么好事？ 5. 他获得了什么奖？他被选入什么精英榜？ B. Pair up and check your answers with your partner’s and decide how the information can help you with the group project. The article, the glosses and my answers:

tables.title: Activity 1A: the glosses in brackets (left out of the spoken text)

examples.text: 近几年，随着网络平台的发展，出现了很多带货网红，网红主播成为了热门职业，很多年轻人想成为网络主播，因为这个职业能带来相当多的收入。其实，很多人不知道这个职业也需要努力工作才能做得好。说到带货网红，薇娅是淘宝网最能卖货的主播，被叫做“淘宝一姐”。除了薇娅，淘宝网还有一个特别能卖货的男主播，叫李佳琦。因为他在淘宝网上卖口红卖得最多，被叫做“口红一哥”。二零一八年“双十一”，他和马云比赛卖口红，结果他卖得比马云多。李佳琦现在有粉丝大约五千万。
examples.translation: jìn jǐ nián suí zhe wǎng luò píng tái de fā zhǎn chū xiàn le hěn duō dài huò wǎng hóng wǎng hóng zhǔ bō chéng wéi le rè mén zhí yè hěn duō nián qīng rén xiǎng chéng wéi wǎng luò zhǔ bō yīn wèi zhè ge zhí yè néng dài lái xiāng dāng duō de shōu rù qí shí hěn duō rén bù zhī dào zhè ge zhí yè yě xū yào nǔ lì gōng zuò cái néng zuò de hǎo shuō dào dài huò wǎng hóng wēi yà shì táo bǎo wǎng zuì néng mài huò de zhǔ bō bèi jiào zuò táo bǎo yì jiě chú le wēi yà táo bǎo wǎng hái yǒu yí gè tè bié néng mài huò de nán zhǔ bō jiào lǐ jiā qí yīn wèi tā zài táo bǎo wǎng shàng mài kǒu hóng mài de zuì duō bèi jiào zuò kǒu hóng yì gē èr líng yī bā nián shuāng shí yī tā hé mǎ yún bǐ sài mài kǒu hóng jié guǒ tā mài de bǐ mǎ yún duō lǐ jiā qí xiàn zài yǒu fěn sī dà yuē wǔ qiān wàn — In recent years, with the development of online platforms, many sales-driving internet celebrities have appeared; internet-celebrity streamer has become a popular profession, and many young people want to become online streamers because this profession can bring considerable income. Actually, many people don’t know that this profession also takes hard work to do well. Speaking of sales-driving internet celebrities, Viya is the best-selling streamer on Taobao and is called the “First Sister of Taobao”. Besides Viya, Taobao has another especially good male streamer, called Li Jiaqi. Because he sells the most lipstick on Taobao, he is called the “First Brother of Lipstick”. At Double Eleven 2018 he competed with Jack Ma in selling lipstick, and he sold more than Jack Ma. Li Jiaqi now has about 50 million fans. (translation mine; the book prints 买口红 in the sentence “他在淘宝网上买口红卖得最多”, an evident slip for 卖口红, which I have corrected, and writes 2018 and 5000 万 in digits)

examples.text: 李佳琦在大学的专业是艺术，他的化妆课成绩非常好。大学毕业后，他就去卖化妆品。很多顾客买口红不喜欢自己试，他就用自己的嘴试口红。后来，他参加淘宝直播比赛，获得了很好的成绩，成为淘宝有名的主播。除了自己赚钱，他也做了很多次公益直播，帮助农民卖货。去年，他获得了“最受欢迎网络红人奖”，被选入“福布斯三十岁以下精英榜”。
examples.translation: lǐ jiā qí zài dà xué de zhuān yè shì yì shù tā de huà zhuāng kè chéng jì fēi cháng hǎo dà xué bì yè hòu tā jiù qù mài huà zhuāng pǐn hěn duō gù kè mǎi kǒu hóng bù xǐ huān zì jǐ shì tā jiù yòng zì jǐ de zuǐ shì kǒu hóng hòu lái tā cān jiā táo bǎo zhí bō bǐ sài huò dé le hěn hǎo de chéng jì chéng wéi táo bǎo yǒu míng de zhǔ bō chú le zì jǐ zhuàn qián tā yě zuò le hěn duō cì gōng yì zhí bō bāng zhù nóng mín mài huò qù nián tā huò dé le zuì shòu huān yíng wǎng luò hóng rén jiǎng bèi xuǎn rù fú bù sī sān shí suì yǐ xià jīng yīng bǎng — Li Jiaqi’s major at university was art, and his makeup class grades were very good. After graduating he went to sell cosmetics. Many customers who buy lipstick don’t like to try it themselves, so he tried lipsticks on his own lips. Later he took part in a Taobao live-stream contest, got very good results and became a famous Taobao streamer. Besides earning money for himself, he has also done many charity live streams, helping farmers sell goods. Last year he won the “Most Popular Internet Personality Award” and was selected for the “Forbes Under 30 Elite List”.

examples.text: 因为这个职业能带来相当多的收入。
examples.translation: yīn wèi zhè ge zhí yè néng dài lái xiāng dāng duō de shōu rù — Activity 1A-1 (my answer): Because this profession can bring considerable income.

examples.text: 李佳琦是淘宝网的男主播，因为他卖口红卖得最多，被叫做“口红一哥”，现在有大约五千万粉丝。
examples.translation: lǐ jiā qí shì táo bǎo wǎng de nán zhǔ bō yīn wèi tā mài kǒu hóng mài de zuì duō bèi jiào zuò kǒu hóng yì gē xiàn zài yǒu dà yuē wǔ qiān wàn fěn sī — 1A-2 (my answer): Li Jiaqi is a male streamer on Taobao; because he sells the most lipstick he is called the “First Brother of Lipstick”, and he now has about fifty million fans.

examples.text: 他在大学的专业是艺术，化妆课成绩非常好。毕业后，他去卖化妆品。
examples.translation: tā zài dà xué de zhuān yè shì yì shù huà zhuāng kè chéng jì fēi cháng hǎo bì yè hòu tā qù mài huà zhuāng pǐn — 1A-3 (my answer): His major at university was art and his makeup class grades were very good. After graduating he went to sell cosmetics.

examples.text: 他也做了很多次公益直播，帮助农民卖货。
examples.translation: tā yě zuò le hěn duō cì gōng yì zhí bō bāng zhù nóng mín mài huò — 1A-4 (my answer): He has also done many charity live streams, helping farmers sell goods.

examples.text: 他获得了“最受欢迎网络红人奖”，被选入“福布斯三十岁以下精英榜”。
examples.translation: tā huò dé le zuì shòu huān yíng wǎng luò hóng rén jiǎng bèi xuǎn rù fú bù sī sān shí suì yǐ xià jīng yīng bǎng — 1A-5 (my answer): He won the “Most Popular Internet Personality Award” and was selected for the “Forbes Under 30 Elite List”.

explanations.title: Activity 1C-E: videos, report and presentation
explanations.body: C. Divide into two groups. Watch the live sales of Li Jiaqi and Viya on YouTube and write the information that you think is useful for your group project. D. Within your group, write a report about Li Jiaqi and Viya. Consolidate the information you collected from the reading and the videos. You may include: how is online live-stream selling in China; an introduction to the background of Li Jiaqi and Viya; what do they sell on the platform; how do they sell and why do they sell so well. E. Each group takes turns presenting their report to the class. The video questions are the book’s; the report is my sample:

examples.text: 她在直播间卖什么？
examples.translation: tā zài zhí bō jiān mài shén me — Activity 1C, Group A (Viya’s live sales, video): What does she sell in the live room?

examples.text: 你觉得她卖得怎么样？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de tā mài de zěn me yàng — How do you think she sells?

examples.text: 他在卖什么？举个例子。
examples.translation: tā zài mài shén me jǔ gè lì zi — Group B (Li Jiaqi’s lipstick live sales, video): What is he selling? Give an example.

examples.text: 你觉得他卖得怎么样？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de tā mài de zěn me yàng — How do you think he sells?

examples.text: 网络直播卖货在中国越来越火。李佳琦和薇娅是淘宝网最有名的两个主播，薇娅被叫做“淘宝一姐”，李佳琦被叫做“口红一哥”，他有大约五千万粉丝。二零一八年“双十一”，他和马云比赛卖口红，结果他卖得比马云多。他们卖得那么好，主要是因为他们很努力，也很会和观众互动。
examples.translation: wǎng luò zhí bō mài huò zài zhōng guó yuè lái yuè huǒ lǐ jiā qí hé wēi yà shì táo bǎo wǎng zuì yǒu míng de liǎng gè zhǔ bō wēi yà bèi jiào zuò táo bǎo yì jiě lǐ jiā qí bèi jiào zuò kǒu hóng yì gē tā yǒu dà yuē wǔ qiān wàn fěn sī èr líng yī bā nián shuāng shí yī tā hé mǎ yún bǐ sài mài kǒu hóng jié guǒ tā mài de bǐ mǎ yún duō tā men mài de nà me hǎo zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tā men hěn nǔ lì yě hěn huì hé guān zhòng hù dòng — Activity 1D (my sample report, built from the article; the book’s prompts are: how is live-stream selling in China, the background of Li Jiaqi and Viya, what do they sell on the platform, how do they sell and why do they sell so well): Live-stream selling in China is getting hotter and hotter. Li Jiaqi and Viya are the two most famous streamers on Taobao; Viya is called the “First Sister of Taobao”, Li Jiaqi the “First Brother of Lipstick”, and he has about fifty million fans. At Double Eleven 2018 he competed with Jack Ma in selling lipstick and sold more. They sell so well mainly because they work hard and are good at interacting with the audience.

options: It is easy and needs no work
The profession can bring considerable income
It is only for old people

exercises.prompt: Who is called the “First Sister of Taobao”?
Why is Li Jiaqi called the “First Brother of Lipstick”?
options: He sells the most lipstick on Taobao

Who did he compete with in selling lipstick at Double Eleven 2018?
What was Li Jiaqi’s major at university?
How did he try lipsticks for customers?
What good deed has he done besides earning money?
options: Charity live streams helping farmers sell goods
exercises.explanation: 公益直播，帮助农民卖货.

exercises.prompt: Which list was he selected for?
exercises.explanation: 福布斯三十岁以下精英榜.

exercises.prompt: 李佳琦在大学的专业是艺___。
他也做了很多次公益直播，帮助农民卖___。

lessons.title: 708. Lesson 27 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: Dianxi Xiaoge and PewDiePie
lessons.subtitle: 滇西小哥 · 美食博主 · 比较李子柒 · 相同和不同 · PewDiePie · 粉丝数 · 广告收入

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You are enrolled in a Chinese basic course and have been studying Chinese for a year. Your teacher assigns a group project asking you to write about new careers in China, focusing on food bloggers. You will present your group report in the class. A. Read the passage and write the EEIs below. B. Pair up and discuss the details of the reading and decide how you can use them for your group project. C. Divide the class into two groups; watch a video about Li Ziqi and Dianxi Xiaoge. Write your notes in the table. E. Within your group, discuss your notes and decide how you can use the information in your project. F. With your group members, write a report on the similarities and differences between Li Ziqi and Dianxi Xiaoge. G. Each group presents its report to the class. (Parts C and E rest on the video, which is not included.) The passage, my EEIs, the notes table and my sample comparison:

rows: 她们现在的事业怎么样
tables.title: Activity 2C: the notes table from the video (the book leaves the cells empty; the video is not included)

rows: 都是农村女孩；都做美食视频；在油管上都有很多粉丝；都是最受欢迎的美食博主
李子柒是四川女孩，她的视频有好听的音乐，她一句话也不说；滇西小哥的名字像男生，她每天戴着草帽，有一条可爱的狗，做饭菜给家里人吃
tables.title: Activity 2F: 比较李子柒和滇西小哥 (my sample, from the two articles only)

examples.text: 说起美食博主，除了四川女孩李子柒，还有一个很受大家喜爱的美食博主叫滇西小哥。如果你没有看过她的视频，从名字上看，以为她是个男生，实际上她和李子柒一样，是个农村女孩。在视频里，她每天穿着普通的衣服，戴着草帽，有一条可爱的狗，做着漂亮、可口的饭菜给家里人吃。人们常常把她和李子柒比较。她们的视频很多人都爱看，在油管上都有很多粉丝，是最受欢迎的美食博主。
examples.translation: shuō qǐ měi shí bó zhǔ chú le sì chuān nǚ hái lǐ zi qī hái yǒu yí gè hěn shòu dà jiā xǐ ài de měi shí bó zhǔ jiào diān xī xiǎo gē rú guǒ nǐ méi yǒu kàn guò tā de shì pín cóng míng zì shàng kàn yǐ wéi tā shì gè nán shēng shí jì shàng tā hé lǐ zi qī yí yàng shì gè nóng cūn nǚ hái zài shì pín lǐ tā měi tiān chuān zhe pǔ tōng de yī fú dài zhe cǎo mào yǒu yì tiáo kě ài de gǒu zuò zhe piào liàng kě kǒu de fàn cài gěi jiā lǐ rén chī rén men cháng cháng bǎ tā hé lǐ zi qī bǐ jiào tā men de shì pín hěn duō rén dōu ài kàn zài yóu guǎn shàng dōu yǒu hěn duō fěn sī shì zuì shòu huān yíng de měi shí bó zhǔ — Speaking of food bloggers, besides the Sichuan girl Li Ziqi, there is another food blogger much loved by everyone called Dianxi Xiaoge (“Little Brother of Western Yunnan”). If you haven’t watched her videos, judging from the name you might think she is a boy, but in fact, like Li Ziqi, she is a country girl. In her videos she wears ordinary clothes every day and a straw hat, has a lovely dog, and makes pretty, delicious meals for her family. People often compare her with Li Ziqi. Many people love to watch both of their videos, both have many fans on YouTube, and they are the most popular food bloggers. (translation mine; the book prints her name with the pinyin Diānxī Xiǎogē and says 油管 as YouTube)

examples.text: 滇西小哥是一个很受大家喜爱的美食博主，是个农村女孩，名字像男生。
examples.translation: diān xī xiǎo gē shì yí gè hěn shòu dà jiā xǐ ài de měi shí bó zhǔ shì gè nóng cūn nǚ hái míng zì xiàng nán shēng — Activity 2A, EEIs (essential elements of information; my list) 1: Dianxi Xiaoge is a much-loved food blogger, a country girl whose name sounds like a boy’s.

examples.text: 她每天穿着普通的衣服，戴着草帽，有一条可爱的狗，做饭菜给家里人吃。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān chuān zhe pǔ tōng de yī fú dài zhe cǎo mào yǒu yì tiáo kě ài de gǒu zuò fàn cài gěi jiā lǐ rén chī — 2: She wears ordinary clothes and a straw hat every day, has a lovely dog and cooks meals for her family.

examples.text: 她和李子柒常常被人们比较，她们在油管上都有很多粉丝。
examples.translation: tā hé lǐ zi qī cháng cháng bèi rén men bǐ jiào tā men zài yóu guǎn shàng dōu yǒu hěn duō fěn sī — 3: People often compare her with Li Ziqi; both have many fans on YouTube.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You are sharing an apartment with a Chinese student in Monterey. Your roommate has just come to the United States and is very interested in American YouTubers. Your roommate asks you to provide a brief introduction to your favorite YouTuber. A. Pair up and talk about the recent report about PewDiePie. Your partner plays the role of your roommate and asks the following questions. You explain the report to your roommate by answering the questions: 1. PewDiePie 有多少粉丝？在全球排第几？ 2. 全球有多少人看他的视频？ 3. 你知道他在油管上通常直播什么？ 4. 为什么很多人喜欢他的视频？ 5. 每月他能赚多少钱？他的钱从哪儿来的？ B. With your partner, introduce another YouTuber that you like to your roommate. You may ask your roommate to introduce a Chinese influencer to you as well. The report, my answers and the questions without a key:

rows: PewDiePie 网红频道详情数据与分析报告; 数据更新时间 2021-07-08
347.7 万 0.25% (printed in this order in the book)
单个视频合作参考费用
单月 YouTube 广告联盟收入
tables.title: Activity 3A: the report on PewDiePie (Latin letters and digits; not spoken)

examples.text: 他有一点一亿粉丝，全球排名第三，在前百分之一。
examples.translation: tā yǒu yì diǎn yí yì fěn sī quán qiú pái míng dì sān zài qián bǎi fēn zhī yī — Activity 3A-1 (my answer, from the report): He has 110 million fans and ranks third in the world, in the top one percent.

lessons.title: 710. Lesson 27 Presentation 3: e-sports and Li Xiaofeng
lessons.subtitle: 电子竞技 · 电竞职业 · 智力活动 · 李晓峰 · 星际争霸 · 英雄联盟 · 王者荣耀 · 冠军

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. Do you like to play video games? Which game is your favorite? B. Do you enjoy or participate in e-sports? Who are your favorite players? C. What are the similarities between e-sports and traditional sports? (Four pictures are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 电子竞技
explanations.body: The three paragraphs of the presentation; the book also prints them in traditional characters.

examples.text: 你听说过玩电脑游戏也是一种职业吗？这种职业就是近些年流行的电子竞技。以前，家长们担心孩子打游戏对学习不好，但是随着电竞职业的出现，人们认识到电子游戏是一种很好的智力活动。
examples.translation: nǐ tīng shuō guò wán diàn nǎo yóu xì yě shì yì zhǒng zhí yè ma zhè zhǒng zhí yè jiù shì jìn xiē nián liú xíng de diàn zi jìng jì yǐ qián jiā zhǎng men dān xīn hái zi dǎ yóu xì duì xué xí bù hǎo dàn shì suí zhe diàn jìng zhí yè de chū xiàn rén men rèn shí dào diàn zǐ yóu xì shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de zhì lì huó dòng — Have you heard that playing computer games is also a profession? This profession is the e-sports that has been popular in recent years. In the past parents worried that children playing games was bad for their studies, but with the appearance of the e-sports profession people have come to realize that video games are a very good mental activity. (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 电子竞技并不像打游戏那么简单。对职业选手来说，当电竞员需要长时间的训练和合作。电竞职业的最大特点是要求选手反应快，所以参加职业比赛的都是年轻人，大部分在二十岁左右。李晓峰是中国第一代电竞选手。上初中时，他跟表弟学会了“星际争霸”的游戏，就迷上了电竞，后来，更成为一名职业选手。他代表中国队参加世界电子竞技大赛，得过两次冠军和两次亚军。
examples.translation: diàn zi jìng jì bìng bú xiàng dǎ yóu xì nà me jiǎn dān duì zhí yè xuǎn shǒu lái shuō dāng diàn jìng yuán xū yào cháng shí jiān de xùn liàn hé hé zuò diàn jìng zhí yè de zuì dà tè diǎn shì yāo qiú xuǎn shǒu fǎn yìng kuài suǒ yǐ cān jiā zhí yè bǐ sài de dōu shì nián qīng rén dà bù fèn zài èr shí suì zuǒ yòu lǐ xiǎo fēng shì zhōng guó dì yī dài diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu shàng chū zhōng shí tā gēn biǎo dì xué huì le xīng jì zhēng bà de yóu xì jiù mí shàng le diàn jìng hòu lái gèng chéng wéi yì míng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu tā dài biǎo zhōng guó duì cān jiā shì jiè diàn zi jìng jì dà sài dé guò liǎng cì guàn jūn hé liǎng cì yà jūn — E-sports is not as simple as playing games. For a professional player, being an e-sports player requires long hours of training and cooperation. The biggest feature of the e-sports profession is that it requires players to react fast, so those who take part in professional competitions are all young people, mostly around twenty years old. Li Xiaofeng is a first-generation Chinese e-sports player. In junior high school he learned the game “StarCraft” from his younger cousin and got hooked on e-sports, and later became a professional player. He represented the Chinese team in the world e-sports contest and won two championships and two runner-up places.

examples.text: 现在，电子竞技在中国非常流行，有了“英雄联盟”和“王者荣耀”这两个游戏后，电竞行业就更火了，许多游戏主播和游戏职业选手都有大量的粉丝，成为了明星。
examples.translation: xiàn zài diàn zi jìng jì zài zhōng guó fēi cháng liú xíng yǒu le yīng xióng lián méng hé wáng zhě róng yào zhè liǎng gè yóu xì hòu diàn jìng háng yè jiù gèng huǒ le xǔ duō yóu xì zhǔ bō hé yóu xì zhí yè xuǎn shǒu dōu yǒu dà liàng de fěn sī chéng wéi le míng xīng — Now e-sports is very popular in China. After the two games “League of Legends” and “Kings of Glory” appeared, the e-sports industry became even hotter, and many game streamers and professional game players have large numbers of fans and have become stars. (the book also prints the passage in traditional characters)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: listen to Presentation 3 once through and answer the question: 1. What is the main idea of this presentation? B. Detailed Listening: listen again and answer: 1. What is a common preconception held by parents regarding video games? 2. What are the physical and mental requirements for professional e-sports players? 3. What is said about Li Xiaofeng? 4. What is one reason for the recent boom of the e-sports industry in China? C. Pair up, discuss the answers and share them with the class. My answers, from the presentation: A. 1. E-sports has become a popular profession in China. B. 1. That playing games is bad for children’s studies. 2. Long training and cooperation, quick reactions, and youth (mostly around twenty). 3. He is a first-generation Chinese e-sports player who learned StarCraft from his cousin in junior high, became a professional and won two championships and two runner-up places for China. 4. The two games “League of Legends” and “Kings of Glory” appeared.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to Passage 1 and answer the questions. B. Pair up and discuss the answers and talk about the popularity of e-sports in the U.S. C. Listen to Passage 2 and mark the statements as True or False. D. Pair up, discuss and justify your answers. Talk about the lives and work of professional e-sports players in the U.S. E. Listen to Passage 3 and mark the statements as True or False. F. Pair up, discuss your answers, and talk about your favorite e-sports player. The passages are audio and not in the book, so my key is given only for 2C-1, 2C-4 and 2E-3, which the presentation itself decides. The questions and statements are the book’s:

examples.text: 现在中国有多少电子竞技队和电竞职业选手？
examples.translation: xiàn zài zhōng guó yǒu duō shǎo diàn zi jìng jì duì hé diàn jìng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu — Activity 2A-1 (audio Passage 1): How many e-sports teams and professional e-sports players are there in China now?

examples.text: 以前家长们为什么不让孩子玩电脑游戏？
examples.translation: yǐ qián jiā zhǎng men wèi shén me bú ràng hái zi wán diàn nǎo yóu xì — 2A-2: Why did parents in the past not let children play computer games?

examples.text: 现在为什么很多人认为打游戏很好？
examples.translation: xiàn zài wèi shén me hěn duō rén rèn wéi dǎ yóu xì hěn hǎo — 2A-3: Why do many people now think playing games is good?

examples.text: 电子竞技什么时候成为亚运会的比赛项目？
examples.translation: diàn zi jìng jì shén me shí hòu chéng wéi yà yùn huì de bǐ sài xiàng mù — 2A-4: When did e-sports become a competition event of the Asian Games?

examples.text: 电子竞技和一般的电脑游戏一样，打得好就能成为电竞选手。
examples.translation: diàn zi jìng jì hé yì bān de diàn nǎo yóu xì yí yàng dǎ de hǎo jiù néng chéng wéi diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu — Activity 2C-1 (true or false, audio Passage 2; my key: False, because the presentation says e-sports is not as simple as playing games): E-sports is the same as ordinary computer games; if you play well you can become an e-sports player.

examples.text: 中国有五点二九亿人玩网络游戏，所以很多中国人都是电竞职业选手。
examples.translation: zhōng guó yǒu wǔ diǎn èr jiǔ yì rén wán wǎng luò yóu xì suǒ yǐ hěn duō zhōng guó rén dōu shì diàn jìng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu — 2C-2: 529 million people in China play online games, so many Chinese are professional e-sports players. (the book writes 5.29 亿 in digits)

examples.text: 职业电竞员每天要训练十几个小时的游戏。
examples.translation: zhí yè diàn jìng yuán měi tiān yào xùn liàn shí jǐ gè xiǎo shí de yóu xì — 2C-3: Professional e-sports players train for over ten hours a day.

examples.text: 职业电竞员的年龄一般很年轻，因为这个职业需要选手反应快。
examples.translation: zhí yè diàn jìng yuán de nián líng yì bān hěn nián qīng yīn wèi zhè ge zhí yè xū yào xuǎn shǒu fǎn yìng kuài — 2C-4 (my key: True, as the presentation says): Professional e-sports players are generally very young because this profession needs players to react fast.

examples.text: 李晓峰从小就喜欢电竞，想成为职业电竞选手。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān diàn jìng xiǎng chéng wéi zhí yè diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu — Activity 2E-1 (true or false, audio Passage 3): Li Xiaofeng has liked e-sports since childhood and wanted to become a professional e-sports player.

examples.text: 李晓峰的爸爸让他打游戏，因为他的学习成绩很好。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng de bà bà ràng tā dǎ yóu xì yīn wèi tā de xué xí chéng jì hěn hǎo — 2E-2: Li Xiaofeng’s father let him play games because his grades were very good.

examples.text: 李晓峰的表弟教他怎么玩“英雄联盟”的游戏。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng de biǎo dì jiāo tā zěn me wán yīng xióng lián méng de yóu xì — 2E-3 (my key: False, as the presentation says he learned StarCraft from his cousin): Li Xiaofeng’s cousin taught him how to play “League of Legends”.

examples.text: 李晓峰的爸爸支持他成为一名电竞职业选手。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng de bà bà zhī chí tā chéng wéi yì míng diàn jìng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu — 2E-4: Li Xiaofeng’s father supported him becoming a professional e-sports player.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up, compare the meaning of the words in each box, and complete each sentence with the correct word. Translate each sentence into English. The boxes are 1. 职业, 行业 2. 选手, 帮手 3. 职业, 业余 4. 冠军, 亚军 5. 智力, 反应 6. 合作, 代表. B. Share your work with the class. My key and translations:

examples.text: 有了“英雄联盟”和“王者荣耀”这两个游戏后，电竞行业变得越来越火。
examples.translation: yǒu le yīng xióng lián méng hé wáng zhě róng yào zhè liǎng gè yóu xì hòu diàn jìng háng yè biàn de yuè lái yuè huǒ — Activity 3A-1a (my key: 行业): After the two games “League of Legends” and “Kings of Glory” appeared, the e-sports industry became hotter and hotter.

examples.text: 现在中国出现了很多新职业，比如“快递小哥”、“网红”等。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zhōng guó chū xiàn le hěn duō xīn zhí yè bǐ rú kuài dì xiǎo gē wǎng hóng děng — 1b (职业): Now many new professions have appeared in China, such as “courier guys” and “internet celebrities”.

examples.text: 职业电竞选手的压力非常大，所以需要很强的体力来进行训练。
examples.translation: zhí yè diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu de yā lì fēi cháng dà suǒ yǐ xū yào hěn qiáng de tǐ lì lái jìn xíng xùn liàn — 2a (选手; the book prints no comma before 所以): The pressure on professional e-sports players is very great, so they need strong physical strength for training.

examples.text: 我早上在网上下了一个单，下午货就送到了。“快递小哥”真是我们的好帮手。
examples.translation: wǒ zǎo shàng zài wǎng shàng xià le yí gè dān xià wǔ huò jiù sòng dào le kuài dì xiǎo gē zhēn shì wǒ men de hǎo bāng shǒu — 2b (帮手): I placed an order online in the morning and the goods arrived in the afternoon. “Courier guys” really are our good helpers.

examples.text: 玩网路游戏的人很多，但只有很少一些人才能成为职业电竞员。
examples.translation: wán wǎng lù yóu xì de rén hěn duō dàn zhǐ yǒu hěn shǎo yì xiē rén cái néng chéng wéi zhí yè diàn jìng yuán — 3a (职业): Many people play online games, but only a very few can become professional e-sports players.

examples.text: 张军喜欢直播游戏，但是他只是一个业余的电竞爱好者。
examples.translation: zhāng jūn xǐ huān zhí bō yóu xì dàn shì tā zhǐ shì yí gè yè yú de diàn jìng ài hào zhě — 3b (业余): Zhang Jun likes to live-stream games, but he is only an amateur e-sports fan.

examples.text: 李晓峰经常参加各种电竞大赛，得了好几次冠军。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng jīng cháng cān jiā gè zhǒng diàn jìng dà sài dé le hǎo jǐ cì guàn jūn — 4a (冠军): Li Xiaofeng often takes part in all kinds of e-sports contests and has won the championship several times.

examples.text: 王刚的运气不太好，每次比赛他都得不了冠军，常常得亚军。
examples.translation: wáng gāng de yùn qì bú tài hǎo měi cì bǐ sài tā dōu dé bù liǎo guàn jūn cháng cháng dé yà jūn — 4b (亚军): Wang Gang’s luck is not so good; in every contest he cannot win the championship and often gets second place.

examples.text: 做电竞员的大部分都是年轻人，因为这个运动需要反应快。
examples.translation: zuò diàn jìng yuán de dà bù fèn dōu shì nián qīng rén yīn wèi zhè ge yùn dòng xū yào fǎn yìng kuài — 5a (反应): Most e-sports players are young people because this sport needs fast reactions.

examples.text: 现在很多人认识到打电子游戏也是一种智力运动。
examples.translation: xiàn zài hěn duō rén rèn shí dào dǎ diàn zǐ yóu xì yě shì yì zhǒng zhì lì yùn dòng — 5b (智力): Now many people realize that playing video games is also a mental sport.

examples.text: 电子竞技这个职业要求电竞选手们的长期训练和合作。
examples.translation: diàn zi jìng jì zhè ge zhí yè yāo qiú diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu men de cháng qī xùn liàn hé hé zuò — 6a (合作): The e-sports profession requires long-term training and cooperation from the players.

examples.text: 李晓峰曾经多次代表中国去参加世界竞技大赛，并获得优秀的成绩。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng céng jīng duō cì dài biǎo zhōng guó qù cān jiā shì jiè jìng jì dà sài bìng huò dé yōu xiù de chéng jì — 6b (代表): Li Xiaofeng has many times represented China in world competitions and achieved excellent results.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and use the following words and expressions to talk about three popular games: 随着……出现 | 并不像……那么…… | 迷上了……. Have you played these games? Talk about the features of the three games and why they are fun. B. Share your group discussion with the class. My sample:

examples.text: 随着电脑的发展，出现了很多好玩的游戏。“星际争霸”并不像别的游戏那么容易，玩的人要想很多办法。“英雄联盟”是五个人一队，大家要合作，很多人迷上了它。“王者荣耀”可以在手机上玩，并不像电脑游戏那么麻烦，也有很多人迷上了它。
examples.translation: suí zhe diàn nǎo de fā zhǎn chū xiàn le hěn duō hǎo wán de yóu xì xīng jì zhēng bà bìng bú xiàng bié de yóu xì nà me róng yì wán de rén yào xiǎng hěn duō bàn fǎ yīng xióng lián méng shì wǔ gè rén yí duì dà jiā yào hé zuò hěn duō rén mí shàng le tā wáng zhě róng yào kě yǐ zài shǒu jī shàng wán bìng bú xiàng diàn nǎo yóu xì nà me má fán yě yǒu hěn duō rén mí shàng le tā — Activity 4A (my sample notes on three popular games, using 随着……出现, 并不像……那么…… and 迷上了……): With the development of computers, many fun games have appeared. “StarCraft” is not as easy as other games, and players must think of many ways. “League of Legends” is played in teams of five, everyone has to cooperate, and many people got hooked on it. “Kings of Glory” can be played on a phone and is not as troublesome as computer games, and many people also got hooked on it. (the book gives the three game titles with pictures and a table “游戏特点” left empty)

lessons.title: 712. Lesson 27 Presentation 3 grammar: the usage of 随着
lessons.subtitle: 随着…… · 随着互联网的发展 · 随着电竞职业的出现 · 随着音乐跳舞 · 随着家人

explanations.title: The Usage of 随着
explanations.body: 随着 means “along with,” “in the wake of,” and “following.” When 随着 is used in the first part of the sentence, it indicates that a change in the first part causes a respective change in the second part. 随着 + Noun Phrase, Subject + Predicate. 随着 can also be used after a subject to indicate “moving together with.” Subject + 随着 + Noun/Pronoun + Verbal Phrase.

rows: 随着 means “along with”, “in the wake of” and “following”; used in the first part of the sentence, it indicates that a change in the first part causes a respective change in the second part
Subject + 随着 + Noun/Pronoun + Verbal Phrase
随着 can also be used after a subject to indicate “moving together with”
tables.title: The Usage of 随着

examples.text: 随着互联网的发展，网路直播成了一个热门职业。
examples.translation: suí zhe hù lián wǎng de fā zhǎn wǎng lù zhí bō chéng le yí gè rè mén zhí yè — At the beginning 1. With the development of the Internet, online live streaming has become a popular profession.

examples.text: 随着电竞职业的出现，人们认识到电子游戏是一种很好的智力活动。
examples.translation: suí zhe diàn jìng zhí yè de chū xiàn rén men rèn shí dào diàn zǐ yóu xì shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de zhì lì huó dòng — 2. With the appearance of the e-sports profession, people have realized that video games are a very good mental activity.

examples.text: 大家随着音乐跳起舞来。
examples.translation: dà jiā suí zhe yīn yuè tiào qǐ wǔ lái — After a subject 1. Everyone started to dance to the music.

examples.text: 比尔随着家人一起搬到了洛杉矶。
examples.translation: bǐ ěr suí zhe jiā rén yì qǐ bān dào le luò shān jī — 2. Bill moved to Los Angeles together with his family.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the sentences with 随着 (six items) and translate what you hear into English. B. Pair up and check your translations with your partner. Then say sentences in Chinese to your partner. (Audio; the sentences are not in the book.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and create sentences with your partner, using the pattern “Subject + 随着 + Noun + Verbal Phrase” and the words given below: 1. 树，风，摇动 2. 女朋友，去，中国 3. 音乐，跳舞 4. 音乐，唱歌. B. Read the sentences that you have created aloud and translate them into English. C. Share your sentences with the class. (Four pictures are not included.) My samples:

examples.text: 树随着风摇动。
examples.translation: shù suí zhe fēng yáo dòng — Activity 2A-1 (my sample; the book glosses 摇动 as yáodòng): The tree sways with the wind.

examples.text: 他随着女朋友去了中国。
examples.translation: tā suí zhe nǚ péng yǒu qù le zhōng guó — 2A-2: He went to China with his girlfriend.

examples.text: 大家随着音乐跳舞。
examples.translation: dà jiā suí zhe yīn yuè tiào wǔ — 2A-3: Everyone dances to the music.

examples.text: 她随着音乐唱起歌来。
examples.translation: tā suí zhe yīn yuè chàng qǐ gē lái — 2A-4: She began to sing along with the music.

exercises.prompt: What does the first part with 随着 cause?
options: A change in the second part
exercises.explanation: A change in the first part causes a change in the second.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence puts 随着 at the beginning?
options: 他随着女朋友去了中国
随着互联网的发展，网路直播成了一个热门职业
比尔随着家人一起搬到了洛杉矶
大家随着音乐跳起舞来

exercises.prompt: What does 大家随着音乐跳起舞来 mean?
options: Everyone started to dance to the music

exercises.prompt: With whom did Bill move to Los Angeles?
exercises.explanation: 比尔随着家人一起搬到了洛杉矶.

options: 去了中国随着他女朋友
随着他女朋友去了中国他
他女朋友去了中国随着
他随着女朋友去了中国
exercises.explanation: Subject + 随着 + Noun + Verbal Phrase.

exercises.prompt: ___着互联网的发展，网路直播成了一个热门职业。

exercises.explanation: 跳起舞来: started to dance.

lessons.title: 713. Lesson 27 Presentation 3 grammar: 认识到, 了解到 and 打听到
lessons.subtitle: 认识到 · 了解到 · 打听到 · 结果补语 到 · 电竞比赛 · 网路游戏

explanations.title: 认识到/了解到/打听到
explanations.body: 认识到, 了解到, 打听到 are verb-complement compound words. 到 is a result complement indicating that the outcome of the verb is achieved with a certain degree of effort. 认识到 is equivalent to “be aware of,” “to have knowledge of,” or “realize” in English, whereas 了解到 means “learn about”; 打听到 means to “inquire and find out.” Subject + 认识到/了解到/打听到 + Noun/Sentence.

rows: Subject + 认识到/了解到/打听到 + Noun/Sentence

verb-complement compound words; 到 is a result complement indicating that the outcome of the verb is achieved with a certain degree of effort. 认识到: “be aware of”, “have knowledge of”, “realize”; 了解到: “learn about”; 打听到: “inquire and find out”
tables.title: 认识到/了解到/打听到

examples.text: 随着电竞职业的出现，人们认识到电子游戏是一种很好的智力活动。
examples.translation: suí zhe diàn jìng zhí yè de chū xiàn rén men rèn shí dào diàn zǐ yóu xì shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de zhì lì huó dòng — 1. With the appearance of the e-sports profession, people have realized that video games are a very good mental activity.

examples.text: 自从了解到怎么开网店以后，他几乎天天都在网上卖各种东西。
examples.translation: zì cóng liǎo jiě dào zěn me kāi wǎng diàn yǐ hòu tā jī hū tiān tiān dōu zài wǎng shàng mài gè zhǒng dōng xī — 2. Ever since he learned how to open an online shop, he has sold all kinds of things online almost every day.

examples.text: 小刚从他表弟那里打听到这个网路游戏的名字。
examples.translation: xiǎo gāng cóng tā biǎo dì nà lǐ dǎ tīng dào zhè ge wǎng lù yóu xì de míng zì — 3. Xiao Gang found out the name of this online game from his younger cousin.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and complete the sentences with 认识到, 了解到 and 打听到. B. With your partner, discuss the meaning of 认识到, 了解到, 打听到 in the sentences and translate them into English. My key and translations (the book leaves the blanks empty):

examples.text: 李晓峰了解到北京有很多电竞比赛的机会，所以他来到北京学习电竞。
examples.translation: lǐ xiǎo fēng liǎo jiě dào běi jīng yǒu hěn duō diàn jìng bǐ sài de jī huì suǒ yǐ tā lái dào běi jīng xué xí diàn jìng — Activity 3A-1 (my key: 了解到; 打听到 also fits): Li Xiaofeng learned that Beijing has many e-sports contest opportunities, so he came to Beijing to study e-sports.

examples.text: 现在，人们渐渐认识到当电竞员是很赚钱的工作。
examples.translation: xiàn zài rén men jiàn jiàn rèn shí dào dāng diàn jìng yuán shì hěn zhuàn qián de gōng zuò — 3A-2 (认识到): Now people gradually realize that being an e-sports player is a very lucrative job.

examples.text: 他到现在还没有认识到学中文有多么重要。
examples.translation: tā dào xiàn zài hái méi yǒu rèn shí dào xué zhōng wén yǒu duō me zhòng yào — 3A-3 (认识到): Up to now he hasn’t realized how important learning Chinese is.

examples.text: 看李子柒的视频，不仅能学会做中国菜，还能了解到中国文化。
examples.translation: kàn lǐ zi qī de shì pín bù jǐn néng xué huì zuò zhōng guó cài hái néng liǎo jiě dào zhōng guó wén huà — 3A-4 (了解到): Watching Li Ziqi’s videos, one can not only learn to cook Chinese dishes but also learn about Chinese culture.

examples.text: 王军刚刚从同学那里打听到一个特别好玩的网路游戏。
examples.translation: wáng jūn gāng gāng cóng tóng xué nà lǐ dǎ tīng dào yí gè tè bié hǎo wán de wǎng lù yóu xì — 3A-5 (打听到): Wang Jun has just found out about a particularly fun online game from a classmate.

examples.text: 在这部电影里，观众们可以了解到中国现在的社会问题。
examples.translation: zài zhè bù diàn yǐng lǐ guān zhòng men kě yǐ liǎo jiě dào zhōng guó xiàn zài de shè huì wèn tí — 3A-6 (了解到): In this film, audiences can learn about China’s social problems today.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Write a short story about video games and e-sports by using 认识到, 了解到, 打听到. Write at least five sentences. B. Pair up and read your story to your partner. C. Share your stories with the class. My sample:

examples.text: 小丽很喜欢打游戏。她从同学那里打听到有一个新的电竞比赛，就去报了名。她了解到比赛的奖金很高，参加的人也很多。比赛以后，她认识到只有长期的训练才能得到好成绩。现在她每天都去训练，也认识到学习和玩游戏都很重要。
examples.translation: xiǎo lì hěn xǐ huān dǎ yóu xì tā cóng tóng xué nà lǐ dǎ tīng dào yǒu yí gè xīn de diàn jìng bǐ sài jiù qù bào le míng tā liǎo jiě dào bǐ sài de jiǎng jīn hěn gāo cān jiā de rén yě hěn duō bǐ sài yǐ hòu tā rèn shí dào zhǐ yǒu cháng qī de xùn liàn cái néng dé dào hǎo chéng jì xiàn zài tā měi tiān dōu qù xùn liàn yě rèn shí dào xué xí hé wán yóu xì dōu hěn zhòng yào — Activity 4A (my sample story, five sentences, about video games and e-sports): Xiao Li likes playing games very much. She found out from a classmate that there is a new e-sports contest and signed up. She learned that the contest prize is high and many people take part. After the contest she realized that only long-term training can bring good results. Now she goes to training every day and has also realized that both studying and playing games are important.

exercises.prompt: What is 到 in these words?
Which fits “小刚从他表弟那里___这个网路游戏的名字”?
Which fits “现在，人们渐渐___当电竞员是很赚钱的工作”?
Which fits “看李子柒的视频，还能___中国文化”?
他到现在还没有认识___学中文有多么重要。
王军刚刚从同学那里打听到一个特别好___的网路游戏。

lessons.title: 714. Lesson 27 Presentation 3 grammar: 当(职业)需要…… and 有了……后
lessons.subtitle: 当电竞员需要 · 学外语需要 · 做作业需要 · 有了…后 · 有了网约车后 · 有了爱彼迎后

explanations.title: 当(职业)需要……(表示条件)
explanations.body: The structure 当(职业)需要…… introduces the conditions that a certain type of occupation requires. 当 + 职业 + 需要 + 条件. This structure can also indicate the conditions for completing a task. Verbal phrase + 需要 + 条件.

rows: 当 + 职业 + 需要 + 条件
introduces the conditions that a certain type of occupation requires
Verbal phrase + 需要 + 条件
can also indicate the conditions for completing a task
tables.title: 当(职业)需要……(表示条件)

examples.text: 对职业选手来说，当电竞员需要长时间的训练和合作。
examples.translation: duì zhí yè xuǎn shǒu lái shuō dāng diàn jìng yuán xū yào cháng shí jiān de xùn liàn hé hé zuò — Occupation 1. For professional players, being an e-sports player requires long training and cooperation.

examples.text: 当外卖员需要了解餐馆附近的街道，用最快的速度把外卖送给顾客。
examples.translation: dāng wài mài yuán xū yào liǎo jiě cān guǎn fù jìn de jiē dào yòng zuì kuài de sù dù bǎ wài mài sòng gěi gù kè — 2. Being a takeout deliverer requires knowing the streets near the restaurants and delivering takeout to customers at the fastest speed.

examples.text: 学外语需要做大量的听力练习和阅读练习。
examples.translation: xué wài yǔ xū yào zuò dà liàng de tīng lì liàn xí hé yuè dú liàn xí — Task 1. Learning a foreign language requires a great deal of listening practice and reading practice.

examples.text: 做作业需要先复习一下当天学的，然后再写。
examples.translation: zuò zuò yè xū yào xiān fù xí yí xià dàng tiān xué de rán hòu zài xiě — 2. Doing homework requires first reviewing what you learned that day, and then writing.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and write a short paragraph for the following topics by using the structure “当(职业)需要……” with your partner: 1. 当职业篮球运动员需要什么条件？ 2. 当老师需要怎么做？ 3. 当军人需要做什么？ B. Share what you have written with the class. My samples:

examples.text: 当职业篮球运动员需要长期的训练，很强的体力，还需要很好的合作精神。
examples.translation: dāng zhí yè lán qiú yùn dòng yuán xū yào cháng qī de xùn liàn hěn qiáng de tǐ lì hái xū yào hěn hǎo de hé zuò jīng shén — Activity 5A-1 (my sample, 当职业篮球运动员): Being a professional basketball player requires long-term training, great physical strength and also a good spirit of cooperation.

examples.text: 当老师需要认真地准备课，耐心地教学生，还需要了解每一个学生。
examples.translation: dāng lǎo shī xū yào rèn zhēn de zhǔn bèi kè nài xīn de jiāo xué shēng hái xū yào liǎo jiě měi yí gè xué shēng — 5A-2 (当老师): Being a teacher requires preparing lessons carefully, teaching students patiently and getting to know every student.

examples.text: 当军人需要经过很多训练，身体要好，还需要听从命令。
examples.translation: dāng jūn rén xū yào jīng guò hěn duō xùn liàn shēn tǐ yào hǎo hái xū yào tīng cóng mìng lìng — 5A-3 (当军人): Being a soldier requires going through a lot of training, being in good health and obeying orders.

explanations.title: 有了……后，……
explanations.body: The structure 有了……后 is used to introduce something that leads to a certain impact and further elaborate on it. 有了……后, impact + elaboration.

rows: introduces something that leads to a certain impact and further elaborates on it
tables.title: 有了……后，……

examples.text: 有了“英雄联盟”和“王者荣耀”这两个游戏后，电竞行业就更火了，许多游戏主播和游戏职业选手都有大量的粉丝，成为了明星。
examples.translation: yǒu le yīng xióng lián méng hé wáng zhě róng yào zhè liǎng gè yóu xì hòu diàn jìng háng yè jiù gèng huǒ le xǔ duō yóu xì zhǔ bō hé yóu xì zhí yè xuǎn shǒu dōu yǒu dà liàng de fěn sī chéng wéi le míng xīng — Example (the book marks 电竞行业就更火了 as the impact, and 许多游戏主播和游戏职业选手都有大量的粉丝，成为了明星 as the elaboration): After the two games “League of Legends” and “Kings of Glory” appeared, the e-sports industry became even hotter, and many game streamers and professional players have large numbers of fans and have become stars.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the following passages. Identify the structure 有了……后, and highlight the sentences that show impact and elaboration. B. Pair up and think about something new or innovative that can impact society or our lives. Write a short paragraph about it using the structure 有了……后 and the impact and elaboration of your work. C. Share your pair’s writing with the class. The passages with my key, then my sample:

examples.text: 有了网约车后，人们的出行变得方便多了，不用站在路边等着好长时间才来一趟的公交车，也不用天天在地铁上和别人挤在一起，只要在手机软件上输入你的地址，车很快就来了。
examples.translation: yǒu le wǎng yuē chē hòu rén men de chū xíng biàn de fāng biàn duō le bú yòng zhàn zài lù biān děng zhe hǎo cháng shí jiān cái lái yí tàng de gōng jiāo chē yě bú yòng tiān tiān zài dì tiě shàng hé bié rén jǐ zài yì qǐ zhǐ yào zài shǒu jī ruǎn jiàn shàng shū rù nǐ de dì zhǐ chē hěn kuài jiù lái le — Activity 6A-1 (my key: the structure is 有了网约车后; the impact is 人们的出行变得方便多了; the elaboration is everything after it. The book prints 手机上软件上, which I have corrected to 手机软件上): After ride-hailing appeared, people’s travel became much more convenient: you no longer stand at the roadside waiting a long time for a bus that comes once in a while, nor squeeze in with others on the subway every day; you just enter your address in a phone app and the car comes very soon.

examples.text: 出门旅游，很多人喜欢住民宿。有了爱彼迎后，旅游住宿就更方便了，在爱彼迎的网站上可以找到各种各样的房子，有的价钱比一般的旅馆便宜很多，而且还可以和房主聊天，认识别的客人。
examples.translation: chū mén lǚ yóu hěn duō rén xǐ huān zhù mín sù yǒu le ài bǐ yíng hòu lǚ yóu zhù sù jiù gèng fāng biàn le zài ài bǐ yíng de wǎng zhàn shàng kě yǐ zhǎo dào gè zhǒng gè yàng de fáng zi yǒu de jià qián bǐ yì bān de lǚ guǎn pián yi hěn duō ér qiě hái kě yǐ hé fáng zhǔ liáo tiān rèn shí bié de kè rén — 6A-2 (my key: the structure is 有了爱彼迎后; the impact is 旅游住宿就更方便了; the elaboration is the rest): When going out to travel, many people like to stay in homestays. After Airbnb appeared, tourist lodging became even more convenient: on the Airbnb website you can find all kinds of houses, some are much cheaper than ordinary hotels, and you can also chat with the host and get to know other guests.

examples.text: 有了智能手机后，人们的生活变得方便多了。出门不用带很多现金，用手机就能付钱；想买东西，在网上下个单，第二天快递员就把东西送到家里来了。
examples.translation: yǒu le zhì néng shǒu jī hòu rén men de shēng huó biàn de fāng biàn duō le chū mén bú yòng dài hěn duō xiàn jīn yòng shǒu jī jiù néng fù qián xiǎng mǎi dōng xī zài wǎng shàng xià gè dān dì èr tiān kuài dì yuán jiù bǎ dōng xī sòng dào jiā lǐ lái le — Activity 6B (my sample on something new that affects our lives, with impact and elaboration): After smartphones appeared, people’s lives became much more convenient. You don’t need to carry much cash when going out, since you can pay with your phone; when you want to buy something, you place an order online and the next day the courier brings it to your home.

exercises.prompt: What does 当 + 职业 + 需要 + 条件 introduce?
What does 当外卖员需要了解餐馆附近的街道 say?
options: Being a takeout deliverer requires knowing the streets near restaurants

exercises.prompt: What does 学外语需要做大量的听力练习和阅读练习 say?
options: Learning a foreign language needs lots of listening and reading practice

exercises.prompt: What does 做作业需要先复习一下当天学的 say?
options: Doing homework requires first reviewing what you learned that day
Something that leads to a certain impact

exercises.prompt: In 有了网约车后，人们的出行变得方便多了, what is the impact?
options: People’s travel became much more convenient

exercises.prompt: What does 爱彼迎 let you do, according to the passage?
options: Find all kinds of houses and chat with the host
exercises.explanation: 各种各样的房子…和房主聊天.

exercises.prompt: 当电竞员需___长时间的训练和合作。
有了网约车后，人们的出行变得方___多了。

lessons.title: 715. Lesson 27 Presentation 3 skill integration: a Fortnite contest and e-sports at the Asian Games
lessons.subtitle: 堡垒之夜 · 决赛 · 荷兰 · 亚运会电竞表演赛 · 王者荣耀国际版 · 皇室战争 · 英雄联盟

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and write the main idea in a sentence. B. Listen to the recording again and answer the questions. C. Pair up and discuss your answers with your partner. Read the script if necessary. D. Talk about the following topics with your partner. (The recording and pictures are not included, so there is no key; the new words, questions and topics are the book’s.)

tables.title: Activity 1A: new words (生词)

examples.text: 有多少人报名参加比赛？有多少人参加决赛？
examples.translation: yǒu duō shǎo rén bào míng cān jiā bǐ sài yǒu duō shǎo rén cān jiā jué sài — Activity 1B-1 (audio): How many people signed up for the contest? How many took part in the finals?

examples.text: 决赛那天，有多少人观看？
examples.translation: jué sài nà tiān yǒu duō shǎo rén guān kàn — 1B-2: On the day of the finals, how many people watched?

examples.text: 参加比赛的选手的年龄有多大？平均年龄多大？
examples.translation: cān jiā bǐ sài de xuǎn shǒu de nián líng yǒu duō dà píng jūn nián líng duō dà — 1B-3: How old were the players in the contest? What was the average age?

examples.text: 参加决赛的选手已经得到了多少钱？如果赢了冠军会得到多少钱？
examples.translation: cān jiā jué sài de xuǎn shǒu yǐ jīng dé dào le duō shǎo qián rú guǒ yíng le guàn jūn huì dé dào duō shǎo qián — 1B-4: How much money had the finalists already received? How much would they get if they won the championship?

examples.text: 二十一岁荷兰青年Ｄａｖｅ和他的英国队友得了第几名？拿到多少奖金？
examples.translation: èr shí yī suì hé lán qīng nián hé tā de yīng guó duì yǒu dé le dì jǐ míng ná dào duō shǎo jiǎng jīn — 1B-5: In what place did the 21-year-old Dutch youth Dave and his British teammate finish? How much prize money did they get? (the book writes 21 and the name Dave in Latin letters)

examples.text: “堡垒之夜”有多少人玩？是哪个国家开发的？
examples.translation: bǎo lěi zhī yè yǒu duō shǎo rén wán shì nǎ ge guó jiā kāi fā de — 1B-6: How many people play “Fortnite”? Which country developed it?

examples.text: 你看过电竞比赛吗？是在现场看还是在线上看？
examples.translation: nǐ kàn guò diàn jìng bǐ sài ma shì zài xiàn chǎng kàn hái shì zài xiàn shàng kàn — Activity 1D: Have you watched an e-sports contest? Did you watch on the spot or online?

examples.text: 你看过的电竞比赛是哪一个？比赛的奖金是多少？
examples.translation: nǐ kàn guò de diàn jìng bǐ sài shì nǎ yí gè bǐ sài de jiǎng jīn shì duō shǎo — Which e-sports contest did you watch? How much was the prize money?

examples.text: 最后是哪个队赢了冠军？
examples.translation: zuì hòu shì nǎ ge duì yíng le guàn jūn — In the end, which team won the championship?

examples.text: 如果你给刚听过的这篇文章一个标题，你会写什么？
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ gěi gāng tīng guò de zhè piān wén zhāng yí gè biāo tí nǐ huì xiě shén me — If you gave the article you just heard a title, what would you write?

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In three groups, A, B and C, read the assigned passage and write a summary of your group’s passage. B. Re-group students by pairing one student from each group with a student from a different group. Exchange your summary with your new partner. C. Pair up and talk about the following topics with your partner. The three passages, the glosses, my summaries and the topics:

rows: 王者荣耀国际版 (Arena of Valor)
the international version of Kings of Glory
皇室战争 (huángshì zhànzhēng, Battle Royale)
the book’s gloss; the game is usually known in English as Clash Royale
tables.title: Activity 2A: the glosses in brackets (left out of the spoken text)

examples.text: 八月二十六日，在二零一八年雅加达亚运会电竞表演赛上，当大屏幕上放出“胜利”这个词的时候，中国电竞队主教练兴奋地和队员们抱在一起。在“王者荣耀国际版”表演赛中，中国队以二比零战胜了台北队，获得了亚运会电竞项目的第一块金牌。
examples.translation: bā yuè èr shí liù rì zài èr líng yī bā nián yǎ jiā dá yà yùn huì diàn jìng biǎo yǎn sài shàng dāng dà píng mù shàng fàng chū shèng lì zhè ge cí de shí hòu zhōng guó diàn jìng duì zhǔ jiào liàn xīng fèn de hé duì yuán men bào zài yì qǐ zài wáng zhě róng yào guó jì bǎn biǎo yǎn sài zhōng zhōng guó duì yǐ èr bǐ líng zhàn shèng le tái běi duì huò dé le yà yùn huì diàn jìng xiàng mù dì dì yī kuài jīn pái — Group A: On August 26, at the e-sports exhibition match of the 2018 Jakarta Asian Games, when the word “victory” appeared on the big screen, the head coach of the Chinese e-sports team excitedly hugged the team members. In the “Arena of Valor” exhibition match the Chinese team beat the Taipei team 2 to 0 and won the first gold medal of the Asian Games e-sports events. (translation mine; the book writes the dates and scores in digits and 2018 without 年, which I added so it reads aloud)

examples.text: 八月二十七日，在个人项目“皇室战争”比赛中，中国选手黄成辉经过十二小时的比赛后，获得了这个项目的银牌。在八月二十九日“英雄联盟”表演赛中，中国队以三比一战胜了韩国队，获得这个项目的金牌。当这三个表演项目全部结束后，中国队获得两块金牌和一块银牌。
examples.translation: bā yuè èr shí qī rì zài gè rén xiàng mù huáng shì zhàn zhēng bǐ sài zhōng zhōng guó xuǎn shǒu huáng chéng huī jīng guò shí èr xiǎo shí de bǐ sài hòu huò dé le zhè ge xiàng mù dì yín pái zài bā yuè èr shí jiǔ rì yīng xióng lián méng biǎo yǎn sài zhōng zhōng guó duì yǐ sān bǐ yí zhàn shèng le hán guó duì huò dé zhè ge xiàng mù dì jīn pái dāng zhè sān gè biǎo yǎn xiàng mù quán bù jié shù hòu zhōng guó duì huò dé liǎng kuài jīn pái hé yí kuài yín pái — Group B: On August 27, in the individual event “Royale” (the book glosses 皇室战争 as Battle Royale), the Chinese player Huang Chenghui won the silver medal in this event after twelve hours of play. In the “League of Legends” exhibition match on August 29, the Chinese team beat the Korean team 3 to 1 and won the gold medal in this event. When all three exhibition events had ended, the Chinese team had won two gold medals and one silver medal. (translation mine)

examples.text: 这是中国电竞队第一次参加亚运会电竞表演赛。中国队取得这么好的成绩，对电竞产业来说是一件很重要的事情，同时也会改变了一些人的看法。以前，很多人认为电竞和玩游戏一样，不能作为一种职业，但现在电竞成为亚运会的表演项目，以后会成为正式的比赛项目，这会给电竞行业的发展带来巨大的影响。
examples.translation: zhè shì zhōng guó diàn jìng duì dì yī cì cān jiā yà yùn huì diàn jìng biǎo yǎn sài zhōng guó duì qǔ dé zhè me hǎo de chéng jì duì diàn jìng chǎn yè lái shuō shì yí jiàn hěn zhòng yào de shì qíng tóng shí yě huì gǎi biàn le yì xiē rén de kàn fǎ yǐ qián hěn duō rén rèn wéi diàn jìng hé wán yóu xì yí yàng bù néng zuò wéi yì zhǒng zhí yè dàn xiàn zài diàn jìng chéng wéi yà yùn huì de biǎo yǎn xiàng mù yǐ hòu huì chéng wéi zhèng shì de bǐ sài xiàng mù zhè huì gěi diàn jìng háng yè de fā zhǎn dài lái jù dà de yǐng xiǎng — Group C: This is the first time the Chinese e-sports team took part in the Asian Games e-sports exhibition matches. That the Chinese team got such good results is a very important thing for the e-sports industry, and it will also change some people’s views. In the past many people thought e-sports was the same as playing games and could not be a profession, but now e-sports has become an exhibition event of the Asian Games and will become an official competition event later, which will bring a huge impact on the development of the e-sports industry. (translation mine; the book prints 会改变了, which looks like a slip for 会改变)

examples.text: 中国电竞队在二零一八年雅加达亚运会电竞表演赛上，以二比零战胜台北队，获得了第一块金牌。
examples.translation: zhōng guó diàn jìng duì zài èr líng yī bā nián yǎ jiā dá yà yùn huì diàn jìng biǎo yǎn sài shàng yǐ èr bǐ líng zhàn shèng tái běi duì huò dé le dì yī kuài jīn pái — Activity 2A, my summary of Group A: At the 2018 Jakarta Asian Games e-sports exhibition, the Chinese team beat the Taipei team 2 to 0 and won the first gold medal.

examples.text: 中国选手黄成辉在“皇室战争”中得了银牌，中国队又在“英雄联盟”中以三比一战胜韩国队得了金牌，一共两块金牌和一块银牌。
examples.translation: zhōng guó xuǎn shǒu huáng chéng huī zài huáng shì zhàn zhēng zhōng dé le yín pái zhōng guó duì yòu zài yīng xióng lián méng zhōng yǐ sān bǐ yí zhàn shèng hán guó duì dé le jīn pái yí gòng liǎng kuài jīn pái hé yí kuài yín pái — My summary of Group B: Chinese player Huang Chenghui won silver in “Royale”, and the Chinese team beat Korea 3 to 1 in “League of Legends” for gold, two golds and one silver in all.

examples.text: 这是中国电竞队第一次参加亚运会，成绩很好，会改变人们对电竞的看法，对电竞行业的发展有巨大的影响。
examples.translation: zhè shì zhōng guó diàn jìng duì dì yī cì cān jiā yà yùn huì chéng jì hěn hǎo huì gǎi biàn rén men duì diàn jìng de kàn fǎ duì diàn jìng háng yè de fā zhǎn yǒu jù dà de yǐng xiǎng — My summary of Group C: This was the Chinese e-sports team’s first Asian Games; the results were good and will change people’s view of e-sports, with a huge impact on the industry’s development.

examples.text: 如果你给刚读过的这篇文章一个标题，你会写什么？
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ gěi gāng dú guò de zhè piān wén zhāng yí gè biāo tí nǐ huì xiě shén me — Activity 2C: If you gave the article you just read a title, what would you write?

examples.text: 为什么说中国电竞队在亚运会上得到冠军，对中国电竞产业很重要？
examples.translation: wèi shén me shuō zhōng guó diàn jìng duì zài yà yùn huì shàng dé dào guàn jūn duì zhōng guó diàn jìng chǎn yè hěn zhòng yào — Why do we say that the Chinese e-sports team winning a championship at the Asian Games is very important for China’s e-sports industry? (my answer: because it changes people’s view that e-sports is only playing games, and e-sports may become an official event)

examples.text: 很多人认为电竞和玩电子游戏差不多，你有什么看法？
examples.translation: hěn duō rén rèn wéi diàn jìng hé wán diàn zǐ yóu xì chà bu duō nǐ yǒu shén me kàn fǎ — Many people think e-sports and playing video games are about the same; what is your view?

lessons.subtitle: 李相赫 · 英雄联盟 · 首尔大学 · 入学资格 · 电竞职业 · 学习和游戏 · 电子邮件

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and read the passages about Li Xianghe (Faker) and write a summary. B. With your partner, talk about the following topics. C. Share your discussion with the class. The passage (printed under the heading 李相赫, with two photos), the glosses, my summary and the questions:

rows: the player’s name; the book gives his in-game name as Faker
the club he joined (left out of the spoken text)
tables.title: Activity 3A: the glosses in brackets

examples.text: 说到游戏“英雄联盟”，不能不提到韩国职业选手李相赫。李相赫于一九九六年五月七日在韩国首尔出生，他的游戏账户名叫Ｆａｋｅｒ。李相赫和爸爸在一起生活，他爸爸一直相信他天生就是一个电竞职业选手。二零一一年十二月，他开始玩“英雄联盟”，他很快就知道这个游戏的玩法。不管是学习还是玩游戏，他都非常努力。即使喜欢玩游戏，他的学习成绩也非常好，而且还得到了首尔大学的入学资格，但是他没有去上大学，他选择了电竞职业，加入了国际电子竞技俱乐部，成为一名“英雄联盟”的电竞选手。Ｆａｋｅｒ的电竞技术非常好，获得很多次冠军，是“英雄联盟”比赛中获得冠军最多的职业选手。
examples.translation: shuō dào yóu xì yīng xióng lián méng bù néng bù tí dào hán guó zhí yè xuǎn shǒu lǐ xiāng hè lǐ xiāng hè yú yī jiǔ jiǔ liù nián wǔ yuè qī rì zài hán guó shǒu ěr chū shēng tā de yóu xì zhàng hù míng jiào lǐ xiāng hè hé bà bà zài yì qǐ shēng huó tā bà bà yì zhí xiāng xìn tā tiān shēng jiù shì yí gè diàn jìng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu èr líng yī yī nián shí èr yuè tā kāi shǐ wán yīng xióng lián méng tā hěn kuài jiù zhī dào zhè ge yóu xì de wán fǎ bù guǎn shì xué xí hái shì wán yóu xì tā dōu fēi cháng nǔ lì jí shǐ xǐ huān wán yóu xì tā de xué xí chéng jì yě fēi cháng hǎo ér qiě hái dé dào le shǒu ěr dà xué de rù xué zī gé dàn shì tā méi yǒu qù shàng dà xué tā xuǎn zé le diàn jìng zhí yè jiā rù le guó jì diàn zi jìng jì jù lè bù chéng wéi yì míng yīng xióng lián méng de diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu de diàn jìng jì shù fēi cháng hǎo huò dé hěn duō cì guàn jūn shì yīng xióng lián méng bǐ sài zhōng huò dé guàn jūn zuì duō de zhí yè xuǎn shǒu — Speaking of the game “League of Legends”, one cannot fail to mention the Korean professional player Li Xianghe (Lee Sang-hyeok). Li Xianghe was born in Seoul, Korea, on May 7, 1996, and his game account name is Faker. Li Xianghe lives with his father, who has always believed he was born to be a professional e-sports player. In December 2011 he began to play “League of Legends” and soon knew how the game is played. Whether studying or playing games, he works very hard. Even though he likes playing games, his grades are very good, and he even got a qualification to enter Seoul National University, but he did not go to university; he chose the e-sports profession, joined an international e-sports club and became an e-sports player of “League of Legends”. Faker’s e-sports skill is very good; he has won many championships and is the professional player with the most championships in “League of Legends” matches. (translation mine; the book names the club SKT T1, left out of the spoken text, and writes the dates in digits)

examples.text: 李相赫是韩国“英雄联盟”职业选手，游戏账户名叫Ｆａｋｅｒ。他学习成绩很好，也很努力，但是没有去上首尔大学，而是选择了电竞职业，获得了很多次冠军。
examples.translation: lǐ xiāng hè shì hán guó yīng xióng lián méng zhí yè xuǎn shǒu yóu xì zhàng hù míng jiào tā xué xí chéng jì hěn hǎo yě hěn nǔ lì dàn shì méi yǒu qù shàng shǒu ěr dà xué ér shì xuǎn zé le diàn jìng zhí yè huò dé le hěn duō cì guàn jūn — Activity 3A, my summary: Li Xianghe is a Korean professional “League of Legends” player whose game account name is Faker. His grades were very good and he worked hard, but he did not go to Seoul National University and chose the e-sports profession instead, winning many championships.

examples.text: 你有没有看过李相赫“英雄联盟”的比赛？你觉得他在比赛中表现怎么样？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guò lǐ xiāng hè yīng xióng lián méng de bǐ sài nǐ jué de tā zài bǐ sài zhōng biǎo xiàn zěn me yàng — Activity 3B: Have you watched Li Xianghe’s “League of Legends” matches? How do you think he performs in contests?

examples.text: 在全球，哪个电竞选手玩“英雄联盟”玩得最好？
examples.translation: zài quán qiú nǎ ge diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu wán yīng xióng lián méng wán de zuì hǎo — Worldwide, which e-sports player plays “League of Legends” best?

examples.text: 李相赫没有去上大学而去做电竞选手，你觉得他的做法怎么样？
examples.translation: lǐ xiāng hè méi yǒu qù shàng dà xué ér qù zuò diàn jìng xuǎn shǒu nǐ jué de tā de zuò fǎ zěn me yàng — Li Xianghe did not go to university but became an e-sports player; what do you think of what he did?

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and compose a short e-mail to Faker. In your e-mail, introduce yourself to Faker and ask him how to balance studying and video game playing. B. With your partner, pretend that you are Faker and write an e-mail responding to the questions about balancing studying and video game playing. C. Share your writing with the class.

rows: 请问怎么平衡学习和玩游戏
tables.title: Activity 4A: the e-mail header (the book leaves TO, CC and Subject blank)

examples.text: 你好！我是一名大学生，正在学中文。我也很喜欢玩“英雄联盟”，常常看你的比赛。我想请问你，怎么才能平衡学习和玩游戏？谢谢！
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo wǒ shì yì míng dà xué shēng zhèng zài xué zhōng wén wǒ yě hěn xǐ huān wán yīng xióng lián méng cháng cháng kàn nǐ de bǐ sài wǒ xiǎng qǐng wèn nǐ zěn me cái néng píng héng xué xí hé wán yóu xì xiè xiè — Activity 4A (my sample e-mail): Hello! I am a university student studying Chinese. I also like playing “League of Legends” and often watch your matches. I’d like to ask you: how can one balance studying and playing games? Thank you! (Activity 4B asks you to pretend to be Faker and write the reply; I give no sample, since it would put invented words into a real person’s mouth.)

exercises.prompt: Which game is Li Xianghe famous for?
What has his father always believed?
options: That he was born to be a professional e-sports player
That he should be a doctor
exercises.explanation: 天生就是一个电竞职业选手.

exercises.prompt: What did he get an entry qualification for?
What did he choose to do?
options: The e-sports profession instead of university

exercises.prompt: What is said about his championships?
options: He has won the most of any professional League of Legends player
exercises.explanation: 获得冠军最多的职业选手.

lessons.subtitle: 当电竞员的好处和坏处 · 游戏调查 · 大学生玩游戏 · 平衡学习和玩 · 游戏直播平台 · 游戏名字

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: Your Chinese roommate is going to graduate from college and wants to be an e-sports player. However, his mother doesn’t want him to engage in e-sports and hopes he can find a regular job. Your roommate asks you to persuade his mother to agree with his decision. A. Listen to the recording and mark the following statements as either True or False. B. Pair up and check your answers with your partner’s. Discuss what information can be used to convince your roommate’s mother. C. With your partner, discuss the pros and cons of playing e-sports as a career, using information from the recording and your personal experience. Provide at least three points for each aspect. D. Each pair takes turns presenting the pros and cons to persuade your roommate’s mother. (The recording is not in the book, so the statements have no key.)

rows: 要长时间训练，压力很大
电竞在中国非常流行，选手可以有大量的粉丝，成为明星
选手要年轻，年纪大了反应慢，就很难再比赛
可以代表国家参加大赛，得冠军
有些人还不把电竞看作一个正式的工作
现在人们认识到电子游戏是一种智力活动
玩游戏的时间太长，对学习和身体都不好
tables.title: Activity 1C: 当电竞员的好处和坏处 (my sample, from Presentation 3 and the skill-integration passages; the book leaves the table empty)

examples.text: 电竞行业在中国越来越火，现在已有五十万电子竞技员。
examples.translation: diàn jìng háng yè zài zhōng guó yuè lái yuè huǒ xiàn zài yǐ yǒu wǔ shí wàn diàn zi jìng jì yuán — Activity 1A-1 (true or false, audio; the book writes 50 万 in digits): The e-sports industry is getting hotter in China, and there are now already 500,000 e-sports players.

examples.text: 在中国，有的大学开始招收电竞专业的学生。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó yǒu de dà xué kāi shǐ zhāo shōu diàn jìng zhuān yè de xué shēng — 1A-2: In China, some universities have begun to admit students in e-sports majors.

examples.text: 尽管电竞发展很快，很多人还是认为电竞员不是一个正式的工作。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn diàn jìng fā zhǎn hěn kuài hěn duō rén hái shì rèn wéi diàn jìng yuán bú shì yí gè zhèng shì de gōng zuò — 1A-3: Although e-sports is developing fast, many people still think e-sports players do not have a proper job.

examples.text: 所有的电竞员工资都很高，可以在一线城市买房子和汽车。
examples.translation: suǒ yǒu de diàn jìng yuán gōng zī dōu hěn gāo kě yǐ zài yí xiàn chéng shì mǎi fáng zi hé qì chē — 1A-4: All e-sports players have very high pay and can buy houses and cars in first-tier cities.

examples.text: 电竞员除了每月的工资以外还有一些其他的收入。
examples.translation: diàn jìng yuán chú le měi yuè de gōng zī yǐ wài hái yǒu yì xiē qí tā de shōu rù — 1A-5: Besides the monthly salary, e-sports players have some other income.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: You are currently enrolled in an intensive Chinese basic course and your schedule of Chinese studies is very tight. Your teacher is aware that some students spend a lot of time playing video games or watching game streaming. To help students better manage their time, your teacher initiates a discussion in the class on how to balance study and play. A. examples.text: 根据最近的一个调查，现在大学生平均一天要玩两个小时的游戏，男生女生都玩，而且越是好学校，玩游戏的人越多，很多人对这个调查结果表示担心。其实，把游戏看作是很可怕的事情是不对的。从这次调查结果来看，有不少和我们以前对游戏的看法有不同的地方。比如，我们过去认为男孩子更喜欢玩游戏，但这次调查却表明，男女都喜欢玩游戏，这说明游戏受到很多人的喜爱。另外我们也应该认识到，游戏已经成为一种娱乐和社交工具，就像有些人喜欢唱歌，游泳，下棋一样。

According to a recent survey, university students now play games for two hours a day on average, boys and girls both play, and the better the school the more people play games; many people expressed worry about the result of this survey. Actually, it is wrong to regard games as a very frightening thing. Judging from the result of this survey, there are quite a few differences from our former views of games. For example, we used to think boys liked playing games more, but this survey shows that both boys and girls like playing games, which shows that games are loved by many people. In addition we should also realize that games have become a tool for entertainment and socializing, just as some people like singing, swimming and playing chess. (translation mine)

examples.text: 这次调查还发现好学校的学生更爱玩游戏，很多人认为他们进了好学校就放松了学习。我不这样认为。有些学生既会学习又会玩，也喜欢社交活动，因为他们有好的学习方法，所以有时间去玩自己喜欢的东西。当然，如果大学生每天就是玩电子游戏，而没有其他的社交活动，或是对学习以及生活中的事情没有兴趣，这就需要去改变这种情况。
examples.translation: zhè cì diào chá hái fā xiàn hǎo xué xiào de xué shēng gèng ài wán yóu xì hěn duō rén rèn wéi tā men jìn le hǎo xué xiào jiù fàng sōng le xué xí wǒ bú zhè yàng rèn wéi yǒu xiē xué shēng jì huì xué xí yòu huì wán yě xǐ huān shè jiāo huó dòng yīn wèi tā men yǒu hǎo de xué xí fāng fǎ suǒ yǐ yǒu shí jiān qù wán zì jǐ xǐ huān de dōng xī dāng rán rú guǒ dà xué shēng měi tiān jiù shì wán diàn zǐ yóu xì ér méi yǒu qí tā de shè jiāo huó dòng huò shì duì xué xí yǐ jí shēng huó zhōng de shì qíng méi yǒu xìng qù zhè jiù xū yào qù gǎi biàn zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng — Paragraph 2. This survey also found that students at good schools like playing games even more, and many people think that once they enter a good school they relax their studies. I don’t think so. Some students both study well and play well and also like social activities; because they have good study methods, they have time to play what they like. Of course, if a university student just plays video games every day, without other social activities, or has no interest in studying and the things in life, then this situation needs to be changed.
