lessons.title: 719. Lesson 27 Area Studies: E-commerce in Rural China
lessons.subtitle: 农村电商 · 直播卖农产品 · 淘宝 · 脱贫 · 手机支付 · 农民 · 乡村振兴

explanations.title: E-commerce in Rural China (1): deliveries to the village
explanations.body: Ten years ago, the choice of products that 800 million rural Chinese consumers could buy depended on what the commissaries sold. Nowadays, when farmers place orders on their mobile phones, goods from cities can be delivered directly to the village. Farmers can buy the same goods at the same price as buyers in the city. Receiving express deliveries has become a part of daily life. In fact, as early as 2014, China launched e-commerce projects in rural areas. It has supported 1,180 counties and achieved coverage of 832 national-level, poverty-stricken counties so far. Rural e-commerce has developed rapidly, and rural online retail sales have increased from 180 billion yuan in 2014 to 1.7 trillion yuan in 2019, as the overall scale has expanded 8.4 times.

explanations.title: (2): infrastructure and payment
explanations.body: The development of rural e-commerce has achieved remarkable results. Due to the construction of rural infrastructure over the years, including the rapid development of communications, logistics, and electronic payment, the various obstacles to e-commerce in the countryside were eliminated. Statistics show that the current number of rural Internet users in China has exceeded 250 million. The average number of bank cards held by each individual in rural areas across the country is 3.61. The number of mobile banking and online banking accounts in rural areas has reached 816 million and 712 million respectively. Banking institutions, third-party payment institutions, telecommunications operators, and Internet technology companies have strengthened their cooperation by allowing rural households to use mobile payments and online payments, which gradually eliminate payment service gaps in rural areas. Nowadays, online shopping has become a norm in farmers’ lives. More and more services and commodities have entered the countryside through e-commerce, which has changed farmers’ lives and consumption habits. (The picture caption reads: 拼多多创尔女装官方旗舰店主播聂建茹正在直播, “Nie Jianru, the streamer of the Pinduoduo Chuang’er women’s wear official flagship store, is live streaming”; the picture is not included.)

explanations.title: (3): livestreaming farmers
explanations.body: At the same time, growing rural e-commerce has greatly broadened the sales channels of agricultural products and promoted farmers’ entrepreneurship and employment. Marketing local produce through livestreaming platforms became popular. According to statistics published by the Alibaba Group, at the end of March 2020, more than 60,000 Chinese farmers were registered as hosts on the Taobao platform. Fields, greenhouses, warehouses and even fishing boats have been transformed into livestreaming studios. The fresh food channel on Taobao alone brings together 168,000 types of agricultural products from 832 poor counties in China and has made 2.5 billion yuan (352 million USD) in sales since January 2020. The agricultural specialty products of some poor villages have become “net celebrity” brands in a short period of time.

explanations.title: (4): support measures and the fight against poverty
explanations.body: In order to help farmers better adapt to this new kind of sales channel, government at all levels and the main e-commerce platforms in China have taken various measures to support these new hosts, providing technical training or organizing events dedicated to the sale of products from the country’s poorest regions. Rural e-commerce logistics continue to accelerate the trend of “industrial products exported to the countryside and agricultural products imported to the city”. It has also provided support for the production and sales of agricultural products. Sales of agricultural products through livestreaming platforms have played an important role in the fight against poverty in recent years. The development of rural e-commerce and the implementation of targeted poverty alleviation are deeply integrated to increase the income of the poor while solving unemployment. According to data from the China E-commerce Poverty Alleviation Alliance in 2019, its member units sold more than 2.8 billion yuan of agricultural products in poverty-stricken areas, covering 842 enterprises in 478 poverty-stricken counties in 22 provinces and assisted 80,000 farmers. As of March 2020, national-level e-commerce in poverty-stricken counties has employed more than 9 million farmers. E-commerce has effectively achieved poverty alleviation and rural revitalization in China. References (titles of the sites only; the web addresses are left out): Logclub, Sina Finance, China.org.cn and ChinAfrica.

lessons.subtitle: 第二十八课 中国的年轻人 · 独生子女 · 赶上好时候 · 舍得花钱 · 目标高 · 加塞儿 · 让座 · 大有前途

explanations.title: Learning objectives of Lesson 28 (China’s Youth, 中国的年轻人)
explanations.body: Upon completion of this lesson, you should be able to: discuss China’s youth including their education, abilities, and ambitions; discuss China’s youth including their values and experiences growing up; discuss China’s youth including their entrepreneurship, such as creativity, goals, and management skills. To perform the above you must master the new words and phrases associated with these functions and the following: discourse grammar (那是, 可不, 说了, 就像……说的, expressions to bring up or elaborate on a topic, inserting a question to draw the listener’s attention, 同时); the 可……了 construction; the expression 注意到; adverbs of degree; 就是 expressing insistence; parallel sentences; 呢 to express contrast; 什么 to soften the tone in a negative sentence; the use of …不…，但是…很… construction; the 要 + verb + 就 + verb …的 construction. The Area Studies topic is the post-’70, post-’80, post-’90 and post-’00 generations and the eras in which they grew up.

explanations.title: Getting Started

examples.text: 小张：老高，刚才电视上的英语演讲比赛，那几个年轻人英语说得太棒了！
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng lǎo gāo gāng cái diàn shì shàng de yīng yǔ yǎn jiǎng bǐ sài nà jǐ gè nián qīng rén yīng yǔ shuō de tài bàng le — Xiao Zhang: Lao Gao, in the English speech contest on TV just now, those young people spoke English so well! (translations in this card are mine)

examples.text: 老高：对。他们从小就学英语，网上又有那么多的学习材料，当然能学好。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo duì tā men cóng xiǎo jiù xué yīng yǔ wǎng shàng yòu yǒu nà me duō de xué xí cái liào dāng rán néng xué hǎo — Lao Gao: Right. They have studied English since childhood and there are so many learning materials online, so of course they can learn it well.

examples.text: 小张：现在的学习条件多好，九零后、零零后真是赶上好时候了。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng xiàn zài de xué xí tiáo jiàn duō hǎo jiǔ líng hòu líng líng hòu zhēn shì gǎn shàng hǎo shí hòu le — Xiao Zhang: Learning conditions are so good now; the post-’90s and post-’00s have really caught good times.

examples.text: 老高：那是。他们都是独生子女，父母舍得花钱，受教育的机会比咱们年轻的时候多多了。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo nà shì tā men dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ fù mǔ shě de huā qián shòu jiào yù de jī huì bǐ zán men nián qīng de shí hòu duō duō le — Lao Gao: Absolutely. They are all only children, their parents are willing to spend money, and their opportunities for education are far more than when we were young.

examples.text: 小张：这代人不但知道得多，能力也比咱们强。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng zhè dài rén bú dàn zhī dào de duō néng lì yě bǐ zán men qiáng — Xiao Zhang: This generation not only knows a lot, but is also more capable than we are.

examples.text: 老高：对，有些人年纪轻轻就有了自己的公司，还有的二十多岁就当上了大学教授。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo duì yǒu xiē rén nián jì qīng qīng jiù yǒu le zì jǐ de gōng sī hái yǒu de èr shí duō suì jiù dāng shàng le dà xué jiào shòu — Lao Gao: Yes, some have their own companies while still very young, and some became university professors in their twenties.

examples.text: 小张：他们不仅能力强，目标也高。有一个稳定的工作，已经不能让他们满足了。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng tā men bù jǐn néng lì qiáng mù biāo yě gāo yǒu yí gè wěn dìng de gōng zuò yǐ jīng bù néng ràng tā men mǎn zú le — Xiao Zhang: Not only are they capable, their goals are also high. Having a stable job can no longer satisfy them.

examples.text: 老高：可不。我儿子说了，他将来要做阿里巴巴的马云，或脸书的扎克伯格。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo kě bù wǒ ér zi shuō le tā jiāng lái yào zuò ā lǐ bā bā de mǎ yún huò liǎn shū de zhā kè bó gé — Lao Gao: Exactly. My son said he wants to be the Jack Ma of Alibaba or the Zuckerberg of Facebook in the future.

examples.text: 小张：这代人想得比咱们可高多了。你发现没有，他们做事也比较文明。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng zhè dài rén xiǎng de bǐ zán men kě gāo duō le nǐ fā xiàn méi yǒu tā men zuò shì yě bǐ jiào wén míng — Xiao Zhang: This generation thinks much higher than we do. Have you noticed that they also behave in a fairly civilized way?

examples.text: 老高：对。我也注意到，他们排队时不大会加塞儿，坐公交时还主动给老人让座。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo duì wǒ yě zhù yì dào tā men pái duì shí bú dà huì jiā sāir zuò gōng jiāo shí hái zhǔ dòng gěi lǎo rén ràng zuò — Lao Gao: Yes. I have also noticed that they rarely cut in line when queueing, and on the bus they even offer their seats to old people on their own initiative.

examples.text: 小张：当然，他们也有一些不足的地方，比如生活能力就不太强。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng dāng rán tā men yě yǒu yì xiē bù zú de dì fāng bǐ rú shēng huó néng lì jiù bú tài qiáng — Xiao Zhang: Of course, they also have some shortcomings, for example their ability to take care of themselves isn’t very strong.

examples.text: 老高：那是。不足总是有的，不过他们这一代还是大有前途的。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo nà shì bù zú zǒng shì yǒu de bú guò tā men zhè yí dài hái shì dà yǒu qián tú de — Lao Gao: Absolutely. There are always shortcomings, but this generation still has a great future.

examples.text: 他们的条件大大改善了，所以知道得更多，能力也更强。
examples.translation: tā men de tiáo jiàn dà dà gǎi shàn le suǒ yǐ zhī dào de gèng duō néng lì yě gèng qiáng — 1A-2 (my answer): They are more knowledgeable and capable due to greatly improved conditions.

examples.text: 因为他们从小就学英语，网上又有很多学习材料。
examples.translation: yīn wèi tā men cóng xiǎo jiù xué yīng yǔ wǎng shàng yòu yǒu hěn duō xué xí cái liào — 1B-1 (my answer): Because they have studied English since childhood and there are many learning materials online.

examples.text: 他们的父母舍得花钱，让他们受教育的机会比以前多多了。
examples.translation: tā men de fù mǔ shě de huā qián ràng tā men shòu jiào yù de jī huì bǐ yǐ qián duō duō le — 1B-2 (my answer): Their parents are willing to spend money, so they have far more opportunities for education than before.

examples.text: 老高的儿子说，他将来要做马云或者扎克伯格；有的人年纪轻轻就有了自己的公司，还有的二十多岁就当上了大学教授。
examples.translation: lǎo gāo de ér zi shuō tā jiāng lái yào zuò mǎ yún huò zhě zhā kè bó gé yǒu de rén nián jì qīng qīng jiù yǒu le zì jǐ de gōng sī hái yǒu de èr shí duō suì jiù dāng shàng le dà xué jiào shòu — 1B-3 (my answer): Lao Gao’s son says he wants to be Jack Ma or Zuckerberg; some have their own companies when very young and some become university professors in their twenties.

examples.text: 他们排队时不大会加塞儿，坐公交时还主动给老人让座。
examples.translation: tā men pái duì shí bú dà huì jiā sāir zuò gōng jiāo shí hái zhǔ dòng gěi lǎo rén ràng zuò — 1B-4 (my answer): They rarely cut in line and offer their seats to old people on the bus.

examples.text: 他们的生活能力不太强。
examples.translation: tā men de shēng huó néng lì bú tài qiáng — 1B-5 (my answer): Their ability to take care of themselves is not very strong.

Why can the young people speak English so well?

options: Wanting to be like Jack Ma or Zuckerberg

options: They rarely cut in line and give up seats on the bus

lessons.title: 721. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 activities 2-4: expressions, fill-in and matching
lessons.subtitle: 独生子女 · 年纪轻轻 · 加塞儿 · 赶上 · 舍得 · 满足 · 不足 · 前途 · 演讲 · 材料

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and think about the expressions in Presentation 1 that are related to the three areas shown in the table below. Write them in the space provided. B. With your partner, complete the sentences using the words listed below: 独生子女 | 演讲 | 年纪轻轻 | 不足 | 目标 | 材料 | 赶上 | 满足 | 前途 | 加塞儿 | 可不 | 文明 | 舍得. C. Take turns translating the sentences into English. My sample table and key:

rows: 从小就学英语; 网上有那么多的学习材料; 学习条件多好; 独生子女; 父母舍得花钱; 受教育的机会多多了
英语说得太棒了; 知道得多; 能力比咱们强; 年纪轻轻就有了自己的公司; 二十多岁就当上了大学教授; 目标也高; 要做马云或扎克伯格
做事比较文明; 排队时不大会加塞儿; 坐公交时主动给老人让座
tables.title: Activity 2A: expressions from Presentation 1 (my sample; the book leaves the table empty)

examples.text: 前边那个人，年纪轻轻的，别人排队他却加塞儿，太不文明了！
examples.translation: qián biān nà ge rén nián jì qīng qīng de bié rén pái duì tā què jiā sāir tài bù wén míng le — Activity 2B-1 (my key: 年纪轻轻, 加塞儿, 文明): That person in front, so young, yet he cuts in while others are queueing; how uncivilized!

examples.text: 甲：他们这一代，多数是独生子女，从小生活条件就很好，真是赶上好时候了。
examples.translation: jiǎ tā men zhè yí dài duō shù shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ cóng xiǎo shēng huó tiáo jiàn jiù hěn hǎo zhēn shì gǎn shàng hǎo shí hòu le — 2B-2 (my key: 独生子女, 赶上, 可不, 前途) A: Most of this generation are only children and have had very good living conditions since childhood; they really caught good times.

examples.text: 乙：可不。他们受教育的机会比我们多多了，将来一定很有前途。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù tā men shòu jiào yù de jī huì bǐ wǒ men duō duō le jiāng lái yí dìng hěn yǒu qián tú — B: Exactly. Their educational opportunities are far more than ours, and they will surely have a great future.

examples.text: 王教授正在为明天的演讲准备材料。
examples.translation: wáng jiào shòu zhèng zài wèi míng tiān de yǎn jiǎng zhǔn bèi cái liào — 2B-3 (my key: 演讲, 材料): Professor Wang is preparing materials for tomorrow’s speech.

examples.text: 他们的能力很强，又有一个很大的目标，也注意到了自己的不足，将来一定会成功的。
examples.translation: tā men de néng lì hěn qiáng yòu yǒu yí gè hěn dà de mù biāo yě zhù yì dào le zì jǐ de bù zú jiāng lái yí dìng huì chéng gōng de — 2B-4 (my key: 目标, 不足): Their ability is very strong and they have a big goal, and they have also noticed their own shortcomings; they will surely succeed in the future.

examples.text: 一个稳定的生活是不大会让他满足的。为了理想，他舍得失去得到的一切。
examples.translation: yí gè wěn dìng de shēng huó shì bú dà huì ràng tā mǎn zú de wèi le lǐ xiǎng tā shě de shī qù dé dào de yí qiè — 2B-5 (my key: 满足, 舍得): A stable life would hardly satisfy him. For his ideal, he is willing to lose everything he has gained.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to two dialogs and match them with the pictures below (A, B and C; three pictures are not included). B. Pair up. Each partner listens to one dialog and writes a summary. Fill in your part of the table below. C. Ask your partner questions about the dialog they hear and fill in the other part of the table. D. Summarize your partner’s dialog. Discuss your summary with your partner. E. Check your summary against the script, then share your summary with the class. (Audio and pictures; the script is not in the book, so there is no key.)

tables.title: Activity 3B: the summary table (the dialogs are audio and the three pictures A, B, C are not included; the cells are empty in the book)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Match the parts in Column A with the parts in Column B by writing the letter in the leftmost column. Share your work with a classmate. B. Pair up and take turns translating the sentences into English. Your partner will translate them back into Chinese without looking at the table. Then go back to the table, check for any errors, and make corrections accordingly. The book’s matching is left blank (and its columns are scrambled in the PDF); the seven completed sentences are my key:

examples.text: 现在的年轻人不但能力强，也很注意文明礼貌。他们排队很少加塞儿。
examples.translation: xiàn zài de nián qīng rén bú dàn néng lì qiáng yě hěn zhù yì wén míng lǐ mào tā men pái duì hěn shǎo jiā sāir — Activity 4, 1-d (my key): Young people today are not only capable but also pay attention to civility and manners. They rarely cut in line.

examples.text: 我弟弟虽然是个九零后，年纪很轻，可他已经是大学教授了。
examples.translation: wǒ dì di suī rán shì gè jiǔ líng hòu nián jì hěn qīng kě tā yǐ jīng shì dà xué jiào shòu le — 2-e: Although my younger brother is post-’90s and very young, he is already a university professor.

examples.text: 我们没赶上好时候，所以年轻时目标不高，只要有一个稳定的工作就满足了。
examples.translation: wǒ men méi gǎn shàng hǎo shí hòu suǒ yǐ nián qīng shí mù biāo bù gāo zhǐ yào yǒu yí gè wěn dìng de gōng zuò jiù mǎn zú le — 3-g: We didn’t catch good times, so our goals were not high when we were young; we were satisfied as long as we had a stable job.

examples.text: 她的中文怎么说得那么棒？她从小就参加中文学校，也经常上网学中文。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén zěn me shuō de nà me bàng tā cóng xiǎo jiù cān jiā zhōng wén xué xiào yě jīng cháng shàng wǎng xué zhōng wén — 4-f: How does she speak Chinese so well? She has attended Chinese school since childhood and often studies Chinese online.

examples.text: 你们的条件比我们年轻时好得太多了，所以你们就应该想得比我们高。
examples.translation: nǐ men de tiáo jiàn bǐ wǒ men nián qīng shí hǎo de tài duō le suǒ yǐ nǐ men jiù yīng gāi xiǎng de bǐ wǒ men gāo — 5-c: Your conditions are far better than ours were when we were young, so you should think higher than we did.

examples.text: 他们还年轻，一定会有这样或那样的不足。
examples.translation: tā men hái nián qīng yí dìng huì yǒu zhè yàng huò nà yàng de bù zú — 6-a: They are still young and will surely have one shortcoming or another.

examples.text: 他们都是独生子女的父母，虽然自己的生活条件不一定很好，可是都舍得花钱让孩子受很好的教育。
examples.translation: tā men dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ de fù mǔ suī rán zì jǐ de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bù yí dìng hěn hǎo kě shì dōu shě de huā qián ràng hái zi shòu hěn hǎo de jiào yù — 7-b: They are all parents of only children; although their own living conditions are not necessarily good, they are all willing to spend money so that their child gets a very good education.

lessons.title: 722. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 grammar: discourse grammar 那是 and 可不
lessons.subtitle: 那是 · 可不 · 可不是吗 · 表示同意 · 在加州学中文 · 蒙特雷 · 国防语言学院

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: 那是
explanations.body: In colloquial Chinese, 那是 can be used to indicate that one agrees with what has been said, similar to “You’re right” or “Absolutely” in English. It is often followed by an explanation.

rows: indicates that one agrees with what has been said, similar to “You’re right” or “Absolutely”; often followed by an explanation
tables.title: Discourse Grammar: 那是

examples.text: 甲：在加州现在学中文的人越来越多了。
examples.translation: jiǎ zài jiā zhōu xiàn zài xué zhōng wén de rén yuè lái yuè duō le — 1. A: More and more people in California are learning Chinese now.

examples.text: 乙：那是，有的地方连小学都有中文课了。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì yǒu de dì fāng lián xiǎo xué dōu yǒu zhōng wén kè le — B: Absolutely; in some places even elementary schools have Chinese classes.

examples.text: 甲：李琳的女儿真有礼貌。
examples.translation: jiǎ lǐ lín de nǚ ér zhēn yǒu lǐ mào — 2. A: Li Lin’s daughter is really polite.

examples.text: 乙：那是，每次看见大人，她老远就问好。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì měi cì kàn jiàn dà rén tā lǎo yuǎn jiù wèn hǎo — B: Absolutely; every time she sees an adult she greets them from far away.

examples.text: 甲：老张唱歌唱得真棒。
examples.translation: jiǎ lǎo zhāng chàng gē chàng de zhēn bàng — 3. A: Lao Zhang sings really well.

examples.text: 乙：那是，他一直是合唱队的主要队员。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā yì zhí shì hé chàng duì de zhǔ yào duì yuán — B: Absolutely; he has always been a main member of the choir.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the exchanges, beginning with 那是. B. Share your work with a classmate. Take turns translating your exchanges into English. My answers (the book leaves the B lines blank):

examples.text: 甲：这儿的天气真好。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhèr de tiān qì zhēn hǎo — Activity 1A-1 (my answers to the five exchanges): A: The weather here is really nice.

examples.text: 乙：那是，这儿一年四季都不太冷也不太热。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì zhèr yì nián sì jì dōu bú tài lěng yě bú tài rè — B: Absolutely; it is neither too cold nor too hot here all year round.

examples.text: 甲：她的中文字写得真漂亮。
examples.translation: jiǎ tā de zhōng wén zì xiě de zhēn piào liàng — 2. A: Her Chinese characters are written beautifully.

examples.text: 乙：那是，她从小就跟奶奶学写毛笔字。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā cóng xiǎo jiù gēn nǎi nǎi xué xiě máo bǐ zì — B: Absolutely; she has learned to write with a brush from her grandmother since childhood.

examples.text: 甲：你和老马是老朋友了吧？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ hé lǎo mǎ shì lǎo péng yǒu le ba — 3. A: You and Lao Ma are old friends, aren’t you?

examples.text: 乙：那是，我们从小学就是同学。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì wǒ men cóng xiǎo xué jiù shì tóng xué — B: Absolutely; we have been classmates since elementary school.

examples.text: 甲：国防语言学院的历史很久了吧？
examples.translation: jiǎ guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn de lì shǐ hěn jiǔ le ba — 4. A: The Defense Language Institute has a long history, doesn’t it?

examples.text: 乙：那是，它是一所很老的学校了。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā shì yì suǒ hěn lǎo de xué xiào le — B: Absolutely; it is a very old school.

examples.text: 甲：琳达学中文学得那么好，连她女儿也喜欢学中文。
examples.translation: jiǎ lín dá xué zhōng wén xué de nà me hǎo lián tā nǚ ér yě xǐ huān xué zhōng wén — 5. A: Linda learns Chinese so well that even her daughter likes learning Chinese.

examples.text: 乙：那是，她们家里常常说中文。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā men jiā lǐ cháng cháng shuō zhōng wén — B: Absolutely; they often speak Chinese at home.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Create four exchanges, using 那是 wherever appropriate. My four exchanges:

examples.text: 甲：你的汉堡真好吃！
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ de hàn bǎo zhēn hǎo chī — Activity 2 (my four exchanges), 1. A: Your burger is really tasty!

examples.text: 乙：那是，这是我自己做的。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì zhè shì wǒ zì jǐ zuò de — B: Absolutely; I made it myself.

examples.text: 甲：你们学校的图书馆真大。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ men xué xiào de tú shū guǎn zhēn dà — 2. A: Your school’s library is really big.

examples.text: 乙：那是，有三层楼呢。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì yǒu sān céng lóu ne — B: Absolutely; it has three floors.

examples.text: 甲：小王的篮球打得真好。
examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo wáng de lán qiú dǎ de zhēn hǎo — 3. A: Xiao Wang plays basketball really well.

examples.text: 乙：那是，他每天都练习两个小时。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí liǎng gè xiǎo shí — B: Absolutely; he practices two hours every day.

examples.text: 甲：这个周末的聚会真有意思。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge zhōu mò de jù huì zhēn yǒu yì si — 4. A: This weekend’s party was really fun.

examples.text: 乙：那是，大家都带了好吃的东西来。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì dà jiā dōu dài le hǎo chī de dōng xī lái — B: Absolutely; everyone brought good food.

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: 可不
explanations.body: 可不 is an abbreviation of 可不是吗 and is used to indicate agreement in colloquial Chinese. Its English equivalent is “Absolutely” or “Exactly!” 可不 is similar to 那是, but with one difference: 那是 is used in a positive context while 可不 is used in both positive and negative contexts.

rows: an abbreviation of 可不是吗, used to indicate agreement; English “Absolutely” or “Exactly!”. Like 那是, but 那是 is used in a positive context while 可不 is used in both positive and negative contexts
tables.title: Discourse Grammar: 可不

examples.text: 甲：没想到今天这么冷！
examples.translation: jiǎ méi xiǎng dào jīn tiān zhè me lěng — 1. A: I didn’t expect it to be this cold today!

examples.text: 乙：可不，刚才出去散步，差点儿把我冻坏了。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù gāng cái chū qù sàn bù chà diǎnr bǎ wǒ dòng huài le — B: Exactly; I went out for a walk just now and almost froze.

examples.text: 甲：蒙特雷的风景真漂亮！
examples.translation: jiǎ méng tè léi de fēng jǐng zhēn piào liàng — 2. A: Monterey’s scenery is really beautiful!

examples.text: 乙：可不，每天都有很多游客来这里玩儿。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō yóu kè lái zhè lǐ wánr — B: Exactly; many tourists come to play here every day.

examples.text: 甲：大明昨天忙得连午饭也没吃上。
examples.translation: jiǎ dà míng zuó tiān máng de lián wǔ fàn yě méi chī shàng — 3. A: Da Ming was so busy yesterday that he didn’t even get lunch.

examples.text: 乙：可不，他这几天准备考试，太紧张了。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù tā zhè jǐ tiān zhǔn bèi kǎo shì tài jǐn zhāng le — B: Exactly; he is preparing for exams these days and is too stressed.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the statements and complete the exchanges using 可不 and the information you hear in each. B. Share your work with a partner. Use the script below to refine your work. C. Write four sentences that describe situations around you. Then pair up, take turns saying a sentence and your partner responds, beginning with 可不. The book prints the script of the four statements (今天下班的时候，马路上的车太多了，开车还不如骑自行车快。旧金山的房子太贵了。我再工作十年，恐怕也买不起一座小房子。今天天气真好，很多人去公园散步，也有的人在海边晒太阳。王老师在国防语言学院工作了三十多年了。她来这儿的时候，我还没出生呢。), so my answers follow it:

examples.text: 甲：今天下班后开车回家，路上走得慢极了。
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān xià bān hòu kāi chē huí jiā lù shàng zǒu de màn jí le — Activity 3A-1 (audio; my answers use the book’s script): A: Driving home after work today, the road was extremely slow.

examples.text: 乙：可不，马路上的车太多了，开车还不如骑自行车快。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù mǎ lù shàng de chē tài duō le kāi chē hái bù rú qí zì xíng chē kuài — B: Exactly; there were too many cars on the road, and driving was not even faster than cycling.

examples.text: 甲：旧金山的房子怎么那么贵啊？
examples.translation: jiǎ jiù jīn shān de fáng zi zěn me nà me guì a — 2. A: Why are houses in San Francisco so expensive?

examples.text: 乙：可不，我再工作十年，恐怕也买不起一座小房子。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù wǒ zài gōng zuò shí nián kǒng pà yě mǎi bù qǐ yí zuò xiǎo fáng zi — B: Exactly; even if I work another ten years I probably couldn’t afford a small house.

examples.text: 甲：今天是个大晴天，太阳特别好。
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān shì gè dà qíng tiān tài yáng tè bié hǎo — 3. A: Today is a big sunny day, with especially good sunshine.

examples.text: 乙：可不，很多人去公园散步，也有的人在海边晒太阳。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù hěn duō rén qù gōng yuán sàn bù yě yǒu de rén zài hǎi biān shài tài yáng — B: Exactly; many people went for a walk in the park and some sunbathed by the sea.

examples.text: 甲：王老师在国防语言学院工作了很长时间了吧？
examples.translation: jiǎ wáng lǎo shī zài guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn gōng zuò le hěn cháng shí jiān le ba — 4. A: Teacher Wang has worked at the Defense Language Institute for a long time, hasn’t she?

examples.text: 乙：可不，她在那儿工作了三十多年了。她来这儿的时候，我还没出生呢。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù tā zài nàr gōng zuò le sān shí duō nián le tā lái zhèr de shí hòu wǒ hái méi chū shēng ne — B: Exactly; she has worked there for over thirty years. When she came here I wasn’t even born yet.

examples.text: 可不，今天的作业特别多。
examples.translation: kě bù jīn tiān de zuò yè tè bié duō — Activity 3C (my situation sentences with the replies): Exactly, there is a lot of homework today. (reply to “今天的作业真多！”)

examples.text: 可不，这个周末我们都没出去玩儿。
examples.translation: kě bú zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men dōu méi chū qù wánr — Exactly, none of us went out to play this weekend. (reply to “这个周末天天下雨。”)

lessons.title: 723. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 grammar: 说了, the 可……了 construction and 注意到
lessons.subtitle: 说了 · 可……了 · 注意到 · 班长说了 · 妈妈说了 · 可好了 · 注意到没有

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: 说了
explanations.body: In daily conversation, 说了 indicates a quotation, like “… has already said” in English, and it often implies that the quoted words carry weight.

rows: in daily conversation, 说了 indicates a quotation, like “… has already said” in English, and it often implies that the quoted words carry weight
tables.title: Discourse Grammar: 说了

examples.text: 班长刚才说了，星期五中午我们要搞聚会，家人和朋友也可以参加。
examples.translation: bān zhǎng gāng cái shuō le xīng qī wǔ zhōng wǔ wǒ men yào gǎo jù huì jiā rén hé péng yǒu yě kě yǐ cān jiā — 1. The class monitor just said that on Friday noon we are going to have a party, and family and friends can also take part.

examples.text: 妈妈说了，不做完作业我就不能玩儿游戏。
examples.translation: mā mā shuō le bú zuò wán zuò yè wǒ jiù bù néng wánr yóu xì — 2. Mom said I can’t play games if I don’t finish my homework.

examples.text: 电视上说了，明天会刮大风，下午有中到大雨。
examples.translation: diàn shì shàng shuō le míng tiān huì guā dà fēng xià wǔ yǒu zhōng dào dà yǔ — 3. The TV said there will be strong wind tomorrow and moderate to heavy rain in the afternoon.

examples.text: 李老师说了，下星期二有单元考试，我们得好好准备。
examples.translation: lǐ lǎo shī shuō le xià xīng qī èr yǒu dān yuán kǎo shì wǒ men děi hǎo hǎo zhǔn bèi — 4. Teacher Li said there is a unit test next Tuesday and we have to prepare well.

examples.text: 医生说了，甜的和咸的东西吃多了对身体都不好。
examples.translation: yī shēng shuō le tián de hé xián de dōng xī chī duō le duì shēn tǐ dōu bù hǎo — 5. The doctor said that eating too much sweet and salty food is bad for the body.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and complete the sentences you hear (six sentences beginning 女儿来短信说了, 她说了, 她还说了, 女儿说了, 她说了, 她又说了). B. Share your work with a classmate. Then, using the script below, take turns translating the sentences into English. The script, then my completed sentences:

examples.text: 太太：女儿刚刚发来短信，说她坐今天夜里从旧金山坐飞机，明天晚上到北京。
examples.translation: tài tài nǚ ér gāng gāng fā lái duǎn xìn shuō tā zuò jīn tiān yè lǐ cóng jiù jīn shān zuò fēi jī míng tiān wǎn shàng dào běi jīng — Wife: Our daughter just sent a text saying she is taking a flight from San Francisco tonight and arrives in Beijing tomorrow evening. (the script of Activity 4A; translations mine)

examples.text: 先生：太好了，那她应该能在家过年了。她哪天到青岛？
examples.translation: xiān shēng tài hǎo le nà tā yīng gāi néng zài jiā guò nián le tā nǎ tiān dào qīng dǎo — Husband: Great, then she should be able to spend the New Year at home. What day does she get to Qingdao?

examples.text: 太太：她可能不过来了，说要去开一个重要的会，三天后就飞回美国。
examples.translation: tài tài tā kě néng bú guò lái le shuō yào qù kāi yí gè zhòng yào de huì sān tiān hòu jiù fēi huí měi guó — Wife: She may not come over; she said she has to go to an important meeting and will fly back to the U.S. three days later.

examples.text: 先生：为什么这么急？
examples.translation: xiān shēng wèi shén me zhè me jí — Husband: Why such a hurry?

examples.text: 太太：她说她的公司做的应用软件，马上就要完成了，这段时间非常忙。
examples.translation: tài tài tā shuō tā de gōng sī zuò de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn mǎ shàng jiù yào wán chéng le zhè duàn shí jiān fēi cháng máng — Wife: She said the app her company is making is about to be finished and she is very busy at this time.

examples.text: 先生：那，要不要咱们去北京看看她？
examples.translation: xiān shēng nà yào bú yào zán men qù běi jīng kàn kàn tā — Husband: Then, shall we go to Beijing to see her?

examples.text: 太太：别了。她说她现在连睡觉的时间都没有，哪有时间陪咱们。
examples.translation: tài tài bié le tā shuō tā xiàn zài lián shuì jiào de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu nǎ yǒu shí jiān péi zán men — Wife: Don’t. She said she doesn’t even have time to sleep now, so how could she have time for us.

examples.text: 先生：好吧，过段时间再说。
examples.translation: xiān shēng hǎo ba guò duàn shí jiān zài shuō — Husband: All right, let’s see after a while.

examples.text: 太太：她说等到夏天就有空儿了，一定回来看咱们。
examples.translation: tài tài tā shuō děng dào xià tiān jiù yǒu kòngr le yí dìng huí lái kàn zán men — Wife: She said she will be free by summer and will definitely come back to see us.

examples.text: 女儿来短信说了，她坐今天夜里从旧金山的飞机，明天晚上到北京。
examples.translation: nǚ ér lái duǎn xìn shuō le tā zuò jīn tiān yè lǐ cóng jiù jīn shān de fēi jī míng tiān wǎn shàng dào běi jīng — Activity 4A, 1 (my reading of the printed script; the audio may divide the sentences differently): The daughter said in her text that she is flying from San Francisco tonight and arrives in Beijing tomorrow evening.

examples.text: 她说了，她要去开一个重要的会，三天后就飞回美国。
examples.translation: tā shuō le tā yào qù kāi yí gè zhòng yào de huì sān tiān hòu jiù fēi huí měi guó — 2: She said she has to go to an important meeting and will fly back to the U.S. three days later.

examples.text: 她还说了，她的公司做的应用软件，马上就要完成了。
examples.translation: tā hái shuō le tā de gōng sī zuò de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn mǎ shàng jiù yào wán chéng le — 3: She also said the app her company is making is about to be finished.

examples.text: 女儿说了，她这段时间非常忙，现在连睡觉的时间都没有。
examples.translation: nǚ ér shuō le tā zhè duàn shí jiān fēi cháng máng xiàn zài lián shuì jiào de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu — 4: The daughter said she is very busy at this time and doesn’t even have time to sleep.

examples.text: 她说了，她哪有时间陪我们。
examples.translation: tā shuō le tā nǎ yǒu shí jiān péi wǒ men — 5: She said she has no time to keep us company.

examples.text: 她又说了，等到夏天就有空儿了，一定回来看我们。
examples.translation: tā yòu shuō le děng dào xià tiān jiù yǒu kòngr le yí dìng huí lái kàn wǒ men — 6: She said again that she will be free by summer and will definitely come back to see us.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: List five things your family members or people close to you have said that you found helpful. Use 说了 wherever appropriate. My five:

examples.text: 妈妈说了，做事情要认真，不能只想着玩儿。
examples.translation: mā mā shuō le zuò shì qíng yào rèn zhēn bù néng zhǐ xiǎng zhe wánr — Activity 5 (my five, 1): Mom said: do things seriously, don’t think only about playing.

examples.text: 爷爷说了，早睡早起身体好。
examples.translation: yé yé shuō le zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēn tǐ hǎo — 2: Grandpa said: going to bed early and getting up early is good for your health.

examples.text: 老师说了，每天都要复习当天学的东西。
examples.translation: lǎo shī shuō le měi tiān dōu yào fù xí dàng tiān xué de dōng xī — 3: The teacher said you must review what you learned every day.

examples.text: 朋友说了，有困难一定告诉他。
examples.translation: péng yǒu shuō le yǒu kùn nán yí dìng gào sù tā — 4: My friend said: if I have difficulties I must tell him.

examples.text: 爸爸说了，学习外语一定要多说多听。
examples.translation: bà bà shuō le xué xí wài yǔ yí dìng yào duō shuō duō tīng — 5: Dad said: to learn a foreign language you must speak and listen a lot.

explanations.title: The 可……了 Construction
explanations.body: This construction is used for emphasis in colloquial Chinese. It is similar to “very” or “so” in English, and the element between 可 and 了 is usually an adjective or verb phrase.

rows: used for emphasis in colloquial Chinese; similar to “very” or “so” in English; the element between 可 and 了 is usually an adjective or verb phrase
tables.title: The 可……了 Construction

examples.text: 昨天我们看的那个电影可好了。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǒ men kàn de nà ge diàn yǐng kě hǎo le — 1. The film we saw yesterday was so good.

examples.text: 你妈妈看上去可年轻了。
examples.translation: nǐ mā mā kàn shàng qù kě nián qīng le — 2. Your mother looks so young.

examples.text: 高铁跑得可快了，从北京到上海不到一天就到了。
examples.translation: gāo tiě pǎo de kě kuài le cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi bú dào yì tiān jiù dào le — 3. High-speed trains run so fast; from Beijing to Shanghai you arrive in less than a day.

examples.text: 下完雨以后我出去散了一会儿步，可舒服了。
examples.translation: xià wán yǔ yǐ hòu wǒ chū qù sàn le yí huìr bù kě shū fú le — 4. After the rain I went out for a short walk, and it was so comfortable.

examples.text: 她没去过中国，但她可喜欢中国了。
examples.translation: tā méi qù guò zhōng guó dàn tā kě xǐ huān zhōng guó le — 5. She has never been to China, but she likes China so much.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and with your partner, use the 可……了 construction to rewrite the following sentences: 1. 徐丽的女儿特爱说英语，见到外国朋友就和人家聊天。 2. 从这里去邮局远得很，走路要四十分钟。 3. 我以前的房间非常小，只能放下一张床和一把椅子。 4. 我们的西瓜特别甜，快买一个尝尝吧。 5. 那家饭馆的烤鸭做得好吃极了。 6. A：那本书你觉得怎么样？B：写得非常好，你也借来看看吧。 7. 她一边走路一边看手机，走得非常慢。 B. Take turns translating each sentence into English, and then back into Chinese. My rewrites:

examples.text: 徐丽的女儿可爱说英语了，见到外国朋友就和人家聊天。
examples.translation: xú lì de nǚ ér kě ài shuō yīng yǔ le jiàn dào wài guó péng yǒu jiù hé rén jiā liáo tiān — Activity 6A-1 (my rewrites): Xu Li’s daughter loves speaking English so much; whenever she meets foreign friends she chats with them.

examples.text: 从这里去邮局可远了，走路要四十分钟。
examples.translation: cóng zhè lǐ qù yóu jú kě yuǎn le zǒu lù yào sì shí fēn zhōng — 2: It’s so far from here to the post office; it takes forty minutes on foot.

examples.text: 我以前的房间可小了，只能放下一张床和一把椅子。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ qián de fáng jiān kě xiǎo le zhǐ néng fàng xià yì zhāng chuáng hé yì bǎ yǐ zi — 3: My former room was so small, it could hold only a bed and a chair.

examples.text: 我们的西瓜可甜了，快买一个尝尝吧。
examples.translation: wǒ men de xī guā kě tián le kuài mǎi yí gè cháng cháng ba — 4: Our watermelons are so sweet; buy one and try it.

examples.text: 那家饭馆的烤鸭做得可好吃了。
examples.translation: nà jiā fàn guǎn de kǎo yā zuò de kě hǎo chī le — 5: That restaurant’s roast duck is so delicious.

examples.text: 甲：那本书你觉得怎么样？
examples.translation: jiǎ nà běn shū nǐ jué de zěn me yàng — 6: A: What do you think of that book?

examples.text: 乙：写得可好了，你也借来看看吧。
examples.translation: yǐ xiě de kě hǎo le nǐ yě jiè lái kàn kàn ba — B: It’s written so well; borrow it and read it too.

examples.text: 她一边走路一边看手机，走得可慢了。
examples.translation: tā yì biān zǒu lù yì biān kàn shǒu jī zǒu de kě màn le — 7: She looks at her phone while walking and walks so slowly.

explanations.title: The Expression 注意到
explanations.body: 注意到 means “having noticed/observed.” 注意到 is different from 注意, as the latter means “paying attention to.” For example, 注意天气的变化 means “to pay attention to the change in weather” while 注意到天气的变化 means “to have noticed a change in the weather.” Sometimes 注意到 is used as a reminder, such as: 你注意到没有？最近你锻炼得越来越少了。

rows: “having noticed/observed”; different from 注意, “paying attention to”: 注意天气的变化 means “to pay attention to the change in weather” while 注意到天气的变化 means “to have noticed a change in the weather”
sometimes used as a reminder, such as 你注意到没有？最近你锻炼得越来越少了。
tables.title: The Expression 注意到

examples.text: 你注意到小张今天的样子了吗？他好像不太舒服。
examples.translation: nǐ zhù yì dào xiǎo zhāng jīn tiān de yàng zi le ma tā hǎo xiàng bú tài shū fú — 1. Have you noticed how Xiao Zhang looks today? He doesn’t seem very well.

examples.text: 她注意到，这儿的冬天比她老家冷多了。
examples.translation: tā zhù yì dào zhèr de dōng tiān bǐ tā lǎo jiā lěng duō le — 2. She noticed that the winter here is much colder than in her hometown.

examples.text: 我注意到新课表已经把说话课改到上午了。
examples.translation: wǒ zhù yì dào xīn kè biǎo yǐ jīng bǎ shuō huà kè gǎi dào shàng wǔ le — 3. I have noticed that the new schedule has changed the speaking class to the morning.

examples.text: 注意到了吧？这次说话考试你考得比上次好很多。
examples.translation: zhù yì dào le ba zhè cì shuō huà kǎo shì nǐ kǎo de bǐ shàng cì hǎo hěn duō — 4. Did you notice? You did much better on this speaking test than last time.

examples.text: 这个字你写得不对，注意到就好了。下次要写对。
examples.translation: zhè ge zì nǐ xiě de bú duì zhù yì dào jiù hǎo le xià cì yào xiě duì — 5. You wrote this character wrong; it’s good that you noticed. Write it correctly next time.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Translate the following sentences into Chinese: 1. Have you noticed his new car? It is parked in front of our building. 2. I have noticed that more and more people have started to exercise. 3. Your pronunciation of this word is incorrect. Have you noticed that? 4. We have noticed that people here are very nice to outsiders. 5. He did not notice that rent here is especially expensive. 6. I have already noticed the mistakes in my homework. B. Check your work with a classmate. Refine your work using the suggested answer keys below:

examples.text: 你注意到他的新车了吗？就停在我们楼的前面。
examples.translation: nǐ zhù yì dào tā de xīn chē le ma jiù tíng zài wǒ men lóu de qián miàn — Activity 7A-1 (the book’s suggested answer): Have you noticed his new car? It is parked in front of our building.

examples.text: 我注意到，越来越多的人开始锻炼身体了。
examples.translation: wǒ zhù yì dào yuè lái yuè duō de rén kāi shǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ le — 7A-2: I have noticed that more and more people have started to exercise.

examples.text: 这个词你的发音不对。你注意到了吗？
examples.translation: zhè ge cí nǐ de fā yīn bú duì nǐ zhù yì dào le ma — 7A-3: Your pronunciation of this word is incorrect. Have you noticed that?

examples.text: 我们注意到，这儿的人对外地人非常好。
examples.translation: wǒ men zhù yì dào zhèr de rén duì wài dì rén fēi cháng hǎo — 7A-4: We have noticed that people here are very nice to outsiders.

examples.text: 他没注意到这里的房租特别贵。
examples.translation: tā méi zhù yì dào zhè lǐ de fáng zū tè bié guì — 7A-5: He did not notice that rent here is especially expensive.

examples.text: 我已经注意到我作业里做错的地方了。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ jīng zhù yì dào wǒ zuò yè lǐ zuò cuò de dì fāng le — 7A-6: I have already noticed the mistakes in my homework.

lessons.title: 724. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 grammar: adverbs of degree
lessons.subtitle: 极 · 最 · 特别 · 非常 · 十分 · 很 · 相当 · 挺 · 稍微 · 有点儿 · 大有前途 · 大晴天

explanations.title: Adverbs of Degree
explanations.body: Adverbs of degree are about degree of intensity and are usually used to modify adjectives and, occasionally, verbs. The table below lists the most-often used adverbs of degree, from the strongest to the least strong. 大 can be used as an adverb of degree, and it usually appears in set phrases such as 形势大好, 大红大绿, 大有前途 and 大好时光. Another common pattern for 大 to be used as an adverb of degree is 大 + monosyllable adjective + noun, such as 大晴天 and 大好人.

rows: 他唱歌唱得极好 – he sings extremely well
他唱歌唱得最好 – he sings the best among …
他唱歌唱得特别好 – he sings especially well
他唱歌唱得非常好 – he sings very well
他唱歌唱得十分好 – he sings very well
他唱歌唱得很好 – he sings very well (a little weaker than 非常 and 十分)
他唱歌唱得相当好 – he sings considerably well (it can be stronger than 很 depending on the way it is said)
他唱歌唱得挺好 – he sings quite well
他唱歌唱得稍微好一点儿 – he sings a little better (still not very good)
他唱歌唱得有点儿不好听 – he sings a little bit poorly
tables.title: Adverbs of Degree (from the strongest to the least strong)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Identify the incorrect uses of adverbs of degree in the following sentences, and make corrections as needed: 1. 昨天我们看了一场电影，那个电影最好。 2. 这儿的天气比我们老家相当好一些。 3. 今天是个很大的阴天。 4. 他走得稍快，我怎么走也赶不上他。 5. 这一代青年人个个优秀，挺有希望。 6. 我弟弟相当不喜欢吃的菜就是鱼，一看见鱼他就头疼。 B. Share your work with a classmate. Go over the suggested answer key below and refine your work if necessary. Then translate each sentence into English. The book’s suggested answers:

examples.text: 昨天我们看了一场电影，那个电影非常好。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǒ men kàn le yì cháng diàn yǐng nà ge diàn yǐng fēi cháng hǎo — Activity 8, 1 (the book’s suggested answer; 特别, 十分, 很, 相当 or 挺 also work; the original wrongly used 最): Yesterday we saw a film, and it was very good.

examples.text: 这儿的天气比我们老家稍微好一些。
examples.translation: zhèr de tiān qì bǐ wǒ men lǎo jiā shāo wēi hǎo yì xiē — 2 (the original wrongly used 相当 with 比): The weather here is a little better than in our hometown.

examples.text: 今天是个大阴天。
examples.translation: jīn tiān shì gè dà yīn tiān — 3 (the original said 很大的阴天): Today is a big overcast day.

examples.text: 他走得极快，我怎么走也赶不上他。
examples.translation: tā zǒu de jí kuài wǒ zěn me zǒu yě gǎn bú shàng tā — 4 (特别, 十分, 很 or 相当 also work; the original said 稍快): He walks extremely fast and no matter how I walk I can’t catch up with him.

examples.text: 这一代青年人个个优秀，大有希望。
examples.translation: zhè yí dài qīng nián rén gè gè yōu xiù dà yǒu xī wàng — 5 (the original said 挺有希望): Every one of this generation of young people is excellent and has great promise.

examples.text: 我弟弟最不喜欢吃的菜就是鱼，一看见鱼他就头疼。
examples.translation: wǒ dì di zuì bù xǐ huān chī de cài jiù shì yú yí kàn jiàn yú tā jiù tóu téng — 6 (the original said 相当不喜欢): The dish my younger brother dislikes most is fish; as soon as he sees fish he gets a headache.

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Each group takes five adjectives from below and creates five phrases using any of the adverbs discussed in Activity 8. For example: 极有礼貌 | 非常有道理 | 有点儿饿. Group 1: 平稳, 舒适, 有道理, 厉害, 饿. Group 2: 有礼貌, 重要, 严重, 顺利, 真实. Group 3: 美好, 便利, 精确, 准时, 辛苦. B. Take turns in your group, using an adjective and an adverb to compose a sentence. When you’re done, select the three best sentences and share them with the class. My phrases:

examples.text: 极平稳 · 非常舒适 · 很有道理 · 相当厉害 · 有点儿饿
examples.translation: jí píng wěn fēi cháng shū shì hěn yǒu dào lǐ xiāng dāng lì hài yǒu diǎnr è — Activity 9, Group 1 (my phrases): extremely stable; very comfortable; very reasonable; considerably formidable; a little hungry.

examples.text: 特别有礼貌 · 十分重要 · 相当严重 · 挺顺利 · 非常真实
examples.translation: tè bié yǒu lǐ mào shí fēn zhòng yào xiāng dāng yán zhòng tǐng shùn lì fēi cháng zhēn shí — Group 2: especially polite; very important; considerably serious; quite smooth; very real.

examples.text: 十分美好 · 极便利 · 相当精确 · 挺准时 · 有点儿辛苦
examples.translation: shí fēn měi hǎo jí biàn lì xiāng dāng jīng què tǐng zhǔn shí yǒu diǎnr xīn kǔ — Group 3: very beautiful; extremely convenient; considerably precise; quite punctual; a little hard-worked.

Which is the least strong in the list?

units.title: 第二十八课 Presentation 1: 吴冬和高云, 不同的新生, 一个村庄的大学生, 零零后, 靖靖的故事, 词汇

lessons.title: 725. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 skill integration: a talk between friends and different new students
lessons.subtitle: 吴冬 · 高云 · 独立 · 安排 · 影响 · 互联网 · 不同的新生 · 大学生活费 · 应用软件

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking, Writing, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog between two friends and answer the following questions in Chinese. Take time to learn these new words first: 应该, 影响, 独立 and 安排. 1. 吴冬的儿子觉得他妈妈怎么样？ 2. 吴冬和她儿子的一个重要不同是什么？ B. Listen to the dialog again and fill in the table with as many details as you can. C. Share your work with a classmate. Then go over the script and refine your work. D. You are playing the part of Wu Dong, whose spouse is on a business trip overseas. Write an email to him in Chinese to tell him what you’ve learned by talking with Gao Yun. Share your email with a classmate. The script, my answers, my table and my e-mail:

headers: 细节 (Details; my sample from the script)
rows: 今年高三，学习还不错；总说妈妈不了解他；将来要当老板，有自己的公司；更独立，要自己决定自己的事情，不喜欢听别人的安排
年轻一代的特点和长大的环境
都是独生子女，生活条件比以前好得多；周末还参加这个班那个班；对他们影响最大的是互联网，很小就有电脑，上中学以后用手机上网；知道得多，想的和上一代不一样，目标也高
tables.title: Activity 1B: the details table (the book leaves the cells empty)

examples.text: 高云：吴冬，你儿子明年就要上大学了吧？他现在怎么样？
examples.translation: gāo yún wú dōng nǐ ér zi míng nián jiù yào shàng dà xué le ba tā xiàn zài zěn me yàng — Gao Yun: Wu Dong, your son is going to university next year, right? How is he now? (the script of Activity 1; translations are mine)

examples.text: 吴冬：他今年高三，学习还不错。不过，他总说我不了解他。我是他妈，怎么会不了解他呢？
examples.translation: wú dōng tā jīn nián gāo sān xué xí hái bú cuò bú guò tā zǒng shuō wǒ bù liǎo jiě tā wǒ shì tā mā zěn me huì bù liǎo jiě tā ne — Wu Dong: He is in his third year of high school this year, and his studies are not bad. But he always says I don’t understand him. I’m his mom, how could I not understand him?

examples.text: 高云：还是会的，因为他们这一代长大的环境，和咱们当时大不一样了。
examples.translation: gāo yún hái shì huì de yīn wèi tā men zhè yí dài zhǎng dà de huán jìng hé zán men dāng shí dà bù yí yàng le — Gao Yun: You still might, because the environment this generation grows up in is very different from ours back then.

examples.text: 吴冬：环境是不一样了，他们赶上好时候了。不说别的，他们这一代都是独生子女，生活条件比我们那时候好得太多了。
examples.translation: wú dōng huán jìng shì bù yí yàng le tā men gǎn shàng hǎo shí hòu le bù shuō bié de tā men zhè yí dài dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ wǒ men nà shí hòu hǎo de tài duō le — Wu Dong: The environment is different; they have caught good times. Not to mention anything else, this generation are all only children and their living conditions are far better than ours were then.

examples.text: 高云：学习环境变化更大。除了平时上课，到了周末他们还参加这个班那个班的。对他们影响最大的是互联网。
examples.translation: gāo yún xué xí huán jìng biàn huà gèng dà chú le píng shí shàng kè dào le zhōu mò tā men hái cān jiā zhè ge bān nà ge bān de duì tā men yǐng xiǎng zuì dà de shì hù lián wǎng — Gao Yun: The learning environment has changed even more. Besides regular classes, at weekends they also attend this class and that class. The thing that influences them most is the Internet.

examples.text: 吴冬：那是。我儿子很小就有电脑，总上网，上中学以后有了手机，就用手机上网。他的同学也都一样。
examples.translation: wú dōng nà shì wǒ ér zi hěn xiǎo jiù yǒu diàn nǎo zǒng shàng wǎng shàng zhōng xué yǐ hòu yǒu le shǒu jī jiù yòng shǒu jī shàng wǎng tā de tóng xué yě dōu yí yàng — Wu Dong: Absolutely. My son had a computer when he was very small and always went online; after he started middle school he got a phone and went online with the phone. His classmates are all the same.

examples.text: 高云：环境好了，知道的事情多，想的和咱们就会不一样。
examples.translation: gāo yún huán jìng hǎo le zhī dào de shì qíng duō xiǎng de hé zán men jiù huì bù yí yàng — Gao Yun: With a better environment, they know many things, and what they think will be different from ours.

examples.text: 吴冬：他们知道得多，目标也高。我儿子说了，将来他要当老板，有自己的公司。
examples.translation: wú dōng tā men zhī dào de duō mù biāo yě gāo wǒ ér zi shuō le jiāng lái tā yào dāng lǎo bǎn yǒu zì jǐ de gōng sī — Wu Dong: They know a lot and their goals are high. My son said that in the future he wants to be a boss and have his own company.

examples.text: 高云：他们也更独立，要自己决定自己的事情，不喜欢听别人的安排。
examples.translation: gāo yún tā men yě gèng dú lì yào zì jǐ jué dìng zì jǐ de shì qíng bù xǐ huān tīng bié rén de ān pái — Gao Yun: They are also more independent; they want to decide their own affairs and don’t like to listen to others’ arrangements.

examples.text: 吴冬：可不。我也注意到，我儿子最不喜欢大人告诉他将来他得当什么，做什么。
examples.translation: wú dōng kě bù wǒ yě zhù yì dào wǒ ér zi zuì bù xǐ huān dà rén gào sù tā jiāng lái tā děi dàng shén me zuò shén me — Wu Dong: Exactly. I have also noticed that my son most dislikes adults telling him what he has to be and do in the future.

examples.text: 他觉得妈妈不了解他。
examples.translation: tā jué de mā mā bù liǎo jiě tā — Activity 1A-1 (my answer, from the script): He thinks his mother doesn’t understand him.

examples.text: 他们长大的环境大不一样：现在的孩子是独生子女，生活条件好得多，学习环境变化更大，受互联网的影响最大。
examples.translation: tā men zhǎng dà de huán jìng dà bù yí yàng xiàn zài de hái zi shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ shēng huó tiáo jiàn hǎo de duō xué xí huán jìng biàn huà gèng dà shòu hù lián wǎng de yǐng xiǎng zuì dà — 1A-2 (my answer): The environments they grew up in are very different: today’s young people are only children with far better living conditions, a changed learning environment and the greatest influence from the Internet.

examples.text: 我今天和高云聊了很久，知道了不少。她说他们这一代长大的环境和我们大不一样：都是独生子女，条件很好，学习环境变化更大，影响最大的是互联网。他们知道得多，目标也高，也更独立，不喜欢听别人的安排。所以儿子总说我不了解他，我想我们应该多听听他的想法。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān hé gāo yún liáo le hěn jiǔ zhī dào le bù shǎo tā shuō tā men zhè yí dài zhǎng dà de huán jìng hé wǒ men dà bù yí yàng dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ tiáo jiàn hěn hǎo xué xí huán jìng biàn huà gèng dà yǐng xiǎng zuì dà de shì hù lián wǎng tā men zhī dào de duō mù biāo yě gāo yě gèng dú lì bù xǐ huān tīng bié rén de ān pái suǒ yǐ ér zi zǒng shuō wǒ bù liǎo jiě tā wǒ xiǎng wǒ men yīng gāi duō tīng tīng tā de xiǎng fǎ — Activity 1D (my sample e-mail from Wu Dong to her husband; the book leaves TO, CC and Subject blank): Today I chatted with Gao Yun for a long time and learned quite a lot. She says the environment this generation grows up in is very different from ours: they are all only children, conditions are very good, the learning environment has changed even more, and the Internet has the greatest influence. They know a lot, their goals are high, and they are more independent and don’t like to listen to others’ arrangements. So our son always says I don’t understand him; I think we should listen to his thoughts more.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage below. Then mark the statements that follow as either True or False. B. Pair up and share your work. Then take turns translating the underlined sentences into English. Your partner will translate them back into Chinese without referring to the passage. C. Work with your partner to create a dialog between a college professor and a journalist using the information above. Act out the dialog for the class. The article, in four parts (the book underlines four sentences, numbered 1) to 4); they are listed after it), my key and my sample interview:

examples.text: 从这个星期开始，大学新生到学校报到，开始他们的大学生活。和他们父母那一代比较，现在的新生有什么特点呢？
examples.translation: cóng zhè ge xīng qī kāi shǐ dà xué xīn shēng dào xué xiào bào dào kāi shǐ tā men de dà xué shēng huó hé tā men fù mǔ nà yí dài bǐ jiào xiàn zài de xīn shēng yǒu shén me tè diǎn ne — Starting this week, new university students report to the schools and begin their university life. Compared with their parents’ generation, what are the characteristics of today’s new students? (title: 不同的新生，不同的大学生活 “Different new students, different university lives”; translations mine)

examples.text: 多年前，新生到学校报到，只会带一些书，还有生活用品，比如衣服、被子、脸盆等。现在有了电脑和网络，书带得少了，生活用品也更漂亮更方便了。很多新生还会带一些自己特别需要的东西。比如一位小周同学是学建筑设计的，她的目标是将来有自己的建筑设计公司。为了更好地学习，她花了几万元，请人特别组装了一台电脑，学习建筑设计的时候用。
examples.translation: duō nián qián xīn shēng dào xué xiào bào dào zhǐ huì dài yì xiē shū hái yǒu shēng huó yòng pǐn bǐ rú yī fú bèi zi liǎn pén děng xiàn zài yǒu le diàn nǎo hé wǎng luò shū dài de shǎo le shēng huó yòng pǐn yě gèng piào liàng gèng fāng biàn le hěn duō xīn shēng hái huì dài yì xiē zì jǐ tè bié xū yào de dōng xī bǐ rú yí wèi xiǎo zhōu tóng xué shì xué jiàn zhù shè jì de tā de mù biāo shì jiāng lái yǒu zì jǐ de jiàn zhù shè jì gōng sī wèi le gèng hǎo de xué xí tā huā le jǐ wàn yuán qǐng rén tè bié zǔ zhuāng le yì tái diàn nǎo xué xí jiàn zhù shè jì de shí hòu yòng — Many years ago, new students reporting to school brought only some books and daily necessities such as clothes, quilts and washbasins. Now that there are computers and the Internet, they bring fewer books and the daily necessities are prettier and more convenient. Many new students also bring some things they especially need. For example, a classmate named Xiao Zhou studies architectural design and her goal is to have her own architectural design company in the future. To study better, she spent tens of thousands of yuan to have someone specially assemble a computer for her to use when studying architectural design.

examples.text: 这些新生的父母上大学时，没有手机，打电话要用公共电话，还常常排队。现在的大学生人人都有手机，手机上的应用软件更是五花八门。“零零后”新生使用最多的应用软件是微信、ＱＱ、支付宝，还有视频软件。由于他们从小就接触互联网，对国外的东西很熟悉，很多新生的手机上安装了英语应用软件，让他们随时可以看国外的东西。
examples.translation: zhè xiē xīn shēng de fù mǔ shàng dà xué shí méi yǒu shǒu jī dǎ diàn huà yào yòng gōng gòng diàn huà hái cháng cháng pái duì xiàn zài de dà xué shēng rén rén dōu yǒu shǒu jī shǒu jī shàng de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn gèng shì wǔ huā bā mén líng líng hòu xīn shēng shǐ yòng zuì duō de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn shì wēi xìn zhī fù bǎo hái yǒu shì pín ruǎn jiàn yóu yú tā men cóng xiǎo jiù jiē chù hù lián wǎng duì guó wài de dōng xī hěn shú xī hěn duō xīn shēng de shǒu jī shàng ān zhuāng le yīng yǔ yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn ràng tā men suí shí kě yǐ kàn guó wài de dōng xī — When these students’ parents went to university they had no mobile phones; to make a call they had to use public phones and often queue. Now every university student has a phone, and the apps on the phones are even more varied. The apps most used by new “post-00” students are WeChat, QQ, Alipay and video apps. Since they have been in contact with the Internet from childhood and are familiar with foreign things, many new students have English apps installed on their phones so they can look at foreign things at any time. (the book writes 00 后 and QQ in digits and Latin letters)

examples.text: 他们的父母几十年前上大学的时候，大学生每个月的生活费是二三十元，只够吃饭。随着生活水平的提高，加上父母为了孩子的教育都舍得花钱，现在大学生每月的生活费差不多一千五到两千元。其中，吃饭七八百元，住宿舍一百多元，电话费五六十元，还有几百块钱可以买自己喜欢的东西。
examples.translation: tā men de fù mǔ jǐ shí nián qián shàng dà xué de shí hòu dà xué shēng měi gè yuè de shēng huó fèi shì èr sān shí yuán zhǐ gòu chī fàn suí zhe shēng huó shuǐ píng de tí gāo jiā shàng fù mǔ wèi le hái zi de jiào yù dōu shě de huā qián xiàn zài dà xué shēng měi yuè de shēng huó fèi chà bu duō yì qiān wǔ dào liǎng qiān yuán qí zhōng chī fàn qī bā bǎi yuán zhù sù shě yì bǎi duō yuán diàn huà fèi wǔ liù shí yuán hái yǒu jǐ bǎi kuài qián kě yǐ mǎi zì jǐ xǐ huān de dōng xī — When their parents went to university several decades ago, a university student’s monthly living expenses were twenty or thirty yuan, only enough for meals. With the rise in living standards, and because parents are all willing to spend money on their children’s education, a university student’s monthly living expenses are now about 1,500 to 2,000 yuan. Of this, meals are 700 to 800 yuan, a dormitory is a little over 100 yuan, the phone bill is 50 to 60 yuan, and a few hundred more yuan can be used to buy things they like. (the book writes the amounts in hanzi except the 1500)

examples.text: 现在有了电脑和网络，书带得少了，生活用品也更漂亮更方便了。
examples.translation: xiàn zài yǒu le diàn nǎo hé wǎng luò shū dài de shǎo le shēng huó yòng pǐn yě gèng piào liàng gèng fāng biàn le — 2B, underlined sentence 1: Now that there are computers and the Internet, they bring fewer books and the daily necessities are prettier and more convenient.

examples.text: 这些新生的父母上大学时，没有手机，打电话要用公共电话，还常常排队。
examples.translation: zhè xiē xīn shēng de fù mǔ shàng dà xué shí méi yǒu shǒu jī dǎ diàn huà yào yòng gōng gòng diàn huà hái cháng cháng pái duì — Underlined sentence 2: When these students’ parents went to university they had no mobile phones; to make a call they had to use public phones and often queue.

examples.text: 由于他们从小就接触互联网，对国外的东西很熟悉，很多新生的手机上安装了英语应用软件，让他们随时可以看国外的东西。
examples.translation: yóu yú tā men cóng xiǎo jiù jiē chù hù lián wǎng duì guó wài de dōng xī hěn shú xī hěn duō xīn shēng de shǒu jī shàng ān zhuāng le yīng yǔ yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn ràng tā men suí shí kě yǐ kàn guó wài de dōng xī — Underlined sentence 3: Since they have been in contact with the Internet from childhood and are familiar with foreign things, many new students have English apps installed on their phones so they can look at foreign things at any time.

examples.text: 随着生活水平的提高，加上父母为了孩子的教育都舍得花钱，现在大学生每月的生活费差不多一千五到两千元。
examples.translation: suí zhe shēng huó shuǐ píng de tí gāo jiā shàng fù mǔ wèi le hái zi de jiào yù dōu shě de huā qián xiàn zài dà xué shēng měi yuè de shēng huó fèi chà bu duō yì qiān wǔ dào liǎng qiān yuán — Underlined sentence 4: With the rise in living standards, and because parents are all willing to spend money on their children’s education, a university student’s monthly living expenses are now about 1,500 to 2,000 yuan.

examples.text: 这篇文章主要讲现在的大学新生和他们父母那一代生活条件的不同。
examples.translation: zhè piān wén zhāng zhǔ yào jiǎng xiàn zài de dà xué xīn shēng hé tā men fù mǔ nà yí dài shēng huó tiáo jiàn de bù tóng — Activity 2A-1 (true or false; my key: True): This article mainly talks about the difference in living conditions between today’s new university students and their parents’ generation.

examples.text: 这些新大学生最喜欢学习科技方面的东西。
examples.translation: zhè xiē xīn dà xué shēng zuì xǐ huān xué xí kē jì fāng miàn de dōng xī — 2A-2 (my key: False, the article does not say this): These new university students most like to study technology.

examples.text: 小周为自己将来的建筑设计公司，准备了一台特别的电脑。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhōu wèi zì jǐ jiāng lái de jiàn zhù shè jì gōng sī zhǔn bèi le yì tái tè bié de diàn nǎo — 2A-3 (my key: True): Xiao Zhou prepared a special computer for her future architectural design company.

examples.text: 很多新生用手机上的英文应用软件看国外的东西。
examples.translation: hěn duō xīn shēng yòng shǒu jī shàng de yīng wén yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn kàn guó wài de dōng xī — 2A-4 (my key: True): Many new students use English apps on their phones to look at foreign things.

examples.text: 父母自己不舍得花钱，但一定要让孩子在学校过得非常舒服。
examples.translation: fù mǔ zì jǐ bù shě de huā qián dàn yí dìng yào ràng hái zi zài xué xiào guò de fēi cháng shū fú — 2A-5 (my key: False, the parents are willing to spend money on their children’s education): The parents are unwilling to spend money themselves, but insist their children live very comfortably at school.

examples.text: 记：教授，请问现在的大学新生和他们父母那一代相比，有什么不同？
examples.translation: jì jiào shòu qǐng wèn xiàn zài de dà xué xīn shēng hé tā men fù mǔ nà yí dài xiāng bǐ yǒu shén me bù tóng — Activity 2C (my sample interview of a professor by a journalist, built from the article): Journalist: Professor, how do today’s new university students differ from their parents’ generation?

examples.text: 教：不同很多。多年前，新生只带一些书和生活用品，现在有了电脑和网络，书带得少了，生活用品也更漂亮更方便了。
examples.translation: jiào bù tóng hěn duō duō nián qián xīn shēng zhǐ dài yì xiē shū hé shēng huó yòng pǐn xiàn zài yǒu le diàn nǎo hé wǎng luò shū dài de shǎo le shēng huó yòng pǐn yě gèng piào liàng gèng fāng biàn le — Professor: Many differences. Years ago new students brought only some books and daily necessities; now that there are computers and the Internet they bring fewer books and the necessities are prettier and more convenient.

examples.text: 记：他们的手机上都有什么？
examples.translation: jì tā men de shǒu jī shàng dōu yǒu shén me — Journalist: What is on their phones?

examples.text: 教：现在的大学生人人都有手机，使用最多的是微信、ＱＱ、支付宝，还有视频软件，很多人还安装了英语应用软件。
examples.translation: jiào xiàn zài de dà xué shēng rén rén dōu yǒu shǒu jī shǐ yòng zuì duō de shì wēi xìn zhī fù bǎo hái yǒu shì pín ruǎn jiàn hěn duō rén hái ān zhuāng le yīng yǔ yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn — Professor: Every university student now has a phone; the most used are WeChat, QQ, Alipay and video apps, and many have installed English apps.

examples.text: 记：那生活费呢？
examples.translation: jì nà shēng huó fèi ne — Journalist: And living expenses?

examples.text: 教：几十年前每个月只有二三十元，现在差不多一千五到两千元，吃饭就要七八百元，因为父母都舍得为孩子的教育花钱。
examples.translation: jiào jǐ shí nián qián měi gè yuè zhǐ yǒu èr sān shí yuán xiàn zài chà bu duō yì qiān wǔ dào liǎng qiān yuán chī fàn jiù yào qī bā bǎi yuán yīn wèi fù mǔ dōu shě de wèi hái zi de jiào yù huā qián — Professor: Decades ago it was only twenty or thirty yuan a month; now it is about 1,500 to 2,000 yuan, with meals alone 700 to 800 yuan, because parents are willing to spend money on their children’s education.

lessons.subtitle: 安徽小村庄 · 大学生 · 高考 · 联合国教科文组织 · 王校长 · 开放 独立 自信 · 摔倒 · 李青的儿子

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the authentic material below and fill in the table. Consult a dictionary if necessary. B. Share your work with a classmate. Assume the role of a journalist interviewing this person (played by your partner) about their experiences. The passage (in three parts) and my table:

rows: 他想像那两个孩子一样考上大学，改变自己的命运，父亲也希望他考上
支持，父亲很高兴，常常鼓励他，说儿子考上大学后自己干活有使不完的劲
他对其他村民有什么影响？
村民叫他“大学生”，思想观念改变了，越来越重视孩子的教育，考上大学的青年差不多有一百人
tables.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3A: the table (the book leaves the cells empty)

examples.text: 我出生在安徽北部的一个小村庄。上小学的时候，听说附近村子有两个农民的孩子考上了大学，大家都十分兴奋，而最兴奋的就是我父亲。他看到了希望，就鼓励我好好学习，将来也要考上大学。
examples.translation: wǒ chū shēng zài ān huī běi bù de yí gè xiǎo cūn zhuāng shàng xiǎo xué de shí hòu tīng shuō fù jìn cūn zi yǒu liǎng gè nóng mín de hái zi kǎo shàng le dà xué dà jiā dōu shí fēn xīng fèn ér zuì xīng fèn de jiù shì wǒ fù qīn tā kàn dào le xī wàng jiù gǔ lì wǒ hǎo hǎo xué xí jiāng lái yě yào kǎo shàng dà xué — I was born in a small village in northern Anhui. When I was in elementary school I heard that two farmers’ children in a nearby village had got into university; everyone was very excited, and the most excited was my father. He saw hope and encouraged me to study hard and get into university in the future as well. (translations of this authentic text are mine; the book gives its web address, which I leave out)

examples.text: 上了高中以后，我学习特别努力。当时我想，我也要像那两个孩子一样，考上大学，改变自己的命运。高中毕业我参加了高考，真的考上了大学，成了我们村第一个大学生。我高兴，父亲更高兴，常常对人说：我儿子考上大学后，我干活有使不完的劲。村里的人也为我考上大学感到骄傲。以前，他们见了我都叫我的名字，自从我考上大学后，大部分村民见了我都叫“大学生”，渐渐地，“大学生”在我们村成了我的另一个名字，可见当时村里出一个大学生，影响有多么大。
examples.translation: shàng le gāo zhōng yǐ hòu wǒ xué xí tè bié nǔ lì dāng shí wǒ xiǎng wǒ yě yào xiàng nà liǎng gè hái zi yí yàng kǎo shàng dà xué gǎi biàn zì jǐ de mìng yùn gāo zhōng bì yè wǒ cān jiā le gāo kǎo zhēn de kǎo shàng le dà xué chéng le wǒ men cūn dì yī gè dà xué shēng wǒ gāo xìng fù qīn gèng gāo xìng cháng cháng duì rén shuō wǒ ér zi kǎo shàng dà xué hòu wǒ gàn huó yǒu shǐ bù wán de jìn cūn lǐ de rén yě wèi wǒ kǎo shàng dà xué gǎn dào jiāo ào yǐ qián tā men jiàn le wǒ dōu jiào wǒ de míng zì zì cóng wǒ kǎo shàng dà xué hòu dà bù fèn cūn mín jiàn le wǒ dōu jiào dà xué shēng jiàn jiàn de dà xué shēng zài wǒ men cūn chéng le wǒ de lìng yí gè míng zì kě jiàn dāng shí cūn lǐ chū yí gè dà xué shēng yǐng xiǎng yǒu duō me dà — After I started high school I studied especially hard. At the time I thought I too would be like those two children: get into university and change my own fate. After high school I took the college entrance exam and really got into university, becoming the first university student of our village. I was happy and my father even happier, often telling people: after my son got into university, I have boundless energy for work. The villagers were also proud of my getting into university. Before, they all called me by my name when they saw me, but since I got into university most villagers call me “university student” when they see me, and gradually “university student” became my other name in our village; one can see how great the influence of a university student coming out of the village was at that time.

examples.text: 我考上大学后，村里人的思想观念也有了很大改变，大家对孩子的教育越来越重视。慢慢地，我们村上大学的孩子越来越多了。到现在，考上大学的青年差不多有一百人。我的两个侄子，从小受我的影响，学习特别刻苦，不仅考上了大学本科，还考上了研究生，远远超过了我。
examples.translation: wǒ kǎo shàng dà xué hòu cūn lǐ rén de sī xiǎng guān niàn yě yǒu le hěn dà gǎi biàn dà jiā duì hái zi de jiào yù yuè lái yuè zhòng shì màn màn de wǒ men cūn shàng dà xué de hái zi yuè lái yuè duō le dào xiàn zài kǎo shàng dà xué de qīng nián chà bu duō yǒu yì bǎi rén wǒ de liǎng gè zhí zi cóng xiǎo shòu wǒ de yǐng xiǎng xué xí tè bié kè kǔ bù jǐn kǎo shàng le dà xué běn kē hái kǎo shàng le yán jiū shēng yuǎn yuǎn chāo guò le wǒ — After I got into university, the villagers’ way of thinking also changed greatly, and everyone has paid more and more attention to their children’s education. Slowly, more and more children from our village went to university. By now, about a hundred young people have got into university. My two nephews, influenced by me since childhood, have studied especially diligently; they not only got into university for a bachelor’s degree but also got into graduate school, far surpassing me.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and take turns telling your partner what you would say in the following situations. Provide as many details as possible. When you are done, switch roles and repeat the activity. 1. 琳达在中国旅游的时候，发现有的高中生英语讲得不错。她想知道他们学习英语的条件怎么样。(three or more sentences) 2. 琳达问你，现在中国的一些年轻人有什么样的目标？(two or more sentences) 3. 她也想知道，在中国年轻人的文明程度怎么样。(three or more sentences) My answers:

examples.text: 琳达，中国的高中生学英语的条件很好，从小就学，网上又有很多学习材料，很多学校还有外国老师。所以有的高中生英语说得不错。
examples.translation: lín dá zhōng guó de gāo zhōng shēng xué yīng yǔ de tiáo jiàn hěn hǎo cóng xiǎo jiù xué wǎng shàng yòu yǒu hěn duō xué xí cái liào hěn duō xué xiào hái yǒu wài guó lǎo shī suǒ yǐ yǒu de gāo zhōng shēng yīng yǔ shuō de bú cuò — Using Chinese, Activity 1, 1 (my answer, three sentences): Linda, Chinese high school students have very good conditions for learning English: they start from childhood, there are many learning materials online and many schools also have foreign teachers. So some high school students speak English quite well.

examples.text: 很多年轻人的目标很高，不满足于一个稳定的工作，有的想自己开公司，有的想当教授。
examples.translation: hěn duō nián qīng rén de mù biāo hěn gāo bù mǎn zú yú yí gè wěn dìng de gōng zuò yǒu de xiǎng zì jǐ kāi gōng sī yǒu de xiǎng dāng jiào shòu — 2 (my answer, two sentences): Many young people have high goals and are not satisfied with a stable job; some want to start their own companies and some want to become professors.

examples.text: 一般来说，他们比较文明，排队时很少加塞儿，坐公交车时还会给老人让座。不过，因为都是独生子女，有的人有点儿任性，生活能力也不太强。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō tā men bǐ jiào wén míng pái duì shí hěn shǎo jiā sāir zuò gōng jiāo chē shí hái huì gěi lǎo rén ràng zuò bú guò yīn wèi dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ yǒu de rén yǒu diǎnr rèn xìng shēng huó néng lì yě bú tài qiáng — 3 (my answer, three sentences): Generally they are fairly civilized: they rarely cut in line when queueing and give up seats to old people on the bus. However, because they are all only children, some are a bit willful and their ability to look after themselves is not strong.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: You are a UNESCO (联合国教科文组织) representative in China working on a case-study about professional development among young people. A. Mr. Wang is the principal of a high school in northeast China. Write an email to him introducing yourself and ask him a few questions about 00 后. B. Mr. Wang just replied to you. He sent you an audio file of a talk he gave to a group of visitors. Listen to his talk and fill in the table. Take time to learn the meanings of these words first. C. Share your notes with a classmate. Then go over the script below and make any necessary changes. D. Mr. Wang recommends that you interview a parent, 李青. Below is information about 李青 and her family, including her son. E. Call 李青, who is played by your partner. Ask questions about her family, her son’s experiences, and what she and her husband have done for their son’s education. My e-mail, the word list, the script of the talk, my table and the call questions:

headers: 信息 (as printed in the book)
rows: 李青今年 43 岁，大学毕业，现在是工程师，每月工资一万五千元；她先生宋民是大学老师，月收入一万两千元；他们都很重视儿子的教育，曾经带他去欧洲和东南亚旅游；加上学费，现在每个月在儿子教育方面的花费两千多元。
从四岁开始就开始参加英语班学英语，后来又参加过周末的数学班和电脑班，每个周末都有钢琴课；现在上高中二年级，学习成绩很好，喜欢电脑，英语讲得也不错；明年考大学，打算将来读博士学位，然后当大学教授。
tables.title: Activity 2D: information about Li Qing and her family

examples.text: 王校长，您好！我是联合国教科文组织驻中国的代表，正在做一个关于年轻人职业发展的研究。我想请教您几个关于零零后的问题：第一，零零后有什么特点？第二，他们的学习条件怎么样？第三，他们和父母的关系怎么样？谢谢您的帮助！
examples.translation: wáng xiào zhǎng nín hǎo wǒ shì lián hé guó jiào kē wén zǔ zhī zhù zhōng guó de dài biǎo zhèng zài zuò yí gè guān yú nián qīng rén zhí yè fā zhǎn de yán jiū wǒ xiǎng qǐng jiào nín jǐ gè guān yú líng líng hòu de wèn tí dì yī líng líng hòu yǒu shén me tè diǎn dì èr tā men de xué xí tiáo jiàn zěn me yàng dì sān tā men hé fù mǔ de guān xì zěn me yàng xiè xiè nín de bāng zhù — Activity 2A (my sample e-mail): Dear Principal Wang, hello! I am a representative of UNESCO in China and am doing a study on the professional development of young people. I would like to ask you a few questions about the post-’00s: first, what are the post-’00s like? Second, how are their learning conditions? Third, what is their relationship with their parents like? Thank you for your help!

examples.text: 各位好！很高兴有机会和大家聊聊零零后的一些情况。刚才有人问，现在零零后的特点是什么？我感觉主要有三点，就是开放、独立，还有自信。由于生活水平的提高，家长能给孩子提供的教育资源，越来越多，也越来越好。我们高三的学生人人有电脑和手机，很多人都在网上关心世界上发生的大事，很多人去外国旅游过。还有一点，我觉得很重要，就是这一代和爸爸妈妈和孩子的关系也更好了。很多爸爸妈妈不只是要孩子努力学习。由于他们都是独生子女，有时候会比较任性，但总的来说，他们的文明程度还是挺高的。最近我们做了一个调查，有一个问题是：如果在马路上看见老人摔倒了，你会不会把老人扶起来？差不多百分之九十的人说会。
examples.translation: gè wèi hǎo hěn gāo xìng yǒu jī huì hé dà jiā liáo liáo líng líng hòu de yì xiē qíng kuàng gāng cái yǒu rén wèn xiàn zài líng líng hòu de tè diǎn shì shén me wǒ gǎn jué zhǔ yào yǒu sān diǎn jiù shì kāi fàng dú lì hái yǒu zì xìn yóu yú shēng huó shuǐ píng de tí gāo jiā zhǎng néng gěi hái zi tí gōng de jiào yù zī yuán yuè lái yuè duō yě yuè lái yuè hǎo wǒ men gāo sān de xué shēng rén rén yǒu diàn nǎo hé shǒu jī hěn duō rén dōu zài wǎng shàng guān xīn shì jiè shàng fā shēng de dà shì hěn duō rén qù wài guó lǚ yóu guò hái yǒu yì diǎn wǒ jué de hěn zhòng yào jiù shì zhè yí dài hé bà bà mā mā hé hái zi de guān xì yě gèng hǎo le hěn duō bà bà mā mā bù zhǐ shì yào hái zi nǔ lì xué xí yóu yú tā men dōu shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ yǒu shí hòu huì bǐ jiào rèn xìng dàn zǒng de lái shuō tā men de wén míng chéng dù hái shì tǐng gāo de zuì jìn wǒ men zuò le yí gè diào chá yǒu yí gè wèn tí shì rú guǒ zài mǎ lù shàng kàn jiàn lǎo rén shuāi dǎo le nǐ huì bú huì bǎ lǎo rén fú qǐ lái chà bu duō bǎi fēn zhī jiǔ shí de rén shuō huì — Hello everyone! I am glad to have the chance to chat with you about the post-’00s. Someone asked just now, what are the characteristics of the post-’00s today? I feel there are mainly three: they are open, independent and self-confident. Because of rising living standards, the educational resources parents can provide for their children are more and more abundant and better and better. Every one of our high-school seniors has a computer and a phone, many care about big events in the world online, and many have traveled abroad. One more point I think is very important: this generation’s relationship with their parents has also become better. Many parents do not only want their children to study hard. Because they are all only children they can sometimes be rather willful, but on the whole their level of civility is still quite high. Recently we did a survey; one question was: if you saw an old person fall on the road, would you help them up? Almost ninety percent said yes. (translation mine; the book writes 00 后 in digits and prints 这一代和爸爸妈妈和孩子的关系, apparently meaning “the relationship between this generation of children and their parents”)
