lessons.title: 727. Lesson 28 Presentation 1 using Chinese in context: Jingjing and her parents’ farmhouse, and vocabulary
lessons.subtitle: 靖靖 · 移民 · 农舍 · 翻修 · 哈佛 斯坦福 · 学费 生活费 · 总是 · 子女 · 舍得 · 前途 · 目标

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking, and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Jingjing is Chinese American, and she is your friend’s friend. Read her story below. B. Work with a classmate to answer the following questions, then individually write the ending. The beginning sentences have been provided: 1. 她的父母重视她的教育吗？ 2. 2008 年她父母买农舍以后，又做什么了？她当时是怎么想的？ 3. 如果哈佛大学或斯坦福大学录取她的话，你觉得她的学费和生活费会从哪儿来？ The ending: 爸爸好像看出了我的心思，马上对我说，“钱的事儿你不用担心，…… C. Discuss your work with your partner. D. Below is the ending of the original article. Discuss what the parents did for their daughter, and then translate it into English. E. Prepare a story of your own about educating children in a U.S. family. Share your work with the class. The story (in three parts), the original ending and my answers:

examples.text: 我父母原来都是中国人，他们很重视我的教育，为了给我一个好的学习环境，在我很小的时候，就带我移民到美国。我是在美国长大的，为了我有一个美好的未来，父母做什么都愿意。
examples.translation: wǒ fù mǔ yuán lái dōu shì zhōng guó rén tā men hěn zhòng shì wǒ de jiào yù wèi le gěi wǒ yí gè hǎo de xué xí huán jìng zài wǒ hěn xiǎo de shí hòu jiù dài wǒ yí mín dào měi guó wǒ shì zài měi guó zhǎng dà de wèi le wǒ yǒu yí gè měi hǎo de wèi lái fù mǔ zuò shén me dōu yuàn yì — My parents were originally both Chinese. They attached great importance to my education, and in order to give me a good learning environment they took me to immigrate to the U.S. when I was very little. I grew up in America, and for me to have a bright future my parents were willing to do anything. (translations of Jingjing’s story are mine)

examples.text: 来美国五年左右，父母就在离我家不远的地方，买了一座农舍。那座农舍不大，也很破旧，但前后院却很大。在以后的差不多七、八年的时间里，每个周末，爸爸妈妈都要带上我，开车去那里翻修那座破旧的房子。一到那里，他们就忙着干活儿，我呢，就在前后院子里跑来跑去。跑累了，我就坐在车里看书。那时我在上中学，年龄还小，从来没想到过问他们：“为什么周末你们不休息，要走那么远，干那么累的活儿呢？”
examples.translation: lái měi guó wǔ nián zuǒ yòu fù mǔ jiù zài lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de dì fāng mǎi le yí zuò nóng shè nà zuò nóng shè bú dà yě hěn pò jiù dàn qián hòu yuàn què hěn dà zài yǐ hòu de chà bu duō qī bā nián de shí jiān lǐ měi gè zhōu mò bà bà mā mā dōu yào dài shàng wǒ kāi chē qù nà lǐ fān xiū nà zuò pò jiù de fáng zi yí dào nà lǐ tā men jiù máng zhe gàn huór wǒ ne jiù zài qián hòu yuàn zi lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù pǎo lèi le wǒ jiù zuò zài chē lǐ kàn shū nà shí wǒ zài shàng zhōng xué nián líng hái xiǎo cóng lái méi xiǎng dào guò wèn tā men wèi shén me zhōu mò nǐ men bù xiū xī yào zǒu nà me yuǎn gàn nà me lèi de huór ne — About five years after we came to America, my parents bought a farmhouse not far from our home. The farmhouse was not big and was very run-down, but the front and back yards were large. For the next seven or eight years, every weekend Mom and Dad would take me and drive there to renovate the dilapidated house. As soon as they arrived they were busy working, while I ran around in the front and back yards. When I was tired of running I sat in the car and read. At that time I was in middle school and still young, and it never occurred to me to ask them: “Why don’t you rest on weekends, and go so far and do such tiring work?”

examples.text: 后来，我上了大学，我的学习成绩一直很好，所以，毕业后，我想先去哈佛大学或斯坦福大学读一个ＭＢＡ，然后到华尔街工作。我和父母说了自己的想法以后，他们非常高兴，鼓励我说：“好，我们支持你！”可是，去那样的学校读书，不但学费很贵，生活费也不便宜，每年最少也要十万美元以上。让我去上那么贵的学校，他们哪来那么多钱哪？
examples.translation: hòu lái wǒ shàng le dà xué wǒ de xué xí chéng jì yì zhí hěn hǎo suǒ yǐ bì yè hòu wǒ xiǎng xiān qù hā fú dà xué huò sī tǎn fú dà xué dú yí gè rán hòu dào huá ěr jiē gōng zuò wǒ hé fù mǔ shuō le zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ yǐ hòu tā men fēi cháng gāo xìng gǔ lì wǒ shuō hǎo wǒ men zhī chí nǐ kě shì qù nà yàng de xué xiào dú shū bú dàn xué fèi hěn guì shēng huó fèi yě bù pián yi měi nián zuì shǎo yě yào shí wàn měi yuán yǐ shàng ràng wǒ qù shàng nà me guì de xué xiào tā men nǎ lái nà me duō qián na — Later I went to university, and my grades were always very good, so after graduating I wanted to go first to Harvard or Stanford for an MBA and then work on Wall Street. After I told my parents my idea they were very happy and encouraged me: “Good, we support you!” But going to such a school, not only is the tuition very expensive, living expenses are not cheap either, at least 100,000 U.S. dollars or more a year. To let me attend such an expensive school, where would they get so much money? (the book writes MBA in Latin letters and 10 万 in digits)

examples.text: 爸爸好像看出了我的心思，马上对我说，“钱的事儿你不用担心，钱我们会为你准备好。”原来，他和妈妈早就计划好，等我上学需要钱的时候，他们就把现在住的房子卖掉，搬到那座农舍去。我呢，就可以用卖房子的钱，去最好的学校读ＭＢＡ了。我从心里感谢他们，我要更努力学习，工作，将来能让他们过上一个幸福的晚年。
examples.translation: bà bà hǎo xiàng kàn chū le wǒ de xīn sī mǎ shàng duì wǒ shuō qián de shìr nǐ bú yòng dān xīn qián wǒ men huì wèi nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo yuán lái tā hé mā mā zǎo jiù jì huà hǎo děng wǒ shàng xué xū yào qián de shí hòu tā men jiù bǎ xiàn zài zhù de fáng zi mài diào bān dào nà zuò nóng shè qù wǒ ne jiù kě yǐ yòng mài fáng zi de qián qù zuì hǎo de xué xiào dú le wǒ cóng xīn lǐ gǎn xiè tā men wǒ yào gèng nǔ lì xué xí gōng zuò jiāng lái néng ràng tā men guò shàng yí gè xìng fú de wǎn nián — Dad seemed to see through my thoughts and immediately said to me, “You don’t need to worry about money; we will have the money ready for you.” It turned out that he and Mom had long ago planned that when I needed money for school they would sell the house they live in now and move to that farmhouse. And I could use the money from selling the house to go to the best school for an MBA. I thank them from my heart; I will study and work even harder so that in the future I can let them live a happy old age. (the original ending, with my translation)

examples.text: 她的父母很重视她的教育。为了给她一个好的学习环境，在她很小的时候就带她移民到美国。
examples.translation: tā de fù mǔ hěn zhòng shì tā de jiào yù wèi le gěi tā yí gè hǎo de xué xí huán jìng zài tā hěn xiǎo de shí hòu jiù dài tā yí mín dào měi guó — Activity 3B-1 (my answer): Her parents valued her education; to give her a good learning environment they took her to immigrate to the U.S. when she was very little.

examples.text: 她父母买了农舍以后，每个周末都带她去翻修那座破旧的房子。她当时年纪小，没想到问父母为什么这么累。
examples.translation: tā fù mǔ mǎi le nóng shè yǐ hòu měi gè zhōu mò dōu dài tā qù fān xiū nà zuò pò jiù de fáng zi tā dāng shí nián jì xiǎo méi xiǎng dào wèn fù mǔ wèi shén me zhè me lèi — 3B-2 (my answer; the book’s 2008 appears in the printed question): After buying the farmhouse her parents took her every weekend to renovate the dilapidated house. She was young then and didn’t think of asking why they worked so hard.

examples.text: 学费和生活费可能是父母把现在住的房子卖掉的钱。
examples.translation: xué fèi hé shēng huó fèi kě néng shì fù mǔ bǎ xiàn zài zhù de fáng zi mài diào de qián — 3B-3 (my answer): The tuition and living expenses might come from the money from selling the house her parents live in now. (the book’s question mentions Harvard and Stanford)

examples.text: 爸爸好像看出了我的心思，马上对我说，“钱的事儿你不用担心，因为我们早就为你准备好了。你好好学习就行。”
examples.translation: bà bà hǎo xiàng kàn chū le wǒ de xīn sī mǎ shàng duì wǒ shuō qián de shìr nǐ bú yòng dān xīn yīn wèi wǒ men zǎo jiù wèi nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le nǐ hǎo hào xué xí jiù xíng — The ending (my own version, finishing the book’s opening line): Dad seemed to see through my thoughts and immediately said to me, “You don’t need to worry about money, because we prepared it for you long ago. Just study well.”

lessons.title: 729. Lesson 28 Presentation 2: a mother’s e-mail to her daughter
lessons.subtitle: 共享单车 · 保护环境 · 想不到一块儿 · 静下心来 · 就像你说的 · 信息发达 · 说出来

explanations.title: Presentation 2: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. How do young people in the U.S. care for the environment? Give an example. B. What impact has technology had on young people in the U.S.? C. What topics do you and your parents not agree on? (Discussion questions; the book gives no answers.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: the e-mail (the book gives the simplified and traditional versions; the traditional text is not repeated)
explanations.body: A mother writes to her daughter, who has gone back to school, about last weekend’s shopping trip and about how their two generations grew up.

examples.text: 女儿，你已经回学校了。妈妈给你发个邮件，想跟你聊聊。
examples.translation: nǚ ér nǐ yǐ jīng huí xué xiào le mā mā gěi nǐ fā gè yóu jiàn xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liáo — Daughter, you have already gone back to school. Mom is sending you an e-mail because I want to chat with you. (Presentation 2, an e-mail from a mother to her daughter; translations mine)

examples.text: 上个周末咱们出去买东西，你就是不让我开车，一定要骑共享单车，说是为了保护环境。当时妈妈很不理解，心想，这零零后是怎么了？现在静下心来，妈妈越想越觉得女儿有道理。就像你说的，世界是我们每个人的，大家都要爱护它。
examples.translation: shàng gè zhōu mò zán men chū qù mǎi dōng xī nǐ jiù shì bú ràng wǒ kāi chē yí dìng yào qí gòng xiǎng dān chē shuō shì wèi le bǎo hù huán jìng dāng shí mā mā hěn bù lǐ jiě xīn xiǎng zhè líng líng hòu shì zěn me le xiàn zài jìng xià xīn lái mā mā yuè xiǎng yuè jué de nǚ ér yǒu dào lǐ jiù xiàng nǐ shuō de shì jiè shì wǒ men měi gè rén de dà jiā dōu yào ài hù tā — Last weekend when we went out shopping, you simply wouldn’t let me drive and insisted on riding a shared bike, saying it was to protect the environment. At the time Mom didn’t understand at all and thought, what is the matter with these post-’00s? Now that I have calmed down, the more I think about it, the more I feel my daughter is right. Just as you said, the world belongs to each of us, and everyone should cherish it. (the book writes 00 后 in digits)

examples.text: 妈妈也在想，为什么咱们有时想不到一块儿呢？这可能是因为我们长大的环境不同。妈妈以前的生活条件没有你们的好，没坐过飞机，没出过国，更没有互联网，对外面的事情了解得很少。你们呢，从小就用互联网，生活在一个信息发达的世界，知道的事情比我们多多了，所以你们不只想着自己，而且也常常关心世界上的事情。还有一点，就是看到不对的事情，你们就会说出来，比妈妈这一代强。
examples.translation: mā mā yě zài xiǎng wèi shén me zán men yǒu shí xiǎng bú dào yí kuàir ne zhè kě néng shì yīn wèi wǒ men zhǎng dà de huán jìng bù tóng mā mā yǐ qián de shēng huó tiáo jiàn méi yǒu nǐ men de hǎo méi zuò guò fēi jī méi chū guò guó gèng méi yǒu hù lián wǎng duì wài miàn de shì qíng liǎo jiě de hěn shǎo nǐ men ne cóng xiǎo jiù yòng hù lián wǎng shēng huó zài yí gè xìn xī fā dá de shì jiè zhī dào de shì qíng bǐ wǒ men duō duō le suǒ yǐ nǐ men bù zhǐ xiǎng zhe zì jǐ ér qiě yě cháng cháng guān xīn shì jiè shàng de shì qíng hái yǒu yì diǎn jiù shì kàn dào bú duì de shì qíng nǐ men jiù huì shuō chū lái bǐ mā mā zhè yí dài qiáng — Mom has also been wondering why we sometimes can’t think alike. Perhaps it is because the environments we grew up in were different. Mom’s living conditions before were not as good as yours; I never rode in a plane, never went abroad, and there certainly was no Internet, so I knew very little about things outside. You, on the other hand, have used the Internet since childhood and live in a world with developed information; you know many more things than we do, so you don’t only think of yourselves but also often care about things in the world. One more thing: when you see something wrong, you speak out, which is better than Mom’s generation.

examples.text: 以后，妈妈要多跟你交流。下次你回来，咱们一起骑共享单车去郊外看风景。
examples.translation: yǐ hòu mā mā yào duō gēn nǐ jiāo liú xià cì nǐ huí lái zán men yì qǐ qí gòng xiǎng dān chē qù jiāo wài kàn fēng jǐng — From now on, Mom wants to communicate with you more. The next time you come back, let’s ride shared bikes together to the suburbs to see the scenery.

examples.text: 就说这么多。妈妈爱你！
examples.translation: jiù shuō zhè me duō mā mā ài nǐ — That’s all I’ll say for now. Mom loves you!

explanations.title: Presentation 2 Activities, Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 2 and answer the questions. 1. Why did the mother write this email? 2. How does the mother feel about her daughter’s generation? B. Detailed Listening: Listen to Presentation 2 again and answer the questions. 1. What upset the mother last weekend? 2. How did the mother feel about it afterward? 3. List the differences between the respective environments in which the mother and daughter grew up. 4. How would the mother most likely respond if she witnessed improper behavior? My answers, in Chinese:

examples.text: 妈妈想跟女儿聊聊，说说自己的想法，也想以后多跟女儿交流。
examples.translation: mā mā xiǎng gēn nǚ ér liáo liáo shuō shuō zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ yě xiǎng yǐ hòu duō gēn nǚ ér jiāo liú — Activity 1A-1 (my answer): Why did the mother write this e-mail? She wanted to chat with her daughter, share her thoughts, and communicate with her more in the future.

examples.text: 妈妈觉得女儿有道理，女儿这一代知道的事情多，关心世界上的事情，比妈妈这一代强。
examples.translation: mā mā jué de nǚ ér yǒu dào lǐ nǚ ér zhè yí dài zhī dào de shì qíng duō guān xīn shì jiè shàng de shì qíng bǐ mā mā zhè yí dài qiáng — 1A-2 (my answer): How does the mother feel about her daughter’s generation? She thinks her daughter is right; this generation knows more, cares about what happens in the world and is better than the mother’s generation.

examples.text: 上个周末买东西的时候，女儿不让妈妈开车，一定要骑共享单车，妈妈当时很不理解。
examples.translation: shàng gè zhōu mò mǎi dōng xī de shí hòu nǚ ér bú ràng mā mā kāi chē yí dìng yào qí gòng xiǎng dān chē mā mā dāng shí hěn bù lǐ jiě — 1B-1 (my answer): What upset the mother last weekend? When they went shopping, her daughter wouldn’t let her drive and insisted on shared bikes; at the time she didn’t understand.

examples.text: 妈妈静下心来想，越想越觉得女儿有道理。
examples.translation: mā mā jìng xià xīn lái xiǎng yuè xiǎng yuè jué de nǚ ér yǒu dào lǐ — 1B-2 (my answer): How did the mother feel afterward? After calming down, the more she thought about it the more she felt her daughter was right.

examples.text: 妈妈以前没坐过飞机，没出过国，没有互联网，对外面的事情了解得很少；女儿从小就用互联网，生活在一个信息发达的世界，知道的事情比妈妈多多了。
examples.translation: mā mā yǐ qián méi zuò guò fēi jī méi chū guò guó méi yǒu hù lián wǎng duì wài miàn de shì qíng liǎo jiě de hěn shǎo nǚ ér cóng xiǎo jiù yòng hù lián wǎng shēng huó zài yí gè xìn xī fā dá de shì jiè zhī dào de shì qíng bǐ mā mā duō duō le — 1B-3 (my answer): The mother had never flown or gone abroad, had no Internet and knew little about the outside; the daughter has used the Internet since childhood and lives in a developed information world, knowing much more.

examples.text: 妈妈这一代看到不对的事情，可能不会说出来，她觉得女儿这一代比她强。
examples.translation: mā mā zhè yí dài kàn dào bú duì de shì qíng kě néng bú huì shuō chū lái tā jué de nǚ ér zhè yí dài bǐ tā qiáng — 1B-4 (my answer): The mother’s generation probably would not speak out when seeing improper behavior, and she thinks her daughter’s generation does better.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Match the following verbs with their objects by writing the number(s) in parentheses. Some verbs may take more than one object. Verbs: 保护, 理解, 爱护, 关心, 共享. Objects: 1. 美食 2. 朋友 3. 她说的话 4. 地球 5. 环境. B. Share your work with a classmate. Together, create sentences using the expressions provided: 1. 静下心来，理解 2. 不让，一定要 3. 有道理，想到一块儿 4. 发现，说出来 5. 当时，现在. My key and sentences:

headers: Objects (my key; some verbs take several)
rows: 理解朋友，理解她说的话
关心朋友，关心地球，关心环境
tables.title: Activity 2A: the verbs and objects (1. 美食 2. 朋友 3. 她说的话 4. 地球 5. 环境)

examples.text: 你静下心来想一想，就会理解他为什么这样做。
examples.translation: nǐ jìng xià xīn lái xiǎng yì xiǎng jiù huì lǐ jiě tā wèi shén me zhè yàng zuò — Activity 2B-1 (my sentence; 静下心来 and 理解): If you calm down and think it over, you will understand why he does it this way.

examples.text: 妈妈不让我去，可我一定要去。
examples.translation: mā mā bú ràng wǒ qù kě wǒ yí dìng yào qù — 2B-2 (my sentence; 不让 and 一定要): Mom won’t let me go, but I insist on going.

examples.text: 你说得有道理，我们俩想到一块儿去了。
examples.translation: nǐ shuō de yǒu dào lǐ wǒ men liǎ xiǎng dào yí kuàir qù le — 2B-3 (my sentence; 有道理 and 想到一块儿): What you say makes sense; the two of us think alike.

examples.text: 看到不对的事情，如果你发现了，就应该说出来。
examples.translation: kàn dào bú duì de shì qíng rú guǒ nǐ fā xiàn le jiù yīng gāi shuō chū lái — 2B-4 (my sentence; 发现 and 说出来): When you see something wrong, if you notice it, you should speak out.

examples.text: 当时我不理解，现在我明白了。
examples.translation: dāng shí wǒ bù lǐ jiě xiàn zài wǒ míng bái le — 2B-5 (my sentence; 当时 and 现在): At the time I didn’t understand; now I do.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and mark the statements as either True or False. First determine the meaning of 北极 and 融化, then share your work with a classmate. B. Listen to the dialog again and write a summary in English. C. Share your summary with your partner in Chinese. Then use the script below to make any necessary corrections. The statements, my key, the script and a sample summary:

tables.title: Activity 3A: the words to work out first

examples.text: 这是女儿给妈妈的电子邮件，她谈到互联网对人们的影响。
examples.translation: zhè shì nǚ ér gěi mā mā de diàn zi yóu jiàn tā tán dào hù lián wǎng duì rén men de yǐng xiǎng — Activity 3A-1 (true or false; my key: True): This is the daughter’s e-mail to her mother, in which she talks about the Internet’s influence on people.

examples.text: 女儿觉得妈妈当年应该坐飞机去北京上大学。
examples.translation: nǚ ér jué de mā mā dāng nián yīng gāi zuò fēi jī qù běi jīng shàng dà xué — 3A-2 (my key: False): The daughter thinks her mother should have flown to Beijing for university back then.

examples.text: 女儿说，妈妈年轻的时候，交通和信息都没有现在这么发达。
examples.translation: nǚ ér shuō mā mā nián qīng de shí hòu jiāo tōng hé xìn xī dōu méi yǒu xiàn zài zhè me fā dá — 3A-3 (my key: True): The daughter says that when her mother was young, transportation and information were not as developed as now.

examples.text: 女儿很感谢爸爸妈妈，因为他们让她最好的学校上学。
examples.translation: nǚ ér hěn gǎn xiè bà bà mā mā yīn wèi tā men ràng tā zuì hǎo de xué xiào shàng xué — 3A-4 (my key: False, she thanks them for good living and learning conditions; the book prints 让她最好的学校上学 without 去): The daughter thanks her parents because they let her attend the best school.

examples.text: 妈妈一直不会用电脑，而女儿很小就有自己的电脑了。
examples.translation: mā mā yì zhí bú huì yòng diàn nǎo ér nǚ ér hěn xiǎo jiù yǒu zì jǐ de diàn nǎo le — 3A-5 (my key: False, the script says only that the mother first saw a computer at eighteen): The mother has never been able to use a computer, while the daughter had her own computer very young.

examples.text: 妈妈，看了您的邮件，我真高兴。谢谢妈妈这么理解我！
examples.translation: mā mā kàn le nín de yóu jiàn wǒ zhēn gāo xìng xiè xiè mā mā zhè me lǐ jiě wǒ — Activity 3 script (the daughter’s reply; translations mine): Mom, I was really happy to read your e-mail. Thank you, Mom, for understanding me so much!

examples.text: 您说得有道理，由于长大的环境不一样，我们有时候会想得不一样。还记得您给我讲过，当年您来北京上大学，先坐公共汽车，再坐长途公共汽车，又坐火车，路上走了四五天。现在呢，从老家来北京，半天就到了。特别是有了互联网，世界变得越来越小，大家很容易知道世界上发生的事情。北极离我们非常远，以前谁也不会关心那么一个地方。可现在大家生活在一个信息发达的世界，我们了解到，地球在变得越来越暖和，北极的冰在慢慢地融化。如果这样发展下去，再过几十年，地球的很多地方就不能住人了。
examples.translation: nín shuō de yǒu dào lǐ yóu yú zhǎng dà de huán jìng bù yí yàng wǒ men yǒu shí hòu huì xiǎng de bù yí yàng hái jì de nín gěi wǒ jiǎng guò dāng nián nín lái běi jīng shàng dà xué xiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē zài zuò cháng tú gōng gòng qì chē yòu zuò huǒ chē lù shàng zǒu le sì wǔ tiān xiàn zài ne cóng lǎo jiā lái běi jīng bàn tiān jiù dào le tè bié shì yǒu le hù lián wǎng shì jiè biàn de yuè lái yuè xiǎo dà jiā hěn róng yì zhī dào shì jiè shàng fā shēng de shì qíng běi jí lí wǒ men fēi cháng yuǎn yǐ qián shuí yě bú huì guān xīn nà me yí gè dì fāng kě xiàn zài dà jiā shēng huó zài yí gè xìn xī fā dá de shì jiè wǒ men liǎo jiě dào dì qiú zài biàn de yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo běi jí de bīng zài màn màn de róng huà rú guǒ zhè yàng fā zhǎn xià qù zài guò jǐ shí nián dì qiú de hěn duō dì fāng jiù bù néng zhù rén le — You are right; because the environments we grew up in are different, we sometimes think differently. I remember you told me that when you came to Beijing for university, you first took a bus, then a long-distance bus, then a train, and spent four or five days on the road. Now, from our hometown to Beijing takes half a day. Especially with the Internet, the world has become smaller and smaller and everyone can easily learn what is happening in the world. The Arctic is very far from us, and in the past nobody cared about such a place. But now everyone lives in a world of developed information; we have learned that the earth is getting warmer and warmer and the ice in the Arctic is slowly melting. If this goes on, in a few decades many places on earth will not be fit to live in.

examples.text: 我也想告诉妈妈，女儿能有今天，是因为我从小就有很好的生活和学习条件，这一切都是您和爸爸给我的。第一次见到电脑的时候您已经十八岁了，而我七八岁就有了自己的电脑，可以天天上网了。女儿要好好地谢谢爸爸妈妈！
examples.translation: wǒ yě xiǎng gào sù mā mā nǚ ér néng yǒu jīn tiān shì yīn wèi wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu hěn hǎo de shēng huó hé xué xí tiáo jiàn zhè yí qiè dōu shì nín hé bà bà gěi wǒ de dì yī cì jiàn dào diàn nǎo de shí hòu nín yǐ jīng shí bā suì le ér wǒ qī bā suì jiù yǒu le zì jǐ de diàn nǎo kě yǐ tiān tiān shàng wǎng le nǚ ér yào hǎo hǎo de xiè xiè bà bà mā mā — I also want to tell Mom that the reason your daughter is where she is today is that I have had very good living and learning conditions since childhood; all of this was given to me by you and Dad. When you first saw a computer you were already eighteen, while I had my own computer at seven or eight and could go online every day. Your daughter wants to thank Mom and Dad properly!

examples.text: 女儿爱您！
examples.translation: nǚ ér ài nín — Your daughter loves you!

examples.text: 女儿谢谢妈妈理解她。她说，由于长大的环境不同，她们有时想得不一样。妈妈当年来北京上大学要走四五天，现在半天就到了，有了互联网，大家很容易知道世界上发生的事情，比如北极的冰在慢慢融化。女儿也谢谢爸爸妈妈从小给她很好的条件，让她七八岁就有了自己的电脑。
examples.translation: nǚ ér xiè xiè mā mā lǐ jiě tā tā shuō yóu yú zhǎng dà de huán jìng bù tóng tā men yǒu shí xiǎng de bù yí yàng mā mā dāng nián lái běi jīng shàng dà xué yào zǒu sì wǔ tiān xiàn zài bàn tiān jiù dào le yǒu le hù lián wǎng dà jiā hěn róng yì zhī dào shì jiè shàng fā shēng de shì qíng bǐ rú běi jí de bīng zài màn màn róng huà nǚ ér yě xiè xiè bà bà mā mā cóng xiǎo gěi tā hěn hǎo de tiáo jiàn ràng tā qī bā suì jiù yǒu le zì jǐ de diàn nǎo — Activity 3B (my sample summary, in Chinese): The daughter thanks her mother for understanding her. She says that because they grew up in different environments they sometimes think differently. When her mother came to Beijing for university it took four or five days; now it takes half a day, and with the Internet everyone easily learns what happens in the world, such as the Arctic ice slowly melting. She also thanks her parents for the good conditions they gave her from childhood, so that she had her own computer at seven or eight.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Choose the correct answers to fill in the blanks, then summarize the passage in English. The book gives thirteen blanks with three choices each (1. a. 听起来 b. 看上去 c. 说她自己; 2. a. 笑着说 b. 又笑又说 c. 笑了说; 3. a. 最少就好 b. 越少越好 c. 少了当然好; 4. a. 快快地 b. 有的 c. 甚至; 5. a. 知道过 b. 被告诉过 c. 听说过; 6. a. 静下心来 b. 边休息边 c. 让自己; 7. a. 想不到一块儿 b. 想不在一起 c. 想不到很多; 8. a. 长得 b. 跳得 c. 站得; 9. a. 住得 b. 想得 c. 感觉得; 10. a. 关心 b. 理解 c. 认识; 11. a. 明白 b. 爱护 c. 打扫; 12. a. 提供 b. 说出 c. 告诉; 13. a. 好好的 b. 好好地 c. 好好得). B. In Chinese, share your summary with a classmate. The passage with my key filled in:

tables.title: Activity 4A: the answers to the thirteen blanks (the book gives the choices only)

examples.text: 有一次我去文具店，买了一盒圆珠笔。我旁边一个看上去不到二十岁的女孩子，告诉服务员她要买笔芯，不买笔。我说了一句，“用笔芯多麻烦。”那女孩儿转过头来，笑着说，“是麻烦，可是塑料很难降解，用得越少越好啊。”她还告诉我，塑料不但对环境不好，还会伤害海里的动物。一些海洋动物，就因为吃了人们丢在海里的塑料袋，生了病，甚至死了……
examples.translation: yǒu yí cì wǒ qù wén jù diàn mǎi le yì hé yuán zhū bǐ wǒ páng biān yí gè kàn shàng qù bú dào èr shí suì de nǚ hái zi gào sù fú wù yuán tā yào mǎi bǐ xīn bù mǎi bǐ wǒ shuō le yí jù yòng bǐ xīn duō má fán nà nǚ háir zhuǎn guò tóu lái xiào zhe shuō shì má fán kě shì sù liào hěn nán jiàng jiě yòng de yuè shǎo yuè hǎo a tā hái gào sù wǒ sù liào bú dàn duì huán jìng bù hǎo hái huì shāng hài hǎi lǐ de dòng wù yì xiē hǎi yáng dòng wù jiù yīn wèi chī le rén men diū zài hǎi lǐ de sù liào dài shēng le bìng shèn zhì sǐ le — Once I went to a stationery store and bought a box of ballpoint pens. Next to me was a girl who looked under twenty, telling the clerk she wanted to buy refills, not pens. I said, “Using refills is so much trouble.” The girl turned her head and said with a smile, “It is trouble, but plastic is very hard to break down, and the less we use the better.” She also told me that plastic is not only bad for the environment but also harms animals in the sea. Some marine animals, just because they ate the plastic bags people threw into the sea, got sick or even died… (Activity 4A, with the blanks filled by my key; the book writes 20 in digits)

examples.text: 她说的这些，我好像以前也听说过，但从来没觉得自己该做些什么。现在看到她认真的样子，我有点儿不好意思。回到家，我静下心来想了又想，觉得能理解他们了，也开始知道为什么我们和他们常常想不到一块儿了。这些零零后，是在互联网的环境下长大的。他们从小就学到了前几代无法学到的知识，所以常常站得比我们高，想得也比我们远。他们的年龄虽然比我们小很多，但是在有些方面，比我们更成熟。他们觉得关心世界、爱护地球是他们该做的事，并且能说出他们的想法，来教育别人。就这一点来说，我们得好好地向他们学习。
examples.translation: tā shuō de zhè xiē wǒ hǎo xiàng yǐ qián yě tīng shuō guò dàn cóng lái méi jué de zì jǐ gāi zuò xiē shén me xiàn zài kàn dào tā rèn zhēn de yàng zi wǒ yǒu diǎnr bù hǎo yì sī huí dào jiā wǒ jìng xià xīn lái xiǎng le yòu xiǎng jué de néng lǐ jiě tā men le yě kāi shǐ zhī dào wèi shén me wǒ men hé tā men cháng cháng xiǎng bú dào yí kuàir le zhè xiē líng líng hòu shì zài hù lián wǎng de huán jìng xià zhǎng dà de tā men cóng xiǎo jiù xué dào le qián jǐ dài wú fǎ xué dào de zhī shí suǒ yǐ cháng cháng zhàn de bǐ wǒ men gāo xiǎng de yě bǐ wǒ men yuǎn tā men de nián líng suī rán bǐ wǒ men xiǎo hěn duō dàn shì zài yǒu xiē fāng miàn bǐ wǒ men gèng chéng shú tā men jué de guān xīn shì jiè ài hù dì qiú shì tā men gāi zuò de shì bìng qiě néng shuō chū tā men de xiǎng fǎ lái jiào yù bié rén jiù zhè yì diǎn lái shuō wǒ men děi hǎo hǎo de xiàng tā men xué xí — I seem to have heard these things she said before, but I never felt I should do something. Now, seeing her earnest look, I feel a little embarrassed. Back home I calmed down and thought it over and over, and felt I could understand them, and began to know why we and they often can’t think alike. These post-’00s grew up in the environment of the Internet. From childhood they learned knowledge that earlier generations could not learn, so they often stand higher than we do and think farther ahead. Although they are much younger than we are, in some respects they are more mature than we are. They feel that caring about the world and cherishing the earth is what they should do, and they can state their ideas to educate others. In this regard, we have to learn from them properly. (the book writes 00 后 in digits)

examples.text: 一个女孩子买笔时只买笔芯，说塑料很难降解，用得越少越好，还会伤害海里的动物。作者听了以后有点儿不好意思，静下心来想，觉得能理解零零后了：他们是在互联网的环境下长大的，站得高，想得远，在有些方面比我们更成熟，我们得好好地向他们学习。
examples.translation: yí gè nǚ hái zi mǎi bǐ shí zhǐ mǎi bǐ xīn shuō sù liào hěn nán jiàng jiě yòng de yuè shǎo yuè hǎo hái huì shāng hài hǎi lǐ de dòng wù zuò zhě tīng le yǐ hòu yǒu diǎnr bù hǎo yì sī jìng xià xīn lái xiǎng jué de néng lǐ jiě líng líng hòu le tā men shì zài hù lián wǎng de huán jìng xià zhǎng dà de zhàn de gāo xiǎng de yuǎn zài yǒu xiē fāng miàn bǐ wǒ men gèng chéng shú wǒ men děi hǎo hǎo de xiàng tā men xué xí — Activity 4 summary (my sample, in Chinese): A girl buying pens bought only refills, saying plastic is very hard to break down, the less used the better, and it also harms sea animals. After hearing this the writer felt a little embarrassed, calmed down and thought, and felt able to understand the post-’00s: they grew up with the Internet, stand higher and think farther, and in some respects are more mature than we are, so we should learn from them properly.

lessons.title: 731. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 grammar: 就是 expressing insistence
lessons.subtitle: 就是要 · 就是不 · 一定要 · 非…不可 · 就是 can be used both affirmatively and negatively

explanations.title: 就是 Expressing Insistence
explanations.body: In addition to expressing emphasis, 就是 can also be used to indicate the desire to do something “no matter what,” implying a degree of inflexibility. This expression is often followed by a modal verb, such as 要 and 想 in affirmative sentences. Note: Both 一定要 and 非…不可 also express desire, but they are used only in affirmative sentences, while 就是 can be used both affirmatively and negatively.

rows: It is not permissible to say
我请他吃水果，可他一定不要吃 / 可他非不吃不可。
tables.title: Note: 一定要 and 非…不可 are used only in affirmative sentences, while 就是 can be used both ways (the book’s incorrect sentences)

examples.text: 我要他别抽烟了，可他就是要抽。
examples.translation: wǒ yào tā bié chōu yān le kě tā jiù shì yào chōu — I told him to stop smoking, but he just insists on smoking. (Grammar and Usage, 就是 Expressing Insistence; translations mine)

examples.text: 别人都去睡觉了，可他就是要打游戏。
examples.translation: bié rén dōu qù shuì jiào le kě tā jiù shì yào dǎ yóu xì — Everyone else has gone to bed, but he just insists on playing games.

examples.text: 我要他跟我一起去锻炼，可他就是不去。
examples.translation: wǒ yào tā gēn wǒ yì qǐ qù duàn liàn kě tā jiù shì bú qù — I wanted him to go exercise with me, but he just won’t go.

examples.text: 甲：网上的书包又便宜又好看，为什么你一定要去商店买呢？
examples.translation: jiǎ wǎng shàng de shū bāo yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn wèi shén me nǐ yí dìng yào qù shāng diàn mǎi ne — A: Backpacks online are both cheap and good-looking; why must you go buy one at a store?

examples.text: 乙：我就是喜欢那家商店的东西。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ jiù shì xǐ huān nà jiā shāng diàn de dōng xī — B: I simply like the things in that store.

examples.text: 甲：纽约太冷了，你还是搬到加州来住吧。
examples.translation: jiǎ niǔ yuē tài lěng le nǐ hái shì bān dào jiā zhōu lái zhù ba — A: New York is too cold; you had better move to California to live.

examples.text: 乙：我就是喜欢纽约，别的地方都不想去。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ jiù shì xǐ huān niǔ yuē bié de dì fāng dōu bù xiǎng qù — B: I simply like New York and don’t want to go anywhere else.

examples.text: 我要他别抽烟了，可他就是要抽。
examples.translation: wǒ yào tā bié chōu yān le kě tā jiù shì yào chōu — Permissible: I told him to stop smoking, but he just insists on smoking.

examples.text: 我要他别抽烟了，可他一定要抽。
examples.translation: wǒ yào tā bié chōu yān le kě tā yí dìng yào chōu — Permissible: … but he insists on smoking.

examples.text: 我要他别抽烟了，可他非抽不可。
examples.translation: wǒ yào tā bié chōu yān le kě tā fēi chōu bù kě — Permissible: … but he must smoke.

examples.text: 我请他吃水果，可他就是不吃。
examples.translation: wǒ qǐng tā chī shuǐ guǒ kě tā jiù shì bù chī — Permissible (the book prints 我请他水果, apparently missing 吃): I invited him to eat fruit, but he just won’t eat it.

explanations.title: Grammar and Usage, Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the sentences and write a modified version of each using 就是 (eight audio items, which are not included; the script is given in B). B. Share your work with a classmate, then use the script below to refine your work. Take turns translating the modified sentences into English. The script, and my versions with 就是:

examples.text: 今天这么冷，我要我儿子多穿点儿衣服，可他还是要穿衬衣去上学。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zhè me lěng wǒ yào wǒ ér zi duō chuān diǎnr yī fú kě tā hái shì yào chuān chèn yī qù shàng xué — Activity 1B script, 1: It is so cold today; I told my son to wear more clothes, but he still insists on wearing a shirt to school.

examples.text: 这家菜店的东西很贵，我想到另一家菜店去买菜，可是我先生非要在这里买不可。
examples.translation: zhè jiā cài diàn de dōng xī hěn guì wǒ xiǎng dào lìng yì jiā cài diàn qù mǎi cài kě shì wǒ xiān shēng fēi yào zài zhè lǐ mǎi bù kě — 2: The things in this vegetable store are expensive and I wanted to buy vegetables at another one, but my husband insists on buying here.

examples.text: 我告诉他，电影院已经关门了，可他一定要去电影院看电影。
examples.translation: wǒ gào sù tā diàn yǐng yuàn yǐ jīng guān mén le kě tā yí dìng yào qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng — 3: I told him the cinema had already closed, but he insisted on going to the cinema to watch a movie.

examples.text: 医生不让他喝酒，可是他非喝不可。
examples.translation: yī shēng bú ràng tā hē jiǔ kě shì tā fēi hē bù kě — 4: The doctor won’t let him drink, but he has to drink.

examples.text: 我不想去，为什么你一定要我去呢？
examples.translation: wǒ bù xiǎng qù wèi shén me nǐ yí dìng yào wǒ qù ne — 5: I don’t want to go; why do you insist that I go?

examples.text: 今天不是特别的日子，可王民非要送鲜花给我不可。
examples.translation: jīn tiān bú shì tè bié de rì zi kě wáng mín fēi yào sòng xiān huā gěi wǒ bù kě — 6: Today is not a special day, but Wang Min insists on giving me fresh flowers.

examples.text: 她知道学中文比较难，但是她一定要学，而且要学得很好。
examples.translation: tā zhī dào xué zhōng wén bǐ jiào nán dàn shì tā yí dìng yào xué ér qiě yào xué de hěn hǎo — 7: She knows learning Chinese is rather difficult, but she insists on learning it and wants to learn it very well.

examples.text: 爸爸告诉他夜里不能上网玩儿游戏，可他根本不听。
examples.translation: bà bà gào sù tā yè lǐ bù néng shàng wǎng wánr yóu xì kě tā gēn běn bù tīng — 8: Dad told him he can’t play online games at night, but he just doesn’t listen at all.

examples.text: 今天这么冷，我要我儿子多穿点儿衣服，可他就是要穿衬衣去上学。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zhè me lěng wǒ yào wǒ ér zi duō chuān diǎnr yī fú kě tā jiù shì yào chuān chèn yī qù shàng xué — Activity 1A, my version with 就是, 1: … but he just insists on wearing a shirt to school.

examples.text: 这家菜店的东西很贵，我想到另一家菜店去买菜，可是我先生就是要在这里买。
examples.translation: zhè jiā cài diàn de dōng xī hěn guì wǒ xiǎng dào lìng yì jiā cài diàn qù mǎi cài kě shì wǒ xiān shēng jiù shì yào zài zhè lǐ mǎi — 2: … but my husband just insists on buying here.

examples.text: 我告诉他，电影院已经关门了，可他就是要去电影院看电影。
examples.translation: wǒ gào sù tā diàn yǐng yuàn yǐ jīng guān mén le kě tā jiù shì yào qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng — 3: … but he just insists on going to the cinema.

examples.text: 医生不让他喝酒，可是他就是要喝。
examples.translation: yī shēng bú ràng tā hē jiǔ kě shì tā jiù shì yào hē — 4: The doctor won’t let him drink, but he just insists on drinking.

examples.text: 我不想去，为什么你就是要我去呢？
examples.translation: wǒ bù xiǎng qù wèi shén me nǐ jiù shì yào wǒ qù ne — 5: I don’t want to go; why do you just insist on my going?

examples.text: 今天不是特别的日子，可王民就是要送鲜花给我。
examples.translation: jīn tiān bú shì tè bié de rì zi kě wáng mín jiù shì yào sòng xiān huā gěi wǒ — 6: Today is not a special day, but Wang Min just insists on giving me flowers.

examples.text: 她知道学中文比较难，但是她就是要学，而且要学得很好。
examples.translation: tā zhī dào xué zhōng wén bǐ jiào nán dàn shì tā jiù shì yào xué ér qiě yào xué de hěn hǎo — 7: She knows Chinese is difficult, but she just insists on studying it, and wants to study it very well.

examples.text: 爸爸告诉他夜里不能上网玩儿游戏，可他就是不听。
examples.translation: bà bà gào sù tā yè lǐ bù néng shàng wǎng wánr yóu xì kě tā jiù shì bù tīng — 8: Dad told him not to play online games at night, but he just won’t listen.

lessons.title: 732. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 grammar: 就像…说的 and parallel sentences
lessons.subtitle: 就像老师说的 · 就像网上说的 · 排比句 · 家是一盏明亮的灯 · 时间就是生命 · 朋友是冬天里的一杯热茶

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: 就像…说的
explanations.body: The expression 就像…说的 introduces what was said previously, and it usually implies that the words carry weight. Activity 2: A. With a classmate, complete the following statements: 1. 就像教官说的， 2. 就像班长说的， 3. 就像老师说的， 4. 就像他太太说的， 5. 就像她先生说的， 6. 就像我妈妈说的， B. Take turns asking your partner to create similar sentences. Provide your partner with the beginning part of the sentence. My completions:

examples.text: 就像老师说的，我们得多说中文。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng lǎo shī shuō de wǒ men děi duō shuō zhōng wén — Just as the teacher said, we have to speak more Chinese. (Discourse Grammar: 就像…说的; translations mine)

examples.text: 就像电视上说的，这几天东部一直在下大雨。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng diàn shì shàng shuō de zhè jǐ tiān dōng bù yì zhí zài xià dà yǔ — Just as it said on TV, it has been raining heavily in the east these past few days.

examples.text: 就像您刚才说的，我们得多读一些真实语料。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng nín gāng cái shuō de wǒ men děi duō dú yì xiē zhēn shí yǔ liào — Just as you said a moment ago, we have to read more authentic material.

examples.text: 就像以前我爷爷总说的，早起早睡身体好。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng yǐ qián wǒ yé yé zǒng shuō de zǎo qǐ zǎo shuì shēn tǐ hǎo — Just as my grandfather always used to say, going to bed and rising early is good for your health.

examples.text: 就像网上说的，小孩子学外语学得特别快。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng wǎng shàng shuō de xiǎo hái zi xué wài yǔ xué de tè bié kuài — Just as it says online, little children learn foreign languages especially fast.

examples.text: 就像教官说的，军人一定要守纪律。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng jiào guān shuō de jūn rén yí dìng yào shǒu jì lǜ — Activity 2A-1 (my completion): Just as the drill instructor said, soldiers must keep discipline.

examples.text: 就像班长说的，我们要互相帮助。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng bān zhǎng shuō de wǒ men yào hù xiāng bāng zhù — 2A-2 (my completion): Just as the class monitor said, we should help each other.

examples.text: 就像老师说的，学语言要多听多说。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng lǎo shī shuō de xué yǔ yán yào duō tīng duō shuō — 2A-3 (my completion): Just as the teacher said, to learn a language you must listen and speak a lot.

examples.text: 就像他太太说的，他工作太忙，应该多休息。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng tā tài tài shuō de tā gōng zuò tài máng yīng gāi duō xiū xī — 2A-4 (my completion): Just as his wife said, he works too hard and should rest more.

examples.text: 就像她先生说的，周末我们去郊外骑车吧。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng tā xiān shēng shuō de zhōu mò wǒ men qù jiāo wài qí chē ba — 2A-5 (my completion): Just as her husband said, let’s go cycling in the suburbs this weekend.

examples.text: 就像我妈妈说的，出门要多穿衣服。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng wǒ mā mā shuō de chū mén yào duō chuān yī fú — 2A-6 (my completion): Just as my mother said, wear more clothes when you go out.

explanations.title: Parallel Sentences
explanations.body: Parallel sentences in Chinese are three or more sentences used together that share the same structure and implication. They can create a sense of rhythm and vigor. Activity 3: A. Listen to the statements and, in English, write the basic idea of each (five audio items, which are not included). B. Share your work with a classmate. Then use the scripts below to refine your work. The scripts, with my basic ideas:

examples.text: 家是一盏明亮的灯，家是一把结实的伞，家是一张舒服的床。
examples.translation: jiā shì yì zhǎn míng liàng de dēng jiā shì yì bǎ jiē shí de sǎn jiā shì yì zhāng shū fú de chuáng — Home is a bright lamp, home is a sturdy umbrella, home is a comfortable bed. (Parallel Sentences, example 1; translations mine)

examples.text: 快乐是一幅画，快乐是一首歌，快乐是一片海。
examples.translation: kuài lè shì yì fú huà kuài lè shì yì shǒu gē kuài lè shì yí piàn hǎi — Happiness is a painting, happiness is a song, happiness is a sea.

examples.text: 时间就是速度，时间就是效率，时间就是生命。
examples.translation: shí jiān jiù shì sù dù shí jiān jiù shì xiào lǜ shí jiān jiù shì shēng mìng — Time is speed, time is efficiency, time is life.

examples.text: 生活是一杯酒，生活是一本书，生活是一支歌。
examples.translation: shēng huó shì yì bēi jiǔ shēng huó shì yì běn shū shēng huó shì yì zhī gē — Activity 3B script, 1: Life is a glass of wine, life is a book, life is a song. (my basic idea in English: life has many flavors and is something to savor)

examples.text: 书是营养，书是明灯，书是朋友。
examples.translation: shū shì yíng yǎng shū shì míng dēng shū shì péng yǒu — 2: Books are nourishment, books are bright lamps, books are friends. (idea: books feed, guide and accompany us)

examples.text: 有阳光就会有黑云，有晴天就会有风雨，有进步就会有困难。
examples.translation: yǒu yáng guāng jiù huì yǒu hēi yún yǒu qíng tiān jiù huì yǒu fēng yǔ yǒu jìn bù jiù huì yǒu kùn nán — 3: Where there is sunshine there will be dark clouds, where there are clear days there will be wind and rain, where there is progress there will be difficulties. (idea: good and bad come together)

examples.text: 朋友是冬天里的一杯热茶，是夏天里的一道凉风，是秋天里的一句“你好！”
examples.translation: péng yǒu shì dōng tiān lǐ de yì bēi rè chá shì xià tiān lǐ de yí dào liáng fēng shì qiū tiān lǐ de yí jù nǐ hǎo — 4: A friend is a cup of hot tea in winter, a cool breeze in summer, a “hello!” in autumn. (idea: friends bring comfort in every season)

examples.text: 忘不了同学们对我的帮助，忘不了老师们对我的教导，忘不了学校对我的爱护。
examples.translation: wàng bù liǎo tóng xué men duì wǒ de bāng zhù wàng bù liǎo lǎo shī men duì wǒ de jiào dǎo wàng bù liǎo xué xiào duì wǒ de ài hù — 5: I can’t forget my classmates’ help, I can’t forget my teachers’ guidance, I can’t forget the school’s care. (idea: gratitude for help, teaching and care)

What does 就像老师说的 mean?

exercises.explanation: They can create a sense of rhythm and vigor.

exercises.explanation: 时间就是速度，时间就是效率，时间就是生命.

exercises.prompt: What is a friend compared with in winter?
exercises.explanation: 朋友是冬天里的一杯热茶.

lessons.title: 733. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 grammar: 呢 to express contrast and expressions with 点
lessons.subtitle: 他呢 · 晚上呢 · 平时呢 · 还有一点 · 关于这一点 · 在这一点上 · 就这一点来说 · 说几点看法

explanations.title: 呢 to Express Contrast
explanations.body: In colloquial Chinese, the particle 呢 can be used to signal a pause to express contrast. Activity 4: A. Modify the following sentences by adding 呢 to the middle of each. B. Share your work with a classmate. Go over the suggested answers below and take turns translating each into English. The examples and the book’s suggested answers:

headers: Original sentences for Activity 4A (add 呢 to the middle of each)
rows: 平时我一到学校就去操场锻炼身体，今天因为要考试，我直接去了教室。
冬天我喜欢滑雪，夏天我喜欢游泳。
现在你们的生活条件太好了。我已经上中学了还不知道电视是什么样子。
老张很喜欢唱歌，他儿子什么音乐也不喜欢。
他喜欢边听音乐边学习。我喜欢学习的时候只学习，别的什么也不做。
星期六我要参加小王的婚礼，星期天我们一家要去旧金山买东西。
tables.title: Activity 4A: the sentences before adding 呢

examples.text: 他太太因为忙没时间收拾房间。他呢，有时间也不想收拾。
examples.translation: tā tài tài yīn wèi máng méi shí jiān shōu shí fáng jiān tā ne yǒu shí jiān yě bù xiǎng shōu shí — His wife is too busy to tidy the room. As for him, even if he has time he doesn’t want to tidy it. (呢 to Express Contrast; translations mine)

examples.text: 他白天在公司忙一天，晚上呢，还要上网学中文。
examples.translation: tā bái tiān zài gōng sī máng yì tiān wǎn shàng ne hái yào shàng wǎng xué zhōng wén — He is busy at the company all day, and in the evening he still has to go online to study Chinese.

examples.text: 今天一下班我就回家了，平时呢，我会先去体育馆锻炼一会儿才回家。
examples.translation: jīn tiān yí xià bān wǒ jiù huí jiā le píng shí ne wǒ huì xiān qù tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn yí huìr cái huí jiā — Today I went home as soon as I got off work; usually, though, I go to the gym for a while first and only then go home.

examples.text: 平时我一到学校就去操场锻炼身体，今天呢，因为要考试，我直接去了教室。
examples.translation: píng shí wǒ yí dào xué xiào jiù qù cāo chǎng duàn liàn shēn tǐ jīn tiān ne yīn wèi yào kǎo shì wǒ zhí jiē qù le jiào shì — Activity 4B suggested answer 1: Usually as soon as I get to school I go to the playground to exercise, but today, because of an exam, I went straight to the classroom.

examples.text: 冬天我喜欢滑雪，夏天呢，我喜欢游泳。
examples.translation: dōng tiān wǒ xǐ huān huá xuě xià tiān ne wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng — 2: In winter I like to ski; in summer I like to swim.

examples.text: 现在你们的生活条件太好了。我呢，已经上中学了还不知道电视是什么样子。
examples.translation: xiàn zài nǐ men de shēng huó tiáo jiàn tài hǎo le wǒ ne yǐ jīng shàng zhōng xué le hái bù zhī dào diàn shì shì shén me yàng zi — 3: Your living conditions now are too good. As for me, I was already in middle school and still didn’t know what a television looked like.

examples.text: 老张很喜欢唱歌，他儿子呢，什么音乐也不喜欢。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng hěn xǐ huān chàng gē tā ér zi ne shén me yīn yuè yě bù xǐ huān — 4: Lao Zhang likes singing very much; his son, though, doesn’t like any music.

examples.text: 他喜欢边听音乐边学习。我呢，喜欢学习的时候只学习，别的什么也不做。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān biān tīng yīn yuè biān xué xí wǒ ne xǐ huān xué xí de shí hòu zhǐ xué xí bié de shén me yě bú zuò — 5: He likes to study while listening to music. I, on the other hand, like to do only studying when I study and nothing else.

examples.text: 星期六我要参加小王的婚礼，星期天呢，我们一家人要去旧金山买东西。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù wǒ yào cān jiā xiǎo wáng de hūn lǐ xīng qī tiān ne wǒ men yì jiā rén yào qù jiù jīn shān mǎi dōng xī — 6: On Saturday I am going to Xiao Wang’s wedding; on Sunday my family is going to San Francisco to shop.

explanations.title: 话语语法: Expressions to Bring up or Elaborate on a Topic
explanations.body: 点 occasionally means “point” or “thing.” In conversation, we can use expressions with 点 to bring up a topic or to elaborate on a topic. Activity 5: A. Translate the following sentences into English, then share them with a classmate. B. Create five sentences using the expressions introduced above, then say their English equivalents to your partner, one at a time. Your partner will say them back to you in Chinese. The sentences, with my translations and my five sentences:

rows: one more thing: to bring up something new
concerning this point: to say more about something
concerning this point: to say more about something
in this regard: to say more about something
5. 说(or 谈)几点看法/想法/观点/意见
tables.title: 话语语法: Expressions to Bring up or Elaborate on a Topic (点 occasionally means “point” or “thing”)

examples.text: 关于这一点，大家还有什么要说的吗？
examples.translation: guān yú zhè yì diǎn dà jiā hái yǒu shén me yào shuō de ma — Activity 5A-1 (translations mine): Concerning this point, does everyone have anything else to say?

examples.text: 说到学中文，还有一点也很重要，就是多看多听真实语料。
examples.translation: shuō dào xué zhōng wén hái yǒu yì diǎn yě hěn zhòng yào jiù shì duō kàn duō tīng zhēn shí yǔ liào — 5A-2: Speaking of learning Chinese, there is one more important thing: read and listen to a lot of authentic material.

examples.text: 我觉得，在这一点上咱们想得都一样，没什么不同。
examples.translation: wǒ jué de zài zhè yì diǎn shàng zán men xiǎng de dōu yí yàng méi shén me bù tóng — 5A-3: I think that on this point we all think the same, with no difference.

examples.text: 关于保护环境的问题，我讲两点自己的想法。
examples.translation: guān yú bǎo hù huán jìng de wèn tí wǒ jiǎng liǎng diǎn zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ — 5A-4: On the question of protecting the environment, let me state two of my own ideas.

examples.text: 就这一点来说，我们还有很多不足。
examples.translation: jiù zhè yì diǎn lái shuō wǒ men hái yǒu hěn duō bù zú — 5A-5: In this regard, we still have many shortcomings.

examples.text: 关于你们的计划，我来说几点自己的意见。
examples.translation: guān yú nǐ men de jì huà wǒ lái shuō jǐ diǎn zì jǐ de yì jiàn — 5A-6: About your plan, let me give a few opinions of my own.

examples.text: 还有一点，学中文一定要多听多说。
examples.translation: hái yǒu yì diǎn xué zhōng wén yí dìng yào duō tīng duō shuō — Activity 5B (my sample sentences, 1): One more thing: to learn Chinese you must listen and speak a lot.

examples.text: 关于这一点，我也有自己的想法。
examples.translation: guān yú zhè yì diǎn wǒ yě yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ — 2: Concerning this point, I have my own ideas too.

examples.text: 在这一点上，我们的看法一样。
examples.translation: zài zhè yì diǎn shàng wǒ men de kàn fǎ yí yàng — 3: On this point, our views are the same.

examples.text: 就这一点来说，他比我强。
examples.translation: jiù zhè yì diǎn lái shuō tā bǐ wǒ qiáng — 4: In this regard, he is better than I am.

examples.text: 关于环保，我想说几点看法。
examples.translation: guān yú huán bǎo wǒ xiǎng shuō jǐ diǎn kàn fǎ — 5: About environmental protection, I would like to share a few views.

lessons.title: 734. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 skill integration: a survey of the post-’00s and their environmental awareness
lessons.subtitle: 意识 · 问卷调查 · 结果 · 重视 · 科学 · 眼界开阔 · 观念 · 王教授

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and see if you and your partner can guess what the following expressions mean (the book’s examples follow, with glosses of mine). B. Listen to the dialog and answer the following questions. Share your answers with your partner. 1. 这个对话主要谈的是什么？ 2. 问卷调查的结果说什么了？ 3. 是什么改变了中国年轻一代对环保问题的看法？ C. Listen to the dialog two more times and list as many details as you can in the table below. Share your work with your partner when you’re done. Go through the script and refine your work. D. Tell your partner how young people in the U.S. have changed their attitude about the environment. Include an example. The words, the script, my answers and table:

headers: 细节 (my sample, from the script)
rows: 对中国十个省的差不多一万名零零后做的调查；百分之七十以上有很强的环保意识；五年前也做过，那时的环保意识比现在差很多
青少年重视环保的原因 (王教授)
受的教育多了，看事情更科学；上网多，眼界更开阔，更关心世界和将来；信息发达，对观念有很大影响；生活条件越来越好，对观念也有相当大的影响
tables.title: Activity 1C: the details table (the book leaves the cells empty)

examples.text: 现在年轻人的环保意识很强。
examples.translation: xiàn zài nián qīng rén de huán bǎo yì shí hěn qiáng — Activity 1A, 1. 意识 (consciousness, awareness; the glosses in this list are mine), the book’s example: Young people today have a strong environmental awareness.

examples.text: 关于环境问题的问卷调查。
examples.translation: guān yú huán jìng wèn tí de wèn juàn diào chá — 2. 问卷调查 (questionnaire survey): A questionnaire survey about environmental problems.

examples.text: 这次单元考试的结果你们知道了吗？
examples.translation: zhè cì dān yuán kǎo shì de jié guǒ nǐ men zhī dào le ma — 3. 结果 (result): Do you all know the results of this unit exam?

examples.text: 以前他们不重视环保，现在重视了。
examples.translation: yǐ qián tā men bú zhòng shì huán bǎo xiàn zài zhòng shì le — 4. 重视 (attach importance to): Before, they did not attach importance to environmental protection; now they do.

examples.text: 认为锻炼身体越多越好是不科学的。
examples.translation: rèn wéi duàn liàn shēn tǐ yuè duō yuè hǎo shì bù kē xué de — 5. 科学 (scientific): It is unscientific to think that the more you exercise the better.

examples.text: 他去过很多地方，眼界很开阔。
examples.translation: tā qù guò hěn duō dì fāng yǎn jiè hěn kāi kuò — 6. 眼界开阔 (yǎnjiè kāikuò, broad horizons): He has been to many places and his horizons are very broad.

examples.text: 环保观念，家庭观念，教育观念。
examples.translation: huán bǎo guān niàn jiā tíng guān niàn jiào yù guān niàn — 7. 观念 (concept, idea): Environmental concepts, family concepts, educational concepts.

examples.text: 记者：王教授，听说您最近对零零后青少年的环保意识，做了一个问卷调查。
examples.translation: jì zhě wáng jiào shòu tīng shuō nín zuì jìn duì líng líng hòu qīng shào nián de huán bǎo yì shí zuò le yí gè wèn juàn diào chá — Reporter: Professor Wang, I hear you recently did a questionnaire survey about the environmental awareness of post-’00s young people. (the Activity 1 script; translations mine; the book writes 00 后 in digits)

examples.text: 教授：对，我们对中国十个省的差不多一万名零零后做了一个问卷调查。
examples.translation: jiào shòu duì wǒ men duì zhōng guó shí gè shěng de chà bu duō yí wàn míng líng líng hòu zuò le yí gè wèn juàn diào chá — Professor: Yes, we did a questionnaire survey of nearly ten thousand post-’00s in ten provinces of China.

examples.text: 记者：能不能把结果给大家介绍一下？
examples.translation: jì zhě néng bù néng bǎ jié guǒ gěi dà jiā jiè shào yí xià — Reporter: Could you introduce the results to everyone?

examples.text: 教授：好啊。简单地说，调查结果告诉我们，现在的零零后，百分之七十以上都有很强的环保意识。
examples.translation: jiào shòu hǎo a jiǎn dān de shuō diào chá jié guǒ gào sù wǒ men xiàn zài de líng líng hòu bǎi fēn zhī qī shí yǐ shàng dōu yǒu hěn qiáng de huán bǎo yì shí — Professor: Sure. Simply put, the survey results tell us that more than seventy percent of today’s post-’00s have a strong environmental awareness.

examples.text: 记者：哦，那很高啊。
examples.translation: jì zhě ó nà hěn gāo a — Reporter: Oh, that is very high.

examples.text: 教授：是的。五年前我们也做过这样的调查，那时青少年的环保意识比现在差很多。
examples.translation: jiào shòu shì de wǔ nián qián wǒ men yě zuò guò zhè yàng de diào chá nà shí qīng shào nián de huán bǎo yì shí bǐ xiàn zài chà hěn duō — Professor: Yes. Five years ago we did a similar survey, and at that time young people’s environmental awareness was much worse than now.

examples.text: 记者：为什么现在的青少年越来越重视环保了呢？
examples.translation: jì zhě wèi shén me xiàn zài de qīng shào nián yuè lái yuè zhòng shì huán bǎo le ne — Reporter: Why are young people today paying more and more attention to environmental protection?

examples.text: 教授：一个重要原因是他们受的教育多了，看事情更科学了。
examples.translation: jiào shòu yí gè zhòng yào yuán yīn shì tā men shòu de jiào yù duō le kàn shì qíng gèng kē xué le — Professor: One important reason is that they are better educated and look at things more scientifically.

examples.text: 记者：可能还有一点。年轻人喜欢上网，看得多了，眼界就更开阔，更关心世界上的事，也更关心将来的事。
examples.translation: jì zhě kě néng hái yǒu yì diǎn nián qīng rén xǐ huān shàng wǎng kàn de duō le yǎn jiè jiù gèng kāi kuò gèng guān xīn shì jiè shàng de shì yě gèng guān xīn jiāng lái de shì — Reporter: There may be one more point. Young people like to go online; seeing more, their horizons become broader, and they care more about world affairs and about the future.

examples.text: 教授：你说得很对。现在信息发达了，对青少年的观念有很大影响。还有，生活条件越来越好，对人们的观念也有相当大的影响。
examples.translation: jiào shòu nǐ shuō de hěn duì xiàn zài xìn xī fā dá le duì qīng shào nián de guān niàn yǒu hěn dà yǐng xiǎng hái yǒu shēng huó tiáo jiàn yuè lái yuè hǎo duì rén men de guān niàn yě yǒu xiāng dāng dà de yǐng xiǎng — Professor: You are quite right. Information is more developed now and has a great influence on young people’s ideas. Also, living conditions are getting better and better, which also has a considerable influence on people’s ideas.

examples.text: 记者：要我看，这一条最重要。每天饭都不够吃，很少有人会想到关心教育和爱护地球。
examples.translation: jì zhě yào wǒ kàn zhè yì tiáo zuì zhòng yào měi tiān fàn dōu bú gòu chī hěn shǎo yǒu rén huì xiǎng dào guān xīn jiào yù hé ài hù dì qiú — Reporter: In my view this one is the most important. When there isn’t enough food every day, few people think of caring about education and cherishing the earth.

examples.text: 教授：你说得有道理！
examples.translation: jiào shòu nǐ shuō de yǒu dào lǐ — Professor: What you say makes sense!

examples.text: 这个对话主要谈的是零零后青少年的环保意识的问卷调查，还有他们越来越重视环保的原因。
examples.translation: zhè ge duì huà zhǔ yào tán de shì líng líng hòu qīng shào nián de huán bǎo yì shí de wèn juàn diào chá hái yǒu tā men yuè lái yuè zhòng shì huán bǎo de yuán yīn — Activity 1B-1 (my answer): The dialog is mainly about the questionnaire survey on post-’00s young people’s environmental awareness and the reasons they are paying more and more attention to the environment.

examples.text: 问卷调查的结果说，现在的零零后，百分之七十以上都有很强的环保意识，比五年前高多了。
examples.translation: wèn juàn diào chá de jié guǒ shuō xiàn zài de líng líng hòu bǎi fēn zhī qī shí yǐ shàng dōu yǒu hěn qiáng de huán bǎo yì shí bǐ wǔ nián qián gāo duō le — 1B-2 (my answer): The survey results say that more than seventy percent of today’s post-’00s have a strong environmental awareness, much higher than five years ago.

examples.text: 他们受的教育多了，看事情更科学了；上网多了，眼界更开阔；信息发达了；生活条件也越来越好。
examples.translation: tā men shòu de jiào yù duō le kàn shì qíng gèng kē xué le shàng wǎng duō le yǎn jiè gèng kāi kuò xìn xī fā dá le shēng huó tiáo jiàn yě yuè lái yuè hǎo — 1B-3 (my answer): They are better educated and see things more scientifically; they go online more and have broader horizons; information is more developed; and living conditions keep improving.

exercises.prompt: How many provinces did the professor’s survey cover?
About how many post-’00s answered the survey?
What share of post-’00s have a strong environmental awareness?
How did young people’s awareness five years ago compare with now?
exercises.explanation: 那时青少年的环保意识比现在差很多.

exercises.prompt: What is one important reason young people value environmental protection more?
What effect does going online have on young people, according to the reporter?
What does the reporter think is the most important reason?

exercises.explanation: 以前他们不重视环保，现在重视了.

每天饭都不够吃，很少有人会想到关心教育和爱___地球。

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the passage below. Consult your dictionary if necessary. B. Take turns translating the underlined sentences into English (the book underlines one sentence in each of the three paragraphs, numbered 1) to 3)). C. Pair up. Ask and answer the questions in Chinese. 1. 这篇文章主要是讲什么的？ 2. 和八零后、九零后的父母比较，零零后的父母有什么特点？ 3. 为什么说零零后比较成熟？ 4. 在学习方面，零零后有什么特点？ D. Turn the passage into a conversation between a reporter and an expert in Chinese education. Act out the dialog for the class. The passage, the underlined sentences, my answers and my sample dialog:

examples.text: 零零后有什么特点呢？首先，他们的生长环境不同。不少零零后的父母是在改革开放的环境中长大的，他们的生活条件，比八零后、九零后的父母当时的条件好很多。等到自己有了孩子，他们很多人可以给孩子买电脑，送孩子参加各种补习班，甚至带孩子出国旅游。
examples.translation: líng líng hòu yǒu shén me tè diǎn ne shǒu xiān tā men de shēng zhǎng huán jìng bù tóng bù shǎo líng líng hòu de fù mǔ shì zài gǎi gé kāi fàng de huán jìng zhōng zhǎng dà de tā men de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ bā líng hòu jiǔ líng hòu de fù mǔ dāng shí de tiáo jiàn hǎo hěn duō děng dào zì jǐ yǒu le hái zi tā men hěn duō rén kě yǐ gěi hái zi mǎi diàn nǎo sòng hái zi cān jiā gè zhǒng bǔ xí bān shèn zhì dài hái zi chū guó lǚ yóu — What are the characteristics of the post-’00s? First, their growing-up environment is different. Many post-’00s’ parents grew up in the environment of reform and opening up, and their living conditions were much better than the conditions of the post-’80s’ and post-’90s’ parents back then. When they had children of their own, many of them could buy computers for their children, send them to all kinds of tutoring classes, and even take them abroad on trips. (Skill Integration, Activity 2; underlined sentence 1 is the second; translations mine)

examples.text: 零零后的第二个特点是比较成熟。虽然他们多数还是学生，但是他们很多人对事情都有自己的看法，有事情喜欢自己作决定。
examples.translation: líng líng hòu de dì èr gè tè diǎn shì bǐ jiào chéng shú suī rán tā men duō shù hái shì xué shēng dàn shì tā men hěn duō rén duì shì qíng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de kàn fǎ yǒu shì qíng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò jué dìng — The second characteristic of the post-’00s is that they are rather mature. Although most of them are still students, many of them have their own views on things and like to make their own decisions. (underlined sentence 2 is the first)

examples.text: 零零后的第三个特点是重视学习。他们是在互联网的影响下长大的，很了解世界上发生的事情，对新的事物特别感兴趣。他们愿意在学习中发现，在发现中找到乐趣。
examples.translation: líng líng hòu de dì sān gè tè diǎn shì zhòng shì xué xí tā men shì zài hù lián wǎng de yǐng xiǎng xià zhǎng dà de hěn liǎo jiě shì jiè shàng fā shēng de shì qíng duì xīn de shì wù tè bié gǎn xìng qù tā men yuàn yì zài xué xí zhōng fā xiàn zài fā xiàn zhōng zhǎo dào lè qù — The third characteristic of the post-’00s is that they value learning. They grew up under the influence of the Internet, know a lot about what happens in the world, and are especially interested in new things. They are willing to discover in learning and to find enjoyment in discovery. (underlined sentence 3 is the first)

examples.text: 不少零零后的父母是在改革开放的环境中长大的，他们的生活条件，比八零后、九零后的父母当时的条件好很多。
examples.translation: bù shǎo líng líng hòu de fù mǔ shì zài gǎi gé kāi fàng de huán jìng zhōng zhǎng dà de tā men de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ bā líng hòu jiǔ líng hòu de fù mǔ dāng shí de tiáo jiàn hǎo hěn duō — Activity 2B, underlined sentence 1 (my translation): Many post-’00s’ parents grew up in the environment of reform and opening up, and their living conditions were much better than the conditions of the post-’80s’ and post-’90s’ parents back then.

examples.text: 虽然他们多数还是学生，但是他们很多人对事情都有自己的看法，有事情喜欢自己作决定。
examples.translation: suī rán tā men duō shù hái shì xué shēng dàn shì tā men hěn duō rén duì shì qíng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de kàn fǎ yǒu shì qíng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò jué dìng — Underlined sentence 2 (my translation): Although most of them are still students, many of them have their own views on things and like to make their own decisions.

examples.text: 他们是在互联网的影响下长大的，很了解世界上发生的事情，对新的事物特别感兴趣。
examples.translation: tā men shì zài hù lián wǎng de yǐng xiǎng xià zhǎng dà de hěn liǎo jiě shì jiè shàng fā shēng de shì qíng duì xīn de shì wù tè bié gǎn xìng qù — Underlined sentence 3 (my translation): They grew up under the influence of the Internet, know a lot about what happens in the world, and are especially interested in new things.

examples.text: 这篇文章主要是讲零零后的三个特点：生长环境不同、比较成熟、重视学习。
examples.translation: zhè piān wén zhāng zhǔ yào shì jiǎng líng líng hòu de sān gè tè diǎn shēng zhǎng huán jìng bù tóng bǐ jiào chéng shú zhòng shì xué xí — Activity 2C-1 (my answer): The article is mainly about three characteristics of the post-’00s: a different growing-up environment, being rather mature, and valuing learning.

examples.text: 零零后的父母是在改革开放的环境中长大的，生活条件比八零后、九零后的父母当时好很多，能给孩子买电脑，送孩子参加补习班，甚至带孩子出国旅游。
examples.translation: líng líng hòu de fù mǔ shì zài gǎi gé kāi fàng de huán jìng zhōng zhǎng dà de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ bā líng hòu jiǔ líng hòu de fù mǔ dāng shí hǎo hěn duō néng gěi hái zi mǎi diàn nǎo sòng hái zi cān jiā bǔ xí bān shèn zhì dài hái zi chū guó lǚ yóu — 2C-2 (my answer): The post-’00s’ parents grew up during reform and opening up, with much better living conditions than the post-’80s’ and post-’90s’ parents had, and could buy computers for their children, send them to tutoring classes and even take them abroad.

examples.text: 因为他们很多人对事情都有自己的看法，有事情喜欢自己作决定。
examples.translation: yīn wèi tā men hěn duō rén duì shì qíng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de kàn fǎ yǒu shì qíng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò jué dìng — 2C-3 (my answer): Because many of them have their own views on things and like to make their own decisions.

examples.text: 他们是在互联网的影响下长大的，很了解世界上发生的事情，对新的事物特别感兴趣，愿意在学习中发现，在发现中找到乐趣。
examples.translation: tā men shì zài hù lián wǎng de yǐng xiǎng xià zhǎng dà de hěn liǎo jiě shì jiè shàng fā shēng de shì qíng duì xīn de shì wù tè bié gǎn xìng qù yuàn yì zài xué xí zhōng fā xiàn zài fā xiàn zhōng zhǎo dào lè qù — 2C-4 (my answer): They grew up under the Internet’s influence, know a lot about the world, are especially interested in new things, and like to discover in learning and find enjoyment in discovery.

examples.text: 记者：请问，零零后有什么特点？
examples.translation: jì zhě qǐng wèn líng líng hòu yǒu shén me tè diǎn — Activity 2D (my sample dialog between a reporter and an expert in Chinese education): Reporter: May I ask, what are the post-’00s like?

examples.text: 专家：首先，他们的生长环境不同。不少零零后的父母是在改革开放的环境中长大的，生活条件比八零后、九零后的父母当时好很多。
examples.translation: zhuān jiā shǒu xiān tā men de shēng zhǎng huán jìng bù tóng bù shǎo líng líng hòu de fù mǔ shì zài gǎi gé kāi fàng de huán jìng zhōng zhǎng dà de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ bā líng hòu jiǔ líng hòu de fù mǔ dāng shí hǎo hěn duō — Expert: First, their growing-up environment is different. Many of their parents grew up during reform and opening up, with living conditions much better than those of the post-’80s’ and post-’90s’ parents back then.

examples.text: 记者：那他们的父母能给孩子什么？
examples.translation: jì zhě nà tā men de fù mǔ néng gěi hái zi shén me — Reporter: Then what can their parents give them?

examples.text: 专家：很多人可以给孩子买电脑，送孩子参加各种补习班，甚至带孩子出国旅游。
examples.translation: zhuān jiā hěn duō rén kě yǐ gěi hái zi mǎi diàn nǎo sòng hái zi cān jiā gè zhǒng bǔ xí bān shèn zhì dài hái zi chū guó lǚ yóu — Expert: Many can buy computers for their children, send them to all kinds of tutoring classes, and even take them abroad.

examples.translation: jì zhě líng líng hòu hái yǒu shén me tè diǎn — Reporter: What other characteristics do the post-’00s have?

examples.text: 专家：第二个特点是比较成熟。他们很多人对事情都有自己的看法，有事情喜欢自己作决定。
examples.translation: zhuān jiā dì èr gè tè diǎn shì bǐ jiào chéng shú tā men hěn duō rén duì shì qíng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de kàn fǎ yǒu shì qíng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò jué dìng — Expert: The second is that they are rather mature. Many have their own views and like to make their own decisions.

They grew up under the Internet’s influence, know a lot about the world and are especially interested in new things.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the authentic material below and write an English summary. Then share your summary with a classmate. First consult a dictionary to learn these terms: 勤奋, 发表, 论文, 博士, 学位 and 被聘为. B. You are having a conversation with the journalist who wrote this report. Ask them questions about Hu Jian’s achievements and promotion. Obtain any details about the promotions of others. Your partner will play the role of the journalist. The report, a sample summary and my sample questions:

tables.title: Activity 3A: terms to look up first

examples.text: 今年二十九岁的胡剑在博士毕业后，成为华东交通大学的教授，他也是华东交大的第一位九零后教授。在接受记者采访时，胡剑说“能够有一点小成果，可能更多还是因为我们比较用功一点或者说勤奋一点，有好几个月都是六点左右去实验室，晚上十二点才回宿舍。”胡剑曾经在世界最有名的科学杂志之一——《Ｓｃｉｅｎｃｅ》杂志上发表过论文。据说，能够在那个杂志上发表论文，是胡剑成为教授的重要原因之一。
examples.translation: jīn nián èr shí jiǔ suì de hú jiàn zài bó shì bì yè hòu chéng wéi huá dōng jiāo tōng dà xué de jiào shòu tā yě shì huá dōng jiāo dà de dì yī wèi jiǔ líng hòu jiào shòu zài jiē shòu jì zhě cǎi fǎng shí hú jiàn shuō néng gòu yǒu yì diǎn xiǎo chéng guǒ kě néng gèng duō hái shì yīn wèi wǒ men bǐ jiào yòng gōng yì diǎn huò zhě shuō qín fèn yì diǎn yǒu hǎo jǐ gè yuè dōu shì liù diǎn zuǒ yòu qù shí yàn shì wǎn shàng shí èr diǎn cái huí sù shè hú jiàn céng jīng zài shì jiè zuì yǒu míng de kē xué zá zhì zhī yī zá zhì shàng fā biǎo guò lùn wén jù shuō néng gòu zài nà ge zá zhì shàng fā biǎo lùn wén shì hú jiàn chéng wéi jiào shòu de zhòng yào yuán yīn zhī yī — Hu Jian, who is twenty-nine this year, became a professor at East China Jiaotong University after earning his doctorate; he is also the university’s first post-’90s professor. In an interview with a reporter, Hu Jian said, “That I have been able to achieve a small result is probably more because we are a bit more hard-working, or diligent; for several months I went to the lab at around six o’clock and returned to the dormitory only at twelve at night.” Hu Jian once published a paper in Science, one of the most famous science journals in the world. It is said that being able to publish a paper in that journal is one of the important reasons Hu Jian became a professor. (Activity 3, an authentic news report adapted from a news site, whose address is left out; the book writes the numbers in digits and Science in Latin letters; translations mine)

examples.text: 最近，网友不止一次看到九零后担任教授的新闻。比如，几天前，二十八岁的女博士李琳担任了南方医科大学教授；二零一九年七月，同样是二十八岁的万龙成为了哈尔滨工业大学教授；二零一八年十二月，获得博士学位的李姗，进入南京农业大学担任教授，那年她也是二十八岁；二零一八年三月，二十八岁的李东，被湖南大学聘为教授。
examples.translation: zuì jìn wǎng yǒu bù zhǐ yí cì kàn dào jiǔ líng hòu dān rèn jiào shòu de xīn wén bǐ rú jǐ tiān qián èr shí bā suì de nǚ bó shì lǐ lín dān rèn le nán fāng yī kē dà xué jiào shòu èr líng yī jiǔ nián qī yuè tóng yàng shì èr shí bā suì de wàn lóng chéng wéi le hā ěr bīn gōng yè dà xué jiào shòu èr líng yī bā nián shí èr yuè huò dé bó shì xué wèi de lǐ shān jìn rù nán jīng nóng yè dà xué dān rèn jiào shòu nà nián tā yě shì èr shí bā suì èr líng yī bā nián sān yuè èr shí bā suì de lǐ dōng bèi hú nán dà xué pìn wèi jiào shòu — Recently, netizens have more than once seen news of post-’90s people becoming professors. For example, a few days ago, Li Lin, a 28-year-old woman doctor, became a professor at Southern Medical University; in July 2019, Wan Long, also 28, became a professor at Harbin Institute of Technology; in December 2018, Li Shan, who had received her doctorate, entered Nanjing Agricultural University as a professor, and she too was 28 that year; in March 2018, Li Dong, 28, was hired as a professor by Hunan University.

examples.text: 胡剑二十九岁，博士毕业后成为华东交通大学的教授，是学校的第一位九零后教授。他很用功，在世界最有名的科学杂志之一上发表过论文，这是他成为教授的重要原因之一。最近还有几位二十八岁的九零后也当了教授。
examples.translation: hú jiàn èr shí jiǔ suì bó shì bì yè hòu chéng wéi huá dōng jiāo tōng dà xué de jiào shòu shì xué xiào de dì yī wèi jiǔ líng hòu jiào shòu tā hěn yòng gōng zài shì jiè zuì yǒu míng de kē xué zá zhì zhī yí shàng fā biǎo guò lùn wén zhè shì tā chéng wéi jiào shòu de zhòng yào yuán yīn zhī yí zuì jìn hái yǒu jǐ wèi èr shí bā suì de jiǔ líng hòu yě dāng le jiào shòu — Activity 3 summary (my sample, in Chinese; the book asks for English): Hu Jian is twenty-nine; after his doctorate he became a professor at East China Jiaotong University, the school’s first post-’90s professor. He is very diligent and published a paper in one of the world’s most famous science journals, which was one of the important reasons he became a professor. Recently several 28-year-old post-’90s people have also become professors.

examples.text: 胡剑是在哪儿当教授的？
examples.translation: hú jiàn shì zài nǎr dāng jiào shòu de — Activity 3B (my sample questions to the journalist): Where did Hu Jian become a professor?

examples.text: 他为什么能这么年轻就当教授？
examples.translation: tā wèi shén me néng zhè me nián qīng jiù dāng jiào shòu — Why was he able to become a professor so young?

examples.text: 他每天几点去实验室，几点回宿舍？
examples.translation: tā měi tiān jǐ diǎn qù shí yàn shì jǐ diǎn huí sù shè — What time did he go to the lab each day, and what time did he return to the dormitory?

examples.text: 他在哪个杂志上发表过论文？
examples.translation: tā zài nǎ ge zá zhì shàng fā biǎo guò lùn wén — In which journal did he publish a paper?

examples.text: 别的九零后教授，都是多大年纪当的教授？
examples.translation: bié de jiǔ líng hòu jiào shòu dōu shì duō dà nián jì dāng de jiào shòu — How old were the other post-’90s professors when they became professors?
