lessons.title: 736. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: situations, and a post-’90s American’s book about China’s young people
lessons.subtitle: 中国的年轻人关心环境吗 · 看法不一样 · 垃圾 · 一个美国九零后的观察 · 全面发展 · 自信 自豪 · 小飞

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and take turns telling your partner what you would say in the following situations. Provide as many details as possible. When you are done, switch roles and repeat the activity. 1. 有人问，现在中国的年轻人关心环境问题吗？ (two or more sentences) 2. 你发现，中国的年轻一代和他们的父母对很多问题的看法不一样。这是为什么呢？ (three or more sentences) 3. 看见有人把垃圾倒在马路上，应该怎么做？ (two or more sentences) My answers:

examples.text: 关心。调查说，百分之七十以上的零零后环保意识很强。他们觉得，关心世界、爱护地球是自己该做的事。
examples.translation: guān xīn diào chá shuō bǎi fēn zhī qī shí yǐ shàng de líng líng hòu huán bǎo yì shí hěn qiáng tā men jué de guān xīn shì jiè ài hù dì qiú shì zì jǐ gāi zuò de shì — Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1, 1 (my answer, two sentences): Yes. Surveys say that more than seventy percent of the post-’00s have a strong environmental awareness. They feel that caring about the world and cherishing the earth is something they should do.

examples.text: 这可能是因为他们长大的环境不一样。父母那一代生活条件不太好，对外面的事情了解得很少；年轻一代从小就用互联网，知道的事情多，眼界也更开阔，所以想得不一样。
examples.translation: zhè kě néng shì yīn wèi tā men zhǎng dà de huán jìng bù yí yàng fù mǔ nà yí dài shēng huó tiáo jiàn bú tài hǎo duì wài miàn de shì qíng liǎo jiě de hěn shǎo nián qīng yí dài cóng xiǎo jiù yòng hù lián wǎng zhī dào de shì qíng duō yǎn jiè yě gèng kāi kuò suǒ yǐ xiǎng de bù yí yàng — 2 (my answer, three sentences): This may be because the environments they grew up in are different. The parents’ generation did not have very good living conditions and knew little about the outside; the young generation have used the Internet since childhood, know many things and have broader horizons, so they think differently.

examples.text: 应该对他说，这样做不对，不要把垃圾倒在马路上。如果他不听，可以告诉警察。
examples.translation: yīng gāi duì tā shuō zhè yàng zuò bú duì bú yào bǎ lā jī dào zài mǎ lù shàng rú guǒ tā bù tīng kě yǐ gào sù jǐng chá — 3 (my answer, two sentences): You should tell him that doing this is wrong and that he should not dump garbage on the road. If he does not listen, you can tell the police.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Your friend’s friend, Zak, has spent a few years in China and he’s just published a book about China’s youth. A. Pair up. Each partner listens to one part of the conversation between Zak and his friend and notes the key information in the table below. First find the meanings of these words. B. Share what you wrote with your partner. Ask your partner at least five questions about what they heard. Use the scripts to refine your work. C. Examine the two images below, taken 40 years apart (the images are not included). How would you describe each? Possible questions to answer: Who could the people be? What are their living conditions like? What educational resources do they have? What will their future provide? D. Tell your partner an imaginary story about one of the pictures. Your partner will tell you a story about the other. The book, the words, the two scripts, my notes and my five questions:

tables.title: Activity 2A: the words to find the meaning of first

headers: 笔记 (my sample, from the scripts)
rows: 作者是美国的九零后，在中国生活了一段时间，写了一本关于中国青年的书，想告诉美国的老百姓
中国青年和美国青年的不同
中国年轻人数量太大了（八零后和九零后超过四亿，是美国的五倍）；童年的目标不一样，美国强调全面发展，中国同龄人都在努力地学习；与外面的世界接触越多，反而越自信，对作为中国人感到自豪
中国青年和他们父母一代的不同
小飞的父母小时候，邻居来看墙上的欧洲风景照片，那时中国很落后；小飞这一代从小学英语、上网，看美国电影和电视节目，很多人出国上学或旅游；经济增长很快，大批年轻人从农村到了城市，开上了汽车，住进漂亮宽敞的高层公寓
多数中国青年关心的事
不再想怎么才能有饭吃，而是问自己想要什么样的自己、家庭和国家，要决定自己、家庭和国家的命运
tables.title: Activity 2A: the notes table (Part 1 and Part 2; the book leaves the cells empty)

examples.text: 《一个美国九零后的观察：中国的年轻人与年轻的中国》
examples.translation: yí gè měi guó jiǔ líng hòu de guān chá zhōng guó de nián qīng rén yǔ nián qīng de zhōng guó — Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2: the book Zak has published (the book writes 90 后 in digits; the title means “A Post-’90s American’s Observations: China’s Young People and Young China”; translation mine; the book gives the web address of an online bookstore, which I leave out)

examples.text: 朋友：听说您最近写了一本关于中国青年人的书。
examples.translation: péng yǒu tīng shuō nín zuì jìn xiě le yì běn guān yú zhōng guó qīng nián rén de shū — Script 1. Friend: I hear you recently wrote a book about Chinese young people. (translations mine)

examples.text: 作者：对。我自己是美国的九零后，在中国生活了一段时间，我想把自己对中国年轻一代的观察写下来，告诉美国的老百姓。
examples.translation: zuò zhě duì wǒ zì jǐ shì měi guó de jiǔ líng hòu zài zhōng guó shēng huó le yí duàn shí jiān wǒ xiǎng bǎ zì jǐ duì zhōng guó nián qīng yí dài de guān chá xiě xià lái gào sù měi guó de lǎo bǎi xìng — Author: Right. I am a post-’90s American; I lived in China for a period and I wanted to write down my observations of China’s young generation and tell ordinary Americans.

examples.text: 朋友：中国青年和美国青年一定有很多不同，对吧？
examples.translation: péng yǒu zhōng guó qīng nián hé měi guó qīng nián yí dìng yǒu hěn duō bù tóng duì ba — Friend: Chinese and American young people must differ in many ways, right?

examples.text: 作者：是的。首先，中国年轻人的数量太大了。八零后和九零后，美国有八千万人，中国是美国的五倍，超过四亿。
examples.translation: zuò zhě shì de shǒu xiān zhōng guó nián qīng rén de shù liàng tài dà le bā líng hòu hé jiǔ líng hòu měi guó yǒu bā qiān wàn rén zhōng guó shì měi guó de wǔ bèi chāo guò sì yì — Author: Yes. First, the number of Chinese young people is huge. For the post-’80s and post-’90s, the U.S. has eighty million, and China has five times as many, over four hundred million.

examples.text: 朋友：四亿？那差不多是美国和加拿大两个国家人口了。
examples.translation: péng yǒu sì yì nà chà bu duō shì měi guó hé jiā ná dà liǎng gè guó jiā rén kǒu le — Friend: Four hundred million? That is about the population of the U.S. and Canada put together.

examples.text: 作者：可不。
examples.translation: zuò zhě kě bù — Author: Exactly.

examples.text: 朋友：还有别的不同吗？
examples.translation: péng yǒu hái yǒu bié de bù tóng ma — Friend: Are there other differences?

examples.text: 作者：另一个不同，就是童年的目标不一样。在美国，我们强调全面发展。
examples.translation: zuò zhě lìng yí gè bù tóng jiù shì tóng nián de mù biāo bù yí yàng zài měi guó wǒ men qiáng diào quán miàn fā zhǎn — Author: Another difference is that childhood goals are different. In the U.S. we emphasize all-round development.

examples.text: 朋友：对，我们不但要学习好，也要参加各种各样的活动。
examples.translation: péng yǒu duì wǒ men bú dàn yào xué xí hǎo yě yào cān jiā gè zhǒng gè yàng de huó dòng — Friend: Right, we have to not only study well but also take part in all kinds of activities.

examples.text: 作者：当我们在到处玩儿、周末在外过夜、去游泳或打篮球的时候，我们的中国同龄人都在努力地学习。
examples.translation: zuò zhě dāng wǒ men zài dào chù wánr zhōu mò zài wài guò yè qù yóu yǒng huò dǎ lán qiú de shí hòu wǒ men de zhōng guó tóng líng rén dōu zài nǔ lì de xué xí — Author: When we were playing everywhere, spending weekends away overnight, swimming or playing basketball, our Chinese peers were all studying hard.

examples.text: 朋友：中国的孩子学习的压力非常大。
examples.translation: péng yǒu zhōng guó de hái zi xué xí de yā lì fēi cháng dà — Friend: Chinese children are under great pressure to study.

examples.text: 作者：还有一点，就是现在中国的年轻人，与外面的世界接触越多，反而越自信。
examples.translation: zuò zhě hái yǒu yì diǎn jiù shì xiàn zài zhōng guó de nián qīng rén yǔ wài miàn de shì jiè jiē chù yuè duō fǎn ér yuè zì xìn — Author: One more thing: today’s Chinese young people, the more they come into contact with the outside world, are on the contrary more self-confident.

examples.text: 朋友：这是为什么？
examples.translation: péng yǒu zhè shì wèi shén me — Friend: Why is that?

examples.text: 作者：他们见得多了，更知道中国这些年的进步。我在中国遇到的年轻人，很多人都对作为中国人感到自豪。
examples.translation: zuò zhě tā men jiàn de duō le gèng zhī dào zhōng guó zhè xiē nián de jìn bù wǒ zài zhōng guó yù dào de nián qīng rén hěn duō rén dōu duì zuò wéi zhōng guó rén gǎn dào zì háo — Author: They have seen more and know better how China has progressed in these years. Many of the young people I met in China feel proud to be Chinese.

examples.text: 朋友：中国的年轻人和他们父母那一代比，有哪些不同呢？
examples.translation: péng yǒu zhōng guó de nián qīng rén hé tā men fù mǔ nà yí dài bǐ yǒu nǎ xiē bù tóng ne — Script 2. Friend: Compared with their parents’ generation, how do China’s young people differ?

examples.text: 作者：我给你举一个例子。我朋友小飞的父母告诉我，当他们还是孩子的时候，一些邻居们总来他们家，就为了看他们家墙上的几张欧洲的风景照片。
examples.translation: zuò zhě wǒ gěi nǐ jǔ yí gè lì zi wǒ péng yǒu xiǎo fēi de fù mǔ gào sù wǒ dāng tā men hái shì hái zi de shí hòu yì xiē lín jū men zǒng lái tā men jiā jiù wèi le kàn tā men jiā qiáng shàng de jǐ zhāng ōu zhōu de fēng jǐng zhào piān — Author: Let me give you an example. My friend Xiao Fei’s parents told me that when they were children, some neighbors always came to their house just to look at a few photos of European scenery on their wall.

examples.text: 朋友：那时中国很落后。听说一般老百姓连去另一个省都很少，更不用说出国了。所以他们觉得西方国家的什么东西都好。
examples.translation: péng yǒu nà shí zhōng guó hěn luò hòu tīng shuō yì bān lǎo bǎi xìng lián qù lìng yí gè shěng dōu hěn shǎo gèng bú yòng shuō chū guó le suǒ yǐ tā men jué de xī fāng guó jiā de shén me dōng xī dōu hǎo — Friend: China was very backward then. I hear ordinary people rarely even went to another province, let alone abroad. So they felt everything in Western countries was good.

examples.text: 作者：到了小飞这一代，从小就学英语，上网，他们是看着美国电影和电视节目长大的，长大以后很多人出国上学或是旅游。
examples.translation: zuò zhě dào le xiǎo fēi zhè yí dài cóng xiǎo jiù xué yīng yǔ shàng wǎng tā men shì kàn zhe měi guó diàn yǐng hé diàn shì jié mù zhǎng dà de zhǎng dà yǐ hòu hěn duō rén chū guó shàng xué huò shì lǚ yóu — Author: By Xiao Fei’s generation, they learned English and went online from childhood, grew up watching American movies and TV shows, and when grown many went abroad to study or travel.

examples.text: 朋友：他们这一代很了解国外的情况。
examples.translation: péng yǒu tā men zhè yí dài hěn liǎo jiě guó wài de qíng kuàng — Friend: This generation knows foreign conditions very well.

examples.text: 作者：小飞说，从他出生到现在，中国的ＧＤＰ增长了二十七倍。大批年轻人从农村到了城市，从骑自行车到开上了汽车，从住又小又旧的房子搬到漂亮宽敞的高层公寓。
examples.translation: zuò zhě xiǎo fēi shuō cóng tā chū shēng dào xiàn zài zhōng guó de zēng zhǎng le èr shí qī bèi dà pī nián qīng rén cóng nóng cūn dào le chéng shì cóng qí zì xíng chē dào kāi shàng le qì chē cóng zhù yòu xiǎo yòu jiù de fáng zi bān dào piào liàng kuān chǎng de gāo céng gōng yù — Author: Xiao Fei says that since he was born, China’s GDP has grown twenty-seven times. Masses of young people have gone from the countryside to the cities, from riding bicycles to driving cars, from living in small old houses to moving into beautiful, spacious high-rise apartments. (the book writes GDP in Latin letters and 27 in digits)

examples.text: 朋友：这个变化是太大了。
examples.translation: péng yǒu zhè ge biàn huà shì tài dà le — Friend: That is an enormous change.

examples.text: 作者：对。现在大多数年轻人不需要想怎么才能有饭吃。他们会问，“我想要一个什么样的自己？一个什么样的家庭？一个什么样的国家？”
examples.translation: zuò zhě duì xiàn zài dà duō shù nián qīng rén bù xū yào xiǎng zěn me cái néng yǒu fàn chī tā men huì wèn wǒ xiǎng yào yí gè shén me yàng de zì jǐ yí gè shén me yàng de jiā tíng yí gè shén me yàng de guó jiā — Author: Yes. Most young people now don’t need to think about how to get enough to eat. They ask, “What kind of self do I want? What kind of family? What kind of country?” (the book’s 年轻人人 has a repeated 人; I print 年轻人)

examples.text: 朋友：他们有自己的想法，要决定自己的命运，还有家庭和国家的命运。
examples.translation: péng yǒu tā men yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ yào jué dìng zì jǐ de mìng yùn hái yǒu jiā tíng hé guó jiā de mìng yùn — Friend: They have their own ideas and want to decide their own fate, and the fate of their family and country.

examples.text: 作者为什么写这本书？
examples.translation: zuò zhě wèi shén me xiě zhè běn shū — Activity 2B (my five questions): Why did the author write this book?

examples.text: 八零后和九零后，中国有多少人？
examples.translation: bā líng hòu hé jiǔ líng hòu zhōng guó yǒu duō shǎo rén — How many post-’80s and post-’90s people does China have?

examples.text: 美国孩子和中国孩子的童年有什么不同？
examples.translation: měi guó hái zi hé zhōng guó hái zi de tóng nián yǒu shén me bù tóng — How do the childhoods of American and Chinese children differ?

examples.text: 为什么中国年轻人越接触外面的世界越自信？
examples.translation: wèi shén me zhōng guó nián qīng rén yuè jiē chù wài miàn de shì jiè yuè zì xìn — Why are Chinese young people more self-confident the more they come into contact with the outside world?

examples.text: 小飞的父母小时候，邻居为什么总来他们家？
examples.translation: xiǎo fēi de fù mǔ xiǎo shí hòu lín jū wèi shén me zǒng lái tā men jiā — Why did the neighbors always come to Xiao Fei’s parents’ house when they were children?

exercises.explanation: 我自己是美国的九零后.

exercises.prompt: How many post-’80s and post-’90s people does the U.S. have, according to Zak?
How does China’s number compare with that of the U.S.?
exercises.explanation: 中国是美国的五倍，超过四亿.

exercises.prompt: What do American childhoods emphasize, according to Zak?
exercises.explanation: 在美国，我们强调全面发展.

exercises.prompt: What do Chinese young people feel the more they contact the outside world?
Why did neighbors come to Xiao Fei’s parents’ house?
options: To look at photos of European scenery
exercises.explanation: 就为了看他们家墙上的几张欧洲的风景照片.

exercises.prompt: By how many times has China’s GDP grown since Xiao Fei was born?
exercises.explanation: 中国的ＧＤＰ增长了二十七倍.

exercises.prompt: What questions do most young people ask now?
options: What kind of self, family and country do I want?
How can I get enough to eat?
exercises.explanation: 我想要一个什么样的自己？一个什么样的家庭？一个什么样的国家？

exercises.prompt: What should you do if you see someone dumping garbage on the road (my answer)?
exercises.explanation: 应该对他说，这样做不对.

他们见得多了，更知道中国这些年的进___。
很多人都对作为中国人感到自___。

lessons.title: 737. Lesson 28 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: from top student to marine, Qi Yifei and her mother
lessons.subtitle: 祁逸菲 · 女学霸变身海军陆战队队员 · 参军 · 妈妈的信 · 惭愧 · 理解 · 坚定地支持

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: When you were in China visiting your old friend last year, she talked about her old classmate 祁逸菲 (Qí Yìfēi), and mentioned that there is a report about this person entitled “女学霸变身海军陆战队队员.” You became interested and wanted to know more about her. A. The following three images, by 祁逸菲, are about Qí Yìfēi (also concerning her parents). Discuss them and the photo and answer the following questions with a classmate (the pictures are not included). 1. 在第一幅画里，一个刚参军的女孩儿，在队伍里偷偷地向后看。她好像有什么不放心的事。她大概在想什么？ 2. 在第二幅画里，这个女孩儿半夜在写信。她可能在给谁写信？她会说些什么？ 3. 第三幅画和最后的照片告诉你什么？ B. Below is part of a letter from Qí Yìfēi’s mother (it is given as a picture). Read it, then discuss what it is about with your partner. Revise your answers in Part A using what you learned from the letter. C. Below is the complete letter. Read it and answer the questions. 1. 她妈妈为什么掉眼泪？ 2. 她妈妈在信里为什么说，她有惭愧也有理解？ D. Read the report. Share the main idea from it with your friends in English. My answers, the letter, the report and a main idea:

examples.text: 她大概在想，爸爸妈妈有没有来送她，他们是不是还在生她的气。
examples.translation: tā dà gài zài xiǎng bà bà mā mā yǒu méi yǒu lái sòng tā tā men shì bú shì hái zài shēng tā de qì — Activity 3A-1 (my answer, based on the report since the pictures are not included): She is probably wondering whether Mom and Dad have come to see her off and whether they are still angry with her.

examples.text: 她可能在给妈妈写信，说说她在部队的生活，也想知道妈妈是不是还在生气。
examples.translation: tā kě néng zài gěi mā mā xiě xìn shuō shuō tā zài bù duì de shēng huó yě xiǎng zhī dào mā mā shì bú shì hái zài shēng qì — 3A-2 (my answer): She may be writing to her mother, telling her about her life in the army and wanting to know whether her mother is still angry.

examples.text: 她妈妈来给她发奖，妈妈和女儿都哭了，妈妈最后理解了她，也支持她。
examples.translation: tā mā mā lái gěi tā fā jiǎng mā mā hé nǚ ér dōu kū le mā mā zuì hòu lǐ jiě le tā yě zhī chí tā — 3A-3 (my answer): Her mother came to present her award, mother and daughter both cried, and in the end her mother understood and supported her.

examples.text: 菲菲：三个月来，妈妈欠你一封信。总觉得有很多话要说，你刚离家时，那几天晚上妈妈都是一夜无眠。
examples.translation: fēi fēi sān gè yuè lái mā mā qiàn nǐ yì fēng xìn zǒng jué de yǒu hěn duō huà yào shuō nǐ gāng lí jiā shí nà jǐ tiān wǎn shàng mā mā dōu shì yí yè wú mián — Activity 3C, the complete letter (translations mine). Feifei: For three months Mom has owed you a letter. I always felt there was so much to say; when you had just left home, for those few nights Mom did not sleep all night.

examples.text: 当我看到你们的训练视频的时候，看到那个在燃烧的铁丝网下匍匐前进的女兵，妈妈还是掉眼泪了。后来我才知道，那个女兵就是你啊！我没有想到我的女儿是如此坚强。
examples.translation: dāng wǒ kàn dào nǐ men de xùn liàn shì pín de shí hòu kàn dào nà ge zài rán shāo de tiě sī wǎng xià pú fú qián jìn de nǚ bīng mā mā hái shì diào yǎn lèi le hòu lái wǒ cái zhī dào nà ge nǚ bīng jiù shì nǐ a wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng dào wǒ de nǚ ér shì rú cǐ jiān qiáng — When I saw the video of your training and saw the woman soldier crawling forward under the burning barbed wire, Mom still shed tears. Only later did I learn that the woman soldier was you! I never thought my daughter was so strong.

examples.text: 几次泪流满面，有心痛，有感动，也有惭愧和理解。你们是“零零后”新生一代，妈妈或许曾经不能理解你，但是妈妈现在坚定地支持你……
examples.translation: jǐ cì lèi liú mǎn miàn yǒu xīn tòng yǒu gǎn dòng yě yǒu cán kuì hé lǐ jiě nǐ men shì líng líng hòu xīn shēng yí dài mā mā huò xǔ céng jīng bù néng lǐ jiě nǐ dàn shì mā mā xiàn zài jiān dìng de zhī chí nǐ — Several times my face was covered with tears: there was heartache, there was being moved, and also shame and understanding. You are the new “post-’00s” generation; Mom perhaps could not understand you before, but Mom now firmly supports you… (the book writes 00 in digits)

examples.text: 女儿，妈妈爱你！
examples.translation: nǚ ér mā mā ài nǐ — Daughter, Mom loves you!

examples.text: 她妈妈看到训练视频里，在燃烧的铁丝网下匍匐前进的女兵，后来才知道那就是自己的女儿，没想到女儿这么坚强，又心痛又感动。
examples.translation: tā mā mā kàn dào xùn liàn shì pín lǐ zài rán shāo de tiě sī wǎng xià pú fú qián jìn de nǚ bīng hòu lái cái zhī dào nà jiù shì zì jǐ de nǚ ér méi xiǎng dào nǚ ér zhè me jiān qiáng yòu xīn tòng yòu gǎn dòng — Activity 3C-1 (my answer): Her mother saw in the training video a woman soldier crawling under burning barbed wire and learned only later that she was her own daughter; she never thought her daughter was so strong, and felt both heartache and being moved.

examples.text: 妈妈以前不支持女儿参军，也不理解她，现在看到女儿这么坚强，觉得惭愧，也理解了她，坚定地支持她。
examples.translation: mā mā yǐ qián bù zhī chí nǚ ér cān jūn yě bù lǐ jiě tā xiàn zài kàn dào nǚ ér zhè me jiān qiáng jué de cán kuì yě lǐ jiě le tā jiān dìng de zhī chí tā — 3C-2 (my answer; 惭愧 cánkuì, be ashamed): Her mother had not supported her enlisting and had not understood her; now seeing how strong her daughter is, she feels ashamed, understands her and firmly supports her.

examples.text: 二零一八年，祁逸菲以很高的分数考入了清华大学美术学院，是个真正的“学霸”。
examples.translation: èr líng yī bā nián qí yì fēi yǐ hěn gāo de fēn shù kǎo rù le qīng huá dà xué měi shù xué yuàn shì gè zhēn zhèng de xué bà — In 2018, Qi Yifei entered the Academy of Arts & Design of Tsinghua University with very high scores; she was a true “top student.” (Activity 3D, the report; translations mine; the book writes 2018 in digits)

examples.text: 但是，在就要上大二时，她却突然决定要参军。对她的打算，她妈妈不支持。妈妈觉得，她该好好地在清华大学学习，将来要当设计师，为什么要当兵呢？可是祁逸菲说，不是清华的学生要去当兵，而是想当兵的人考上了清华！
examples.translation: dàn shì zài jiù yào shàng dà èr shí tā què tū rán jué dìng yào cān jūn duì tā de dǎ suàn tā mā mā bù zhī chí mā mā jué de tā gāi hǎo hǎo de zài qīng huá dà xué xué xí jiāng lái yào dāng shè jì shī wèi shén me yào dāng bīng ne kě shì qí yì fēi shuō bú shì qīng huá de xué shēng yào qù dāng bīng ér shì xiǎng dāng bīng de rén kǎo shàng le qīng huá — But just as she was about to start her second year, she suddenly decided to join the army. Her mother did not support her plan. Her mother felt she should study well at Tsinghua and in the future become a designer, so why become a soldier? But Qi Yifei said it was not that a Tsinghua student wanted to be a soldier, but that someone who wanted to be a soldier had got into Tsinghua!

examples.text: 祁逸菲穿上了军装。但一幅漫画作品，却说出了她的心事：在新兵队伍里，有一个女兵在往后看。祁逸菲画的是她自己。没得到父母同意她就参了军，她不停地在送行的家长中找爸爸妈妈的身影，希望在最后一分钟得到他们的支持。
examples.translation: qí yì fēi chuān shàng le jūn zhuāng dàn yì fú màn huà zuò pǐn què shuō chū le tā de xīn shì zài xīn bīng duì wǔ lǐ yǒu yí gè nǚ bīng zài wǎng hòu kàn qí yì fēi huà de shì tā zì jǐ méi dé dào fù mǔ tóng yì tā jiù cān le jūn tā bù tíng de zài sòng xíng de jiā zhǎng zhōng zhǎo bà bà mā mā de shēn yǐng xī wàng zài zuì hòu yì fēn zhōng dé dào tā men de zhī chí — Qi Yifei put on the uniform. But a cartoon revealed what was on her mind: in the line of new recruits, there is a woman soldier looking back. Qi Yifei drew herself. She had joined the army without her parents’ consent, and kept looking among the parents seeing their children off for the figures of her mom and dad, hoping to get their support in the last minute.

examples.text: 三个多月的训练过去了，新兵们迎来了训练结业仪式。祁逸菲第一次穿上了洁白的海军军服。就在一天前，她偷偷画了一幅漫画，想跟妈妈说说她在部队的生活，但这封信却并没有寄出去。不过，祁逸菲很想知道，父母是不是还在生她的气。
examples.translation: sān gè duō yuè de xùn liàn guò qù le xīn bīng men yíng lái le xùn liàn jié yè yí shì qí yì fēi dì yī cì chuān shàng le jié bái de hǎi jūn jūn fú jiù zài yì tiān qián tā tōu tōu huà le yì fú màn huà xiǎng gēn mā mā shuō shuō tā zài bù duì de shēng huó dàn zhè fēng xìn què bìng méi yǒu jì chū qù bú guò qí yì fēi hěn xiǎng zhī dào fù mǔ shì bú shì hái zài shēng tā de qì — More than three months of training passed, and the new recruits welcomed the graduation ceremony of the training. Qi Yifei put on the pure-white navy uniform for the first time. Just a day before, she had secretly drawn a cartoon wanting to tell her mother about her life in the army, but this letter was not sent out. (the book prints 没有 twice here) Still, Qi Yifei very much wanted to know whether her parents were still angry with her.

examples.text: 因为祁逸菲表现优秀，部队要发奖给她。她走上领奖台，忽然发现，为她发奖的是她妈妈！妈妈和女儿都哭了。几天之后，祁逸菲到了海军陆战队。她还收到了妈妈的一封信。
examples.translation: yīn wèi qí yì fēi biǎo xiàn yōu xiù bù duì yào fā jiǎng gěi tā tā zǒu shàng lǐng jiǎng tái hū rán fā xiàn wèi tā fā jiǎng de shì tā mā mā mā mā hé nǚ ér dōu kū le jǐ tiān zhī hòu qí yì fēi dào le hǎi jūn lù zhàn duì tā hái shōu dào le mā mā de yì fēng xìn — Because Qi Yifei performed excellently, the unit wanted to give her an award. She walked onto the podium and suddenly found that the one presenting her award was her mother! Mother and daughter both cried. A few days later Qi Yifei arrived at the Navy Marine Corps. She also received a letter from her mother.

examples.text: 祁逸菲考上清华大学美术学院，却在要上大二时决定参军，妈妈不支持。她在训练中表现优秀，结业仪式上，给她发奖的竟是妈妈，母女都哭了。妈妈后来在信里说，她理解女儿，也坚定地支持她。
examples.translation: qí yì fēi kǎo shàng qīng huá dà xué měi shù xué yuàn què zài yào shàng dà èr shí jué dìng cān jūn mā mā bù zhī chí tā zài xùn liàn zhōng biǎo xiàn yōu xiù jié yè yí shì shàng gěi tā fā jiǎng de jìng shì mā mā mǔ nǚ dōu kū le mā mā hòu lái zài xìn lǐ shuō tā lǐ jiě nǚ ér yě jiān dìng de zhī chí tā — Activity 3D, main idea (my sample, in Chinese; the book asks for English): Qi Yifei got into Tsinghua’s Academy of Arts & Design but decided to join the army just before her second year, and her mother did not support her. She did excellently in training, and at the graduation ceremony the person who presented her award was her mother; both cried. Her mother later wrote in a letter that she understood her daughter and firmly supported her.

lessons.title: 739. Lesson 28 Presentation 3: a livestream about the post-’90s who start businesses
lessons.subtitle: 老李有话说 · 九零后创业 · 礼物说 · 温城辉 · 创新 · 先进的管理方法 · 快速增长

explanations.title: Presentation 3: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. Can you share a brief story about a young American entrepreneur? B. If you were to become an entrepreneur, what business would you choose? (Discussion questions; the book gives no answers.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: Lao Li’s livestream
explanations.body: A host of a livestream program tells about Wen Chenghui, who founded a gift-shopping website.

examples.text: 大家好！我是老李，谢谢各位观看我的直播节目“老李有话说”。
examples.translation: dà jiā hǎo wǒ shì lǎo lǐ xiè xiè gè wèi guān kàn wǒ de zhí bō jié mù lǎo lǐ yǒu huà shuō — Hello everyone! I’m Lao Li, and thank you all for watching my live program “Lao Li Has Something to Say.” (Presentation 3; translations mine; the traditional-character copy is not repeated)

examples.text: 今天咱们聊聊九零后创业的事儿。大家有没有发现，九零后虽然才二三十岁，可是他们中的一些人已经是大公司的老板了。“礼物说”这个购物网站，听说过吧？它专卖礼品，是一位九零后创办的，叫温城辉，他的网站一年销售的礼品有几十亿元。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zán men liáo liáo jiǔ líng hòu chuàng yè de shìr dà jiā yǒu méi yǒu fā xiàn jiǔ líng hòu suī rán cái èr sān shí suì kě shì tā men zhōng de yì xiē rén yǐ jīng shì dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn le lǐ wù shuō zhè ge gòu wù wǎng zhàn tīng shuō guò ba tā zhuān mài lǐ pǐn shì yí wèi jiǔ líng hòu chuàng bàn de jiào wēn chéng huī tā de wǎng zhàn yì nián xiāo shòu de lǐ pǐn yǒu jǐ shí yì yuán — Today let’s chat about post-’90s starting businesses. Have you noticed that although the post-’90s are only twenty or thirty years old, some of them are already bosses of big companies? The shopping website “Liwushuo,” you’ve heard of it, right? It sells only gifts and was founded by a post-’90s person called Wen Chenghui; the gifts his website sells in a year amount to several billion yuan. (the book writes 90 后 in digits)

examples.text: 像很多九零后年轻人一样，温城辉有很多创新的想法。几年前，他看到网上礼品店虽然很多，但都没什么特色。温城辉觉得顾客买礼物不难，但是买到满意的礼物很难。所以，他就建了“礼物说”网站，给顾客一些好的建议，让顾客买到最好的礼物。另外，温城辉觉得，要做网站就做最好的。一般的平台只卖东西，可在他的平台上，顾客不但可以买到礼物，而且还可以从视频上看到使用礼物的效果。温城辉还有很多先进的管理方法，比如用高科技管理公司，使公司的销售快速增长。同时，买过东西的人，还可以在平台上向别人介绍礼物，吸引了更多的新顾客。
examples.translation: xiàng hěn duō jiǔ líng hòu nián qīng rén yí yàng wēn chéng huī yǒu hěn duō chuàng xīn de xiǎng fǎ jǐ nián qián tā kàn dào wǎng shàng lǐ pǐn diàn suī rán hěn duō dàn dōu méi shén me tè sè wēn chéng huī jué de gù kè mǎi lǐ wù bù nán dàn shì mǎi dào mǎn yì de lǐ wù hěn nán suǒ yǐ tā jiù jiàn le lǐ wù shuō wǎng zhàn gěi gù kè yì xiē hǎo de jiàn yì ràng gù kè mǎi dào zuì hǎo de lǐ wù lìng wài wēn chéng huī jué de yào zuò wǎng zhàn jiù zuò zuì hǎo de yì bān de píng tái zhǐ mài dōng xī kě zài tā de píng tái shàng gù kè bú dàn kě yǐ mǎi dào lǐ wù ér qiě hái kě yǐ cóng shì pín shàng kàn dào shǐ yòng lǐ wù de xiào guǒ wēn chéng huī hái yǒu hěn duō xiān jìn de guǎn lǐ fāng fǎ bǐ rú yòng gāo kē jì guǎn lǐ gōng sī shǐ gōng sī de xiāo shòu kuài sù zēng zhǎng tóng shí mǎi guò dōng xī de rén hái kě yǐ zài píng tái shàng xiàng bié rén jiè shào lǐ wù xī yǐn le gèng duō de xīn gù kè — Like many young post-’90s people, Wen Chenghui has many innovative ideas. A few years ago he saw that although there were many online gift shops, none had much character. Wen Chenghui felt that it is not hard for customers to buy gifts, but it is hard to buy a gift they are satisfied with. So he built the “Liwushuo” website to give customers some good suggestions so they could buy the best gift. Also, Wen Chenghui felt that if you build a website you should build the best. Ordinary platforms only sell things, but on his platform customers can not only buy gifts but also see in videos the effect of using the gifts. Wen Chenghui also has many advanced management methods, for example using high tech to manage the company, which makes the company’s sales grow fast. At the same time, people who have bought things can also introduce gifts to others on the platform, attracting more new customers.

examples.text: 好，今天就聊这么多。咱们下次节目再见！
examples.translation: hǎo jīn tiān jiù liáo zhè me duō zán men xià cì jié mù zài jiàn — Well, that’s all for today. See you at the next program!

explanations.title: Presentation 3 Activities, Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 3 and mark the following statements as either True or False. 1. 温城辉和老李是朋友或同事。 2. “礼物说”是一个在互联网上卖礼物的公司。 3. 温城辉做了一个教大家怎么买礼物的网站。 B. Detail Listening: Listen to Presentation 3 again and answer the questions. 1. 老李做的是什么节目？ 2. “礼物说”是一个什么网站？ 3. 温城辉为什么要建“礼物说”这个网站？ 4. “礼物说”有什么特点？ 5. 温城辉创业有什么特点？ My key and answers:

examples.text: 温城辉和老李是朋友或同事。
examples.translation: wēn chéng huī hé lǎo lǐ shì péng yǒu huò tóng shì — Activity 1A-1 (true or false; my key: False, the program only says Lao Li talks about him): Wen Chenghui and Lao Li are friends or colleagues.

examples.text: “礼物说”是一个在互联网上卖礼物的公司。
examples.translation: lǐ wù shuō shì yí gè zài hù lián wǎng shàng mài lǐ wù de gōng sī — 1A-2 (my key: True): “Liwushuo” is a company that sells gifts on the Internet.

examples.text: 温城辉做了一个教大家怎么买礼物的网站。
examples.translation: wēn chéng huī zuò le yí gè jiāo dà jiā zěn me mǎi lǐ wù de wǎng zhàn — 1A-3 (my key: True, it gives customers good suggestions): Wen Chenghui made a website that teaches everyone how to buy gifts.

examples.text: 老李做的是直播节目“老李有话说”。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ zuò de shì zhí bō jié mù lǎo lǐ yǒu huà shuō — Activity 1B-1 (my answer): Lao Li does the live program “Lao Li Has Something to Say.”

examples.text: “礼物说”是专卖礼品的购物网站，是九零后温城辉创办的，一年销售的礼品有几十亿元。
examples.translation: lǐ wù shuō shì zhuān mài lǐ pǐn de gòu wù wǎng zhàn shì jiǔ líng hòu wēn chéng huī chuàng bàn de yì nián xiāo shòu de lǐ pǐn yǒu jǐ shí yì yuán — 1B-2 (my answer): “Liwushuo” is a shopping website that sells only gifts, founded by the post-’90s Wen Chenghui; it sells several billion yuan of gifts a year.

examples.text: 因为他看到网上礼品店虽然很多，但都没什么特色。顾客买礼物不难，买到满意的礼物很难，所以他建了这个网站，给顾客一些好的建议。
examples.translation: yīn wèi tā kàn dào wǎng shàng lǐ pǐn diàn suī rán hěn duō dàn dōu méi shén me tè sè gù kè mǎi lǐ wù bù nán mǎi dào mǎn yì de lǐ wù hěn nán suǒ yǐ tā jiàn le zhè ge wǎng zhàn gěi gù kè yì xiē hǎo de jiàn yì — 1B-3 (my answer): Because he saw that online gift shops, though many, had no character. Buying a gift is not hard for customers, but buying a satisfying one is, so he built this website to give customers good suggestions.

examples.text: 在这个平台上，顾客不但可以买到礼物，而且可以从视频上看到使用礼物的效果，买过东西的人还可以向别人介绍礼物。
examples.translation: zài zhè ge píng tái shàng gù kè bú dàn kě yǐ mǎi dào lǐ wù ér qiě kě yǐ cóng shì pín shàng kàn dào shǐ yòng lǐ wù de xiào guǒ mǎi guò dōng xī de rén hái kě yǐ xiàng bié rén jiè shào lǐ wù — 1B-4 (my answer): On this platform customers can not only buy gifts but also see in videos the effect of using them, and people who have bought things can introduce gifts to others.

examples.text: 他有很多创新的想法，还有先进的管理方法，比如用高科技管理公司，使公司的销售快速增长。
examples.translation: tā yǒu hěn duō chuàng xīn de xiǎng fǎ hái yǒu xiān jìn de guǎn lǐ fāng fǎ bǐ rú yòng gāo kē jì guǎn lǐ gōng sī shǐ gōng sī de xiāo shòu kuài sù zēng zhǎng — 1B-5 (my answer): He has many innovative ideas and advanced management methods, for example using high tech to manage the company, making its sales grow fast.

What can customers see in videos on his platform?

explanations.body: A. Pair up and fill in the table with the expressions you’ve just learned. B. Reorder the expressions below to make logical and correct sentences. C. Pair up and share your sentences. Then go over the suggested answers below and refine your work if necessary. The table, the jumbled expressions and the book’s suggested answers:

headers: 中文词语 (my sample, from the presentation)
rows: 年轻，才二三十岁，创业，大公司的老板，有创新的想法
创办，建网站，成立公司，做老板，有创新的想法
给顾客好的建议，让顾客买到满意的礼物，看到使用礼物的效果，向别人介绍礼物，有特色
先进的管理方法，用高科技管理公司，使公司的销售快速增长
tables.title: Activity 2A: the table (the book gives the four topics and leaves the cells empty)

rows: 大公司的 | 创业的很多 | 也有很成功的 | 老板了 | 九零后 | 有的已经是
要用就要用 | 没什么 | 一般的 | 特色 | 最好的 | 购物软件
他的新网站 | 很多顾客 | 快速 | 使销售额 | 增长 | 吸引了
人们感兴趣的 | 是一位八零后创办的 | “今日头条” | 它专门介绍 | 新闻和信息
而且 | 使用礼物的 | 那个网站 | 方法和效果 | 还介绍 | 不但卖礼物
tables.title: Activity 2B: reorder the expressions to make logical and correct sentences (the book writes 80 后 and 90 后 in digits)

examples.text: 九零后创业的很多，也有很成功的，有的已经是大公司的老板了。
examples.translation: jiǔ líng hòu chuàng yè de hěn duō yě yǒu hěn chéng gōng de yǒu de yǐ jīng shì dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn le — Activity 2C suggested answer 1: Many post-’90s people start businesses, and some are very successful; some are already bosses of big companies. (translations mine)

examples.text: 一般的购物软件没什么特色，要用就要用最好的。
examples.translation: yì bān de gòu wù ruǎn jiàn méi shén me tè sè yào yòng jiù yào yòng zuì hǎo de — 2: Ordinary shopping apps have no particular character; if you use one, use the best.

examples.text: 他的新网站吸引了很多顾客，使销售额快速增长。
examples.translation: tā de xīn wǎng zhàn xī yǐn le hěn duō gù kè shǐ xiāo shòu é kuài sù zēng zhǎng — 3: His new website attracted many customers and made sales grow quickly.

examples.text: “今日头条”是一位八零后创办的，它专门介绍人们感兴趣的新闻和信息。
examples.translation: jīn rì tou tiáo shì yí wèi bā líng hòu chuàng bàn de tā zhuān mén jiè shào rén men gǎn xìng qù de xīn wén hé xìn xī — 4: “Toutiao” was founded by a post-’80s person and specializes in news and information people are interested in. (the book glosses nothing here)

examples.text: 那个网站不但卖礼物，而且还介绍使用礼物的方法和效果。
examples.translation: nà ge wǎng zhàn bú dàn mài lǐ wù ér qiě hái jiè shào shǐ yòng lǐ wù de fāng fǎ hé xiào guǒ — 5: That website not only sells gifts but also introduces the methods and effects of using them.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen and complete the following statements with what you hear. B. Pair up and share your answers. Then check your work against the scripts below. Take turns translating the sentences into English. The beginnings and the scripts:

rows: 温城辉这个人你听说过吧？
我先生管理公司很辛苦。
他们不但给我介绍了礼物特点，
在网上买一般的衣服不难，
建一个网上的礼品店没什么难的，
现在很多九零后创办了自己公司。
tables.title: Activity 3A: the sentence beginnings printed in the book (the rest is audio)

examples.text: 九零后虽然年龄不大，可是他们中有些人创业非常成功。
examples.translation: jiǔ líng hòu suī rán nián líng bú dà kě shì tā men zhōng yǒu xiē rén chuàng yè fēi cháng chéng gōng — Activity 3B script, 1 (translations mine): Although the post-’90s are not old, some of them have been very successful in starting businesses.

examples.text: 温城辉这个人你听说过吧？他是九零后，有一个网上买礼品的平台，特别受年轻人的欢迎。
examples.translation: wēn chéng huī zhè ge rén nǐ tīng shuō guò ba tā shì jiǔ líng hòu yǒu yí gè wǎng shàng mǎi lǐ pǐn de píng tái tè bié shòu nián qīng rén de huān yíng — 2: You’ve heard of Wen Chenghui, right? He is post-’90s and has an online platform for buying gifts that is especially popular with young people.

examples.text: 用他的想法来做网站，一定能吸引很多顾客，销售额会越来越高。
examples.translation: yòng tā de xiǎng fǎ lái zuò wǎng zhàn yí dìng néng xī yǐn hěn duō gù kè xiāo shòu é huì yuè lái yuè gāo — 3: If you build the website with his idea, it will certainly attract many customers and sales will get higher and higher.

examples.text: 我先生管理公司很辛苦。他的生日快到了，我会给他买件礼物，要买就买他最喜欢的。
examples.translation: wǒ xiān shēng guǎn lǐ gōng sī hěn xīn kǔ tā de shēng rì kuài dào le wǒ huì gěi tā mǎi jiàn lǐ wù yào mǎi jiù mǎi tā zuì xǐ huān de — 4: My husband works hard managing his company. His birthday is coming, and I will buy him a gift; if I buy, I’ll buy what he likes best.

examples.text: 他们不但给我介绍了礼物特点，而且还给我看了使用礼物的效果。
examples.translation: tā men bú dàn gěi wǒ jiè shào le lǐ wù tè diǎn ér qiě hái gěi wǒ kàn le shǐ yòng lǐ wù de xiào guǒ — 5: They not only introduced the gift’s features to me but also showed me the effect of using it.

examples.text: 在网上买一般的衣服不难，但是买到我喜欢的衣服很难，所以我只好到商店去买。
examples.translation: zài wǎng shàng mǎi yì bān de yī fú bù nán dàn shì mǎi dào wǒ xǐ huān de yī fú hěn nán suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ hǎo dào shāng diàn qù mǎi — 6: Buying ordinary clothes online is not hard, but buying clothes I like is, so I have no choice but to go buy at a store.

examples.text: 建一个网上的礼品店没什么难的，但是能吸引大量的年轻的顾客，使销售额快速增长，很难。
examples.translation: jiàn yí gè wǎng shàng de lǐ pǐn diàn méi shén me nán de dàn shì néng xī yǐn dà liàng de nián qīng de gù kè shǐ xiāo shòu é kuài sù zēng zhǎng hěn nán — 7: Building an online gift shop is nothing hard, but attracting large numbers of young customers and making sales grow fast is hard.

examples.text: 现在很多九零后创办了自己公司。他们一般都有很多创新的想法，同时还用高科技来管理公司。
examples.translation: xiàn zài hěn duō jiǔ líng hòu chuàng bàn le zì jǐ gōng sī tā men yì bān dōu yǒu hěn duō chuàng xīn de xiǎng fǎ tóng shí hái yòng gāo kē jì lái guǎn lǐ gōng sī — 8: Many post-’90s people now have founded their own companies. They generally have many innovative ideas and at the same time use high tech to manage the company.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the exchanges using the expressions provided (the book gives the questions, A, and the expressions in brackets, and leaves B blank). B. Pair up, share and refine your work. Then, take turns translating the exchanges into English and your partner translates them back into Chinese. My completed exchanges:

examples.text: 甲：今天老李的直播节目聊什么？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān lǎo lǐ de zhí bō jié mù liáo shén me — Activity 4A-1 (expressions: 90 后, 创业; the answers are mine): A: What did Lao Li’s livestream talk about today?

examples.text: 乙：今天老李聊九零后创业的事儿。
examples.translation: yǐ jīn tiān lǎo lǐ liáo jiǔ líng hòu chuàng yè de shìr — B: Today Lao Li talked about post-’90s starting businesses.

examples.text: 甲：现在年轻人创办公司不难吧？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiàn zài nián qīng rén chuàng bàn gōng sī bù nán ba — 4A-2 (不难, 创新, 很难): A: It isn’t hard for young people to found companies now, is it?

examples.text: 乙：创办公司不难，但是要有创新的想法，成功很难。
examples.translation: yǐ chuàng bàn gōng sī bù nán dàn shì yào yǒu chuàng xīn de xiǎng fǎ chéng gōng hěn nán — B: Founding a company is not hard, but having innovative ideas and succeeding is hard.

examples.text: 甲：他们的公司为什么那么成功？
examples.translation: jiǎ tā men de gōng sī wèi shén me nà me chéng gōng — 4A-3 (高科技, 要做就…): A: Why is their company so successful?

examples.text: 乙：因为他们用高科技管理公司，而且要做就做最好的。
examples.translation: yǐ yīn wèi tā men yòng gāo kē jì guǎn lǐ gōng sī ér qiě yào zuò jiù zuò zuì hǎo de — B: Because they use high tech to manage the company, and if they do it they do the best.

examples.text: 甲：那他是怎么做到的呢？
examples.translation: jiǎ nà tā shì zěn me zuò dào de ne — 4A-4 (介绍, 吸引, 同时): A: Then how did he do it?

examples.text: 乙：他在网站上介绍礼物，吸引了很多顾客，同时让买过东西的人向别人介绍礼物。
examples.translation: yǐ tā zài wǎng zhàn shàng jiè shào lǐ wù xī yǐn le hěn duō gù kè tóng shí ràng mǎi guò dōng xī de rén xiàng bié rén jiè shào lǐ wù — B: He introduces gifts on the site and attracts many customers, and at the same time lets people who have bought things introduce gifts to others.

examples.text: 甲：你是怎么想起来要做购物网站的？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ shì zěn me xiǎng qǐ lái yào zuò gòu wù wǎng zhàn de — 4A-5 (像…一样, 想法): A: How did you come up with the idea of making a shopping website?

examples.text: 乙：像很多九零后年轻人一样，我有很多创新的想法。
examples.translation: yǐ xiàng hěn duō jiǔ líng hòu nián qīng rén yí yàng wǒ yǒu hěn duō chuàng xīn de xiǎng fǎ — B: Like many young post-’90s people, I have many innovative ideas.

examples.text: 甲：九零后才二三十岁，很年轻啊。
examples.translation: jiǎ jiǔ líng hòu cái èr sān shí suì hěn nián qīng a — 4A-6 (虽然, 可是, 老板): A: The post-’90s are only twenty or thirty, very young.

examples.text: 乙：虽然他们才二三十岁，可是有的已经是大公司的老板了。
examples.translation: yǐ suī rán tā men cái èr sān shí suì kě shì yǒu de yǐ jīng shì dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn le — B: Although they are only twenty or thirty, some are already bosses of big companies.

examples.text: 甲：刚开始他们的网站没能吸引很多顾客，那后来呢？
examples.translation: jiǎ gāng kāi shǐ tā men de wǎng zhàn méi néng xī yǐn hěn duō gù kè nà hòu lái ne — 4A-7 (建议, 快速, 增长): A: At first their website could not attract many customers; what happened later?

examples.text: 乙：后来他们给顾客一些好的建议，销售就快速增长了。
examples.translation: yǐ hòu lái tā men gěi gù kè yì xiē hǎo de jiàn yì xiāo shòu jiù kuài sù zēng zhǎng le — B: Later they gave customers some good suggestions and sales grew fast.

examples.text: 甲：现在购物网站太多了。他的有什么不一样吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiàn zài gòu wù wǎng zhàn tài duō le tā de yǒu shén me bù yí yàng ma — 4A-8 (一般, 可, 同时): A: There are too many shopping websites now. What is different about his?

examples.text: 乙：一般的网站只卖东西，可他的网站同时还能让顾客看到使用礼物的效果。
examples.translation: yǐ yì bān de wǎng zhàn zhǐ mài dōng xī kě tā de wǎng zhàn tóng shí hái néng ràng gù kè kàn dào shǐ yòng lǐ wù de xiào guǒ — B: Ordinary websites only sell things, but his also lets customers see the effect of using the gifts.

How does the wife in the script decide on her husband’s gift?

exercises.explanation: 同时还用高科技来管理公司.

lessons.title: 741. Lesson 28 Presentation 3 grammar: inserting a question to draw the listener’s attention, and 什么 to soften a negative sentence
lessons.subtitle: 听说了吗？ · 你知道吗？ · 你发现没有？ · 没什么草和树 · 没什么道理 · 不怎么好听

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: Inserting a Question to Draw Listener’s Attention
explanations.body: To describe something in spoken Chinese, you may start by asking a question. This can help attract the listener’s attention. The following examples show two methods of description; one is direct (a), and the other begins with a question (b). Activity 1: A. Modify the statements so they begin with a question: 1. 九零后才二三十岁，可有的已经是大公司的老板了。 2. 要学好中文就得多说。 3. 那部新电影很好看。 4. 咱们这儿现在能看到蓝天了！ 5. 后来她越想越觉得女儿说得有道理。 B. Pair up and share your work. Each partner will write five sentences that describe things in Monterey or DLI, each starting with a question. The examples, my versions and my sentences:

examples.text: 中文系新来了一位老师，是南京人，北京语言大学毕业的。
examples.translation: zhōng wén xì xīn lái le yí wèi lǎo shī shì nán jīng rén běi jīng yǔ yán dà xué bì yè de — Discourse Grammar: Inserting a Question to Draw Listener’s Attention. 1a (direct): A new teacher has arrived in the Chinese department; he is from Nanjing and graduated from Beijing Language and Culture University. (translations mine)

examples.text: 听说了吗？中文系新来了一位老师，是南京人，北京语言大学毕业的。
examples.translation: tīng shuō le ma zhōng wén xì xīn lái le yí wèi lǎo shī shì nán jīng rén běi jīng yǔ yán dà xué bì yè de — 1b (with a question): Have you heard? A new teacher has arrived in the Chinese department; he is from Nanjing and graduated from Beijing Language and Culture University.

examples.text: 老张的小儿子要去美国加州上大学了。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng de xiǎo ér zi yào qù měi guó jiā zhōu shàng dà xué le — 2a: Lao Zhang’s youngest son is going to university in California.

examples.text: 老张的小儿子你认识吧？他要去美国加州上大学了。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng de xiǎo ér zi nǐ rèn shí ba tā yào qù měi guó jiā zhōu shàng dà xué le — 2b: You know Lao Zhang’s youngest son, right? He is going to university in California.

examples.text: 锻炼太多对身体也不好。
examples.translation: duàn liàn tài duō duì shēn tǐ yě bù hǎo — 3a: Too much exercise is not good for the body either.

examples.text: 你知道吗？锻炼太多对身体也不好。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào ma duàn liàn tài duō duì shēn tǐ yě bù hǎo — 3b: Did you know? Too much exercise is not good for the body either.

examples.text: 这几天马路上的车比以前少多了。
examples.translation: zhè jǐ tiān mǎ lù shàng de chē bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le — 4a: These days there are far fewer cars on the road than before.

examples.text: 你发现没有？这几天马路上的车比以前少多了。
examples.translation: nǐ fā xiàn méi yǒu zhè jǐ tiān mǎ lù shàng de chē bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le — 4b: Have you noticed? These days there are far fewer cars on the road than before.

examples.text: 今天新华商场的女装打七折。
examples.translation: jīn tiān xīn huá shāng chǎng de nǚ zhuāng dǎ qī zhé — 5a: Women’s clothing at Xinhua Mall is 30 percent off today.

examples.text: 听说了吗？今天新华商场的女装打七折呢。
examples.translation: tīng shuō le ma jīn tiān xīn huá shāng chǎng de nǚ zhuāng dǎ qī zhé ne — 5b: Have you heard? Women’s clothing at Xinhua Mall is 30 percent off today.

examples.text: 你知道吗？九零后才二三十岁，可有的已经是大公司的老板了。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào ma jiǔ líng hòu cái èr sān shí suì kě yǒu de yǐ jīng shì dà gōng sī de lǎo bǎn le — Activity 1A-1 (my version beginning with a question; translations mine): Did you know? The post-’90s are only twenty or thirty, but some are already bosses of big companies.

examples.text: 你知道怎么才能学好中文吗？要学好中文就得多说。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào zěn me cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén ma yào xué hǎo zhōng wén jiù děi duō shuō — 1A-2: Do you know how to learn Chinese well? To learn Chinese well you have to speak a lot.

examples.text: 你看过那部新电影吗？那部新电影很好看。
examples.translation: nǐ kàn guò nà bù xīn diàn yǐng ma nà bù xīn diàn yǐng hěn hǎo kàn — 1A-3: Have you seen that new movie? That new movie is very good.

examples.text: 你发现没有？咱们这儿现在能看到蓝天了！
examples.translation: nǐ fā xiàn méi yǒu zán men zhèr xiàn zài néng kàn dào lán tiān le — 1A-4: Have you noticed? We can see blue sky here now!

examples.text: 你知道吗？后来她越想越觉得女儿说得有道理。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào ma hòu lái tā yuè xiǎng yuè jué de nǚ ér shuō de yǒu dào lǐ — 1A-5: Do you know what? Later, the more she thought, the more she felt her daughter was right.

examples.text: 你去过蒙特雷的海边吗？那儿的风景特别美。
examples.translation: nǐ qù guò méng tè léi de hǎi biān ma nàr de fēng jǐng tè bié měi — Activity 1B (my five sample sentences about Monterey or DLI, each starting with a question): Have you been to the Monterey seaside? The scenery there is especially beautiful.

examples.text: 你知道吗？蒙特雷的夏天不太热。
examples.translation: nǐ zhī dào ma méng tè léi de xià tiān bú tài rè — Did you know? Summers in Monterey are not too hot.

examples.text: 听说了吗？学校下个星期有一次中文考试。
examples.translation: tīng shuō le ma xué xiào xià gè xīng qī yǒu yí cì zhōng wén kǎo shì — Have you heard? The school has a Chinese exam next week.

examples.text: 你发现没有？这几天学校里的人比以前少多了。
examples.translation: nǐ fā xiàn méi yǒu zhè jǐ tiān xué xiào lǐ de rén bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le — Have you noticed? These days there are far fewer people at school than before.

examples.text: 你认识我们的中文老师吧？她是北京人。
examples.translation: nǐ rèn shí wǒ men de zhōng wén lǎo shī ba tā shì běi jīng rén — You know our Chinese teacher, right? She is from Beijing.

explanations.title: 什么 to Soften the Tone in a Negative Sentence
explanations.body: Sometimes 什么 is used before a noun or noun phrase in a negative sentence to soften the tone a bit. It is similar to “little” or “few” in English. With adjectives, 怎么 is used to soften the tone. Activity 2: A. Complete the exchanges using 什么 to soften the tone. B. Pair up and check your work. Check the suggested answers below to refine your work. The examples and the book’s suggested answers:

examples.text: 这儿没有草和树。
examples.translation: zhèr méi yǒu cǎo hé shù — 什么 to Soften the Tone in a Negative Sentence (the book marks each change with an arrow): 1. There is no grass or trees here. (translations mine)

examples.text: 这儿没什么草和树。
examples.translation: zhèr méi shén me cǎo hé shù — → There isn’t much grass or many trees here.

examples.text: 他这么说没道理。
examples.translation: tā zhè me shuō méi dào lǐ — 2. It is unreasonable for him to say so.

examples.text: 他这么说没什么道理。
examples.translation: tā zhè me shuō méi shén me dào lǐ — → There isn’t much reason in what he says.

examples.text: 那个电影不好看。
examples.translation: nà ge diàn yǐng bù hǎo kàn — 3. That movie is not good.

examples.text: 那个电影没什么好看的。
examples.translation: nà ge diàn yǐng méi shén me hǎo kàn de — → That movie is not much to watch. (好看的 here is a noun phrase)

examples.text: 我今天太忙了，中午都没吃饭。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān tài máng le zhōng wǔ dōu méi chī fàn — 4. I was too busy today and didn’t even eat lunch.

examples.text: 我今天太忙了，中午都没吃什么饭。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān tài máng le zhōng wǔ dōu méi chī shén me fàn — → I was too busy today and didn’t eat much of a lunch.

examples.text: 做这个工作我没经验。
examples.translation: zuò zhè ge gōng zuò wǒ méi jīng yàn — 5. I have no experience in doing this job.

examples.text: 做这个工作我没什么经验。
examples.translation: zuò zhè ge gōng zuò wǒ méi shén me jīng yàn — → I don’t have much experience in doing this job.

examples.text: 那首歌不好听。
examples.translation: nà shǒu gē bù hǎo tīng — Note: With adjectives, 怎么 is used to soften the tone. Instead of this: That song is not nice to listen to.

examples.text: 那首歌不怎么好听。
examples.translation: nà shǒu gē bù zěn me hǎo tīng — say this: That song isn’t all that nice to listen to.

examples.text: 甲：今天公园里的人多不多？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān gōng yuán lǐ de rén duō bù duō — Activity 2A-1 (the book’s suggested answers; translations mine). A: Are there many people in the park today?

examples.text: 乙：今天公园里没什么人。
examples.translation: yǐ jīn tiān gōng yuán lǐ méi shén me rén — B: There aren’t many people in the park today.

examples.text: 甲：今天你们有听力作业吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān nǐ men yǒu tīng lì zuò yè ma — 2. A: Do you have listening homework today?

examples.text: 乙：今天我们没什么听力作业。
examples.translation: yǐ jīn tiān wǒ men méi shén me tīng lì zuò yè — B: We don’t have much listening homework today.

examples.text: 甲：他们的网站的特色是什么？
examples.translation: jiǎ tā men de wǎng zhàn de tè sè shì shén me — 3. A: What is the special feature of their website?

examples.text: 乙：他们的网站没什么特色。
examples.translation: yǐ tā men de wǎng zhàn méi shén me tè sè — B: Their website doesn’t have much of a special feature.

examples.text: 甲：老李他们那儿的风景怎么样？好看吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ lǎo lǐ tā men nàr de fēng jǐng zěn me yàng hǎo kàn ma — 4. A: How is the scenery where Lao Li and the others are? Is it pretty?

examples.text: 乙：他们那儿没什么好看的风景。
examples.translation: yǐ tā men nàr méi shén me hǎo kàn de fēng jǐng — B: There isn’t much pretty scenery where they are.

examples.text: 甲：听说你写了一本书，是吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ tīng shuō nǐ xiě le yì běn shū shì ma — 5. A: I hear you wrote a book, is that so?

examples.text: 乙：我没写什么书。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ méi xiě shén me shū — B: I haven’t written any book to speak of.

examples.text: 甲：你在杭州认识很多人吧？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ zài háng zhōu rèn shí hěn duō rén ba — 6. A: You know a lot of people in Hangzhou, don’t you?

examples.text: 乙：我在杭州不认识什么人。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ zài háng zhōu bú rèn shí shén me rén — B: I don’t know many people in Hangzhou.

你知道吗？锻炼太多对身体也不好

lessons.title: 742. Lesson 28 Presentation 3 grammar: …不…, 但是…很…, 要+Verb+就+Verb…的 and 同时
lessons.subtitle: 不难，但是很难 · 要买就买最好的 · 同时 · 他也是 · 再吃几天药，同时要注意休息

explanations.title: The …不…, 但是…很… Construction
explanations.body: This construction emphasizes a certain aspect over another aspect. With it the speaker first acknowledges the existence of one aspect, and then says something to emphasize the other. This is not a fixed usage, and similar expressions can be used to replace 不, 但是 and 很 respectively. The structure can also be turned into …很…, 但是…不… or others that are similar. Activity 3: A. Listen to the short dialogs and answer the questions in Chinese. Use the …不…, 但是…很… or similar constructions. B. Pair up and share your work. Then go over the scripts to refine your sentences. C. Write three sentences describing your studies or life, using the construction or its variations. Share your work with your partner. The examples, the questions, the scripts and my three sentences:

examples.text: 她学中文开始得不早，但是学得很好。
examples.translation: tā xué zhōng wén kāi shǐ de bù zǎo dàn shì xué de hěn hǎo — The …不…, 但是…很… Construction: 1. She did not start learning Chinese early, but she learns it very well. (translations mine)

examples.text: 一次两次早起床锻炼身体不难，但是每天早起床锻炼身体很难。
examples.translation: yí cì liǎng cì zǎo qǐ chuáng duàn liàn shēn tǐ bù nán dàn shì měi tiān zǎo qǐ chuáng duàn liàn shēn tǐ hěn nán — 2. Getting up early to exercise once or twice is not hard, but doing so every day is very hard.

examples.text: 我不觉得他的想法很好，但是很理解他为什么这么想。
examples.translation: wǒ bù jué de tā de xiǎng fǎ hěn hǎo dàn shì hěn lǐ jiě tā wèi shén me zhè me xiǎng — 3. I don’t think his idea is very good, but I understand very well why he thinks so.

examples.text: 他对我很好，很像是我的哥哥，但他不是我哥哥。
examples.translation: tā duì wǒ hěn hǎo hěn xiàng shì wǒ dī gē gē dàn tā bú shì wǒ gē gē — 4. He is very good to me and is very much like my older brother, but he is not my brother.

examples.text: 我的英文阅读很好，但是我的英语口语不好。
examples.translation: wǒ de yīng wén yuè dú hěn hǎo dàn shì wǒ de yīng yǔ kǒu yǔ bù hǎo — 5. My English reading is very good, but my spoken English is not.

examples.text: 说话人怎么了？
examples.translation: shuō huà rén zěn me le — Activity 3A-1 (questions as printed; my answers follow in the scripts below): What happened to the speaker?

examples.text: 在那个地方他有很多好朋友吗？
examples.translation: zài nà ge dì fāng tā yǒu hěn duō hǎo péng yǒu ma — 3A-2: Does he have many good friends in that place?

examples.text: 蒙特雷秋天常下雨吗？
examples.translation: méng tè léi qiū tiān cháng xià yǔ ma — 3A-3: Does it often rain in Monterey in autumn?

examples.text: 大家都能上电视吗？
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu néng shàng diàn shì ma — 3A-4: Can everyone get on TV?

examples.text: 他妈妈高兴还是不高兴？
examples.translation: tā mā mā gāo xìng hái shì bù gāo xìng — 3A-5: Is his mother happy or unhappy?

examples.text: 他儿子最近学习认真不认真？
examples.translation: tā ér zi zuì jìn xué xí rèn zhēn bú rèn zhēn — 3A-6: Has his son been studying seriously lately?

examples.text: 今天中午我不小心把电话丢了，很不开心，可是下午又找到了，我马上又高兴了。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zhōng wǔ wǒ bù xiǎo xīn bǎ diàn huà diū le hěn bù kāi xīn kě shì xià wǔ yòu zhǎo dào le wǒ mǎ shàng yòu gāo xìng le — Activity 3B script, 1 (translations mine): At noon today I carelessly lost my phone and was very unhappy, but I found it again in the afternoon and was happy again right away.

examples.text: 在那儿他认识的人很多，可是好朋友没有几个。
examples.translation: zài nàr tā rèn shí de rén hěn duō kě shì hǎo péng yǒu méi yǒu jǐ gè — 2: He knows many people there, but has few good friends.

examples.text: 蒙特雷冬天下雨很多，但是秋天下得不多。
examples.translation: méng tè léi dōng tiān xià yǔ hěn duō dàn shì qiū tiān xià de bù duō — 3: It rains a lot in Monterey in winter, but not much in autumn.

examples.text: 看电视很容易，可是上电视却没那么容易。
examples.translation: kàn diàn shì hěn róng yì kě shì shàng diàn shì què méi nà me róng yì — 4: Watching TV is easy, but getting on TV is not so easy.

examples.text: 我几个星期没给家里打电话，妈妈不高兴，可今天我突然回家，她高兴地跳了起来。
examples.translation: wǒ jǐ gè xīng qī méi gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà mā mā bù gāo xìng kě jīn tiān wǒ tū rán huí jiā tā gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái — 5: I hadn’t called home for several weeks and my mom was unhappy, but today I suddenly came home and she jumped for joy.

examples.text: 他儿子最近学习很不认真，可是玩儿游戏特别认真。
examples.translation: tā ér zi zuì jìn xué xí hěn bú rèn zhēn kě shì wánr yóu xì tè bié rèn zhēn — 6: His son has been very careless in his studies lately, but is especially serious about playing games.

examples.text: 每天做听力作业不难，但是每天做完所有的作业很难。
examples.translation: měi tiān zuò tīng lì zuò yè bù nán dàn shì měi tiān zuò wán suǒ yǒu de zuò yè hěn nán — Activity 3C (my three sentences, 1): Doing the listening homework each day is not hard, but finishing all the homework every day is very hard.

examples.text: 我的汉字写得不好，但是我的发音很好。
examples.translation: wǒ de hàn zì xiě de bù hǎo dàn shì wǒ de fā yīn hěn hǎo — 2: My characters are not well written, but my pronunciation is very good.

examples.text: 蒙特雷夏天不太热，但是风很大。
examples.translation: méng tè léi xià tiān bú tài rè dàn shì fēng hěn dà — 3: Monterey summers are not too hot, but it is very windy.

explanations.title: The 要+Verb+就+Verb …的 Construction
explanations.body: This construction is similar to “get a good one if you really want it,” or “do it this way if you really want to do it.” Activity 4: A. Pair up. Study each of the pictures (six pictures, which are not included), and take turns saying something about each one using the construction. B. Write four statements using the construction. Two of the statements will be false and the other two true. Share your statements with the class, and have your classmates guess which two statements are true. The examples and my four statements:

examples.text: 你的手机该换了。要换就换个好的，我给你钱。
examples.translation: nǐ de shǒu jī gāi huàn le yào huàn jiù huàn gè hǎo de wǒ gěi nǐ qián — The 要+Verb+就+Verb …的 Construction (similar to “get a good one if you really want it”): 1. Your phone should be replaced. If you replace it, get a good one; I’ll give you the money. (translations mine)

examples.text: 这个工程咱们来做吧，要做就做个最有意思的。
examples.translation: zhè ge gōng chéng zán men lái zuò ba yào zuò jiù zuò gè zuì yǒu yì si de — 2. Let’s do this project; if we do it, let’s do the most interesting one.

examples.text: 甲：电影院里同时演三个电影，咱们看哪个？
examples.translation: jiǎ diàn yǐng yuàn lǐ tóng shí yǎn sān gè diàn yǐng zán men kàn nǎ ge — 3. A: Three movies are showing at the cinema at the same time; which shall we watch?

examples.text: 乙：看这个吧，同学们都说好。要看就看大家都喜欢的。
examples.translation: yǐ kàn zhè ge ba tóng xué men dōu shuō hǎo yào kàn jiù kàn dà jiā dōu xǐ huān de — B: Let’s watch this one; classmates all say it’s good. If we watch, let’s watch what everyone likes.

examples.text: 甲：中午咱们去哪儿吃饭。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhōng wǔ zán men qù nǎr chī fàn — 4. A: Where shall we go for lunch? (the book ends this question with a period)

examples.text: 乙：去海边那家中餐馆吧，在这儿它比较有名，要去就去好的。
examples.translation: yǐ qù hǎi biān nà jiā zhōng cān guǎn ba zài zhèr tā bǐ jiào yǒu míng yào qù jiù qù hǎo de — B: Let’s go to that Chinese restaurant by the sea; it is rather famous here, and if we go, let’s go to a good one.

examples.text: 吃的东西我要买就买最好的，可他呢，要买就买最便宜的。
examples.translation: chī de dōng xī wǒ yào mǎi jiù mǎi zuì hǎo de kě tā ne yào mǎi jiù mǎi zuì pián yi de — 5. For food, if I buy, I buy the best, but he, if he buys, buys the cheapest.

examples.text: 我要买手机就买最新的。
examples.translation: wǒ yào mǎi shǒu jī jiù mǎi zuì xīn de — Activity 4B (my four sample statements; the book asks for two true and two false ones, which is for the learner to decide), 1: If I buy a phone, I buy the newest.

examples.text: 要吃中餐就去海边那家中餐馆吃。
examples.translation: yào chī zhōng cān jiù qù hǎi biān nà jiā zhōng cān guǎn chī — 2: If you want Chinese food, go to that Chinese restaurant by the sea.

examples.text: 要学中文就学最难的。
examples.translation: yào xué zhōng wén jiù xué zuì nán de — 3: If you study Chinese, study the hardest kind.

examples.text: 要喝咖啡就喝最便宜的。
examples.translation: yào hē kā fēi jiù hē zuì pián yi de — 4: If you drink coffee, drink the cheapest.

explanations.title: Discourse Grammar: Adverb 同时
explanations.body: In addition to indicating two or more things happening at the same time, 同时 can also be used at the beginning of a sentence to indicate “at the same time” or “on the other hand.” Activity 5: A. Rearrange the expressions provided to make logical and correct sentences. Then share your work with a classmate. B. Go over the suggested answers below and refine your work if necessary. C. Write four statements that describe you and your life at DLI. Use 同时 at the beginning of each sentence. Share your work with your partner. The examples, the suggested answers and my four sentences:

rows: 教英语 | 他也是 | 同时 | 他 | 合唱团的团长 | 在附近的中学
最好的 | 我同学 | 朋友 | 同时 | 他是 | 他也是 | 我
非常棒 | 风景 | 同时 | 加州的 | 加州的 | 大学 | 很漂亮 | 也
再吃几天药 | 注意休息 | 同时 | 你还得 | 要
她也 | 同时 | 一张生日卡 | 一份礼物 | 送给妈妈 | 她寄给妈妈
tables.title: Activity 5A: rearrange the expressions to make logical and correct sentences

examples.text: 我们是学生，同时我们也是军人，得经常参加军事训练。
examples.translation: wǒ men shì xué shēng tóng shí wǒ men yě shì jūn rén děi jīng cháng cān jiā jūn shì xùn liàn — Discourse Grammar: Adverb 同时 (at the same time, on the other hand). 1. We are students, and at the same time we are also soldiers and have to take part in military training often. (translations mine)

examples.text: 中国是一个经济大国，同时它也是一个发展中国家。
examples.translation: zhōng guó shì yí gè jīng jì dà guó tóng shí tā yě shì yí gè fā zhǎn zhōng guó jiā — 2. China is a big economic power, and at the same time it is also a developing country.

examples.text: 他很想找一个好工作，同时他也不想住得离家太远。
examples.translation: tā hěn xiǎng zhǎo yí gè hǎo gōng zuò tóng shí tā yě bù xiǎng zhù de lí jiā tài yuǎn — 3. He very much wants to find a good job, and at the same time he doesn’t want to live too far from home.

examples.text: 张老师要我们好好准备下星期的考试，同时她也要我们不要熬夜，注意休息。
examples.translation: zhāng lǎo shī yào wǒ men hǎo hǎo zhǔn bèi xià xīng qī de kǎo shì tóng shí tā yě yào wǒ men bú yào áo yè zhù yì xiū xī — 4. Teacher Zhang wants us to prepare well for next week’s exam, and at the same time she also wants us not to stay up late and to get rest.

examples.text: 我每天花很多时间在手机上看东西，同时我也知道这样做对身体不好。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān huā hěn duō shí jiān zài shǒu jī shàng kàn dōng xī tóng shí wǒ yě zhī dào zhè yàng zuò duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo — 5. I spend a lot of time every day looking at things on my phone, and at the same time I also know that doing so is bad for my health.

examples.text: 他在附近的中学教英语，同时他也是合唱团的团长。
examples.translation: tā zài fù jìn de zhōng xué jiào yīng yǔ tóng shí tā yě shì hé chàng tuán de tuán zhǎng — Activity 5B suggested answer 1: He teaches English at a nearby middle school, and at the same time he is also the head of the choir.

examples.text: 他是我同学，同时他也是我最好的朋友。
examples.translation: tā shì wǒ tóng xué tóng shí tā yě shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu — 2: He is my classmate, and at the same time he is also my best friend.

examples.text: 加州的风景很漂亮，同时加州大学也非常棒。
examples.translation: jiā zhōu de fēng jǐng hěn piào liàng tóng shí jiā zhōu dà xué yě fēi cháng bàng — 3: California’s scenery is beautiful, and at the same time the University of California is also excellent.

examples.text: 你还得再吃几天药，同时要注意休息。
examples.translation: nǐ hái děi zài chī jǐ tiān yào tóng shí yào zhù yì xiū xī — 4: You still have to take medicine for a few more days, and at the same time you should rest.

examples.text: 她寄给妈妈一张生日卡。同时，她也送给妈妈一份礼物。
examples.translation: tā jì gěi mā mā yì zhāng shēng rì kǎ tóng shí tā yě sòng gěi mā mā yí fèn lǐ wù — 5: She mailed her mother a birthday card. At the same time, she also gave her mother a gift.

examples.text: 我每天都要上课。同时，我还要做很多作业。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān dōu yào shàng kè tóng shí wǒ hái yào zuò hěn duō zuò yè — Activity 5C (my four sentences with 同时 at the beginning, 1): I have class every day. At the same time, I also have a lot of homework.

examples.text: 我在学习中文。同时，我也在了解中国文化。
examples.translation: wǒ zài xué xí zhōng wén tóng shí wǒ yě zài liǎo jiě zhōng guó wén huà — 2: I am studying Chinese. At the same time, I am also learning about Chinese culture.

examples.text: 我喜欢蒙特雷的天气。同时，我也喜欢这里的海边。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān méng tè léi de tiān qì tóng shí wǒ yě xǐ huān zhè lǐ de hǎi biān — 3: I like Monterey’s weather. At the same time, I also like the seaside here.

examples.text: 我要好好学习。同时，我也要注意休息。
examples.translation: wǒ yào hǎo hào xué xí tóng shí wǒ yě yào zhù yì xiū xī — 4: I want to study hard. At the same time, I also want to get enough rest.

exercises.prompt: What does the …不…，但是…很… construction do?
exercises.explanation: emphasizes a certain aspect over another aspect.

exercises.prompt: What does 看电视很容易，可是上电视却没那么容易 contrast?
options: Watching TV and getting on TV
exercises.explanation: 看电视很容易，可是上电视却没那么容易.

exercises.prompt: What does 要买就买最好的 mean?
options: If you buy, buy the best

exercises.prompt: What is the 要+Verb+就+Verb …的 construction like in English?
options: “Get a good one if you really want it”
exercises.explanation: similar to get a good one if you really want it.

exercises.prompt: What does 同时 at the start of a sentence mean?
options: At the same time; on the other hand
exercises.explanation: 同时 at the beginning of a sentence.

exercises.prompt: In script 5, why does the mother jump for joy?
exercises.explanation: 今天我突然回家，她高兴地跳了起来.

exercises.prompt: What does the son do seriously in the script?
Which is the suggested answer of 5 in Activity 5B?
options: 她送给妈妈一张生日卡同时
一份礼物她寄给妈妈了同时

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Speaking, Listening, Writing, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. If you had an opportunity to ask Wen Chenghui (温城辉) questions about his early days in entrepreneurship, what questions would you ask? Write four questions and share them with a classmate. B. Listen to the dialog about Wen Chenghui’s experiences when he began his business and answer the questions. Check your dictionary for the meanings of 生意, 创意, 组织, 聪明, 产品, 第一桶金, 模式 and 合作 first. 1. 开始时温城辉创业的模式是什么？ 2. 他的成功离不开什么？ C. Listen to the dialog again. Then pair up and discuss the following topics. Provide as many details as possible in the table. D. Go over the script and refine your notes. E. Write an email to a Chinese friend and tell them about Wen Chenghui’s early business experiences. My questions, the words, the script, my answers, table and e-mail:

rows: the first bucket of gold, the first big sum of money
tables.title: Activity 1B: the words to check in a dictionary first

headers: 细节 (my sample, from the script)
rows: 上大学的时候，他想把美丽的校园风景画成明信片，卖给学校的学生
不同学校的人找风景，再请人画成画，一切通过互联网来做，同时做很多学校
最后在网上销售；有了新产品，发一条微博，转发给本校的学生；一个星期在一个学校就能卖一万张明信片
没有网络，不会有人跟他合作，更不会做得像现在这么大

examples.text: 你是怎么想起来创业的？
examples.translation: nǐ shì zěn me xiǎng qǐ lái chuàng yè de — Activity 1A (my four questions for Wen Chenghui): How did you come up with starting a business?

examples.text: 你最开始做的是什么生意？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì kāi shǐ zuò de shì shén me shēng yì — What business did you start with?

examples.text: 你的第一桶金是怎么得到的？
examples.translation: nǐ de dì yī tǒng jīn shì zěn me dé dào de — How did you earn your first bucket of gold (first big sum)?

examples.text: 互联网对你的生意有什么帮助？
examples.translation: hù lián wǎng duì nǐ de shēng yì yǒu shén me bāng zhù — How has the Internet helped your business?

examples.text: 王辛：温城辉是怎么开始创业的？
examples.translation: wáng xīn wēn chéng huī shì zěn me kāi shǐ chuàng yè de — Wang Xin: How did Wen Chenghui start his business? (Activity 1D script; translations mine)

examples.text: 马林：那是上大学的时候。一天，他忽然想，校园的风景这么美，要是把它画成明信片，再卖给学校的学生，生意大概会不错。
examples.translation: mǎ lín nà shì shàng dà xué de shí hòu yì tiān tā hū rán xiǎng xiào yuán de fēng jǐng zhè me měi yào shì bǎ tā huà chéng míng xìn piàn zài mài gěi xué xiào de xué shēng shēng yì dà gài huì bú cuò — Ma Lin: It was when he was at university. One day he suddenly thought, the campus scenery is so beautiful; if he painted it onto postcards and sold them to the school’s students, business would probably be good.

examples.text: 王辛：结果怎么样？
examples.translation: wáng xīn jié guǒ zěn me yàng — Wang Xin: How did it turn out?

examples.text: 马林：很成功，明信片卖了很多。然后，他又组织不同学校的学生，做不同的校园的风景明信片，生意越做越大。
examples.translation: mǎ lín hěn chéng gōng míng xìn piàn mài le hěn duō rán hòu tā yòu zǔ zhī bù tóng xué xiào de xué shēng zuò bù tóng de xiào yuán de fēng jǐng míng xìn piàn shēng yì yuè zuò yuè dà — Ma Lin: Very successful; he sold many postcards. Then he organized students from different schools to make postcards of different campuses’ scenery, and the business grew bigger and bigger.

examples.text: 王辛：对，要做就做大的。可是，做一个学校不难，同时做很多学校会不会很难呢？
examples.translation: wáng xīn duì yào zuò jiù zuò dà de kě shì zuò yí gè xué xiào bù nán tóng shí zuò hěn duō xué xiào huì bú huì hěn nán ne — Wang Xin: Right, if you do it, do it big. But doing one school is not hard; wouldn’t doing many schools at the same time be very hard?

examples.text: 马林：一切通过互联网来做，就没那么难了。不同学校的人找风景，再请人画成画，最后在网上销售。
examples.translation: mǎ lín yí qiè tōng guò hù lián wǎng lái zuò jiù méi nà me nán le bù tóng xué xiào de rén zhǎo fēng jǐng zài qǐng rén huà chéng huà zuì hòu zài wǎng shàng xiāo shòu — Ma Lin: If everything is done through the Internet, it isn’t that hard. People at different schools find scenery, then have people paint it into pictures, and finally it is sold online.

examples.text: 王辛：太聪明了！销售情况怎么样？
examples.translation: wáng xīn tài cōng míng le xiāo shòu qíng kuàng zěn me yàng — Wang Xin: Very clever! How are the sales?

examples.text: 马林：很好。有了新产品，他只要发一条微博，转发给本校的学生，大家就都知道了。一个星期在一个学校就能卖一万张明信片。
examples.translation: mǎ lín hěn hǎo yǒu le xīn chǎn pǐn tā zhǐ yào fā yì tiáo wēi bó zhuǎn fā gěi běn xiào de xué shēng dà jiā jiù dōu zhī dào le yí gè xīng qī zài yí gè xué xiào jiù néng mài yí wàn zhāng míng xìn piàn — Ma Lin: Very good. When there is a new product, he only needs to post a microblog and have it forwarded to the students of his own school, and everyone knows. In one week at one school he can sell ten thousand postcards.

examples.text: 王辛：同时在很多学校做，能卖多少明信片啊！
examples.translation: wáng xīn tóng shí zài hěn duō xué xiào zuò néng mài duō shǎo míng xìn piàn a — Wang Xin: Doing it at many schools at the same time, how many postcards that can sell!

examples.text: 马林：对。他的第一桶金就是这样得到的。
examples.translation: mǎ lín duì tā de dì yī tǒng jīn jiù shì zhè yàng dé dào de — Ma Lin: Yes. His first bucket of gold was earned just this way.

examples.text: 王辛：网上找人提供想法，网上再找人去画，最后网上销售。这个模式太棒了。
examples.translation: wáng xīn wǎng shàng zhǎo rén tí gōng xiǎng fǎ wǎng shàng zài zhǎo rén qù huà zuì hòu wǎng shàng xiāo shòu zhè ge mó shì tài bàng le — Wang Xin: Finding people online to provide ideas, finding people online to paint, and finally selling online. This model is wonderful.

examples.text: 马林：他自己说，没有网络，不会有人跟他合作，更不会做得像现在这么大。
examples.translation: mǎ lín tā zì jǐ shuō méi yǒu wǎng luò bú huì yǒu rén gēn tā hé zuò gèng bú huì zuò de xiàng xiàn zài zhè me dà — Ma Lin: He says himself that without the Internet nobody would cooperate with him, still less would it have become as big as it is now.

examples.text: 王辛：可不。现在的年轻人又聪明，又懂高科技，一定大有前途。
examples.translation: wáng xīn kě bú xiàn zài de nián qīng rén yòu cōng míng yòu dǒng gāo kē jì yí dìng dà yǒu qián tú — Wang Xin: Exactly. Today’s young people are both clever and understand high tech; they certainly have a great future.

examples.text: 开始时他的模式是：网上找人提供想法，网上再找人去画，最后在网上销售。
examples.translation: kāi shǐ shí tā de mó shì shì wǎng shàng zhǎo rén tí gōng xiǎng fǎ wǎng shàng zài zhǎo rén qù huà zuì hòu zài wǎng shàng xiāo shòu — Activity 1B-1 (my answer): What was Wen Chenghui’s business model at the start? Finding people online to provide ideas, finding people online to paint, and finally selling online.

examples.text: 他的成功离不开互联网。
examples.translation: tā de chéng gōng lí bù kāi hù lián wǎng — 1B-2 (my answer): What does his success depend on? It cannot be separated from the Internet.

examples.text: 你好！我最近听说了温城辉创业的故事，想告诉你。他上大学的时候，想把校园的风景画成明信片，卖给学校的学生，结果很成功。后来他组织不同学校的学生，做不同校园的风景明信片，一切通过互联网来做：网上找人提供想法，网上再找人去画，最后在网上销售。一个星期在一个学校就能卖一万张明信片，他的第一桶金就是这样得到的。他自己说，没有网络，不会有人跟他合作，更不会做得像现在这么大。
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo wǒ zuì jìn tīng shuō le wēn chéng huī chuàng yè de gù shì xiǎng gào sù nǐ tā shàng dà xué de shí hòu xiǎng bǎ xiào yuán de fēng jǐng huà chéng míng xìn piàn mài gěi xué xiào de xué shēng jié guǒ hěn chéng gōng hòu lái tā zǔ zhī bù tóng xué xiào de xué shēng zuò bù tóng xiào yuán de fēng jǐng míng xìn piàn yí qiè tōng guò hù lián wǎng lái zuò wǎng shàng zhǎo rén tí gōng xiǎng fǎ wǎng shàng zài zhǎo rén qù huà zuì hòu zài wǎng shàng xiāo shòu yí gè xīng qī zài yí gè xué xiào jiù néng mài yí wàn zhāng míng xìn piàn tā de dì yī tǒng jīn jiù shì zhè yàng dé dào de tā zì jǐ shuō méi yǒu wǎng luò bú huì yǒu rén gēn tā hé zuò gèng bú huì zuò de xiàng xiàn zài zhè me dà — Activity 1E (my sample e-mail): Hello! I recently heard the story of how Wen Chenghui started his business and wanted to tell you. When he was at university he wanted to paint the campus scenery onto postcards and sell them to the students, and it was very successful. Later he organized students from different schools to make postcards of different campuses’ scenery, doing everything through the Internet: finding people online to provide ideas, finding people online to paint, and finally selling online. In one week at one school he could sell ten thousand postcards, and that is how he earned his first bucket of gold. He says himself that without the Internet nobody would have cooperated with him, still less would it have become as big as it is now.

exercises.prompt: What did Wen Chenghui first decide to turn campus scenery into?
Who did he sell the first postcards to?
How did he make many schools’ postcards without it being very hard?
options: Everything was done through the Internet
exercises.explanation: 一切通过互联网来做，就没那么难了.

exercises.prompt: How did he tell students about new products?
options: He posted a microblog for forwarding
exercises.explanation: 他只要发一条微博，转发给本校的学生.

exercises.prompt: How many postcards could he sell in a week at one school?
exercises.explanation: 一个星期在一个学校就能卖一万张明信片.

exercises.prompt: What is the “first bucket of gold”?
options: His first big sum of money
exercises.explanation: 他的第一桶金就是这样得到的.

exercises.prompt: What does his success depend on?
exercises.explanation: 没有网络，不会有人跟他合作.

exercises.prompt: What do Wang Xin and Ma Lin think of today’s young people?
options: They are clever and have a great future

exercises.prompt: 没有网络，不会有人跟他合___。
他的第一桶___就是这样得到的。
