lessons.title: 757. Lesson 29 Presentation 2: valuing education is a Chinese tradition
lessons.subtitle: 重视教育 · 孔子 · 早教班 · 学区房 · 补习班 · 舍不得给自己花钱 · 压力太大 · 身心健康

explanations.title: Presentation 2: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. What is your impression of education in China? B. Do you think children’s education is the responsibility of schools, or the family? C. What role does family play in the education of their children? D. What aspect of your early education do you think was the most successful and which was most in need of improvement? E. Do you think education has a significant impact on a person’s development? Provide an example. (The pictures, of a statue of Confucius at a middle school and of middle school students, are not included; the book gives no answers.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: valuing education
explanations.body: A passage on the tradition of valuing education and its cost.

examples.text: 重视教育是中国人的传统。两千多年前，孔子就说过，人人都应该受教育，社会的发展和教育分不开。现在的中国人特别重视孩子的教育，因为他们相信，有了好的教育，孩子才能有更好的前途。
examples.translation: zhòng shì jiào yù shì zhōng guó rén de chuán tǒng liǎng qiān duō nián qián kǒng zi jiù shuō guò rén rén dōu yīng gāi shòu jiào yù shè huì de fā zhǎn hé jiào yù fēn bù kāi xiàn zài de zhōng guó rén tè bié zhòng shì hái zi de jiào yù yīn wèi tā men xiāng xìn yǒu le hǎo de jiào yù hái zi cái néng yǒu gèng hǎo de qián tú — Valuing education is a tradition of the Chinese people. More than two thousand years ago Confucius already said that everyone should receive an education and that the development of society cannot be separated from education. Today’s Chinese people especially value their children’s education, because they believe that only with a good education can children have a better future. (Presentation 2; translations mine; the traditional-character copy is not repeated)

examples.text: 为了让孩子从小就受到很好的教育，孩子两三岁时，家长就会把他们送到早教班。到了孩子上学的年龄，一些家庭还会买很贵的学区房，好让孩子上更好的学校。上学以后，家长们还会送孩子上补习班和兴趣班，来提高他们的学习和各方面的能力。
examples.translation: wèi le ràng hái zi cóng xiǎo jiù shòu dào hěn hǎo de jiào yù hái zi liǎng sān suì shí jiā zhǎng jiù huì bǎ tā men sòng dào zǎo jiào bān dào le hái zi shàng xué de nián líng yì xiē jiā tíng hái huì mǎi hěn guì de xué qū fáng hǎo ràng hái zi shàng gèng hǎo de xué xiào shàng xué yǐ hòu jiā zhǎng men hái huì sòng hái zi shàng bǔ xí bān hé xìng qù bān lái tí gāo tā men de xué xí hé gè fāng miàn de néng lì — To give children a very good education from an early age, when children are two or three years old, parents send them to early-education classes. When the children reach school age, some families also buy very expensive homes in a good school district so that the children can go to better schools. After they start school, parents also send them to tutoring classes and interest classes to improve their studies and abilities in all respects.

examples.text: 中国家长在孩子的教育上花的钱是最多的。父母们舍不得给自己花钱，但只要对孩子的教育有好处，再多的钱他们也愿意花，每个家庭百分之三十的钱都会用在孩子身上。
examples.translation: zhōng guó jiā zhǎng zài hái zi de jiào yù shàng huā de qián shì zuì duō de fù mǔ men shě bù de gěi zì jǐ huā qián dàn zhǐ yào duì hái zi de jiào yù yǒu hǎo chù zài duō de qián tā men yě yuàn yì huā měi gè jiā tíng bǎi fēn zhī sān shí de qián dōu huì yòng zài hái zi shēn shàng — Chinese parents spend the most money on their children’s education. Parents are reluctant to spend money on themselves, but as long as it benefits their children’s education, they are willing to spend however much money it takes; thirty percent of each family’s money is spent on the children. (the book writes 30% in digits)

examples.text: 家长们重视教育是对的，但是，有的时候会使孩子感觉压力太大。有的孩子睡觉时间不够，有的失去学习兴趣，还有的跟父母的关系变得紧张起来。所以，家长们在重视教育的同时，也要关心孩子的身心健康。
examples.translation: jiā zhǎng men zhòng shì jiào yù shì duì de dàn shì yǒu de shí hòu huì shǐ hái zi gǎn jué yā lì tài dà yǒu de hái zi shuì jiào shí jiān bú gòu yǒu de shī qù xué xí xìng qù hái yǒu de gēn fù mǔ de guān xì biàn de jǐn zhāng qǐ lái suǒ yǐ jiā zhǎng men zài zhòng shì jiào yù de tóng shí yě yào guān xīn hái zi de shēn xīn jiàn kāng — It is right for parents to value education, but sometimes it makes children feel too much pressure. Some children don’t get enough sleep, some lose interest in learning, and some become tense in their relationship with their parents. So while valuing education, parents should also care about their children’s physical and mental health.

explanations.title: Presentation 2 Activities, Activities 1 to 3
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening): A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 2 once and answer the questions. 1. What’s the main idea of the passage? 2. What are the subtopics of this main idea? B. Detailed Listening: Listen to Presentation 2 again and answer the questions. 1. What did Confucius say about education? 2. Why do parents value their children’s education? 3. What did the parents do to provide good education for their children? 4. What statistic is provided on how much Chinese parents spend on their children’s education? 5. What are some of the negative effects of placing excessive value on a child’s education? 6. What is suggested to balance out any negative effects? Activity 2 (Reading): Sort the following words into the correct categories. Activity 3 (Listening): A. Listen to the passage about Confucius and answer the questions. Pair up and discuss your answers with your partner. 1. According to this passage, what is profound about Confucius? 2. What did you hear about the conversation between Confucius and his students? 3. Why did Confucius value the education of ordinary people? (Activity 3 is audio, so I give no key.) examples.text: 这篇文章的主要意思是：中国的家长很重视孩子的教育，花很多钱，但也要关心孩子的身心健康。
examples.translation: zhè piān wén zhāng de zhǔ yào yì si shì zhōng guó de jiā zhǎng hěn zhòng shì hái zi de jiào yù huā hěn duō qián dàn yě yào guān xīn hái zi de shēn xīn jiàn kāng — Activity 1A-1 (my answer): The main idea is that Chinese parents value their children’s education and spend a lot of money, but should also care about their physical and mental health.

examples.text: 小话题有：重视教育的传统，家长为孩子做的事，花的钱，教育太重视的坏处和建议。
examples.translation: xiǎo huà tí yǒu zhòng shì jiào yù de chuán tǒng jiā zhǎng wèi hái zi zuò de shì huā de qián jiào yù tài zhòng shì de huài chù hé jiàn yì — 1A-2 (my answer): The subtopics: the tradition of valuing education, what parents do for their children, the money spent, and the negative effects of overvaluing education with a suggestion.

examples.text: 孔子说过，人人都应该受教育，社会的发展和教育分不开。
examples.translation: kǒng zi shuō guò rén rén dōu yīng gāi shòu jiào yù shè huì de fā zhǎn hé jiào yù fēn bù kāi — 1B-1 (my answer): Confucius said everyone should receive an education and that society’s development cannot be separated from education.

examples.text: 因为他们相信，有了好的教育，孩子才能有更好的前途。
examples.translation: yīn wèi tā men xiāng xìn yǒu le hǎo de jiào yù hái zi cái néng yǒu gèng hǎo de qián tú — 1B-2 (my answer): Because they believe that only with a good education can children have a better future.

examples.text: 把孩子送到早教班，买学区房，送孩子上补习班和兴趣班。
examples.translation: bǎ hái zi sòng dào zǎo jiào bān mǎi xué qū fáng sòng hái zi shàng bǔ xí bān hé xìng qù bān — 1B-3 (my answer): They send them to early-education classes, buy school-district homes, and send them to tutoring and interest classes.

examples.text: 每个家庭百分之三十的钱都会用在孩子身上。
examples.translation: měi gè jiā tíng bǎi fēn zhī sān shí de qián dōu huì yòng zài hái zi shēn shàng — 1B-4 (my answer): Thirty percent of each family’s money is spent on the children.

examples.text: 孩子感觉压力太大，睡觉时间不够，失去学习兴趣，跟父母的关系变得紧张。
examples.translation: hái zi gǎn jué yā lì tài dà shuì jiào shí jiān bú gòu shī qù xué xí xìng qù gēn fù mǔ de guān xì biàn de jǐn zhāng — 1B-5 (my answer): Children feel too much pressure, don’t sleep enough, lose interest in learning and become tense with their parents.

examples.text: 家长们在重视教育的同时，也要关心孩子的身心健康。
examples.translation: jiā zhǎng men zài zhòng shì jiào yù de tóng shí yě yào guān xīn hái zi de shēn xīn jiàn kāng — 1B-6 (my answer): While valuing education, parents should also care about their children’s physical and mental health.

lessons.title: 758. Lesson 29 Presentation 2 activities and grammar: what a family spends, student stress, and 再…也…
lessons.subtitle: 教育费 · 学习压力 · 轻松快乐的家庭环境 · 再…也… · 不管…都… · 再多的钱也愿意花

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading) and Activity 5 (Reading)
explanations.body: Activity 4: Pair up. Take turns completing a sight translation (reading the passage silently and translating it aloud into English) of the passage, sentence by sentence. Activity 5: Pair up. Read the passage and discuss the following questions. 1. What reasons are given in the passage for student stress? 2. What are the symptoms of the stress? 3. What should parents do for their children? The passages and my answers:

examples.text: 一个普通的中国家庭会把多少钱花在孩子的教育上呢？
examples.translation: yí gè pǔ tōng de zhōng guó jiā tíng huì bǎ duō shǎo qián huā zài hái zi de jiào yù shàng ne — Activity 4 (sight translation; translations mine): How much money does an ordinary Chinese family spend on their children’s education?

examples.text: 从孩子出生到大学毕业，一般来说，一个孩子的教育费是五十到一百三十万人民币。如果送孩子出国留学，那这个数字最少也会达到两百万人民币。准备这么多钱，对每个普通家庭来说，都是很大的压力。平均来说，父母会把百分之十五的钱花在孩子现在的教育上，还会把百分之十八的钱存起来，为孩子以后的教育做准备。这些钱都是直接用在孩子的教育上的，另外，还有一些钱也是为了孩子的教育花的，比如买学区房就是很多家庭的选择。
examples.translation: cóng hái zi chū shēng dào dà xué bì yè yì bān lái shuō yí gè hái zi de jiào yù fèi shì wǔ shí dào yì bǎi sān shí wàn rén mín bì rú guǒ sòng hái zi chū guó liú xué nà zhè ge shù zì zuì shǎo yě huì dá dào liǎng bǎi wàn rén mín bì zhǔn bèi zhè me duō qián duì měi gè pǔ tōng jiā tíng lái shuō dōu shì hěn dà de yā lì píng jūn lái shuō fù mǔ huì bǎ bǎi fēn zhī shí wǔ de qián huā zài hái zi xiàn zài de jiào yù shàng hái huì bǎ bǎi fēn zhī shí bā de qián cún qǐ lái wèi hái zi yǐ hòu de jiào yù zuò zhǔn bèi zhè xiē qián dōu shì zhí jiē yòng zài hái zi de jiào yù shàng de lìng wài hái yǒu yì xiē qián yě shì wèi le hái zi de jiào yù huā de bǐ rú mǎi xué qū fáng jiù shì hěn duō jiā tíng de xuǎn zé — From a child’s birth to university graduation, generally speaking, a child’s education costs between 500,000 and 1,300,000 yuan. If the child is sent abroad to study, this figure will reach at least 2,000,000 yuan. Preparing this much money is a great pressure for every ordinary family. On average, parents spend 15 percent of their money on the child’s present education and save 18 percent for the child’s future education. This money is spent directly on the child’s education; in addition, some other money is also spent for the child’s education, for example buying a school-district home is the choice of many families. (the book writes 50, 130, 200, 15% and 18% in digits)

examples.text: 在中国，上了小学三年级以后，就有百分之七十以上的学生感觉到学习压力太大。学生的作业太多，考试太多。很多孩子除了在学校的八个小时以外，还要上补习班、兴趣班，连周末也没有时间休息。而且，每个学生都有升学考试的压力，不光上中学要考试，上大学要考试，甚至上小学也要考试。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó shàng le xiǎo xué sān nián jí yǐ hòu jiù yǒu bǎi fēn zhī qī shí yǐ shàng de xué shēng gǎn jué dào xué xí yā lì tài dà xué shēng de zuò yè tài duō kǎo shì tài duō hěn duō hái zi chú le zài xué xiào de bā gè xiǎo shí yǐ wài hái yào shàng bǔ xí bān xìng qù bān lián zhōu mò yě méi yǒu shí jiān xiū xī ér qiě měi gè xué shēng dōu yǒu shēng xué kǎo shì de yā lì bù guāng shàng zhōng xué yào kǎo shì shàng dà xué yào kǎo shì shèn zhì shàng xiǎo xué yě yào kǎo shì — Activity 5: In China, after the third year of elementary school more than 70 percent of students feel too much pressure in their studies. Students have too much homework and too many exams. Many children, besides the eight hours at school, also attend tutoring classes and interest classes and have no time to rest even on weekends. Moreover, every student faces the pressure of entrance exams: not only is there an exam for middle school and for university, there is even an exam for elementary school. (translations mine; the book writes 70% in digits)

examples.text: 因为压力太大，有的孩子不愿意做作业，不愿意去上学；有的孩子害怕考试，考试前吃不下饭，睡不好觉，甚至每次到考试前就生病；还有的孩子跟父母的关系紧张，不愿意回家，也不愿意和父母说学校的事。
examples.translation: yīn wèi yā lì tài dà yǒu de hái zi bú yuàn yì zuò zuò yè bú yuàn yì qù shàng xué yǒu de hái zi hài pà kǎo shì kǎo shì qián chī bú xià fàn shuì bù hǎo jiào shèn zhì měi cì dào kǎo shì qián jiù shēng bìng hái yǒu de hái zi gēn fù mǔ de guān xì jǐn zhāng bú yuàn yì huí jiā yě bú yuàn yì hé fù mǔ shuō xué xiào de shì — Because of the great pressure, some children are unwilling to do homework or go to school; some children are afraid of exams, can’t eat before exams, can’t sleep well and even get sick every time exams approach; and some children are tense with their parents, unwilling to go home and unwilling to tell their parents about school.

examples.text: 家长们对孩子的要求都很高，觉得这样对孩子有好处。但真正为孩子好，就应该给他们一个轻松快乐的家庭环境，这样才能让他们的身心健康发展。
examples.translation: jiā zhǎng men duì hái zi de yāo qiú dōu hěn gāo jué de zhè yàng duì hái zi yǒu hǎo chù dàn zhēn zhèng wèi hái zi hǎo jiù yīng gāi gěi tā men yí gè qīng sōng kuài lè de jiā tíng huán jìng zhè yàng cái néng ràng tā men de shēn xīn jiàn kāng fā zhǎn — Parents all have high demands on their children and feel that this is good for them. But to really do good for children, one should give them a relaxed and happy family environment, so that their bodies and minds can develop healthily.

examples.text: 作业太多，考试太多，课外还要上补习班、兴趣班，每个学生都有升学考试的压力。
examples.translation: zuò yè tài duō kǎo shì tài duō kè wài hái yào shàng bǔ xí bān xìng qù bān měi gè xué shēng dōu yǒu shēng xué kǎo shì de yā lì — Activity 5-1 (my answer): What reasons are given for student stress? Too much homework and too many exams, tutoring and interest classes outside school, and the pressure of entrance exams for every student.

examples.text: 不愿意做作业，不愿意去上学；害怕考试，吃不下饭，睡不好觉，生病；和父母关系紧张。
examples.translation: bú yuàn yì zuò zuò yè bú yuàn yì qù shàng xué hài pà kǎo shì chī bú xià fàn shuì bù hǎo jiào shēng bìng hé fù mǔ guān xì jǐn zhāng — 5-2 (my answer): What are the symptoms? Unwillingness to do homework or go to school; fear of exams, loss of appetite, poor sleep, illness; tense relations with parents.

examples.text: 应该给孩子一个轻松快乐的家庭环境，让他们的身心健康发展。
examples.translation: yīng gāi gěi hái zi yí gè qīng sōng kuài lè de jiā tíng huán jìng ràng tā men de shēn xīn jiàn kāng fā zhǎn — 5-3 (my answer): What should parents do? Give their children a relaxed and happy family environment so their bodies and minds develop healthily.

explanations.title: 再…也…, and 再…也… vs. 不管…都…
explanations.body: The structure 再…也… is usually used in a sentence hypothetically, indicating determination, meaning “even if” or “no matter how (much).” When subject 1 and subject 2 are the same, one can be omitted. In the 不管…都… structure, 不管 is usually followed with a question word, noun phrases for choices, or affirmative-negative phrases. Activity 1: A. Pair up. Verbally translate the following sentences into English, then change each into the 再…也 structure without changing its meaning: 1. 不管多忙，我都要回家看父母。 2. 不管多累，他都要自己照顾小孩。 3. 不管孩子听不听话，你都不应该打他们。 4. 不管你给我多少钱，我都不会接受这个工作。 5. 不管多么苦，都不能苦孩子；不管多么穷，都不能穷教育。 B. Complete the sentences using 再…也… (the beginnings: 1. 中文再难, 2. 衣服再贵, 3. 你再说什么, 4. 花再多的钱, 5. …，我也要把作业做完。 6. …，我也不会相信。) C. Have you ever decided to do something despite unfavorable conditions? Share your experiences with your class. The examples and my versions:

examples.text: 天气再不好，我也要去跑步。
examples.translation: tiān qì zài bù hǎo wǒ yě yào qù pǎo bù — 再…也… (usually used hypothetically, indicating determination: “even if” or “no matter how”; Subj. 1 + 再 + extreme situation, subj. 2 + 也 + what will happen), 1: However bad the weather is, I will go running. (translations mine)

examples.text: 父母再辛苦，也要让孩子过上好的生活。
examples.translation: fù mǔ zài xīn kǔ yě yào ràng hái zi guò shàng hǎo de shēng huó — 2: However hard it is for the parents, they want their children to have a good life.

examples.text: 为了孩子的教育，再多的钱他们也愿意花。
examples.translation: wèi le hái zi de jiào yù zài duō de qián tā men yě yuàn yì huā — 3: For their children’s education they are willing to spend however much money it takes.

examples.text: 你再哭我也不会让你去。
examples.translation: nǐ zài kū wǒ yě bú huì ràng nǐ qù — 4: However much you cry, I won’t let you go.

examples.text: 有了百度地图，不管上哪儿你都不会迷路。
examples.translation: yǒu le bǎi dù dì tú bù guǎn shàng nǎr nǐ dōu bú huì mí lù — 再…也… vs. 不管…都… (不管 is usually followed with a question word, noun phrases for choices, or affirmative-negative phrases), 1: With Baidu Maps, wherever you go you won’t get lost.

examples.text: 不管多辛苦，父母都会想办法送孩子出国。
examples.translation: bù guǎn duō xīn kǔ fù mǔ dōu huì xiǎng bàn fǎ sòng hái zi chū guó — 2: However hard it is, parents will find a way to send their children abroad.

examples.text: 不管是补习班还是兴趣班，学费都很贵。
examples.translation: bù guǎn shì bǔ xí bān hái shì xìng qù bān xué fèi dōu hěn guì — 3: Whether tutoring classes or interest classes, the tuition is very expensive.

examples.text: 不管喜不喜欢，你都得去上课。
examples.translation: bù guǎn xǐ bù xǐ huān nǐ dōu děi qù shàng kè — 4: Whether you like it or not, you have to go to class.

examples.text: 再辛苦，父母也会送孩子出国。
examples.translation: zài xīn kǔ fù mǔ yě huì sòng hái zi chū guó — Example 2 is interchangeable with 再…也…: 不管多辛苦，父母都会想办法送孩子出国 = 再辛苦，父母也会送孩子出国。

examples.text: 再不喜欢，你也得去上课。
examples.translation: zài bù xǐ huān nǐ yě děi qù shàng kè — Example 4 can be modified as 再…也…, but the meaning differs slightly: 不管喜不喜欢，你都得去上课 means “Whether you like it or not, you have to go to class”; 再不喜欢，你也得去上课 means “No matter how much you dislike it, you have to go to class.”

examples.text: 再忙，我也要回家看父母。
examples.translation: zài máng wǒ yě yào huí jiā kàn fù mǔ — Activity 1A, 1 (my 再…也 version; the book asks to translate and change the sentences): However busy I am, I will go home to see my parents.

examples.text: 再累，他也要自己照顾小孩。
examples.translation: zài lèi tā yě yào zì jǐ zhào gù xiǎo hái — 2: However tired he is, he will look after the child himself.

examples.text: 孩子再不听话，你也不应该打他们。
examples.translation: hái zi zài bù tīng huà nǐ yě bù yīng gāi dǎ tā men — 3: However disobedient the children are, you should not hit them.

examples.text: 你给我再多的钱，我也不会接受这个工作。
examples.translation: nǐ gěi wǒ zài duō de qián wǒ yě bú huì jiē shòu zhè ge gōng zuò — 4: However much money you give me, I won’t accept this job.

examples.text: 再苦也不能苦孩子，再穷也不能穷教育。
examples.translation: zài kǔ yě bù néng kǔ hái zi zài qióng yě bù néng qióng jiào yù — 5: However hard it is, one must not make children suffer; however poor one is, one must not skimp on education.

examples.text: 中文再难，我也要学好。
examples.translation: zhōng wén zài nán wǒ yě yào xué hǎo — Activity 1B, 1 (my completion): However hard Chinese is, I will learn it well.

examples.text: 衣服再贵，她也要买。
examples.translation: yī fú zài guì tā yě yào mǎi — 2: However expensive the clothes are, she will buy them.

examples.text: 你再说什么，我也不会改变主意。
examples.translation: nǐ zài shuō shén me wǒ yě bú huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yì — 3: Whatever else you say, I won’t change my mind.

examples.text: 花再多的钱，他们也愿意。
examples.translation: huā zài duō de qián tā men yě yuàn yì — 4: However much money it costs, they are willing.

examples.text: 时间再晚，我也要把作业做完。
examples.translation: shí jiān zài wǎn wǒ yě yào bǎ zuò yè zuò wán — 5: However late it is, I will finish my homework.

examples.text: 他说得再好听，我也不会相信。
examples.translation: tā shuō de zài hǎo tīng wǒ yě bú huì xiāng xìn — 6: However nicely he talks, I won’t believe it.

exercises.prompt: What does 天气再不好，我也要去跑步 mean?
options: However bad the weather, I’ll go running
exercises.explanation: 天气再不好，我也要去跑步.

exercises.prompt: What does 不管…都… usually follow with?
options: A question word, noun phrases for choices, or affirmative-negative phrases
exercises.explanation: 不管 is usually followed with a question word ….

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is interchangeable with 不管多辛苦，父母都会想办法送孩子出国?
options: 再辛苦，父母也会送孩子出国

exercises.prompt: How does 再不喜欢，你也得去上课 differ from 不管喜不喜欢，你都得去上课?
options: “No matter how much you dislike it” rather than “whether you like it or not”
There is no difference at all
It means you can stay home

exercises.prompt: According to Activity 5, what share of students feel too much pressure after third grade?
What do some children do before exams, according to the passage?
options: Can’t eat or sleep well, even get sick
exercises.explanation: 考试前吃不下饭，睡不好觉.

exercises.prompt: How much does a child’s education cost at least if sent abroad?
exercises.explanation: 最少也会达到两百万人民币.

exercises.prompt: 天气再不好，我___要去跑步。
不___多辛苦，父母都会想办法送孩子出国。
为了孩子的教育，再多的钱他们也愿___花。

lessons.title: 759. Lesson 29 Presentation 2 grammar: 好 indicating purpose and 在…的同时
lessons.subtitle: 好让孩子上更好的学校 · 好入睡 · 我们好做笔记 · 为了 vs 好 · 在重视教育的同时 · 在发展经济的同时

explanations.title: 好 indicating purpose
explanations.body: 好 can mean “in order to” or “for the sake of,” and expresses a purpose (Action, 好 + Purpose). 为了 is also used for expressing purpose. Activity 2: A. Listen to the sentences and translate them into English (five audio items, which are not included). B. Change the following 为了 sentences into “好 + purpose” sentences. Make any necessary changes: 1. 为了挣钱，他离开老家到大城市工作。 2. 为了家人的生活，爸爸每天辛辛苦苦地工作。 3. 为了孩子能上更好的学校，他们在这个学区租了很贵的房子。 4. 为了给奶奶治病，爸爸把房子卖了。 5. 为了让身体更健康，他每天都坚持锻炼。 C. Pair up. Talk with your partner about your own experience of effort you made for a specific reason, using the “好 + purpose” structure. The examples and my versions:

rows: 为了 + Purpose (noun phr./verb phr.), Subj. + action
tables.title: 为了 and 好 compared

examples.text: 一些家庭还会买很贵的学区房，好让孩子上更好的学校。
examples.translation: yì xiē jiā tíng hái huì mǎi hěn guì de xué qū fáng hǎo ràng hái zi shàng gèng hǎo de xué xiào — 好 indicating purpose (“in order to” or “for the sake of”; Action, 好 + Purpose), 1: Some families also buy very expensive school-district homes so that their children can go to better schools. (translations mine)

examples.text: 她睡前常喝一杯牛奶，好入睡。
examples.translation: tā shuì qián cháng hē yì bēi niú nǎi hǎo rù shuì — 2: She often drinks a glass of milk before bed to fall asleep.

examples.text: 老师，请说慢点儿，我们好做笔记。
examples.translation: lǎo shī qǐng shuō màn diǎnr wǒ men hǎo zuò bǐ jì — 3: Teacher, please speak a bit slower so that we can take notes.

examples.text: 请把车停到里面，好让别人走路。
examples.translation: qǐng bǎ chē tíng dào lǐ miàn hǎo ràng bié rén zǒu lù — 4: Please park the car inside so that others can walk.

examples.text: 为了让大家听清楚，老师又讲了一遍。
examples.translation: wèi le ràng dà jiā tīng qīng chǔ lǎo shī yòu jiǎng le yí biàn — 为了 is also used for expressing purpose (为了 + verb phrase): To let everyone hear clearly, the teacher explained once more.

examples.text: 为了孩子的前途，他每天努力工作。
examples.translation: wèi le hái zi de qián tú tā měi tiān nǔ lì gōng zuò — (为了 + noun phrase): For his child’s future, he works hard every day.

examples.text: 为了家人，他每天努力工作。
examples.translation: wèi le jiā rén tā měi tiān nǔ lì gōng zuò — Activity 2B, the book’s example (translations mine): For his family, he works hard every day.

examples.text: 他每天努力工作，好让家人有更好的生活。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān nǔ lì gōng zuò hǎo ràng jiā rén yǒu gèng hǎo de shēng huó — → He works hard every day so that his family can have a better life.

examples.text: 他离开老家到大城市工作，好挣钱。
examples.translation: tā lí kāi lǎo jiā dào dà chéng shì gōng zuò hǎo zhèng qián — 2B-1 (my 好 version): He left his hometown to work in a big city in order to earn money.

examples.text: 爸爸每天辛辛苦苦地工作，好让家人过上好生活。
examples.translation: bà bà měi tiān xīn xīn kǔ kǔ de gōng zuò hǎo ràng jiā rén guò shàng hǎo shēng huó — 2B-2: Dad works hard every day so that the family can live well.

examples.text: 他们在这个学区租了很贵的房子，好让孩子能上更好的学校。
examples.translation: tā men zài zhè ge xué qū zū le hěn guì de fáng zi hǎo ràng hái zi néng shàng gèng hǎo de xué xiào — 2B-3: They rented an expensive home in this school district so that the child can go to a better school.

examples.text: 爸爸把房子卖了，好给奶奶治病。
examples.translation: bà bà bǎ fáng zi mài le hǎo gěi nǎi nǎi zhì bìng — 2B-4: Dad sold the house so as to pay for Grandma’s treatment.

examples.text: 他每天都坚持锻炼，好让身体更健康。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān dōu jiān chí duàn liàn hǎo ràng shēn tǐ gèng jiàn kāng — 2B-5: He keeps exercising every day so as to be healthier.

explanations.title: 在…的同时
explanations.body: 在…的同时 is the formal use of 同时, and often has the meaning of reminding or urging, so the second clause often contains a modal auxiliary, like 要, 应该, 不能, etc. Activity 3: A. Verbally change the following formal 在…同时 sentences into casual 同时 sentences: 1. 在为自己考虑的同时，也应该为别人想想。 2. 在学好汉语的同时，也要了解中国的文化。 3. 在发展经济的同时，我们也应该注意保护环境。 B. Rewrite the following casual 同时 sentences into formal 在…同时 sentences: 1. 高科技给人们带来很多方便，同时也带来一些不好的影响。 2. 父母们在培养自己孩子，同时也在为国家培养人才。 3. 我们要注重孩子学习，同时也要注意培养他们独立生活的能力。 C. Pair up. Think about the relation between two issues in the following list and state your opinion using the “在…同时” structure: 1. 工作和家人 2. 钱和健康 3. 孩子的快乐和前途 4. 爱孩子和尊重孩子 5. 爱好和＿＿ 6. 完成自己的工作和＿＿ 7. ＿＿和＿＿. The examples and my versions:

examples.text: 我们在重视教育的同时，也要关心孩子的身心健康。
examples.translation: wǒ men zài zhòng shì jiào yù de tóng shí yě yào guān xīn hái zi de shēn xīn jiàn kāng — 在…的同时 (the formal use of 同时, often reminding or urging, so the second clause often contains a modal like 要, 应该, 不能; (Subj.) + 在…的同时, (Subj.) + 也 + verb phrase), 1: While valuing education, we should also care about children’s physical and mental health. (translations mine)

examples.text: 在发展经济的同时，我们也应该注意保护环境。
examples.translation: zài fā zhǎn jīng jì de tóng shí wǒ men yě yīng gāi zhù yì bǎo hù huán jìng — 2: While developing the economy, we should also pay attention to protecting the environment.

examples.text: 在努力工作的同时，也不能忘了锻炼身体。
examples.translation: zài nǔ lì gōng zuò de tóng shí yě bù néng wàng le duàn liàn shēn tǐ — 3: While working hard, one also must not forget to exercise.

examples.text: 为自己考虑，同时也应该为别人想想。
examples.translation: wèi zì jǐ kǎo lǜ tóng shí yě yīng gāi wèi bié rén xiǎng xiǎng — Activity 3A, 1 (my casual 同时 version): Think of yourself, and at the same time also think of others.

examples.text: 学好汉语，同时也要了解中国的文化。
examples.translation: xué hǎo hàn yǔ tóng shí yě yào liǎo jiě zhōng guó de wén huà — 2: Learn Chinese well, and at the same time also understand Chinese culture.

examples.text: 发展经济，同时我们也应该注意保护环境。
examples.translation: fā zhǎn jīng jì tóng shí wǒ men yě yīng gāi zhù yì bǎo hù huán jìng — 3: Develop the economy, and at the same time we should also pay attention to protecting the environment.

examples.text: 在高科技给人们带来很多方便的同时，也带来一些不好的影响。
examples.translation: zài gāo kē jì gěi rén men dài lái hěn duō fāng biàn de tóng shí yě dài lái yì xiē bù hǎo de yǐng xiǎng — Activity 3B, 1 (my formal version): While high tech brings people much convenience, it also brings some bad influences.

examples.text: 父母们在培养自己孩子的同时，也在为国家培养人才。
examples.translation: fù mǔ men zài péi yǎng zì jǐ hái zi de tóng shí yě zài wèi guó jiā péi yǎng rén cái — 2: While parents bring up their own children, they are also cultivating talent for the country.

examples.text: 我们在注重孩子学习的同时，也要注意培养他们独立生活的能力。
examples.translation: wǒ men zài zhù zhòng hái zi xué xí de tóng shí yě yào zhù yì péi yǎng tā men dú lì shēng huó de néng lì — 3: While we attach importance to children’s studies, we should also pay attention to cultivating their ability to live independently.

examples.text: 在工作的同时，也不能忘了家人。
examples.translation: zài gōng zuò de tóng shí yě bù néng wàng le jiā rén — Activity 3C, 1 工作和家人 (my sentence): While working, one must not forget one’s family.

examples.text: 在赚钱的同时，也要注意健康。
examples.translation: zài zhuàn qián de tóng shí yě yào zhù yì jiàn kāng — 2 钱和健康: While making money, one should also pay attention to health.

examples.text: 在关心孩子快乐的同时，也要想想他们的前途。
examples.translation: zài guān xīn hái zi kuài lè de tóng shí yě yào xiǎng xiǎng tā men de qián tú — 3 孩子的快乐和前途: While caring about children’s happiness, one should also think about their future.

examples.text: 在爱孩子的同时，也要尊重孩子。
examples.translation: zài ài hái zi de tóng shí yě yào zūn zhòng hái zi — 4 爱孩子和尊重孩子: While loving children, one should also respect them. (items 5 to 7 of the book’s list are blanks for the learner)

lessons.title: 760. Lesson 29 Presentation 2 grammar: 用在…上 (spend … on …)
lessons.subtitle: 用在孩子身上 · 花在教育上 · 把时间用在阅读上 · 好钢用在刀刃上

explanations.title: 用在…上 (Spend… on certain person/thing/aspect/area)
explanations.body: The structure is (把) + Obj. 1 + 用在/花在 + Obj. 2/Action 上. When Object 2 in the structure is a living entity, it usually appears in the form of 身上. Activity 4: A. Listen to the following sentences and translate them into English (five audio items, which are not included). Pair up and compare your work with that of your partner. B. Read the following sentences and translate them into English. Guess the meaning of any unknown words. C. Pair up. Describe how you and your roommate, or you and your family members, spend your time and money. The examples and my translations:

examples.text: 每个家庭百分之三十的钱都会用在孩子身上。
examples.translation: měi gè jiā tíng bǎi fēn zhī sān shí de qián dōu huì yòng zài hái zi shēn shàng — 用在…上 (Spend … on a certain person/thing/aspect/area; (把) + Obj. 1 + 用在/花在 + Obj. 2/Action 上; when Object 2 is a living entity it usually appears in the form of 身上), 1: Thirty percent of each family’s money is spent on the children. (translations mine)

examples.text: 年轻人要把时间多用在学习和工作上。
examples.translation: nián qīng rén yào bǎ shí jiān duō yòng zài xué xí hé gōng zuò shàng — 2: Young people should spend more of their time on study and work.

examples.text: 人们常常把钱花在并不需要的东西上。
examples.translation: rén men cháng cháng bǎ qián huā zài bìng bù xū yào de dōng xī shàng — 3: People often spend money on things they don’t need.

examples.text: 您把钱都用在给我买书上，而不愿把钱用在您自己买衣服上。
examples.translation: nín bǎ qián dōu yòng zài gěi wǒ mǎi shū shàng ér bú yuàn bǎ qián yòng zài nín zì jǐ mǎi yī fú shàng — 4: You spend all your money on buying me books and are unwilling to spend money on buying clothes for yourself.

examples.text: 我把一半的钱都花在他们身上了。
examples.translation: wǒ bǎ yí bàn de qián dōu huā zài tā men shēn shàng le — 5: I have spent half of my money on them.

examples.text: 我不是什么天才，我只是把别人喝咖啡的时间都用在工作上了。
examples.translation: wǒ bú shì shén me tiān cái wǒ zhǐ shì bǎ bié rén hē kā fēi de shí jiān dōu yòng zài gōng zuò shàng le — Activity 4B, 1 (translations mine): I’m no genius; I just spent all the time other people spend drinking coffee on work.

examples.text: 我们不应该让学生把全部时间都用在学习上，而要给学生留下许多自由的时间，他才能顺利地学习。
examples.translation: wǒ men bù yīng gāi ràng xué shēng bǎ quán bù shí jiān dōu yòng zài xué xí shàng ér yào gěi xué shēng liú xià xǔ duō zì yóu de shí jiān tā cái néng shùn lì de xué xí — 2: We should not make students spend all their time on studying, but leave them a lot of free time, so that they can study smoothly.

examples.text: 花在教育上的钱一定不会白花。
examples.translation: huā zài jiào yù shàng de qián yí dìng bú huì bái huā — 3: Money spent on education is certainly not wasted.

examples.text: 把时间用在阅读上吧，这样你就可以轻松地得到别的人很辛苦才能得到的东西。
examples.translation: bǎ shí jiān yòng zài yuè dú shàng ba zhè yàng nǐ jiù kě yǐ qīng sōng de dé dào bié de rén hěn xīn kǔ cái néng dé dào de dōng xī — 4: Spend your time on reading; that way you can easily get what other people have to work very hard to get.

examples.text: 中国父母最可爱也是最可怜的地方，就是他们把所有的心血都花在子女身上。
examples.translation: zhōng guó fù mǔ zuì kě ài yě shì zuì kě lián de dì fāng jiù shì tā men bǎ suǒ yǒu de xīn xuè dōu huā zài zǐ nǚ shēn shàng — 5: What is most lovable and also most pitiable about Chinese parents is that they pour all their heart’s blood into their children.

examples.text: 好钢用在刀刃上。
examples.translation: hǎo gāng yòng zài dāo rèn shàng — 6: Good steel is used on the blade’s edge (spend your best resources where they matter most).

options: Spend … on a certain person, thing or aspect

exercises.explanation: it usually appears in the form of 身上.

lessons.title: 761. Lesson 29 Presentation 2 skill integration: education and a country’s development
lessons.subtitle: 国家的发展和教育 · 占ＧＤＰ · 付出 · 水平 · 素质 · 劳动力

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. In Chinese or English, discuss the following questions with your partner. 1. How is a country’s development related to education? 2. What can you tell from the information in the table below? B. Read the passage. Guess the meaning of the underlined words in context and translate the sentences in brackets. Compare your translations with your partner’s. C. How does the passage answer the two questions in Step A? (The underlining is lost in the text; the five words are listed in the table.)

headers: Public expenditure as a share of GDP (2018)
tables.title: Activity 1A: the table (as printed; the two spending figures are in different currencies)

headers: Meaning (my glosses; the book leaves the meanings blank for the learner)
tables.title: Word Meanings

examples.text: 大家都知道，最近几十年中国的发展很快。专家说，中国的发展和中国人的传统分不开。中国人的传统中有非常重要的一点，就是重视教育和学习。中国家庭为中国教育的发展付出了很多。全世界平均来说，国家花在教育上的钱占ＧＤＰ的百分之四点九，有的国家占到了百分之六以上，而中国只有百分之四点一，远远低于世界平均水平。中国学生的教育费大部分是每个家庭自己付的。正是因为有了每一个家庭的付出，才能让更多的孩子受到更好的教育，大大提高了人口素质，为国家的发展准备了高质量的劳动力。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu zhī dào zuì jìn jǐ shí nián zhōng guó de fā zhǎn hěn kuài zhuān jiā shuō zhōng guó de fā zhǎn hé zhōng guó rén de chuán tǒng fēn bù kāi zhōng guó rén de chuán tǒng zhōng yǒu fēi cháng zhòng yào de yì diǎn jiù shì zhòng shì jiào yù hé xué xí zhōng guó jiā tíng wèi zhōng guó jiào yù de fā zhǎn fù chū le hěn duō quán shì jiè píng jūn lái shuō guó jiā huā zài jiào yù shàng de qián zhàn de bǎi fēn zhī sì diǎn jiǔ yǒu de guó jiā zhàn dào le bǎi fēn zhī liù yǐ shàng ér zhōng guó zhǐ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī sì diǎn yì yuǎn yuǎn dī yú shì jiè píng jūn shuǐ píng zhōng guó xué shēng de jiào yù fèi dà bù fèn shì měi gè jiā tíng zì jǐ fù de zhèng shì yīn wèi yǒu le měi yí gè jiā tíng de fù chū cái néng ràng gèng duō de hái zi shòu dào gèng hǎo de jiào yù dà dà tí gāo le rén kǒu sù zhì wèi guó jiā de fā zhǎn zhǔn bèi le gāo zhì liàng de láo dòng lì — Activity 1B: Everyone knows that China has developed very fast in recent decades. Experts say that 1) [China’s development cannot be separated from the Chinese people’s traditions. One very important point in the Chinese tradition is the value placed on education and learning.] 2) [Chinese families have paid a great deal for the development of China’s education.] Worldwide, on average, the money a country spends on education makes up 4.9 percent of GDP, and some countries reach more than 6 percent, while China has only 4.1 percent, far below the world average. Most of Chinese students’ education costs are paid by each family itself. 3) [It is precisely because of each family’s contribution that more children could receive a better education, which greatly raised the quality of the population and prepared a high-quality labor force for the country’s development.] (the book marks sentences 1 to 3 in brackets for translation, writes GDP as Latin letters and the percentages in digits; the translation is mine)

examples.text: 国家的发展和教育分不开：中国的发展很快，是因为中国人重视教育，每个家庭为孩子的教育付出了很多。
examples.translation: guó jiā de fā zhǎn hé jiào yù fēn bù kāi zhōng guó de fā zhǎn hěn kuài shì yīn wèi zhōng guó rén zhòng shì jiào yù měi gè jiā tíng wèi hái zi de jiào yù fù chū le hěn duō — Activity 1A-1 / 1C (my answer): A country’s development cannot be separated from education: China developed fast because the Chinese value education and every family pays a great deal for it.

examples.text: 美国的公共教育支出占国内生产总值的百分之五，中国是百分之四点一一，所以中国国家花的钱比较少，家庭花的钱比较多。
examples.translation: měi guó de gōng gòng jiào yù zhī chū zhàn guó nèi shēng chǎn zǒng zhí de bǎi fēn zhī wǔ zhōng guó shì bǎi fēn zhī sì diǎn yī yī suǒ yǐ zhōng guó guó jiā huā de qián bǐ jiào shǎo jiā tíng huā de qián bǐ jiào duō — 1A-2 / 1C (my answer): U.S. public expenditure is 5.0 percent of GDP and China’s is 4.11 percent, so the Chinese state spends less and families spend more.

examples.text: 中国的发展和中国人的传统分不开。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de fā zhǎn hé zhōng guó rén de chuán tǒng fēn bù kāi — Translations, 1 (my version of the book’s sentence 1; the book leaves translations blank): China’s development cannot be separated from the Chinese people’s traditions.

examples.text: 中国家庭为中国教育的发展付出了很多。
examples.translation: zhōng guó jiā tíng wèi zhōng guó jiào yù de fā zhǎn fù chū le hěn duō — 2: Chinese families have paid a great deal for the development of China’s education.

examples.text: 正是因为有了每一个家庭的付出，才能让更多的孩子受到更好的教育。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi yǒu le měi yí gè jiā tíng de fù chū cái néng ràng gèng duō de hái zi shòu dào gèng hǎo de jiào yù — 3 (first half): It is precisely because of every family’s contribution that more children can receive a better education.

lessons.subtitle: 香港补习班 · 教育类软件 · 张云的两个女儿 · 张林送女儿出国 · 天价 · 陪读

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading, Listening, and Speaking): A and B
explanations.body: A. Listen to the passage and answer the questions. 1. What was said in the passage about changes made by the parents? 2. When did they make this change, and why? 3. How do parents feel about the cost? (Audio, so I give no key.) B. Read the passage and answer the question. 1. According to the passage, why is 补习班 prosperous in Hong Kong? (The photo is not included.)

examples.text: 在香港，只有百分之十八的高中学生毕业以后能上大学。所以，学生们从小就要为大学考试而努力。从小学开始就有很多孩子参加补习班，到了高中，超过四分之三的香港学生都会参加补习班。有不少人说，大多数香港学生并不需要上补习班，但是补习班的广告让人们觉得，不上补习班就考不上大学。一些补习班的老师在Ｆａｃｅｂｏｏｋ上有大量的粉丝，有的明星补习老师年收入达到一千万港元，约一百三十万美元。
examples.translation: zài xiāng gǎng zhǐ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī shí bā de gāo zhōng xué shēng bì yè yǐ hòu néng shàng dà xué suǒ yǐ xué shēng men cóng xiǎo jiù yào wèi dà xué kǎo shì ér nǔ lì cóng xiǎo xué kāi shǐ jiù yǒu hěn duō hái zi cān jiā bǔ xí bān dào le gāo zhōng chāo guò sì fēn zhī sān de xiāng gǎng xué shēng dōu huì cān jiā bǔ xí bān yǒu bù shǎo rén shuō dà duō shù xiāng gǎng xué shēng bìng bù xū yào shàng bǔ xí bān dàn shì bǔ xí bān de guǎng gào ràng rén men jué de bú shàng bǔ xí bān jiù kǎo bú shàng dà xué yì xiē bǔ xí bān de lǎo shī zài shàng yǒu dà liàng de fěn sī yǒu de míng xīng bǔ xí lǎo shī nián shōu rù dá dào yì qiān wàn gǎng yuán yuē yì bǎi sān shí wàn měi yuán — Activity 3B: In Hong Kong, only 18 percent of high school students can go to university after graduating. So students work hard for the university exam from childhood. Many children attend tutoring classes beginning in elementary school, and by high school more than three quarters of Hong Kong students attend them. Quite a few people say that most Hong Kong students do not actually need tutoring classes, but the ads for tutoring classes make people feel that without them one cannot pass the university exam. Some tutoring teachers have a great many fans on Facebook, and some star tutors earn up to 10 million Hong Kong dollars a year, about 1.3 million U.S. dollars. (the book writes 18%, 3/4, Facebook, 1000万 and 130万 in digits and Latin letters; the photo is not included; translation mine)

examples.text: 因为补习班的广告让人们觉得，不上补习班就考不上大学。
examples.translation: yīn wèi bǔ xí bān de guǎng gào ràng rén men jué de bú shàng bǔ xí bān jiù kǎo bú shàng dà xué — Activity 3B-1 (my answer): Because the ads for tutoring classes make people feel that without them they cannot pass the university exam; star tutors also earn a great deal, and only a small share of students can enter university.

explanations.title: Activity 3 C and D
explanations.body: C. Read the passage and answer the questions. 1. What are some alternate choices parents can make for their children’s education, other than hobby classes and “cram” schools? 2. Why would parents make this choice? D. Pair up. Each partner reads one paragraph of the passage. Tell your partner the information in your part, and then answer the questions together. 1. How much money did this mother spend, and how was it spent? 2. How does the mother keep in contact with her child? 3. What is her dilemma? 4. What caused her decision?

examples.text: 跟兴趣班和补习班比起来，教育类软件可以说是“非常便宜”，但是它种类丰富，满足了很多家长的需要。
examples.translation: gēn xìng qù bān hé bǔ xí bān bǐ qǐ lái jiào yù lèi ruǎn jiàn kě yǐ shuō shì fēi cháng pián yi dàn shì tā zhǒng lèi fēng fù mǎn zú le hěn duō jiā zhǎng de xū yào — Activity 3C: Compared with hobby classes and tutoring classes, educational software can be called “very cheap,” but it comes in rich variety and meets the needs of many parents. (translations mine)

examples.text: 张云有两个女儿。大女儿十岁，上小学四年级；小女儿七岁，读一年级。除了上学和体育运动这样的兴趣班，别的课几乎都是在教育软件上完成的。
examples.translation: zhāng yún yǒu liǎng gè nǚ ér dà nǚ ér shí suì shàng xiǎo xué sì nián jí xiǎo nǚ ér qī suì dú yì nián jí chú le shàng xué hé tǐ yù yùn dòng zhè yàng de xìng qù bān bié de kè jī hū dōu shì zài jiào yù ruǎn jiàn shàng wán chéng de — Zhang Yun has two daughters. The elder is 10 and in fourth grade; the younger is 7 and in first grade. Apart from school and hobby classes such as sports, almost all other classes are completed on educational software. (the book writes 10 and 7 in digits)

examples.text: 两年前，张云在给孩子选择课程时，发现许多喜欢的课在当地都很难找到，所以，她就转向了种类丰富的教育应用软件。张云给孩子们选择的课程一般每个三百到四百元，两个孩子可以一起使用。
examples.translation: liǎng nián qián zhāng yún zài gěi hái zi xuǎn zé kè chéng shí fā xiàn xǔ duō xǐ huān de kè zài dāng dì dōu hěn nán zhǎo dào suǒ yǐ tā jiù zhuǎn xiàng le zhǒng lèi fēng fù de jiào yù yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn zhāng yún gěi hái zi men xuǎn zé de kè chéng yì bān měi gè sān bǎi dào sì bǎi yuán liǎng gè hái zi kě yǐ yì qǐ shǐ yòng — Two years ago, when choosing courses for her children, Zhang Yun found that many of the classes she liked were hard to find locally, so she turned to educational apps with a rich variety. The courses she chooses for the children generally cost 300 to 400 yuan each, and the two children can use them together. (the book writes 300 and 400 in digits)

examples.text: 教育软件。
examples.translation: jiào yù ruǎn jiàn — Activity 3C-1 (my answer): Educational software (online courses and apps).

examples.text: 因为教育软件比兴趣班和补习班便宜得多，种类丰富，满足很多家长的需要，而且当地很难找到喜欢的课。
examples.translation: yīn wèi jiào yù ruǎn jiàn bǐ xīng qù bān hé bǔ xí bān pián yi de duō zhǒng lèi fēng fù mǎn zú hěn duō jiā zhǎng de xū yào ér qiě dāng dì hěn nán zhǎo dào xǐ huān de kè — 3C-2 (my answer): Because educational software is much cheaper than hobby and tutoring classes, has rich variety, meets many parents’ needs, and the classes they like are hard to find locally.

examples.text: 跟兴趣班和补习班比，送孩子出国简直可以说是“天价”。在深圳工作的一位老师张林说，去年，她把十岁的女儿送到国外上学，所有费用加在一起，大概三百多万人民币。每天下班后，张林都会同女儿视频聊天，问问她生活上是不是适应，学习上需要什么帮助。不过，她还是不太放心，她说，“我很想去国外陪读，但是又得上班赚钱。”
examples.translation: gēn xìng qù bān hé bǔ xí bān bǐ sòng hái zi chū guó jiǎn zhí kě yǐ shuō shì tiān jià zài shēn zhèn gōng zuò de yí wèi lǎo shī zhāng lín shuō qù nián tā bǎ shí suì de nǚ ér sòng dào guó wài shàng xué suǒ yǒu fèi yòng jiā zài yì qǐ dà gài sān bǎi duō wàn rén mín bì měi tiān xià bān hòu zhāng lín dōu huì tóng nǚ ér shì pín liáo tiān wèn wèn tā shēng huó shàng shì bú shì shì yìng xué xí shàng xū yào shén me bāng zhù bú guò tā hái shì bú tài fàng xīn tā shuō wǒ hěn xiǎng qù guó wài péi dú dàn shì yòu děi shàng bān zhuàn qián — Activity 3D, Paragraph 1: Compared with hobby classes and tutoring classes, sending a child abroad can simply be called a “sky-high price.” Zhang Lin, a teacher who works in Shenzhen, says that last year she sent her ten-year-old daughter to study abroad, and all the costs added together were about three million-plus yuan. Every day after work Zhang Lin video-chats with her daughter, asking whether she is adapting in daily life and what help she needs in her studies. But she is still a bit worried; she says, “I very much want to go abroad to accompany her studies, but I also have to go to work to earn money.” (the book writes 十岁 as printed; translation mine)

examples.text: 有朋友问她，为什么要让自己这么辛苦？让女儿在国内读书不好吗？但张林说，“花这么多钱，我的压力当然也很大，但我觉得国外的教育可能更适合她。孩子在国内学习压力太大，而且，为了让孩子能考上好学校，家长们花在补习班上的钱甚至比送孩子出国更多。除了花钱，父母们还要花时间陪孩子学习，接送孩子上学放学。跟他们比，我更轻松一些。”
examples.translation: yǒu péng yǒu wèn tā wèi shén me yào ràng zì jǐ zhè me xīn kǔ ràng nǚ ér zài guó nèi dú shū bù hǎo ma dàn zhāng lín shuō huā zhè me duō qián wǒ de yā lì dāng rán yě hěn dà dàn wǒ jué de guó wài de jiào yù kě néng gèng shì hé tā hái zi zài guó nèi xué xí yā lì tài dà ér qiě wèi le ràng hái zi néng kǎo shàng hǎo xué xiào jiā zhǎng men huā zài bǔ xí bān shàng de qián shèn zhì bǐ sòng hái zi chū guó gèng duō chú le huā qián fù mǔ men hái yào huā shí jiān péi hái zi xué xí jiē sòng hái zi shàng xué fàng xué gēn tā men bǐ wǒ gèng qīng sōng yì xiē — Paragraph 2: A friend asked her, why make yourself so tired? Wouldn’t it be good to let your daughter study in China? But Zhang Lin says, “Spending this much money, of course my pressure is also great, but I feel that education abroad may suit her better. The pressure of studying in China is too great for children, and moreover, to get their children into good schools, parents spend even more on tutoring classes than on sending their children abroad. Besides spending money, parents also have to spend time accompanying children’s studies and taking them to and from school. Compared with them, I am a little more relaxed.”

examples.text: 她花了三百多万人民币，把十岁的女儿送到国外上学，所有的费用加在一起。
examples.translation: tā huā le sān bǎi duō wàn rén mín bì bǎ shí suì de nǚ ér sòng dào guó wài shàng xué suǒ yǒu de fèi yòng jiā zài yì qǐ — Activity 3D-1 (my answer): She spent over three million yuan to send her ten-year-old daughter abroad, all costs added together.

examples.text: 每天下班后，她都同女儿视频聊天。
examples.translation: měi tiān xià bān hòu tā dōu tóng nǚ ér shì pín liáo tiān — 3D-2: Every day after work she video-chats with her daughter.

examples.text: 她很想去国外陪女儿读书，但是又得上班赚钱。
examples.translation: tā hěn xiǎng qù guó wài péi nǚ ér dú shū dàn shì yòu děi shàng bān zhuàn qián — 3D-3: She would like to go abroad to accompany her daughter’s studies, but also has to work to earn money.

examples.text: 孩子在国内学习压力太大，家长花在补习班上的钱甚至比送孩子出国更多，而且国外的教育可能更适合她。
examples.translation: hái zi zài guó nèi xué xí yā lì tài dà jiā zhǎng huā zài bǔ xí bān shàng de qián shèn zhì bǐ sòng hái zi chū guó gèng duō ér qiě guó wài de jiào yù kě néng gèng shì hé tā — 3D-4: The pressure in China is too great for children, parents spend even more on tutoring than on going abroad, and she thinks foreign education may suit her daughter better.

lessons.subtitle: 糖的实验 · 等候时间 · 吃苦和努力 · 上海留学 · ＰＩＳＡ考试 · 清华 · 第三语言

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, watch the video and, in Chinese, describe what happened. B. In groups of three, listen to the social-science research experiment conducted in 1972 and discuss the question at the end. (The video and audio are not included; no key.) C. Read the findings of the experiment and compare it with your discussion.

examples.text: 十几年后，人们发现，当年面对糖等候时间长，最长的三分之一的孩子，在学习上超过等候时间短，最短的三分之一的孩子，他们的大学入学考试分数比等候时间最短的三分之一的孩子高出了二百一十分，满分一千六百分。这些等待时间长的小孩，不仅后来学习成绩更好，而且在生活的各个方面也都更有优势，他们比较少做不成熟的事；工作更努力；而且在三十岁左右的时候，他们的身体也比那些等候时间短的孩子们更健康。这大概就是大部分中国父母的想法：为了以后更好的生活，现在吃苦和努力都是应该的，他们不仅这样要求自己，也这样要求孩子。
examples.translation: shí jǐ nián hòu rén men fā xiàn dāng nián miàn duì táng děng hòu shí jiān cháng zuì cháng de sān fēn zhī yì de hái zi zài xué xí shàng chāo guò děng hòu shí jiān duǎn zuì duǎn de sān fēn zhī yì de hái zi tā men de dà xué rù xué kǎo shì fēn shù bǐ děng hòu shí jiān zuì duǎn de sān fēn zhī yì de hái zi gāo chū le èr bǎi yī shí fēn mǎn fēn yì qiān liù bǎi fēn zhè xiē děng dài shí jiān cháng de xiǎo hái bù jǐn hòu lái xué xí chéng jì gèng hǎo ér qiě zài shēng huó de gè gè fāng miàn yě dōu gèng yǒu yōu shì tā men bǐ jiào shǎo zuò bù chéng shú de shì gōng zuò gèng nǔ lì ér qiě zài sān shí suì zuǒ yòu de shí hòu tā men de shēn tǐ yě bǐ nà xiē děng hòu shí jiān duǎn de hái zi men gèng jiàn kāng zhè dà gài jiù shì dà bù fèn zhōng guó fù mǔ de xiǎng fǎ wèi le yǐ hòu gèng hǎo de shēng huó xiàn zài chī kǔ hé nǔ lì dōu shì yīng gāi de tā men bù jǐn zhè yàng yāo qiú zì jǐ yě zhè yàng yāo qiú hái zi — Activity 1C: More than ten years later, people found that the children who had waited longest for the candy (the longest third) did better in their studies than the children who waited the shortest time (the shortest third): their university entrance exam scores were 210 points higher (out of 1600) than those of the shortest-waiting third. These long-waiting children not only later had better grades but were also better off in many other aspects of life: they did fewer immature things, worked harder, and at around the age of 30 were also healthier than the children who waited a short time. This is probably the thought of most Chinese parents: for a better life later, suffering and working hard now is only right; they make this demand not only of themselves but also of their children. (the book writes 1/3, 210, 1600 and 30 in digits and puts the fractions in brackets; the book’s sentence “面对糖等候时间长” is kept as printed; translation mine)

examples.text: 我从小就害怕考试，十六岁到中国上海留学的时候，我才知道中国的考试比美国多得多。一年以后我回到美国，所有的老师都问我：中国的高中跟美国的高中有什么不一样？我们怎么才能赶上中国的高中？他们的担心是有道理的。在二零一零年的ＰＩＳＡ考试中，中国上海的学生在数学、阅读和科学三个考试中都是第一，而美国平均排在全世界的第二十三、二十四名。从那以后我更害怕考试了，连我的父母都开始给我压力，说我应该像中国学生那样努力学习。但是上大学以后，这样的担心就减少了。大学三年级我是在中国北京的一所大学读的。虽然我没有参加过中国的高考，但是我发现学习对我来说并不是很难，我也没有觉得我的中国同学比我聪明很多，而且上课和写作业都是用我的第三语言——中文。如果考试没有那么重要，可能我从小就不应该那么害怕它？
examples.translation: wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù hài pà kǎo shì shí liù suì dào zhōng guó shàng hǎi liú xué de shí hòu wǒ cái zhī dào zhōng guó de kǎo shì bǐ měi guó duō de duō yì nián yǐ hòu wǒ huí dào měi guó suǒ yǒu de lǎo shī dōu wèn wǒ zhōng guó de gāo zhōng gēn měi guó de gāo zhōng yǒu shén me bù yí yàng wǒ men zěn me cái néng gǎn shàng zhōng guó de gāo zhōng tā men de dān xīn shì yǒu dào lǐ de zài èr líng yī líng nián de kǎo shì zhōng zhōng guó shàng hǎi de xué shēng zài shù xué yuè dú hé kē xué sān gè kǎo shì zhōng dōu shì dì yī ér měi guó píng jūn pái zài quán shì jiè de dì èr shí sān èr shí sì míng cóng nà yǐ hòu wǒ gèng hài pà kǎo shì le lián wǒ de fù mǔ dōu kāi shǐ gěi wǒ yā lì shuō wǒ yīng gāi xiàng zhōng guó xué shēng nà yàng nǔ lì xué xí dàn shì shàng dà xué yǐ hòu zhè yàng de dān xīn jiù jiǎn shǎo le dà xué sān nián jí wǒ shì zài zhōng guó běi jīng de yì suǒ dà xué dú de suī rán wǒ méi yǒu cān jiā guò zhōng guó de gāo kǎo dàn shì wǒ fā xiàn xué xí duì wǒ lái shuō bìng bú shì hěn nán wǒ yě méi yǒu jué de wǒ de zhōng guó tóng xué bǐ wǒ cōng míng hěn duō ér qiě shàng kè hé xiě zuò yè dōu shì yòng wǒ de dì sān yǔ yán zhōng wén rú guǒ kǎo shì méi yǒu nà me zhòng yào kě néng wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù bù yīng gāi nà me hài pà tā — Activity 2C: I have been afraid of exams since childhood. When I went to study in Shanghai, China, at sixteen, I learned that China has far more exams than the U.S. A year later I returned to the U.S., and all the teachers asked me: How are Chinese high schools different from American ones? How can we catch up with China’s high schools? Their worry was justified. In the 2010 PISA test, students from Shanghai were first in all three tests, mathematics, reading and science, while the U.S. ranked on average 23rd and 24th in the world. After that I was even more afraid of exams; even my parents began to put pressure on me, saying I should study as hard as Chinese students. But after I went to university, such worries decreased. In my third year I studied at a university in Beijing, China. Although I had never taken the Chinese gaokao, I found that studying was not very hard for me, nor did I feel that my Chinese classmates were much smarter than I, and classes and homework were all in my third language, Chinese. If exams are not that important, perhaps I should not have been so afraid of them from childhood? (adapted from a newspaper article; the source site is left out; the book writes 16, 2010 and 23, 24 in digits and gives the glosses in brackets; translation mine)

examples.text: 不过，我一到了大学，这些担心就减少了。我大三时在清华读了一学期的进修课。我当时的同学确实很聪明和友好，求知欲也很强。但不管我有没有参加过高考，我跟他们一起学习从来没有觉得吃力，同时也没有觉得同学比我聪明得多，而上课和写作业时用的都是我的第三语言——中文。我在清华上的课大多都是历史系的课，而我很快发现我可以利用我在美国做独立历史研究的经验来对我们班的讨论作出贡献。
examples.translation: bú guò wǒ yí dào le dà xué zhè xiē dān xīn jiù jiǎn shǎo le wǒ dà sān shí zài qīng huá dú le yì xué qī de jìn xiū kè wǒ dāng shí de tóng xué què shí hěn cōng míng hé yǒu hǎo qiú zhī yù yě hěn qiáng dàn bù guǎn wǒ yǒu méi yǒu cān jiā guò gāo kǎo wǒ gēn tā men yì qǐ xué xí cóng lái méi yǒu jué de chī lì tóng shí yě méi yǒu jué de tóng xué bǐ wǒ cōng míng de duō ér shàng kè hé xiě zuò yè shí yòng de dōu shì wǒ de dì sān yǔ yán zhōng wén wǒ zài qīng huá shàng de kè dà duō dōu shì lì shǐ xì de kè ér wǒ hěn kuài fā xiàn wǒ kě yǐ lì yòng wǒ zài měi guó zuò dú lì lì shǐ yán jiū de jīng yàn lái duì wǒ men bān de tǎo lùn zuò chū gòng xiàn — Activity 2D, part of the original article: But as soon as I got to university, these worries decreased. In my third year I took a one-semester advanced course at Tsinghua. My classmates at the time were indeed very smart and friendly, with a strong thirst for knowledge. But whether or not I had taken the gaokao, I never felt it was a strain to study with them, and I did not feel my classmates were much smarter than I, while classes and homework were in my third language, Chinese. Most of the classes I took at Tsinghua were history-department classes, and I quickly found that I could use my experience of independent historical research in the U.S. to contribute to our class discussions. (translation mine; the book asks the learner to use machine translation on the reason part)

examples.text: 他在清华上的课大多是历史系的课，他可以利用自己在美国做独立历史研究的经验来对班上的讨论作出贡献，所以他不觉得吃力。
examples.translation: tā zài qīng huá shàng de kè dà duō shì lì shǐ xì de kè tā kě yǐ lì yòng zì jǐ zài měi guó zuò dú lì lì shǐ yán jiū de jīng yàn lái duì bān shàng de tǎo lùn zuò chū gòng xiàn suǒ yǐ tā bù jué de chī lì — Activity 2D, Reason (my answer): Most of his classes at Tsinghua were history classes, and he could use his experience of independent historical research in the U.S. to contribute to class discussions, so he did not find it a strain.

examples.text: 考试多的压力不一定让人学得更好，他的聪明和努力不比中国同学差。
examples.translation: kǎo shì duō de yā lì bù yí dìng ràng rén xué de gèng hǎo tā de cōng míng hé nǔ lì bù bǐ zhōng guó tóng xué chà — 2C (my own possible discussion point; the book gives no answer): The pressure of many exams does not necessarily make people learn better; his intelligence and effort were not inferior to his Chinese classmates’.

options: Children who waited longer did worse
Children who waited longer did better in their studies
exercises.explanation: 等候时间长的孩子，在学习上超过等候时间短的孩子.

exercises.prompt: How many points higher were the long-waiting children’s exam scores?
What was the full score of the exam mentioned?
About how old were the children when the health comparison was made?
What do most Chinese parents think, according to the passage?
options: Hardship and hard work now is right, for a better life later
exercises.explanation: 现在吃苦和努力都是应该的.

exercises.prompt: How old was the U.S. student when he went to study in Shanghai?
exercises.explanation: 十六岁到中国上海留学.

exercises.prompt: In which test were Shanghai students first in all three subjects?
exercises.explanation: 在二零一零年的ＰＩＳＡ考试中.

options: He could use his experience of independent history research
exercises.explanation: 可以利用我在美国做独立历史研究的经验.

我从小就害怕考试，十六岁到中国上海留___的时候。

lessons.subtitle: 你有学习压力吗 · 压力大怎么办 · 体育锻炼 · 足够的睡觉时间 · 游学 · 长见识 · 更自信

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking): the stress checklist
explanations.body: A. Check the items that apply to you to see if you experience stress from your studies. B. Do you experience other symptoms of stress? Share your information with your partner and add it to the above list (the book gives five blank lines). C. What are useful ways for you to reduce stress while studying? Share your thoughts with the class. D. Read the following suggestions for reducing study stress. Find any that may be useful to you. (The three small pictures are not included.)

examples.text: 上次考试考得不好
examples.translation: shàng cì kǎo shì kǎo de bù hǎo — Activity 3A, “你有学习压力吗？” Check the items that apply to you; 1. I did poorly on the last exam. (the book gives no key; translations mine)

examples.text: 学习上有困难的时候，我不知道该怎么办
examples.translation: xué xí shàng yǒu kùn nán de shí hòu wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn — 2. When I have difficulty in my studies, I don’t know what to do.

examples.text: 老师讲的我听不懂
examples.translation: lǎo shī jiǎng de wǒ tīng bù dǒng — 3. I can’t understand what the teacher says.

examples.text: 上课有的东西没听懂，但是我不想问老师
examples.translation: shàng kè yǒu de dōng xī méi tīng dǒng dàn shì wǒ bù xiǎng wèn lǎo shī — 4. In class there are things I didn’t understand, but I don’t want to ask the teacher.

examples.text: 上课的时候没有办法好好听课，总是想到别的东西
examples.translation: shàng kè de shí hòu méi yǒu bàn fǎ hǎo hǎo tīng kè zǒng shì xiǎng dào bié de dōng xī — 5. In class I can’t listen properly; I’m always thinking of other things.

examples.text: 我觉得老师不太关心学生
examples.translation: wǒ jué de lǎo shī bú tài guān xīn xué shēng — 6. I feel the teacher doesn’t care much about students.

examples.text: 我不知道自己能不能学好
examples.translation: wǒ bù zhī dào zì jǐ néng bù néng xué hǎo — 7. I don’t know whether I can learn well.

examples.text: 我觉得作业太多了
examples.translation: wǒ jué de zuò yè tài duō le — 8. I feel there is too much homework.

examples.text: 有时候很难完成作业
examples.translation: yǒu shí hòu hěn nán wán chéng zuò yè — 9. Sometimes it is hard to finish homework.

examples.text: 学习上的竞争太厉害了
examples.translation: xué xí shàng de jìng zhēng tài lì hài le — 10. The competition in studies is too fierce.

examples.text: 需要太多时间学习，没有时间锻炼和玩儿
examples.translation: xū yào tài duō shí jiān xué xí méi yǒu shí jiān duàn liàn hé wánr — 11. I need too much time to study and have no time to exercise and play. (玩儿 as printed)

examples.text: 体重减少或增加了
examples.translation: tǐ zhòng jiǎn shǎo huò zēng jiā le — 12. My weight has decreased or increased. (the book writes 减少/增加 with a slash)

examples.text: 总是觉得累，睡觉时间变长或变短了
examples.translation: zǒng shì jué de lèi shuì jiào shí jiān biàn cháng huò biàn duǎn le — 13. I always feel tired; my sleep time has become longer or shorter. (the book writes 变长/变短 with a slash)

examples.text: 学习和考试给我很大的压力
examples.translation: xué xí hé kǎo shì gěi wǒ hěn dà de yā lì — 14. Studies and exams give me great pressure.

examples.text: 我没有朋友
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu péng yǒu — 15. I have no friends.

examples.text: 我觉得没有人关心我
examples.translation: wǒ jué de méi yǒu rén guān xīn wǒ — 16. I feel nobody cares about me.

examples.text: 以前喜欢做的事现在没有兴趣了
examples.translation: yǐ qián xǐ huān zuò de shì xiàn zài méi yǒu xìng qù le — 17. I am no longer interested in things I used to like doing.

examples.text: 学习压力大怎么办呢？试试这些办法吧！
examples.translation: xué xí yā lì dà zěn me bàn ne shì shì zhè xiē bàn fǎ ba — Activity 3D: What to do about heavy study stress? Try these methods! (translations mine)

examples.text: 首先要理解，生活中每个人都有压力，不要害怕压力。
examples.translation: shǒu xiān yào lǐ jiě shēng huó zhōng měi gè rén dōu yǒu yā lì bú yào hài pà yā lì — 1. First understand that everyone in life has pressure; don’t be afraid of pressure.

examples.text: 制定一个学习计划，每天坚持完成当天的计划。
examples.translation: zhì dìng yí gè xué xí jì huà měi tiān jiān chí wán chéng dàng tiān de jì huà — 2. Make a study plan and keep finishing that day’s plan every day.

examples.text: 不懂的问题及时问老师或同学。
examples.translation: bù dǒng de wèn tí jí shí wèn lǎo shī huò tóng xué — 3. Ask the teacher or classmates promptly about questions you don’t understand.

examples.text: 体育锻炼。体育运动是减压的好办法。在周末你还可以跟朋友一起爬山、打球等。
examples.translation: tǐ yù duàn liàn tǐ yù yùn dòng shì jiǎn yā de hǎo bàn fǎ zài zhōu mò nǐ hái kě yǐ gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ pá shān dǎ qiú děng — 4. Physical exercise. Sports are a good way to reduce stress. On weekends you can also go hiking or play ball with friends.

examples.text: 把压力写下来。写出来以后你可能会发现，这些压力没有你想的那么严重。
examples.translation: bǎ yā lì xiě xià lái xiě chū lái yǐ hòu nǐ kě néng huì fā xiàn zhè xiē yā lì méi yǒu nǐ xiǎng de nà me yán zhòng — 5. Write the stress down. After writing it out you may find that the stress is not as serious as you thought.

examples.text: 一定要有足够的睡觉时间。睡觉前把所有的电子产品都关上。
examples.translation: yí dìng yào yǒu zú gòu de shuì jiào shí jiān shuì jiào qián bǎ suǒ yǒu de diàn zi chǎn pǐn dōu guān shàng — 6. Be sure to have enough sleeping time. Turn off all electronic products before sleep.

examples.text: 吃好饭。有的人觉得学习辛苦，应该多吃大鱼大肉。还有的人觉得学习紧张的时候吃点儿零食会开心起来。但这些想法都不对，应该多吃一些新鲜的蔬菜和水果。
examples.translation: chī hǎo fàn yǒu de rén jué de xué xí xīn kǔ yīng gāi duō chī dà yú dà ròu hái yǒu de rén jué de xué xí jǐn zhāng de shí hòu chī diǎnr líng shí huì kāi xīn qǐ lái dàn zhè xiē xiǎng fǎ dōu bú duì yīng gāi duō chī yì xiē xīn xiān de shū cài hé shuǐ guǒ — 7. Eat well. Some people think study is hard and one should eat lots of fish and meat. Others think that when study is tense eating some snacks will cheer them up. But these ideas are all wrong; one should eat more fresh vegetables and fruit. (the book’s items 7 and 8 split this sentence after 学习紧张的时候, which looks like a layout slip, so I join them here and the following items are numbered 8 and 9 in my reading)

examples.text: 闻香气。很多人闻到香气会觉得轻松快乐。
examples.translation: wén xiāng qì hěn duō rén wén dào xiāng qì huì jué de qīng sōng kuài lè — 8 (the book’s 9). Smell fragrances. Many people feel relaxed and happy when they smell a fragrance.

examples.text: 根据自己的爱好做一些活动，当你学习累了，可以出去打球，跑步，散步，也可以阅读，听歌，跳舞。
examples.translation: gēn jù zì jǐ de ài hào zuò yì xiē huó dòng dāng nǐ xué xí lèi le kě yǐ chū qù dǎ qiú pǎo bù sàn bù yě kě yǐ yuè dú tīng gē tiào wǔ — 9 (the book’s 10). Do some activities according to your hobbies; when you are tired from studying you can go out to play ball, run, or take a walk, or you can read, listen to songs, or dance.

examples.text: 我觉得体育锻炼对我最有用，学习累了的时候我会出去跑步，也会跟朋友一起打球。
examples.translation: wǒ jué de tǐ yù duàn liàn duì wǒ zuì yǒu yòng xué xí lèi le de shí hòu wǒ huì chū qù pǎo bù yě huì gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ dǎ qiú — Activity 3C (my possible answer; the book gives none): I find exercise most useful; when I am tired from studying I go running and also play ball with friends.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Listening and Speaking): study tours
explanations.body: A. Read the passage about a “study tour.” Divide the passage into a few sections and summarize the main idea of each section. Compare your work with a classmate’s. B. Do you have any study tour experiences? If yes, your partners will write some questions to ask you about your experience. C. What are the benefits of study tours? Discuss with your partners and list them below. D. Listen to a list of benefits of study tours and take notes. Note the items not included in your list. (The book gives lines for the summary, sections and notes.)

examples.text: “游学”就是离开自己生活的地方，到另一个全新的环境学习和旅游，体验当地生活。近些年来，越来越多的中国家庭有能力而且愿意为孩子的教育花更多的钱，游学也成了孩子培养计划中的一个。这几年参加游学的学生不断增加，他们主要是去一些英语国家，比如英国、美国、加拿大、澳大利亚等。一位家庭月收入约三万的家长说，自己为了让孩子去英国游学一个月，花了十万。可看到孩子回来后长见识了，更自信了，认识了很多朋友，所以想有机会让孩子再去一次。
examples.translation: yóu xué jiù shì lí kāi zì jǐ shēng huó de dì fāng dào lìng yí gè quán xīn de huán jìng xué xí hé lǚ yóu tǐ yàn dāng dì shēng huó jìn xiē nián lái yuè lái yuè duō de zhōng guó jiā tíng yǒu néng lì ér qiě yuàn yì wèi hái zi de jiào yù huā gèng duō de qián yóu xué yě chéng le hái zi péi yǎng jì huà zhōng de yí gè zhè jǐ nián cān jiā yóu xué de xué shēng bú duàn zēng jiā tā men zhǔ yào shì qù yì xiē yīng yǔ guó jiā bǐ rú yīng guó měi guó jiā ná dà ào dà lì yà děng yí wèi jiā tíng yuè shōu rù yuē sān wàn de jiā zhǎng shuō zì jǐ wèi le ràng hái zi qù yīng guó yóu xué yí gè yuè huā le shí wàn kě kàn dào hái zi huí lái hòu zhǎng jiàn shí le gèng zì xìn le rèn shí le hěn duō péng yǒu suǒ yǐ xiǎng yǒu jī huì ràng hái zi zài qù yí cì — Activity 4A: “Study tour” means leaving the place where you live and going to a completely new environment to study and travel, experiencing local life. In recent years more and more Chinese families have the ability and the willingness to spend more money on their children’s education, and study tours have become one part of children’s development plans. In the past few years the number of students on study tours has kept increasing; they mainly go to English-speaking countries such as the U.K., the U.S., Canada and Australia. A parent whose family’s monthly income is about 30,000 said that to send her child on a one-month study tour in the U.K. she spent 100,000. But seeing the child return having broadened their horizons, more self-confident and having made many friends, she wants to give the child another chance. (the book writes 30,000 as 三万 and 100,000 as 十万 in Chinese already; the photo is not included; translation mine)

examples.text: 第一部分：什么是游学。第二部分：越来越多的家庭愿意花钱让孩子游学，学生主要去英语国家。第三部分：一位家长的例子。
examples.translation: dì yī bù fèn shén me shì yóu xué dì èr bù fèn yuè lái yuè duō de jiā tíng yuàn yì huā qián ràng hái zi yóu xué xué shēng zhǔ yào qù yīng yǔ guó jiā dì sān bù fèn yí wèi jiā zhǎng de lì zi — Activity 4A, Sections (my division; the book gives lines for learners): One: what a study tour is. Two: more and more families are willing to spend money on study tours, mostly to English-speaking countries. Three: one parent’s example.

examples.text: 游学的好处有：长见识，更自信，认识很多朋友，提高外语水平，体验当地生活。
examples.translation: yóu xué de hǎo chù yǒu zhǎng jiàn shí gèng zì xìn rèn shí hěn duō péng yǒu tí gāo wài yǔ shuǐ píng tǐ yàn dāng dì shēng huó — Activity 4C (my list of benefits; the book leaves the list to the learners, and 4D is audio, so there is no key for that): Broader horizons, more self-confidence, making many friends, improving foreign-language level, experiencing local life.

explanations.title: Presentation 3: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up. Discuss the following questions with your partner. A. Is there any difference between rural and urban education in the United States? B. In the United States, does the quality of teaching vary greatly from school to school? What determines the difference? C. In the United States, what are the rules that determine which students can attend school? D. Have you ever faced any difficulties that affected your ability to study? Name one. (The four pictures are not included; the book gives no answers.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 留守儿童 and 流动儿童
explanations.body: A passage about the education of the children of rural migrant workers.

examples.text: 在中国，很多农村人到大城市去打工。他们工作很辛苦，挣的钱也不多，很难让全家人一起在城里生活，只好把孩子留在农村。这些孩子就成了“留守儿童”。现在中国有几千万留守儿童，他们的父母都在城市打工，常常一年才能见一次面。因为父母不在身边，这些孩子在学习和生活上都有很多困难。有些小孩得自己做饭，到地里干活，有的还要照顾弟弟妹妹，很少有时间学习，而且学习上有了困难也没有人帮助。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó hěn duō nóng cūn rén dào dà chéng shì qù dǎ gōng tā men gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ zhèng de qián yě bù duō hěn nán ràng quán jiā rén yì qǐ zài chéng lǐ shēng huó zhǐ hǎo bǎ hái zi liú zài nóng cūn zhè xiē hái zi jiù chéng le liú shǒu ér tóng xiàn zài zhōng guó yǒu jǐ qiān wàn liú shǒu ér tóng tā men de fù mǔ dōu zài chéng shì dǎ gōng cháng cháng yì nián cái néng jiàn yí cì miàn yīn wèi fù mǔ bú zài shēn biān zhè xiē hái zi zài xué xí hé shēng huó shàng dōu yǒu hěn duō kùn nán yǒu xiē xiǎo hái děi zì jǐ zuò fàn dào dì lǐ gàn huó yǒu de hái yào zhào gù dì di mèi mèi hěn shǎo yǒu shí jiān xué xí ér qiě xué xí shàng yǒu le kùn nán yě méi yǒu rén bāng zhù — In China, many rural people go to big cities to work. They work very hard and don’t earn much; it is very hard for the whole family to live together in the city, so they have no choice but to leave their children in the countryside. These children have become “left-behind children.” Now China has tens of millions of left-behind children; their parents all work in cities and often can meet only once a year. Because their parents are not at their side, these children have many difficulties in study and life. Some children have to cook for themselves and work in the fields, some also have to look after younger brothers and sisters, have little time to study, and when they have difficulty in their studies, nobody helps them. (translations mine; the traditional-character copy is not repeated)

examples.text: 也有的农村孩子跟着父母一起来到城市，成为“流动儿童”。因为他们不是那些城市的居民，所以上不了那里的学校。虽然有的学校可以让他们上学，可是学费很贵，他们上不起。有些人开办了学校，专门收“流动儿童”。这些学校学费不太贵，不过教学质量不太好，有的还比不上农村的学校。
examples.translation: yě yǒu de nóng cūn hái zi gēn zhe fù mǔ yì qǐ lái dào chéng shì chéng wéi liú dòng ér tóng yīn wèi tā men bú shì nà xiē chéng shì de jū mín suǒ yǐ shàng bù liǎo nà lǐ de xué xiào suī rán yǒu de xué xiào kě yǐ ràng tā men shàng xué kě shì xué fèi hěn guì tā men shàng bù qǐ yǒu xiē rén kāi bàn le xué xiào zhuān mén shōu liú dòng ér tóng zhè xiē xué xiào xué fèi bú tài guì bú guò jiào xué zhì liàng bú tài hǎo yǒu de hái bǐ bú shàng nóng cūn de xué xiào — Some rural children also follow their parents to the city and become “migrant children.” Because they are not residents of those cities, they cannot attend school there. Although some schools let them attend, the tuition is very expensive and they cannot afford it. Some people have set up schools that specially admit “migrant children.” These schools’ tuition is not too expensive, but the quality of teaching is not very good, and some are even no match for rural schools.

examples.text: 在中国，“留守儿童”和“流动儿童”的教育是一个很大的问题，现在大家正在想办法解决。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó liú shǒu ér tóng hé liú dòng ér tóng de jiào yù shì yí gè hěn dà de wèn tí xiàn zài dà jiā zhèng zài xiǎng bàn fǎ jiě jué — In China, the education of “left-behind children” and “migrant children” is a very big problem, and everyone is now trying to find ways to solve it.

explanations.title: Presentation 3 Activities, Activities 1 to 3
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening): A. Global Listening: Listen to Presentation 3 once and answer the questions. 1. Who are the two groups of children mentioned in the article? 2. What do these two groups of children have in common? B. Detailed Listening: Listen to Presentation 3 again and answer the questions. 1. How did the “left behind children” come about? 2. Why can’t most migrant workers bring their children to live with them in the city? 3. What difficulties are faced by these children? Provide examples. 4. How did migrant children emerge? 5. What difficulties do the migrant children have with school? Activity 2 (Speaking and Listening): Form groups of three. Each member retells the presentation from one of the following three aspects. Activity 3 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking): A. Listen to a migrant worker’s monolog and answer the questions: 1. What do you know about the family of this migrant worker? 2. What are the reasons that he leaves his kids at home? Name three. 3. What was said about the schools in the city for the migrant workers’ children? 4. How does he save money? 5. What goal does he hope to achieve? (audio, so I give no key) B. Pair up. Discuss your answers with your partner. C. Read a journal entry of a migrant worker’s daughter and answer the questions: 1. Describe the scene when her parents come back to visit. How does the girl feel about it? 2. What are the girl’s responsibilities when the parents are away from home? 3. What difficulties does she have to deal with? 4. What does she say about the children’s life in that area? 5. What does she wish for in the future? D. Pair up. Discuss your answers with your partner. The journal entry and my answers:

examples.text: 我六岁多的时候，爸爸妈妈就出去打工了，那时候，弟弟才三岁。我们跟爷爷奶奶生活在一起。爸爸妈妈每年春节的时候会回来看我们，给我们买好多好吃的东西、好看的衣服，还给弟弟买玩具。我喜欢这些东西，但是我更希望全家人在一起。爷爷奶奶身体都不太好，但是他们还得到地里去干活。有几个月奶奶病了，我放学以后就做饭，弟弟去帮爷爷干活。我们的学校离家很远，要走一个小时。我每天带弟弟一起去上学。弟弟不会做的作业，我就帮他，但是我不会做的作业，就没有人帮我了。我有困难的时候就会更想爸爸妈妈，他们如果在家就好了。但是，学校里有好多同学都和我们一样，爸爸妈妈都在外面打工，还有的学生自己也出去打工了。我想好好上学，以后挣了钱给爸爸妈妈，他们就不用到那么远的地方去工作了。
examples.translation: wǒ liù suì duō de shí hòu bà bà mā mā jiù chū qù dǎ gōng le nà shí hòu dì di cái sān suì wǒ men gēn yé yé nǎi nǎi shēng huó zài yì qǐ bà bà mā mā měi nián chūn jié de shí hòu huì huí lái kàn wǒ men gěi wǒ men mǎi hǎo duō hǎo chī de dōng xī hǎo kàn de yī fú hái gěi dì di mǎi wán jù wǒ xǐ huān zhè xiē dōng xī dàn shì wǒ gèng xī wàng quán jiā rén zài yì qǐ yé yé nǎi nǎi shēn tǐ dōu bú tài hǎo dàn shì tā men hái děi dào dì lǐ qù gàn huó yǒu jǐ gè yuè nǎi nǎi bìng le wǒ fàng xué yǐ hòu jiù zuò fàn dì di qù bāng yé yé gàn huó wǒ men de xué xiào lí jiā hěn yuǎn yào zǒu yí gè xiǎo shí wǒ měi tiān dài dì di yì qǐ qù shàng xué dì di bú huì zuò de zuò yè wǒ jiù bāng tā dàn shì wǒ bú huì zuò de zuò yè jiù méi yǒu rén bāng wǒ le wǒ yǒu kùn nán de shí hòu jiù huì gèng xiǎng bà bà mā mā tā men rú guǒ zài jiā jiù hǎo le dàn shì xué xiào lǐ yǒu hǎo duō tóng xué dōu hé wǒ men yí yàng bà bà mā mā dōu zài wài miàn dǎ gōng hái yǒu de xué shēng zì jǐ yě chū qù dǎ gōng le wǒ xiǎng hǎo hǎo shàng xué yǐ hòu zhèng le qián gěi bà bà mā mā tā men jiù bú yòng dào nà me yuǎn de dì fāng qù gōng zuò le — Activity 3C, a journal entry of a migrant worker’s daughter: When I was a little over six, my parents went out to work; my little brother was only three then. We live with our grandparents. Every Spring Festival my parents come back to see us, buying us lots of good things to eat and nice clothes, and toys for my brother. I like these things, but I would rather have the whole family together. My grandparents are both in poor health, but they still have to go work in the fields. For several months Grandma was ill; after school I cooked, and my brother went to help Grandpa. Our school is far from home, a one-hour walk. Every day I take my brother to school. If my brother can’t do his homework I help him, but when I can’t do mine, nobody helps me. When I have difficulties I miss my parents even more; if only they were home. But many classmates at school are like us, with both parents working outside, and some students go out to work themselves. I want to study hard and, when I earn money later, give it to my parents so they won’t need to work so far away. (translation mine; the book writes six and three in Chinese)
