explanations.title: The 只好 + Verb Phrase structure, and 只好 vs. 得
explanations.body: In this structure, 只好 means “no other choice but,” or “be resigned to do something.” Unfavorable condition, (Subj.) + 只好 + verb phrase. 只好 expresses a passive decision and has to be used with a condition. 得 usually indicates a voluntary decision or is reminding/urging others to do something. 得 can be used independently without pre-conditions. Activity 1: A. Complete the sentences with the 只好 + verb phrase structure (the beginnings: 1. 我的右手受伤了， 2. 专家门诊的号已经挂完了， 3. 我跟他约好三点见面，可是他三点半还没有来， 4. 老张病了，没有办法继续工作， 5. 我的护照丢了， 6. 出了门才想起来没带手机， 7. 我们想去海边跑步，可是风太大了， 8. 最近工作太多了，上班的时候根本做不完，). B. Answer the questions using 只好: 1. 上课的时候你没有带书，怎么办？ 2. 你的车在路上坏了，怎么办？ 3. 请朋友吃饭，吃完才发现自己没带钱包，怎么办？ 4. 你的父母没有钱为你付大学的学费，怎么办？ 5. 已经晚上十二点了，旁边住的人还在聚会，唱歌，怎么办？ C. Pair up. Talk with your partner about times you had to make choices you were reluctant to make but were resigned to. Follow the structure of the sample mini paragraph. The examples and my answers:

examples.text: 家里没有饭了，我只好吃了点儿零食。
examples.translation: jiā lǐ méi yǒu fàn le wǒ zhǐ hǎo chī le diǎnr líng shí — 只好 (Unfavorable condition, (Subj.) + 只好 + verb phrase; “no other choice but,” “be resigned to do something”), 1: There was no food at home, so I had no choice but to eat some snacks. (translations mine)

examples.text: 高铁票卖完了，我只好坐普通火车。
examples.translation: gāo tiě piào mài wán le wǒ zhǐ hǎo zuò pǔ tōng huǒ chē — 2: The high-speed rail tickets were sold out, so I had to take a regular train.

examples.text: 我的车坏了，只好走回家。
examples.translation: wǒ de chē huài le zhǐ hǎo zǒu huí jiā — 3: My car broke down, so I had to walk home.

examples.text: 看比赛的人太多了，我找不到座位，只好站着看。
examples.translation: kàn bǐ sài de rén tài duō le wǒ zhǎo bú dào zuò wèi zhǐ hǎo zhàn zhe kàn — 4: There were too many people watching the match; I couldn’t find a seat, so I had to watch standing.

examples.text: 没有医保卡也可以，但你得付现金。
examples.translation: méi yǒu yī bǎo kǎ yě kě yǐ dàn nǐ děi fù xiàn jīn — 只好 vs. 得 (只好 expresses a passive decision and has to be used with a condition; 得 usually indicates a voluntary decision or is reminding/urging others to do something and can be used independently without pre-conditions), 1: It’s fine without a medical insurance card, but you have to pay cash.

examples.text: 因为没有医保卡，我只好付现金看医生。
examples.translation: yīn wèi méi yǒu yī bǎo kǎ wǒ zhǐ hǎo fù xiàn jīn kàn yī shēng — 2: Because I had no medical insurance card, I had to pay cash to see the doctor.

examples.text: 有些小孩得自己做饭。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē xiǎo hái děi zì jǐ zuò fàn — 3: Some children have to cook for themselves.

examples.text: 爸爸妈妈都在外打工，爷爷奶奶又病了，孩子只好自己做饭。
examples.translation: bà bà mā mā dōu zài wài dǎ gōng yé yé nǎi nǎi yòu bìng le hái zi zhǐ hǎo zì jǐ zuò fàn — 4: Both parents work away, and the grandparents are also ill, so the child has no choice but to cook for himself.

examples.text: 我的右手受伤了，只好用左手写字。
examples.translation: wǒ de yòu shǒu shòu shāng le zhǐ hǎo yòng zuǒ shǒu xiě zì — Activity 1A, 1 (my completions): My right hand was hurt, so I had to write with my left hand.

examples.text: 专家门诊的号已经挂完了，只好看普通门诊。
examples.translation: zhuān jiā mén zhěn de hào yǐ jīng guà wán le zhǐ hǎo kàn pǔ tōng mén zhěn — 2: The specialist clinic appointments were all booked, so I had to go to the regular clinic.

examples.text: 我跟他约好三点见面，可是他三点半还没有来，只好给他打电话。
examples.translation: wǒ gēn tā yuē hǎo sān diǎn jiàn miàn kě shì tā sān diǎn bàn hái méi yǒu lái zhǐ hǎo gěi tā dǎ diàn huà — 3: I arranged to meet him at three, but he hadn’t come by half past, so I had to call him.

examples.text: 老张病了，没有办法继续工作，只好请假回家休息。
examples.translation: lǎo zhāng bìng le méi yǒu bàn fǎ jì xù gōng zuò zhǐ hǎo qǐng jià huí jiā xiū xī — 4: Lao Zhang was ill and couldn’t continue working, so he had to take leave and rest at home.

examples.text: 我的护照丢了，只好去办一个新的。
examples.translation: wǒ de hù zhào diū le zhǐ hǎo qù bàn yí gè xīn de — 5: My passport was lost, so I had to go get a new one.

examples.text: 出了门才想起来没带手机，只好回家去拿。
examples.translation: chū le mén cái xiǎng qǐ lái méi dài shǒu jī zhǐ hǎo huí jiā qù ná — 6: Only after going out did I remember I hadn’t brought my phone, so I had to go home to get it.

examples.text: 我们想去海边跑步，可是风太大了，只好在家里看电视。
examples.translation: wǒ men xiǎng qù hǎi biān pǎo bù kě shì fēng tài dà le zhǐ hǎo zài jiā lǐ kàn diàn shì — 7: We wanted to run at the seaside, but the wind was too strong, so we had to watch TV at home.

examples.text: 最近工作太多了，上班的时候根本做不完，只好带回家做。
examples.translation: zuì jìn gōng zuò tài duō le shàng bān de shí hòu gēn běn zuò bù wán zhǐ hǎo dài huí jiā zuò — 8: Recently there is too much work; I can’t finish it at all during work hours, so I have to take it home.

examples.text: 我没有带书，只好看同学的书。
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu dài shū zhǐ hǎo kàn tóng xué de shū — Activity 1B, 1 (my answers): I didn’t bring my book, so I had to read my classmate’s.

examples.text: 我的车在路上坏了，只好打电话叫拖车。
examples.translation: wǒ de chē zài lù shàng huài le zhǐ hǎo dǎ diàn huà jiào tuō chē — 2: My car broke down on the road, so I had to call a tow truck.

examples.text: 我没带钱包，只好用手机付钱。
examples.translation: wǒ méi dài qián bāo zhǐ hǎo yòng shǒu jī fù qián — 3: I didn’t bring my wallet, so I had to pay with my phone.

examples.text: 我只好自己打工挣学费。
examples.translation: wǒ zhǐ hǎo zì jǐ dǎ gōng zhèng xué fèi — 4: I would have no choice but to work myself to earn tuition.

examples.text: 我只好戴上耳机睡觉。
examples.translation: wǒ zhǐ hǎo dài shàng ěr jī shuì jiào — 5: I had to put on earphones to sleep. (the book writes 12 点 in digits)

examples.text: 在中国，很多农村人到大城市去打工。他们工作很辛苦，挣的钱也不多，很难让全家人一起在城里生活，只好把孩子留在农村。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó hěn duō nóng cūn rén dào dà chéng shì qù dǎ gōng tā men gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ zhèng de qián yě bù duō hěn nán ràng quán jiā rén yì qǐ zài chéng lǐ shēng huó zhǐ hǎo bǎ hái zi liú zài nóng cūn — Activity 1C, the book’s sample mini paragraph (precondition + difficulties + 只好 + unwanted decision): In China, many rural people go to big cities to work. They work very hard and don’t earn much; it is very hard for the whole family to live together in the city, so they have no choice but to leave their children in the countryside.

options: No other choice but; be resigned to doing something

exercises.prompt: What does 只好 need in the sentence?
exercises.explanation: has to be used with a condition.

exercises.prompt: Which usually indicates a voluntary decision or urging?
exercises.explanation: 得 usually indicates a voluntary decision or is reminding/urging.

exercises.prompt: What does 高铁票卖完了，我只好坐普通火车 mean?
options: The tickets were sold out, so I had to take a regular train

exercises.prompt: What does 没有医保卡也可以，但你得付现金 mean?
options: It’s fine without the card, but you have to pay cash

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is complete with a condition?
options: 我的车坏了，只好走回家

exercises.prompt: Which word fits “上次他___了我一个大忙”?
看比赛的人太多了，我找不到座位，只好站___看。
我的护照丢了，我得去补___一个。
这个菜是专___为你做的，快尝尝吧！

lessons.title: 768. Lesson 29 Presentation 3 grammar: Verb + 不起 (can’t afford)
lessons.subtitle: 买不起 · 吃不起 · 住不起 · 上不起 · 买得起 · 付得起付不起 · 养不起

explanations.title: Verb + 不起
explanations.body: Verb + 不起 is commonly used to express affordability. For example, 买不起 (can’t afford to buy), or 吃不起 (can’t afford to eat). Activity 2: A. Listen to the sentences and translate what you hear into English (six audio items, so no key). B. Translate the sentences into English. C. Pair up. Imagine a poor person and take turns discussing the person’s life, using the Verb + 不起 phrase. Compare your work with that of another pair. The patterns, examples and my translations:

rows: Verb + 不 + Verb + 得起 (+ Obj.) or Verb + 得起 + Verb + 不起 (+ Obj.) (as printed)
tables.title: Verb + 不起: patterns

examples.text: 那件衣服是你两个月的工资，你买得起吗？
examples.translation: nà jiàn yī fú shì nǐ liǎng gè yuè de gōng zī nǐ mǎi de qǐ ma — Verb + 不起 (commonly used to express affordability, e.g. 买不起 can’t afford to buy, 吃不起 can’t afford to eat), 1: That piece of clothing is two months of your salary; can you afford to buy it? (translations mine)

examples.text: 这家旅馆太贵了，我们住不起。
examples.translation: zhè jiā lǚ guǎn tài guì le wǒ men zhù bù qǐ — 2: This hotel is too expensive; we can’t afford to stay.

examples.text: 一张票两千块钱，你看不看得起这么贵的演出？
examples.translation: yì zhāng piào liǎng qiān kuài qián nǐ kàn bú kàn de qǐ zhè me guì de yǎn chū — 3: A ticket is two thousand yuan; can you afford to see such an expensive show?

examples.text: 大学的学费那么贵，你付得起付不起？
examples.translation: dà xué de xué fèi nà me guì nǐ fù de qǐ fù bù qǐ — 4: University tuition is so expensive; can you afford to pay it or not?

examples.text: 许多美国人买不起健康保险。
examples.translation: xǔ duō měi guó rén mǎi bù qǐ jiàn kāng bǎo xiǎn — Activity 2B, 1 (translations mine): Many Americans can’t afford health insurance.

examples.text: 我家有四只狗，我已经快养不起他们了。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā yǒu sì zhǐ gǒu wǒ yǐ jīng kuài yǎng bù qǐ tā men le — 2: My family has four dogs, and I almost can’t afford to keep them any more.

examples.text: 一般的大学生租不起这么贵的房子。
examples.translation: yì bān de dà xué shēng zū bù qǐ zhè me guì de fáng zi — 3: An ordinary university student can’t afford to rent such an expensive home.

examples.text: 对那些买不起书又爱看书的人来说，图书馆是一个好地方。
examples.translation: duì nà xiē mǎi bù qǐ shū yòu ài kàn shū de rén lái shuō tú shū guǎn shì yí gè hǎo dì fāng — 4: For those who can’t afford books but love to read, the library is a good place.

examples.text: 我买不起苹果八代，只买得起八袋苹果。
examples.translation: wǒ mǎi bù qǐ píng guǒ bā dài zhǐ mǎi de qǐ bā dài píng guǒ — 5: I can’t afford an Apple 8 (a pun on 八代 and 八袋); I can only afford eight bags of apples. (the book writes 8代 and 8袋 with digits)

examples.text: 他家很穷，买不起新衣服，吃不起肉，住不起大房子。
examples.translation: tā jiā hěn qióng mǎi bù qǐ xīn yī fú chī bù qǐ ròu zhù bù qǐ dà fáng zi — Activity 2C (my sample about a poor person; the book gives none): His family is very poor; they can’t afford new clothes, can’t afford meat, and can’t afford a big house.

exercises.prompt: What is the negative form of Verb + 不起?
exercises.explanation: Negative Form: Verb + 得起 (as the book labels the contrasting form).

exercises.prompt: What does 这家旅馆太贵了，我们住不起 mean?
options: This hotel is too expensive; we can’t afford it

exercises.prompt: What does 你付得起付不起？ ask?
options: Can you afford to pay or not?

exercises.prompt: What does 许多美国人买不起健康保险 mean?
options: Many Americans can’t afford health insurance

exercises.prompt: What do those who can’t afford books but love reading need, per the sentence?
这家旅馆太贵了，我们住___起。
那件衣服是你两个月的工资，你买___起吗？

lessons.title: 769. Lesson 29 Presentation 3 grammar: 比不上 and 比不上 vs. 没有
lessons.subtitle: 比得上 · 比不上 · 没有 + adjective · 能力比不上你 · 比不上农村的学校 · 重庆的气候比不上蒙特雷

explanations.title: 比不上 and 比不上 vs. 没有
explanations.body: 比不上 is a fixed expression to make a comparison. It means an ability or condition that cannot be compared with, or is no match for something/someone else. 比不上 indicates inferiority of ability or condition, while 没有 can convey inferiority or simply a neutral comparison. Activity 3: A. Listen to the sentences and translate what you hear into English (four audio items, so no key). B. Translate the sentences into English. C. Change the following 比不上 comparison into 没有 comparison sentences: 1. 你唱歌比不上他。 2. 我的中文水平比不上他。 3. 这所学校的教学质量比不上城里的学校。 4. 香港在这方面的发展很慢，甚至比不上一些西部城市。 D. Change the following 没有 comparisons into 比不上 comparisons, if applicable: 1. 妈妈以前的生活条件没有你们的好。 2. 学拼音没有学汉字那么难。 3. 重庆的气候没有蒙特雷这么好。 4. 小米手机没有苹果手机贵。 5. 小文的考试成绩没有马克高。 (My judgment: 1, 3 and 5 can change; 2 and 4 are neutral comparisons, so they stay with 没有.) E. In groups of three, imagine a superhero and describe him or her with 比得上. Share your work with the other group and compare the two figures with 比不上. The patterns, examples and my versions:

tables.title: 比不上 and 比得上
比不上 vs. 没有: structure

examples.text: 这些学校学费不太贵，不过教学质量不太好，有的还比不上农村的学校。
examples.translation: zhè xiē xué xiào xué fèi bú tài guì bú guò jiào xué zhì liàng bú tài hǎo yǒu de hái bǐ bú shàng nóng cūn de xué xiào — 比不上 (a fixed expression for comparison; an ability or condition that cannot be compared with, no match for something/someone else; A 比得上 B / A 比不上 B), from Presentation 3: These schools’ tuition is not too expensive, but the teaching quality is not very good, and some are even no match for rural schools. (translations mine)

examples.text: 没有什么药比得上锻炼。
examples.translation: méi yǒu shén me yào bǐ děi shàng duàn liàn — 1: No medicine can match exercise.

examples.text: 你们的演出简直比得上专业的摇滚乐队了。
examples.translation: nǐ men de yǎn chū jiǎn zhí bǐ děi shàng zhuān yè de yáo gǔn yuè duì le — 2: Your performance can simply rival a professional rock band.

examples.text: 重庆的气候比不上蒙特雷。
examples.translation: chóng qìng de qì hòu bǐ bú shàng méng tè léi — 3: Chongqing’s climate is no match for Monterey’s.

examples.text: 公交车没有地铁方便。
examples.translation: gōng jiāo chē méi yǒu dì tiě fāng biàn — 比不上 vs. 没有, A. Structure, 1: The bus is not as convenient as the subway.

examples.text: 你们公司没有我们公司大。
examples.translation: nǐ men gōng sī méi yǒu wǒ men gōng sī dà — 2: Your company is not as big as ours.

examples.text: 公交车的速度比不上地铁。
examples.translation: gōng jiāo chē de sù dù bǐ bú shàng dì tiě — 3: The speed of the bus is no match for the subway.

examples.text: 你们公司比不上我们公司。
examples.translation: nǐ men gōng sī bǐ bú shàng wǒ men gōng sī — 4: Your company is no match for our company.

examples.text: 我的能力比不上你。
examples.translation: wǒ de néng lì bǐ bú shàng nǐ — B. Meaning (比不上 indicates the inferior of ability or condition, while 没有 can convey inferiority or simply a neutral comparison), 1: My ability is no match for yours.

examples.text: 爸爸做的菜没有妈妈做的好吃。
examples.translation: bà bà zuò de cài méi yǒu mā mā zuò de hǎo chī — 2: The food Dad makes is not as tasty as what Mom makes.

examples.text: 爸爸做的菜比不上妈妈做的。
examples.translation: bà bà zuò de cài bǐ bú shàng mā mā zuò de — = Dad’s cooking is no match for Mom’s.

examples.text: 蒙特雷的夏天没有重庆那么热。
examples.translation: méng tè léi de xià tiān méi yǒu chóng qìng nà me rè — 3: Monterey’s summer is not as hot as Chongqing’s.

examples.text: 我有很多地方比不上他们，还需要好好学习和提高。
examples.translation: wǒ yǒu hěn duō dì fāng bǐ bú shàng tā men hái xū yào hǎo hǎo xué xí hé tí gāo — Activity 3B, 1 (translations mine): There are many respects in which I am no match for them, and I still need to study hard and improve.

examples.text: 老王比不上他的朋友们那么有钱，但他的快乐没人能比得上。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng bǐ bú shàng tā de péng yǒu men nà me yǒu qián dàn tā de kuài lè méi rén néng bǐ děi shàng — 2: Lao Wang is not as rich as his friends, but nobody can match his happiness.

examples.text: 看到别人的好处容易，看到自己的好处难，所以人们常常觉得自己比不上别人。
examples.translation: kàn dào bié rén de hǎo chù róng yì kàn dào zì jǐ de hǎo chù nán suǒ yǐ rén men cháng cháng jué děi zì jǐ bǐ bú shàng bié rén — 3: It is easy to see others’ strengths and hard to see one’s own, so people often feel they are no match for others.

examples.text: 没有一个朋友能比得上健康，没有一个敌人能比得上疾病。
examples.translation: méi yǒu yí gè péng yǒu néng bǐ děi shàng jiàn kāng méi yǒu yí gè dí rén néng bǐ děi shàng jí bìng — 4: No friend can match health, and no enemy can match illness.

examples.text: 你唱歌没有他唱得好。
examples.translation: nǐ chàng gē méi yǒu tā chàng de hǎo — Activity 3C, 1 (my 没有 versions; the book gives none): You don’t sing as well as he does.

examples.text: 我的中文水平没有他的高。
examples.translation: wǒ de zhōng wén shuǐ píng méi yǒu tā de gāo — 2: My Chinese level is not as high as his.

examples.text: 这所学校的教学质量没有城里的学校好。
examples.translation: zhè suǒ xué xiào de jiào xué zhì liàng méi yǒu chéng lǐ de xué xiào hǎo — 3: This school’s teaching quality is not as good as the schools in the city.

examples.text: 香港在这方面的发展很慢，甚至没有一些西部城市发展得快。
examples.translation: xiāng gǎng zài zhè fāng miàn de fā zhǎn hěn màn shèn zhì méi yǒu yì xiē xī bù chéng shì fā zhǎn de kuài — 4: Hong Kong’s development in this respect is slow, even not as fast as some western cities.

examples.text: 妈妈以前的生活条件比不上你们的。
examples.translation: mā mā yǐ qián de shēng huó tiáo jiàn bǐ bú shàng nǐ men de — Activity 3D, 1 (my 比不上 versions, where applicable): Mom’s past living conditions were no match for yours.

examples.text: 重庆的气候比不上蒙特雷。
examples.translation: chóng qìng de qì hòu bǐ bú shàng méng tè léi — 3: Chongqing’s climate is no match for Monterey’s.

examples.text: 小文的考试成绩比不上马克的。
examples.translation: xiǎo wén de kǎo shì chéng jì bǐ bú shàng mǎ kè de — 5: Xiaowen’s exam scores are no match for Mark’s.

examples.text: 超级英雄的力气比得上一百头大象，跑得比得上飞机。
examples.translation: chāo jí yīng xióng de lì qì bǐ děi shàng yì bǎi tóu dà xiàng pǎo de bǐ děi shàng fēi jī — Activity 3E (my sample for the superhero; the book gives none): The superhero’s strength can match a hundred elephants, and he runs as fast as an airplane.

exercises.explanation: an ability or condition that cannot be compared with.

exercises.prompt: What is the affirmative of 比不上?
What does 没有什么药比得上锻炼 mean?
exercises.explanation: 没有什么药比得上锻炼.

exercises.prompt: Which comparison can convey a neutral comparison, not just inferiority?
exercises.explanation: 没有 can convey inferiority or simply a neutral comparison.

exercises.prompt: What does 我的能力比不上你 mean?

lessons.subtitle: 农村留守儿童 · 九百多万 · 见不到父母 · 爷爷奶奶 · 身心健康 · 急需解决的问题

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Reading, Listening, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the following passage and make a table of the statistics (audio). Pair up and compare your work with your partner’s. B. Discuss the following questions with your partner. C. Read the passage and answer the questions: What are the difficulties faced by 留守儿童 in the passage? Compare your answer with your discussion results from Part B, question 2 above. The table, the questions, the passage and my answers:

headers: Statistics (my table from the printed passage, Activity 1C; the book’s table for the audio passage is blank, and the 2010 figures are in the audio, so not included)
rows: 农村留守儿童九百多万；百分之三十的留守儿童一年只能见到父母一到两次；百分之十五的留守儿童一年也见不到父母一次；近百分之九十的留守儿童和爷爷奶奶生活在一起
tables.title: Activity 1A: a table of the statistics

examples.text: 什么是农村留守儿童？
examples.translation: shén me shì nóng cūn liú shǒu ér tóng — Activity 1B, 1 (translations mine): What are rural left-behind children?

examples.text: 留守儿童可能面对哪些困难？
examples.translation: liú shǒu ér tóng kě néng miàn duì nǎ xiē kùn nán — 2: What difficulties might left-behind children face?

examples.text: 农村留守儿童就是父母去城市打工，自己留在农村的孩子。
examples.translation: nóng cūn liú shǒu ér tóng jiù shì fù mǔ qù chéng shì dǎ gōng zì jǐ liú zài nóng cūn de hái zi — 1B-1 (my answer; the book gives none): Rural left-behind children are children whose parents go to work in the city and who stay in the countryside.

examples.text: 他们可能要自己做饭、干活儿，学习上没有人帮助，安全和身心健康也有问题。
examples.translation: tā men kě néng yào zì jǐ zuò fàn gàn huór xué xí shàng méi yǒu rén bāng zhù ān quán hé shēn xīn jiàn kāng yě yǒu wèn tí — 1B-2 (my answer): They may have to cook and work by themselves, have no help with study, and have safety and physical and mental health problems.

examples.text: 二零一八年，中国农村留守儿童有九百多万。百分之三十的留守儿童一年只能见到父母一到两次，百分之十五的留守儿童甚至一年也见不到父母一次。由于父母长期不在身边，留守儿童要面对安全、身心健康、教育、甚至是基本生活的难题。近百分之九十的留守儿童和爷爷奶奶生活在一起，爷爷奶奶们年龄比较大，有些身体也不太好。孩子们不仅要照顾自己，有时还要照顾比自己还小的弟弟妹妹们。很多爷爷奶奶也没有读过什么书，大部分连小学都没有读完。而随着孩子一天天长大，在学习和生活上的困难越来越多，爷爷奶奶很难给他们需要的帮助。有些留守儿童甚至根本没有人照顾，他们的安全、教育和身心健康都是急需解决的问题。
examples.translation: èr líng yī bā nián zhōng guó nóng cūn liú shǒu ér tóng yǒu jiǔ bǎi duō wàn bǎi fēn zhī sān shí de liú shǒu ér tóng yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn dào fù mǔ yí dào liǎng cì bǎi fēn zhī shí wǔ de liú shǒu ér tóng shèn zhì yì nián yě jiàn bú dào fù mǔ yí cì yóu yú fù mǔ cháng qī bú zài shēn biān liú shǒu ér tóng yào miàn duì ān quán shēn xīn jiàn kāng jiào yù shèn zhì shì jī běn shēng huó de nán tí jìn bǎi fēn zhī jiǔ shí de liú shǒu ér tóng hé yé yé nǎi nǎi shēng huó zài yì qǐ yé yé nǎi nǎi men nián líng bǐ jiào dà yǒu xiē shēn tǐ yě bú tài hǎo hái zi men bù jǐn yào zhào gù zì jǐ yǒu shí hái yào zhào gù bǐ zì jǐ hái xiǎo de dì di mèi mèi men hěn duō yé yé nǎi nǎi yě méi yǒu dú guò shén me shū dà bù fèn lián xiǎo xué dōu méi yǒu dú wán ér suí zhe hái zi yì tiān tiān zhǎng dà zài xué xí hé shēng huó shàng de kùn nán yuè lái yuè duō yé yé nǎi nǎi hěn nán gěi tā men xū yào de bāng zhù yǒu xiē liú shǒu ér tóng shèn zhì gēn běn méi yǒu rén zhào gù tā men de ān quán jiào yù hé shēn xīn jiàn kāng dōu shì jí xū jiě jué de wèn tí — Activity 1C: In 2018 China had more than 9 million rural left-behind children. 30 percent of them can see their parents only one or two times a year, and 15 percent cannot even see their parents once a year. Because their parents are away for a long time, left-behind children face difficulties of safety, physical and mental health, education, and even basic living. Nearly 90 percent live with their grandparents, who are relatively old, and some are not in good health. The children not only have to look after themselves, but sometimes also after younger brothers and sisters. Many grandparents have not read much either, and most did not even finish primary school. As the children grow up day by day, their difficulties in study and life increase, and it is hard for the grandparents to give them the help they need. Some left-behind children even have nobody at all to look after them, and their safety, education and physical and mental health are problems in urgent need of solving. (the book writes 2018, 900, 30%, 15% and 90% in digits; translation mine)

examples.text: 安全，身心健康，教育，基本生活。
examples.translation: ān quán shēn xīn jiàn kāng jiào yù jī běn shēng huó — Activity 1C, difficulties (my answer): 1. Safety. 2. Physical and mental health. 3. Education and basic living.

examples.text: 爷爷奶奶年龄比较大，身体也不太好，没有读过什么书，很难给孩子需要的帮助。
examples.translation: yé yé nǎi nǎi nián líng bǐ jiào dà shēn tǐ yě bú tài hǎo méi yǒu dú guò shén me shū hěn nán gěi hái zi xū yào de bāng zhù — (my note) The grandparents are old, in poor health and little educated, so it is hard for them to give the children the help they need.

lessons.title: 771. Lesson 29 Presentation 3 skill integration: a father’s dilemma and a free summer class
lessons.subtitle: 李正华 · 不放心 · 玩电脑游戏 · 挣钱就带不了孩子 · 金花村 · 暑假兴趣班 · 村长

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Read the passage and check your understanding with your partner, then discuss possible solutions for the problem described. The passage and my sample:

examples.text: 李正华和太太在重庆市打工好几年了，他们在农村老家有一个上五年级的儿子，儿子从小就跟着爷爷奶奶长大。李正华对记者说：“让儿子在家里我们不放心，让他到城里来我们又没有时间照顾他。”他说，儿子读书的学校离家只有二十分钟，上一二年级的时候，儿子每天一放学就回家，可到四年级的时候，每天放学好几个小时以后才回家。原来，儿子每天放学后都到同学家里去玩儿电脑游戏。儿子说：“回家以后没什么好玩的，跟爷爷奶奶也没什么话说，只能跟同学玩儿。”李正华说：“我们也没有办法，带孩子就挣不了钱，挣钱就带不了孩子。”学校的老师也对记者说，学校一般下午两三点就放学了，大部分孩子都不回家，聚在一起玩游戏。
examples.translation: lǐ zhèng huá hé tài tài zài chóng qìng shì dǎ gōng hǎo jǐ nián le tā men zài nóng cūn lǎo jiā yǒu yí gè shàng wǔ nián jí de ér zi ér zi cóng xiǎo jiù gēn zhe yé yé nǎi nǎi zhǎng dà lǐ zhèng huá duì jì zhě shuō ràng ér zi zài jiā lǐ wǒ men bú fàng xīn ràng tā dào chéng lǐ lái wǒ men yòu méi yǒu shí jiān zhào gù tā tā shuō ér zi dú shū de xué xiào lí jiā zhǐ yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng shàng yī èr nián jí de shí hòu ér zi měi tiān yí fàng xué jiù huí jiā kě dào sì nián jí de shí hòu měi tiān fàng xué hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí yǐ hòu cái huí jiā yuán lái ér zi měi tiān fàng xué hòu dōu dào tóng xué jiā lǐ qù wánr diàn nǎo yóu xì ér zi shuō huí jiā yǐ hòu méi shén me hǎo wán de gēn yé yé nǎi nǎi yě méi shén me huà shuō zhǐ néng gēn tóng xué wánr lǐ zhèng huá shuō wǒ men yě méi yǒu bàn fǎ dài hái zi jiù zhèng bù liǎo qián zhèng qián jiù dài bù liǎo hái zi xué xiào de lǎo shī yě duì jì zhě shuō xué xiào yì bān xià wǔ liǎng sān diǎn jiù fàng xué le dà bù fèn hái zi dōu bù huí jiā jù zài yì qǐ wán yóu xì — Activity 3: Li Zhenghua and his wife have worked in Chongqing for several years. In their rural hometown they have a fifth-grade son, who has grown up with his grandparents since childhood. Li Zhenghua told a reporter: “Leaving our son at home we don’t feel at ease; bringing him to the city we have no time to look after him.” He said the school where his son studies is only twenty minutes from home. In first and second grade the son came home as soon as school was out, but by fourth grade he came home several hours after school. It turned out that every day after school the son went to a classmate’s home to play computer games. The son said: “After I get home there is nothing fun, and I have nothing to say to my grandparents, so I can only play with classmates.” Li Zhenghua said: “We have no way out either: if we take care of the child, we can’t earn money; if we earn money, we can’t take care of the child.” The school’s teacher also told the reporter that school generally lets out at two or three in the afternoon and most children don’t go home but gather to play games. (translation mine)

examples.text: 可以请学校的老师在放学以后组织一些活动，让孩子有事做；也可以让爷爷奶奶多跟孩子聊天，或者让孩子到爸爸妈妈打工的城市上学。
examples.translation: kě yǐ qǐng xué xiào de lǎo shī zài fàng xué yǐ hòu zǔ zhī yì xiē huó dòng ràng hái zi yǒu shì zuò yě kě yǐ ràng yé yé nǎi nǎi duō gēn hái zi liáo tiān huò zhě ràng hái zi dào bà bà mā mā dǎ gōng de chéng shì shàng xué — Activity 3, possible solutions (my sample; the book gives no key): The school’s teachers could organize activities after school so children have something to do; the grandparents could talk with the child more, or the child could go to school in the city where the parents work.

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 4 (Speaking, Listening and Reading)
explanations.body: A. In groups of three, discuss the following questions. 1. How do the 留守儿童 spend their summer vacation? 2. What can the college students do for the 留守儿童 during their summer vacation? B. Read the passage about the summer vacation of 留守儿童 and answer the questions. Compare your answer with your partner and discuss the differences, if any. 1. What specific word in the passage describes the summer vacation of 留守儿童? 2. What caused the problem? 3. What did the college students do for the children? 4. What is the current situation? 5. Describe three ways the author illustrates how the college students bring benefit to the 留守儿童 (Direct narration / Example / Quotation). The passage and my answers:

examples.text: 金花村位于重庆山区，这里有很多留守儿童。每次到暑假的时候，孩子们的生活都很没有意思，爷爷奶奶没有办法在学习上帮助他们，更不能带他们去游玩。几年前，重庆大学的几个学生在这里开办了一个免费的留守儿童兴趣班。到现在，重庆大学已经有二百名学生参加了这个活动，附近的二十三个村子都有了免费的暑假兴趣班。孩子们不仅暑假生活更丰富，而且学习上也有了进步。村里有一个叫李晴的孩子，他的爸爸妈妈都在很远的城市打工。六年前他开始参加村里的暑假兴趣班，从那时候起，他就喜欢上了英语，觉得学好英语就可以了解外面的世界。今年高考，李晴考上了四川外语学院。村长说，因为这些大学生，村里很多孩子都有了上大学的愿望。
examples.translation: jīn huā cūn wèi yú chóng qìng shān qū zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō liú shǒu ér tóng měi cì dào shǔ jià de shí hòu hái zi men de shēng huó dōu hěn méi yǒu yì si yé yé nǎi nǎi méi yǒu bàn fǎ zài xué xí shàng bāng zhù tā men gèng bù néng dài tā men qù yóu wán jǐ nián qián chóng qìng dà xué de jǐ gè xué shēng zài zhè lǐ kāi bàn le yí gè miǎn fèi de liú shǒu ér tóng xìng qù bān dào xiàn zài chóng qìng dà xué yǐ jīng yǒu èr bǎi míng xué shēng cān jiā le zhè ge huó dòng fù jìn de èr shí sān gè cūn zi dōu yǒu le miǎn fèi de shǔ jià xìng qù bān hái zi men bù jǐn shǔ jià shēng huó gèng fēng fù ér qiě xué xí shàng yě yǒu le jìn bù cūn lǐ yǒu yí gè jiào lǐ qíng de hái zi tā de bà bà mā mā dōu zài hěn yuǎn de chéng shì dǎ gōng liù nián qián tā kāi shǐ cān jiā cūn lǐ de shǔ jià xìng qù bān cóng nà shí hòu qǐ tā jiù xǐ huān shàng le yīng yǔ jué de xué hǎo yīng yǔ jiù kě yǐ liǎo jiě wài miàn de shì jiè jīn nián gāo kǎo lǐ qíng kǎo shàng le sì chuān wài yǔ xué yuàn cūn zhǎng shuō yīn wèi zhè xiē dà xué shēng cūn lǐ hěn duō hái zi dōu yǒu le shàng dà xué de yuàn wàng — Activity 4B: Jinhua Village is in the mountain area of Chongqing, and there are many left-behind children here. Every summer vacation the children’s life is very boring; the grandparents have no way to help them with study, much less take them out to play. A few years ago, several students of Chongqing University set up a free interest class for left-behind children here. By now 200 Chongqing University students have taken part in this activity, and 23 nearby villages have free summer interest classes. The children not only have a richer summer vacation but also progress in their studies. A child in the village called Li Qing has parents who both work in a far-away city. Six years ago he began to attend the village summer interest class, and since then he has come to like English, feeling that learning English well lets one understand the outside world. This year in the gaokao Li Qing was admitted to Sichuan International Studies University. The village head says that because of these university students many children in the village now have the wish to go to university. (the book writes 200 and 23 in digits; translation mine)

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 5 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the story about a futsal team and answer the questions. 1. Why is this futsal team special? 2. What did they achieve, and why? 3. Why were the two boys outstanding? 4. What opportunity was offered to them? B. Pair up. Each partner listens to one part of the story and tells their partner about it (Part 1 and Part 2 are audio, so no key). C. Imagine the two boys’ life in 10 years. Share your thoughts with the class. The story and my answers:

examples.text: 这是一所普通的农村小学，但是有一个很特别的足球队。球队的十三个队员都是留守儿童，教练是不太懂足球的数学老师。但是，他们赢过很多专业球队，两次在全国比赛得到第二名。专家们都说，这些孩子能赢，主要是因为太能吃苦，太能跑了。因为有足球特长，这些孩子有了一个新的机会：到城里的中学读书。最让人高兴的是，球队的两名队员——国林和云丰被评为全国最优秀小球员，城里一所有名的中学请他们免费上学。
examples.translation: zhè shì yì suǒ pǔ tōng de nóng cūn xiǎo xué dàn shì yǒu yí gè hěn tè bié de zú qiú duì qiú duì de shí sān gè duì yuán dōu shì liú shǒu ér tóng jiào liàn shì bú tài dǒng zú qiú de shù xué lǎo shī dàn shì tā men yíng guò hěn duō zhuān yè qiú duì liǎng cì zài quán guó bǐ sài dé dào dì èr míng zhuān jiā men dōu shuō zhè xiē hái zi néng yíng zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi tài néng chī kǔ tài néng pǎo le yīn wèi yǒu zú qiú tè cháng zhè xiē hái zi yǒu le yí gè xīn de jī huì dào chéng lǐ de zhōng xué dú shū zuì ràng rén gāo xìng de shì qiú duì de liǎng míng duì yuán guó lín hé yún fēng bèi píng wéi quán guó zuì yōu xiù xiǎo qiú yuán chéng lǐ yì suǒ yǒu míng de zhōng xué qǐng tā men miǎn fèi shàng xué — Activity 5A: This is an ordinary rural elementary school, but it has a very special futsal team. The team’s thirteen players are all left-behind children, and the coach is a math teacher who doesn’t know much about soccer. But they have beaten many professional teams and twice won second place in national competitions. The experts all say that these children can win mainly because they can endure hardship so well and can run so much. Because of their soccer talent, these children have a new opportunity: to study at a middle school in the city. Most gratifying of all, two players of the team, Guolin and Yunfeng, were named the best young players in the country, and a famous city middle school invited them to study for free. (the book writes 13 in digits and joins the dash as “--”; translation mine)

examples.text: 球队的十三个队员都是留守儿童，教练是不太懂足球的数学老师。
examples.translation: qiú duì de shí sān gè duì yuán dōu shì liú shǒu ér tóng jiào liàn shì bú tài dǒng zú qiú de shù xué lǎo shī — Activity 5A-1 (my answers; the book gives none): The team’s thirteen players are all left-behind children, and the coach is a math teacher who doesn’t know much about soccer.

examples.text: 他们赢过很多专业球队，两次在全国比赛得到第二名，因为他们太能吃苦，太能跑了。
examples.translation: tā men yíng guò hěn duō zhuān yè qiú duì liǎng cì zài quán guó bǐ sài dé dào dì èr míng yīn wèi tā men tài néng chī kǔ tài néng pǎo le — 5A-2: They beat many professional teams and twice won second place in national matches, because they can endure hardship and run a lot.

examples.text: 因为国林和云丰被评为全国最优秀小球员。
examples.translation: yīn wèi guó lín hé yún fēng bèi píng wéi quán guó zuì yōu xiù xiǎo qiú yuán — 5A-3: Because Guolin and Yunfeng were named the best young players in the country.

examples.text: 城里一所有名的中学请他们免费上学。
examples.translation: chéng lǐ yì suǒ yǒu míng de zhōng xué qǐng tā men miǎn fèi shàng xué — 5A-4: A famous city middle school invited them to study for free.

examples.text: 十年以后，他们可能成了专业的足球运动员，也可能上了大学。
examples.translation: shí nián yǐ hòu tā men kě néng chéng le zhuān yè de zú qiú yùn dòng yuán yě kě néng shàng le dà xué — 5C (my imagining; the book gives none): In ten years they might be professional football players, or might have gone to university.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Using what you learned thus far, discuss with your partner who 农民工 are. What are the difficulties they face? List them below (the book gives two empty lines: 什么是农民工, 他们有哪些困难). B. Read the short passage and determine what is missing in your discussion. What is missing? (The book gives no key.)

examples.text: 农民工就是那些从农村到城市打工的人，他们大多数是从中国的中部和西部贫穷的地区到东部经济发达的地区工作。到二零一八年，中国的农民工超过二点八亿。农民工的教育水平比较低，干的都是城里人不愿意做的最苦最累的活儿。他们是城市中工作条件最差，收入最低的人。他们很难和家人生活在一起，也不能照顾留在农村的老人和孩子。有的农民工把孩子带到城市，但是，这些孩子都面对在城里上学难，上学贵的困难。
examples.translation: nóng mín gōng jiù shì nà xiē cóng nóng cūn dào chéng shì dǎ gōng de rén tā men dà duō shù shì cóng zhōng guó de zhōng bù hé xī bù pín qióng de dì qū dào dōng bù jīng jì fā dá de dì qū gōng zuò dào èr líng yī bā nián zhōng guó de nóng mín gōng chāo guò èr diǎn bā yì nóng mín gōng de jiào yù shuǐ píng bǐ jiào dī gàn de dōu shì chéng lǐ rén bú yuàn yì zuò de zuì kǔ zuì lèi de huór tā men shì chéng shì zhōng gōng zuò tiáo jiàn zuì chà shōu rù zuì dī de rén tā men hěn nán hé jiā rén shēng huó zài yì qǐ yě bù néng zhào gù liú zài nóng cūn de lǎo rén hé hái zi yǒu de nóng mín gōng bǎ hái zi dài dào chéng shì dàn shì zhè xiē hái zi dōu miàn duì zài chéng lǐ shàng xué nán shàng xué guì de kùn nán — Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1B: Migrant workers (农民工) are people who go from the countryside to cities to work. Most of them go from the poor central and western regions of China to work in the economically developed eastern regions. By 2018 China’s migrant workers numbered more than 280 million. Their education level is relatively low, and the work they do is the hardest and most tiring work city people don’t want to do. They are the people with the worst working conditions and lowest incomes in the city. It is hard for them to live with their families, and they cannot look after the old people and children left in the countryside. Some migrant workers bring their children to the city, but these children all face the difficulties of schooling in the city being hard and expensive. (the book writes 2018 and 2.8 in digits; translation mine)

lessons.title: 773. Lesson 29 Presentation 3 using Chinese in context: should a young teacher go to a migrant children’s school?
lessons.subtitle: 流动儿童学校 · 工资比较低 · 校工 · 十平米 · 待遇 · 留住好老师 · 让打工者的孩子不再打工

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 2 (Reading, Listening, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the question a young teacher posted online. In groups of three, discuss how you would answer his question. List the reasons you support or oppose his idea using your understanding of the migrant children’s school. Are you for or against his idea? Your reasons: B. Each member offers answers and lists the reasons why they are for or against his proposal. (The three answers follow; the book gives For/Against Reasons tables for each.) C. Tell your partners about your passage. As a group you will: 1. List the three answers in order of how strongly they support his idea. 2. What are the main reasons for supporting his idea? 3. What are the main reasons for arguing against his idea? 4. Why do you support or argue against his idea? (The three small photos are not included.) The question, the three answers and my notes:

examples.text: 我当老师已经几年了，最近我想去一所流动儿童学校教书，我一直都很想帮助那些孩子。但是我也知道这样的学校工资都比较低。我也到了结婚的年龄，应该存一点钱了。你们觉得我应该去吗？
examples.translation: wǒ dāng lǎo shī yǐ jīng jǐ nián le zuì jìn wǒ xiǎng qù yì suǒ liú dòng ér tóng xué xiào jiāo shū wǒ yì zhí dōu hěn xiǎng bāng zhù nà xiē hái zi dàn shì wǒ yě zhī dào zhè yàng de xué xiào gōng zī dōu bǐ jiào dī wǒ yě dào le jié hūn de nián líng yīng gāi cún yì diǎn qián le nǐ men jué de wǒ yīng gāi qù ma — Activity 2A: I have been a teacher for several years. Recently I want to go teach at a migrant children’s school; I have always very much wanted to help those children. But I also know that the pay at such schools is quite low. I have also reached marrying age and should save a little money. Do you think I should go? (translation mine)

examples.text: 我就是从流动儿童学校毕业的。说真的，学校的条件太差了，学生对学习的要求也不高。但是那里的校长和老师都很好，我自己到现在都很感谢我的语文老师，是她给我的生活打开了一个窗口。我们班有很多同学的家庭环境都很差，但我觉得你应该去完成自己的理想。而且，有很多孩子需要像你这样有爱心的老师。
examples.translation: wǒ jiù shì cóng liú dòng ér tóng xué xiào bì yè de shuō zhēn de xué xiào de tiáo jiàn tài chà le xué shēng duì xué xí de yāo qiú yě bù gāo dàn shì nà lǐ de xiào zhǎng hé lǎo shī dōu hěn hǎo wǒ zì jǐ dào xiàn zài dōu hěn gǎn xiè wǒ de yǔ wén lǎo shī shì tā gěi wǒ de shēng huó dǎ kāi le yí gè chuāng kǒu wǒ men bān yǒu hěn duō tóng xué de jiā tíng huán jìng dōu hěn chà dàn wǒ jué de nǐ yīng gāi qù wán chéng zì jǐ de lǐ xiǎng ér qiě yǒu hěn duō hái zi xū yào xiàng nǐ zhè yàng yǒu ài xīn de lǎo shī — Activity 2B, 1: I graduated from a migrant children’s school myself. Honestly, the school’s conditions were very poor, and the students’ demands on their studies were not high either. But the principal and teachers there were all very good; I still thank my Chinese teacher to this day, for it was she who opened a window onto life for me. Many of my classmates had very poor family backgrounds, but I think you should go and fulfil your own ideal. Besides, many children need a teacher with a loving heart like you. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我就在这样一所学校当校工。有人愿意为农民工的孩子做点儿事我很高兴，但是我想告诉你，这里的厕所很脏，教师宿舍非常小，只有十平米左右。班主任的工资每个月只有四千多元，一般老师就更低了。相比起来，一般学校的老师平均每年有十万元的工资。这样的待遇根本不可能留住好老师，很多老师来教几个月就走了。所以你要好好想一想再做决定。
examples.translation: wǒ jiù zài zhè yàng yì suǒ xué xiào dāng xiào gōng yǒu rén yuàn yì wèi nóng mín gōng de hái zi zuò diǎnr shì wǒ hěn gāo xìng dàn shì wǒ xiǎng gào sù nǐ zhè lǐ de cè suǒ hěn zāng jiào shī sù shè fēi cháng xiǎo zhǐ yǒu shí píng mǐ zuǒ yòu bān zhǔ rèn de gōng zī měi gè yuè zhǐ yǒu sì qiān duō yuán yì bān lǎo shī jiù gèng dī le xiāng bǐ qǐ lái yì bān xué xiào de lǎo shī píng jūn měi nián yǒu shí wàn yuán de gōng zī zhè yàng de dài yù gēn běn bù kě néng liú zhù hǎo lǎo shī hěn duō lǎo shī lái jiāo jǐ gè yuè jiù zǒu le suǒ yǐ nǐ yào hǎo hǎo xiǎng yì xiǎng zài zuò jué dìng — 2: I work as a school custodian at such a school. I’m glad someone is willing to do something for migrant workers’ children, but I want to tell you that the toilets here are very dirty, the teachers’ dormitories are very small, only about ten square meters. A homeroom teacher’s pay is only a little over 4,000 yuan a month, and ordinary teachers earn even less. By comparison, teachers at ordinary schools average 100,000 yuan a year. Such treatment simply cannot keep good teachers; many teachers leave after teaching a few months. So think it over carefully before deciding. (the book writes 4000 and 10 万 in digits; translation mine)

examples.text: 农民工辛辛苦苦地工作，就是想要孩子以后能过得比自己好。我看到一所学校的大门上写着“让打工者的孩子不再打工”，可是农民工子弟学校的教学质量这么差，他们的孩子怎么可能有好的前途？那些孩子学习都不太努力，反正中学一毕业就要跟父母一样去打工。那些孩子不好教，而且老师的工资也确实不高，所以只能是尊重你自己的选择。但说真的，我真的希望有人能好好教那些孩子，给他们希望。
examples.translation: nóng mín gōng xīn xīn kǔ kǔ de gōng zuò jiù shì xiǎng yào hái zi yǐ hòu néng guò de bǐ zì jǐ hǎo wǒ kàn dào yì suǒ xué xiào de dà mén shàng xiě zhe ràng dǎ gōng zhě de hái zi bú zài dǎ gōng kě shì nóng mín gōng zǐ dì xué xiào de jiào xué zhì liàng zhè me chà tā men de hái zi zěn me kě néng yǒu hǎo de qián tú nà xiē hái zi xué xí dōu bú tài nǔ lì fǎn zhèng zhōng xué yí bì yè jiù yào gēn fù mǔ yí yàng qù dǎ gōng nà xiē hái zi bù hǎo jiāo ér qiě lǎo shī de gōng zī yě què shí bù gāo suǒ yǐ zhǐ néng shì zūn zhòng nǐ zì jǐ de xuǎn zé dàn shuō zhēn de wǒ zhēn de xī wàng yǒu rén néng hǎo hǎo jiāo nà xiē hái zi gěi tā men xī wàng — 3: Migrant workers work hard precisely because they want their children to live better than themselves. I saw on the gate of a school the words “Let the children of workers no longer be workers,” but the teaching quality at migrant workers’ children’s schools is so poor; how could their children have a good future? Those children don’t study very hard anyway, since as soon as middle school ends they will go to work like their parents. Those children are not easy to teach, and teachers’ pay really is not high, so I can only respect your own choice. But honestly, I really hope someone will teach those children well and give them hope. (translation mine)

examples.text: 支持：他可以帮助很需要老师的孩子，完成自己的理想。反对：工资太低，条件很差，他也应该存钱结婚。
examples.translation: zhī chí tā kě yǐ bāng zhù hěn xū yào lǎo shī de hái zi wán chéng zì jǐ de lǐ xiǎng fǎn duì gōng zī tài dī tiáo jiàn hěn chà tā yě yīng gāi cún qián jié hūn — Activity 2A (my notes; the book leaves lines for Are you for or against and Your reasons): For: he can help children who greatly need teachers and fulfil his own ideal. Against: the pay is too low, conditions are poor, and he should also save money for marriage.

examples.text: 第一个人最支持，第三个人比较犹豫，第二个人最不支持。
examples.translation: dì yī gè rén zuì zhī chí dì sān gè rén bǐ jiào yóu yù dì èr gè rén zuì bù zhī chí — Activity 2C-1 (my order of strength of support, strongest first; the book gives none): the first writer supports most, the third is hesitant, and the second supports least.

options: Teach at a migrant children’s school

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activities 3 to 6
explanations.body: The tasks of Activities 3 to 6 and the two reading passages with my notes:

headers: Task (the answers to these are audio, video or discussion; the book gives no key)
rows: A. Do you think it’s better to have the children of migrant workers and children from the city attend the same schools, or should they be separated? In groups of three, discuss the possible benefits and drawbacks. B. Read the following passage and add the information to your notes above.

A. In groups of three, discuss, in Chinese, the possible reasons for the low performance of the students in 农民工子弟学校. B. Each member listens to one of the three online chats about this problem and writes the main ideas that they hear (audio). C. Tell your partners about what you hear. Discuss what you agree with and do not agree with. D. Read the following passage to learn additional reasons for the low performance of the migrant students and discuss the reasons why the city has a restrictive policy towards them.

Pair up and discuss the following questions with your partner. 1. What difficulties do children experience if they don’t live with any parents? 2. Share your opinions of these situations with the class.

A. Watch a video about 留守儿童 and think about the following questions. 1. What were peasants’ lives like in China before modern times? 2. How did they change later? 3. How did the 留守儿童 emerge? 4. What is life currently like for Tang Yuwen? 5. What did he do when his parents came back? 6. What’s his biggest wish now? 7. What does he want to do when he grows up? B. In groups of three, share what you think about 留守儿童’s situation and the impact their situation will have on their growth. (The video is not included.)
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activities 3 to 6

examples.text: 我们学校以前全是城里的学生，后来到这里打工的人越来越多，我们就开始收一些农民工的孩子。一是想帮助这些孩子，二是可以增加学校的收入。但是问题来了，那些从农村来的学生，他们的学习比城市学生要差得多。如果一个班的农村学生超过百分之三十，老师上课就很困难了，一个班的教学质量都会下降。有些城市家长对学校很不满意，就会让自己孩子转到别的学校去。所以，城市学生渐渐离开，现在，我们学校全是农民工的孩子了。

examples.text: 在所有的大城市中，上海是对农民工比较友好的，住在市区的农民工子女大多可以进入公办学校。但是，当一所公办学校开始接受农民工子女的时候，原有的城市学生常常会离开这所学校，最后，这些学校有百分之八十到九十的学生都是农民工子女。在沪城中学，每个年级有五个班，其中一个班全部是农民工子女。在初中一二年级的时候，这个班的平均成绩一直是全年级的第二三名，也就是说，这些流动儿童的学习成绩超过了一半或一半以上的城市学生。但是到了初中三年级，这个班的平均成绩变成了全年级的最后一名。主要的原因是，农民工子女不能在上海参加中考，就是初中升高中的考试。到了初中的最后一年，他们只好回到农村老家上学。如果继续留在上海，初中毕业以后只能上职业中学。而且，职业中学虽然有很多专业，但只有三个专业让农民工子女选择：厨师、酒店服务、技工。也就是说，从职业中学毕业以后，这些孩子只能跟父母一样，在饭店、旅馆、工厂做一些低收入的工作。看不到希望的学生们也就失去了学习的兴趣和动力。

But when a public school starts to admit migrant children, the original city students often leave, and in the end these schools have 80 to 90 percent migrant children. At Hucheng Middle School each grade has five classes, one of which is entirely migrant children. In the first and second years of junior high, this class’s average score was always second or third in the grade; that is, these migrant children’s grades surpassed half or more than half of the city students. But in the third year of junior high, the class’s average score became last in the grade. The main reason is that migrant children cannot take the zhongkao, the high-school entrance exam, in Shanghai. In the last year of junior high they have no choice but to go back to their rural hometowns to study. If they stay in Shanghai, after junior high they can only go to vocational schools. Moreover, although vocational schools have many majors, only three are open to migrant children: cook, hotel service, and skilled worker. That is, after graduating from vocational school these children can only, like their parents, do low-income jobs in restaurants, hotels and factories. Students who can’t see hope also lose their interest and drive in studying. (the book writes 80-90% in digits; translation mine)

lessons.title: 776. Lesson 29 Area Studies: China’s Education
lessons.subtitle: 夏朝 · 西周 · 国学和乡学 · 太学 · 九年义务教育 · 小班 中班 大班 · 教育经费

explanations.title: China’s Education: from ancient schools to the People’s Republic
explanations.body: China was the first country in the world to have a complete educational system. According to historic record, as early as the Xia Dynasty (夏朝 2070–1600 BC) China had schools. There were two types of schools in the Western Zhou Dynasty (西周 1046–771 BC): 国学 and 乡学. 国学 was established in the capital of the Western Zhou Dynasty and the capitals of the feudal states. 国学 was divided into “universities” and “elementary schools.” Only the children of slave owners and nobles could enter 国学. 乡学 was set up in various places for the children of ordinary slave owners and nobles to study. The earliest institution of higher learning in ancient times was 太学 in the Western Han Dynasty (西汉 202 BC–9 AD). Emperor Wu (汉武帝) of the Western Han Dynasty accepted the advice of the famous thinker and master of classics Dong Zhongshu (董仲舒) and founded 太学 in 长安 (now 西安), the capital of the country in Han Dynasty. However, it was not until the end of the Qing Dynasty (清朝 1644–1912) that schools with modern education methods began to appear in China. After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, the undertaking of education has been further developed.

explanations.title: Compulsory education and higher education
explanations.body: Since 1986, China has implemented nine years of compulsory education, including six years of elementary school and three years of junior high school for students between the ages of 6 and 15. In 2010, about 82.5% of students would choose to continue their three-year high school education. The government-sponsored national examination for general higher education institutions is a prerequisite for entering most higher education institutions. In 2010, 27% of senior high school graduates will continue to receive four years of undergraduate education. Additionally, postgraduate education is also provided, and the government has established intermediate and advanced technical schools to provide students with vocational education.

explanations.title: Administration, school numbers and literacy
explanations.body: The education of the People’s Republic of China is under the supervision of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. The provincial people’s governments set up education departments, and lower-level institutions set up education bureaus to manage local educational affairs. In 2019, China has a total of 161,811 elementary schools, 51,982 junior high schools, 13,737 senior high schools, 10,299 secondary vocational schools, 2,663 regular colleges and universities, and 1,418 higher vocational colleges. As of 2015, the literacy rate of the population over the age of 15 is 96.4% (males 98.2%, females 94.5%). In contrast, in 1950 the literacy rate was only 20% of the population.

explanations.title: Preschool education
explanations.body: Preschool education in China generally starts at the age of three, in kindergarten. Preschool education in China is generally divided into three stages: lower classes (小班 3–4 years old), middle classes (中班 4–5 years old), and upper classes (大班 5–6 years old). In some kindergartens and elementary schools, there are also “preschools” to educate children under the age of 6 to adapt to school life. Life in kindergarten consists of many learning activities and educational games, with three meals a day. Preschool is similar to school, but the time is shorter and there are more outdoor activities.

explanations.title: Spending on education and the urban-rural gap
explanations.body: China’s spending on education remained above 4 percent of the gross domestic product (GDP) in 2018. That year, public spending on education in China reached 3.49 billion yuan (as printed; a national total would be in trillions, so this looks like a slip in the book). Even though educational spending in China improved a lot in the last decades, when calculated per student, expenditure is still far behind developed countries. While spending per student on education in OECD countries averaged nearly $15,600 U.S. in 2016, it reached only $5,300 U.S. per student in China in 2018, which is less than one third of that spent by other developed countries. This fact sheds some light on the average quality of the educational system in China and reminds us that China is an extremely large and populous country. In China some elite schools in the big cities coexist with vast numbers of schools in the countryside operating on a completely different level of quality. For this reason, in China’s big cities, more than 70% of students can go to college. In contrast, less than 5 percent of students in poor rural areas can go to college. Therefore, China still has a long way to go before it can provide the best education for every student in the country, despite the great progress that has been made in the past decades.

examples.text: 利用网路平台订餐很容易，你得先下单，然后确认你的信息，付款后，他们还会给你发送电子发票。餐点送到前你还可以定位追踪，这样的智能科技给我们的生活带来了很大的便利。
examples.translation: lì yòng wǎng lù píng tái dìng cān hěn róng yì nǐ děi xiān xià dān rán hòu què rèn nǐ de xìn xī fù kuǎn hòu tā men hái huì gěi nǐ fā sòng diàn zi fā piào cān diǎn sòng dào qián nǐ hái kě yǐ dìng wèi zhuī zōng zhè yàng de zhì néng kē jì gěi wǒ men de shēng huó dài lái le hěn dà de biàn lì — Passage 1 (completed; my key): Ordering meals through an online platform is easy: you first place the order and then confirm your information, and after you pay they also send you an electronic invoice. Before the food arrives you can also locate and track it; such smart technology has brought great convenience to our lives. (the book writes 网路 as printed)

examples.text: 为了让自己更有优势，以后能找到理想的工作，很多人选择出国留学。但是由于在国外念书还得适应国外的生活，所以比较辛苦，特别是年纪小的留学生，所以有些父母会跟着孩子到国外去陪读，照顾他们。
examples.translation: wèi le ràng zì jǐ gèng yǒu yōu shì yǐ hòu néng zhǎo dào lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò hěn duō rén xuǎn zé chū guó liú xué dàn shì yóu yú zài guó wài niàn shū hái děi shì yìng guó wài de shēng huó suǒ yǐ bǐ jiào xīn kǔ tè bié shì nián jì xiǎo de liú xué shēng suǒ yǐ yǒu xiē fù mǔ huì gēn zhe hái zi dào guó wài qù péi dú zhào gù tā men — Passage 2: To have more of an advantage and later find an ideal job, many people choose to study abroad. But since studying abroad also means adapting to life abroad, it is rather hard, especially for young students, so some parents follow their children abroad to accompany their studies and look after them.

examples.text: 中国的父母相信，孩子有好的教育才会有好的将来，因此很重视孩子的学习成绩，除了想办法让孩子去好的学区读书，下课后送孩子补习以外，为了培养孩子的特长，还送孩子去上各种兴趣班，所以在中国父母和孩子的压力都很大。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de fù mǔ xiāng xìn hái zi yǒu hǎo de jiào yù cái huì yǒu hǎo de jiāng lái yīn cǐ hěn zhòng shì hái zi de xué xí chéng jì chú le xiǎng bàn fǎ ràng hái zi qù hǎo de xué qū dú shū xià kè hòu sòng hái zi bǔ xí yǐ wài wèi le péi yǎng hái zi de tè cháng hái sòng hái zi qù shàng gè zhǒng xìng qù bān suǒ yǐ zài zhōng guó fù mǔ hé hái zi de yā lì dōu hěn dà — Passage 3: Chinese parents believe that children will have a good future only with a good education, so they value children’s grades; besides finding ways to get their children into a good school district and sending them to tutoring after class, to cultivate their children’s special talents they also send them to all kinds of interest classes, so in China both parents and children are under great pressure.

examples.text: 九零后、零零后出生的孩子多半是独生子女，这一代人由于学习条件比较好，而且从小生活在信息发达的世界，所以能力强，目标高，在想法上也比较先进，他们不满足于传统的工作，觉得要做就要做最好的，所以很多人自己创业，当上了老板。
examples.translation: jiǔ líng hòu líng líng hòu chū shēng de hái zi duō bàn shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ zhè yí dài rén yóu yú xué xí tiáo jiàn bǐ jiào hǎo ér qiě cóng xiǎo shēng huó zài xìn xī fā dá de shì jiè suǒ yǐ néng lì qiáng mù biāo gāo zài xiǎng fǎ shàng yě bǐ jiào xiān jìn tā men bù mǎn zú yú chuán tǒng de gōng zuò jué de yào zuò jiù yào zuò zuì hǎo de suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén zì jǐ chuàng yè dāng shàng le lǎo bǎn — Passage 4: Most children born in the 1990s and 2000s are only children. Because their learning conditions are rather good and they grew up in a world of advanced information, this generation is capable, has high goals and is also rather progressive in its thinking; they are not content with traditional jobs, feeling that if they do something they should do it best, so many start their own businesses and become bosses. (the book writes 90 后 and 00 后 with digits)

examples.text: 网红是现在很热门的新职业。他们在网上直播，和粉丝互动，粉丝会打赏他们，他们还可以带货，所以很多人靠这个赚钱。
examples.translation: wǎng hóng shì xiàn zài hěn rè mén de xīn zhí yè tā men zài wǎng shàng zhí bō hé fěn sī hù dòng fěn sī huì dǎ shǎng tā men tā men hái kě yǐ dài huò suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén kào zhè ge zhuàn qián — Activity 3E (my sample paragraph; the book gives only the word list 带货 互动 赚钱 电竞 反应 网红 打赏 职业比赛): Internet celebrity is a very popular new profession today. They live-stream online and interact with fans, the fans tip them, and they can also sell goods, so many people make money this way.

explanations.title: Vocabulary Review, Activity 4 (Listening, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the questions and answer them using your knowledge and what you learned from the presentations (six audio questions, so no key). B. Pair up. Students exchange information in Chinese. C. Listen to the following key sentences from presentations and translate them (eight audio items). D. Pair up. Students take turns saying the sentences in Chinese using their translations from Step C. E. Read the scripts aloud with your partner to confirm your answers. The scripts:

examples.text: 快递员的生活就跟打仗似的，每天要送好几百单，连喝水的时间都没有。
examples.translation: kuài dì yuán de shēng huó jiù gēn dǎ zhàng shì de měi tiān yào sòng hǎo jǐ bǎi dān lián hē shuǐ de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu — Activity 4E, 1 (key sentences from the presentations; translations mine): A courier’s life is just like fighting a battle; he has to deliver several hundred orders a day, with not even time to drink water.

examples.text: “滴滴出行”可以根据乘客需要，提供特别的服务，他们甚至还有代驾服务呢！
examples.translation: dī dī chū xíng kě yǐ gēn jù chéng kè xū yào tí gōng tè bié de fú wù tā men shèn zhì hái yǒu dài jià fú wù ne — 2: DiDi Chuxing can provide special services according to passengers’ needs; they even have a designated-driver service!

examples.text: 只要动动手指，滑动一下页面，看看照片和用户评价，很快就可以选择到满意的民宿。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào dòng dòng shǒu zhǐ huá dòng yí xià yè miàn kàn kàn zhào piān hé yòng hù píng jià hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ xuǎn zé dào mǎn yì de mín sù — 3: Just move your fingers, swipe the page, and look at the photos and user reviews, and you can quickly choose a homestay you are satisfied with.

examples.text: 最近有六百年历史的故宫也在网上直播，让更多的年轻人了解古代文物，爱上传统文化。
examples.translation: zuì jìn yǒu liù bǎi nián lì shǐ de gù gōng yě zài wǎng shàng zhí bō ràng gèng duō de nián qīng rén liǎo jiě gǔ dài wén wù ài shàng chuán tǒng wén huà — 4: Recently the Forbidden City, with six hundred years of history, has also been live-streamed online, letting more young people learn about ancient cultural relics and fall in love with traditional culture.

examples.text: 随着电竞职业的出现，人们认识到电子游戏是一种很好的智力活动，还能训练合作和反应力。
examples.translation: suí zhe diàn jìng zhí yè de chū xiàn rén men rèn shí dào diàn zǐ yóu xì shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de zhì lì huó dòng hái néng xùn liàn hé zuò hé fǎn yìng lì — 5: With the appearance of the e-sports profession, people have come to see that video games are a good mental activity that can also train cooperation and reaction.

examples.text: 你有没有注意到九零后零零后的年轻人排队时不大会加塞儿，坐公交时还主动给老人让座？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhù yì dào jiǔ líng hòu líng líng hòu de nián qīng rén pái duì shí bú dà huì jiā sāir zuò gōng jiāo shí hái zhǔ dòng gěi lǎo rén ràng zuò — 6: Have you noticed that young people born in the 1990s and 2000s don’t often cut in line when queuing and even actively give up their seats to old people on the bus? (the book writes 90 后 00 后 with digits)

examples.text: 培养兴趣对孩子的发展很有好处，而且有了特长，在升学考试的时候还可以加分。
examples.translation: péi yǎng xìng qù duì hái zi de fā zhǎn hěn yǒu hǎo chù ér qiě yǒu le tè cháng zài shēng xué kǎo shì de shí hòu hái kě yǐ jiā fēn — 7: Cultivating interests is very good for a child’s development, and with a special talent one can also gain extra points in entrance exams.

examples.text: 很多父母觉得国内的学习环境比不上国外，所以只要付得起学费、生活费都会把孩子送出国留学。
examples.translation: hěn duō fù mǔ jué de guó nèi de xué xí huán jìng bǐ bú shàng guó wài suǒ yǐ zhǐ yào fù de qǐ xué fèi shēng huó fèi dōu huì bǎ hái zi sòng chū guó liú xué — 8: Many parents feel that the learning environment at home is no match for that abroad, so as long as they can afford the tuition and living costs they will send their child abroad to study.

explanations.title: Vocabulary Review, Activity 5 (Listening, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialogs and answer the questions. Dialog 1: 1. What did the first speaker propose? 2. What was the second speaker’s opinion about the first speaker’s proposal? Dialog 2: 1. What was the first speaker’s comment? 2. How did the second speaker feel about the first speaker’s comment? Dialog 3: 1. What did the parents decide to do? 2. What was the daughter’s opinion? Dialog 4: 1. What problem did the first speaker encounter? 2. What did the second speaker say about the situation? Dialog 5: 1. What did the first speaker think of the second speaker’s job? 2. What was the second speaker’s reply? Dialog 6: 1. What is “Chibo”? 2. What was the second speaker’s comment about it? (The dialogs are audio, so I give no key.) B. Listen to the short passages, paying attention to the connection between each unit of meaning to understand the entire picture, and then translate them (six audio items). Read the scripts aloud to confirm your answers. The scripts:

examples.text: 很多留学生觉得国内的工资待遇比不上国外，所以选择在国外生活下去，但是随着国内经济发展越来越快，也有很多优秀的人才学到国外的经验后回国创业。
examples.translation: hěn duō liú xué shēng jué de guó nèi de gōng zī dài yù bǐ bú shàng guó wài suǒ yǐ xuǎn zé zài guó wài shēng huó xià qù dàn shì suí zhe guó nèi jīng jì fā zhǎn yuè lái yuè kuài yě yǒu hěn duō yōu xiù de rén cái xué dào guó wài de jīng yàn hòu huí guó chuàng yè — Activity 5B, 1 (scripts; translations mine): Many international students feel that domestic pay and treatment are no match for those abroad, so they choose to keep living abroad, but as the domestic economy develops faster and faster, many outstanding talents also return home to start businesses after learning from foreign experience.

examples.text: 由于带着宠物出门很麻烦，有越来越多主人选择出游时把宠物寄养在宠物旅馆。这些旅馆除了照顾宠物的吃住以外，也可以帮你安排带宠物散步、帮宠物洗澡等服务，非常方便。
examples.translation: yóu yú dài zhe chǒng wù chū mén hěn má fán yǒu yuè lái yuè duō zhǔ rén xuǎn zé chū yóu shí bǎ chǒng wù jì yǎng zài chǒng wù lǚ guǎn zhè xiē lǚ guǎn chú le zhào gù chǒng wù de chī zhù yǐ wài yě kě yǐ bāng nǐ ān pái dài chǒng wù sàn bù bāng chǒng wù xǐ zǎo děng fú wù fēi cháng fāng biàn — 2: Because going out with a pet is troublesome, more and more owners choose to board their pets at pet hotels when traveling. Besides looking after the pets’ food and lodging, these hotels can also arrange services such as walking the pet and bathing it, which is very convenient.

examples.text: 到博物馆参观，为了节省排队的时间，很多人会先在网上订票。到了博物馆，为了更了解每件展品，有些人还会请人专门介绍，几个小时下来，大家都觉得学到很多东西。
examples.translation: dào bó wù guǎn cān guān wèi le jié shěng pái duì de shí jiān hěn duō rén huì xiān zài wǎng shàng dìng piào dào le bó wù guǎn wèi le gèng liǎo jiě měi jiàn zhǎn pǐn yǒu xiē rén hái huì qǐng rén zhuān mén jiè shào jǐ gè xiǎo shí xià lái dà jiā dōu jué de xué dào hěn duō dōng xī — 3: When visiting a museum, to save time queuing many people book tickets online first. At the museum, to understand each exhibit better, some people also ask someone to give a special introduction, and after several hours everyone feels they have learned a lot.

examples.text: 对多半的美国父母来说，虽然学习成绩很重要，但是培养孩子独立生活、解决问题的能力更重要，所以常常会让孩子在下课后或是放暑假的时候到外面去打工。
examples.translation: duì duō bàn de měi guó fù mǔ lái shuō suī rán xué xí chéng jì hěn zhòng yào dàn shì péi yǎng hái zi dú lì shēng huó jiě jué wèn tí de néng lì gèng zhòng yào suǒ yǐ cháng cháng huì ràng hái zi zài xià kè hòu huò shì fàng shǔ jià de shí hòu dào wài miàn qù dǎ gōng — 4: For most American parents, although grades are important, cultivating a child’s ability to live independently and solve problems is more important, so they often let their children go out to work after class or during summer vacation.

examples.text: 为了保护环境，现在有越来越多的人选择骑自行车上班或上课。很多城市也提供共享单车，让人们可以用手机或是信用卡轻松租到，因此骑自行车在城里游览也成了年轻游客的新选择。
examples.translation: wèi le bǎo hù huán jìng xiàn zài yǒu yuè lái yuè duō de rén xuǎn zé qí zì xíng chē shàng bān huò shàng kè hěn duō chéng shì yě tí gōng gòng xiǎng dān chē ràng rén men kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī huò shì xìn yòng kǎ qīng sōng zū dào yīn cǐ qí zì xíng chē zài chéng lǐ yóu lǎn yě chéng le nián qīng yóu kè de xīn xuǎn zé — 5: To protect the environment, more and more people now choose to bike to work or class. Many cities also provide shared bikes that people can easily rent with a phone or a credit card, so touring the city by bike has also become a new choice for young tourists.

examples.text: 对中国父母来说，买房子除了看房子的条件，交通、环境以外，房子的地点是不是在好的学区内也很重要。所以学区越好的房子也越贵，但是为了孩子，很多家长觉得花这笔钱值得！
examples.translation: duì zhōng guó fù mǔ lái shuō mǎi fáng zi chú le kàn fáng zi de tiáo jiàn jiāo tōng huán jìng yǐ wài fáng zi de dì diǎn shì bú shì zài hǎo de xué qū nèi yě hěn zhòng yào suǒ yǐ xué qū yuè hǎo de fáng zi yě yuè guì dàn shì wèi le hái zi hěn duō jiā zhǎng jué de huā zhè bǐ qián zhí de — 6: For Chinese parents, besides the condition of the house, traffic and environment, whether the house’s location is in a good school district is also very important. So the better the school district, the more expensive the house, but for their children many parents feel this money is well spent!

Some spaces may require you to say more than one sentence. If your marker falls on a purple space, you can pick any topic to speak about. If your marker falls on an orange space, your partner chooses a question for you. (The board with its questions is a picture and is not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation Activities Review, Activity 1 (Speaking, Writing, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. In Chinese, take turns telling your partner what you would say in the following situations. Key words have been provided. B. Go over the suggested answer keys below and refine your sentences. (The book writes the numbers in the keys with Chinese numerals; one key reads 准时达到, which looks like a slip for 准时到达, and is written here as 准时到达.)

rows: How making your own food can be faster than having it delivered to you. Order your food on this platform with your mobile phone and it will arrive in twenty minutes. You can also order fruit and drinks.

Homestays are both convenient and inexpensive, which is an important reason why we choose them. In addition, the procedure for finding one is very simple. All it requires is to move your fingers a little bit. It will take less than five minutes.
(又…又…，是…的重要原因，另外，动动手指)
In the past, people used to wait a long time to get a taxi. Now they just use their smart phone to order a ride. Because the vehicle can accurately find your location, it will usually arrive on time.

At first, we were worried that a student might develop bad habits there. Now we know that the members of her host family are all very nice and they often help her with her life needs and her studies. We are not as worried any longer.
(养成，寄宿家庭，在生活和学习上)

Many parents, no matter how hard their lives are, send their children to study in America at their own expense. After getting their degrees, some of these young people choose to stay in the United States to work, and some return to China to become “haigui.”

Nowadays, Chinese people have many ways to travel abroad. Some join tour groups, some like to travel by themselves, and some take one-destination tours. Regardless of the method, most Chinese tourists like to do a lot of shopping abroad.
(旅游方式；有的…，有的…，还有的…；不管，都…；扫货)
Every day, delivery men work from dawn to night, in the wind and in the rain, and they work like soldiers fighting a battle. Aren’t they worthy of respect since they serve everyone so well?
(起早贪黑；风里来雨里去；跟…似的；难道不…吗？)

You can make money by chatting on live broadcast platforms, but to make a lot of money, it helps to be an internet celebrity with many fans. Not only can you be a celebrity by chatting, but also by singing, dancing, or cooking online.

With the popularity of e-sports competitions, some young people have become professional e-sports players. They are characterized by high intelligence and quick responses. I know a professional player who represented China in the World Series.

People of their generation luckily live in a prosperous time. Have you noticed this? Some people have become presidents of large companies at a young age, while others have become professors at famous universities in their early 30’s.
(赶上，注意到，年纪轻轻，三十多岁)
As Teacher Wang said just now, your generation grew up in a well-informed environment, and we grew up in a completely different environment, so sometimes the two generations don’t think the same way.
It’s not difficult to start a business, but it’s difficult to start a business that customers like, with fast growing sales plus advanced management styles.

The number of interest classes we enrolled our child in is relatively small. Some parents signed up seven or eight classes for their kids, but teachers say that attending too many classes could be counterproductive.

With a good education, children can have a better future. However, I feel that by living in a very expensive school district and attending an expensive school, the child will not necessarily receive a good education.

Parents work hard in big cities but don’t make much money, so their children have no choice but to become “left-behind children.” Even if these children live with their parents in the city, they cannot afford to attend good schools there.

explanations.title: Presentation Activities Review, Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Speaking, and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to several short dialogs and mark the following statements as either True or False. B. Pair up to discuss your answers and explain your reasoning. Go over the scripts below to check your answers. (The audio is not included; my True/False key is worked out from the scripts.)

headers: True/False (my key; the book gives none)
rows: 如果你想出国旅游，得把三个平台都下载到你的手机上。
False (Dialog 1: the platforms are for ordering takeout, homestays and rides)
外卖平台和“滴滴出行”都有定位服务。
第一个说话人会去欧洲留学。
False (Dialog 3: he is told to travel to Europe, not to study)
第一个说话人在国外学的专业(major)不太好，所以他担心回国后会成为“海待”。
False (Dialog 4: his major is good; he worries because “haigui” have lost their advantage)
这位“快递小哥”觉得他的工作太辛苦，应该学习做网络直播，将来当“网红”。
False (Dialog 5: his friend suggests it; he declines)
第一个说话人的儿子电脑游戏玩儿得好，反应也快，很快就要当电竞员了。
False (Dialog 6: the speaker worries; the other suggests he try)
现在的孩子从小就学英语，两个说话人是上了大学才开始学英语的。
90后和00后成长的环境信息发达，所以他们知道得多，能力也很强。
两个说话人都觉得，中国人为孩子的教育花钱花得太多了。
False (Dialog 9: they explain it as a tradition)
第二个说话人担心自己的孩子不好好地做作业。
False (Dialog 10: the child studies in the village and calls when stuck)

examples.text: 甲：我经常听说什么外卖平台、短租平台，还有网约车平台。这些平台都是做什么用的？
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ jīng cháng tīng shuō shén me wài mài píng tái duǎn zū píng tái hái yǒu wǎng yuē chē píng tái zhè xiē píng tái dōu shì zuò shén me yòng de — Dialog 1 (scripts; translations mine). A: I often hear about takeout platforms, short-term rental platforms and ride-hailing platforms. What are these platforms for?

examples.text: 乙：它们都是在网上提供服务的应用软件。把它们下载下来，就可以订外卖，订民宿，或是预约叫车。
examples.translation: yǐ tā men dōu shì zài wǎng shàng tí gōng fú wù de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn bǎ tā men xià zài xià lái jiù kě yǐ dìng wài mài dìng mín sù huò shì yù yuē jiào chē — B: They are all apps that provide services online. Download them and you can order takeout, book a homestay, or reserve a ride.

examples.text: 甲：咱们能知道外卖小哥什么时候把菜送到吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ zán men néng zhī dào wài mài xiǎo gē shén me shí hòu bǎ cài sòng dào ma — Dialog 2. A: Can we know when the delivery man will bring the food?

examples.text: 乙：能啊。看，这里是定位服务，随时告诉你外卖小哥走到哪里了。“滴滴出行”也有这个服务，你不是用过吗？
examples.translation: yǐ néng a kàn zhè lǐ shì dìng wèi fú wù suí shí gào sù nǐ wài mài xiǎo gē zǒu dào nǎ lǐ le dī dī chū xíng yě yǒu zhè ge fú wù nǐ bú shì yòng guò ma — B: Yes. Look, this is the location service, which tells you at any time where the delivery man has got to. DiDi Chuxing has this service too; haven’t you used it?

examples.text: 甲：现在有公费留学，也有自费留学。在国外上学的有小学生、中学生、大学生，还有研究生。那么多人都能出国留学，为什么我不能呢？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiàn zài yǒu gōng fèi liú xué yě yǒu zì fèi liú xué zài guó wài shàng xué de yǒu xiǎo xué shēng zhōng xué shēng dà xué shēng hái yǒu yán jiū shēng nà me duō rén dōu néng chū guó liú xué wèi shén me wǒ bù néng ne — Dialog 3. A: Now there is study abroad at public expense and at one’s own expense. Those studying abroad include primary, middle and university students, and graduate students. So many people can study abroad; why can’t I?

examples.text: 乙：快七十岁了，你还留什么学呀！下个月出国旅游吧，这次咱们去欧洲。你想参加旅行团呢，还是来一次自由行？
examples.translation: yǐ kuài qī shí suì le nǐ hái liú shén me xué ya xià gè yuè chū guó lǚ yóu ba zhè cì zán men qù ōu zhōu nǐ xiǎng cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán ne hái shì lái yí cì zì yóu xíng — B: You’re nearly seventy; what study abroad are you talking about! Let’s travel abroad next month, this time to Europe. Do you want to join a tour group, or have a free-travel trip?

examples.text: 甲：我很快就要毕业了。毕业后我想回国找工作，可是现在“海归”已经没什么优势了，我会不会变成“海待”呀？
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ hěn kuài jiù yào bì yè le bì yè hòu wǒ xiǎng huí guó zhǎo gōng zuò kě shì xiàn zài hǎi guī yǐ jīng méi shén me yōu shì le wǒ huì bú huì biàn chéng hǎi dài ya — Dialog 4. A: I’m about to graduate. After graduating I want to return home to find a job, but “haigui” no longer have much of an advantage; will I become a “haidai”?

examples.text: 乙：别担心。你的专业好，学习成绩也不错，会找到条件和待遇都不错的工作的。
examples.translation: yǐ bié dān xīn nǐ de zhuān yè hǎo xué xí chéng jì yě bú cuò huì zhǎo dào tiáo jiàn hé dài yù dōu bú cuò de gōng zuò de — B: Don’t worry. Your major is good and your grades are fine; you’ll find a job with good conditions and pay.

examples.text: 甲：听说了吗？小马做网络直播成了“网红”，收入可高了。你别当“快递小哥”了，太辛苦，也当个“网红”吧。
examples.translation: jiǎ tīng shuō le ma xiǎo mǎ zuò wǎng luò zhí bō chéng le wǎng hóng shōu rù kě gāo le nǐ bié dāng kuài dì xiǎo gē le tài xīn kǔ yě dāng gè wǎng hóng ba — Dialog 5. A: Have you heard? Xiao Ma became an “internet celebrity” doing live streaming, and his income is really high. Stop being a “courier”; it’s too hard. Be an “internet celebrity” too.

examples.text: 乙：我虽然每天起早贪黑，风里来雨里去的，可是顾客尊重我，收入也稳定。再说，做网络直播的那么多，变成“网红”的有几个？
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ suī rán měi tiān qǐ zǎo tān hēi fēng lǐ lái yǔ lǐ qù de kě shì gù kè zūn zhòng wǒ shōu rù yě wěn dìng zài shuō zuò wǎng luò zhí bō de nà me duō biàn chéng wǎng hóng de yǒu jǐ gè — B: Although I work from dawn to night every day in wind and rain, customers respect me and my income is stable. Besides, so many people do live streaming; how many become “internet celebrities”?

examples.text: 甲：我儿子从小就喜欢玩儿电子游戏。我担心他不好好学习，将来找不到好工作。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ ér zi cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān wánr diàn zǐ yóu xì wǒ dān xīn tā bù hǎo hào xué xí jiāng lái zhǎo bú dào hǎo gōng zuò — Dialog 6. A: My son has loved playing video games since he was small. I worry he won’t study well and won’t find a good job in the future.

examples.text: 乙：现在有一种专门玩儿电脑游戏的职业，叫电子竞技，玩儿得好的人可以做职业电竞员。你儿子如果玩儿得好，反应快，应该去试一试。
examples.translation: yǐ xiàn zài yǒu yì zhǒng zhuān mén wánr diàn nǎo yóu xì de zhí yè jiào diàn zi jìng jì wánr de hǎo de rén kě yǐ zuò zhí yè diàn jìng yuán nǐ ér zi rú guǒ wánr de hǎo fǎn yìng kuài yīng gāi qù shì yí shì — B: Now there is a profession devoted to playing computer games, called e-sports, and those who play well can become professional e-sports players. If your son plays well and reacts fast, he should give it a try.

examples.text: 甲：你注意到没有？现在不少的孩子的英语都很棒，能看英语书和英语电影。咱们呢，进大学以前连ＡＢＣ都不认识。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ zhù yì dào méi yǒu xiàn zài bù shǎo de hái zi de yīng yǔ dōu hěn bàng néng kàn yīng yǔ shū hé yīng yǔ diàn yǐng zán men ne jìn dà xué yǐ qián lián dōu bú rèn shí — Dialog 7. A: Have you noticed? Quite a few children now have very good English and can read English books and watch English films. As for us, before entering university we didn’t even know our ABC.

examples.text: 乙：那是。他们这一代学习条件太好了，从小就上英语课，还总是上网看国外的东西，英语比咱们好多了。
examples.translation: yǐ nà shì tā men zhè yí dài xué xí tiáo jiàn tài hǎo le cóng xiǎo jiù shàng yīng yǔ kè hái zǒng shì shàng wǎng kàn guó wài de dōng xī yīng yǔ bǐ zán men hǎo duō le — B: That’s true. Their generation has such good learning conditions; they take English classes from childhood and also always look at foreign things online, so their English is much better than ours.

examples.text: 甲：那位九零后企业家，有那么多好想法，还懂技术，会管理，他的公司一定会越做越好。
examples.translation: jiǎ nà wèi jiǔ líng hòu qǐ yè jiā yǒu nà me duō hǎo xiǎng fǎ hái dǒng jì shù huì guǎn lǐ tā de gōng sī yí dìng huì yuè zuò yuè hǎo — Dialog 8. A: That entrepreneur born in the 1990s has so many good ideas, understands technology and can manage; his company will certainly do better and better.

examples.text: 乙：可不。九零后和零零后在信息发达的环境里长大，知道得多，能力也强。另外，他们的目标也高，将来一定大有前途。
examples.translation: yǐ kě bù jiǔ líng hòu hé líng líng hòu zài xìn xī fā dá de huán jìng lǐ zhǎng dà zhī dào de duō néng lì yě qiáng lìng wài tā men de mù biāo yě gāo jiāng lái yí dìng dà yǒu qián tú — B: Exactly. People born in the 1990s and 2000s grew up in an environment of advanced information, know a lot and are capable. Also, their goals are high, and they will certainly have a bright future. (the book writes 90 后 and 00 后 with digits)

examples.text: 甲：很多中国家长花很多钱，送孩子去参加各种兴趣班，有的甚至买特别贵的学区房，就为了让孩子上个好学校。为什么？
examples.translation: jiǎ hěn duō zhōng guó jiā zhǎng huā hěn duō qián sòng hái zi qù cān jiā gè zhǒng xìng qù bān yǒu de shèn zhì mǎi tè bié guì de xué qū fáng jiù wèi le ràng hái zi shàng gè hǎo xué xiào wèi shén me — Dialog 9. A: Many Chinese parents spend a lot of money sending their children to all kinds of interest classes, and some even buy very expensive homes in school districts, just so the child can attend a good school. Why?

examples.text: 乙：重视教育是中国人的传统。家长这么做，是为了让孩子受到很好的教育，将来有一个更好的前途。
examples.translation: yǐ zhòng shì jiào yù shì zhōng guó rén de chuán tǒng jiā zhǎng zhè me zuò shì wèi le ràng hái zi shòu dào hěn hǎo de jiào yù jiāng lái yǒu yí gè gèng hǎo de qián tú — B: Valuing education is a tradition of the Chinese people. Parents do this so that their children get a very good education and have a better future.

examples.text: 甲：你们在北京打工这么辛苦，孩子又来不了，那他们的教育怎么办？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ men zài běi jīng dǎ gōng zhè me xīn kǔ hái zi yòu lái bù liǎo nà tā men de jiào yù zěn me bàn — Dialog 10. A: You work so hard in Beijing and the child can’t come; what about their education?

examples.text: 乙：孩子一直在农村老家上学，学校的教学质量还不是很高。有时候作业不会做，就打电话过来问我或她爸。
examples.translation: yǐ hái zi yì zhí zài nóng cūn lǎo jiā shàng xué xué xiào de jiào xué zhì liàng hái bú shì hěn gāo yǒu shí hòu zuò yè bú huì zuò jiù dǎ diàn huà guò lái wèn wǒ huò tā bà — B: The child has always gone to school in the rural hometown, and the school’s teaching quality isn’t very high. Sometimes when she can’t do her homework she calls me or her dad to ask.

exercises.prompt: What are the three kinds of platform in Dialog 1 for?
options: Ordering takeout, booking homestays and reserving rides
exercises.explanation: 订外卖，订民宿，或是预约叫车.

exercises.prompt: What do both the takeout platform and DiDi have, per Dialog 2?
What does B suggest to A in Dialog 3?
exercises.explanation: 下个月出国旅游吧，这次咱们去欧洲.

exercises.prompt: What is A afraid of in Dialog 4?
Why does B decline to become an internet celebrity in Dialog 5?
options: Customers respect him, his income is stable, and few succeed
exercises.explanation: 顾客尊重我，收入也稳定.

exercises.prompt: What does B tell A about e-sports in Dialog 6?
options: It is a profession; if the son plays well and reacts fast he should try

exercises.prompt: What did the speakers not know before university in Dialog 7?
exercises.explanation: 进大学以前连ＡＢＣ都不认识.

exercises.prompt: What are the nineties-born and 2000s-born generations like, per Dialog 8?
options: They know a lot and are capable, with high goals
exercises.explanation: 知道得多，能力也强……目标也高.

exercises.prompt: What explains Chinese parents’ spending on education, per Dialog 9?
exercises.explanation: 重视教育是中国人的传统.

exercises.prompt: What happens when the child in Dialog 10 can’t do homework?
options: She phones her mother or father
exercises.explanation: 就打电话过来问我或她爸.

你的专业好，学习成绩也不错，会找到条件和待___都不错的工作的。

lessons.title: 783. Lesson 30 Presentation Activities Review: matching Column A with Column B
lessons.subtitle: 国际航线 · 过节越忙 · 网红 · 留守儿童 · 不加塞儿 · 一键完成 · 陪读 · 大件行李 · 培养兴趣

explanations.title: Presentation Activities Review, Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Match the parts in Column A with those in Column B by writing the letter in the leftmost column. B. Check your answers with a partner. Take turns translating the sentences into English. The book gives no key; the matching below is mine.

rows: 1. 现在国际航线比以前多了不少，机票也越来越便宜，
g. 所以出国旅游的人越来越多。
2. 小宋每天忙着做快递，过春节也没见到他。
a. 可不是嘛，越是过节他越忙，一天从早到晚就跟打仗似的。
3. 于新说她总上网聊天，也没看见她上班。她在做什么呀？
f. 她现在是“网红”，可有名了。随着粉丝的增加，收入比以前当护士的时候多多了。
4. 那里学校的学费太贵了，
k. 农民工的孩子上不起，他们只好留在老家当“留守儿童”。
5. 你注意到没有，现在的孩子比过去文明多了，
c. 该排队就排队，不喜欢加塞儿。
6. 这个手机软件最好的地方，
h. 是“一键完成”，还可以看到用户评价。
7. 你工作很辛苦，机票又这么贵，还要去美国啊？
j. 得去陪陪孩子。我怕她一个人在那儿压力太大，不适应。
8. 现在，我静下心来想了想，
d. 开始理解为什么你不送孩子去很贵的学校了。
9. 不管去哪里旅游，除了“扫货”以外，
l. 她还喜欢拍很多照片。
e. 连蔬菜或药都可以给你送到家。
11. 他们可以根据乘客的需要，提供特别的服务吗？
b. 他们还提供大件行李和宠物服务。
12. 我们送孩子来少年宫参加画画班，
i. 就是要培养他的各种兴趣，希望对他将来的发展有好处。

examples.text: 你注意到没有，现在的孩子比过去文明多了，该排队就排队，不喜欢加塞儿。
examples.translation: nǐ zhù yì dào méi yǒu xiàn zài de hái zi bǐ guò qù wén míng duō le gāi pái duì jiù pái duì bù xǐ huān jiā sāir — 5-c: Have you noticed that today’s children are much more civilized than in the past? They queue when they should and don’t like to cut in line.

examples.text: 这个手机软件最好的地方，是“一键完成”，还可以看到用户评价。
