examples.translation: bù guǎn qù nǎ lǐ lǚ yóu chú le sǎo huò yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huān pāi hěn duō zhào piān — 9-l: Wherever she travels, besides shopping sprees she also likes to take lots of photos.

examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo sòng měi tiān máng zhe zuò kuài dì guò chūn jié yě méi jiàn dào tā — Activity 3A, 2-a (as a short dialog; translations mine). A: Xiao Song is busy delivering packages every day; I didn’t even see him at Spring Festival.

explanations.title: Grammar and Usage Review, Activities 1 to 4
explanations.body: How to start a topic and gain an audience’s attention; how to elaborate; how to add additional information; how to clarify your information. The tasks, the printed sentences and my notes on the techniques:

headers: Task (the answers are audio, blanks or free discussion; the book gives no key)
rows: A. Pair up and discuss the techniques you can use to start a new topic that will get the attention of your audience. C. Pair up. Start a topic in a way that catches your partner’s attention (two blank lines).
Elaborate on the topics in Activity 1, Parts B and C. You can use the above techniques, and feel free to explore. Share your work with your partner (six blank lines).
Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking): How to Add Additional Information to Discourse

There are two basic kinds of additional information to add to your discourse: coordinative/progressive and contrasting/adversative. Pair up. Listen to the following sentences (eight audio items), find the signal word for the additional information, and discuss with your partner the relationship between the additional information and the previous information. The book gives a table with the columns Signal Word and Purpose of the Additional Information.
Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking): How to Clarify Your Information
Pair up. Explain the meanings of the underlined words and determine how the writer clarified the meanings. (The underlining is lost in the text.)
tables.title: Grammar and Usage Review, Activities 1 to 4: the tasks

examples.text: 说到当地最好的广东菜馆，那就是东海餐馆了。
examples.translation: shuō dào dāng dì zuì hǎo de guǎng dōng cài guǎn nà jiù shì dōng hǎi cān guǎn le — Activity 1B, 1 (translations mine; my technique: “说到…” brings up a topic by mentioning it): Speaking of the best Cantonese restaurant in the area, that would be the Donghai Restaurant.

examples.text: 说起Ｓａｌｉｎａｓ，人们就会想到“美国的菜篮子”。
examples.translation: shuō qǐ rén men jiù huì xiǎng dào měi guó de cài lán zi — 2 (technique: “说起…” plus a well-known association): Speaking of Salinas, people think of “America’s salad bowl.” (the book writes Salinas in Latin letters)

examples.text: 你们注意到了吗？随着经济的发展，自然环境越来越差了。
examples.translation: nǐ men zhù yì dào le ma suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn zì rán huán jìng yuè lái yuè chà le — 3 (technique: a question that draws attention, “你们注意到了吗？”): Have you noticed? With economic development, the natural environment is getting worse and worse.

examples.text: 去过美国的人都注意到，那里冬天室内暖气温度太高，
examples.translation: qù guò měi guó de rén dōu zhù yì dào nà lǐ dōng tiān shì nèi nuǎn qì wēn dù tài gāo — 4 (technique: “…都注意到” appeals to a shared observation): People who have been to the U.S. have all noticed that in winter the indoor heating there is too hot, (the book prints this sentence with a final comma)

examples.text: 你发现了吗？肚子饿的时候最好不要去商店买东西。
examples.translation: nǐ fā xiàn le ma dù zi è de shí hòu zuì hǎo bú yào qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī — 5 (technique: a question that draws attention, “你发现了吗？”): Have you found out? When you are hungry it is best not to go shopping.

examples.text: 以前出门，人们主要是靠自行车和公交车，现在有了很多新的选择，其中最受欢迎的就是“滴滴出行”。
examples.translation: yǐ qián chū mén rén men zhǔ yào shì kào zì xíng chē hé gōng jiāo chē xiàn zài yǒu le hěn duō xīn de xuǎn zé qí zhōng zuì shòu huān yíng de jiù shì dī dī chū xíng — 6 (technique: contrasting past and present, “以前…现在…”): In the past, people going out mainly relied on bicycles and buses; now there are many new choices, the most popular of which is DiDi Chuxing.

examples.text: 人们喜欢她的视频，主要是因为画面非常美，而且还可以了解到中国的美食和文化。
examples.translation: rén men xǐ huān tā de shì pín zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi huà miàn fēi cháng měi ér qiě hái kě yǐ liǎo jiě dào zhōng guó de měi shí hé wén huà — Activity 2A, 1 (translations mine; my technique: give the main reason, then add more with “而且”): People like her videos mainly because the pictures are very beautiful, and also one can learn about Chinese food and culture.

examples.text: 这一代年轻人比咱们的能力强多了。有的人年纪轻轻就开办了自己的公司，有的人二十多岁就当上了大学教授，还有的人在各种国际比赛中得奖。
examples.translation: zhè yí dài nián qīng rén bǐ zán men de néng lì qiáng duō le yǒu de rén nián jì qīng qīng jiù kāi bàn le zì jǐ de gōng sī yǒu de rén èr shí duō suì jiù dāng shàng le dà xué jiào shòu hái yǒu de rén zài gè zhǒng guó jì bǐ sài zhōng dé jiǎng — 2 (technique: a general statement, then examples with “有的…有的…还有的…”): This generation of young people is much more capable than we are. Some started their own companies at a young age, some became university professors in their twenties, and others won prizes in various international competitions.

examples.text: 她说话做事的样子很像她的妈妈，特别是有些习惯动作，比如想问题的时候喜欢玩儿笔。
examples.translation: tā shuō huà zuò shì de yàng zi hěn xiàng tā de mā mā tè bié shì yǒu xiē xí guàn dòng zuò bǐ rú xiǎng wèn tí de shí hòu xǐ huān wánr bǐ — 3 (technique: a general statement, then a specific one with “特别是…比如…”): The way she speaks and acts is very like her mother, especially some habitual movements, for example liking to play with a pen when thinking about a problem.

examples.text: 压力大的时候可以做一些有氧运动，比如散步，慢跑，骑自行车，游泳，跳舞什么的。
examples.translation: yā lì dà de shí hòu kě yǐ zuò yì xiē yǒu yǎng yùn dòng bǐ rú sàn bù màn pǎo qí zì xíng chē yóu yǒng tiào wǔ shén me de — Activity 4, 1 (translations mine; my analysis: “比如” gives examples to clarify): When under stress you can do some aerobic exercise, for example walking, jogging, cycling, swimming, dancing and so on.

examples.text: 有些城市甚至有幼升小的考试，也就是说，从幼儿园毕业上小学也要经过考试。
examples.translation: yǒu xiē chéng shì shèn zhì yǒu yòu shēng xiǎo de kǎo shì yě jiù shì shuō cóng yòu ér yuán bì yè shàng xiǎo xué yě yào jīng guò kǎo shì — 2 (“也就是说” restates in other words): Some cities even have an exam for moving from kindergarten to elementary school; that is to say, graduating from kindergarten into elementary school also requires an exam.

examples.text: 农民工的孩子不能在当地参加中考，就是初中升高中的考试。
examples.translation: nóng mín gōng de hái zi bù néng zài dāng dì cān jiā zhōng kǎo jiù shì chū zhōng shēng gāo zhōng de kǎo shì — 3 (“就是” defines the term): The children of migrant workers cannot take the zhongkao locally, that is, the exam for going from junior high to high school.

examples.text: 在这个信息发达的世界，出现了越来越多的“阿宅”。“阿宅”主要指的是那些整天呆在家里或宿舍里，除了上网，就是玩电游、看动漫，生活中只有自己，不喜欢跟别人在一起的人。
examples.translation: zài zhè ge xìn xī fā dá de shì jiè chū xiàn le yuè lái yuè duō de ā zhái ā zhái zhǔ yào zhǐ de shì nà xiē zhěng tiān dāi zài jiā lǐ huò sù shè lǐ chú le shàng wǎng jiù shì wán diàn yóu kàn dòng màn shēng huó zhōng zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ bù xǐ huān gēn bié rén zài yì qǐ de rén — 4 (“主要指的是” defines the term): In this world of advanced information, more and more “otaku” have appeared. “Otaku” mainly refers to people who stay at home or in a dormitory all day, who apart from going online just play video games and watch anime, have only themselves in their lives and don’t like being with others.

examples.text: 在北京街头，你会看到一排排的红色自行车，只要用手机扫码就可以使用，在市区很多地方都有停放点，给人们提供了很多方便，这就是人们常说的“共享单车”。
examples.translation: zài běi jīng jiē tóu nǐ huì kàn dào yì pái pái de hóng sè zì xíng chē zhǐ yào yòng shǒu jī sǎo mǎ jiù kě yǐ shǐ yòng zài shì qū hěn duō dì fāng dōu yǒu tíng fàng diǎn gěi rén men tí gōng le hěn duō fāng biàn zhè jiù shì rén men cháng shuō de gòng xiǎng dān chē — 5 (“这就是人们常说的…” names what has been described): On Beijing’s streets you will see rows and rows of red bicycles that can be used just by scanning a code with a phone, with parking spots in many parts of the city, bringing people much convenience; this is what people often call “shared bikes.”

What does “这就是人们常说的‘共享单车’” do?

lessons.title: 785. Lesson 30 Grammar and Usage Review: strengthening an argument, commenting, determination and softening
lessons.subtitle: 难道…吗 · 像镜子似的 · 父亲是一座山 · 就像爱因斯坦说的 · 总之 · 再…也… · 不管…都… · 一点儿道理也没有 · 好像不太合适

explanations.title: Grammar and Usage Review, Activity 5 (Reading and Speaking): How to Strengthen Your Argument
explanations.body: A. In this unit, you learned several ways to strengthen your arguments and make your statements more impactful. Read the five techniques in Column A and match them with the sentences in Column B. B. Create your own statements and share them with your partner: 1. A rhetorical question about traveling abroad. 2. A metaphor about fast food delivery. 3. Parallel sentences about time, friendship, or family. 4. A quotation about education. 5. Summary about your life at DLI. The matching and my samples:

rows: 1. Use a rhetorical question to arouse listener’s thoughts and reflection.
b. 当农民难道就不需要文化知识了吗？
2. Use a metaphor to boost the impression.
e. 圆圆的月亮像镜子似的挂在天上。
3. Use parallel sentences to make your argument clear and organized, and to strengthen the emotion.
d. 父亲是一座山，在困难时给我依靠；父亲是一片海，给我最深的爱；父亲是一盏灯，照亮我前方的路。
4. Use quotations to encourage others to support you.
a. 就像爱因斯坦说的，“兴趣是最好的老师”，没有兴趣只有压力你是不可能学好的。
5. Use summarization to bring your narration to a conclusion and state your idea clearly.
c. 你可以去图书馆查书，也可以上网查资料，还可以问同事，总之你明天一定要把报告交上来。
tables.title: Activity 5A: strengthening an argument (the book gives no key; the matching is mine)

examples.text: 当农民难道就不需要文化知识了吗？
examples.translation: dāng nóng mín nán dào jiù bù xū yào wén huà zhī shí le ma — Activity 5A, b (translations mine): Does being a farmer mean you don’t need any education?

examples.text: 圆圆的月亮像镜子似的挂在天上。
examples.translation: yuán yuán de yuè liàng xiàng jìng zi shì de guà zài tiān shàng — e: The round moon hangs in the sky like a mirror.

examples.text: 父亲是一座山，在困难时给我依靠；父亲是一片海，给我最深的爱；父亲是一盏灯，照亮我前方的路。
examples.translation: fù qīn shì yí zuò shān zài kùn nán shí gěi wǒ yī kào fù qīn shì yí piàn hǎi gěi wǒ zuì shēn de ài fù qīn shì yì zhǎn dēng zhào liàng wǒ qián fāng de lù — d: Father is a mountain, giving me support in hard times; Father is a sea, giving me the deepest love; Father is a lamp, lighting the road ahead of me.

examples.text: 就像爱因斯坦说的，“兴趣是最好的老师”，没有兴趣只有压力你是不可能学好的。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng ài yīn sī tǎn shuō de xìng qù shì zuì hǎo de lǎo shī méi yǒu xìng qù zhǐ yǒu yā lì nǐ shì bù kě néng xué hǎo de — a: As Einstein said, “Interest is the best teacher”; with no interest and only pressure you can’t possibly learn well.

examples.text: 你可以去图书馆查书，也可以上网查资料，还可以问同事，总之你明天一定要把报告交上来。
examples.translation: nǐ kě yǐ qù tú shū guǎn chá shū yě kě yǐ shàng wǎng chá zī liào hái kě yǐ wèn tóng shì zǒng zhī nǐ míng tiān yí dìng yào bǎ bào gào jiāo shàng lái — c: You can go to the library to look up books, you can search for material online, and you can ask colleagues, but in short you must hand in the report tomorrow.

examples.text: 出国旅游难道只是为了购物吗？
examples.translation: chū guó lǚ yóu nán dào zhǐ shì wèi le gòu wù ma — Activity 5B, 1 (my sample; the book gives only the five prompts): Is traveling abroad only for shopping?

examples.text: 外卖小哥像风一样，把热饭送到你的手上。
examples.translation: wài mài xiǎo gē xiàng fēng yí yàng bǎ rè fàn sòng dào nǐ de shǒu shàng — 2 (metaphor about delivery): The delivery man is like the wind, bringing hot food into your hands.

examples.text: 时间是一条河，带走了过去；朋友是一棵树，给我们阴凉；家人是一盏灯，永远为我们亮着。
examples.translation: shí jiān shì yì tiáo hé dài zǒu le guò qù péng yǒu shì yì kē shù gěi wǒ men yīn liáng jiā rén shì yì zhǎn dēng yǒng yuǎn wèi wǒ men liàng zhe — 3 (parallel sentences): Time is a river that carries the past away; friends are a tree that gives us shade; family is a lamp that is always lit for us.

examples.text: 就像孔子说的，“有教无类”。
examples.translation: jiù xiàng kǒng zi shuō de yǒu jiào wú lèi — 4 (a quotation about education): As Confucius said, “In education there are no class distinctions.”

examples.text: 总之，我在这里的学习生活很紧张，但是我每天都学到很多新东西。
examples.translation: zǒng zhī wǒ zài zhè lǐ de xué xí shēng huó hěn jǐn zhāng dàn shì wǒ měi tiān dōu xué dào hěn duō xīn dōng xī — 5 (summary about my life at DLI, kept generic): In short, my life of study here is very tense, but every day I learn a lot of new things.

explanations.title: Grammar and Usage Review, Activities 6 to 8
explanations.body: How to comment, how to state determination and how to soften one’s tone. The tasks, my samples and my stern and soft versions:

headers: Task (audio or free production; the book gives no key)
rows: Activity 6 (Listening and Speaking): How to Comment

A. Pair up. With your partner, listen to the following sentences (six audio items) and discuss how strongly the second speaker agrees with the first (Agree? Disagree?). B. Pair up. Your partner will make a statement and you comment on it. Take turns practicing, each partner makes three statements.
Activity 7 (Listening and Speaking): How to State Determination

A. Listen to the statement and translate what you hear into English (five audio items). Then pair up and compare your work with your partner’s. B. Use 再…，也…，不管…，都…，要…，就…，一定，and 就是 to create sentences that state your determination, or that of people you know (six blank lines).
Activity 8 (Reading and Speaking): How to soften one’s tone
Rewrite the following sentences to make them sound sterner, and then write them softer: 1. 他说的没道理。 2. 那部电影没意思。 3. 这本书写得不好。 4. 你这样做不对。

explanations.title: Grammar and Usage Review, Activity 9 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Complete the sentence using one of the phrases supplied. Pair up and compare your work with your partner’s and discuss any inconsistencies. The book gives no key; my choices are below, with the completed sentences.

headers: Sentence (the book’s, with the choice left open)
rows: ＿＿农民工的辛苦劳动，才有了中国城市的高速发展。
＿＿这次考试很难，但我还是考出了好成绩。
应该＿＿每个人的能力和特长来安排他们的工作。
记者在采访中＿＿了真实的情况。
下个星期，我＿＿去上海出差。
老师又说了一遍，＿＿让同学们能记下来。
他把时间都＿＿打电子游戏上了。
不管遇到(encounter)什么困难，都一定要＿＿。
猴子(monkey)很聪明，不过＿＿大象(elephant)。但是，大象还＿＿海豚(dolphin)聪明。
很多孩子考上了大学，但是＿＿学费。
地里的活儿太多了，他一个人根本＿＿。
这次考试的结果＿＿还是不错的。
＿＿经济的发展，人们的收入也不断提高。

examples.text: 正是因为农民工的辛苦劳动，才有了中国城市的高速发展。
examples.translation: zhèng shì yīn wèi nóng mín gōng de xīn kǔ láo dòng cái yǒu le zhōng guó chéng shì de gāo sù fā zhǎn — Activity 9, 1 (completed sentences; my key; translations mine): It is precisely because of the migrant workers’ hard labor that Chinese cities have developed so fast.

examples.text: 应该根据每个人的能力和特长来安排他们的工作。
examples.translation: yīng gāi gēn jù měi gè rén de néng lì hé tè cháng lái ān pái tā men de gōng zuò — 4: Work should be assigned according to each person’s ability and special talents.

examples.translation: jì zhě zài cǎi fǎng zhòng liǎo jiě dào le zhēn shí de qíng kuàng — 5: In the interview the reporter learned the real situation.

examples.text: 下个星期，我得去上海出差。
examples.translation: xià gè xīng qī wǒ děi qù shàng hǎi chū chāi — 6: Next week I have to go to Shanghai on a business trip.

examples.text: 老师又说了一遍，好让同学们能记下来。
examples.translation: lǎo shī yòu shuō le yí biàn hǎo ràng tóng xué men néng jì xià lái — 7: The teacher said it once more so that the students could write it down.

examples.text: 他把时间都用在打电子游戏上了。
examples.translation: tā bǎ shí jiān dōu yòng zài dǎ diàn zǐ yóu xì shàng le — 8: He has spent all his time playing video games.

examples.text: 不管遇到什么困难，都一定要坚持下去。
examples.translation: bù guǎn yù dào shén me kùn nán dōu yí dìng yào jiān chí xià qù — 9: No matter what difficulties you meet, you must keep going.

examples.text: 猴子很聪明，不过比不上大象。但是，大象还没有海豚聪明。
examples.translation: hóu zi hěn cōng míng bú guò bǐ bú shàng dà xiàng dàn shì dà xiàng hái méi yǒu hǎi tún cōng míng — 10: Monkeys are very clever, but they are no match for elephants. But elephants are still not as clever as dolphins.

examples.text: 很多孩子考上了大学，但是付不起学费。

examples.text: 地里的活儿太多了，他一个人根本干不过来。
examples.translation: dì lǐ de huór tài duō le tā yí gè rén gēn běn gàn bú guò lái — 12: There is too much work in the fields; he can’t possibly handle it alone.

examples.text: 这次考试的结果总的来说还是不错的。
examples.translation: zhè cì kǎo shì de jié guǒ zǒng de lái shuō hái shì bú cuò de — 13: On the whole, the result of this exam is still good.

examples.text: 随着经济的发展，人们的收入也不断提高。
examples.translation: suí zhe jīng jì de fā zhǎn rén men de shōu rù yě bú duàn tí gāo — 14: With the development of the economy, people’s incomes also keep rising.

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 1 (Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Working in groups of three, each student listens to one monolog to learn the main idea and supporting details (the book gives a blank grid for each monolog with Topic, Elements mentioned, Main Idea in one Chinese sentence, and Details). B. When you are done, exchange information with your group members. Take notes on the information provided in their monologs. C. Listen to each monolog again and mark the following statements as either True or False. D. Together, read the scripts and check your information and answers. The scripts, my notes and my key:

examples.text: 现在，我是一个外卖食物迷。对我来说，每天最重要的一件事情就是打开手机里的外卖应用软件，点开我喜爱的餐馆，看看当天的菜单，然后点餐，确认所点的饭菜、应付的金额和配送地址，最后下单和付款，前后不到五分钟，我的饭菜很快就会在路上了。现在用手机叫外卖又省时又便宜，还有很多选择。外卖平台上你想点什么都可以，除了本地餐馆的饭菜和特色菜以外，你还可以点一些蛋糕店、饮料店的甜点和饮料，甚至连星巴克的咖啡也可以点。外卖小哥总是能够以最快的速度把外卖送到你的手上。在等外卖的时候，你还可以随时查看外卖平台的定位服务，追踪外卖小哥到了哪儿。而且，要是路上的交通很堵，外卖小哥总是会给你打电话，告诉你还需要几分钟。
examples.translation: xiàn zài wǒ shì yí gè wài mài shí wù mí duì wǒ lái shuō měi tiān zuì zhòng yào de yí jiàn shì qíng jiù shì dǎ kāi shǒu jī lǐ de wài mài yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn diǎn kāi wǒ xǐ ài de cān guǎn kàn kàn dàng tiān de cài dān rán hòu diǎn cān què rèn suǒ diǎn de fàn cài yìng fù de jīn é hé pèi sòng dì zhǐ zuì hòu xià dān hé fù kuǎn qián hòu bú dào wǔ fēn zhōng wǒ de fàn cài hěn kuài jiù huì zài lù shàng le xiàn zài yòng shǒu jī jiào wài mài yòu shěng shí yòu pián yi hái yǒu hěn duō xuǎn zé wài mài píng tái shàng nǐ xiǎng diǎn shén me dōu kě yǐ chú le běn dì cān guǎn de fàn cài hé tè sè cài yǐ wài nǐ hái kě yǐ diǎn yì xiē dàn gāo diàn yǐn liào diàn de tián diǎn hé yǐn liào shèn zhì lián xīng bā kè de kā fēi yě kě yǐ diǎn wài mài xiǎo gē zǒng shì néng gòu yǐ zuì kuài de sù dù bǎ wài mài sòng dào nǐ de shǒu shàng zài děng wài mài de shí hòu nǐ hái kě yǐ suí shí chá kàn wài mài píng tái de dìng wèi fú wù zhuī zōng wài mài xiǎo gē dào le nǎr ér qiě yào shì lù shàng de jiāo tōng hěn dǔ wài mài xiǎo gē zǒng shì huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà gào sù nǐ hái xū yào jǐ fēn zhōng — Monolog 1 (script; translations mine): Now I am a takeout food fan. For me the most important thing each day is opening the takeout app on my phone, tapping my favorite restaurant, looking at that day’s menu, then ordering, confirming the food ordered, the amount payable and the delivery address, and finally placing the order and paying; in under five minutes my meal is on its way. Ordering takeout by phone now saves time and is cheap, and there are many choices. On the takeout platform you can order anything you want: besides local restaurants’ dishes and specialties, you can also order desserts and drinks from cake shops and drink shops, even coffee from Starbucks. The delivery man can always bring the takeout to your hand at top speed. While waiting you can check the platform’s location service at any time and track where the delivery man has got to. And if the traffic on the road is jammed, the delivery man will always call you and tell you how many more minutes are needed. (the book prints 手机的里的外卖; read here as 手机里的外卖)

examples.text: 最近我和我的朋友们都爱上了民宿和短租房这样的旅行住宿方式。民宿和短租屋一般来说比较便宜，价格只有普通宾馆的三分之一或一半，特别适合我们这些学生党。这也是我们喜欢住民宿的主要原因。另外，我们都喜欢去一些小镇、乡村，自然风景优美的地方，住民宿可以让你真正体验当地的文化和习俗。还有，旅行中也能结交到很多新朋友。来自不同国家的游客，因为住在同一家民宿，一起聊天、吃饭、分享旅行的新闻，最后成为了朋友。现在大家都使用短租平台的手机应用，所以订民宿和短租房也特别容易，我们常常只要动一下手指，打开页面，看看照片和用户评价，就可以决定住哪家民宿了。接下来就是输入住宿时间和入住人的信息，然后选择手机付款，最后提交订单就可以了。
examples.translation: zuì jìn wǒ hé wǒ de péng yǒu men dōu ài shàng le mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng zhè yàng de lǚ xíng zhù sù fāng shì mín sù hé duǎn zū wū yì bān lái shuō bǐ jiào pián yi jià gé zhǐ yǒu pǔ tōng bīn guǎn de sān fēn zhī yí huò yí bàn tè bié shì hé wǒ men zhè xiē xué shēng dǎng zhè yě shì wǒ men xǐ huān zhù mín sù de zhǔ yào yuán yīn lìng wài wǒ men dōu xǐ huān qù yì xiē xiǎo zhèn xiāng cūn zì rán fēng jǐng yōu měi de dì fāng zhù mín sù kě yǐ ràng nǐ zhēn zhèng tǐ yàn dāng dì de wén huà hé xí sú hái yǒu lǚ xíng zhōng yě néng jié jiāo dào hěn duō xīn péng yǒu lái zì bù tóng guó jiā de yóu kè yīn wèi zhù zài tóng yì jiā mín sù yì qǐ liáo tiān chī fàn fēn xiǎng lǚ xíng de xīn wén zuì hòu chéng wéi le péng yǒu xiàn zài dà jiā dōu shǐ yòng duǎn zū píng tái de shǒu jī yìng yòng suǒ yǐ dìng mín sù hé duǎn zū fáng yě tè bié róng yì wǒ men cháng cháng zhǐ yào dòng yí xià shǒu zhǐ dǎ kāi yè miàn kàn kàn zhào piān hé yòng hù píng jià jiù kě yǐ jué dìng zhù nǎ jiā mín sù le jiē xià lái jiù shì shū rù zhù sù shí jiān hé rù zhù rén de xìn xī rán hòu xuǎn zé shǒu jī fù kuǎn zuì hòu tí jiāo dìng dān jiù kě yǐ le — Monolog 2: Recently my friends and I have all fallen in love with homestays and short-term rentals as a way to lodge when traveling. Homestays and short-term rentals are generally cheaper, with prices only a third or half of ordinary hotels, which suits us students especially. This is also the main reason we like staying in homestays. Besides, we all like going to small towns, villages and places with beautiful natural scenery, and staying in a homestay lets you truly experience the local culture and customs. Also, you can make many new friends on a trip. Tourists from different countries, because they stay in the same homestay, chat, eat and share travel news together and finally become friends. Now everyone uses the short-term rental platform apps, so booking homestays and rentals is also very easy; we often just move a finger, open the page, look at the photos and user reviews, and can decide which homestay to stay in. Next is entering the stay dates and guests’ information, then choosing to pay by phone, and finally submitting the order.

examples.text: 自从“滴滴出行”这样的网约车平台出现以后，我们这些上班族就有了更多、更方便的选择。“滴滴”除了提供出租车服务以外，还提供顺风车、拼车、专车等服务。每天，如果不想挤公交车或者坐地铁，我就搭顺风车，或者跟几个同事一起坐“滴滴”拼车上下班。这样既省去了等候的时间，还可以跟司机或同事一起分担交通的费用。另外，上班路上也更轻松愉快。因为，大家都是在智能手机上直接预约叫车，所以叫车以后，根据你手机所在位置和“滴滴”的精确定位，司机就可以准确无误地找到你。要是你需要特别的服务，就提前预约。有一次，我的同事晚上喝酒喝多了，就叫了“代驾”服务。代驾司机不但准时到达，开着车把我同事送到家门口，甚至还给同事的爱人打了电话。
examples.translation: zì cóng dī dī chū xíng zhè yàng de wǎng yuē chē píng tái chū xiàn yǐ hòu wǒ men zhè xiē shàng bān zú jiù yǒu le gèng duō gèng fāng biàn de xuǎn zé dī dī chú le tí gōng chū zū chē fú wù yǐ wài hái tí gōng shùn fēng chē pīn chē zhuān chē děng fú wù měi tiān rú guǒ bù xiǎng jǐ gōng jiāo chē huò zhě zuò dì tiě wǒ jiù dā shùn fēng chē huò zhě gēn jǐ gè tóng shì yì qǐ zuò dī dī pīn chē shàng xià bān zhè yàng jì shěng qù le děng hòu de shí jiān hái kě yǐ gēn sī jī huò tóng shì yì qǐ fēn dān jiāo tōng de fèi yòng lìng wài shàng bān lù shàng yě gèng qīng sōng yú kuài yīn wèi dà jiā dōu shì zài zhì néng shǒu jī shàng zhí jiē yù yuē jiào chē suǒ yǐ jiào chē yǐ hòu gēn jù nǐ shǒu jī suǒ zài wèi zhì hé dī dī de jīng què dìng wèi sī jī jiù kě yǐ zhǔn què wú wù de zhǎo dào nǐ yào shì nǐ xū yào tè bié de fú wù jiù tí qián yù yuē yǒu yí cì wǒ de tóng shì wǎn shàng hē jiǔ hē duō le jiù jiào le dài jià fú wù dài jià sī jī bú dàn zhǔn shí dào dá kāi zhe chē bǎ wǒ tóng shì sòng dào jiā mén kǒu shèn zhì hái gěi tóng shì de ài rén dǎ le diàn huà — Monolog 3: Since ride-hailing platforms like DiDi Chuxing appeared, we office workers have had more and more convenient choices. Besides taxi service, DiDi also offers carpool, ride-sharing and private-car services. Every day, if I don’t want to squeeze onto the bus or take the subway, I take a carpool ride, or ride a DiDi shared car to and from work with a few colleagues. This both saves waiting time and lets you share the transport cost with the driver or colleagues. Besides, the way to work is more relaxed and pleasant. Because everyone books the ride directly on the smartphone, after you call a car, according to your phone’s location and DiDi’s precise positioning, the driver can find you without error. If you need special service, book ahead. Once, a colleague of mine drank too much in the evening and called the “designated driver” service. The driver not only arrived on time and drove my colleague to his doorstep, but even phoned my colleague’s spouse.

What does the speaker of Monolog 3 do if she doesn’t want to take a crowded bus or the subway?

exercises.explanation: 我就搭顺风车，或者跟几个同事一起坐“滴滴”拼车.

exercises.prompt: What did the designated driver do for the colleague who drank too much?
options: Arrived on time, drove him to his door and even phoned his spouse
exercises.explanation: 准时到达，开着车把我同事送到家门口，甚至还给同事的爱人打了电话.

examples.text: 老李：老王啊，最近怎么没看到你常来公园锻炼啊？
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ lǎo wáng a zuì jìn zěn me méi kàn dào nǐ cháng lái gōng yuán duàn liàn a — Lao Wang’s trip (script; translations mine). Lao Li: Lao Wang, why haven’t I seen you coming to the park to exercise lately?

examples.text: 老王：你不知道啊？我和老伴最近参加了一个旅行团去欧洲玩了两个星期。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng nǐ bù zhī dào a wǒ hé lǎo bàn zuì jìn cān jiā le yí gè lǚ xíng tuán qù ōu zhōu wán le liǎng gè xīng qī — Lao Wang: Don’t you know? My wife and I recently joined a tour group and went to Europe for two weeks.

examples.text: 老李：去欧洲，那得花不少钱吧？
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ qù ōu zhōu nà děi huā bù shǎo qián ba — Lao Li: Going to Europe, that must cost quite a lot of money?

examples.text: 老王：不多，每个人才一万五千块。现在去欧洲的老年团有很多优惠。还有，现在大家都有钱了，付个旅行团的团费没问题。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng bù duō měi gè rén cái yí wàn wǔ qiān kuài xiàn zài qù ōu zhōu de lǎo nián tuán yǒu hěn duō yōu huì hái yǒu xiàn zài dà jiā dōu yǒu qián le fù gè lǚ xíng tuán de tuán fèi méi wèn tí — Lao Wang: Not much, only 15,000 yuan per person. There are many discounts now on senior tours to Europe. Also, everyone has money now, so paying a tour group’s fee is no problem. (the book writes 15,000 in digits)

examples.text: 老李：那签证好办吗？
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ nà qiān zhèng hǎo bàn ma — Lao Li: Is the visa easy to get?

examples.text: 老王：非常好办。现在都是旅行团给你代办。就是你自己去办签证也越来越容易。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng fēi cháng hǎo bàn xiàn zài dōu shì lǚ xíng tuán gěi nǐ dài bàn jiù shì nǐ zì jǐ qù bàn qiān zhèng yě yuè lái yuè róng yì — Lao Wang: Very easy. Now the tour group handles it for you. Even getting a visa yourself is getting easier and easier.

examples.text: 老李：你们坐的是哪家航空公司的飞机呢？
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ nǐ men zuò de shì nǎ jiā háng kōng gōng sī de fēi jī ne — Lao Li: Which airline’s plane did you take?

examples.text: 老王：这次我们坐的是中国国际航空公司的飞机。在欧洲，我们也坐了法航的一些短途飞机。法航也有很多新增的飞中国的国际航班，航线也很多。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng zhè cì wǒ men zuò de shì zhōng guó guó jì háng kōng gōng sī de fēi jī zài ōu zhōu wǒ men yě zuò le fǎ háng de yì xiē duǎn tú fēi jī fǎ háng yě yǒu hěn duō xīn zēng de fēi zhōng guó de guó jì háng bān háng xiàn yě hěn duō — Lao Wang: This time we took Air China. In Europe we also took some short-haul Air France flights. Air France also has many newly added international flights to China, and many routes.

examples.text: 老李：你们旅行的时候，行程都是旅行团给安排好了的吧？
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ nǐ men lǚ xíng de shí hòu xíng chéng dōu shì lǚ xíng tuán gěi ān pái hǎo le de ba — Lao Li: When you traveled, the itinerary was all arranged by the tour group, right?

examples.text: 老王：当然，我们年纪大了，加上语言不通，让旅行团安排所有的行程最方便。不像我儿子他们那些年轻人，说什么要自由行，自驾游。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng dāng rán wǒ men nián jì dà le jiā shàng yǔ yán bù tōng ràng lǚ xíng tuán ān pái suǒ yǒu de xíng chéng zuì fāng biàn bú xiàng wǒ ér zi tā men nà xiē nián qīng rén shuō shén me yào zì yóu xíng zì jià yóu — Lao Wang: Of course; we are old, and on top of that don’t speak the language, so letting the tour group arrange the whole itinerary is the most convenient. Not like my son and those young people, who say they want free travel and self-driving tours.

examples.text: 老李：他们开车旅行，可以慢慢开，慢慢看，真正体验当地的文化和生活。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ tā men kāi chē lǚ xíng kě yǐ màn màn kāi màn màn kàn zhēn zhèng tǐ yàn dāng dì de wén huà hé shēng huó — Lao Li: When they travel by car, they can drive slowly, look slowly, and truly experience the local culture and life.

examples.text: 老王：我们出国旅行的目的不一样。这次，我主要是带着老伴一起出国庆祝我们的金婚纪念日。顺便参观一下当地的博物馆和名胜古迹。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng wǒ men chū guó lǚ xíng de mù dì bù yí yàng zhè cì wǒ zhǔ yào shì dài zhe lǎo bàn yì qǐ chū guó qìng zhù wǒ men de jīn hūn jì niàn rì shùn biàn cān guān yí xià dāng dì de bó wù guǎn hé míng shèng gǔ jì — Lao Wang: Our purpose in traveling abroad is different. This time I mainly took my wife abroad to celebrate our golden wedding anniversary, and also visited local museums and places of interest.

examples.text: 老李：真好。我们跟年轻人的想法不一样。他们出国玩是为了放松身心、了解世界或是学习新东西。我们呢，就是到处看看，逛逛，欣赏一下风景。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ zhēn hǎo wǒ men gēn nián qīng rén de xiǎng fǎ bù yí yàng tā men chū guó wán shì wèi le fàng sōng shēn xīn liǎo jiě shì jiè huò shì xué xí xīn dōng xī wǒ men ne jiù shì dào chù kàn kàn guàng guàng xīn shǎng yí xià fēng jǐng — Lao Li: Lovely. Our thinking differs from young people’s. They go abroad to relax, to learn about the world or to learn new things. We just look around, stroll, and enjoy the scenery.

examples.text: 老王：还有啊，这次出去我发现中国人在国外“扫货”真是太厉害了。每到一个购物中心，都可以看到中国游客在那儿购物，买名牌，说是便宜。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng hái yǒu a zhè cì chū qù wǒ fā xiàn zhōng guó rén zài guó wài sǎo huò zhēn shì tài lì hài le měi dào yí gè gòu wù zhōng xīn dōu kě yǐ kàn dào zhōng guó yóu kè zài nàr gòu wù mǎi míng pái shuō shì pián yi — Lao Wang: And also, going out this time I found that Chinese people’s shopping sprees abroad are really too much. At every shopping center you can see Chinese tourists shopping there, buying famous brands, saying it’s cheap.

examples.text: 老李：哎，中国人现在是太有钱了吗？我觉得看看世界可以，买名牌就没有必要了吧。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ āi zhōng guó rén xiàn zài shì tài yǒu qián le ma wǒ jué de kàn kàn shì jiè kě yǐ mǎi míng pái jiù méi yǒu bì yào le ba — Lao Li: Hey, are Chinese people too rich now? I think seeing the world is fine, but buying famous brands is not necessary.

Listen to the passage and answer the following questions: 1. Who is the speaker? 2. How many different attributes of the speaker’s generation are described? And what are they? 3. What is your impression of the speaker? C. Listen to the passage a second time and write detailed information for the following questions: 1. What is the general view of the speaker’s generation? 2. Does the speaker agree or not? What is the speaker’s argument? 3. List the impact of the internet and mobile devices on the speaker’s generation. 4. List the hobbies and interests of the speaker’s generation. 5. What contributes to the speaker’s confidence? D. Work in groups of three and share your answers with your partners. Read the script and check whether you have additional questions. E. In the same group, discuss the characteristics of Generation Z in the U.S. The words, the script and my answers:

B2. How many different attributes of the speaker’s generation are described? What are they?

Four: they grew up with the internet and phones (and love net slang); their views of the world come from the internet, giving global horizons and higher goals such as caring about the environment; their interests are broad and special (celebrities, games, friends, selfies, anime); and rich knowledge, vision and interests make them more confident

examples.text: 大家好，我叫陆凡，二零零四年出生，所以是标准的零零后。现在大家都说我们是幸福的一代人，因为我们的父母和许多前辈们给我们创造了非常好的生活和学习条件。我觉得这样说，没错。可是呢，我们这些零零后除了享受这些好条件以外，我们也有很多自己的想法和目标，另外我们跟父母这一辈人的兴趣和爱好也有很大的不同。首先，我们成长的时期是中国的经济和互联网快速发展的时期。从小我们就开始接触和使用互联网和手机。现在网上有很多网络流行语，特别受我们这些零零后的喜爱，因为这样的语言给人的感觉更加可爱，我们不太喜欢过于正式地讲话。同样，我们对世界的看法也有很多是来自于互联网上的信息和各种知识。只要我们想学习，可以每天二十四小时不停地在手机上和网上了解想要知道的信息。正是这个原因，我们的视野更加全球化，目标也更高。比如说，我们这一代人很关心环保，关心地球。我们喜欢骑共享单车，目标就是为了有一个更加绿色的世界。还有，我们的兴趣爱好既广泛，又特别。我们喜欢明星、游戏、交友、自拍、动漫等等。平时我们的学习很紧张，还要上很多的培训班和兴趣班，但这些并没有影响我们成为“动漫迷”。丰富的知识、广阔的视野和众多的兴趣和爱好，让我们这些零零后更加自信。
examples.translation: dà jiā hǎo wǒ jiào lù fán èr líng líng sì nián chū shēng suǒ yǐ shì biāo zhǔn de líng líng hòu xiàn zài dà jiā dōu shuō wǒ men shì xìng fú de yí dài rén yīn wèi wǒ men de fù mǔ hé xǔ duō qián bèi men gěi wǒ men chuàng zào le fēi cháng hǎo de shēng huó hé xué xí tiáo jiàn wǒ jué de zhè yàng shuō méi cuò kě shì ne wǒ men zhè xiē líng líng hòu chú le xiǎng shòu zhè xiē hǎo tiáo jiàn yǐ wài wǒ men yě yǒu hěn duō zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ hé mù biāo lìng wài wǒ men gēn fù mǔ zhè yí bèi rén de xìng qù hé ài hào yě yǒu hěn dà de bù tóng shǒu xiān wǒ men chéng zhǎng de shí qī shì zhōng guó de jīng jì hé hù lián wǎng kuài sù fā zhǎn de shí qī cóng xiǎo wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ jiē chù hé shǐ yòng hù lián wǎng hé shǒu jī xiàn zài wǎng shàng yǒu hěn duō wǎng luò liú xíng yǔ tè bié shòu wǒ men zhè xiē líng líng hòu de xǐ ài yīn wèi zhè yàng de yǔ yán gěi rén de gǎn jué gèng jiā kě ài wǒ men bú tài xǐ huān guò yú zhèng shì de jiǎng huà tóng yàng wǒ men duì shì jiè de kàn fǎ yě yǒu hěn duō shì lái zì yú hù lián wǎng shàng de xìn xī hé gè zhǒng zhī shí zhǐ yào wǒ men xiǎng xué xí kě yǐ měi tiān èr shí sì xiǎo shí bù tíng de zài shǒu jī shàng hé wǎng shàng liǎo jiě xiǎng yào zhī dào de xìn xī zhèng shì zhè ge yuán yīn wǒ men de shì yě gèng jiā quán qiú huà mù biāo yě gèng gāo bǐ rú shuō wǒ men zhè yí dài rén hěn guān xīn huán bǎo guān xīn dì qiú wǒ men xǐ huān qí gòng xiǎng dān chē mù biāo jiù shì wèi le yǒu yí gè gèng jiā lǜ sè de shì jiè hái yǒu wǒ men de xìng qù ài hào jì guǎng fàn yòu tè bié wǒ men xǐ huān míng xīng yóu xì jiāo yǒu zì pāi dòng màn děng děng píng shí wǒ men de xué xí hěn jǐn zhāng hái yào shàng hěn duō de péi xùn bān hé xìng qù bān dàn zhè xiē bìng méi yǒu yǐng xiǎng wǒ men chéng wéi dòng màn mí fēng fù de zhī shí guǎng kuò de shì yě hé zhòng duō de xìng qù hé ài hào ràng wǒ men zhè xiē líng líng hòu gèng jiā zì xìn — Activity 4D, script of Lu Fan’s talk (translations mine): Hello everyone, my name is Lu Fan. I was born in 2004, so I am a typical post-2000s kid. Now everyone says we are a happy generation, because our parents and many elders created very good living and study conditions for us. I think that’s right. But besides enjoying these good conditions, we post-2000s also have many ideas and goals of our own, and our interests and hobbies differ greatly from our parents’ generation. First, the period in which we grew up was one of rapid development of China’s economy and the internet. From childhood we began to come into contact with and use the internet and phones. There are now many internet slang words, especially loved by us post-2000s, because such language feels cuter and we don’t like to speak too formally. Likewise, many of our views of the world come from information and knowledge on the internet. As long as we want to learn, we can find out the information we want on phones and online 24 hours a day without stopping. It is precisely for this reason that our horizons are more global and our goals higher. For example, our generation cares a lot about environmental protection and the earth. We like to ride shared bikes, with the aim of a greener world. Also, our interests and hobbies are both broad and special. We like celebrities, games, making friends, selfies, anime and so on. Our studies are usually tense and we also attend many training classes and interest classes, but these haven’t stopped us from becoming “anime fans.” Rich knowledge, broad horizons and many interests and hobbies make us post-2000s even more confident. (the book writes 2004, 00 后 and 24 with digits)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 5 (Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Listen to a TV interview about children from the countryside and complete the tasks. A. Listen to the interview once and answer the multiple-choice questions: 1. What is the topic of the interview? (农村的留守儿童 / 城市里的流动儿童 / 留守儿童和流动儿童 / 留守儿童的心理问题) 2. Who are the two guest speakers? (Two journalists / Two experts from the Ministry of Education / Two professors, one from Beijing University and one from Qinghua University / Two professors, one from Beijing University and one from Renmin University) B. Pair up. Each partner listens to one part of the interview and answers the related questions. C. When you have answered the questions, exchange information with your partner and ask each other the questions. Write down their answers. D. Read the scripts together and check your information. E. Work in groups of three and discuss the following questions. The scripts and my answers:

rows: A1. What is the topic of the interview?
留守儿童和流动儿童 (left-behind children and migrant children)
A2. Who are the two guest speakers?
Two professors, one from Beijing University and one from Renmin University
B Part 1, 1. The guest’s definition of the children’s group
Children left in their hometown with grandparents or relatives because their parents work in cities
B Part 1, 2. Why have these children been left behind?
The parents work long hours with no time for them, and city life is expensive
B Part 1, 3. How do they live? Three details
Looked after by older people; cooked for and taken to school; seldom have parental love or chances to talk with parents
B Part 2, 1. The definition of the group
Children who follow working parents to live in the city for at least half a year
B Part 2, 2. Are they more fortunate? Why?
Yes, somewhat: they can be with their parents and get their care and love
School fees and entering schools; some schools have poor quality; frequent moves to new schools and environments

examples.text: 主持人：大家好，欢迎大家来参加我们的节目。今天我们非常高兴地请到了两位教育方面的专家：一位是来自北京大学的王林教授；另一位呢是人民大学的张刚教授。
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén dà jiā hǎo huān yíng dà jiā lái cān jiā wǒ men de jié mù jīn tiān wǒ men fēi cháng gāo xìng de qǐng dào le liǎng wèi jiào yù fāng miàn de zhuān jiā yí wèi shì lái zì běi jīng dà xué de wáng lín jiào shòu lìng yí wèi ne shì rén mín dà xué de zhāng gāng jiào shòu — Part 1 script (translations mine). Host: Hello everyone, welcome to our program. Today we are delighted to have two experts in education: Professor Wang Lin from Peking University and Professor Zhang Gang from Renmin University.

examples.text: 王林：大家好！
examples.translation: wáng lín dà jiā hǎo — Wang Lin: Hello everyone!

examples.text: 张刚：大家好！
examples.translation: zhāng gāng dà jiā hǎo — Zhang Gang: Hello everyone!

examples.text: 主持人：你们二位都是教育专家，请先说说我们国家留守儿童和流动儿童的情况，好吗？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén nǐ men èr wèi dōu shì jiào yù zhuān jiā qǐng xiān shuō shuō wǒ men guó jiā liú shǒu ér tóng hé liú dòng ér tóng de qíng kuàng hǎo ma — Host: You are both education experts; please first tell us about the situation of left-behind children and migrant children in our country, all right?

examples.text: 王林：好的。我们大家都知道，现在中国的农村呢有大量的留守儿童，主要就是那些父母需要到城市里打工而被留在老家跟自己的爷爷、奶奶、外公、外婆或亲戚一起生活的孩子们。他们常常很久见不到自己父母。
examples.translation: wáng lín hǎo de wǒ men dà jiā dōu zhī dào xiàn zài zhōng guó de nóng cūn ne yǒu dà liàng de liú shǒu ér tóng zhǔ yào jiù shì nà xiē fù mǔ xū yào dào chéng shì lǐ dǎ gōng ér bèi liú zài lǎo jiā gēn zì jǐ de yé yé nǎi nǎi wài gōng wài pó huò qīn qī yì qǐ shēng huó de hái zi men tā men cháng cháng hěn jiǔ jiàn bú dào zì jǐ fù mǔ — Wang Lin: All right. We all know that rural China now has a great many left-behind children, mainly children whose parents have to go work in cities and who are left in their hometowns to live with their grandparents or relatives. They often can’t see their parents for a long time.

examples.text: 主持人：那打工的父母为什么不把孩子也带到城市里呢？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén nà dǎ gōng de fù mǔ wèi shén me bù bǎ hái zi yě dài dào chéng shì lǐ ne — Host: Then why don’t the working parents bring their children to the city?

examples.text: 王林：一般来说，打工的父母们工作非常辛苦，每天要工作很长时间，他们没有时间来照顾自己的孩子。还有一个原因就是，城市里的生活很贵，有些父母没有足够的钱可以让自己的孩子们在城里生活。
examples.translation: wáng lín yì bān lái shuō dǎ gōng de fù mǔ men gōng zuò fēi cháng xīn kǔ měi tiān yào gōng zuò hěn cháng shí jiān tā men méi yǒu shí jiān lái zhào gù zì jǐ de hái zi hái yǒu yí gè yuán yīn jiù shì chéng shì lǐ de shēng huó hěn guì yǒu xiē fù mǔ méi yǒu zú gòu de qián kě yǐ ràng zì jǐ de hái zi men zài chéng lǐ shēng huó — Wang Lin: Generally, working parents work very hard, long hours every day, and have no time to look after their children. Another reason is that life in the city is expensive, and some parents don’t have enough money for their children to live in the city.

examples.text: 主持人：这些留守儿童们在农村都是怎么生活的呢？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén zhè xiē liú shǒu ér tóng men zài nóng cūn dōu shì zěn me shēng huó de ne — Host: How do these left-behind children live in the countryside?

examples.text: 王林：他们主要是由家里年纪比较大的老人们来照顾，给他们做饭、送他们去上学等等。但是，孩子们很少有父母的关爱，也很少有机会跟父母交流。
examples.translation: wáng lín tā men zhǔ yào shì yóu jiā lǐ nián jì bǐ jiào dà de lǎo rén men lái zhào gù gěi tā men zuò fàn sòng tā men qù shàng xué děng děng dàn shì hái zi men hěn shǎo yǒu fù mǔ de guān ài yě hěn shǎo yǒu jī huì gēn fù mǔ jiāo liú — Wang Lin: They are mainly looked after by the older people at home, who cook for them, take them to school and so on. But the children rarely have their parents’ love and care, and rarely have a chance to talk with their parents.

examples.text: 主持人：那流动儿童又是什么样的孩子呢？张教授，请你来谈谈，好吗？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén nà liú dòng ér tóng yòu shì shén me yàng de hái zi ne zhāng jiào shòu qǐng nǐ lái tán tán hǎo ma — Part 2 script. Host: And what kind of children are migrant children? Professor Zhang, please tell us, will you?

examples.text: 张刚：好的。现在我们所说的“流动儿童”就是指那些随着打工的父母到城市里生活至少半年以上的孩子们。跟留守儿童相比，他们更幸运一些，至少能够和自己的父母在一起，能得到父母的照顾和爱护。
examples.translation: zhāng gāng hǎo de xiàn zài wǒ men suǒ shuō de liú dòng ér tóng jiù shì zhǐ nà xiē suí zhe dǎ gōng de fù mǔ dào chéng shì lǐ shēng huó zhì shǎo bàn nián yǐ shàng de hái zi men gēn liú shǒu ér tóng xiāng bǐ tā men gèng xìng yùn yì xiē zhì shǎo néng gòu hé zì jǐ de fù mǔ zài yì qǐ néng dé dào fù mǔ de zhào gù hé ài hù — Zhang Gang: All right. What we now call “migrant children” are children who follow their working parents to live in the city for at least half a year. Compared with left-behind children they are somewhat luckier: at least they can be with their parents and get their care and love.

examples.text: 主持人：为什么我们不可以让更多的留守儿童变成流动儿童呢？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén wèi shén me wǒ men bù kě yǐ ràng gèng duō de liú shǒu ér tóng biàn chéng liú dòng ér tóng ne — Host: Why can’t we let more left-behind children become migrant children?

examples.text: 张刚：虽然流动儿童的生活和环境好一些，但是他们同样也有很多的困难。比如上学的问题。开始的时候，流动儿童进入城市里的公立学校需要交很多的钱。
examples.translation: zhāng gāng suī rán liú dòng ér tóng de shēng huó hé huán jìng hǎo yì xiē dàn shì tā men tóng yàng yě yǒu hěn duō de kùn nán bǐ rú shàng xué de wèn tí kāi shǐ de shí hòu liú dòng ér tóng jìn rù chéng shì lǐ de gōng lì xué xiào xū yào jiāo hěn duō de qián — Zhang Gang: Although migrant children’s life and environment are somewhat better, they too have many difficulties, for example school. At the start, migrant children had to pay a lot of money to enter public schools in the city.

examples.text: 主持人：那现在呢？
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén nà xiàn zài ne — Host: And now?

examples.text: 张刚：现在百分之八十的孩子可以去附近的公办学校读书。另外的百分之二十可能会去一些打工子弟的学校，但这些学校的教育质量比较差，甚至有的还不如农村的学校。
examples.translation: zhāng gāng xiàn zài bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de hái zi kě yǐ qù fù jìn de gōng bàn xué xiào dú shū lìng wài de bǎi fēn zhī èr shí kě néng huì qù yì xiē dǎ gōng zǐ dì de xué xiào dàn zhè xiē xué xiào de jiào yù zhì liàng bǐ jiào chà shèn zhì yǒu de hái bù rú nóng cūn de xué xiào — Zhang Gang: Now 80 percent of the children can go to a nearby public school. The other 20 percent may go to some migrant workers’ children’s schools, but the education quality at these schools is relatively poor, and some are even not as good as rural schools. (the book writes 80% and 20% in digits)

examples.text: 主持人：所以，总的来说流动儿童的条件比以前好一些。
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén suǒ yǐ zǒng de lái shuō liú dòng ér tóng de tiáo jiàn bǐ yǐ qián hǎo yì xiē — Host: So, on the whole, migrant children’s conditions are somewhat better than before.

examples.text: 张刚：是这样的。不过，因为打工的父母常常换工作，或者搬到别的城市去打工，这些流动儿童不得不跟着父母不停地搬家，进入一个新的学校，习惯一个新的环境。这样，对孩子也会有很大的影响。
examples.translation: zhāng gāng shì zhè yàng de bú guò yīn wèi dǎ gōng de fù mǔ cháng cháng huàn gōng zuò huò zhě bān dào bié de chéng shì qù dǎ gōng zhè xiē liú dòng ér tóng bù dé bù gēn zhe fù mǔ bù tíng de bān jiā jìn rù yí gè xīn de xué xiào xí guàn yí gè xīn de huán jìng zhè yàng duì hái zi yě huì yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng — Zhang Gang: That’s right. But because working parents often change jobs or move to other cities to work, these migrant children have no choice but to keep moving with their parents, entering a new school and getting used to a new environment. This too has a great impact on the children.

examples.text: 主持人：好的，现在我们休息一下。待会儿接着再聊。
examples.translation: zhǔ chí rén hǎo de xiàn zài wǒ men xiū xī yí xià dài huìr jiē zhe zài liáo — Host: All right, let’s take a break now and continue chatting later. (the book prints 呆会儿, read here as 待会儿)

examples.text: 美国有留守儿童或流动儿童吗？
examples.translation: měi guó yǒu liú shǒu ér tóng huò liú dòng ér tóng ma — Activity 5E (translations mine): Are there left-behind or migrant children in America?

examples.text: 如果有，请描述一下他们的生活。
examples.translation: rú guǒ yǒu qǐng miáo shù yí xià tā men de shēng huó — If so, please describe their life.

examples.text: 如果没有，请解释为什么没有这样的情况？
examples.translation: rú guǒ méi yǒu qǐng jiě shì wèi shén me méi yǒu zhè yàng de qíng kuàng — If not, please explain why there is no such situation?

exercises.prompt: Why do people call Lu Fan’s generation happy?
options: Parents and elders created very good living and study conditions
exercises.explanation: 我们的父母和许多前辈们给我们创造了非常好的生活和学习条件.

exercises.prompt: What kind of language do the post-2000s like?
options: Cute internet slang rather than overly formal speech
exercises.explanation: 我们不太喜欢过于正式地讲话.

exercises.prompt: What do the post-2000s care about, per Lu Fan?
What do they like, besides games and celebrities?
What makes Lu Fan’s generation more confident?
options: Rich knowledge, broad horizons and many interests
exercises.explanation: 丰富的知识、广阔的视野和众多的兴趣和爱好.

exercises.prompt: Who are the two guests in the TV interview?
Why don’t working parents bring their children to the city?
options: No time to look after them, and city life is expensive
exercises.explanation: 没有时间来照顾自己的孩子……城市里的生活很贵.

exercises.prompt: How long must a child live in the city to count as a “migrant child”?
What share of migrant children can now attend nearby public schools?
exercises.explanation: 现在百分之八十的孩子可以去附近的公办学校读书.

exercises.prompt: What is another difficulty for migrant children?
options: Frequent moves to new schools and environments
exercises.explanation: 不停地搬家，进入一个新的学校，习惯一个新的环境.

exercises.prompt: 我们的视野更加全球___，目标也更高。
这些学校的教育质量比较差，甚至有的还不如农村的学___。

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the news article about foreign visitors in China and complete the tasks. The article (four paragraphs) and the tasks:

headers: Task (the article is printed twice in the book; the tables are blank and the book gives no key)
rows: Pair up and read the first paragraph together. Share your understanding of the paragraph and predict what information you can expect in the paragraphs that follow. (Your Prediction:)

Work in groups of three. Each group member reads one paragraph of the following article. Summarize your paragraph and complete the details in the table, then share your information with your partners and take notes on their information. Student 1, Paragraph 2: Main idea of the paragraph; Who; What platform & app used; What the person does with the app; Reasons for using the app; Other information. Student 2, Paragraph 3: Main idea; Who; What platform & app used; Services provided by the app; Reasons for using the app; What the person does with the app. Student 3, Paragraph 4: Main idea; Who; What platform & app used; What the person does with the app; Reasons for using the app; Other information.
Quickly read through the other two paragraphs not assigned to you. Then tell your partners what you would do in China if you were working or studying there today.
tables.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 6 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking): the tasks

examples.text: 随着科技和人工智能的发展，智能手机和手机应用越来越普遍，特别是在中国。如果你是最近到中国旅游过的外国人，你会发现当代的中国人长途旅行坐高铁，市内交通打滴滴，购物上淘宝，吃饭叫美团、饿了么，聊天付款靠微信，一切尽在掌上——一个智能手机就能走遍天下。
examples.translation: suí zhe kē jì hé rén gōng zhì néng de fā zhǎn zhì néng shǒu jī hé shǒu jī yìng yòng yuè lái yuè pǔ biàn tè bié shì zài zhōng guó rú guǒ nǐ shì zuì jìn dào zhōng guó lǚ yóu guò de wài guó rén nǐ huì fā xiàn dāng dài de zhōng guó rén cháng tú lǚ xíng zuò gāo tiě shì nèi jiāo tōng dǎ dī dī gòu wù shàng táo bǎo chī fàn jiào měi tuán è le me liáo tiān fù kuǎn kào wēi xìn yí qiè jǐn zài zhǎng shàng yí gè zhì néng shǒu jī jiù néng zǒu biàn tiān xià — Activity 6, paragraph 1 (translations mine): With the development of technology and artificial intelligence, smartphones and phone apps are becoming more and more common, especially in China. If you are a foreigner who has recently traveled in China, you will find that today’s Chinese take high-speed rail for long trips, use DiDi in the city, shop on Taobao, order meals from Meituan and Ele.me, and chat and pay with WeChat; everything is in the palm of your hand, and one smartphone can take you everywhere.

examples.text: 在上海工作的美国人珍妮，已经习惯了这样的生活方式。她最经常使用的一款外卖软件叫“美团”。她也尝试下载使用过其他的外卖软件，比如“饿了么”，但用得最多的还是“美团”。现在珍妮已经成了外卖点餐的大户，她每天要在外卖平台上点两顿餐，甚至有时候会点第三顿。首先，因为她喜欢中国菜，什么菜都想试吃一下。另外，她喜欢根据外卖平台上的图片点外卖，所以每次点外卖的时候都很开心。虽然她看不懂外卖软件上餐厅的中文介绍和用户评价，但是只要看到照片她就会很惊喜。能够在一个平台上点那么多餐厅的饭菜，而且还有电子发票和账单，扫一下“二维码”就可以手机付款，对她来说，这简直太幸福了。
examples.translation: zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò de měi guó rén zhēn nī yǐ jīng xí guàn le zhè yàng de shēng huó fāng shì tā zuì jīng cháng shǐ yòng de yì kuǎn wài mài ruǎn jiàn jiào měi tuán tā yě cháng shì xià zài shǐ yòng guò qí tā de wài mài ruǎn jiàn bǐ rú è le me dàn yòng de zuì duō de hái shì měi tuán xiàn zài zhēn nī yǐ jīng chéng le wài mài diǎn cān de dà hù tā měi tiān yào zài wài mài píng tái shàng diǎn liǎng dùn cān shèn zhì yǒu shí hòu huì diǎn dì sān dùn shǒu xiān yīn wèi tā xǐ huān zhōng guó cài shén me cài dōu xiǎng shì chī yí xià lìng wài tā xǐ huān gēn jù wài mài píng tái shàng de tú piàn diǎn wài mài suǒ yǐ měi cì diǎn wài mài de shí hòu dōu hěn kāi xīn suī rán tā kàn bù dǒng wài mài ruǎn jiàn shàng cān tīng de zhōng wén jiè shào hé yòng hù píng jià dàn shì zhǐ yào kàn dào zhào piān tā jiù huì hěn jīng xǐ néng gòu zài yí gè píng tái shàng diǎn nà me duō cān tīng de fàn cài ér qiě hái yǒu diàn zi fā piào hé zhàng dān sǎo yí xià èr wéi mǎ jiù kě yǐ shǒu jī fù kuǎn duì tā lái shuō zhè jiǎn zhí tài xìng fú le — Paragraph 2: Jenny, an American working in Shanghai, is already used to this way of life. The takeout app she uses most is called “Meituan.” She has also tried downloading other takeout apps, such as “Ele.me,” but the one she uses most is still “Meituan.” Jenny has now become a heavy takeout customer: she orders two meals a day on the platform and sometimes even a third. First, because she likes Chinese food and wants to try every dish. Also, she likes ordering according to the pictures on the platform, so she is happy every time. Although she can’t read the restaurants’ Chinese descriptions and user reviews on the app, as long as she sees the photos she is pleasantly surprised. Being able to order from so many restaurants on one platform, with electronic invoices and bills, and paying by phone by scanning a “QR code,” is simply too happy a thing for her.

examples.text: 来自荷兰的玛丽说，到中国之后她发现使用手机的机会特别多，比如说：打车软件、共享单车小程序等。很多外国人在中国生活的时候发现在这里的打车软件特别流行和受欢迎，似乎每个人都会用打车软件，不光叫快车、专车，还能招到出租车。第一次去中国，那儿的朋友告诉她必须下载两个手机应用：一个是微信；另一个就是滴滴。有了它们，她可以去中国的任何一个地方。如果手机上没有滴滴出行，她就寸步难行。玛丽很少打车，只有当她要去一趟北京特别远的郊区，她才会使用网约车。相对来说，她更喜欢尝试共享单车。在荷兰，大部分人都喜欢骑自行车出行。
examples.translation: lái zì hé lán de mǎ lì shuō dào zhōng guó zhī hòu tā fā xiàn shǐ yòng shǒu jī de jī huì tè bié duō bǐ rú shuō dǎ chē ruǎn jiàn gòng xiǎng dān chē xiǎo chéng xù děng hěn duō wài guó rén zài zhōng guó shēng huó de shí hòu fā xiàn zài zhè lǐ de dǎ chē ruǎn jiàn tè bié liú xíng hé shòu huān yíng sì hū měi gè rén dōu huì yòng dǎ chē ruǎn jiàn bù guāng jiào kuài chē zhuān chē hái néng zhāo dào chū zū chē dì yī cì qù zhōng guó nàr de péng yǒu gào sù tā bì xū xià zài liǎng gè shǒu jī yìng yòng yí gè shì wēi xìn lìng yí gè jiù shì dī dī yǒu le tā men tā kě yǐ qù zhōng guó de rèn hé yí gè dì fāng rú guǒ shǒu jī shàng méi yǒu dī dī chū xíng tā jiù cùn bù nán xíng mǎ lì hěn shǎo dǎ chē zhǐ yǒu dāng tā yào qù yí tàng běi jīng tè bié yuǎn de jiāo qū tā cái huì shǐ yòng wǎng yuē chē xiāng duì lái shuō tā gèng xǐ huān cháng shì gòng xiǎng dān chē zài hé lán dà bù fèn rén dōu xǐ huān qí zì xíng chē chū xíng — Paragraph 3: Mary, from the Netherlands, says that after arriving in China she found there were especially many chances to use the phone, for example ride-hailing apps and shared-bike mini programs. Many foreigners living in China find that ride-hailing apps are especially popular here; it seems everyone uses them, not only to call express and private cars but even to hail taxis. On her first trip to China, friends there told her she must download two apps: one was WeChat and the other DiDi. With them she can go anywhere in China. Without DiDi on her phone she could hardly take a step. Mary rarely takes a car; only when she has to go to a particularly far suburb of Beijing does she use a ride-hailing car. Relatively speaking she prefers trying shared bikes. In the Netherlands most people like to travel by bike.

examples.text: 其实除了聊天、移动支付、叫外卖、打车之外，在中国也有很多人在手机上安装民宿、短租平台的应用软件，实现“一键”式的民宿短租预定，真正实现了“衣食住行”都在手机上。来自加拿大的留学生杰西说，中国人每天好像就住在自己的手机里。说到旅行住宿，他发现很多中国的年轻人现在都喜欢住民宿、短租房。他的很多中国朋友喜欢用中国本土的小猪短租、蚂蚁短租等平台。但是，对他来说，“爱彼迎”的英文平台更方便一些。不过，有时候跟中国朋友一起旅行，他也跟他们一样，通过中文的短租平台，找到一些非常便宜的民宿。他特别喜欢那些有中国文化特色和当地习俗的民宿。有些房主还亲自给房客做家常菜和当地的饭，这让杰西觉得可以有更多美好的回忆。他也喜欢通过手机应用给房主打分，写评价。还有，他也经常在旅行中给自己的家人发送照片，分享在中国的经历。
examples.translation: qí shí chú le liáo tiān yí dòng zhī fù jiào wài mài dǎ chē zhī wài zài zhōng guó yě yǒu hěn duō rén zài shǒu jī shàng ān zhuāng mín sù duǎn zū píng tái de yìng yòng ruǎn jiàn shí xiàn yí jiàn shì de mín sù duǎn zū yù dìng zhēn zhèng shí xiàn le yī shí zhù xíng dōu zài shǒu jī shàng lái zì jiā ná dà de liú xué shēng jié xī shuō zhōng guó rén měi tiān hǎo xiàng jiù zhù zài zì jǐ de shǒu jī lǐ shuō dào lǚ xíng zhù sù tā fā xiàn hěn duō zhōng guó de nián qīng rén xiàn zài dōu xǐ huān zhù mín sù duǎn zū fáng tā de hěn duō zhōng guó péng yǒu xǐ huān yòng zhōng guó běn tǔ de xiǎo zhū duǎn zū mǎ yǐ duǎn zū děng píng tái dàn shì duì tā lái shuō ài bǐ yíng de yīng wén píng tái gèng fāng biàn yì xiē bú guò yǒu shí hòu gēn zhōng guó péng yǒu yì qǐ lǚ xíng tā yě gēn tā men yí yàng tōng guò zhōng wén de duǎn zū píng tái zhǎo dào yì xiē fēi cháng pián yi de mín sù tā tè bié xǐ huān nà xiē yǒu zhōng guó wén huà tè sè hé dāng dì xí sú de mín sù yǒu xiē fáng zhǔ hái qīn zì gěi fáng kè zuò jiā cháng cài hé dāng dì de fàn zhè ràng jié xī jué de kě yǐ yǒu gèng duō měi hǎo de huí yì tā yě xǐ huān tōng guò shǒu jī yìng yòng gěi fáng zhǔ dǎ fēn xiě píng jià hái yǒu tā yě jīng cháng zài lǚ xíng zhōng gěi zì jǐ de jiā rén fā sòng zhào piān fēn xiǎng zài zhōng guó de jīng lì — Paragraph 4: In fact, besides chatting, mobile payment, ordering takeout and hailing rides, many people in China also install homestay and short-term-rental apps on their phones, making “one-key” bookings possible, truly realizing “clothing, food, housing and transport” all on the phone. Jesse, an international student from Canada, says that Chinese people seem to live in their phones every day. Speaking of travel lodging, he found that many young Chinese now like homestays and short-term rentals. Many of his Chinese friends like using Chinese platforms such as Xiaozhu Duanzu and Mayi Duanzu. But for him, the English platform of “Airbnb” is a bit more convenient. Still, when traveling with Chinese friends he too, like them, finds some very cheap homestays through the Chinese platforms. He especially likes homestays with Chinese cultural features and local customs. Some hosts even personally cook home-style and local dishes for guests, which lets Jesse feel he has more beautiful memories. He also likes rating hosts and writing reviews through the phone app. Also, he often sends photos to his family during travel, sharing his experiences in China.

exercises.prompt: What does Mary prefer to try?

来自加拿大的留学生杰西.

exercises.prompt: Which platform is more convenient for Jesse?

explanations.body: Read the news article 中国的三次留学热 and complete the tasks. The article (four paragraphs), the book’s tasks and my answers:

headers: Book’s task (the book leaves the answer lines blank)
rows: Discuss the following topic with a partner and write down key words in Chinese: 出国留学的好处

Pair up. Each student reads two paragraphs of the news article. Determine the topic sentence in each paragraph, then write a summary of the paragraph. (Topic Sentence / Summary for each pair of paragraphs)
Share your information with your partner when you are done. Together, create a title for the article in Chinese. (The article’s own heading is 中国的三次留学热.)
Compare the three waves of Chinese students studying abroad and complete the table (留学热 | 发生时间 | 特点和不同).
tables.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 7 (Reading, Writing, Speaking, and Listening): the tasks

rows: 从九十年代起，中国一共经历了三次留学热。
第一波留学热在九十年代初，自费留学开始多起来，很多留学生毕业后留在国外工作。
二零零零年左右……中国开始了第二波留学热。
第二波的留学生多来自富裕家庭，分高中毕业和本科毕业后出国两批，希望找到理想的工作。
二零零八年以后，出国留学热继续升温，成为第三波留学热。
普通工薪家庭也加入留学大军，小留学生越来越多，有的妈妈还陪读。
一般来说，出国留学以后，留学生们的优势很明显。
留学生的英文、团队工作能力和解决问题的能力都有优势，但近年来“海归”渐渐失去了优势。

tables.title: Activity 7D: the three waves compared (my answers)

examples.text: 从九十年代起，中国一共经历了三次留学热。第一波留学热开始于九十年代初。那时候，留学更多是个人选择，自费留学的慢慢开始多起来，不像以前有很多是公费出国留学的。当时出去的留学生毕业后有很多人选择了留在国外工作和生活，因为那时国外的待遇和条件比国内好得多。
examples.translation: cóng jiǔ shí nián dài qǐ zhōng guó yí gòng jīng lì le sān cì liú xué rè dì yī bō liú xué rè kāi shǐ yú jiǔ shí nián dài chū nà shí hòu liú xué gèng duō shì gè rén xuǎn zé zì fèi liú xué de màn màn kāi shǐ duō qǐ lái bú xiàng yǐ qián yǒu hěn duō shì gōng fèi chū guó liú xué de dāng shí chū qù de liú xué shēng bì yè hòu yǒu hěn duō rén xuǎn zé le liú zài guó wài gōng zuò hé shēng huó yīn wèi nà shí guó wài de dài yù hé tiáo jiàn bǐ guó nèi hǎo de duō — Activity 7, paragraph 1 (translations mine): Since the nineties, China has gone through three study-abroad booms in all. The first wave began in the early nineties. At that time studying abroad was more a personal choice; self-funded study slowly began to increase, unlike before, when many went abroad at public expense. Many of the students who went out then chose, after graduating, to stay abroad to work and live, because at that time pay and conditions abroad were far better than at home.

examples.text: 二零零零年左右，随着互联网的出现和发展，中国开始了第二波留学热。这些留学生多来自富裕的家庭。而且，这一次的留学热也可以分为两批：高中毕业出去留学的和本科读完之后出去留学的。他们主要是去国外读大学或研究生，希望以后可以找到一个工资高、待遇好、工作环境适合的理想工作，可以在国内或是在国外工作。
examples.translation: èr líng líng líng nián zuǒ yòu suí zhe hù lián wǎng de chū xiàn hé fā zhǎn zhōng guó kāi shǐ le dì èr bō liú xué rè zhè xiē liú xué shēng duō lái zì fù yù de jiā tíng ér qiě zhè yí cì de liú xué rè yě kě yǐ fēn wéi liǎng pī gāo zhōng bì yè chū qù liú xué de hé běn kē dú wán zhī hòu chū qù liú xué de tā men zhǔ yào shì qù guó wài dú dà xué huò yán jiū shēng xī wàng yǐ hòu kě yǐ zhǎo dào yí gè gōng zī gāo dài yù hǎo gōng zuò huán jìng shì hé de lǐ xiǎng gōng zuò kě yǐ zài guó nèi huò shì zài guó wài gōng zuò — Paragraph 2: Around 2000, with the appearance and development of the internet, China began its second study-abroad wave. These students mostly came from wealthy families. Moreover, this wave can be divided into two batches: those who went out after high school and those who went out after finishing a bachelor’s degree. They mainly went abroad to study at university or graduate school, hoping later to find an ideal job with high pay, good benefits and a suitable working environment, which they could do at home or abroad. (the book writes 2000 in digits)

examples.text: 二零零八年以后，出国留学热继续升温，成为第三波留学热。经过二十年的快速发展，中国经济又上了一个新台阶，相当数量的普通工薪家庭也越来越有钱，开始加入留学大军。除了到国外读研究生、大学以外，去读中学、甚至小学的也越来越多。很多小留学生跟寄宿家庭住在一起，有的家庭还让妈妈一起去国外陪读，就是为了能够更好地照顾孩子，因为孩子太小，语言沟通和独立生活能力都不行。
examples.translation: èr líng líng bā nián yǐ hòu chū guó liú xué rè jì xù shēng wēn chéng wéi dì sān bō liú xué rè jīng guò èr shí nián de kuài sù fā zhǎn zhōng guó jīng jì yòu shàng le yí gè xīn tái jiē xiāng dāng shù liàng de pǔ tōng gōng xīn jiā tíng yě yuè lái yuè yǒu qián kāi shǐ jiā rù liú xué dà jūn chú le dào guó wài dú yán jiū shēng dà xué yǐ wài qù dú zhōng xué shèn zhì xiǎo xué de yě yuè lái yuè duō hěn duō xiǎo liú xué shēng gēn jì sù jiā tíng zhù zài yì qǐ yǒu de jiā tíng hái ràng mā mā yì qǐ qù guó wài péi dú jiù shì wèi le néng gòu gèng hǎo de zhào gù hái zi yīn wèi hái zi tài xiǎo yǔ yán gōu tōng hé dú lì shēng huó néng lì dōu bù xíng — Paragraph 3: After 2008 the study-abroad fever kept heating up and became the third wave. After twenty years of rapid development, China’s economy had moved up to a new level, and a considerable number of ordinary salaried families also grew richer and richer and began to join the army of students abroad. Besides going abroad for graduate school and university, more and more go to middle school or even primary school. Many young students abroad live with host families, and some families even have the mother go along to accompany the child’s studies, precisely to look after the child better, because the child is too small and language communication and the ability to live independently are both inadequate. (the book writes 2008 in digits)

examples.text: 一般来说，出国留学以后，留学生们的优势很明显。首先，他们的英文越来越好。另外，留学的经历也让他们更适应跟一个集体和团队一起工作。还有，他们也能够解决很多意外出现的问题。再加上国外的学位和对国外文化的了解，回国找工作的时候，他们特别受欢迎。但是，近些年来，这些“海归”们渐渐地失去了优势，因为回国的人特别多；还有，国内的高级人才也越来越多，这些回国的留学生们有时候找不到理想的工作，甚至成了“海待”。
examples.translation: yì bān lái shuō chū guó liú xué yǐ hòu liú xué shēng men de yōu shì hěn míng xiǎn shǒu xiān tā men de yīng wén yuè lái yuè hǎo lìng wài liú xué de jīng lì yě ràng tā men gèng shì yìng gēn yí gè jí tǐ hé tuán duì yì qǐ gōng zuò hái yǒu tā men yě néng gòu jiě jué hěn duō yì wài chū xiàn de wèn tí zài jiā shàng guó wài de xué wèi hé duì guó wài wén huà de liǎo jiě huí guó zhǎo gōng zuò de shí hòu tā men tè bié shòu huān yíng dàn shì jìn xiē nián lái zhè xiē hǎi guī men jiàn jiàn de shī qù le yōu shì yīn wèi huí guó de rén tè bié duō hái yǒu guó nèi de gāo jí rén cái yě yuè lái yuè duō zhè xiē huí guó de liú xué shēng men yǒu shí hòu zhǎo bú dào lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò shèn zhì chéng le hǎi dài — Paragraph 4: Generally speaking, after studying abroad, students’ advantages are obvious. First, their English gets better and better. Also, the experience makes them better suited to working with a group and a team. Besides, they can solve many problems that arise unexpectedly. Add a foreign degree and an understanding of foreign culture, and when they come home to look for work they are especially welcome. But in recent years these “returnees” (海归) have gradually lost the advantage, because very many people are returning; also, domestic high-level talent is increasing too, and these returned students sometimes can’t find an ideal job and even become “海待” (a pun on 海归, “returnees who wait”).

exercises.prompt: How many study-abroad waves has China had since the nineties, according to the article?
exercises.explanation: 中国一共经历了三次留学热.

exercises.prompt: In the first wave, what changed compared with earlier years?
options: More students paid their own way
exercises.explanation: 自费留学的慢慢开始多起来，不像以前有很多是公费出国留学的.

exercises.prompt: Why did many first-wave students stay abroad after graduating?
options: Pay and conditions abroad were far better
exercises.explanation: 因为那时国外的待遇和条件比国内好得多.

exercises.prompt: Where did second-wave students mostly come from?
exercises.explanation: 这些留学生多来自富裕的家庭.

exercises.prompt: Into which two batches could the second wave be divided?
options: Those leaving after high school and those leaving after a bachelor’s degree
exercises.explanation: 高中毕业出去留学的和本科读完之后出去留学的.
相当数量的普通工薪家庭也越来越有钱，开始加入留学大军.

exercises.prompt: Why do some mothers go abroad with young students?
options: The children are too young for language and independent living
exercises.explanation: 孩子太小，语言沟通和独立生活能力都不行.

exercises.prompt: Which is NOT listed as a returnee’s advantage?
Why have returnees gradually lost their advantage?
options: Many are returning and domestic talent is increasing
exercises.explanation: 回国的人特别多；国内的高级人才也越来越多.

exercises.prompt: 近些年来，这些“海归”们渐渐地失去了___势。
自费留学的慢慢开始多起来，不像以前有很多是公___出国留学的。
这些回国的留学生们有时候找不到理想的工作，甚至成了“海___”。
exercises.explanation: 海待: the book’s pun on 海归.

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 8 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Read the news article about new occupations and complete the tasks. The article (four paragraphs), the book’s tasks, and my answers and key:

rows: Skim the article very quickly and determine its structure. In the diagram that follows on the next page, each paragraph is numbered, and different structures are shown (结构图 (1), (2), (3)). Select the one diagram that shows the correct order of the article, then share your answer with a classmate. (The three diagrams are not reproduced here; the layout of the numbered boxes is not clear enough in the text. My own reading of the structure: paragraph 1 introduces the new occupations in general, and paragraphs 2, 3 and 4 each describe one of them.)

Work in groups of three. Individually, working as quickly as possible, find the definitions of the terms (网约配送员, 直播销售员, 电子竞技员) from the article, then underline the sentences that contain them. Share your work with your group members and complete the table in Chinese characters.

In your group, read more information about the three occupations in the related paragraphs. Distribute the words from the list. Each student selects all the related words for one occupation. Then share your results with your team members.
In your own words, describe the occupation you read about in Step C. Add more information if you can: 这是什么职业? 哪些人做这样的职业? 这样的职业需要做什么?

examples.text: 随着中国经济和科技快速发展，大家所做的工作和从事的职业也发生了很大的变化。新的职业和工种不停地出现，在中国公布的新职业中，除了大家最熟悉的网约配送员以外，还新增了直播销售员、电子竞技员、人工智能训练师、无人机驾驶员等新职业和新工种。
examples.translation: suí zhe zhōng guó jīng jì hé kē jì kuài sù fā zhǎn dà jiā suǒ zuò de gōng zuò hé cóng shì de zhí yè yě fā shēng le hěn dà de biàn huà xīn de zhí yè hé gōng zhǒng bù tíng de chū xiàn zài zhōng guó gōng bù de xīn zhí yè zhōng chú le dà jiā zuì shú xī de wǎng yuē pèi sòng yuán yǐ wài hái xīn zēng le zhí bō xiāo shòu yuán diàn zi jìng jì yuán rén gōng zhì néng xùn liàn shī wú rén jī jià shǐ yuán děng xīn zhí yè hé xīn gōng zhǒng — Activity 8, paragraph 1 (translations mine): With the rapid development of China’s economy and technology, the work people do and the occupations they engage in have also changed greatly. New occupations and types of work keep appearing; among the new occupations announced in China, besides the online-platform delivery worker everyone knows best, live-stream seller, e-sports player, AI trainer, drone pilot and other new occupations and types of work have been added.

examples.text: 网约配送员，也就是大家最熟悉的“外卖小哥”、“快递小哥”这样的新职业。他们通过移动互联网平台，接收客户订单，然后根据订单的需要，按照平台提供的智能路线，在最短的时间内将订单物品送到指定地点或用户的手上。现在，一小时买菜、叫外卖、送快递等服务越来越普遍。
examples.translation: wǎng yuē pèi sòng yuán yě jiù shì dà jiā zuì shú xī de wài mài xiǎo gē kuài dì xiǎo gē zhè yàng de xīn zhí yè tā men tōng guò yí dòng hù lián wǎng píng tái jiē shōu kè hù dìng dān rán hòu gēn jù dìng dān de xū yào àn zhào píng tái tí gōng de zhì néng lù xiàn zài zuì duǎn de shí jiān nèi jiāng dìng dān wù pǐn sòng dào zhǐ dìng dì diǎn huò yòng hù de shǒu shàng xiàn zài yì xiǎo shí mǎi cài jiào wài mài sòng kuài dì děng fú wù yuè lái yuè pǔ biàn — Paragraph 2: The online-platform delivery worker (网约配送员) is the new occupation everyone knows best as the “takeout guy” or “courier guy.” Through the mobile-internet platform they receive customer orders and then, according to the order’s needs and following the smart route the platform provides, deliver the ordered goods in the shortest time to the designated place or into the user’s hands. Now one-hour grocery buying, takeout and express delivery services are more and more common.

examples.text: 直播销售员，就是人们熟知的“电商主播”和“带货网红”这样的职业。一支话筒、一个摄像头、一台电脑就可以打造出一种前所未有的购物体验，网红主播们正在改变大家的购物习惯。许多观众说，物美价廉是他们喜爱直播购物的最重要原因。不少主播也会在带货的同时，增加直播的娱乐和互动活动，这样他们的粉丝越来越多，流量也越来越大。
examples.translation: zhí bō xiāo shòu yuán jiù shì rén men shú zhī de diàn shāng zhǔ bō hé dài huò wǎng hóng zhè yàng de zhí yè yì zhī huà tǒng yí gè shè xiàng tóu yì tái diàn nǎo jiù kě yǐ dǎ zào chū yì zhǒng qián suǒ wèi yǒu de gòu wù tǐ yàn wǎng hóng zhǔ bō men zhèng zài gǎi biàn dà jiā de gòu wù xí guàn xǔ duō guān zhòng shuō wù měi jià lián shì tā men xǐ ài zhí bō gòu wù de zuì zhòng yào yuán yīn bù shǎo zhǔ bō yě huì zài dài huò de tóng shí zēng jiā zhí bō de yú lè hé hù dòng huó dòng zhè yàng tā men de fěn sī yuè lái yuè duō liú liàng yě yuè lái yuè dà — Paragraph 3: The live-stream seller (直播销售员) is the occupation people know as the “e-commerce host” and the “goods-selling internet celebrity.” One microphone, one camera and one computer can create a shopping experience never seen before, and influencer hosts are changing everyone’s shopping habits. Many viewers say that good quality at a low price is the most important reason they like live-stream shopping. Quite a few hosts also add entertainment and interactive activities to the live stream while selling goods, so their fans grow more and more numerous and their traffic larger and larger.

examples.text: 以前，大家对电子竞技员这类职业的看法就是：他们是对电子游戏和网络游戏入迷的人。很多人认为电竞就是打游戏，他们甚至说电竞是“电子海洛因”。所以，很多家长和老师都担心孩子和学生打游戏，更不用说让他们以后做这样的工作了。可是，现在这种职业终于有了自己正式的名字“电子竞技员”，也就是从事不同类型电子竞技项目比赛、陪练、体验及活动表演的人员。电子竞技职业已经成长为一个成熟的职业。
examples.translation: yǐ qián dà jiā duì diàn zi jìng jì yuán zhè lèi zhí yè de kàn fǎ jiù shì tā men shì duì diàn zǐ yóu xì hé wǎng luò yóu xì rù mí de rén hěn duō rén rèn wéi diàn jìng jiù shì dǎ yóu xì tā men shèn zhì shuō diàn jìng shì diàn zi hǎi luò yīn suǒ yǐ hěn duō jiā zhǎng hé lǎo shī dōu dān xīn hái zi hé xué shēng dǎ yóu xì gèng bú yòng shuō ràng tā men yǐ hòu zuò zhè yàng de gōng zuò le kě shì xiàn zài zhè zhǒng zhí yè zhōng yú yǒu le zì jǐ zhèng shì de míng zì diàn zi jìng jì yuán yě jiù shì cóng shì bù tóng lèi xíng diàn zi jìng jì xiàng mù bǐ sài péi liàn tǐ yàn jí huó dòng biǎo yǎn de rén yuán diàn zi jìng jì zhí yè yǐ jīng chéng zhǎng wèi yí gè chéng shú de zhí yè — Paragraph 4: Before, people’s view of occupations like the e-sports player was that they were people addicted to video games and online games. Many people thought e-sports was just playing games and even called e-sports “electronic heroin.” So many parents and teachers worried about children and students playing games, let alone letting them do such work later. But now this occupation has finally got its own formal name, “e-sports player” (电子竞技员), meaning personnel engaged in competition, practice-partnering, experience-testing and activity performances in different types of e-sports events. The e-sports profession has grown into a mature profession.
