lessons.title: 793. Lesson 30 Skill Integration Review: China’s post-90s generation
lessons.subtitle: 九零后 · 独生子女 · 离职率 · 注重 · 前途 · 创业 · 创始人 · 朝九晚五 · 辞职 · 自媒体 · 粉丝 · 自我价值

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Read the news report about China’s post-90s generation and complete the tasks. The report (four paragraphs), the book’s tasks and my answers:

rows: Work in groups of three. Each student reads one of the first three paragraphs. Find and underline the topic sentence in your paragraph. Then summarize the paragraph in the space provided (Student 1 第一段 / Student 2 第二段 / Student 3 第三段).
Exchange your information with your group members when you are done.
Read paragraph four together and discuss the relationship between it and the previous three paragraphs.
In your group, discuss the characteristics of the Millennial generation in the U.S. (Characteristics of Millennials 美国千禧一代的特点: a blank box.)
Compare the differences and similarities between the Chinese generations born from 1990 to 2000 and the U.S. Millennial generation. (中国90后 vs 美国千禧一代: a table with 相同点 and 不同点, both blank.)
tables.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): the tasks

rows: 中国的九零后大多是独生子女，很少有兄弟姐妹，他们得到了更多的关心和照顾。
九零后多是独生子女，家庭舍得花钱，学习条件好，所以外语、文化和教育程度更高。
跟“七零后”“八零后”相比，九零后在工作以后，他们的离职率明显比较高。
九零后更注重理想的、有前途的工作，工作不合适就马上换。
进入职场后的九零后们，他们常常有着更高的目标和梦想。
很多九零后选择创业，像马欢那样离开朝九晚五的生活，在创业中实现自我价值。
总结前三段：九零后爱思考、有想法、独立、能力强，是有前途的一代人。
tables.title: Activity 9A and 9C: topic sentences, summaries and the role of paragraph four (my answers; the book gives none)

examples.text: 中国的九零后大多是独生子女，很少有兄弟姐妹，他们得到了更多的关心和照顾。从小他们的生活环境和学习条件就不一样，除了有更好的学校教育以外，每个家庭也都舍得把钱花在孩子身上，让他们从小就学外语和各种技能。再加上互联网和个人电脑的普及，他们还可以在网上找到很多的学习材料。所以，很多人的外语能力很强，文化和教育程度也更高。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de jiǔ líng hòu dà duō shì dú shēng zǐ nǚ hěn shǎo yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi tā men dé dào le gèng duō de guān xīn hé zhào gù cóng xiǎo tā men de shēng huó huán jìng hé xué xí tiáo jiàn jiù bù yí yàng chú le yǒu gèng hǎo de xué xiào jiào yù yǐ wài měi gè jiā tíng yě dōu shě de bǎ qián huā zài hái zi shēn shàng ràng tā men cóng xiǎo jiù xué wài yǔ hé gè zhǒng jì néng zài jiā shàng hù lián wǎng hé gè rén diàn nǎo de pǔ jí tā men hái kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng zhǎo dào hěn duō de xué xí cái liào suǒ yǐ hěn duō rén de wài yǔ néng lì hěn qiáng wén huà hé jiào yù chéng dù yě gèng gāo — Activity 9, paragraph 1 (translations mine): Most of China’s post-90s are only children with few brothers or sisters, and they received more care and attention. From childhood their living environment and study conditions were different: besides better school education, every family was willing to spend money on its child and let them learn foreign languages and various skills from an early age. Add the spread of the internet and personal computers, and they can also find a lot of study material online. So many have strong foreign-language ability and a higher level of culture and education. (the book writes 90 in digits)

examples.text: 跟“七零后”“八零后”相比，九零后在工作以后，他们的离职率明显比较高。要是工作不合适，他们马上就会换工作。对于九零后，稳定的工作不再能够满足他们，他们更注重理想的工作，有前途的工作。找工作时，他们最看重的是工作要能够实现个人的理想。还有的认为，工作必须适合自己的兴趣，做人开心最重要。
examples.translation: gēn qī líng hòu bā líng hòu xiāng bǐ jiǔ líng hòu zài gōng zuò yǐ hòu tā men de lí zhí lǜ míng xiǎn bǐ jiào gāo yào shì gōng zuò bù hé shì tā men mǎ shàng jiù huì huàn gōng zuò duì yú jiǔ líng hòu wěn dìng de gōng zuò bú zài néng gòu mǎn zú tā men tā men gèng zhù zhòng lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò yǒu qián tú de gōng zuò zhǎo gōng zuò shí tā men zuì kàn zhòng de shì gōng zuò yào néng gòu shí xiàn gè rén de lǐ xiǎng hái yǒu de rèn wéi gōng zuò bì xū shì hé zì jǐ de xìng qù zuò rén kāi xīn zuì zhòng yào — Paragraph 2: Compared with the “post-70s” and “post-80s,” the post-90s clearly have a higher turnover rate once they start working. If a job isn’t suitable, they will change jobs right away. For the post-90s, a stable job can no longer satisfy them; they value an ideal job, a job with prospects. When looking for work, what they care about most is that the job can realize their personal ideals. Some also think that a job must suit one’s interests and that being happy is what matters most. (the book writes 70, 80 and 90 in digits)

examples.text: 进入职场后的九零后们，他们常常有着更高的目标和梦想。很多九零后选择了创业这条路，他们创办公司，自己当老板。马欢是一家自媒体创业公司的创始人。大学毕业之后，他进入一家单位开始朝九晚五的生活。但是，日复一日的工作和无趣的生活让他选择了辞职，开始互联网创业。经过几年的努力和管理，他的自媒体公司吸引了众多的读者，粉丝超过了二十五万，文章的阅读量也在快速增长，他也开始变得小有名气。马欢在创业中感受到快乐，实现了自我的价值。
examples.translation: jìn rù zhí chǎng hòu de jiǔ líng hòu men tā men cháng cháng yǒu zhe gèng gāo de mù biāo hé mèng xiǎng hěn duō jiǔ líng hòu xuǎn zé le chuàng yè zhè tiáo lù tā men chuàng bàn gōng sī zì jǐ dāng lǎo bǎn mǎ huān shì yì jiā zì méi tǐ chuàng yè gōng sī de chuàng shǐ rén dà xué bì yè zhī hòu tā jìn rù yì jiā dān wèi kāi shǐ zhāo jiǔ wǎn wǔ de shēng huó dàn shì rì fù yí rì de gōng zuò hé wú qù de shēng huó ràng tā xuǎn zé le cí zhí kāi shǐ hù lián wǎng chuàng yè jīng guò jǐ nián de nǔ lì hé guǎn lǐ tā de zì méi tǐ gōng sī xī yǐn le zhòng duō de dú zhě fěn sī chāo guò le èr shí wǔ wàn wén zhāng de yuè dú liàng yě zài kuài sù zēng zhǎng tā yě kāi shǐ biàn de xiǎo yǒu míng qì mǎ huān zài chuàng yè zhōng gǎn shòu dào kuài lè shí xiàn le zì wǒ de jià zhí — Paragraph 3: The post-90s who have entered the workplace often have higher goals and dreams. Many post-90s chose the road of starting a business: they set up companies and become their own bosses. Ma Huan is the founder of a self-media startup. After graduating from university he joined an organization and began a nine-to-five life. But the day-after-day work and dull life made him choose to resign and start an internet business. After several years of effort and management, his self-media company attracted a great many readers, his fans exceeded 250,000, the reading volume of his articles is growing fast, and he is beginning to become somewhat well known. In starting a business Ma Huan has felt joy and realized his self-worth. (the book prints 常常有着有更高的目标, with a doubled 有; read here as 有着更高的目标. The book writes 90 and 25 万 in digits.)

examples.text: 中国的九零后，爱思考、想法独特，思想独立，个人能力也很强，他们正成为有前途的一代人。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de jiǔ líng hòu ài sī kǎo xiǎng fǎ dú tè sī xiǎng dú lì gè rén néng lì yě hěn qiáng tā men zhèng chéng wéi yǒu qián tú de yí dài rén — Paragraph 4: China’s post-90s love to think, have unique ideas and independent thought, and have strong personal ability; they are becoming a generation with a future.

exercises.prompt: Why did most post-90s receive more care and attention?
exercises.explanation: 大多是独生子女，很少有兄弟姐妹，他们得到了更多的关心和照顾.

exercises.prompt: What are families willing to spend money on, per paragraph 1?
options: Their child’s learning of foreign languages and skills
exercises.explanation: 舍得把钱花在孩子身上，让他们从小就学外语和各种技能.

exercises.prompt: How does the post-90s turnover rate compare with the post-70s and post-80s?
What do the post-90s care about most when job hunting?
exercises.explanation: 最看重的是工作要能够实现个人的理想.
马欢是一家自媒体创业公司的创始人.

options: The day-after-day work and dull life
exercises.explanation: 日复一日的工作和无趣的生活让他选择了辞职.

exercises.prompt: How many fans does his company have?
What role does paragraph four play?
options: It sums up the first three paragraphs as a conclusion
exercises.explanation: 他们正成为有前途的一代人.

exercises.prompt: 中国的九零后大多是独___子女。
他进入一家单位开始朝九晚___的生活。
exercises.explanation: 朝九晚五: nine to five.

exercises.prompt: 日复一日的工作和无趣的生活让他选择了辞___。
他们更注重理想的工作，有前___的工作。

lessons.title: 794. Lesson 30 Skill Integration Review: education in Chinese families
lessons.subtitle: 重视教育 · 孔子 · 孟母三迁 · 学区房 · 私立学校 · 双语学校 · 早教班 · 兴趣班 · 补习班 · 虎妈 · 狼爸 · 严厉

explanations.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 10 (Reading, Writing, Speaking, and Listening)
explanations.body: Read the article from an educational magazine and complete the tasks. The article (four paragraphs), the book’s tasks and my answers:

rows: Read the article and highlight the topic sentence of each paragraph. If you cannot find the topic sentence, use your own words to summarize the paragraph in one Chinese sentence. (Four numbered blank lines.)
After you finish, pair up and share your topic sentences with a partner.

Each student reads two paragraphs and writes the answers for the following questions. Student 1 (Paragraphs 1 and 2): 1. 为什么每个中国家庭想送自己的孩子上更好的学校，接受更好的教育? 2. 什么是“孟母三迁”的故事? 3. 现代中国家庭为了孩子的教育常常做什么? Student 2 (Paragraphs 3 and 4): 1. 中国的父母怎么培养孩子的学习和各方面的能力? 2. 什么是“虎妈”和“狼爸”? 3. 中国的家长给孩子太多的压力造成什么样的后果?
Share your answers with your partner and find out the answers to your partner’s questions.

Individually, write a short paragraph that describes how your parents taught you, their educational styles and methods, etc. Write five to eight sentences to complete this task. (The title line is 父母对我的教育.)
Work in groups of three and share your stories.
tables.title: Skill Integration Review, Activity 10 (Reading, Writing, Speaking, and Listening): the tasks

rows: 1. 中国人自古以来就非常重视教育。 2. 在现代的中国，为了让孩子受到好的教育，这样的家庭到处都是。 3. 家长们也特别关注孩子学习和各方面能力的培养。 4. 有的家长特别希望孩子以后可以成功，所以给了孩子很多的压力。
因为中国人重视教育，相信教育可以改变一个人的前途。
孟子小时候，他的母亲为了让他有好的老师、邻居和同学，三次搬家。
买学区房，把孩子送到私立学校或双语学校，更有钱的家庭送孩子出国留学。
上学前送孩子去早教班；上学后报各种兴趣班、补习班，例如外语、音乐、舞蹈、美术和竞赛班。
教育孩子的方式特别严厉的家长。
孩子觉得父母不尊重他们的学习自由，慢慢失去学习的兴趣，和父母的关系越来越紧张。
tables.title: Activity 10: my answers

examples.text: 中国人自古以来就非常重视教育，可以说这是中国人的一个好传统。教育家孔子在两千多年前就开始设立自己的学堂，学生们跟着孔子不但学习中国文化知识，还学习孔子的思想，孔子希望通过教育让国家更强大。同时，中国的家庭也相信教育可以改变一个人的前途。因此，每一个中国家庭，只要有一点能力，都会想尽一切办法来让自己的孩子能够上更好的学校，接受更好的教育。
examples.translation: zhōng guó rén zì gǔ yǐ lái jiù fēi cháng zhòng shì jiào yù kě yǐ shuō zhè shì zhōng guó rén de yí gè hǎo chuán tǒng jiào yù jiā kǒng zi zài liǎng qiān duō nián qián jiù kāi shǐ shè lì zì jǐ de xué táng xué shēng men gēn zhe kǒng zi bú dàn xué xí zhōng guó wén huà zhī shí hái xué xí kǒng zi de sī xiǎng kǒng zi xī wàng tōng guò jiào yù ràng guó jiā gèng qiáng dà tóng shí zhōng guó de jiā tíng yě xiāng xìn jiào yù kě yǐ gǎi biàn yí gè rén de qián tú yīn cǐ měi yí gè zhōng guó jiā tíng zhǐ yào yǒu yì diǎn néng lì dōu huì xiǎng jǐn yí qiè bàn fǎ lái ràng zì jǐ de hái zi néng gòu shàng gèng hǎo de xué xiào jiē shòu gèng hǎo de jiào yù — Activity 10, paragraph 1 (translations mine): Chinese people have valued education very much since ancient times, and one can say this is a good tradition of the Chinese. The educator Confucius began setting up his own school more than two thousand years ago; students who followed Confucius studied not only Chinese cultural knowledge but also Confucius’ thought, and Confucius hoped to make the country stronger through education. At the same time, Chinese families also believe education can change a person’s future. Therefore every Chinese family, as long as it has a little ability, will think of every way to let its children go to a better school and receive a better education.

examples.text: 中国古代“孟母三迁”的故事，说的就是伟大的思想家孟子小时候，他的母亲三次搬家，为的是让他有好的老师、好的邻居、好的同学，以便受到好的教育。而在现代的中国，这样的家庭到处都是。很多的家庭都会花高价买学区房，好让自己的孩子可以上更好的学校。还有的家庭把孩子送到私立学校或双语学校，让孩子可以学习更加国际化的课程。更有钱的家庭就直接把孩子送到国外去留学，希望他们的孩子以后可以有更大的优势。
examples.translation: zhōng guó gǔ dài mèng mǔ sān qiān de gù shì shuō de jiù shì wěi dà de sī xiǎng jiā mèng zi xiǎo shí hòu tā de mǔ qīn sān cì bān jiā wèi de shì ràng tā yǒu hǎo de lǎo shī hǎo de lín jū hǎo de tóng xué yǐ biàn shòu dào hǎo de jiào yù ér zài xiàn dài de zhōng guó zhè yàng de jiā tíng dào chù dōu shì hěn duō de jiā tíng dōu huì huā gāo jià mǎi xué qū fáng hǎo ràng zì jǐ de hái zi kě yǐ shàng gèng hǎo de xué xiào hái yǒu de jiā tíng bǎ hái zi sòng dào sī lì xué xiào huò shuāng yǔ xué xiào ràng hái zi kě yǐ xué xí gèng jiā guó jì huà de kè chéng gèng yǒu qián de jiā tíng jiù zhí jiē bǎ hái zi sòng dào guó wài qù liú xué xī wàng tā men de hái zi yǐ hòu kě yǐ yǒu gèng dà de yōu shì — Paragraph 2: The ancient Chinese story of “Mencius’ mother moved three times” tells how, when the great thinker Mencius was small, his mother moved house three times so that he would have good teachers, good neighbors and good classmates and thereby receive a good education. In modern China such families are everywhere. Many families will pay a high price for a house in a good school district so that their children can go to a better school. Some families send their children to private or bilingual schools so they can study more internationalized courses. Richer families directly send their children abroad to study, hoping their children will have a bigger advantage later.

examples.text: 除了注意孩子的学习环境以外，家长们也特别关注孩子学习和各方面能力的培养。上学以前，孩子们会被送到早教班，学习各种智力开发的课程和游戏。上学以后，家长们给孩子们报名参加各种兴趣班、补习班。外语是家长们最喜欢给孩子们选的课程。另外，还有各种音乐课程，舞蹈课，美术课。高年级的还会参加各种数学、化学、物理等竞赛班的学习。
examples.translation: chú le zhù yì hái zi de xué xí huán jìng yǐ wài jiā zhǎng men yě tè bié guān zhù hái zi xué xí hé gè fāng miàn néng lì de péi yǎng shàng xué yǐ qián hái zi men huì bèi sòng dào zǎo jiào bān xué xí gè zhǒng zhì lì kāi fā de kè chéng hé yóu xì shàng xué yǐ hòu jiā zhǎng men gěi hái zi men bào míng cān jiā gè zhǒng xìng qù bān bǔ xí bān wài yǔ shì jiā zhǎng men zuì xǐ huān gěi hái zi men xuǎn de kè chéng lìng wài hái yǒu gè zhǒng yīn yuè kè chéng wǔ dǎo kè měi shù kè gāo nián jí de hái huì cān jiā gè zhǒng shù xué huà xué wù lǐ děng jìng sài bān de xué xí — Paragraph 3: Besides paying attention to the children’s learning environment, parents also especially care about the cultivation of their children’s learning and abilities in all respects. Before school, children are sent to early-education classes to study courses and games that develop intelligence. After they start school, parents sign their children up for all kinds of interest classes and tutoring classes. Foreign languages are the course parents like best to choose for their children. There are also music courses, dance classes and art classes. Older students also join mathematics, chemistry, physics and other competition classes.

examples.text: 有的家长特别希望孩子以后可以成功，所以给了孩子很多的压力。有些人还被戏称为“虎妈”和“狼爸”，就是因为他们教育孩子的方式特别严厉。但是这样做的效果并不好，有时候让孩子觉得父母不尊重他们的学习自由，慢慢地失去了学习的兴趣，和父母的关系也变得越来越紧张。
examples.translation: yǒu de jiā zhǎng tè bié xī wàng hái zi yǐ hòu kě yǐ chéng gōng suǒ yǐ gěi le hái zi hěn duō de yā lì yǒu xiē rén hái bèi xì chēng wéi hǔ mā hé láng bà jiù shì yīn wèi tā men jiào yù hái zi de fāng shì tè bié yán lì dàn shì zhè yàng zuò de xiào guǒ bìng bù hǎo yǒu shí hòu ràng hái zi jué de fù mǔ bù zūn zhòng tā men de xué xí zì yóu màn màn de shī qù le xué xí de xìng qù hé fù mǔ de guān xì yě biàn de yuè lái yuè jǐn zhāng — Paragraph 4: Some parents especially hope their children will succeed later, and so they put a lot of pressure on them. Some are even jokingly called “tiger moms” and “wolf dads” precisely because their way of educating children is especially strict. But this approach does not work well; sometimes it makes children feel their parents do not respect their freedom to study, so they slowly lose interest in learning and their relationship with their parents grows more and more tense.

exercises.prompt: Who began setting up his own school more than two thousand years ago?
exercises.explanation: 教育家孔子在两千多年前就开始设立自己的学堂.

exercises.prompt: What did Confucius hope to achieve through education?
exercises.explanation: 孔子希望通过教育让国家更强大.

exercises.prompt: Why did Mencius’ mother move house three times?
options: So he would have good teachers, neighbors and classmates
exercises.explanation: 为的是让他有好的老师、好的邻居、好的同学.

exercises.prompt: What do many modern families pay a high price for?
options: A house in a good school district
exercises.explanation: 很多的家庭都会花高价买学区房.

exercises.prompt: Where are children sent before they start school?
exercises.explanation: 上学以前，孩子们会被送到早教班.

exercises.prompt: Which course do parents most like to choose for their children?
exercises.explanation: 外语是家长们最喜欢给孩子们选的课程.

exercises.prompt: Who are called “tiger moms” and “wolf dads”?
options: Parents who educate their children in an especially strict way
exercises.explanation: 他们教育孩子的方式特别严厉.

exercises.prompt: What can too much pressure lead to?
options: Children lose interest in learning and relations grow tense
exercises.explanation: 慢慢地失去了学习的兴趣，和父母的关系也变得越来越紧张.

exercises.prompt: 中国人自古以来就非常重视___育。
上学以前，孩子们会被送到早___班。
有些人还被戏称为“虎妈”和“狼___”。
他们教育孩子的方式特别严___。

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A scenario about Professor Liu’s family trip to the U.S. The book prints only the scenario, the tasks and the group grid; the email itself is audio and is not included, and the answers are left blank.

rows: Scenario: You have received an email from Professor Liu, the teacher who taught you Chinese when you studied in Beijing last year. Her family is coming to the U.S. for vacation next month. This is their first trip to the U.S. and they need your recommendations for food delivery, accommodations, and transportation.
Listen to the email from Professor Liu and note the information (TO, CC, Subject). The email is audio and is not printed in the book, so it is not included here.
Pair up. Discuss the email from Professor Liu, and identify what help she needs for her family vacation in the U.S.
In three groups, discuss how to respond to Professor Liu’s questions, and write your responses in the table (see below).
Each group presents their discussion. After the presentations, consolidate your information and write a response to Professor Liu (TO, Subject: 写给刘老师的电子邮件).
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 1: Professor Liu’s email
Activity 1C: the response grid (the book leaves the last three columns blank for you to fill in)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A scenario at a homestay service center. The letter from the host family, the issues it raises and my suggestions:

rows: Scenario: You are working in a homestay service center as a volunteer. Your service center has received a letter from a host family asking for suggestions on how to get along with a Chinese student they have recently accepted. Your supervisor tasks you to provide suggestions for the host family.
Pair up, read the letter from the host family, and write down the issues described in the letter.
In two groups, discuss the issues and provide at least three suggestions for improving the relationship between the host family and Zhang Xue (你们的建议: 第一组, 第二组).
Each group takes turns presenting their suggestions to the class. Select the best suggestions for the host family and submit them to the supervisor for review.
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 2: the host-family letter

headers: Issues in the letter (my notes; the book leaves the line blank)
rows: Her spoken English is not very good, so she doesn’t want to talk with the family much and doesn’t chat after dinner
She eats very little and seems not to like American food
She declines TV time and hiking, saying she is busy studying
At weekend parties she looks unhappy and rarely speaks with the family’s friends
tables.title: Activity 2A: the issues

headers: Suggestions (mine; the book leaves the table blank)
rows: 多鼓励她说英文，别笑她的口语；每天找一个固定的时间和她聊聊天；问问她中国的生活和学习。
问问她喜欢吃什么，偶尔做一顿中餐，或者一起去中餐馆；请她参加活动，但不要勉强；聚会前先告诉她，让她可以带朋友参加。
tables.title: Activity 2B: suggestions for the host family

examples.text: 一个月前，我们从寄宿家庭服务中心接收了一名来自中国的留学生。她叫张雪，现在上高中一年级，学习成绩很好，特别是数学成绩，在全班第一名，人也非常有礼貌，我们都很喜欢她。不过，因为她的英文口语不太好，她不太愿意和我们多交流。每天晚上吃完晚饭，她就回到自己的房间看书学习，不跟我们聊天。她平时吃饭吃得很少，好像不太喜欢美国饭。有时候，我们叫她和我们在一起看电视，或是一起出去爬山，她说她很忙，需要看书，写作业。周末的时候，我们经常请一些朋友在家里聚会，她看起来不太高兴，很少和我的朋友说话。我知道中国的学生认为学习最重要，因为他们的父母希望他们考上一个好大学，可是我觉得他们来到美国，不仅要好好学习，也要有一些社交活动，多了解美国人的生活和文化，这对他们的学习也会有帮助。我想请你们给我一些建议，怎么才能让张雪很快乐地跟我们生活在一起。
examples.translation: yí gè yuè qián wǒ men cóng jì sù jiā tíng fú wù zhōng xīn jiē shōu le yì míng lái zì zhōng guó de liú xué shēng tā jiào zhāng xuě xiàn zài shàng gāo zhōng yì nián jí xué xí chéng jì hěn hǎo tè bié shì shù xué chéng jì zài quán bān dì yī míng rén yě fēi cháng yǒu lǐ mào wǒ men dōu hěn xǐ huān tā bú guò yīn wèi tā de yīng wén kǒu yǔ bú tài hǎo tā bú tài yuàn yì hé wǒ men duō jiāo liú měi tiān wǎn shàng chī wán wǎn fàn tā jiù huí dào zì jǐ de fáng jiān kàn shū xué xí bù gēn wǒ men liáo tiān tā píng shí chī fàn chī de hěn shǎo hǎo xiàng bú tài xǐ huān měi guó fàn yǒu shí hòu wǒ men jiào tā hé wǒ men zài yì qǐ kàn diàn shì huò shì yì qǐ chū qù pá shān tā shuō tā hěn máng xū yào kàn shū xiě zuò yè zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ men jīng cháng qǐng yì xiē péng yǒu zài jiā lǐ jù huì tā kàn qǐ lái bú tài gāo xìng hěn shǎo hé wǒ de péng yǒu shuō huà wǒ zhī dào zhōng guó de xué shēng rèn wéi xué xí zuì zhòng yào yīn wèi tā men de fù mǔ xī wàng tā men kǎo shàng yí gè hǎo dà xué kě shì wǒ jué de tā men lái dào měi guó bù jǐn yào hǎo hào xué xí yě yào yǒu yì xiē shè jiāo huó dòng duō liǎo jiě měi guó rén de shēng huó hé wén huà zhè duì tā men de xué xí yě huì yǒu bāng zhù wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ men gěi wǒ yì xiē jiàn yì zěn me cái néng ràng zhāng xuě hěn kuài lè de gēn wǒ men shēng huó zài yì qǐ — Activity 2A, the host family’s letter (translations mine): A month ago we received from the host-family service center an international student from China. Her name is Zhang Xue; she is now in the first year of high school and her grades are very good, especially in math, where she is first in the whole class; she is also very polite, and we all like her very much. But because her spoken English is not very good, she is not very willing to talk with us much. Every evening after dinner she goes back to her own room to read and study and doesn’t chat with us. She usually eats very little and seems not to like American food very much. Sometimes we ask her to watch TV with us or go out hiking together, and she says she is very busy and needs to read and do homework. On weekends we often invite some friends over for a party at home; she looks not very happy and rarely speaks with my friends. I know that Chinese students think study is most important, because their parents hope they will get into a good university, but I feel that when they come to America they should not only study hard but also have some social activities and learn more about Americans’ life and culture, which will also help their studies. We would like to ask you for some suggestions on how to make Zhang Xue live with us happily.

You’ve been requested to give a presentation on emerging careers in China to the classmates who have never been to China. Your presentation will help them better understand career opportunities in China and their impact on people’s lives.
In three groups, discuss these three emerging careers in China, and their impact on people’s lives and society. You can use the information that follows for reference.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 4 (Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A scenario about interviewing the post-90s entrepreneur Wen Chenghui. The recording’s script and my sample interview questions:

rows: Scenario: You are studying Chinese in Beijing University. The Student Union has invited Wen Chenghui, a post-90s entrepreneur and the founder of “Liwushuo,” to talk to the students in Beijing University. Your teacher asks you and your classmates to come up with some questions that you will use to interview Wen Chenghui after his talk.
Listen to the recording and write the essential information you hear.
Pair up and summarize the details of the recording with your partner. Read the script, if necessary.
With your partner, create at least five interview questions that focus on Wen Chenghui’s entrepreneurial story (six numbered lines).
After creating the interview questions, your partner plays the role of Wen Chenghui. Interview your partner with the questions you created (six numbered answer lines).
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 4: Wen Chenghui

headers: Interview questions (my samples; the book leaves the lines blank, and the answers are for your partner to give)
rows: 1. 你为什么十六岁就开始创业？
He began at 16 while still in high school
2. 你在学校里卖的杂志是怎么做出来的？赚了多少钱？
The magazine he made and sold at school earned several thousand yuan
3. 你和朋友的工作室为什么卖手画的明信片？
4. “礼物说”这个手机软件是怎么做出来的？
5. 这个软件为什么这么成功？
More than two million downloads in under four months
6. 你为什么说九零后创业最大的优势是“最懂用户”？
His own explanation of the post-90s advantage
tables.title: Activity 4C: sample interview questions (mine)

examples.text: 这个身材很瘦，戴着眼镜，说起话来像个大男孩的温城辉，很难让人想到他就是“礼物说”的创始人。温城辉十六岁就开始创业，那时候他还在读高中，他自己做了一本杂志在学校里卖，结果赚了好几千块钱。读大一时，他和朋友成立了一个工作室，卖手画的明信片，一共卖出一百万张，赚了十多万。后来，他的公司做出一个叫“礼物说”的手机软件，用户下载软件后就可以买到自己喜欢的礼物。这个软件非常成功，不到四个月，就有两百多万人下载，卖出去的礼物有一千万元。当大家问温城辉为什么会这么成功，他说九零后创业最大的优势是“最懂用户”。
examples.translation: zhè ge shēn cái hěn shòu dài zhe yǎn jìng shuō qǐ huà lái xiàng gè dà nán hái de wēn chéng huī hěn nán ràng rén xiǎng dào tā jiù shì lǐ wù shuō de chuàng shǐ rén wēn chéng huī shí liù suì jiù kāi shǐ chuàng yè nà shí hòu tā hái zài dú gāo zhōng tā zì jǐ zuò le yì běn zá zhì zài xué xiào lǐ mài jié guǒ zhuàn le hǎo jǐ qiān kuài qián dú dà yì shí tā hé péng yǒu chéng lì le yí gè gōng zuò shì mài shǒu huà de míng xìn piàn yí gòng mài chū yì bǎi wàn zhāng zhuàn le shí duō wàn hòu lái tā de gōng sī zuò chū yí gè jiào lǐ wù shuō de shǒu jī ruǎn jiàn yòng hù xià zài ruǎn jiàn hòu jiù kě yǐ mǎi dào zì jǐ xǐ huān de lǐ wù zhè ge ruǎn jiàn fēi cháng chéng gōng bú dào sì gè yuè jiù yǒu liǎng bǎi duō wàn rén xià zài mài chū qù de lǐ wù yǒu yì qiān wàn yuán dāng dà jiā wèn wēn chéng huī wèi shén me huì zhè me chéng gōng tā shuō jiǔ líng hòu chuàng yè zuì dà de yōu shì shì zuì dǒng yòng hù — Activity 4, the script “The hottest post-90s entrepreneur” (最火的九零后创业者; translations mine): Thin, wearing glasses, and speaking like a big boy, Wen Chenghui makes it hard for people to think he is the founder of “Liwushuo” (礼物说). Wen Chenghui began his business at 16, when he was still in high school: he made a magazine himself and sold it at school, and as a result earned several thousand yuan. In his first year of university he and friends set up a studio selling hand-drawn postcards, selling one million in all and earning over 100,000 yuan. Later his company produced a mobile app called “Liwushuo”; after downloading it users can buy gifts they like. The app was very successful: in under four months more than two million people downloaded it, and the gifts sold were worth ten million yuan. When people asked Wen Chenghui why he could be so successful, he said the post-90s entrepreneurs’ biggest advantage is “understanding users best.” (the book writes 90, 16, 100 万, 10 多万, 200 多万 and 1000 万 in digits)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A scenario about a presentation at a Youth Center. The two groups’ questions:

rows: Scenario: You are working in a Youth Center as a volunteer. Since you have learned Chinese for a year and have visited China before, you are asked to give a presentation to the students of Chinese in the Youth Center on after-school programs, left-behind children, and migrant children in China. Your presentation will help them better understand youth education and social issues in China.
In two groups, Group A discusses after-school programs and Group B discusses left-behind and migrant children in China. You may use the information below for reference.
Create a PowerPoint presentation to illustrate your discussion points.
Each group takes turns presenting their discussion points to the class, followed by questions and answers.
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Review, Activity 5: the Youth Center

examples.text: 甲组 补习班和兴趣班
examples.translation: jiǎ zǔ bǔ xí bān hé xìng qù bān — Group A (甲组, printed A组), tutoring classes and interest classes (translations mine).

examples.text: 中国的家长为什么让孩子去参加补习班或是兴趣班？
examples.translation: zhōng guó de jiā zhǎng wèi shén me ràng hái zi qù cān jiā bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān — 1. Why do Chinese parents let their children attend tutoring or interest classes?

examples.text: 孩子在补习班或是兴趣班学什么？
examples.translation: hái zi zài bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān xué shén me — 2. What do children learn in tutoring or interest classes?

examples.text: 这些补习班或是兴趣班多少钱？
examples.translation: zhè xiē bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān duō shǎo qián — 3. How much do these tutoring or interest classes cost?

examples.text: 孩子每周去几次补习班或是兴趣班？
examples.translation: hái zi měi zhōu qù jǐ cì bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān — 4. How many times a week do children go to tutoring or interest classes?

examples.text: 他们喜欢去这些补习班或是兴趣班吗？
examples.translation: tā men xǐ huān qù zhè xiē bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān ma — 5. Do they like going to these classes?

examples.text: 这些补习班或是兴趣班对孩子有什么影响？
examples.translation: zhè xiē bǔ xí bān huò shì xìng qù bān duì hái zi yǒu shén me yǐng xiǎng — 6. What influence do these classes have on children?

examples.text: 乙组 留守儿童和流动儿童
examples.translation: yǐ zǔ liú shǒu ér tóng hé liú dòng ér tóng — Group B (乙组, printed B组), left-behind children and migrant children.

examples.text: 什么是留守儿童？
examples.translation: shén me shì liú shǒu ér tóng — 1. What are left-behind children?

examples.text: 他们多长时间才能见到父母？
examples.translation: tā men duō cháng shí jiān cái néng jiàn dào fù mǔ — 2. How long does it take before they can see their parents?

examples.text: 他们平时的生活怎么样？
examples.translation: tā men píng shí de shēng huó zěn me yàng — 3. What is their everyday life like?

examples.text: 什么是流动儿童？
examples.translation: shén me shì liú dòng ér tóng — 4. What are migrant children?

examples.text: 他们为什么不可以上学？
examples.translation: tā men wèi shén me bù kě yǐ shàng xué — 5. Why can’t they go to school? (as printed)

examples.text: 你觉得政府应该怎么解决流动儿童上学的问题？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de zhèng fǔ yīng gāi zěn me jiě jué liú dòng ér tóng shàng xué de wèn tí — 6. How do you think the government should solve the problem of migrant children attending school?
